+// PortablePathLimits bounds the encoded path, each encoded component, and path
+// depth. Zero means unbounded for that field; negative values are invalid.
+// File-count and byte-size ceilings live in safefile because they describe a
+// collection of files rather than a path.
+type PortablePathLimits struct {
+	MaxPathBytes      int
+	MaxComponentBytes int
+	MaxDepth          int
+}
+
+// ValidatePortableSlashPath accepts only a non-empty, clean, slash-separated
+// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects
+// Git metadata aliases, platform-specific separators and volumes, Windows
+// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
+// invalid UTF-8.
+func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
+	if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if value == "" {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path is empty: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains a backslash path separator: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" || driveQualified(value) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path %q is absolute, drive-qualified, or UNC: %w", value, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if limits.MaxPathBytes > 0 && len(value) > limits.MaxPathBytes {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(value), limits.MaxPathBytes, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	components := strings.Split(value, "/")
+	if limits.MaxDepth > 0 && len(components) > limits.MaxDepth {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path has %d components; maximum is %d: %w", len(components), limits.MaxDepth, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	for _, component := range components {
+		if component == ".." {
+			return fmt.Errorf("path contains parent traversal: %w", ErrTraversal)
+		}
+		if err := ValidatePortableComponent(component, limits.MaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q: %w", component, err)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ValidatePortableComponent applies the per-component part of
+// ValidatePortableSlashPath. maxBytes may be zero for no size limit.
+func ValidatePortableComponent(component string, maxBytes int) error {
+	if maxBytes < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("negative component limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if !utf8.ValidString(component) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("component contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", err, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if maxBytes > 0 && len(component) > maxBytes {
+		return fmt.Errorf("component is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(component), maxBytes, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if strings.IndexFunc(component, isPortableControl) >= 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component contains control characters: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	windowsAlias := strings.TrimRight(component, ". ")
+	if strings.EqualFold(windowsAlias, ".git") {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains reserved Git metadata: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if windowsAlias != component {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q has a trailing dot or space and is not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q contains characters that are not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if windowsReservedName(component) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q is a reserved Windows device name: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ValidatePortablePathSet validates every path and rejects collisions at any
+// component boundary after Unicode normalization and full Unicode case folding.
+// Exact duplicate paths are left to the caller's type/cardinality policy.
+func ValidatePortablePathSet(paths []string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
+	type collisionNode struct {
+		spelling string
+		first    string
+		children map[string]*collisionNode
+	}
+	root := &collisionNode{children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
+	for _, value := range paths {
+		if err := ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, limits); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("portable path %q: %w", value, err)
+		}
+		current := root
+		for _, component := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
+			key := portableCollisionKey(component)
+			next, exists := current.children[key]
+			if exists && next.spelling != component {
+				return fmt.Errorf("paths %q and %q collide on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems at %q and %q: %w",
+					next.first, value, next.spelling, component, ErrPathCollision)
+			}
+			if !exists {
+				next = &collisionNode{spelling: component, first: value, children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
+				current.children[key] = next
+			}
+			current = next
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func portableCollisionKey(component string) string {
+	return norm.NFC.String(cases.Fold().String(norm.NFC.String(component)))
+}
+
+func isPortableControl(r rune) bool {
+	return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
+}
+
+func windowsReservedName(component string) bool {
+	base := component
+	if dot := strings.IndexByte(base, '.'); dot >= 0 {
+		base = base[:dot]
+	}
+	base = strings.TrimRight(base, " ")
+	upper := strings.ToUpper(base)
+	switch upper {
+	case "CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", "CONIN$", "CONOUT$", "CLOCK$":
+		return true
+	}
+	if len([]rune(upper)) != 4 {
+		return false
+	}
+	runes := []rune(upper)
+	prefix := string(runes[:3])
+	if prefix != "COM" && prefix != "LPT" {
+		return false
+	}
+	last := runes[3]
+	return last >= '1' && last <= '9' || last == '¹' || last == '²' || last == '³'
+}

```text
1	---
2	description: Inventory repositories, tasks, and live runtime activity across SSH-reachable machines with dev fleet, and safely fast-forward a branch between them.
3	authority: project
4	status: stable
5	verified_on: 2026-08-28
6	---
7
8	# Remote repository fleet
9
10	`dev fleet` fans out over SSH to other machines running their own `dev`, so you can see and open their repositories and safely propagate a branch, without merging their independent configuration into this machine's view.
11
12	## What a fleet is
13
14	A remote fleet is a list of other hosts, each running its own `dev` binary against its own `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, its own scan roots, its own task registry, and its own runtime. `dev fleet` never centralizes or takes ownership of that state — it only asks each host's `dev` for a read-only snapshot over SSH and reports what comes back. A host with no `dev` installed, or an unreachable host, degrades that one row; it never blocks the rest of the fleet.
15
16	This is a different concept from the REMOTE TUI view and publishing/PR flows,
17	which use `gh` or `glab` for GitHub/GitLab repository publication and PRs, plus
18	the Azure CLI for Azure DevOps inventory and PRs. Fleet talks to *your own
19	machines* about *your own local checkouts* on those machines.
20
21	## Configure hosts
22
23	```bash
24	dev fleet config init
25	dev fleet config edit
26	dev fleet config show
27	dev fleet config path
28	```
29
30	Hosts live in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` (override the path with the global `--remotes <path>` flag). `config init` writes a starter file (`--force` to overwrite, `--stdout` to print without writing); `config edit` opens it in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` (`--editor` overrides); `config show` prints the effective configuration with any plaintext password redacted; `config path` prints the resolved path.
31
32	```toml
33	schema_version = 1
34
35	[defaults]
36	connect_timeout = "15s"
37	command_timeout = "5m"
38	cache_ttl = "15m"
39	max_parallel = 4
40	dev_path = "auto"
41
42	[[hosts]]
43	name = "lab"
44	ssh_alias = "lab"
45
46	[[hosts]]
47	name = "vps"
48	hostname = "203.0.113.10"
49	user = "dev"
50	port = 22
51	identity_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
52	ssh_login_password_source = { type = "bitwarden", item = "ssh-vps-login" }
53	```
54
55	`schema_version = 1` is required. `[defaults]` supplies `connect_timeout`, `command_timeout`, `cache_ttl`, `max_parallel` (fan-out concurrency), and `dev_path` (`"auto"` searches `PATH`); each `[[hosts]]` entry inherits any of these it does not set explicitly. A host needs `name` plus either `ssh_alias` (preferred — it reuses `~/.ssh/config`'s `ProxyJump`, `IdentityAgent`, and host-key policy exactly like a plain `ssh` invocation) or `hostname` (optionally with `user`, `port`, `identity_file`). `ssh_login_password_source.type` is one of `none` (default), `prompt`, `plain` (inline `value`), or `bitwarden` (`item` looked up with the `bw` CLI). A config file with a `plain` password must be mode `0600`, or `dev fleet` refuses to load it.
56
57	## `dev fleet` commands
58
59	| Command | Flags | Purpose |
60	|---|---|---|
61	| `dev fleet list` | `--host <name>` (repeatable), `--repo <query>`, `--json`, `--cached`, `--strict` | List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts |
62	| `dev fleet status` | `--json`, `--strict` | Probe configured hosts and report snapshot health |
63	| `dev fleet sync <repo>` | `--push`, `--remote <name>`, `--host <name>` (repeatable), `--json` | Push optionally, then safely fast-forward clean matching checkouts |
64	| `dev fleet open <host> <repo>` | — | Open a remote repository through Herdr or an SSH login shell |
65	| `dev fleet config init` | `-f`/`--force`, `--stdout` | Write a starter `remotes.toml` |
66	| `dev fleet config edit` | `--editor <cmd>` | Open `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` |
67	| `dev fleet config show` | — | Print the effective configuration (passwords redacted) |
68	| `dev fleet config path` | — | Print the resolved `remotes.toml` path |
69
70	`--repo` on `list` filters by name, remote identity, branch, or path; `--cached` answers entirely from the last saved snapshot with no network activity; `--strict` turns an unreachable/timeout/incompatible/invalid host into a non-zero exit for both `list` and `status`. `sync <repo>` resolves `<repo>` locally like any other repository reference; without `--push` its `HEAD` must already equal the fetched upstream, and `--remote` picks which Git remote identifies the repository across hosts (default: the branch's upstream remote, then `origin`).
71
72	`dev fleet` also registers four hidden commands (`_snapshot`, `_sync`, `_open-herdr`, `_shell`) that exist only to be invoked by `dev fleet` itself on the far end of an SSH connection — they are the wire protocol, not a user-facing surface.
73
74	## Transport and authentication
75
76	Every fleet command reaches a host by shelling out to the system `ssh` binary with `ConnectTimeout`, `ServerAliveInterval=15`, and `ServerAliveCountMax=2`, and first attempts `BatchMode=yes` — key or agent authentication only, exactly like a script-friendly `ssh` call. `dev fleet open` additionally allocates a PTY (`-t`) for its interactive login shell.
77
78	If that attempt is rejected with "permission denied" and the host defines a `ssh_login_password_source`, `dev` retries once with password authentication. The password itself never touches argv or the environment: `dev` re-executes itself as a one-shot `SSH_ASKPASS` helper, and the secret is handed to that helper over an inherited file descriptor. `prompt` reads a hidden password from `/dev/tty` at run time; `plain` and `bitwarden` resolve it from the config file or from `bw get password <item>` respectively.
79
80	On the remote side, `dev_path = "auto"` (the default) searches common install locations (`~/.local/bin`, `~/go/bin`, mise shims, Homebrew/Linuxbrew, `/usr/local/bin`, `/snap/bin`) and then `PATH`, exiting `127` if no `dev` is found; an explicit absolute `dev_path` skips that search and execs it directly.
81
82	## What's cached vs. durable
83
84	`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` is durable, user-authored configuration, on the same footing as `config.toml` — `dev fleet config init`/`edit` manage it, and nothing regenerates it automatically.
85
86	Each successful probe writes a per-host JSON snapshot under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json`. That cache is a disposable accelerator, not durable data: it is fingerprinted with an "endpoint ID" derived from the host's connection fields and timeouts, so editing a host's `ssh_alias`, `hostname`, `user`, `identity_file`, `dev_path`, or timeouts automatically invalidates its old cache the next time `dev` reads it. `dev cache list` shows its path, size, and age; `dev cache clear fleet` (or `dev cache clear all`) removes it outright. There is nothing to "rebuild" explicitly — the next `dev fleet list`, `dev fleet status`, or TUI FLEET reload regenerates it from a fresh probe.
87
88	The cache exists so an unreachable, timed-out, incompatible, or invalid-response host can still report its last known state (marked `stale`, with `FromCache` set) instead of vanishing from the listing; `--cached` uses only this cache and never touches the network. Each remote host's own `config.toml`, task registry, and repository paths remain authoritative on that host — the cache only ever holds a read-only snapshot of them.
89
90	## Fleet in the TUI
91
92	FLEET is one of the TUI's six views (`TASKS`, `REPOS`, `FLEET`, `TRY`, `REMOTE`, `SKILLS`, switched with `tab`/`h`/`l`). Like REMOTE, it loads lazily — nothing is fetched until the view is first opened — but it seeds itself from any cached snapshots that are still within `defaults.cache_ttl` so the first render is not empty. `r` forces a live reload of every configured host.
93
94	Its table shows `HOST`, `STATE`, `REPO`, `BRANCH`, `GIT`, `LIVE`, `TASKS`, and `PATH`. `enter` opens the selected repository: for a local host row this is an ordinary local open; for a remote row `dev` prefers native Herdr remoting when that host's snapshot reports the `herdr` runtime and the host connects through `ssh_alias` with no password step, and otherwise falls back to an interactive SSH login shell in the repository's directory. Git changes are read-only in this view — FLEET is for inspecting and opening work, not editing it in place.
95
96	`e` opens `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` — the file this view is about, rather than dev's own `config.toml`, which `e` opens everywhere else. On leaving the editor `dev` reparses the file before using it. A parse failure, an unknown field, or a permissions problem on a file holding a plaintext password is reported and the previous rows are kept, so a typo cannot silently drop a host from the fleet. A file that parses triggers an immediate live reload of every configured host.
97
98	## Degrading gracefully
99
100	Every host is probed independently, so one bad host never fails the fleet as a whole. Per-host states are `ok`, `stale` (cache reused, optionally with an error explaining why), `no-dev` (the remote has no `dev` on its `PATH` — reported, not an error), `unreachable` (SSH itself failed), `timeout`, `incompatible` (an old or unrecognized remote `dev`), and `invalid-response` (malformed snapshot JSON). `ok` and a clean `no-dev` never fail `--strict`; every other state does, including a `stale` result that carries an error.
101
102	Separately, forge integration is optional: `gh` and `glab` enable GitHub/GitLab
103	inventory, publication, and pull/merge requests, while `az` enables Azure
104	DevOps inventory and pull requests. `dev doctor` reports missing CLIs as
105	warnings. Local Git workflows remain available, but an explicit non-interactive
106	publication request fails with login/install guidance instead of silently
107	changing its meaning. Azure DevOps inventory is additionally opt-in and stays
108	disabled until `forge.azure_devops` targets are configured.
109

113	- [`internal/fleet/config.go`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/blob/main/internal/fleet/config.go)

 `./docs/guides/remote-fleet.zh-TW.md`

```text
1	---
2	description: 透過 dev fleet 在 SSH 可連線的多台機器間盤點 repository、task 與 live runtime activity，並安全地在機器間 fast-forward 一個 branch。
3	authority: project
4	status: stable
5	verified_on: 2026-08-28
6	lang: zh-TW
7	---
8
9	# Remote repository fleet
10
11	!!! note "術語規則"
12	    有公認中文譯名且本文使用中文時，首次以「中文 (English original)」呈現。產品名稱與 Git／CLI／agent domain terms 可直接保留英文；沒有公認譯名不得自創。程式碼、API／tool 名稱、CLI flag、套件名與路徑一律不翻譯。
13
14	`dev fleet` 透過 SSH 連到其他執行自己 `dev` 的機器，讓你能查看並開啟它們的 repository、安全地傳播 branch，而不會把它們各自獨立的設定合併進這台機器的視角。
15
16	## Fleet 是什麼
17
18	Remote fleet 是一份其他 host 的清單，每個 host 都執行自己的 `dev` binary，使用自己的 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`、自己的 scan roots、自己的 task registry 與自己的 runtime。`dev fleet` 從不集中管理或取得那份 state 的 ownership，它只會透過 SSH 向每個 host 的 `dev` 要一份 read-only snapshot，並回報收到的結果。沒有安裝 `dev` 的 host，或無法連線的 host，只會讓那一列 degrade；不會擋住 fleet 其餘部分。
19
20	這與 REMOTE TUI view 及 publishing/PR flow 是不同概念——GitHub/GitLab
21	repository publishing 與 PR 使用 `gh` 或 `glab`，Azure DevOps inventory 與 PR
22	則使用 Azure CLI。Fleet 溝通的對象是*你自己的機器*上*你自己的 local
23	checkout*。
24
25	## 設定 hosts
26
27	```bash
28	dev fleet config init
29	dev fleet config edit
30	dev fleet config show
31	dev fleet config path
32	```
33
34	Host 設定放在 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml`（可用全域 `--remotes <path>` flag 覆寫路徑）。`config init` 會寫入一份 starter file（`--force` 覆寫既有檔案、`--stdout` 只印出不寫入）；`config edit` 會用 `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` 開啟它（`--editor` 可覆寫）；`config show` 印出目前生效的設定，明文密碼會被遮蔽；`config path` 印出解析後的路徑。
35
36	```toml
37	schema_version = 1
38
39	[defaults]
40	connect_timeout = "15s"
41	command_timeout = "5m"
42	cache_ttl = "15m"
43	max_parallel = 4
44	dev_path = "auto"
45
46	[[hosts]]
47	name = "lab"
48	ssh_alias = "lab"
49
50	[[hosts]]
51	name = "vps"
52	hostname = "203.0.113.10"
53	user = "dev"
54	port = 22
55	identity_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
56	ssh_login_password_source = { type = "bitwarden", item = "ssh-vps-login" }
57	```
58
59	`schema_version = 1` 為必填。`[defaults]` 提供 `connect_timeout`、`command_timeout`、`cache_ttl`、`max_parallel`（fan-out 並行度）與 `dev_path`（`"auto"` 會搜尋 `PATH`）；每個 `[[hosts]]` 項目未明確設定的欄位都會沿用這些預設值。一個 host 需要 `name`，並搭配 `ssh_alias`（優先——它會沿用 `~/.ssh/config` 的 `ProxyJump`、`IdentityAgent` 與 host-key policy，行為與單純的 `ssh` 呼叫完全一致）或 `hostname`（可搭配 `user`、`port`、`identity_file`）其中之一。`ssh_login_password_source.type` 可為 `none`（預設）、`prompt`、`plain`（內嵌 `value`）或 `bitwarden`（用 `item` 透過 `bw` CLI 查詢）。設定檔若含 `plain` 密碼，檔案權限必須是 `0600`，否則 `dev fleet` 會拒絕載入。
60
61	## `dev fleet` 指令
62
63	| Command | Flags | Purpose |
64	|---|---|---|
65	| `dev fleet list` | `--host <name>`（可重複）、`--repo <query>`、`--json`、`--cached`、`--strict` | List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts |
66	| `dev fleet status` | `--json`、`--strict` | Probe configured hosts and report snapshot health |
67	| `dev fleet sync <repo>` | `--push`、`--remote <name>`、`--host <name>`（可重複）、`--json` | Push optionally, then safely fast-forward clean matching checkouts |
68	| `dev fleet open <host> <repo>` | — | Open a remote repository through Herdr or an SSH login shell |
69	| `dev fleet config init` | `-f`/`--force`、`--stdout` | Write a starter `remotes.toml` |
70	| `dev fleet config edit` | `--editor <cmd>` | Open `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` |
71	| `dev fleet config show` | — | Print the effective configuration (passwords redacted) |
72	| `dev fleet config path` | — | Print the resolved `remotes.toml` path |
73
74	`list` 的 `--repo` 會依 name、remote identity、branch 或 path 過濾；`--cached` 完全依最後一次儲存的 snapshot 回答，不會有任何 network activity；`--strict` 會讓 `list` 與 `status` 在 host 為 unreachable/timeout/incompatible/invalid 時回傳非零結果。`sync <repo>` 對 `<repo>` 的解析方式與其他 repository reference 相同；沒有 `--push` 時，其 `HEAD` 必須已等於 fetch 後的 upstream；`--remote` 決定用哪個 Git remote 在各 host 間識別這個 repository（預設：branch 的 upstream remote，其次是 `origin`）。
75
76	`dev fleet` 還註冊了四個 hidden command（`_snapshot`、`_sync`、`_open-herdr`、`_shell`），它們的存在只是為了讓 `dev fleet` 在 SSH 連線的另一端自行呼叫——這是 wire protocol，不是給使用者直接使用的介面。
77
78	## Transport 與認證
79
80	每個 fleet command 都透過呼叫系統的 `ssh` binary 連到 host，帶上 `ConnectTimeout`、`ServerAliveInterval=15`、`ServerAliveCountMax=2`，並且第一次嘗試一律用 `BatchMode=yes`——只用 key 或 agent authentication，行為就像一次適合腳本化的 `ssh` 呼叫。`dev fleet open` 另外會為它的 interactive login shell 配置 PTY（`-t`）。
81
82	若該次嘗試因 "permission denied" 被拒絕，且該 host 設定了 `ssh_login_password_source`，`dev` 會再重試一次、改用密碼驗證。密碼本身不會出現在 argv 或環境變數中：`dev` 會把自己重新以一次性的 `SSH_ASKPASS` helper 執行，密碼透過一個繼承的 file descriptor 交給那個 helper。`prompt` 會在執行當下從 `/dev/tty` 讀取隱藏輸入；`plain` 與 `bitwarden` 則分別從設定檔或 `bw get password <item>` 取得。
83
84	在遠端那一側，預設的 `dev_path = "auto"` 會搜尋常見安裝位置（`~/.local/bin`、`~/go/bin`、mise shims、Homebrew/Linuxbrew、`/usr/local/bin`、`/snap/bin`）再查 `PATH`，找不到 `dev` 就以 `127` 結束；明確指定絕對路徑的 `dev_path` 則會跳過搜尋，直接 exec 該路徑。
85
86	## 哪些是 cache、哪些是 durable
87
88	`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` 是 durable、由使用者撰寫的設定，與 `config.toml` 地位相同——由 `dev fleet config init`/`edit` 管理，不會被自動重新產生。
89
90	每次成功探測都會在 `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json` 寫入該 host 的 JSON snapshot。這份 cache 是可拋棄的加速機制，不是 durable data：它會依 host 的連線欄位與 timeout 產生一個「endpoint ID」指紋，因此修改 host 的 `ssh_alias`、`hostname`、`user`、`identity_file`、`dev_path` 或 timeout，下次 `dev` 讀取時會自動讓舊 cache 失效。`dev cache list` 會顯示它的路徑、大小與存在時間；`dev cache clear fleet`（或 `dev cache clear all`）可直接移除它。沒有需要手動「重建」的步驟——下一次 `dev fleet list`、`dev fleet status` 或 TUI 的 FLEET reload 就會用一次新的探測重新產生它。
91
92	這份 cache 存在的目的，是讓 unreachable、timeout、incompatible 或 invalid-response 的 host 仍能回報上一次已知的狀態（標記為 `stale`，並設定 `FromCache`），而不是直接從清單消失；`--cached` 只會使用這份 cache，完全不連網路。每個 remote host 自己的 `config.toml`、task registry 與 repository path，在該 host 上仍是唯一權威來源——cache 只保存它們的 read-only snapshot。
93
94	## TUI 中的 FLEET
95
96	FLEET 是 TUI 六個 view 之一（`TASKS`、`REPOS`、`FLEET`、`TRY`、`REMOTE`、`SKILLS`，用 `tab`/`h`/`l` 切換）。與 REMOTE 一樣採延遲載入——view 第一次開啟前不會抓取任何資料——但它會先用仍在 `defaults.cache_ttl` 期限內的 cached snapshot 填入畫面，讓初次顯示不是空的。`r` 會強制對所有已設定的 host 做一次 live reload。
97
98	它的表格欄位是 `HOST`、`STATE`、`REPO`、`BRANCH`、`GIT`、`LIVE`、`TASKS`、`PATH`。`enter` 會開啟選取的 repository：local host 的列是一般的 local open；remote 的列則是，當該 host 的 snapshot 回報 `herdr` runtime，且該 host 透過 `ssh_alias` 連線、不需要密碼步驟時，優先使用原生 Herdr remoting，否則退回在該 repository 目錄下開啟 interactive SSH login shell。這個 view 中 Git 的變更是唯讀的——FLEET 是用來檢視與開啟工作，不是在原地編輯它。
99
100	`e` 會用 `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` 開啟 `remotes.toml`——也就是這個 view 實際對應的檔案，而不是其他 view 中 `e` 所開啟的 dev 自身 `config.toml`。離開編輯器後，`dev` 會先重新解析該檔案才使用它。解析失敗、出現未知欄位，或含有明文密碼的檔案權限有問題時，都會被回報並保留原本的資料列，因此打錯字不會安靜地讓某台 host 從 fleet 中消失。檔案解析成功則會立即對所有已設定的 host 觸發一次 live reload。
101
102	## 優雅降級
103
104	每個 host 都是獨立探測的，所以一個壞掉的 host 不會讓整個 fleet 失敗。每個 host 的狀態有 `ok`、`stale`（重用 cache，可能附帶說明原因的 error）、`no-dev`（remote 的 `PATH` 上沒有 `dev`——僅回報，不視為 error）、`unreachable`（SSH 本身失敗）、`timeout`、`incompatible`（remote 的 `dev` 版本過舊或無法辨識）與 `invalid-response`（snapshot JSON 格式不正確）。`ok` 與乾淨的 `no-dev` 不會讓 `--strict` 失敗；其餘狀態都會，包括帶有 error 的 `stale` 結果。
105
106	另一方面，forge integration 是 optional：`gh` 與 `glab` 提供 GitHub/GitLab
107	inventory、publishing 與 pull/merge request；`az` 提供 Azure DevOps inventory 與
108	pull request。缺少 CLI 時，`dev doctor` 只回報 warning，local Git workflow 仍可用；
109	但 explicit non-interactive publication request 會附 login/install 指引失敗，不會靜默
110	改變操作意義。Azure DevOps inventory 還額外是 opt-in：未設定
111	`forge.azure_devops` targets 前一律停用。
112

35	Report-only is the default; differing target content requires explicit --replace.`,
36			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
37			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {

39					return errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one --to host")
40				}
41				target := targets[0]

45				}

52					StdoutLimit: localfiles.MaxApplyResponseBytes,
53				}
54				client := localfiles.Client{Runner: transport}
55				// Capability is deliberately first: no project file body or source file

57				capability, err := client.Probe(ctxOf(), host)

60				}

67				limits, err := localfiles.NegotiateLimits(app.Cfg.LocalFiles.Limits(), capability.Limits)

136				}
137				result, err := client.Apply(ctxOf(), host, capability, envelope)
138				if err != nil {
139					return err
140				}
141				return renderFleetFilesReport(app, result.PublicReport(), jsonOutput)
142			},

156	func fleetFilesHost(cfg fleet.Config, name string) (fleet.Host, error) {
157		var selected *fleet.Host
158		for index := range cfg.Hosts {
159			if cfg.Hosts[index].Name == name {
160				if selected != nil {
161					return fleet.Host{}, errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one target")
162				}
163				copy := cfg.Hosts[index]
164				selected = &copy
165			}
166		}
167		if selected == nil {

169		}

173	func fleetFilePatterns(project projectconfig.Result, adHoc []string) []localfiles.Pattern {

187	func resolveFleetFilesSource(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (string, gitx.Status, string, string, error) {
188		checkout := ""
189		if ref == "" {
190			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
191			if err != nil {
192				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
193			}
194			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
195			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
196				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
197			}
198			checkout = gitRepo.Root
199		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
200			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
201				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
202				if discoverErr != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
203					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
204				}
205				checkout = gitRepo.Root
206			}
207		}
208		if checkout == "" {
209			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
210			if err != nil {
211				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
212			}
213			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
214			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
215				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
216			}
217			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
218		}
219		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
220		if err != nil {
221			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
222		}
223		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
224			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
225		}
226		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
227		if err != nil {
228			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
229		}
230		identity, err := sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
231		if err != nil {
232			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
233		}
234		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil
235	}
236
237	func sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
238		var preferred []string
239		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
240			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
241		}
242		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
243		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
244		if err != nil {
245			return "", err
246		}
247		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
248		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
249		for _, remote := range preferred {
250			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
251				continue
252			}
253			seenRemote[remote] = true
254			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
255			if err != nil {
256				continue
257			}
258			identitySet := map[string]bool{}
259			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
260				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
261					identitySet[identity] = true
262				}
263			}
264			if len(identitySet) == 1 {
265				for identity := range identitySet {
266					return identity, nil
267				}
268			}
269		}
270		return "", errors.New("source checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
271	}

273	func renderFleetFilesReport(app *App, report localfiles.Report, jsonOutput bool) error {
274		if jsonOutput {
275			encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
276			encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
277			return encoder.Encode(report)
278		}
279		table := app.newTable("PATH", "SIZE", "MODE", "STATE")
280		for _, file := range report.Files {
281			table.Add(file.Path, fmt.Sprintf("%d", file.Size), file.Mode, string(file.State))
282		}
283		table.Render(app.Out)
284		return nil
285	}

83	// collectLocalRepoContext is the single CLI collector used by repo context and
84	// status. It executes only local Git/task/runtime probes; includeTopology adds
85	// repository-wide remote/ref facts but never performs fetch or other network I/O.
86	func collectLocalRepoContext(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, selectedPath string, includeTopology bool) localRepoContext {
87		var (
88			tasks    = []*task.Task{}
89			tasksErr error
90		)
91		if app.Tasks == nil {
92			tasksErr = errors.New("task store is unavailable")
93		} else {
94			listed, err := app.Tasks.List()
95			if err != nil {
96				tasksErr = err
97			} else {
98				tasks = tasksForRepo(listed, repository)
99			}
100		}
101
102		rt := app.Runtime()
103		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
104		local := localRepoContext{
105			Context: inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, repository, tasks, sessions, rt.Name()),
106			Runtimes: []repocontext.RuntimeInput{{
107				Backend: rt.Name(), Available: rt.Available(), Sessions: sessions, Err: runtimeErr,
108			}},
109			SelectedCheckout: -1,
110		}
111		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
112		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
113		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
114			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
115		} else {
116			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
117		}
118		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
119			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
120		}
121		return local

151	func collectRepoContextForge(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool, now time.Time) repocontext.ForgeInput {
152		cacheInput := func(cache forge.Cache, collectionErr error) repocontext.ForgeInput {
153			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
154			if forgeCacheStale(cache, app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, now) {
155				freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
156			}
157			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
158			if !cache.Complete || collectionErr != nil {
159				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
160			}
161			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
162				Authority: assessment.AuthorityCache, Freshness: freshness,
163				Completeness: completeness, ObservedAt: cache.FetchedAt,
164				Records: append([]forge.RemoteRepo{}, cache.Repos...),
165				Err:     errors.Join(collectionErr, forgeCacheErrors(cache)),
166			}
167		}
168
169		if !refresh {
170			cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
171			if !ok {
172				return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: errors.New("no cached forge inventory; rerun with --refresh to collect one")}
173			}
174			return cacheInput(cache, nil)
175		}
176
177		rows, collectionErr := collectRemotes(ctx, app)
178		records := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(rows))
179		for _, row := range rows {
180			records = append(records, row.Repo)
181		}
182		if collectionErr == nil {
183			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
184				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
185				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
186				Records: records,
187			}
188		}
189		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
190			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
191			if len(records) > 0 {
192				cached.Records = records
193			}
194			return cached
195		}
196		if len(records) > 0 {
197			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
198				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
199				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
200				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
201			}
202		}
203		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
204	}
205
206	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
207		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
208			return true
209		}
210		if ttl <= 0 {
211			return false
212		}
213		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
214	}
215
216	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
217		var providerErrors []error
218		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
219		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
220		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
221			name := string(kind)
222			kinds = append(kinds, name)
223			byKind[name] = status
224		}
225		sort.Strings(kinds)
226		for _, kind := range kinds {
227			status := byKind[kind]
228			if status.Error != "" {
229				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
230			} else if !status.Complete {
231				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
232			}
233		}
234		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
235	}

237	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
238		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
239		if err != nil {
240			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
241		}
242		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
243			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
244			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
245			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
246		}
247		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
248			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
249		}
250		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
251			return input
252		}
253		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
254		if parallel <= 0 {
255			parallel = 1
256		}
257		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
258		var wait sync.WaitGroup
259		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
260			wait.Add(1)
261			go func() {
262				defer wait.Done()
263				semaphore <- struct{}{}
264				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
265				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
266			}()
267		}
268		wait.Wait()
269		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
270			input.Err = err
271		}
272		return input
273	}

55	// CapabilityRequest is content-free and is always exchanged before any

73		}
74		if r.Feature != "local-files" {

77		if r.ProtocolVersion != LocalFilesProtocolVersion {

83	// CapabilityResponse contains only non-secret host facts. Unsupported native
84	// platforms return a stable reason before the caller constructs a payload.
85	type CapabilityResponse struct {
86		SchemaVersion   int        `json:"schema_version"`
87		Feature         string     `json:"feature"`
88		ProtocolVersion int        `json:"protocol_version"`
89		MachineID       string     `json:"machine_id"`
90		Platform        string     `json:"platform"`
91		Supported       bool       `json:"supported"`
92		Reason          string     `json:"reason,omitempty"`
93		Limits          FileLimits `json:"limits"`
94	}

96	func (r CapabilityResponse) Validate(request CapabilityRequest) error {
97		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
98			return err
99		}
100		if r.SchemaVersion != request.SchemaVersion || r.Feature != request.Feature || r.ProtocolVersion != request.ProtocolVersion {
101			return errors.New("capability response does not match the request")
102		}
103		if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
104			return err
105		}
106		if r.Platform == "" {
107			return errors.New("capability response has no platform")
108		}
109		if r.Supported {
110			if r.Reason != "" {
111				return errors.New("supported capability must not include a reason")
112			}
113			if err := r.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
114				return fmt.Errorf("capability limits: %w", err)
115			}
116		} else if r.Reason == "" {
117			return errors.New("unsupported capability has no reason")
118		}
119		return nil
120	}

122	// DecodeStrict reads exactly one bounded JSON value, rejects unknown fields,
123	// and requires EOF after optional JSON whitespace.
124	func DecodeStrict(reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
125		if reader == nil || target == nil {
126			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a reader and target")
127		}
128		if maxBytes <= 0 {
129			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a positive limit")
130		}
131		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maxBytes+1))
132		if err != nil {
133			return fmt.Errorf("read fleet protocol: %w", err)
134		}
135		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
136			return fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
137		}
138		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
139		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
140		if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
141			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol: %w", err)
142		}
143		var extra any
144		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
145			if err == nil {
146				return errors.New("decode fleet protocol: multiple JSON values")
147			}
148			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol trailing data: %w", err)
149		}
150		return nil
151	}
152
153	// MarshalBounded encodes one protocol value and enforces the matching bound
154	// before it can be handed to Transport.
155	func MarshalBounded(value any, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
156		if maxBytes <= 0 {
157			return nil, errors.New("fleet protocol encode requires a positive limit")
158		}
159		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode fleet protocol: %w", err)
162		}
163		if int64(len(data))+1 > maxBytes {
164			return nil, fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
165		}
166		return append(data, '\n'), nil
167	}
168
169	// UnmarshalStrict applies DecodeStrict to an in-memory transport response.
170	func UnmarshalStrict(data []byte, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
171		return DecodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(data), maxBytes, target)
172	}

13	var localFileDependencyComponents = map[string]bool{
14		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "vendor": true,
15		"__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "target": true, ".terraform": true,
16		"dist": true, "build": true, ".next": true,

19	// ValidateLocalFilePattern validates the deliberately small cross-platform
20	// grammar accepted by [local_files]. Literal path components use portable slash
21	// paths; '*' and '?' match within one component and a component equal to '**'
22	// matches zero or more components. Character classes, escaping, volumes, and
23	// platform-specific separators are intentionally unsupported.
24	func ValidateLocalFilePattern(value string) error {
25		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
26			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is required and must be trimmed")
27		}
28		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
29			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is not valid UTF-8")
30		}
31		if len(value) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes {
32			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is %d bytes; maximum is %d", len(value), safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes)
33		}
34		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
35			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must use '/' separators")
36		}
37		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasSuffix(value, "/") || strings.Contains(value, "//") {
38			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must be a clean repository-relative slash path")
39		}
40		if strings.ContainsAny(value, "[]{}") {
41			return fmt.Errorf("pattern supports only '*', '?' and whole-component '**' wildcards")
42		}
43		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
44		if len(components) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth {
45			return fmt.Errorf("pattern has %d components; maximum is %d", len(components), safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth)
46		}
47		for _, component := range components {
48			if localFileDependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)] {
49				return fmt.Errorf("pattern enters dependency directory %q", component)
50			}
51			if component == "**" {
52				continue
53			}
54			if strings.Contains(component, "**") {
55				return fmt.Errorf("'**' must occupy a complete path component")
56			}
57			placeholder := strings.NewReplacer("*", "x", "?", "x").Replace(component)
58			if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(placeholder, safefile.CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
59				return fmt.Errorf("component %q: %w", component, err)
60			}
61			for _, r := range component {
62				if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
63					return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a control character", component)
64				}
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}
69

224	// NewReport constructs, canonicalizes, and seals a report.
225	func NewReport(profile Profile, generatedAt time.Time, gates []Gate) (Report, error) {
226		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Profile: profile, GeneratedAt: generatedAt, Gates: gates}
227		if err := report.Seal(); err != nil {
228			return Report{}, err

230		return report, nil
231	}

233	// Seal canonicalizes the report and records a fingerprint over every field
234	// except Fingerprint itself.
235	func (r *Report) Seal() error {
236		if r == nil {
237			return errors.New("seal nil assessment report")
238		}
239		if r.SchemaVersion == 0 {
240			r.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
241		}
242		canonical := r.Canonical()
243		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
244		if err := canonical.validateContent(); err != nil {
245			return err
246		}
247		fingerprint, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
248		if err != nil {
249			return err
250		}
251		canonical.Fingerprint = fingerprint
252		*r = canonical
253		return nil
254	}
255
256	// Validate verifies the schema, policy invariants, canonical fingerprint, and
257	// deterministic ordering of a sealed report.
258	func (r Report) Validate() error {
259		if err := r.validateContent(); err != nil {
260			return err
261		}
262		if !ValidFingerprint(r.Fingerprint) {
263			return fmt.Errorf("invalid report fingerprint %q", r.Fingerprint)
264		}
265		canonical := r.Canonical()
266		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
267		want, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		if r.Fingerprint != want {
272			return fmt.Errorf("assessment fingerprint mismatch: got %s, want %s", r.Fingerprint, want)
273		}
274		if !reportsEqualOrdering(r, r.Canonical()) {
275			return errors.New("assessment report is not in canonical order")
276		}
277		return nil
278	}

280	func (r Report) validateContent() error {
281		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
282			return fmt.Errorf("assessment schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
283		}
284		if err := r.Profile.Validate(); err != nil {
285			return err
286		}
287		if r.GeneratedAt.IsZero() {
288			return errors.New("assessment generated_at is required")
289		}
290		seenGates := make(map[string]struct{}, len(r.Gates))
291		for _, gate := range r.Gates {
292			if err := gate.Validate(r.Profile); err != nil {
293				return err
294			}
295			if _, exists := seenGates[gate.Code]; exists {
296				return fmt.Errorf("assessment repeats gate %q", gate.Code)
297			}
298			seenGates[gate.Code] = struct{}{}
299		}
300		return nil
301	}

303	// Canonical returns a deep copy with UTC timestamps and order-insensitive
304	// collections sorted by their complete stable representation.
305	func (r Report) Canonical() Report {
306		result := r
307		result.GeneratedAt = canonicalTime(result.GeneratedAt)
308		result.Gates = make([]Gate, len(r.Gates))
309		copy(result.Gates, r.Gates)
310		for gateIndex := range result.Gates {
311			gate := &result.Gates[gateIndex]
312			gate.Sources = append([]Source(nil), gate.Sources...)
313			for sourceIndex := range gate.Sources {
314				gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt = canonicalTime(gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt)
315			}
316			sort.Slice(gate.Sources, func(i, j int) bool {
317				left, right := gate.Sources[i], gate.Sources[j]
318				return strings.Join([]string{left.ID, string(left.Authority), string(left.Freshness), string(left.Completeness), left.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), left.Fingerprint}, "\x00") <
319					strings.Join([]string{right.ID, string(right.Authority), string(right.Freshness), string(right.Completeness), right.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), right.Fingerprint}, "\x00")
320			})
321			gate.Reasons = append([]Reason(nil), gate.Reasons...)
322			sort.Slice(gate.Reasons, func(i, j int) bool {
323				left, right := gate.Reasons[i], gate.Reasons[j]
324				return strings.Join([]string{left.Code, left.Subject, left.Detail, left.Remediation}, "\x00") <
325					strings.Join([]string{right.Code, right.Subject, right.Detail, right.Remediation}, "\x00")
326			})
327		}
328		sort.Slice(result.Gates, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Gates[i].Code < result.Gates[j].Code })
329		return result
330	}

332	func (r Report) computeFingerprint() (string, error) {
333		payload := struct {
334			SchemaVersion int       `json:"schema_version"`
335			Profile       Profile   `json:"profile"`
336			GeneratedAt   time.Time `json:"generated_at"`
337			Gates         []Gate    `json:"gates"`
338		}{r.SchemaVersion, r.Profile, r.GeneratedAt, r.Gates}
339		encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
340		if err != nil {
341			return "", fmt.Errorf("encode assessment fingerprint: %w", err)
342		}
343		return FingerprintBytes(encoded), nil
344	}

346	// Decode reads exactly one strict schema-v1 report and verifies its seal.
347	func Decode(reader io.Reader) (Report, error) {
348		if reader == nil {
349			return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment from nil reader")
350		}
351		decoder := json.NewDecoder(reader)
352		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
353		var report Report
354		if err := decoder.Decode(&report); err != nil {
355			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment: %w", err)
356		}
357		var extra any
358		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
359			if err == nil {
360				return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment: multiple JSON values")
361			}
362			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment trailing data: %w", err)
363		}
364		if err := report.Validate(); err != nil {
365			return Report{}, err
366		}
367		return report, nil
368	}
369
370	func FingerprintBytes(value []byte) string {
371		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
372		return fingerprintPrefix + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
373	}
374
375	func ValidFingerprint(value string) bool {
376		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix) || len(value) != len(fingerprintPrefix)+sha256.Size*2 {
377			return false
378		}
379		digest := strings.TrimPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix)
380		if digest != strings.ToLower(digest) {
381			return false
382		}
383		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(digest)
384		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size
385	}
386
387	func validateText(name, value string, required bool) error {
388		if value == "" {
389			if required {
390				return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
391			}
392			return nil
393		}
394		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
395			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
396		}
397		if value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
398			return fmt.Errorf("%s must be trimmed", name)
399		}
400		for _, char := range value {
401			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
402				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
403			}
404		}
405		return nil
406	}
407
408	func canonicalTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
409		if value.IsZero() {
410			return value
411		}
412		return value.Round(0).UTC()
413	}
414
415	func reportsEqualOrdering(left, right Report) bool {
416		leftJSON, leftErr := json.Marshal(left)
417		rightJSON, rightErr := json.Marshal(right)
418		return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && string(leftJSON) == string(rightJSON)
419	}

1	package assessment
2
3	import "fmt"
4
5	// ReduceOutcomes combines independent requirements using the fail-closed
6	// precedence blocked > indeterminate > eligible > not-applicable. No evidence
7	// is itself indeterminate.
8	func ReduceOutcomes(outcomes ...Outcome) Outcome {
9		if len(outcomes) == 0 {
10			return OutcomeIndeterminate
11		}
12		result := OutcomeNotApplicable
13		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
14			switch outcome {
15			case OutcomeBlocked:
16				return OutcomeBlocked
17			case OutcomeIndeterminate:
18				result = OutcomeIndeterminate
19			case OutcomeEligible:
20				if result == OutcomeNotApplicable {
21					result = OutcomeEligible
22				}
23			case OutcomeNotApplicable:
24			default:
25				return OutcomeIndeterminate
26			}
27		}
28		return result
29	}
30
31	// Reduce applies source-quality policy after reducing requirement outcomes.
32	// Cheap reports retain the observed result for display. Deep reports downgrade
33	// any conclusive result to indeterminate unless every relied-on source is fresh,
34	// complete, and backed by a live authority.
35	func Reduce(profile Profile, sources []Source, outcomes ...Outcome) (Outcome, error) {
36		if err := profile.Validate(); err != nil {
37			return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
38		}
39		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
40			if err := outcome.Validate(); err != nil {
41				return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
42			}
43		}
44		for _, source := range sources {
45			if err := source.Validate(); err != nil {
46				return OutcomeIndeterminate, fmt.Errorf("reduce assessment source: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		result := ReduceOutcomes(outcomes...)
50		if result == OutcomeNotApplicable || result == OutcomeIndeterminate {
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		if len(sources) == 0 {
54			return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
55		}
56		if profile == ProfileDeep {
57			for _, source := range sources {
58				if !source.conclusive() {
59					return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
60				}
61			}
62		}
63		return result, nil
64	}
65

19	const SchemaVersion = 1
20
21	type document struct {
22		SchemaVersion int    `json:"schema_version"`
23		MachineID     string `json:"machine_id"`
24	}
25
26	type Store struct {
27		Path     string
28		generate func() string
29	}
30
31	func DefaultPath() string {
32		return filepath.Join(devconfig.DataHome(), "dev", "machine", "v1", "identity.json")
33	}
34
35	func NewStore(path string) *Store {
36		if path == "" {
37			path = DefaultPath()
38		}
39		if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path); err == nil {
40			path = absolute
41		}
42		return &Store{Path: filepath.Clean(path), generate: uuid.NewString}
43	}
44
45	// LoadOrCreate returns this machine's stable ID from the default private store.
46	func LoadOrCreate(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
47		return NewStore("").LoadOrCreate(ctx)
48	}
49
50	func Validate(value string) error {
51		parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
52		if err != nil || parsed == uuid.Nil || parsed.String() != value {
53			return fmt.Errorf("machine_id %q is not a canonical non-zero UUID", value)
54		}
55		return nil
56	}
57
58	func (s *Store) Load() (string, error) {
59		if s == nil || s.Path == "" {
60			return "", errors.New("load machine identity from nil store")
61		}
62		if err := checkPrivateDir(filepath.Dir(s.Path)); err != nil {
63			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity directory: %w", err)
64		}
65		info, err := os.Lstat(s.Path)
66		if err != nil {
67			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity: %w", err)
68		}
69		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
70			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity %s is not a regular file", s.Path)
71		}
72		private, err := privateModeMatches(s.Path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
73		if err != nil {
74			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity permissions: %w", err)
75		}
76		if !private {
77			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", s.Path)
78		}
79		file, err := os.Open(s.Path)
80		if err != nil {
81			return "", fmt.Errorf("open machine identity: %w", err)
82		}
83		defer file.Close()
84		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
85		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
86		var payload document
87		if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
88			return "", fmt.Errorf("decode machine identity: %w", err)
89		}
90		var extra any
91		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
92			if err == nil {
93				return "", errors.New("decode machine identity: multiple JSON values")
94			}
95			return "", fmt.Errorf("decode machine identity trailing data: %w", err)
96		}
97		if payload.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity schema_version %d: want %d", payload.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
99		}
100		if err := Validate(payload.MachineID); err != nil {
101			return "", err
102		}
103		return payload.MachineID, nil
104	}
105
106	func (s *Store) LoadOrCreate(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
107		if s == nil || s.Path == "" {
108			return "", errors.New("create machine identity with nil store")
109		}
110		if ctx == nil {
111			ctx = context.Background()
112		}
113		directory := filepath.Dir(s.Path)
114		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("prepare machine identity directory: %w", err)
116		}
117		lockDirectory := filepath.Join(directory, ".lock")
118		if err := ensurePrivateDir(lockDirectory); err != nil {
119			return "", fmt.Errorf("prepare machine identity lock: %w", err)
120		}
121		var result string
122		err := lockx.WithDir(ctx, lockDirectory, "machine identity", func() error {
123			loaded, err := s.Load()
124			if err == nil {
125				result = loaded
126				return nil
127			}
128			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
129				return err
130			}
131			generate := s.generate
132			if generate == nil {
133				generate = uuid.NewString
134			}
135			candidate := generate()
136			if err := Validate(candidate); err != nil {
137				return fmt.Errorf("generate machine identity: %w", err)
138			}
139			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {
140				return err
141			}
142			result = candidate
143			return nil
144		})
145		return result, err
146	}
147
148	func (s *Store) write(id string) error {
149		if err := Validate(id); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		directory := filepath.Dir(s.Path)
153		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
154			return err
155		}
156		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(directory, ".identity-*.tmp")
157		if err != nil {
158			return fmt.Errorf("create machine identity temp file: %w", err)
159		}
160		name := temporary.Name()
161		defer os.Remove(name)
162		if err := setPrivateMode(name, 0o600); err != nil {
163			_ = temporary.Close()
164			return err
165		}
166		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)
167		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
168		if err := encoder.Encode(document{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, MachineID: id}); err != nil {
169			_ = temporary.Close()
170			return fmt.Errorf("encode machine identity: %w", err)
171		}
172		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
173			_ = temporary.Close()
174			return fmt.Errorf("sync machine identity: %w", err)
175		}
176		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
177			return fmt.Errorf("close machine identity: %w", err)
178		}
179		if err := replaceFile(name, s.Path); err != nil {
180			return fmt.Errorf("publish machine identity: %w", err)
181		}
182		if err := syncDirectory(directory); err != nil {
183			return fmt.Errorf("sync machine identity directory: %w", err)
184		}
185		return nil
186	}
187
188	func ensurePrivateDir(path string) error {
189		created := false
190		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
191			if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
192				return err
193			}
194			created = true
195		} else if err != nil {
196			return err
197		}
198		if created {
199			if err := setPrivateMode(path, 0o700); err != nil {
200				return err
201			}
202		}
203		return checkPrivateDir(path)
204	}
205
206	func checkPrivateDir(path string) error {
207		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
208		if err != nil {
209			return err
210		}
211		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
212			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a private directory", path)
213		}
214		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o700)
215		if err != nil {
216			return fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity directory permissions: %w", err)
217		}
218		if !private {
219			return fmt.Errorf("machine identity directory %s permissions are not private (want 0700 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
220		}
221		return nil
222	}

307	// and also returned to the caller.
308	func RecoverySnapshotOf(ctx context.Context, dir string) (RecoverySnapshot, error) {
309		snapshot := RecoverySnapshot{
310			Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete,
311			Refs:         []RecoveryRef{},
312			Worktrees:    []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{},
313			AdminRoots:   []RecoveryAdminRoot{},
314			Findings:     []RecoveryFinding{},
315			trackedBytes: make(map[string][]byte),
316			adminBytes:   make(map[string][]byte),
317		}
318		collector := recoveryCollector{ctx: ctx, snapshot: &snapshot}
319		if err := collector.contextError("repository", dir); err != nil {
320			collector.finalize()
321			return snapshot, err
322		}
323
324		repository, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
325		if err != nil {
326			if cancelErr := collector.failure("repository-probe-failed", "repository", dir, err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
327				collector.finalize()
328				return snapshot, cancelErr
329			}
330			snapshot.Completeness = RecoveryCompletenessUnknown
331			collector.finalize()
332			return snapshot, err
333		}
334		snapshot.Repository = RecoveryRepositoryFacts{
335			Root:            repository.Root,
336			GitDir:          filepath.Clean(repository.GitDir),
337			CommonDir:       filepath.Clean(repository.GitCommonDir),
338			Bare:            repository.Bare,
339			PromisorRemotes: []string{},
340			Alternates:      []RecoveryAlternate{},
341		}
342
343		if err := collector.collectObjectFormat(repository); err != nil {
344			collector.finalize()
345			return snapshot, err
346		}
347		if err := collector.collectRefs(repository); err != nil {
348			collector.finalize()
349			return snapshot, err
350		}
351		if err := collector.collectRepositoryConfig(repository); err != nil {
352			collector.finalize()
353			return snapshot, err
354		}
355		if err := collector.collectShallow(repository); err != nil {
356			collector.finalize()
357			return snapshot, err
358		}
359		if err := collector.collectWorktreeList(repository); err != nil {
360			collector.finalize()
361			return snapshot, err
362		}
363		collector.collectStoragePlacement(repository)
364
365		for index := range snapshot.Worktrees {
366			if err := collector.collectWorktree(repository, &snapshot.Worktrees[index]); err != nil {
367				collector.finalize()
368				return snapshot, err
369			}
370		}
371		if err := collector.collectAdminRoots(repository); err != nil {
372			collector.finalize()
373			return snapshot, err
374		}
375		collector.collectObjectStoreFeatures(repository)
376		collector.finalize()
377		return snapshot, nil
378	}
379
380	type recoveryCollector struct {
381		ctx            context.Context
382		snapshot       *RecoverySnapshot
383		cancelRecorded bool
384	}
385
386	func (collector *recoveryCollector) contextError(scope, subject string) error {
387		if cause := context.Cause(collector.ctx); cause != nil {
388			if !collector.cancelRecorded {
389				collector.cancelRecorded = true
390				collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
391					Code: "collection-cancelled", Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure,
392					Scope: scope, Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: cause.Error(),
393				})
394			}
395			collector.markPartial(nil)
396			return cause
397		}
398		return nil
399	}
400
401	func (collector *recoveryCollector) failure(code, scope, subject string, err error, local *RecoveryCompleteness) error {
402		if cause := context.Cause(collector.ctx); cause != nil || errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
403			if cause == nil {
404				cause = err
405			}
406			if !collector.cancelRecorded {
407				collector.cancelRecorded = true
408				collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
409					Code: "collection-cancelled", Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure,
410					Scope: scope, Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: cause.Error(),
411				})
412			}
413			collector.markPartial(local)
414			return cause
415		}
416		collector.markPartial(local)
417		collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
418			Code: code, Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure, Scope: scope,
419			Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: recoveryCleanText(err.Error()),
420		})
421		return nil
422	}
423
424	func (collector *recoveryCollector) blocker(code, scope, subject, message string) {
425		collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
426			Code: code, Kind: RecoveryFindingBlocker, Scope: scope,
427			Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: message,
428		})
429	}
430
431	func (collector *recoveryCollector) addFinding(finding RecoveryFinding) {
432		finding.Code = recoveryIdentifier(finding.Code)
433		finding.Scope = recoveryIdentifier(finding.Scope)
434		finding.Subject = recoveryCleanSubject(finding.Subject)
435		finding.Message = recoveryCleanText(finding.Message)
436		collector.snapshot.Findings = append(collector.snapshot.Findings, finding)
437	}
438
439	func (collector *recoveryCollector) markPartial(local *RecoveryCompleteness) {
440		if collector.snapshot.Completeness != RecoveryCompletenessUnknown {
441			collector.snapshot.Completeness = RecoveryCompletenessPartial
442		}
443		if local != nil && *local != RecoveryCompletenessUnknown {
444			*local = RecoveryCompletenessPartial
445		}
446	}
447
448	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectObjectFormat(repository Repo) error {
449		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
450			"rev-parse", "--show-object-format=storage")
451		if err != nil {
452			if cancelErr := collector.failure("object-format-probe-failed", "object-format", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
453				return cancelErr
454			}
455		}
456		format := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
457		if format == "" {
458			if err == nil {
459				_ = collector.failure("object-format-parse-failed", "object-format", "repository", errors.New("Git returned an empty object format"), nil)
460			}
461			return nil
462		}
463		if strings.ContainsAny(format, "\x00\r\n \t") {
464			_ = collector.failure("object-format-parse-failed", "object-format", "repository", fmt.Errorf("unexpected object format %q", format), nil)
465			return nil
466		}
467		collector.snapshot.ObjectFormat = format
468		return nil
469	}
470
471	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectRefs(repository Repo) error {
472		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
473			"for-each-ref", "--sort=refname", "--format=%(refname)%00%(objectname)%00%(objecttype)%00", "refs")
474		if err != nil {
475			if cancelErr := collector.failure("refs-probe-failed", "refs", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
476				return cancelErr
477			}
478		}
479		refs, parseErr := parseRecoveryRefs(output)
480		collector.snapshot.Refs = refs
481		if parseErr != nil {
482			_ = collector.failure("refs-parse-failed", "refs", "repository", parseErr, nil)
483		}
484		return nil
485	}
486
487	func parseRecoveryRefs(output []byte) ([]RecoveryRef, error) {
488		refs := []RecoveryRef{}
489		var parseErrors []error
490		for recordIndex, record := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{'\n'}) {
491			record = bytes.TrimSuffix(record, []byte{'\r'})
492			if len(record) == 0 {
493				continue
494			}
495			fields := bytes.Split(record, []byte{0})
496			if len(fields) == 4 && len(fields[3]) == 0 {
497				fields = fields[:3]
498			}
499			if len(fields) != 3 {
500				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d has %d fields", recordIndex, len(fields)))
501				continue
502			}
503			name, oid, objectType := string(fields[0]), string(fields[1]), string(fields[2])
504			if !utf8.ValidString(name) || !strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/") || oid == "" || objectType == "" {
505				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d is invalid", recordIndex))
506				continue
507			}
508			refs = append(refs, RecoveryRef{Name: name, OID: oid, ObjectType: objectType, Kind: recoveryRefKind(name)})
509		}
510		sort.Slice(refs, func(i, j int) bool { return refs[i].Name < refs[j].Name })
511		return refs, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
512	}
513
514	func recoveryRefKind(name string) RecoveryRefKind {
515		switch {
516		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/heads/"):
517			return RecoveryRefHead
518		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/tags/"):
519			return RecoveryRefTag
520		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/notes/"):
521			return RecoveryRefNote
522		case name == "refs/stash":
523			return RecoveryRefStash
524		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/remotes/"):
525			return RecoveryRefRemote
526		default:
527			return RecoveryRefOther
528		}
529	}
530
531	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectRepositoryConfig(repository Repo) error {
532		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
533			"config", "--null", "--local", "--list")
534		if err != nil {
535			if cancelErr := collector.failure("config-probe-failed", "repository-config", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
536				return cancelErr
537			}
538		}
539		var parseErrors []error
540		promisorRemotes := map[string]struct{}{}
541		for recordIndex, record := range recoveryNULRecords(output) {
542			newline := bytes.IndexByte(record, '\n')
543			if newline < 1 {
544				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("config record %d has no key/value separator", recordIndex))
545				continue
546			}
547			key := strings.ToLower(string(record[:newline]))
548			value := string(record[newline+1:])
549			switch {
550			case key == "extensions.partialclone":
551				if strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
552					collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
553					promisorRemotes[strings.TrimSpace(value)] = struct{}{}
554				}
555			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "remote.") && strings.HasSuffix(key, ".promisor"):
556				remote := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "remote."), ".promisor")
557				parsed, boolErr := recoveryGitBool(value)
558				if boolErr != nil {
559					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("config %s: %w", key, boolErr))
560					continue
561				}
562				if parsed {
563					collector.snapshot.Repository.Promisor = true
564					collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
565					promisorRemotes[remote] = struct{}{}
566				}
567			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "remote.") && strings.HasSuffix(key, ".partialclonefilter"):
568				remote := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "remote."), ".partialclonefilter")
569				collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
570				promisorRemotes[remote] = struct{}{}
571			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "filter.lfs."):
572				collector.snapshot.Repository.LFSConfigured = true
573			}
574		}
575		for remote := range promisorRemotes {
576			if remote != "" {
577				collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes = append(collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes, remote)
578			}
579		}
580		sort.Strings(collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes)
581		if parseErr := errors.Join(parseErrors...); parseErr != nil {
582			_ = collector.failure("config-parse-failed", "repository-config", "repository", parseErr, nil)
583		}
584		return nil
585	}
586
587	func recoveryGitBool(value string) (bool, error) {
588		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
589		case "true", "yes", "on", "1":
590			return true, nil
591		case "false", "no", "off", "0", "":
592			return false, nil
593		default:
594			return false, fmt.Errorf("invalid Git boolean %q", value)
595		}
596	}
597
598	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectShallow(repository Repo) error {
599		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
600			"rev-parse", "--is-shallow-repository")
601		if err != nil {
602			if cancelErr := collector.failure("shallow-probe-failed", "object-store", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
603				return cancelErr
604			}
605			return nil
606		}
607		shallow, parseErr := strconv.ParseBool(strings.TrimSpace(string(output)))
608		if parseErr != nil {
609			_ = collector.failure("shallow-parse-failed", "object-store", "repository", parseErr, nil)
610			return nil
611		}
612		collector.snapshot.Repository.Shallow = shallow
613		if shallow {
614			collector.blocker("shallow-repository", "object-store", "repository", "repository history is shallow")
615		}
616		return nil
617	}
618
619	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectWorktreeList(repository Repo) error {
620		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
621			"worktree", "list", "--porcelain", "-z")
622		if err != nil {
623			if cancelErr := collector.failure("worktrees-probe-failed", "worktrees", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
624				return cancelErr
625			}
626		}
627		worktrees, parseErr := parseRecoveryWorktrees(output)
628		if parseErr != nil {
629			_ = collector.failure("worktrees-parse-failed", "worktrees", "repository", parseErr, nil)
630		}
631		if len(worktrees) == 0 && repository.Root != "" {
632			worktrees = append(worktrees, RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{
633				Path: repository.Root, GitDir: repository.GitDir, Bare: repository.Bare,
634				Main: true, Presence: RecoveryPresenceUnknown, Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessPartial,
635			})
636			if err == nil && parseErr == nil {
637				_ = collector.failure("worktrees-parse-failed", "worktrees", "repository", errors.New("Git returned no worktrees"), &worktrees[0].Completeness)
638			}
639		}
640		collector.snapshot.Worktrees = worktrees
641		return nil
642	}
643
644	func parseRecoveryWorktrees(output []byte) ([]RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot, error) {
645		worktrees := []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{}
646		var current *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot
647		var parseErrors []error
648		flush := func() {
649			if current == nil {
650				return
651			}
652			if current.Path == "" {
653				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, errors.New("worktree record has no path"))
654			} else {
655				current.Main = len(worktrees) == 0
656				worktrees = append(worktrees, *current)
657			}
658			current = nil
659		}
660		for fieldIndex, raw := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{0}) {
661			if len(raw) == 0 {
662				flush()
663				continue
664			}
665			keyBytes, valueBytes, hasValue := bytes.Cut(raw, []byte{' '})
666			key, value := string(keyBytes), ""
667			if hasValue {
668				value = string(valueBytes)
669			}
670			if key == "worktree" {
671				flush()
672				current = &RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{
673					Path: value, Presence: RecoveryPresenceUnknown, Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete,
674					Operations: []RecoveryOperation{}, IndexEntries: []RecoveryIndexEntry{},
675					TrackedFiles: []RecoveryTrackedFile{}, DirtyPaths: []RecoveryDirtyPath{},
676					UntrackedPaths: []string{}, IgnoredPaths: []string{}, LFSPaths: []RecoveryLFSPath{},
677					Submodules: []RecoverySubmodule{}, NestedRepositories: []RecoveryNestedRepository{},
678				}
679				continue
680			}
681			if current == nil {
682				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("worktree field %d precedes a worktree path", fieldIndex))
683				continue
684			}
685			switch key {
686			case "HEAD":
687				current.Head = value
688			case "branch":
689				current.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(value, "refs/heads/")
690			case "detached":
691				current.Detached = true
692			case "bare":
693				current.Bare = true
694			case "locked":
695				current.Locked, current.LockedReason = true, value
696			case "prunable":
697				current.Prunable, current.PrunableReason = true, value
698			}
699		}
700		flush()
701		return worktrees, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
702	}
703
704	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectStoragePlacement(repository Repo) {
705		facts := &collector.snapshot.Repository
706		if repository.Root != "" {
707			inside, err := pathx.Contains(repository.Root, repository.GitDir)
708			if err != nil {
709				_ = collector.failure("git-dir-placement-probe-failed", "storage", "git-dir", err, nil)
710			} else {
711				facts.GitDirOutsideRoot = !inside
712			}
713		}
714		mainRoot := repository.Root
715		for _, worktree := range collector.snapshot.Worktrees {
716			if worktree.Main && worktree.Path != "" {
717				mainRoot = worktree.Path
718				break
719			}
720		}
721		if mainRoot != "" {
722			inside, err := pathx.Contains(mainRoot, repository.GitCommonDir)
723			if err != nil {
724				_ = collector.failure("common-dir-placement-probe-failed", "storage", "common-dir", err, nil)
725			} else {
726				facts.CommonDirOutsideMainRoot = !inside
727				if !inside {
728					collector.blocker("external-common-directory", "storage", "common-dir", "Git common directory is outside the main worktree root")
729				}
730			}
731		}
732		facts.SharedCommonDir = repository.GitDir != repository.GitCommonDir || len(collector.snapshot.Worktrees) > 1
733	}
734
735	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectIndex(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
736		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil,
737			"ls-files", "--stage", "-v", "-z", "--sparse", "--full-name")
738		if err != nil {
739			if cancelErr := collector.failure("index-probe-failed", "index", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
740				return cancelErr
741			}
742		}
743		entries, parseErr := parseRecoveryIndex(output)
744		worktree.IndexEntries = entries
745		if parseErr != nil {
746			_ = collector.failure("index-parse-failed", "index", worktree.Path, parseErr, &worktree.Completeness)
747		}
748		for _, entry := range entries {
749			if entry.Mode == "040000" {
750				worktree.SparseIndex = true
751			}
752		}
753		return nil
754	}
755
756	func parseRecoveryIndex(output []byte) ([]RecoveryIndexEntry, error) {
757		entries := []RecoveryIndexEntry{}
758		var parseErrors []error
759		for recordIndex, record := range recoveryNULRecords(output) {
760			header, pathBytes, ok := bytes.Cut(record, []byte{'\t'})
761			if !ok || len(pathBytes) == 0 || !utf8.Valid(pathBytes) {
762				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has an invalid path field", recordIndex))
763				continue
764			}
765			fields := strings.Fields(string(header))
766			if len(fields) != 4 || len(fields[0]) != 1 {
767				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has an invalid header", recordIndex))
768				continue
769			}
770			if _, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(fields[1], 8, 32); modeErr != nil {
771				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d mode %q: %w", recordIndex, fields[1], modeErr))
772				continue
773			}
774			stage, stageErr := strconv.Atoi(fields[3])
775			if stageErr != nil || stage < 0 || stage > 3 {
776				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has invalid stage %q", recordIndex, fields[3]))
777				continue
778			}
779			tag := fields[0][0]
780			upper := tag
781			if upper >= 'a' && upper <= 'z' {
782				upper -= 'a' - 'A'
783			}
784			entries = append(entries, RecoveryIndexEntry{
785				Path: string(pathBytes), Mode: fields[1], OID: fields[2], Stage: stage, Tag: fields[0],
786				AssumeUnchanged: tag >= 'a' && tag <= 'z', SkipWorktree: upper == 'S',
787			})
788		}
789		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
790			if entries[i].Path != entries[j].Path {
791				return entries[i].Path < entries[j].Path
792			}
793			if entries[i].Stage != entries[j].Stage {
794				return entries[i].Stage < entries[j].Stage
795			}
796			return entries[i].Mode < entries[j].Mode
797		})
798		return entries, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
799	}
800
801	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectSparseConfig(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
802		probes := []struct {
803			key    string
804			target *bool
805		}{
806			{"core.sparseCheckout", &worktree.SparseCheckout},
807			{"core.sparseCheckoutCone", &worktree.SparseCone},
808			{"index.sparse", &worktree.SparseIndex},
809		}
810		for _, probe := range probes {
811			output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil,
812				"config", "--bool", "--default=false", "--get", probe.key)
813			if err != nil {
814				if cancelErr := collector.failure("sparse-config-probe-failed", "sparse", worktree.Path+":"+probe.key, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
815					return cancelErr
816				}
817				continue
818			}
819			value, boolErr := recoveryGitBool(string(output))
820			if boolErr != nil {
821				_ = collector.failure("sparse-config-parse-failed", "sparse", worktree.Path+":"+probe.key, boolErr, &worktree.Completeness)
822				continue
823			}
824			*probe.target = *probe.target || value
825		}
826		if worktree.SparseCheckout {
827			collector.blocker("sparse-checkout", "sparse", worktree.Path, "worktree uses sparse checkout")
828		}
829		if worktree.SparseIndex {
830			collector.blocker("sparse-index", "sparse", worktree.Path, "worktree index contains sparse directory state")
831		}
832		return nil
833	}
834
835	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectStatus(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
836		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil,
837			"status", "--porcelain=v2", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
838		if err != nil {
839			if cancelErr := collector.failure("status-probe-failed", "status", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
840				return cancelErr
841			}
842		}
843		dirty, untracked, parseErr := parseRecoveryStatus(output)
844		worktree.DirtyPaths, worktree.UntrackedPaths = dirty, untracked
845		if parseErr != nil {
846			_ = collector.failure("status-parse-failed", "status", worktree.Path, parseErr, &worktree.Completeness)
847		}
848		return nil
849	}
850
851	func parseRecoveryStatus(output []byte) ([]RecoveryDirtyPath, []string, error) {
852		records := recoveryNULRecords(output)
853		dirty := []RecoveryDirtyPath{}
854		untracked := []string{}
855		var parseErrors []error
856		for index := 0; index < len(records); index++ {
857			record := string(records[index])
858			if record == "" {
859				continue
860			}
861			switch record[0] {
862			case '1', '2':
863				fields := strings.Fields(record)
864				path := statusPath(record)
865				if len(fields) < 2 || len(fields[1]) != 2 || path == "" {
866					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("status record %d is malformed", index))
867					continue
868				}
869				change := RecoveryDirtyPath{
870					Path: path, Kind: "ordinary", IndexStatus: string(fields[1][0]), WorktreeStatus: string(fields[1][1]),
871				}
872				if record[0] == '2' {
873					change.Kind = "rename-or-copy"
874					if index+1 >= len(records) {
875						parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("rename status record %d has no source path", index))
876					} else {
877						index++
