938	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectLFS(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
939		paths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(worktree.IndexEntries)+len(worktree.UntrackedPaths)+len(worktree.IgnoredPaths))
940		for _, entry := range worktree.IndexEntries {
941			paths[entry.Path] = struct{}{}
942		}
943		for _, path := range worktree.UntrackedPaths {
944			paths[path] = struct{}{}
945		}
946		for _, path := range worktree.IgnoredPaths {
947			paths[path] = struct{}{}
948		}
949		ordered := make([]string, 0, len(paths))
950		for path := range paths {
951			ordered = append(ordered, path)
952		}
953		sort.Strings(ordered)
954		if len(ordered) == 0 {
955			return nil
956		}
957		var input bytes.Buffer
958		for _, path := range ordered {
959			input.WriteString(path)
960			input.WriteByte(0)
961		}
962		byPath := map[string]*RecoveryLFSPath{}
963		probes := []struct {
964			name   string
965			cached bool
966		}{
967			{"index", true},
968			{"worktree", false},
969		}
970		for _, probe := range probes {
971			args := []string{"check-attr"}
972			if probe.cached {
973				args = append(args, "--cached")
974			}
975			args = append(args, "-z", "--stdin", "filter")
976			output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, input.Bytes(), args...)
977			if err != nil {
978				if cancelErr := collector.failure("lfs-attribute-probe-failed", "lfs", worktree.Path+":"+probe.name, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
979					return cancelErr
980				}
981			}
982			values := recoveryNULRecords(output)
983			if len(values)%3 != 0 {
984				_ = collector.failure("lfs-attribute-parse-failed", "lfs", worktree.Path+":"+probe.name,
985					fmt.Errorf("Git returned %d attribute fields, want a multiple of three", len(values)), &worktree.Completeness)
986				continue
987			}
988			for field := 0; field < len(values); field += 3 {
989				path, attribute, value := string(values[field]), string(values[field+1]), string(values[field+2])
990				if attribute != "filter" || value != "lfs" {
991					continue
992				}
993				fact := byPath[path]
994				if fact == nil {
995					fact = &RecoveryLFSPath{Path: path}
996					byPath[path] = fact
997				}
998				if probe.cached {
999					fact.IndexAttributes = true
1000				} else {
1001					fact.WorktreeAttributes = true
1002				}
1003			}
1004		}
1005		for _, path := range ordered {
1006			if fact := byPath[path]; fact != nil {
1007				worktree.LFSPaths = append(worktree.LFSPaths, *fact)
1008				collector.blocker("lfs-path", "lfs", worktree.Path+":"+path, "path is governed by the Git LFS filter")
1009			}
1010		}
1011		return nil
1012	}

1040	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectObjectStoreFeatures(repository Repo) {
1041		facts := &collector.snapshot.Repository
1042		for _, root := range collector.snapshot.AdminRoots {
1043			if root.Kind != RecoveryAdminCommonDir {
1044				continue
1045			}
1046			for _, entry := range root.Entries {
1047				if entry.Type == RecoveryEntryRegular && strings.HasPrefix(entry.Path, "objects/pack/") && strings.HasSuffix(entry.Path, ".promisor") {
1048					facts.PromisorPackFiles++
1049				}
1050			}
1051		}
1052		if facts.PromisorPackFiles > 0 {
1053			facts.Promisor = true
1054			facts.PartialClone = true
1055		}
1056
1057		seenAlternates := map[string]struct{}{}
1058		addAlternate := func(source, path string) {
1059			path = strings.TrimSpace(path)
1060			if path == "" {
1061				return
1062			}
1063			if !filepath.IsAbs(path) && source == "objects/info/alternates" {
1064				path = filepath.Join(repository.GitCommonDir, "objects", path)
1065			}
1066			if canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path); err == nil {
1067				path = canonical
1068			} else {
1069				_ = collector.failure("alternate-path-probe-failed", "object-store", path, err, nil)
1070				path = filepath.Clean(path)
1071			}
1072			key := source + "\x00" + path
1073			if _, exists := seenAlternates[key]; exists {
1074				return
1075			}
1076			seenAlternates[key] = struct{}{}
1077			facts.Alternates = append(facts.Alternates, RecoveryAlternate{Source: source, Path: path})
1078			collector.blocker("alternate-object-store", "object-store", path, "repository depends on an alternate object directory")
1079		}
1080
1081		if data, ok := collector.snapshot.adminBytes[recoveryAdminKey(RecoveryAdminCommonDir, "objects/info/alternates")]; ok {
1082			for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.ReplaceAll(string(data), "\r\n", "\n"), "\n") {
1083				addAlternate("objects/info/alternates", line)
1084			}
1085		}
1086		for _, path := range filepath.SplitList(os.Getenv("GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES")) {
1087			addAlternate("environment", path)
1088		}
1089		sort.Slice(facts.Alternates, func(i, j int) bool {
1090			return strings.Join([]string{facts.Alternates[i].Source, facts.Alternates[i].Path}, "\x00") <
1091				strings.Join([]string{facts.Alternates[j].Source, facts.Alternates[j].Path}, "\x00")
1092		})
1093		if facts.PartialClone {
1094			collector.blocker("partial-clone", "object-store", "repository", "repository uses partial-clone storage")
1095		}
1096		if facts.Promisor {
1097			collector.blocker("promisor-object-store", "object-store", "repository", "repository has promisor object storage")
1098		}
1099	}

1140	func recoveryGit(ctx context.Context, dir string, input []byte, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
1141		if cause := context.Cause(ctx); cause != nil {
1142			return nil, cause
1143		}
1144		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
1145		command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
1146		command.Dir = dir
1147		command.Env = recoveryEnvironment()
1148		if input != nil {
1149			command.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(input)
1150		}
1151		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
1152		command.Stdout = &stdout
1153		command.Stderr = &stderr
1154		if err := command.Run(); err != nil {
1155			if cause := context.Cause(ctx); cause != nil {
1156				return stdout.Bytes(), cause
1157			}
1158			return stdout.Bytes(), &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
1159		}
1160		return stdout.Bytes(), nil
1161	}

1163	func recoveryEnvironment() []string {
1164		environment := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+1)
1165		for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
1166			key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
1167			if key != "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS" {
1168				environment = append(environment, entry)
1169			}
1170		}
1171		return append(environment, "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0")
1172	}

1180			records = records[:len(records)-1]

1182		return records

1217	func recoveryIdentifier(value string) string {
1218		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
1219		var result strings.Builder
1220		lastDash := false
1221		for _, character := range value {
1222			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '.' || character == '/' || character == ':' || character == '_' {
1223				result.WriteRune(character)
1224				lastDash = false
1225				continue
1226			}
1227			if !lastDash {
1228				result.WriteByte('-')
1229				lastDash = true
1230			}
1231		}
1232		identifier := strings.Trim(result.String(), "-./:_")
1233		if identifier == "" {
1234			return "unknown"
1235		}
1236		return identifier
1237	}

132		case AuthorityLocalLive, AuthorityRemoteLive, AuthorityDerivedLive, AuthorityCache:
133		default:
134			return fmt.Errorf("source %s has unknown authority %q", s.ID, s.Authority)
135		}
136		switch s.Freshness {
137		case FreshnessFresh, FreshnessStale, FreshnessUnknown:
138		default:
139			return fmt.Errorf("source %s has unknown freshness %q", s.ID, s.Freshness)
140		}
141		switch s.Completeness {
142		case CompletenessComplete, CompletenessPartial, CompletenessUnknown:
143		default:
144			return fmt.Errorf("source %s has unknown completeness %q", s.ID, s.Completeness)
145		}
146		if s.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
147			return fmt.Errorf("source %s observed_at is required", s.ID)
148		}
149		if !ValidFingerprint(s.Fingerprint) {
150			return fmt.Errorf("source %s has invalid fingerprint %q", s.ID, s.Fingerprint)
151		}
152		return nil
153	}
154
155	func (s Source) conclusive() bool {
156		if s.Freshness != FreshnessFresh || s.Completeness != CompletenessComplete {
157			return false
158		}
159		switch s.Authority {
160		case AuthorityLocalLive, AuthorityRemoteLive, AuthorityDerivedLive:
161			return true
162		default:
163			return false
164		}
165	}
166
167	func (r Reason) Validate() error {
168		if !identifierPattern.MatchString(r.Code) {
169			return fmt.Errorf("invalid reason code %q", r.Code)
170		}
171		if err := validateText("reason subject", r.Subject, true); err != nil {
172			return fmt.Errorf("reason %s: %w", r.Code, err)
173		}
174		if err := validateText("reason detail", r.Detail, true); err != nil {
175			return fmt.Errorf("reason %s: %w", r.Code, err)
176		}
177		if err := validateText("reason remediation", r.Remediation, false); err != nil {
178			return fmt.Errorf("reason %s: %w", r.Code, err)
179		}
180		return nil
181	}
182
183	func (g Gate) Validate(profile Profile) error {
184		if err := profile.Validate(); err != nil {
185			return err
186		}
187		if !identifierPattern.MatchString(g.Code) {
188			return fmt.Errorf("invalid gate code %q", g.Code)
189		}
190		if err := g.Outcome.Validate(); err != nil {
191			return fmt.Errorf("gate %s: %w", g.Code, err)
192		}
193		seenSources := make(map[string]struct{}, len(g.Sources))
194		for _, source := range g.Sources {
195			if err := source.Validate(); err != nil {
196				return fmt.Errorf("gate %s: %w", g.Code, err)
197			}
198			if _, exists := seenSources[source.ID]; exists {
199				return fmt.Errorf("gate %s repeats source %q", g.Code, source.ID)
200			}
201			seenSources[source.ID] = struct{}{}
202		}
203		for _, reason := range g.Reasons {
204			if err := reason.Validate(); err != nil {
205				return fmt.Errorf("gate %s: %w", g.Code, err)
206			}
207		}
208		if (g.Outcome == OutcomeEligible || g.Outcome == OutcomeBlocked) && len(g.Sources) == 0 {
209			return fmt.Errorf("gate %s outcome %s requires evidence", g.Code, g.Outcome)
210		}
211		if (g.Outcome == OutcomeBlocked || g.Outcome == OutcomeIndeterminate) && len(g.Reasons) == 0 {
212			return fmt.Errorf("gate %s outcome %s requires a reason", g.Code, g.Outcome)
213		}
214		if profile == ProfileDeep && (g.Outcome == OutcomeEligible || g.Outcome == OutcomeBlocked) {
215			for _, source := range g.Sources {
216				if !source.conclusive() {
217					return fmt.Errorf("gate %s has conclusive outcome %s from non-conclusive source %s", g.Code, g.Outcome, source.ID)
218				}
219			}
220		}
221		return nil
222	}
223
224	// NewReport constructs, canonicalizes, and seals a report.
225	func NewReport(profile Profile, generatedAt time.Time, gates []Gate) (Report, error) {
226		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Profile: profile, GeneratedAt: generatedAt, Gates: gates}
227		if err := report.Seal(); err != nil {
228			return Report{}, err
229		}
230		return report, nil
231	}
232
233	// Seal canonicalizes the report and records a fingerprint over every field
234	// except Fingerprint itself.
235	func (r *Report) Seal() error {
236		if r == nil {
237			return errors.New("seal nil assessment report")
238		}
239		if r.SchemaVersion == 0 {
240			r.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
241		}
242		canonical := r.Canonical()
243		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
244		if err := canonical.validateContent(); err != nil {
245			return err
246		}
247		fingerprint, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
248		if err != nil {
249			return err
250		}
251		canonical.Fingerprint = fingerprint
252		*r = canonical
253		return nil
254	}
255
256	// Validate verifies the schema, policy invariants, canonical fingerprint, and
257	// deterministic ordering of a sealed report.
258	func (r Report) Validate() error {
259		if err := r.validateContent(); err != nil {
260			return err
261		}
262		if !ValidFingerprint(r.Fingerprint) {
263			return fmt.Errorf("invalid report fingerprint %q", r.Fingerprint)
264		}
265		canonical := r.Canonical()
266		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
267		want, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		if r.Fingerprint != want {
272			return fmt.Errorf("assessment fingerprint mismatch: got %s, want %s", r.Fingerprint, want)
273		}
274		if !reportsEqualOrdering(r, r.Canonical()) {
275			return errors.New("assessment report is not in canonical order")
276		}
277		return nil
278	}
279
280	func (r Report) validateContent() error {
281		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
282			return fmt.Errorf("assessment schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
283		}
284		if err := r.Profile.Validate(); err != nil {
285			return err
286		}
287		if r.GeneratedAt.IsZero() {
288			return errors.New("assessment generated_at is required")
289		}
290		seenGates := make(map[string]struct{}, len(r.Gates))
291		for _, gate := range r.Gates {
292			if err := gate.Validate(r.Profile); err != nil {
293				return err
294			}
295			if _, exists := seenGates[gate.Code]; exists {
296				return fmt.Errorf("assessment repeats gate %q", gate.Code)
297			}
298			seenGates[gate.Code] = struct{}{}
299		}
300		return nil
301	}
302
303	// Canonical returns a deep copy with UTC timestamps and order-insensitive
304	// collections sorted by their complete stable representation.
305	func (r Report) Canonical() Report {
306		result := r
307		result.GeneratedAt = canonicalTime(result.GeneratedAt)
308		result.Gates = make([]Gate, len(r.Gates))
309		copy(result.Gates, r.Gates)
310		for gateIndex := range result.Gates {
311			gate := &result.Gates[gateIndex]
312			gate.Sources = append([]Source(nil), gate.Sources...)
313			for sourceIndex := range gate.Sources {
314				gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt = canonicalTime(gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt)
315			}
316			sort.Slice(gate.Sources, func(i, j int) bool {
317				left, right := gate.Sources[i], gate.Sources[j]
318				return strings.Join([]string{left.ID, string(left.Authority), string(left.Freshness), string(left.Completeness), left.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), left.Fingerprint}, "\x00") <
319					strings.Join([]string{right.ID, string(right.Authority), string(right.Freshness), string(right.Completeness), right.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), right.Fingerprint}, "\x00")
320			})
321			gate.Reasons = append([]Reason(nil), gate.Reasons...)
322			sort.Slice(gate.Reasons, func(i, j int) bool {
323				left, right := gate.Reasons[i], gate.Reasons[j]
324				return strings.Join([]string{left.Code, left.Subject, left.Detail, left.Remediation}, "\x00") <
325					strings.Join([]string{right.Code, right.Subject, right.Detail, right.Remediation}, "\x00")
326			})
327		}
328		sort.Slice(result.Gates, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Gates[i].Code < result.Gates[j].Code })
329		return result
330	}
331
332	func (r Report) computeFingerprint() (string, error) {
333		payload := struct {
334			SchemaVersion int       `json:"schema_version"`
335			Profile       Profile   `json:"profile"`
336			GeneratedAt   time.Time `json:"generated_at"`
337			Gates         []Gate    `json:"gates"`
338		}{r.SchemaVersion, r.Profile, r.GeneratedAt, r.Gates}
339		encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
340		if err != nil {
341			return "", fmt.Errorf("encode assessment fingerprint: %w", err)
342		}
343		return FingerprintBytes(encoded), nil
344	}
345
346	// Decode reads exactly one strict schema-v1 report and verifies its seal.
347	func Decode(reader io.Reader) (Report, error) {
348		if reader == nil {
349			return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment from nil reader")
350		}
351		decoder := json.NewDecoder(reader)
352		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
353		var report Report
354		if err := decoder.Decode(&report); err != nil {
355			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment: %w", err)
356		}
357		var extra any
358		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
359			if err == nil {
360				return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment: multiple JSON values")
361			}
362			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment trailing data: %w", err)
363		}
364		if err := report.Validate(); err != nil {
365			return Report{}, err
366		}
367		return report, nil
368	}
369
370	func FingerprintBytes(value []byte) string {
371		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
372		return fingerprintPrefix + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
373	}
374
375	func ValidFingerprint(value string) bool {
376		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix) || len(value) != len(fingerprintPrefix)+sha256.Size*2 {
377			return false
378		}
379		digest := strings.TrimPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix)
380		if digest != strings.ToLower(digest) {
381			return false
382		}
383		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(digest)
384		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size
385	}
386
387	func validateText(name, value string, required bool) error {
388		if value == "" {
389			if required {
390				return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
391			}
392			return nil
393		}
394		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
395			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
396		}
397		if value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
398			return fmt.Errorf("%s must be trimmed", name)
399		}
400		for _, char := range value {
401			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
402				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
403			}
404		}
405		return nil
406	}
407
408	func canonicalTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
409		if value.IsZero() {
410			return value
411		}
412		return value.Round(0).UTC()
413	}
414
415	func reportsEqualOrdering(left, right Report) bool {
416		leftJSON, leftErr := json.Marshal(left)
417		rightJSON, rightErr := json.Marshal(right)
418		return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && string(leftJSON) == string(rightJSON)
419	}

1	package assessment
2
3	import "fmt"
4
5	// ReduceOutcomes combines independent requirements using the fail-closed
6	// precedence blocked > indeterminate > eligible > not-applicable. No evidence
7	// is itself indeterminate.
8	func ReduceOutcomes(outcomes ...Outcome) Outcome {
9		if len(outcomes) == 0 {
10			return OutcomeIndeterminate
11		}
12		result := OutcomeNotApplicable
13		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
14			switch outcome {
15			case OutcomeBlocked:
16				return OutcomeBlocked
17			case OutcomeIndeterminate:
18				result = OutcomeIndeterminate
19			case OutcomeEligible:
20				if result == OutcomeNotApplicable {
21					result = OutcomeEligible
22				}
23			case OutcomeNotApplicable:
24			default:
25				return OutcomeIndeterminate
26			}
27		}
28		return result
29	}
30
31	// Reduce applies source-quality policy after reducing requirement outcomes.
32	// Cheap reports retain the observed result for display. Deep reports downgrade
33	// any conclusive result to indeterminate unless every relied-on source is fresh,
34	// complete, and backed by a live authority.
35	func Reduce(profile Profile, sources []Source, outcomes ...Outcome) (Outcome, error) {
36		if err := profile.Validate(); err != nil {
37			return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
38		}
39		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
40			if err := outcome.Validate(); err != nil {
41				return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
42			}
43		}
44		for _, source := range sources {
45			if err := source.Validate(); err != nil {
46				return OutcomeIndeterminate, fmt.Errorf("reduce assessment source: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		result := ReduceOutcomes(outcomes...)
50		if result == OutcomeNotApplicable || result == OutcomeIndeterminate {
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		if len(sources) == 0 {
54			return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
55		}
56		if profile == ProfileDeep {
57			for _, source := range sources {
58				if !source.conclusive() {
59					return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
60				}
61			}
62		}
63		return result, nil
64	}

31	func DefaultPath() string {

35	func NewStore(path string) *Store {

37			path = DefaultPath()
38		}
39		if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path); err == nil {
40			path = absolute

58	func (s *Store) Load() (string, error) {
59		if s == nil || s.Path == "" {
60			return "", errors.New("load machine identity from nil store")
61		}
62		if err := checkPrivateDir(filepath.Dir(s.Path)); err != nil {
63			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity directory: %w", err)
64		}
65		info, err := os.Lstat(s.Path)
66		if err != nil {
67			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity: %w", err)
68		}
69		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
70			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity %s is not a regular file", s.Path)
71		}
72		private, err := privateModeMatches(s.Path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
73		if err != nil {
74			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity permissions: %w", err)
75		}
76		if !private {
77			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", s.Path)
78		}
79		file, err := os.Open(s.Path)
80		if err != nil {
81			return "", fmt.Errorf("open machine identity: %w", err)
82		}

84		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
85		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()

106	func (s *Store) LoadOrCreate(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
107		if s == nil || s.Path == "" {
108			return "", errors.New("create machine identity with nil store")
109		}
110		if ctx == nil {
111			ctx = context.Background()
112		}
113		directory := filepath.Dir(s.Path)
114		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("prepare machine identity directory: %w", err)
116		}
117		lockDirectory := filepath.Join(directory, ".lock")
118		if err := ensurePrivateDir(lockDirectory); err != nil {
119			return "", fmt.Errorf("prepare machine identity lock: %w", err)
120		}
121		var result string
122		err := lockx.WithDir(ctx, lockDirectory, "machine identity", func() error {
123			loaded, err := s.Load()
124			if err == nil {
125				result = loaded
126				return nil
127			}
128			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
129				return err
130			}
131			generate := s.generate
132			if generate == nil {
133				generate = uuid.NewString
134			}
135			candidate := generate()
136			if err := Validate(candidate); err != nil {
137				return fmt.Errorf("generate machine identity: %w", err)
138			}
139			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {
140				return err
141			}
142			result = candidate
143			return nil
144		})
145		return result, err
146	}

148	func (s *Store) write(id string) error {
149		if err := Validate(id); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		directory := filepath.Dir(s.Path)
153		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
154			return err
155		}
156		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(directory, ".identity-*.tmp")
157		if err != nil {
158			return fmt.Errorf("create machine identity temp file: %w", err)
159		}
160		name := temporary.Name()
161		defer os.Remove(name)
162		if err := setPrivateMode(name, 0o600); err != nil {
163			_ = temporary.Close()
164			return err
165		}
166		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)
167		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
168		if err := encoder.Encode(document{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, MachineID: id}); err != nil {
169			_ = temporary.Close()
170			return fmt.Errorf("encode machine identity: %w", err)
171		}
172		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
173			_ = temporary.Close()
174			return fmt.Errorf("sync machine identity: %w", err)
175		}
176		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
177			return fmt.Errorf("close machine identity: %w", err)
178		}
179		if err := replaceFile(name, s.Path); err != nil {
180			return fmt.Errorf("publish machine identity: %w", err)
181		}
182		if err := syncDirectory(directory); err != nil {
183			return fmt.Errorf("sync machine identity directory: %w", err)
184		}
185		return nil
186	}

188	func ensurePrivateDir(path string) error {

190		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
191			if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
192				return err
193			}
194			created = true
195		} else if err != nil {
196			return err
197		}
198		if created {
199			if err := setPrivateMode(path, 0o700); err != nil {
200				return err
201			}
202		}
203		return checkPrivateDir(path)
204	}

212			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a private directory", path)
213		}
214		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o700)
215		if err != nil {
216			return fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity directory permissions: %w", err)
217		}
218		if !private {
219			return fmt.Errorf("machine identity directory %s permissions are not private (want 0700 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
220		}

55	// CapabilityRequest is content-free and is always exchanged before any
56	// feature payload.
57	type CapabilityRequest struct {
58		SchemaVersion   int    `json:"schema_version"`
59		Feature         string `json:"feature"`
60		ProtocolVersion int    `json:"protocol_version"`
61	}
62
63	func LocalFilesCapabilityRequest() CapabilityRequest {
64		return CapabilityRequest{
65			SchemaVersion: ProtocolSchemaVersion, Feature: "local-files",
66			ProtocolVersion: LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
67		}
68	}
69
70	func (r CapabilityRequest) Validate() error {
71		if r.SchemaVersion != ProtocolSchemaVersion {
72			return fmt.Errorf("capability schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, ProtocolSchemaVersion)
73		}
74		if r.Feature != "local-files" {
75			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported capability feature %q", r.Feature)
76		}
77		if r.ProtocolVersion != LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
78			return fmt.Errorf("local-files protocol_version %d: want %d", r.ProtocolVersion, LocalFilesProtocolVersion)
79		}
80		return nil
81	}

83	// CapabilityResponse contains only non-secret host facts. Unsupported native
84	// platforms return a stable reason before the caller constructs a payload.
85	type CapabilityResponse struct {
86		SchemaVersion   int        `json:"schema_version"`
87		Feature         string     `json:"feature"`
88		ProtocolVersion int        `json:"protocol_version"`
89		MachineID       string     `json:"machine_id"`
90		Platform        string     `json:"platform"`
91		Supported       bool       `json:"supported"`
92		Reason          string     `json:"reason,omitempty"`
93		Limits          FileLimits `json:"limits"`
94	}
95
96	func (r CapabilityResponse) Validate(request CapabilityRequest) error {
97		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
98			return err
99		}
100		if r.SchemaVersion != request.SchemaVersion || r.Feature != request.Feature || r.ProtocolVersion != request.ProtocolVersion {
101			return errors.New("capability response does not match the request")
102		}
103		if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
104			return err
105		}
106		if r.Platform == "" {
107			return errors.New("capability response has no platform")
108		}
109		if r.Supported {
110			if r.Reason != "" {
111				return errors.New("supported capability must not include a reason")
112			}
113			if err := r.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
114				return fmt.Errorf("capability limits: %w", err)
115			}
116		} else if r.Reason == "" {
117			return errors.New("unsupported capability has no reason")
118		}
119		return nil
120	}

122	// DecodeStrict reads exactly one bounded JSON value, rejects unknown fields,
123	// and requires EOF after optional JSON whitespace.
124	func DecodeStrict(reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
125		if reader == nil || target == nil {
126			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a reader and target")
127		}
128		if maxBytes <= 0 {
129			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a positive limit")
130		}
131		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maxBytes+1))
132		if err != nil {
133			return fmt.Errorf("read fleet protocol: %w", err)
134		}
135		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
136			return fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
137		}
138		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
139		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
140		if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
141			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol: %w", err)
142		}
143		var extra any
144		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
145			if err == nil {
146				return errors.New("decode fleet protocol: multiple JSON values")
147			}
148			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol trailing data: %w", err)
149		}
150		return nil
151	}
152
153	// MarshalBounded encodes one protocol value and enforces the matching bound
154	// before it can be handed to Transport.
155	func MarshalBounded(value any, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
156		if maxBytes <= 0 {
157			return nil, errors.New("fleet protocol encode requires a positive limit")
158		}
159		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode fleet protocol: %w", err)
162		}
163		if int64(len(data))+1 > maxBytes {
164			return nil, fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
165		}
166		return append(data, '\n'), nil
167	}
168
169	// UnmarshalStrict applies DecodeStrict to an in-memory transport response.
170	func UnmarshalStrict(data []byte, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
171		return DecodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(data), maxBytes, target)
172	}

31	// MaybeServeAskpass turns the dev executable into a one-shot SSH_ASKPASS
32	// helper. The password arrives through an inherited descriptor, never argv.
33	func MaybeServeAskpass() (bool, int) {
34		if os.Getenv(askpassMarker) != "1" {
35			return false, 0
36		}
37		fd, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv(askpassFD))
38		if err != nil || fd < 3 {
39			return true, 2
40		}
41		file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), "dev-fleet-askpass")
42		if file == nil {
43			return true, 2
44		}
45		defer file.Close()
46		password, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 64*1024))
47		if err != nil {
48			return true, 2
49		}
50		password = bytes.TrimSuffix(password, []byte{'\n'})
51		_, err = os.Stdout.Write(append(password, '\n'))
52		if err != nil {
53			return true, 2
54		}
55		return true, 0
56	}

58	type RetryPolicy string

87	// Interactive replaces the caller's terminal with an SSH PTY for a fixed dev
88	// helper command. Password sources use the same descriptor-backed askpass path
89	// as non-interactive probes.
90	func (t Transport) Interactive(ctx context.Context, host Host, remoteArgs []string, usePassword bool) error {
91		password := ""
92		if usePassword && host.PasswordKind() != "none" {
93			resolved, err := t.resolvePassword(host)
94			if err != nil {
95				return err
96			}
97			password = resolved
98		}
99		args := sshArgs(host, true, password != "")
100		args = append(args, host.Destination(), remoteCommand(host, remoteArgs))
101		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "ssh", args...)
102		cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
103		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LC_ALL=C")
104		return runSSHCommand(cmd, password)
105
106	}

108	// Run preserves the v0.2 fleet behavior: retry once with the configured
109	// password only when SSH exits 255 with an authentication-denial diagnostic.
110	// New mutating protocols should call RunWithOptions and choose a retry policy
111	// explicitly.
112	func (t Transport) Run(ctx context.Context, host Host, remoteArgs []string, stdin []byte, pty bool) Result {
113		return t.run(ctx, host, remoteArgs, stdin, pty, RunOptions{Retry: RetryAuthentication})
114	}

116	// RunWithOptions executes a fixed, noninteractive protocol command with an
117	// explicit retry policy. It always requests no PTY and disables forwarding.
118	func (t Transport) RunWithOptions(ctx context.Context, host Host, remoteArgs []string, stdin []byte, options RunOptions) Result {
119		return t.run(ctx, host, remoteArgs, stdin, false, options)
120	}

122	func (t Transport) run(ctx context.Context, host Host, remoteArgs []string, stdin []byte, pty bool, options RunOptions) Result {
123		if options.Retry == "" {
124			options.Retry = RetryNever
125		}
126		if options.Retry != RetryNever && options.Retry != RetryAuthentication {
127			return localTransportFailure(fmt.Sprintf("fleet transport: unknown retry policy %q", options.Retry))
128		}
129		stdinLimit := effectiveLimit(t.StdinLimit, DefaultStdinLimit)
130		if int64(len(stdin)) > stdinLimit {
131			message := fmt.Sprintf("fleet transport: stdin exceeds %d-byte limit", stdinLimit)
132			return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}
133		}
134		timeout := host.CommandTimeout.Duration
135		if timeout <= 0 {
136			timeout = 5 * time.Minute
137		}
138		commandCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
139		defer cancel()
140
141		first := t.runAttempt(commandCtx, host, remoteArgs, stdin, pty, "")
142		if options.Retry != RetryAuthentication || first.CaptureError != "" || first.ExitCode != 255 || host.PasswordKind() == "none" || !permissionDenied(first.Stderr) {
143			first.TimedOut = first.TimedOut || errors.Is(commandCtx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded)
144			return first
145		}
146		password, err := t.resolvePassword(host)
147		if err != nil {
148			message := "fleet transport: " + err.Error()
149			first.TransportError = message
150			first.Stderr = boundedBytes([]byte(message), effectiveLimit(t.StderrLimit, DefaultStderrLimit))
151			return first
152		}
153		second := t.runAttempt(commandCtx, host, remoteArgs, stdin, pty, password)
154		second.UsedPassword = true
155		second.Attempts = first.Attempts + second.Attempts
156		second.TimedOut = second.TimedOut || errors.Is(commandCtx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded)
157		return second
158	}

160	func (t Transport) runAttempt(ctx context.Context, host Host, remoteArgs []string, stdin []byte, pty bool, password string) Result {
161		args := sshArgs(host, pty, password != "")
162		args = append(args, host.Destination(), remoteCommand(host, remoteArgs))
163		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "ssh", args...)
164		cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(stdin)
165		stdout := newCaptureBuffer(effectiveLimit(t.StdoutLimit, DefaultStdoutLimit))
166		stderr := newCaptureBuffer(effectiveLimit(t.StderrLimit, DefaultStderrLimit))
167		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = stdout, stderr
168		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LC_ALL=C")
169		err := runSSHCommand(cmd, password)
170		result := Result{Stdout: stdout.Bytes(), Stderr: stderr.Bytes(), ExitCode: 0, Attempts: 1}
171		if stdout.Exceeded() || stderr.Exceeded() {
172			message := captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr)
173			result.ExitCode = 125
174			result.CaptureError = message
175			result.TransportError = message
176			result.Stderr = appendBounded(result.Stderr, []byte("\n"+message), effectiveLimit(t.StderrLimit, DefaultStderrLimit))
177			return result
178		}
179		if err == nil {
180			return result
181		}
182		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
183		if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || errors.Is(ctx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded) {
184			result.ExitCode, result.TimedOut = 124, true
185		} else if errors.As(err, &exitErr) {
186			result.ExitCode = exitErr.ExitCode()
187			if result.ExitCode < 0 {
188				result.ExitCode = 255
189			}
190		} else {
191			result.ExitCode = 255
192			if len(result.Stderr) == 0 {
193				result.Stderr = []byte(err.Error())
194			}
195		}
196		return result
197	}

199	// runSSHCommand starts SSH before writing an askpass secret. Starting first is
200	// load-bearing: a secret larger than the pipe capacity must remain cancellable
201	// through the command context instead of blocking before SSH exists.
202	func runSSHCommand(cmd *exec.Cmd, password string) error {
203		if password == "" {
204			return cmd.Run()
205		}
206		executable, err := os.Executable()
207		if err != nil {
208			return err
209		}
210		reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
211		if err != nil {
212			return err
213		}
214		cmd.ExtraFiles = []*os.File{reader}
215		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
216			askpassMarker+"=1", askpassFD+"=3", "SSH_ASKPASS="+executable,
217			"SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force", "DISPLAY=dev-fleet")
218		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
219			_ = reader.Close()
220			_ = writer.Close()
221			return err
222		}
223		// The child owns its inherited descriptor after Start; closing the parent
224		// copy lets an early SSH exit interrupt a blocked write.
225		readerCloseErr := reader.Close()
226		writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
227		go func() {
228			_, writeErr := io.Copy(writer, strings.NewReader(password+"\n"))
229			writeDone <- errors.Join(writeErr, writer.Close())
230		}()
231		waitErr := cmd.Wait()
232		// A descendant could retain the inherited read descriptor after SSH exits.
233		// Close our writer so that cannot strand the write goroutine.
234		_ = writer.Close()
235		writeErr := <-writeDone
236		return errors.Join(waitErr, readerCloseErr, writeErr)
237	}

239	func sshArgs(host Host, pty, password bool) []string {
240		connect := host.ConnectTimeout.Duration
241		if connect <= 0 {
242			connect = 15 * time.Second
243		}
244		seconds := int(connect.Round(time.Second) / time.Second)
245		if seconds < 1 {
246			seconds = 1
247		}
248		args := []string{"-o", "ConnectTimeout=" + strconv.Itoa(seconds), "-o", "ServerAliveInterval=15", "-o", "ServerAliveCountMax=2"}
249		if password {
250			args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=no", "-o", "PubkeyAuthentication=no", "-o", "PreferredAuthentications=keyboard-interactive,password", "-o", "NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1")
251		} else {
252			args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=yes")
253		}
254		if pty {
255			args = append(args, "-t")
256		} else {
257			// A fixed protocol command never needs a TTY or client-side forwarding.
258			// Do not add host-key overrides here: OpenSSH's configured strict host-key
259			// verification remains authoritative.
260			args = append(args,
261				"-T",
262				"-o", "ClearAllForwardings=yes",
263				"-o", "ForwardAgent=no",
264				"-o", "ForwardX11=no",
265				"-o", "PermitLocalCommand=no",
266			)
267		}
268		if host.User != "" && host.SSHAlias != "" {
269			args = append(args, "-l", host.User)
270		}
271		if host.Port > 0 {
272			args = append(args, "-p", strconv.Itoa(host.Port))
273		}
274		if host.IdentityFile != "" && !password {
275			args = append(args, "-i", devconfig.Expand(host.IdentityFile))
276		}
277		return args
278	}

280	func remoteCommand(host Host, args []string) string {
281		devPath := host.DevPath
282		if devPath == "" {
283			devPath = "auto"
284		}
285		quotedArgs := make([]string, len(args))
286		for index, arg := range args {
287			quotedArgs[index] = shellQuote(arg)
288		}
289		joined := strings.Join(quotedArgs, " ")
290		if devPath != "auto" {
291			return "exec " + shellQuote(devconfig.Expand(devPath)) + " " + joined
292		}
293		path := `PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:/opt/homebrew/bin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/snap/bin:$PATH"`
294		return path + "; export PATH; command -v dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 127; exec dev " + joined
295	}
296
297	func shellQuote(value string) string {
298		return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'"
299	}
300
301	func permissionDenied(stderr []byte) bool {
302		return strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(stderr)), "permission denied")
303	}

305	func (t Transport) resolvePassword(host Host) (string, error) {
306		source := host.SSHLoginPasswordSource
307		switch host.PasswordKind() {
308		case "plain":
309			return source.Value, nil
310		case "bitwarden":
311			cmd := exec.Command("bw", "get", "password", source.Item)
312			out, err := cmd.Output()
313			if err != nil {
314				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve Bitwarden SSH password for %s: %w", host.Name, err)
315			}
316			return strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), nil
317		case "prompt":
318			promptPasswordMu.Lock()
319			defer promptPasswordMu.Unlock()
320			writer := t.Err
321			if writer == nil {
322				writer = os.Stderr
323			}
324			fmt.Fprintf(writer, "SSH password for %s: ", host.Name)
325			terminal, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
326			if err != nil {
327				return "", fmt.Errorf("open terminal for SSH password: %w", err)
328			}
329			defer terminal.Close()
330			password, err := term.ReadPassword(terminal.Fd())
331			fmt.Fprintln(writer)
332			if err != nil {
333				return "", err
334			}
335			return string(password), nil
336		default:
337			return "", nil
338		}
339	}

341	type captureBuffer struct {
342		limit    int64
343		buffer   bytes.Buffer
344		exceeded bool
345	}
346
347	func newCaptureBuffer(limit int64) *captureBuffer {
348		return &captureBuffer{limit: limit}
349	}
350
351	func (b *captureBuffer) Write(value []byte) (int, error) {
352		remaining := b.limit - int64(b.buffer.Len())
353		if remaining > 0 {
354			keep := int64(len(value))
355			if keep > remaining {
356				keep = remaining
357			}
358			_, _ = b.buffer.Write(value[:int(keep)])
359		}
360		if int64(len(value)) > remaining {
361			b.exceeded = true
362		}
363		// Consume excess output without retaining it. The command timeout still
364		// bounds a peer that writes forever, while the parent process stays bounded.
365		return len(value), nil
366	}
367
368	func (b *captureBuffer) Bytes() []byte {
369		return append([]byte(nil), b.buffer.Bytes()...)
370	}
371
372	func (b *captureBuffer) Exceeded() bool { return b.exceeded }
373
374	func effectiveLimit(configured, fallback int64) int64 {
375		if configured <= 0 {
376			return fallback
377		}
378		return configured
379	}
380
381	func captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr *captureBuffer) string {
382		streams := make([]string, 0, 2)
383		if stdout.Exceeded() {
384			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stdout exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stdout.limit))
385		}
386		if stderr.Exceeded() {
387			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stderr exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stderr.limit))
388		}
389		return "fleet transport: remote " + strings.Join(streams, " and ")
390	}
391
392	func boundedBytes(value []byte, limit int64) []byte {
393		if int64(len(value)) > limit {
394			value = value[:int(limit)]
395		}
396		return append([]byte(nil), value...)
397	}
398
399	func appendBounded(current, suffix []byte, limit int64) []byte {
400		if int64(len(current)) >= limit {
401			return append([]byte(nil), current...)
402		}
403		available := limit - int64(len(current))
404		if int64(len(suffix)) > available {
405			suffix = suffix[:int(available)]
406		}
407		return append(append([]byte(nil), current...), suffix...)
408	}
409
410	func localTransportFailure(message string) Result {
411		return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}
412	}

10		"time"
11
12		"github.com/BurntSushi/toml"
13		devconfig "github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/machineid"
15	)
16
17	const ConfigSchemaVersion = 1
18
19	type PasswordSource struct {
20		Type  string `toml:"type" json:"type"`
21		Value string `toml:"value" json:"-"`
22		Item  string `toml:"item" json:"item,omitempty"`
23	}
24
25	type Defaults struct {
26		ConnectTimeout devconfig.Duration `toml:"connect_timeout"`
27		CommandTimeout devconfig.Duration `toml:"command_timeout"`
28		CacheTTL       devconfig.Duration `toml:"cache_ttl"`
29		MaxParallel    int                `toml:"max_parallel"`
30		DevPath        string             `toml:"dev_path"`
31	}
32
33	type Host struct {
34		Name string `toml:"name" json:"name"`
35		// MachineID is an optional expected remote UUID pin. This config layer
36		// validates and fingerprints it; capability-aware callers must compare it.
37		MachineID    string `toml:"machine_id" json:"machine_id,omitempty"`
38		SSHAlias     string `toml:"ssh_alias" json:"ssh_alias,omitempty"`
39		Hostname     string `toml:"hostname" json:"hostname,omitempty"`
40		User         string `toml:"user" json:"user,omitempty"`
41		Port         int    `toml:"port" json:"port,omitempty"`
42		IdentityFile string `toml:"identity_file" json:"identity_file,omitempty"`
43		DevPath      string `toml:"dev_path" json:"dev_path,omitempty"`
44
45		ConnectTimeout devconfig.Duration `toml:"connect_timeout" json:"-"`
46		CommandTimeout devconfig.Duration `toml:"command_timeout" json:"-"`
47
48		SSHLoginPasswordSource PasswordSource `toml:"ssh_login_password_source" json:"ssh_login_password_source"`
49	}
50
51	type Config struct {
52		SchemaVersion int      `toml:"schema_version"`
53		Defaults      Defaults `toml:"defaults"`
54		Hosts         []Host   `toml:"hosts"`
55		Source        string   `toml:"-"`
56	}
57
58	func DefaultConfig() Config {
59		return Config{
60			SchemaVersion: ConfigSchemaVersion,
61			Defaults: Defaults{
62				ConnectTimeout: devconfig.Duration{Duration: 15 * time.Second},
63				CommandTimeout: devconfig.Duration{Duration: 5 * time.Minute},
64				CacheTTL:       devconfig.Duration{Duration: 15 * time.Minute},
65				MaxParallel:    4,
66				DevPath:        "auto",
67			},
68		}
69	}
70
71	func ConfigFile() string {
72		return filepath.Join(devconfig.ConfigHome(), "dev", "remotes.toml")
73	}
74
75	func LoadConfig(path string) (Config, error) {
76		cfg := DefaultConfig()
77		if path == "" {
78			path = ConfigFile()
79		}
80		metadata, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
81		switch {
82		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
83			return cfg, nil
84		case err != nil:
85			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
86		}
87		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
88			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: unknown field(s): %v", path, undecoded)
89		}
90		cfg.Source = path
91		cfg.ApplyDefaults()
92		if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
93			return cfg, err
94		}
95		return cfg, nil
96	}
97
98	func (c *Config) ApplyDefaults() {
99		for index := range c.Hosts {
100			host := &c.Hosts[index]
101			if host.DevPath == "" {
102				host.DevPath = c.Defaults.DevPath
103			}
104			if host.ConnectTimeout.Duration == 0 {
105				host.ConnectTimeout = c.Defaults.ConnectTimeout
106			}
107			if host.CommandTimeout.Duration == 0 {
108				host.CommandTimeout = c.Defaults.CommandTimeout
109			}
110		}
111	}
112
113	func (c Config) Validate() error {
114		if c.SchemaVersion != ConfigSchemaVersion {
115			return fmt.Errorf("remotes schema_version %d: want %d", c.SchemaVersion, ConfigSchemaVersion)
116		}
117		if c.Defaults.MaxParallel <= 0 {
118			return errors.New("defaults.max_parallel must be positive")
119		}
120		if c.Defaults.ConnectTimeout.Duration <= 0 || c.Defaults.CommandTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
121			return errors.New("default timeouts must be positive")
122		}
123		seen := map[string]bool{}
124		for index, host := range c.Hosts {
125			if strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) == "" || host.Name != strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) {
126				return fmt.Errorf("hosts[%d].name is required and must be trimmed", index)
127			}
128			if seen[host.Name] {
129				return fmt.Errorf("duplicate host name %q", host.Name)
130			}
131			seen[host.Name] = true
132			if host.MachineID != "" {
133				if err := machineid.Validate(host.MachineID); err != nil {
134					return fmt.Errorf("host %q: %w", host.Name, err)
135				}
136			}
137			if host.SSHAlias == "" && host.Hostname == "" {
138				return fmt.Errorf("host %q must define ssh_alias or hostname", host.Name)
139			}
140			if host.Port < 0 || host.Port > 65535 {
141				return fmt.Errorf("host %q port %d is invalid", host.Name, host.Port)
142			}
143			if host.ConnectTimeout.Duration <= 0 || host.CommandTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
144				return fmt.Errorf("host %q timeouts must be positive", host.Name)
145			}
146			if host.DevPath != "" && host.DevPath != "auto" && !filepath.IsAbs(devconfig.Expand(host.DevPath)) {
147				return fmt.Errorf("host %q dev_path must be auto or absolute", host.Name)
148			}
149			if err := validatePasswordSource(host.Name, host.SSHLoginPasswordSource); err != nil {
150				return err
151			}
152		}
153		return nil
154	}
155
156	func validatePasswordSource(host string, source PasswordSource) error {
157		kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(source.Type))
158		if kind == "" {
159			kind = "none"
160		}
161		switch kind {
162		case "none", "prompt":
163			return nil
164		case "plain":
165			if source.Value == "" {
166				return fmt.Errorf("host %q plain ssh_login_password_source requires value", host)
167			}
168		case "bitwarden":
169			if source.Item == "" {
170				return fmt.Errorf("host %q bitwarden ssh_login_password_source requires item", host)
171			}
172		default:
173			return fmt.Errorf("host %q ssh_login_password_source.type %q: want none, plain, prompt or bitwarden", host, source.Type)
174		}
175		return nil
176	}
177
178	func (h Host) PasswordKind() string {
179		kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(h.SSHLoginPasswordSource.Type))
180		if kind == "" {
181			return "none"
182		}
183		return kind
184	}
185
186	func (h Host) Destination() string {
187		if h.SSHAlias != "" {
188			return h.SSHAlias
189		}
190		if h.User != "" {
191			return h.User + "@" + h.Hostname
192		}
193		return h.Hostname
194	}
195
196	func CheckPrivateMode(path string, cfg Config) error {
197		needsPrivate := false
198		for _, host := range cfg.Hosts {
199			if host.PasswordKind() == "plain" {
200				needsPrivate = true
201				break
202			}
203		}
204		if !needsPrivate {
205			return nil
206		}
207		info, err := os.Stat(path)
208		if err != nil {
209			return err
210		}
211		if info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
212			return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a plaintext SSH password and must have mode 0600", path)
213		}
214		return nil
215	}
216

241	func (r PlanResponse) Validate(request PlanRequest) error {
242		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
243			return err
244		}
245		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || r.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion ||
246			r.RequestID != request.RequestID || r.ManifestDigest != request.ManifestDigest ||
247			r.TargetMachine != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
248			return errors.New("plan response binding does not match request")
249		}
250		if !validDigest(r.TargetCheckout) {
251			return errors.New("plan response has an invalid checkout identity")
252		}
253		if len(r.Files) != len(request.Files) {
254			return errors.New("plan response file count does not match request")
255		}
256		for index, file := range r.Files {
257			spec := request.Files[index]
258			if file.Path != spec.Path || file.Size != spec.Size || file.Mode != spec.Mode || !file.State.validPlan() {
259				return fmt.Errorf("plan response metadata for %q does not match request", spec.Path)
260			}
261			switch file.Action {
262			case actionCurrent:
263				if file.State != StateCurrent || file.TargetSHA256 != spec.SHA256 || file.TargetMode != spec.Mode {
264					return fmt.Errorf("plan response current observation for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
265				}
266			case actionCreate:
267				if file.State != StateReady || file.TargetSHA256 != "" || file.TargetMode != "" {
268					return fmt.Errorf("plan response create observation for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
269				}
270			case actionReplace:
271				if !request.Replace || file.State != StateReady || !validDigest(file.TargetSHA256) || !validFileMode(file.TargetMode) {
272					return fmt.Errorf("plan response replace observation for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
273				}
274			case "":
275				if file.State == StateReady || file.State == StateCurrent {
276					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q omits a required action", spec.Path)
277				}
278				if file.TargetSHA256 != "" && !validDigest(file.TargetSHA256) {
279					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an invalid target digest", spec.Path)
280				}
281				if file.TargetMode != "" && !validFileMode(file.TargetMode) {
282					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an invalid target mode", spec.Path)
283				}
284			default:
285				return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an unknown action", spec.Path)
286			}

289			return errors.New("plan response digest does not match")

292	}

321		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || r.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion ||
322			r.RequestID != request.RequestID || r.PlanDigest != plan.PlanDigest || len(r.Files) != len(request.Files) {
323			return errors.New("apply response binding does not match plan")
324		}
325		for index, file := range r.Files {
326			spec := request.Files[index]
327			if file.Path != spec.Path || file.Size != spec.Size || file.Mode != spec.Mode || !file.State.validResult() {
328				return fmt.Errorf("apply response metadata for %q does not match plan", spec.Path)
329			}
330			expected := StateCurrent
331			switch plan.Files[index].Action {
332			case actionCreate:
333				expected = StateCreated
334			case actionReplace:
335				expected = StateReplaced
336			case actionCurrent:
337			default:
338				return fmt.Errorf("apply response action for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
339			}
340			if file.State != expected {
341				return fmt.Errorf("apply response state for %q does not match plan", spec.Path)
342			}
343		}
344		return nil
345	}

347	func manifestDigest(request PlanRequest) string {
348		payload := struct {
349			Domain    string           `json:"domain"`
350			RequestID string           `json:"request_id"`
351			Binding   Binding          `json:"binding"`
352			Limits    fleet.FileLimits `json:"limits"`
353			Replace   bool             `json:"replace"`
354			Files     []FileSpec       `json:"files"`
355		}{"dev-local-files-manifest-v1", request.RequestID, request.Binding, request.Limits, request.Replace, request.Files}
356		return digestJSON(payload)
357	}
358
359	func planDigest(request PlanRequest, response PlanResponse) string {
360		files := append([]PlanFile(nil), response.Files...)
361		payload := struct {
362			Domain         string     `json:"domain"`
363			ManifestDigest string     `json:"manifest_digest"`
364			TargetMachine  string     `json:"target_machine_id"`
365			TargetCheckout string     `json:"target_checkout_id"`
366			Files          []PlanFile `json:"files"`
367		}{"dev-local-files-plan-v1", request.ManifestDigest, response.TargetMachine, response.TargetCheckout, files}
368		return digestJSON(payload)
369	}

371	func digestJSON(value any) string {
372		data, _ := json.Marshal(value)
373		digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
374		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
375	}
376
377	func digestBytes(value []byte) string {
378		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
379		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
380	}
381
382	func validDigest(value string) bool {
383		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != len("sha256:")+sha256.Size*2 {
384			return false
385		}
386		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"))
387		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size && value == strings.ToLower(value)
388	}
389
390	func validOID(value string) bool {
391		if len(value) != 40 && len(value) != 64 || value != strings.ToLower(value) {
392			return false
393		}
394		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
395		return err == nil
396	}
397
398	func validFileMode(value string) bool {
399		if len(value) != 4 {
400			return false
401		}
402		mode, err := strconv.ParseUint(value, 8, 12)
403		return err == nil && mode <= 0o777
404	}
405
406	func validateText(name, value string) error {
407		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
408			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
409		}
410		for _, r := range value {
411			if unicode.IsControl(r) {
412				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
413			}
414		}
415		return nil
416	}

420		sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].Path < result[j].Path })
421		return result
422	}

15	)
16
17	var ErrPlanBlocked = errors.New("portable-file plan is blocked")
18
19	type SourceOptions struct {
20		Checkout string
21		Binding  Binding
22		Patterns []Pattern
23		Limits   safefile.Limits
24		Replace  bool
25		// RequestID is a focused-test seam. Production leaves it empty.
26		RequestID string
27	}
28
29	// Source is an exact, content-addressed local manifest. It keeps no file bytes;
30	// BuildEnvelope reopens and rehashes each non-current source after target plan.
31	type Source struct {
32		checkout string
33		request  PlanRequest
34	}
35
36	func (s *Source) Request() PlanRequest { return s.request }
37
38	func PrepareSource(ctx context.Context, options SourceOptions) (*Source, Report, error) {
39		if err := options.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
40			return nil, Report{}, err
41		}
42		if err := options.Binding.Validate(); err != nil {
43			return nil, Report{}, err
44		}
45		paths, err := Expand(options.Checkout, options.Patterns, options.Limits)
46		if err != nil {
47			return nil, Report{}, err
48		}
49		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, options.Limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
50			return nil, Report{}, err
51		}
52		requestID := options.RequestID
53		if requestID == "" {
54			requestID = uuid.NewString()
55		}
56		request := PlanRequest{
57			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
58			RequestID: requestID, Binding: options.Binding, Limits: limitsToWire(options.Limits),
59			Replace: options.Replace,
60		}
61		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}
62		blocked := false
63		for _, path := range paths {
64			public := PublicFile{Path: path, Mode: "0600", State: StateFailed}
65			observed, observeErr := observePath(ctx, options.Checkout, path, options.Limits, true)
66			if observeErr != nil {
67				public.State = stateForError(observeErr)
68				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
69				blocked = true
70				continue
71			}
72			if !observed.exists {
73				public.State = StateMissing
74				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
75				blocked = true
76				continue
77			}
78			public.Size = observed.info.Size()
79			if observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0 {
80				public.Mode = "0700"
81			}
82			if eligibilityErr := proveGitEligibility(ctx, options.Checkout, path); eligibilityErr != nil {
83				public.State = stateForError(eligibilityErr)
84				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
85				blocked = true
86				continue
87			}
88			public.State = StateReady
89			report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
90			request.Files = append(request.Files, FileSpec{
91				Path: path, Size: observed.info.Size(), Mode: public.Mode, SHA256: observed.digest,
92			})
93		}
94		report.Files = sortedPublic(report.Files)
95		if blocked {
96			return nil, report, ErrPlanBlocked
97		}
98		sort.Slice(request.Files, func(i, j int) bool { return request.Files[i].Path < request.Files[j].Path })
99		request.ManifestDigest = manifestDigest(request)
100		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
101			return nil, report, err
102		}
103		return &Source{checkout: options.Checkout, request: request}, report, nil
104	}
105
106	// BuildEnvelope performs the source-side apply revalidation and includes bytes
107	// only for target actions that create or explicitly replace a file.
108	func (s *Source) BuildEnvelope(ctx context.Context, plan PlanResponse, retainForEvict bool) (ApplyEnvelope, error) {
109		if s == nil {
110			return ApplyEnvelope{}, errors.New("build local-files envelope from nil source")
111		}
112		if err := plan.Validate(s.request); err != nil {
113			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
114		}
115		envelope := ApplyEnvelope{
116			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
117			Request: s.request, Plan: plan, RetainForEvict: retainForEvict,
118		}
119		for index, planned := range plan.Files {
120			if planned.Action == actionCurrent {
121				continue
122			}
123			if planned.Action != actionCreate && planned.Action != actionReplace {
124				return ApplyEnvelope{}, ErrPlanBlocked
125			}
126			spec := s.request.Files[index]
127			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
128				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
129			}
130			observed, err := observePath(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path, s.request.SafeLimits(), true)
131			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 ||
132				(observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0) != spec.executable() {
133				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
134			}
135			envelope.Payloads = append(envelope.Payloads, Payload{
136				Path: spec.Path, Content: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(observed.data),
137			})
138		}
139		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
140			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
141		}
142		return envelope, nil
143	}
144
145	func (e ApplyEnvelope) Validate() error {
146		if e.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || e.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
147			return errors.New("unsupported local-files apply protocol")
148		}
149		if err := e.Request.Validate(); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		if err := e.Plan.Validate(e.Request); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		expected := map[string]FileSpec{}
156		for index, planned := range e.Plan.Files {
157			if planned.Action == actionCreate || planned.Action == actionReplace {
158				expected[e.Request.Files[index].Path] = e.Request.Files[index]
159			}
160		}
161		if len(e.Payloads) != len(expected) {
162			return errors.New("apply payload count does not match target actions")
163		}
164		seen := map[string]bool{}
165		var total int64
166		for index, payload := range e.Payloads {
167			if index > 0 && e.Payloads[index-1].Path >= payload.Path {
168				return errors.New("apply payload paths must be unique and sorted")
169			}
170			spec, ok := expected[payload.Path]
171			if !ok || seen[payload.Path] {
172				return fmt.Errorf("unexpected apply payload for %q", payload.Path)
173			}
174			seen[payload.Path] = true
175			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
176			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
177				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q is not canonical base64", payload.Path)
178			}
179			if int64(len(decoded)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(decoded) != spec.SHA256 {
180				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q does not match its manifest", payload.Path)
181			}
182			if int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes || int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxTotalBytes-total {
183				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q exceeds negotiated limits", payload.Path)
184			}
185			total += int64(len(decoded))
186		}
187		return nil
188	}
189
190	func stateForError(err error) State {
191		switch {
192		case errors.Is(err, ErrUnsafe), errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrUnsafeType), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrNotPortable), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrPathCollision):
193			return StateBlockedUnsafe
194		case errors.Is(err, ErrIneligible):
195			return StateBlockedIneligible
196		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
197			return StateMissing
198		default:
199			return StateFailed
200		}
201	}
202
203	func limitsToWire(limits safefile.Limits) fleet.FileLimits {
204		return fleet.FileLimits{
205			MaxFiles: limits.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: limits.MaxFileBytes,
206			MaxTotalBytes: limits.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: limits.MaxPathBytes,
207			MaxComponentBytes: limits.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: limits.MaxPathDepth,
208		}
209	}
210
211	// NegotiateLimits takes the lower value for every policy field and validates
212	// both sides against this binary's compiled ceilings.
213	func NegotiateLimits(local safefile.Limits, remote fleet.FileLimits) (safefile.Limits, error) {
214		if err := local.Validate(); err != nil {
215			return safefile.Limits{}, err
216		}
217		remoteLimits := safefile.Limits{
218			MaxFiles: remote.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: remote.MaxFileBytes,
219			MaxTotalBytes: remote.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: remote.MaxPathBytes,
220			MaxComponentBytes: remote.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: remote.MaxPathDepth,
221		}
222		if err := remoteLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
223			return safefile.Limits{}, err
224		}
225		result := safefile.Limits{
226			MaxFiles:          min(local.MaxFiles, remoteLimits.MaxFiles),
227			MaxFileBytes:      min(local.MaxFileBytes, remoteLimits.MaxFileBytes),
228			MaxTotalBytes:     min(local.MaxTotalBytes, remoteLimits.MaxTotalBytes),
229			MaxPathBytes:      min(local.MaxPathBytes, remoteLimits.MaxPathBytes),
230			MaxComponentBytes: min(local.MaxComponentBytes, remoteLimits.MaxComponentBytes),
231			MaxPathDepth:      min(local.MaxPathDepth, remoteLimits.MaxPathDepth),
232		}
233		return result, result.Validate()
234	}

101	func (s *Service) resolveTarget(ctx context.Context, binding Binding) (targetCheckout, error) {
102		if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
103			return targetCheckout{}, err
104		}
105		options := repo.DefaultOptions()
106		if s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth > 0 {
107			options.MaxDepth = s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth
108		}
109		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, s.Config.DiscoveryRoots(), options)
110		if err != nil {
111			return targetCheckout{}, err
112		}
113		type candidate struct {
114			path      string
115			commonDir string
116		}
117		var candidates []candidate
118		for _, repository := range repositories {
119			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
120				continue
121			}
122			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
123			if err != nil {
124				continue
125			}
126			matched, err := checkoutHasIdentity(ctx, gitRepo.Root, binding.RemoteIdentity)
127			if err != nil || !matched {
128				continue
129			}
130			candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: gitRepo.Root, commonDir: gitRepo.GitCommonDir})
131		}
132		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].commonDir < candidates[j].commonDir })
133		switch len(candidates) {
134		case 0:
135			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAbsent}
136		case 1:
137		default:
138			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAmbiguous}
139		}
140		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidates[0].path, binding.Branch)
141		if err != nil {
142			return targetCheckout{}, err
143		}
144		if !checkedOut || worktree.Bare || worktree.Prunable {
145			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetFetchedOnly}
146		}
147		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
148		if err != nil {
149			return targetCheckout{}, err
150		}
151		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
152		if err != nil {
153			return targetCheckout{}, err
154		}
155		if status.Detached || status.Branch != binding.Branch || head != binding.HeadOID || worktree.Head != binding.HeadOID {
156			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetStale}
157		}
158		checkout := targetCheckout{
159			root: worktree.Path, commonDir: candidates[0].commonDir,
160			identity: binding.RemoteIdentity, branch: binding.Branch, head: head,
161		}
162		checkout.id = digestJSON(struct {
163			Domain    string `json:"domain"`
164			CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
165			Root      string `json:"root"`
166			Branch    string `json:"branch"`
167			Head      string `json:"head"`
168		}{"dev-local-files-checkout-v1", checkout.commonDir, checkout.root, checkout.branch, checkout.head})
169		return checkout, nil
170	}

172	func checkoutHasIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, wanted string) (bool, error) {
173		names, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
174		if err != nil {
175			return false, err
176		}
177		for _, name := range strings.Fields(names) {
178			for _, kind := range []string{"--all"} {
179				urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", kind, name)
180				if err != nil {
181					continue
182				}
183				for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
184					if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
185						return true, nil
186					}
187				}
188			}
189			pushURLs, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--push", "--all", name)
190			if err == nil {
191				for _, raw := range strings.Split(pushURLs, "\n") {
192					if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
193						return true, nil
194					}
195				}
196			}
197		}
198		return false, nil
199	}

201	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
202		if s == nil {
203			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
204		}
205		if s.platform() == "windows" {
206			return PlanResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
207		}
208		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
209			return PlanResponse{}, err
210		}
211		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
212		if err != nil {
213			return PlanResponse{}, err
214		}
215		if id != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
216			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
217		}
218		hostLimits := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
219		if err := hostLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
220			return PlanResponse{}, err
221		}
222		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(hostLimits, request.Limits)
223		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
224			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("plan limits do not match target policy")
225		}
226		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, request.Binding)
227		if err != nil {
228			return PlanResponse{}, err
229		}
230		response := PlanResponse{
231			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
232			RequestID: request.RequestID, ManifestDigest: request.ManifestDigest,
233			TargetMachine: id, TargetCheckout: checkout.id,
234		}
235		for _, spec := range request.Files {
236			planned := PlanFile{PublicFile: spec.public(StateFailed)}
237			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
238				planned.State = stateForError(err)
239				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
240				continue
241			}
242			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, request.SafeLimits(), true)
243			if err != nil {
244				planned.State = stateForError(err)
245				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
246				continue
247			}
248			targetMode := ""
249			if observed.exists {
250				targetMode = fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm())
251			}
252			switch {
253			case !observed.exists:
254				planned.State, planned.Action = StateReady, actionCreate
255			case observed.digest == spec.SHA256 && targetMode == spec.Mode:
256				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateCurrent, actionCurrent, observed.digest, targetMode
257			case request.Replace:
258				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateReady, actionReplace, observed.digest, targetMode
259			default:
260				planned.State, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateBlockedConflict, observed.digest, targetMode
261			}
262			response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
263		}
264		response.PlanDigest = planDigest(request, response)
265		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
266			return PlanResponse{}, err
267		}
268		return response, nil
269	}

7		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/fleet"
8	)
9
10	var (
11		ErrNoRemoteDev     = errors.New("target does not provide a compatible dev protocol")
12		ErrUnreachable     = errors.New("target host is unreachable")
13		ErrRemoteTimeout   = errors.New("target protocol timed out")
14		ErrMachinePin      = errors.New("target machine ID does not match the configured host pin")
15		ErrMachineUnpinned = errors.New("mutating local-file apply requires host.machine_id")
16	)
17
18	type Runner interface {
19		RunWithOptions(context.Context, fleet.Host, []string, []byte, fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result
20	}
21
22	type Client struct{ Runner Runner }
23
24	func (c Client) run(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, maxResponse int64) ([]byte, error) {
25		if c.Runner == nil {
26			return nil, errors.New("local-files client has no fleet transport")
27		}
28		// Capability and plan are read-only. Apply is permanently bound to its
29		// request ID and plan digest by the target journal, so an authentication-only
30		// retry cannot duplicate an unbound mutation.
31		result := c.Runner.RunWithOptions(ctx, host, args, stdin, fleet.RunOptions{Retry: fleet.RetryAuthentication})
32		if int64(len(result.Stdout)) > maxResponse {
33			return nil, errors.New("target protocol response exceeded its bound")
34		}
35		if result.ExitCode == 0 && result.CaptureError == "" {
36			return result.Stdout, nil
37		}
38		switch {
39		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
40			return nil, ErrRemoteTimeout
41		case result.ExitCode == 127:
42			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
43		case result.ExitCode == 255:
44			return nil, ErrUnreachable
45		default:
46			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
47		}
48	}
49
50	func (c Client) Probe(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
51		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
52		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
53		if err != nil {
54			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
55		}
56		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_capability"}, body, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
57		if err != nil {
58			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
59		}
60		var response fleet.CapabilityResponse
61		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes, &response); err != nil {
62			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
63		}
64		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
65			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
66		}
67		if host.MachineID != "" && host.MachineID != response.MachineID {
68			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
69		}
70		if !response.Supported {
71			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, errors.New("target does not support local-file payloads")
72		}
73		return response, nil
74	}
75
76	func (c Client) Plan(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
77		if capability.MachineID != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
78			return PlanResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
79		}
80		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
81			return PlanResponse{}, err
82		}
83		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
84		if err != nil {
85			return PlanResponse{}, err
86		}
87		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-plan"}, body, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
88		if err != nil {
89			return PlanResponse{}, err
90		}
91		var response PlanResponse
92		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes, &response); err != nil {
93			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
94		}
95		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
96			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
97		}
98		return response, nil
99	}
100
101	func (c Client) Apply(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
102		if host.MachineID == "" {
103			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachineUnpinned
104		}
105		if host.MachineID != capability.MachineID || envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine != capability.MachineID {
106			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
107		}
108		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
109			return ApplyResponse{}, err
110		}
111		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(envelope, MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes)
112		if err != nil {
113			return ApplyResponse{}, err
114		}
115		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-apply"}, body, MaxApplyResponseBytes)
116		if err != nil {
117			return ApplyResponse{}, err
118		}
119		var response ApplyResponse
120		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxApplyResponseBytes, &response); err != nil {
121			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
122		}
123		if err := response.Validate(envelope.Request, envelope.Plan); err != nil {
124			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
125		}
126		return response, nil
127	}
