24	// Expand resolves validated project and --file patterns locally into a sorted,
25	// duplicate-free list of exact slash paths. It never follows links or descends
26	// into Git metadata, nested repositories, submodules, or dependency trees.
27	func Expand(root string, patterns []Pattern, limits safefile.Limits) ([]string, error) {
28		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
29			return nil, err
30		}
31		if len(patterns) == 0 {
32			return nil, errors.New("no local-file patterns were configured or passed with --file")
33		}
34		for _, pattern := range patterns {
35			if err := projectconfig.ValidateLocalFilePattern(pattern.Value); err != nil {
36				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s: %w", patternSource(pattern), err)
37			}
38			for _, component := range strings.Split(pattern.Value, "/") {
39				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
40					return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s enters dependency directory %q", patternSource(pattern), component)
41				}
42			}
43		}
44		rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(root)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect source checkout: %w", err)
47		}
48		if !rootInfo.IsDir() || rootInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
49			return nil, errors.New("source checkout is not a held regular directory")
50		}
51
52		matches := map[string]struct{}{}
53		matchedPatterns := make([]bool, len(patterns))
54		visited := 0
55		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
56			if walkErr != nil {
57				return walkErr
58			}
59			if filename == root {
60				return nil
61			}
62			visited++
63			if visited > maxWalkEntries {
64				return fmt.Errorf("source checkout exceeds %d entries while expanding local-file patterns", maxWalkEntries)
65			}
66			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, filename)
67			if err != nil {
68				return err
69			}
70			slash := filepath.ToSlash(relative)
71			components := strings.Split(slash, "/")
72			base := strings.ToLower(components[len(components)-1])
73			if entry.IsDir() {
74				if base == ".git" {
75					return filepath.SkipDir
76				}
77				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[base]; blocked {
78					for _, pattern := range patterns {
79						if matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
80							return fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern enters dependency directory %q", slash)
81						}
82					}
83					return filepath.SkipDir
84				}
85				if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(filename, ".git")); err == nil {
86					return filepath.SkipDir
87				} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
88					return fmt.Errorf("inspect nested repository boundary %s: %w", slash, err)
89				}
90			}
91			matched := false
92			for index, pattern := range patterns {
93				if !entry.IsDir() && matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
94					matchedPatterns[index] = true
95					matched = true
96				}
97			}
98			if matched {
99				matches[slash] = struct{}{}
100			}
101			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 && entry.IsDir() {
102				return filepath.SkipDir
103			}
104			return nil
105		})
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, err
108		}
109		for index, matched := range matchedPatterns {
110			if !matched {
111				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s matched no source path", patternSource(patterns[index]))
112			}
113		}
114		paths := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
115		for path := range matches {
116			paths = append(paths, path)
117		}
118		sort.Strings(paths)
119		if len(paths) > limits.MaxFiles {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("patterns expanded to %d paths; maximum is %d", len(paths), limits.MaxFiles)
121		}
122		return paths, nil
123	}
124
125	func patternSource(pattern Pattern) string {
126		if strings.TrimSpace(pattern.Source) == "" {
127			return "explicit input"
128		}
129		return pattern.Source
130	}
131
132	func matchPattern(pattern, candidate string) bool {
133		patternParts := strings.Split(pattern, "/")
134		candidateParts := strings.Split(candidate, "/")
135		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
136		memo := map[key]bool{}
137		seen := map[key]bool{}
138		var match func(int, int) bool
139		match = func(patternIndex, candidateIndex int) bool {
140			state := key{patternIndex, candidateIndex}
141			if seen[state] {
142				return memo[state]
143			}
144			seen[state] = true
145			var result bool
146			switch {
147			case patternIndex == len(patternParts):
148				result = candidateIndex == len(candidateParts)
149			case patternParts[patternIndex] == "**":
150				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex) ||
151					candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && match(patternIndex, candidateIndex+1)
152			case candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && matchComponent(patternParts[patternIndex], candidateParts[candidateIndex]):
153				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex+1)
154			}
155			memo[state] = result
156			return result
157		}
158		return match(0, 0)
159	}
160
161	func matchComponent(pattern, candidate string) bool {
162		p, c := []rune(pattern), []rune(candidate)
163		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
164		memo := map[key]bool{}
165		seen := map[key]bool{}
166		var match func(int, int) bool
167		match = func(pi, ci int) bool {
168			state := key{pi, ci}
169			if seen[state] {
170				return memo[state]
171			}
172			seen[state] = true
173			var result bool
174			switch {
175			case pi == len(p):
176				result = ci == len(c)
177			case p[pi] == '*':
178				result = match(pi+1, ci) || ci < len(c) && match(pi, ci+1)
179			case ci < len(c) && (p[pi] == '?' || p[pi] == c[ci]):
180				result = match(pi+1, ci+1)
181			}
182			memo[state] = result
183			return result
184		}
185		return match(0, 0)
186	}
187
188	func hasDependencyComponent(path string) bool {
189		for _, component := range strings.Split(path, "/") {
190			if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
191				return true
192			}
193		}
194		return false
195	}

16	var (
17		ErrUnsafe     = errors.New("portable file path is unsafe")
18		ErrIneligible = errors.New("portable file is not untracked and ignored")
19		ErrDrift      = errors.New("portable file checkout state changed")
20	)

22	type observation struct {
23		exists bool
24		info   fs.FileInfo
25		data   []byte
26		digest string
27	}
28
29	func observePath(ctx context.Context, checkout, slashPath string, limits safefile.Limits, read bool) (observation, error) {
30		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
31			return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("path %q: %w: %w", slashPath, err, ErrUnsafe)
32		}
33		if hasDependencyComponent(slashPath) {
34			return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("path %q enters a dependency directory: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe)
35		}
36		held, err := openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath, false)
37		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
38			return observation{exists: false}, nil
39		}
40		if err != nil {
41			return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("open path %q: %w: %w", slashPath, err, ErrUnsafe)
42		}
43		finish := func(result observation, operationErr error) (observation, error) {
44			closeErr := held.close()
45			if operationErr != nil {
46				return observation{}, errors.Join(operationErr, closeErr)
47			}
48			if closeErr != nil {
49				return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("verify held path %q: %w", slashPath, closeErr)
50			}
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		name := pathBase(slashPath)
54		info, err := held.parent.Lstat(name)
55		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
56			return finish(observation{exists: false}, nil)
57		}
58		if err != nil {
59			return finish(observation{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect path %q: %w", slashPath, err))
60		}
61		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
62			return finish(observation{}, fmt.Errorf("path %q is not a regular file: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe))
63		}
64		result := observation{exists: true, info: info}
65		if read {
66			data, stable, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, held.parent, name, info, limits.MaxFileBytes)
67			if err != nil {
68				return finish(observation{}, fmt.Errorf("read path %q: %w", slashPath, err))
69			}
70			result.info, result.data, result.digest = stable, data, digestBytes(data)
71		}
72		return finish(result, nil)
73	}
74
75	func proveGitEligibility(ctx context.Context, checkout, slashPath string) error {
76		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
77			return fmt.Errorf("path %q: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe)
78		}
79		literal := ":(literal)" + slashPath
80		tracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "ls-files", "-z", "--", literal)
81		if err != nil {
82			return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git tracking for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
83		}
84		if tracked != "" {
85			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is tracked: %w", slashPath, ErrIneligible)
86		}
87		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
88		for index := range components {
89			prefix := strings.Join(components[:index+1], "/")
90			staged, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z", "--", ":(literal)"+prefix)
91			if err != nil {
92				return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git mode for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
93			}
94			for _, record := range strings.Split(staged, "\x00") {
95				if strings.HasPrefix(record, "160000 ") {
96					return fmt.Errorf("path %q crosses a submodule: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe)
97				}
98			}
99		}
100		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "check-ignore", "--no-index", "--quiet", "--", slashPath)
101		if err == nil {
102			return nil
103		}
104		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
105		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 {
106			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is not ignored on this host: %w", slashPath, ErrIneligible)
107		}
108		return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git ignore status for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
109	}

27	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
28		if s == nil {
29			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
30		}
31		if s.platform() == "windows" {
32			return ApplyResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
33		}
34		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
35		if err != nil {
36			return ApplyResponse{}, err
37		}
38		// This check intentionally precedes envelope validation. The hidden command
39		// performs the same capability check before reading stdin at all.
40		if id != envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine {
41			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
42		}
43		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
44			return ApplyResponse{}, err
45		}
46		authority := s.Authority
47		if authority == nil {
48			authority = lease.New("")
49		}
50		key := lease.BranchKey(envelope.Request.Binding.RemoteIdentity, envelope.Request.Binding.Branch)
51		var response ApplyResponse
52		err = authority.WithMutation(ctx, []lease.Key{key}, func() error {
53			var applyErr error
54			response, applyErr = s.applyUnderLease(ctx, envelope)
55			return applyErr
56		})
57		return response, err
58	}

60	func (s *Service) applyUnderLease(ctx context.Context, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
61		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, envelope.Request.Binding)
62		if err != nil {
63			return ApplyResponse{}, err
64		}
65		if checkout.id != envelope.Plan.TargetCheckout {
66			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("target checkout changed after planning")
67		}
68		if err := s.validateNegotiatedLimits(envelope.Request); err != nil {
69			return ApplyResponse{}, err
70		}
71
72		store, exists, err := openOperationStore(s.StoreRoot, envelope.Request.RequestID)
73		if err != nil {
74			return ApplyResponse{}, err
75		}
76		var prior journal
77		if exists {
78			prior, err = store.loadJournal()
79			if err != nil {
80				return ApplyResponse{}, err
81			}
82			if prior.PlanDigest != envelope.Plan.PlanDigest || prior.ManifestDigest != envelope.Request.ManifestDigest ||
83				prior.RetainForEvict != envelope.RetainForEvict {
84				return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("local-files request ID is already bound to another apply")
85			}
86			if prior.Phase == phaseCompleted {

89			if prior.Phase == phaseApplying || prior.Phase == phaseReconcile {
90				if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &prior); err != nil {
91					prior.Phase = phaseReconcile
92					_ = store.writeJournal(prior)

94				}
95				prior.Phase = phaseRolledBack
96				if err := store.writeJournal(prior); err != nil {
97					return ApplyResponse{}, err
98				}
99			}
100			if prior.Phase == phaseRolledBack {
101				if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
102					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("prior rolled-back local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
103				}
104			}
105		}
106
107		files, missingDirs, err := preflightApply(ctx, checkout.root, envelope)
108		if err != nil {
109			return ApplyResponse{}, err
110		}
111		if store == nil || !exists {
112			store, err = newOperationStore(s.StoreRoot, envelope.Request.RequestID)
113			if err != nil {
114				return ApplyResponse{}, err
115			}
116		}
117		if err := store.ensureLayout(); err != nil {
118			return ApplyResponse{}, err
119		}
120		value := journal{
121			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, RequestID: envelope.Request.RequestID,
122			PlanDigest: envelope.Plan.PlanDigest, ManifestDigest: envelope.Request.ManifestDigest,
123			RetainForEvict: envelope.RetainForEvict, Phase: phaseStaged,
124			CreatedDirs: missingDirs,
125		}
126		for _, file := range files {
127			entry := journalFile{Path: file.spec.Path, Size: file.spec.Size, Mode: file.spec.Mode, Action: file.planned.Action, State: file.planned.State}
128			if entry.Action == actionReplace {
129				entry.OldSHA256 = file.before.digest
130				entry.OldMode = file.planned.TargetMode
131			}
132			value.Files = append(value.Files, entry)
133		}
134		if err := store.writeManifest(envelope); err != nil {
135			return ApplyResponse{}, err
136		}

138			if file.planned.Action != actionCurrent || envelope.RetainForEvict {
139				if err := store.writeBlob(store.blobPath(index), file.content, file.spec.executable()); err != nil {
140					return ApplyResponse{}, err
141				}
142			}
143			if file.planned.Action == actionReplace {
144				if err := store.writeBlob(store.rollbackPath(index), file.before.data, file.before.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0); err != nil {
145					return ApplyResponse{}, err
146				}
147			}
148		}
149		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
150			return ApplyResponse{}, err
151		}
152		if err := s.fault("after-stage", ""); err != nil {
153			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
154		}
155		value.Phase = phaseApplying
156		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
157			return ApplyResponse{}, err
158		}
159
160		for index, file := range files {
161			if file.planned.Action == actionCurrent {
162				value.Files[index].State = StateCurrent
163				continue
164			}
165			if err := s.fault("before-publish", file.spec.Path); err != nil {
166				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
167			}
168			parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, file.spec.Path, true)
169			if err != nil {
170				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
171			}
172			name := pathBase(file.spec.Path)
173			switch file.planned.Action {
174			case actionCreate:
175				_, err = safefile.CreatePrivateNoClobber(ctx, parent.parent, name, file.content, file.spec.executable())
176			case actionReplace:
177				_, err = safefile.AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx, parent.parent, name, file.before.info, file.content, file.spec.executable())
178			default:

180			}
181			closeErr := parent.close()
182			err = errors.Join(err, closeErr)
183			if err != nil {
184				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
185			}
186			if err := s.fault("after-publish", file.spec.Path); err != nil {
187				// The journal may not yet say Published. rollback infers publication

189				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
190			}

199			}

212			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
213		}
214		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(envelope.RetainForEvict); err != nil {
215			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("local-files apply completed but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
216		}
217		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
218	}

220	func (s *Service) validateNegotiatedLimits(request PlanRequest) error {
221		host := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
222		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(host, request.Limits)
223		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
224			return errors.New("apply limits do not match target policy")
225		}
226		return nil
227	}

229	func preflightApply(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope) ([]preflightFile, []string, error) {
230		payloads := map[string][]byte{}
231		for _, payload := range envelope.Payloads {
232			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
233			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
234				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("decode canonical payload for %q", payload.Path)
235			}
236			payloads[payload.Path] = decoded
237		}
238		files := make([]preflightFile, len(envelope.Request.Files))
239		missingSet := map[string]bool{}
240		for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
241			planned := envelope.Plan.Files[index]
242			if planned.Action == "" {
243				return nil, nil, ErrPlanBlocked
244			}
245			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
246				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
247			}
248			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
249			if err != nil {
250				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
251			}
252			file := preflightFile{spec: spec, planned: planned, before: observed}
253			switch planned.Action {
254			case actionCurrent:
255				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
256					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q is no longer current: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
257				}
258				file.content = observed.data
259			case actionCreate:
260				if observed.exists {
261					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q appeared after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
262				}
263				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
264			case actionReplace:
265				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != planned.TargetSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
266					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed before replacement: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
267				}
268				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
269			default:
270				return nil, nil, errors.New("invalid local-files target action")
271			}
272			if int64(len(file.content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(file.content) != spec.SHA256 {
273				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("content for %q no longer matches the plan", spec.Path)
274			}
275			missing, err := missingParentDirectories(checkout, spec.Path)
276			if err != nil {
277				return nil, nil, err
278			}
279			for _, directory := range missing {
280				missingSet[directory] = true
281			}
282			files[index] = file
283		}
284		missing := make([]string, 0, len(missingSet))
285		for directory := range missingSet {
286			missing = append(missing, directory)
287		}
288		sort.Strings(missing)
289		return files, missing, nil
290	}

292	func (s *Service) failAndRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal, cause error) error {
293		value.Phase = phaseReconcile
294		_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
295		if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, value); err != nil {
296			value.Phase = phaseReconcile
297			_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
298			return errors.New("local-files apply failed and requires reconciliation")
299		}
300		value.Phase = phaseRolledBack
301		for index := range value.Files {
302			if value.Files[index].Action != actionCurrent {
303				value.Files[index].State = StateRolledBack
304				value.Files[index].Published = false
305			}
306		}
307		if err := store.writeJournal(*value); err != nil {
308			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but journal finalization failed")
309		}
310		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
311			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
312		}
313		return fmt.Errorf("local-files apply failed and was rolled back: %w", cause)
314	}
315
316	func (s *Service) rollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal) error {
317		for index := len(value.Files) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
318			entry := &value.Files[index]
319			if entry.Action == actionCurrent {
320				continue
321			}
322			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
323			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
324				return err
325			}
326			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
327			if err != nil {
328				return err
329			}
330			switch entry.Action {
331			case actionCreate:
332				if !observed.exists {
333					continue
334				}
335				if observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
336					return errors.New("created target changed before rollback")
337				}
338				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
339				if err != nil {
340					return err
341				}
342				err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(spec.Path))
343				err = errors.Join(err, syncHeldRoot(parent.parent), parent.close())
344				if err != nil {
345					return err
346				}
347			case actionReplace:
348				if observed.exists && observed.digest == entry.OldSHA256 {
349					continue
350				}
351				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
352					return errors.New("replacement target changed before rollback")
353				}
354				oldContent, err := store.readBlob(index, true, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
355				if err != nil || digestBytes(oldContent) != entry.OldSHA256 {
356					return errors.New("replacement rollback blob is unavailable")
357				}
358				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
359				if err != nil {
360					return err
361				}
362				current, err := parent.parent.Lstat(pathBase(spec.Path))
363				oldMode, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(entry.OldMode, 8, 12)
364				err = errors.Join(err, modeErr)
365				if err == nil {
366					_, err = safefile.AtomicReplace(ctx, parent.parent, pathBase(spec.Path), current, oldContent, fs.FileMode(oldMode))
367				}
368				err = errors.Join(err, parent.close())
369				if err != nil {
370					return err
371				}
372			}
373		}
374		directories := append([]string(nil), value.CreatedDirs...)
375		sort.Slice(directories, func(i, j int) bool {
376			left, right := strings.Count(directories[i], "/"), strings.Count(directories[j], "/")
377			if left != right {
378				return left > right
379			}
380			return directories[i] > directories[j]
381		})
382		for _, directory := range directories {
383			if err := removeEmptyDirectory(checkout.root, directory); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
384				return err
385			}
386		}
387		return verifyRollback(ctx, checkout.root, envelope, *value)
388	}
389
390	func verifyRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope, value journal) error {
391		for index, entry := range value.Files {
392			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
393			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
394			if err != nil {
395				return err
396			}
397			switch entry.Action {
398			case actionCurrent:
399				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != envelope.Plan.Files[index].TargetMode {
400					return errors.New("current target changed during rollback")
401				}
402			case actionCreate:
403				if observed.exists {
404					return errors.New("created target remains after rollback")
405				}
406			case actionReplace:
407				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != entry.OldSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != entry.OldMode {
408					return errors.New("replacement target was not restored")
409				}
410			}
411		}
412		return nil
413	}
414
415	func (s *Service) verifyCompleted(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value journal) (ApplyResponse, error) {
416		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
417			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files journal no longer matches the checkout")
418		}
419		if value.RetainForEvict {
420			for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
421				content, err := store.readBlob(index, false, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
422				if err != nil || int64(len(content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(content) != spec.SHA256 {
423					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("retained local-files recovery blob is unavailable")
424				}
425			}
426		} else if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
427			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
428		}
429		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
430	}

432	func verifyAllCurrent(ctx context.Context, checkout string, specs []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
433		for _, spec := range specs {
434			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
435				return err
436			}
437			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, limits, true)
438			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size {
439				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q failed post-write verification", spec.Path)
440			}
441			if fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != spec.Mode {
442				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q permissions do not match the manifest", spec.Path)
443			}
444		}
445		return nil
446	}

448	func responseFromJournal(value journal) ApplyResponse {
449		files := make([]PublicFile, len(value.Files))
450		for index, entry := range value.Files {
451			files[index] = PublicFile{Path: entry.Path, Size: entry.Size, Mode: entry.Mode, State: entry.State}
452		}
453		return ApplyResponse{
454			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
455			RequestID: value.RequestID, PlanDigest: value.PlanDigest, Files: files,
456		}
457	}

466	type heldParent struct {
467		checkout string
468		rootInfo fs.FileInfo
469		root     *os.Root
470		parent   *os.Root
471		roots    []*os.Root
472		edges    []heldEdge
473	}
474
475	type heldEdge struct {
476		parent *os.Root
477		name   string
478		info   fs.FileInfo
479	}
480
481	func openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath string, create bool) (*heldParent, error) {
482		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
483			return nil, err
484		}
485		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
486		if err != nil {
487			return nil, err
488		}
489		held := &heldParent{checkout: checkout, rootInfo: rootInfo, root: root, parent: root, roots: []*os.Root{root}}
490		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
491		prefix := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1)
492		for _, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
493			prefix = append(prefix, component)
494			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
495			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
496				if err := held.parent.Mkdir(component, 0o700); err != nil {
497					_ = held.close()
498					return nil, err
499				}
500				child, info, err = safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
501			}
502			if err != nil {
503				_ = held.close()
504				return nil, err
505			}
506			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
507				_ = child.Close()
508				_ = held.close()
509				return nil, ErrUnsafe
510			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
511				_ = child.Close()
512				_ = held.close()
513				return nil, err
514			}
515			held.edges = append(held.edges, heldEdge{parent: held.parent, name: component, info: info})
516			held.roots = append(held.roots, child)
517			held.parent = child
518		}
519		return held, nil
520	}
521
522	func (h *heldParent) close() error {
523		if h == nil {
524			return nil
525		}
526		var result error
527		for index := len(h.edges) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
528			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(h.edges[index].parent, h.edges[index].name, h.edges[index].info))
529		}
530		result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyRoot(h.checkout, h.rootInfo))
531		for index := len(h.roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
532			result = errors.Join(result, h.roots[index].Close())
533		}
534		h.roots = nil
535		return result
536	}
537
538	func syncHeldRoot(root *os.Root) error {
539		file, err := root.Open(".")
540		if err != nil {
541			return err
542		}
543		defer file.Close()
544		return file.Sync()
545	}
546
547	func missingParentDirectories(checkout, slashPath string) ([]string, error) {
548		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
549		root, _, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
550		if err != nil {
551			return nil, err
552		}
553		roots := []*os.Root{root}
554		defer func() {
555			for index := len(roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
556				_ = roots[index].Close()
557			}
558		}()
559		current := root
560		for index, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
561			child, _, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(current, component)
562			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
563				missing := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1-index)
564				for end := index + 1; end < len(components); end++ {
565					missing = append(missing, strings.Join(components[:end], "/"))
566				}
567				return missing, nil
568			}
569			if err != nil {
570				return nil, err
571			}
572			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
573				_ = child.Close()
574				return nil, ErrUnsafe
575			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
576				_ = child.Close()
577				return nil, err
578			}
579			roots = append(roots, child)
580			current = child
581		}
582		return nil, nil
583	}
584
585	func removeEmptyDirectory(checkout, slashPath string) error {
586		parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath, false)
587		if err != nil {
588			return err
589		}
590		err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(slashPath))
591		return errors.Join(err, parent.close())
592	}
593
594	func pathBase(slashPath string) string {
595		parts := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
596		return parts[len(parts)-1]
597	}

126		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(data, 2<<20, &value); err != nil {

135	func validateJournal(value journal) error {
136		if value.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || value.RequestID == "" || !validDigest(value.PlanDigest) || !validDigest(value.ManifestDigest) {
137			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal binding")
138		}
139		switch value.Phase {
140		case phaseStaged, phaseApplying, phaseCompleted, phaseRolledBack, phaseReconcile:
141		default:
142			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal phase")
143		}
144		for index, file := range value.Files {
145			if index > 0 && value.Files[index-1].Path >= file.Path {
146				return errors.New("local-files journal paths are not sorted")
147			}
148			switch file.Action {
149			case actionCurrent, actionCreate, actionReplace:
150			default:
151				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid action")
152			}
153			if !file.State.validResult() {
154				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid result state")
155			}
156			if file.Size < 0 || file.Mode != "0600" && file.Mode != "0700" {
157				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid public metadata")
158			}
159			if file.Action == actionReplace && (!validDigest(file.OldSHA256) || !validFileMode(file.OldMode)) {
160				return errors.New("local-files replacement journal lacks rollback binding")
161			}
162		}
163		if !sort.StringsAreSorted(value.CreatedDirs) {
164			return errors.New("local-files journal directories are not sorted")
165		}
166		return nil
167	}

189	func (s *operationStore) writeBlob(filename string, content []byte, executable bool) error {
190		if existing, err := readPrivateFile(filename, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes); err == nil {
191			if digestBytes(existing) != digestBytes(content) {
192				return errors.New("existing local-files blob does not match operation")
193			}
194			return nil
195		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
196			return err

198		parentPath := filepath.Dir(filename)
199		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(parentPath)
200		if err != nil {
201			return err

29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}

44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}

49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}

55			_ = root.Close()

58			}

60		}

206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}

215		return SameFileState(left, right) && samePlatformState(left, right)

218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}

32	// applies finalMode, and atomically hard-links it to the absent destination.
33	// The hard-link publication is same-directory and cannot replace an existing
34	// path. This generic helper exists so callers such as repotemplate can preserve
35	// intentional public modes; secret-bearing callers should use
36	// CreatePrivateNoClobber.
37	func CreateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {

88	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
89	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
90	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
91	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
92	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.

215			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
216		}
217		return nil
218	}
219
220	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
221		for len(data) > 0 {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return err
224			}
225			written, err := writer.Write(data)
226			if err != nil {
227				return err
228			}
229			if written == 0 {
230				return io.ErrShortWrite
231			}
232			data = data[written:]
233		}
234		return context.Cause(ctx)
235	}
236
237	func randomStageName() (string, error) {
238		var random [16]byte
239		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
240			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
241		}
242		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
243	}

8	)

10	const (
11		// CompiledMaxFiles is the maximum number of portable files accepted by one
12		// operation. Runtime policy may lower, but never raise, this ceiling.
13		CompiledMaxFiles = 128
14		// CompiledMaxFileBytes is the maximum size of one portable file.
15		CompiledMaxFileBytes int64 = 8 << 20
16		// CompiledMaxTotalBytes is the maximum aggregate portable payload size.
17		CompiledMaxTotalBytes int64 = 32 << 20
18		// CompiledMaxPathBytes bounds a slash-separated portable relative path.
19		CompiledMaxPathBytes = 4096
20		// CompiledMaxComponentBytes bounds one portable path component.
21		CompiledMaxComponentBytes = 255
22		// CompiledMaxPathDepth bounds portable path nesting.
23		CompiledMaxPathDepth = 64
24	)
25
26	var (
27		// ErrInvalidLimits reports a zero, negative, or above-ceiling policy.
28		ErrInvalidLimits = errors.New("invalid safe-file limits")
29		// ErrManifestLimit reports a manifest that exceeds its validated policy.
30		ErrManifestLimit = errors.New("safe-file manifest limit exceeded")
31		// ErrDuplicatePath reports the same exact portable path more than once.
32		ErrDuplicatePath = errors.New("duplicate safe-file path")
33	)
34
35	// Limits is the reusable compiled policy for portable file manifests. Every
36	// field is required and must be no greater than the corresponding compiled
37	// ceiling, allowing host configuration to lower limits without weakening them.
38	type Limits struct {
39		MaxFiles          int
40		MaxFileBytes      int64
41		MaxTotalBytes     int64
42		MaxPathBytes      int
43		MaxComponentBytes int
44		MaxPathDepth      int
45	}
46
47	// DefaultLimits returns the maximum policy supported by this binary.
48	func DefaultLimits() Limits {
49		return Limits{
50			MaxFiles:          CompiledMaxFiles,
51			MaxFileBytes:      CompiledMaxFileBytes,
52			MaxTotalBytes:     CompiledMaxTotalBytes,
53			MaxPathBytes:      CompiledMaxPathBytes,
54			MaxComponentBytes: CompiledMaxComponentBytes,
55			MaxPathDepth:      CompiledMaxPathDepth,
56		}
57	}
58
59	// Validate rejects incomplete policy and values above the compiled ceilings.
60	func (limits Limits) Validate() error {
61		maximum := DefaultLimits()
62		switch {
63		case limits.MaxFiles <= 0 || limits.MaxFiles > maximum.MaxFiles:
64			return fmt.Errorf("max files %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxFiles, maximum.MaxFiles, ErrInvalidLimits)
65		case limits.MaxFileBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxFileBytes > maximum.MaxFileBytes:
66			return fmt.Errorf("max file bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxFileBytes, maximum.MaxFileBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
67		case limits.MaxTotalBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxTotalBytes > maximum.MaxTotalBytes:
68			return fmt.Errorf("max total bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxTotalBytes, maximum.MaxTotalBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
69		case limits.MaxPathBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxPathBytes > maximum.MaxPathBytes:
70			return fmt.Errorf("max path bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxPathBytes, maximum.MaxPathBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
71		case limits.MaxComponentBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes > maximum.MaxComponentBytes:
72			return fmt.Errorf("max component bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxComponentBytes, maximum.MaxComponentBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
73		case limits.MaxPathDepth <= 0 || limits.MaxPathDepth > maximum.MaxPathDepth:
74			return fmt.Errorf("max path depth %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxPathDepth, maximum.MaxPathDepth, ErrInvalidLimits)
75		default:
76			return nil
77		}
78	}
79
80	// PathLimits projects the filesystem path portion of a validated policy.
81	func (limits Limits) PathLimits() pathx.PortablePathLimits {
82		return pathx.PortablePathLimits{
83			MaxPathBytes:      limits.MaxPathBytes,
84			MaxComponentBytes: limits.MaxComponentBytes,
85			MaxDepth:          limits.MaxPathDepth,
86		}
87	}
88
89	// Metadata is the content-free portion of one portable regular file used for
90	// validating counts, sizes, paths, and collisions before any bytes are opened.
91	type Metadata struct {
92		Path string
93		Size int64
94	}
95
96	// ValidateManifest enforces a validated limits policy over the complete file
97	// set, including exact duplicates and portable case/normalization collisions.
98	func ValidateManifest(files []Metadata, limits Limits) error {
99		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
100			return err
101		}
102		if len(files) > limits.MaxFiles {
103			return fmt.Errorf("manifest has %d files; maximum is %d: %w", len(files), limits.MaxFiles, ErrManifestLimit)
104		}
105		paths := make([]string, 0, len(files))
106		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(files))
107		var total int64
108		for _, file := range files {
109			if file.Size < 0 {
110				return fmt.Errorf("file %q has negative size: %w", file.Path, ErrManifestLimit)
111			}
112			if file.Size > limits.MaxFileBytes {
113				return fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", file.Path, file.Size, limits.MaxFileBytes, ErrManifestLimit)
114			}
115			if _, exists := seen[file.Path]; exists {
116				return fmt.Errorf("path %q appears more than once: %w", file.Path, ErrDuplicatePath)
117			}
118			seen[file.Path] = struct{}{}
119			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
120			if file.Size > limits.MaxTotalBytes-total {
121				return fmt.Errorf("manifest exceeds %d total bytes: %w", limits.MaxTotalBytes, ErrManifestLimit)
122			}
123			total += file.Size
124		}
125		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
126			return err
127		}
128		return nil
129	}

1	// Package lease provides cooperative, durable repository operation fencing.
2	// Its default authority lives in private XDG state, outside repository roots.
3	package lease
4
5	import (
6		"errors"
7		"fmt"
8		"regexp"

16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/machineid"
17	)
18
19	const SchemaVersion = 1
20
21	type Scope string
22
23	const (
24		ScopeRepository Scope = "repository"
25		ScopeBranch     Scope = "branch"
26	)
27
28	type Key struct {
29		Repository string `json:"repository"`
30		Scope      Scope  `json:"scope"`
31		Branch     string `json:"branch,omitempty"`
32	}
33
34	type Request struct {
35		OperationID string `json:"operation_id"`
36		Digest      string `json:"digest"`
37		MachineID   string `json:"machine_id,omitempty"`
38	}
39
40	// Binding permanently associates an idempotency ID with one manifest digest.
41	type Binding struct {
42		OperationID string `json:"operation_id"`
43		Digest      string `json:"digest"`
44	}
45
46	type Token struct {
47		OperationID string `json:"operation_id"`
48		Digest      string `json:"digest"`
49		Epoch       uint64 `json:"epoch"`
50	}
51
52	type Claim struct {
53		Token     Token     `json:"token"`
54		MachineID string    `json:"machine_id,omitempty"`
55		CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
56	}
57
58	type TombstoneKind string
59
60	const (
61		TombstoneAborted  TombstoneKind = "aborted"
62		TombstoneReturned TombstoneKind = "returned"
63	)
64
65	type Tombstone struct {
66		Kind          TombstoneKind `json:"kind"`
67		Token         Token         `json:"token"`
68		AdvancedEpoch uint64        `json:"advanced_epoch"`
69		CreatedAt     time.Time     `json:"created_at"`
70	}
71
72	// Record is the durable state for one canonical operation key. At most one of
73	// Reservation and Fence can be active.
74	type Record struct {
75		Key         Key         `json:"key"`
76		Epoch       uint64      `json:"epoch"`
77		Reservation *Claim      `json:"reservation,omitempty"`
78		Fence       *Claim      `json:"fence,omitempty"`
79		Tombstones  []Tombstone `json:"tombstones,omitempty"`
80	}
81
82	type Snapshot struct {
83		SchemaVersion int       `json:"schema_version"`
84		LastEpoch     uint64    `json:"last_epoch"`
85		Bindings      []Binding `json:"bindings"`
86		Records       []Record  `json:"records"`
87	}
88
89	var (
90		ErrBlocked       = errors.New("operation lease blocked")
91		ErrConflict      = errors.New("operation lease conflict")
92		ErrEpochMismatch = errors.New("operation lease epoch mismatch")
93		ErrReturned      = errors.New("operation lease token is terminal")
94
95		operationIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)
96	)
97
98	type BlockedError struct {
99		Key         Key
100		Kind        string
101		OperationID string
102	}
103
104	func (e *BlockedError) Error() string {
105		return fmt.Sprintf("%s lease for %s is blocked by %s operation %s", e.Key.Scope, e.Key.subject(), e.Kind, e.OperationID)
106	}
107
108	func (e *BlockedError) Unwrap() error { return ErrBlocked }
109
110	func RepositoryKey(repository string) Key {
111		return Key{Repository: repository, Scope: ScopeRepository}
112	}
113
114	func BranchKey(repository, branch string) Key {
115		return Key{Repository: repository, Scope: ScopeBranch, Branch: branch}
116	}
117
118	func (k Key) Validate() error {
119		if err := validateIdentity("repository identity", k.Repository); err != nil {
120			return err
121		}
122		switch k.Scope {
123		case ScopeRepository:
124			if k.Branch != "" {
125				return errors.New("repository lease key must not name a branch")
126			}
127		case ScopeBranch:
128			if err := validateIdentity("branch", k.Branch); err != nil {
129				return err
130			}
131		default:
132			return fmt.Errorf("unknown lease scope %q", k.Scope)
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
137	func (k Key) canonical() string {
138		// Length prefixes keep arbitrary valid identities unambiguous.
139		return fmt.Sprintf("%08x:%s:%s:%08x:%s", len(k.Repository), k.Repository, k.Scope, len(k.Branch), k.Branch)
140	}
141
142	func (k Key) subject() string {
143		if k.Scope == ScopeBranch {
144			return k.Repository + " branch " + k.Branch
145		}
146		return k.Repository
147	}
148
149	func (r Request) Validate() error {
150		if !operationIDPattern.MatchString(r.OperationID) {
151			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation id %q", r.OperationID)
152		}
153		if !assessment.ValidFingerprint(r.Digest) {
154			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has invalid digest %q", r.OperationID, r.Digest)
155		}
156		if r.MachineID != "" {
157			if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
158				return err
159			}
160		}
161		return nil
162	}
163
164	func (b Binding) Validate() error {
165		return (Request{OperationID: b.OperationID, Digest: b.Digest}).Validate()
166	}
167
168	func (t Token) Validate() error {
169		if err := (Request{OperationID: t.OperationID, Digest: t.Digest}).Validate(); err != nil {
170			return err
171		}
172		if t.Epoch == 0 {
173			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has zero lease epoch", t.OperationID)
174		}
175		return nil
176	}
177
178	func (t Token) matches(other Token) bool {
179		return t.OperationID == other.OperationID && t.Digest == other.Digest && t.Epoch == other.Epoch
180	}
181
182	func (t Token) sameOperation(request Request) bool {
183		return t.OperationID == request.OperationID && t.Digest == request.Digest
184	}
185
186	// CanonicalKeys validates, deduplicates, and sorts keys in the one order used
187	// by every multi-key acquisition.
188	func CanonicalKeys(keys []Key) ([]Key, error) {
189		if len(keys) == 0 {
190			return nil, errors.New("operation lease requires at least one key")
191		}
192		unique := make(map[string]Key, len(keys))
193		for _, key := range keys {
194			if err := key.Validate(); err != nil {
195				return nil, err
196			}
197			unique[key.canonical()] = key
198		}
199		canonical := make([]Key, 0, len(unique))
200		for _, key := range unique {
201			canonical = append(canonical, key)
202		}
203		sort.Slice(canonical, func(i, j int) bool { return canonical[i].canonical() < canonical[j].canonical() })
204		return canonical, nil
205	}
206
207	func validateIdentity(name, value string) error {
208		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
209			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
210		}
211		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
212			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
213		}
214		for _, char := range value {
215			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
216				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
217			}
218		}
219		return nil
220	}
221

23	const stateFilename = "authority.json"

25	type Authority struct {
26		root  string
27		clock func() time.Time
28	}
29
30	func DefaultRoot() string {
31		return filepath.Join(devconfig.DataHome(), "dev", "leases", "v1")
32	}
33
34	func New(root string) *Authority {
35		if root == "" {
36			root = DefaultRoot()
37		}
38		if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root); err == nil {
39			root = absolute
40		}
41		return &Authority{root: filepath.Clean(root), clock: time.Now}
42	}
43
44	func (a *Authority) Root() string {
45		if a == nil {
46			return ""
47		}
48		return a.root
49	}
50
51	// Reserve creates a blocking pre-publication claim. Repeating the exact
52	// operation and key set is idempotent; reusing an operation ID with a different
53	// digest is a conflict.
54	func (a *Authority) Reserve(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, request Request) (Token, error) {
55		return a.activate(ctx, keys, request, false)
56	}
57
58	// Fence drains existing cooperative guards and durably prevents new ordinary
59	// mutations. It can promote an exact reservation or create a direct fence.
60	func (a *Authority) Fence(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, request Request) (Token, error) {
61		return a.activate(ctx, keys, request, true)
62	}
63
64	func (a *Authority) activate(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, request Request, fence bool) (Token, error) {
65		if a == nil {
66			return Token{}, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
67		}
68		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
69			return Token{}, err
70		}
71		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
72		if err != nil {
73			return Token{}, err
74		}
75		var result Token
76		err = a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func([]Key) error {
77			return a.updateState(ctx, func(state *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
78				if err := checkOperationReuse(*state, claimed, request); err != nil {
79					return false, err
80				}
81				bindingAdded := ensureBinding(state, request)
82				if err := checkHierarchyClaims(*state, claimed, request); err != nil {
83					return false, err
84				}
85				canonical := claimed
86
87				claims := make([]*Claim, len(canonical))
88				claimKinds := make([]string, len(canonical))
89				for index, key := range canonical {
90					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
91					if record == nil {
92						continue
93					}
94					switch {
95					case record.Reservation != nil:
96						claims[index], claimKinds[index] = record.Reservation, "reservation"
97					case record.Fence != nil:
98						claims[index], claimKinds[index] = record.Fence, "fence"
99					}
100				}
101
102				allSameKind := true
103				var existing Token
104				for index, claim := range claims {
105					wantedKind := "reservation"
106					if fence {
107						wantedKind = "fence"
108					}
109					if claim == nil || claimKinds[index] != wantedKind || !claim.Token.sameOperation(request) || claim.MachineID != request.MachineID {
110						allSameKind = false
111						break
112					}
113					if index == 0 {
114						existing = claim.Token
115					} else if !existing.matches(claim.Token) {
116						return false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s has inconsistent epochs: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
117					}
118				}
119				if allSameKind {
120					result = existing
121					return bindingAdded, nil
122				}
123
124				promoteReservation := fence
125				anyClaim := false
126				for index, claim := range claims {
127					if claim == nil {
128						promoteReservation = false
129						continue
130					}
131					anyClaim = true
132					if claimKinds[index] != "reservation" || !claim.Token.sameOperation(request) || claim.MachineID != request.MachineID {
133						return false, blockedOrConflict(canonical[index], claimKinds[index], *claim, request)
134					}
135				}
136				if anyClaim && !promoteReservation {
137					return false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s only owns part of the requested key set: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
138				}
139
140				epoch, err := allocateEpoch(state)
141				if err != nil {
142					return false, err
143				}
144				result = Token{OperationID: request.OperationID, Digest: request.Digest, Epoch: epoch}
145				now := canonicalTime(a.clock())
146				for _, key := range canonical {
147					record := ensureRecord(state, key)
148					record.Epoch = epoch
149					claim := &Claim{Token: result, MachineID: request.MachineID, CreatedAt: now}
150					if fence {
151						record.Reservation = nil
152						record.Fence = claim
153					} else {
154						record.Reservation = claim
155						record.Fence = nil
156					}
157				}
158				return true, nil
159			})
160		})
161		return result, err
162	}
163
164	// ReleaseReservation clears an exact reservation and advances the authority
165	// epoch. It is non-terminal; AbortReservation should be used for a terminal
166	// pre-fence cancellation.
167	func (a *Authority) ReleaseReservation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token) (uint64, error) {
168		return a.finishClaim(ctx, keys, token, "reservation", "")
169	}
170
171	// AbortReservation clears an exact reservation and retains a permanent
172	// terminal tombstone so delayed prepare replays cannot recreate it.
173	func (a *Authority) AbortReservation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token) (uint64, error) {
174		return a.finishClaim(ctx, keys, token, "reservation", TombstoneAborted)
175	}
176
177	// Return clears an exact fence and retains a permanent terminal tombstone so
178	// delayed accepts carrying the old epoch fail closed.
179	func (a *Authority) Return(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token) (uint64, error) {
180		return a.finishClaim(ctx, keys, token, "fence", TombstoneReturned)
181	}
182
183	func (a *Authority) finishClaim(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token, claimKind string, terminal TombstoneKind) (uint64, error) {
184		if a == nil {
185			return 0, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
186		}
187		if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
188			return 0, err
189		}
190		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
191		if err != nil {
192			return 0, err
193		}
194		var advanced uint64
195		err = a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func([]Key) error {
196			return a.updateState(ctx, func(state *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
197				canonical := claimed
198				if terminal != "" {
199					if epoch, found, err := matchingTerminal(*state, canonical, token, terminal); err != nil {
200						return false, err
201					} else if found {
202						advanced = epoch
203						return false, nil
204					}
205				}
206				if err := validateClaimKeySet(*state, canonical, token, claimKind); err != nil {
207					return false, err
208				}
209				for _, key := range canonical {
210					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
211					if record == nil {
212						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s has no active %s: %w", key.subject(), claimKind, ErrEpochMismatch)
213					}
214					var claim *Claim
215					if claimKind == "reservation" {
216						claim = record.Reservation
217					} else {
218						claim = record.Fence
219					}
220					if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
221						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s does not hold operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
222					}
223				}
224				epoch, err := allocateEpoch(state)
225				if err != nil {
226					return false, err
227				}
228				advanced = epoch
229				now := canonicalTime(a.clock())
230				for _, key := range canonical {
231					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
232					record.Epoch = epoch
233					if claimKind == "reservation" {
234						record.Reservation = nil
235					} else {
236						record.Fence = nil
237					}
238					if terminal != "" {
239						record.Tombstones = append(record.Tombstones, Tombstone{Kind: terminal, Token: token, AdvancedEpoch: epoch, CreatedAt: now})

241				}
242				return true, nil
243			})
244		})
245		return advanced, err
246	}
247
248	// WithMutation runs an ordinary mutator only when no requested key is reserved
249	// or fenced. A branch key automatically includes its repository ancestor so a
250	// repository fence covers every branch. The locks remain held until operation
251	// returns.
252	func (a *Authority) WithMutation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func() error) error {
253		return a.WithGuard(ctx, keys, nil, operation)
254	}
255
256	// WithGuard permits the exact owner of an active reservation or fence to work
257	// while rejecting stale, returned, and mismatched tokens. A nil token is an
258	// ordinary mutation guard and includes repository ancestors. It is
259	// non-reentrant: operation must not reacquire an overlapping key.
260	func (a *Authority) WithGuard(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token *Token, operation func() error) error {
261		if a == nil {
262			return errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
263		}
264		if operation == nil {
265			return errors.New("operation lease guard requires an operation")
266		}
267		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool)
272		if token != nil {
273			if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
274				return err
275			}
276		} else {
277			for _, key := range claimed {
278				if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
279					repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
280				}
281			}
282		}
283		return a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func(locked []Key) error {
284			checked := locked
285			if token != nil {
286				// Repository ancestors participate in draining but are not part of a
287				// branch-scoped token's ownership claim.
288				checked = claimed
289			}
290			if err := a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
291				matched := 0
292				for _, key := range checked {
293					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
294					if record == nil {
295						if token != nil {
296							return fmt.Errorf("%s has no operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
297						}
298						continue
299					}
300					if token != nil && hasTerminal(*record, *token) {
301						return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrReturned)
302					}
303					claim, kind := activeClaim(*record)
304					if claim == nil {
305						if token != nil {
306							return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is no longer active on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrEpochMismatch)
307						}
308						continue
309					}
310					if token == nil || !claim.Token.matches(*token) {
311						return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
312					}
313					matched++
314				}
315				if token != nil && matched != len(checked) {
316					return fmt.Errorf("operation %s does not own the complete key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrEpochMismatch)
317				}
318				if token != nil {
319					if err := validateGuardKeySet(state, claimed, *token); err != nil {
320						return err
321					}
322				}
323				if token == nil {
324					for _, record := range state.Records {
325						if record.Key.Scope != ScopeBranch || !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
326							continue
327						}
328						if claim, kind := activeClaim(record); claim != nil {
329							return &BlockedError{Key: record.Key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
330						}
331					}
332				}
333				return nil
334			}); err != nil {
335				return err
336			}
337			return operation()
338		})
339	}
340
341	// Inspect returns records for the requested keys while holding those key locks.
342	// Untouched keys are represented with Epoch zero and are never persisted.
343	func (a *Authority) Inspect(ctx context.Context, keys []Key) ([]Record, error) {
344		if a == nil {
345			return nil, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
346		}
347		var result []Record
348		err := a.withKeyLocks(ctx, keys, func(canonical []Key) error {
349			return a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
350				result = make([]Record, 0, len(canonical))
351				for _, key := range canonical {
352					if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
353						result = append(result, cloneRecord(*record))
354					} else {
355						result = append(result, Record{Key: key})
356					}
357				}
358				return nil
359			})
360		})
361		return result, err
362	}
363
364	func mutationKeys(keys []Key) []Key {
365		expanded := append([]Key(nil), keys...)
366		for _, key := range keys {
367			if key.Scope == ScopeBranch {
368				expanded = append(expanded, RepositoryKey(key.Repository))
369			}
370		}
371		return expanded
372	}
373
374	func (a *Authority) withKeyLocks(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func([]Key) error) error {
375		canonical, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
376		if err != nil {
377			return err
378		}
379		if ctx == nil {
380			ctx = context.Background()
381		}
382		if err := a.ensureLayout(); err != nil {
383			return err
384		}
385		var acquire func(int) error
386		acquire = func(index int) error {
387			if index == len(canonical) {
388				return operation(canonical)
389			}
390			directory := a.keyLockDir(canonical[index])
391			if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
392				return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation key lock: %w", err)
393			}
394			return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease key", func() error { return acquire(index + 1) })
395		}
396		return acquire(0)
397	}
398
399	func (a *Authority) updateState(ctx context.Context, mutate func(*Snapshot) (bool, error)) error {
400		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
401			state, err := a.loadState()
402			if err != nil {
403				return err
404			}
405			changed, err := mutate(&state)
406			if err != nil || !changed {
407				return err
408			}
409			return a.writeState(state)
410		})
411	}
412
413	func (a *Authority) readState(ctx context.Context, read func(Snapshot) error) error {
414		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
415			state, err := a.loadState()
416			if err != nil {
417				return err
418			}
419			return read(state)
420		})
421	}
422
423	func (a *Authority) withStateLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
424		directory := filepath.Join(a.root, ".authority")
425		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
426			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation authority lock: %w", err)
427		}
428		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease authority", operation)
429	}
430
431	func (a *Authority) ensureLayout() error {
432		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
433			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation lease root: %w", err)
434		}
435		if err := ensurePrivateDir(filepath.Join(a.root, ".keys")); err != nil {
436			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation lease key root: %w", err)
437		}
438		return nil
439	}

441	func (a *Authority) keyLockDir(key Key) string {
442		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(key.canonical()))
443		return filepath.Join(a.root, ".keys", hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]))
444	}

448	func (a *Authority) loadState() (Snapshot, error) {
449		path := a.statePath()
450		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
451		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {

460		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
461		if err != nil {

463		}
464		if !private {
465			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
466		}
467		file, err := os.Open(path)
468		if err != nil {
469			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("open operation lease state: %w", err)
470		}
471		defer file.Close()
472		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
473		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
474		var state Snapshot
475		if err := decoder.Decode(&state); err != nil {
476			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state: %w", err)
477		}
478		var extra any
479		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
480			if err == nil {
481				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("decode operation lease state: multiple JSON values")
482			}
483			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state trailing data: %w", err)
484		}
485		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
486			return Snapshot{}, err
487		}
488		canonical := canonicalSnapshot(state)
489		encodedState, _ := json.Marshal(state)
490		encodedCanonical, _ := json.Marshal(canonical)
491		if string(encodedState) != string(encodedCanonical) {
492			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("operation lease state is not in canonical order")
493		}
494		return state, nil
495	}
