47	func assessCheckout(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
48		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
49			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the selected checkout is absent from the local inventory", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
50		}
51		checkout := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex]
52		switch {
53		case checkout.Worktree.Bare || context.Repo.Bare:
54			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
55		case checkout.PathErr != nil:
56			return indeterminate("checkout-path-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path could not be inspected", "restore path access and rerun context")
57		case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
58			return blocked("checkout-missing", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path is missing or prunable", "repair or remove the stale worktree registration")
59		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
60			return indeterminate("checkout-status-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "Git status could not be collected", "repair the checkout and rerun context")
61		case checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached || checkout.Branch() == "":
62			return blocked("checkout-detached", "selected-checkout", "the checkout does not have an attached branch", "check out an explicit branch")
63		case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
64			return blocked("checkout-conflicted", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d unmerged path(s)", checkout.Status.Conflicted), "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement")
65		case checkout.Status.Dirty():
66			return blocked("checkout-dirty", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d changed path(s)", checkout.Status.Changed), "commit or deliberately preserve the changes")
67		default:
68			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
69		}
70	}
71
72	func assessTasks(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) Readiness {
73		if context.TaskErr != nil {
74			return indeterminate("task-inventory-unavailable", "task-inventory", "task records could not be collected", "repair the task store and rerun context")
75		}
76		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
77			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "task scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
78		}
79		tracked := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Tasks
80		active := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(tracked))
81		for _, candidate := range tracked {
82			if candidate != nil && candidate.State != task.Done {
83				active = append(active, candidate)
84			}
85		}
86		if len(active) == 0 {
87			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
88		}
89		var reasons []assessment.Reason
90		hasIndeterminate := false
91		for _, candidate := range active {
92			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
93				hasIndeterminate = true
94				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
95					Code: "task-record-invalid", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task record is invalid",
96					Remediation: "repair or recreate the task record",
97				})
98				continue
99			}
100			if hostname != "" && candidate.Owner != "" && candidate.Owner != hostname {
101				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
102					Code: "task-owned-elsewhere", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task is owned by another machine",
103					Remediation: "complete an explicit ownership handoff before writing",
104				})
105			}
106			if candidate.State == task.Hot {
107				if context.RuntimeErr != nil {
108					hasIndeterminate = true
109					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
110						Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task cannot be checked against live runtime state",
111						Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
112					})
113				} else if len(context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Sessions) == 0 {
114					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
115						Code: "hot-task-runtime-missing", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task has no observed runtime session",
116						Remediation: "resume the task or reconcile its lifecycle state",
117					})
118				}
119			}
120		}
121		if hasReason(reasons, "task-owned-elsewhere") || hasReason(reasons, "hot-task-runtime-missing") {
122			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
123		}
124		if hasIndeterminate {
125			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
126		}
127		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
128	}

130	func assessWorktrees(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
131		if context.WorktreeErr != nil {
132			return indeterminate("worktree-inventory-unavailable", "worktrees", "linked worktrees could not be enumerated", "repair Git worktree metadata and rerun context")
133		}
134		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
135			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "worktree scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
136		}
137		indices := []int{}
138		if selectedIndex > 0 {
139			indices = append(indices, selectedIndex)
140		} else {
141			for index := 1; index < len(context.Checkouts); index++ {
142				indices = append(indices, index)
143			}
144		}
145		if len(indices) == 0 {
146			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
147		}
148		var reasons []assessment.Reason
149		hasUnknown := context.RuntimeErr != nil
150		if hasUnknown {
151			reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
152				Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "worktrees",
153				Detail:      "worktree runtime coverage could not be collected",
154				Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
155			})
156		}
157		for _, index := range indices {
158			checkout := context.Checkouts[index]
159			subject := fmt.Sprintf("worktree:%d", index)
160			switch {
161			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
162				hasUnknown = true
163				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-path-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path could not be inspected", Remediation: "restore path access and rerun context"})
164			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
165				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-missing", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path is missing or prunable", Remediation: "repair or remove the stale worktree registration"})
166			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
167				hasUnknown = true
168				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-status-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "Git status could not be collected for the worktree", Remediation: "repair the worktree and rerun context"})
169			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
170				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-locked", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree is locked", Remediation: "verify the lock owner before unlocking it"})
171			case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
172				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-conflicted", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree has unmerged paths", Remediation: "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement"})
173			case checkout.Status.Dirty():
174				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-dirty", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree contains uncommitted changes", Remediation: "commit or deliberately preserve the changes"})
175			case len(checkout.Sessions) > 0:
176				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-runtime-live", Subject: subject, Detail: "a runtime session still covers the worktree", Remediation: "quiesce and close the runtime before retirement"})
177			}
178		}
179		if len(reasons) == 0 {
180			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
181		}
182		if hasKnownBlocker(reasons) {
183			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
184		}
185		if hasUnknown {
186			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
187		}
188		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
189	}

191	func blocked(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {

193	}

197	}

199	func hasReason(reasons []assessment.Reason, code string) bool {

204		}

213			}

8	// FormatMarkdown extends the legacy deterministic handoff with additive safe
9	// remote, fleet, provenance, and readiness sections. legacy remains unchanged
10	// at the front so existing copy/paste consumers retain their headings.
11	func FormatMarkdown(report Report, legacy string) string {
12		var b strings.Builder
13		b.WriteString(strings.TrimSpace(legacy))
14		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n\n## Context report\n\n- Schema: %d\n- Generated: `%s`\n", report.SchemaVersion, report.GeneratedAt.Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"))
15		if report.SelectedCheckout != nil {
16			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Selected checkout: `%s`", report.SelectedCheckout.Path)
17			if report.SelectedCheckout.Branch != nil {
18				fmt.Fprintf(&b, " (`%s`)", *report.SelectedCheckout.Branch)
19			}
20			b.WriteString("\n")
21		} else {
22			b.WriteString("- Selected checkout: unavailable\n")
23		}
24
25		b.WriteString("\n## Readiness\n")
26		for _, gate := range report.Assessment.Gates {
27			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n- `%s`: **%s**", gate.Code, gate.Outcome)
28			if len(gate.Reasons) > 0 {
29				fmt.Fprintf(&b, " — %s", gate.Reasons[0].Detail)
30			}
31			b.WriteString("\n")
32		}
33
34		b.WriteString("\n## Safe remotes\n")
35		if len(report.Remotes) == 0 {

93	func writeEndpoints(b *strings.Builder, kind string, endpoints []RemoteEndpoint) {
94		if len(endpoints) == 0 {
95			fmt.Fprintf(b, "\n- %s: unavailable\n", kind)
96			return
97		}
98		for _, endpoint := range endpoints {
99			fmt.Fprintf(b, "\n- %s: ", kind)
100			if endpoint.Identity != nil {
101				fmt.Fprintf(b, "`%s`", *endpoint.Identity)
102			} else {
103				b.WriteString("unavailable")
104			}
105			if endpoint.WebURL != nil {
106				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s (%s, %s)", endpoint.WebURL.URL, endpoint.WebURL.Provider, endpoint.WebURL.Source)
107			}
108			if endpoint.Error != nil {
109				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", *endpoint.Error)
110			}
111			b.WriteString("\n")
112		}
113	}

115	func humanAge(seconds int64) string {
116		switch {
117		case seconds < 60:
118			return fmt.Sprintf("%ds", seconds)
119		case seconds < 3600:
120			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", seconds/60)
121		case seconds < 86400:
122			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", seconds/3600)
123		default:
124			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", seconds/86400)
125		}
126	}

99	// Import writes a transported note with its exact durable identity and
100	// timestamps. Path is always derived from the validated repository and note IDs;
101	// a source Path is never trusted. An identical revision is an idempotent replay,
102	// while reusing an ID for different content is a conflict. Import changes only
103	// Markdown source data and deliberately does not update or rebuild the FTS cache.
104	func (s *Store) Import(ctx context.Context, source *Note) (*Note, error) {
105		if s == nil {
106			return nil, errors.New("import into nil note store")
107		}
108		if source == nil {
109			return nil, errors.New("import nil note")
110		}
111		if ctx == nil {
112			ctx = context.Background()
113		}
114
115		candidate := clone(source)
116		candidate.Path = ""
117		if candidate.SchemaVersion == 0 {
118			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
119		}
120		originalRevision := source.Revision()
121		candidate.Normalize()
122		if candidate.Revision() != originalRevision {
123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("import note %s must already be normalized to preserve its revision: %w",
124				source.ID, ErrInvalid)
125		}
126		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
127			return nil, err
128		}
129
130		s.mu.Lock()
131		defer s.mu.Unlock()
132		var imported *Note
133		err := s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
134			target, err := s.confinedImportPath(candidate.RepositoryID, candidate.ID)
135			if err != nil {
136				return err
137			}
138			current, err := s.importedNoteByID(candidate.ID)
139			switch {
140			case err == nil:
141				if current.Revision() != candidate.Revision() {
142					return fmt.Errorf("note %s already exists with different content: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
143				}
144				if filepath.Clean(current.Path) != filepath.Clean(target) {
145					return fmt.Errorf("note %s exists outside its imported repository path: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
146				}
147				imported = clone(current)
148				return nil
149			case !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
150				return err
151			}
152
153			candidate.Path = target
154			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
155				return err
156			}
157			imported = clone(candidate)
158			return nil
159		})
160		return imported, err
161	}

163	func (s *Store) confinedImportPath(repositoryID, id string) (string, error) {
164		root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
165		if err != nil {
166			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
167		}
168		repositoryDir := filepath.Join(root, repositoryID)
169		if info, err := os.Lstat(repositoryDir); err == nil {
170			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
171				return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository directory %s is a symlink: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
172			}
173			if !info.IsDir() {
174				return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository path %s is not a directory: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
175			}
176		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
177			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect note repository directory %s: %w", repositoryID, err)
178		}
179
180		path := filepath.Join(repositoryDir, id+".md")
181		if info, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
182			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
183				return "", fmt.Errorf("note path %s is not a regular file: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
184			}
185		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
186			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect note path %s: %w", id, err)
187		}
188		confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
189		if err != nil {
190			return "", fmt.Errorf("confine imported note path: %w", err)
191		}
192		return confined, nil
193	}

195	// importedNoteByID performs the global uniqueness lookup used by Import while
196	// refusing to read through symlinks or accept legacy files nested more deeply
197	// than the one-repository-directory layout.
198	func (s *Store) importedNoteByID(id string) (*Note, error) {
199		paths, err := s.notePaths("")
200		if err != nil {
201			return nil, err
202		}
203		root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
204		if err != nil {
205			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
206		}
207		var match string
208		for _, path := range paths {
209			if strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md") != id {
210				continue
211			}
212			info, err := os.Lstat(path)
213			if err != nil {
214				return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect existing note %s: %w", id, err)
215			}
216			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
217				return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is not a regular file: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
218			}
219			confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
220			if err != nil {
221				return nil, fmt.Errorf("confine existing note %s: %w", id, err)
222			}
223			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, confined)
224			if err != nil {
225				return nil, fmt.Errorf("relativize existing note %s: %w", id, err)
226			}
227			parts := strings.Split(filepath.Clean(relative), string(filepath.Separator))
228			if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] != id+".md" {
229				return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is outside the repository note layout: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
230			}
231			if match != "" {
232				return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate note ID %s: %w", id, ErrConflict)
233			}
234			match = confined
235		}
236		if match == "" {
237			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
238		}
239		return s.read(match)
240	}

300				return fmt.Errorf("note %s: %w", id, ErrConflict)
301			}
302			candidate := *current
303			candidate.Body, candidate.Tags, candidate.Updated = body, tags, s.now()
304			candidate.Normalize()
305			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
306				return err
307			}
308			if err := s.writeAtomic(&candidate); err != nil {
309				return err
310			}
311			updated = clone(&candidate)
312			return nil
313		})
314		return updated, err
315	}

295	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
296	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
297	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather

299	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
300		if ref == "" {

310			}
311		}
312		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
313		var hits []*Task
314		for _, t := range all {

323		case 0:

325		default:

329			}

336	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15		"unicode"
16		"unicode/utf8"
17
18		"golang.org/x/text/cases"
19		"golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm"
20	)
21
22	var (
23		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
24		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
25		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
26		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
27		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
28		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
29		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
30		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
31		// ErrNotPortable reports a relative path that cannot be represented safely
32		// and with the same meaning on supported Unix and Windows filesystems.
33		ErrNotPortable = errors.New("path is not portable")
34		// ErrPathCollision reports distinct spellings that identify the same path on
35		// a case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystem.
36		ErrPathCollision = errors.New("portable path collision")
37		// ErrPathLimit reports a portable path that exceeds an explicit policy limit.
38		ErrPathLimit = errors.New("portable path limit exceeded")
39	)
40
41	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
42	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
43	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
44	// before creating or moving anything into it.
45	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
46		if path == "" {
47			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
48		}
49		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
50		if err != nil {
51			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
52		}
53		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
54
55		probe := absolute
56		var missing []string
57		for {
58			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
59			if err == nil {
60				slices.Reverse(missing)
61				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
62				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
63			}
64			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
65				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
66			}
67			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
68			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
69			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
70			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
71			// still-missing suffix.
72			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
73				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
74				if readErr != nil {
75					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
76				}
77				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
78					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
79				}
80				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
81					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
82				}
83				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
84				if resolveErr != nil {
85					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
86				}
87				slices.Reverse(missing)
88				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
89				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
90			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
91				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
92			}
93			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
94			if parent == probe {
95				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
96			}
97			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
98			probe = parent
99		}
100	}
101
102	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
103	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
104	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
105	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
106		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
107			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
108		}
109		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
110		if err != nil {
111			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
112		}
113		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
114		if err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
116		}
117
118		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
119		if err != nil {
120			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
121			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
122			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
123			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
124		}
125		switch {
126		case rel == ".":
127			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
128		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
129			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
130		default:
131			return canonicalCandidate, nil
132		}
133	}
134
135	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
136	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
137	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
138		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
139		if err == nil {
140			return true, nil
141		}
142		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
143			return false, nil
144		}
145		return false, err
146	}
147
148	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
149	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
150		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
151		if err != nil {
152			return false, err
153		}
154		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
155		if err != nil {
156			return false, err
157		}
158		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
159			return true, nil
160		}
161		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
162	}
163
164	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
165	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
166	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
167	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
168		switch {
169		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
170			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
171		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
172			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
173		case component == "." || component == "..":
174			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
175		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
176			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
177		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
178			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
179		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
180			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
181		default:
182			return nil
183		}
184	}
185
186	// PortablePathLimits bounds the encoded path, each encoded component, and path
187	// depth. Zero means unbounded for that field; negative values are invalid.
188	// File-count and byte-size ceilings live in safefile because they describe a
189	// collection of files rather than a path.
190	type PortablePathLimits struct {
191		MaxPathBytes      int
192		MaxComponentBytes int
193		MaxDepth          int
194	}
195
196	// ValidatePortableSlashPath accepts only a non-empty, clean, slash-separated
197	// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects
198	// Git metadata aliases, platform-specific separators and volumes, Windows
199	// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
200	// invalid UTF-8.
201	func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
202		if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
203			return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
204		}
205		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
206			return fmt.Errorf("path contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
207		}
208		if value == "" {
209			return fmt.Errorf("path is empty: %w", ErrNotPortable)
210		}
211		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
212			return fmt.Errorf("path contains a backslash path separator: %w", ErrNotPortable)
213		}
214		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" || driveQualified(value) {
215			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is absolute, drive-qualified, or UNC: %w", value, ErrNotPortable)
216		}
217		if limits.MaxPathBytes > 0 && len(value) > limits.MaxPathBytes {
218			return fmt.Errorf("path is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(value), limits.MaxPathBytes, ErrPathLimit)
219		}
220		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
221		if limits.MaxDepth > 0 && len(components) > limits.MaxDepth {
222			return fmt.Errorf("path has %d components; maximum is %d: %w", len(components), limits.MaxDepth, ErrPathLimit)
223		}
224		for _, component := range components {
225			if component == ".." {
226				return fmt.Errorf("path contains parent traversal: %w", ErrTraversal)
227			}
228			if err := ValidatePortableComponent(component, limits.MaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
229				return fmt.Errorf("path component %q: %w", component, err)
230			}
231		}
232		return nil
233	}
234
235	// ValidatePortableComponent applies the per-component part of
236	// ValidatePortableSlashPath. maxBytes may be zero for no size limit.
237	func ValidatePortableComponent(component string, maxBytes int) error {
238		if maxBytes < 0 {
239			return fmt.Errorf("negative component limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
240		}
241		if !utf8.ValidString(component) {
242			return fmt.Errorf("component contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
243		}
244		if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
245			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", err, ErrNotPortable)
246		}
247		if maxBytes > 0 && len(component) > maxBytes {
248			return fmt.Errorf("component is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(component), maxBytes, ErrPathLimit)
249		}
250		if strings.IndexFunc(component, isPortableControl) >= 0 {
251			return fmt.Errorf("path component contains control characters: %w", ErrNotPortable)
252		}
253		windowsAlias := strings.TrimRight(component, ". ")
254		if strings.EqualFold(windowsAlias, ".git") {
255			return fmt.Errorf("path contains reserved Git metadata: %w", ErrNotPortable)
256		}
257		if windowsAlias != component {
258			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q has a trailing dot or space and is not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
259		}
260		if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) {
261			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q contains characters that are not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
262		}
263		if windowsReservedName(component) {
264			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q is a reserved Windows device name: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
265		}
266		return nil
267	}
268
269	// ValidatePortablePathSet validates every path and rejects collisions at any
270	// component boundary after Unicode normalization and full Unicode case folding.
271	// Exact duplicate paths are left to the caller's type/cardinality policy.
272	func ValidatePortablePathSet(paths []string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
273		type collisionNode struct {
274			spelling string
275			first    string
276			children map[string]*collisionNode
277		}
278		root := &collisionNode{children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
279		for _, value := range paths {
280			if err := ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, limits); err != nil {
281				return fmt.Errorf("portable path %q: %w", value, err)
282			}
283			current := root
284			for _, component := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
285				key := portableCollisionKey(component)
286				next, exists := current.children[key]
287				if exists && next.spelling != component {
288					return fmt.Errorf("paths %q and %q collide on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems at %q and %q: %w",
289						next.first, value, next.spelling, component, ErrPathCollision)
290				}
291				if !exists {
292					next = &collisionNode{spelling: component, first: value, children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
293					current.children[key] = next
294				}
295				current = next
296			}
297		}
298		return nil
299	}
300
301	func portableCollisionKey(component string) string {
302		return norm.NFC.String(cases.Fold().String(norm.NFC.String(component)))
303	}
304
305	func isPortableControl(r rune) bool {
306		return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
307	}
308
309	func windowsReservedName(component string) bool {
310		base := component
311		if dot := strings.IndexByte(base, '.'); dot >= 0 {
312			base = base[:dot]
313		}
314		base = strings.TrimRight(base, " ")
315		upper := strings.ToUpper(base)
316		switch upper {
317		case "CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", "CONIN$", "CONOUT$", "CLOCK$":
318			return true
319		}
320		if len([]rune(upper)) != 4 {
321			return false
322		}
323		runes := []rune(upper)
324		prefix := string(runes[:3])
325		if prefix != "COM" && prefix != "LPT" {
326			return false
327		}
328		last := runes[3]
329		return last >= '1' && last <= '9' || last == '¹' || last == '²' || last == '³'
330	}
331
332	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
333	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
334	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
335	// single component.
336	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
337		if len(components) == 0 {
338			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
339		}
340		for i, component := range components {
341			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
342				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
343			}
344		}
345		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
346		if err != nil {
347			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
348		}
349		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
350	}
351
352	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
353		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
354			return false
355		}
356		letter := component[0]
357		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
358	}
359
360	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
361		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
362			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
363		}) {
364			if component == ".." {
365				return true
366			}
367		}
368		return false
369	}

89	// Prepare validates and reads a template source. A live local Git worktree is
90	// filtered through Git so tracked files (including tracked ignored files) and
91	// untracked non-ignored files are retained without copying ignored secrets. A
92	// ref or non-local source is checked out into an isolated repository first.
93	func Prepare(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Snapshot, error) {
94		request.Source = strings.TrimSpace(request.Source)
95		request.Ref = strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref)
96		request.Subdir = strings.TrimSpace(request.Subdir)
97		if request.Source == "" {
98			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("template source is required")
99		}
100		if strings.HasPrefix(request.Ref, "-") {
101			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template ref %q must not start with '-'", request.Ref)
102		}
103		subdir, err := cleanSubdir(request.Subdir)
104		if err != nil {
105			return Snapshot{}, err
106		}
107
108		local := config.Expand(request.Source)
109		info, statErr := os.Lstat(local)
110		localSource := statErr == nil
111		if statErr == nil {
112			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
113				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source %q is a symlink", repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source))
114			}
115			if !info.IsDir() {
116				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source %q is not a directory", repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source))
117			}
118		} else if !errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
119			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect template source %q: %v", repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source),
120				repo.RedactCloneError(statErr, request.Source, local))
121		}
122		if localSource && request.Ref == "" {
123			return snapshotDirectory(ctx, repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source), local, "", "", subdir, snapshotSource{
124				local: true,
125				live:  true,
126			})
127		}
128
129		checkout, resolvedRef, cleanup, err := checkoutGitSource(ctx, request.Source, request.Ref)
130		if err != nil {
131			return Snapshot{}, err
132		}
133		defer cleanup()
134		return snapshotDirectory(ctx, repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source), checkout, request.Ref, resolvedRef, subdir, snapshotSource{
135			local: localSource,
136		})
137	}
138
139	func checkoutGitSource(ctx context.Context, source, ref string) (string, string, func(), error) {
140		parent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "dev-repo-template-*")
141		if err != nil {
142			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("create template checkout: %w", err)
143		}
144		cleanup := func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(parent) }
145		checkout := filepath.Join(parent, "source")
146		normalized := repo.NormalizeCloneRef(source)
147		safeSource := repo.RedactCloneRef(source)
148		redact := func(err error) error { return repo.RedactCloneError(err, source, normalized) }
149		if ref == "" {
150			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, parent, "clone", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--", normalized, checkout); err != nil {
151				cleanup()
152				return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("clone template source %q: %v", safeSource, redact(err))
153			}
154			resolved, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
155			if err != nil {
156				cleanup()
157				return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("resolve template HEAD: %v", redact(err))
158			}
159			return checkout, resolved, cleanup, nil
160		}
161
162		if err := os.Mkdir(checkout, 0o755); err != nil {
163			cleanup()
164			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("create template checkout: %w", err)
165		}
166		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "init", "--quiet"); err != nil {
167			cleanup()
168			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("initialize template checkout: %v", redact(err))
169		}
170		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "add", "--", "origin", normalized); err != nil {
171			cleanup()
172			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("configure template source %q: %v", safeSource, redact(err))
173		}
174		checkoutTarget := "FETCH_HEAD"
175		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "fetch", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "origin", ref); err != nil {
176			if _, exactErr := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "fetch", "--quiet", "origin", ref); exactErr != nil {
177				if _, fullErr := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "fetch", "--quiet", "origin"); fullErr != nil {
178					cleanup()
179					joined := errors.Join(err, exactErr, fullErr)
180					return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("fetch template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(joined))
181				}
182				checkoutTarget = ref
183			}
184		}
185		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", checkoutTarget); err != nil && checkoutTarget == ref {
186			if _, remoteErr := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", "origin/"+ref); remoteErr != nil {
187				cleanup()
188				return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("checkout template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(errors.Join(err, remoteErr)))
189			}
190		} else if err != nil {
191			cleanup()
192			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("checkout template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(err))
193		}
194		resolved, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
195		if err != nil {
196			cleanup()
197			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("resolve template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(err))
198		}
199		return checkout, resolved, cleanup, nil
200	}

202	func snapshotDirectory(ctx context.Context, sourceLabel, rootPath, ref, commit, subdir string, source snapshotSource) (Snapshot, error) {
203		root, rootInfo, err := openNamedRoot(rootPath)
204		if err != nil {
205			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve template source %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
206		}
207		defer root.Close()
208
209		selected := root
210		selectedInfo := rootInfo
211		selectedPath := rootPath
212		if subdir != "" {
213			selected, selectedInfo, err = openRelativeRoot(root, subdir)
214			if err != nil {
215				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template subdirectory %q: %w", subdir, err)
216			}
217			defer selected.Close()
218			selectedPath = filepath.Join(rootPath, filepath.FromSlash(subdir))
219		}
220
221		snapshot := Snapshot{
222			Source: sourceLabel, Ref: ref, Commit: commit, Subdir: subdir,
223			Local: source.local, Live: source.live,
224		}
225		if source.live {
226			paths, filtered, err := liveGitPaths(ctx, selectedPath)
227			if err != nil {
228				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("list live template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
229			}
230			if err := verifyNamedRoot(selectedPath, selectedInfo); err != nil {
231				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source changed while listing: %w", err)
232			}
233			snapshot.GitFiltered = filtered
234			if filtered {
235				tree, err := buildSelectionTree(paths)
236				if err != nil {
237					return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
238				}
239				if _, err := snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx, selected, tree, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
240					return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
241				}
242			} else if err := snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, selected, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
243				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
244			}
245		} else if err := snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, selected, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
246			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
247		}
248		if err := verifyNamedRoot(selectedPath, selectedInfo); err != nil {
249			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source changed during snapshot: %w", err)
250		}
251		if err := finalizeSnapshot(&snapshot); err != nil {
252			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
253		}
254		return snapshot, nil
255	}

257	func openNamedRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
258		return safefile.OpenRoot(path)
259	}

261	func openRelativeRoot(base *os.Root, relative string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
262		current := base
263		owned := false
264		for _, component := range strings.Split(relative, "/") {
265			next, _, err := openChildRoot(current, component)
266			if err != nil {
267				if owned {
268					current.Close()
269				}
270				return nil, nil, err
271			}
272			if owned {
273				current.Close()
274			}
275			current, owned = next, true
276		}
277		info, err := current.Stat(".")
278		if err != nil {
279			current.Close()
280			return nil, nil, err
281		}
282		return current, info, nil
283	}
284
285	func openChildRoot(parent *os.Root, name string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
286		return safefile.OpenChildRoot(parent, name)
287	}

289	func verifyNamedRoot(path string, expected fs.FileInfo) error {
290		return safefile.VerifyRoot(path, expected)
291	}
292
293	func verifyChildRoot(parent *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo) error {

297	func liveGitPaths(ctx context.Context, root string) ([]string, bool, error) {
298		if _, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, root); err != nil {
299			if errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
300				return nil, false, nil
301			}
302			return nil, false, err
303		}
304		selected := map[string]bool{}
305		tracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "ls-files", "-z", "--stage", "--", ".")
306		if err != nil {
307			return nil, false, err
308		}
309		for _, record := range splitNUL(tracked) {
310			tab := strings.IndexByte(record, '\t')
311			if tab < 0 {
312				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("unexpected git ls-files record %q", record)
313			}
314			header, path := record[:tab], record[tab+1:]
315			fields := strings.Fields(header)
316			if len(fields) < 1 {
317				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("unexpected git ls-files record %q", record)
318			}
319			if fields[0] == "160000" {
320				continue
321			}
322			selected[path] = true
323		}
324		untracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "ls-files", "-z", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "--", ".")
325		if err != nil {
326			return nil, false, err
327		}
328		for _, path := range splitNUL(untracked) {
329			selected[path] = true
330		}
331		paths := make([]string, 0, len(selected))
332		for path := range selected {
333			cleaned, err := validateSnapshotPath(path)
334			if err != nil {
335				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q: %w", path, err)
336			}
337			paths = append(paths, cleaned)
338		}
339		sort.Strings(paths)
340		return paths, true, nil
341	}
342
343	func splitNUL(value string) []string {
344		value = strings.TrimSuffix(value, "\x00")
345		if value == "" {
346			return nil
347		}
348		return strings.Split(value, "\x00")
349	}

351	type selectionNode struct {
352		leaf     bool
353		children map[string]*selectionNode
354	}
355
356	func buildSelectionTree(paths []string) (*selectionNode, error) {
357		root := &selectionNode{children: map[string]*selectionNode{}}
358		for _, path := range paths {
359			current := root
360			components := strings.Split(path, "/")
361			for index, component := range components {
362				if current.leaf {
363					return nil, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q is below another selected file", path)
364				}
365				if current.children[component] == nil {
366					current.children[component] = &selectionNode{children: map[string]*selectionNode{}}
367				}
368				current = current.children[component]
369				if index == len(components)-1 {
370					if len(current.children) > 0 {
371						return nil, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q is the parent of another selected path", path)
372					}
373					current.leaf = true
374				}
375			}
376		}
377		return root, nil
378	}

380	func snapshotWholeRoot(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, relative string, snapshot *Snapshot) error {
381		if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
382			return err
383		}
384		directory, err := root.Open(".")
385		if err != nil {
386			return err
387		}
388		defer directory.Close()
389		before, err := directory.Stat()
390		if err != nil {
391			return err
392		}
393		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(-1)
394		if err != nil {
395			return err
396		}
397		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
398		for _, entry := range entries {
399			name := entry.Name()
400			if strings.EqualFold(name, ".git") {
401				continue
402			}
403			if err := validateSnapshotComponent(name); err != nil {
404				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
405			}
406			info, err := root.Lstat(name)
407			if err != nil {
408				return fmt.Errorf("inspect template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
409			}
410			path := joinRelative(relative, name)
411			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
412				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a symlink", path)
413			}
414			switch {
415			case info.IsDir():
416				child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
417				if err != nil {
418					return fmt.Errorf("open template directory %q: %w", path, err)
419				}
420				snapshot.Directories = append(snapshot.Directories, Directory{Path: path, Mode: held.Mode().Perm()})
421				err = snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, child, path, snapshot)
422				verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
423				closeErr := child.Close()
424				if err != nil {
425					return err
426				}
427				if verifyErr != nil {
428					return verifyErr
429				}
430				if closeErr != nil {
431					return closeErr
432				}
433			case info.Mode().IsRegular():
434				data, opened, err := readStableRootFile(ctx, root, name, info)
435				if err != nil {
436					return fmt.Errorf("read template file %q: %w", path, err)
437				}
438				snapshot.Files = append(snapshot.Files, File{Path: path, Mode: opened.Mode().Perm(), Data: data})
439			default:
440				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a special file (%s)", path, info.Mode().Type())
441			}
442		}
443		after, err := directory.Stat()
444		if err != nil {
445			return err
446		}
447		if !stableInfo(before, after) {
448			return errors.New("source directory changed during snapshot")
449		}
450		return nil
451	}
452
453	func snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, node *selectionNode, relative string, snapshot *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
454		if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
455			return false, err
456		}
457		before, err := root.Stat(".")
458		if err != nil {
459			return false, err
460		}
461		names := make([]string, 0, len(node.children))
462		for name := range node.children {
463			names = append(names, name)
464		}
465		sort.Strings(names)
466		included := false
467		for _, name := range names {
468			childNode := node.children[name]
469			info, err := root.Lstat(name)
470			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && childNode.leaf && len(childNode.children) == 0 {
471				continue
472			}
473			if err != nil {
474				return false, fmt.Errorf("inspect selected template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
475			}
476			path := joinRelative(relative, name)
477			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
478				return false, fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a symlink", path)
479			}
480			if len(childNode.children) > 0 {
481				if childNode.leaf || !info.IsDir() {
482					return false, fmt.Errorf("selected Git path %q is not a directory tree", path)
483				}
484				child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
485				if err != nil {
486					return false, fmt.Errorf("open selected template directory %q: %w", path, err)
487				}
488				childIncluded, walkErr := snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx, child, childNode, path, snapshot)
489				verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
490				closeErr := child.Close()
491				if walkErr != nil {
492					return false, walkErr
493				}
494				if verifyErr != nil {
495					return false, verifyErr
496				}
497				if closeErr != nil {
498					return false, closeErr
499				}
500				if childIncluded {
501					snapshot.Directories = append(snapshot.Directories, Directory{Path: path, Mode: held.Mode().Perm()})
502					included = true
503				}
504				continue
505			}
506			if !childNode.leaf || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
507				return false, fmt.Errorf("selected Git path %q is not a regular file", path)
508			}
509			data, opened, err := readStableRootFile(ctx, root, name, info)
510			if err != nil {
511				return false, fmt.Errorf("read selected template file %q: %w", path, err)
512			}
513			snapshot.Files = append(snapshot.Files, File{Path: path, Mode: opened.Mode().Perm(), Data: data})
514			included = true
515		}
516		after, err := root.Stat(".")
517		if err != nil {
518			return false, err
519		}
520		if !stableInfo(before, after) {
521			return false, errors.New("source directory changed during snapshot")
522		}
523		return included, nil
524	}
525
526	func readStableRootFile(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
527		return safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, root, name, expected, 0)
528	}
529
530	func stableInfo(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
531		return safefile.SameFileState(left, right)
532	}
533
534	// Summary returns a content-free description suitable for user-facing plans.
535	func (snapshot Snapshot) Summary() Summary {
536		preview, truncated := snapshotPathPreview(snapshot)
537		return Summary{
538			Source: snapshot.Source, Ref: snapshot.Ref, Commit: snapshot.Commit, Subdir: snapshot.Subdir,
539			Local: snapshot.Local, Live: snapshot.Live, GitFiltered: snapshot.GitFiltered,
540			Files: len(snapshot.Files), Directories: len(snapshot.Directories),
541			PathPreview: preview, PathPreviewTruncated: truncated,
542		}
543	}
544
545	func snapshotPathPreview(snapshot Snapshot) ([]string, bool) {
546		paths := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Files)+len(snapshot.Directories))
547		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
548			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
549		}
550		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
551			paths = append(paths, directory.Path+"/")
552		}
553		sort.Strings(paths)
554		truncated := len(paths) > pathPreviewLimit
555		if truncated {
556			paths = paths[:pathPreviewLimit]
557		}
558		return append([]string(nil), paths...), truncated
559	}

561	// Apply writes a prepared snapshot into a newly initialized, otherwise empty
562	// repository. All traversal and creation stays relative to a held os.Root, and
563	// file permissions are applied through the opened file descriptor.
564	func (snapshot Snapshot) Apply(destination string) (ApplyResult, error) {
565		result := ApplyResult{Summary: snapshot.Summary()}
566		if err := validateSnapshot(snapshot); err != nil {
567			return result, err
568		}
569		root, rootInfo, err := openNamedRoot(destination)
570		if err != nil {
571			return result, fmt.Errorf("resolve template destination: %w", err)
572		}
573		defer root.Close()
574		entries, err := readRootEntries(root)
575		if err != nil {
576			return result, fmt.Errorf("inspect template destination: %w", err)
577		}
578		gitMetadata := false
579		for _, entry := range entries {
580			if entry.Name() == ".git" {
581				info, err := root.Lstat(entry.Name())
582				if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.IsDir() {
583					return result, errors.New("template destination has unsafe Git metadata")
584				}
585				gitMetadata = true
586				continue
587			}
588			return result, fmt.Errorf("template destination is not a new repository: %q already exists", entry.Name())
589		}
590		if !gitMetadata {
591			return result, errors.New("template destination is not an initialized Git repository")
592		}
593
594		tree, err := buildApplyTree(snapshot)
595		if err != nil {
596			return result, err
597		}
598		if err := applyTree(root, tree, &result); err != nil {
599			return result, err
600		}
601		if err := verifyNamedRoot(destination, rootInfo); err != nil {
602			return result, fmt.Errorf("template destination changed during apply: %w", err)
603		}
604		return result, nil
605	}
606
607	func readRootEntries(root *os.Root) ([]os.DirEntry, error) {
608		directory, err := root.Open(".")
609		if err != nil {
610			return nil, err
611		}
612		defer directory.Close()
613		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(-1)
614		if err != nil {
615			return nil, err
616		}
617		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
618		return entries, nil
619	}
620
621	type applyNode struct {
622		directory *Directory
623		file      *File
624		children  map[string]*applyNode
625	}
626
627	func buildApplyTree(snapshot Snapshot) (*applyNode, error) {
628		root := &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
629		add := func(path string) *applyNode {
630			current := root
631			for _, component := range strings.Split(path, "/") {
632				if current.children[component] == nil {
633					current.children[component] = &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
634				}
635				current = current.children[component]
636			}
637			return current
638		}
639		for index := range snapshot.Directories {
640			directory := &snapshot.Directories[index]
641			add(directory.Path).directory = directory
642		}
643		for index := range snapshot.Files {
644			file := &snapshot.Files[index]
645			add(file.Path).file = file
646		}
647		return root, nil
648	}
649
650	func applyTree(root *os.Root, node *applyNode, result *ApplyResult) error {
651		names := make([]string, 0, len(node.children))
652		for name := range node.children {
653			names = append(names, name)
654		}
655		sort.Strings(names)
656		for _, name := range names {
657			childNode := node.children[name]
658			if childNode.file != nil {
659				if err := writeRootFile(root, name, *childNode.file); err != nil {
660					return fmt.Errorf("create template file %q: %w", childNode.file.Path, err)
661				}
662				result.AppliedFiles++
663				continue
664			}
665			if err := root.Mkdir(name, 0o700); err != nil {
666				return fmt.Errorf("create template directory %q: %w", name, err)
667			}
668			child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
669			if err != nil {
670				return fmt.Errorf("open created template directory %q: %w", name, err)
671			}
672			walkErr := applyTree(child, childNode, result)
673			mode := fs.FileMode(0o755)
674			if childNode.directory != nil {
675				mode = childNode.directory.Mode.Perm()
676				result.AppliedDirectories++
677			}
678			chmodErr := chmodRootDirectory(child, mode)
679			verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
680			closeErr := child.Close()
681			if walkErr != nil {
682				return walkErr
683			}
684			if chmodErr != nil {
685				return fmt.Errorf("set template directory mode %q: %w", name, chmodErr)
686			}
687			if verifyErr != nil {
688				return verifyErr
689			}
690			if closeErr != nil {
691				return closeErr
692			}
693		}
694		return nil
695	}
696
697	func writeRootFile(root *os.Root, name string, file File) error {
698		_, err := safefile.CreateNoClobber(context.Background(), root, name, file.Data, file.Mode.Perm())
699		return err
700	}
701
702	func chmodRootDirectory(root *os.Root, mode fs.FileMode) error {
703		directory, err := root.Open(".")
704		if err != nil {
705			return err
706		}
707		defer directory.Close()
708		return directory.Chmod(mode.Perm())
709	}

711	func finalizeSnapshot(snapshot *Snapshot) error {
712		sort.SliceStable(snapshot.Files, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Files[i].Path < snapshot.Files[j].Path })
713		sort.SliceStable(snapshot.Directories, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Directories[i].Path < snapshot.Directories[j].Path })
714		return validateSnapshot(*snapshot)
715	}
716
717	func validateSnapshot(snapshot Snapshot) error {
718		paths := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Directories)+len(snapshot.Files))
719		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
720			paths = append(paths, directory.Path)
721		}
722		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
723			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
724		}
725		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
726			return fmt.Errorf("template paths: %w", err)
727		}
728
729		types := make(map[string]string, len(paths))
730		validate := func(relative, kind string, mode fs.FileMode) error {
731			cleaned, err := validateSnapshotPath(relative)
732			if err != nil || cleaned != relative {
733				if err == nil {
734					err = errors.New("path is not a clean relative path")
735				}
736				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q: %w", kind, relative, err)
737			}
738			if mode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
739				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q has unsupported mode %s", kind, relative, mode)
740			}
741			if previous, exists := types[relative]; exists {
742				return fmt.Errorf("template path %q is declared as both %s and %s", relative, previous, kind)
743			}
744			for parent := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(relative))); parent != "."; parent = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(parent))) {
745				if types[parent] == "file" {
746					return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q is below file %q", kind, relative, parent)
747				}
748			}
749			types[relative] = kind
750			return nil
751		}
752		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
753			if err := validate(directory.Path, "directory", directory.Mode); err != nil {
754				return err
755			}
756		}
757		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
758			if err := validate(file.Path, "file", file.Mode); err != nil {
759				return err
760			}
761			prefix := file.Path + "/"
762			for existing := range types {
763				if strings.HasPrefix(existing, prefix) {
764					return fmt.Errorf("template file %q is the parent of %q", file.Path, existing)
765				}
766			}
767		}
768		return nil
769	}
770
771	func cleanSubdir(value string) (string, error) {
772		if value == "" || value == "." {
773			return "", nil
774		}
775		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
776			return "", fmt.Errorf("template subdirectory %q: %w", value, err)
777		}
778		return value, nil
779	}
780
781	func validateSnapshotPath(value string) (string, error) {
782		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
783			return "", err
784		}
785		return value, nil
786	}
787
788	func validateSnapshotComponent(component string) error {
789		return pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(component, 0)
790	}

792	func joinRelative(parent, name string) string {
793		if parent == "" {
794			return name
795		}
796		return parent + "/" + name
797	}

12	const unsafeRemoteLabel = "<unsafe remote>"

14	// RedactRemoteRef returns a terminal-safe remote reference for public display.
15	// URL userinfo, query, and fragment components are removed structurally. SSH
16	// usernames such as git@host remain visible, while an scp-like prefix containing
17	// a password/token separator is redacted. Invalid UTF-8, controls, malformed
18	// explicit URLs, and encoded path controls are replaced by a fixed label.
19	func RedactRemoteRef(ref string) string {
20		if !utf8.ValidString(ref) || strings.IndexFunc(ref, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
21			return unsafeRemoteLabel
22		}
23		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
24		if ref == "" {
25			return ""
26		}
27		parsed, err := url.Parse(ref)
28		explicitURL := strings.Contains(ref, "://")
29		if explicitURL && (err != nil || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" && !strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file")) {
30			return unsafeRemoteLabel
31		}
32		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && (explicitURL || parsed.Host != "" || strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file")) {
33			path, unescapeErr := url.PathUnescape(parsed.EscapedPath())
34			if unescapeErr != nil || !utf8.ValidString(path) || strings.IndexFunc(path, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
35				return unsafeRemoteLabel
36			}
37			parsed.User = nil
38			parsed.RawQuery = ""
39			parsed.ForceQuery = false
40			parsed.Fragment = ""
41			parsed.RawFragment = ""
42			redacted := parsed.String()
43			if !utf8.ValidString(redacted) || strings.IndexFunc(redacted, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
44				return unsafeRemoteLabel
45			}
46			return redacted
47		}
48		if err != nil && strings.Contains(ref, "://") {
49			return unsafeRemoteLabel
50		}
51
52		at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@')
53		if at > 0 && strings.Contains(ref[:at], ":") {
54			return "***@" + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[at+1:])
55		}
56		if at > 0 {
57			colon := strings.IndexByte(ref[at+1:], ':')
58			if colon >= 0 {
59				colon += at + 1
60				return ref[:colon+1] + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[colon+1:])
61			}
62		}
63		if colon := strings.IndexByte(ref, ':'); colon > 0 && !strings.ContainsAny(ref[:colon], `/\\`) && !isDrivePrefix(ref[:colon+1]) {
64			return ref[:colon+1] + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[colon+1:])
65		}
66		return ref
67	}
68
69	// RedactCloneRef is retained for existing clone results and diagnostics. It
70	// changes display only; callers continue to pass the original reference to Git.
71	func RedactCloneRef(ref string) string {
72		return RedactRemoteRef(ref)
73	}
74
75	func isRemoteControl(r rune) bool {
76		return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
77	}
78
79	func isDrivePrefix(value string) bool {
80		return len(value) == 2 && value[1] == ':' && (value[0] >= 'a' && value[0] <= 'z' || value[0] >= 'A' && value[0] <= 'Z')
81	}
82
83	func stripRemoteQueryFragment(value string) string {
84		if index := strings.IndexAny(value, "?#"); index >= 0 {
85			return value[:index]
86		}
87		return value
88	}
89
90	// RedactCloneError returns an error whose displayed message cannot echo
91	// credential-bearing clone references passed to Git.
92	func RedactCloneError(err error, refs ...string) error {
93		if err == nil {
94			return nil
95		}
96		message := err.Error()
97		refs = append([]string(nil), refs...)
98		sort.SliceStable(refs, func(i, j int) bool { return len(refs[i]) > len(refs[j]) })
99		for _, ref := range refs {
100			if ref == "" {
101				continue
102			}
103			message = strings.ReplaceAll(message, ref, RedactCloneRef(ref))
104			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(ref)
105			if trimmed != "" && trimmed != ref {
106				message = strings.ReplaceAll(message, trimmed, RedactCloneRef(trimmed))
107			}
108		}
109		return errors.New(message)
110	}
111

104	func (e *BlockedError) Error() string {

110	func RepositoryKey(repository string) Key {
111		return Key{Repository: repository, Scope: ScopeRepository}
112	}

118	func (k Key) Validate() error {
119		if err := validateIdentity("repository identity", k.Repository); err != nil {
120			return err
121		}
122		switch k.Scope {
123		case ScopeRepository:
124			if k.Branch != "" {
125				return errors.New("repository lease key must not name a branch")
126			}
127		case ScopeBranch:
128			if err := validateIdentity("branch", k.Branch); err != nil {
129				return err
130			}
131		default:
132			return fmt.Errorf("unknown lease scope %q", k.Scope)
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
137	func (k Key) canonical() string {
138		// Length prefixes keep arbitrary valid identities unambiguous.
139		return fmt.Sprintf("%08x:%s:%s:%08x:%s", len(k.Repository), k.Repository, k.Scope, len(k.Branch), k.Branch)
140	}
141
142	func (k Key) subject() string {
143		if k.Scope == ScopeBranch {
144			return k.Repository + " branch " + k.Branch
145		}
146		return k.Repository
147	}
148
149	func (r Request) Validate() error {
150		if !operationIDPattern.MatchString(r.OperationID) {
151			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation id %q", r.OperationID)
152		}
153		if !assessment.ValidFingerprint(r.Digest) {
154			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has invalid digest %q", r.OperationID, r.Digest)
155		}
156		if r.MachineID != "" {
157			if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
158				return err
159			}
160		}
161		return nil
162	}
163
164	func (b Binding) Validate() error {
165		return (Request{OperationID: b.OperationID, Digest: b.Digest}).Validate()
166	}
167
168	func (t Token) Validate() error {
169		if err := (Request{OperationID: t.OperationID, Digest: t.Digest}).Validate(); err != nil {
170			return err
171		}
172		if t.Epoch == 0 {
173			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has zero lease epoch", t.OperationID)
174		}
175		return nil
176	}
177
178	func (t Token) matches(other Token) bool {
179		return t.OperationID == other.OperationID && t.Digest == other.Digest && t.Epoch == other.Epoch
180	}
181
182	func (t Token) sameOperation(request Request) bool {
183		return t.OperationID == request.OperationID && t.Digest == request.Digest
184	}
185
186	// CanonicalKeys validates, deduplicates, and sorts keys in the one order used
187	// by every multi-key acquisition.
188	func CanonicalKeys(keys []Key) ([]Key, error) {
189		if len(keys) == 0 {
190			return nil, errors.New("operation lease requires at least one key")
191		}
192		unique := make(map[string]Key, len(keys))
193		for _, key := range keys {
194			if err := key.Validate(); err != nil {
195				return nil, err
196			}
197			unique[key.canonical()] = key
198		}
199		canonical := make([]Key, 0, len(unique))
200		for _, key := range unique {
201			canonical = append(canonical, key)
202		}
203		sort.Slice(canonical, func(i, j int) bool { return canonical[i].canonical() < canonical[j].canonical() })
204		return canonical, nil
205	}
206
207	func validateIdentity(name, value string) error {
208		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
209			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
210		}
211		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
212			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
213		}
214		for _, char := range value {
215			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
216				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
217			}
218		}
219		return nil
220	}

64	func (a *Authority) activate(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, request Request, fence bool) (Token, error) {
65		if a == nil {
66			return Token{}, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
67		}
68		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
69			return Token{}, err
70		}

72		if err != nil {

74		}
75		var result Token
76		err = a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func([]Key) error {
77			return a.updateState(ctx, func(state *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
78				if err := checkOperationReuse(*state, claimed, request); err != nil {
79					return false, err
80				}

83					return false, err
84				}
85				canonical := claimed

87				claims := make([]*Claim, len(canonical))
88				claimKinds := make([]string, len(canonical))
89				for index, key := range canonical {
90					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
91					if record == nil {
92						continue
93					}
94					switch {
95					case record.Reservation != nil:
96						claims[index], claimKinds[index] = record.Reservation, "reservation"
97					case record.Fence != nil:
98						claims[index], claimKinds[index] = record.Fence, "fence"
99					}
100				}
101
102				allSameKind := true
103				var existing Token
104				for index, claim := range claims {
105					wantedKind := "reservation"
106					if fence {
107						wantedKind = "fence"
108					}
109					if claim == nil || claimKinds[index] != wantedKind || !claim.Token.sameOperation(request) || claim.MachineID != request.MachineID {
110						allSameKind = false
111						break
112					}
113					if index == 0 {
114						existing = claim.Token
115					} else if !existing.matches(claim.Token) {
116						return false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s has inconsistent epochs: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
117					}
118				}
119				if allSameKind {
120					result = existing
121					return bindingAdded, nil
122				}
123
124				promoteReservation := fence
125				anyClaim := false
126				for index, claim := range claims {
127					if claim == nil {
128						promoteReservation = false
129						continue
130					}
131					anyClaim = true
132					if claimKinds[index] != "reservation" || !claim.Token.sameOperation(request) || claim.MachineID != request.MachineID {

135				}
136				if anyClaim && !promoteReservation {
137					return false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s only owns part of the requested key set: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
138				}
139
140				epoch, err := allocateEpoch(state)
141				if err != nil {
142					return false, err
143				}
144				result = Token{OperationID: request.OperationID, Digest: request.Digest, Epoch: epoch}
145				now := canonicalTime(a.clock())
146				for _, key := range canonical {
147					record := ensureRecord(state, key)
148					record.Epoch = epoch
149					claim := &Claim{Token: result, MachineID: request.MachineID, CreatedAt: now}
150					if fence {
151						record.Reservation = nil
152						record.Fence = claim
153					} else {
154						record.Reservation = claim
155						record.Fence = nil
156					}
157				}
158				return true, nil
159			})
160		})
161		return result, err

164	// ReleaseReservation clears an exact reservation and advances the authority
165	// epoch. It is non-terminal; AbortReservation should be used for a terminal
166	// pre-fence cancellation.

171	// AbortReservation clears an exact reservation and retains a permanent
172	// terminal tombstone so delayed prepare replays cannot recreate it.

183	func (a *Authority) finishClaim(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token, claimKind string, terminal TombstoneKind) (uint64, error) {
184		if a == nil {
185			return 0, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
186		}
187		if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
188			return 0, err
189		}
190		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
191		if err != nil {
192			return 0, err
193		}
194		var advanced uint64
195		err = a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func([]Key) error {
196			return a.updateState(ctx, func(state *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
197				canonical := claimed
198				if terminal != "" {
199					if epoch, found, err := matchingTerminal(*state, canonical, token, terminal); err != nil {
200						return false, err
201					} else if found {
202						advanced = epoch
203						return false, nil
204					}
205				}
206				if err := validateClaimKeySet(*state, canonical, token, claimKind); err != nil {
207					return false, err
208				}
209				for _, key := range canonical {
210					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
211					if record == nil {
212						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s has no active %s: %w", key.subject(), claimKind, ErrEpochMismatch)
213					}
214					var claim *Claim
215					if claimKind == "reservation" {
216						claim = record.Reservation
217					} else {
218						claim = record.Fence
219					}
220					if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
221						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s does not hold operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
222					}
223				}
224				epoch, err := allocateEpoch(state)
225				if err != nil {
226					return false, err
227				}
228				advanced = epoch
229				now := canonicalTime(a.clock())
230				for _, key := range canonical {
231					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
232					record.Epoch = epoch
233					if claimKind == "reservation" {
234						record.Reservation = nil
235					} else {
236						record.Fence = nil
237					}
238					if terminal != "" {
239						record.Tombstones = append(record.Tombstones, Tombstone{Kind: terminal, Token: token, AdvancedEpoch: epoch, CreatedAt: now})
240					}
241				}
242				return true, nil
243			})
244		})
245		return advanced, err
246	}

248	// WithMutation runs an ordinary mutator only when no requested key is reserved
249	// or fenced. A branch key automatically includes its repository ancestor so a
250	// repository fence covers every branch. The locks remain held until operation
251	// returns.
252	func (a *Authority) WithMutation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func() error) error {
253		return a.WithGuard(ctx, keys, nil, operation)
254	}

256	// WithGuard permits the exact owner of an active reservation or fence to work
257	// while rejecting stale, returned, and mismatched tokens. A nil token is an
258	// ordinary mutation guard and includes repository ancestors. It is
259	// non-reentrant: operation must not reacquire an overlapping key.
260	func (a *Authority) WithGuard(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token *Token, operation func() error) error {
261		if a == nil {
262			return errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
263		}
264		if operation == nil {
265			return errors.New("operation lease guard requires an operation")
266		}
267		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool)
272		if token != nil {
273			if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
274				return err
275			}
276		} else {
277			for _, key := range claimed {
278				if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
279					repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
280				}
281			}
282		}
283		return a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func(locked []Key) error {
284			checked := locked
285			if token != nil {
286				// Repository ancestors participate in draining but are not part of a
287				// branch-scoped token's ownership claim.
288				checked = claimed
289			}
290			if err := a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
291				matched := 0
292				for _, key := range checked {
293					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
294					if record == nil {
295						if token != nil {
296							return fmt.Errorf("%s has no operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
297						}
298						continue
299					}
300					if token != nil && hasTerminal(*record, *token) {
301						return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrReturned)
302					}
303					claim, kind := activeClaim(*record)
304					if claim == nil {
305						if token != nil {
306							return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is no longer active on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrEpochMismatch)
307						}
308						continue
309					}
310					if token == nil || !claim.Token.matches(*token) {
311						return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
312					}
313					matched++
314				}
315				if token != nil && matched != len(checked) {
316					return fmt.Errorf("operation %s does not own the complete key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrEpochMismatch)
317				}
318				if token != nil {
319					if err := validateGuardKeySet(state, claimed, *token); err != nil {
320						return err
321					}
322				}
323				if token == nil {
324					for _, record := range state.Records {
325						if record.Key.Scope != ScopeBranch || !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
326							continue
327						}
328						if claim, kind := activeClaim(record); claim != nil {
329							return &BlockedError{Key: record.Key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
330						}
331					}
332				}
333				return nil
334			}); err != nil {
335				return err
336			}
337			return operation()
338		})
339	}

341	// Inspect returns records for the requested keys while holding those key locks.
342	// Untouched keys are represented with Epoch zero and are never persisted.
343	func (a *Authority) Inspect(ctx context.Context, keys []Key) ([]Record, error) {
344		if a == nil {
345			return nil, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
346		}
347		var result []Record
348		err := a.withKeyLocks(ctx, keys, func(canonical []Key) error {
349			return a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
350				result = make([]Record, 0, len(canonical))
351				for _, key := range canonical {
352					if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
353						result = append(result, cloneRecord(*record))
354					} else {
355						result = append(result, Record{Key: key})
356					}
357				}
358				return nil
359			})
360		})
361		return result, err
362	}

364	func mutationKeys(keys []Key) []Key {

366		for _, key := range keys {

374	func (a *Authority) withKeyLocks(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func([]Key) error) error {
375		canonical, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
376		if err != nil {
377			return err
378		}
379		if ctx == nil {
380			ctx = context.Background()
381		}
382		if err := a.ensureLayout(); err != nil {
383			return err
384		}
385		var acquire func(int) error
386		acquire = func(index int) error {
387			if index == len(canonical) {
388				return operation(canonical)
389			}
390			directory := a.keyLockDir(canonical[index])
391			if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
392				return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation key lock: %w", err)
393			}
394			return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease key", func() error { return acquire(index + 1) })
395		}
396		return acquire(0)
397	}

399	func (a *Authority) updateState(ctx context.Context, mutate func(*Snapshot) (bool, error)) error {
400		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
401			state, err := a.loadState()
402			if err != nil {
403				return err
404			}
405			changed, err := mutate(&state)
406			if err != nil || !changed {
407				return err
408			}
409			return a.writeState(state)
410		})

455			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state: %w", err)
456		}
457		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
458			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s is not a regular file", path)
459		}
460		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
461		if err != nil {
462			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state permissions: %w", err)
463		}
464		if !private {
465			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
466		}
467		file, err := os.Open(path)
468		if err != nil {
469			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("open operation lease state: %w", err)
470		}
471		defer file.Close()
472		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
473		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
474		var state Snapshot
475		if err := decoder.Decode(&state); err != nil {
476			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state: %w", err)
477		}
478		var extra any
479		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
480			if err == nil {
481				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("decode operation lease state: multiple JSON values")
482			}
483			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state trailing data: %w", err)
484		}
485		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
486			return Snapshot{}, err
487		}
488		canonical := canonicalSnapshot(state)
489		encodedState, _ := json.Marshal(state)
490		encodedCanonical, _ := json.Marshal(canonical)
491		if string(encodedState) != string(encodedCanonical) {
492			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("operation lease state is not in canonical order")
493		}
494		return state, nil
495	}
