42	// WebURLRequest supplies a Git remote plus, when available, the exact live
43	// forge inventory record matched to it. Additional host lists identify trusted
44	// enterprise web hosts and authorize matching SSH-host transforms. Environment-
45	// configured GH_HOST and GITLAB_HOST values are included automatically.
46	type WebURLRequest struct {
47		Remote      string
48		Exact       *RemoteRepo
49		GitHubHosts []string
50		GitLabHosts []string
51	}
52
53	// DeriveWebURL returns a display-safe browser URL when the evidence can be
54	// mapped without guessing. Evidence order is exact RemoteRepo URL, strict Azure
55	// mapping, then literal/configured GitHub or GitLab endpoints. Unknown SSH
56	// aliases, local paths, file URLs, unsupported schemes/ports, controls, and
57	// ambiguous encoded separators return unavailable.
58	func DeriveWebURL(request WebURLRequest) (WebURL, bool) {
59		if request.Exact != nil {
60			if result, ok := webURLFromExact(*request.Exact); ok {
61				return result, true
62			}
63		}
64		if _, rawURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(request.Remote); ok {
65			if _, _, safeURL, ok := parseSafeHTTPS(rawURL); ok {
66				return WebURL{
67					URL: safeURL, Provider: AzureDevOps,
68					Source: WebURLSourceAzureRemote, Confidence: WebURLConfidenceStrict,
69				}, true
70			}
71		}
72
73		endpoint, ok := parseForgeEndpoint(request.Remote)
74		if !ok {
75			return WebURL{}, false
76		}
77		hosts := webHostPolicy(request)
78		provider := hosts.provider(endpoint.host, endpoint.transport == "ssh")
79		if provider == Unknown || !validRepositorySegments(provider, endpoint.segments) {
80			return WebURL{}, false
81		}
82		segments := stripGitSuffix(endpoint.segments)
83		if segments == nil {
84			return WebURL{}, false
85		}

130	func parseForgeEndpoint(raw string) (forgeEndpoint, bool) {

135		if raw == "" {
136			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
137		}
138		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
139			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
140			if err != nil || u.Opaque != "" || u.Hostname() == "" || !validWebHost(u.Hostname()) {
141				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
142			}
143			host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
144			segments, ok := decodeURLPath(u.EscapedPath())
145			if !ok {
146				return forgeEndpoint{}, false

148			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
149			case "https":

151					return forgeEndpoint{}, false

154			case "ssh":

156					return forgeEndpoint{}, false

158				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
159					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
160				}
161				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: host, segments: segments}, true
162			default:
163				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
164			}
165		}
166
167		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
168		if at <= 0 || raw[:at] != "git" {
169			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
170		}
171		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
172		if colon < 0 {
173			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
174		}
175		colon += at + 1
176		host := raw[at+1 : colon]

179		}
180		path := stripQueryFragment(raw[colon+1:])
181		segments, ok := decodeURLPath(path)
182		if !ok {
183			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
184		}
185		return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: strings.ToLower(host), segments: segments}, true

207	func decodeURLPath(path string) ([]string, bool) {
208		path = strings.Trim(path, "/")

219			if err != nil || decoded == "" || decoded == "." || decoded == ".." || !utf8.ValidString(decoded) ||
220				strings.ContainsAny(decoded, `/\\`) || hasEncodedSeparator(decoded) || containsControl(decoded) {
221				return nil, false
222			}
223			segments = append(segments, decoded)
224		}
225		return segments, true
226	}

266	func hasEncodedSeparator(value string) bool {
267		current := value
268		for depth := 0; depth < 8; depth++ {
269			lower := strings.ToLower(current)
270			if strings.Contains(lower, "%2f") || strings.Contains(lower, "%5c") {
271				return true
272			}
273			if !strings.ContainsRune(current, '%') {
274				return false
275			}
276			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(current)
277			if err != nil || decoded == current {
278				return false
279			}
280			current = decoded
281		}
282		// Deeply nested escaping is unnecessary for repository identities and is
283		// ambiguous across clients with different decode counts.
284		return true
285	}

291		return value

364	func normalizeConfiguredHost(raw string) (string, bool) {
365		if !safeRawURLText(raw) {
366			return "", false
367		}
368		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
369		if raw == "" {
370			return "", false
371		}
372		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
373			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
374			if err != nil || !strings.EqualFold(u.Scheme, "https") || u.User != nil || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" ||
375				u.Path != "" && u.Path != "/" || u.Hostname() == "" || u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
376				return "", false
377			}
378			raw = u.Hostname()
379		} else if strings.ContainsAny(raw, `/\\@?#`) {
380			return "", false
381		} else {
382			u, err := url.Parse("//" + raw)
383			if err != nil || u.Hostname() == "" || u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
384				return "", false
385			}
386			raw = u.Hostname()
387		}
388		if !validWebHost(raw) || !strings.Contains(raw, ".") {
389			return "", false
390		}
391		return strings.ToLower(raw), true
392	}

394	func validWebHost(host string) bool {
395		if host == "" || strings.HasSuffix(host, ".") || !utf8.ValidString(host) {
396			return false
397		}
398		for _, r := range host {
399			if r > unicode.MaxASCII || !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' || r == '-' || r == '.') {
400				return false
401			}
402		}
403		for _, label := range strings.Split(host, ".") {
404			if label == "" || strings.HasPrefix(label, "-") || strings.HasSuffix(label, "-") {
405				return false
406			}
407		}
408		return true
409	}

12	const unsafeRemoteLabel = "<unsafe remote>"
13
14	// RedactRemoteRef returns a terminal-safe remote reference for public display.
15	// URL userinfo, query, and fragment components are removed structurally. SSH
16	// usernames such as git@host remain visible, while an scp-like prefix containing
17	// a password/token separator is redacted. Invalid UTF-8, controls, malformed
18	// explicit URLs, and encoded path controls are replaced by a fixed label.
19	func RedactRemoteRef(ref string) string {
20		if !utf8.ValidString(ref) || strings.IndexFunc(ref, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
21			return unsafeRemoteLabel
22		}
23		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
24		if ref == "" {
25			return ""
26		}
27		parsed, err := url.Parse(ref)
28		explicitURL := strings.Contains(ref, "://")
29		if explicitURL && (err != nil || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" && !strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file")) {
30			return unsafeRemoteLabel
31		}
32		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && (explicitURL || parsed.Host != "" || strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file")) {
33			path, unescapeErr := url.PathUnescape(parsed.EscapedPath())
34			if unescapeErr != nil || !utf8.ValidString(path) || strings.IndexFunc(path, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
35				return unsafeRemoteLabel
36			}
37			parsed.User = nil
38			parsed.RawQuery = ""
39			parsed.ForceQuery = false
40			parsed.Fragment = ""
41			parsed.RawFragment = ""
42			redacted := parsed.String()
43			if !utf8.ValidString(redacted) || strings.IndexFunc(redacted, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
44				return unsafeRemoteLabel
45			}
46			return redacted
47		}
48		if err != nil && strings.Contains(ref, "://") {
49			return unsafeRemoteLabel
50		}
51
52		at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@')
53		if at > 0 && strings.Contains(ref[:at], ":") {
54			return "***@" + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[at+1:])
55		}
56		if at > 0 {
57			colon := strings.IndexByte(ref[at+1:], ':')
58			if colon >= 0 {
59				colon += at + 1
60				return ref[:colon+1] + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[colon+1:])
61			}
62		}
63		if colon := strings.IndexByte(ref, ':'); colon > 0 && !strings.ContainsAny(ref[:colon], `/\\`) && !isDrivePrefix(ref[:colon+1]) {
64			return ref[:colon+1] + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[colon+1:])
65		}
66		return ref
67	}

69	// RedactCloneRef is retained for existing clone results and diagnostics. It
70	// changes display only; callers continue to pass the original reference to Git.
71	func RedactCloneRef(ref string) string {
72		return RedactRemoteRef(ref)
73	}
74
75	func isRemoteControl(r rune) bool {
76		return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
77	}
78
79	func isDrivePrefix(value string) bool {
80		return len(value) == 2 && value[1] == ':' && (value[0] >= 'a' && value[0] <= 'z' || value[0] >= 'A' && value[0] <= 'Z')
81	}
82
83	func stripRemoteQueryFragment(value string) string {
84		if index := strings.IndexAny(value, "?#"); index >= 0 {
85			return value[:index]
86		}
87		return value
88	}

90	// RedactCloneError returns an error whose displayed message cannot echo
91	// credential-bearing clone references passed to Git.
92	func RedactCloneError(err error, refs ...string) error {
93		if err == nil {
94			return nil
95		}
96		message := err.Error()
97		refs = append([]string(nil), refs...)
98		sort.SliceStable(refs, func(i, j int) bool { return len(refs[i]) > len(refs[j]) })
99		for _, ref := range refs {
100			if ref == "" {
101				continue
102			}
103			message = strings.ReplaceAll(message, ref, RedactCloneRef(ref))
104			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(ref)
105			if trimmed != "" && trimmed != ref {
106				message = strings.ReplaceAll(message, trimmed, RedactCloneRef(trimmed))
107			}
108		}
109		return errors.New(message)
110	}

30		"paths": true, "runtime": true, "stats": true, "tui": true,
31		"bootstrap": true, "forge": true, "update": true,
32	}
33
34	var allowedScaffoldTopLevel = map[string]bool{
35		"version": true, "default_preset": true, "default_agents": true, "presets": true,
36	}

38	// Load reads the two fixed project files without changing the repository.
39	// legacy may be nil. When supplied, its values have lower precedence than
40	// .dev-cli/config.toml and its source is retained per effective field.
41	func Load(repoRoot string, legacy *Layer) (Result, error) {
42		paths, err := ResolvePaths(repoRoot)
43		if err != nil {
44			return Result{}, err
45		}
46		result := Result{Paths: paths, Sources: map[string]string{}}
47
48		if legacy != nil {
49			source := strings.TrimSpace(legacy.Source)
50			if source == "" {
51				source = LegacySource
52			}
53			if err := legacy.Override.validate(); err != nil {
54				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("validate legacy project config %s: %w", source, err)
55			}
56			result.Effective = overlay(result.Effective, legacy.Override, source, result.Sources)
57			result.Layers = append(result.Layers, source)
58		}
59
60		configData, present, err := readOptional(paths.Config)
61		if err != nil {
62			return Result{}, err
63		}
64		result.ConfigPresent = present
65		if present {
66			project, metadata, err := decodeProjectConfig(configData)
67			if err != nil {
68				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", paths.Config, err)
69			}
70			if project.Version != nil && *project.Version != projectConfigVersion {
71				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: version %d is unsupported (want %d)", paths.Config, *project.Version, projectConfigVersion)
72			}
73			result.Project = Override{Worktree: project.Worktree, LocalFiles: project.LocalFiles, Repo: project.Repo}
74			if err := result.Project.validate(); err != nil {
75				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("validate %s: %w", paths.Config, err)
76			}
77			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnosticsForUndecoded(paths.Config, metadata.Undecoded())...)
78			result.Effective = overlay(result.Effective, result.Project, paths.Config, result.Sources)
79			result.Layers = append(result.Layers, paths.Config)
80		}
81
82		scaffoldData, present, err := readOptional(paths.Scaffolds)
83		if err != nil {
84			return Result{}, err
85		}
86		result.ScaffoldsPresent = present
87		var scaffoldDocument map[string]any
88		if present {
89			if _, err := toml.Decode(string(scaffoldData), &scaffoldDocument); err != nil {
90				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", paths.Scaffolds, err)
91			}
92			if err := validateScaffoldVersion(scaffoldDocument); err != nil {
93				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", paths.Scaffolds, err)
94			}
95			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, scaffoldDiagnostics(paths.Scaffolds, scaffoldDocument)...)
96		}
97
98		result.ExecutionHash, err = executionHash(paths.Root, result.Effective, scaffoldDocument)
99		if err != nil {
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("hash executable project config: %w", err)
101		}
102		sortDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics)
103		return result, nil
104	}
105
106	func readOptional(path string) ([]byte, bool, error) {
107		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
108		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
109			return nil, false, nil
110		}
111		if err != nil {
112			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
113		}
114		return data, true, nil
115	}
116
117	func decodeProjectConfig(data []byte) (projectFile, toml.MetaData, error) {
118		var project projectFile
119		metadata, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &project)
120		return project, metadata, err
121	}
122
123	func diagnosticsForUndecoded(source string, keys []toml.Key) []Diagnostic {
124		diagnostics := make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(keys))
125		seenDenied := map[string]bool{}
126		seenUnknown := map[string]bool{}
127		for _, undecoded := range keys {
128			key := undecoded.String()
129			top, _, _ := strings.Cut(key, ".")
130			if deniedTopLevelSections[top] {
131				if seenDenied[top] {
132					continue
133				}
134				seenDenied[top] = true
135				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
136					Kind: DiagnosticDenied, Source: source, Key: top,
137					Message: fmt.Sprintf("project config cannot override host section %s", top),
138				})
139				continue
140			}
141			if seenUnknown[key] {
142				continue
143			}
144			seenUnknown[key] = true
145			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
146				Kind: DiagnosticUnknown, Source: source, Key: key,
147				Message: fmt.Sprintf("unknown project config key %s was ignored", key),
148			})
149		}
150		return diagnostics
151	}
152
153	func scaffoldDiagnostics(source string, document map[string]any) []Diagnostic {
154		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
155		for key := range document {
156			if allowedScaffoldTopLevel[key] {
157				continue
158			}
159			kind := DiagnosticUnknown
160			message := fmt.Sprintf("unknown scaffold config section %s was ignored", key)
161			if deniedTopLevelSections[key] {
162				kind = DiagnosticDenied
163				message = fmt.Sprintf("scaffold config cannot override host section %s", key)
164			}
165			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Kind: kind, Source: source, Key: key, Message: message})
166		}
167		return diagnostics
168	}
169
170	func validateScaffoldVersion(document map[string]any) error {
171		value, ok := document["version"]
172		if !ok {
173			return nil
174		}
175		version, ok := value.(int64)
176		if !ok {
177			return fmt.Errorf("version must be an integer")
178		}
179		if version != projectConfigVersion {
180			return fmt.Errorf("version %d is unsupported (want %d)", version, projectConfigVersion)
181		}
182		return nil
183	}
184
185	func overlay(base, next Override, source string, sources map[string]string) Override {
186		if next.Worktree.Include != nil {
187			value := append([]string(nil), (*next.Worktree.Include)...)
188			base.Worktree.Include = &value
189			sources["worktree.include"] = source
190		}
191		if next.Worktree.Link != nil {

201		}

203			value := *next.Worktree.Strategy
204			base.Worktree.Strategy = &value
205			sources["worktree.strategy"] = source
206		}
207		if next.Worktree.Strategies != nil {
208			merged := map[string]string{}
209			if base.Worktree.Strategies != nil {
210				for key, value := range *base.Worktree.Strategies {
211					merged[key] = value
212				}
213			}
214			for key, value := range *next.Worktree.Strategies {
215				merged[key] = value
216				sources["worktree.strategies."+key] = source
217			}
218			base.Worktree.Strategies = &merged
219		}
220		if next.Worktree.ProvisionTimeout != nil {
221			value := *next.Worktree.ProvisionTimeout
222			base.Worktree.ProvisionTimeout = &value
223			sources["worktree.provision_timeout"] = source
224		}
225		if next.LocalFiles.Include != nil {
226			value := append([]string(nil), (*next.LocalFiles.Include)...)
227			base.LocalFiles.Include = &value
228			sources["local_files.include"] = source
229		}
230		if next.Repo.Setup.Preset != nil {
231			value := *next.Repo.Setup.Preset
232			base.Repo.Setup.Preset = &value
233			sources["repo.setup.preset"] = source
234		}
235		if next.Repo.Setup.Handoff != nil {
236			value := *next.Repo.Setup.Handoff
237			base.Repo.Setup.Handoff = &value

250			base.Repo.Setup.CheckIn = nil
251			delete(sources, "repo.setup.check_in")
252			sources["repo.setup.commit"] = source
253		}
254		return base
255	}

257	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
258		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
259			if diagnostics[i].Source != diagnostics[j].Source {
260				return diagnostics[i].Source < diagnostics[j].Source
261			}
262			if diagnostics[i].Key != diagnostics[j].Key {
263				return diagnostics[i].Key < diagnostics[j].Key
264			}
265			return diagnostics[i].Kind < diagnostics[j].Kind
266		})
267	}

+// File-count and byte-size ceilings live in safefile because they describe a

+type PortablePathLimits struct {

+	MaxComponentBytes int

+
+// ValidatePortableSlashPath accepts only a non-empty, clean, slash-separated
+// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects
+// Git metadata aliases, platform-specific separators and volumes, Windows
+// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
+// invalid UTF-8.
+func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
+	if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
+	}

+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}

+		return fmt.Errorf("path is empty: %w", ErrNotPortable)

+	if limits.MaxPathBytes > 0 && len(value) > limits.MaxPathBytes {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(value), limits.MaxPathBytes, ErrPathLimit)

+		}
+		if err := ValidatePortableComponent(component, limits.MaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q: %w", component, err)
+		}
+	}

+// ValidatePortableComponent applies the per-component part of
+// ValidatePortableSlashPath. maxBytes may be zero for no size limit.
+func ValidatePortableComponent(component string, maxBytes int) error {
+	if maxBytes < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("negative component limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if !utf8.ValidString(component) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("component contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", err, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if maxBytes > 0 && len(component) > maxBytes {
+		return fmt.Errorf("component is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(component), maxBytes, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if strings.IndexFunc(component, isPortableControl) >= 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component contains control characters: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	windowsAlias := strings.TrimRight(component, ". ")
+	if strings.EqualFold(windowsAlias, ".git") {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains reserved Git metadata: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if windowsAlias != component {

+	}
+	if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q contains characters that are not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}

+// ValidatePortablePathSet validates every path and rejects collisions at any
+// component boundary after Unicode normalization and full Unicode case folding.
+// Exact duplicate paths are left to the caller's type/cardinality policy.
+func ValidatePortablePathSet(paths []string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
+	type collisionNode struct {
+		spelling string
+		first    string
+		children map[string]*collisionNode
+	}
+	root := &collisionNode{children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
+	for _, value := range paths {
+		if err := ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, limits); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("portable path %q: %w", value, err)
+		}
+		current := root
+		for _, component := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
+			key := portableCollisionKey(component)
+			next, exists := current.children[key]
+			if exists && next.spelling != component {
+				return fmt.Errorf("paths %q and %q collide on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems at %q and %q: %w",

+			if !exists {
+				next = &collisionNode{spelling: component, first: value, children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
+				current.children[key] = next
+			}
+			current = next
+		}
+	}

+	runes := []rune(upper)

+	return last >= '1' && last <= '9' || last == '¹' || last == '²' || last == '³'

138			if file.planned.Action != actionCurrent || envelope.RetainForEvict {
139				if err := store.writeBlob(store.blobPath(index), file.content, file.spec.executable()); err != nil {
140					return ApplyResponse{}, err
141				}
142			}
143			if file.planned.Action == actionReplace {
144				if err := store.writeBlob(store.rollbackPath(index), file.before.data, file.before.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0); err != nil {
145					return ApplyResponse{}, err
146				}
147			}
148		}
149		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
150			return ApplyResponse{}, err
151		}
152		if err := s.fault("after-stage", ""); err != nil {
153			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
154		}
155		value.Phase = phaseApplying
156		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
157			return ApplyResponse{}, err
158		}
159
160		for index, file := range files {
161			if file.planned.Action == actionCurrent {
162				value.Files[index].State = StateCurrent
163				continue
164			}
165			if err := s.fault("before-publish", file.spec.Path); err != nil {
166				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
167			}
168			parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, file.spec.Path, true)
169			if err != nil {
170				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
171			}
172			name := pathBase(file.spec.Path)
173			switch file.planned.Action {
174			case actionCreate:
175				_, err = safefile.CreatePrivateNoClobber(ctx, parent.parent, name, file.content, file.spec.executable())
176			case actionReplace:
177				_, err = safefile.AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx, parent.parent, name, file.before.info, file.content, file.spec.executable())
178			default:
179				err = errors.New("invalid local-files publication action")
180			}
181			closeErr := parent.close()
182			err = errors.Join(err, closeErr)
183			if err != nil {
184				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
185			}
186			if err := s.fault("after-publish", file.spec.Path); err != nil {
187				// The journal may not yet say Published. rollback infers publication
188				// from the exact old/new digests, which covers this crash boundary.
189				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
190			}
191			value.Files[index].Published = true
192			if file.planned.Action == actionCreate {
193				value.Files[index].State = StateCreated
194			} else {
195				value.Files[index].State = StateReplaced
196			}
197			if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
198				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
199			}
200		}
201		if err := s.fault("before-final-verify", ""); err != nil {
202			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
203		}
204		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
205			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
206		}
207		if err := s.fault("before-complete", ""); err != nil {
208			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
209		}
210		value.Phase = phaseCompleted
211		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
212			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
213		}
214		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(envelope.RetainForEvict); err != nil {
215			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("local-files apply completed but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
216		}
217		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
218	}

220	func (s *Service) validateNegotiatedLimits(request PlanRequest) error {
221		host := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
222		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(host, request.Limits)
223		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
224			return errors.New("apply limits do not match target policy")
225		}
226		return nil

229	func preflightApply(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope) ([]preflightFile, []string, error) {
230		payloads := map[string][]byte{}
231		for _, payload := range envelope.Payloads {
232			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
233			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
234				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("decode canonical payload for %q", payload.Path)
235			}
236			payloads[payload.Path] = decoded
237		}
238		files := make([]preflightFile, len(envelope.Request.Files))
239		missingSet := map[string]bool{}
240		for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
241			planned := envelope.Plan.Files[index]
242			if planned.Action == "" {
243				return nil, nil, ErrPlanBlocked
244			}
245			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
246				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
247			}
248			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
249			if err != nil {
250				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
251			}
252			file := preflightFile{spec: spec, planned: planned, before: observed}
253			switch planned.Action {
254			case actionCurrent:
255				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
256					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q is no longer current: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
257				}
258				file.content = observed.data
259			case actionCreate:
260				if observed.exists {
261					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q appeared after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
262				}
263				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
264			case actionReplace:
265				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != planned.TargetSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
266					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed before replacement: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
267				}
268				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
269			default:
270				return nil, nil, errors.New("invalid local-files target action")
271			}
272			if int64(len(file.content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(file.content) != spec.SHA256 {
273				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("content for %q no longer matches the plan", spec.Path)
274			}
275			missing, err := missingParentDirectories(checkout, spec.Path)
276			if err != nil {
277				return nil, nil, err
278			}
279			for _, directory := range missing {
280				missingSet[directory] = true
281			}
282			files[index] = file
283		}
284		missing := make([]string, 0, len(missingSet))
285		for directory := range missingSet {
286			missing = append(missing, directory)
287		}
288		sort.Strings(missing)
289		return files, missing, nil
290	}

292	func (s *Service) failAndRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal, cause error) error {
293		value.Phase = phaseReconcile
294		_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
295		if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, value); err != nil {
296			value.Phase = phaseReconcile
297			_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
298			return errors.New("local-files apply failed and requires reconciliation")
299		}
300		value.Phase = phaseRolledBack
301		for index := range value.Files {
302			if value.Files[index].Action != actionCurrent {
303				value.Files[index].State = StateRolledBack
304				value.Files[index].Published = false
305			}
306		}
307		if err := store.writeJournal(*value); err != nil {
308			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but journal finalization failed")
309		}
310		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
311			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
312		}
313		return fmt.Errorf("local-files apply failed and was rolled back: %w", cause)
314	}
315
316	func (s *Service) rollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal) error {
317		for index := len(value.Files) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
318			entry := &value.Files[index]
319			if entry.Action == actionCurrent {
320				continue
321			}
322			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
323			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
324				return err
325			}
326			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
327			if err != nil {
328				return err
329			}
330			switch entry.Action {
331			case actionCreate:
332				if !observed.exists {
333					continue
334				}
335				if observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
336					return errors.New("created target changed before rollback")
337				}
338				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
339				if err != nil {
340					return err
341				}
342				err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(spec.Path))
343				err = errors.Join(err, syncHeldRoot(parent.parent), parent.close())
344				if err != nil {
345					return err
346				}
347			case actionReplace:
348				if observed.exists && observed.digest == entry.OldSHA256 {
349					continue
350				}
351				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
352					return errors.New("replacement target changed before rollback")
353				}
354				oldContent, err := store.readBlob(index, true, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
355				if err != nil || digestBytes(oldContent) != entry.OldSHA256 {
356					return errors.New("replacement rollback blob is unavailable")
357				}
358				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
359				if err != nil {
360					return err
361				}
362				current, err := parent.parent.Lstat(pathBase(spec.Path))
363				oldMode, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(entry.OldMode, 8, 12)
364				err = errors.Join(err, modeErr)
365				if err == nil {
366					_, err = safefile.AtomicReplace(ctx, parent.parent, pathBase(spec.Path), current, oldContent, fs.FileMode(oldMode))
367				}
368				err = errors.Join(err, parent.close())
369				if err != nil {
370					return err
371				}
372			}
373		}
374		directories := append([]string(nil), value.CreatedDirs...)
375		sort.Slice(directories, func(i, j int) bool {
376			left, right := strings.Count(directories[i], "/"), strings.Count(directories[j], "/")
377			if left != right {
378				return left > right
379			}
380			return directories[i] > directories[j]
381		})
382		for _, directory := range directories {
383			if err := removeEmptyDirectory(checkout.root, directory); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
384				return err
385			}
386		}
387		return verifyRollback(ctx, checkout.root, envelope, *value)
388	}
389
390	func verifyRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope, value journal) error {
391		for index, entry := range value.Files {
392			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
393			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
394			if err != nil {
395				return err
396			}
397			switch entry.Action {
398			case actionCurrent:
399				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != envelope.Plan.Files[index].TargetMode {
400					return errors.New("current target changed during rollback")
401				}
402			case actionCreate:
403				if observed.exists {
404					return errors.New("created target remains after rollback")
405				}
406			case actionReplace:
407				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != entry.OldSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != entry.OldMode {
408					return errors.New("replacement target was not restored")
409				}
410			}
411		}
412		return nil
413	}
414
415	func (s *Service) verifyCompleted(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value journal) (ApplyResponse, error) {
416		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
417			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files journal no longer matches the checkout")
418		}
419		if value.RetainForEvict {
420			for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
421				content, err := store.readBlob(index, false, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
422				if err != nil || int64(len(content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(content) != spec.SHA256 {
423					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("retained local-files recovery blob is unavailable")
424				}
425			}
426		} else if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
427			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
428		}
429		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
430	}
431
432	func verifyAllCurrent(ctx context.Context, checkout string, specs []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
433		for _, spec := range specs {
434			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
435				return err
436			}
437			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, limits, true)
438			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size {
439				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q failed post-write verification", spec.Path)
440			}
441			if fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != spec.Mode {
442				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q permissions do not match the manifest", spec.Path)
443			}
444		}
445		return nil
446	}
447
448	func responseFromJournal(value journal) ApplyResponse {
449		files := make([]PublicFile, len(value.Files))
450		for index, entry := range value.Files {
451			files[index] = PublicFile{Path: entry.Path, Size: entry.Size, Mode: entry.Mode, State: entry.State}
452		}
453		return ApplyResponse{
454			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
455			RequestID: value.RequestID, PlanDigest: value.PlanDigest, Files: files,
456		}
457	}

459	func (s *Service) fault(point, path string) error {

461			return nil
462		}
463		return s.Fault(point, path)

466	type heldParent struct {
467		checkout string
468		rootInfo fs.FileInfo
469		root     *os.Root
470		parent   *os.Root
471		roots    []*os.Root
472		edges    []heldEdge
473	}
474
475	type heldEdge struct {
476		parent *os.Root
477		name   string
478		info   fs.FileInfo
479	}
480
481	func openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath string, create bool) (*heldParent, error) {
482		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
483			return nil, err
484		}
485		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
486		if err != nil {
487			return nil, err
488		}
489		held := &heldParent{checkout: checkout, rootInfo: rootInfo, root: root, parent: root, roots: []*os.Root{root}}
490		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
491		prefix := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1)
492		for _, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
493			prefix = append(prefix, component)
494			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
495			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
496				if err := held.parent.Mkdir(component, 0o700); err != nil {
497					_ = held.close()
498					return nil, err
499				}
500				child, info, err = safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
501			}
502			if err != nil {
503				_ = held.close()
504				return nil, err
505			}
506			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
507				_ = child.Close()
508				_ = held.close()
509				return nil, ErrUnsafe
510			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
511				_ = child.Close()
512				_ = held.close()
513				return nil, err
514			}
515			held.edges = append(held.edges, heldEdge{parent: held.parent, name: component, info: info})
516			held.roots = append(held.roots, child)
517			held.parent = child
518		}
519		return held, nil
520	}
521
522	func (h *heldParent) close() error {
523		if h == nil {
524			return nil
525		}
526		var result error
527		for index := len(h.edges) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
528			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(h.edges[index].parent, h.edges[index].name, h.edges[index].info))
529		}
530		result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyRoot(h.checkout, h.rootInfo))
531		for index := len(h.roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
532			result = errors.Join(result, h.roots[index].Close())
533		}
534		h.roots = nil
535		return result
536	}
537
538	func syncHeldRoot(root *os.Root) error {
539		file, err := root.Open(".")
540		if err != nil {
541			return err
542		}
543		defer file.Close()
544		return file.Sync()
545	}
546
547	func missingParentDirectories(checkout, slashPath string) ([]string, error) {
548		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
549		root, _, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
550		if err != nil {
551			return nil, err
552		}
553		roots := []*os.Root{root}
554		defer func() {
555			for index := len(roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
556				_ = roots[index].Close()
557			}
558		}()
559		current := root
560		for index, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
561			child, _, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(current, component)
562			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
563				missing := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1-index)
564				for end := index + 1; end < len(components); end++ {
565					missing = append(missing, strings.Join(components[:end], "/"))
566				}
567				return missing, nil
568			}
569			if err != nil {
570				return nil, err
571			}
572			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
573				_ = child.Close()
574				return nil, ErrUnsafe
575			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
576				_ = child.Close()
577				return nil, err
578			}
579			roots = append(roots, child)
580			current = child
581		}
582		return nil, nil
583	}
584
585	func removeEmptyDirectory(checkout, slashPath string) error {
586		parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath, false)
587		if err != nil {
588			return err
589		}
590		err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(slashPath))
591		return errors.Join(err, parent.close())
592	}
593
594	func pathBase(slashPath string) string {
595		parts := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
596		return parts[len(parts)-1]
597	}

392	func targetErrorIs(err error, code TargetCode) bool {
393		var target *TargetError
394		return errors.As(err, &target) && target.Code == code
395	}

397	func runGit(t *testing.T, directory string, args ...string) string {
398		t.Helper()
399		command := exec.Command("git", args...)
400		command.Dir = directory
401		command.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1", "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0")
402		output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
403		if err != nil {
404			t.Fatalf("git %s in %s: %v\n%s", strings.Join(args, " "), directory, err, output)
405		}
406		return strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
407	}

409	func writeTestFile(t *testing.T, path, body string) {
410		t.Helper()
411		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
412			t.Fatal(err)
413		}
414		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
415			t.Fatal(err)
416		}
417	}

419	func assertTestFile(t *testing.T, path, body string, mode os.FileMode) {
420		t.Helper()
421		got, err := os.ReadFile(path)
422		if err != nil || string(got) != body {
423			t.Fatalf("%s = %q, %v; want %q", path, got, err, body)
424		}
425		if runtime.GOOS != "windows" {
426			info, err := os.Stat(path)
427			if err != nil || info.Mode().Perm() != mode {
428				t.Fatalf("%s mode = %v, %v; want %o", path, info.Mode().Perm(), err, mode)
429			}
430		}
431	}

24	func (r *recordingRunner) RunWithOptions(_ context.Context, _ fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, options fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result {
25		r.calls = append(r.calls, recordedCall{args: append([]string(nil), args...), stdin: append([]byte(nil), stdin...), retry: options.Retry})
26		if len(r.results) == 0 {
27			return fleet.Result{ExitCode: 127}

29		result := r.results[0]
30		r.results = r.results[1:]
31		return result
32	}

518	// The result remains only a hint for matching.
519	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {

523		}

526		}

530			}

532				return remoteIdentityKey(parsed.Host, parsed.EscapedPath())
533			}
534		}
535		if looksLikeLocalRemote(identity) {
536			return ""
537		}
538
539		afterUser := identity
540		user := ""
541		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(afterUser, '@'); at >= 0 {
542			user, afterUser = afterUser[:at], afterUser[at+1:]

544		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
545			if user != "" && !strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && !strings.HasPrefix(remotePath, "/") {

547			}
548			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
549		}

551		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
552		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
553			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
554		}
555		return ""
556	}

558	func normalizeAzureDevOpsRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
559		if kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(identity); kind == forge.AzureDevOps && name != "" {
560			return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + name
561		}
562
563		// Records written before Azure support already contain the generic
564		// host/path form. Recognize it so existing catalog entries migrate on read.
565		trimmed := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSpace(identity), ".git"), "/")
566		parts := strings.Split(trimmed, "/")
567		decode := func(values []string) ([]string, bool) {
568			out := make([]string, len(values))
569			for i, value := range values {
570				decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(value)
571				if err != nil || decoded == "" || strings.Contains(decoded, "/") {
572					return nil, false
573				}
574				out[i] = decoded
575			}
576			return out, true
577		}
578		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "dev.azure.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[3], "_git") {
579			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{parts[1], parts[2], parts[4]}); ok {
580				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")

582		}
583		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "ssh.dev.azure.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[1], "v3") {

587		}
588		if len(parts) >= 4 && strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(parts[0]), ".visualstudio.com") &&
589			!strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[len(parts)-2], "_git") {
590			organization := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.ToLower(parts[0]), ".visualstudio.com")
591			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{organization, parts[len(parts)-3], parts[len(parts)-1]}); ok {
592				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")

594		}
595		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com") &&

597			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{strings.TrimPrefix(parts[1], "~"), parts[2], parts[4]}); ok {
598				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
599			}
600		}
601		return ""
602	}

604	func looksLikeLocalRemote(identity string) bool {
605		if filepath.IsAbs(identity) || strings.HasPrefix(identity, `\\`) {
606			return true
607		}
608		for _, prefix := range []string{"./", "../", "~/", `.\`, `..\`, `~\`} {
609			if strings.HasPrefix(identity, prefix) {
610				return true
611			}
612		}
613		if len(identity) >= 2 && identity[1] == ':' {
614			letter := identity[0]
615			if letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z' {
616				return true
617			}
618		}
619		return !strings.ContainsAny(identity, `/\:@`)

87	// Discover walks every root and returns the repositories found, sorted by
88	// display name. Unreadable directories are skipped rather than fatal — a scan
89	// root that has been unmounted must not break `dev ls`.
90	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
91		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
92			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
93		}
94		seen := map[string]bool{}
95		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
96		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
97		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
98		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
99		identities := map[string]bool{}
100		var out []Repo
101
102		for _, root := range roots {
103			info, err := os.Stat(root)
104			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
105				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
106			}
107			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
108
109			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
110				if err != nil {
111					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
112				}
113				if ctx.Err() != nil {
114					return ctx.Err()
115				}
116				isRoot := path == rootClean
117				name := d.Name()
118				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
119				isDir := d.IsDir()
120				if isLink {
121					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
122					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
123					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
124					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
125						isDir = info.IsDir()
126					}
127				}
128				if !isDir {
129					return nil
130				}
131				if !isRoot && (skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare")) {
132					return filepath.SkipDir
133				}
134
135				rel := "."
136				depth := 0
137				if !isRoot {
138					rel, _ = filepath.Rel(rootClean, path)
139					depth = len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
140				}
141
142				if isRepoDir(path) {
143					real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
144					if real == "" {
145						real = path
146					}
147					bare := isBareDir(path)
148					identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot := real, real, real, real

151						// worktree. Submodules are already hidden below their parent
152						// repository because discovery never descends into one.
153						return filepath.SkipDir
154					}
155					if !bare && !opts.Fast {
156						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path); err == nil {
157							// A linked worktree is execution state, not another
158							// project in the repo inventory.
159							if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
160								return filepath.SkipDir
161							}
162							identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot = g.GitCommonDir, g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir, g.MainRoot
163							real = g.MainRoot
164						}
165					}
166					if !seen[path] && !identities[identity] {
167						seen[path], identities[identity] = true, true
168						out = append(out, Repo{
169							Name:      name,
170							Path:      path,
171							RealPath:  real,
172							Symlink:   isLink,
173							Root:      rootClean,
174							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
175							GitDir:    gitDir,
176							CommonDir: commonDir,
177							MainRoot:  mainRoot,
178							Bare:      bare,
179							HasGit:    true,
180						})
181					}
182					// Never descend into a repo: its subdirectories are source
183					// code, and any nested .git is a submodule or a worktree that
184					// belongs to this repo, not a project of its own.
185					return filepath.SkipDir
186				}
187				if depth >= opts.MaxDepth {
188					return filepath.SkipDir
189				}
190				if opts.IncludeNonRepos && depth == 1 {
191					if !seen[path] {
192						seen[path] = true
193						out = append(out, Repo{Name: name, Path: path, Root: rootClean, Category: ""})
194					}
195				}
196				return nil
197			})
198			if err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
199				return out, ctx.Err()
200			}
201		}
202
203		for i := range out {

217	// isRepoDir reports whether path is a repository root: it holds a .git entry
218	// (directory for a normal clone, file for a linked worktree or submodule).
219	func isRepoDir(path string) bool {
220		if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
221			return true
222		}
223		return isBareDir(path)
224	}

226	func gitEntryIsFile(path string) bool {

231	// isBareDir recognises a bare repository by its skeleton, without shelling out.
232	func isBareDir(path string) bool {
233		for _, marker := range []string{"HEAD", "objects", "refs"} {
234			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, marker)); err != nil {
235				return false
236			}

241	// Resolve finds a repo by name, display name, or path.
242	//
243	// Matching is deliberately layered: an exact name or path wins outright, and
244	// only then does a substring search run — so a repo literally named "web"
245	// is never shadowed by "web-frontend".
246	func Resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
247		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, DefaultOptions())
248	}

250	// ResolveCompletion resolves the same references without launching one Git
251	// process per repository in the scan roots.
252	func ResolveCompletion(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
253		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, CompletionOptions())

256	func resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string, opts Options) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
257		all, err := Discover(ctx, roots, opts)
258		if err != nil {
259			return Repo{}, nil, err
260		}
261		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
262			if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, abs); err == nil {
263				real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs)
264				if real == "" {
265					real = g.MainRoot
266				}
267				// Preserve an explicit navigation alias. The caller named this
268				// path on purpose; resolving it to the physical checkout would
269				// defeat a bootstrap symlink catalog.
270				return Repo{
271					Name: filepath.Base(abs), Path: abs, RealPath: real,
272					Symlink: real != abs, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
273				}, nil, nil
274			}
275		}
276		for _, r := range all {
277			if r.Name == ref || r.Display() == ref || r.Path == ref {
278				return r, nil, nil
279			}
280		}
281		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
282		var hits []Repo
283		for _, r := range all {
284			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Display()), needle) {
285				hits = append(hits, r)
286			}
287		}
288		switch len(hits) {
289		case 1:
290			return hits[0], nil, nil
291		case 0:
292			return Repo{}, nil, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref}
293		default:
294			return Repo{}, hits, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: hits}
295		}
296	}

298	// NotFoundError reports a repo reference that matched nothing.
299	type NotFoundError struct{ Ref string }
300
301	func (e *NotFoundError) Error() string { return "no repository matching " + e.Ref }
302
303	// AmbiguousError reports a repo reference that matched several repos.
304	type AmbiguousError struct {
305		Ref        string
306		Candidates []Repo
307	}
308
309	func (e *AmbiguousError) Error() string {
310		names := make([]string, len(e.Candidates))
311		for i, c := range e.Candidates {
312			names[i] = c.Display()
313		}
314		return e.Ref + " is ambiguous: " + strings.Join(names, ", ")
315	}

91						RemoteIdentity: identity, Branch: status.Branch, HeadOID: head,
92						SourceMachine: sourceMachine, TargetMachine: capability.MachineID,
93					},
94					Patterns: patterns, Limits: limits, Replace: replace,
95				})
96				if err != nil {
97					if len(sourceReport.Files) > 0 {
98						if renderErr := renderFleetFilesReport(app, sourceReport, jsonOutput); renderErr != nil {
99							return renderErr
100						}
101					}
102					return err
103				}
104				plan, err := client.Plan(ctxOf(), host, capability, source.Request())
105				if err != nil {
106					return err
107				}
108				planReport := plan.PublicReport()
109				if !planReport.Successful() {
110					if err := renderFleetFilesReport(app, planReport, jsonOutput); err != nil {
111						return err
112					}
113					return localfiles.ErrPlanBlocked
114				}
115				if !apply {
116					return renderFleetFilesReport(app, planReport, jsonOutput)
117				}
118				if jsonOutput && !yes {
119					return errors.New("fleet files --apply --json requires --yes")
120				}
121				if !yes {
122					if !app.interactive() {
123						return errors.New("non-interactive fleet files --apply requires --yes")
124					}
125					if err := renderFleetFilesReport(app, planReport, false); err != nil {
126						return err
127					}
128					if !confirm(app, bufio.NewReader(app.In), fmt.Sprintf("apply %d portable file(s) to %s", len(planReport.Files), host.Name)) {
129						fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Cancelled; no files changed.")
130						return nil
131					}
132				}
133				envelope, err := source.BuildEnvelope(ctxOf(), plan, retainForEvict)
134				if err != nil {
135					return err
136				}
137				result, err := client.Apply(ctxOf(), host, capability, envelope)
138				if err != nil {
139					return err
140				}
141				return renderFleetFilesReport(app, result.PublicReport(), jsonOutput)
142			},
143		}
144		flags := cmd.Flags()
145		flags.StringArrayVar(&targets, "to", nil, "single configured target host (required)")
146		flags.StringArrayVar(&filePatterns, "file", nil, "additional portable relative pattern (repeatable)")
147		flags.BoolVar(&apply, "apply", false, "apply the verified plan")
148		flags.BoolVar(&replace, "replace", false, "replace differing target files observed by this plan")
149		flags.BoolVar(&yes, "yes", false, "confirm apply without prompting (does not imply --replace)")
150		flags.BoolVar(&jsonOutput, "json", false, "emit content-free JSON")
151		flags.BoolVar(&retainForEvict, "retain-for-evict", false, "retain immutable target recovery blobs")
152		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeRepos(app)
153		return cmd
154	}

156	func fleetFilesHost(cfg fleet.Config, name string) (fleet.Host, error) {
157		var selected *fleet.Host
158		for index := range cfg.Hosts {
159			if cfg.Hosts[index].Name == name {
160				if selected != nil {
161					return fleet.Host{}, errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one target")
162				}
163				copy := cfg.Hosts[index]
164				selected = &copy
165			}
166		}
167		if selected == nil {
168			return fleet.Host{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
169		}
170		return *selected, nil
171	}

173	func fleetFilePatterns(project projectconfig.Result, adHoc []string) []localfiles.Pattern {
174		var patterns []localfiles.Pattern
175		if project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include != nil {
176			source, _ := project.SourceFor("local_files.include")
177			for _, value := range *project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include {
178				patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: source})
179			}
180		}
181		for _, value := range adHoc {
182			patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: "--file"})
183		}
184		return patterns

187	func resolveFleetFilesSource(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (string, gitx.Status, string, string, error) {
188		checkout := ""
189		if ref == "" {
190			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
191			if err != nil {
192				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
193			}
194			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
195			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
196				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
197			}
198			checkout = gitRepo.Root
199		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
200			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
201				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
202				if discoverErr != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
203					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
204				}
205				checkout = gitRepo.Root
206			}
207		}
208		if checkout == "" {
209			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
210			if err != nil {
211				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
212			}
213			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
214			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
215				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
216			}
217			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
218		}
219		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
220		if err != nil {
221			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
222		}
223		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
224			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
225		}
226		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
227		if err != nil {
228			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
229		}
230		identity, err := sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
231		if err != nil {
232			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
233		}
234		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil
235	}
236
237	func sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
238		var preferred []string
239		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
240			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
241		}
242		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
243		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
244		if err != nil {
245			return "", err
246		}
247		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
248		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
249		for _, remote := range preferred {
250			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
251				continue
252			}
253			seenRemote[remote] = true
254			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
255			if err != nil {
256				continue
257			}
258			identitySet := map[string]bool{}
259			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
260				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
261					identitySet[identity] = true
262				}
263			}
264			if len(identitySet) == 1 {
265				for identity := range identitySet {
266					return identity, nil
267				}
268			}
269		}
270		return "", errors.New("source checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
271	}

273	func renderFleetFilesReport(app *App, report localfiles.Report, jsonOutput bool) error {
274		if jsonOutput {
275			encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
276			encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
277			return encoder.Encode(report)
278		}
279		table := app.newTable("PATH", "SIZE", "MODE", "STATE")
280		for _, file := range report.Files {
281			table.Add(file.Path, fmt.Sprintf("%d", file.Size), file.Mode, string(file.State))
282		}
283		table.Render(app.Out)
284		return nil
285	}

287	func writeFleetProtocol(writer io.Writer, value any, limit int64) error {
288		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(value, limit)
289		if err != nil {
290			return err
291		}
292		_, err = writer.Write(body)
293		return err
294	}

336				// capability exchange is the only route by which a client sends content.
337				capability, err := service.Capability(ctxOf(), fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest())
338				if err != nil {
339					return err
340				}
341				if !capability.Supported {
342					return errors.New("native target does not support local-file payloads")
343				}
344				var envelope localfiles.ApplyEnvelope
345				if err := fleet.DecodeStrict(app.In, localfiles.MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes, &envelope); err != nil {
346					return err
347				}
348				response, err := service.Apply(ctxOf(), envelope)
349				if err != nil {
350					return err
351				}
352				return writeFleetProtocol(app.Out, response, localfiles.MaxApplyResponseBytes)
353			},

108	func TestFleetFilesFakeSSHProcess(t *testing.T) {
109		if os.Getenv("DEV_FAKE_SSH") != "1" {
110			return
111		}
112		remoteCommand := os.Args[len(os.Args)-1]
113		helper := ""
114		for _, candidate := range []string{"_capability", "_files-plan", "_files-apply"} {
115			if strings.Contains(remoteCommand, "'"+candidate+"'") {
116				helper = candidate
117				break
118			}
119		}
120		if helper == "" {
121			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "unsupported fake SSH command")
122			os.Exit(127)
123		}
124		log, err := os.OpenFile(os.Getenv("DEV_FAKE_SSH_LOG"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
125		if err == nil {

243		}

246	func (h *fleetFilesHarness) run(args ...string) (string, string, error) {
247		h.t.Helper()
248		var out, errOut bytes.Buffer
249		root := cli.NewRootCommandWithIO(&out, &errOut)
250		root.SetArgs(append([]string{"--config", h.sourceConfig, "--remotes", h.remotes}, args...))
251		err := root.Execute()
252		return out.String(), errOut.String(), err
253	}
254
255	func fleetFilesConfig(repoPath, statePath string) string {
256		return fmt.Sprintf("[paths]\nscan_roots = []\nrepo_paths = [%q]\nstate_dir = %q\n[runtime]\nbackend = \"none\"\n", filepath.ToSlash(repoPath), filepath.ToSlash(statePath))
257	}
258
259	func writeFleetFilesRemotes(t *testing.T, path, machineID string) {
260		t.Helper()
261		body := fmt.Sprintf(`schema_version = 1
262	[[hosts]]
263	name = "target"
264	machine_id = %q
265	ssh_alias = "fake-target"
266	`, machineID)
267		fleetFilesWriteMode(t, path, body, 0o600)
268	}
269
270	func writeMachineIdentity(t *testing.T, home, machineID string) {
271		t.Helper()
272		path := filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share", "dev", "machine", "v1", "identity.json")
273		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o700); err != nil {
274			t.Fatal(err)
275		}
276		if err := os.Chmod(filepath.Dir(path), 0o700); err != nil {
277			t.Fatal(err)
278		}
279		body := fmt.Sprintf("{\"schema_version\":1,\"machine_id\":%q}\n", machineID)
280		fleetFilesWriteMode(t, path, body, 0o600)
281	}
282
283	func fleetFilesGit(t *testing.T, directory string, args ...string) string {
284		t.Helper()
285		command := exec.Command("git", args...)
286		command.Dir = directory
287		command.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1", "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0")
288		output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
289		if err != nil {
290			t.Fatalf("git %s: %v\n%s", strings.Join(args, " "), err, output)
291		}
292		return strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
293	}
294
295	func fleetFilesWrite(t *testing.T, path, body string) {
296		t.Helper()
297		fleetFilesWriteMode(t, path, body, 0o644)
298	}
299
300	func fleetFilesWriteMode(t *testing.T, path, body string, mode os.FileMode) {
301		t.Helper()
302		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
303			t.Fatal(err)
304		}
305		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), mode); err != nil {
306			t.Fatal(err)
307		}
308	}
309
310	func assertNoSecretBelow(t *testing.T, root, secret string) {
311		t.Helper()
312		_ = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, entry os.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
313			if walkErr != nil || entry.IsDir() {
314				return nil
315			}
316			body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
317			if err == nil && strings.Contains(string(body), secret) {
318				t.Errorf("cache file %s contains transferred content", path)
319			}
320			return nil
321		})
322	}

        Long: `Fan out to machines in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml over SSH.

 Each machine runs its own dev binary and therefore uses its own XDG config and
 repository paths. Missing dev installations and repositories are reported but
 do not make the rest of the fleet unusable.`,

17	const ConfigSchemaVersion = 1
18
19	type PasswordSource struct {
20		Type  string `toml:"type" json:"type"`

22		Item  string `toml:"item" json:"item,omitempty"`

30		DevPath        string             `toml:"dev_path"`
31	}
32
33	type Host struct {
34		Name string `toml:"name" json:"name"`
35		// MachineID is an optional expected remote UUID pin. This config layer
36		// validates and fingerprints it; capability-aware callers must compare it.
37		MachineID    string `toml:"machine_id" json:"machine_id,omitempty"`
38		SSHAlias     string `toml:"ssh_alias" json:"ssh_alias,omitempty"`
39		Hostname     string `toml:"hostname" json:"hostname,omitempty"`
40		User         string `toml:"user" json:"user,omitempty"`
41		Port         int    `toml:"port" json:"port,omitempty"`
42		IdentityFile string `toml:"identity_file" json:"identity_file,omitempty"`
43		DevPath      string `toml:"dev_path" json:"dev_path,omitempty"`
44
45		ConnectTimeout devconfig.Duration `toml:"connect_timeout" json:"-"`
46		CommandTimeout devconfig.Duration `toml:"command_timeout" json:"-"`
47
48		SSHLoginPasswordSource PasswordSource `toml:"ssh_login_password_source" json:"ssh_login_password_source"`
49	}
50
51	type Config struct {
52		SchemaVersion int      `toml:"schema_version"`
53		Defaults      Defaults `toml:"defaults"`
54		Hosts         []Host   `toml:"hosts"`
55		Source        string   `toml:"-"`
56	}
57
58	func DefaultConfig() Config {
59		return Config{
60			SchemaVersion: ConfigSchemaVersion,
61			Defaults: Defaults{
62				ConnectTimeout: devconfig.Duration{Duration: 15 * time.Second},
63				CommandTimeout: devconfig.Duration{Duration: 5 * time.Minute},
64				CacheTTL:       devconfig.Duration{Duration: 15 * time.Minute},
65				MaxParallel:    4,
66				DevPath:        "auto",
67			},
68		}
69	}
70
71	func ConfigFile() string {
72		return filepath.Join(devconfig.ConfigHome(), "dev", "remotes.toml")
73	}
74
75	func LoadConfig(path string) (Config, error) {
76		cfg := DefaultConfig()
77		if path == "" {
78			path = ConfigFile()
79		}
80		metadata, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
81		switch {
82		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
83			return cfg, nil
84		case err != nil:
85			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
86		}
87		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
88			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: unknown field(s): %v", path, undecoded)
89		}
90		cfg.Source = path
91		cfg.ApplyDefaults()
92		if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
93			return cfg, err
94		}
95		return cfg, nil
96	}
97
98	func (c *Config) ApplyDefaults() {
99		for index := range c.Hosts {
100			host := &c.Hosts[index]
101			if host.DevPath == "" {
102				host.DevPath = c.Defaults.DevPath
103			}
104			if host.ConnectTimeout.Duration == 0 {
105				host.ConnectTimeout = c.Defaults.ConnectTimeout
106			}
107			if host.CommandTimeout.Duration == 0 {
108				host.CommandTimeout = c.Defaults.CommandTimeout
109			}
110		}
111	}
112
113	func (c Config) Validate() error {
114		if c.SchemaVersion != ConfigSchemaVersion {
115			return fmt.Errorf("remotes schema_version %d: want %d", c.SchemaVersion, ConfigSchemaVersion)
116		}
117		if c.Defaults.MaxParallel <= 0 {
118			return errors.New("defaults.max_parallel must be positive")
119		}
120		if c.Defaults.ConnectTimeout.Duration <= 0 || c.Defaults.CommandTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
121			return errors.New("default timeouts must be positive")
122		}
123		seen := map[string]bool{}
124		for index, host := range c.Hosts {
125			if strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) == "" || host.Name != strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) {
126				return fmt.Errorf("hosts[%d].name is required and must be trimmed", index)
127			}
128			if seen[host.Name] {
129				return fmt.Errorf("duplicate host name %q", host.Name)
130			}
131			seen[host.Name] = true
132			if host.MachineID != "" {
133				if err := machineid.Validate(host.MachineID); err != nil {
134					return fmt.Errorf("host %q: %w", host.Name, err)
135				}
136			}
137			if host.SSHAlias == "" && host.Hostname == "" {
138				return fmt.Errorf("host %q must define ssh_alias or hostname", host.Name)
139			}
140			if host.Port < 0 || host.Port > 65535 {
141				return fmt.Errorf("host %q port %d is invalid", host.Name, host.Port)
142			}
143			if host.ConnectTimeout.Duration <= 0 || host.CommandTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
144				return fmt.Errorf("host %q timeouts must be positive", host.Name)
145			}
146			if host.DevPath != "" && host.DevPath != "auto" && !filepath.IsAbs(devconfig.Expand(host.DevPath)) {
147				return fmt.Errorf("host %q dev_path must be auto or absolute", host.Name)
148			}
149			if err := validatePasswordSource(host.Name, host.SSHLoginPasswordSource); err != nil {
150				return err
151			}
152		}
153		return nil
154	}
155
156	func validatePasswordSource(host string, source PasswordSource) error {
157		kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(source.Type))
158		if kind == "" {
159			kind = "none"
160		}
161		switch kind {
162		case "none", "prompt":
163			return nil
164		case "plain":
165			if source.Value == "" {
166				return fmt.Errorf("host %q plain ssh_login_password_source requires value", host)
167			}
168		case "bitwarden":
169			if source.Item == "" {
170				return fmt.Errorf("host %q bitwarden ssh_login_password_source requires item", host)
171			}
172		default:
173			return fmt.Errorf("host %q ssh_login_password_source.type %q: want none, plain, prompt or bitwarden", host, source.Type)
174		}
175		return nil
176	}
177
178	func (h Host) PasswordKind() string {
179		kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(h.SSHLoginPasswordSource.Type))
180		if kind == "" {
181			return "none"
182		}
183		return kind
184	}
185
186	func (h Host) Destination() string {
187		if h.SSHAlias != "" {
188			return h.SSHAlias
189		}
190		if h.User != "" {
191			return h.User + "@" + h.Hostname

1	# ~/.config/shell/63_tmux_path.sh
2	# Source: dot_config/shell/63_tmux_path.sh (managed by chezmoi)
3	#
4	# `tpath` — print + copy the CURRENT tmux pane's address, POSIX, sourced by
5	# both zsh and bash. Copies the readable target `session:window.pane` (e.g.
6	# `main:2.1`) to the system clipboard via tmux's OSC 52 bridge, and prints
7	# `target` / `pane_id` / `cwd` to stdout for reference.
8	#
9	# Why: when a human and an AI agent share a tmux session, you need a quick way
10	# to grab the pane you're looking at — to reconnect later, or to tell the agent
11	# "operate on THIS pane" (`tmux capture-pane -pt <target>` /
12	# `tmux send-keys -t <target> ...`). The stable `pane_id` (%N, survives
13	# window/pane reordering) and cwd are printed alongside so you can paste the
14	# richer form into an agent chat when the readable target isn't enough.
15	#
16	# GUI/keyboard equivalents (same "Copy pane path" action):
17	#   - right-click a pane → "Copy pane path"   (MouseDown3Pane menu)
18	#   - prefix + M-p → "Copy pane path"          (menu-pane.sh)
19	#   - prefix + P                               (direct keybinding)
20	# All defined in dot_config/tmux/keybindings.conf.tmpl + menu-pane.sh.
21	#
22	# stdout is kept pipe-clean (`tpath | head -1` yields the target line); the
23	# "copied" confirmation goes to stderr.
24
25	# Skip silently if tmux isn't on PATH (cron, headless SSH, fresh box).
26	command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
27
28	# tpath — copy current pane's session:window.pane to clipboard, print details.
29	tpath() {
30	    if [ -z "${TMUX:-}" ]; then
31	        printf 'tpath: not inside a tmux session\n' >&2
32	        return 1
33	    fi
34
35	    _tpath_target=$(tmux display-message -p '#{session_name}:#{window_index}.#{pane_index}')
36	    _tpath_id=$(tmux display-message -p '#{pane_id}')
37	    _tpath_cwd=$(tmux display-message -p '#{pane_current_path}')
38
39	    # Copy ONLY the readable target. `set-buffer -w` loads tmux's paste buffer
40	    # AND forwards via OSC 52 (needs `set-clipboard on` in common.conf) — works
41	    # over SSH without shelling out to pbcopy/xclip on the remote host.
42	    tmux set-buffer -w "$_tpath_target"
43
44	    printf 'target : %s\n' "$_tpath_target"
45	    printf 'pane_id: %s\n' "$_tpath_id"
46	    printf 'cwd    : %s\n' "$_tpath_cwd"
47	    printf 'Copied pane path: %s\n' "$_tpath_target" >&2
48
49	    unset _tpath_target _tpath_id _tpath_cwd
50	}
51

38	func newFleetFilesHarness(t *testing.T) *fleetFilesHarness {

42		remoteHome := filepath.Join(root, "remote-home")

44		targetRoot := filepath.Join(root, "target-repos")
45		remote := filepath.Join(root, "git-remote.git")
46		sourceRepo := filepath.Join(sourceRoot, "demo")
47		targetRepo := filepath.Join(targetRoot, "demo")
48		for _, directory := range []string{sourceHome, remoteHome, sourceRoot, targetRoot} {
49			if err := os.MkdirAll(directory, 0o700); err != nil {
50				t.Fatal(err)
51			}
52		}
53		fleetFilesGit(t, root, "init", "--bare", remote)
54		fleetFilesGit(t, root, "init", "-b", "main", sourceRepo)
55		fleetFilesGit(t, sourceRepo, "config", "user.email", "test@example.test")
56		fleetFilesGit(t, sourceRepo, "config", "user.name", "Test")

58		fleetFilesWrite(t, filepath.Join(sourceRepo, ".dev-cli", "config.toml"), "version = 1\n[local_files]\ninclude = [\".env\"]\n")

60		fleetFilesGit(t, sourceRepo, "add", ".gitignore", ".dev-cli/config.toml", "README.md")

108	func TestFleetFilesFakeSSHProcess(t *testing.T) {
109		if os.Getenv("DEV_FAKE_SSH") != "1" {
110			return
111		}
112		remoteCommand := os.Args[len(os.Args)-1]
113		helper := ""
114		for _, candidate := range []string{"_capability", "_files-plan", "_files-apply"} {
115			if strings.Contains(remoteCommand, "'"+candidate+"'") {
116				helper = candidate
117				break
118			}
119		}
120		if helper == "" {
121			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "unsupported fake SSH command")
122			os.Exit(127)
123		}
124		log, err := os.OpenFile(os.Getenv("DEV_FAKE_SSH_LOG"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
125		if err == nil {
126			fmt.Fprintln(log, helper)
127			_ = log.Close()
128		}
129		remoteHome := os.Getenv("DEV_FAKE_SSH_REMOTE_HOME")
130		_ = os.Setenv("HOME", remoteHome)
131		_ = os.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(remoteHome, ".config"))
132		_ = os.Setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", filepath.Join(remoteHome, ".local", "share"))
133		_ = os.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", filepath.Join(remoteHome, ".cache"))
134		root := cli.NewRootCommandWithIO(os.Stdout, os.Stderr)
135		root.SetArgs([]string{"--config", os.Getenv("DEV_FAKE_SSH_TARGET_CONFIG"), "fleet", helper})
136		if err := root.Execute(); err != nil {
137			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "remote protocol failed")
138			os.Exit(2)
139		}
140		os.Exit(0)
141	}

143	func TestFleetFilesFakeSSHPlanApplyAndRedaction(t *testing.T) {
144		h := newFleetFilesHarness(t)
145		planOut, planErr, err := h.run("fleet", "files", "demo", "--to", "target", "--json")
146		if err != nil {
147			t.Fatalf("plan: %v\nstderr=%s", err, planErr)
148		}
149		var plan localfiles.Report
150		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(planOut), &plan); err != nil || len(plan.Files) != 1 || plan.Files[0].State != localfiles.StateReady {
151			t.Fatalf("plan report = %+v, %v\n%s", plan, err, planOut)
152		}
153		if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(h.targetRepo, ".env")); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
154			t.Fatalf("report-only plan mutated target: %v", err)
155		}
156
157		applyOut, applyErr, err := h.run("fleet", "files", "demo", "--to", "target", "--apply", "--yes", "--json")
158		if err != nil {
159			t.Fatalf("apply: %v\nstderr=%s", err, applyErr)
160		}
161		var result localfiles.Report
162		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(applyOut), &result); err != nil || len(result.Files) != 1 || result.Files[0].State != localfiles.StateCreated {
163			t.Fatalf("apply report = %+v, %v\n%s", result, err, applyOut)
164		}
165		body, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(h.targetRepo, ".env"))
166		if err != nil || string(body) != fleetFilesSecret+"\n" {
167			t.Fatalf("target content = %q, %v", body, err)
168		}
169		if runtime.GOOS != "windows" {
170			info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(h.targetRepo, ".env"))
171			if err != nil || info.Mode().Perm() != 0o600 {
172				t.Fatalf("target mode = %v, %v", info.Mode().Perm(), err)
173			}
174		}
175		combined := planOut + planErr + applyOut + applyErr
176		if strings.Contains(combined, fleetFilesSecret) || strings.Contains(combined, "sha256:") || strings.Contains(combined, "content_base64") {
177			t.Fatalf("public output leaked private protocol data: %s", combined)
178		}
179		log, err := os.ReadFile(h.log)
180		if err != nil {
181			t.Fatal(err)
182		}
183		sequence := strings.Fields(string(log))
184		want := []string{"_capability", "_files-plan", "_capability", "_files-plan", "_files-apply"}
185		if strings.Join(sequence, " ") != strings.Join(want, " ") {
186			t.Fatalf("protocol order = %v, want %v", sequence, want)
187		}
188		assertNoSecretBelow(t, filepath.Join(h.sourceHome, ".cache"), fleetFilesSecret)
189		assertNoSecretBelow(t, filepath.Join(h.remoteHome, ".cache"), fleetFilesSecret)
190	}

315			}

24	func (r *recordingRunner) RunWithOptions(_ context.Context, _ fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, options fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result {
25		r.calls = append(r.calls, recordedCall{args: append([]string(nil), args...), stdin: append([]byte(nil), stdin...), retry: options.Retry})
26		if len(r.results) == 0 {
27			return fleet.Result{ExitCode: 127}

31		return result

34	func capabilityResult(t *testing.T, machineID string, supported bool, reason string) fleet.Result {
35		t.Helper()
36		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
37		response := fleet.CapabilityResponse{
38			SchemaVersion: request.SchemaVersion, Feature: request.Feature,
39			ProtocolVersion: request.ProtocolVersion, MachineID: machineID,
40			Platform: "linux", Supported: supported, Reason: reason,
41			Limits: limitsToWire(safefileDefault()),
42		}
43		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(response, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
44		if err != nil {
45			t.Fatal(err)
46		}
47		return fleet.Result{ExitCode: 0, Stdout: body}
48	}
