```text
35	func newRepoPair(t *testing.T) *repoPair {
36		t.Helper()
37		root := t.TempDir()
38		remote := filepath.Join(root, "remote.git")
39		source := filepath.Join(root, "source")
40		target := filepath.Join(root, "target")
41		runGit(t, root, "init", "--bare", remote)
42		runGit(t, root, "init", "-b", "main", source)
43		runGit(t, source, "config", "user.email", "test@example.test")
44		runGit(t, source, "config", "user.name", "Test")
45		writeTestFile(t, filepath.Join(source, ".gitignore"), ".env\n.env.*\n.mcp/\nsecret-*/\n")
46		writeTestFile(t, filepath.Join(source, "README.md"), "tracked\n")
47		runGit(t, source, "add", ".gitignore", "README.md")
48		runGit(t, source, "commit", "-m", "initial")
49		runGit(t, source, "remote", "add", "origin", remote)
50		runGit(t, source, "push", "-u", "origin", "main")
51		runGit(t, remote, "symbolic-ref", "HEAD", "refs/heads/main")
52		runGit(t, root, "clone", remote, target)
53		runGit(t, source, "remote", "set-url", "origin", testRemoteURL)
54		runGit(t, target, "remote", "set-url", "origin", testRemoteURL)
55		head := runGit(t, source, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
56		cfg := config.Default()
57		cfg.Paths.ScanRoots = nil
58		cfg.Paths.RepoPaths = []string{target}
59		cfg.Paths.StateDir = filepath.Join(root, "state")
60		service := NewService(cfg)
61		service.Platform = "linux"
62		service.StoreRoot = filepath.Join(root, "target-state", "local-files")
63		service.Authority = lease.New(filepath.Join(root, "target-state", "leases"))
64		service.LoadMachineID = func(context.Context) (string, error) { return testTargetMachine, nil }
65		return &repoPair{
66			source: source, target: target, head: head, service: service,
67			limits: cfg.LocalFiles.Limits(),
68			binding: Binding{
69				RemoteIdentity: catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(testRemoteURL), Branch: "main", HeadOID: head,
70				SourceMachine: testSourceMachine, TargetMachine: testTargetMachine,
71			},
72		}
73	}

75	func (p *repoPair) prepare(t *testing.T, patterns []string, replace bool) (*Source, PlanResponse) {
76		t.Helper()
77		inputs := make([]Pattern, len(patterns))
78		for index, pattern := range patterns {
79			inputs[index] = Pattern{Value: pattern, Source: "test"}
80		}
81		source, report, err := PrepareSource(t.Context(), SourceOptions{
82			Checkout: p.source, Binding: p.binding, Patterns: inputs, Limits: p.limits, Replace: replace,
83		})
84		if err != nil {
85			t.Fatalf("prepare source: %v; report=%+v", err, report)
86		}
87		plan, err := p.service.Plan(t.Context(), source.Request())
88		if err != nil {
89			t.Fatalf("plan target: %v", err)
90		}
91		return source, plan
92	}

94	func (p *repoPair) apply(t *testing.T, source *Source, plan PlanResponse, retain bool) (ApplyEnvelope, ApplyResponse) {
95		t.Helper()
96		envelope, err := source.BuildEnvelope(t.Context(), plan, retain)
97		if err != nil {
98			t.Fatal(err)
99		}
100		response, err := p.service.Apply(t.Context(), envelope)
101		if err != nil {
102			t.Fatal(err)
103		}
104		return envelope, response
105	}

107	func TestPlanCreateApplyCurrentAndIdempotentRetry(t *testing.T) {

109		writeTestFile(t, filepath.Join(p.source, ".env"), "TOKEN=top-secret\n")
110		source, plan := p.prepare(t, []string{".env"}, false)
111		if len(plan.Files) != 1 || plan.Files[0].State != StateReady || plan.Files[0].Action != actionCreate {
112			t.Fatalf("create plan = %+v", plan.Files)
113		}

115		if response.Files[0].State != StateCreated {

119
120		retried, err := p.service.Apply(t.Context(), envelope)
121		if err != nil || retried.Files[0].State != StateCreated {
122			t.Fatalf("idempotent retry = %+v, %v", retried, err)
123		}
124
125		currentSource, currentPlan := p.prepare(t, []string{".env"}, false)
126		if currentPlan.Files[0].State != StateCurrent || currentPlan.Files[0].Action != actionCurrent {
127			t.Fatalf("current plan = %+v", currentPlan.Files)
128		}
129		currentEnvelope, err := currentSource.BuildEnvelope(t.Context(), currentPlan, false)
130		if err != nil {
131			t.Fatal(err)
132		}
133		if len(currentEnvelope.Payloads) != 0 {
134			t.Fatal("current file content should not cross the wire")
135		}
136		_, currentResult := p.apply(t, currentSource, currentPlan, false)
137		if currentResult.Files[0].State != StateCurrent {
138			t.Fatalf("current apply = %+v", currentResult.Files)
139		}
140	}

392	func targetErrorIs(err error, code TargetCode) bool {
393		var target *TargetError
394		return errors.As(err, &target) && target.Code == code
395	}

397	func runGit(t *testing.T, directory string, args ...string) string {
398		t.Helper()
399		command := exec.Command("git", args...)
400		command.Dir = directory
401		command.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1", "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0")
402		output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
403		if err != nil {
404			t.Fatalf("git %s in %s: %v\n%s", strings.Join(args, " "), directory, err, output)
405		}
406		return strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
407	}

409	func writeTestFile(t *testing.T, path, body string) {
410		t.Helper()
411		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
412			t.Fatal(err)
413		}
414		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
415			t.Fatal(err)
416		}
417	}
418
419	func assertTestFile(t *testing.T, path, body string, mode os.FileMode) {
420		t.Helper()
421		got, err := os.ReadFile(path)
422		if err != nil || string(got) != body {
423			t.Fatalf("%s = %q, %v; want %q", path, got, err, body)
424		}
425		if runtime.GOOS != "windows" {
426			info, err := os.Stat(path)
427			if err != nil || info.Mode().Perm() != mode {
428				t.Fatalf("%s mode = %v, %v; want %o", path, info.Mode().Perm(), err, mode)
429			}
430		}
431	}
```

```text
7		"syscall"
8	)
9
10	func openRegularForRead(root *os.Root, name string) (*os.File, error) {
11		// O_NONBLOCK prevents a regular-to-FIFO rename race from hanging the
12		// process. O_NOFOLLOW rejects a final-component link before post-open
13		// identity checks run.
14		return root.OpenFile(name, os.O_RDONLY|syscall.O_NONBLOCK|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW, 0)
15	}
```

```text
10	func samePlatformState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
11		leftStat, leftOK := left.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
12		rightStat, rightOK := right.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
13		if !leftOK || !rightOK {
14			return leftOK == rightOK
15		}
```

```text
613:83	- 擴充 `internal/wt` provisioning service：以 checkout/OID + plan hash 為 key 的 private setup journal；content-addressed/idempotent steps 可重播，任意 command 逐步記錄 `pending/running/completed/indeterminate`。
675:145	After A’s fence is durable, B holds its repository/branch leases while publishing the target state. It matches all configured fetch/push identities and reuses exactly one clone; ambiguity blocks. If absent, it computes the final destination from B’s own path policy and materializes the verified staging clone without exposing a partial canonical checkout. It then creates/fast-forwards only the checkouts required by task state/mode. Ahead/diverged/dirty/live-agent targets block. Worktree tasks use B’s configured path and explicit expected ref; WARM worktree tasks get a checkout, COLD tasks do not. Branch/direct tasks may use canonical checkout only when unique and safe—never silently change mode. Acceptance may apply only deterministic, journaled portable files; it never runs `post_create`, dependency installers/copies, or other arbitrary provisioning inside the replayable distributed transaction. Transfer does not copy trust/credentials or open a runtime. Accepted HOT tasks become WARM; WARM/COLD stay as-is. After acceptance, B runs provisioning as a separate B-owned setup transaction through `dev resume` or `dev wt provision`; accepted existing WARM checkouts must enter this flow just like newly recreated worktrees. A private journal is bound to checkout identity/OID and provisioning-plan hash. Before each arbitrary command, fsync `running`; after success, fsync `completed`. 38	}
```

```text
40	func (e *UnsupportedSchemaError) Error() string {
41		if e.ID == "" {
42			return fmt.Sprintf("catalog schema version %d: %v", e.Version, ErrUnsupportedSchema)
43		}
44		return fmt.Sprintf("catalog asset %s has schema version %d: %v", e.ID, e.Version, ErrUnsupportedSchema)

49	// ImportConflictError describes why an exact-ID import could not be reconciled.

51	type ImportConflictError struct {

54		Field      string

58	func (e *ImportConflictError) Error() string {
59		detail := e.Reason

62		}

64			return fmt.Sprintf("catalog asset %s conflicts with asset %s on %s: %s: %v",
65				e.ID, e.ExistingID, e.Field, detail, ErrConflict)
66		}
67		if e.Field != "" {

69		}

201	func ValidateID(id string) error {
202		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {
203			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrInvalidID)
204		}
205		return nil
206	}
207
208	// NormalizeTags trims, lowercases, deduplicates and sorts tags. Sorting makes
209	// persisted output deterministic regardless of the order in which callers add
210	// labels.
211	func NormalizeTags(tags []string) []string {
212		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(tags))
213		for _, tag := range tags {
214			tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
215			if tag != "" {
216				seen[tag] = struct{}{}
217			}
218		}
219		out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
220		for tag := range seen {
221			out = append(out, tag)
222		}
223		sort.Strings(out)
224		return out
225	}
226
227	// Normalize applies the lossless normalizations stores use before validation.
228	func (e *Entry) Normalize() {
229		if e == nil {
230			return
231		}
232		e.Name = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
233		e.Tags = NormalizeTags(e.Tags)
234		e.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RemoteIdentity)
235		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
236			e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity)
237		}
238	}
239
240	// Title is the human label, falling back to the stable ID for damaged display
241	// data. Persisted entries still require a name during validation.
242	func (e Entry) Title() string {
243		if e.Name != "" {
244			return e.Name
245		}
246		return e.ID
247	}
248
249	// HasTag reports membership after applying the same normalization as storage.
250	func (e Entry) HasTag(tag string) bool {
251		tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
252		return tag != "" && slices.Contains(e.Tags, tag)
253	}
254
255	// LocationFor returns host's location without exposing the map for mutation.
256	func (e Entry) LocationFor(host string) (Location, bool) {
257		location, ok := e.Locations[host]
258		return location, ok
259	}

261	// SetLocation validates and records one host location.
262	func (e *Entry) SetLocation(host string, location Location) error {
263		if e == nil {
264			return errors.New("set location on nil catalog entry")
265		}
266		if err := validateLocationForSet(host, location); err != nil {
267			return err
268		}
269		if e.Locations == nil {
270			e.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
271		}
272		e.Locations[host] = location
273		return nil
274	}

276	// Clone returns a deep copy suitable for mutation before an atomic update.
277	func (e Entry) Clone() *Entry {
278		clone := e
279		clone.Tags = append([]string(nil), e.Tags...)
280		if e.Experiment != nil {
281			value := *e.Experiment
282			clone.Experiment = &value
283		}
284		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
285			value := *e.RecoveryReceipt
286			clone.RecoveryReceipt = &value
287		}
288		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
289			value := *e.MoveIntent
290			clone.MoveIntent = &value
291		}
292		if e.Locations != nil {
293			clone.Locations = make(map[string]Location, len(e.Locations))
294			for host, location := range e.Locations {
295				clone.Locations[host] = location
296			}
297		}
298		return &clone
299	}

301	// Validate rejects records that later lifecycle operations could not interpret
302	// safely. Store.Create fills identity and timestamps before calling it.
303	func (e Entry) Validate() error {
304		if e.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
305			return &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: e.ID, Version: e.SchemaVersion}
306		}
307		if err := ValidateID(e.ID); err != nil {
308			return err
309		}
310		switch e.Kind {
311		case KindTry:
312			if e.Experiment == nil {
313				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: try kind requires experiment metadata", e.ID)
314			}
315		case KindRepository:
316		default:
317			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown kind %q", e.ID, e.Kind)
318		}
319		if strings.TrimSpace(e.Name) == "" {
320			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: name is required", e.ID)
321		}
322		if !slices.Equal(e.Tags, NormalizeTags(e.Tags)) {
323			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: tags must be normalized lowercase values", e.ID)
324		}
325		if e.Experiment != nil {
326			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
327			case PhaseActive, PhaseDeprecated, PhaseGraduated:
328			default:
329				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown experiment phase %q", e.ID, e.Experiment.Phase)
330			}
331			switch {
332			case e.Kind == KindTry && e.Experiment.Phase == PhaseGraduated:
333				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: graduated experiment must be a repository", e.ID)
334			case e.Kind == KindRepository && e.Experiment.Phase != PhaseGraduated:
335				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: repository experiment history must be graduated", e.ID)
336			}
337			if e.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
338				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment started timestamp is required", e.ID)
339			}
340			if e.Experiment.Slug == "" {
341				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment slug is required", e.ID)
342			}
343			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(e.Experiment.Slug); err != nil {
344				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment slug: %w", e.ID, err)
345			}
346			if e.Experiment.OriginalPath == "" {
347				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment original path is required", e.ID)
348			}
349			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
350			case PhaseDeprecated:
351				if e.Experiment.DeprecatedAt.IsZero() || e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath == "" {
352					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: deprecated experiment requires timestamp and path", e.ID)
353				}
354			case PhaseGraduated:
355				if e.Experiment.GraduatedAt.IsZero() || e.Experiment.GraduatedPath == "" {
356					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: graduated experiment requires timestamp and path", e.ID)
357				}
358			}
359			if err := validateStringFields("experiment", []struct {
360				name  string
361				value string
362			}{
363				{"slug", e.Experiment.Slug},
364				{"origin_url", e.Experiment.OriginURL},
365				{"original_path", e.Experiment.OriginalPath},
366				{"deprecated_path", e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath},
367				{"graduated_path", e.Experiment.GraduatedPath},
368			}); err != nil {
369				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
370			}
371		}
372		hosts := make([]string, 0, len(e.Locations))
373		for host := range e.Locations {
374			hosts = append(hosts, host)
375		}
376		sort.Strings(hosts)
377		for _, host := range hosts {
378			if err := validateLocation(host, e.Locations[host]); err != nil {
379				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
380			}
381		}
382		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
383			if err := validateRecoveryReceipt(*e.RecoveryReceipt); err != nil {
384				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
385			}
386		}
387		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
388			if err := validateMoveIntent(*e.MoveIntent); err != nil {
389				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
390			}
391		}
392		if e.Created.IsZero() || e.Discovered.IsZero() || e.Updated.IsZero() {
393			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: created, discovered and updated timestamps are required", e.ID)
394		}
395		return nil
396	}
397
398	func validateLocation(host string, location Location) error {
399		return validateLocationValue(host, location, true)
400	}
401
402	func validateLocationForSet(host string, location Location) error {
403		return validateLocationValue(host, location, false)
404	}
405
406	func validateLocationValue(host string, location Location, requireUpdated bool) error {
407		if err := validateHostValue("location host", host); err != nil {
408			return err
409		}
410		fields := []struct {
411			name  string
412			value string
413		}{
414			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
415			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
416			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
417			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
418		}
419		for _, field := range fields {
420			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
421				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
422			}
423		}
424		if requireUpdated && location.Updated.IsZero() {
425			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: updated timestamp is required", host)
426		}
427		switch location.State {
428		case LocationPresent:
429			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
430				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
431			}
432		case LocationArchived:
433			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
434				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
435			}
436		case LocationEvicted:
437			if location.RestorePath == "" {
438				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
439			}
440		default:
441			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
442		}
443		return nil
444	}
445
446	func validateRecoveryReceipt(receipt RecoveryReceipt) error {
447		if err := validateHostValue("recovery receipt host", receipt.Host); err != nil {
448			return err
449		}
450		if receipt.Method == "" || receipt.Method != strings.TrimSpace(receipt.Method) {
451			return errors.New("recovery receipt method is required and must be normalized")
452		}
453		if receipt.Created.IsZero() || receipt.Verified.IsZero() {
454			return errors.New("recovery receipt requires created and verified timestamps")
455		}
456		fields := []struct {
457			name  string
458			value string
459		}{
460			{"method", receipt.Method},
461			{"source_path", receipt.SourcePath},
462			{"restore_path", receipt.RestorePath},
463			{"remote_identity", receipt.RemoteIdentity},
464			{"remote_name", receipt.RemoteName},
465			{"remote_url", receipt.RemoteURL},
466			{"revision", receipt.Revision},
467			{"refs_digest", receipt.RefsDigest},
468			{"archive_path", receipt.ArchivePath},
469			{"checksum", receipt.Checksum},
470		}
471		return validateStringFields("recovery receipt", fields)
472	}
473
474	func validateMoveIntent(intent MoveIntent) error {
475		if err := validateHostValue("move intent host", intent.Host); err != nil {
476			return err
477		}
478		if intent.Operation == "" || intent.Operation != strings.TrimSpace(intent.Operation) {
479			return errors.New("move intent operation is required and must be normalized")
480		}
481		if intent.Started.IsZero() {
482			return errors.New("move intent started timestamp is required")
483		}
484		if intent.SourcePath == "" || intent.DestinationPath == "" {
485			return errors.New("move intent requires source and destination paths")
486		}
487		if err := validateStringFields("move intent", []struct {
488			name  string
489			value string
490		}{
491			{"operation", intent.Operation},
492			{"source_path", intent.SourcePath},
493			{"destination_path", intent.DestinationPath},
494		}); err != nil {
495			return err
496		}
497		if filepath.Clean(intent.SourcePath) == filepath.Clean(intent.DestinationPath) {
498			return errors.New("move intent source and destination are identical")
499		}
500		return nil
501	}
502
503	func validateHostValue(name, host string) error {
504		if host == "" {
505			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
506		}
507		if host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
508			return fmt.Errorf("%s %q is not normalized", name, host)
509		}
510		return nil
511	}
512
513	func validateStringFields(scope string, fields []struct {
514		name  string
515		value string
516	}) error {
517		for _, field := range fields {
518			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
519				return fmt.Errorf("%s %s contains NUL", scope, field.name)
520			}
521		}
522		return nil
523	}
```

```text
30	// Diagnostic describes one record skipped by a directory listing. The listing

90	// NewStore returns a catalog rooted at dir.

93			Dir:        dir,

95			clock:      time.Now,

105	// WithLock runs operation while holding the catalog's cross-process advisory
106	// lock. It is intended for short read-match-write transactions; expensive
107	// discovery belongs before the lock. The operating system releases the lock if
108	// the process exits unexpectedly.
109	func (s *Store) WithLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
110		if s == nil {
111			return errors.New("lock nil catalog store")
112		}
113		if operation == nil {
114			return errors.New("catalog lock requires an operation")
115		}
116		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "catalog", operation)
117	}

120	// Create assigns a random stable ID and atomically persists entry. The caller's
121	// value is updated only after the rename succeeds.
122	func (s *Store) Create(entry *Entry) error {
123		if entry == nil {
124			return errors.New("create nil catalog entry")
125		}
126		if entry.ID != "" {
127			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog asset: ID is assigned by the store")
128		}
129
130		s.mu.Lock()
131		defer s.mu.Unlock()
132
133		for range 32 {
134			candidate := entry.Clone()
135			candidate.ID = s.nextID()
136			if err := ValidateID(candidate.ID); err != nil {
137				return fmt.Errorf("generated catalog ID: %w", err)
138			}
139
140			now := s.now()
141			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
142			if candidate.Created.IsZero() {
143				candidate.Created = now
144			}
145			if candidate.Discovered.IsZero() {
146				candidate.Discovered = now
147			}
148			candidate.Updated = now
149			prepareNewNested(candidate, now)
150			candidate.Normalize()
151			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
152				return err
153			}
154			if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
155				return fmt.Errorf("create catalog directory: %w", err)
156			}
157			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
158				continue
159			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
160				return fmt.Errorf("check catalog ID %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
161			}
162			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
163				return err
164			}
165			*entry = *candidate
166			return nil
167		}
168		return fmt.Errorf("generate unique catalog ID: %w", ErrAlreadyExists)
169	}

171	// Import merges portable metadata for an exact stable ID and records location as
172	// host's local view. Source locations are deliberately ignored: only the caller-
173	// supplied target location may claim a path on this machine. Move intents and
174	// recovery receipts are host-owned lifecycle authority and cannot be imported.
175	// The complete read-check-write transaction runs under the catalog's advisory
176	// lock so concurrent processes cannot claim the same target path.
177	func (s *Store) Import(ctx context.Context, source *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, error) {
178		if s == nil {
179			return nil, errors.New("import into nil catalog store")
180		}
181		if source == nil {
182			return nil, errors.New("import nil catalog entry")
183		}
184		if source.MoveIntent != nil {
185			return nil, importConflict(source.ID, source.ID, "move_intent", "host-local move authority cannot be imported")
186		}
187		if source.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
188			return nil, importConflict(source.ID, source.ID, "recovery_receipt", "recovery authority cannot be imported before target verification")
189		}
190		if err := validateLocationForSet(host, location); err != nil {
191			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog import target location: %w", err)
192		}
193
194		incoming := source.Clone()
195		if incoming.SchemaVersion == 0 {
196			incoming.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
197		}
198		incoming.Locations = nil
199		incoming.RecoveryReceipt = nil
200		incoming.MoveIntent = nil
201		incoming.Normalize()
202
203		// Validate all source-owned fields before locking or creating the store. A
204		// zero location timestamp is allowed at the API boundary and is stamped only
205		// after the lock is held so a replay can retain the first import's timestamp.
206		validationLocation := location
207		if validationLocation.Updated.IsZero() {
208			validationLocation.Updated = incoming.Updated
209		}
210		incoming.Locations = map[string]Location{host: validationLocation}
211		if err := incoming.Validate(); err != nil {
212			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate imported catalog asset %s: %w", incoming.ID, err)
213		}
214
215		s.mu.Lock()
216		defer s.mu.Unlock()
217
218		var imported *Entry
219		err := s.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
220			entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
221			if err != nil {
222				return err
223			}
224			if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
225				return incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
226			}
227
228			var current *Entry
229			for _, entry := range entries {
230				if entry.ID == incoming.ID {
231					current = entry
232					break
233				}
234			}
235			if current != nil && current.MoveIntent != nil {
236				return importConflict(current.ID, current.ID, "move_intent",
237					fmt.Sprintf("target has a pending %s move", current.MoveIntent.Operation))
238			}
239
240			targetLocation := location
241			if targetLocation.Updated.IsZero() {
242				if previous, ok := currentLocation(current, host); ok && !locationPayloadChanged(previous, targetLocation) {
243					targetLocation.Updated = previous.Updated
244				} else {
245					targetLocation.Updated = s.now()
246				}
247			} else if previous, ok := currentLocation(current, host); ok &&
248				!locationPayloadChanged(previous, targetLocation) && previous.Updated.After(targetLocation.Updated) {
249				// Replaying an older observation of the same path must not move the
250				// target's location timestamp backwards.
251				targetLocation.Updated = previous.Updated
252			}
253			if err := validateLocation(host, targetLocation); err != nil {
254				return fmt.Errorf("catalog import target location: %w", err)
255			}
256			if err := rejectImportedPathOwner(entries, incoming.ID, host, targetLocation); err != nil {
257				return err
258			}
259
260			if current == nil {
261				created := incoming.Clone()
262				created.Locations = map[string]Location{host: targetLocation}
263				if err := created.Validate(); err != nil {
264					return fmt.Errorf("validate imported catalog asset %s: %w", created.ID, err)
265				}
266				if err := s.writeAtomic(created); err != nil {
267					return err
268				}
269				imported = created.Clone()
270				return nil
271			}
272
273			merged, changed, err := mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming, host, targetLocation)
274			if err != nil {
275				return err
276			}
277			if !changed {
278				imported = current.Clone()
279				return nil
280			}
281			if err := s.writeAtomic(merged); err != nil {
282				return err
283			}
284			imported = merged.Clone()
285			return nil
286		})
287		return imported, err
288	}

290	func importConflict(id, existingID, field, reason string) error {

294	func currentLocation(entry *Entry, host string) (Location, bool) {
295		if entry == nil {

297		}

301	func rejectImportedPathOwner(entries []*Entry, importedID, host string, target Location) error {
302		targetPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(target)
303		if err != nil {
304			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize imported location on host %s: %w", host, err)
305		}
306		for _, entry := range entries {
307			if entry.ID == importedID {
308				continue
309			}
310			owned, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
311			if !ok {
312				continue
313			}
314			ownedPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(owned)
315			if err != nil {
316				return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize catalog asset %s location on host %s: %w", entry.ID, host, err)
317			}
318			ownedSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ownedPaths))
319			for _, path := range ownedPaths {
320				ownedSet[path] = struct{}{}
321			}
322			for _, path := range targetPaths {
323				if _, exists := ownedSet[path]; exists {
324					return importConflict(importedID, entry.ID, "location",
325						fmt.Sprintf("target path %q on host %s is already owned", path, host))
326				}
327			}
328		}
329		return nil
330	}

332	func canonicalLocationPaths(location Location) ([]string, error) {
333		fields := []struct {
334			name  string
335			value string
336		}{
337			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
338			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
339			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
340			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
341		}
342		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(fields))
343		for _, field := range fields {
344			if field.value == "" {
345				continue
346			}
347			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(field.value)
348			if err != nil {
349				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s %q: %w", field.name, field.value, err)
350			}
351			seen[canonical] = struct{}{}
352		}
353		paths := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
354		for path := range seen {
355			paths = append(paths, path)
356		}
357		sort.Strings(paths)
358		return paths, nil
359	}

361	func mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, bool, error) {
362		if current.SchemaVersion != incoming.SchemaVersion {
363			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "schema_version", "schema versions differ")
364		}
365		if current.Kind != incoming.Kind {
366			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "kind",
367				fmt.Sprintf("durable kind %q differs from imported kind %q", current.Kind, incoming.Kind))
368		}
369		if current.Name != incoming.Name {
370			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "name",
371				fmt.Sprintf("durable name %q differs from imported name %q", current.Name, incoming.Name))
372		}
373
374		merged := current.Clone()
375		changed := false
376
377		currentSummary := strings.TrimSpace(merged.Note)
378		incomingSummary := strings.TrimSpace(incoming.Note)
379		switch {
380		case currentSummary != "" && incomingSummary != "" && merged.Note != incoming.Note:
381			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "note", "nonempty summaries differ")
382		case currentSummary == "" && incomingSummary != "":
383			merged.Note = incoming.Note
384			changed = true
385		}
386
387		tags := NormalizeTags(append(append([]string(nil), merged.Tags...), incoming.Tags...))
388		if !slices.Equal(merged.Tags, tags) {
389			merged.Tags = tags
390			changed = true
391		}
392
393		switch {
394		case merged.RemoteIdentity != "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "" && merged.RemoteIdentity != incoming.RemoteIdentity:
395			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "remote_identity",
396				fmt.Sprintf("durable identity %q differs from imported identity %q", merged.RemoteIdentity, incoming.RemoteIdentity))
397		case merged.RemoteIdentity == "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "":
398			merged.RemoteIdentity = incoming.RemoteIdentity
399			changed = true
400		}
401
402		switch {
403		case merged.Experiment == nil && incoming.Experiment != nil:
404			value := *incoming.Experiment
405			merged.Experiment = &value
406			changed = true
407		case merged.Experiment != nil && incoming.Experiment != nil && !experimentsEqual(*merged.Experiment, *incoming.Experiment):
408			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "experiment", "experiment metadata differs")
409		}
410
411		if value := earlierTime(merged.Created, incoming.Created); !value.Equal(merged.Created) {
412			merged.Created = value
413			changed = true
414		}
415		if value := earlierTime(merged.Discovered, incoming.Discovered); !value.Equal(merged.Discovered) {
416			merged.Discovered = value
417			changed = true
418		}
419		if value := laterTime(merged.LastOpened, incoming.LastOpened); !value.Equal(merged.LastOpened) {
420			merged.LastOpened = value
421			changed = true
422		}
423		if value := laterTime(merged.Updated, incoming.Updated); !value.Equal(merged.Updated) {
424			merged.Updated = value
425			changed = true
426		}
427
428		previous, exists := merged.LocationFor(host)
429		if !exists || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) || !previous.Updated.Equal(location.Updated) {
430			if merged.Locations == nil {
431				merged.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
432			}
433			merged.Locations[host] = location
434			changed = true
435		}
436		merged.Normalize()
437		if err := merged.Validate(); err != nil {
438			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("validate merged catalog asset %s: %w", merged.ID, err)
439		}
440		return merged, changed, nil
441	}
442
443	func experimentsEqual(left, right Experiment) bool {
444		return left.Phase == right.Phase &&
445			left.Slug == right.Slug &&
446			left.OriginURL == right.OriginURL &&
447			left.Started.Equal(right.Started) &&
448			left.OriginalPath == right.OriginalPath &&
449			left.DeprecatedAt.Equal(right.DeprecatedAt) &&
450			left.DeprecatedPath == right.DeprecatedPath &&
451			left.GraduatedAt.Equal(right.GraduatedAt) &&
452			left.GraduatedPath == right.GraduatedPath
453	}
454
455	func earlierTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
456		if left.IsZero() || !right.IsZero() && right.Before(left) {
457			return right
458		}
459		return left
460	}
461
462	func laterTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
463		if right.After(left) {
464			return right
465		}
466		return left
467	}

469	// Get loads one asset by exact ID.
470	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
471		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
472			return nil, err
473		}
474		return s.get(id)
475	}
476
477	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
478		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
479		if err != nil {
480			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
481				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
482			}
483			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
484		}
485		var header struct {
486			SchemaVersion int `toml:"schema_version"`
487		}
488		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &header); err != nil {
489			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
490		}
491		if header.SchemaVersion != 0 && header.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
492			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: header.SchemaVersion}
493		}
494
495		var entry Entry
496		metadata, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &entry)
497		if err != nil {
498			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
499		}
500		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
501			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: unknown field(s): %v", id, undecoded)
502		}
503		entry.ID = id
504		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
505		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
506		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
507			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
508		}
509		entry.Normalize()
510		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
511			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
512		}
513		return &entry, nil
514	}
515
516	// List loads every valid record in deterministic ID order. Per-record failures
517	// are skipped and sent to the configured diagnostic sink; directory-level
518	// failures are returned.
519	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
520		entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
521		if err != nil {
522			return nil, err
523		}
524		s.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
525		return entries, nil
526	}
527
528	func (s *Store) reportDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
529		if s.diagnostics == nil {
530			return
531		}
532		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
533			s.diagnostics(diagnostic)
534		}
535	}
536
537	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
538	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
539	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
540		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
541		if err != nil {
542			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
543				return nil, nil, nil
544			}
545			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
546		}
547
548		var entries []*Entry
549		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
550		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
551			name := directoryEntry.Name()
552			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
553				continue
554			}
555			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
556			entry, err := s.Get(id)
557			if err != nil {
558				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
559				continue
560			}
561			entries = append(entries, entry)
562		}
563		Sort(entries)
564		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
565		return entries, diagnostics, nil
566	}
567
568	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
569	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
570	// immutable.
571	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
572		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
573			return nil, err
574		}
575		if mutate == nil {
576			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
577		}
578
579		s.mu.Lock()
580		defer s.mu.Unlock()
581
582		current, err := s.get(id)
583		if err != nil {
584			return nil, err
585		}
586		updated := current.Clone()
587		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
588			return nil, err
589		}
590		if updated.ID != current.ID {
591			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
592		}
593		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
594			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
595		}
596		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
597			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
598		}
599		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
600			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
601		}
602
603		now := s.now()
604		updated.Updated = now
605		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
606		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)
607		updated.Normalize()
608		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
609			return nil, err
610		}
611		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
612			return nil, err
613		}
614		return updated.Clone(), nil
615	}
616
617	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
618	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
619		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
620			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
621		})
622	}
623
624	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
625		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
626		if err != nil {
627			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
628		}
629		name := temporary.Name()
630		defer os.Remove(name)
631
632		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
633			_ = temporary.Close()
634			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
635		}
636		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
637			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
638		}
639		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
640			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
641		}
642		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
643			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
644		}
645		return nil
646	}
647
648	func (s *Store) nextID() string {
649		if s.generateID == nil {
650			return uuid.NewString()
651		}
652		return s.generateID()
653	}

655	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
656		if s.clock == nil {
657			return time.Now().UTC()
658		}
659		return s.clock().UTC()
660	}

662	func prepareNewNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
663		if entry.Experiment != nil {
664			if entry.Experiment.Phase == "" {
665				entry.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
666			}
667			if entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
668				entry.Experiment.Started = now
669			}
670		}
671		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
672			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
673				location.Updated = now
674				entry.Locations[host] = location
675			}
676		}
677		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
678			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
679		}
680		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
681			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
682		}
683	}
684
685	func prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
686		if current.Experiment == nil && updated.Experiment != nil {
687			if updated.Experiment.Phase == "" {
688				updated.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
689			}
690			if updated.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
691				updated.Experiment.Started = now
692			}
693		}
694		if updated.RecoveryReceipt != nil && updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() &&
695			(current.RecoveryReceipt == nil || recoveryPayloadChanged(*current.RecoveryReceipt, *updated.RecoveryReceipt)) {
696			updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
697		}
698		if updated.MoveIntent != nil && updated.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() &&
699			(current.MoveIntent == nil || moveIntentPayloadChanged(*current.MoveIntent, *updated.MoveIntent)) {
700			updated.MoveIntent.Started = now
701		}
702	}
703
704	func recoveryPayloadChanged(left, right RecoveryReceipt) bool {
705		left.Created = time.Time{}
706		right.Created = time.Time{}
707		return left != right
708	}
709
710	func moveIntentPayloadChanged(left, right MoveIntent) bool {
711		left.Started = time.Time{}
712		right.Started = time.Time{}
713		return left != right
714	}
715
716	func stampChangedLocations(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
717		for host, location := range updated.Locations {
718			previous, existed := current.Locations[host]
719			if !existed || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) {
720				location.Updated = now
721			} else {
722				// Updated is store-owned metadata. A mutation that did not change this
723				// host's location must not make it look newly observed.
724				location.Updated = previous.Updated
725			}
726			updated.Locations[host] = location
727		}
728	}
729
730	func locationPayloadChanged(left, right Location) bool {
731		left.Updated = time.Time{}
732		right.Updated = time.Time{}
733		return left != right
734	}
```

```text
1	// Package note stores timestamped repository thoughts as ordinary Markdown
2	// files. SQLite indexes them for search, but the files are the durable source
3	// of truth: readable without dev, syncable without database merge conflicts,
4	// and recoverable after every cache is deleted.
5	package note
6
7	import (
8		"crypto/sha256"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"strings"
12		"time"
13
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
15	)
16
17	const CurrentSchemaVersion = 1
18
19	var (
20		ErrNotFound   = errors.New("note not found")
21		ErrConflict   = errors.New("note changed since it was opened")
22		ErrInvalid    = errors.New("invalid note")
23		ErrRepository = errors.New("invalid note repository")
24	)
25
26	// ImportConflictError describes a transported note ID already bound to
27	// different durable content. Revisions identify the conflict without exposing
28	// the private note body.
29	type ImportConflictError struct {
30		ID               string
31		ExistingRevision string
32		ImportedRevision string
33		Reason           string
34	}
35
36	func (e *ImportConflictError) Error() string {
37		reason := e.Reason
38		if reason == "" {
39			reason = "same ID has different durable content"
40		}
41		return fmt.Sprintf("note %s import conflict: %s: %v", e.ID, reason, ErrConflict)
42	}
43
44	func (e *ImportConflictError) Unwrap() error { return ErrConflict }
45
46	// Note is one timestamped thought attached to a stable catalog asset ID.
47	type Note struct {
48		SchemaVersion int       `toml:"schema_version" json:"schema_version"`
49		ID            string    `toml:"id" json:"id"`
50		RepositoryID  string    `toml:"repository_id" json:"repository_id"`
51		Repository    string    `toml:"repository" json:"repository"`
52		Created       time.Time `toml:"created" json:"created"`
53		Updated       time.Time `toml:"updated" json:"updated"`
54		Tags          []string  `toml:"tags" json:"tags"`
55
56		Body string `toml:"-" json:"body"`
57		Path string `toml:"-" json:"path,omitempty"`
58	}
59
60	func (n *Note) Normalize() {
61		if n == nil {
62			return
63		}
64		n.Repository = strings.TrimSpace(n.Repository)
65		n.Body = normalizeBody(n.Body)
66		n.Tags = catalog.NormalizeTags(n.Tags)
67	}
68
69	func (n Note) Validate() error {
70		if n.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
71			return fmt.Errorf("note %s schema version %d: %w", n.ID, n.SchemaVersion, ErrInvalid)
72		}
73		if err := catalog.ValidateID(n.ID); err != nil {
74			return fmt.Errorf("note ID: %w", err)
75		}
76		if err := catalog.ValidateID(n.RepositoryID); err != nil {
77			return fmt.Errorf("repository ID: %w: %w", err, ErrRepository)
78		}
79		if strings.TrimSpace(n.Repository) == "" {
80			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: repository name is required: %w", n.ID, ErrRepository)
81		}
82		if strings.TrimSpace(n.Body) == "" {
83			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: body is empty: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
84		}
85		if n.Created.IsZero() || n.Updated.IsZero() {
86			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: created and updated are required: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
87		}
88		if n.Updated.Before(n.Created) {
89			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: updated precedes created: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
90		}
91		return nil
92	}
93
94	// Revision fingerprints every field an editor is allowed to preserve or
95	// replace. Update compares it while holding the mutation lock, preventing a
96	// stale editor session from silently overwriting another process's changes.
97	func (n Note) Revision() string {
98		payload := strings.Join([]string{
99			n.ID, n.RepositoryID, n.Repository,
100			n.Created.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
101			n.Updated.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
102			strings.Join(n.Tags, "\x00"), n.Body,
103		}, "\x00")
104		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(payload)))
105	}
106
107	// Preview returns the first non-empty body line, collapsed and truncated.
108	func (n Note) Preview(limit int) string {
109		line := ""
110		for _, candidate := range strings.Split(n.Body, "\n") {
111			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate) != "" {
112				line = strings.Join(strings.Fields(candidate), " ")
113				break
114			}
115		}
116		if limit <= 0 || len([]rune(line)) <= limit {
117			return line
118		}
119		runes := []rune(line)
120		return string(runes[:limit-1]) + "…"
121	}
122
123	func normalizeBody(body string) string {
124		body = strings.ReplaceAll(body, "\r\n", "\n")
125		body = strings.TrimSpace(body)
126		if body == "" {
127			return ""
128		}
129		return body + "\n"
130	}
```

```text
43	func NewStore(dir string, options ...StoreOption) *Store {

53	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, repositoryID, repositoryName, body string, tags []string) (*Note, error) {
54		if ctx == nil {
55			ctx = context.Background()

73			for range 32 {

92				return nil
93			}
94			return errors.New("generate unique note ID: too many collisions")
95		})
96		return created, err
97	}

99	// Import writes a transported note with its exact durable identity and
100	// timestamps. Path is always derived from the validated repository and note IDs;
101	// a source Path is never trusted. An identical revision is an idempotent replay,
102	// while reusing an ID for different content is a conflict. Import changes only
103	// Markdown source data and deliberately does not update or rebuild the FTS cache.
104	func (s *Store) Import(ctx context.Context, source *Note) (*Note, error) {
105		if s == nil {
106			return nil, errors.New("import into nil note store")
107		}
108		if source == nil {
109			return nil, errors.New("import nil note")
110		}
111		if ctx == nil {
112			ctx = context.Background()
113		}
114
115		candidate := clone(source)
116		candidate.Path = ""
117		if candidate.SchemaVersion == 0 {
118			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
119		}
120		originalRevision := source.Revision()
121		candidate.Normalize()
122		if candidate.Revision() != originalRevision {
123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("import note %s must already be normalized to preserve its revision: %w",
124				source.ID, ErrInvalid)
125		}
126		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
127			return nil, err
128		}
129
130		s.mu.Lock()
131		defer s.mu.Unlock()
132		var imported *Note
133		err := s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
134			target, err := s.confinedImportPath(candidate.RepositoryID, candidate.ID)
135			if err != nil {
136				return err
137			}
138			current, err := s.importedNoteByID(candidate.ID)
139			switch {
140			case err == nil:
141				if current.Revision() != candidate.Revision() {
142					return fmt.Errorf("note %s already exists with different content: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
143				}
144				if filepath.Clean(current.Path) != filepath.Clean(target) {
145					return fmt.Errorf("note %s exists outside its imported repository path: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
146				}
147				imported = clone(current)
148				return nil
149			case !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
150				return err
151			}
152
153			candidate.Path = target
154			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
155				return err
156			}
157			imported = clone(candidate)
158			return nil
159		})
160		return imported, err
161	}

163	func (s *Store) confinedImportPath(repositoryID, id string) (string, error) {
164		root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
165		if err != nil {
166			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
167		}
168		repositoryDir := filepath.Join(root, repositoryID)
169		if info, err := os.Lstat(repositoryDir); err == nil {
170			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
171				return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository directory %s is a symlink: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
172			}
173			if !info.IsDir() {
174				return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository path %s is not a directory: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
175			}
176		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
177			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect note repository directory %s: %w", repositoryID, err)
178		}
179
180		path := filepath.Join(repositoryDir, id+".md")
181		if info, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
182			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
183				return "", fmt.Errorf("note path %s is not a regular file: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
184			}
185		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
186			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect note path %s: %w", id, err)
187		}
188		confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
189		if err != nil {
190			return "", fmt.Errorf("confine imported note path: %w", err)
191		}
192		return confined, nil
193	}

195	// importedNoteByID performs the global uniqueness lookup used by Import while
196	// refusing to read through symlinks or accept legacy files nested more deeply
197	// than the one-repository-directory layout.
198	func (s *Store) importedNoteByID(id string) (*Note, error) {
199		paths, err := s.notePaths("")
200		if err != nil {
201			return nil, err
202		}
203		root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
204		if err != nil {
205			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
206		}
207		var match string
208		for _, path := range paths {
209			if strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md") != id {
210				continue
211			}
212			info, err := os.Lstat(path)
213			if err != nil {
214				return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect existing note %s: %w", id, err)
215			}
216			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
217				return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is not a regular file: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
218			}
219			confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
220			if err != nil {
221				return nil, fmt.Errorf("confine existing note %s: %w", id, err)
222			}
223			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, confined)
224			if err != nil {
225				return nil, fmt.Errorf("relativize existing note %s: %w", id, err)
226			}
227			parts := strings.Split(filepath.Clean(relative), string(filepath.Separator))
228			if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] != id+".md" {
229				return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is outside the repository note layout: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
230			}
231			if match != "" {
232				return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate note ID %s: %w", id, ErrConflict)
233			}
234			match = confined
235		}
236		if match == "" {
237			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
238		}
239		return s.read(match)
240	}
241
242	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Note, error) {
243		if id == "" {
244			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty note ID: %w", ErrNotFound)
245		}
246		paths, err := s.notePaths("")
247		if err != nil {
248			return nil, err
249		}
250		var match string
251		for _, path := range paths {
252			if strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md") == id {
253				if match != "" {
254					return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate note ID %s", id)
255				}
256				match = path
257			}
258		}
259		if match == "" {
260			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
261		}
262		return s.read(match)
263	}

265	// List returns notes newest-first. Empty repositoryID means all repositories.
266	func (s *Store) List(repositoryID string) ([]*Note, error) {
267		paths, err := s.notePaths(repositoryID)
268		if err != nil {
269			return nil, err
270		}
271		notes := make([]*Note, 0, len(paths))
272		for _, path := range paths {
273			n, err := s.read(path)
274			if err != nil {
275				if s.diagnostics != nil {
276					s.diagnostics(path, err)
277				}
278				continue
279			}
280			notes = append(notes, n)
281		}
282		Sort(notes)
283		return notes, nil

286	// Update replaces body/tags while preserving identity, repository and Created.
287	func (s *Store) Update(ctx context.Context, id, expectedRevision, body string, tags []string) (*Note, error) {
288		if ctx == nil {
289			ctx = context.Background()
290		}
291		s.mu.Lock()
292		defer s.mu.Unlock()
293		var updated *Note
294		err := s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
295			current, err := s.Get(id)
296			if err != nil {
297				return err
298			}
299			if expectedRevision == "" || current.Revision() != expectedRevision {
300				return fmt.Errorf("note %s: %w", id, ErrConflict)
301			}
302			candidate := *current
303			candidate.Body, candidate.Tags, candidate.Updated = body, tags, s.now()
304			candidate.Normalize()
305			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
306				return err
307			}
308			if err := s.writeAtomic(&candidate); err != nil {
309				return err
310			}
311			updated = clone(&candidate)
312			return nil
313		})
314		return updated, err
315	}

317	func (s *Store) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
318		if ctx == nil {
319			ctx = context.Background()
320		}
321		s.mu.Lock()
322		defer s.mu.Unlock()
323		return s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
324			n, err := s.Get(id)
325			if err != nil {
326				return err
327			}
328			dir := filepath.Dir(n.Path)
329			if err := os.Remove(n.Path); err != nil {
330				return err
331			}
332			if err := syncNoteDir(dir); err != nil {
333				return err
334			}
335			// Empty repository directories are noise and carry no identity of their own.
336			if err := os.Remove(dir); err == nil {
337				return syncNoteDir(filepath.Dir(dir))
338			}
339			return nil
340		})
341	}

343	func (s *Store) Path(repositoryID string) string {

350	func Sort(notes []*Note) {
351		sort.SliceStable(notes, func(i, j int) bool {
352			if !notes[i].Created.Equal(notes[j].Created) {
353				return notes[i].Created.After(notes[j].Created)
354			}
355			return notes[i].ID < notes[j].ID
356		})
357	}

359	func (s *Store) read(path string) (*Note, error) {
360		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
361		if err != nil {
362			return nil, err
363		}
364		meta, body, err := split(data)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", filepath.Base(path), err)
367		}
368		var n Note
369		md, err := toml.Decode(string(meta), &n)
370		if err != nil {
371			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode %s frontmatter: %w", filepath.Base(path), err)
372		}
373		if unknown := md.Undecoded(); len(unknown) > 0 {
374			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode %s: unknown field(s): %v", filepath.Base(path), unknown)
375		}
376		n.Body, n.Path = string(body), path
377		n.Normalize()
378		if err := n.Validate(); err != nil {
379			return nil, err
380		}
381		if want := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md"); n.ID != want {
382			return nil, fmt.Errorf("note ID %s does not match filename %s: %w", n.ID, want, ErrInvalid)
383		}
384		if want := filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(path)); n.RepositoryID != want {
385			return nil, fmt.Errorf("repository ID %s does not match directory %s: %w", n.RepositoryID, want, ErrRepository)
386		}
387		return &n, nil
388	}
389
390	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(n *Note) error {
391		dir := filepath.Dir(n.Path)
392		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o700); err != nil {
393			return err
394		}
395		for _, privateDir := range []string{filepath.Dir(dir), dir} {
396			if err := os.Chmod(privateDir, 0o700); err != nil {
397				return fmt.Errorf("set private note directory mode: %w", err)
398			}
399		}
400		var front bytes.Buffer
401		if err := toml.NewEncoder(&front).Encode(n); err != nil {
402			return err
403		}
404		content := delimiter + "\n" + front.String() + delimiter + "\n\n" + n.Body
405		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, "."+n.ID+".*.tmp")
406		if err != nil {
407			return err
408		}
409		name := tmp.Name()
410		defer os.Remove(name)
411		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
412			_ = tmp.Close()
413			return fmt.Errorf("set private note temp file mode: %w", err)
414		}
415		if _, err := tmp.WriteString(content); err != nil {
416			_ = tmp.Close()
417			return err
418		}
419		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
420			_ = tmp.Close()
421			return fmt.Errorf("sync note temp file: %w", err)
422		}
423		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
424			return err
425		}
426		if err := os.Rename(name, n.Path); err != nil {
427			return err
428		}
429		// Sync both the note directory (rename entry) and its parent (new
430		// repository directory) before reporting durable success.
431		return errors.Join(syncNoteDir(dir), syncNoteDir(filepath.Dir(dir)))
432	}
433
434	func split(data []byte) ([]byte, []byte, error) {
435		if !bytes.HasPrefix(data, []byte(delimiter+"\n")) {
436			return nil, nil, errors.New("missing opening +++ frontmatter delimiter")
437		}
438		rest := data[len(delimiter)+1:]
439		marker := []byte("\n" + delimiter + "\n")
440		i := bytes.Index(rest, marker)
441		if i < 0 {
442			return nil, nil, errors.New("missing closing +++ frontmatter delimiter")
443		}
444		meta := rest[:i]
445		body := rest[i+len(marker):]
446		body = bytes.TrimPrefix(body, []byte("\n"))
447		return meta, body, nil
448	}

450	func (s *Store) notePaths(repositoryID string) ([]string, error) {
451		root := s.Dir
452		if repositoryID != "" {
453			root = filepath.Join(root, repositoryID)
454		}
455		var paths []string
456		err := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
457			if err != nil {
458				if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
459					return nil
460				}
461				return err
462			}
463			if entry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
464				return nil
465			}
466			paths = append(paths, path)
467			return nil
468		})
469		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
470			return nil, nil
471		}
472		sort.Strings(paths)
473		return paths, err
474	}

476	func (s *Store) path(repositoryID, id string) string {
477		return filepath.Join(s.Dir, repositoryID, id+".md")
478	}

494	func clone(n *Note) *Note {
495		if n == nil {

503	func (s *Store) withFileLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) (err error) {
504		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o700); err != nil {
505			return err
506		}
507		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(s.Dir)
508		if err != nil {
509			return err
510		}
511		canonical, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absolute)
512		if err != nil {
513			return err
514		}
515		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonical), "."+filepath.Base(canonical)+".lock")
516		lock, err := acquireNoteFileLock(ctx, lockPath)
517		if err != nil {
518			return err
519		}
520		defer func() { err = errors.Join(err, lock.Close()) }()
521		return operation()
522	}
```

```text
2	// change streams exist, what state each is in, which machine owns it, and what

16	// State is where a change stream sits in its lifecycle.
17	type State string
18
19	const (
20		// Hot: worktree and branch exist, a runtime session is open, actively worked on.
21		Hot State = "hot"
22		// Warm: worktree and branch kept, runtime closed. Back within days.
23		Warm State = "warm"
24		// Cold: committed and pushed, worktree removed. Reconstructible anywhere.
25		Cold State = "cold"
26		// Done: merged. Kept only until the entry is reaped.
27		Done State = "done"
28	)

30	// States lists the lifecycle in order, for help text and validation.
31	var States = []State{Hot, Warm, Cold, Done}
32
33	// ParseState validates a user-supplied state name.
34	func ParseState(s string) (State, error) {
35		got := State(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s)))
36		for _, valid := range States {
37			if got == valid {
38				return got, nil
39			}
40		}
41		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown state %q: want one of %s", s, JoinStates(", "))
42	}

44	// JoinStates renders the valid state names.
45	func JoinStates(sep string) string {
46		parts := make([]string, len(States))
47		for i, s := range States {
48			parts[i] = string(s)
49		}
50		return strings.Join(parts, sep)

84	// Task is one change stream. Field names are the TOML keys.
85	type Task struct {

90		// Name is the human label ("atp security recovery").
91		Name string `toml:"name"`
92		// Repo is the repository's display name.
93		Repo string `toml:"repo"`
94		// RepoPath is the main checkout, the directory git commands run in.
95		RepoPath string `toml:"repo_path"`
96		// Branch is the change stream's identity — the one durable handle that
97		// survives every machine, worktree and runtime.
98		Branch string `toml:"branch"`

100		// integrate without re-guessing.

109		State State `toml:"state"`

132	// Revision returns a deterministic fingerprint of the task identity and every
133	// field represented by its TOML record. It is deliberately computed rather
134	// than persisted: older dev binaries can continue to read and rewrite task
135	// files without erasing a revision field they do not know about.
136	func (t Task) Revision() string {
137		hash := sha256.New()
138		writeString := func(value string) {
139			var length [8]byte
140			binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(value)))
141			_, _ = hash.Write(length[:])
142			_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(value))
143		}
144		writeTime := func(value time.Time) {
145			writeString(value.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano))
146		}
147
148		writeString("dev-task-revision-v1")
149		writeString(t.ID)
150		writeString(t.Name)
151		writeString(t.Repo)
152		writeString(t.RepoPath)
153		writeString(t.Branch)
154		writeString(t.Base)
155		writeString(t.WorktreePath)
156		writeString(string(t.Mode))
157		writeString(string(t.State))
158		writeString(t.Owner)
159		writeString(t.Next)
160		writeString(t.Note)
161		writeString(fmt.Sprint(len(t.Tags)))
162		for _, tag := range t.Tags {
163			writeString(tag)
164		}
165		writeString(t.AgentSession)
166		writeString(t.RuntimeHandle)
167		writeString(t.RuntimeName)
168		writeTime(t.Created)
169		writeTime(t.Updated)
170
171		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
172	}

201	func (t Task) Validate() error {
202		if t.ID != "" {
203			if err := ValidateID(t.ID); err != nil {
204				return fmt.Errorf("task ID: %w", err)
205			}
206		}
207		switch {
208		case t.Repo == "":
209			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo is required", t.ID)
210		case t.Branch == "":
211			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: branch is required", t.ID)
212		case t.RepoPath == "":
213			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo_path is required", t.ID)
214		}
215		if _, err := ParseState(string(t.State)); err != nil {
216			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
217		}
218		switch t.Mode {
219		case "", ModeWorktree, ModeBranch, ModeDirect:
220		default:
221			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: unknown mode %q", t.ID, t.Mode)
222		}
223		return nil
224	}
```

```text
28	// Store is a directory of one-TOML-file-per-task.
29	//
30	// One file per task, rather than a single registry document, is a deliberate
31	// choice: the state directory is meant to be syncable across machines (it can
32	// simply be a git repo), and a shared central file would conflict on every
33	// parallel edit while separate files merge cleanly.
34	type Store struct{ Dir string }

36	// NewStore returns a store rooted at dir.
37	func NewStore(dir string) *Store { return &Store{Dir: dir} }

39	// ImportOutcome reports what ImportExact observed or changed.
40	type ImportOutcome string
41
42	const (
43		// ImportCreated means no task used the imported ID and a file was created.
44		ImportCreated ImportOutcome = "created"
45		// ImportIdentical means the same ID and semantic content were already stored.
46		ImportIdentical ImportOutcome = "identical"
47		// ImportConflict means the ID already held different semantic content.
48		ImportConflict ImportOutcome = "conflict"

51	var (

56	// ValidateID checks that id can be used as exactly one visible filename stem.
57	func ValidateID(id string) error {
58		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {
59			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrInvalidID)
60		}
61		return nil
62	}
63
64	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
65	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
66		clean := func(s string) string {
67			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
68			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
69				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
70			}
71			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
72		}
73		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
74		if r == "" {
75			r = "repo"
76		}
77		if b == "" {
78			b = "branch"
79		}
80		return r + "__" + b
81	}

85	// Save writes a task, stamping Updated (and Created on first write). Mutations
86	// across Store instances and processes are serialized by the store lock.
87	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {
88		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
89		if err != nil {
90			return err
91		}
92		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
93			stampForSave(candidate)
94			return s.writeAtomic(candidate)
95		})
96		if err != nil {
97			return err
98		}
99		*t = *candidate
100		return nil
101	}
102
103	// SaveIfRevision writes t only while the stored task still has
104	// expectedRevision. The comparison and replacement happen under one
105	// cross-process lock so a stale writer cannot overwrite a newer mutation.
106	func (s *Store) SaveIfRevision(t *Task, expectedRevision string) error {
107		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
108		if err != nil {
109			return err
110		}
111		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
112			current, err := s.get(candidate.ID)
113			if err != nil {
114				return err
115			}
116			if expectedRevision == "" || current.Revision() != expectedRevision {
117				return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
118			}
119			stampForSave(candidate)
120			return s.writeAtomic(candidate)
121		})
122		if err != nil {
123			return err
124		}
125		*t = *candidate
126		return nil
127	}

129	// ImportExact creates t under its supplied ID without changing any semantic
130	// field or timestamp. Replaying identical content is a no-op; reusing an ID
131	// for different content reports ImportConflict and ErrConflict.
132	func (s *Store) ImportExact(t *Task) (ImportOutcome, error) {
133		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, false)
134		if err != nil {
135			return "", err
136		}
137		var outcome ImportOutcome
138		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
139			current, err := s.get(candidate.ID)
140			switch {
141			case err == nil && current.Revision() == candidate.Revision():
142				outcome = ImportIdentical
143				return nil
144			case err == nil:
145				outcome = ImportConflict
146				return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
147			case !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
148				return err
149			}
150			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
151				return err
152			}
153			outcome = ImportCreated
154			return nil
155		})
156		return outcome, err
157	}

179	func prepareCandidate(t *Task, deriveID bool) (*Task, error) {
180		if t == nil {
181			return nil, errors.New("save nil task")
182		}

184		candidate.Tags = append([]string(nil), t.Tags...)
185		if candidate.ID == "" && deriveID {

187		}

190		}

205	func (s *Store) withMutationLock(operation func() error) error {
206		if s == nil {

212	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(t *Task) error {
213		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
214			return fmt.Errorf("create task state directory: %w", err)
215		}
216		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+t.ID+".*.tmp")
217		if err != nil {
218			return fmt.Errorf("create task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
219		}
220		name := tmp.Name()
221		defer os.Remove(name)
222		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o644); err != nil {
223			_ = tmp.Close()
224			return fmt.Errorf("set task %s file mode: %w", t.ID, err)
225		}
226		if err := toml.NewEncoder(tmp).Encode(t); err != nil {
227			_ = tmp.Close()
228			return fmt.Errorf("encode task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
229		}
230		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
231			_ = tmp.Close()
232			return fmt.Errorf("sync task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
233		}
234		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
235			return fmt.Errorf("close task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
236		}
237		if err := replaceFile(name, s.path(t.ID)); err != nil {
238			return fmt.Errorf("replace task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
239		}
240		if err := errors.Join(syncDirectory(s.Dir), syncDirectory(filepath.Dir(s.Dir))); err != nil {
241			return fmt.Errorf("sync task %s directory: %w", t.ID, err)
242		}
243		return nil
244	}

246	// List loads every task, sorted by state (hot first) then most recent.
247	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Task, error) {
248		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
249		if err != nil {
250			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
251				return nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
252			}
253			return nil, err
254		}
255		var out []*Task
256		for _, e := range entries {
257			name := e.Name()
258			if e.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
259				continue
260			}
261			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
262			t, err := s.Get(id)
263			if err != nil {
264				// One corrupt file must not hide the rest of the inventory.
265				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: skipping %s: %v\n", name, err)
266				continue
267			}
268			out = append(out, t)
269		}
270		Sort(out)
271		return out, nil
272	}

274	// Delete removes a task entry under the mutation lock. It never touches git
275	// state.
276	func (s *Store) Delete(id string) error {
277		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
278			return err
279		}
280		return s.withMutationLock(func() error {
281			err := os.Remove(s.path(id))
282			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
283				return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
284			}
285			if err != nil {
286				return err
287			}
288			if err := syncDirectory(s.Dir); err != nil {
289				return fmt.Errorf("sync task directory after deleting %s: %w", id, err)
290			}
291			return nil
292		})
293	}

295	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
296	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
297	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather
298	// than a silent pick.
299	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
300		if ref == "" {
301			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty task reference: %w", ErrNotFound)
302		}
303		all, err := s.List()
304		if err != nil {
305			return nil, err
306		}
307		for _, t := range all {
308			if t.ID == ref || t.Branch == ref {
309				return t, nil
310			}
311		}
312		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
313		var hits []*Task
314		for _, t := range all {
315			hay := strings.ToLower(t.ID + " " + t.Name + " " + t.Branch + " " + t.Repo)
316			if strings.Contains(hay, needle) {
317				hits = append(hits, t)
318			}
319		}
320		switch len(hits) {
321		case 1:
322			return hits[0], nil
323		case 0:
324			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", ref, ErrNotFound)
325		default:
326			names := make([]string, len(hits))
327			for i, t := range hits {
328				names[i] = t.ID
329			}
330			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))
331		}
332	}
333
334	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
335	//
336	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
337	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
338	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
339	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
340	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
341	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
342		all, err := s.List()
343		if err != nil {
344			return nil, err
345		}
346		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
347			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
348		}
349		var best *Task
350		var bestLen int
351		for _, t := range all {
352			root := t.WorktreePath
353			if root == "" {
354				root = t.RepoPath
355			}
356			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
357				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
358			}
359		}
360		if best == nil {
361			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
362		}
363		return best, nil
364	}
365
366	// stateRank orders states so the inventory reads as an attention queue.
367	func stateRank(s State) int {
368		switch s {
369		case Hot:
370			return 0
371		case Warm:
372			return 1
373		case Cold:
374			return 2
375		case Done:
376			return 3
377		}
378		return 4
379	}
380
381	// Sort orders tasks hot-first, then by most recently updated.
382	func Sort(ts []*Task) {
383		sort.SliceStable(ts, func(i, j int) bool {
384			ri, rj := stateRank(ts[i].State), stateRank(ts[j].State)
385			if ri != rj {
386				return ri < rj
387			}
388			if !ts[i].Updated.Equal(ts[j].Updated) {
389				return ts[i].Updated.After(ts[j].Updated)
390			}
391			return ts[i].ID < ts[j].ID
392		})
393	}
```

```text
+func TestRedactRemoteRefStripsURLSecretsAndControls(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, test := range []struct {
+		input string
+		want  string
+	}{
+		{
+			"https://alice:password@example.test/group/repo.git?access_token=query-secret#fragment-secret",
+			"https://example.test/group/repo.git",
+		},
+		{"ssh://git@example.test/group/repo.git?token=secret#fragment", "ssh://example.test/group/repo.git"},
+		{"file:///tmp/repo?token=secret#fragment", "file:///tmp/repo"},
+		{"git@example.test:group/repo.git?token=secret#fragment", "git@example.test:group/repo.git"},
+		{"oauth2:password@example.test:group/repo.git?token=secret", "***@example.test:group/repo.git"},
+		{"oauth2:password@example.test/group/repo.git?token=secret", "***@example.test/group/repo.git"},
+		{"work:group/repo.git?token=secret#fragment", "work:group/repo.git"},
+		{"relative/path?literal#name", "relative/path?literal#name"},
+		{"https://example.test/group/repo%0a.git", unsafeRemoteLabel},
+		{"https://[malformed/secret", unsafeRemoteLabel},
+		{"git@example.test:group/repo.git\x1b[31m", unsafeRemoteLabel},
+		{"git@example.test:group/" + string(rune(0x202e)) + "repo.git", unsafeRemoteLabel},
+		{string([]byte{'b', 'a', 'd', 0xff}), unsafeRemoteLabel},
+	} {
+		got := RedactRemoteRef(test.input)
+		if got != test.want {
+			t.Errorf("RedactRemoteRef(%q) = %q, want %q", test.input, got, test.want)
+		}
+		if strings.IndexFunc(got, func(r rune) bool { return r < ' ' || r == 0x7f }) >= 0 {
+			t.Errorf("RedactRemoteRef(%q) retained a control in %q", test.input, got)
+		}
+	}
+}

+			t.Fatalf("redacted error leaked %q: %q", secret, message)
+		}
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(message, "https://example.test/owner/repo.git") {
+		t.Fatalf("redacted error lost safe endpoint: %q", message)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestRedactCloneErrorReplacesOriginalControlBearingRef(t *testing.T) {
+	ref := "https://user:secret@example.test/owner/repo.git\n"
+	err := RedactCloneError(errors.New("git clone failed for "+ref), ref)
+	if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "secret") || strings.ContainsRune(err.Error(), '\n') || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), unsafeRemoteLabel) {
+		t.Fatalf("redacted control-bearing error = %q", err)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestDisplayRedactionDoesNotChangeCloneNormalization(t *testing.T) {
+	ref := "https://user:password@github.com/owner/repo.git?token=raw#raw"
+	if got := NormalizeCloneRef(ref); got != ref {
+		t.Fatalf("NormalizeCloneRef changed raw clone input: %q", got)
+	}
+	if got := RedactCloneRef(ref); got == ref || strings.Contains(got, "password") || strings.Contains(got, "token") {
+		t.Fatalf("RedactCloneRef did not isolate display: %q", got)
+	}
+}
```

_**Agent - sidechain (gpt-5.6-sol 2026-08-31 16:23:18Z)**_

## Diagnosis

The failure comes from a mixed Go installation in the current process:

- `go` resolves to `/usr/local/bin/go`
  - Symlinked to Homebrew Go **1.27.0**
- `GOROOT` is `/Users/david/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.26.4`
  - Contains Go **1.26.4** compiler tools
- Consequently, `go env GOTOOLDIR` points into the 1.26.4 installation even though the driver is 1.27.0.

Confirmed identities:

```text
/usr/local/bin/go                                      go1.27.0
$GOROOT/pkg/tool/darwin_amd64/compile                  go1.26.4
```

That mismatched driver/tool pair causes the compile-artifact version error. It is not evidence of corrupt source or a cache requiring deletion.

A fresh login shell resolves mise’s Go 1.26.4 consistently, so the durable shell configuration is coherent. The malformed state is specific to this inherited process: `/usr/local/bin` was placed before mise’s Go directory while mise’s `GOROOT` remained exported.

Relevant shell configuration:

- `/Users/david/.config/mise/config.toml`: `go = "latest"`, currently resolving to 1.26.4.
- `/Users/david/.config/shell/02_legacy_tools.sh`: adds Homebrew Go as a fallback.
- `/Users/david/.config/shell/05_mise.sh`: subsequently activates mise and normally puts mise’s toolchain first.
- `/Users/david/.zshrc`: loads those modules in that order.

## Safe test command

Use the repository-declared 1.26.4 toolchain consistently, only for this process:

```sh
cd /Users/david/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-remote-transfer
env -u GOROOT \
  PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/installs/go/1.26.4/bin:$PATH" \
```

582506	139	## Target preparation

582508	141	Separate branch/ref evidence from checkout evidence. 582511	144
582512	145	After A’s fence is durable, B holds its repository/branch leases while publishing the target state. Worktree tasks use B’s configured path and explicit expected ref; WARM worktree tasks get a checkout, COLD tasks do not. Branch/direct tasks may use canonical checkout only when unique and safe—never silently change mode. A journal cannot promise exactly-once for an external side effect, so automatic resume is limited to content-addressed/proven-idempotent steps.
