```text
1	// Package lockx provides a cross-platform advisory lock over a directory.
2	//
3	// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction
4	// code need to serialize mutations, and neither should have to depend on the
5	// other to get a lock.
6	package lockx
7
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"errors"
11		"fmt"
12		"os"
13		"path/filepath"
14	)
15
16	// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir. The lock file
17	// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
18	// directory being protected. label names the caller in wrapped errors.
19	func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
20		if operation == nil {
21			return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
22		}
23		if ctx == nil {
24			ctx = context.Background()
25		}
26		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
27			return fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
28		}
29		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
32		}
33		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
34		if err != nil {
35			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
36		}
37		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
38		lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
41		}
42		defer func() {
43			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
44				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", label, releaseErr))
45			}
46		}()
47		return operation()
48	}
49
```

301	// Build joins live local facts with optional external observations. It performs
302	// no probes and never places raw Git endpoints in the returned report.
303	func Build(input BuildInput) (Report, error) {
304		now := input.GeneratedAt
305		if now.IsZero() {
306			now = time.Now().UTC()
307		}
308		now = now.Round(0).UTC()
309
310		report := Report{
311			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion,
312			GeneratedAt:   now,
313			Repository: Repository{
314				Name: input.Context.Repo.Name, Display: input.Context.Repo.Display(),
315				Path: input.Context.Repo.Path, RealPath: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.RealPath),
316				CommonDir: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.CommonDir),
317				Bare:      input.Context.Repo.Bare, HasGit: input.Context.Repo.HasGit,
318			},
319			Sources:      []Source{},
320			Capabilities: []Capability{},
321			Remotes:      []Remote{},
322			Errors:       []CollectionError{},
323		}
324
325		report.Local = buildLocalFacts(input, &report.Errors)
326		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(report.Local.Checkouts) {
327			checkout := report.Local.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout]
328			report.SelectedCheckout = &CheckoutSelection{
329				Index: checkout.Index, Path: checkout.Path, Branch: checkout.Branch,
330				Canonical: checkout.Canonical, Ownership: checkout.Ownership,
331			}
332		} else {
333			message := "selected checkout is not present in the local checkout inventory"
334			if input.SelectionErr != nil {
335				message = cleanError(input.SelectionErr)
336			}
337			report.Errors = append(report.Errors, CollectionError{
338				Code: "selection-unavailable", Scope: "local", Subject: "selected-checkout", Message: message,
339			})
340		}
341
342		localIdentities := privateRemoteIdentities(input.Topology)
343		report.Remotes, report.Forge, report.Errors = buildRemoteFacts(now, input, report.Errors)
344		report.Fleet, report.Errors = buildFleetFacts(now, input.Fleet, localIdentities, report.Errors)
345
346		sources := buildSources(now, input, report)
347		report.Sources = sources
348		report.Capabilities = buildCapabilities(input, report)
349
350		readiness := AssessLocal(input.Context, input.SelectedCheckout, input.Hostname)
351		sourceMap := make(map[string]assessment.Source, len(sources))
352		for _, source := range sources {
353			sourceMap[source.ID] = source.assessmentSource()
354		}
355		gates := []assessment.Gate{
356			readinessGate("checkout-readiness", readiness.Checkout, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.checkout")),
357			readinessGate("task-readiness", readiness.Task, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.tasks", "local.runtime")),
358			readinessGate("worktree-readiness", readiness.Worktree, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.worktrees", "local.runtime")),
359			{
360				Code: "whole-clone-eviction", Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate,
361				Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{
362					Code: "recovery-proof-unavailable", Subject: "repository",
363					Detail:      "whole-clone eviction is not assessed by the context profile",
364					Remediation: "create and restore-verify a recovery receipt before eviction",
365				}},
366			},
367		}
368		assessmentReport, err := assessment.NewReport(assessment.ProfileCheap, now, gates)
369		if err != nil {
370			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("seal repository context assessment: %w", err)
371		}
372		report.Assessment = assessmentReport
373
374		sort.Slice(report.Errors, func(i, j int) bool {
375			left, right := report.Errors[i], report.Errors[j]
376			return strings.Join([]string{left.Scope, left.Code, left.Subject, left.Message}, "\x00") <
377				strings.Join([]string{right.Scope, right.Code, right.Subject, right.Message}, "\x00")
378		})
379		return report, nil
380	}

382	func buildLocalFacts(input BuildInput, reportErrors *[]CollectionError) LocalFacts {
383		context := input.Context
384		local := LocalFacts{
385			Checkouts:                          make([]CheckoutFacts, 0, len(context.Checkouts)),
386			OtherTasks:                         []TaskFacts{},
387			ObservedLinkedWorktreeAdminEntries: context.WorktreeCount,
388			CheckoutsComplete:                  context.WorktreeErr == nil,
389			TaskInventoryComplete:              context.TaskErr == nil,
390			Runtimes:                           []RuntimeFacts{},
391		}
392		if context.WorktreeErr == nil {
393			count := context.WorktreeCount
394			local.LinkedWorktreeCount = &count
395		} else {
396			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("worktree-inventory-failed", "local", "worktrees", context.WorktreeErr))
397		}
398		if context.TaskErr != nil {
399			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-inventory-failed", "local", "tasks", context.TaskErr))
400		}
401
402		for index, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
403			facts := CheckoutFacts{
404				Index: index, Path: checkout.Worktree.Path, Canonical: index == 0,
405				Ownership: checkout.Ownership, Locked: checkout.Worktree.Locked,
406				LockedReason:   optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)),
407				Prunable:       checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
408				PrunableReason: optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)),
409				Branch:         optionalString(checkout.Branch()), Head: optionalString(checkout.Worktree.Head),
410				LastActivity: optionalTime(checkout.LastActivity), LastCommit: optionalTime(checkout.LastCommit),
411				LastSubject: optionalString(checkout.LastSubject), Sessions: []RuntimeSession{}, Tasks: []TaskFacts{},
412			}
413			switch {
414			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
415				facts.State = "error"
416				facts.PathError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.PathErr))
417				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-path-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.PathErr))
418			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
419				facts.State = "missing"
420				exists := false
421				facts.Exists = &exists
422			case checkout.Worktree.Bare || index == 0 && context.Repo.Bare:
423				facts.State = "bare"
424				exists := true
425				facts.Exists = &exists
426				detached := false
427				facts.Detached = &detached
428			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
429				facts.State = "error"
430				exists := true
431				facts.Exists = &exists
432				facts.StatusError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.StatusErr))
433				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-status-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.StatusErr))
434			default:
435				facts.State = "available"
436				exists := true
437				facts.Exists = &exists
438				status := checkout.Status
439				facts.Status = &status
440				detached := checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached
441				facts.Detached = &detached
442			}
443			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
444				facts.Tasks = append(facts.Tasks, taskFacts(tracked))
445				if tracked != nil {
446					if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
447						*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
448					}
449				}
450			}
451			local.Checkouts = append(local.Checkouts, facts)
452		}
453		for _, tracked := range context.OtherTasks {
454			local.OtherTasks = append(local.OtherTasks, taskFacts(tracked))
455			if tracked != nil {
456				if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
457					*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
458				}
459			}
460		}
461
462		runtimes := input.Runtimes
463		if len(runtimes) == 0 && (context.Runtime != "" || context.RuntimeErr != nil || len(context.Sessions()) > 0) {
464			runtimes = []RuntimeInput{{
465				Backend: context.Runtime, Available: context.RuntimeErr == nil,
466				Sessions: context.Sessions(), Err: context.RuntimeErr,
467			}}
468		}
469		for runtimeIndex, observed := range runtimes {
470			backend := strings.TrimSpace(observed.Backend)
471			if backend == "" {
472				backend = fmt.Sprintf("unknown-%d", runtimeIndex+1)
473			}
474			runtimeFacts := RuntimeFacts{
475				Backend: backend, Available: observed.Available,
476				SourceID: "local.runtime", Sessions: []RuntimeSession{},
477			}
478			if observed.Err != nil {
479				runtimeFacts.Error = optionalString(cleanError(observed.Err))
480				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("runtime-inventory-failed", "local", "runtime:"+safeIdentifier(backend), observed.Err))
481			}
482			for _, session := range observed.Sessions {
483				indices := sessionCheckoutIndices(context, session)
484				if len(indices) == 0 {
485					continue
486				}
487				projected := RuntimeSession{
488					Backend: backend, Handle: session.Handle, Label: optionalString(session.Label),
489					AgentStatus:   optionalString(session.AgentStatus),
490					AgentSessions: append([]string{}, session.AgentSessions...),
491					Focused:       session.Focused, Checkouts: indices,
492				}
493				sort.Strings(projected.AgentSessions)
494				runtimeFacts.Sessions = append(runtimeFacts.Sessions, projected)
495				for _, checkoutIndex := range indices {
496					if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(local.Checkouts) {
497						local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions = append(local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions, projected)
498					}
499				}
500			}
501			sortRuntimeSessions(runtimeFacts.Sessions)
502			local.Runtimes = append(local.Runtimes, runtimeFacts)
503		}
504		sort.Slice(local.Runtimes, func(i, j int) bool { return local.Runtimes[i].Backend < local.Runtimes[j].Backend })
505		for index := range local.Checkouts {
506			sortRuntimeSessions(local.Checkouts[index].Sessions)
507		}
508		return local
509	}

511	func buildRemoteFacts(now time.Time, input BuildInput, reportErrors []CollectionError) ([]Remote, ForgeFacts, []CollectionError) {
512		forgeFacts := ForgeFacts{Error: optionalError(input.Forge.Err)}
513		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
514			sourceID := "forge.inventory"
515			forgeFacts.SourceID = &sourceID
516			records := len(input.Forge.Records)
517			forgeFacts.RecordsConsidered = &records
518			complete := input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete
519			forgeFacts.Complete = &complete
520		} else if input.Forge.Err != nil {
521			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-unavailable", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
522		}
523		if input.Forge.Err != nil && !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
524			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-partial", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
525		}
526		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
527			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("remote-topology-failed", "local", "remotes", input.TopologyErr))
528			if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
529				zero := 0
530				forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &zero
531			}
532			return []Remote{}, forgeFacts, reportErrors
533		}
534
535		recordsByIdentity := forgeRecordsByIdentity(input.Forge.Records)
536		currentUpstream := ""
537		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(input.Context.Checkouts) {
538			status := input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].Status
539			if input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].StatusErr == nil && status.Upstream != "" {
540				currentUpstream, _, _ = strings.Cut(status.Upstream, "/")
541			}
542		}
543		matchedRecords := map[string]struct{}{}
544		remotes := make([]Remote, 0, len(input.Topology.Remotes))
545		for _, observed := range input.Topology.Remotes {
546			remote := Remote{Name: observed.Name, Roles: remoteRoles(observed.Name, currentUpstream), Fetch: []RemoteEndpoint{}, Push: []RemoteEndpoint{}}
547			for index, raw := range observed.FetchURLs {
548				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
549				remote.Fetch = append(remote.Fetch, endpoint)
550				for _, key := range matched {
551					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
552				}
553				if endpointErr != nil {
554					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
555						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.fetch.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
556					})
557				}
558			}
559			for index, raw := range observed.PushURLs {
560				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
561				remote.Push = append(remote.Push, endpoint)
562				for _, key := range matched {
563					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
564				}
565				if endpointErr != nil {
566					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
567						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.push.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
568					})
569				}
570			}
571			remotes = append(remotes, remote)
572		}
573		if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
574			matches := len(matchedRecords)
575			forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &matches
576		}
577		return remotes, forgeFacts, reportErrors
578	}

580	type endpointBuildError struct {
581		Code    string
582		Message string
583	}
584
585	func buildRemoteEndpoint(raw string, records map[string][]forge.RemoteRepo, forgeAvailable, exactForge bool) (RemoteEndpoint, []string, *endpointBuildError) {
586		transport, displayIdentity, displayOK := publicEndpointIdentity(raw)
587		forgeMatch := "unavailable"
588		if forgeAvailable {
589			forgeMatch = "none"
590		}
591		endpoint := RemoteEndpoint{Transport: transport, Identity: optionalString(displayIdentity), ForgeMatch: forgeMatch}
592		privateIdentity := privateRemoteIdentity(raw)
593		if !displayOK {
594			message := "endpoint has no display-safe cross-host identity"
595			endpoint.Error = &message
596			return endpoint, nil, &endpointBuildError{Code: "remote-identity-unavailable", Message: message}
597		}
598
599		candidates := dedupeForgeRecords(records[privateIdentity])
600		var exact *forge.RemoteRepo
601		matched := []string{}
602		switch len(candidates) {
603		case 1:
604			if exactForge {
605				exact = &candidates[0]
606			}
607			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "exact"
608			matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidates[0]))
609		case 0:
610			if forgeAvailable {
611				endpoint.ForgeMatch = "none"
612			}
613		default:
614			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "ambiguous"
615			message := fmt.Sprintf("normalized endpoint identity matches %d forge records", len(candidates))
616			endpoint.Error = &message
617			for _, candidate := range candidates {
618				matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidate))
619			}
620			if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw}); ok {
621				endpoint.WebURL = &web
622			}
623			return endpoint, matched, &endpointBuildError{Code: "forge-match-ambiguous", Message: message}
624		}
625		if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw, Exact: exact}); ok {
626			endpoint.WebURL = &web
627		}
628		return endpoint, matched, nil
629	}

631	func buildFleetFacts(now time.Time, input FleetInput, localIdentities map[string]struct{}, reportErrors []CollectionError) (FleetFacts, []CollectionError) {
632		facts := FleetFacts{Coverage: FleetCoverageConfiguredHostsOnly, Hosts: []FleetHostObservation{}, Error: optionalError(input.Err)}
633		if !input.Configured {
634			if input.Err == nil {
635				facts.Error = optionalString("fleet configuration was not collected")
636			}
637			if facts.Error != nil {
638				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-config-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "configuration", Message: *facts.Error})
639			}
640			return facts, reportErrors
641		}
642		count := len(input.ConfiguredHostNames)
643		facts.ConfiguredHosts = &count
644		results := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
645		for _, result := range input.Results {
646			if _, exists := results[result.Name]; !exists {
647				results[result.Name] = result
648			}
649		}
650		for index, name := range input.ConfiguredHostNames {
651			result, found := results[name]
652			if !found {
653				result = fleet.HostResult{Name: name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "configured host produced no observation"}
654			}
655			host := FleetHostObservation{
656				Name: name, State: result.State, CachedAt: optionalTimeValue(result.CachedAt),
657				Match: FleetMatchUnavailable, Repositories: []FleetRepository{}, Error: optionalString(cleanText(result.Error)),
658			}
659			if result.Snapshot != nil {
660				matches := matchingFleetRepositories(result.Snapshot.Repositories, localIdentities)
661				for _, matched := range matches {
662					host.Repositories = append(host.Repositories, fleetRepositoryFacts(matched))
663				}
664				switch {
665				case len(localIdentities) == 0:
666					host.Match = FleetMatchUnavailable
667					if host.Error == nil {
668						host.Error = optionalString("local repository has no normalized remote identity")
669					}
670				case len(matches) == 0:
671					host.Match = FleetMatchNotFound
672				case len(matches) == 1:
673					host.Match = FleetMatchExact
674				default:
675					host.Match = FleetMatchAmbiguous
676					message := fmt.Sprintf("%d repositories on this host share a local normalized remote identity", len(matches))
677					if host.Error == nil {
678						host.Error = &message
679					}
680					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-match-ambiguous", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: message})
681				}
682
683				observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
684				if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
685					observedAt = *result.CachedAt
686				}
687				if !observedAt.IsZero() {
688					sourceID := fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index)
689					host.SourceID = &sourceID
690				}
691			}
692			if result.Error != "" || result.Snapshot == nil {
693				message := result.Error
694				if message == "" {
695					message = "host produced no repository snapshot"
696				}
697				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-host-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: cleanText(message)})
698			}
699			facts.Hosts = append(facts.Hosts, host)
700		}
701		return facts, reportErrors
702	}

704	func buildSources(now time.Time, input BuildInput, report Report) []Source {
705		sources := []Source{}
706		selectedFacts := any(nil)
707		checkoutCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessUnknown
708		if report.SelectedCheckout != nil {
709			selectedFacts = report.Local.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
710			checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessComplete
711			selected := input.Context.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
712			if selected.PathErr != nil || selected.StatusErr != nil {
713				checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
714			}
715		}
716		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.checkout", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, checkoutCompleteness, now, now, selectedFacts))
717
718		taskCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
719		if input.Context.TaskErr != nil {
720			taskCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
721		}
722		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.tasks", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, taskCompleteness, now, now, struct {
723			Checkouts  []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
724			OtherTasks []TaskFacts     `json:"other_tasks"`
725		}{report.Local.Checkouts, report.Local.OtherTasks}))
726
727		worktreeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
728		if input.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
729			worktreeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
730		}
731		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.worktrees", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, worktreeCompleteness, now, now, struct {
732			Count     *int            `json:"count"`
733			Checkouts []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
734		}{report.Local.LinkedWorktreeCount, report.Local.Checkouts}))
735
736		runtimeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
737		if len(report.Local.Runtimes) == 0 {
738			runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
739		}
740		for _, observed := range report.Local.Runtimes {
741			if observed.Error != nil {
742				runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
743			}
744		}
745		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.runtime", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, runtimeCompleteness, now, now, report.Local.Runtimes))
746
747		remoteCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
748		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
749			remoteCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
750		}
751		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.remotes", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, remoteCompleteness, now, now, report.Remotes))
752
753		if input.Fleet.Configured {
754			sources = append(sources, newSource("local.fleet-config", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, assessment.CompletenessComplete, now, now, input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames))
755		}
756		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
757			freshness := input.Forge.Freshness
758			if freshness == "" {
759				freshness = assessment.FreshnessUnknown
760			}
761			completeness := input.Forge.Completeness
762			if completeness == "" {
763				completeness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
764			}
765			sources = append(sources, newSource("forge.inventory", input.Forge.Authority, freshness, completeness, input.Forge.ObservedAt, now, struct {
766				Remotes []Remote   `json:"remotes"`
767				Forge   ForgeFacts `json:"forge"`
768			}{report.Remotes, report.Forge}))
769		}
770		resultByName := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
771		for _, result := range input.Fleet.Results {
772			resultByName[result.Name] = result
773		}
774		for index, name := range input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames {
775			result, ok := resultByName[name]
776			if !ok || result.Snapshot == nil || index >= len(report.Fleet.Hosts) {
777				continue
778			}
779			observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
780			if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
781				observedAt = *result.CachedAt
782			}
783			if observedAt.IsZero() {
784				continue
785			}
786			authority := assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive
787			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
788			if result.FromCache {
789				authority = assessment.AuthorityCache
790				if input.Fleet.CacheTTL > 0 && now.Sub(observedAt) > input.Fleet.CacheTTL {
791					freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
792				}
793			}
794			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
795			if result.Error != "" || result.State != fleet.HostOK && !result.FromCache {
796				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
797			}
798			sources = append(sources, newSource(fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index), authority, freshness, completeness, observedAt, now, report.Fleet.Hosts[index]))
799		}
800		sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool { return sources[i].ID < sources[j].ID })
801		return sources
802	}

804	func buildCapabilities(input BuildInput, report Report) []Capability {
805		capabilities := []Capability{}
806		localState := CapabilityAvailable
807		if input.TopologyErr != nil || input.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
808			localState = CapabilityPartial
809		}
810		for _, checkout := range input.Context.Checkouts {
811			if checkout.PathErr != nil || checkout.StatusErr != nil {
812				localState = CapabilityPartial
813			}
814		}
815		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{Code: "local-git", State: localState, SourceIDs: []string{"local.checkout", "local.worktrees", "local.remotes"}})
816
817		taskState := CapabilityAvailable
818		if input.Context.TaskErr != nil {
819			taskState = CapabilityPartial
820		}
821		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{Code: "task-inventory", State: taskState, SourceIDs: []string{"local.tasks"}})
822
823		runtimeState := CapabilityAvailable
824		if len(report.Local.Runtimes) == 0 {
825			runtimeState = CapabilityUnavailable
826		}
827		for _, observed := range report.Local.Runtimes {
828			if observed.Error != nil {
829				runtimeState = CapabilityPartial
830			}
831		}
832		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{Code: "runtime-inventory", State: runtimeState, SourceIDs: []string{"local.runtime"}})
833
834		forgeCapability := Capability{Code: "forge-inventory", State: CapabilityUnavailable, SourceIDs: []string{}}
835		if report.Forge.SourceID != nil {
836			forgeCapability.State = CapabilityAvailable
837			forgeCapability.SourceIDs = []string{*report.Forge.SourceID}
838			if input.Forge.Err != nil || input.Forge.Completeness != assessment.CompletenessComplete {
839				forgeCapability.State = CapabilityPartial
840			}
841		}
842		if report.Forge.Error != nil {
843			forgeCapability.Detail = *report.Forge.Error
844		}
845		capabilities = append(capabilities, forgeCapability)
846
847		fleetCapability := Capability{Code: "fleet-inventory", State: CapabilityUnavailable, SourceIDs: []string{}}
848		if input.Fleet.Configured {
849			fleetCapability.State = CapabilityAvailable
850			fleetCapability.SourceIDs = []string{"local.fleet-config"}
851			for _, host := range report.Fleet.Hosts {
852				if host.SourceID != nil {
853					fleetCapability.SourceIDs = append(fleetCapability.SourceIDs, *host.SourceID)
854				}
855				if host.Error != nil || host.SourceID == nil {
856					fleetCapability.State = CapabilityPartial
857				}
858			}
859		}
860		if report.Fleet.Error != nil {
861			fleetCapability.Detail = *report.Fleet.Error
862		}
863		capabilities = append(capabilities, fleetCapability)
864		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{
865			Code: "whole-clone-eviction", State: CapabilityNotImplemented, SourceIDs: []string{},
866			Detail: "context does not implement recovery receipt or restore-verification proof",
867		})
868		for index := range capabilities {
869			sort.Strings(capabilities[index].SourceIDs)
870		}
871		sort.Slice(capabilities, func(i, j int) bool { return capabilities[i].Code < capabilities[j].Code })
872		return capabilities
873	}

875	func readinessGate(code string, readiness Readiness, sources []assessment.Source) assessment.Gate {
876		return assessment.Gate{Code: code, Outcome: readiness.Outcome, Sources: sources, Reasons: append([]assessment.Reason{}, readiness.Reasons...)}

879	func sourcesNamed(sources map[string]assessment.Source, names ...string) []assessment.Source {
880		result := make([]assessment.Source, 0, len(names))
881		for _, name := range names {
882			if source, ok := sources[name]; ok {
883				result = append(result, source)
884			}
885		}
886		return result
887	}

889	func newSource(id string, authority assessment.Authority, freshness assessment.Freshness, completeness assessment.Completeness, observedAt, now time.Time, facts any) Source {
890		observedAt = observedAt.Round(0).UTC()
891		encoded, err := json.Marshal(facts)
892		if err != nil {
893			encoded = []byte(fmt.Sprintf("unencodable:%T", facts))
894		}
895		age := int64(0)
896		if now.After(observedAt) {
897			age = int64(now.Sub(observedAt) / time.Second)
898		}
899		return Source{
900			ID: id, Authority: authority, Freshness: freshness, Completeness: completeness,
901			ObservedAt: observedAt, AgeSeconds: age, Fingerprint: assessment.FingerprintBytes(encoded),
902		}
903	}

905	func taskFacts(tracked *task.Task) TaskFacts {
906		if tracked == nil {
907			return TaskFacts{}
908		}
909		return TaskFacts{
910			ID: tracked.ID, Name: tracked.Name, Branch: tracked.Branch, Base: optionalString(tracked.Base),
911			Mode: tracked.EffectiveMode(), State: tracked.State, Owner: optionalString(tracked.Owner),
912			Next: optionalString(tracked.Next), Tags: append([]string{}, tracked.Tags...),
913			AgentSession: optionalString(tracked.AgentSession), RuntimeName: optionalString(tracked.RuntimeName),
914			RuntimeHandle: optionalString(tracked.RuntimeHandle), CreatedAt: optionalTime(tracked.Created), UpdatedAt: optionalTime(tracked.Updated),
915		}
916	}

918	func sessionCheckoutIndices(context inventory.RepoContext, session runtime.Session) []int {
919		seen := map[int]struct{}{}
920		for _, dir := range session.Dirs {

969	func publicEndpointIdentity(raw string) (transport, identity string, ok bool) {
970		if !utf8.ValidString(raw) || containsControl(raw) {
971			return "unknown", "", false
972		}
973		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
974		if trimmed == "" {
975			return "unknown", "", false
976		}
977		redacted := trimmed
978		if parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
979			transport = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
980			parsed.User = nil
981			parsed.RawQuery = ""
982			parsed.ForceQuery = false
983			parsed.Fragment = ""
984			redacted = parsed.String()
985		} else {
986			if index := strings.IndexAny(redacted, "?#"); index >= 0 {
987				redacted = redacted[:index]
988			}
989			colon := strings.IndexByte(redacted, ':')
990			at := strings.LastIndexByte(redacted, '@')
991			if at >= 0 && colon > at {
992				transport = "ssh"
993				redacted = "git@" + redacted[at+1:]
994			} else if filepath.IsAbs(redacted) || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, "~") {
995				transport = "local"
996			} else {
997				transport = "unknown"
998			}
999		}
1000		identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(redacted)
1001		if identity == "" || containsControl(identity) {
1002			return transport, "", false
1003		}
1004		return transport, identity, true
1005	}

1007	func forgeRecordsByIdentity(records []forge.RemoteRepo) map[string][]forge.RemoteRepo {

1012				identity := privateRemoteIdentity(raw)

1014					continue
1015				}
1016				if _, exists := seen[identity]; exists {
1017					continue
1018				}
1019				seen[identity] = struct{}{}
1020				result[identity] = append(result[identity], record)

1022		}

1026	func dedupeForgeRecords(records []forge.RemoteRepo) []forge.RemoteRepo {
1027		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
1028		result := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(records))
1029		for _, record := range records {

1033			}

1037		sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return forgeRecordKey(result[i]) < forgeRecordKey(result[j]) })

1111	func cleanError(err error) string {
1112		if err == nil {
1113			return ""
1114		}
1115		return cleanText(err.Error())
1116	}

1118	// cleanText removes controls and structurally redacts URL/scp-like tokens while
1119	// preserving enough of an error to diagnose which probe failed.
1120	func cleanText(value string) string {
1121		value = strings.Map(func(r rune) rune {
1122			if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
1123				return ' '
1124			}
1125			return r
1126		}, value)
1127		fields := strings.Fields(value)
1128		for index, field := range fields {
1129			fields[index] = redactTextToken(field)
1130		}
1131		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(fields, " "))
1132	}
1133
1134	func redactTextToken(token string) string {
1135		prefix := strings.TrimLeft(token, "([{<\"'")
1136		leading := token[:len(token)-len(prefix)]
1137		core := strings.TrimRight(prefix, ")]}>\"',;.")
1138		trailing := prefix[len(core):]
1139		if parsed, err := url.Parse(core); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
1140			parsed.User = nil
1141			parsed.RawQuery = ""
1142			parsed.ForceQuery = false
1143			parsed.Fragment = ""
1144			return leading + parsed.String() + trailing
1145		}
1146		colon := strings.IndexByte(core, ':')
1147		at := strings.LastIndexByte(core, '@')
1148		if at > 0 && colon > at {
1149			core = "[redacted]@" + core[at+1:]
1150			if query := strings.IndexAny(core, "?#"); query >= 0 {
1151				core = core[:query]
1152			}
1153		}
1154		return leading + core + trailing
1155	}
1156
1157	func containsControl(value string) bool {
1158		return strings.IndexFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
1159			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
1160		}) >= 0
1161	}
1162
1163	func safeIdentifier(value string) string {
1164		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
1165		var b strings.Builder
1166		lastDash := false
1167		for _, r := range value {
1168			if r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' {
1169				b.WriteRune(r)
1170				lastDash = false
1171			} else if !lastDash {
1172				b.WriteByte('-')
1173				lastDash = true
1174			}
1175		}
1176		result := strings.Trim(b.String(), "-")
1177		if result == "" {
1178			return "unknown"
1179		}
1180		return result
1181	}
1182
1183	func optionalString(value string) *string {
1184		if value == "" {
1185			return nil
1186		}
1187		copy := value
1188		return &copy
1189	}
1190
1191	func optionalTime(value time.Time) *time.Time {
1192		if value.IsZero() {
1193			return nil
1194		}
1195		copy := value.Round(0).UTC()
1196		return &copy
1197	}

1199	func optionalTimeValue(value *time.Time) *time.Time {

1202		}
1203		copy := value.Round(0).UTC()

12	// Readiness is one cheap, local-only context projection. It intentionally

18	}

20	// LocalReadiness keeps independently actionable checkout, task, and worktree

37	// AssessLocal derives readiness from facts already collected by inventory. It
38	// does not run Git, inspect a runtime, or contact a forge/fleet host.
39	func AssessLocal(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) LocalReadiness {
40		return LocalReadiness{
41			Checkout: assessCheckout(context, selectedIndex),
42			Task:     assessTasks(context, selectedIndex, hostname),
43			Worktree: assessWorktrees(context, selectedIndex),
44		}
45	}

47	func assessCheckout(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
48		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
49			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the selected checkout is absent from the local inventory", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
50		}
51		checkout := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex]
52		switch {
53		case checkout.Worktree.Bare || context.Repo.Bare:
54			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
55		case checkout.PathErr != nil:
56			return indeterminate("checkout-path-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path could not be inspected", "restore path access and rerun context")
57		case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
58			return blocked("checkout-missing", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path is missing or prunable", "repair or remove the stale worktree registration")
59		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
60			return indeterminate("checkout-status-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "Git status could not be collected", "repair the checkout and rerun context")
61		case checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached || checkout.Branch() == "":
62			return blocked("checkout-detached", "selected-checkout", "the checkout does not have an attached branch", "check out an explicit branch")
63		case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
64			return blocked("checkout-conflicted", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d unmerged path(s)", checkout.Status.Conflicted), "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement")
65		case checkout.Status.Dirty():
66			return blocked("checkout-dirty", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d changed path(s)", checkout.Status.Changed), "commit or deliberately preserve the changes")
67		default:
68			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
69		}
70	}
71
72	func assessTasks(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) Readiness {
73		if context.TaskErr != nil {
74			return indeterminate("task-inventory-unavailable", "task-inventory", "task records could not be collected", "repair the task store and rerun context")
75		}
76		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
77			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "task scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
78		}
79		tracked := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Tasks
80		active := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(tracked))
81		for _, candidate := range tracked {
82			if candidate != nil && candidate.State != task.Done {
83				active = append(active, candidate)
84			}
85		}
86		if len(active) == 0 {
87			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
88		}
89		var reasons []assessment.Reason
90		hasIndeterminate := false
91		for _, candidate := range active {
92			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
93				hasIndeterminate = true
94				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
95					Code: "task-record-invalid", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task record is invalid",
96					Remediation: "repair or recreate the task record",
97				})
98				continue
99			}
100			if hostname != "" && candidate.Owner != "" && candidate.Owner != hostname {
101				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
102					Code: "task-owned-elsewhere", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task is owned by another machine",
103					Remediation: "complete an explicit ownership handoff before writing",
104				})
105			}
106			if candidate.State == task.Hot {
107				if context.RuntimeErr != nil {
108					hasIndeterminate = true
109					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
110						Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task cannot be checked against live runtime state",
111						Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
112					})
113				} else if len(context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Sessions) == 0 {
114					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
115						Code: "hot-task-runtime-missing", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task has no observed runtime session",
116						Remediation: "resume the task or reconcile its lifecycle state",
117					})
118				}
119			}
120		}
121		if hasReason(reasons, "task-owned-elsewhere") || hasReason(reasons, "hot-task-runtime-missing") {
122			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
123		}
124		if hasIndeterminate {
125			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
126		}
127		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
128	}

130	func assessWorktrees(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
131		if context.WorktreeErr != nil {
132			return indeterminate("worktree-inventory-unavailable", "worktrees", "linked worktrees could not be enumerated", "repair Git worktree metadata and rerun context")
133		}
134		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
135			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "worktree scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
136		}
137		indices := []int{}
138		if selectedIndex > 0 {
139			indices = append(indices, selectedIndex)
140		} else {
141			for index := 1; index < len(context.Checkouts); index++ {
142				indices = append(indices, index)
143			}
144		}
145		if len(indices) == 0 {
146			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
147		}
148		var reasons []assessment.Reason
149		hasUnknown := context.RuntimeErr != nil
150		if hasUnknown {
151			reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
152				Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "worktrees",
153				Detail:      "worktree runtime coverage could not be collected",
154				Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
155			})
156		}
157		for _, index := range indices {
158			checkout := context.Checkouts[index]
159			subject := fmt.Sprintf("worktree:%d", index)
160			switch {
161			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
162				hasUnknown = true
163				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-path-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path could not be inspected", Remediation: "restore path access and rerun context"})
164			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
165				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-missing", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path is missing or prunable", Remediation: "repair or remove the stale worktree registration"})
166			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
167				hasUnknown = true
168				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-status-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "Git status could not be collected for the worktree", Remediation: "repair the worktree and rerun context"})
169			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
170				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-locked", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree is locked", Remediation: "verify the lock owner before unlocking it"})
171			case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
172				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-conflicted", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree has unmerged paths", Remediation: "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement"})
173			case checkout.Status.Dirty():
174				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-dirty", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree contains uncommitted changes", Remediation: "commit or deliberately preserve the changes"})
175			case len(checkout.Sessions) > 0:
176				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-runtime-live", Subject: subject, Detail: "a runtime session still covers the worktree", Remediation: "quiesce and close the runtime before retirement"})
177			}
178		}
179		if len(reasons) == 0 {
180			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
181		}
182		if hasKnownBlocker(reasons) {
183			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
184		}
185		if hasUnknown {
186			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
187		}
188		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
189	}

191	func blocked(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
192		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
193	}

195	func indeterminate(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
196		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
197	}

199	func hasReason(reasons []assessment.Reason, code string) bool {
200		for _, reason := range reasons {
201			if reason.Code == code {
202				return true
203			}
204		}
205		return false

212				return true
213			}
214		}
215		return false
216	}

8	// FormatMarkdown extends the legacy deterministic handoff with additive safe
9	// remote, fleet, provenance, and readiness sections. legacy remains unchanged
10	// at the front so existing copy/paste consumers retain their headings.
11	func FormatMarkdown(report Report, legacy string) string {
12		var b strings.Builder
13		b.WriteString(strings.TrimSpace(legacy))
14		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n\n## Context report\n\n- Schema: %d\n- Generated: `%s`\n", report.SchemaVersion, report.GeneratedAt.Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"))
15		if report.SelectedCheckout != nil {
16			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Selected checkout: `%s`", report.SelectedCheckout.Path)
17			if report.SelectedCheckout.Branch != nil {
18				fmt.Fprintf(&b, " (`%s`)", *report.SelectedCheckout.Branch)
19			}
20			b.WriteString("\n")
21		} else {
22			b.WriteString("- Selected checkout: unavailable\n")
23		}
24
25		b.WriteString("\n## Readiness\n")
26		for _, gate := range report.Assessment.Gates {
27			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n- `%s`: **%s**", gate.Code, gate.Outcome)
28			if len(gate.Reasons) > 0 {
29				fmt.Fprintf(&b, " — %s", gate.Reasons[0].Detail)
30			}
31			b.WriteString("\n")
32		}
33
34		b.WriteString("\n## Safe remotes\n")
35		if len(report.Remotes) == 0 {
36			b.WriteString("\n- No remotes were observed.\n")
37		}
38		for _, remote := range report.Remotes {
39			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n### %s", remote.Name)
40			if len(remote.Roles) > 0 {
41				roles := make([]string, len(remote.Roles))
42				for index, role := range remote.Roles {
43					roles[index] = string(role)
44				}
45				fmt.Fprintf(&b, " — %s", strings.Join(roles, ", "))
46			}
47			b.WriteString("\n")
48			writeEndpoints(&b, "fetch", remote.Fetch)
49			writeEndpoints(&b, "push", remote.Push)
50		}
51
52		b.WriteString("\n## Fleet observations\n\n")
53		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Coverage: **%s**\n", report.Fleet.Coverage)
54		if report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts == nil {
55			b.WriteString("- Configured hosts: unavailable\n")
56		} else {
57			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Configured hosts: %d\n", *report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts)
58		}
59		if len(report.Fleet.Hosts) == 0 && report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts != nil && *report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts == 0 {
60			b.WriteString("- No fleet hosts are configured.\n")
61		}
62		sourceByID := map[string]Source{}
63		for _, source := range report.Sources {
64			sourceByID[source.ID] = source
65		}
66		for _, host := range report.Fleet.Hosts {
67			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: %s; match %s", host.Name, host.State, host.Match)
68			if host.SourceID != nil {
69				if source, ok := sourceByID[*host.SourceID]; ok {
70					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "; %s (%s, %s old)", source.Authority, source.Freshness, humanAge(source.AgeSeconds))
71				}
72			}
73			if len(host.Repositories) == 1 {
74				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "; `%s` on `%s`", host.Repositories[0].Display, host.Repositories[0].Path)
75			} else if len(host.Repositories) > 1 {
76				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "; %d exact-identity candidates", len(host.Repositories))
77			}
78			if host.Error != nil {
79				fmt.Fprintf(&b, " — %s", *host.Error)
80			}
81			b.WriteString("\n")
82		}
83
84		if len(report.Errors) > 0 {
85			b.WriteString("\n## Collection errors\n\n")
86			for _, contextError := range report.Errors {
87				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` (%s/%s): %s\n", contextError.Code, contextError.Scope, contextError.Subject, contextError.Message)
88			}
89		}
90		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
91	}
92
93	func writeEndpoints(b *strings.Builder, kind string, endpoints []RemoteEndpoint) {
94		if len(endpoints) == 0 {
95			fmt.Fprintf(b, "\n- %s: unavailable\n", kind)
96			return
97		}
98		for _, endpoint := range endpoints {
99			fmt.Fprintf(b, "\n- %s: ", kind)
100			if endpoint.Identity != nil {
101				fmt.Fprintf(b, "`%s`", *endpoint.Identity)
102			} else {
103				b.WriteString("unavailable")
104			}
105			if endpoint.WebURL != nil {
106				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s (%s, %s)", endpoint.WebURL.URL, endpoint.WebURL.Provider, endpoint.WebURL.Source)
107			}
108			if endpoint.Error != nil {
109				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", *endpoint.Error)
110			}
111			b.WriteString("\n")
112		}
113	}
114
115	func humanAge(seconds int64) string {
116		switch {
117		case seconds < 60:
118			return fmt.Sprintf("%ds", seconds)
119		case seconds < 3600:
120			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", seconds/60)
121		case seconds < 86400:
122			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", seconds/3600)
123		default:
124			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", seconds/86400)
125		}
126	}

124	func resolveRepoContextTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (repo.Repo, string, error) {
125		if len(args) == 1 {
126			resolved, _, err := resolveRepoRef(app, args[0])
127			if err != nil {
128				return repo.Repo{}, "", err
129			}
130			return resolved, resolved.Path, nil
131		}
132		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
133		if err != nil {
134			return repo.Repo{}, "", err
135		}
136		discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
137		if err != nil {
138			return repo.Repo{}, "", fmt.Errorf("%s is not a git repository — pass a repo", config.Contract(cwd))
139		}
140		selectedPath := discovered.Root
141		if selectedPath == "" {
142			selectedPath = discovered.MainRoot
143		}
144		return repo.Repo{
145			Name: discovered.Name, Path: discovered.MainRoot, RealPath: discovered.MainRoot,
146			GitDir: discovered.GitCommonDir, CommonDir: discovered.GitCommonDir,
147			MainRoot: discovered.MainRoot, HasGit: true, Bare: discovered.Bare,
148		}, selectedPath, nil

151	func collectRepoContextForge(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool, now time.Time) repocontext.ForgeInput {
152		cacheInput := func(cache forge.Cache, collectionErr error) repocontext.ForgeInput {
153			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
154			if forgeCacheStale(cache, app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, now) {
155				freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
156			}
157			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
158			if !cache.Complete || collectionErr != nil {
159				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
160			}
161			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
162				Authority: assessment.AuthorityCache, Freshness: freshness,
163				Completeness: completeness, ObservedAt: cache.FetchedAt,
164				Records: append([]forge.RemoteRepo{}, cache.Repos...),
165				Err:     errors.Join(collectionErr, forgeCacheErrors(cache)),
166			}
167		}
168
169		if !refresh {
170			cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
171			if !ok {
172				return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: errors.New("no cached forge inventory; rerun with --refresh to collect one")}
173			}
174			return cacheInput(cache, nil)
175		}
176
177		rows, collectionErr := collectRemotes(ctx, app)
178		records := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(rows))
179		for _, row := range rows {
180			records = append(records, row.Repo)
181		}
182		if collectionErr == nil {
183			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
184				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
185				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
186				Records: records,
187			}
188		}
189		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
190			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
191			if len(records) > 0 {
192				cached.Records = records
193			}
194			return cached
195		}
196		if len(records) > 0 {
197			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
198				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
199				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
200				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
201			}
202		}
203		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
204	}
205
206	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
207		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
208			return true
209		}
210		if ttl <= 0 {
211			return false
212		}
213		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
214	}
215
216	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
217		var providerErrors []error
218		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
219		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
220		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
221			name := string(kind)
222			kinds = append(kinds, name)
223			byKind[name] = status
224		}
225		sort.Strings(kinds)
226		for _, kind := range kinds {
227			status := byKind[kind]
228			if status.Error != "" {
229				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
230			} else if !status.Complete {
231				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
232			}
233		}
234		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
235	}
236
237	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
238		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
239		if err != nil {
240			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
241		}
242		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
243			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
244			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
245			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
246		}
247		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
248			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
249		}
250		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
251			return input
252		}
253		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
254		if parallel <= 0 {
255			parallel = 1
256		}
257		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
258		var wait sync.WaitGroup
259		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
260			wait.Add(1)
261			go func() {
262				defer wait.Done()
263				semaphore <- struct{}{}
264				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
265				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
266			}()
267		}
268		wait.Wait()
269		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
270			input.Err = err
271		}
272		return input
273	}

1	package inventory

18	// CheckoutOwnership says who is expected to clean up a checkout. Canonical and
19	// dev-owned checkouts are part of dev's durable inventory; external and
20	// ephemeral checkouts are still shown because hiding them would make the WT
21	// count impossible to explain.
22	type CheckoutOwnership string
23
24	const (
25		CheckoutCanonical CheckoutOwnership = "canonical"
26		CheckoutDev       CheckoutOwnership = "dev"
27		CheckoutExternal  CheckoutOwnership = "external"
28		CheckoutEphemeral CheckoutOwnership = "ephemeral"
29	)
30
31	// RepoCheckout is one checkout in a repository context. The first checkout is
32	// always the canonical checkout; the rest are linked worktrees in Git order.
33	type RepoCheckout struct {
34		Worktree gitx.Worktree
35		Status   gitx.Status
36		// StatusErr is retained so a prunable or unreadable checkout can remain
37		// visible without pretending its Git state was successfully inspected.
38		StatusErr error
39		// PathErr distinguishes an unreadable checkout path from a checkout which is
40		// conclusively missing. Callers must not turn either case into a clean Git
41		// status.
42		PathErr      error
43		Exists       bool
44		LastActivity time.Time
45		LastCommit   time.Time
46		LastSubject  string
47		Sessions     []runtime.Session
48		Tasks        []*task.Task
49		Ownership    CheckoutOwnership
50	}
51
52	// Branch returns the named branch, falling back to the live status for the
53	// synthetic canonical checkout.
54	func (c RepoCheckout) Branch() string {
55		if c.Worktree.Branch != "" {
56			return c.Worktree.Branch
57		}
58		return c.Status.Branch
59	}
60
61	// RepoContext is the complete operational context for one discovered repo.
62	type RepoContext struct {
63		Repo repo.Repo
64		// Checkouts contains the canonical checkout followed by linked worktrees.
65		Checkouts []RepoCheckout
66		// OtherTasks are tracked branches which are not checked out here (for
67		// example cold or branch-only tasks on another branch).
68		OtherTasks []*task.Task
69		Runtime    string
70		// RuntimeErr and TaskErr retain collection failures so a report cannot
71		// mislabel unavailable observations as a closed runtime or an untracked task.
72		RuntimeErr error
73		TaskErr    error
74		// WorktreeCount is kept separately so a failed Git query can still explain
75		// the number shown from the administrative worktrees directory.
76		WorktreeCount int
77		WorktreeErr   error
78		LastActivity  time.Time
79	}
80
81	// Main returns the canonical checkout.
82	func (c RepoContext) Main() (RepoCheckout, bool) {
83		if len(c.Checkouts) == 0 {
84			return RepoCheckout{}, false
85		}
86		return c.Checkouts[0], true
87	}
88
89	// Linked returns only linked worktrees.
90	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
91		if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
92			return nil
93		}
94		return c.Checkouts[1:]
95	}
96
97	// CheckoutIndexForPath returns the most-specific checkout containing path. It
98	// uses the same symlink-aware matching as runtime assignment, so a current
99	// directory under a nested linked worktree never resolves to the canonical
100	// checkout merely because that checkout is its lexical parent.
101	func (c RepoContext) CheckoutIndexForPath(path string) (int, bool) {
102		best, bestLen := -1, -1
103		for index := range c.Checkouts {
104			for _, root := range checkoutRoots(c.Repo, index, c.Checkouts[index]) {
105				if pathContains(root, path) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
106					best, bestLen = index, len(filepath.Clean(root))
107				}
108			}
109		}
110		return best, best >= 0
111	}
112
113	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
114	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
115	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
116		seen := map[string]bool{}
117		var out []runtime.Session
118		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
119			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
120				key := session.Handle
121				if key == "" {
122					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
123				}
124				if seen[key] {
125					continue
126				}
127				seen[key] = true
128				out = append(out, session)
129			}
130		}
131		return out
132	}
133
134	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository.
135	// Repositories with no linked-worktree admin entries deliberately skip
136	// `git worktree list`; this keeps the common whole-machine inventory path fast.
137	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
138		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
139
140		out := RepoContext{Repo: r, Runtime: runtimeName}
141		mainExists, mainPathErr := pathIsDir(r.Path)
142		main := RepoCheckout{
143			Worktree: gitx.Worktree{Path: r.Path, Main: true},
144			Exists:   mainExists, PathErr: mainPathErr, Ownership: CheckoutCanonical,
145		}
146		if r.Bare {
147			main.Worktree.Bare = true
148		} else {
149			main.Status, main.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
150			main.Worktree.Branch = main.Status.Branch
151			main.Worktree.Detached = main.Status.Detached
152			main.LastActivity, main.LastCommit, main.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, r.Path, main.Status)
153		}
154		out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, main)
155
156		out.WorktreeCount, out.WorktreeErr = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
157		if out.WorktreeErr == nil && out.WorktreeCount > 0 {
158			worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
159			if err != nil {
160				out.WorktreeErr = err
161			} else {
162				out.WorktreeCount = 0
163				for _, w := range worktrees {
164					if w.Main {
165						continue
166					}
167					exists, pathErr := pathIsDir(w.Path)
168					checkout := RepoCheckout{
169						Worktree: w, Exists: exists, PathErr: pathErr, Ownership: CheckoutExternal,
170					}
171					if checkout.Exists && checkout.PathErr == nil && !w.Prunable {
172						checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, w.Path)
173						checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, w.Path, checkout.Status)
174					}
175					if IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
176						checkout.Ownership = CheckoutEphemeral
177					}
178					out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
179					out.WorktreeCount++
180				}
181			}
182		}
183
184		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
185		assignSessions(&out, sessions)
186		for _, checkout := range out.Checkouts {
187			if checkout.LastActivity.After(out.LastActivity) {
188				out.LastActivity = checkout.LastActivity
189			}
190			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
191				if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
192					out.LastActivity = t.Updated
193				}
194			}
195		}
196		for _, t := range out.OtherTasks {
197			if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
198				out.LastActivity = t.Updated
199			}
200		}
201		return out
202	}
203
204	// IsEphemeralWorktree recognises turn-scoped checkouts owned by an agent
205	// harness. They stay visible, but the label prevents an agent from treating
206	// them like durable dev-owned work.
207	func IsEphemeralWorktree(path, branch string) bool {
208		slashPath := filepath.ToSlash(path)
209		return strings.Contains(slashPath, "/.claude/worktrees/") ||
210			strings.HasPrefix(branch, "worktree-")
211	}
212
213	func linkedAdminCount(commonDir string) (int, error) {
214		if commonDir == "" {
215			return 0, nil
216		}
217		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(commonDir, "worktrees"))
218		if err != nil {
219			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
220				return 0, nil
221			}
222			return 0, err
223		}
224		n := 0
225		for _, entry := range entries {
226			if entry.IsDir() {
227				n++
228			}
229		}
230		return n, nil
231	}
232
233	func pathIsDir(path string) (bool, error) {
234		info, err := os.Stat(path)
235		if err != nil {
236			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
237				return false, nil
238			}
239			return false, err
240		}
241		if !info.IsDir() {
242			return false, fmt.Errorf("checkout path is not a directory")
243		}
244		return true, nil
245	}

247	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
248		latest := status.LatestChange
249		var commit time.Time
250		var subject string
251		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
252			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
253			if commit.After(latest) {
254				latest = commit
255			}
256			subject = lastSubject
257		}
258		return latest, commit, subject
259	}

261	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
262		for _, t := range tasks {
263			assigned := false
264			if t.WorktreePath != "" {
265				for i := 1; i < len(out.Checkouts); i++ {
266					if samePath(t.WorktreePath, out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path) {
267						out.Checkouts[i].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, t)
268						out.Checkouts[i].Ownership = CheckoutDev
269						assigned = true
270						break
271					}
272				}
273			} else if len(out.Checkouts) > 0 && t.Branch == out.Checkouts[0].Branch() {
274				out.Checkouts[0].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[0].Tasks, t)
275				assigned = true
276			}
277			if !assigned {
278				out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, t)
279			}
280		}
281		for i := range out.Checkouts {
282			sort.SliceStable(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
283				return out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[a].ID < out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[b].ID
284			})
285		}
286		sort.SliceStable(out.OtherTasks, func(i, j int) bool {
287			return out.OtherTasks[i].ID < out.OtherTasks[j].ID
288		})
289	}

291	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
292	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
293	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
294	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
295		for _, session := range sessions {
296			assigned := map[int]bool{}
297			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
298				best, bestLen := -1, -1
299				for i := range out.Checkouts {
300					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Repo, i, out.Checkouts[i]) {
301						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
302							best, bestLen = i, len(filepath.Clean(root))
303						}
304					}
305				}
306				if best >= 0 {
307					assigned[best] = true
308				}
309			}
310			for i := range assigned {
311				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
312			}
313		}
314	}

316	func checkoutRoots(r repo.Repo, index int, checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
317		roots := []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
318		if index == 0 && r.RealPath != "" && !samePath(r.RealPath, r.Path) {
319			roots = append(roots, r.RealPath)
320		}
321		return roots
322	}
323
324	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
325		if root == "" || path == "" {
326			return false
327		}
328		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
329		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
330			return false
331		}
332		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
333	}
334
335	func samePath(a, b string) bool {
336		return a != "" && b != "" && normalizePath(a) == normalizePath(b)
337	}
338
339	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
340	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
341	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
342	// is not sufficient.
343	func normalizePath(path string) string {
344		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
345		cur := clean
346		for {
347			if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
348				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
349				if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
350					return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
351				}
352				return filepath.Clean(real)
353			}
354			parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
355			if parent == cur {
356				return clean
357			}
358			cur = parent
359		}
360	}

362	// FormatRepoContext renders the deterministic Markdown used by both the CLI
363	// and the TUI's yy binding. checkoutIndex < 0 means the whole repository.
364	func FormatRepoContext(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
365		var b strings.Builder
366		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
367			checkout := c.Checkouts[checkoutIndex]
368			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev worktree context: %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout))
369			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, false)
370			return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
371		}
372
373		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev repo context: %s\n\n", c.Repo.Display())
374		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Repository: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Display())
375		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Main path: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Path)
376		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Linked worktrees: %d\n", c.WorktreeCount)
377		if c.Runtime != "" && c.Runtime != "none" {
378			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime: `%s`\n", c.Runtime)
379		}
380		if c.WorktreeErr != nil {
381			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Worktree inventory error: %s\n", c.WorktreeErr)
382		}
383		if c.RuntimeErr != nil {
384			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime inventory error: %s\n", c.RuntimeErr)
385		}
386		if c.TaskErr != nil {
387			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Task inventory error: %s\n", c.TaskErr)
388		}
389		b.WriteString("\n## Checkouts\n")
390		for i, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
391			b.WriteString("\n")
392			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, i == 0)
393		}
394		if len(c.OtherTasks) > 0 {
395			b.WriteString("\n## Other tracked tasks\n\n")
396			for _, t := range c.OtherTasks {
397				writeTaskMarkdown(&b, t)
398			}
399		}
400		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
401	}
402
403	func writeCheckoutMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, c RepoContext, checkout RepoCheckout, canonical bool) {
404		label := string(checkout.Ownership)
405		if canonical {
406			label = "canonical"
407		}
408		fmt.Fprintf(b, "### %s — %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout), label)
409		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Path: `%s`\n", checkout.Worktree.Path)
410		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Branch: `%s`\n", displayBranch(checkout))
411		if checkout.Worktree.Bare {
412			b.WriteString("- Git: bare repository\n")
413		} else if checkout.PathErr != nil {
414			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.PathErr)
415		} else if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
416			b.WriteString("- Git: unavailable (checkout path is missing)\n")
417		} else if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
418			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.StatusErr)
419		} else {
420			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: %s", checkout.Status.Summary())
421			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
422				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", checkout.Status.Breakdown())
423			}
424			b.WriteString("\n")
425			if checkout.Status.Upstream != "" {
426				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Upstream: `%s`\n", checkout.Status.Upstream)
427			} else {
428				b.WriteString("- Upstream: not published\n")
429			}
430		}
431		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
432			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)
433			if reason == "" {
434				reason = "no reason recorded"
435			}
436			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: locked — %s\n", reason)
437		}
438		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || checkout.PathErr == nil && !checkout.Exists {
439			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)
440			if reason == "" {
441				reason = "checkout path is missing"
442			}
443			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: prunable — %s\n", reason)
444		}
445		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
446			if c.RuntimeErr != nil {
447				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: unavailable (%s)\n", c.RuntimeErr)
448			} else {
449				b.WriteString("- Runtime: closed\n")
450			}
451		} else {
452			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
453				status := session.AgentStatus
454				if status == "" {
455					status = "unknown"
456				}
457				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: `%s %s` (%s)\n", c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
458				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
459					fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Agent sessions: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
460				}
461			}
462		}
463		if len(checkout.Tasks) == 0 {
464			if c.TaskErr != nil {
465				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: unavailable (%s)\n", c.TaskErr)
466			} else {
467				b.WriteString("- Task: untracked\n")
468			}
469		} else {
470			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
471				writeTaskMarkdown(b, t)
472			}
473		}
474	}
475
476	func writeTaskMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, t *task.Task) {
477		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: `%s` — %s", t.ID, t.State)
478		if t.Next != "" {
479			fmt.Fprintf(b, "; next: %s", t.Next)
480		}
481		b.WriteString("\n")
482		if t.AgentSession != "" {
483			fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Recorded agent: `%s`\n", t.AgentSession)
484		}
485	}
486
487	func displayBranch(checkout RepoCheckout) string {
488		if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
489			return branch
490		}
491		if checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached {
492			return "(detached HEAD)"
493		}
494		return "(unknown branch)"
495	}
496
497	func markdownCodes(values []string) string {
498		quoted := make([]string, 0, len(values))
499		for _, value := range values {
500			quoted = append(quoted, "`"+value+"`")
501		}
502		return strings.Join(quoted, ", ")
503	}
504
505	// FormatSessions renders the ys payload. checkoutIndex < 0 selects the whole
506	// repository; otherwise it selects one checkout.
507	func FormatSessions(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
508		indices := make([]int, 0, len(c.Checkouts))
509		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
510			indices = append(indices, checkoutIndex)
511		} else {
512			for i := range c.Checkouts {
513				indices = append(indices, i)
514			}
515		}
516		var b strings.Builder
517		for _, i := range indices {
518			checkout := c.Checkouts[i]
519			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
520				status := session.AgentStatus
521				if status == "" {
522					status = "unknown"
523				}
524				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s %s` (%s)\n",
525					checkout.Worktree.Path, c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
526				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
527					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - agents: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
528				}
529			}
530		}
531		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
532	}

534	// LinkedWorktreePaths returns the yw payload: absolute linked-worktree paths,
535	// one per line. The canonical checkout is intentionally excluded because WT
536	// counts linked worktrees only.
537	func LinkedWorktreePaths(c RepoContext) string {
538		paths := make([]string, 0, len(c.Linked()))
539		for _, checkout := range c.Linked() {
540			paths = append(paths, checkout.Worktree.Path)
541		}
542		return strings.Join(paths, "\n")
543	}

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Evaluating privacy modes**

I’m analyzing privacy modes for files. If the current target file has identical content but a different mode, there’s a conflict. If I use the "replace true" option, it will replace the existing content. Also, if the target file has a mode of 0700, it can be executable if the source file is executable as well. On the other hand, the source file's public mode is constrained based on its execute bit.
</details></think>

717	func validateSnapshot(snapshot Snapshot) error {
718		paths := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Directories)+len(snapshot.Files))
719		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
720			paths = append(paths, directory.Path)
721		}
722		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
723			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
724		}
725		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
726			return fmt.Errorf("template paths: %w", err)
727		}
728
729		types := make(map[string]string, len(paths))
730		validate := func(relative, kind string, mode fs.FileMode) error {
731			cleaned, err := validateSnapshotPath(relative)
732			if err != nil || cleaned != relative {
733				if err == nil {
734					err = errors.New("path is not a clean relative path")
735				}
736				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q: %w", kind, relative, err)
737			}
738			if mode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
739				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q has unsupported mode %s", kind, relative, mode)
740			}
741			if previous, exists := types[relative]; exists {
742				return fmt.Errorf("template path %q is declared as both %s and %s", relative, previous, kind)
743			}
744			for parent := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(relative))); parent != "."; parent = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(parent))) {
745				if types[parent] == "file" {
746					return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q is below file %q", kind, relative, parent)
747				}
748			}
749			types[relative] = kind
750			return nil
751		}
752		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
753			if err := validate(directory.Path, "directory", directory.Mode); err != nil {
754				return err
755			}
756		}
757		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
758			if err := validate(file.Path, "file", file.Mode); err != nil {
759				return err
760			}
761			prefix := file.Path + "/"
762			for existing := range types {
763				if strings.HasPrefix(existing, prefix) {
764					return fmt.Errorf("template file %q is the parent of %q", file.Path, existing)
765				}
766			}
767		}
768		return nil
769	}

114	func resolveFleetOpenRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, request fleet.OpenRequest) (repo.Repo, error) {
115		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
116		if err != nil {
117			return repo.Repo{}, err
118		}
119		var matches []repo.Repo
120		wantedIdentity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(request.RemoteIdentity)
121		for _, repository := range repositories {
122			if request.Path != "" && (sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.Path) || sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.RealPath)) {
123				return repository, nil
124			}
125			if wantedIdentity == "" {
126				continue
127			}
128			topology, topologyErr := gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
129			if topologyErr == nil && matchingSnapshotIdentity(topology, wantedIdentity) {
130				matches = append(matches, repository)
131			}
132		}
133		if len(matches) == 1 {
134			return matches[0], nil
135		}
136		if len(matches) > 1 {
137			return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("remote identity matches multiple repositories")
138		}
139		return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is no longer discoverable", request.Name)
140	}
141
142	func matchingSnapshotIdentity(topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) bool {
143		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
144			for _, raw := range append(append([]string{}, remote.FetchURLs...), remote.PushURLs...) {
145				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == identity {
146					return true
147				}
148			}
149		}
150		return false
151	}

566	func collectFleetHost(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, cachedOnly bool) fleet.HostResult {
567		endpointID := fleet.EndpointID(host)
568		cached, cachedAt, haveCache := fleet.LoadCache(host)
569		if cachedOnly {
570			if haveCache {
571				return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostStale, Snapshot: &cached, CachedAt: &cachedAt, FromCache: true, EndpointID: endpointID}
572			}
573			return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "no cached snapshot", EndpointID: endpointID}
574		}
575		transport := fleet.Transport{Err: os.Stderr}
576		result := transport.Run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_snapshot"}, nil, false)
577		if result.ExitCode == 0 {
578			var snapshot fleet.Snapshot
579			if err := json.Unmarshal(result.Stdout, &snapshot); err == nil && snapshot.SchemaVersion == fleet.SnapshotSchemaVersion {
580				_ = fleet.SaveCache(host, snapshot)
581				return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostOK, Snapshot: &snapshot, PasswordAuth: result.UsedPassword, EndpointID: endpointID}
582			}
583			return cachedFleetFailure(host, fleet.HostInvalid, "remote dev returned invalid snapshot JSON", cached, cachedAt, haveCache)
584		}
585		state := fleet.HostIncompatible
586		detail := strings.TrimSpace(string(result.Stderr))
587		switch {
588		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
589			state = fleet.HostTimeout
590		case result.ExitCode == 127:
591			state = fleet.HostNoDev
592		case result.ExitCode == 255:
593			state = fleet.HostUnreachable
594		case strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(detail), "unknown command"):
595			state = fleet.HostIncompatible
596		}
597		if detail == "" {
598			detail = fmt.Sprintf("remote command exited %d", result.ExitCode)
599		}
600		return cachedFleetFailure(host, state, detail, cached, cachedAt, haveCache)
601	}

603	func cachedFleetFailure(host fleet.Host, state fleet.HostState, detail string, cached fleet.Snapshot, cachedAt time.Time, haveCache bool) fleet.HostResult {
604		if haveCache && state != fleet.HostNoDev {

606		}
607		return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: state, Error: detail, EndpointID: fleet.EndpointID(host)}
