```text
566	func collectFleetHost(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, cachedOnly bool) fleet.HostResult {
567		endpointID := fleet.EndpointID(host)
568		cached, cachedAt, haveCache := fleet.LoadCache(host)
569		if cachedOnly {
570			if haveCache {
571				return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostStale, Snapshot: &cached, CachedAt: &cachedAt, FromCache: true, EndpointID: endpointID}
572			}
573			return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "no cached snapshot", EndpointID: endpointID}
574		}
575		transport := fleet.Transport{Err: os.Stderr}
576		result := transport.Run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_snapshot"}, nil, false)
577		if result.ExitCode == 0 {
578			var snapshot fleet.Snapshot
579			if err := json.Unmarshal(result.Stdout, &snapshot); err == nil && snapshot.SchemaVersion == fleet.SnapshotSchemaVersion {
580				_ = fleet.SaveCache(host, snapshot)
581				return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostOK, Snapshot: &snapshot, PasswordAuth: result.UsedPassword, EndpointID: endpointID}
582			}
583			return cachedFleetFailure(host, fleet.HostInvalid, "remote dev returned invalid snapshot JSON", cached, cachedAt, haveCache)
584		}
585		state := fleet.HostIncompatible
586		detail := strings.TrimSpace(string(result.Stderr))
587		switch {
588		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
589			state = fleet.HostTimeout
590		case result.ExitCode == 127:
591			state = fleet.HostNoDev
592		case result.ExitCode == 255:
593			state = fleet.HostUnreachable
594		case strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(detail), "unknown command"):
595			state = fleet.HostIncompatible
596		}
597		if detail == "" {
598			detail = fmt.Sprintf("remote command exited %d", result.ExitCode)
599		}
600		return cachedFleetFailure(host, state, detail, cached, cachedAt, haveCache)
601	}

606		}
```

```text
12	// Cache is the on-disk forge inventory. It exists for UI latency, not as a
13	// source of truth: the REMOTE tab should open instantly, and r refreshes it.
14	type Cache struct {
15		Version   int                     `json:"version,omitempty"`
16		FetchedAt time.Time               `json:"fetched_at"`
17		Complete  bool                    `json:"complete,omitempty"`
18		Providers map[Kind]ProviderStatus `json:"providers,omitempty"`
19		Repos     []RemoteRepo            `json:"repos"`
20	}
21
22	const CacheVersion = 2
23
24	type ProviderStatus struct {
25		FetchedAt time.Time `json:"fetched_at,omitempty"`
26		Complete  bool      `json:"complete"`
27		Error     string    `json:"error,omitempty"`
28	}
29
30	// LoadCache returns only a fresh, complete cache. TUI callers that can label
31	// stale rows while refreshing use LoadCacheAny instead.
32	func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool) {
33		c, ok := LoadCacheAny(path)
34		if !ok || !c.Fresh(maxAge) {
35			return Cache{}, false
36		}
37		return c, true
38	}
39
40	// LoadCacheAny returns a cache regardless of age or completeness. This powers
41	// stale-while-revalidate UI behavior; callers must inspect Fresh/Complete.
42	func LoadCacheAny(path string) (Cache, bool) {
43		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return Cache{}, false
46		}
47		var c Cache
48		if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) != nil || c.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
49			return Cache{}, false
50		}
51		if c.Version == 0 {
52			// Version 1 caches were valid snapshots but capped per provider, so they
53			// are useful for instant display and must immediately be refreshed.
54			c.Complete = false
55		}
56		return c, true
57	}
58
59	func (c Cache) Fresh(maxAge time.Duration) bool {
60		if c.Version != CacheVersion || !c.Complete {
61			return false
62		}
63		if maxAge <= 0 {
64			return true
65		}
66		if len(c.Providers) == 0 {
67			return time.Since(c.FetchedAt) <= maxAge
68		}
69		for _, provider := range c.Providers {
70			if !provider.Complete || provider.Error != "" || provider.FetchedAt.IsZero() || time.Since(provider.FetchedAt) > maxAge {
71				return false
72			}
73		}
74		return true
75	}
76
77	// SaveCache atomically replaces the cache. A partial forge response may be
78	// cached — its FetchedAt still says exactly when it was observed.
79	func SaveCache(path string, repos []RemoteRepo) error {
80		now := time.Now().UTC()
81		providers := map[Kind]ProviderStatus{}
82		for _, repo := range repos {
83			providers[repo.Forge] = ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
84		}
85		return SaveCacheState(path, Cache{Version: CacheVersion, FetchedAt: now, Complete: true, Providers: providers, Repos: repos})
86	}
87
88	// SaveCacheState atomically replaces the versioned inventory cache.
89	func SaveCacheState(path string, cache Cache) error {
90		if path == "" {
91			return errors.New("empty cache path")
92		}
93		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
94			return err
95		}
96		if cache.Version == 0 {
97			cache.Version = CacheVersion
98		}
99		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
100			cache.FetchedAt = time.Now().UTC()
101		}
102		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(cache, "", "  ")
103		if err != nil {
104			return err
105		}
106		b = append(b, '\n')
107		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".remotes-*.tmp")
108		if err != nil {
109			return err
110		}
111		name := tmp.Name()
112		defer os.Remove(name)
113		if _, err := tmp.Write(b); err != nil {
114			tmp.Close()
115			return err
116		}
117		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
118			return err
119		}
120		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o600); err != nil {
121			return err
122		}
123		return os.Rename(name, path)
124	}
125
126	// CacheExists reports whether any cache file exists, even stale. Used only for
127	// diagnostics.
128	func CacheExists(path string) bool {
129		_, err := os.Stat(path)
130		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
131	}
```

```text
247	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
248		latest := status.LatestChange
249		var commit time.Time
250		var subject string
251		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
252			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
253			if commit.After(latest) {
254				latest = commit
255			}
256			subject = lastSubject
257		}
258		return latest, commit, subject

324	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
325		if root == "" || path == "" {

329		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {

339	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
340	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
341	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
342	// is not sufficient.
343	func normalizePath(path string) string {
344		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
345		cur := clean
346		for {
347			if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
348				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
349				if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
350					return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
351				}
352				return filepath.Clean(real)
353			}
354			parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
355			if parent == cur {
356				return clean
357			}
358			cur = parent
359		}
360	}
```

```text
1	// Package task stores the small amount of state git cannot answer: which
2	// change streams exist, what state each is in, which machine owns it, and what
3	// the next action is. Everything else — branch, dirty, ahead/behind, whether a
4	// worktree exists — is derived live and deliberately not stored here.

16	// State is where a change stream sits in its lifecycle.
17	type State string
18
19	const (
20		// Hot: worktree and branch exist, a runtime session is open, actively worked on.
21		Hot State = "hot"
22		// Warm: worktree and branch kept, runtime closed. Back within days.
23		Warm State = "warm"
24		// Cold: committed and pushed, worktree removed. Reconstructible anywhere.
25		Cold State = "cold"
26		// Done: merged. Kept only until the entry is reaped.
27		Done State = "done"
28	)

30	// States lists the lifecycle in order, for help text and validation.
31	var States = []State{Hot, Warm, Cold, Done}
32
33	// ParseState validates a user-supplied state name.
34	func ParseState(s string) (State, error) {
35		got := State(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s)))
36		for _, valid := range States {
37			if got == valid {
38				return got, nil
39			}
40		}
41		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown state %q: want one of %s", s, JoinStates(", "))
42	}
43
44	// JoinStates renders the valid state names.
45	func JoinStates(sep string) string {
46		parts := make([]string, len(States))
47		for i, s := range States {
48			parts[i] = string(s)
49		}
50		return strings.Join(parts, sep)
51	}
52
53	// Icon is the glyph shown in the inventory.
54	func (s State) Icon() string {
55		switch s {
56		case Hot:
57			return "🔥"
58		case Warm:
59			return "🌤"
60		case Cold:
61			return "❄️"

96		// Branch is the change stream's identity — the one durable handle that
97		// survives every machine, worktree and runtime.
98		Branch string `toml:"branch"`
99		// Base is the ref the branch was created from, recorded so `dev done` can
100		// integrate without re-guessing.

102		// WorktreePath is the linked checkout, empty when the task works directly
103		// in the main checkout or has gone cold.

106		// checkout, or the current branch directly. Older entries infer it.
107		Mode CheckoutMode `toml:"mode"`
108
109		State State `toml:"state"`
110		// Owner is the hostname that last held this task hot. One writer per
111		// branch at a time avoids two machines diverging the same history.
112		Owner string `toml:"owner"`

132	// Revision returns a deterministic fingerprint of the task identity and every
133	// field represented by its TOML record. It is deliberately computed rather
134	// than persisted: older dev binaries can continue to read and rewrite task
135	// files without erasing a revision field they do not know about.
136	func (t Task) Revision() string {
137		hash := sha256.New()
138		writeString := func(value string) {
139			var length [8]byte
140			binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(value)))
141			_, _ = hash.Write(length[:])
142			_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(value))
143		}
144		writeTime := func(value time.Time) {
145			writeString(value.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano))
146		}
147
148		writeString("dev-task-revision-v1")
149		writeString(t.ID)
150		writeString(t.Name)
151		writeString(t.Repo)
152		writeString(t.RepoPath)
153		writeString(t.Branch)
154		writeString(t.Base)
155		writeString(t.WorktreePath)
156		writeString(string(t.Mode))
157		writeString(string(t.State))
158		writeString(t.Owner)
159		writeString(t.Next)
160		writeString(t.Note)
161		writeString(fmt.Sprint(len(t.Tags)))
162		for _, tag := range t.Tags {
163			writeString(tag)
164		}
165		writeString(t.AgentSession)
166		writeString(t.RuntimeHandle)
167		writeString(t.RuntimeName)
168		writeTime(t.Created)
169		writeTime(t.Updated)
170
171		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
172	}
```

The context report has a concrete credential leak: its custom SCP parser only strips usernames when the first colon is after `@`, so a remote such as `oauth2:secret@example.com:group/repo.git` is normalized into a public identity containing `secret`. The readiness projection also examines only tasks attached to the selected checkout, omitting repository-level COLD/other-branch tasks that the transfer scope explicitly includes.

```text
17	func newStatusCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
18		return &cobra.Command{
19			Use:   "status",
20			Short: "Show the full context of the current directory",
21			Long: `Answer "where am I and what is this?" for the current directory: which repo
22	and checkout, which branch and how it stands against upstream, which task it
23	belongs to, whether a runtime session is hosting it, and which recognized Herdr
24	agents occupy this canonical Git worktree.`,
25			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
26			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
27				ctx := ctxOf()
28				style := app.outStyle()
29				field := func(label, value string) {
30					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s%s\n", style.label(fmt.Sprintf("%-11s", label)), value)
31				}
32				cwd, err := os.Getwd()
33				if err != nil {
34					return err
35				}
36
37				g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
38				if err != nil {
39					field("directory", config.Contract(cwd))
40					field("repo", style.warning("— not a git repository"))
41					return nil
42				}
43
44				selectedPath := g.Root
45				if selectedPath == "" {
46					selectedPath = g.MainRoot
47				}
48				local := collectLocalRepoContext(ctx, app, repo.Repo{
49					Name: g.Name, Path: g.MainRoot, RealPath: g.MainRoot,
50					GitDir: g.GitCommonDir, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir,
51					MainRoot: g.MainRoot, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
52				}, selectedPath, false)
53
54				kind := "main checkout"
55				if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
56					kind = "linked worktree"
57				}
58				field("repo", fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s)", g.Name, kind))
59				field("checkout", config.Contract(selectedPath))
60				if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
61					field("main", config.Contract(g.MainRoot))
62				}
63
64				var selected *inventory.RepoCheckout
65				if local.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && local.SelectedCheckout < len(local.Context.Checkouts) {
66					selected = &local.Context.Checkouts[local.SelectedCheckout]
67				}
68				if selected == nil {
69					field("branch", style.warning("— checkout unavailable"))
70				} else if g.Bare {
71					field("branch", "(bare repository)")
72				} else if selected.StatusErr != nil {
73					field("branch", style.warning("— Git status unavailable"))
74					app.warnf("could not inspect checkout status: %v", selected.StatusErr)
75				} else {
76					st := selected.Status
77					branch := st.Branch
78					if st.Detached {
79						branch = "(detached HEAD)"
80					}
81					field("branch", fmt.Sprintf("%s  %s", branch, style.git(st.Summary())))
82					if st.Dirty() {
83						field("changes", style.warning(st.Breakdown()))
84						if types := st.TypeBreakdown(); types != "" {
85							field("types", style.warning(types))
86						}
87					}
88					if st.Upstream != "" {
89						field("upstream", st.Upstream)
90					} else {
91						field("upstream", style.warning("— not published"))
92					}
93					if st.Conflicted > 0 {
94						field("conflicts", style.danger(fmt.Sprintf("%d unmerged path(s) — resolve before anything else", st.Conflicted)))
95					}
96				}
97				field("readiness", repocontext.AssessLocal(local.Context, local.SelectedCheckout, config.Hostname()).Summary())
98				if base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, g.MainRoot); base != "" {
99					field("default", base)
100				}
101				if k := forge.Detect(ctx, g.MainRoot); k != forge.Unknown {
102					field("forge", fmt.Sprint(k))
103				}
104
105				if local.Context.WorktreeErr == nil && len(local.Context.Checkouts) > 1 {
106					field("worktrees", fmt.Sprint(len(local.Context.Checkouts)))
107					for index, checkout := range local.Context.Checkouts {
108						marker := "  "
109						if index == local.SelectedCheckout {
110							marker = "→ "
111						}
112						name := checkout.Branch()
113						if name == "" {
114							name = "(detached)"
115						}
116						fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s%-28s %s\n", marker, name, config.Contract(checkout.Worktree.Path))
117					}
118				} else if local.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
119					app.warnf("could not inspect linked worktrees: %v", local.Context.WorktreeErr)
120				}
121
122				rt := app.Runtime()
123				if _, ok := rt.(runtime.AgentActivityLister); ok {
124					activities, err := checkoutAgentActivities(ctx, rt, selectedPath, "")
125					if err != nil {
126						app.warnf("could not inspect live agent activity: %v", err)
127					} else if len(activities) == 0 {
128						field("activities", style.dim("— none"))
129					} else {
130						for _, activity := range activities {
131							name := activity.Name
132							if name == "" {
133								name = activity.Agent
134							}
135							field("activity", style.success(fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s %s (%s)",
136								name, activity.Status, activity.PaneID, activity.WorkspaceID)))
137						}
138					}
139				}
140
141				if local.Context.TaskErr != nil {
142					field("task", style.warning("— task inventory unavailable"))
143					app.warnf("could not inspect tracked tasks: %v", local.Context.TaskErr)
144					return nil
145				}
146				if selected == nil || len(selected.Tasks) == 0 {
147					field("task", style.warning("— not tracked; `dev start` to record it"))
148					return nil
149				}
150				t := selected.Tasks[0]
151				field("task", fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (%s)", style.taskStateFor(t.State.Label(), t.State.Icon()), t.Title(), t.ID))
152				field("owner", dash(t.Owner))
153				field("next", dash(t.Next))
154				if t.Note != "" {
155					field("note", t.Note)
156				}
157				if t.AgentSession != "" {
158					field("agent", style.success(t.AgentSession))
159				}
160				if host := config.Hostname(); !t.OwnedBy(host) {
161					app.warnf("this task is owned by %s — pushing from here can diverge the branch", t.Owner)
162				}
163				return nil
164			},
165		}
166	}
```

```text
31		remotesPath := filepath.Join(root, "remotes.toml")

33			t.Fatal(err)
34		}
35
36		marker := filepath.Join(root, "ssh-was-run")
37		if goruntime.GOOS != "windows" {
38			bin := filepath.Join(root, "bin")
39			if err := os.MkdirAll(bin, 0o755); err != nil {
40				t.Fatal(err)
41			}
42			ssh := filepath.Join(bin, "ssh")
43			if err := os.WriteFile(ssh, []byte("#!/bin/sh\nprintf called > "+marker+"\nexit 99\n"), 0o755); err != nil {
44				t.Fatal(err)
45			}
46			t.Setenv("PATH", bin+string(os.PathListSeparator)+os.Getenv("PATH"))
47		}
48
49		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
50		runtimeErr := context.DeadlineExceeded
51		app := &App{

62			t.Fatalf("default repo context invoked ssh; marker error = %v", err)
```

```text
1	package tui

3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"path/filepath"

9		"github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss"

15	)
16
17	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
18	// render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
19	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
20	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
21	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
22		// Header + its blank line, table header, blank before detail, blank before
23		// footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and terminal width.
24		fixed := 2 + 1 + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
25		h := m.height - fixed
26		if h < 3 {
27			return 3
28		}
29		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
30		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
31			h--
32		}
33		return h
34	}
35
36	func lineCount(s string) int {
37		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\n")
38		if s == "" {
39			return 0
40		}
41		return strings.Count(s, "\n") + 1
42	}
43
44	// View implements tea.Model.
45	func (m Model) View() string {
46		if m.quitting {
47			return ""
48		}
49		if m.noteMode() {
50			return m.renderNotes()
51		}
52		if m.overlay.kind != overlayNone {
53			return m.renderOverlay()
54		}
55		if m.mode == modeStats {
56			return m.renderStats()
57		}
58		var b strings.Builder
59		b.WriteString(m.renderHeader())
60		b.WriteString("\n")
61
62		switch m.view {
63		case ViewRepos:
64			b.WriteString(m.renderRepos())
65		case ViewFleet:
66			b.WriteString(m.renderFleet())
67		case ViewTries:
68			b.WriteString(m.renderTries())
69		case ViewRemote:
70			b.WriteString(m.renderRemotes())
71		case ViewSkills:
72			b.WriteString(m.renderSkills())
73		default:
74			b.WriteString(m.renderTasks())
75		}
76
77		b.WriteString("\n")
78		b.WriteString(m.renderDetail())
79		b.WriteString("\n")
80		b.WriteString(m.renderFooter())
81		return b.String()
82	}
83
84	func (m Model) renderStats() string {
85		var b strings.Builder
86		title := "repo activity"
87		if m.stats != nil && m.stats.Repo != "" {
88			title = m.stats.Repo + " activity"
89		}
90		b.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev  HEATMAP  "+title) + "\n\n")
91		if m.err != nil {
92			b.WriteString("  " + styleErr.Render("✗ "+m.err.Error()) + "\n")
93		} else if m.stats == nil {
94			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Loading activity…") + "\n")
95		} else if m.stats.Seconds == 0 {
96			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("No activity recorded for this repository.\n"))
97			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Press b to backfill only this repo from Git history.\n"))
98		} else {
99			b.WriteString(m.stats.Heatmap)
100			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n  %s   %d active days   %s → %s\n",
101				styleOK.Render(humanSeconds(m.stats.Seconds)), m.stats.ActiveDays,
102				m.stats.Since.Format("2006-01-02"), m.stats.Until.Format("2006-01-02"))
103		}
104		b.WriteString("\n  " + styleHelp.Render("b backfill this repo · r reread stats · H / esc back · q quit"))
105		return b.String()
106	}
107
108	func humanSeconds(seconds int) string {
109		d := time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second
110		if d < time.Hour {
111			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
112		}
113		return fmt.Sprintf("%dh %dm", int(d.Hours()), int(d.Minutes())%60)
114	}
115
116	// renderHeader shows the tab strip, so which list is showing — and that there
117	// is another one — is never in doubt.
118	func (m Model) renderHeader() string {
119		var tabs []string
120		for _, v := range Views {
121			label := " " + strings.ToUpper(v.String()) + " "
122			if v == m.view {
123				tabs = append(tabs, styleSelected.Render(label))
124			} else {
125				tabs = append(tabs, styleDim.Render(label))
126			}
127		}
128		line := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  " + strings.Join(tabs, styleDim.Render("│")) +
129			"   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary())
130		if m.filter != "" {
131			line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter)
132		}
133		return line + "\n"
134	}
135
136	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
137	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
138	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
139		h := m.listHeight()
140		if n <= h {
141			return 0, n
142		}
143		from = m.at() - h/2
144		if from < 0 {
145			from = 0
146		}
147		if from+h > n {
148			from = n - h
149		}
150		return from, from + h
151	}

153	func (m Model) renderTasks() string {
154		rows := m.visibleTasks()
155		if len(rows) == 0 {
156			return m.emptyTasks()
157		}
158		nameW, branchW, nextW := m.columnWidths()
159
160		var b strings.Builder
161		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s  %-6s  %-*s  %-16s  %-5s  %s",
162			nameW, "TASK", "STATE", branchW, "BRANCH", "GIT", "AGE", "NEXT")) + "\n")
163
164		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
165		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
166			r := rows[i]
167			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-*s  %-6s  %-*s  %-16s  %-5s  %s",
168				nameW, pad(r.Task.Title(), nameW),
169				r.Task.State.Label(),
170				branchW, pad(r.Task.Branch, branchW),
171				pad(gitColumn(r), 16),
172				pad(shortAge(r), 5),
173				pad(nextColumn(r), nextW),
174			)
175			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, colourState(r.Task.State, line)))
176		}
177		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
178		return b.String()
179	}

181	func (m Model) renderRepos() string {
182		items := m.visibleRepoItems()
183		if len(items) == 0 {
184			if m.loadingLocal {
185				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading local repositories…") + "\n"
186			}
187			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No repositories found. Check paths.scan_roots in your config,"+
188				" or run `dev config init`.\n")
189		}
190		columns := m.repoColumns()
191
192		var b strings.Builder
193		var headers []string
194		for _, c := range columns {
195			headers = append(headers, fitCell(c.header, c.width))
196		}
197		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
198
199		from, to := m.window(len(items))
200		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
201			item := items[i]
202			r := item.Repo
203			cells := make([]string, 0, len(columns))
204			for _, c := range columns {
205				cells = append(cells, fitCell(m.repoItemColumnValue(item, c.name), c.width))
206			}
207			line := strings.Join(cells, "  ")
208			styled := line
209			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
210				if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
211					styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
212				} else if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal ||
213					checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
214					styled = styleDim.Render(line)
215				}
216			} else if r.Status.Dirty() {
217				styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
218			} else if len(r.Tasks) == 0 && !r.Live {
219				styled = styleClean.Render(line)
220			}
221			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
222		}
223		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(items), from, to))
224		return b.String()
225	}

227	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
228		r := item.Repo
229		checkout, child := item.checkout()
230		if !child {
231			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
232				marker := "▸ "
233				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
234					marker = "▾ "
235				}
236				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
237			}
238			if name == "live" {
239				return parentLiveColumn(r)
240			}
241			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
242		}
243
244		switch name {
245		case "repo":
246			connector := "├─ "
247			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
248				connector = "└─ "
249			}
250			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
251			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
252				label = checkout.Branch()
253			}
254			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
255				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
256			}
257			return connector + label
258		case "branch":
259			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
260				return branch
261			}
262			return "(detached)"
263		case "git":
264			switch {
265			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
266				return "prunable"
267			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
268				return "locked"
269			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
270				return "?"
271			default:
272				return checkout.Status.Summary()
273			}
274		case "live":
275			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout)
276		case "latest":
277			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
278		case "worktrees":
279			return "—"
280		case "tasks":
281			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
282		case "notes":
283			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
284				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
285			}
286			return "—"
287		case "category":
288			return "—"
289		case "path":
290			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
291		}
292		return ""
293	}

295	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
296		sessions := r.Sessions()
297		if len(sessions) == 0 {
298			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
299		}
300		if len(sessions) > 1 {
301			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
302		}
303		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
304		if status != "" {
305			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
306		}
307		return r.Runtime
308	}

310	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) string {
311		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
312			return "closed"
313		}
314		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
315			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
316		}
317		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
318			return runtimeName + ":" + status
319		}
320		return runtimeName
321	}

323	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
324		if len(tasks) == 0 {
325			return "—"
326		}
327		counts := map[task.State]int{}
328		for _, t := range tasks {
329			counts[t.State]++
330		}
331		var parts []string
332		for _, state := range task.States {
333			if counts[state] > 0 {
334				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
335			}
336		}
337		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
338	}

340	type repoColumnSpec struct {
341		name, header string
342		width, min   int
343	}
344
345	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
346		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
347		if len(names) == 0 {
348			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
349		}
350		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
351			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
352			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
353			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
354			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
355			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
356			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
357			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
358			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
359			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
360			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
361			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
362			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
363		}
364		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
365		for _, name := range names {
366			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
367				columns = append(columns, c)
368			}
369		}
370		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
371		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
372		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
373		for _, c := range columns {
374			total += c.width
375		}
376		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
377			for i := range columns {
378				if columns[i].name != preferred {
379					continue
380				}
381				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
382				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
383				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
384				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
385					columns[i].width--
386					total--
387				}
388			}
389			if total <= m.width {
390				break
391			}
392		}
393		return columns
394	}
395
396	func repoColumnValue(r RepoRow, name string) string {
397		switch name {
398		case "repo":
399			return r.Repo.Display()
400		case "branch":
401			if r.Repo.Bare {
402				return "(bare)"
403			}
404			return r.Status.Branch
405		case "git":
406			if r.Repo.Bare {
407				return "—"
408			}
409			return r.Status.Summary()
410		case "remote":
411			if r.TopologyErr != nil {
412				return "?"
413			}
414			return r.Topology.Summary()
415		case "size":
416			return sizeCell(r.Usage, r.SizeError, r.SizeTarget)
417		case "live":
418			if !r.Live {
419				return "—"
420			}
421			if r.RuntimeStatus != "" {
422				return r.Runtime + ":" + r.RuntimeStatus
423			}
424			return r.Runtime
425		case "latest":
426			return latestAge(r.LastActivity)
427		case "worktrees":
428			if r.Worktrees > 0 {
429				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.Worktrees)
430			}
431			return "—"
432		case "tasks":
433			if tasks := r.StateSummary(); tasks != "" {
434				return tasks
435			}
436			return "—"
437		case "notes":
438			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
439				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
440			}
441			return "—"
442		case "category":
443			if r.Repo.Category != "" {
444				return r.Repo.Category
445			}
446			return "—"
447		case "path":
448			return contract(r.Repo.Path)
449		}
450		return ""
451	}
452
453	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
454		if at.IsZero() {
455			return "—"
456		}
457		d := time.Since(at)
458		switch {
459		case d < time.Hour:
460			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
461		case d < 24*time.Hour:
462			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
463		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
464			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
465		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
466			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
467		default:
468			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
469		}
470	}

472	func fitCell(s string, width int) string {
473		s = pad(s, width)
474		if n := lipgloss.Width(s); n < width {
475			s += strings.Repeat(" ", width-n)
476		}
477		return s
478	}

480	func (m Model) renderRemotes() string {
481		if m.remotesLoading && len(m.remotes) == 0 {
482			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading repositories from forge CLIs…") + "\n"
483		}
484		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
485		if len(rows) == 0 {
486			if !m.remotesLoaded {
487				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Remote repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
488			}
489			if m.filter != "" {
490				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repository matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
491			}
492			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repositories returned. Check forge authentication and `dev doctor`.") + "\n"
493		}
494		nameW := clamp(m.width*30/100, 18, 38)
495		descW := m.width - nameW - 38
496		if descW < 12 {
497			descW = 12
498		}
499
500		var b strings.Builder
501		if m.remotesLoading {
502			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Showing cached repositories while refreshing…") + "\n")
503		}
504		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
505			"FORGE", nameW, "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "UPDATED", "LOCAL", "DESCRIPTION")) + "\n")
506		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
507		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
508			r := rows[i]
509			local := "—"
510			if r.Cloned() {
511				local = "yes"
512				if r.LocalKind != "" {
513					local = string(r.LocalKind)
514					if r.LocalKind == "repository" {
515						local = "repo"
516					}
517				}
518			}
519			vis := strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility)
520			if vis == "" {
521				vis = "—"
522			}
523			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
524				r.Repo.Forge, nameW, pad(r.Repo.FullName, nameW),
525				pad(vis, 9), pad(remoteAge(r), 12), pad(local, 7), pad(r.Repo.Description, descW))
526			styled := line
527			if r.Cloned() {
528				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
529			} else if r.Repo.Archived {
530				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
531			}
532			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
533		}
534		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
535		return b.String()
536	}
537
538	func (m Model) renderFleet() string {
539		rows := m.visibleFleet()
540		if len(rows) == 0 {
541			if m.fleetLoading {
542				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading configured dev hosts…") + "\n"
543			}
544			if !m.fleetLoaded {
545				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Fleet repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
546			}
547			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No fleet row matches the current filter.") + "\n"
548		}
549		hostW := clamp(m.width*14/100, 10, 22)
550		repoW := clamp(m.width*24/100, 16, 34)
551		pathW := m.width - hostW - repoW - 58
552		if pathW < 12 {
553			pathW = 12
554		}
555		var b strings.Builder
556		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
557			hostW, "HOST", "STATE", repoW, "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "PATH")) + "\n")
558		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
559		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
560			row := rows[i]
561			repoName, branch, git, live, tasks, path := "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", row.Error
562			if row.Repository != nil {
563				repoName, branch, git, path = row.Repository.Display, row.Repository.Branch, row.Repository.Status.Summary(), contract(row.Repository.Path)
564				if row.Repository.Live {
565					live = row.Repository.Runtime
566					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
567						live += ":" + row.Repository.AgentStatus
568					}
569				}
570				tasks = fleetTasks(row.Repository.Tasks.Hot, row.Repository.Tasks.Warm, row.Repository.Tasks.Cold, row.Repository.Tasks.Done)
571			}
572			state := string(row.State)
573			if row.FromCache {
574				state = "stale"
575			}
576			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
577				hostW, pad(row.Host, hostW), pad(state, 8), repoW, pad(repoName, repoW), pad(branch, 18),
578				pad(git, 14), pad(live, 10), pad(tasks, 8), pad(path, pathW))
579			styled := line
580			if row.Repository != nil && row.Repository.Live {
581				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
582			} else if row.State != "ok" {
583				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
584			}
585			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
586		}
587		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
588		return b.String()
589	}
590	func (m Model) renderSkills() string {
591		if m.skillsLoading {
592			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading local agent skills…") + "\n"
593		}
594		if m.skillsChecking {
595			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Checking skill sources…") + "\n"
596		}
597		rows := m.visibleSkills()
598		if len(rows) == 0 {
599			if !m.skillsLoaded {
600				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Agent skills load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
601			}
602			if m.filter != "" {
603				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skill matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
604			}
605			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skills found. Press a to open the installer.") + "\n"
606		}
607		skillW := clamp(m.width*24/100, 14, 30)
608		agentW := clamp(m.width*25/100, 16, 34)
609		showSource := m.width >= 76
610		sourceW := m.width - skillW - agentW - 35
611		if sourceW < 12 {
612			sourceW = 12
613		}
614
615		var b strings.Builder
616		if showSource {
617			b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-10s  %-*s  %s",
618				"SCOPE", skillW, "SKILL", "UPDATE", agentW, "AGENTS", "SOURCE")) + "\n")
619		} else {
620			b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-10s  %s",
621				"SCOPE", skillW, "SKILL", "UPDATE", "AGENTS")) + "\n")
622		}
623		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
624		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
625			row := rows[i]
626			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-7s  %-*s  %-10s  %s",
627				row.Scope, skillW, pad(row.Name, skillW), skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus),
628				pad(skillAgentSummary(row.Agents), agentW))
629			if showSource {
630				line += "  " + pad(skillSource(row), sourceW)
631			}
632			styled := line
633			switch row.UpdateStatus {
634			case agentskill.UpdateAvailable, agentskill.UpdateMissing, agentskill.UpdateFailed:
635				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
636			case agentskill.UpdateCurrent:
637				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
638			case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
639				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
640			}
641			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
642		}
643		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
644		return b.String()
645	}

647	func fleetTasks(hot, warm, cold, done int) string {
648		var parts []string
649		for _, item := range []struct {
650			label string
651			n     int
652		}{{"H", hot}, {"W", warm}, {"C", cold}, {"D", done}} {
653			if item.n > 0 {
654				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", item.label, item.n))
655			}
656		}
657		if len(parts) == 0 {
658			return "—"
659		}
660		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
661	}
662
663	func skillUpdateLabel(status agentskill.UpdateStatus) string {
664		switch status {
665		case agentskill.UpdateAvailable:
666			return "update"
667		case agentskill.UpdateMissing:
668			return "missing"
669		case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
670			return "unknown"
671		case agentskill.UpdateFailed:
672			return "failed"
673		default:
674			return string(status)
675		}
676	}
677
678	func skillAgentSummary(agents []string) string {
679		if len(agents) == 0 {
680			return "—"
681		}
682		if len(agents) <= 3 {
683			return strings.Join(agents, ", ")
684		}
685		return strings.Join(agents[:3], ", ") + fmt.Sprintf(" +%d", len(agents)-3)
686	}
687
688	func skillSource(row agentskill.Skill) string {
689		if row.Source != "" {
690			return row.Source
691		}
692		return string(row.ManagedBy)
693	}
694
695	func remoteAge(r RemoteRow) string {
696		if r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
697			return "—"
698		}
699		d := time.Since(r.Repo.UpdatedAt)
700		switch {
701		case d < 24*time.Hour:
702			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh ago", int(d.Hours()))
703		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
704			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd ago", int(d.Hours()/24))
705		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
706			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw ago", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
707		default:
708			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo ago", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
709		}
710	}

715			return styleSelected.Render("▸ ") + styleSelected.Render(plain) + "\n"
716		}
717		return "  " + styled + "\n"

739	func (m Model) columnWidths() (name, branch, next int) {
740		const fixed = 2 + 6 + 16 + 5 + 10
741		avail := m.width - fixed
742		if avail < 40 {
743			avail = 40
744		}
745		name = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
746		branch = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
747		next = avail - name - branch
748		if next < 10 {
749			next = 10
750		}
751		return name, branch, next
752	}

754	// renderDetail shows what does not fit in the table — the reason to have a
755	// dashboard rather than a listing.
756	func (m Model) renderDetail() string {
757		switch m.mode {
758		case modeFilter:
759			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("filter ") + m.input.View() +
760				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to keep it · esc to clear")
761		case modeEditNext:
762			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("next action ") + m.input.View() +
763				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to save · esc to cancel")
764		case modeConfirmPark:
765			row, _ := m.currentTask()
766			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("park "+row.Task.Title()) +
767				"\n  next: " + m.input.View() +
768				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to park (session closes, worktree stays) · esc to cancel")
769		case modeStartTask:
770			r, _ := m.currentRepo()
771			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("start work in "+r.Repo.Name) +
772				"\n  name: " + m.input.View() +
773				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to create the branch, worktree and session · esc to cancel")
774		case modeStartDirect:
775			r, _ := m.currentRepo()
776			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("track direct work in "+r.Repo.Name) +
777				"\n  name: " + m.input.View() +
778				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to track the current branch; no branch/worktree is created · esc to cancel")
779		case modeConfirmClone:
780			r, _ := m.currentRemote()
781			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("clone "+r.Repo.FullName) +
782				"\n  to: " + contract(filepath.Join("<project_root>", r.Repo.Name)) +
783				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to clone into project_root · esc to cancel")
784		case modeConfirmSkillUpdate:
785			row, _ := m.currentSkill()
786			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("update "+string(row.Scope)+" skill "+row.Name) +
787				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to update this skill · esc to cancel")
788		case modeCopy:
789			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("copy ") +
790				"y context · p path · b branch · s sessions · w worktree paths" +
791				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("press a second key · esc to cancel")
792		}
793
794		if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok {
795			lines := []string{
796				fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("host"), row.Host),
797				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("state"), row.State),
798			}
799			if row.Repository != nil {
800				lines = append(lines,
801					fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("path"), contract(row.Repository.Path)),
802					fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("branch"), row.Repository.Branch),
803					fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("git  "), row.Repository.Status.Breakdown()),
804				)
805				if len(row.Repository.RemoteIdentities) > 0 {
806					lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("remote"), strings.Join(row.Repository.RemoteIdentities, ", ")))
807				}
808				if row.Repository.Live {
809					live := strings.TrimSpace(row.Repository.Runtime + " " + row.Repository.RuntimeHandle)
810					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
811						live += " · " + row.Repository.AgentStatus
812					}
813					lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("live"), styleLive.Render(live)))
814				}
815			}
816			if row.Error != "" {
817				lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("note "), styleDrift.Render(row.Error)))
818			}
819			return strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n"
820		}
821		if row, ok := m.currentSkill(); ok {
822			lines := []string{
823				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("scope  "), row.Scope),
824				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("root   "), contract(row.ScopeRoot)),
825				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("path   "), contract(row.Path)),
826				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("managed"), row.ManagedBy),
827				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("agents "), strings.Join(row.Agents, ", ")),
828				fmt.Sprintf("  %s %s", styleDim.Render("update "), row.UpdateStatus),

1155	// wrapBindings lays the key hints out over as many lines as the width needs,
1156	// rather than truncating them — a hint you cannot read is not a hint.
1157	func wrapBindings(items []string, width int) string {
1158		if width < 20 {
1159			width = 20
1160		}
1161		var lines []string
1162		cur := ""
1163		for _, it := range items {
1164			candidate := it
1165			if cur != "" {
1166				candidate = cur + " · " + it
1167			}
1168			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > width && cur != "" {
1169				lines = append(lines, cur)
1170				cur = it
1171				continue
1172			}
1173			cur = candidate
1174		}
1175		if cur != "" {
1176			lines = append(lines, cur)
1177		}
1178		return strings.Join(lines, "\n  ")
1179	}

1198	func shortAge(r inventory.Row) string {

1203		case d.Hours() < 24:
1204			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
1205		case d.Hours() < 24*14:

1207		case d.Hours() < 24*60:

1228	// pad truncates to n display columns, measuring the way lipgloss renders so
1229	// CJK repo and task names do not shift the table.
1230	func pad(s string, n int) string {
1231		if lipgloss.Width(s) <= n {
1232			return s
1233		}
1234		var b strings.Builder
1235		used := 0
1236		for _, r := range s {
1237			w := lipgloss.Width(string(r))
1238			if used+w > n-1 {
1239				break
1240			}
1241			b.WriteRune(r)
1242			used += w
1243		}
1244		return b.String() + "…"
1245	}
1246
1247	func clamp(v, lo, hi int) int {
1248		if v < lo {
1249			return lo
1250		}
1251		if v > hi {
1252			return hi
1253		}
1254		return v
1255	}
```

```text
1	// Package note stores timestamped repository thoughts as ordinary Markdown
2	// files. SQLite indexes them for search, but the files are the durable source
3	// of truth: readable without dev, syncable without database merge conflicts,
4	// and recoverable after every cache is deleted.
5	package note
6
7	import (
8		"crypto/sha256"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"strings"
12		"time"
13
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
15	)
16
17	const CurrentSchemaVersion = 1
18
19	var (
20		ErrNotFound   = errors.New("note not found")
21		ErrConflict   = errors.New("note changed since it was opened")
22		ErrInvalid    = errors.New("invalid note")
23		ErrRepository = errors.New("invalid note repository")
24	)
25
26	// ImportConflictError describes a transported note ID already bound to
27	// different durable content. Revisions identify the conflict without exposing
28	// the private note body.
29	type ImportConflictError struct {
30		ID               string
31		ExistingRevision string
32		ImportedRevision string
33		Reason           string
34	}
35
36	func (e *ImportConflictError) Error() string {
37		reason := e.Reason
38		if reason == "" {
39			reason = "same ID has different durable content"
40		}
41		return fmt.Sprintf("note %s import conflict: %s: %v", e.ID, reason, ErrConflict)
42	}
43
44	func (e *ImportConflictError) Unwrap() error { return ErrConflict }
45
46	// Note is one timestamped thought attached to a stable catalog asset ID.
47	type Note struct {
48		SchemaVersion int       `toml:"schema_version" json:"schema_version"`
49		ID            string    `toml:"id" json:"id"`
50		RepositoryID  string    `toml:"repository_id" json:"repository_id"`
51		Repository    string    `toml:"repository" json:"repository"`
52		Created       time.Time `toml:"created" json:"created"`
53		Updated       time.Time `toml:"updated" json:"updated"`
54		Tags          []string  `toml:"tags" json:"tags"`
55
56		Body string `toml:"-" json:"body"`
57		Path string `toml:"-" json:"path,omitempty"`
58	}
59
60	func (n *Note) Normalize() {
61		if n == nil {
62			return
63		}
64		n.Repository = strings.TrimSpace(n.Repository)
65		n.Body = normalizeBody(n.Body)
66		n.Tags = catalog.NormalizeTags(n.Tags)
67	}
68
69	func (n Note) Validate() error {
70		if n.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
71			return fmt.Errorf("note %s schema version %d: %w", n.ID, n.SchemaVersion, ErrInvalid)
72		}
73		if err := catalog.ValidateID(n.ID); err != nil {
74			return fmt.Errorf("note ID: %w", err)
75		}
76		if err := catalog.ValidateID(n.RepositoryID); err != nil {
77			return fmt.Errorf("repository ID: %w: %w", err, ErrRepository)
78		}
79		if strings.TrimSpace(n.Repository) == "" {
80			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: repository name is required: %w", n.ID, ErrRepository)
81		}
82		if strings.TrimSpace(n.Body) == "" {
83			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: body is empty: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
84		}
85		if n.Created.IsZero() || n.Updated.IsZero() {
86			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: created and updated are required: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
87		}
88		if n.Updated.Before(n.Created) {
89			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: updated precedes created: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
90		}
91		return nil
92	}
93
94	// Revision fingerprints every field an editor is allowed to preserve or
95	// replace. Update compares it while holding the mutation lock, preventing a
96	// stale editor session from silently overwriting another process's changes.
97	func (n Note) Revision() string {
98		payload := strings.Join([]string{
99			n.ID, n.RepositoryID, n.Repository,
100			n.Created.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
101			n.Updated.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
102			strings.Join(n.Tags, "\x00"), n.Body,
103		}, "\x00")
104		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(payload)))
105	}
106
107	// Preview returns the first non-empty body line, collapsed and truncated.
108	func (n Note) Preview(limit int) string {
109		line := ""
110		for _, candidate := range strings.Split(n.Body, "\n") {
111			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate) != "" {
112				line = strings.Join(strings.Fields(candidate), " ")
113				break
114			}
115		}
116		if limit <= 0 || len([]rune(line)) <= limit {
117			return line
118		}
119		runes := []rune(line)
120		return string(runes[:limit-1]) + "…"
121	}
122
123	func normalizeBody(body string) string {
124		body = strings.ReplaceAll(body, "\r\n", "\n")
125		body = strings.TrimSpace(body)
126		if body == "" {
127			return ""
128		}
129		return body + "\n"
130	}
131
```

```text
1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"

22	var (
23		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
24		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
25		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
26		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
27		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
28		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
29		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
30		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
31		// ErrNotPortable reports a relative path that cannot be represented safely
32		// and with the same meaning on supported Unix and Windows filesystems.
33		ErrNotPortable = errors.New("path is not portable")
34		// ErrPathCollision reports distinct spellings that identify the same path on
35		// a case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystem.
36		ErrPathCollision = errors.New("portable path collision")
37		// ErrPathLimit reports a portable path that exceeds an explicit policy limit.
38		ErrPathLimit = errors.New("portable path limit exceeded")
39	)

41	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
42	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
43	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
44	// before creating or moving anything into it.
45	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
46		if path == "" {
47			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
48		}
49		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
50		if err != nil {
51			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
52		}
53		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
54
55		probe := absolute
56		var missing []string
57		for {
58			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
59			if err == nil {
60				slices.Reverse(missing)
61				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
62				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
63			}
64			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
65				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
66			}
67			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
68			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
69			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
70			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
71			// still-missing suffix.
72			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
73				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
74				if readErr != nil {
75					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
76				}
77				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
78					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
79				}
80				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
81					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
82				}
83				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
84				if resolveErr != nil {
85					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
86				}
87				slices.Reverse(missing)
88				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
89				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
90			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
91				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
92			}
93			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
94			if parent == probe {
95				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
96			}
97			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
98			probe = parent
99		}
100	}
101
102	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
103	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
104	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
105	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
106		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
107			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
108		}
109		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
110		if err != nil {
111			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
112		}
113		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
114		if err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
116		}
117
118		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
119		if err != nil {
120			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
121			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
122			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
123			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
124		}
125		switch {
126		case rel == ".":
127			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
128		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
129			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
130		default:
131			return canonicalCandidate, nil
132		}
133	}
134
135	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
136	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
137	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
138		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
139		if err == nil {
140			return true, nil
141		}
142		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
143			return false, nil
144		}
145		return false, err
146	}
147
148	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
149	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
150		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
151		if err != nil {
152			return false, err
153		}
154		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
155		if err != nil {
156			return false, err
157		}
158		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
159			return true, nil
160		}
161		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
162	}
163
164	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
165	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
166	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
167	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
168		switch {
169		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
170			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
171		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
172			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
173		case component == "." || component == "..":
174			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
175		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
176			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
177		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
178			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
179		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
180			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
181		default:
182			return nil
183		}
184	}
```

```text
151					return forgeEndpoint{}, false

154			case "ssh":

156					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
157				}
158				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
159					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
160				}
161				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: host, segments: segments}, true
162			default:
163				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
164			}
165		}

167		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')

170		}
171		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')

207	func decodeURLPath(path string) ([]string, bool) {
208		path = strings.Trim(path, "/")

221				return nil, false
222			}
223			segments = append(segments, decoded)
224		}
225		return segments, true
226	}

271				return true

279			}
280			current = decoded

283		// ambiguous across clients with different decode counts.
284		return true
285	}

394	func validWebHost(host string) bool {

397		}
398		for _, r := range host {
399			if r > unicode.MaxASCII || !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' || r == '-' || r == '.') {
400				return false
401			}
402		}
403		for _, label := range strings.Split(host, ".") {
404			if label == "" || strings.HasPrefix(label, "-") || strings.HasSuffix(label, "-") {

406			}
407		}
```

```text
 func parseAzureDevOpsRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
    var raw []struct {
        Name          string `json:"name"`
        DefaultBranch string `json:"defaultBranch"`
        IsFork        bool   `json:"isFork"`
        RemoteURL     string `json:"remoteUrl"`
        SSHURL        string `json:"sshUrl"`
        Project       struct {

            Visibility string `json:"visibility"`
        } `json:"project"`

    if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode az repos list: %w", err)
    }
    repos := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
    for _, item := range raw {
        identity, webURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(item.RemoteURL)
        if !ok {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode az repos list: unrecognized remoteUrl %q", item.RemoteURL)

        repos = append(repos, RemoteRepo{

            Visibility:    strings.ToLower(item.Project.Visibility),
            DefaultBranch: strings.TrimPrefix(item.DefaultBranch, "refs/heads/"),
            Fork:          item.IsFork,

    }
    return repos, nil

 // Preferred returns the first available forge, for commands like `repo new`
 // that have no existing remote to infer from.
 func Preferred() (Forge, error) {
    for _, f := range []Forge{&gh{}, &glab{}} {
        if f.Available() {
            return f, nil
        }
    }
    return nil, errors.New("neither gh nor glab is installed")
 }

 // PublishRepo creates an empty upstream through adapters that support the
 // caller-managed remote/push flow. It never changes local Git configuration.
 func PublishRepo(ctx context.Context, f Forge, dir string, req RepoRequest) (CreateRepoResult, error) {
    publisher, ok := f.(RepoPublisher)
    if !ok {
        return CreateRepoResult{}, &ErrUnsupported{Kind: f.Kind(), Operation: "caller-managed repository publishing"}
    }
    return publisher.PublishRepo(ctx, dir, req)
 }

 // Probe checks installation and authentication without turning an optional
 // integration into a command failure. GitHub and GitLab are intentionally
 // probed against the host their create commands will use in a repository-less
 // working directory.
 func Probe(ctx context.Context, kind Kind) Readiness {
    f, err := For(kind)
    if err != nil {
        return Readiness{
            Forge: kind, Status: ReadinessUnsupported,
            Detail: err.Error(), Action: "use a supported forge or add the remote with git",
        }
    }
    return ProbeForge(ctx, f)
 }

 // ProbeForge is Probe for an already-selected adapter.
 func ProbeForge(ctx context.Context, f Forge) Readiness {
    result := Readiness{Forge: f.Kind(), Bin: f.Bin()}
    if !f.Available() {
        result.Status = ReadinessMissingCLI
        result.Detail = fmt.Sprintf("%s is not installed", f.Bin())
        result.Action = installAndLoginAction(f.Kind())
        return result
    }

 // run executes a forge CLI, streaming stderr through so the user sees the
 // CLI's own authentication prompts and error messages verbatim.
 func run(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
    cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
    cmd.Dir = dir
    var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
    cmd.Stdout = &stdout
    cmd.Stderr = &stderr
    cmd.Stdin = os.Stdin
    if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
        detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
        if detail != "" {
            return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
                bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
        }
        return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
    }
    return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
 }

 // runCombined is used for non-interactive publishing because gh/glab versions
 // differ on whether the created repository URL is written to stdout or stderr.
 // Stdin is deliberately left closed so a supposedly complete publish request
 // cannot unexpectedly drop into a second provider-owned wizard.
 func runCombined(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
    cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
    cmd.Dir = dir
    var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
    cmd.Stdout = &stdout
    cmd.Stderr = &stderr
    if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
        detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
        if detail != "" {
            return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
                bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
        }
        return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
    }
    return strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()) + "\n" + strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())), nil
 }

 func have(bin string) bool {
    _, err := lookupPath(bin)
    return err == nil
 }

 func lastHTTPURL(out string) string {
    var found string
    for _, field := range strings.Fields(out) {
        candidate := strings.Trim(field, "<>()[]{}\"',;.")
        if strings.HasPrefix(candidate, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(candidate, "https://") {
            found = candidate
        }
    }
    return found
 }

 func TestForReturnsAdapters(t *testing.T) {
    gh, err := forge.For(forge.GitHub)
    if err != nil || gh.Bin() != "gh" {
        t.Errorf("GitHub adapter: %v %v", gh, err)
    }
    gl, err := forge.For(forge.GitLab)
    if err != nil || gl.Bin() != "glab" {
        t.Errorf("GitLab adapter: %v %v", gl, err)
    }
    az, err := forge.For(forge.AzureDevOps)
    if err != nil || az.Bin() != "az" {
        t.Errorf("Azure DevOps adapter: %v %v", az, err)
    }
    if _, err := forge.For(forge.Unknown); err == nil {
        t.Error("an unknown host has no adapter, and callers must fall back to plain git")
    }
 }

 func TestCloneURL(t *testing.T) {
    gh, _ := forge.For(forge.GitHub)
    if got := gh.CloneURL("owner/repo"); got != "https://github.com/owner/repo.git" {
        t.Errorf("shorthand: %q", got)
    }
    // A full URL must pass through untouched, or an enterprise host would be
    // rewritten to github.com.
    full := "https://github.example.com/owner/repo.git"
    if got := gh.CloneURL(full); got != full {
        t.Errorf("full URL should pass through, got %q", got)
    }
    if got := gh.CloneURL("git@github.com:owner/repo.git"); got != "git@github.com:owner/repo.git" {
        t.Errorf("ssh URL should pass through, got %q", got)
    }

    gl, _ := forge.For(forge.GitLab)
    if got := gl.CloneURL("group/repo"); got != "https://gitlab.com/group/repo.git" {
        t.Errorf("gitlab shorthand: %q", got)
    }
 }

 // Every entry point must fail with a clear, actionable error rather than
 // panicking when the CLI is absent — the whole point of treating forges as
 // optional.
 func TestMissingCLIErrorsClearly(t *testing.T) {
    for _, k := range []forge.Kind{forge.GitHub, forge.GitLab} {
        f, _ := forge.For(k)
        if f.Available() {
            continue // installed on this machine; nothing to assert
        }
        if _, err := f.CreatePR(t.Context(), t.TempDir(), forge.PRRequest{Base: "main", Head: "x"}); err == nil {
            t.Errorf("%s CreatePR should error when the CLI is missing", k)
        } else if _, ok := err.(*forge.ErrNoCLI); !ok {
            t.Errorf("%s should report ErrNoCLI, got %T", k, err)
        }
    }
 }
```

```text
282	// at all. It matches the layout documented in the README.
283	func Default() Config {
284		return Config{
285			Paths: Paths{
286				ScanRoots:    []string{"~/Documents/Program", "~/src/tries"},
287				TriesRoot:    "~/src/tries",
288				WorktreeRoot: "~/Worktrees",
289				WorktreePath: "{{worktree_root}}/{{repo}}/{{branch|slug}}",
290				StateDir:     filepath.Join(DataHome(), "dev"),
291				ProjectRoot:  "~/Documents/Program",
292			},
293			Runtime: Runtime{
294				Backend:        "auto",
295				MetadataSource: "dev",
296			},
297			Worktree: Worktree{
298				Include:          []string{".env", ".env.local"},
299				Link:             nil,
300				PostCreate:       PostCreate{Auto: true},
301				Strategy:         "reinstall",
302				ProvisionTimeout: Duration{10 * time.Minute},
303			},
304			LocalFiles: localFilesFromLimits(safefile.DefaultLimits()),
305			Bootstrap: Bootstrap{
306				MaxDepth:       8,
307				FollowSymlinks: true,
308				Layout:         "flat",
309			},
310			Stats: Stats{
311				Sampler:        true,
312				WakaTime:       false,
313				WakaTimeConfig: "~/.wakatime.cfg",
314			},
315			Update: Update{Check: true},
316		}
317	}

319	// Load reads config.toml over the defaults. A missing file is not an error —
320	// dev must be useful with zero setup. A malformed file is, because silently
321	// falling back to defaults would send worktrees to the wrong volume.
322	func Load(path string) (Config, error) {
323		cfg := Default()
324		if path == "" {
325			path = ConfigFile()
326		}
327		md, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
328		switch {
329		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
330			return cfg, nil
331		case err != nil:
332			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
333		}
334		if undecoded := md.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
335			// Unknown keys are usually typos ("worktree_dir" vs "worktree_root").
336			// Warn rather than fail so a newer config still works on an older dev.
337			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: unknown key(s) in %s: %v\n", path, undecoded)
338		}
339		cfg.Source = path
340		return cfg, cfg.Validate()
341	}
```

```text
    cmd := &cobra.Command{
        Use:   "fleet",
        Short: "Inspect and safely synchronize dev repositories across machines",
        Long: `Fan out to machines in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml over SSH.

    )
    return cmd

 func encodeOpenRequest(request fleet.OpenRequest) string {
    data, _ := json.Marshal(request)
    return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(data)

 func decodeOpenRequest(value string) (fleet.OpenRequest, error) {
    data, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(value)
    if err != nil {
        return fleet.OpenRequest{}, err
    }
    var request fleet.OpenRequest
    if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &request); err != nil {
        return fleet.OpenRequest{}, err
    }
    return request, nil

            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet open request: %w", err)
            }
            repository, err := resolveFleetOpenRepository(ctxOf(), app, request)
            if err != nil {
                return err
            }
            if herdrOpen {
                rt, ok := app.runtimeNamed("herdr").(*runtime.Herdr)
                if !ok || !rt.Available() {
                    return errors.New("remote Herdr server is not available")
                }
                opened, err := openCheckout(ctxOf(), rt, repository.Path, repository.Name)
                if err != nil {
                    return err

                if err := rt.Focus(ctxOf(), opened.Handle); err != nil {
                    return err

            if err := os.Chdir(repository.Path); err != nil {
                return err
            }
            return replaceProcessWithShell()

 }

 type Config struct {
    SchemaVersion int      `toml:"schema_version"`
    Defaults      Defaults `toml:"defaults"`
    Hosts         []Host   `toml:"hosts"`
    Source        string   `toml:"-"`
 }

 func DefaultConfig() Config {
    return Config{
        SchemaVersion: ConfigSchemaVersion,
        Defaults: Defaults{
            ConnectTimeout: devconfig.Duration{Duration: 15 * time.Second},
            CommandTimeout: devconfig.Duration{Duration: 5 * time.Minute},
            CacheTTL:       devconfig.Duration{Duration: 15 * time.Minute},
            MaxParallel:    4,
            DevPath:        "auto",
        },
    }
 }

 func ConfigFile() string {
    return filepath.Join(devconfig.ConfigHome(), "dev", "remotes.toml")
 }

 func LoadConfig(path string) (Config, error) {
    cfg := DefaultConfig()
    if path == "" {
        path = ConfigFile()
    }
    metadata, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
    switch {
    case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
        return cfg, nil
    case err != nil:
        return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
    }
    if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
        return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: unknown field(s): %v", path, undecoded)
    }
    cfg.Source = path
    cfg.ApplyDefaults()
    if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
        return cfg, err
    }
    return cfg, nil
 }

 func (c *Config) ApplyDefaults() {
    for index := range c.Hosts {
        host := &c.Hosts[index]
        if host.DevPath == "" {
            host.DevPath = c.Defaults.DevPath
        }
        if host.ConnectTimeout.Duration == 0 {
            host.ConnectTimeout = c.Defaults.ConnectTimeout
        }
        if host.CommandTimeout.Duration == 0 {
            host.CommandTimeout = c.Defaults.CommandTimeout
        }
    }
 }

 func (c Config) Validate() error {
    if c.SchemaVersion != ConfigSchemaVersion {
        return fmt.Errorf("remotes schema_version %d: want %d", c.SchemaVersion, ConfigSchemaVersion)
    }
    if c.Defaults.MaxParallel <= 0 {
        return errors.New("defaults.max_parallel must be positive")
    }
    if c.Defaults.ConnectTimeout.Duration <= 0 || c.Defaults.CommandTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
        return errors.New("default timeouts must be positive")
    }
    seen := map[string]bool{}
    for index, host := range c.Hosts {
        if strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) == "" || host.Name != strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) {
            return fmt.Errorf("hosts[%d].name is required and must be trimmed", index)
        }
        if seen[host.Name] {
            return fmt.Errorf("duplicate host name %q", host.Name)
        }
        seen[host.Name] = true
+		if host.MachineID != "" {
+			if err := machineid.Validate(host.MachineID); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("host %q: %w", host.Name, err)
+			}
+		}
        if host.SSHAlias == "" && host.Hostname == "" {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q must define ssh_alias or hostname", host.Name)
        }
        if host.Port < 0 || host.Port > 65535 {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q port %d is invalid", host.Name, host.Port)
        }
        if host.ConnectTimeout.Duration <= 0 || host.CommandTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q timeouts must be positive", host.Name)
        }
        if host.DevPath != "" && host.DevPath != "auto" && !filepath.IsAbs(devconfig.Expand(host.DevPath)) {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q dev_path must be auto or absolute", host.Name)
        }
        if err := validatePasswordSource(host.Name, host.SSHLoginPasswordSource); err != nil {
            return err
        }
    }
    return nil
 }

 func validatePasswordSource(host string, source PasswordSource) error {
    kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(source.Type))
    if kind == "" {
        kind = "none"
    }
    switch kind {
    case "none", "prompt":
        return nil
    case "plain":
        if source.Value == "" {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q plain ssh_login_password_source requires value", host)
        }
    case "bitwarden":
        if source.Item == "" {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q bitwarden ssh_login_password_source requires item", host)
        }
    default:
        return fmt.Errorf("host %q ssh_login_password_source.type %q: want none, plain, prompt or bitwarden", host, source.Type)
    }
    return nil
 }

 func (h Host) PasswordKind() string {
    kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(h.SSHLoginPasswordSource.Type))
    if kind == "" {
        return "none"
    }
    return kind
 }

 func (h Host) Destination() string {
    if h.SSHAlias != "" {
        return h.SSHAlias
    }
    if h.User != "" {
        return h.User + "@" + h.Hostname
    }
    return h.Hostname
 }

 func CheckPrivateMode(path string, cfg Config) error {
    needsPrivate := false
    for _, host := range cfg.Hosts {
        if host.PasswordKind() == "plain" {
            needsPrivate = true
            break
        }
    }
    if !needsPrivate {
        return nil
    }
    info, err := os.Stat(path)
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }
    if info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
        return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a plaintext SSH password and must have mode 0600", path)
    }
    return nil
 }

    askpassFD     = "DEV_FLEET_SSH_ASKPASS_FD"
+
+	DefaultStdinLimit  int64 = 32 << 20
+	DefaultStdoutLimit int64 = 8 << 20
+	DefaultStderrLimit int64 = 1 << 20
 )

 var promptPasswordMu sync.Mutex

 // MaybeServeAskpass turns the dev executable into a one-shot SSH_ASKPASS
 // helper. The password arrives through an inherited descriptor, never argv.
 func MaybeServeAskpass() (bool, int) {
    if os.Getenv(askpassMarker) != "1" {
        return false, 0
    }
    fd, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv(askpassFD))
    if err != nil || fd < 3 {
        return true, 2
    }
    file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), "dev-fleet-askpass")
    if file == nil {
        return true, 2
    }
    defer file.Close()
    password, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 64*1024))
    if err != nil {
        return true, 2
    }
    password = bytes.TrimSuffix(password, []byte{'\n'})
    _, err = os.Stdout.Write(append(password, '\n'))
    if err != nil {
        return true, 2
    }
    return true, 0
 }

+// runSSHCommand starts SSH before writing an askpass secret. Starting first is
+// load-bearing: a secret larger than the pipe capacity must remain cancellable
+// through the command context instead of blocking before SSH exists.
+func runSSHCommand(cmd *exec.Cmd, password string) error {
+	if password == "" {
+		return cmd.Run()
+	}
+	executable, err := os.Executable()
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	cmd.ExtraFiles = []*os.File{reader}
+	cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
+		askpassMarker+"=1", askpassFD+"=3", "SSH_ASKPASS="+executable,
+		"SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force", "DISPLAY=dev-fleet")
+	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
+		_ = reader.Close()
+		_ = writer.Close()
+		return err
+	}
+	// The child owns its inherited descriptor after Start; closing the parent
+	// copy lets an early SSH exit interrupt a blocked write.
+	readerCloseErr := reader.Close()
+	writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		_, writeErr := io.Copy(writer, strings.NewReader(password+"\n"))
+		writeDone <- errors.Join(writeErr, writer.Close())
+	}()
+	waitErr := cmd.Wait()
+	// A descendant could retain the inherited read descriptor after SSH exits.
+	// Close our writer so that cannot strand the write goroutine.
+	_ = writer.Close()
+	writeErr := <-writeDone
+	return errors.Join(waitErr, readerCloseErr, writeErr)
+}
```
