 func sshArgs(host Host, pty, password bool) []string {
    connect := host.ConnectTimeout.Duration
    if connect <= 0 {
        connect = 15 * time.Second
    }
    seconds := int(connect.Round(time.Second) / time.Second)
    if seconds < 1 {
        seconds = 1
    }
    args := []string{"-o", "ConnectTimeout=" + strconv.Itoa(seconds), "-o", "ServerAliveInterval=15", "-o", "ServerAliveCountMax=2"}
    if password {
        args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=no", "-o", "PubkeyAuthentication=no", "-o", "PreferredAuthentications=keyboard-interactive,password", "-o", "NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1")
    } else {
        args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=yes")
    }
    if pty {
        args = append(args, "-t")
+	} else {
+		// A fixed protocol command never needs a TTY or client-side forwarding.
+		// Do not add host-key overrides here: OpenSSH's configured strict host-key
+		// verification remains authoritative.
+		args = append(args,
+			"-T",
+			"-o", "ClearAllForwardings=yes",
+			"-o", "ForwardAgent=no",
+			"-o", "ForwardX11=no",
+			"-o", "PermitLocalCommand=no",
+		)
    }
    if host.User != "" && host.SSHAlias != "" {
        args = append(args, "-l", host.User)
    }
    if host.Port > 0 {
        args = append(args, "-p", strconv.Itoa(host.Port))
    }
    if host.IdentityFile != "" && !password {
        args = append(args, "-i", devconfig.Expand(host.IdentityFile))
    }
    return args
 }

 func remoteCommand(host Host, args []string) string {
    devPath := host.DevPath
    if devPath == "" {
        devPath = "auto"
    }
    quotedArgs := make([]string, len(args))
    for index, arg := range args {
        quotedArgs[index] = shellQuote(arg)
    }
    joined := strings.Join(quotedArgs, " ")
    if devPath != "auto" {
        return "exec " + shellQuote(devconfig.Expand(devPath)) + " " + joined
    }
    path := `PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:/opt/homebrew/bin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/snap/bin:$PATH"`
    return path + "; export PATH; command -v dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 127; exec dev " + joined
 }

 func shellQuote(value string) string {
    return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'"
 }

 func permissionDenied(stderr []byte) bool {
    return strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(stderr)), "permission denied")
 }

 func (t Transport) resolvePassword(host Host) (string, error) {
    source := host.SSHLoginPasswordSource
    switch host.PasswordKind() {
    case "plain":
        return source.Value, nil
    case "bitwarden":
        cmd := exec.Command("bw", "get", "password", source.Item)
        out, err := cmd.Output()
        if err != nil {
            return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve Bitwarden SSH password for %s: %w", host.Name, err)
        }
        return strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), nil
    case "prompt":
        promptPasswordMu.Lock()
        defer promptPasswordMu.Unlock()
        writer := t.Err
        if writer == nil {
            writer = os.Stderr
        }
        fmt.Fprintf(writer, "SSH password for %s: ", host.Name)
        terminal, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
        if err != nil {
            return "", fmt.Errorf("open terminal for SSH password: %w", err)
        }
        defer terminal.Close()
        password, err := term.ReadPassword(terminal.Fd())
        fmt.Fprintln(writer)
        if err != nil {
            return "", err
        }
        return string(password), nil
    default:
        return "", nil
    }
 }

+type captureBuffer struct {
+	limit    int64
+	buffer   bytes.Buffer
+	exceeded bool
+}
+
+func newCaptureBuffer(limit int64) *captureBuffer {
+	return &captureBuffer{limit: limit}
+}
+
+func (b *captureBuffer) Write(value []byte) (int, error) {
+	remaining := b.limit - int64(b.buffer.Len())
+	if remaining > 0 {
+		keep := int64(len(value))
+		if keep > remaining {
+			keep = remaining
+		}
+		_, _ = b.buffer.Write(value[:int(keep)])
+	}
+	if int64(len(value)) > remaining {
+		b.exceeded = true
+	}
+	// Consume excess output without retaining it. The command timeout still
+	// bounds a peer that writes forever, while the parent process stays bounded.
+	return len(value), nil
+}
+
+func (b *captureBuffer) Bytes() []byte {
+	return append([]byte(nil), b.buffer.Bytes()...)
+}
+
+func (b *captureBuffer) Exceeded() bool { return b.exceeded }
+
+func effectiveLimit(configured, fallback int64) int64 {
+	if configured <= 0 {
+		return fallback
+	}
+	return configured
+}
+
+func captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr *captureBuffer) string {
+	streams := make([]string, 0, 2)
+	if stdout.Exceeded() {
+		streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stdout exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stdout.limit))
+	}
+	if stderr.Exceeded() {
+		streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stderr exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stderr.limit))
+	}
+	return "fleet transport: remote " + strings.Join(streams, " and ")
+}
+
+func boundedBytes(value []byte, limit int64) []byte {
+	if int64(len(value)) > limit {
+		value = value[:int(limit)]
+	}
+	return append([]byte(nil), value...)
+}
+
+func appendBounded(current, suffix []byte, limit int64) []byte {
+	if int64(len(current)) >= limit {
+		return append([]byte(nil), current...)
+	}
+	available := limit - int64(len(current))
+	if int64(len(suffix)) > available {
+		suffix = suffix[:int(available)]
+	}
+	return append(append([]byte(nil), current...), suffix...)
+}
+
+func localTransportFailure(message string) Result {
+	return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}

 // ResolvePaths canonicalizes repoRoot and proves both fixed files remain below
 // it. This also rejects a .dev-cli directory or file symlink that escapes the
 // repository.
 func ResolvePaths(repoRoot string) (FilePaths, error) {
    root, err := pathx.Canonical(repoRoot)
    if err != nil {
        return FilePaths{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize repository root: %w", err)
    }
    configPath, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, filepath.Join(root, DirectoryName, ConfigFilename))
    if err != nil {
        return FilePaths{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve %s: %w", ConfigRelativePath, err)
    }
    scaffoldsPath, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, filepath.Join(root, DirectoryName, ScaffoldsFilename))
    if err != nil {
        return FilePaths{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve %s: %w", ScaffoldsRelativePath, err)
    }
    return FilePaths{Root: root, Config: configPath, Scaffolds: scaffoldsPath}, nil
 }

 // ConfigPath returns the canonical fixed project config path.
 func ConfigPath(repoRoot string) (string, error) {
    paths, err := ResolvePaths(repoRoot)
    return paths.Config, err
 }

 // ScaffoldsPath returns the canonical fixed project scaffold path.
 func ScaffoldsPath(repoRoot string) (string, error) {
    paths, err := ResolvePaths(repoRoot)
    return paths.Scaffolds, err
 }

 func validateRelativePath(value string) error {
    if value == "" {
        return fmt.Errorf("path must not be empty")
    }
    if filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" {
        return fmt.Errorf("path %q must be repository-relative", value)
    }
    for _, part := range strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' || r == '\\' }) {
        if part == ".." {
            return fmt.Errorf("path %q contains parent traversal", value)
        }
    }
    if filepath.Clean(value) == "." {
        return fmt.Errorf("path %q names the repository root", value)
    }
    return nil

303	// RecoverySnapshotOf captures refs, registered worktrees, every worktree index
304	// and materialized tracked file, private Git administration, and unsupported
305	// storage topologies without modifying Git state. Ordinary probe failures are
306	// retained in Findings and produce a partial snapshot; cancellation is retained
307	// and also returned to the caller.
308	func RecoverySnapshotOf(ctx context.Context, dir string) (RecoverySnapshot, error) {
309		snapshot := RecoverySnapshot{
310			Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete,
311			Refs:         []RecoveryRef{},
312			Worktrees:    []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{},
313			AdminRoots:   []RecoveryAdminRoot{},
314			Findings:     []RecoveryFinding{},
315			trackedBytes: make(map[string][]byte),
316			adminBytes:   make(map[string][]byte),
317		}
318		collector := recoveryCollector{ctx: ctx, snapshot: &snapshot}
319		if err := collector.contextError("repository", dir); err != nil {
320			collector.finalize()
321			return snapshot, err
322		}
323
324		repository, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
325		if err != nil {
326			if cancelErr := collector.failure("repository-probe-failed", "repository", dir, err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
327				collector.finalize()
328				return snapshot, cancelErr
329			}
330			snapshot.Completeness = RecoveryCompletenessUnknown
331			collector.finalize()
332			return snapshot, err
333		}
334		snapshot.Repository = RecoveryRepositoryFacts{
335			Root:            repository.Root,
336			GitDir:          filepath.Clean(repository.GitDir),
337			CommonDir:       filepath.Clean(repository.GitCommonDir),
338			Bare:            repository.Bare,
339			PromisorRemotes: []string{},
340			Alternates:      []RecoveryAlternate{},
341		}
342
343		if err := collector.collectObjectFormat(repository); err != nil {
344			collector.finalize()
345			return snapshot, err
346		}
347		if err := collector.collectRefs(repository); err != nil {
348			collector.finalize()
349			return snapshot, err
350		}
351		if err := collector.collectRepositoryConfig(repository); err != nil {
352			collector.finalize()
353			return snapshot, err
354		}
355		if err := collector.collectShallow(repository); err != nil {
356			collector.finalize()
357			return snapshot, err
358		}
359		if err := collector.collectWorktreeList(repository); err != nil {
360			collector.finalize()
361			return snapshot, err
362		}
363		collector.collectStoragePlacement(repository)
364
365		for index := range snapshot.Worktrees {
366			if err := collector.collectWorktree(repository, &snapshot.Worktrees[index]); err != nil {
367				collector.finalize()
368				return snapshot, err
369			}
370		}
371		if err := collector.collectAdminRoots(repository); err != nil {
372			collector.finalize()
373			return snapshot, err
374		}
375		collector.collectObjectStoreFeatures(repository)
376		collector.finalize()
377		return snapshot, nil
378	}

380	type recoveryCollector struct {
381		ctx            context.Context
382		snapshot       *RecoverySnapshot
383		cancelRecorded bool
384	}

386	func (collector *recoveryCollector) contextError(scope, subject string) error {
387		if cause := context.Cause(collector.ctx); cause != nil {
388			if !collector.cancelRecorded {
389				collector.cancelRecorded = true
390				collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
391					Code: "collection-cancelled", Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure,
392					Scope: scope, Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: cause.Error(),
393				})
394			}
395			collector.markPartial(nil)
396			return cause
397		}
398		return nil
399	}
400
401	func (collector *recoveryCollector) failure(code, scope, subject string, err error, local *RecoveryCompleteness) error {
402		if cause := context.Cause(collector.ctx); cause != nil || errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
403			if cause == nil {
404				cause = err
405			}
406			if !collector.cancelRecorded {
407				collector.cancelRecorded = true
408				collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
409					Code: "collection-cancelled", Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure,
410					Scope: scope, Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: cause.Error(),
411				})
412			}
413			collector.markPartial(local)
414			return cause
415		}
416		collector.markPartial(local)
417		collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
418			Code: code, Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure, Scope: scope,
419			Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: recoveryCleanText(err.Error()),
420		})
421		return nil
422	}
423
424	func (collector *recoveryCollector) blocker(code, scope, subject, message string) {
425		collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
426			Code: code, Kind: RecoveryFindingBlocker, Scope: scope,
427			Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: message,
428		})
429	}

431	func (collector *recoveryCollector) addFinding(finding RecoveryFinding) {
432		finding.Code = recoveryIdentifier(finding.Code)
433		finding.Scope = recoveryIdentifier(finding.Scope)
434		finding.Subject = recoveryCleanSubject(finding.Subject)
435		finding.Message = recoveryCleanText(finding.Message)
436		collector.snapshot.Findings = append(collector.snapshot.Findings, finding)
437	}

439	func (collector *recoveryCollector) markPartial(local *RecoveryCompleteness) {
440		if collector.snapshot.Completeness != RecoveryCompletenessUnknown {
441			collector.snapshot.Completeness = RecoveryCompletenessPartial
442		}
443		if local != nil && *local != RecoveryCompletenessUnknown {
444			*local = RecoveryCompletenessPartial
445		}
446	}

448	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectObjectFormat(repository Repo) error {
449		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
450			"rev-parse", "--show-object-format=storage")
451		if err != nil {
452			if cancelErr := collector.failure("object-format-probe-failed", "object-format", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
453				return cancelErr
454			}
455		}
456		format := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
457		if format == "" {
458			if err == nil {
459				_ = collector.failure("object-format-parse-failed", "object-format", "repository", errors.New("Git returned an empty object format"), nil)
460			}
461			return nil
462		}
463		if strings.ContainsAny(format, "\x00\r\n \t") {
464			_ = collector.failure("object-format-parse-failed", "object-format", "repository", fmt.Errorf("unexpected object format %q", format), nil)
465			return nil
466		}
467		collector.snapshot.ObjectFormat = format
468		return nil
469	}
470
471	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectRefs(repository Repo) error {
472		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
473			"for-each-ref", "--sort=refname", "--format=%(refname)%00%(objectname)%00%(objecttype)%00", "refs")
474		if err != nil {
475			if cancelErr := collector.failure("refs-probe-failed", "refs", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
476				return cancelErr
477			}
478		}
479		refs, parseErr := parseRecoveryRefs(output)
480		collector.snapshot.Refs = refs
481		if parseErr != nil {
482			_ = collector.failure("refs-parse-failed", "refs", "repository", parseErr, nil)
483		}
484		return nil
485	}
486
487	func parseRecoveryRefs(output []byte) ([]RecoveryRef, error) {
488		refs := []RecoveryRef{}
489		var parseErrors []error
490		for recordIndex, record := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{'\n'}) {
491			record = bytes.TrimSuffix(record, []byte{'\r'})
492			if len(record) == 0 {
493				continue
494			}
495			fields := bytes.Split(record, []byte{0})
496			if len(fields) == 4 && len(fields[3]) == 0 {
497				fields = fields[:3]
498			}
499			if len(fields) != 3 {
500				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d has %d fields", recordIndex, len(fields)))
501				continue
502			}
503			name, oid, objectType := string(fields[0]), string(fields[1]), string(fields[2])
504			if !utf8.ValidString(name) || !strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/") || oid == "" || objectType == "" {
505				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d is invalid", recordIndex))
506				continue
507			}
508			refs = append(refs, RecoveryRef{Name: name, OID: oid, ObjectType: objectType, Kind: recoveryRefKind(name)})
509		}
510		sort.Slice(refs, func(i, j int) bool { return refs[i].Name < refs[j].Name })
511		return refs, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
512	}
513
514	func recoveryRefKind(name string) RecoveryRefKind {
515		switch {
516		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/heads/"):
517			return RecoveryRefHead
518		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/tags/"):
519			return RecoveryRefTag
520		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/notes/"):
521			return RecoveryRefNote
522		case name == "refs/stash":
523			return RecoveryRefStash
524		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/remotes/"):
525			return RecoveryRefRemote
526		default:
527			return RecoveryRefOther
528		}
529	}
530
531	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectRepositoryConfig(repository Repo) error {
532		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
533			"config", "--null", "--local", "--list")
534		if err != nil {
535			if cancelErr := collector.failure("config-probe-failed", "repository-config", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
536				return cancelErr
537			}
538		}
539		var parseErrors []error
540		promisorRemotes := map[string]struct{}{}
541		for recordIndex, record := range recoveryNULRecords(output) {
542			newline := bytes.IndexByte(record, '\n')
543			if newline < 1 {
544				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("config record %d has no key/value separator", recordIndex))
545				continue
546			}
547			key := strings.ToLower(string(record[:newline]))
548			value := string(record[newline+1:])
549			switch {
550			case key == "extensions.partialclone":
551				if strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
552					collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
553					promisorRemotes[strings.TrimSpace(value)] = struct{}{}
554				}
555			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "remote.") && strings.HasSuffix(key, ".promisor"):
556				remote := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "remote."), ".promisor")
557				parsed, boolErr := recoveryGitBool(value)
558				if boolErr != nil {
559					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("config %s: %w", key, boolErr))
560					continue
561				}
562				if parsed {
563					collector.snapshot.Repository.Promisor = true
564					collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
565					promisorRemotes[remote] = struct{}{}
566				}
567			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "remote.") && strings.HasSuffix(key, ".partialclonefilter"):
568				remote := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "remote."), ".partialclonefilter")
569				collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
570				promisorRemotes[remote] = struct{}{}
571			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "filter.lfs."):
572				collector.snapshot.Repository.LFSConfigured = true
573			}
574		}
575		for remote := range promisorRemotes {
576			if remote != "" {
577				collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes = append(collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes, remote)
578			}
579		}
580		sort.Strings(collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes)
581		if parseErr := errors.Join(parseErrors...); parseErr != nil {
582			_ = collector.failure("config-parse-failed", "repository-config", "repository", parseErr, nil)
583		}
584		return nil
585	}
586
587	func recoveryGitBool(value string) (bool, error) {
588		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
589		case "true", "yes", "on", "1":
590			return true, nil
591		case "false", "no", "off", "0", "":
592			return false, nil
593		default:
594			return false, fmt.Errorf("invalid Git boolean %q", value)
595		}
596	}
597
598	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectShallow(repository Repo) error {
599		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
600			"rev-parse", "--is-shallow-repository")
601		if err != nil {
602			if cancelErr := collector.failure("shallow-probe-failed", "object-store", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
603				return cancelErr
604			}
605			return nil
606		}
607		shallow, parseErr := strconv.ParseBool(strings.TrimSpace(string(output)))
608		if parseErr != nil {
609			_ = collector.failure("shallow-parse-failed", "object-store", "repository", parseErr, nil)
610			return nil
611		}
612		collector.snapshot.Repository.Shallow = shallow
613		if shallow {
614			collector.blocker("shallow-repository", "object-store", "repository", "repository history is shallow")
615		}
616		return nil
617	}
618
619	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectWorktreeList(repository Repo) error {
620		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
621			"worktree", "list", "--porcelain", "-z")
622		if err != nil {
623			if cancelErr := collector.failure("worktrees-probe-failed", "worktrees", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
624				return cancelErr
625			}
626		}
627		worktrees, parseErr := parseRecoveryWorktrees(output)
628		if parseErr != nil {
629			_ = collector.failure("worktrees-parse-failed", "worktrees", "repository", parseErr, nil)
630		}
631		if len(worktrees) == 0 && repository.Root != "" {
632			worktrees = append(worktrees, RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{
633				Path: repository.Root, GitDir: repository.GitDir, Bare: repository.Bare,
634				Main: true, Presence: RecoveryPresenceUnknown, Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessPartial,
635			})
636			if err == nil && parseErr == nil {
637				_ = collector.failure("worktrees-parse-failed", "worktrees", "repository", errors.New("Git returned no worktrees"), &worktrees[0].Completeness)
638			}
639		}
640		collector.snapshot.Worktrees = worktrees
641		return nil
642	}
643
644	func parseRecoveryWorktrees(output []byte) ([]RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot, error) {
645		worktrees := []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{}
646		var current *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot
647		var parseErrors []error
648		flush := func() {
649			if current == nil {
650				return
651			}
652			if current.Path == "" {
653				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, errors.New("worktree record has no path"))
654			} else {
655				current.Main = len(worktrees) == 0
656				worktrees = append(worktrees, *current)
657			}
658			current = nil
659		}
660		for fieldIndex, raw := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{0}) {
661			if len(raw) == 0 {
662				flush()
663				continue
664			}
665			keyBytes, valueBytes, hasValue := bytes.Cut(raw, []byte{' '})
666			key, value := string(keyBytes), ""
667			if hasValue {
668				value = string(valueBytes)
669			}
670			if key == "worktree" {
671				flush()
672				current = &RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{
673					Path: value, Presence: RecoveryPresenceUnknown, Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete,
674					Operations: []RecoveryOperation{}, IndexEntries: []RecoveryIndexEntry{},
675					TrackedFiles: []RecoveryTrackedFile{}, DirtyPaths: []RecoveryDirtyPath{},
676					UntrackedPaths: []string{}, IgnoredPaths: []string{}, LFSPaths: []RecoveryLFSPath{},
677					Submodules: []RecoverySubmodule{}, NestedRepositories: []RecoveryNestedRepository{},
678				}
679				continue
680			}
681			if current == nil {
682				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("worktree field %d precedes a worktree path", fieldIndex))
683				continue
684			}
685			switch key {
686			case "HEAD":
687				current.Head = value
688			case "branch":
689				current.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(value, "refs/heads/")
690			case "detached":
691				current.Detached = true
692			case "bare":
693				current.Bare = true
694			case "locked":
695				current.Locked, current.LockedReason = true, value
696			case "prunable":
697				current.Prunable, current.PrunableReason = true, value
698			}
699		}
700		flush()
701		return worktrees, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
702	}
703
704	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectStoragePlacement(repository Repo) {
705		facts := &collector.snapshot.Repository
706		if repository.Root != "" {
707			inside, err := pathx.Contains(repository.Root, repository.GitDir)
708			if err != nil {
709				_ = collector.failure("git-dir-placement-probe-failed", "storage", "git-dir", err, nil)
710			} else {
711				facts.GitDirOutsideRoot = !inside
712			}
713		}
714		mainRoot := repository.Root
715		for _, worktree := range collector.snapshot.Worktrees {
716			if worktree.Main && worktree.Path != "" {
717				mainRoot = worktree.Path
718				break
719			}
720		}
721		if mainRoot != "" {
722			inside, err := pathx.Contains(mainRoot, repository.GitCommonDir)
723			if err != nil {
724				_ = collector.failure("common-dir-placement-probe-failed", "storage", "common-dir", err, nil)
725			} else {
726				facts.CommonDirOutsideMainRoot = !inside
727				if !inside {
728					collector.blocker("external-common-directory", "storage", "common-dir", "Git common directory is outside the main worktree root")
729				}
730			}
731		}
732		facts.SharedCommonDir = repository.GitDir != repository.GitCommonDir || len(collector.snapshot.Worktrees) > 1
733	}
734
735	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectIndex(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
736		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil,
737			"ls-files", "--stage", "-v", "-z", "--sparse", "--full-name")
738		if err != nil {
739			if cancelErr := collector.failure("index-probe-failed", "index", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
740				return cancelErr
741			}
742		}
743		entries, parseErr := parseRecoveryIndex(output)
744		worktree.IndexEntries = entries
745		if parseErr != nil {
746			_ = collector.failure("index-parse-failed", "index", worktree.Path, parseErr, &worktree.Completeness)
747		}
748		for _, entry := range entries {
749			if entry.Mode == "040000" {
750				worktree.SparseIndex = true
751			}
752		}
753		return nil
754	}
755
756	func parseRecoveryIndex(output []byte) ([]RecoveryIndexEntry, error) {
757		entries := []RecoveryIndexEntry{}
758		var parseErrors []error
759		for recordIndex, record := range recoveryNULRecords(output) {
760			header, pathBytes, ok := bytes.Cut(record, []byte{'\t'})
761			if !ok || len(pathBytes) == 0 || !utf8.Valid(pathBytes) {
762				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has an invalid path field", recordIndex))
763				continue
764			}
765			fields := strings.Fields(string(header))
766			if len(fields) != 4 || len(fields[0]) != 1 {
767				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has an invalid header", recordIndex))
768				continue
769			}
770			if _, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(fields[1], 8, 32); modeErr != nil {
771				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d mode %q: %w", recordIndex, fields[1], modeErr))
772				continue
773			}
774			stage, stageErr := strconv.Atoi(fields[3])
775			if stageErr != nil || stage < 0 || stage > 3 {
776				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has invalid stage %q", recordIndex, fields[3]))
777				continue
778			}
779			tag := fields[0][0]
780			upper := tag
781			if upper >= 'a' && upper <= 'z' {
782				upper -= 'a' - 'A'
783			}
784			entries = append(entries, RecoveryIndexEntry{
785				Path: string(pathBytes), Mode: fields[1], OID: fields[2], Stage: stage, Tag: fields[0],
786				AssumeUnchanged: tag >= 'a' && tag <= 'z', SkipWorktree: upper == 'S',
787			})
788		}
789		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
790			if entries[i].Path != entries[j].Path {
791				return entries[i].Path < entries[j].Path
792			}
793			if entries[i].Stage != entries[j].Stage {
794				return entries[i].Stage < entries[j].Stage
795			}
796			return entries[i].Mode < entries[j].Mode
797		})
798		return entries, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
799	}
800
801	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectSparseConfig(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
802		probes := []struct {
803			key    string
804			target *bool
805		}{
806			{"core.sparseCheckout", &worktree.SparseCheckout},
807			{"core.sparseCheckoutCone", &worktree.SparseCone},
808			{"index.sparse", &worktree.SparseIndex},
809		}
810		for _, probe := range probes {
811			output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil,
812				"config", "--bool", "--default=false", "--get", probe.key)
813			if err != nil {
814				if cancelErr := collector.failure("sparse-config-probe-failed", "sparse", worktree.Path+":"+probe.key, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
815					return cancelErr
816				}
817				continue
818			}
819			value, boolErr := recoveryGitBool(string(output))
820			if boolErr != nil {
821				_ = collector.failure("sparse-config-parse-failed", "sparse", worktree.Path+":"+probe.key, boolErr, &worktree.Completeness)
822				continue
823			}
824			*probe.target = *probe.target || value
825		}
826		if worktree.SparseCheckout {
827			collector.blocker("sparse-checkout", "sparse", worktree.Path, "worktree uses sparse checkout")
828		}
829		if worktree.SparseIndex {
830			collector.blocker("sparse-index", "sparse", worktree.Path, "worktree index contains sparse directory state")
831		}
832		return nil
833	}
834
835	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectStatus(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
836		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil,
837			"status", "--porcelain=v2", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
838		if err != nil {
839			if cancelErr := collector.failure("status-probe-failed", "status", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
840				return cancelErr
841			}
842		}
843		dirty, untracked, parseErr := parseRecoveryStatus(output)
844		worktree.DirtyPaths, worktree.UntrackedPaths = dirty, untracked
845		if parseErr != nil {
846			_ = collector.failure("status-parse-failed", "status", worktree.Path, parseErr, &worktree.Completeness)
847		}
848		return nil
849	}
850
851	func parseRecoveryStatus(output []byte) ([]RecoveryDirtyPath, []string, error) {
852		records := recoveryNULRecords(output)
853		dirty := []RecoveryDirtyPath{}
854		untracked := []string{}
855		var parseErrors []error
856		for index := 0; index < len(records); index++ {
857			record := string(records[index])
858			if record == "" {
859				continue
860			}
861			switch record[0] {
862			case '1', '2':
863				fields := strings.Fields(record)
864				path := statusPath(record)
865				if len(fields) < 2 || len(fields[1]) != 2 || path == "" {
866					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("status record %d is malformed", index))
867					continue
868				}
869				change := RecoveryDirtyPath{
870					Path: path, Kind: "ordinary", IndexStatus: string(fields[1][0]), WorktreeStatus: string(fields[1][1]),
871				}
872				if record[0] == '2' {
873					change.Kind = "rename-or-copy"
874					if index+1 >= len(records) {
875						parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("rename status record %d has no source path", index))
876					} else {
877						index++
878						change.OldPath = string(records[index])
879					}
880				}
881				dirty = append(dirty, change)
882			case 'u':
883				fields := strings.Fields(record)
884				path := statusPath(record)
885				if len(fields) < 2 || len(fields[1]) != 2 || path == "" {
886					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("unmerged status record %d is malformed", index))
887					continue
888				}
889				dirty = append(dirty, RecoveryDirtyPath{
890					Path: path, Kind: "unmerged", IndexStatus: string(fields[1][0]), WorktreeStatus: string(fields[1][1]),
891				})
892			case '?':
893				path := strings.TrimPrefix(record, "? ")
894				if path == record || path == "" {
895					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("untracked status record %d is malformed", index))
896					continue
897				}
898				untracked = append(untracked, path)
899			case '#':
900				// Branch headers are allowed if a future caller adds --branch.
901			default:
902				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("unknown status record %d type %q", index, record[0]))
903			}
904		}
905		sort.Slice(dirty, func(i, j int) bool {
906			return strings.Join([]string{dirty[i].Path, dirty[i].OldPath, dirty[i].Kind}, "\x00") <
907				strings.Join([]string{dirty[j].Path, dirty[j].OldPath, dirty[j].Kind}, "\x00")
908		})
909		sort.Strings(untracked)
910		return dirty, untracked, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
911	}
912
913	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectIgnored(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
914		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil,
915			"ls-files", "--others", "--ignored", "--exclude-standard", "--full-name", "-z")
916		if err != nil {
917			if cancelErr := collector.failure("ignored-probe-failed", "ignored", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
918				return cancelErr
919			}
920		}
921		paths := []string{}
922		var parseErrors []error
923		for recordIndex, record := range recoveryNULRecords(output) {
924			if len(record) == 0 || !utf8.Valid(record) {
925				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ignored record %d has an invalid path", recordIndex))
926				continue
927			}
928			paths = append(paths, string(record))
929		}
930		sort.Strings(paths)
931		worktree.IgnoredPaths = paths
932		if parseErr := errors.Join(parseErrors...); parseErr != nil {
933			_ = collector.failure("ignored-parse-failed", "ignored", worktree.Path, parseErr, &worktree.Completeness)
934		}
935		return nil
936	}
937
938	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectLFS(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
939		paths := make(map[string]struct{}, len(worktree.IndexEntries)+len(worktree.UntrackedPaths)+len(worktree.IgnoredPaths))
940		for _, entry := range worktree.IndexEntries {
941			paths[entry.Path] = struct{}{}
942		}
943		for _, path := range worktree.UntrackedPaths {
944			paths[path] = struct{}{}
945		}
946		for _, path := range worktree.IgnoredPaths {
947			paths[path] = struct{}{}
948		}
949		ordered := make([]string, 0, len(paths))
950		for path := range paths {
951			ordered = append(ordered, path)
952		}
953		sort.Strings(ordered)
954		if len(ordered) == 0 {
955			return nil
956		}
957		var input bytes.Buffer
958		for _, path := range ordered {
959			input.WriteString(path)
960			input.WriteByte(0)
961		}
962		byPath := map[string]*RecoveryLFSPath{}
963		probes := []struct {
964			name   string
965			cached bool
966		}{
967			{"index", true},
968			{"worktree", false},
969		}
970		for _, probe := range probes {
971			args := []string{"check-attr"}
972			if probe.cached {
973				args = append(args, "--cached")
974			}
975			args = append(args, "-z", "--stdin", "filter")
976			output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, input.Bytes(), args...)
977			if err != nil {
978				if cancelErr := collector.failure("lfs-attribute-probe-failed", "lfs", worktree.Path+":"+probe.name, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
979					return cancelErr
980				}
981			}
982			values := recoveryNULRecords(output)
983			if len(values)%3 != 0 {
984				_ = collector.failure("lfs-attribute-parse-failed", "lfs", worktree.Path+":"+probe.name,
985					fmt.Errorf("Git returned %d attribute fields, want a multiple of three", len(values)), &worktree.Completeness)
986				continue
987			}
988			for field := 0; field < len(values); field += 3 {
989				path, attribute, value := string(values[field]), string(values[field+1]), string(values[field+2])
990				if attribute != "filter" || value != "lfs" {
991					continue
992				}
993				fact := byPath[path]
994				if fact == nil {
995					fact = &RecoveryLFSPath{Path: path}
996					byPath[path] = fact
997				}
998				if probe.cached {
999					fact.IndexAttributes = true
1000				} else {
1001					fact.WorktreeAttributes = true
1002				}
1003			}
1004		}
1005		for _, path := range ordered {
1006			if fact := byPath[path]; fact != nil {
1007				worktree.LFSPaths = append(worktree.LFSPaths, *fact)
1008				collector.blocker("lfs-path", "lfs", worktree.Path+":"+path, "path is governed by the Git LFS filter")
1009			}
1010		}
1011		return nil
1012	}
1013
1014	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectSubmodules(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) map[string]struct{} {
1015		paths := map[string]struct{}{}
1016		for _, entry := range worktree.IndexEntries {
1017			if entry.Mode != "160000" {
1018				continue
1019			}
1020			worktree.Submodules = append(worktree.Submodules, RecoverySubmodule{Path: entry.Path, OID: entry.OID, Stage: entry.Stage})
1021			paths[entry.Path] = struct{}{}
1022		}
1023		sort.Slice(worktree.Submodules, func(i, j int) bool {
1024			if worktree.Submodules[i].Path != worktree.Submodules[j].Path {
1025				return worktree.Submodules[i].Path < worktree.Submodules[j].Path
1026			}
1027			return worktree.Submodules[i].Stage < worktree.Submodules[j].Stage
1028		})
1029		ordered := make([]string, 0, len(paths))
1030		for path := range paths {
1031			ordered = append(ordered, path)
1032		}
1033		sort.Strings(ordered)
1034		for _, path := range ordered {
1035			collector.blocker("submodule", "submodule", worktree.Path+":"+path, "gitlink requires independent submodule recovery proof")
1036		}
1037		return paths
1038	}
1039
1040	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectObjectStoreFeatures(repository Repo) {
1041		facts := &collector.snapshot.Repository
1042		for _, root := range collector.snapshot.AdminRoots {
1043			if root.Kind != RecoveryAdminCommonDir {
1044				continue
1045			}
1046			for _, entry := range root.Entries {
1047				if entry.Type == RecoveryEntryRegular && strings.HasPrefix(entry.Path, "objects/pack/") && strings.HasSuffix(entry.Path, ".promisor") {
1048					facts.PromisorPackFiles++
1049				}
1050			}
1051		}
1052		if facts.PromisorPackFiles > 0 {
1053			facts.Promisor = true
1054			facts.PartialClone = true
1055		}
1056

38	func PrepareSource(ctx context.Context, options SourceOptions) (*Source, Report, error) {
39		if err := options.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {

106	// BuildEnvelope performs the source-side apply revalidation and includes bytes

108	func (s *Source) BuildEnvelope(ctx context.Context, plan PlanResponse, retainForEvict bool) (ApplyEnvelope, error) {
109		if s == nil {
110			return ApplyEnvelope{}, errors.New("build local-files envelope from nil source")
111		}
112		if err := plan.Validate(s.request); err != nil {
113			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
114		}
115		envelope := ApplyEnvelope{
116			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
117			Request: s.request, Plan: plan, RetainForEvict: retainForEvict,
118		}
119		for index, planned := range plan.Files {
120			if planned.Action == actionCurrent {
121				continue
122			}
123			if planned.Action != actionCreate && planned.Action != actionReplace {
124				return ApplyEnvelope{}, ErrPlanBlocked
125			}
126			spec := s.request.Files[index]
127			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
128				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
129			}
130			observed, err := observePath(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path, s.request.SafeLimits(), true)
131			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 ||
132				(observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0) != spec.executable() {
133				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
134			}
135			envelope.Payloads = append(envelope.Payloads, Payload{
136				Path: spec.Path, Content: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(observed.data),
137			})
138		}
139		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
140			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
141		}
142		return envelope, nil
143	}

145	func (e ApplyEnvelope) Validate() error {
146		if e.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || e.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
147			return errors.New("unsupported local-files apply protocol")
148		}
149		if err := e.Request.Validate(); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		if err := e.Plan.Validate(e.Request); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		expected := map[string]FileSpec{}
156		for index, planned := range e.Plan.Files {
157			if planned.Action == actionCreate || planned.Action == actionReplace {
158				expected[e.Request.Files[index].Path] = e.Request.Files[index]
159			}
160		}
161		if len(e.Payloads) != len(expected) {
162			return errors.New("apply payload count does not match target actions")
163		}
164		seen := map[string]bool{}
165		var total int64
166		for index, payload := range e.Payloads {
167			if index > 0 && e.Payloads[index-1].Path >= payload.Path {
168				return errors.New("apply payload paths must be unique and sorted")
169			}
170			spec, ok := expected[payload.Path]
171			if !ok || seen[payload.Path] {
172				return fmt.Errorf("unexpected apply payload for %q", payload.Path)
173			}
174			seen[payload.Path] = true
175			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
176			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
177				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q is not canonical base64", payload.Path)
178			}
179			if int64(len(decoded)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(decoded) != spec.SHA256 {
180				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q does not match its manifest", payload.Path)
181			}
182			if int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes || int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxTotalBytes-total {
183				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q exceeds negotiated limits", payload.Path)
184			}
185			total += int64(len(decoded))
186		}
187		return nil
188	}

190	func stateForError(err error) State {

193			return StateBlockedUnsafe
194		case errors.Is(err, ErrIneligible):
195			return StateBlockedIneligible
196		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
197			return StateMissing
198		default:
199			return StateFailed

212	// both sides against this binary's compiled ceilings.
213	func NegotiateLimits(local safefile.Limits, remote fleet.FileLimits) (safefile.Limits, error) {
214		if err := local.Validate(); err != nil {
215			return safefile.Limits{}, err
216		}
217		remoteLimits := safefile.Limits{
218			MaxFiles: remote.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: remote.MaxFileBytes,
219			MaxTotalBytes: remote.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: remote.MaxPathBytes,
220			MaxComponentBytes: remote.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: remote.MaxPathDepth,
221		}
222		if err := remoteLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
223			return safefile.Limits{}, err
224		}
225		result := safefile.Limits{
226			MaxFiles:          min(local.MaxFiles, remoteLimits.MaxFiles),
227			MaxFileBytes:      min(local.MaxFileBytes, remoteLimits.MaxFileBytes),
228			MaxTotalBytes:     min(local.MaxTotalBytes, remoteLimits.MaxTotalBytes),
229			MaxPathBytes:      min(local.MaxPathBytes, remoteLimits.MaxPathBytes),
230			MaxComponentBytes: min(local.MaxComponentBytes, remoteLimits.MaxComponentBytes),
231			MaxPathDepth:      min(local.MaxPathDepth, remoteLimits.MaxPathDepth),
232		}
233		return result, result.Validate()
234	}

101	func (s *Service) resolveTarget(ctx context.Context, binding Binding) (targetCheckout, error) {
102		if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
103			return targetCheckout{}, err
104		}
105		options := repo.DefaultOptions()
106		if s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth > 0 {
107			options.MaxDepth = s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth
108		}
109		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, s.Config.DiscoveryRoots(), options)
110		if err != nil {
111			return targetCheckout{}, err
112		}
113		type candidate struct {
114			path      string
115			commonDir string
116		}
117		var candidates []candidate
118		for _, repository := range repositories {
119			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
120				continue
121			}
122			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
123			if err != nil {
124				continue
125			}
126			matched, err := checkoutHasIdentity(ctx, gitRepo.Root, binding.RemoteIdentity)
127			if err != nil || !matched {
128				continue
129			}
130			candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: gitRepo.Root, commonDir: gitRepo.GitCommonDir})
131		}
132		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].commonDir < candidates[j].commonDir })
133		switch len(candidates) {
134		case 0:
135			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAbsent}
136		case 1:
137		default:
138			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAmbiguous}
139		}
140		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidates[0].path, binding.Branch)
141		if err != nil {
142			return targetCheckout{}, err
143		}
144		if !checkedOut || worktree.Bare || worktree.Prunable {
145			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetFetchedOnly}
146		}
147		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
148		if err != nil {
149			return targetCheckout{}, err
150		}
151		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
152		if err != nil {
153			return targetCheckout{}, err
154		}
155		if status.Detached || status.Branch != binding.Branch || head != binding.HeadOID || worktree.Head != binding.HeadOID {
156			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetStale}
157		}
158		checkout := targetCheckout{
159			root: worktree.Path, commonDir: candidates[0].commonDir,
160			identity: binding.RemoteIdentity, branch: binding.Branch, head: head,
161		}
162		checkout.id = digestJSON(struct {
163			Domain    string `json:"domain"`
164			CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
165			Root      string `json:"root"`
166			Branch    string `json:"branch"`
167			Head      string `json:"head"`
168		}{"dev-local-files-checkout-v1", checkout.commonDir, checkout.root, checkout.branch, checkout.head})
169		return checkout, nil
170	}
171
172	func checkoutHasIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, wanted string) (bool, error) {
173		names, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
174		if err != nil {
175			return false, err
176		}
177		for _, name := range strings.Fields(names) {
178			for _, kind := range []string{"--all"} {
179				urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", kind, name)
180				if err != nil {
181					continue
182				}
183				for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
184					if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
185						return true, nil
186					}
187				}
188			}
189			pushURLs, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--push", "--all", name)
190			if err == nil {
191				for _, raw := range strings.Split(pushURLs, "\n") {
192					if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
193						return true, nil
194					}
195				}
196			}
197		}
198		return false, nil
199	}
200
201	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
202		if s == nil {
203			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
204		}
205		if s.platform() == "windows" {
206			return PlanResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
207		}
208		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
209			return PlanResponse{}, err
210		}
211		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
212		if err != nil {
213			return PlanResponse{}, err
214		}
215		if id != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
216			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
217		}
218		hostLimits := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
219		if err := hostLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
220			return PlanResponse{}, err
221		}
222		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(hostLimits, request.Limits)
223		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
224			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("plan limits do not match target policy")
225		}
226		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, request.Binding)
227		if err != nil {
228			return PlanResponse{}, err
229		}
230		response := PlanResponse{
231			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
232			RequestID: request.RequestID, ManifestDigest: request.ManifestDigest,
233			TargetMachine: id, TargetCheckout: checkout.id,
234		}
235		for _, spec := range request.Files {
236			planned := PlanFile{PublicFile: spec.public(StateFailed)}
237			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
238				planned.State = stateForError(err)
239				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
240				continue
241			}
242			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, request.SafeLimits(), true)
243			if err != nil {
244				planned.State = stateForError(err)
245				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
246				continue
247			}
248			targetMode := ""
249			if observed.exists {
250				targetMode = fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm())
251			}
252			switch {
253			case !observed.exists:
254				planned.State, planned.Action = StateReady, actionCreate
255			case observed.digest == spec.SHA256 && targetMode == spec.Mode:
256				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateCurrent, actionCurrent, observed.digest, targetMode
257			case request.Replace:
258				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateReady, actionReplace, observed.digest, targetMode
259			default:
260				planned.State, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateBlockedConflict, observed.digest, targetMode
261			}
262			response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
263		}
264		response.PlanDigest = planDigest(request, response)
265		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
266			return PlanResponse{}, err
267		}
268		return response, nil
269	}

135	func validateJournal(value journal) error {
136		if value.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || value.RequestID == "" || !validDigest(value.PlanDigest) || !validDigest(value.ManifestDigest) {
137			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal binding")
138		}
139		switch value.Phase {
140		case phaseStaged, phaseApplying, phaseCompleted, phaseRolledBack, phaseReconcile:
141		default:
142			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal phase")
143		}
144		for index, file := range value.Files {
145			if index > 0 && value.Files[index-1].Path >= file.Path {
146				return errors.New("local-files journal paths are not sorted")
147			}
148			switch file.Action {
149			case actionCurrent, actionCreate, actionReplace:
150			default:
151				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid action")
152			}
153			if !file.State.validResult() {
154				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid result state")
155			}
156			if file.Size < 0 || file.Mode != "0600" && file.Mode != "0700" {
157				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid public metadata")
158			}
159			if file.Action == actionReplace && (!validDigest(file.OldSHA256) || !validFileMode(file.OldMode)) {
160				return errors.New("local-files replacement journal lacks rollback binding")
161			}
162		}
163		if !sort.StringsAreSorted(value.CreatedDirs) {
164			return errors.New("local-files journal directories are not sorted")
165		}
166		return nil
167	}

191			if digestBytes(existing) != digestBytes(content) {

304	func readPrivateFile(path string, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
305		parentPath := filepath.Dir(path)
306		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(parentPath)
307		if err != nil {
308			return nil, err
309		}
310		defer root.Close()
311		name := filepath.Base(path)
312		info, err := root.Lstat(name)
313		if err != nil {
314			return nil, err
315		}
316		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
317			return nil, errors.New("local-files state file is not a private regular file")
318		}
319		data, _, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(context.Background(), root, name, info, maxBytes)
320		if err != nil {
321			return nil, err
322		}
323		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(parentPath, rootInfo); err != nil {
324			return nil, err
325		}
326		return data, nil
327	}

156	func fleetFilesHost(cfg fleet.Config, name string) (fleet.Host, error) {

162				}

164				selected = &copy
165			}
166		}
167		if selected == nil {

169		}
170		return *selected, nil

187	func resolveFleetFilesSource(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (string, gitx.Status, string, string, error) {
188		checkout := ""
189		if ref == "" {
190			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
191			if err != nil {
192				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
193			}
194			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
195			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
196				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
197			}
198			checkout = gitRepo.Root
199		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
200			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
201				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
202				if discoverErr != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
203					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
204				}
205				checkout = gitRepo.Root
206			}
207		}
208		if checkout == "" {
209			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
210			if err != nil {
211				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
212			}
213			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
214			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
215				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
216			}
217			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
218		}
219		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
220		if err != nil {
221			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
222		}
223		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
224			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
225		}
226		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
227		if err != nil {
228			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
229		}
230		identity, err := sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
231		if err != nil {
232			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
233		}
234		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil
235	}
236
237	func sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
238		var preferred []string
239		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
240			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
241		}
242		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
243		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
244		if err != nil {
245			return "", err
246		}
247		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
248		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
249		for _, remote := range preferred {
250			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
251				continue
252			}
253			seenRemote[remote] = true
254			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
255			if err != nil {
256				continue
257			}
258			identitySet := map[string]bool{}
259			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
260				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
261					identitySet[identity] = true
262				}
263			}
264			if len(identitySet) == 1 {
265				for identity := range identitySet {
266					return identity, nil
267				}
268			}
269		}
270		return "", errors.New("source checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
271	}

1	// Package safefile provides held-root filesystem operations for untrusted
2	// relative paths. It keeps traversal relative to os.Root handles, rejects links
3	// and special files, revalidates filesystem identity, and detects observable
4	// source mutation while reading.
5	package safefile
6
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"

18	var (
19		// ErrChanged reports that a named root, child, or file no longer identifies
20		// the object observed by the caller.
21		ErrChanged = errors.New("filesystem object changed")
22		// ErrUnsafeType reports a symlink, reparse point, directory, or other
23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.
24		ErrUnsafeType = errors.New("unsafe filesystem object type")
25		// ErrFileLimit reports a regular file whose bytes exceed the read policy.
26		ErrFileLimit = errors.New("file size limit exceeded")
27	)
28
29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}
63

135	// ReadStableRegular reads one child file while proving that the directory name,
136	// opened descriptor, and final directory name all identify the expected regular
137	// file with unchanged observable metadata. maxBytes must be non-negative; zero
138	// means unbounded. Supplying the FileInfo from an earlier directory listing
139	// detects replacement or mutation between selection and opening.
140	func ReadStableRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
141		if root == nil {
142			return nil, nil, errors.New("read stable file: nil root")
143		}
144		if maxBytes < 0 {
145			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("negative maximum file size: %w", ErrFileLimit)
146		}
147		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
148			return nil, nil, err
149		}
150		before, err := root.Lstat(name)
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, nil, err
153		}
154		if expected == nil {
155			expected = before
156		}
157		if unsafeLink(before) || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
158			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is not a regular file: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
159		}
160		if !sameStableSourceState(expected, before) {
161			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed before opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
162		}
163		if maxBytes > 0 && before.Size() > maxBytes {
164			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", before.Size(), maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
165		}
166
167		file, err := openRegularForRead(root, name)
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, nil, err
170		}
171		defer file.Close()
172		opened, err := file.Stat()
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, nil, err
175		}
176		if unsafeLink(opened) || !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(expected, opened) {
177			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
178		}
179		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, nil, err
182		}
183		if unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, current) {
184			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
185		}
186
187		data, err := readAllContext(ctx, file, maxBytes)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, nil, err
190		}
191		after, err := file.Stat()
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, nil, err
194		}
195		current, err = root.Lstat(name)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, nil, err
198		}
199		if unsafeLink(after) || unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, after) ||
200			!sameStableSourceState(after, current) || after.Size() != int64(len(data)) {
201			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed during read: %w", ErrChanged)
202		}
203		return data, opened, nil
204	}
205
206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}
213
214	func sameStableSourceState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
215		return SameFileState(left, right) && samePlatformState(left, right)
216	}
217
218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}
243
244	func unsafeLink(info fs.FileInfo) bool {
245		return info != nil && (info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || isReparsePoint(info))
246	}
247

10	const (
11		// CompiledMaxFiles is the maximum number of portable files accepted by one
12		// operation. Runtime policy may lower, but never raise, this ceiling.
13		CompiledMaxFiles = 128
14		// CompiledMaxFileBytes is the maximum size of one portable file.
15		CompiledMaxFileBytes int64 = 8 << 20
16		// CompiledMaxTotalBytes is the maximum aggregate portable payload size.
17		CompiledMaxTotalBytes int64 = 32 << 20
18		// CompiledMaxPathBytes bounds a slash-separated portable relative path.
19		CompiledMaxPathBytes = 4096
20		// CompiledMaxComponentBytes bounds one portable path component.
21		CompiledMaxComponentBytes = 255
22		// CompiledMaxPathDepth bounds portable path nesting.
23		CompiledMaxPathDepth = 64
24	)
25
26	var (
27		// ErrInvalidLimits reports a zero, negative, or above-ceiling policy.
28		ErrInvalidLimits = errors.New("invalid safe-file limits")
29		// ErrManifestLimit reports a manifest that exceeds its validated policy.
30		ErrManifestLimit = errors.New("safe-file manifest limit exceeded")
31		// ErrDuplicatePath reports the same exact portable path more than once.
32		ErrDuplicatePath = errors.New("duplicate safe-file path")
33	)
34
35	// Limits is the reusable compiled policy for portable file manifests. Every
36	// field is required and must be no greater than the corresponding compiled
37	// ceiling, allowing host configuration to lower limits without weakening them.
38	type Limits struct {
39		MaxFiles          int
40		MaxFileBytes      int64
41		MaxTotalBytes     int64
42		MaxPathBytes      int
43		MaxComponentBytes int
44		MaxPathDepth      int
45	}
46
47	// DefaultLimits returns the maximum policy supported by this binary.
48	func DefaultLimits() Limits {
49		return Limits{
50			MaxFiles:          CompiledMaxFiles,
51			MaxFileBytes:      CompiledMaxFileBytes,
52			MaxTotalBytes:     CompiledMaxTotalBytes,
53			MaxPathBytes:      CompiledMaxPathBytes,
54			MaxComponentBytes: CompiledMaxComponentBytes,
55			MaxPathDepth:      CompiledMaxPathDepth,
56		}
57	}
58
59	// Validate rejects incomplete policy and values above the compiled ceilings.
60	func (limits Limits) Validate() error {
61		maximum := DefaultLimits()
62		switch {
63		case limits.MaxFiles <= 0 || limits.MaxFiles > maximum.MaxFiles:
64			return fmt.Errorf("max files %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxFiles, maximum.MaxFiles, ErrInvalidLimits)
65		case limits.MaxFileBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxFileBytes > maximum.MaxFileBytes:
66			return fmt.Errorf("max file bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxFileBytes, maximum.MaxFileBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
67		case limits.MaxTotalBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxTotalBytes > maximum.MaxTotalBytes:
68			return fmt.Errorf("max total bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxTotalBytes, maximum.MaxTotalBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
69		case limits.MaxPathBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxPathBytes > maximum.MaxPathBytes:
70			return fmt.Errorf("max path bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxPathBytes, maximum.MaxPathBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
71		case limits.MaxComponentBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes > maximum.MaxComponentBytes:
72			return fmt.Errorf("max component bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxComponentBytes, maximum.MaxComponentBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
73		case limits.MaxPathDepth <= 0 || limits.MaxPathDepth > maximum.MaxPathDepth:
74			return fmt.Errorf("max path depth %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxPathDepth, maximum.MaxPathDepth, ErrInvalidLimits)
75		default:
76			return nil
77		}
78	}
79
80	// PathLimits projects the filesystem path portion of a validated policy.
81	func (limits Limits) PathLimits() pathx.PortablePathLimits {
82		return pathx.PortablePathLimits{
83			MaxPathBytes:      limits.MaxPathBytes,
84			MaxComponentBytes: limits.MaxComponentBytes,
85			MaxDepth:          limits.MaxPathDepth,
86		}
87	}
88
89	// Metadata is the content-free portion of one portable regular file used for
90	// validating counts, sizes, paths, and collisions before any bytes are opened.
91	type Metadata struct {
92		Path string
93		Size int64
94	}
95
96	// ValidateManifest enforces a validated limits policy over the complete file
97	// set, including exact duplicates and portable case/normalization collisions.
98	func ValidateManifest(files []Metadata, limits Limits) error {
99		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
100			return err
101		}
102		if len(files) > limits.MaxFiles {
103			return fmt.Errorf("manifest has %d files; maximum is %d: %w", len(files), limits.MaxFiles, ErrManifestLimit)
104		}
105		paths := make([]string, 0, len(files))
106		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(files))
107		var total int64
108		for _, file := range files {
109			if file.Size < 0 {
110				return fmt.Errorf("file %q has negative size: %w", file.Path, ErrManifestLimit)
111			}
112			if file.Size > limits.MaxFileBytes {
113				return fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", file.Path, file.Size, limits.MaxFileBytes, ErrManifestLimit)
114			}
115			if _, exists := seen[file.Path]; exists {
116				return fmt.Errorf("path %q appears more than once: %w", file.Path, ErrDuplicatePath)
117			}
118			seen[file.Path] = struct{}{}
119			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
120			if file.Size > limits.MaxTotalBytes-total {
121				return fmt.Errorf("manifest exceeds %d total bytes: %w", limits.MaxTotalBytes, ErrManifestLimit)
122			}
123			total += file.Size
124		}
125		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
126			return err
127		}
128		return nil
129	}

1	package gitx

3	import (
4		"context"

8
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
10	)
11
12	// Worktree is one entry of `git worktree list --porcelain`.
13	type Worktree struct {
14		Path string
15		// Head is the commit the worktree is checked out at.
16		Head string
17		// Branch is the short branch name, empty when detached.
18		Branch   string
19		Detached bool
20		Bare     bool
21		// Locked reports a `git worktree lock`; Prunable reports a checkout whose
22		// directory has gone missing. Both block a plain remove.
23		Locked         bool
24		LockedReason   string
25		Prunable       bool
26		PrunableReason string
27		// Main reports the primary (non-linked) checkout.
28		Main bool
29	}
30
31	// Worktrees lists every worktree of the repository containing dir, in git's
32	// own order: the main checkout first, then linked worktrees.
33	func Worktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]Worktree, error) {
34		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
35		if err != nil {
36			return nil, err
37		}
38		var (
39			list []Worktree
40			cur  *Worktree
41		)
42		flush := func() {
43			if cur != nil {
44				list = append(list, *cur)
45				cur = nil
46			}
47		}
48		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
49			if line == "" { // records are blank-line separated
50				flush()
51				continue
52			}
53			key, val, _ := strings.Cut(line, " ")
54			switch key {
55			case "worktree":
56				flush()
57				cur = &Worktree{Path: val, Main: len(list) == 0}
58			case "HEAD":
59				if cur != nil {
60					cur.Head = val
61				}
62			case "branch":
63				if cur != nil {
64					cur.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(val, "refs/heads/")
65				}
66			case "detached":
67				if cur != nil {
68					cur.Detached = true
69				}
70			case "bare":
71				if cur != nil {
72					cur.Bare = true
73				}
74			case "locked":
75				if cur != nil {
76					cur.Locked, cur.LockedReason = true, val
77				}
78			case "prunable":
79				if cur != nil {
80					cur.Prunable, cur.PrunableReason = true, val
81				}
82			}
83		}
84		flush()
85		return list, nil
86	}
87
88	// WorktreeFor finds the worktree checked out on branch, if any. Git refuses to
89	// check the same branch out twice, so at most one can match.
90	func WorktreeFor(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) (Worktree, bool, error) {
91		list, err := Worktrees(ctx, dir)
92		if err != nil {
93			return Worktree{}, false, err
94		}
95		for _, w := range list {
96			if w.Branch == branch {
97				return w, true, nil
98			}
99		}
100		return Worktree{}, false, nil
101	}
102
103	// AddWorktree creates a linked worktree at path.
104	//
105	// When branch already exists it is checked out; otherwise it is created from
106	// base. Passing an explicit base matters: without one git branches from the
107	// *current* HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on feature/A would
108	// silently inherit feature/A's commits.
109	func AddWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path, branch, base string) error {
110		exists := BranchExists(ctx, dir, branch)
111		args := []string{"worktree", "add"}
112		if exists {
113			args = append(args, path, branch)
114		} else {
115			args = append(args, "-b", branch, path)
116			if base != "" {
117				args = append(args, base)
118			}
119		}
120		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
121		return err
122	}
123
124	// MoveWorktree relocates a linked worktree through Git so the shared
125	// administrative metadata keeps pointing at the checkout's new path. dir may
126	// be any checkout of the same repository.
127	func MoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, source, destination string) error {
128		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "move", source, destination)
129		return err
130	}
131
132	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
133	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
134	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
135		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
136		if err != nil {
137			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current directory before removing worktree: %w", err)
138		}
139		inside, err := pathx.Contains(path, cwd)
140		if err != nil {
141			return fmt.Errorf("compare current directory with worktree %s: %w", path, err)
142		}
143		if inside {
144			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to remove worktree %s while the caller is inside it", path)
145		}
146		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
147		if force {
148			args = append(args, "--force")
149		}
150		args = append(args, path)
151		_, err = run(ctx, dir, args...)
152		return err
153	}
154
155	// PruneWorktrees clears administrative entries for checkouts whose directories
156	// were deleted behind git's back.
157	func PruneWorktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {
158		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "prune")
159		return err
160	}
161
162	// BranchExists reports whether a local branch of that name exists.
163	func BranchExists(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) bool {
164		if branch == "" {
165			return false
166		}
167		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+branch)
168		return err == nil
169	}
170
171	// RefExists reports whether any ref or commit-ish resolves.
172	func RefExists(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) bool {
173		if ref == "" {
174			return false
175		}
176		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")
177		return err == nil
178	}

14	// RedactRemoteRef returns a terminal-safe remote reference for public display.
15	// URL userinfo, query, and fragment components are removed structurally. SSH
16	// usernames such as git@host remain visible, while an scp-like prefix containing
17	// a password/token separator is redacted. Invalid UTF-8, controls, malformed
18	// explicit URLs, and encoded path controls are replaced by a fixed label.
19	func RedactRemoteRef(ref string) string {

21			return unsafeRemoteLabel
22		}

30			return unsafeRemoteLabel
31		}
32		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && (explicitURL || parsed.Host != "" || strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file")) {
33			path, unescapeErr := url.PathUnescape(parsed.EscapedPath())
34			if unescapeErr != nil || !utf8.ValidString(path) || strings.IndexFunc(path, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
35				return unsafeRemoteLabel

37			parsed.User = nil
38			parsed.RawQuery = ""
39			parsed.ForceQuery = false
40			parsed.Fragment = ""
41			parsed.RawFragment = ""
42			redacted := parsed.String()

543		}
544		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
545			if user != "" && !strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && !strings.HasPrefix(remotePath, "/") {
546				remotePath = "~" + user + "/" + remotePath
547			}
548			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
549		}
550
551		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
552		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
553			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
554		}
555		return ""
556	}
557
558	func normalizeAzureDevOpsRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
559		if kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(identity); kind == forge.AzureDevOps && name != "" {
560			return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + name
561		}
562
563		// Records written before Azure support already contain the generic
564		// host/path form. Recognize it so existing catalog entries migrate on read.
565		trimmed := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSpace(identity), ".git"), "/")
566		parts := strings.Split(trimmed, "/")
567		decode := func(values []string) ([]string, bool) {
568			out := make([]string, len(values))
569			for i, value := range values {
570				decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(value)
571				if err != nil || decoded == "" || strings.Contains(decoded, "/") {
572					return nil, false
573				}
574				out[i] = decoded
575			}
576			return out, true
577		}
578		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "dev.azure.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[3], "_git") {
579			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{parts[1], parts[2], parts[4]}); ok {
580				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
581			}
582		}
583		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "ssh.dev.azure.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[1], "v3") {
584			if decoded, ok := decode(parts[2:]); ok {
585				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
586			}
587		}
588		if len(parts) >= 4 && strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(parts[0]), ".visualstudio.com") &&
589			!strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[len(parts)-2], "_git") {
590			organization := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.ToLower(parts[0]), ".visualstudio.com")
591			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{organization, parts[len(parts)-3], parts[len(parts)-1]}); ok {
592				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
593			}
594		}
595		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com") &&
596			strings.HasPrefix(parts[1], "~") && strings.EqualFold(parts[3], "_ssh") {
597			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{strings.TrimPrefix(parts[1], "~"), parts[2], parts[4]}); ok {
598				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
599			}
600		}
601		return ""
602	}
603
604	func looksLikeLocalRemote(identity string) bool {
605		if filepath.IsAbs(identity) || strings.HasPrefix(identity, `\\`) {
606			return true
607		}
608		for _, prefix := range []string{"./", "../", "~/", `.\`, `..\`, `~\`} {
609			if strings.HasPrefix(identity, prefix) {
610				return true
611			}
612		}
613		if len(identity) >= 2 && identity[1] == ':' {
614			letter := identity[0]
615			if letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z' {
616				return true
617			}
618		}
619		return !strings.ContainsAny(identity, `/\:@`)

75	func LoadConfig(path string) (Config, error) {
76		cfg := DefaultConfig()
77		if path == "" {
78			path = ConfigFile()
79		}
80		metadata, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
81		switch {

84		case err != nil:

88			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: unknown field(s): %v", path, undecoded)
89		}
90		cfg.Source = path
91		cfg.ApplyDefaults()
92		if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
93			return cfg, err
94		}
95		return cfg, nil
96	}

113	func (c Config) Validate() error {
114		if c.SchemaVersion != ConfigSchemaVersion {
115			return fmt.Errorf("remotes schema_version %d: want %d", c.SchemaVersion, ConfigSchemaVersion)
116		}
117		if c.Defaults.MaxParallel <= 0 {
118			return errors.New("defaults.max_parallel must be positive")
119		}
120		if c.Defaults.ConnectTimeout.Duration <= 0 || c.Defaults.CommandTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
121			return errors.New("default timeouts must be positive")
122		}
123		seen := map[string]bool{}
124		for index, host := range c.Hosts {
125			if strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) == "" || host.Name != strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) {
126				return fmt.Errorf("hosts[%d].name is required and must be trimmed", index)
127			}
128			if seen[host.Name] {
129				return fmt.Errorf("duplicate host name %q", host.Name)
130			}
131			seen[host.Name] = true
132			if host.MachineID != "" {
133				if err := machineid.Validate(host.MachineID); err != nil {
134					return fmt.Errorf("host %q: %w", host.Name, err)
135				}
136			}
137			if host.SSHAlias == "" && host.Hostname == "" {
138				return fmt.Errorf("host %q must define ssh_alias or hostname", host.Name)
139			}
140			if host.Port < 0 || host.Port > 65535 {
141				return fmt.Errorf("host %q port %d is invalid", host.Name, host.Port)
142			}

144				return fmt.Errorf("host %q timeouts must be positive", host.Name)
145			}

148			}

150				return err
151			}
152		}

156	func validatePasswordSource(host string, source PasswordSource) error {
157		kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(source.Type))
158		if kind == "" {
159			kind = "none"
160		}
161		switch kind {
162		case "none", "prompt":
163			return nil
164		case "plain":
165			if source.Value == "" {
166				return fmt.Errorf("host %q plain ssh_login_password_source requires value", host)
167			}
168		case "bitwarden":
169			if source.Item == "" {
170				return fmt.Errorf("host %q bitwarden ssh_login_password_source requires item", host)
171			}
172		default:
173			return fmt.Errorf("host %q ssh_login_password_source.type %q: want none, plain, prompt or bitwarden", host, source.Type)
174		}
175		return nil
176	}

196	func CheckPrivateMode(path string, cfg Config) error {

213		}

215	}

114	func resolveFleetOpenRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, request fleet.OpenRequest) (repo.Repo, error) {
115		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
116		if err != nil {
117			return repo.Repo{}, err
118		}
119		var matches []repo.Repo
120		wantedIdentity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(request.RemoteIdentity)
121		for _, repository := range repositories {
122			if request.Path != "" && (sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.Path) || sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.RealPath)) {
123				return repository, nil
124			}
125			if wantedIdentity == "" {
126				continue
127			}
128			topology, topologyErr := gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
129			if topologyErr == nil && matchingSnapshotIdentity(topology, wantedIdentity) {
130				matches = append(matches, repository)
131			}
132		}
133		if len(matches) == 1 {
134			return matches[0], nil
135		}
136		if len(matches) > 1 {
137			return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("remote identity matches multiple repositories")
138		}
139		return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is no longer discoverable", request.Name)
140	}
