142	func matchingSnapshotIdentity(topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) bool {
143		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {

145				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == identity {
146					return true
147				}
148			}
149		}
150		return false
151	}

861	func newFleetConfigInitCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
862		var force, stdout bool
863		cmd := &cobra.Command{Use: "init", Short: "Write a starter remotes.toml", Args: cobra.NoArgs, RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
864			if stdout {
865				fmt.Fprint(app.Out, fleetStarterConfig)
866				return nil
867			}
868			path := fleetConfigPath(app)
869			if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil && !force {
870				return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists (use --force to overwrite)", config.Contract(path))

872			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
873				return err
874			}
875			if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(fleetStarterConfig), 0o600); err != nil {
876				return err
877			}
878			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "wrote %s\n", config.Contract(path))
879			return nil
880		}}
881		cmd.Flags().BoolVarP(&force, "force", "f", false, "overwrite an existing file")
882		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&stdout, "stdout", false, "print without writing")
883		return cmd
884	}

887	// seeding the starter file when there is none. The TUI runs the same command

893				return nil, err
894			}

898			}

23	var ErrProtocolLimit = errors.New("fleet protocol size limit exceeded")

25	// FileLimits is the wire representation of a target's downward-clamped
26	// portable-file policy. It deliberately does not carry include patterns.
27	type FileLimits struct {
28		MaxFiles          int   `json:"max_files"`
29		MaxFileBytes      int64 `json:"max_file_bytes"`
30		MaxTotalBytes     int64 `json:"max_total_bytes"`
31		MaxPathBytes      int   `json:"max_path_bytes"`
32		MaxComponentBytes int   `json:"max_component_bytes"`
33		MaxPathDepth      int   `json:"max_path_depth"`
34	}

36	func (l FileLimits) Validate() error {
37		switch {
38		case l.MaxFiles <= 0:
39			return errors.New("max_files must be positive")
40		case l.MaxFileBytes <= 0:
41			return errors.New("max_file_bytes must be positive")
42		case l.MaxTotalBytes <= 0:
43			return errors.New("max_total_bytes must be positive")
44		case l.MaxPathBytes <= 0:
45			return errors.New("max_path_bytes must be positive")
46		case l.MaxComponentBytes <= 0:
47			return errors.New("max_component_bytes must be positive")
48		case l.MaxPathDepth <= 0:
49			return errors.New("max_path_depth must be positive")
50		default:
51			return nil
52		}
53	}
54
55	// CapabilityRequest is content-free and is always exchanged before any
56	// feature payload.
57	type CapabilityRequest struct {
58		SchemaVersion   int    `json:"schema_version"`
59		Feature         string `json:"feature"`
60		ProtocolVersion int    `json:"protocol_version"`
61	}
62
63	func LocalFilesCapabilityRequest() CapabilityRequest {

70	func (r CapabilityRequest) Validate() error {
71		if r.SchemaVersion != ProtocolSchemaVersion {
72			return fmt.Errorf("capability schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, ProtocolSchemaVersion)
73		}
74		if r.Feature != "local-files" {
75			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported capability feature %q", r.Feature)
76		}
77		if r.ProtocolVersion != LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
78			return fmt.Errorf("local-files protocol_version %d: want %d", r.ProtocolVersion, LocalFilesProtocolVersion)
79		}
80		return nil
81	}

83	// CapabilityResponse contains only non-secret host facts. Unsupported native
84	// platforms return a stable reason before the caller constructs a payload.
85	type CapabilityResponse struct {
86		SchemaVersion   int        `json:"schema_version"`
87		Feature         string     `json:"feature"`
88		ProtocolVersion int        `json:"protocol_version"`
89		MachineID       string     `json:"machine_id"`
90		Platform        string     `json:"platform"`
91		Supported       bool       `json:"supported"`
92		Reason          string     `json:"reason,omitempty"`
93		Limits          FileLimits `json:"limits"`
94	}
95
96	func (r CapabilityResponse) Validate(request CapabilityRequest) error {
97		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
98			return err
99		}
100		if r.SchemaVersion != request.SchemaVersion || r.Feature != request.Feature || r.ProtocolVersion != request.ProtocolVersion {
101			return errors.New("capability response does not match the request")
102		}
103		if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
104			return err
105		}
106		if r.Platform == "" {

108		}
109		if r.Supported {
110			if r.Reason != "" {
111				return errors.New("supported capability must not include a reason")
112			}
113			if err := r.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
114				return fmt.Errorf("capability limits: %w", err)
115			}
116		} else if r.Reason == "" {
117			return errors.New("unsupported capability has no reason")
118		}
119		return nil
120	}
121
122	// DecodeStrict reads exactly one bounded JSON value, rejects unknown fields,
123	// and requires EOF after optional JSON whitespace.
124	func DecodeStrict(reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
125		if reader == nil || target == nil {
126			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a reader and target")
127		}
128		if maxBytes <= 0 {
129			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a positive limit")
130		}
131		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maxBytes+1))
132		if err != nil {
133			return fmt.Errorf("read fleet protocol: %w", err)
134		}
135		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
136			return fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
137		}
138		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
139		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
140		if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
141			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol: %w", err)
142		}
143		var extra any
144		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
145			if err == nil {
146				return errors.New("decode fleet protocol: multiple JSON values")
147			}
148			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol trailing data: %w", err)
149		}
150		return nil
151	}
152
153	// MarshalBounded encodes one protocol value and enforces the matching bound
154	// before it can be handed to Transport.
155	func MarshalBounded(value any, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
156		if maxBytes <= 0 {
157			return nil, errors.New("fleet protocol encode requires a positive limit")
158		}
159		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode fleet protocol: %w", err)
162		}
163		if int64(len(data))+1 > maxBytes {
164			return nil, fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
165		}
166		return append(data, '\n'), nil
167	}
168
169	// UnmarshalStrict applies DecodeStrict to an in-memory transport response.
170	func UnmarshalStrict(data []byte, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
171		return DecodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(data), maxBytes, target)
172	}

13		ErrRemoteTimeout   = errors.New("target protocol timed out")
14		ErrMachinePin      = errors.New("target machine ID does not match the configured host pin")
15		ErrMachineUnpinned = errors.New("mutating local-file apply requires host.machine_id")
16	)

18	type Runner interface {
19		RunWithOptions(context.Context, fleet.Host, []string, []byte, fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result
20	}
21
22	type Client struct{ Runner Runner }
23
24	func (c Client) run(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, maxResponse int64) ([]byte, error) {
25		if c.Runner == nil {
26			return nil, errors.New("local-files client has no fleet transport")
27		}
28		// Capability and plan are read-only. Apply is permanently bound to its
29		// request ID and plan digest by the target journal, so an authentication-only
30		// retry cannot duplicate an unbound mutation.
31		result := c.Runner.RunWithOptions(ctx, host, args, stdin, fleet.RunOptions{Retry: fleet.RetryAuthentication})
32		if int64(len(result.Stdout)) > maxResponse {
33			return nil, errors.New("target protocol response exceeded its bound")
34		}
35		if result.ExitCode == 0 && result.CaptureError == "" {
36			return result.Stdout, nil
37		}
38		switch {
39		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
40			return nil, ErrRemoteTimeout
41		case result.ExitCode == 127:
42			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
43		case result.ExitCode == 255:
44			return nil, ErrUnreachable
45		default:
46			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
47		}
48	}
49
50	func (c Client) Probe(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
51		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
52		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
53		if err != nil {
54			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
55		}
56		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_capability"}, body, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
57		if err != nil {
58			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
59		}
60		var response fleet.CapabilityResponse
61		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes, &response); err != nil {
62			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
63		}
64		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
65			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
66		}
67		if host.MachineID != "" && host.MachineID != response.MachineID {
68			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
69		}
70		if !response.Supported {
71			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, errors.New("target does not support local-file payloads")
72		}
73		return response, nil
74	}
75
76	func (c Client) Plan(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
77		if capability.MachineID != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
78			return PlanResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
79		}
80		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
81			return PlanResponse{}, err
82		}
83		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
84		if err != nil {
85			return PlanResponse{}, err
86		}
87		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-plan"}, body, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
88		if err != nil {

90		}
91		var response PlanResponse
92		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes, &response); err != nil {
93			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
94		}
95		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
96			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
97		}
98		return response, nil
99	}
100
101	func (c Client) Apply(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
102		if host.MachineID == "" {
103			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachineUnpinned
104		}
105		if host.MachineID != capability.MachineID || envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine != capability.MachineID {
106			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
107		}
108		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
109			return ApplyResponse{}, err
110		}
111		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(envelope, MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes)
112		if err != nil {
113			return ApplyResponse{}, err
114		}
115		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-apply"}, body, MaxApplyResponseBytes)
116		if err != nil {
117			return ApplyResponse{}, err
118		}
119		var response ApplyResponse
120		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxApplyResponseBytes, &response); err != nil {
121			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
122		}
123		if err := response.Validate(envelope.Request, envelope.Plan); err != nil {
124			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
125		}
126		return response, nil

13	type recordedCall struct {
14		args  []string
15		stdin []byte

19	type recordingRunner struct {
20		results []fleet.Result
21		calls   []recordedCall
22	}
23
24	func (r *recordingRunner) RunWithOptions(_ context.Context, _ fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, options fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result {
25		r.calls = append(r.calls, recordedCall{args: append([]string(nil), args...), stdin: append([]byte(nil), stdin...), retry: options.Retry})
26		if len(r.results) == 0 {
27			return fleet.Result{ExitCode: 127}
28		}
29		result := r.results[0]
30		r.results = r.results[1:]
31		return result
32	}

34	func capabilityResult(t *testing.T, machineID string, supported bool, reason string) fleet.Result {
35		t.Helper()
36		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
37		response := fleet.CapabilityResponse{
38			SchemaVersion: request.SchemaVersion, Feature: request.Feature,
39			ProtocolVersion: request.ProtocolVersion, MachineID: machineID,
40			Platform: "linux", Supported: supported, Reason: reason,
41			Limits: limitsToWire(safefileDefault()),
42		}
43		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(response, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
44		if err != nil {
45			t.Fatal(err)
46		}
47		return fleet.Result{ExitCode: 0, Stdout: body}
48	}

108	func TestFleetFilesFakeSSHProcess(t *testing.T) {
109		if os.Getenv("DEV_FAKE_SSH") != "1" {
110			return
111		}
112		remoteCommand := os.Args[len(os.Args)-1]
113		helper := ""
114		for _, candidate := range []string{"_capability", "_files-plan", "_files-apply"} {
115			if strings.Contains(remoteCommand, "'"+candidate+"'") {
116				helper = candidate
117				break
118			}
119		}
120		if helper == "" {
121			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "unsupported fake SSH command")
122			os.Exit(127)
123		}
124		log, err := os.OpenFile(os.Getenv("DEV_FAKE_SSH_LOG"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
125		if err == nil {
126			fmt.Fprintln(log, helper)
127			_ = log.Close()
128		}
129		remoteHome := os.Getenv("DEV_FAKE_SSH_REMOTE_HOME")
130		_ = os.Setenv("HOME", remoteHome)
131		_ = os.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(remoteHome, ".config"))
132		_ = os.Setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", filepath.Join(remoteHome, ".local", "share"))
133		_ = os.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", filepath.Join(remoteHome, ".cache"))
134		root := cli.NewRootCommandWithIO(os.Stdout, os.Stderr)
135		root.SetArgs([]string{"--config", os.Getenv("DEV_FAKE_SSH_TARGET_CONFIG"), "fleet", helper})
136		if err := root.Execute(); err != nil {
137			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "remote protocol failed")
138			os.Exit(2)
139		}
140		os.Exit(0)
141	}

16	type UncommitReceipt struct {

18		Parent  string    `json:"parent"`

35	func InProgress(dir string) (string, bool, error) {
36		repository, err := Discover(context.Background(), dir)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", false, err
39		}
40		// REBASE_HEAD is deliberately absent: Git leaves it behind after a rebase
41		// *completes*, so treating it as evidence would permanently block every
42		// worktree that was ever rebased. Only the rebase state directories prove
43		// a rebase is still running.
44		for _, candidate := range []string{
45			"MERGE_HEAD", "CHERRY_PICK_HEAD", "REVERT_HEAD",
46			"rebase-merge", "rebase-apply", "sequencer",
47		} {
48			for _, root := range []string{repository.GitDir, repository.GitCommonDir} {
49				if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(root, candidate)); err == nil {
50					return candidate, true, nil
51				} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
52					return "", false, err
53				}
54			}
55		}
56		return "", false, nil
57	}
58
59	func Uncommit(ctx context.Context, dir string, rewritePublished bool) (*UncommitReceipt, error) {
60		repository, status, err := transactionPreflight(ctx, dir, rewritePublished)
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, err
63		}
64		if status.Staged > 0 {
65			return nil, fmt.Errorf("uncommit requires an empty index so existing staged work is not mixed")
66		}
67		line, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", "HEAD")
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, err
70		}
71		fields := strings.Fields(line)
72		if len(fields) != 2 {
73			if len(fields) == 1 {
74				return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot uncommit the root commit")
75			}
76			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot uncommit a merge commit; parent topology would be lost")
77		}
78		receipt := &UncommitReceipt{OldOID: fields[0], Parent: fields[1], Branch: status.Branch, Created: time.Now().UTC()}
79		path := uncommitReceiptPath(repository.GitDir)
80		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("an uncommit receipt already exists; run dev git recommit first")
82		} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
83			return nil, err
84		}
85		if err := writeJSONAtomic(path, receipt); err != nil {
86			return nil, err
87		}
88		if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "reset", "--soft", receipt.Parent); err != nil {
89			_ = os.Remove(path)
90			return nil, err
91		}
92		return receipt, nil
93	}
94
95	func Recommit(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, error) {
96		repository, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", err
99		}
100		if operation, active, err := InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
101			return "", err
102		} else if active {
103			return "", fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
104		}
105		path := uncommitReceiptPath(repository.GitDir)
106		receipt, err := readReceipt(path)
107		if err != nil {
108			return "", err
109		}
110		status, err := StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
111		if err != nil {
112			return "", err
113		}
114		if status.Detached || status.Branch != receipt.Branch {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", receipt.Branch, status.Branch)
116		}
117		if status.Staged == 0 {
118			return "", fmt.Errorf("nothing is staged to recommit")
119		}
120		head, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
121		if err != nil {
122			return "", err
123		}
124		if head != receipt.Parent {
125			return "", fmt.Errorf("HEAD changed since uncommit: expected %s, got %s", receipt.Parent, head)
126		}
127		if !RefExists(ctx, repository.Root, receipt.OldOID) {
128			return "", fmt.Errorf("original commit %s is no longer available", receipt.OldOID)
129		}
130		if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "commit", "-C", receipt.OldOID); err != nil {
131			return "", err
132		}
133		commit, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
134		if err != nil {
135			return "", err
136		}
137		if err := os.Remove(path); err != nil {
138			return "", fmt.Errorf("commit created, but remove uncommit receipt: %w", err)
139		}
140		return commit, nil
141	}
142
143	func PullRebase(ctx context.Context, dir string) (PullRebaseResult, error) {
144		repository, status, err := transactionPreflight(ctx, dir, true)
145		if err != nil {
146			return PullRebaseResult{}, err
147		}
148		if status.Upstream == "" {
149			return PullRebaseResult{}, fmt.Errorf("branch %s has no upstream", status.Branch)
150		}
151		var result PullRebaseResult
152		lockDir := filepath.Join(repository.GitCommonDir, "dev-git-transactions")
153		err = lockx.WithDir(ctx, lockDir, "git transaction", func() error {
154			current, err := StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
155			if err != nil {
156				return err
157			}
158			if current.Dirty() {
159				result.HadLocalWork = true
160				tag := fmt.Sprintf("dev-pull-rebase-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
161				if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "stash", "push", "--include-untracked", "-m", tag); err != nil {
162					return err
163				}
164				result.StashOID, err = stashOIDForTag(ctx, repository.Root, tag)
165				if err != nil {
166					return fmt.Errorf("capture created stash oid: %w", err)
167				}
168				if result.StashOID == "" {
169					return fmt.Errorf("Git reported local work but created no stash; refusing to reuse an existing stash")
170				}
171			}
172			if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "-c", "rebase.autoStash=false", "pull", "--rebase"); err != nil {
173				return fmt.Errorf("pull --rebase failed; local work remains in stash %s: %w", result.StashOID, err)
174			}
175			if result.StashOID == "" {
176				return nil
177			}
178			if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "stash", "apply", "--index", result.StashOID); err != nil {
179				return fmt.Errorf("restore local work from stash %s failed; stash retained: %w", result.StashOID, err)
180			}
181			result.Restored = true
182			selector, ok, err := stashSelector(ctx, repository.Root, result.StashOID)
183			if err != nil {
184				return err
185			}
186			if !ok {
187				return nil // Applied bytes are safe; retaining an extra stash beats dropping the wrong one.
188			}
189			if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "stash", "drop", selector); err != nil {
190				return fmt.Errorf("local work restored, but exact stash %s was retained: %w", result.StashOID, err)
191			}
192			result.Dropped = true
193			return nil
194		})
195		return result, err
196	}

198	func AmendAll(ctx context.Context, dir string, options AmendOptions) (string, []string, error) {
199		repository, _, err := transactionPreflight(ctx, dir, options.RewritePublished)
200		if err != nil {

256			paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:]))

284	func transactionPreflight(ctx context.Context, dir string, rewritePublished bool) (Repo, Status, error) {
285		repository, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
286		if err != nil {
287			return Repo{}, Status{}, err
288		}
289		if repository.Bare {
290			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("transaction requires a working tree")
291		}
292		status, err := StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
293		if err != nil {
294			return Repo{}, Status{}, err
295		}
296		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
297			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("transaction refuses detached HEAD")
298		}
299		if status.Conflicted > 0 {
300			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("transaction refuses %d conflicted path(s)", status.Conflicted)
301		}
302		if operation, active, err := InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
303			return Repo{}, Status{}, err
304		} else if active {
305			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
306		}
307		if status.Published() && status.Ahead == 0 && !rewritePublished {
308			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("HEAD is already contained in %s; pass --rewrite-published to acknowledge rewriting it", status.Upstream)
309		}
310		return repository, status, nil
311	}

315	func readReceipt(path string) (*UncommitReceipt, error) {
316		file, err := os.Open(path)
317		if err != nil {
318			return nil, err
319		}
320		defer file.Close()
321		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
322		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
323		var receipt UncommitReceipt
324		if err := decoder.Decode(&receipt); err != nil {
325			return nil, err
326		}
327		if receipt.OldOID == "" || receipt.Parent == "" || receipt.Branch == "" {
328			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid uncommit receipt")
329		}
330		return &receipt, nil
331	}

333	func writeJSONAtomic(path string, value any) error {
334		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".dev-receipt-*.tmp")
335		if err != nil {
336			return err
337		}
338		name := tmp.Name()
339		defer os.Remove(name)
340		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
341			tmp.Close()
342			return err
343		}
344		if err := json.NewEncoder(tmp).Encode(value); err != nil {
345			tmp.Close()
346			return err
347		}
348		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
349			return err
350		}
351		return os.Rename(name, path)
352	}

354	func stashSelector(ctx context.Context, dir, oid string) (string, bool, error) {
355		out, err := Run(ctx, dir, "stash", "list", "--format=%H%x09%gd")
356		if err != nil {
357			return "", false, err
358		}
359		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
360			got, selector, ok := strings.Cut(line, "\t")
361			if ok && got == oid {
362				return selector, true, nil
363			}
364		}
365		return "", false, nil
366	}

368	func stashOIDForTag(ctx context.Context, dir, tag string) (string, error) {
369		out, err := Run(ctx, dir, "stash", "list", "--format=%H%x09%gs")
370		if err != nil {
371			return "", err
372		}
373		var match string
374		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
375			oid, subject, ok := strings.Cut(line, "\t")
376			if !ok || !strings.HasSuffix(subject, ": "+tag) {
377				continue
378			}
379			if match != "" && match != oid {
380				return "", fmt.Errorf("multiple stashes matched transaction tag %s", tag)
381			}
382			match = oid
383		}
384		return match, nil
385	}

390				values[j], values[j-1] = values[j-1], values[j]
391			}

244	// only then does a substring search run — so a repo literally named "web"
245	// is never shadowed by "web-frontend".
246	func Resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {

256	func resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string, opts Options) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
257		all, err := Discover(ctx, roots, opts)
258		if err != nil {
259			return Repo{}, nil, err
260		}
261		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
262			if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, abs); err == nil {
263				real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs)
264				if real == "" {
265					real = g.MainRoot
266				}
267				// Preserve an explicit navigation alias. The caller named this
268				// path on purpose; resolving it to the physical checkout would
269				// defeat a bootstrap symlink catalog.
270				return Repo{
271					Name: filepath.Base(abs), Path: abs, RealPath: real,
272					Symlink: real != abs, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
273				}, nil, nil
274			}
275		}
276		for _, r := range all {
277			if r.Name == ref || r.Display() == ref || r.Path == ref {
278				return r, nil, nil
279			}
280		}
281		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
282		var hits []Repo
283		for _, r := range all {
284			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Display()), needle) {
285				hits = append(hits, r)
286			}
287		}
288		switch len(hits) {
289		case 1:
290			return hits[0], nil, nil
291		case 0:
292			return Repo{}, nil, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref}
293		default:
294			return Repo{}, hits, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: hits}
295		}
296	}

package os // import "os"

type Root struct {
    // Has unexported fields.
}
    Root may be used to only access files within a single directory tree.

    Methods on Root can only access files and directories beneath a root
    directory. If any component of a file name passed to a method of Root
    references a location outside the root, the method returns an error.
    File names may reference the directory itself (.).

    Methods on Root will follow symbolic links, but symbolic links may not
    reference a location outside the root. Symbolic links must not be absolute.

    Methods on Root do not prohibit traversal of filesystem boundaries, Linux
    bind mounts, /proc special files, or access to Unix device files.

    Methods on Root are safe to be used from multiple goroutines simultaneously.

    On most platforms, creating a Root opens a file descriptor or handle
    referencing the directory. If the directory is moved, methods on Root
    reference the original directory in its new location.

    Root's behavior differs on some platforms:

      - When GOOS=windows, file names may not reference Windows reserved device
        names such as NUL and COM1.
      - On Unix, Root.Chmod, Root.Chown, and Root.Chtimes are vulnerable to a
        race condition. If the target of the operation is changed from a regular
        file to a symlink while the operation is in progress, the operation may
        be performed on the link rather than the link target.
      - When GOOS=js, Root is vulnerable to TOCTOU (time-of-check-time-of-use)
        attacks in symlink validation, and cannot ensure that operations will
        not escape the root.
      - When GOOS=plan9 or GOOS=js, Root does not track directories across
        renames. On these platforms, a Root references a directory name,
        not a file descriptor.
      - WASI preview 1 (GOOS=wasip1) does not support Root.Chmod.

14	// Repo is a scratch repository under t.TempDir().
15	type Repo struct {
16		T    *testing.T
17		Root string
18	}

20	// New initialises a repository with one commit on branch "main".
21	func New(t *testing.T) *Repo {
22		t.Helper()
23		// Windows hands back an 8.3 short path (C:\Users\RUNNER~1\...) that git then
24		// reports in its long form, so canonicalize once up front.
25		tempDir := t.TempDir()
26		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(tempDir); err == nil {
27			tempDir = resolved
28		}
29		root := filepath.Join(tempDir, "repo")
30		if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o755); err != nil {
31			t.Fatal(err)
32		}
33		r := &Repo{T: t, Root: root}
34		r.Git("init", "--initial-branch=main")
35		// Identity and signing are configured locally so the test never depends on
36		// (or is broken by) the developer's global git config.
37		r.Git("config", "user.email", "dev@example.test")
38		r.Git("config", "user.name", "dev test")
39		r.Git("config", "commit.gpgsign", "false")
40		// Keep line endings and symlinks byte-for-byte on every platform; the
41		// Windows CI runner defaults core.autocrlf to true.
42		r.Git("config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
43		r.Git("config", "core.symlinks", "true")
44		r.Write("README.md", "# test repo\n")
45		r.Git("add", "README.md")
46		r.Git("commit", "-m", "chore: initial commit")
47		return r
48	}
49
50	// Git runs a git command in the repo root and fails the test on error.
51	func (r *Repo) Git(args ...string) string {
52		r.T.Helper()
53		return r.GitIn(r.Root, args...)
54	}

56	// GitIn runs a git command in an arbitrary directory (e.g. a linked worktree).
57	func (r *Repo) GitIn(dir string, args ...string) string {
58		r.T.Helper()
59		cmd := exec.Command("git", args...)
60		cmd.Dir = dir
61		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
62			"GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="+os.DevNull, // ignore the developer's ~/.gitconfig
63			"GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM="+os.DevNull,

66		)
67		out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
68		if err != nil {

70		}

package gitx_test

import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
    "slices"
    "testing"

    "github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
    "github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx/gittest"
)

func TestRecoverySnapshotCapturesHiddenTrackedBytesAndRepositoryState(t *testing.T) {
    repository := gittest.New(t)
    repository.Git("update-ref", "refs/recovery/custom", repository.Git("rev-parse", "HEAD"))
    repository.Write(".gitignore", ".env\n")
    repository.Git("add", ".gitignore")
    repository.Git("commit", "-m", "test: add ignore rules")
    repository.Write(".env", "private\n")
    if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(repository.Root, "nested"), 0o755); err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(repository.Root, "nested", ".git"), []byte("gitdir: elsewhere\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    repository.Git("update-index", "--assume-unchanged", "README.md")
    hiddenBody := []byte("hidden working tree edit\n")
    if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(repository.Root, "README.md"), hiddenBody, 0o644); err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }

    snapshot, err := gitx.RecoverySnapshotOf(t.Context(), repository.Root)
    if err != nil {
        t.Fatal(err)
    }
    if snapshot.Completeness != gitx.RecoveryCompletenessComplete {
        t.Fatalf("snapshot completeness = %s; findings=%+v", snapshot.Completeness, snapshot.Findings)
    }
    if snapshot.ObjectFormat == "" || len(snapshot.Worktrees) != 1 || len(snapshot.AdminRoots) != 1 {
        t.Fatalf("snapshot envelope = format %q, worktrees %d, admin roots %d", snapshot.ObjectFormat, len(snapshot.Worktrees), len(snapshot.AdminRoots))
    }
    if !slices.ContainsFunc(snapshot.Refs, func(ref gitx.RecoveryRef) bool {
        return ref.Name == "refs/recovery/custom" && ref.Kind == gitx.RecoveryRefOther
    }) {
        t.Fatalf("custom ref missing: %+v", snapshot.Refs)
    }

    worktree := snapshot.Worktrees[0]
    if worktree.Presence != gitx.RecoveryPresencePresent || worktree.GitDir == "" {
        t.Fatalf("worktree identity = %+v", worktree)
    }
    if !slices.Contains(worktree.IgnoredPaths, ".env") {
        t.Fatalf("ignored paths = %v", worktree.IgnoredPaths)
    }
    if !slices.ContainsFunc(worktree.IndexEntries, func(entry gitx.RecoveryIndexEntry) bool {
        return entry.Path == "README.md" && entry.AssumeUnchanged
    }) {
        t.Fatalf("assume-unchanged index entry missing: %+v", worktree.IndexEntries)
    }
    tracked, ok := snapshot.RawTrackedBytes(worktree.Path, "README.md")
    if !ok || string(tracked) != string(hiddenBody) {
        t.Fatalf("raw tracked bytes = %q, %v", tracked, ok)
    }
    tracked[0] = 'X'
    again, ok := snapshot.RawTrackedBytes(worktree.Path, "README.md")
    if !ok || string(again) != string(hiddenBody) {
        t.Fatal("RawTrackedBytes did not return a defensive copy")
    }
    if !slices.ContainsFunc(worktree.NestedRepositories, func(nested gitx.RecoveryNestedRepository) bool {
        return nested.Path == "nested" && nested.MarkerType == gitx.RecoveryEntryRegular
    }) || !hasRecoveryFinding(snapshot, "nested-repository") {
        t.Fatalf("nested repository evidence = %+v; findings=%+v", worktree.NestedRepositories, snapshot.Findings)
    }
    config, ok := snapshot.RawAdminBytes(gitx.RecoveryAdminCommonDir, "config")
    if !ok || len(config) == 0 {
        t.Fatal("Git config was not retained as private admin bytes")
    }
}

func TestRecoverySnapshotCancellationIsExplicit(t *testing.T) {
    repository := gittest.New(t)
    ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
    cancel()
    snapshot, err := gitx.RecoverySnapshotOf(ctx, repository.Root)
    if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
        t.Fatalf("cancellation error = %v", err)
    }
    if snapshot.Completeness == gitx.RecoveryCompletenessComplete || !hasRecoveryFinding(snapshot, "collection-cancelled") {
        t.Fatalf("cancelled snapshot = completeness %s, findings %+v", snapshot.Completeness, snapshot.Findings)
    }
}

func hasRecoveryFinding(snapshot gitx.RecoverySnapshot, code string) bool {
    return slices.ContainsFunc(snapshot.Findings, func(finding gitx.RecoveryFinding) bool {
        return finding.Code == code && finding.Blocking
    })
}

127			entry := journalFile{Path: file.spec.Path, Size: file.spec.Size, Mode: file.spec.Mode, Action: file.planned.Action, State: file.planned.State}
128			if entry.Action == actionReplace {
129				entry.OldSHA256 = file.before.digest
130				entry.OldMode = file.planned.TargetMode
131			}
132			value.Files = append(value.Files, entry)
133		}
134		if err := store.writeManifest(envelope); err != nil {
135			return ApplyResponse{}, err
136		}
137		for index, file := range files {
138			if file.planned.Action != actionCurrent || envelope.RetainForEvict {
139				if err := store.writeBlob(store.blobPath(index), file.content, file.spec.executable()); err != nil {
140					return ApplyResponse{}, err
141				}
142			}
143			if file.planned.Action == actionReplace {
144				if err := store.writeBlob(store.rollbackPath(index), file.before.data, file.before.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0); err != nil {
145					return ApplyResponse{}, err
146				}
147			}
148		}
149		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
150			return ApplyResponse{}, err
151		}
152		if err := s.fault("after-stage", ""); err != nil {
153			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
154		}
155		value.Phase = phaseApplying
156		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
157			return ApplyResponse{}, err
158		}
159
160		for index, file := range files {
161			if file.planned.Action == actionCurrent {
162				value.Files[index].State = StateCurrent
163				continue
164			}
165			if err := s.fault("before-publish", file.spec.Path); err != nil {
166				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
167			}
168			parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, file.spec.Path, true)
169			if err != nil {
170				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
171			}
172			name := pathBase(file.spec.Path)
173			switch file.planned.Action {
174			case actionCreate:
175				_, err = safefile.CreatePrivateNoClobber(ctx, parent.parent, name, file.content, file.spec.executable())
176			case actionReplace:
177				_, err = safefile.AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx, parent.parent, name, file.before.info, file.content, file.spec.executable())
178			default:
179				err = errors.New("invalid local-files publication action")
180			}
181			closeErr := parent.close()
182			err = errors.Join(err, closeErr)
183			if err != nil {
184				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
185			}
186			if err := s.fault("after-publish", file.spec.Path); err != nil {
187				// The journal may not yet say Published. rollback infers publication
188				// from the exact old/new digests, which covers this crash boundary.
189				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
190			}
191			value.Files[index].Published = true
192			if file.planned.Action == actionCreate {
193				value.Files[index].State = StateCreated
194			} else {
195				value.Files[index].State = StateReplaced
196			}
197			if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
198				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
199			}
200		}
201		if err := s.fault("before-final-verify", ""); err != nil {
202			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
203		}
204		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
205			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
206		}
207		if err := s.fault("before-complete", ""); err != nil {
208			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
209		}
210		value.Phase = phaseCompleted
211		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
212			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
213		}
214		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(envelope.RetainForEvict); err != nil {
215			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("local-files apply completed but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
216		}
217		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
218	}

229	func preflightApply(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope) ([]preflightFile, []string, error) {
230		payloads := map[string][]byte{}
231		for _, payload := range envelope.Payloads {
232			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
233			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
234				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("decode canonical payload for %q", payload.Path)
235			}
236			payloads[payload.Path] = decoded
237		}
238		files := make([]preflightFile, len(envelope.Request.Files))
239		missingSet := map[string]bool{}
240		for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
241			planned := envelope.Plan.Files[index]
242			if planned.Action == "" {
243				return nil, nil, ErrPlanBlocked
244			}
245			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
246				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
247			}
248			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
249			if err != nil {
250				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
251			}
252			file := preflightFile{spec: spec, planned: planned, before: observed}
253			switch planned.Action {
254			case actionCurrent:
255				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
256					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q is no longer current: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
257				}
258				file.content = observed.data
259			case actionCreate:
260				if observed.exists {
261					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q appeared after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
262				}
263				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
264			case actionReplace:
265				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != planned.TargetSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
266					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed before replacement: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
267				}
268				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
269			default:
270				return nil, nil, errors.New("invalid local-files target action")
271			}
272			if int64(len(file.content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(file.content) != spec.SHA256 {
273				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("content for %q no longer matches the plan", spec.Path)
274			}
275			missing, err := missingParentDirectories(checkout, spec.Path)
276			if err != nil {
277				return nil, nil, err
278			}
279			for _, directory := range missing {
280				missingSet[directory] = true
281			}
282			files[index] = file
283		}
284		missing := make([]string, 0, len(missingSet))
285		for directory := range missingSet {
286			missing = append(missing, directory)
287		}
288		sort.Strings(missing)
289		return files, missing, nil
290	}

292	func (s *Service) failAndRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal, cause error) error {
293		value.Phase = phaseReconcile
294		_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
295		if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, value); err != nil {
296			value.Phase = phaseReconcile
297			_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
298			return errors.New("local-files apply failed and requires reconciliation")
299		}
300		value.Phase = phaseRolledBack
301		for index := range value.Files {
302			if value.Files[index].Action != actionCurrent {
303				value.Files[index].State = StateRolledBack
304				value.Files[index].Published = false
305			}
306		}
307		if err := store.writeJournal(*value); err != nil {
308			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but journal finalization failed")
309		}
310		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
311			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
312		}
313		return fmt.Errorf("local-files apply failed and was rolled back: %w", cause)
314	}

316	func (s *Service) rollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal) error {
317		for index := len(value.Files) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
318			entry := &value.Files[index]
319			if entry.Action == actionCurrent {
320				continue
321			}
322			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
323			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
324				return err
325			}
326			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
327			if err != nil {
328				return err
329			}
330			switch entry.Action {
331			case actionCreate:
332				if !observed.exists {
333					continue
334				}
335				if observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
336					return errors.New("created target changed before rollback")
337				}
338				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
339				if err != nil {
340					return err
341				}
342				err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(spec.Path))
343				err = errors.Join(err, syncHeldRoot(parent.parent), parent.close())
344				if err != nil {
345					return err
346				}
347			case actionReplace:
348				if observed.exists && observed.digest == entry.OldSHA256 {
349					continue
350				}
351				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
352					return errors.New("replacement target changed before rollback")
353				}
354				oldContent, err := store.readBlob(index, true, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
355				if err != nil || digestBytes(oldContent) != entry.OldSHA256 {
356					return errors.New("replacement rollback blob is unavailable")
357				}
358				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
359				if err != nil {
360					return err
361				}
362				current, err := parent.parent.Lstat(pathBase(spec.Path))
363				oldMode, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(entry.OldMode, 8, 12)
364				err = errors.Join(err, modeErr)
365				if err == nil {
366					_, err = safefile.AtomicReplace(ctx, parent.parent, pathBase(spec.Path), current, oldContent, fs.FileMode(oldMode))
367				}
368				err = errors.Join(err, parent.close())
369				if err != nil {
370					return err
371				}
372			}
373		}
374		directories := append([]string(nil), value.CreatedDirs...)
375		sort.Slice(directories, func(i, j int) bool {
376			left, right := strings.Count(directories[i], "/"), strings.Count(directories[j], "/")
377			if left != right {
378				return left > right
379			}
380			return directories[i] > directories[j]
381		})
382		for _, directory := range directories {
383			if err := removeEmptyDirectory(checkout.root, directory); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
384				return err
385			}
386		}
387		return verifyRollback(ctx, checkout.root, envelope, *value)
388	}
389
390	func verifyRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope, value journal) error {
391		for index, entry := range value.Files {
392			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
393			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
394			if err != nil {
395				return err
396			}
397			switch entry.Action {
398			case actionCurrent:
399				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != envelope.Plan.Files[index].TargetMode {
400					return errors.New("current target changed during rollback")
401				}
402			case actionCreate:
403				if observed.exists {
404					return errors.New("created target remains after rollback")
405				}
406			case actionReplace:
407				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != entry.OldSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != entry.OldMode {
408					return errors.New("replacement target was not restored")
409				}
410			}
411		}
412		return nil
413	}

415	func (s *Service) verifyCompleted(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value journal) (ApplyResponse, error) {
416		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
417			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files journal no longer matches the checkout")
418		}
419		if value.RetainForEvict {
420			for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
421				content, err := store.readBlob(index, false, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
422				if err != nil || int64(len(content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(content) != spec.SHA256 {
423					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("retained local-files recovery blob is unavailable")
424				}
425			}
426		} else if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
427			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
428		}
429		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
430	}

432	func verifyAllCurrent(ctx context.Context, checkout string, specs []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
433		for _, spec := range specs {
434			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
435				return err
436			}
437			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, limits, true)
438			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size {
439				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q failed post-write verification", spec.Path)
440			}
441			if fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != spec.Mode {
442				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q permissions do not match the manifest", spec.Path)
443			}
444		}
445		return nil
446	}

448	func responseFromJournal(value journal) ApplyResponse {

455			RequestID: value.RequestID, PlanDigest: value.PlanDigest, Files: files,

466	type heldParent struct {
467		checkout string
468		rootInfo fs.FileInfo
469		root     *os.Root
470		parent   *os.Root
471		roots    []*os.Root
472		edges    []heldEdge
473	}

475	type heldEdge struct {
476		parent *os.Root
477		name   string
478		info   fs.FileInfo
479	}
480
481	func openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath string, create bool) (*heldParent, error) {
482		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
483			return nil, err
484		}
485		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
486		if err != nil {
487			return nil, err
488		}
489		held := &heldParent{checkout: checkout, rootInfo: rootInfo, root: root, parent: root, roots: []*os.Root{root}}
490		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
491		prefix := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1)
492		for _, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
493			prefix = append(prefix, component)
494			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
495			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
496				if err := held.parent.Mkdir(component, 0o700); err != nil {
497					_ = held.close()
498					return nil, err
499				}
500				child, info, err = safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
501			}
502			if err != nil {
503				_ = held.close()
504				return nil, err
505			}
506			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
507				_ = child.Close()
508				_ = held.close()
509				return nil, ErrUnsafe
510			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
511				_ = child.Close()
512				_ = held.close()
513				return nil, err
514			}
515			held.edges = append(held.edges, heldEdge{parent: held.parent, name: component, info: info})
516			held.roots = append(held.roots, child)
517			held.parent = child
518		}
519		return held, nil
520	}
521
522	func (h *heldParent) close() error {
523		if h == nil {
524			return nil
525		}
526		var result error
527		for index := len(h.edges) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
528			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(h.edges[index].parent, h.edges[index].name, h.edges[index].info))
529		}
530		result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyRoot(h.checkout, h.rootInfo))
531		for index := len(h.roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
532			result = errors.Join(result, h.roots[index].Close())
533		}
534		h.roots = nil
535		return result
536	}
537
538	func syncHeldRoot(root *os.Root) error {
539		file, err := root.Open(".")
540		if err != nil {
541			return err
542		}
543		defer file.Close()
544		return file.Sync()
545	}

547	func missingParentDirectories(checkout, slashPath string) ([]string, error) {
548		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
549		root, _, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
550		if err != nil {
551			return nil, err
552		}
553		roots := []*os.Root{root}
554		defer func() {
555			for index := len(roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
556				_ = roots[index].Close()
557			}
558		}()
559		current := root
560		for index, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
561			child, _, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(current, component)
562			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
563				missing := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1-index)
564				for end := index + 1; end < len(components); end++ {
565					missing = append(missing, strings.Join(components[:end], "/"))
566				}
567				return missing, nil
568			}
569			if err != nil {
570				return nil, err
571			}
572			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
573				_ = child.Close()
574				return nil, ErrUnsafe
575			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
576				_ = child.Close()
577				return nil, err
578			}
579			roots = append(roots, child)
580			current = child
581		}
582		return nil, nil
583	}
584
585	func removeEmptyDirectory(checkout, slashPath string) error {
586		parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath, false)
587		if err != nil {
588			return err
589		}
590		err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(slashPath))
591		return errors.Join(err, parent.close())
592	}
593
594	func pathBase(slashPath string) string {
595		parts := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
596		return parts[len(parts)-1]
597	}

77	// CreatePrivateNoClobber is CreateNoClobber with a clamped owner-only final
78	// mode. executable is the only way to grant execute permission.
79	func CreatePrivateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
80		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
82		}
83		return CreateNoClobber(ctx, root, name, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
84	}
85
86	// AtomicReplace stages and syncs data in the target directory, revalidates the
87	// existing regular file against observed, and atomically renames the staged file
88	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
89	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
90	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
91	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
92	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.
93	func AtomicReplace(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
94		if root == nil {
95			return nil, errors.New("atomic replace: nil root")
96		}
97		if observed == nil {
98			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replace %q without observed state: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
99		}
100		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)
107		if err != nil {
108			return nil, err
109		}
110		defer func() {
111			if stagedName != "" {
112				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
113			}
114		}()
115		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
116			return nil, err
117		}
118		if err := root.Rename(stagedName, name); err != nil {
119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("atomically replace %q: %w", name, err)
120		}
121		stagedName = ""
122		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
123		if err != nil {
124			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
125		}
126		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
127			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
128		}
129		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
130			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
131		}
132		return published, nil
133	}
134
135	// AtomicReplacePrivate is AtomicReplace with owner-only final permissions.
136	func AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
137		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
138			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
139		}
140		return AtomicReplace(ctx, root, name, observed, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
141	}
142
143	func verifyReplaceTarget(root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo) error {
144		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("inspect replacement target %q: %w: %w", name, err, ErrReplaceTarget)
147		}
148		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(observed, current) {
149			return fmt.Errorf("replacement target %q changed or is not a regular file: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
150		}
151		return nil
152	}
153
154	func stageRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (string, fs.FileInfo, error) {
155		if finalMode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
156			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported final file mode %s", finalMode)
157		}
158		var name string
159		var writer *os.File
160		for attempt := 0; attempt < 32; attempt++ {
161			candidate, err := randomStageName()
162			if err != nil {
163				return "", nil, err
164			}
165			writer, err = root.OpenFile(candidate, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
166			if err == nil {
167				name = candidate
168				break
169			}
170			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
171				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("create private staging file: %w", err)
172			}
173		}
174		if writer == nil {
175			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
176		}
177		keep := true
178		defer func() {
179			if keep {
180				_ = writer.Close()
181				_ = root.Remove(name)
182			}
183		}()
184		if err := writeAllContext(ctx, writer, data); err != nil {
185			return "", nil, err
186		}
187		if err := writer.Chmod(finalMode.Perm()); err != nil {
188			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("set staged file mode: %w", err)
189		}
190		if err := writer.Sync(); err != nil {
191			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("sync staged file: %w", err)
192		}
193		opened, err := writer.Stat()
194		if err != nil {
195			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect staged file: %w", err)
196		}
197		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
198			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("close staged file: %w", err)
199		}
200		keep = false
201		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
202		if err != nil {
203			_ = root.Remove(name)
204			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("reopen staged file name: %w", err)
205		}
206		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(opened, current) {
207			_ = root.Remove(name)
208			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("staging file changed before publication: %w", ErrChanged)
209		}
210		return name, current, nil
211	}
212
213	func validateTargetName(name string) error {
214		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
215			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
216		}
217		return nil
218	}
219
220	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
221		for len(data) > 0 {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return err
224			}
225			written, err := writer.Write(data)
226			if err != nil {
227				return err
228			}
229			if written == 0 {
230				return io.ErrShortWrite
231			}
232			data = data[written:]
233		}
234		return context.Cause(ctx)
235	}
236
237	func randomStageName() (string, error) {
238		var random [16]byte
239		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
240			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
241		}
242		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
243	}

535	func missingParentDirectories(checkout, slashPath string) ([]string, error) {
536		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
537		root, _, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
538		if err != nil {
539			return nil, err
540		}
541		roots := []*os.Root{root}
542		defer func() {
543			for index := len(roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
544				_ = roots[index].Close()
545			}
546		}()
547		current := root
548		for index, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
549			child, _, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(current, component)
550			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
551				missing := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1-index)
552				for end := index + 1; end < len(components); end++ {
553					missing = append(missing, strings.Join(components[:end], "/"))
554				}
555				return missing, nil
556			}
557			if err != nil {
558				return nil, err
559			}
560			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
561				_ = child.Close()
562				return nil, ErrUnsafe
563			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
564				_ = child.Close()
565				return nil, err
566			}
567			roots = append(roots, child)
568			current = child
569		}
570		return nil, nil
571	}

87			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
88		}
89		var reasons []assessment.Reason
90		hasIndeterminate := false
91		for _, candidate := range active {
92			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
93				hasIndeterminate = true
94				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
95					Code: "task-record-invalid", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task record is invalid",
96					Remediation: "repair or recreate the task record",
97				})
98				continue
99			}
100			if hostname != "" && candidate.Owner != "" && candidate.Owner != hostname {
101				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
102					Code: "task-owned-elsewhere", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task is owned by another machine",
103					Remediation: "complete an explicit ownership handoff before writing",
104				})
105			}
106			if candidate.State == task.Hot {
107				if context.RuntimeErr != nil {
108					hasIndeterminate = true
109					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
110						Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task cannot be checked against live runtime state",
111						Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
112					})
113				} else if len(context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Sessions) == 0 {
114					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
115						Code: "hot-task-runtime-missing", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task has no observed runtime session",
116						Remediation: "resume the task or reconcile its lifecycle state",
117					})
118				}
119			}
120		}
121		if hasReason(reasons, "task-owned-elsewhere") || hasReason(reasons, "hot-task-runtime-missing") {
122			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
123		}
124		if hasIndeterminate {
125			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
126		}
127		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
128	}

130	func assessWorktrees(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
131		if context.WorktreeErr != nil {
132			return indeterminate("worktree-inventory-unavailable", "worktrees", "linked worktrees could not be enumerated", "repair Git worktree metadata and rerun context")
133		}
134		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
135			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "worktree scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
136		}
137		indices := []int{}
138		if selectedIndex > 0 {
139			indices = append(indices, selectedIndex)
140		} else {
141			for index := 1; index < len(context.Checkouts); index++ {
142				indices = append(indices, index)
143			}
144		}
145		if len(indices) == 0 {
146			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
147		}
148		var reasons []assessment.Reason
149		hasUnknown := context.RuntimeErr != nil
150		if hasUnknown {
151			reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
152				Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "worktrees",
153				Detail:      "worktree runtime coverage could not be collected",
154				Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
155			})
156		}
157		for _, index := range indices {
158			checkout := context.Checkouts[index]
159			subject := fmt.Sprintf("worktree:%d", index)
160			switch {
161			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
162				hasUnknown = true
163				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-path-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path could not be inspected", Remediation: "restore path access and rerun context"})
164			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
165				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-missing", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path is missing or prunable", Remediation: "repair or remove the stale worktree registration"})
166			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
167				hasUnknown = true
168				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-status-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "Git status could not be collected for the worktree", Remediation: "repair the worktree and rerun context"})
169			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
170				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-locked", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree is locked", Remediation: "verify the lock owner before unlocking it"})
171			case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
172				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-conflicted", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree has unmerged paths", Remediation: "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement"})
173			case checkout.Status.Dirty():
174				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-dirty", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree contains uncommitted changes", Remediation: "commit or deliberately preserve the changes"})
175			case len(checkout.Sessions) > 0:
176				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-runtime-live", Subject: subject, Detail: "a runtime session still covers the worktree", Remediation: "quiesce and close the runtime before retirement"})
177			}
178		}
179		if len(reasons) == 0 {
180			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
181		}
182		if hasKnownBlocker(reasons) {
183			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
184		}
185		if hasUnknown {
186			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
187		}
188		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
189	}
190
191	func blocked(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
192		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
193	}
194
195	func indeterminate(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
196		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
197	}
198
199	func hasReason(reasons []assessment.Reason, code string) bool {
200		for _, reason := range reasons {
201			if reason.Code == code {
202				return true
203			}
204		}
205		return false
206	}
207
208	func hasKnownBlocker(reasons []assessment.Reason) bool {
209		for _, reason := range reasons {
210			switch reason.Code {
211			case "worktree-missing", "worktree-locked", "worktree-conflicted", "worktree-dirty", "worktree-runtime-live":
212				return true
213			}
214		}
215		return false
216	}

31	// RepoCheckout is one checkout in a repository context. The first checkout is

81	// Main returns the canonical checkout.

84			return RepoCheckout{}, false

97	// CheckoutIndexForPath returns the most-specific checkout containing path. It
98	// uses the same symlink-aware matching as runtime assignment, so a current
99	// directory under a nested linked worktree never resolves to the canonical
100	// checkout merely because that checkout is its lexical parent.
101	func (c RepoContext) CheckoutIndexForPath(path string) (int, bool) {
102		best, bestLen := -1, -1
103		for index := range c.Checkouts {
104			for _, root := range checkoutRoots(c.Repo, index, c.Checkouts[index]) {
105				if pathContains(root, path) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
106					best, bestLen = index, len(filepath.Clean(root))
107				}
108			}
109		}
110		return best, best >= 0
111	}

113	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
114	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
115	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
116		seen := map[string]bool{}
117		var out []runtime.Session
118		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
119			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
120				key := session.Handle
121				if key == "" {
122					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
123				}
124				if seen[key] {
125					continue
126				}
127				seen[key] = true
128				out = append(out, session)
129			}
130		}
131		return out
132	}

134	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository.
135	// Repositories with no linked-worktree admin entries deliberately skip
136	// `git worktree list`; this keeps the common whole-machine inventory path fast.
137	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
138		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
139
140		out := RepoContext{Repo: r, Runtime: runtimeName}
141		mainExists, mainPathErr := pathIsDir(r.Path)
142		main := RepoCheckout{
143			Worktree: gitx.Worktree{Path: r.Path, Main: true},
144			Exists:   mainExists, PathErr: mainPathErr, Ownership: CheckoutCanonical,
145		}
146		if r.Bare {
147			main.Worktree.Bare = true
148		} else {
149			main.Status, main.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
150			main.Worktree.Branch = main.Status.Branch
151			main.Worktree.Detached = main.Status.Detached
152			main.LastActivity, main.LastCommit, main.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, r.Path, main.Status)
153		}
154		out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, main)
155
156		out.WorktreeCount, out.WorktreeErr = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
157		if out.WorktreeErr == nil && out.WorktreeCount > 0 {
158			worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
159			if err != nil {
160				out.WorktreeErr = err
161			} else {
162				out.WorktreeCount = 0
163				for _, w := range worktrees {
164					if w.Main {
165						continue
166					}
167					exists, pathErr := pathIsDir(w.Path)
168					checkout := RepoCheckout{
169						Worktree: w, Exists: exists, PathErr: pathErr, Ownership: CheckoutExternal,
170					}
171					if checkout.Exists && checkout.PathErr == nil && !w.Prunable {
172						checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, w.Path)
173						checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, w.Path, checkout.Status)
174					}
175					if IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
176						checkout.Ownership = CheckoutEphemeral
177					}
178					out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
179					out.WorktreeCount++
180				}
181			}
182		}
183
184		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
185		assignSessions(&out, sessions)
186		for _, checkout := range out.Checkouts {
187			if checkout.LastActivity.After(out.LastActivity) {
188				out.LastActivity = checkout.LastActivity
189			}
190			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
191				if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
192					out.LastActivity = t.Updated
193				}
194			}
195		}
196		for _, t := range out.OtherTasks {
197			if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
198				out.LastActivity = t.Updated
199			}
200		}
201		return out
202	}

204	// IsEphemeralWorktree recognises turn-scoped checkouts owned by an agent
205	// harness. They stay visible, but the label prevents an agent from treating
206	// them like durable dev-owned work.
207	func IsEphemeralWorktree(path, branch string) bool {
208		slashPath := filepath.ToSlash(path)
209		return strings.Contains(slashPath, "/.claude/worktrees/") ||
210			strings.HasPrefix(branch, "worktree-")
211	}

213	func linkedAdminCount(commonDir string) (int, error) {
214		if commonDir == "" {
215			return 0, nil
216		}
217		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(commonDir, "worktrees"))
218		if err != nil {
219			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
220				return 0, nil
221			}
222			return 0, err
223		}
224		n := 0
225		for _, entry := range entries {

227				n++

233	func pathIsDir(path string) (bool, error) {
234		info, err := os.Stat(path)
235		if err != nil {
236			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
237				return false, nil
238			}
239			return false, err
240		}
241		if !info.IsDir() {
242			return false, fmt.Errorf("checkout path is not a directory")
243		}
244		return true, nil
245	}

247	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
248		latest := status.LatestChange
249		var commit time.Time
250		var subject string
251		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
252			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
253			if commit.After(latest) {
254				latest = commit
255			}
256			subject = lastSubject
257		}
258		return latest, commit, subject
259	}

261	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
262		for _, t := range tasks {
263			assigned := false
264			if t.WorktreePath != "" {
265				for i := 1; i < len(out.Checkouts); i++ {
266					if samePath(t.WorktreePath, out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path) {
267						out.Checkouts[i].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, t)
268						out.Checkouts[i].Ownership = CheckoutDev
269						assigned = true
270						break
271					}
272				}
273			} else if len(out.Checkouts) > 0 && t.Branch == out.Checkouts[0].Branch() {
274				out.Checkouts[0].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[0].Tasks, t)
275				assigned = true
276			}
277			if !assigned {
278				out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, t)
279			}
280		}
281		for i := range out.Checkouts {
282			sort.SliceStable(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
283				return out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[a].ID < out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[b].ID
284			})
285		}
286		sort.SliceStable(out.OtherTasks, func(i, j int) bool {
287			return out.OtherTasks[i].ID < out.OtherTasks[j].ID
288		})
289	}

291	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
292	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
293	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
294	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
295		for _, session := range sessions {
296			assigned := map[int]bool{}
297			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
298				best, bestLen := -1, -1
299				for i := range out.Checkouts {
300					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Repo, i, out.Checkouts[i]) {
301						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
302							best, bestLen = i, len(filepath.Clean(root))
303						}
304					}
305				}
306				if best >= 0 {
307					assigned[best] = true
308				}
309			}
310			for i := range assigned {
311				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
312			}
313		}
314	}

316	func checkoutRoots(r repo.Repo, index int, checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
317		roots := []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
318		if index == 0 && r.RealPath != "" && !samePath(r.RealPath, r.Path) {
319			roots = append(roots, r.RealPath)
320		}
321		return roots
322	}
323
324	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
325		if root == "" || path == "" {
326			return false
327		}
328		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
329		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
330			return false
331		}
332		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
333	}
334
335	func samePath(a, b string) bool {
336		return a != "" && b != "" && normalizePath(a) == normalizePath(b)
337	}
338
339	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
340	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
341	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
342	// is not sufficient.
343	func normalizePath(path string) string {
344		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
345		cur := clean
346		for {
347			if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
348				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
349				if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
350					return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
351				}
352				return filepath.Clean(real)
353			}
354			parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
355			if parent == cur {
356				return clean
357			}
358			cur = parent
359		}
360	}

362	// FormatRepoContext renders the deterministic Markdown used by both the CLI
363	// and the TUI's yy binding. checkoutIndex < 0 means the whole repository.
364	func FormatRepoContext(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
365		var b strings.Builder
366		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
367			checkout := c.Checkouts[checkoutIndex]
368			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev worktree context: %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout))
369			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, false)
370			return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"

372
373		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev repo context: %s\n\n", c.Repo.Display())
374		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Repository: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Display())
375		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Main path: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Path)
376		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Linked worktrees: %d\n", c.WorktreeCount)
377		if c.Runtime != "" && c.Runtime != "none" {
378			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime: `%s`\n", c.Runtime)
379		}
380		if c.WorktreeErr != nil {
381			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Worktree inventory error: %s\n", c.WorktreeErr)
382		}
383		if c.RuntimeErr != nil {
384			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime inventory error: %s\n", c.RuntimeErr)
385		}
386		if c.TaskErr != nil {
387			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Task inventory error: %s\n", c.TaskErr)
388		}
389		b.WriteString("\n## Checkouts\n")
390		for i, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
391			b.WriteString("\n")
392			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, i == 0)
393		}
394		if len(c.OtherTasks) > 0 {
395			b.WriteString("\n## Other tracked tasks\n\n")
396			for _, t := range c.OtherTasks {
397				writeTaskMarkdown(&b, t)
398			}
399		}
400		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
401	}
