 ## [Unreleased]

+### Added
+
+- `dev repo context [repo]` now has an additive schema-v1 `--json` report and an
+  explicit `--refresh` path. Local checkout, Git, task, worktree, and runtime facts
+  stay live and network-free; optional forge and configured-fleet observations carry
+  source, age, freshness, completeness, and collection errors. Remote endpoints are
+  structurally sanitized before public output, and readiness remains split by scope
+  instead of collapsing unknown evidence into a global safe value.
+- `dev fleet machine-id <host>` exposes the remote host's non-secret durable machine
+  UUID and compares it with the optional `machine_id` pin in `remotes.toml`.
+  `dev fleet files [repo-or-path] --to <host>` plans a one-way transfer of explicitly
+  allowlisted ignored files and mutates only with `--apply`; both hosts must prove
+  every exact path is untracked, ignored, regular, portable, bounded, and bound to the
+  same fetch identity, attached branch, and commit; apply additionally requires the
+  pinned target machine. Differing target bytes require a separate `--replace`;
+  `--yes` never implies replacement.
+
+### Fixed
+
+- Task writes now carry an in-memory revision from read to write, so existing
+  lifecycle callers cannot silently overwrite a concurrent process's newer task
+  record. Catalog create, update, import, and experiment reconciliation share one
+  cross-process transaction lock, while corrupt task records make repository-context
+  inventory explicitly incomplete instead of disappearing behind a warning.
+- Portable-file retries now recover an interrupted store both before and after the
+  first journal write. The operation binding is durable before manifests or payloads,
...

331	+			if previous, ok := currentLocation(current, host); ok && !locationPayloadChanged(previous, targetLocation) {
332	+				targetLocation.Updated = previous.Updated
333	+			} else {
334	+				targetLocation.Updated = s.now()
335	+			}
336	+		} else if previous, ok := currentLocation(current, host); ok &&
337	+			!locationPayloadChanged(previous, targetLocation) && previous.Updated.After(targetLocation.Updated) {
338	+			// Replaying an older observation of the same path must not move the
339	+			// target's location timestamp backwards.
340	+			targetLocation.Updated = previous.Updated
341	+		}
342	+		if err := validateLocation(host, targetLocation); err != nil {
343	+			return fmt.Errorf("catalog import target location: %w", err)
344	+		}
345	+		if err := rejectImportedPathOwner(entries, incoming.ID, host, targetLocation); err != nil {
346	+			return err
347	+		}
348	+
349	+		if current == nil {
350	+			created := incoming.Clone()
351	+			created.Locations = map[string]Location{host: targetLocation}
352	+			if err := created.Validate(); err != nil {
353	+				return fmt.Errorf("validate imported catalog asset %s: %w", created.ID, err)
354	+			}
355	+			if err := s.writeAtomic(created); err != nil {
356	+				return err
357	+			}
358	+			imported = created.Clone()
359	+			return nil
360	+		}
361	+
362	+		merged, changed, err := mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming, host, targetLocation)
363	+		if err != nil {
364	+			return err
365	+		}
366	+		if !changed {
367	+			imported = current.Clone()
368	+			return nil
369	+		}
370	+		if err := s.writeAtomic(merged); err != nil {
371	+			return err
372	+		}
373	+		imported = merged.Clone()
374	+		return nil
375	+	})
376	+	return imported, err
377	+}

379	+func importConflict(id, existingID, field, reason string) error {
380	+	return &ImportConflictError{ID: id, ExistingID: existingID, Field: field, Reason: reason}
381	+}
382	+
383	+func currentLocation(entry *Entry, host string) (Location, bool) {
384	+	if entry == nil {
385	+		return Location{}, false
386	+	}
387	+	return entry.LocationFor(host)
388	+}
389	+
390	+func rejectImportedPathOwner(entries []*Entry, importedID, host string, target Location) error {
391	+	targetPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(target)
392	+	if err != nil {
393	+		return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize imported location on host %s: %w", host, err)
394	+	}
395	+	for _, entry := range entries {
396	+		if entry.ID == importedID {
397	+			continue
398	+		}
399	+		owned, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
400	+		if !ok {
401	+			continue
402	+		}
403	+		ownedPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(owned)
404	+		if err != nil {
405	+			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize catalog asset %s location on host %s: %w", entry.ID, host, err)
406	+		}
407	+		ownedSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ownedPaths))
408	+		for _, path := range ownedPaths {
409	+			ownedSet[path] = struct{}{}
410	+		}
411	+		for _, path := range targetPaths {
412	+			if _, exists := ownedSet[path]; exists {
413	+				return importConflict(importedID, entry.ID, "location",
414	+					fmt.Sprintf("target path %q on host %s is already owned", path, host))
415	+			}
416	+		}
417	+	}
418	+	return nil
419	+}
420	+
421	+func canonicalLocationPaths(location Location) ([]string, error) {
422	+	fields := []struct {
423	+		name  string
424	+		value string
425	+	}{
426	+		{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
427	+		{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
428	+		{"real_path", location.RealPath},
429	+		{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
430	+	}
431	+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(fields))
432	+	for _, field := range fields {
433	+		if field.value == "" {
434	+			continue
435	+		}
436	+		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(field.value)
437	+		if err != nil {
438	+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s %q: %w", field.name, field.value, err)
439	+		}
440	+		seen[canonical] = struct{}{}
441	+	}
442	+	paths := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
443	+	for path := range seen {
444	+		paths = append(paths, path)
445	+	}
446	+	sort.Strings(paths)
447	+	return paths, nil
448	+}
449	+
450	+func mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, bool, error) {
451	+	if current.SchemaVersion != incoming.SchemaVersion {
452	+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "schema_version", "schema versions differ")
453	+	}
454	+	if current.Kind != incoming.Kind {
455	+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "kind",
456	+			fmt.Sprintf("durable kind %q differs from imported kind %q", current.Kind, incoming.Kind))
457	+	}
458	+	if current.Name != incoming.Name {
459	+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "name",
460	+			fmt.Sprintf("durable name %q differs from imported name %q", current.Name, incoming.Name))
461	+	}
462	+
463	+	merged := current.Clone()
464	+	changed := false
465	+
466	+	currentSummary := strings.TrimSpace(merged.Note)
467	+	incomingSummary := strings.TrimSpace(incoming.Note)
468	+	switch {
469	+	case currentSummary != "" && incomingSummary != "" && merged.Note != incoming.Note:
470	+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "note", "nonempty summaries differ")
471	+	case currentSummary == "" && incomingSummary != "":
472	+		merged.Note = incoming.Note
473	+		changed = true
474	+	}
475	+
476	+	tags := NormalizeTags(append(append([]string(nil), merged.Tags...), incoming.Tags...))
477	+	if !slices.Equal(merged.Tags, tags) {
478	+		merged.Tags = tags
479	+		changed = true
480	+	}
481	+
482	+	switch {
483	+	case merged.RemoteIdentity != "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "" && merged.RemoteIdentity != incoming.RemoteIdentity:
484	+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "remote_identity",
485	+			fmt.Sprintf("durable identity %q differs from imported identity %q", merged.RemoteIdentity, incoming.RemoteIdentity))
486	+	case merged.RemoteIdentity == "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "":
487	+		merged.RemoteIdentity = incoming.RemoteIdentity
488	+		changed = true
489	+	}
490	+
491	+	switch {
492	+	case merged.Experiment == nil && incoming.Experiment != nil:
493	+		value := *incoming.Experiment
494	+		merged.Experiment = &value
495	+		changed = true
496	+	case merged.Experiment != nil && incoming.Experiment != nil && !experimentsEqual(*merged.Experiment, *incoming.Experiment):
497	+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "experiment", "experiment metadata differs")
498	+	}
499	+
500	+	if value := earlierTime(merged.Created, incoming.Created); !value.Equal(merged.Created) {
501	+		merged.Created = value
502	+		changed = true
503	+	}
504	+	if value := earlierTime(merged.Discovered, incoming.Discovered); !value.Equal(merged.Discovered) {
505	+		merged.Discovered = value
506	+		changed = true
507	+	}
508	+	if value := laterTime(merged.LastOpened, incoming.LastOpened); !value.Equal(merged.LastOpened) {
509	+		merged.LastOpened = value
510	+		changed = true
511	+	}
512	+	if value := laterTime(merged.Updated, incoming.Updated); !value.Equal(merged.Updated) {
513	+		merged.Updated = value
514	+		changed = true
515	+	}
516	+
517	+	previous, exists := merged.LocationFor(host)
518	+	if !exists || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) || !previous.Updated.Equal(location.Updated) {
519	+		if merged.Locations == nil {
520	+			merged.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
521	+		}
522	+		merged.Locations[host] = location
523	+		changed = true
524	+	}
525	+	merged.Normalize()
526	+	if err := merged.Validate(); err != nil {
527	+		return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("validate merged catalog asset %s: %w", merged.ID, err)
528	+	}
529	+	return merged, changed, nil
530	+}
531	+
532	+func experimentsEqual(left, right Experiment) bool {
533	+	return left.Phase == right.Phase &&
534	+		left.Slug == right.Slug &&
535	+		left.OriginURL == right.OriginURL &&
536	+		left.Started.Equal(right.Started) &&
537	+		left.OriginalPath == right.OriginalPath &&
538	+		left.DeprecatedAt.Equal(right.DeprecatedAt) &&
539	+		left.DeprecatedPath == right.DeprecatedPath &&
540	+		left.GraduatedAt.Equal(right.GraduatedAt) &&
541	+		left.GraduatedPath == right.GraduatedPath
542	+}
543	+
544	+func earlierTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
545	+	if left.IsZero() || !right.IsZero() && right.Before(left) {
546	+		return right
547	+	}
548	+	return left
549	+}
550	+
551	+func laterTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
552	+	if right.After(left) {
553	+		return right
554	+	}
555	+	return left
556	+}

224	// NewReport constructs, canonicalizes, and seals a report.
225	func NewReport(profile Profile, generatedAt time.Time, gates []Gate) (Report, error) {
226		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Profile: profile, GeneratedAt: generatedAt, Gates: gates}
227		if err := report.Seal(); err != nil {
228			return Report{}, err

233	// Seal canonicalizes the report and records a fingerprint over every field
234	// except Fingerprint itself.
235	func (r *Report) Seal() error {
236		if r == nil {
237			return errors.New("seal nil assessment report")
238		}
239		if r.SchemaVersion == 0 {
240			r.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
241		}
242		canonical := r.Canonical()
243		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
244		if err := canonical.validateContent(); err != nil {
245			return err
246		}
247		fingerprint, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
248		if err != nil {
249			return err
250		}
251		canonical.Fingerprint = fingerprint
252		*r = canonical
253		return nil
254	}

256	// Validate verifies the schema, policy invariants, canonical fingerprint, and
257	// deterministic ordering of a sealed report.
258	func (r Report) Validate() error {
259		if err := r.validateContent(); err != nil {
260			return err
261		}
262		if !ValidFingerprint(r.Fingerprint) {
263			return fmt.Errorf("invalid report fingerprint %q", r.Fingerprint)
264		}
265		canonical := r.Canonical()
266		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
267		want, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		if r.Fingerprint != want {
272			return fmt.Errorf("assessment fingerprint mismatch: got %s, want %s", r.Fingerprint, want)
273		}
274		if !reportsEqualOrdering(r, r.Canonical()) {
275			return errors.New("assessment report is not in canonical order")
276		}
277		return nil
278	}

303	// Canonical returns a deep copy with UTC timestamps and order-insensitive

332	func (r Report) computeFingerprint() (string, error) {
333		payload := struct {
334			SchemaVersion int       `json:"schema_version"`
335			Profile       Profile   `json:"profile"`
336			GeneratedAt   time.Time `json:"generated_at"`
337			Gates         []Gate    `json:"gates"`
338		}{r.SchemaVersion, r.Profile, r.GeneratedAt, r.Gates}
339		encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
340		if err != nil {
341			return "", fmt.Errorf("encode assessment fingerprint: %w", err)
342		}
343		return FingerprintBytes(encoded), nil
344	}

346	// Decode reads exactly one strict schema-v1 report and verifies its seal.
347	func Decode(reader io.Reader) (Report, error) {
348		if reader == nil {
349			return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment from nil reader")
350		}
351		decoder := json.NewDecoder(reader)
352		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
353		var report Report
354		if err := decoder.Decode(&report); err != nil {
355			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment: %w", err)
356		}
357		var extra any
358		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
359			if err == nil {
360				return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment: multiple JSON values")
361			}
362			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment trailing data: %w", err)
363		}
364		if err := report.Validate(); err != nil {
365			return Report{}, err
366		}
367		return report, nil
368	}

370	func FingerprintBytes(value []byte) string {
371		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
372		return fingerprintPrefix + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
373	}
374
375	func ValidFingerprint(value string) bool {
376		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix) || len(value) != len(fingerprintPrefix)+sha256.Size*2 {
377			return false
378		}
379		digest := strings.TrimPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix)
380		if digest != strings.ToLower(digest) {
381			return false
382		}
383		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(digest)
384		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size
385	}
386
387	func validateText(name, value string, required bool) error {
388		if value == "" {
389			if required {
390				return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
391			}
392			return nil
393		}
394		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
395			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
396		}
397		if value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
398			return fmt.Errorf("%s must be trimmed", name)
399		}
400		for _, char := range value {
401			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
402				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
403			}

1	package assessment
2
3	import "fmt"
4
5	// ReduceOutcomes combines independent requirements using the fail-closed
6	// precedence blocked > indeterminate > eligible > not-applicable. No evidence
7	// is itself indeterminate.
8	func ReduceOutcomes(outcomes ...Outcome) Outcome {
9		if len(outcomes) == 0 {
10			return OutcomeIndeterminate
11		}
12		result := OutcomeNotApplicable
13		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
14			switch outcome {
15			case OutcomeBlocked:
16				return OutcomeBlocked
17			case OutcomeIndeterminate:
18				result = OutcomeIndeterminate
19			case OutcomeEligible:
20				if result == OutcomeNotApplicable {
21					result = OutcomeEligible
22				}
23			case OutcomeNotApplicable:
24			default:
25				return OutcomeIndeterminate
26			}
27		}
28		return result
29	}
30
31	// Reduce applies source-quality policy after reducing requirement outcomes.
32	// Cheap reports retain the observed result for display. Deep reports downgrade
33	// any conclusive result to indeterminate unless every relied-on source is fresh,
34	// complete, and backed by a live authority.
35	func Reduce(profile Profile, sources []Source, outcomes ...Outcome) (Outcome, error) {
36		if err := profile.Validate(); err != nil {
37			return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
38		}
39		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
40			if err := outcome.Validate(); err != nil {
41				return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
42			}
43		}
44		for _, source := range sources {
45			if err := source.Validate(); err != nil {
46				return OutcomeIndeterminate, fmt.Errorf("reduce assessment source: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		result := ReduceOutcomes(outcomes...)
50		if result == OutcomeNotApplicable || result == OutcomeIndeterminate {
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		if len(sources) == 0 {
54			return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
55		}
56		if profile == ProfileDeep {
57			for _, source := range sources {
58				if !source.conclusive() {
59					return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
60				}
61			}
62		}
63		return result, nil
64	}
65

13	const (
14		// ProtocolSchemaVersion is the outer schema shared by new bounded fleet
15		// protocols. Feature protocol versions evolve independently inside it.
16		ProtocolSchemaVersion = 1
17		// LocalFilesProtocolVersion is the first portable local-file protocol.
18		LocalFilesProtocolVersion = 1
19		// MaxCapabilityBytes bounds either side of capability negotiation.
20		MaxCapabilityBytes int64 = 16 << 10
21	)
22
23	var ErrProtocolLimit = errors.New("fleet protocol size limit exceeded")
24
25	// FileLimits is the wire representation of a target's downward-clamped
26	// portable-file policy. It deliberately does not carry include patterns.
27	type FileLimits struct {
28		MaxFiles          int   `json:"max_files"`
29		MaxFileBytes      int64 `json:"max_file_bytes"`
30		MaxTotalBytes     int64 `json:"max_total_bytes"`
31		MaxPathBytes      int   `json:"max_path_bytes"`
32		MaxComponentBytes int   `json:"max_component_bytes"`
33		MaxPathDepth      int   `json:"max_path_depth"`
34	}
35
36	func (l FileLimits) Validate() error {
37		switch {
38		case l.MaxFiles <= 0:
39			return errors.New("max_files must be positive")
40		case l.MaxFileBytes <= 0:
41			return errors.New("max_file_bytes must be positive")
42		case l.MaxTotalBytes <= 0:
43			return errors.New("max_total_bytes must be positive")
44		case l.MaxPathBytes <= 0:
45			return errors.New("max_path_bytes must be positive")
46		case l.MaxComponentBytes <= 0:
47			return errors.New("max_component_bytes must be positive")
48		case l.MaxPathDepth <= 0:
49			return errors.New("max_path_depth must be positive")
50		default:
51			return nil
52		}
53	}
54
55	// CapabilityRequest is content-free and is always exchanged before any
56	// feature payload.
57	type CapabilityRequest struct {
58		SchemaVersion   int    `json:"schema_version"`
59		Feature         string `json:"feature"`
60		ProtocolVersion int    `json:"protocol_version"`
61	}
62
63	func LocalFilesCapabilityRequest() CapabilityRequest {
64		return CapabilityRequest{
65			SchemaVersion: ProtocolSchemaVersion, Feature: "local-files",
66			ProtocolVersion: LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
67		}
68	}
69
70	func (r CapabilityRequest) Validate() error {
71		if r.SchemaVersion != ProtocolSchemaVersion {
72			return fmt.Errorf("capability schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, ProtocolSchemaVersion)
73		}
74		if r.Feature != "local-files" {
75			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported capability feature %q", r.Feature)
76		}
77		if r.ProtocolVersion != LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
78			return fmt.Errorf("local-files protocol_version %d: want %d", r.ProtocolVersion, LocalFilesProtocolVersion)
79		}
80		return nil
81	}
82
83	// CapabilityResponse contains only non-secret host facts. Unsupported native
84	// platforms return a stable reason before the caller constructs a payload.
85	type CapabilityResponse struct {
86		SchemaVersion   int        `json:"schema_version"`
87		Feature         string     `json:"feature"`
88		ProtocolVersion int        `json:"protocol_version"`
89		MachineID       string     `json:"machine_id"`
90		Platform        string     `json:"platform"`
91		Supported       bool       `json:"supported"`
92		Reason          string     `json:"reason,omitempty"`
93		Limits          FileLimits `json:"limits"`
94	}
95
96	func (r CapabilityResponse) Validate(request CapabilityRequest) error {
97		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
98			return err
99		}
100		if r.SchemaVersion != request.SchemaVersion || r.Feature != request.Feature || r.ProtocolVersion != request.ProtocolVersion {
101			return errors.New("capability response does not match the request")
102		}
103		if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
104			return err
105		}
106		if r.Platform == "" {
107			return errors.New("capability response has no platform")
108		}
109		if r.Supported {
110			if r.Reason != "" {
111				return errors.New("supported capability must not include a reason")
112			}
113			if err := r.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
114				return fmt.Errorf("capability limits: %w", err)
115			}
116		} else if !validCapabilityReason(r.Reason) {
117			return errors.New("unsupported capability has no valid reason code")
118		}
119		return nil
120	}
121
122	func validCapabilityReason(reason string) bool {
123		if reason == "" || len(reason) > 128 {
124			return false
125		}
126		for _, character := range reason {
127			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '-' {
128				continue
129			}
130			return false
131		}
132		return true
133	}
134
135	// DecodeStrict reads exactly one bounded JSON value, rejects unknown fields,
136	// and requires EOF after optional JSON whitespace.
137	func DecodeStrict(reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
138		if reader == nil || target == nil {
139			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a reader and target")
140		}
141		if maxBytes <= 0 {
142			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a positive limit")
143		}
144		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maxBytes+1))
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("read fleet protocol: %w", err)
147		}
148		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
149			return fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
150		}
151		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
152		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
153		if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
154			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol: %w", err)
155		}
156		var extra any
157		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
158			if err == nil {
159				return errors.New("decode fleet protocol: multiple JSON values")
160			}
161			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol trailing data: %w", err)
162		}
163		return nil
164	}
165
166	// MarshalBounded encodes one protocol value and enforces the matching bound
167	// before it can be handed to Transport.
168	func MarshalBounded(value any, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
169		if maxBytes <= 0 {
170			return nil, errors.New("fleet protocol encode requires a positive limit")
171		}
172		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode fleet protocol: %w", err)
175		}
176		if int64(len(data))+1 > maxBytes {
177			return nil, fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
178		}
179		return append(data, '\n'), nil
180	}
181
182	// UnmarshalStrict applies DecodeStrict to an in-memory transport response.
183	func UnmarshalStrict(data []byte, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
184		return DecodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(data), maxBytes, target)
185	}

13	var localFileDependencyComponents = map[string]bool{
14		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "vendor": true,
15		"__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "target": true, ".terraform": true,
16		"dist": true, "build": true, ".next": true,
17	}

19	// ValidateLocalFilePattern validates the deliberately small cross-platform
20	// grammar accepted by [local_files]. Literal path components use portable slash
21	// paths; '*' and '?' match within one component and a component equal to '**'
22	// matches zero or more components. Character classes, escaping, volumes, and
23	// platform-specific separators are intentionally unsupported.
24	func ValidateLocalFilePattern(value string) error {
25		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
26			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is required and must be trimmed")
27		}
28		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
29			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is not valid UTF-8")
30		}
31		if len(value) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes {
32			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is %d bytes; maximum is %d", len(value), safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes)
33		}
34		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
35			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must use '/' separators")
36		}
37		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasSuffix(value, "/") || strings.Contains(value, "//") {
38			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must be a clean repository-relative slash path")
39		}
40		if strings.ContainsAny(value, "[]{}") {
41			return fmt.Errorf("pattern supports only '*', '?' and whole-component '**' wildcards")
42		}
43		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
44		if len(components) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth {
45			return fmt.Errorf("pattern has %d components; maximum is %d", len(components), safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth)
46		}
47		for _, component := range components {
48			if localFileDependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)] {
49				return fmt.Errorf("pattern enters dependency directory %q", component)
50			}
51			if component == "**" {
52				continue
53			}
54			if strings.Contains(component, "**") {
55				return fmt.Errorf("'**' must occupy a complete path component")
56			}
57			placeholder := strings.NewReplacer("*", "x", "?", "x").Replace(component)
58			if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(placeholder, safefile.CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
59				return fmt.Errorf("component %q: %w", component, err)
60			}
61			for _, r := range component {
62				if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
63					return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a control character", component)
64				}
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}
69

39	func newFleetMachineIDCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
40		var jsonOutput bool
41		cmd := &cobra.Command{
42			Use:   "machine-id <host>",
43			Short: "Show and compare a remote host's stable machine ID",
44			Long: `Run the content-free capability probe for one configured fleet host and
45	compare its stable machine UUID with the optional machine_id pin in remotes.toml.
46	This command never writes the pin; verify the UUID through an independent channel
47	before copying it into host configuration.`,
48			Args: cobra.ExactArgs(1),
49			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
50				fleetConfig, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
51				if err != nil {
52					return err
53				}
54				host, err := fleetFilesHost(fleetConfig, args[0])
55				if err != nil {
56					return err
57				}
58				client := localfiles.Client{Runner: fleet.Transport{
59					Err: app.Err, StdinLimit: fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes, StdoutLimit: fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes,
60				}}
61				capability, err := client.Identify(ctxOf(), host)
62				if err != nil {
63					return err
64				}
65				report := fleetMachineIDReport{
66					SchemaVersion: 1, Host: host.Name, MachineID: capability.MachineID,
67					PinState: "unpinned", Platform: capability.Platform, Feature: capability.Feature,
68					ProtocolVersion: capability.ProtocolVersion, Supported: capability.Supported,
69				}
70				if host.MachineID != "" {
71					configured := host.MachineID
72					report.ConfiguredMachineID = &configured
73					report.PinState = "match"
74					if configured != capability.MachineID {
75						report.PinState = "mismatch"
76					}
77				}
78				if capability.Reason != "" {
79					reason := capability.Reason
80					report.Reason = &reason
81				}
82				if jsonOutput {
83					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
84					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
85					return encoder.Encode(report)
86				}
87				featureState := "supported"
88				if !report.Supported {
89					featureState = "unsupported"
90					if report.Reason != nil {
91						featureState += " (" + *report.Reason + ")"
92					}
93				}
94				table := app.newTable("HOST", "MACHINE ID", "PIN", "PLATFORM", "LOCAL FILES")
95				table.Add(report.Host, report.MachineID, report.PinState, report.Platform, featureState)
96				table.Render(app.Out)
97				if report.PinState != "match" {
98					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\nVerify the UUID independently, then set machine_id = %q for host %q in %s.\n",
99						report.MachineID, report.Host, config.Contract(fleetConfigPath(app)))
100				}
101				return nil
102			},
103		}
104		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&jsonOutput, "json", false, "emit JSON")
105		return cmd
106	}

108	func newFleetFilesCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
109		var targets []string
110		var filePatterns []string
111		var apply, replace, yes, jsonOutput bool
112		cmd := &cobra.Command{
113			Use:   "files [repo-or-path]",
114			Short: "Plan or apply one-way transfer of explicit ignored local files",
115			Long: `Expand project [local_files] patterns and repeatable --file patterns in one
116	selected checkout, then prove each exact file is untracked, ignored, regular, and
117	portable on both hosts. The target clone, branch, and HEAD must already match.
118	Report-only is the default; differing target content requires explicit --replace.`,
119			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
120			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
121				if len(targets) != 1 || strings.TrimSpace(targets[0]) == "" {
122					return errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one --to host")
123				}
124				target := targets[0]
125				fleetConfig, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
126				if err != nil {
127					return err
128				}
129				host, err := fleetFilesHost(fleetConfig, target)
130				if err != nil {
131					return err
132				}
133				transport := fleet.Transport{
134					Err: app.Err, StdinLimit: localfiles.MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes,
135					StdoutLimit: localfiles.MaxApplyResponseBytes,
136				}
137				client := localfiles.Client{Runner: transport}
138				// Capability is deliberately first: no project file body or source file
139				// bytes have been read when an old, unpinned, or unsupported target fails.
140				capability, err := client.Probe(ctxOf(), host)
141				if err != nil {
142					return err
143				}
144				if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
145					return errors.New("native Windows local-file payloads are not enabled")
146				}
147				if apply && host.MachineID == "" {
148					return localfiles.ErrMachineUnpinned
149				}
150				limits, err := localfiles.NegotiateLimits(app.Cfg.LocalFiles.Limits(), capability.Limits)
151				if err != nil {
152					return err
153				}
154				ref := ""
155				if len(args) == 1 {
156					ref = args[0]
157				}
158				checkout, status, head, identity, err := resolveFleetFilesSource(ctxOf(), app, ref)
159				if err != nil {
160					return err
161				}
162				project, err := projectconfig.Load(checkout, nil)
163				if err != nil {
164					return err
165				}
166				patterns := fleetFilePatterns(project, filePatterns)
167				sourceMachine, err := machineid.LoadOrCreate(ctxOf())
168				if err != nil {
169					return err
170				}
171				source, sourceReport, err := localfiles.PrepareSource(ctxOf(), localfiles.SourceOptions{
172					Checkout: checkout,
173					Binding: localfiles.Binding{
174						RemoteIdentity: identity, Branch: status.Branch, HeadOID: head,
175						SourceMachine: sourceMachine, TargetMachine: capability.MachineID,
176					},
177					Patterns: patterns, Limits: limits, Replace: replace,
178				})
179				if err != nil {
180					if len(sourceReport.Files) > 0 {
181						if renderErr := renderFleetFilesReport(app, sourceReport, jsonOutput); renderErr != nil {
182							return renderErr
183						}
184					}
185					return err
186				}
187				plan, err := client.Plan(ctxOf(), host, capability, source.Request())
188				if err != nil {
189					return err
190				}
191				planReport := plan.PublicReport()
192				if !planReport.Successful() {
193					if err := renderFleetFilesReport(app, planReport, jsonOutput); err != nil {
194						return err
195					}
196					return localfiles.ErrPlanBlocked
197				}
198				if !apply {
199					return renderFleetFilesReport(app, planReport, jsonOutput)
200				}
201				if jsonOutput && !yes {
202					return errors.New("fleet files --apply --json requires --yes")
203				}
204				if !yes {
205					if !app.interactive() {
206						return errors.New("non-interactive fleet files --apply requires --yes")
207					}
208					if err := renderFleetFilesReport(app, planReport, false); err != nil {
209						return err
210					}
211					if !confirm(app, bufio.NewReader(app.In), fmt.Sprintf("apply %d portable file(s) to %s", len(planReport.Files), host.Name)) {
212						fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Cancelled; no files changed.")
213						return nil
214					}
215				}
216				envelope, err := source.BuildEnvelope(ctxOf(), plan, false)
217				if err != nil {
218					return err
219				}
220				result, err := client.Apply(ctxOf(), host, capability, envelope)
221				if err != nil {
222					return err
223				}
224				return renderFleetFilesReport(app, result.PublicReport(), jsonOutput)
225			},
226		}
227		flags := cmd.Flags()
228		flags.StringArrayVar(&targets, "to", nil, "single configured target host (required)")
229		flags.StringArrayVar(&filePatterns, "file", nil, "additional portable relative pattern (repeatable)")
230		flags.BoolVar(&apply, "apply", false, "apply the verified plan")

232		flags.BoolVar(&yes, "yes", false, "confirm apply without prompting (does not imply --replace)")
233		flags.BoolVar(&jsonOutput, "json", false, "emit content-free JSON")
234		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeRepos(app)

238	func fleetFilesHost(cfg fleet.Config, name string) (fleet.Host, error) {

240		for index := range cfg.Hosts {

242				if selected != nil {
243					return fleet.Host{}, errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one target")
244				}

246				selected = &copy
247			}
248		}

251		}

269	func resolveFleetFilesSource(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (string, gitx.Status, string, string, error) {
270		checkout := ""
271		if ref == "" {
272			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
273			if err != nil {
274				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
275			}
276			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
277			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
278				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
279			}
280			checkout = gitRepo.Root
281		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
282			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
283				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
284				if discoverErr != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
285					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
286				}
287				checkout = gitRepo.Root
288			}
289		}
290		if checkout == "" {
291			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
292			if err != nil {
293				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
294			}
295			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
296			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
297				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
298			}
299			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
300		}
301		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
302		if err != nil {
303			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
304		}
305		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
306			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
307		}
308		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
309		if err != nil {
310			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
311		}
312		identity, err := sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
313		if err != nil {
314			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
315		}
316		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil
317	}
318
319	func sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
320		var preferred []string
321		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
322			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
323		}
324		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
325		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
326		if err != nil {
327			return "", err
328		}
329		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
330		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
331		for _, remote := range preferred {
332			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
333				continue
334			}
335			seenRemote[remote] = true
336			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
337			if err != nil {
338				continue
339			}
340			identitySet := map[string]bool{}
341			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
342				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
343					identitySet[identity] = true
344				}
345			}
346			if len(identitySet) == 1 {
347				for identity := range identitySet {
348					return identity, nil
349				}
350			}
351		}
352		return "", errors.New("source checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
353	}

355	func renderFleetFilesReport(app *App, report localfiles.Report, jsonOutput bool) error {
356		if jsonOutput {
357			encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
358			encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
359			return encoder.Encode(report)
360		}
361		table := app.newTable("PATH", "SIZE", "MODE", "STATE")
362		for _, file := range report.Files {
363			table.Add(file.Path, fmt.Sprintf("%d", file.Size), file.Mode, string(file.State))
364		}
365		table.Render(app.Out)
366		return nil
367	}

83	// collectLocalRepoContext is the single CLI collector used by repo context and
84	// status. It executes only local Git/task/runtime probes; includeTopology adds
85	// repository-wide remote/ref facts but never performs fetch or other network I/O.
86	func collectLocalRepoContext(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, selectedPath string, includeTopology bool) localRepoContext {
87		var (
88			tasks    = []*task.Task{}
89			tasksErr error
90		)
91		if app.Tasks == nil {
92			tasksErr = errors.New("task store is unavailable")
93		} else {
94			listed, diagnostics, err := app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
95			if err != nil {
96				tasksErr = err
97			} else {
98				tasks = tasksForRepo(listed, repository)
99				for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
100					tasksErr = errors.Join(tasksErr, diagnostic)
101				}
102			}
103		}
104
105		rt := app.Runtime()
106		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
107		local := localRepoContext{
108			Context: inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, repository, tasks, sessions, rt.Name()),
109			Runtimes: []repocontext.RuntimeInput{{
110				Backend: rt.Name(), Available: rt.Available(), Sessions: sessions, Err: runtimeErr,
111			}},
112			SelectedCheckout: -1,
113		}
114		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
115		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
116		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
117			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
118		} else {
119			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
120		}
121		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
122			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)

154	func collectRepoContextForge(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool, now time.Time) repocontext.ForgeInput {
155		cacheInput := func(cache forge.Cache, collectionErr error) repocontext.ForgeInput {
156			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
157			if forgeCacheStale(cache, app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, now) {
158				freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
159			}
160			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
161			if !cache.Complete || collectionErr != nil {
162				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
163			}
164			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
165				Authority: assessment.AuthorityCache, Freshness: freshness,
166				Completeness: completeness, ObservedAt: cache.FetchedAt,
167				Records: append([]forge.RemoteRepo{}, cache.Repos...),
168				Err:     errors.Join(collectionErr, forgeCacheErrors(cache)),
169			}
170		}
171
172		if !refresh {
173			cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
174			if !ok {
175				return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: errors.New("no cached forge inventory; rerun with --refresh to collect one")}
176			}
177			return cacheInput(cache, nil)
178		}
179
180		rows, collectionErr := collectRemotes(ctx, app)
181		records := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(rows))
182		for _, row := range rows {
183			records = append(records, row.Repo)
184		}
185		if collectionErr == nil {
186			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
187				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
188				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
189				Records: records,
190			}
191		}
192		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
193			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
194			if len(records) > 0 {
195				cached.Records = records
196			}
197			return cached
198		}
199		if len(records) > 0 {
200			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
201				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
202				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
203				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
204			}
205		}
206		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
207	}
208
209	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
210		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
211			return true
212		}
213		if ttl <= 0 {
214			return false
215		}
216		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
217	}
218
219	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
220		var providerErrors []error
221		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
222		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
223		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
224			name := string(kind)
225			kinds = append(kinds, name)
226			byKind[name] = status
227		}
228		sort.Strings(kinds)
229		for _, kind := range kinds {
230			status := byKind[kind]
231			if status.Error != "" {
232				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
233			} else if !status.Complete {
234				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
235			}
236		}
237		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
238	}

240	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
241		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
242		if err != nil {
243			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
244		}
245		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
246			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
247			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
248			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
249		}
250		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
251			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
252		}
253		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
254			return input
255		}
256		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
257		if parallel <= 0 {
258			parallel = 1
259		}
260		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
261		var wait sync.WaitGroup
262		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
263			wait.Add(1)
264			go func() {
265				defer wait.Done()
266				semaphore <- struct{}{}
267				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
268				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
269			}()
270		}
271		wait.Wait()
272		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
273			input.Err = err
274		}
275		return input
276	}

13	const (
14		// ProtocolSchemaVersion is the outer schema shared by new bounded fleet
15		// protocols. Feature protocol versions evolve independently inside it.
16		ProtocolSchemaVersion = 1
17		// LocalFilesProtocolVersion is the first portable local-file protocol.
18		LocalFilesProtocolVersion = 1
19		// MaxCapabilityBytes bounds either side of capability negotiation.
20		MaxCapabilityBytes int64 = 16 << 10

23	var ErrProtocolLimit = errors.New("fleet protocol size limit exceeded")
24
25	// FileLimits is the wire representation of a target's downward-clamped
26	// portable-file policy. It deliberately does not carry include patterns.
27	type FileLimits struct {
28		MaxFiles          int   `json:"max_files"`
29		MaxFileBytes      int64 `json:"max_file_bytes"`
30		MaxTotalBytes     int64 `json:"max_total_bytes"`
31		MaxPathBytes      int   `json:"max_path_bytes"`
32		MaxComponentBytes int   `json:"max_component_bytes"`
33		MaxPathDepth      int   `json:"max_path_depth"`
34	}
35
36	func (l FileLimits) Validate() error {
37		switch {
38		case l.MaxFiles <= 0:
39			return errors.New("max_files must be positive")
40		case l.MaxFileBytes <= 0:
41			return errors.New("max_file_bytes must be positive")
42		case l.MaxTotalBytes <= 0:
43			return errors.New("max_total_bytes must be positive")
44		case l.MaxPathBytes <= 0:
45			return errors.New("max_path_bytes must be positive")
46		case l.MaxComponentBytes <= 0:
47			return errors.New("max_component_bytes must be positive")
48		case l.MaxPathDepth <= 0:
49			return errors.New("max_path_depth must be positive")
50		default:
51			return nil
52		}
53	}
54
55	// CapabilityRequest is content-free and is always exchanged before any
56	// feature payload.
57	type CapabilityRequest struct {
58		SchemaVersion   int    `json:"schema_version"`
59		Feature         string `json:"feature"`
60		ProtocolVersion int    `json:"protocol_version"`
61	}
62
63	func LocalFilesCapabilityRequest() CapabilityRequest {
64		return CapabilityRequest{
65			SchemaVersion: ProtocolSchemaVersion, Feature: "local-files",
66			ProtocolVersion: LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
67		}
68	}
69
70	func (r CapabilityRequest) Validate() error {
71		if r.SchemaVersion != ProtocolSchemaVersion {
72			return fmt.Errorf("capability schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, ProtocolSchemaVersion)
73		}
74		if r.Feature != "local-files" {
75			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported capability feature %q", r.Feature)
76		}
77		if r.ProtocolVersion != LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
78			return fmt.Errorf("local-files protocol_version %d: want %d", r.ProtocolVersion, LocalFilesProtocolVersion)
79		}
80		return nil
81	}

83	// CapabilityResponse contains only non-secret host facts. Unsupported native
84	// platforms return a stable reason before the caller constructs a payload.
85	type CapabilityResponse struct {
86		SchemaVersion   int        `json:"schema_version"`
87		Feature         string     `json:"feature"`
88		ProtocolVersion int        `json:"protocol_version"`
89		MachineID       string     `json:"machine_id"`
90		Platform        string     `json:"platform"`
91		Supported       bool       `json:"supported"`
92		Reason          string     `json:"reason,omitempty"`
93		Limits          FileLimits `json:"limits"`

96	func (r CapabilityResponse) Validate(request CapabilityRequest) error {
97		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
98			return err
99		}
100		if r.SchemaVersion != request.SchemaVersion || r.Feature != request.Feature || r.ProtocolVersion != request.ProtocolVersion {
101			return errors.New("capability response does not match the request")

103		if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {

112			}
113			if err := r.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
114				return fmt.Errorf("capability limits: %w", err)
115			}
116		} else if !validCapabilityReason(r.Reason) {
117			return errors.New("unsupported capability has no valid reason code")
118		}
119		return nil
120	}
121
122	func validCapabilityReason(reason string) bool {
123		if reason == "" || len(reason) > 128 {
124			return false
125		}
126		for _, character := range reason {
127			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '-' {
128				continue
129			}
130			return false
131		}
132		return true
133	}
134
135	// DecodeStrict reads exactly one bounded JSON value, rejects unknown fields,
136	// and requires EOF after optional JSON whitespace.
137	func DecodeStrict(reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
138		if reader == nil || target == nil {
139			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a reader and target")
140		}
141		if maxBytes <= 0 {
142			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a positive limit")
143		}
144		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maxBytes+1))
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("read fleet protocol: %w", err)
147		}
148		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
149			return fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
150		}
151		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
152		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
153		if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
154			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol: %w", err)
155		}
156		var extra any
157		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
158			if err == nil {
159				return errors.New("decode fleet protocol: multiple JSON values")
160			}
161			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol trailing data: %w", err)
162		}
163		return nil
164	}
165
166	// MarshalBounded encodes one protocol value and enforces the matching bound
167	// before it can be handed to Transport.
168	func MarshalBounded(value any, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
169		if maxBytes <= 0 {
170			return nil, errors.New("fleet protocol encode requires a positive limit")
171		}
172		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode fleet protocol: %w", err)
175		}
176		if int64(len(data))+1 > maxBytes {
177			return nil, fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
178		}
179		return append(data, '\n'), nil
180	}
181
182	// UnmarshalStrict applies DecodeStrict to an in-memory transport response.
183	func UnmarshalStrict(data []byte, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
184		return DecodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(data), maxBytes, target)
185	}

10	var (

12		ErrUnreachable     = errors.New("target host is unreachable")
13		ErrRemoteTimeout   = errors.New("target protocol timed out")
14		ErrMachinePin      = errors.New("target machine ID does not match the configured host pin")
15		ErrMachineUnpinned = errors.New("mutating local-file apply requires host.machine_id")

17
18	type Runner interface {
19		RunWithOptions(context.Context, fleet.Host, []string, []byte, fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result
20	}
21
22	type Client struct{ Runner Runner }
23
24	func (c Client) run(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, maxResponse int64) ([]byte, error) {
25		if c.Runner == nil {
26			return nil, errors.New("local-files client has no fleet transport")
27		}
28		// Capability and plan are read-only. Apply is permanently bound to its
29		// request ID and plan digest by the target journal, so an authentication-only
30		// retry cannot duplicate an unbound mutation.
31		result := c.Runner.RunWithOptions(ctx, host, args, stdin, fleet.RunOptions{Retry: fleet.RetryAuthentication})
32		if int64(len(result.Stdout)) > maxResponse {
33			return nil, errors.New("target protocol response exceeded its bound")
34		}
35		if result.ExitCode == 0 && result.CaptureError == "" {
36			return result.Stdout, nil
37		}
38		switch {
39		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
40			return nil, ErrRemoteTimeout
41		case result.ExitCode == 127:
42			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
43		case result.ExitCode == 255:
44			return nil, ErrUnreachable
45		default:
46			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
47		}
48	}
49
50	// Identify performs the content-free capability exchange without enforcing the
51	// configured machine pin. It exists for explicit onboarding and diagnostics;
52	// mutating or payload-bearing callers must use Probe.
53	func (c Client) Identify(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
54		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
55		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
56		if err != nil {
57			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
58		}
59		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_capability"}, body, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
60		if err != nil {
61			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
62		}
63		var response fleet.CapabilityResponse
64		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes, &response); err != nil {
65			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
66		}
67		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
68			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
69		}
70		return response, nil
71	}
72
73	func (c Client) Probe(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
74		response, err := c.Identify(ctx, host)
75		if err != nil {
76			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
77		}
78		if host.MachineID != "" && host.MachineID != response.MachineID {
79			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
80		}
81		if !response.Supported {
82			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, errors.New("target does not support local-file payloads")
83		}
84		return response, nil
85	}
86
87	func (c Client) Plan(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
88		if capability.MachineID != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
89			return PlanResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
90		}
91		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
92			return PlanResponse{}, err
93		}
94		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
95		if err != nil {
96			return PlanResponse{}, err
97		}
98		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-plan"}, body, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
99		if err != nil {
100			return PlanResponse{}, err
101		}
102		var response PlanResponse
103		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes, &response); err != nil {
104			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
105		}
106		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
107			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
108		}
109		return response, nil
110	}
111
112	func (c Client) Apply(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
113		if host.MachineID == "" {
114			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachineUnpinned
115		}
116		if host.MachineID != capability.MachineID || envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine != capability.MachineID {
117			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
118		}
119		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
120			return ApplyResponse{}, err
121		}
122		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(envelope, MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes)
123		if err != nil {
124			return ApplyResponse{}, err
125		}
126		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-apply"}, body, MaxApplyResponseBytes)
127		if err != nil {
128			return ApplyResponse{}, err
129		}
130		var response ApplyResponse
131		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxApplyResponseBytes, &response); err != nil {
132			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
133		}
134		if err := response.Validate(envelope.Request, envelope.Plan); err != nil {
135			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
136		}
137		return response, nil
138	}

14	)
15
16	var (
17		ErrUnsafe     = errors.New("portable file path is unsafe")
18		ErrIneligible = errors.New("portable file is not untracked and ignored")
19		ErrDrift      = errors.New("portable file checkout state changed")
20	)
21
22	type observation struct {
23		exists bool
24		info   fs.FileInfo
25		data   []byte
26		digest string
27	}
28
29	func observePath(ctx context.Context, checkout, slashPath string, limits safefile.Limits, read bool) (observation, error) {
30		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
31			return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("path %q: %w: %w", slashPath, err, ErrUnsafe)
32		}
33		if hasDependencyComponent(slashPath) {
34			return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("path %q enters a dependency directory: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe)
35		}
36		held, err := openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath, false)
37		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
38			return observation{exists: false}, nil
39		}
40		if err != nil {
41			return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("open path %q: %w: %w", slashPath, err, ErrUnsafe)
42		}
43		finish := func(result observation, operationErr error) (observation, error) {
44			closeErr := held.close()
45			if operationErr != nil {
46				return observation{}, errors.Join(operationErr, closeErr)
47			}
48			if closeErr != nil {
49				return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("verify held path %q: %w", slashPath, closeErr)
50			}
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		name := pathBase(slashPath)
54		info, err := held.parent.Lstat(name)
55		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
56			return finish(observation{exists: false}, nil)
57		}
58		if err != nil {
59			return finish(observation{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect path %q: %w", slashPath, err))
60		}
61		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
62			return finish(observation{}, fmt.Errorf("path %q is not a regular file: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe))
63		}
64		result := observation{exists: true, info: info}
65		if read {
66			data, stable, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, held.parent, name, info, limits.MaxFileBytes)
67			if err != nil {
68				return finish(observation{}, fmt.Errorf("read path %q: %w", slashPath, err))
69			}
70			result.info, result.data, result.digest = stable, data, digestBytes(data)
71		}
72		return finish(result, nil)
73	}
74
75	func proveGitEligibility(ctx context.Context, checkout, slashPath string) error {
76		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
77			return fmt.Errorf("path %q: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe)
78		}
79		literal := ":(literal)" + slashPath
80		tracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "ls-files", "-z", "--", literal)
81		if err != nil {
82			return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git tracking for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
83		}
84		if tracked != "" {
85			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is tracked: %w", slashPath, ErrIneligible)
86		}
87		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
88		for index := range components {
89			prefix := strings.Join(components[:index+1], "/")
90			staged, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z", "--", ":(literal)"+prefix)
91			if err != nil {
92				return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git mode for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
93			}
94			for _, record := range strings.Split(staged, "\x00") {
95				if strings.HasPrefix(record, "160000 ") {
96					return fmt.Errorf("path %q crosses a submodule: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe)
97				}
98			}
99		}
100		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "check-ignore", "--no-index", "--quiet", "--", slashPath)
101		if err == nil {
102			return nil
103		}
104		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
105		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 {
106			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is not ignored on this host: %w", slashPath, ErrIneligible)
107		}
108		return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git ignore status for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
109	}

26	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
27		if s == nil {
28			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
29		}
30		if s.platform() == "windows" {
31			return ApplyResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
32		}
33		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
34		if err != nil {
35			return ApplyResponse{}, err
36		}
37		// This check intentionally precedes envelope validation. The hidden command
38		// performs the same capability check before reading stdin at all.
39		if id != envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine {
40			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
41		}
42		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
43			return ApplyResponse{}, err
44		}
45		authority := s.Authority
46		if authority == nil {
47			authority = lease.New("")
48		}
49		key := lease.BranchKey(envelope.Request.Binding.RemoteIdentity, envelope.Request.Binding.Branch)
50		var response ApplyResponse
51		err = authority.WithMutation(ctx, []lease.Key{key}, func() error {
52			var applyErr error
53			response, applyErr = s.applyUnderLease(ctx, envelope)
54			return applyErr
55		})
56		return response, err
57	}
58
59	func (s *Service) applyUnderLease(ctx context.Context, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
60		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, envelope.Request.Binding)
61		if err != nil {
62			return ApplyResponse{}, err
63		}
64		if checkout.id != envelope.Plan.TargetCheckout {
65			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("target checkout changed after planning")
66		}
67		if err := s.validateNegotiatedLimits(envelope.Request); err != nil {
68			return ApplyResponse{}, err
69		}
70
71		store, exists, err := openOperationStore(s.StoreRoot, envelope.Request.RequestID)
72		if err != nil {
73			return ApplyResponse{}, err
74		}
75		var prior journal
76		if exists {
77			prior, err = store.loadJournal()
78			if err != nil {
79				return ApplyResponse{}, err
80			}
81			if prior.PlanDigest != envelope.Plan.PlanDigest || prior.ManifestDigest != envelope.Request.ManifestDigest ||
82				prior.RetainForEvict != envelope.RetainForEvict {
83				return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("local-files request ID is already bound to another apply")
84			}
85			if prior.Phase == phaseCompleted {
86				return s.verifyCompleted(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, prior)
87			}
88			if prior.Phase == phaseApplying || prior.Phase == phaseReconcile {
89				if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &prior); err != nil {
90					prior.Phase = phaseReconcile
91					_ = store.writeJournal(prior)
92					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("prior local-files apply requires reconciliation")
93				}
94				prior.Phase = phaseRolledBack
95				if err := store.writeJournal(prior); err != nil {
96					return ApplyResponse{}, err
97				}
98			}
99			if prior.Phase == phaseRolledBack {
100				if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
101					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("prior rolled-back local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
102				}
103			}
104		}
105
106		files, err := preflightApply(ctx, checkout.root, envelope)
107		if err != nil {
108			return ApplyResponse{}, err
109		}
110		value := journal{
111			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, RequestID: envelope.Request.RequestID,
112			PlanDigest: envelope.Plan.PlanDigest, ManifestDigest: envelope.Request.ManifestDigest,
113			RetainForEvict: envelope.RetainForEvict, Phase: phaseStaged,
114		}
115		for _, file := range files {
116			entry := journalFile{Path: file.spec.Path, Size: file.spec.Size, Mode: file.spec.Mode, Action: file.planned.Action, State: file.planned.State}
117			if entry.Action == actionReplace {
118				entry.OldSHA256 = file.before.digest
119				entry.OldMode = file.planned.TargetMode
120			}
121			value.Files = append(value.Files, entry)
122		}
123		if store == nil || !exists {
124			store, err = newOperationStore(s.StoreRoot, envelope.Request.RequestID)
125			if err != nil {
126				return ApplyResponse{}, err
127			}
128			if err := store.ensureOperation(); err != nil {
129				return ApplyResponse{}, err
130			}
131			if err := s.fault("after-store-create", ""); err != nil {
132				return ApplyResponse{}, err
133			}
134		}
135		// The operation binding is durable before any manifest or payload bytes.
136		// A crash from this point is a resumable staged journal, never an opaque
137		// request-ID directory that permanently poisons retries.
138		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
139			return ApplyResponse{}, err
140		}
141		if err := s.fault("after-journal", ""); err != nil {
142			return ApplyResponse{}, err
143		}
144		if err := store.ensurePayloadLayout(); err != nil {
145			return ApplyResponse{}, err
146		}
147		if err := store.writeManifest(envelope); err != nil {
148			return ApplyResponse{}, err
149		}
150		for index, file := range files {
151			if file.planned.Action != actionCurrent || envelope.RetainForEvict {
152				if err := store.writeBlob(store.blobPath(index), file.content, file.spec.executable()); err != nil {
153					return ApplyResponse{}, err
154				}
155			}
156			if file.planned.Action == actionReplace {
157				if err := store.writeBlob(store.rollbackPath(index), file.before.data, file.before.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0); err != nil {
158					return ApplyResponse{}, err
159				}
160			}
161		}
162		if err := s.fault("after-stage", ""); err != nil {
163			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
164		}
165		value.Phase = phaseApplying
166		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
167			return ApplyResponse{}, err
168		}
169
170		for index, file := range files {
171			if file.planned.Action == actionCurrent {
172				value.Files[index].State = StateCurrent
173				continue
174			}
175			if err := s.fault("before-publish", file.spec.Path); err != nil {
176				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
177			}
178			parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, file.spec.Path, true)
179			if err != nil {
180				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
181			}
182			name := pathBase(file.spec.Path)
183			switch file.planned.Action {
184			case actionCreate:
185				_, err = safefile.CreatePrivateNoClobber(ctx, parent.parent, name, file.content, file.spec.executable())
186			case actionReplace:
187				_, err = safefile.AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx, parent.parent, name, file.before.info, file.content, file.spec.executable())
188			default:
189				err = errors.New("invalid local-files publication action")
190			}
191			closeErr := parent.close()
192			err = errors.Join(err, closeErr)
193			if err != nil {
194				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
195			}
196			if err := s.fault("after-publish", file.spec.Path); err != nil {
197				// The journal may not yet say Published. rollback infers publication
198				// from the exact old/new digests, which covers this crash boundary.
199				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
200			}
201			value.Files[index].Published = true
202			if file.planned.Action == actionCreate {
203				value.Files[index].State = StateCreated
204			} else {
205				value.Files[index].State = StateReplaced
206			}
207			if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
208				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
209			}
210		}
211		if err := s.fault("before-final-verify", ""); err != nil {
212			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
213		}
214		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
215			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
216		}
217		if err := s.fault("before-complete", ""); err != nil {
218			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
219		}
220		value.Phase = phaseCompleted
221		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
222			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
223		}
224		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(envelope.RetainForEvict); err != nil {
225			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("local-files apply completed but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
226		}
227		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
228	}

230	func (s *Service) validateNegotiatedLimits(request PlanRequest) error {
231		host := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
232		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(host, request.Limits)
233		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
234			return errors.New("apply limits do not match target policy")
235		}
236		return nil
237	}

239	func preflightApply(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope) ([]preflightFile, error) {
240		payloads := map[string][]byte{}
241		for _, payload := range envelope.Payloads {
242			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
243			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
244				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode canonical payload for %q", payload.Path)
245			}
246			payloads[payload.Path] = decoded
247		}
248		files := make([]preflightFile, len(envelope.Request.Files))
249		for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
250			planned := envelope.Plan.Files[index]
251			if planned.Action == "" {
252				return nil, ErrPlanBlocked
253			}
254			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
255				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
256			}
257			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
258			if err != nil {
259				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
260			}
261			file := preflightFile{spec: spec, planned: planned, before: observed}
262			switch planned.Action {
263			case actionCurrent:
264				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
265					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q is no longer current: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
266				}
267				file.content = observed.data
268			case actionCreate:
269				if observed.exists {
270					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q appeared after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
271				}
272				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
273			case actionReplace:
274				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != planned.TargetSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
275					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed before replacement: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
276				}
277				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
278			default:
279				return nil, errors.New("invalid local-files target action")
280			}
281			if int64(len(file.content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(file.content) != spec.SHA256 {
282				return nil, fmt.Errorf("content for %q no longer matches the plan", spec.Path)
283			}
284			files[index] = file
285		}
286		return files, nil
287	}
288
289	func (s *Service) failAndRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal, cause error) error {
290		value.Phase = phaseReconcile
291		_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
292		if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, value); err != nil {
293			value.Phase = phaseReconcile
294			_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
295			return errors.New("local-files apply failed and requires reconciliation")
296		}
297		value.Phase = phaseRolledBack
298		for index := range value.Files {
299			if value.Files[index].Action != actionCurrent {
300				value.Files[index].State = StateRolledBack
301				value.Files[index].Published = false
302			}
303		}
304		if err := store.writeJournal(*value); err != nil {
305			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but journal finalization failed")
306		}
307		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
308			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
309		}
310		return fmt.Errorf("local-files apply failed and was rolled back: %w", cause)
311	}
312
313	func (s *Service) rollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal) error {
314		for index := len(value.Files) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
315			entry := &value.Files[index]
316			if entry.Action == actionCurrent {
317				continue
318			}
319			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
320			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
321				return err
322			}
323			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
324			if err != nil {
325				return err
326			}
327			switch entry.Action {
328			case actionCreate:
329				if !observed.exists {
330					continue
331				}
332				if observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
333					return errors.New("created target changed before rollback")
334				}
335				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
336				if err != nil {
337					return err
338				}
339				err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(spec.Path))
340				err = errors.Join(err, syncHeldRoot(parent.parent), parent.close())
341				if err != nil {
342					return err
343				}
344			case actionReplace:
345				if observed.exists && observed.digest == entry.OldSHA256 {
346					continue
347				}
348				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
349					return errors.New("replacement target changed before rollback")
350				}
351				oldContent, err := store.readBlob(index, true, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
352				if err != nil || digestBytes(oldContent) != entry.OldSHA256 {
353					return errors.New("replacement rollback blob is unavailable")
354				}
355				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
356				if err != nil {
357					return err
358				}
359				current, err := parent.parent.Lstat(pathBase(spec.Path))
360				oldMode, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(entry.OldMode, 8, 12)
361				err = errors.Join(err, modeErr)
362				if err == nil {
363					_, err = safefile.AtomicReplace(ctx, parent.parent, pathBase(spec.Path), current, oldContent, fs.FileMode(oldMode))
364				}
365				err = errors.Join(err, parent.close())
366				if err != nil {
367					return err
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		// Empty parent directories are intentionally retained. A path alone cannot
372		// prove that a directory still has the identity created by this operation;
373		// deleting it after a crash could remove another process's replacement.
374		return verifyRollback(ctx, checkout.root, envelope, *value)
375	}
376
377	func verifyRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope, value journal) error {
378		for index, entry := range value.Files {
379			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
380			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
381			if err != nil {
382				return err
383			}
384			switch entry.Action {
385			case actionCurrent:
386				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != envelope.Plan.Files[index].TargetMode {
387					return errors.New("current target changed during rollback")
388				}
389			case actionCreate:
390				if observed.exists {
391					return errors.New("created target remains after rollback")
392				}
393			case actionReplace:
394				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != entry.OldSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != entry.OldMode {
395					return errors.New("replacement target was not restored")
396				}
397			}
398		}
399		return nil
400	}
401
402	func (s *Service) verifyCompleted(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value journal) (ApplyResponse, error) {
403		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
404			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files journal no longer matches the checkout")
405		}
406		if value.RetainForEvict {
407			for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
408				content, err := store.readBlob(index, false, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
409				if err != nil || int64(len(content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(content) != spec.SHA256 {
410					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("retained local-files recovery blob is unavailable")
411				}
412			}
413		} else if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
414			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
415		}
416		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
417	}
418
419	func verifyAllCurrent(ctx context.Context, checkout string, specs []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
420		for _, spec := range specs {
421			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
422				return err
423			}
424			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, limits, true)
425			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size {
426				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q failed post-write verification", spec.Path)
427			}
428			if fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != spec.Mode {
429				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q permissions do not match the manifest", spec.Path)
430			}
431		}
432		return nil
433	}
434
435	func responseFromJournal(value journal) ApplyResponse {
436		files := make([]PublicFile, len(value.Files))
437		for index, entry := range value.Files {
438			files[index] = PublicFile{Path: entry.Path, Size: entry.Size, Mode: entry.Mode, State: entry.State}
439		}
440		return ApplyResponse{
441			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
442			RequestID: value.RequestID, PlanDigest: value.PlanDigest, Files: files,
443		}
444	}
445
446	func (s *Service) fault(point, path string) error {
447		if s.Fault == nil {
448			return nil
449		}
450		return s.Fault(point, path)
451	}
452
453	type heldParent struct {
454		checkout string
455		rootInfo fs.FileInfo
456		root     *os.Root
457		parent   *os.Root
458		roots    []*os.Root
459		edges    []heldEdge
460	}
461
462	type heldEdge struct {
463		parent *os.Root
464		name   string
465		info   fs.FileInfo
466	}
467
468	func openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath string, create bool) (*heldParent, error) {
469		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
470			return nil, err
471		}
472		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		held := &heldParent{checkout: checkout, rootInfo: rootInfo, root: root, parent: root, roots: []*os.Root{root}}
477		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
478		prefix := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1)
479		for _, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
480			prefix = append(prefix, component)
481			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
482			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
483				if err := held.parent.Mkdir(component, 0o700); err != nil {
484					_ = held.close()
485					return nil, err
486				}
487				child, info, err = safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
488			}
489			if err != nil {
490				_ = held.close()
491				return nil, err
492			}
493			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
494				_ = child.Close()
495				_ = held.close()
496				return nil, ErrUnsafe
497			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
498				_ = child.Close()
499				_ = held.close()
500				return nil, err
501			}
502			held.edges = append(held.edges, heldEdge{parent: held.parent, name: component, info: info})
503			held.roots = append(held.roots, child)
504			held.parent = child
505		}
506		return held, nil
507	}
508
509	func (h *heldParent) close() error {
510		if h == nil {
511			return nil
512		}
513		var result error
514		for index := len(h.edges) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
515			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(h.edges[index].parent, h.edges[index].name, h.edges[index].info))
516		}
517		result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyRoot(h.checkout, h.rootInfo))
518		for index := len(h.roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
519			result = errors.Join(result, h.roots[index].Close())
520		}
521		h.roots = nil
522		return result
523	}
524
525	func syncHeldRoot(root *os.Root) error {
526		file, err := root.Open(".")
527		if err != nil {
528			return err
529		}
530		defer file.Close()
531		return file.Sync()
532	}
533
534	func pathBase(slashPath string) string {
535		parts := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
536		return parts[len(parts)-1]
537	}
