78
79	## Shared domains
80
81	- 新增 `internal/assessment`: schema/version、evidence provenance/freshness/completeness、gate/outcome/reason code、canonical fingerprint 與 outcome reduction；保持 presentation-neutral，讓 inventory/transfer/recovery/local-files 各自產生 evidence。
82	- 擴充 `internal/inventory/repo_context.go`: 保留每個 checkout 的 status error、runtime enumeration error、Git topology、catalog/note/artifact摘要、safe remotes、fleet observations 與 scoped gates；CLI/TUI 消費同一 aggregate，不能再以 `tui.RepoRow` 當 domain contract。
83	- 新增 `internal/lease`: 獨立於 task/transfer 的 cooperative operation authority；以 canonical Git identity + branch/repository scope 鎖定，保存 reservation/fence epoch，讓所有目前版本的 Git/worktree/artifact/local-file/task mutator 在任何 side effect 前共用同一 lock/guard。
84	- 新增 `internal/transfer`: portable task DTO、source/target plan、strict wire protocol、private object/sidecar staging、journal/store、phase transition、sidecar import、fencing/abort/return/reconciliation。
85	- 新增 `internal/localfiles`: project manifest resolution、ignored-file expansion、held-root snapshot、plan/conflict policy、bounded wire payload、target apply/rollback/immutable recovery copy/receipt；供 `fleet files` 與 `fleet transfer --with-local-files` 共用。
86	- 新增 `internal/recovery`: all-ref 與 Git-administrative manifest/artifact/receipt、reclaim assessment、restore drill/apply、eviction intent/reconciliation。
87	- 擴充 `internal/wt` provisioning service：以 checkout/OID + plan hash 為 key 的 private setup journal；content-addressed/idempotent steps 可重播，任意 command 逐步記錄 `pending/running/completed/indeterminate`。
88	- 新增 `internal/forge/weburl.go`: 從 live Git endpoint 或 exact forge match 保守產生 display-safe HTTPS URL；raw Git URL 與 public DTO 分離。
89	- CLI orchestration 拆到 `internal/cli/repo_context.go`、`fleet_files.go`、`fleet_transfer.go`、`backup.go`、`reclaim.go`、`restore.go`、`evict.go`；既有 `fleet.Transport` 只負責 transport，不承擔 policy。
90
91	Reuse rather than duplicate:
92
93	- repository/checkout identity: `gitx.Discover`, `repo.Resolve/Discover`, `pathx.Canonical/Contains`;
94	- local Git: `gitx.StatusOf`, `Worktrees`, `WorktreeFor`, `RecoveryTopologyOf`, `InProgress`, `AnalyzeFinish`, `Run`;

103
104	Create a private, durable machine UUID (independent state stores make this host-local) and expose it through a non-secret capability command. Add an optional expected machine ID to each `remotes.toml` host; any mutating transfer/files/restore operation requires it to be pinned and match, while list/status may merely warn. SSH host-key validation remains mandatory.

Add non-PTY `ssh -T` protocol mode and disable agent/X11/port forwarding; probe compatibility before sending note bodies or file content. Old/no-dev/incompatible targets fail before payload transmission.
107
108	# Repository context and safe remote links
109
110	Extend `dev repo context` rather than adding another status synonym. Human/JSON sections:
111
112	1. identity, selected checkout, generated time and source provenance;
113	2. canonical + linked worktrees, per-checkout Git/error/activity;
114	3. tasks, owner/fence, artifacts and every observed runtime backend;
115	4. every Git remote with role (current upstream/origin/upstream), sanitized endpoint identity, provider and safe plain HTTPS web URL when confidently derivable;
116	5. matching configured fleet hosts, path/branch/task/runtime summaries, live/stale/unreachable/incompatible state and snapshot age;
117	6. scoped readiness and stable blocker/remediation codes;
118	7. coverage/errors, including the explicit statement that fleet means configured hosts only.
119
120	`--json` is a new additive schema-v1 report; unknown/error values remain null/status entries, never zeroed or silently omitted. 124	# Portable local files
125
126	Add a new project-owned `[local_files]` section in `.dev-cli/config.toml` with explicit portable relative patterns, plus repeatable ad-hoc `--file`. Do not inherit existing `worktree.include` defaults: a repository may propose candidates, but only the explicit `fleet files` invocation or `transfer --with-local-files` authorizes off-machine export. Define a small portable glob grammar, expand it locally to sorted exact paths, and send no glob over the wire.
127
128	For every file, both hosts must prove it is untracked and ignored under their own Git configuration; tracked files travel through Git. Only bounded regular files are accepted—no directories, symlinks/reparse points, sockets, devices, FIFOs, `.git`, nested repositories or submodule boundaries. Initial hard ceilings: 128 files, 8 MiB/file, 32 MiB total, bounded path/component depth; host settings may lower but not raise compiled limits.
129
130	Plan states are `ready`, `current`, `blocked-conflict`, `blocked-ineligible`, `blocked-unsafe`, `missing`, `failed`. Source and target must be the same normalized repo identity, branch and exact OID. Apply preflights the complete set, reopens both roots through held handles, and journals the transfer:
131
132	- missing target: stage private temp (`0600`), stream/hash exact length, sync, then publish atomically without replacement;
133	- identical target: no-op/current;
134	- differing target: block unless `--replace`; replace requires the target digest observed in the displayed plan, private rollback copy, atomic swap, post-write rehash and rollback/reconciliation on failure;
135	- `--yes` never implies `--replace`; no deletion or last-writer-wins mode.
136
137	Target acceptance additionally retains each transferred file as an immutable, manifest-bound private recovery blob under the target transfer store; it materializes and rehashes that blob in staging. A source-deletion acknowledgement releases only ownership coordination: the blob, manifest and receipt reference remain immutable for the full recovery-receipt lifetime, including after A is gone and B’s working checkout is modified or evicted. They may be released only by a separately confirmed durable-receipt purge or after an independently restore-verified immutable backup supersedes them. B’s current-version replace/files/evict flows must honor this retention record. A must not treat a mutable working copy as deletion proof and must preserve its staged source if the target blob cannot be revalidated. Standalone `fleet files` may release the blob when source is retained, or use explicit `--retain-for-evict` to create recovery evidence.
138
139	Clamp final privacy to owner-only (`0600`, or `0700` only for explicitly executable source); do not copy ACL/xattr/owner/timestamps. Public human/JSON results contain path/size/state only—no content or hash. Native Windows targets remain capability-blocked before content is sent until the transport, ACL, reparse-point and atomicity contract is fully implemented and tested.
140
141	# Transfer protocol
142
143	## Target preparation
144
145	Separate branch/ref evidence from checkout evidence. For every selected task/current branch, A resolves `refs/heads/<branch>` directly through the shared Git common directory and captures exact OID/object format without requiring it to be checked out. Only branches with an existing checkout require conflict-free, operation-free, fully clean checkout evidence. COLD/unattached task refs must equal the freshly fetched/advertised remote tip before transfer and remain COLD on B with no checkout; this lets one repository transfer several serial branch-mode tasks without pretending they are all attached. Every published ref uses an explicit `<oid>:refs/heads/<branch>` ordinary push and the live remote tip must equal exactly that OID (not merely contain it).
146
147	Before A is fenced, B may only create a durable reservation, validate conflicts, and fetch expected objects into a private, non-discoverable transfer staging repository. Existing clones are reserved through the shared lease authority but no branch/worktree is moved; absent clones are staged under the private transfer directory rather than passed directly to `repo.Acquire`. Operation-owned incomplete staging can be verified and safely recreated/reused on retry, while any pre-existing or user-modified destination remains untouched.
148
149	After A’s fence is durable, B holds its repository/branch leases while publishing the target state. It matches all configured fetch/push identities and reuses exactly one clone; ambiguity blocks. If absent, it computes the final destination from B’s own path policy and materializes the verified staging clone without exposing a partial canonical checkout. It then creates/fast-forwards only the checkouts required by task state/mode. Ahead/diverged/dirty/live-agent targets block. Worktree tasks use B’s configured path and explicit expected ref; WARM worktree tasks get a checkout, COLD tasks do not. Branch/direct tasks may use canonical checkout only when unique and safe—never silently change mode. Acceptance may apply only deterministic, journaled portable files; it never runs `post_create`, dependency installers/copies, or other arbitrary provisioning inside the replayable distributed transaction. Transfer does not copy trust/credentials or open a runtime. Accepted HOT tasks become WARM; WARM/COLD stay as-is. After acceptance, B runs provisioning as a separate B-owned setup transaction through `dev resume` or `dev wt provision`; accepted existing WARM checkouts must enter this flow just like newly recreated worktrees. A private journal is bound to checkout identity/OID and provisioning-plan hash. Before each arbitrary command, fsync `running`; after success, fsync `completed`. A crash in `running` becomes `indeterminate` and is never auto-replayed—only explicit `--retry-indeterminate` or operator-attested `--mark-complete` can advance it. A journal cannot promise exactly-once for an external side effect, so automatic resume is limited to content-addressed/proven-idempotent steps. Context separately reports `transfer-complete` and `setup-pending/indeterminate/ready` so acceptance is never misrepresented as a fully provisioned environment.
150
151	## Sidecar rehydration
152
153	Portable task DTO contains stable ID, name/repo display, branch/base/mode/state/next/note/tags/timestamps and source provenance, but never A paths or runtime handles. On B, bind `RepoPath`/`WorktreePath` from B, clear runtime/agent hints, and import with exact-ID + revision conflict detection. Add task-store cross-process locking/CAS, but make the operation lease—not the task file—the authoritative fence so a selected branch with no task is still protected. Retrofit every current `dev` path that can mutate or expose a certified repository/branch/checkout/sidecar (`dev git`, lifecycle/TUI, adopt, worktree/repo/bootstrap/fleet setup, artifact finalization, local-file apply) to acquire/check the same lease before its first effect and hold it through Git/filesystem changes plus final CAS.
154
155	Catalog import preserves stable ID, metadata/tags/remote identity, adds B’s machine-specific location, and blocks pending move or conflicting ID/path/non-empty summaries. Note import preserves ID/repository ID/timestamps/tags/body; exact revision is idempotent, differing same-ID content blocks. Durable Markdown is written before disposable FTS rebuild; FTS failure is reported without rolling back durable notes. Note/file content travels only via bounded SSH stdin and is never echoed or cached.
156
157	## Idempotent no-two-writer handoff
158
159	Persist strict private source and target journals keyed by random transfer ID + manifest digest. Sequence:
160
161	1. **Plan**: live source/target assessment, no mutation.
162	2. **Publish**: create source intent; revalidate fingerprint; push/verify exact branch OIDs.
163	3. **Reserve/stage B**: durably reserve the target identities, validate sidecar/path conflicts and fetch objects into private staging only. Do not publish a working checkout, provision, write portable files, or expose target tasks.
164	4. **Fence A**: from an external coordinator, require caller/runtime outside all selected checkouts. Acquire all selected branch/repository operation leases in deterministic order, thereby drain already-started current-version mutators; while still holding them, revalidate Git/sidecar revisions, record B machine ID + fencing epoch durably, normalize HOT→WARM and then release the locks. Every later current-version source mutation sees the fence and fails. Keep every A byte.
165	5. **Accept/publish B**: under the same target reservations/leases, require the exact epoch/digest, revalidate staging and target state, publish/create the required checkouts, apply optional deterministic portable files, and import catalog/notes/tasks idempotently. Do not run arbitrary provisioning. Set B owner and write the acceptance receipt last; only then release the target reservation so ordinary B commands can see a writable accepted state and later run local `dev resume` provisioning.
166	6. **Complete/reconcile**: lost response is resolved through `fleet transfer status`; no distributed rollback. A remains present but fenced until explicit eviction or ownership return.
167
168	Same ID+digest resumes; same ID+different digest rejects. `abort` is terminal only before source fence and cleans solely journal-owned staging. After fence, `return` first acquires B’s leases, quiesces the exact manifest, writes a durable `returned` tombstone keyed by ID/digest/epoch that permanently rejects delayed prepare/accept replays, then lets A verify it and CAS-unfence the unchanged source while advancing the epoch. If B is unreachable or indeterminate, A remains safely fenced; generic `resume --force` cannot override a transfer fence. This permits a zero-writer window but never intentionally two cooperative writers. Document that raw Git and old binaries can bypass dev’s lease.
169
170	# Backup, reclaim, restore, and eviction
171
172	## Backup receipt
173
174	Add a fresh `gitx` recovery snapshot that inventories all local `refs/heads/*`, tags, notes, stash and other refs/OIDs; dirty/untracked/ignored/unreadable paths; Git operations/worktrees; LFS; submodules/nested repositories; shallow/partial clone, alternates and external/shared Git storage. Do not derive eviction cleanliness solely from `StatusOf`/`AnalyzeFinish`: enumerate index flags (`assume-unchanged`, `skip-worktree`, sparse-index state) without mutating the real index, then read/hash every materialized tracked path through held roots into a raw-byte manifest. The restore drill must independently materialize the receipt and compare exact working-tree bytes; hidden edits, unsafe sparse entries, clean/smudge-filter differences or missing external filter behavior must either enter an immutable recovery artifact or block/require a named discard. Repeat the flag/raw-byte proof during final eviction under the operation leases. Separately enumerate every private GitDir/common-dir administrative entry (config, hooks, info/exclude/attributes, rr-cache, reflogs and unknown files) through held roots. Classify only proven Git-managed/regenerable entries as reconstructible; preserve each remaining regular file in a private recovery artifact outside the eviction roots or require an item-scoped discard. Credential-bearing config is never uploaded to a Git remote. `RecoveryTopology` remains descriptive and is never promoted to proof.
175
176	`backup --push` authorizes one resolved effective push endpoint, not merely a remote name. Resolve Git rewrites plus every `pushurl`; if more than one effective destination exists, fail closed and require a dedicated single-endpoint recovery remote. Show the sanitized endpoint and exact ref mappings, bind both to the plan fingerprint, re-resolve immediately before push, refuse non-fast-forward/conflicting writes, and verify mappings at that same endpoint. Stash/custom refs require explicit receipt-scoped recovery mappings; unresolved reflog-only/unreachable objects remain blockers unless separately acknowledged for discard. Write an append-only private schema-v1 receipt only after verification; it records endpoint-set digest, exact ref/OID mappings, object/admin-artifact manifest digests, exclusions, source fingerprint and protocol versions—not credentials/raw URLs.
177
178	## Reclaim and restore proof
179
180	`reclaim` joins fresh evidence for every checkout/root, ref/object, Git-administrative entry, ignored file, immutable portable-file recovery blob, task/fence, catalog/note revision, artifact, all available runtime backends, caller containment, owned/shared bytes and configured fleet state. Each potentially unique item must map to an immutable recovery artifact/receipt, retained XDG state outside every deletion root, or a separately named item/category discard acknowledgement; a mutable live B working copy alone never qualifies. Stale/no-dev/unreachable evidence is indeterminate, never pass.
181
182	`restore --verify` restores into an isolated new staging directory, fetches every receipt mapping, verifies exact refs/OIDs and reachable object closure, restores and byte-verifies the classified Git-administrative artifact at the correct post-clone phase, and checks LFS/submodule proof where supported. It also materializes every portable-file recovery blob used by the eviction gate without exposing contents in output. Unsupported LFS/submodule/nested/external-object layouts block eviction rather than weakening the claim. Regular `restore --apply` uses the same plan/revalidation to reconstruct a real destination. A backup receipt without a successful matching restore drill cannot authorize eviction.
183
184	## Journaled actual eviction
185
186	`evict` never runs inside transfer. It defaults to the same report as reclaim and requires explicit `--apply`, exact target, matching receipt, current verified restore, and exact confirmation (`YES`; noninteractive `--yes` only with explicit target). Named acknowledgements such as `--discard-ignored`, `--discard-dirty`, `--discard-unreachable`, `--override-keep` are independent; `--yes` does not imply data loss and there is no generic `--force`.
187
188	Under recovery/task/catalog/Git operation leases, evict re-runs every check, closes only eligible runtime surfaces from outside them, waits and re-enumerates all backends, and freezes every reviewed checkout/Git root. Apply filesystem custody to **each** owned linked worktree before removal: write a per-root intent, use a Git-aware move into an unguessable same-parent private staging path so registration/common-dir remain valid, revoke traversal/new opens, completely enumerate file and directory descriptors into that staged inode tree, wait for existing handles to close, rerun that worktree’s index-flag/raw-byte proof, then remove the staged registration while preserving its branch/common-dir. A linked root that cannot be moved/probed/reproved blocks instead of falling back to ordinary `git worktree remove`.
189
190	After all linked roots are safely retired, apply the same sequence to the ordinary canonical clone: write/finalize its intent, atomically rename it into same-parent private staging, revoke new opens, drain all handles, and rerun the full raw-byte/Git-administrative manifest proof under custody before physical removal. If handle enumeration is unavailable/incomplete, any writer remains, or evidence changes at any root, preserve every affected staged root/intent and return indeterminate for later reconcile—never continue on an acknowledgement disguised as proof. External git dirs, alternates, cross-filesystem/shared-common-dir ambiguity, and platforms without the custody/open-handle contract block actual eviction.
191
192	Only after target bytes are absent: durably record source deletion completion on A, have B acknowledge it to release the transfer ownership hold (not the recovery blobs), remove A task records whose exact portable revisions were accepted by B (transfer receipt retains audit data), mark A catalog location `evicted` with recovery/restore reference, and clear the intent. If B/recovery evidence becomes unreachable after staging rename but before physical deletion, preserve the staged A root and reconcile rather than continue. Retain catalog metadata, quick-note copies, Git-administrative recovery artifacts, portable-file blobs, stats and transfer/recovery receipts outside clone roots for their receipt lifetimes; deleting those durable recovery assets is a future separately scoped, confirmed purge. Other ignored data blocks or needs its named discard acknowledgement.

33	fleet-host observations use their private caches by default and expose provenance,
34	age and collection errors; --refresh may contact forge providers and fleet hosts.
35	With no repository argument, the repository containing the current directory is
36	used, and a linked-worktree current directory remains the selected checkout while
37	the report still covers the whole clone.`,
38			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
39			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
40				ctx := ctxOf()
41				repository, selectedPath, err := resolveRepoContextTarget(ctx, app, args)
42				if err != nil {
43					return err
44				}
45				local := collectLocalRepoContext(ctx, app, repository, selectedPath, true)
46				now := time.Now().UTC()
47				forgeFacts := collectRepoContextForge(ctx, app, refresh, now)
48				fleetFacts := collectRepoContextFleet(ctx, app, refresh)
49				report, err := repocontext.Build(repocontext.BuildInput{
50					GeneratedAt: now, Context: local.Context,
51					SelectedCheckout: local.SelectedCheckout, SelectionErr: local.SelectionErr,
52					Topology: local.Topology, TopologyErr: local.TopologyErr,
53					Runtimes: local.Runtimes, Forge: forgeFacts, Fleet: fleetFacts,
54					Hostname: config.Hostname(),
55				})
56				if err != nil {
57					return err
58				}
59				if jsonOut {
60					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
61					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
62					return encoder.Encode(report)
63				}
64				legacy := inventory.FormatRepoContext(local.Context, -1)
65				fmt.Fprint(app.Out, repocontext.FormatMarkdown(report, legacy))
66				return nil
67			},
68		}
69		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit the additive schema-v1 JSON report")
70		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&refresh, "refresh", false, "refresh external forge and configured fleet observations")
71		return cmd
72	}
73
74	type localRepoContext struct {
75		Context          inventory.RepoContext
76		SelectedCheckout int
77		SelectionErr     error
78		Topology         gitx.RecoveryTopology
79		TopologyErr      error
80		Runtimes         []repocontext.RuntimeInput
81	}
82
83	// collectLocalRepoContext is the single CLI collector used by repo context and
84	// status. It executes only local Git/task/runtime probes; includeTopology adds
85	// repository-wide remote/ref facts but never performs fetch or other network I/O.
86	func collectLocalRepoContext(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, selectedPath string, includeTopology bool) localRepoContext {
87		var (
88			tasks    = []*task.Task{}
89			tasksErr error
90		)
91		if app.Tasks == nil {
92			tasksErr = errors.New("task store is unavailable")
93		} else {
94			listed, diagnostics, err := app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
95			if err != nil {
96				tasksErr = err
97			} else {
98				tasks = tasksForRepo(listed, repository)
99				for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
100					tasksErr = errors.Join(tasksErr, diagnostic)
101				}
102			}
103		}
104
105		rt := app.Runtime()
106		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
107		local := localRepoContext{
108			Context: inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, repository, tasks, sessions, rt.Name()),
109			Runtimes: []repocontext.RuntimeInput{{
110				Backend: rt.Name(), Available: rt.Available(), Sessions: sessions, Err: runtimeErr,
111			}},
112			SelectedCheckout: -1,
113		}
114		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
115		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
116		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
117			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
118		} else {
119			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
120		}
121		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
122			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
123		}
124		return local
125	}
126
127	func resolveRepoContextTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (repo.Repo, string, error) {
128		if len(args) == 1 {
129			resolved, _, err := resolveRepoRef(app, args[0])
130			if err != nil {
131				return repo.Repo{}, "", err
132			}
133			return resolved, resolved.Path, nil
134		}
135		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
136		if err != nil {
137			return repo.Repo{}, "", err
138		}
139		discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
140		if err != nil {
141			return repo.Repo{}, "", fmt.Errorf("%s is not a git repository — pass a repo", config.Contract(cwd))
142		}
143		selectedPath := discovered.Root
144		if selectedPath == "" {
145			selectedPath = discovered.MainRoot
146		}
147		return repo.Repo{
148			Name: discovered.Name, Path: discovered.MainRoot, RealPath: discovered.MainRoot,
149			GitDir: discovered.GitCommonDir, CommonDir: discovered.GitCommonDir,
150			MainRoot: discovered.MainRoot, HasGit: true, Bare: discovered.Bare,
151		}, selectedPath, nil
152	}
153
154	func collectRepoContextForge(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool, now time.Time) repocontext.ForgeInput {
155		cacheInput := func(cache forge.Cache, collectionErr error) repocontext.ForgeInput {
156			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
157			if forgeCacheStale(cache, app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, now) {
158				freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
159			}
160			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
161			if !cache.Complete || collectionErr != nil {
162				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
163			}
164			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
165				Authority: assessment.AuthorityCache, Freshness: freshness,
166				Completeness: completeness, ObservedAt: cache.FetchedAt,
167				Records: append([]forge.RemoteRepo{}, cache.Repos...),
168				Err:     errors.Join(collectionErr, forgeCacheErrors(cache)),
169			}
170		}
171
172		if !refresh {
173			cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
174			if !ok {
175				return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: errors.New("no cached forge inventory; rerun with --refresh to collect one")}
176			}
177			return cacheInput(cache, nil)
178		}
179
180		rows, collectionErr := collectRemotes(ctx, app)
181		records := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(rows))
182		for _, row := range rows {
183			records = append(records, row.Repo)
184		}
185		if collectionErr == nil {
186			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
187				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
188				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
189				Records: records,
190			}
191		}
192		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
193			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
194			if len(records) > 0 {
195				cached.Records = records
196			}
197			return cached
198		}
199		if len(records) > 0 {
200			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
201				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
202				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
203				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
204			}
205		}
206		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
207	}
208
209	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
210		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
211			return true
212		}
213		if ttl <= 0 {
214			return false
215		}
216		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
217	}
218
219	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
220		var providerErrors []error
221		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
222		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
223		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
224			name := string(kind)
225			kinds = append(kinds, name)
226			byKind[name] = status
227		}
228		sort.Strings(kinds)
229		for _, kind := range kinds {
230			status := byKind[kind]
231			if status.Error != "" {
232				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
233			} else if !status.Complete {
234				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
235			}
236		}
237		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
238	}
239
240	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
241		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
242		if err != nil {
243			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
244		}
245		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
246			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
247			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
248			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
249		}
250		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
251			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
252		}
253		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
254			return input
255		}
256		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
257		if parallel <= 0 {
258			parallel = 1
259		}
260		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
261		var wait sync.WaitGroup
262		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
263			wait.Add(1)
264			go func() {
265				defer wait.Done()
266				semaphore <- struct{}{}
267				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
268				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
269			}()
270		}
271		wait.Wait()
272		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
273			input.Err = err
274		}
275		return input
276	}

12	// Readiness is one cheap, local-only context projection. It intentionally
13	// carries no authority to mutate; the full Report binds the same result to
14	// point-in-time evidence sources.
15	type Readiness struct {
16		Outcome assessment.Outcome
17		Reasons []assessment.Reason
18	}
19
20	// LocalReadiness keeps independently actionable checkout, task, and worktree
21	// scopes separate. There is deliberately no global safe boolean.
22	type LocalReadiness struct {
23		Checkout Readiness
24		Task     Readiness
25		Worktree Readiness

28	// Summary is the compact status/TUI projection.
29	func (r LocalReadiness) Summary() string {

31			"checkout " + string(r.Checkout.Outcome),
32			"task " + string(r.Task.Outcome),

37	// AssessLocal derives readiness from facts already collected by inventory. It
38	// does not run Git, inspect a runtime, or contact a forge/fleet host.
39	func AssessLocal(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) LocalReadiness {
40		return LocalReadiness{
41			Checkout: assessCheckout(context, selectedIndex),
42			Task:     assessTasks(context, selectedIndex, hostname),
43			Worktree: assessWorktrees(context, selectedIndex),
44		}
45	}
46
47	func assessCheckout(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
48		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
49			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the selected checkout is absent from the local inventory", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
50		}
51		checkout := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex]
52		switch {
53		case checkout.Worktree.Bare || context.Repo.Bare:
54			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
55		case checkout.PathErr != nil:
56			return indeterminate("checkout-path-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path could not be inspected", "restore path access and rerun context")
57		case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
58			return blocked("checkout-missing", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path is missing or prunable", "repair or remove the stale worktree registration")
59		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
60			return indeterminate("checkout-status-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "Git status could not be collected", "repair the checkout and rerun context")
61		case checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached || checkout.Branch() == "":
62			return blocked("checkout-detached", "selected-checkout", "the checkout does not have an attached branch", "check out an explicit branch")
63		case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
64			return blocked("checkout-conflicted", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d unmerged path(s)", checkout.Status.Conflicted), "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement")
65		case checkout.Status.Dirty():
66			return blocked("checkout-dirty", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d changed path(s)", checkout.Status.Changed), "commit or deliberately preserve the changes")
67		default:
68			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
69		}
70	}
71
72	func assessTasks(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) Readiness {
73		if context.TaskErr != nil {
74			return indeterminate("task-inventory-unavailable", "task-inventory", "task records could not be collected", "repair the task store and rerun context")
75		}
76		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
77			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "task scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
78		}
79		// Transfer/repository readiness covers every non-DONE task attached to the
80		// clone, including cold and branch-only records without a local checkout.
81		// Looking only at the selected checkout can otherwise hide another machine's
82		// ownership claim and incorrectly report not-applicable.
83		active := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(context.OtherTasks)+len(context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Tasks))
84		sessionCount := map[string]int{}
85		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
86		add := func(candidate *task.Task, sessions int) {
87			if candidate == nil || candidate.State == task.Done {
88				return
89			}
90			if _, exists := seen[candidate.ID]; exists {
91				return
92			}
93			seen[candidate.ID] = struct{}{}
94			active = append(active, candidate)
95			sessionCount[candidate.ID] = sessions
96		}
97		for _, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
98			for _, candidate := range checkout.Tasks {
99				add(candidate, len(checkout.Sessions))
100			}
101		}
102		for _, candidate := range context.OtherTasks {
103			add(candidate, 0)
104		}
105		if len(active) == 0 {
106			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
107		}
108		var reasons []assessment.Reason
109		hasIndeterminate := false
110		for _, candidate := range active {
111			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
112				hasIndeterminate = true
113				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
114					Code: "task-record-invalid", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task record is invalid",
115					Remediation: "repair or recreate the task record",
116				})
117				continue
118			}
119			if hostname != "" && candidate.Owner != "" && candidate.Owner != hostname {
120				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
121					Code: "task-owned-elsewhere", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task is owned by another machine",
122					Remediation: "complete an explicit ownership handoff before writing",
123				})
124			}
125			if candidate.State == task.Hot {
126				if context.RuntimeErr != nil {
127					hasIndeterminate = true
128					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
129						Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task cannot be checked against live runtime state",
130						Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
131					})
132				} else if sessionCount[candidate.ID] == 0 {
133					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
134						Code: "hot-task-runtime-missing", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task has no observed runtime session",
135						Remediation: "resume the task or reconcile its lifecycle state",
136					})
137				}
138			}
139		}
140		if hasReason(reasons, "task-owned-elsewhere") || hasReason(reasons, "hot-task-runtime-missing") {
141			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
142		}
143		if hasIndeterminate {
144			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
145		}
146		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
147	}
148
149	func assessWorktrees(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
150		if context.WorktreeErr != nil {
151			return indeterminate("worktree-inventory-unavailable", "worktrees", "linked worktrees could not be enumerated", "repair Git worktree metadata and rerun context")
152		}
153		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
154			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "worktree scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
155		}
156		indices := []int{}
157		if selectedIndex > 0 {
158			indices = append(indices, selectedIndex)
159		} else {
160			for index := 1; index < len(context.Checkouts); index++ {
161				indices = append(indices, index)
162			}
163		}
164		if len(indices) == 0 {
165			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
166		}
167		var reasons []assessment.Reason
168		hasUnknown := context.RuntimeErr != nil
169		if hasUnknown {
170			reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
171				Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "worktrees",
172				Detail:      "worktree runtime coverage could not be collected",
173				Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
174			})
175		}
176		for _, index := range indices {
177			checkout := context.Checkouts[index]
178			subject := fmt.Sprintf("worktree:%d", index)
179			switch {
180			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
181				hasUnknown = true
182				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-path-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path could not be inspected", Remediation: "restore path access and rerun context"})
183			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
184				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-missing", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path is missing or prunable", Remediation: "repair or remove the stale worktree registration"})
185			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
186				hasUnknown = true
187				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-status-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "Git status could not be collected for the worktree", Remediation: "repair the worktree and rerun context"})
188			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
189				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-locked", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree is locked", Remediation: "verify the lock owner before unlocking it"})
190			case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
191				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-conflicted", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree has unmerged paths", Remediation: "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement"})
192			case checkout.Status.Dirty():
193				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-dirty", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree contains uncommitted changes", Remediation: "commit or deliberately preserve the changes"})
194			case len(checkout.Sessions) > 0:
195				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-runtime-live", Subject: subject, Detail: "a runtime session still covers the worktree", Remediation: "quiesce and close the runtime before retirement"})
196			}
197		}
198		if len(reasons) == 0 {
199			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
200		}
201		if hasKnownBlocker(reasons) {
202			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
203		}
204		if hasUnknown {
205			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
206		}
207		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
208	}
209
210	func blocked(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
211		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
212	}
213
214	func indeterminate(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
215		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
216	}
217
218	func hasReason(reasons []assessment.Reason, code string) bool {
219		for _, reason := range reasons {
220			if reason.Code == code {
221				return true
222			}
223		}
224		return false
225	}
226
227	func hasKnownBlocker(reasons []assessment.Reason) bool {
228		for _, reason := range reasons {
229			switch reason.Code {
230			case "worktree-missing", "worktree-locked", "worktree-conflicted", "worktree-dirty", "worktree-runtime-live":
231				return true
232			}
233		}
234		return false
235	}

1	// Package repocontext composes the versioned, presentation-neutral report used
2	// by dev repo context. Collection stays at the CLI/runtime boundaries; this
3	// package only joins already-observed facts and never performs network I/O.
4	package repocontext
5
6	import (
7		"encoding/json"
8		"fmt"
9		"net/url"
10		"path/filepath"
11		"sort"
12		"strings"
13		"time"
14		"unicode"
15		"unicode/utf8"
16
17		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/assessment"
18		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
19		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/fleet"
20		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/forge"
21		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
22		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/inventory"
23		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
24		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
25	)
26
27	const (
28		// SchemaVersion is the additive public repository-context JSON contract.
29		SchemaVersion = 1
30		// FleetCoverageConfiguredHostsOnly prevents a configured fleet snapshot from
31		// being mistaken for discovery of every machine which may hold the clone.
32		FleetCoverageConfiguredHostsOnly = "configured-hosts-only"
33	)
34
35	// Report is the schema-v1 repository context envelope. Unknown values use nil
36	// pointers or explicit state/error fields rather than a meaningful zero value.
37	type Report struct {
38		SchemaVersion    int                `json:"schema_version"`
39		GeneratedAt      time.Time          `json:"generated_at"`
40		Repository       Repository         `json:"repository"`
41		SelectedCheckout *CheckoutSelection `json:"selected_checkout"`
42		Sources          []Source           `json:"sources"`
43		Capabilities     []Capability       `json:"capabilities"`
44		Local            LocalFacts         `json:"local"`
45		Remotes          []Remote           `json:"remotes"`
46		Forge            ForgeFacts         `json:"forge"`
47		Fleet            FleetFacts         `json:"fleet"`
48		Assessment       assessment.Report  `json:"assessment"`
49		Errors           []CollectionError  `json:"errors"`
50	}
51
52	// Source exposes evidence provenance and age. Its assessment fields deliberately
53	// match assessment.Source so gates can cite the exact same evidence.
54	type Source struct {

301	// Build joins live local facts with optional external observations. It performs
302	// no probes and never places raw Git endpoints in the returned report.
303	func Build(input BuildInput) (Report, error) {
304		now := input.GeneratedAt
305		if now.IsZero() {
306			now = time.Now().UTC()
307		}
308		now = now.Round(0).UTC()
309
310		report := Report{
311			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion,
312			GeneratedAt:   now,
313			Repository: Repository{
314				Name: input.Context.Repo.Name, Display: input.Context.Repo.Display(),
315				Path: input.Context.Repo.Path, RealPath: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.RealPath),
316				CommonDir: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.CommonDir),
317				Bare:      input.Context.Repo.Bare, HasGit: input.Context.Repo.HasGit,
318			},
319			Sources:      []Source{},
320			Capabilities: []Capability{},
321			Remotes:      []Remote{},
322			Errors:       []CollectionError{},
323		}
324
325		report.Local = buildLocalFacts(input, &report.Errors)
326		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(report.Local.Checkouts) {
327			checkout := report.Local.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout]
328			report.SelectedCheckout = &CheckoutSelection{
329				Index: checkout.Index, Path: checkout.Path, Branch: checkout.Branch,
330				Canonical: checkout.Canonical, Ownership: checkout.Ownership,
331			}
332		} else {
333			message := "selected checkout is not present in the local checkout inventory"
334			if input.SelectionErr != nil {
335				message = cleanError(input.SelectionErr)
336			}
337			report.Errors = append(report.Errors, CollectionError{
338				Code: "selection-unavailable", Scope: "local", Subject: "selected-checkout", Message: message,
339			})
340		}
341
342		localIdentities := privateRemoteIdentities(input.Topology)
343		report.Remotes, report.Forge, report.Errors = buildRemoteFacts(now, input, report.Errors)
344		report.Fleet, report.Errors = buildFleetFacts(now, input.Fleet, localIdentities, report.Errors)
345
346		sources := buildSources(now, input, report)
347		report.Sources = sources
348		report.Capabilities = buildCapabilities(input, report)
349
350		readiness := AssessLocal(input.Context, input.SelectedCheckout, input.Hostname)
351		sourceMap := make(map[string]assessment.Source, len(sources))
352		for _, source := range sources {
353			sourceMap[source.ID] = source.assessmentSource()
354		}
355		gates := []assessment.Gate{
356			readinessGate("checkout-readiness", readiness.Checkout, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.checkout")),
357			readinessGate("task-readiness", readiness.Task, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.tasks", "local.runtime")),
358			readinessGate("worktree-readiness", readiness.Worktree, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.worktrees", "local.runtime")),
359			{
360				Code: "whole-clone-eviction", Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate,
361				Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{
362					Code: "recovery-proof-unavailable", Subject: "repository",
363					Detail:      "whole-clone eviction is not assessed by the context profile",
364					Remediation: "create and restore-verify a recovery receipt before eviction",
365				}},
366			},
367		}
368		assessmentReport, err := assessment.NewReport(assessment.ProfileCheap, now, gates)
369		if err != nil {
370			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("seal repository context assessment: %w", err)
371		}
372		report.Assessment = assessmentReport
373
374		sort.Slice(report.Errors, func(i, j int) bool {
375			left, right := report.Errors[i], report.Errors[j]
376			return strings.Join([]string{left.Scope, left.Code, left.Subject, left.Message}, "\x00") <
377				strings.Join([]string{right.Scope, right.Code, right.Subject, right.Message}, "\x00")
378		})
379		return report, nil
380	}
381
382	func buildLocalFacts(input BuildInput, reportErrors *[]CollectionError) LocalFacts {
383		context := input.Context
384		local := LocalFacts{
385			Checkouts:                          make([]CheckoutFacts, 0, len(context.Checkouts)),
386			OtherTasks:                         []TaskFacts{},
387			ObservedLinkedWorktreeAdminEntries: context.WorktreeCount,
388			CheckoutsComplete:                  context.WorktreeErr == nil,
389			TaskInventoryComplete:              context.TaskErr == nil,
390			Runtimes:                           []RuntimeFacts{},
391		}
392		if context.WorktreeErr == nil {
393			count := context.WorktreeCount
394			local.LinkedWorktreeCount = &count
395		} else {
396			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("worktree-inventory-failed", "local", "worktrees", context.WorktreeErr))
397		}
398		if context.TaskErr != nil {
399			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-inventory-failed", "local", "tasks", context.TaskErr))
400		}
401
402		for index, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
403			facts := CheckoutFacts{
404				Index: index, Path: checkout.Worktree.Path, Canonical: index == 0,
405				Ownership: checkout.Ownership, Locked: checkout.Worktree.Locked,
406				LockedReason:   optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)),
407				Prunable:       checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
408				PrunableReason: optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)),
409				Branch:         optionalString(checkout.Branch()), Head: optionalString(checkout.Worktree.Head),
410				LastActivity: optionalTime(checkout.LastActivity), LastCommit: optionalTime(checkout.LastCommit),
411				LastSubject: optionalString(checkout.LastSubject), Sessions: []RuntimeSession{}, Tasks: []TaskFacts{},
412			}
413			switch {
414			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
415				facts.State = "error"
416				facts.PathError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.PathErr))
417				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-path-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.PathErr))
418			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
419				facts.State = "missing"
420				exists := false
421				facts.Exists = &exists
422			case checkout.Worktree.Bare || index == 0 && context.Repo.Bare:
423				facts.State = "bare"
424				exists := true
425				facts.Exists = &exists
426				detached := false
427				facts.Detached = &detached
428			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
429				facts.State = "error"
430				exists := true
431				facts.Exists = &exists
432				facts.StatusError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.StatusErr))
433				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-status-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.StatusErr))
434			default:
435				facts.State = "available"
436				exists := true
437				facts.Exists = &exists
438				status := checkout.Status
439				facts.Status = &status
440				detached := checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached
441				facts.Detached = &detached
442			}
443			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
444				facts.Tasks = append(facts.Tasks, taskFacts(tracked))
445				if tracked != nil {
446					if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
447						*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
448					}
449				}
450			}
451			local.Checkouts = append(local.Checkouts, facts)
452		}
453		for _, tracked := range context.OtherTasks {
454			local.OtherTasks = append(local.OtherTasks, taskFacts(tracked))
455			if tracked != nil {
456				if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
457					*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
458				}
459			}
460		}
461
462		runtimes := input.Runtimes
463		if len(runtimes) == 0 && (context.Runtime != "" || context.RuntimeErr != nil || len(context.Sessions()) > 0) {
464			runtimes = []RuntimeInput{{
465				Backend: context.Runtime, Available: context.RuntimeErr == nil,
466				Sessions: context.Sessions(), Err: context.RuntimeErr,
467			}}
468		}
469		for runtimeIndex, observed := range runtimes {
470			backend := strings.TrimSpace(observed.Backend)
471			if backend == "" {
472				backend = fmt.Sprintf("unknown-%d", runtimeIndex+1)
473			}
474			runtimeFacts := RuntimeFacts{
475				Backend: backend, Available: observed.Available,
476				SourceID: "local.runtime", Sessions: []RuntimeSession{},
477			}
478			if observed.Err != nil {
479				runtimeFacts.Error = optionalString(cleanError(observed.Err))
480				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("runtime-inventory-failed", "local", "runtime:"+safeIdentifier(backend), observed.Err))
481			}
482			for _, session := range observed.Sessions {
483				indices := sessionCheckoutIndices(context, session)
484				if len(indices) == 0 {
485					continue
486				}
487				projected := RuntimeSession{
488					Backend: backend, Handle: session.Handle, Label: optionalString(session.Label),
489					AgentStatus:   optionalString(session.AgentStatus),
490					AgentSessions: append([]string{}, session.AgentSessions...),
491					Focused:       session.Focused, Checkouts: indices,
492				}
493				sort.Strings(projected.AgentSessions)
494				runtimeFacts.Sessions = append(runtimeFacts.Sessions, projected)
495				for _, checkoutIndex := range indices {
496					if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(local.Checkouts) {
497						local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions = append(local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions, projected)
498					}
499				}
500			}
501			sortRuntimeSessions(runtimeFacts.Sessions)
502			local.Runtimes = append(local.Runtimes, runtimeFacts)
503		}
504		sort.Slice(local.Runtimes, func(i, j int) bool { return local.Runtimes[i].Backend < local.Runtimes[j].Backend })
505		for index := range local.Checkouts {
506			sortRuntimeSessions(local.Checkouts[index].Sessions)
507		}
508		return local
509	}
510
511	func buildRemoteFacts(now time.Time, input BuildInput, reportErrors []CollectionError) ([]Remote, ForgeFacts, []CollectionError) {
512		forgeFacts := ForgeFacts{Error: optionalError(input.Forge.Err)}
513		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
514			sourceID := "forge.inventory"
515			forgeFacts.SourceID = &sourceID
516			records := len(input.Forge.Records)
517			forgeFacts.RecordsConsidered = &records
518			complete := input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete
519			forgeFacts.Complete = &complete
520		} else if input.Forge.Err != nil {
521			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-unavailable", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
522		}
523		if input.Forge.Err != nil && !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
524			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-partial", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
525		}
526		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
527			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("remote-topology-failed", "local", "remotes", input.TopologyErr))
528			if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
529				zero := 0
530				forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &zero
531			}
532			return []Remote{}, forgeFacts, reportErrors
533		}
534
535		recordsByIdentity := forgeRecordsByIdentity(input.Forge.Records)
536		currentUpstream := ""
537		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(input.Context.Checkouts) {
538			status := input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].Status
539			if input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].StatusErr == nil && status.Upstream != "" {
540				currentUpstream, _, _ = strings.Cut(status.Upstream, "/")
541			}
542		}
543		matchedRecords := map[string]struct{}{}
544		remotes := make([]Remote, 0, len(input.Topology.Remotes))
545		for _, observed := range input.Topology.Remotes {
546			remote := Remote{Name: observed.Name, Roles: remoteRoles(observed.Name, currentUpstream), Fetch: []RemoteEndpoint{}, Push: []RemoteEndpoint{}}
547			for index, raw := range observed.FetchURLs {
548				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
549				remote.Fetch = append(remote.Fetch, endpoint)
550				for _, key := range matched {
551					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
552				}
553				if endpointErr != nil {
554					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
555						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.fetch.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
556					})
557				}
558			}
559			for index, raw := range observed.PushURLs {
560				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
561				remote.Push = append(remote.Push, endpoint)
562				for _, key := range matched {
563					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
564				}
565				if endpointErr != nil {
566					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
567						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.push.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
568					})
569				}
570			}
571			remotes = append(remotes, remote)
572		}
573		if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
574			matches := len(matchedRecords)
575			forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &matches
576		}
577		return remotes, forgeFacts, reportErrors
578	}
579
580	type endpointBuildError struct {
581		Code    string
582		Message string
583	}
584
585	func buildRemoteEndpoint(raw string, records map[string][]forge.RemoteRepo, forgeAvailable, exactForge bool) (RemoteEndpoint, []string, *endpointBuildError) {
586		transport, displayIdentity, displayOK := publicEndpointIdentity(raw)
587		forgeMatch := "unavailable"
588		if forgeAvailable {
589			forgeMatch = "none"
590		}
591		endpoint := RemoteEndpoint{Transport: transport, Identity: optionalString(displayIdentity), ForgeMatch: forgeMatch}
592		privateIdentity := privateRemoteIdentity(raw)
593		if !displayOK {
594			message := "endpoint has no display-safe cross-host identity"
595			endpoint.Error = &message
596			return endpoint, nil, &endpointBuildError{Code: "remote-identity-unavailable", Message: message}
597		}
598
599		candidates := dedupeForgeRecords(records[privateIdentity])
600		var exact *forge.RemoteRepo
601		matched := []string{}
602		switch len(candidates) {
603		case 1:
604			if exactForge {
605				exact = &candidates[0]
606			}
607			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "exact"
608			matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidates[0]))
609		case 0:
610			if forgeAvailable {
611				endpoint.ForgeMatch = "none"
612			}
613		default:
614			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "ambiguous"
615			message := fmt.Sprintf("normalized endpoint identity matches %d forge records", len(candidates))
616			endpoint.Error = &message
617			for _, candidate := range candidates {
618				matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidate))
619			}
620			if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw}); ok {
621				endpoint.WebURL = &web
622			}
623			return endpoint, matched, &endpointBuildError{Code: "forge-match-ambiguous", Message: message}
624		}
625		if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw, Exact: exact}); ok {
626			endpoint.WebURL = &web
627		}
628		return endpoint, matched, nil
629	}

631	func buildFleetFacts(now time.Time, input FleetInput, localIdentities map[string]struct{}, reportErrors []CollectionError) (FleetFacts, []CollectionError) {
632		facts := FleetFacts{Coverage: FleetCoverageConfiguredHostsOnly, Hosts: []FleetHostObservation{}, Error: optionalError(input.Err)}
633		if !input.Configured {
634			if input.Err == nil {
635				facts.Error = optionalString("fleet configuration was not collected")
636			}
637			if facts.Error != nil {
638				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-config-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "configuration", Message: *facts.Error})
639			}
640			return facts, reportErrors
641		}
642		count := len(input.ConfiguredHostNames)
643		facts.ConfiguredHosts = &count
644		results := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
645		for _, result := range input.Results {
646			if _, exists := results[result.Name]; !exists {
647				results[result.Name] = result
648			}
649		}
650		for index, name := range input.ConfiguredHostNames {
651			result, found := results[name]
652			if !found {
653				result = fleet.HostResult{Name: name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "configured host produced no observation"}
654			}
655			host := FleetHostObservation{
656				Name: name, State: result.State, CachedAt: optionalTimeValue(result.CachedAt),
657				Match: FleetMatchUnavailable, Repositories: []FleetRepository{}, Error: optionalString(cleanText(result.Error)),
658			}
659			if result.Snapshot != nil {
660				matches := matchingFleetRepositories(result.Snapshot.Repositories, localIdentities)
661				for _, matched := range matches {
662					host.Repositories = append(host.Repositories, fleetRepositoryFacts(matched))
663				}
664				switch {
665				case len(localIdentities) == 0:
666					host.Match = FleetMatchUnavailable
667					if host.Error == nil {
668						host.Error = optionalString("local repository has no normalized remote identity")
669					}
670				case len(matches) == 0:
671					host.Match = FleetMatchNotFound
672				case len(matches) == 1:
673					host.Match = FleetMatchExact
674				default:
675					host.Match = FleetMatchAmbiguous
676					message := fmt.Sprintf("%d repositories on this host share a local normalized remote identity", len(matches))
677					if host.Error == nil {
678						host.Error = &message
679					}
680					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-match-ambiguous", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: message})
681				}
682
683				observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
684				if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
685					observedAt = *result.CachedAt
686				}
687				if !observedAt.IsZero() {
688					sourceID := fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index)
689					host.SourceID = &sourceID
690				}
691			}
692			if result.Error != "" || result.Snapshot == nil {
693				message := result.Error
694				if message == "" {
695					message = "host produced no repository snapshot"
696				}
697				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-host-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: cleanText(message)})
698			}
699			facts.Hosts = append(facts.Hosts, host)
700		}
701		return facts, reportErrors
702	}

704	func buildSources(now time.Time, input BuildInput, report Report) []Source {
705		sources := []Source{}
706		selectedFacts := any(nil)
707		checkoutCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessUnknown
708		if report.SelectedCheckout != nil {
709			selectedFacts = report.Local.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
710			checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessComplete
711			selected := input.Context.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
712			if selected.PathErr != nil || selected.StatusErr != nil {
713				checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
714			}
715		}
716		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.checkout", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, checkoutCompleteness, now, now, selectedFacts))
717
718		taskCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
719		if input.Context.TaskErr != nil {
720			taskCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
721		}
722		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.tasks", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, taskCompleteness, now, now, struct {
723			Checkouts  []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
724			OtherTasks []TaskFacts     `json:"other_tasks"`
725		}{report.Local.Checkouts, report.Local.OtherTasks}))
726
727		worktreeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
728		if input.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
729			worktreeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
730		}
731		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.worktrees", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, worktreeCompleteness, now, now, struct {
732			Count     *int            `json:"count"`
733			Checkouts []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
734		}{report.Local.LinkedWorktreeCount, report.Local.Checkouts}))
735
736		runtimeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
737		if len(report.Local.Runtimes) == 0 {
738			runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
739		}
740		for _, observed := range report.Local.Runtimes {
741			if observed.Error != nil {
742				runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
743			}
744		}
745		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.runtime", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, runtimeCompleteness, now, now, report.Local.Runtimes))
746
747		remoteCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
748		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
749			remoteCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
750		}
751		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.remotes", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, remoteCompleteness, now, now, report.Remotes))
752
753		if input.Fleet.Configured {
754			sources = append(sources, newSource("local.fleet-config", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, assessment.CompletenessComplete, now, now, input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames))
755		}
756		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
757			freshness := input.Forge.Freshness
758			if freshness == "" {
759				freshness = assessment.FreshnessUnknown
760			}
761			completeness := input.Forge.Completeness
762			if completeness == "" {
763				completeness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
764			}
765			sources = append(sources, newSource("forge.inventory", input.Forge.Authority, freshness, completeness, input.Forge.ObservedAt, now, struct {
766				Remotes []Remote   `json:"remotes"`
767				Forge   ForgeFacts `json:"forge"`
768			}{report.Remotes, report.Forge}))
769		}
770		resultByName := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
771		for _, result := range input.Fleet.Results {
772			resultByName[result.Name] = result
773		}
774		for index, name := range input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames {
775			result, ok := resultByName[name]
776			if !ok || result.Snapshot == nil || index >= len(report.Fleet.Hosts) {
777				continue
778			}
779			observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
780			if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
781				observedAt = *result.CachedAt
782			}
783			if observedAt.IsZero() {
784				continue
785			}
786			authority := assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive
787			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
788			if result.FromCache {
789				authority = assessment.AuthorityCache
790				if input.Fleet.CacheTTL > 0 && now.Sub(observedAt) > input.Fleet.CacheTTL {
791					freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
792				}
793			}
794			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
795			if result.Error != "" || result.State != fleet.HostOK && !result.FromCache {
796				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
797			}
798			sources = append(sources, newSource(fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index), authority, freshness, completeness, observedAt, now, report.Fleet.Hosts[index]))
799		}
800		sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool { return sources[i].ID < sources[j].ID })
801		return sources
802	}

804	func buildCapabilities(input BuildInput, report Report) []Capability {
805		capabilities := []Capability{}
806		localState := CapabilityAvailable
807		if input.TopologyErr != nil || input.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
808			localState = CapabilityPartial
809		}
810		for _, checkout := range input.Context.Checkouts {
811			if checkout.PathErr != nil || checkout.StatusErr != nil {
812				localState = CapabilityPartial
813			}
814		}
815		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{Code: "local-git", State: localState, SourceIDs: []string{"local.checkout", "local.worktrees", "local.remotes"}})
816
817		taskState := CapabilityAvailable
818		if input.Context.TaskErr != nil {
819			taskState = CapabilityPartial
820		}
821		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{Code: "task-inventory", State: taskState, SourceIDs: []string{"local.tasks"}})
822
823		runtimeState := CapabilityAvailable
824		if len(report.Local.Runtimes) == 0 {
825			runtimeState = CapabilityUnavailable
826		}
827		for _, observed := range report.Local.Runtimes {
828			if observed.Error != nil {
829				runtimeState = CapabilityPartial
830			}
831		}
832		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{Code: "runtime-inventory", State: runtimeState, SourceIDs: []string{"local.runtime"}})
833
834		forgeCapability := Capability{Code: "forge-inventory", State: CapabilityUnavailable, SourceIDs: []string{}}
835		if report.Forge.SourceID != nil {
836			forgeCapability.State = CapabilityAvailable
837			forgeCapability.SourceIDs = []string{*report.Forge.SourceID}
838			if input.Forge.Err != nil || input.Forge.Completeness != assessment.CompletenessComplete {
839				forgeCapability.State = CapabilityPartial
840			}
841		}
842		if report.Forge.Error != nil {
843			forgeCapability.Detail = *report.Forge.Error
844		}
845		capabilities = append(capabilities, forgeCapability)
846
847		fleetCapability := Capability{Code: "fleet-inventory", State: CapabilityUnavailable, SourceIDs: []string{}}
848		if input.Fleet.Configured {
849			fleetCapability.State = CapabilityAvailable
850			fleetCapability.SourceIDs = []string{"local.fleet-config"}
851			for _, host := range report.Fleet.Hosts {
852				if host.SourceID != nil {
853					fleetCapability.SourceIDs = append(fleetCapability.SourceIDs, *host.SourceID)
854				}
855				if host.Error != nil || host.SourceID == nil {
856					fleetCapability.State = CapabilityPartial
857				}
858			}
859		}
860		if report.Fleet.Error != nil {
861			fleetCapability.Detail = *report.Fleet.Error
862		}
863		capabilities = append(capabilities, fleetCapability)
864		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{
865			Code: "whole-clone-eviction", State: CapabilityNotImplemented, SourceIDs: []string{},
866			Detail: "context does not implement recovery receipt or restore-verification proof",
867		})
868		for index := range capabilities {
869			sort.Strings(capabilities[index].SourceIDs)
870		}
871		sort.Slice(capabilities, func(i, j int) bool { return capabilities[i].Code < capabilities[j].Code })
872		return capabilities
873	}

889	func newSource(id string, authority assessment.Authority, freshness assessment.Freshness, completeness assessment.Completeness, observedAt, now time.Time, facts any) Source {
890		observedAt = observedAt.Round(0).UTC()
891		encoded, err := json.Marshal(facts)
892		if err != nil {
893			encoded = []byte(fmt.Sprintf("unencodable:%T", facts))
894		}
895		age := int64(0)
896		if now.After(observedAt) {
897			age = int64(now.Sub(observedAt) / time.Second)
898		}
899		return Source{
900			ID: id, Authority: authority, Freshness: freshness, Completeness: completeness,
901			ObservedAt: observedAt, AgeSeconds: age, Fingerprint: assessment.FingerprintBytes(encoded),
902		}
903	}

962	func privateRemoteIdentity(raw string) string {
963		if !utf8.ValidString(raw) || containsControl(raw) {
964			return ""
965		}
966		return catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw)
967	}

969	func publicEndpointIdentity(raw string) (transport, identity string, ok bool) {
970		if !utf8.ValidString(raw) || containsControl(raw) {
971			return "unknown", "", false
972		}
973		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
974		if trimmed == "" {
975			return "unknown", "", false
976		}
977		redacted := trimmed
978		if parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
979			transport = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
980			parsed.User = nil
981			parsed.RawQuery = ""
982			parsed.ForceQuery = false
983			parsed.Fragment = ""
984			redacted = parsed.String()
985		} else {
986			if index := strings.IndexAny(redacted, "?#"); index >= 0 {
987				redacted = redacted[:index]
988			}
989			colon := strings.IndexByte(redacted, ':')
990			at := strings.LastIndexByte(redacted, '@')
991			if at >= 0 && colon > at {
992				transport = "ssh"
993				redacted = "git@" + redacted[at+1:]
994			} else if filepath.IsAbs(redacted) || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, "~") {
995				transport = "local"
996			} else {
997				transport = "unknown"
998			}
999		}
1000		identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(redacted)
1001		if identity == "" || containsControl(identity) {
1002			return transport, "", false
1003		}
1004		return transport, identity, true
1005	}

1007	func forgeRecordsByIdentity(records []forge.RemoteRepo) map[string][]forge.RemoteRepo {
1008		result := map[string][]forge.RemoteRepo{}
1009		for _, record := range records {
1010			seen := map[string]struct{}{}
1011			for _, raw := range []string{record.CloneURL, record.SSHURL, record.URL} {
1012				identity := privateRemoteIdentity(raw)
1013				if identity == "" {
1014					continue
1015				}
1016				if _, exists := seen[identity]; exists {
1017					continue
1018				}
1019				seen[identity] = struct{}{}
1020				result[identity] = append(result[identity], record)
1021			}
1022		}
1023		return result
1024	}
1025
1026	func dedupeForgeRecords(records []forge.RemoteRepo) []forge.RemoteRepo {
1027		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
1028		result := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(records))
1029		for _, record := range records {
1030			key := forgeRecordKey(record)
1031			if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
1032				continue
1033			}
1034			seen[key] = struct{}{}
1035			result = append(result, record)
1036		}
1037		sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return forgeRecordKey(result[i]) < forgeRecordKey(result[j]) })
1038		return result
1039	}

1041	func forgeRecordKey(record forge.RemoteRepo) string {
1042		return strings.Join([]string{string(record.Forge), record.FullName, record.URL}, "\x00")
1043	}

1059	func matchingFleetRepositories(repositories []fleet.RepoSnapshot, localIdentities map[string]struct{}) []fleet.RepoSnapshot {
1060		if len(localIdentities) == 0 {
1061			return nil
1062		}
1063		matches := []fleet.RepoSnapshot{}
1064		for _, repository := range repositories {
1065			matched := false
1066			for _, raw := range repository.RemoteIdentities {
1067				identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw)
1068				if identity == "" {
1069					continue
1070				}
1071				if _, ok := localIdentities[identity]; ok {
1072					matched = true
1073					break
1074				}
1075			}
1076			if matched {
1077				matches = append(matches, repository)
1078			}
1079		}
1080		sort.Slice(matches, func(i, j int) bool {
1081			return strings.Join([]string{matches[i].Display, matches[i].Path}, "\x00") <
1082				strings.Join([]string{matches[j].Display, matches[j].Path}, "\x00")
1083		})
1084		return matches
1085	}

1118	// cleanText removes controls and structurally redacts URL/scp-like tokens while
1119	// preserving enough of an error to diagnose which probe failed.
1120	func cleanText(value string) string {
1121		value = strings.Map(func(r rune) rune {
1122			if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
1123				return ' '
1124			}
1125			return r
1126		}, value)
1127		fields := strings.Fields(value)
1128		for index, field := range fields {
1129			fields[index] = redactTextToken(field)
1130		}
1131		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(fields, " "))
1132	}
1133
1134	func redactTextToken(token string) string {
1135		prefix := strings.TrimLeft(token, "([{<\"'")
1136		leading := token[:len(token)-len(prefix)]
1137		core := strings.TrimRight(prefix, ")]}>\"',;.")
1138		trailing := prefix[len(core):]
1139		if parsed, err := url.Parse(core); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
1140			parsed.User = nil
1141			parsed.RawQuery = ""
1142			parsed.ForceQuery = false
1143			parsed.Fragment = ""
1144			return leading + parsed.String() + trailing
1145		}
1146		colon := strings.IndexByte(core, ':')
1147		at := strings.LastIndexByte(core, '@')
1148		if at > 0 && colon > at {
1149			core = "[redacted]@" + core[at+1:]
1150			if query := strings.IndexAny(core, "?#"); query >= 0 {
1151				core = core[:query]
1152			}
1153		}
1154		return leading + core + trailing
1155	}
1156
1157	func containsControl(value string) bool {
1158		return strings.IndexFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
1159			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
1160		}) >= 0
1161	}
1162
1163	func safeIdentifier(value string) string {
1164		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
1165		var b strings.Builder
1166		lastDash := false
1167		for _, r := range value {
1168			if r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' {
1169				b.WriteRune(r)
1170				lastDash = false
1171			} else if !lastDash {
1172				b.WriteByte('-')
1173				lastDash = true
1174			}
1175		}
1176		result := strings.Trim(b.String(), "-")
1177		if result == "" {
1178			return "unknown"
1179		}
1180		return result
1181	}

8	// FormatMarkdown extends the legacy deterministic handoff with additive safe
9	// remote, fleet, provenance, and readiness sections. legacy remains unchanged
10	// at the front so existing copy/paste consumers retain their headings.
11	func FormatMarkdown(report Report, legacy string) string {
12		var b strings.Builder
13		b.WriteString(strings.TrimSpace(legacy))
14		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n\n## Context report\n\n- Schema: %d\n- Generated: `%s`\n", report.SchemaVersion, report.GeneratedAt.Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"))
15		if report.SelectedCheckout != nil {
16			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Selected checkout: `%s`", report.SelectedCheckout.Path)
17			if report.SelectedCheckout.Branch != nil {
18				fmt.Fprintf(&b, " (`%s`)", *report.SelectedCheckout.Branch)
19			}
20			b.WriteString("\n")
21		} else {
22			b.WriteString("- Selected checkout: unavailable\n")
23		}
24
25		b.WriteString("\n## Readiness\n")
26		for _, gate := range report.Assessment.Gates {
27			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n- `%s`: **%s**", gate.Code, gate.Outcome)
28			if len(gate.Reasons) > 0 {
29				fmt.Fprintf(&b, " — %s", gate.Reasons[0].Detail)
30			}
31			b.WriteString("\n")
32		}
33
34		b.WriteString("\n## Safe remotes\n")
35		if len(report.Remotes) == 0 {
36			b.WriteString("\n- No remotes were observed.\n")
37		}
38		for _, remote := range report.Remotes {
39			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n### %s", remote.Name)
40			if len(remote.Roles) > 0 {
41				roles := make([]string, len(remote.Roles))
42				for index, role := range remote.Roles {
43					roles[index] = string(role)
44				}
45				fmt.Fprintf(&b, " — %s", strings.Join(roles, ", "))
46			}
47			b.WriteString("\n")
48			writeEndpoints(&b, "fetch", remote.Fetch)
49			writeEndpoints(&b, "push", remote.Push)
50		}
51
52		b.WriteString("\n## Fleet observations\n\n")
53		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Coverage: **%s**\n", report.Fleet.Coverage)
54		if report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts == nil {
55			b.WriteString("- Configured hosts: unavailable\n")
56		} else {
57			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Configured hosts: %d\n", *report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts)
58		}
59		if len(report.Fleet.Hosts) == 0 && report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts != nil && *report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts == 0 {
60			b.WriteString("- No fleet hosts are configured.\n")
61		}
62		sourceByID := map[string]Source{}
63		for _, source := range report.Sources {
64			sourceByID[source.ID] = source
65		}
66		for _, host := range report.Fleet.Hosts {
67			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: %s; match %s", host.Name, host.State, host.Match)
68			if host.SourceID != nil {

70					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "; %s (%s, %s old)", source.Authority, source.Freshness, humanAge(source.AgeSeconds))
71				}
72			}

75			} else if len(host.Repositories) > 1 {

88			}

93	func writeEndpoints(b *strings.Builder, kind string, endpoints []RemoteEndpoint) {
94		if len(endpoints) == 0 {
95			fmt.Fprintf(b, "\n- %s: unavailable\n", kind)
96			return
97		}
98		for _, endpoint := range endpoints {
99			fmt.Fprintf(b, "\n- %s: ", kind)
100			if endpoint.Identity != nil {
101				fmt.Fprintf(b, "`%s`", *endpoint.Identity)
102			} else {
103				b.WriteString("unavailable")
104			}
105			if endpoint.WebURL != nil {
106				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s (%s, %s)", endpoint.WebURL.URL, endpoint.WebURL.Provider, endpoint.WebURL.Source)
107			}
108			if endpoint.Error != nil {
109				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", *endpoint.Error)
110			}
111			b.WriteString("\n")
112		}
113	}

115	func humanAge(seconds int64) string {
116		switch {
117		case seconds < 60:
118			return fmt.Sprintf("%ds", seconds)
119		case seconds < 3600:
120			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", seconds/60)
121		case seconds < 86400:
122			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", seconds/3600)
123		default:
124			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", seconds/86400)
125		}
126	}
