59
60		configData, present, err := readOptional(paths.Config)
61		if err != nil {
62			return Result{}, err
63		}
64		result.ConfigPresent = present
65		if present {
66			project, metadata, err := decodeProjectConfig(configData)
67			if err != nil {
68				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", paths.Config, err)
69			}
70			if project.Version != nil && *project.Version != projectConfigVersion {
71				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: version %d is unsupported (want %d)", paths.Config, *project.Version, projectConfigVersion)
72			}
73			result.Project = Override{Worktree: project.Worktree, LocalFiles: project.LocalFiles, Repo: project.Repo}
74			if err := result.Project.validate(); err != nil {
75				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("validate %s: %w", paths.Config, err)
76			}
77			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, diagnosticsForUndecoded(paths.Config, metadata.Undecoded())...)
78			result.Effective = overlay(result.Effective, result.Project, paths.Config, result.Sources)
79			result.Layers = append(result.Layers, paths.Config)
80		}
81
82		scaffoldData, present, err := readOptional(paths.Scaffolds)
83		if err != nil {
84			return Result{}, err
85		}
86		result.ScaffoldsPresent = present
87		var scaffoldDocument map[string]any
88		if present {
89			if _, err := toml.Decode(string(scaffoldData), &scaffoldDocument); err != nil {
90				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", paths.Scaffolds, err)
91			}
92			if err := validateScaffoldVersion(scaffoldDocument); err != nil {
93				return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", paths.Scaffolds, err)
94			}
95			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, scaffoldDiagnostics(paths.Scaffolds, scaffoldDocument)...)
96		}
97
98		result.ExecutionHash, err = executionHash(paths.Root, result.Effective, scaffoldDocument)
99		if err != nil {
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("hash executable project config: %w", err)
101		}
102		sortDiagnostics(result.Diagnostics)
103		return result, nil
104	}
105
106	func readOptional(path string) ([]byte, bool, error) {
107		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
108		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
109			return nil, false, nil
110		}
111		if err != nil {
112			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
113		}
114		return data, true, nil
115	}
116
117	func decodeProjectConfig(data []byte) (projectFile, toml.MetaData, error) {
118		var project projectFile
119		metadata, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &project)
120		return project, metadata, err
121	}
122
123	func diagnosticsForUndecoded(source string, keys []toml.Key) []Diagnostic {
124		diagnostics := make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(keys))
125		seenDenied := map[string]bool{}
126		seenUnknown := map[string]bool{}
127		for _, undecoded := range keys {
128			key := undecoded.String()
129			top, _, _ := strings.Cut(key, ".")
130			if deniedTopLevelSections[top] {
131				if seenDenied[top] {
132					continue
133				}
134				seenDenied[top] = true
135				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
136					Kind: DiagnosticDenied, Source: source, Key: top,
137					Message: fmt.Sprintf("project config cannot override host section %s", top),
138				})
139				continue
140			}
141			if seenUnknown[key] {
142				continue
143			}
144			seenUnknown[key] = true
145			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
146				Kind: DiagnosticUnknown, Source: source, Key: key,
147				Message: fmt.Sprintf("unknown project config key %s was ignored", key),
148			})
149		}
150		return diagnostics
151	}
152
153	func scaffoldDiagnostics(source string, document map[string]any) []Diagnostic {
154		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
155		for key := range document {
156			if allowedScaffoldTopLevel[key] {
157				continue
158			}
159			kind := DiagnosticUnknown
160			message := fmt.Sprintf("unknown scaffold config section %s was ignored", key)
161			if deniedTopLevelSections[key] {
162				kind = DiagnosticDenied
163				message = fmt.Sprintf("scaffold config cannot override host section %s", key)
164			}
165			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Kind: kind, Source: source, Key: key, Message: message})
166		}
167		return diagnostics
168	}
169
170	func validateScaffoldVersion(document map[string]any) error {
171		value, ok := document["version"]
172		if !ok {
173			return nil
174		}
175		version, ok := value.(int64)
176		if !ok {
177			return fmt.Errorf("version must be an integer")
178		}
179		if version != projectConfigVersion {
180			return fmt.Errorf("version %d is unsupported (want %d)", version, projectConfigVersion)
181		}
182		return nil
183	}
184
185	func overlay(base, next Override, source string, sources map[string]string) Override {
186		if next.Worktree.Include != nil {
187			value := append([]string(nil), (*next.Worktree.Include)...)
188			base.Worktree.Include = &value
189			sources["worktree.include"] = source
190		}
191		if next.Worktree.Link != nil {
192			value := append([]string(nil), (*next.Worktree.Link)...)
193			base.Worktree.Link = &value
194			sources["worktree.link"] = source
195		}
196		if next.Worktree.PostCreate != nil {
197			value := *next.Worktree.PostCreate
198			value.Commands = append([]string(nil), value.Commands...)
199			base.Worktree.PostCreate = &value
200			sources["worktree.post_create"] = source
201		}
202		if next.Worktree.Strategy != nil {
203			value := *next.Worktree.Strategy
204			base.Worktree.Strategy = &value
205			sources["worktree.strategy"] = source
206		}
207		if next.Worktree.Strategies != nil {
208			merged := map[string]string{}
209			if base.Worktree.Strategies != nil {
210				for key, value := range *base.Worktree.Strategies {
211					merged[key] = value
212				}
213			}
214			for key, value := range *next.Worktree.Strategies {
215				merged[key] = value
216				sources["worktree.strategies."+key] = source
217			}
218			base.Worktree.Strategies = &merged
219		}
220		if next.Worktree.ProvisionTimeout != nil {
221			value := *next.Worktree.ProvisionTimeout
222			base.Worktree.ProvisionTimeout = &value
223			sources["worktree.provision_timeout"] = source
224		}
225		if next.LocalFiles.Include != nil {
226			value := append([]string(nil), (*next.LocalFiles.Include)...)
227			base.LocalFiles.Include = &value
228			sources["local_files.include"] = source
229		}
230		if next.Repo.Setup.Preset != nil {
231			value := *next.Repo.Setup.Preset
232			base.Repo.Setup.Preset = &value
233			sources["repo.setup.preset"] = source
234		}
235		if next.Repo.Setup.Handoff != nil {
236			value := *next.Repo.Setup.Handoff
237			base.Repo.Setup.Handoff = &value
238			sources["repo.setup.handoff"] = source
239		}
240		if next.Repo.Setup.CheckIn != nil {
241			value := *next.Repo.Setup.CheckIn
242			base.Repo.Setup.CheckIn = &value
243			base.Repo.Setup.Commit = nil
244			delete(sources, "repo.setup.commit")
245			sources["repo.setup.check_in"] = source
246		}
247		if next.Repo.Setup.Commit != nil {
248			value := *next.Repo.Setup.Commit
249			base.Repo.Setup.Commit = &value
250			base.Repo.Setup.CheckIn = nil
251			delete(sources, "repo.setup.check_in")
252			sources["repo.setup.commit"] = source
253		}
254		return base
255	}
256
257	func sortDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
258		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool {
259			if diagnostics[i].Source != diagnostics[j].Source {
260				return diagnostics[i].Source < diagnostics[j].Source
261			}
262			if diagnostics[i].Key != diagnostics[j].Key {
263				return diagnostics[i].Key < diagnostics[j].Key
264			}
265			return diagnostics[i].Kind < diagnostics[j].Kind
266		})
267	}
268
269	// executionHash fingerprints only project-owned settings that can cause an
270	// external command to run. The scaffold schema lives in internal/scaffold;
271	// this package intentionally extracts only hooks and skill setup generically.
272	func executionHash(repoRoot string, effective Override, scaffoldDocument map[string]any) (string, error) {
273		payload := map[string]any{}
274		if effective.Worktree.PostCreate != nil {
275			payload["worktree.post_create"] = effective.Worktree.PostCreate
276		}
277		// A project-selected preset can switch which hooks or skill setup runs even
278		// when the executable definitions themselves live in a global layer.
279		if effective.Repo.Setup.Preset != nil {
280			payload["repo.setup.preset"] = *effective.Repo.Setup.Preset
281		}
282		presets, hasPresets := scaffoldDocument["presets"]
283		selectors, hasSelectors := extractScaffoldSelectors(scaffoldDocument)
284		if hasSelectors {
285			payload["scaffolds.selectors"] = selectors
286		}
287		hasExecutableScaffold := false
288		if hasPresets {
289			if extracted, ok := extractExecutableScaffold(presets); ok {
290				hasExecutableScaffold = true
291				payload["scaffolds.presets"] = extracted
292			}
293		}
294		if files, ok := extractNamedScaffoldValues(presets, map[string]bool{"files": true}); ok {
295			// A project can override only a generated file while an inherited global
296			// hook executes it. Bind every project-owned file declaration even when the
297			// executable selector/definition lives in another layer.
298			payload["scaffolds.files"] = files
299			templates, err := hashProjectTemplateSources(repoRoot, presets)
300			if err != nil {
301				return "", err
302			}
303			if len(templates) > 0 {
304				payload["scaffolds.template_content"] = templates
305			}
306		}
307		if effective.Worktree.PostCreate != nil || hasExecutableScaffold || hasSelectors {
308			localFiles, err := hashLocalExecutionFiles(repoRoot, effective, presets)
309			if err != nil {
310				return "", err
311			}
312			if len(localFiles) > 0 {
313				payload["local_execution_content"] = localFiles
314			}
315		}
316		if hasExecutableScaffold || hasSelectors {
317			localSkills, err := hashLocalSkillSources(repoRoot, presets)
318			if err != nil {
319				return "", err
320			}
321			if len(localSkills) > 0 {
322				payload["local_skill_content"] = localSkills
323			}
324		}
325		if len(payload) == 0 {
326			return "", nil
327		}
328		canonical, err := json.Marshal(payload)
329		if err != nil {
330			return "", err
331		}
332		hash := sha256.New()
333		_, _ = hash.Write([]byte("dev-project-execution-v1\x00"))
334		_, _ = hash.Write(canonical)
335		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
336	}
337
338	func extractScaffoldSelectors(document map[string]any) (any, bool) {
339		out := map[string]any{}
340		for _, key := range []string{"default_preset", "default_agents"} {
341			if value, ok := document[key]; ok {
342				out[key] = value
343			}
344		}
345		if presets, ok := document["presets"]; ok {
346			if inherited, found := extractNamedScaffoldValues(presets, map[string]bool{"extends": true, "catalog": true}); found {
347				out["presets"] = inherited
348			}
349		}
350		return out, len(out) > 0
351	}
352
353	func extractNamedScaffoldValues(value any, names map[string]bool) (any, bool) {
354		switch typed := value.(type) {
355		case map[string]any:
356			out := map[string]any{}
357			for key, child := range typed {
358				if names[key] {
359					out[key] = child
360					continue
361				}
362				if nested, ok := extractNamedScaffoldValues(child, names); ok {
363					out[key] = nested
364				}
365			}
366			return out, len(out) > 0
367		case []map[string]any:
368			out := make([]any, 0, len(typed))
369			for index, child := range typed {
370				if nested, ok := extractNamedScaffoldValues(child, names); ok {
371					out = append(out, map[string]any{"index": index, "value": nested})
372				}
373			}
374			return out, len(out) > 0
375		case []any:
376			out := make([]any, 0, len(typed))
377			for index, child := range typed {
378				if nested, ok := extractNamedScaffoldValues(child, names); ok {
379					out = append(out, map[string]any{"index": index, "value": nested})
380				}
381			}
382			return out, len(out) > 0
383		default:
384			return nil, false
385		}
386	}
387
388	func hashProjectTemplateSources(repoRoot string, presets any) (map[string]string, error) {
389		sources := map[string]bool{}
390		collectFileSources(presets, false, sources)
391		result := map[string]string{}
392		base := filepath.Join(repoRoot, DirectoryName)
393		templatesRoot := filepath.Join(base, "templates")
394		for source := range sources {
395			normalized := path.Clean(strings.ReplaceAll(source, `\`, "/"))
396			if normalized == "." || normalized == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(normalized, "../") || path.IsAbs(normalized) {
397				return nil, fmt.Errorf("project scaffold template source %q must stay inside %s/templates", source, DirectoryName)
398			}
399			candidate := filepath.Join(templatesRoot, filepath.FromSlash(normalized))
400			if normalized == "templates" || strings.HasPrefix(normalized, "templates/") {
401				candidate = filepath.Join(base, filepath.FromSlash(normalized))
402			}
403			resolved, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(templatesRoot, candidate)
404			if err != nil {
405				return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve project scaffold template source %q: %w", source, err)
406			}
407			digest, err := hashRegularFile(resolved)
408			if err != nil {
409				return nil, fmt.Errorf("hash project scaffold template source %q: %w", source, err)
410			}
411			result[normalized] = digest
412		}
413		return result, nil
414	}
415
416	func collectFileSources(value any, inFiles bool, result map[string]bool) {
417		switch typed := value.(type) {
418		case map[string]any:
419			if inFiles {
420				if source, ok := typed["source"].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(source) != "" {
421					result[source] = true
422				}
423			}
424			for key, child := range typed {
425				collectFileSources(child, inFiles || key == "files", result)
426			}
427		case []map[string]any:
428			for _, child := range typed {
429				collectFileSources(child, inFiles, result)
430			}
431		case []any:
432			for _, child := range typed {
433				collectFileSources(child, inFiles, result)
434			}
435		}
436	}
437
438	func hashLocalExecutionFiles(repoRoot string, effective Override, presets any) (map[string]string, error) {
439		candidates := map[string]bool{}
440		if effective.Worktree.PostCreate != nil {
441			for _, command := range effective.Worktree.PostCreate.Commands {
442				collectCommandFileCandidate(strings.Fields(command), candidates)
443			}
444		}
445		collectScaffoldCommandFiles(presets, candidates)
446		result := map[string]string{}
447		for candidate := range candidates {
448			if strings.Contains(candidate, "{{") {
449				continue
450			}
451			candidate = strings.Trim(candidate, `"'`)
452			if !looksLikeLocalExecutionPath(candidate) {
453				continue
454			}
455			resolved := candidate
456			if !filepath.IsAbs(resolved) {
457				resolved = filepath.Join(repoRoot, filepath.FromSlash(strings.ReplaceAll(resolved, `\`, "/")))
458			}
459			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(resolved)
460			if err != nil {
461				continue // Generated scaffold destinations may not exist until apply.
462			}
463			info, err := os.Stat(canonical)
464			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) || err == nil && !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
465				continue
466			}
467			if err != nil {
468				return nil, err
469			}
470			digest, err := hashRegularFile(canonical)
471			if err != nil {
472				return nil, err
473			}
474			result[stableExecutionPath(repoRoot, canonical)] = digest
475		}
476		return result, nil
477	}
478
479	func collectScaffoldCommandFiles(value any, result map[string]bool) {
480		switch typed := value.(type) {
481		case map[string]any:
482			for key, child := range typed {
483				switch key {
484				case "command":
485					collectCommandFileCandidate(stringSlice(child), result)
486				case "run":
487					if command, ok := child.(string); ok {
488						collectCommandFileCandidate(strings.Fields(command), result)
489					}
490				default:
491					collectScaffoldCommandFiles(child, result)
492				}
493			}
494		case []map[string]any:
495			for _, child := range typed {
496				collectScaffoldCommandFiles(child, result)
497			}
498		case []any:
499			for _, child := range typed {
500				collectScaffoldCommandFiles(child, result)
501			}
502		}
503	}
504
505	func collectCommandFileCandidate(command []string, result map[string]bool) {
506		if len(command) == 0 {
507			return
508		}
509		if looksLikeLocalExecutionPath(command[0]) {
510			result[command[0]] = true
511			return
512		}
513		switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Base(command[0])) {
514		case "sh", "bash", "dash", "zsh", "python", "python3", "ruby", "perl", "node", "pwsh", "powershell", "powershell.exe":
515			for _, argument := range command[1:] {
516				if argument == "-c" || argument == "-e" || argument == "-m" || strings.HasPrefix(argument, "-") {
517					if argument == "-c" || argument == "-e" || argument == "-m" {
518						return
519					}
520					continue
521				}
522				if looksLikeLocalExecutionPath(argument) {
523					result[argument] = true
524				}
525				return
526			}
527		}
528	}
529
530	func stringSlice(value any) []string {
531		var result []string
532		switch typed := value.(type) {
533		case []any:
534			for _, item := range typed {
535				if text, ok := item.(string); ok {
536					result = append(result, text)
537				}
538			}
539		case []string:
540			result = append(result, typed...)
541		}
542		return result
543	}
544
545	func looksLikeLocalExecutionPath(value string) bool {
546		value = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), `"'`)
547		return value != "" && (filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" ||
548			strings.HasPrefix(value, "./") || strings.HasPrefix(value, ".\\") ||
549			strings.Contains(value, "/") || strings.Contains(value, `\`))
550	}
551
552	func hashLocalSkillSources(repoRoot string, presets any) (map[string]string, error) {
553		sources := map[string]bool{}
554		collectLocalSkillSources(presets, sources)
555		result := map[string]string{}
556		for source := range sources {
557			resolved := source
558			if strings.HasPrefix(resolved, "file://") {
559				resolved = strings.TrimPrefix(resolved, "file://")
560			}
561			if strings.HasPrefix(resolved, "~/") || strings.HasPrefix(resolved, "~\\") {
562				home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
563				if err != nil {
564					return nil, err
565				}
566				resolved = filepath.Join(home, resolved[2:])
567			} else if !filepath.IsAbs(resolved) {
568				resolved = filepath.Join(repoRoot, resolved)
569			}
570			if info, err := os.Lstat(resolved); err != nil {
571				return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect local setup skill source %q: %w", source, err)
572			} else if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
573				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local setup skill source %q must not be a symlink", source)
574			}
575			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(resolved)
576			if err != nil {
577				return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve local setup skill source %q: %w", source, err)
578			}
579			digest, err := hashTree(canonical)
580			if err != nil {
581				return nil, fmt.Errorf("hash local setup skill source %q: %w", source, err)
582			}
583			result[stableExecutionPath(repoRoot, canonical)] = digest
584		}
585		return result, nil
586	}
587
588	func stableExecutionPath(repoRoot, filename string) string {
589		if inside, err := pathx.Contains(repoRoot, filename); err == nil && inside {
590			if relative, err := filepath.Rel(repoRoot, filename); err == nil {
591				return "repo:" + filepath.ToSlash(relative)
592			}
593		}
594		return "external:" + filepath.Clean(filename)
595	}
596
597	func collectLocalSkillSources(value any, result map[string]bool) {
598		switch typed := value.(type) {
599		case map[string]any:
600			if _, hasSetup := typed["setup"]; hasSetup {
601				if source, ok := typed["source"].(string); ok && IsLocalSkillSource(source) {
602					result[source] = true
603				}
604			}
605			for _, child := range typed {
606				collectLocalSkillSources(child, result)
607			}
608		case []map[string]any:
609			for _, child := range typed {
610				collectLocalSkillSources(child, result)
611			}
612		case []any:
613			for _, child := range typed {
614				collectLocalSkillSources(child, result)
615			}
616		}
617	}
618
619	// IsLocalSkillSource reports whether the upstream skills CLI will resolve a
620	// source from the local filesystem instead of fetching mutable remote content.
621	func IsLocalSkillSource(source string) bool {
622		source = strings.TrimSpace(source)
623		return source == "." || source == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(source) || filepath.VolumeName(source) != "" ||
624			strings.HasPrefix(source, "./") || strings.HasPrefix(source, ".\\") ||
625			strings.HasPrefix(source, "../") || strings.HasPrefix(source, "..\\") ||
626			strings.HasPrefix(source, "~/") || strings.HasPrefix(source, "~\\") || strings.HasPrefix(source, "file://")
627	}
628
629	func hashRegularFile(filename string) (string, error) {
630		info, err := os.Stat(filename)
631		if err != nil {
632			return "", err
633		}
634		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
635			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s is not a regular file", filename)
636		}
637		data, err := os.ReadFile(filename)
638		if err != nil {
639			return "", err
640		}
641		hash := sha256.New()
642		fmt.Fprintf(hash, "mode:%04o\x00", info.Mode().Perm())
643		_, _ = hash.Write(data)
644		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
645	}
646
647	func hashTree(root string) (string, error) {
648		info, err := os.Lstat(root)
649		if err != nil {
650			return "", err
651		}
652		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
653			return "", fmt.Errorf("local setup skill root must not be a symlink")
654		}
655		if info.Mode().IsRegular() {
656			return hashRegularFile(root)
657		}
658		if !info.IsDir() {
659			return "", fmt.Errorf("local setup skill source is not a directory or regular file")
660		}
661		hash := sha256.New()
662		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
663			if walkErr != nil {
664				return walkErr
665			}
666			if filename == root {
667				return nil
668			}
669			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, filename)
670			if err != nil {
671				return err
672			}
673			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
674				return fmt.Errorf("local setup skill source contains symlink %s", relative)
675			}
676			if entry.IsDir() {
677				return nil
678			}
679			info, err := entry.Info()
680			if err != nil {
681				return err
682			}
683			if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
684				return fmt.Errorf("local setup skill source contains non-regular file %s", relative)
685			}
686			data, err := os.ReadFile(filename)
687			if err != nil {
688				return err
689			}
690			fmt.Fprintf(hash, "%s\x00%04o\x00", filepath.ToSlash(relative), info.Mode().Perm())
691			_, _ = hash.Write(data)
692			_, _ = hash.Write([]byte{0})
693			return nil
694		})
695		if err != nil {
696			return "", err
697		}
698		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
699	}
700
701	func extractExecutableScaffold(value any) (any, bool) {
702		switch typed := value.(type) {
703		case map[string]any:
704			out := map[string]any{}
705			for key, child := range typed {
706				switch key {
707				case "hooks", "skills", "setup":
708					out[key] = child
709				default:
710					if nested, ok := extractExecutableScaffold(child); ok {
711						out[key] = nested
712					}
713				}
714			}
715			return out, len(out) > 0
716		case []map[string]any:
717			out := make([]any, 0, len(typed))
718			for index, child := range typed {
719				if nested, ok := extractExecutableScaffold(child); ok {
720					out = append(out, map[string]any{"index": index, "value": nested})
721				}
722			}
723			return out, len(out) > 0
724		case []any:
725			out := make([]any, 0, len(typed))
726			for index, child := range typed {
727				if nested, ok := extractExecutableScaffold(child); ok {
728					out = append(out, map[string]any{"index": index, "value": nested})
729				}
730			}
731			return out, len(out) > 0
732		default:
733			return nil, false
734		}
735	}
736

172	func (o Override) validate() error {
173		w := o.Worktree
174		validStrategy := func(value string) bool {
175			switch value {
176			case "reinstall", "copy", "link", "skip":
177				return true
178			default:
179				return false
180			}
181		}
182		if w.Strategy != nil && !validStrategy(*w.Strategy) {
183			return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategy %q: want reinstall, copy, link or skip", *w.Strategy)
184		}
185		if w.Strategies != nil {
186			for ecosystem, strategy := range *w.Strategies {
187				if strings.TrimSpace(ecosystem) == "" {
188					return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategies contains an empty ecosystem name")
189				}
190				if !validStrategy(strategy) {
191					return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategies.%s %q: want reinstall, copy, link or skip", ecosystem, strategy)
192				}
193			}
194		}
195		if w.ProvisionTimeout != nil && w.ProvisionTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
196			return fmt.Errorf("worktree.provision_timeout must be positive")
197		}
198		if w.Link != nil {
199			for index, value := range *w.Link {
200				if err := validateRelativePath(value); err != nil {
201					return fmt.Errorf("worktree.link[%d]: %w", index, err)
202				}
203			}
204		}
205		if o.LocalFiles.Include != nil {
206			for index, value := range *o.LocalFiles.Include {
207				if err := ValidateLocalFilePattern(value); err != nil {
208					return fmt.Errorf("local_files.include[%d]: %w", index, err)
209				}
210			}
211		}
212		setup := o.Repo.Setup
213		if setup.Preset != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*setup.Preset) == "" {
214			return fmt.Errorf("repo.setup.preset must not be empty")
215		}
216		if setup.Handoff != nil {
217			switch *setup.Handoff {
218			case "stay", "cd", "open", "start":
219			default:
220				return fmt.Errorf("repo.setup.handoff %q: want stay, cd, open or start", *setup.Handoff)
221			}
222		}
223		if setup.CheckIn != nil {
224			switch *setup.CheckIn {
225			case "commit", "stage", "none":
226			default:
227				return fmt.Errorf("repo.setup.check_in %q: want commit, stage or none", *setup.CheckIn)
228			}
229		}
230		if setup.CheckIn != nil && setup.Commit != nil {
231			return fmt.Errorf("repo.setup cannot set both check_in and commit")
232		}
233		return nil
234	}

236	func validateRelativePath(value string) error {
237		if value == "" {
238			return fmt.Errorf("path must not be empty")
239		}
240		if filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" {
241			return fmt.Errorf("path %q must be repository-relative", value)
242		}
243		for _, part := range strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' || r == '\\' }) {
244			if part == ".." {
245				return fmt.Errorf("path %q contains parent traversal", value)
246			}
247		}
248		if filepath.Clean(value) == "." {
249			return fmt.Errorf("path %q names the repository root", value)
250		}
251		return nil
252	}

89	// Prepare validates and reads a template source. A live local Git worktree is
90	// filtered through Git so tracked files (including tracked ignored files) and
91	// untracked non-ignored files are retained without copying ignored secrets. A
92	// ref or non-local source is checked out into an isolated repository first.
93	func Prepare(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Snapshot, error) {
94		request.Source = strings.TrimSpace(request.Source)
95		request.Ref = strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref)
96		request.Subdir = strings.TrimSpace(request.Subdir)
97		if request.Source == "" {
98			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("template source is required")
99		}
100		if strings.HasPrefix(request.Ref, "-") {
101			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template ref %q must not start with '-'", request.Ref)
102		}
103		subdir, err := cleanSubdir(request.Subdir)
104		if err != nil {
105			return Snapshot{}, err
106		}
107
108		local := config.Expand(request.Source)
109		info, statErr := os.Lstat(local)
110		localSource := statErr == nil
111		if statErr == nil {
112			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
113				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source %q is a symlink", repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source))
114			}
115			if !info.IsDir() {
116				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source %q is not a directory", repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source))
117			}
118		} else if !errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
119			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect template source %q: %v", repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source),
120				repo.RedactCloneError(statErr, request.Source, local))
121		}
122		if localSource && request.Ref == "" {
123			return snapshotDirectory(ctx, repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source), local, "", "", subdir, snapshotSource{
124				local: true,
125				live:  true,
126			})
127		}
128
129		checkout, resolvedRef, cleanup, err := checkoutGitSource(ctx, request.Source, request.Ref)
130		if err != nil {
131			return Snapshot{}, err
132		}
133		defer cleanup()
134		return snapshotDirectory(ctx, repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source), checkout, request.Ref, resolvedRef, subdir, snapshotSource{
135			local: localSource,
136		})
137	}

139	func checkoutGitSource(ctx context.Context, source, ref string) (string, string, func(), error) {
140		parent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "dev-repo-template-*")
141		if err != nil {
142			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("create template checkout: %w", err)
143		}
144		cleanup := func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(parent) }
145		checkout := filepath.Join(parent, "source")
146		normalized := repo.NormalizeCloneRef(source)
147		safeSource := repo.RedactCloneRef(source)
148		redact := func(err error) error { return repo.RedactCloneError(err, source, normalized) }
149		if ref == "" {
150			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, parent, "clone", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--", normalized, checkout); err != nil {
151				cleanup()
152				return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("clone template source %q: %v", safeSource, redact(err))
153			}
154			resolved, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
155			if err != nil {
156				cleanup()
157				return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("resolve template HEAD: %v", redact(err))
158			}
159			return checkout, resolved, cleanup, nil
160		}
161
162		if err := os.Mkdir(checkout, 0o755); err != nil {
163			cleanup()
164			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("create template checkout: %w", err)
165		}
166		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "init", "--quiet"); err != nil {
167			cleanup()
168			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("initialize template checkout: %v", redact(err))
169		}
170		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "add", "--", "origin", normalized); err != nil {
171			cleanup()
172			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("configure template source %q: %v", safeSource, redact(err))
173		}
174		checkoutTarget := "FETCH_HEAD"
175		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "fetch", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "origin", ref); err != nil {
176			if _, exactErr := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "fetch", "--quiet", "origin", ref); exactErr != nil {
177				if _, fullErr := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "fetch", "--quiet", "origin"); fullErr != nil {
178					cleanup()
179					joined := errors.Join(err, exactErr, fullErr)
180					return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("fetch template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(joined))
181				}
182				checkoutTarget = ref
183			}
184		}
185		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", checkoutTarget); err != nil && checkoutTarget == ref {
186			if _, remoteErr := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", "origin/"+ref); remoteErr != nil {
187				cleanup()
188				return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("checkout template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(errors.Join(err, remoteErr)))
189			}
190		} else if err != nil {
191			cleanup()
192			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("checkout template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(err))
193		}
194		resolved, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
195		if err != nil {
196			cleanup()
197			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("resolve template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(err))
198		}
199		return checkout, resolved, cleanup, nil
200	}
201
202	func snapshotDirectory(ctx context.Context, sourceLabel, rootPath, ref, commit, subdir string, source snapshotSource) (Snapshot, error) {
203		root, rootInfo, err := openNamedRoot(rootPath)
204		if err != nil {
205			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve template source %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
206		}
207		defer root.Close()
208
209		selected := root
210		selectedInfo := rootInfo
211		selectedPath := rootPath
212		if subdir != "" {
213			selected, selectedInfo, err = openRelativeRoot(root, subdir)
214			if err != nil {
215				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template subdirectory %q: %w", subdir, err)
216			}
217			defer selected.Close()
218			selectedPath = filepath.Join(rootPath, filepath.FromSlash(subdir))
219		}
220
221		snapshot := Snapshot{
222			Source: sourceLabel, Ref: ref, Commit: commit, Subdir: subdir,
223			Local: source.local, Live: source.live,
224		}
225		if source.live {
226			paths, filtered, err := liveGitPaths(ctx, selectedPath)
227			if err != nil {
228				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("list live template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
229			}
230			if err := verifyNamedRoot(selectedPath, selectedInfo); err != nil {
231				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source changed while listing: %w", err)
232			}
233			snapshot.GitFiltered = filtered
234			if filtered {
235				tree, err := buildSelectionTree(paths)
236				if err != nil {
237					return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
238				}
239				if _, err := snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx, selected, tree, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
240					return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
241				}
242			} else if err := snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, selected, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
243				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
244			}
245		} else if err := snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, selected, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
246			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
247		}
248		if err := verifyNamedRoot(selectedPath, selectedInfo); err != nil {
249			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source changed during snapshot: %w", err)
250		}
251		if err := finalizeSnapshot(&snapshot); err != nil {
252			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
253		}
254		return snapshot, nil
255	}

261	func openRelativeRoot(base *os.Root, relative string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
262		current := base
263		owned := false
264		for _, component := range strings.Split(relative, "/") {
265			next, _, err := openChildRoot(current, component)
266			if err != nil {
267				if owned {
268					current.Close()
269				}
270				return nil, nil, err
271			}
272			if owned {
273				current.Close()
274			}
275			current, owned = next, true
276		}
277		info, err := current.Stat(".")
278		if err != nil {
279			current.Close()
280			return nil, nil, err
281		}
282		return current, info, nil
283	}

297	func liveGitPaths(ctx context.Context, root string) ([]string, bool, error) {
298		if _, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, root); err != nil {
299			if errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
300				return nil, false, nil
301			}
302			return nil, false, err
303		}
304		selected := map[string]bool{}
305		tracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "ls-files", "-z", "--stage", "--", ".")
306		if err != nil {
307			return nil, false, err
308		}
309		for _, record := range splitNUL(tracked) {
310			tab := strings.IndexByte(record, '\t')
311			if tab < 0 {
312				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("unexpected git ls-files record %q", record)
313			}
314			header, path := record[:tab], record[tab+1:]
315			fields := strings.Fields(header)
316			if len(fields) < 1 {
317				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("unexpected git ls-files record %q", record)
318			}
319			if fields[0] == "160000" {
320				continue
321			}
322			selected[path] = true
323		}
324		untracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "ls-files", "-z", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "--", ".")
325		if err != nil {
326			return nil, false, err
327		}
328		for _, path := range splitNUL(untracked) {
329			selected[path] = true
330		}
331		paths := make([]string, 0, len(selected))
332		for path := range selected {
333			cleaned, err := validateSnapshotPath(path)
334			if err != nil {
335				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q: %w", path, err)
336			}
337			paths = append(paths, cleaned)
338		}
339		sort.Strings(paths)
340		return paths, true, nil
341	}
342
343	func splitNUL(value string) []string {
344		value = strings.TrimSuffix(value, "\x00")
345		if value == "" {
346			return nil
347		}
348		return strings.Split(value, "\x00")
349	}

351	type selectionNode struct {
352		leaf     bool
353		children map[string]*selectionNode
354	}
355
356	func buildSelectionTree(paths []string) (*selectionNode, error) {
357		root := &selectionNode{children: map[string]*selectionNode{}}
358		for _, path := range paths {
359			current := root
360			components := strings.Split(path, "/")
361			for index, component := range components {
362				if current.leaf {
363					return nil, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q is below another selected file", path)
364				}
365				if current.children[component] == nil {
366					current.children[component] = &selectionNode{children: map[string]*selectionNode{}}
367				}
368				current = current.children[component]
369				if index == len(components)-1 {
370					if len(current.children) > 0 {
371						return nil, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q is the parent of another selected path", path)
372					}
373					current.leaf = true
374				}
375			}
376		}
377		return root, nil
378	}

380	func snapshotWholeRoot(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, relative string, snapshot *Snapshot) error {
381		if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
382			return err
383		}
384		directory, err := root.Open(".")
385		if err != nil {
386			return err
387		}
388		defer directory.Close()
389		before, err := directory.Stat()
390		if err != nil {
391			return err
392		}
393		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(-1)
394		if err != nil {
395			return err
396		}
397		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
398		for _, entry := range entries {
399			name := entry.Name()
400			if strings.EqualFold(name, ".git") {
401				continue
402			}
403			if err := validateSnapshotComponent(name); err != nil {
404				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
405			}
406			info, err := root.Lstat(name)
407			if err != nil {
408				return fmt.Errorf("inspect template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
409			}
410			path := joinRelative(relative, name)
411			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
412				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a symlink", path)
413			}
414			switch {
415			case info.IsDir():
416				child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
417				if err != nil {
418					return fmt.Errorf("open template directory %q: %w", path, err)
419				}
420				snapshot.Directories = append(snapshot.Directories, Directory{Path: path, Mode: held.Mode().Perm()})
421				err = snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, child, path, snapshot)
422				verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
423				closeErr := child.Close()
424				if err != nil {
425					return err
426				}
427				if verifyErr != nil {
428					return verifyErr
429				}
430				if closeErr != nil {
431					return closeErr
432				}
433			case info.Mode().IsRegular():
434				data, opened, err := readStableRootFile(ctx, root, name, info)
435				if err != nil {
436					return fmt.Errorf("read template file %q: %w", path, err)
437				}
438				snapshot.Files = append(snapshot.Files, File{Path: path, Mode: opened.Mode().Perm(), Data: data})
439			default:
440				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a special file (%s)", path, info.Mode().Type())
441			}
442		}
443		after, err := directory.Stat()
444		if err != nil {
445			return err
446		}
447		if !stableInfo(before, after) {
448			return errors.New("source directory changed during snapshot")
449		}
450		return nil
451	}
452
453	func snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, node *selectionNode, relative string, snapshot *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
454		if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
455			return false, err
456		}
457		before, err := root.Stat(".")
458		if err != nil {
459			return false, err
460		}
461		names := make([]string, 0, len(node.children))
462		for name := range node.children {
463			names = append(names, name)
464		}
465		sort.Strings(names)
466		included := false
467		for _, name := range names {
468			childNode := node.children[name]
469			info, err := root.Lstat(name)
470			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && childNode.leaf && len(childNode.children) == 0 {
471				continue
472			}
473			if err != nil {
474				return false, fmt.Errorf("inspect selected template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
475			}
476			path := joinRelative(relative, name)
477			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
478				return false, fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a symlink", path)
479			}
480			if len(childNode.children) > 0 {
481				if childNode.leaf || !info.IsDir() {
482					return false, fmt.Errorf("selected Git path %q is not a directory tree", path)
483				}
484				child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
485				if err != nil {
486					return false, fmt.Errorf("open selected template directory %q: %w", path, err)
487				}
488				childIncluded, walkErr := snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx, child, childNode, path, snapshot)
489				verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
490				closeErr := child.Close()
491				if walkErr != nil {
492					return false, walkErr
493				}
494				if verifyErr != nil {
495					return false, verifyErr
496				}
497				if closeErr != nil {
498					return false, closeErr
499				}
500				if childIncluded {
501					snapshot.Directories = append(snapshot.Directories, Directory{Path: path, Mode: held.Mode().Perm()})
502					included = true
503				}
504				continue
505			}
506			if !childNode.leaf || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
507				return false, fmt.Errorf("selected Git path %q is not a regular file", path)
508			}
509			data, opened, err := readStableRootFile(ctx, root, name, info)
510			if err != nil {
511				return false, fmt.Errorf("read selected template file %q: %w", path, err)
512			}
513			snapshot.Files = append(snapshot.Files, File{Path: path, Mode: opened.Mode().Perm(), Data: data})
514			included = true
515		}
516		after, err := root.Stat(".")
517		if err != nil {
518			return false, err
519		}
520		if !stableInfo(before, after) {
521			return false, errors.New("source directory changed during snapshot")
522		}
523		return included, nil
524	}

526	func readStableRootFile(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {

534	// Summary returns a content-free description suitable for user-facing plans.
535	func (snapshot Snapshot) Summary() Summary {
536		preview, truncated := snapshotPathPreview(snapshot)
537		return Summary{
538			Source: snapshot.Source, Ref: snapshot.Ref, Commit: snapshot.Commit, Subdir: snapshot.Subdir,
539			Local: snapshot.Local, Live: snapshot.Live, GitFiltered: snapshot.GitFiltered,
540			Files: len(snapshot.Files), Directories: len(snapshot.Directories),
541			PathPreview: preview, PathPreviewTruncated: truncated,
542		}
543	}
544
545	func snapshotPathPreview(snapshot Snapshot) ([]string, bool) {
546		paths := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Files)+len(snapshot.Directories))
547		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
548			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
549		}
550		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
551			paths = append(paths, directory.Path+"/")
552		}
553		sort.Strings(paths)
554		truncated := len(paths) > pathPreviewLimit
555		if truncated {
556			paths = paths[:pathPreviewLimit]
557		}
558		return append([]string(nil), paths...), truncated
559	}

561	// Apply writes a prepared snapshot into a newly initialized, otherwise empty
562	// repository. All traversal and creation stays relative to a held os.Root, and
563	// file permissions are applied through the opened file descriptor.
564	func (snapshot Snapshot) Apply(destination string) (ApplyResult, error) {
565		result := ApplyResult{Summary: snapshot.Summary()}
566		if err := validateSnapshot(snapshot); err != nil {
567			return result, err
568		}
569		root, rootInfo, err := openNamedRoot(destination)
570		if err != nil {
571			return result, fmt.Errorf("resolve template destination: %w", err)
572		}
573		defer root.Close()
574		entries, err := readRootEntries(root)
575		if err != nil {
576			return result, fmt.Errorf("inspect template destination: %w", err)
577		}
578		gitMetadata := false
579		for _, entry := range entries {
580			if entry.Name() == ".git" {
581				info, err := root.Lstat(entry.Name())
582				if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.IsDir() {
583					return result, errors.New("template destination has unsafe Git metadata")
584				}
585				gitMetadata = true
586				continue
587			}
588			return result, fmt.Errorf("template destination is not a new repository: %q already exists", entry.Name())
589		}
590		if !gitMetadata {
591			return result, errors.New("template destination is not an initialized Git repository")
592		}
593
594		tree, err := buildApplyTree(snapshot)
595		if err != nil {
596			return result, err
597		}
598		if err := applyTree(root, tree, &result); err != nil {
599			return result, err
600		}
601		if err := verifyNamedRoot(destination, rootInfo); err != nil {
602			return result, fmt.Errorf("template destination changed during apply: %w", err)
603		}
604		return result, nil
605	}
606
607	func readRootEntries(root *os.Root) ([]os.DirEntry, error) {
608		directory, err := root.Open(".")
609		if err != nil {
610			return nil, err
611		}
612		defer directory.Close()
613		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(-1)
614		if err != nil {
615			return nil, err
616		}
617		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
618		return entries, nil
619	}

621	type applyNode struct {
622		directory *Directory
623		file      *File
624		children  map[string]*applyNode
625	}
626
627	func buildApplyTree(snapshot Snapshot) (*applyNode, error) {
628		root := &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
629		add := func(path string) *applyNode {
630			current := root
631			for _, component := range strings.Split(path, "/") {
632				if current.children[component] == nil {
633					current.children[component] = &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
634				}
635				current = current.children[component]
636			}
637			return current
638		}
639		for index := range snapshot.Directories {
640			directory := &snapshot.Directories[index]
641			add(directory.Path).directory = directory
642		}
643		for index := range snapshot.Files {
644			file := &snapshot.Files[index]
645			add(file.Path).file = file
646		}
647		return root, nil
648	}
649
650	func applyTree(root *os.Root, node *applyNode, result *ApplyResult) error {
651		names := make([]string, 0, len(node.children))
652		for name := range node.children {
653			names = append(names, name)
654		}
655		sort.Strings(names)
656		for _, name := range names {
657			childNode := node.children[name]
658			if childNode.file != nil {
659				if err := writeRootFile(root, name, *childNode.file); err != nil {
660					return fmt.Errorf("create template file %q: %w", childNode.file.Path, err)
661				}
662				result.AppliedFiles++
663				continue
664			}
665			if err := root.Mkdir(name, 0o700); err != nil {
666				return fmt.Errorf("create template directory %q: %w", name, err)
667			}
668			child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
669			if err != nil {
670				return fmt.Errorf("open created template directory %q: %w", name, err)
671			}
672			walkErr := applyTree(child, childNode, result)
673			mode := fs.FileMode(0o755)
674			if childNode.directory != nil {
675				mode = childNode.directory.Mode.Perm()
676				result.AppliedDirectories++
677			}
678			chmodErr := chmodRootDirectory(child, mode)
679			verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
680			closeErr := child.Close()
681			if walkErr != nil {
682				return walkErr
683			}
684			if chmodErr != nil {
685				return fmt.Errorf("set template directory mode %q: %w", name, chmodErr)
686			}
687			if verifyErr != nil {
688				return verifyErr
689			}
690			if closeErr != nil {
691				return closeErr
692			}
693		}
694		return nil
695	}
696
697	func writeRootFile(root *os.Root, name string, file File) error {
698		_, err := safefile.CreateNoClobber(context.Background(), root, name, file.Data, file.Mode.Perm())
699		return err
700	}
701
702	func chmodRootDirectory(root *os.Root, mode fs.FileMode) error {
703		directory, err := root.Open(".")
704		if err != nil {
705			return err
706		}
707		defer directory.Close()
708		return directory.Chmod(mode.Perm())
709	}

711	func finalizeSnapshot(snapshot *Snapshot) error {
712		sort.SliceStable(snapshot.Files, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Files[i].Path < snapshot.Files[j].Path })
713		sort.SliceStable(snapshot.Directories, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Directories[i].Path < snapshot.Directories[j].Path })
714		return validateSnapshot(*snapshot)
715	}
716
717	func validateSnapshot(snapshot Snapshot) error {
718		paths := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Directories)+len(snapshot.Files))
719		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
720			paths = append(paths, directory.Path)
721		}
722		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
723			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
724		}
725		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
726			return fmt.Errorf("template paths: %w", err)
727		}
728
729		types := make(map[string]string, len(paths))
730		validate := func(relative, kind string, mode fs.FileMode) error {
731			cleaned, err := validateSnapshotPath(relative)
732			if err != nil || cleaned != relative {
733				if err == nil {
734					err = errors.New("path is not a clean relative path")
735				}
736				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q: %w", kind, relative, err)
737			}
738			if mode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
739				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q has unsupported mode %s", kind, relative, mode)
740			}
741			if previous, exists := types[relative]; exists {
742				return fmt.Errorf("template path %q is declared as both %s and %s", relative, previous, kind)
743			}
744			for parent := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(relative))); parent != "."; parent = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(parent))) {
745				if types[parent] == "file" {
746					return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q is below file %q", kind, relative, parent)
747				}
748			}
749			types[relative] = kind
750			return nil
751		}
752		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
753			if err := validate(directory.Path, "directory", directory.Mode); err != nil {
754				return err
755			}
756		}
757		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
758			if err := validate(file.Path, "file", file.Mode); err != nil {
759				return err
760			}
761			prefix := file.Path + "/"
762			for existing := range types {
763				if strings.HasPrefix(existing, prefix) {
764					return fmt.Errorf("template file %q is the parent of %q", file.Path, existing)
765				}
766			}
767		}
768		return nil
769	}
770
771	func cleanSubdir(value string) (string, error) {
772		if value == "" || value == "." {
773			return "", nil
774		}
775		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
776			return "", fmt.Errorf("template subdirectory %q: %w", value, err)
777		}
778		return value, nil
779	}
780
781	func validateSnapshotPath(value string) (string, error) {
782		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
783			return "", err
784		}
785		return value, nil
786	}
787
788	func validateSnapshotComponent(component string) error {
789		return pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(component, 0)
790	}

792	func joinRelative(parent, name string) string {
793		if parent == "" {
794			return name
795		}
796		return parent + "/" + name
797	}

231	// RecoveryAdminRootKind identifies which Git administrative root was walked.

236		RecoveryAdminCommonDir RecoveryAdminRootKind = "common-dir"

239	// RecoveryAdminEntry is held-root metadata for every Git administrative entry.
