190	func stateForError(err error) State {
191		switch {
192		case errors.Is(err, ErrUnsafe), errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrUnsafeType), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrNotPortable), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrPathCollision):
193			return StateBlockedUnsafe
194		case errors.Is(err, ErrIneligible):
195			return StateBlockedIneligible
196		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
197			return StateMissing
198		default:
199			return StateFailed
200		}
201	}

203	func limitsToWire(limits safefile.Limits) fleet.FileLimits {
204		return fleet.FileLimits{
205			MaxFiles: limits.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: limits.MaxFileBytes,
206			MaxTotalBytes: limits.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: limits.MaxPathBytes,
207			MaxComponentBytes: limits.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: limits.MaxPathDepth,
208		}
209	}

211	// NegotiateLimits takes the lower value for every policy field and validates

213	func NegotiateLimits(local safefile.Limits, remote fleet.FileLimits) (safefile.Limits, error) {
214		if err := local.Validate(); err != nil {
215			return safefile.Limits{}, err
216		}
217		remoteLimits := safefile.Limits{
218			MaxFiles: remote.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: remote.MaxFileBytes,
219			MaxTotalBytes: remote.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: remote.MaxPathBytes,
220			MaxComponentBytes: remote.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: remote.MaxPathDepth,
221		}
222		if err := remoteLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
223			return safefile.Limits{}, err
224		}
225		result := safefile.Limits{
226			MaxFiles:          min(local.MaxFiles, remoteLimits.MaxFiles),
227			MaxFileBytes:      min(local.MaxFileBytes, remoteLimits.MaxFileBytes),
228			MaxTotalBytes:     min(local.MaxTotalBytes, remoteLimits.MaxTotalBytes),
229			MaxPathBytes:      min(local.MaxPathBytes, remoteLimits.MaxPathBytes),
230			MaxComponentBytes: min(local.MaxComponentBytes, remoteLimits.MaxComponentBytes),
231			MaxPathDepth:      min(local.MaxPathDepth, remoteLimits.MaxPathDepth),
232		}
233		return result, result.Validate()
234	}

79			ProtocolVersion: request.ProtocolVersion, MachineID: id,
80			Platform: s.platform(), Limits: limitsToWire(limits), Supported: true,
81		}
82		if response.Platform == "windows" {
83			response.Supported = false
84			response.Reason = "native-windows-acl-transport-disabled"
85		}
86		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
87			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
88		}
89		return response, nil

92	type targetCheckout struct {
93		root      string
94		commonDir string
95		identity  string
96		branch    string
97		head      string
98		id        string
99	}
100
101	func (s *Service) resolveTarget(ctx context.Context, binding Binding) (targetCheckout, error) {
102		if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
103			return targetCheckout{}, err
104		}
105		options := repo.DefaultOptions()
106		if s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth > 0 {
107			options.MaxDepth = s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth
108		}
109		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, s.Config.DiscoveryRoots(), options)
110		if err != nil {
111			return targetCheckout{}, err
112		}
113		type candidate struct {
114			path      string
115			commonDir string
116		}
117		var candidates []candidate
118		for _, repository := range repositories {
119			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
120				continue
121			}
122			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
123			if err != nil {
124				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect discovered target repository: %w", err)
125			}
126			matched, err := checkoutHasIdentity(ctx, gitRepo.Root, binding.RemoteIdentity)
127			if err != nil {
128				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect target repository fetch identities: %w", err)
129			}
130			if !matched {
131				continue
132			}
133			candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: gitRepo.Root, commonDir: gitRepo.GitCommonDir})
134		}
135		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].commonDir < candidates[j].commonDir })
136		switch len(candidates) {
137		case 0:
138			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAbsent}
139		case 1:
140		default:
141			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAmbiguous}
142		}
143		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidates[0].path, binding.Branch)
144		if err != nil {
145			return targetCheckout{}, err
146		}
147		if !checkedOut || worktree.Bare || worktree.Prunable {
148			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetFetchedOnly}
149		}
150		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
151		if err != nil {
152			return targetCheckout{}, err
153		}
154		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
155		if err != nil {
156			return targetCheckout{}, err
157		}
158		if status.Detached || status.Branch != binding.Branch || head != binding.HeadOID || worktree.Head != binding.HeadOID {
159			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetStale}
160		}
161		checkout := targetCheckout{
162			root: worktree.Path, commonDir: candidates[0].commonDir,
163			identity: binding.RemoteIdentity, branch: binding.Branch, head: head,
164		}
165		checkout.id = digestJSON(struct {
166			Domain    string `json:"domain"`
167			CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
168			Root      string `json:"root"`
169			Branch    string `json:"branch"`
170			Head      string `json:"head"`
171		}{"dev-local-files-checkout-v1", checkout.commonDir, checkout.root, checkout.branch, checkout.head})
172		return checkout, nil
173	}
174
175	func checkoutHasIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, wanted string) (bool, error) {
176		names, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
177		if err != nil {
178			return false, err
179		}
180		for _, name := range strings.Fields(names) {
181			// Repository identity is established from fetch URLs. A push-only match
182			// can name a different mirror or publication target and must not authorize
183			// writing local files into an otherwise unrelated clone.
184			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", name)
185			if err != nil {
186				continue
187			}
188			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
189				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
190					return true, nil
191				}
192			}
193		}
194		return false, nil
195	}
196
197	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
198		if s == nil {
199			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
200		}
201		if s.platform() == "windows" {
202			return PlanResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
203		}
204		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
205			return PlanResponse{}, err
206		}
207		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
208		if err != nil {
209			return PlanResponse{}, err
210		}
211		if id != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
212			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
213		}
214		hostLimits := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
215		if err := hostLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
216			return PlanResponse{}, err
217		}
218		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(hostLimits, request.Limits)
219		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
220			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("plan limits do not match target policy")
221		}
222		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, request.Binding)
223		if err != nil {
224			return PlanResponse{}, err
225		}
226		response := PlanResponse{
227			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
228			RequestID: request.RequestID, ManifestDigest: request.ManifestDigest,
229			TargetMachine: id, TargetCheckout: checkout.id,
230		}
231		for _, spec := range request.Files {
232			planned := PlanFile{PublicFile: spec.public(StateFailed)}
233			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
234				planned.State = stateForError(err)
235				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
236				continue
237			}
238			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, request.SafeLimits(), true)
239			if err != nil {
240				planned.State = stateForError(err)
241				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
242				continue
243			}
244			targetMode := ""
245			if observed.exists {
246				targetMode = fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm())
247			}
248			switch {
249			case !observed.exists:
250				planned.State, planned.Action = StateReady, actionCreate
251			case observed.digest == spec.SHA256 && targetMode == spec.Mode:
252				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateCurrent, actionCurrent, observed.digest, targetMode
253			case request.Replace:
254				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateReady, actionReplace, observed.digest, targetMode
255			default:
256				planned.State, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateBlockedConflict, observed.digest, targetMode
257			}
258			response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
259		}
260		response.PlanDigest = planDigest(request, response)
261		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
262			return PlanResponse{}, err
263		}
264		return response, nil
265	}

77	func openOperationStore(root, requestID string) (*operationStore, bool, error) {

79			root = defaultStoreRoot()
80		}
81		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(root)
82		if err != nil {
83			return nil, false, err
84		}
85		store := &operationStore{root: canonical, requestID: requestID, operation: filepath.Join(canonical, requestID)}
86		info, err := os.Lstat(store.operation)
87		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
88			return store, false, nil
89		}
90		if err != nil {
91			return nil, false, err
92		}
93		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
94			return nil, false, errors.New("local-files operation store is not a private directory")
95		}
96		if journalInfo, journalErr := os.Lstat(store.journalPath()); errors.Is(journalErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
97			// Older interrupted builds could stage a manifest and blobs before their
98			// first durable journal write. Publication always followed that write, so a
99			// private store with no journal is safe to discard only after its complete
100			// operation-owned layout has been verified.
101			if err := store.discardUninitialized(info); err != nil {

107		} else if !journalInfo.Mode().IsRegular() || journalInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || journalInfo.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
108			return nil, false, errors.New("local-files journal is not a private regular file")

126	func (s *operationStore) discardUninitialized(expected fs.FileInfo) error {
127		walkErr := filepath.WalkDir(s.operation, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
128			if walkErr != nil {
129				return walkErr
130			}
131			if path == s.operation {
132				return nil
133			}
134			relative, err := filepath.Rel(s.operation, path)
135			if err != nil {
136				return err
137			}
138			relative = filepath.ToSlash(relative)
139			info, err := entry.Info()
140			if err != nil {
141				return err
142			}
143			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
144				return errors.New("unjournaled local-files store contains an unsafe entry")
145			}
146			parts := strings.Split(relative, "/")
147			switch {
148			case len(parts) == 1 && parts[0] == "manifest.json" && info.Mode().IsRegular():
149				return nil
150			case len(parts) == 1 && (parts[0] == "blobs" || parts[0] == "rollback") && info.IsDir():
151				return nil
152			case len(parts) == 1 && strings.HasPrefix(parts[0], ".dev-safefile-") && info.Mode().IsRegular():
153				return nil
154			case len(parts) == 2 && (parts[0] == "blobs" || parts[0] == "rollback") && info.Mode().IsRegular():
155				if isOperationBlobName(parts[1]) || strings.HasPrefix(parts[1], ".dev-safefile-") {
156					return nil
157				}
158			}
159			return errors.New("unjournaled local-files store contains an unknown entry")
160		})
161		if walkErr != nil {
162			return fmt.Errorf("inspect unjournaled local-files store: %w", walkErr)
163		}
164		current, err := os.Lstat(s.operation)
165		if err != nil || !os.SameFile(expected, current) || !current.IsDir() || current.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
166			return errors.New("unjournaled local-files store changed during inspection")
167		}
168		if err := os.RemoveAll(s.operation); err != nil {
169			return fmt.Errorf("remove unjournaled local-files store: %w", err)
170		}
171		return syncDirectoryPath(s.root)
172	}

197	func (s *operationStore) loadJournal() (journal, error) {
198		data, err := readPrivateFile(s.journalPath(), 2<<20)
199		if err != nil {
200			return journal{}, err
201		}
202		var value journal
203		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(data, 2<<20, &value); err != nil {
204			return journal{}, fmt.Errorf("decode local-files journal: %w", err)
205		}
206		if err := validateJournal(value); err != nil {
207			return journal{}, err
208		}
209		return value, nil
210	}
211
212	func validateJournal(value journal) error {
213		if value.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || value.RequestID == "" || !validDigest(value.PlanDigest) || !validDigest(value.ManifestDigest) {
214			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal binding")
215		}
216		switch value.Phase {
217		case phaseStaged, phaseApplying, phaseCompleted, phaseRolledBack, phaseReconcile:
218		default:
219			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal phase")
220		}
221		for index, file := range value.Files {
222			if index > 0 && value.Files[index-1].Path >= file.Path {
223				return errors.New("local-files journal paths are not sorted")
224			}
225			switch file.Action {
226			case actionCurrent, actionCreate, actionReplace:
227			default:
228				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid action")
229			}
230			if !file.State.validResult() {
231				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid result state")
232			}
233			if file.Size < 0 || file.Mode != "0600" && file.Mode != "0700" {
234				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid public metadata")
235			}
236			if file.Action == actionReplace && (!validDigest(file.OldSHA256) || !validFileMode(file.OldMode)) {
237				return errors.New("local-files replacement journal lacks rollback binding")
238			}
239		}
240		return nil
241	}
242

264		if existing, err := readPrivateFile(filename, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes); err == nil {
265			if digestBytes(existing) != digestBytes(content) {
266				return errors.New("existing local-files blob does not match operation")

16	const maxWalkEntries = 200_000
17
18	var dependencyComponents = map[string]struct{}{
19		"node_modules": {}, ".venv": {}, "venv": {}, "vendor": {},
20		"__pycache__": {}, ".tox": {}, "target": {}, ".terraform": {},
21		"dist": {}, "build": {}, ".next": {},
22	}

24	// Expand resolves validated project and --file patterns locally into a sorted,
25	// duplicate-free list of exact slash paths. It never follows links or descends
26	// into Git metadata, nested repositories, submodules, or dependency trees.
27	func Expand(root string, patterns []Pattern, limits safefile.Limits) ([]string, error) {
28		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
29			return nil, err
30		}
31		if len(patterns) == 0 {
32			return nil, errors.New("no local-file patterns were configured or passed with --file")
33		}
34		for _, pattern := range patterns {
35			if err := projectconfig.ValidateLocalFilePattern(pattern.Value); err != nil {
36				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s: %w", patternSource(pattern), err)
37			}
38			for _, component := range strings.Split(pattern.Value, "/") {
39				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
40					return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s enters dependency directory %q", patternSource(pattern), component)
41				}
42			}
43		}
44		rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(root)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect source checkout: %w", err)
47		}
48		if !rootInfo.IsDir() || rootInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
49			return nil, errors.New("source checkout is not a held regular directory")
50		}
51
52		matches := map[string]struct{}{}
53		matchedPatterns := make([]bool, len(patterns))
54		visited := 0
55		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
56			if walkErr != nil {
57				return walkErr
58			}
59			if filename == root {
60				return nil
61			}
62			visited++
63			if visited > maxWalkEntries {
64				return fmt.Errorf("source checkout exceeds %d entries while expanding local-file patterns", maxWalkEntries)
65			}
66			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, filename)
67			if err != nil {
68				return err
69			}
70			slash := filepath.ToSlash(relative)
71			components := strings.Split(slash, "/")
72			base := strings.ToLower(components[len(components)-1])
73			if entry.IsDir() {
74				if base == ".git" {
75					return filepath.SkipDir
76				}
77				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[base]; blocked {
78					for _, pattern := range patterns {
79						if matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
80							return fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern enters dependency directory %q", slash)
81						}
82					}
83					return filepath.SkipDir
84				}
85				if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(filename, ".git")); err == nil {
86					return filepath.SkipDir
87				} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
88					return fmt.Errorf("inspect nested repository boundary %s: %w", slash, err)
89				}
90			}
91			matched := false
92			for index, pattern := range patterns {
93				if !entry.IsDir() && matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
94					matchedPatterns[index] = true
95					matched = true
96				}
97			}
98			if matched {
99				matches[slash] = struct{}{}
100			}
101			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 && entry.IsDir() {
102				return filepath.SkipDir
103			}
104			return nil
105		})
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, err
108		}
109		for index, matched := range matchedPatterns {
110			if !matched {
111				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s matched no source path", patternSource(patterns[index]))
112			}
113		}
114		paths := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
115		for path := range matches {
116			paths = append(paths, path)
117		}
118		sort.Strings(paths)
119		if len(paths) > limits.MaxFiles {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("patterns expanded to %d paths; maximum is %d", len(paths), limits.MaxFiles)
121		}
122		return paths, nil
123	}
124
125	func patternSource(pattern Pattern) string {
126		if strings.TrimSpace(pattern.Source) == "" {
127			return "explicit input"
128		}
129		return pattern.Source
130	}
131
132	func matchPattern(pattern, candidate string) bool {
133		patternParts := strings.Split(pattern, "/")
134		candidateParts := strings.Split(candidate, "/")
135		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
136		memo := map[key]bool{}
137		seen := map[key]bool{}
138		var match func(int, int) bool
139		match = func(patternIndex, candidateIndex int) bool {
140			state := key{patternIndex, candidateIndex}
141			if seen[state] {
142				return memo[state]
143			}
144			seen[state] = true
145			var result bool
146			switch {
147			case patternIndex == len(patternParts):
148				result = candidateIndex == len(candidateParts)
149			case patternParts[patternIndex] == "**":
150				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex) ||
151					candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && match(patternIndex, candidateIndex+1)
152			case candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && matchComponent(patternParts[patternIndex], candidateParts[candidateIndex]):
153				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex+1)
154			}
155			memo[state] = result
156			return result
157		}
158		return match(0, 0)
159	}
160
161	func matchComponent(pattern, candidate string) bool {
162		p, c := []rune(pattern), []rune(candidate)
163		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
164		memo := map[key]bool{}
165		seen := map[key]bool{}
166		var match func(int, int) bool
167		match = func(pi, ci int) bool {
168			state := key{pi, ci}
169			if seen[state] {
170				return memo[state]
171			}
172			seen[state] = true
173			var result bool
174			switch {
175			case pi == len(p):
176				result = ci == len(c)
177			case p[pi] == '*':
178				result = match(pi+1, ci) || ci < len(c) && match(pi, ci+1)
179			case ci < len(c) && (p[pi] == '?' || p[pi] == c[ci]):
180				result = match(pi+1, ci+1)
181			}
182			memo[state] = result
183			return result
184		}
185		return match(0, 0)
186	}
187
188	func hasDependencyComponent(path string) bool {
189		for _, component := range strings.Split(path, "/") {
190			if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
191				return true
192			}
193		}
194		return false
195	}

48	func (s State) validPlan() bool {

53		default:

139	func validateFileSpecs(files []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
140		metadata := make([]safefile.Metadata, len(files))
141		for index, file := range files {
142			if index > 0 && files[index-1].Path >= file.Path {
143				return errors.New("file manifest paths must be unique and sorted")
144			}
145			if file.Mode != "0600" && file.Mode != "0700" {
146				return fmt.Errorf("file %q has unsupported mode", file.Path)
147			}
148			if !validDigest(file.SHA256) {
149				return fmt.Errorf("file %q has an invalid SHA-256 digest", file.Path)
150			}
151			metadata[index] = safefile.Metadata{Path: file.Path, Size: file.Size}
152		}
153		return safefile.ValidateManifest(metadata, limits)

176	func (r PlanRequest) Validate() error {

178			return errors.New("unsupported local-files plan protocol")
179		}
180		parsed, err := uuid.Parse(r.RequestID)

182			return errors.New("plan request has an invalid request ID")

190		if err := r.SafeLimits().Validate(); err != nil {
191			return fmt.Errorf("safe-file limits: %w", err)

193		if len(r.Files) == 0 {

195		}

197			return err

241	func (r PlanResponse) Validate(request PlanRequest) error {
242		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
243			return err
244		}
245		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || r.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion ||
246			r.RequestID != request.RequestID || r.ManifestDigest != request.ManifestDigest ||
247			r.TargetMachine != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
248			return errors.New("plan response binding does not match request")
249		}
250		if !validDigest(r.TargetCheckout) {
251			return errors.New("plan response has an invalid checkout identity")
252		}
253		if len(r.Files) != len(request.Files) {
254			return errors.New("plan response file count does not match request")
255		}
256		for index, file := range r.Files {
257			spec := request.Files[index]
258			if file.Path != spec.Path || file.Size != spec.Size || file.Mode != spec.Mode || !file.State.validPlan() {
259				return fmt.Errorf("plan response metadata for %q does not match request", spec.Path)
260			}
261			switch file.Action {
262			case actionCurrent:
263				if file.State != StateCurrent || file.TargetSHA256 != spec.SHA256 || file.TargetMode != spec.Mode {
264					return fmt.Errorf("plan response current observation for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
265				}
266			case actionCreate:
267				if file.State != StateReady || file.TargetSHA256 != "" || file.TargetMode != "" {
268					return fmt.Errorf("plan response create observation for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
269				}
270			case actionReplace:
271				if !request.Replace || file.State != StateReady || !validDigest(file.TargetSHA256) || !validFileMode(file.TargetMode) {
272					return fmt.Errorf("plan response replace observation for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
273				}
274			case "":
275				if file.State == StateReady || file.State == StateCurrent {
276					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q omits a required action", spec.Path)
277				}
278				if file.TargetSHA256 != "" && !validDigest(file.TargetSHA256) {
279					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an invalid target digest", spec.Path)
280				}
281				if file.TargetMode != "" && !validFileMode(file.TargetMode) {
282					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an invalid target mode", spec.Path)
283				}
284			default:
285				return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an unknown action", spec.Path)
286			}
287		}
288		if !validDigest(r.PlanDigest) || r.PlanDigest != planDigest(request, r) {
289			return errors.New("plan response digest does not match")
290		}
291		return nil
292	}

336			case actionCurrent:

371	func digestJSON(value any) string {
372		data, _ := json.Marshal(value)
373		digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
374		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
375	}
376
377	func digestBytes(value []byte) string {
378		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
379		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
380	}
381
382	func validDigest(value string) bool {
383		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != len("sha256:")+sha256.Size*2 {
384			return false
385		}
386		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"))
387		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size && value == strings.ToLower(value)
388	}
389
390	func validOID(value string) bool {
391		if len(value) != 40 && len(value) != 64 || value != strings.ToLower(value) {
392			return false
393		}
394		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
395		return err == nil
396	}
397
398	func validFileMode(value string) bool {
399		if len(value) != 4 {
400			return false
401		}
402		mode, err := strconv.ParseUint(value, 8, 12)
403		return err == nil && mode <= 0o777
404	}
405
406	func validateText(name, value string) error {
407		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
408			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
409		}
410		for _, r := range value {
411			if unicode.IsControl(r) {
412				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
413			}
414		}
415		return nil
416	}

418	func sortedPublic(files []PublicFile) []PublicFile {
419		result := append([]PublicFile(nil), files...)
420		sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].Path < result[j].Path })
421		return result
422	}

26			return 0o700

31	// CreateNoClobber stages data in an unguessable owner-private file, syncs it,
32	// applies finalMode, and atomically hard-links it to the absent destination.
33	// The hard-link publication is same-directory and cannot replace an existing
34	// path. This generic helper exists so callers such as repotemplate can preserve
35	// intentional public modes; secret-bearing callers should use
36	// CreatePrivateNoClobber.
37	func CreateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
38		if root == nil {
39			return nil, errors.New("atomic create: nil root")
40		}
41		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
42			return nil, err
43		}
44		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, err
47		}
48		defer func() {
49			if stagedName != "" {
50				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
51			}
52		}()
53		if err := root.Link(stagedName, name); err != nil {
54			return nil, fmt.Errorf("publish %q without replacement: %w", name, err)
55		}
56		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify published file %q: %w", name, err)
59		}
60		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
61			return nil, fmt.Errorf("published file %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
62		}
63		if err := root.Remove(stagedName); err != nil {
64			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remove staging link for %q: %w", name, err)
65		}
66		stagedName = ""
67		published, err = root.Lstat(name)
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, fmt.Errorf("refresh published file %q: %w", name, err)
70		}
71		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
72			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after creating %q: %w", name, err)
73		}
74		return published, nil
75	}

86	// AtomicReplace stages and syncs data in the target directory, revalidates the
87	// existing regular file against observed, and atomically renames the staged file
88	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
89	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
90	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
91	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
92	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.
93	func AtomicReplace(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
94		if root == nil {
95			return nil, errors.New("atomic replace: nil root")
96		}
97		if observed == nil {
98			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replace %q without observed state: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
99		}
100		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)
107		if err != nil {
108			return nil, err
109		}
110		defer func() {
111			if stagedName != "" {
112				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
113			}
114		}()
115		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
116			return nil, err
117		}
118		if err := root.Rename(stagedName, name); err != nil {
119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("atomically replace %q: %w", name, err)
120		}
121		stagedName = ""
122		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
123		if err != nil {
124			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
125		}
126		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
127			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
128		}
129		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
130			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
131		}
132		return published, nil
133	}

135	// AtomicReplacePrivate is AtomicReplace with owner-only final permissions.
136	func AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {

149			return fmt.Errorf("replacement target %q changed or is not a regular file: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
150		}

154	func stageRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (string, fs.FileInfo, error) {
155		if finalMode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
156			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported final file mode %s", finalMode)
157		}
158		var name string
159		var writer *os.File
160		for attempt := 0; attempt < 32; attempt++ {
161			candidate, err := randomStageName()
162			if err != nil {
163				return "", nil, err
164			}
165			writer, err = root.OpenFile(candidate, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
166			if err == nil {
167				name = candidate
168				break
169			}
170			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
171				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("create private staging file: %w", err)
172			}
173		}
174		if writer == nil {
175			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
176		}
177		keep := true
178		defer func() {
179			if keep {
180				_ = writer.Close()
181				_ = root.Remove(name)
182			}
183		}()
184		if err := writeAllContext(ctx, writer, data); err != nil {
185			return "", nil, err
186		}
187		if err := writer.Chmod(finalMode.Perm()); err != nil {
188			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("set staged file mode: %w", err)
189		}
190		if err := writer.Sync(); err != nil {
191			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("sync staged file: %w", err)
192		}
193		opened, err := writer.Stat()
194		if err != nil {
195			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect staged file: %w", err)
196		}
197		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
198			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("close staged file: %w", err)
199		}
200		keep = false
201		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
202		if err != nil {
203			_ = root.Remove(name)
204			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("reopen staged file name: %w", err)
205		}
206		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(opened, current) {
207			_ = root.Remove(name)
208			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("staging file changed before publication: %w", ErrChanged)
209		}
210		return name, current, nil
211	}

213	func validateTargetName(name string) error {

215			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
216		}

218	}

220	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
221		for len(data) > 0 {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return err
224			}
225			written, err := writer.Write(data)
226			if err != nil {
227				return err
228			}
229			if written == 0 {
230				return io.ErrShortWrite
231			}
232			data = data[written:]
233		}
234		return context.Cause(ctx)
235	}

239		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
240			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
241		}
242		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
243	}

31	func DefaultPath() string {

35	func NewStore(path string) *Store {

37			path = DefaultPath()
38		}
39		if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path); err == nil {
40			path = absolute
41		}
42		return &Store{Path: filepath.Clean(path), generate: uuid.NewString}
43	}

50	func Validate(value string) error {
51		parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
52		if err != nil || parsed == uuid.Nil || parsed.String() != value {
53			return fmt.Errorf("machine_id %q is not a canonical non-zero UUID", value)
54		}
55		return nil
56	}

58	func (s *Store) Load() (string, error) {
59		if s == nil || s.Path == "" {
60			return "", errors.New("load machine identity from nil store")
61		}
62		if err := checkPrivateDir(filepath.Dir(s.Path)); err != nil {
63			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity directory: %w", err)
64		}
65		info, err := os.Lstat(s.Path)
66		if err != nil {
67			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity: %w", err)
68		}
69		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
70			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity %s is not a regular file", s.Path)
71		}
72		private, err := privateModeMatches(s.Path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
73		if err != nil {
74			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity permissions: %w", err)
75		}
76		if !private {
77			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", s.Path)
78		}
79		file, err := os.Open(s.Path)
80		if err != nil {
81			return "", fmt.Errorf("open machine identity: %w", err)
82		}
83		defer file.Close()
84		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
85		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
86		var payload document
87		if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
88			return "", fmt.Errorf("decode machine identity: %w", err)
89		}
90		var extra any
91		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
92			if err == nil {

94			}
95			return "", fmt.Errorf("decode machine identity trailing data: %w", err)
96		}
97		if payload.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {

99		}
100		if err := Validate(payload.MachineID); err != nil {
101			return "", err
102		}
103		return payload.MachineID, nil
104	}

107		if s == nil || s.Path == "" {
108			return "", errors.New("create machine identity with nil store")
109		}
110		if ctx == nil {
111			ctx = context.Background()
112		}
113		directory := filepath.Dir(s.Path)
114		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("prepare machine identity directory: %w", err)
116		}
117		lockDirectory := filepath.Join(directory, ".lock")

119			return "", fmt.Errorf("prepare machine identity lock: %w", err)
120		}
121		var result string
122		err := lockx.WithDir(ctx, lockDirectory, "machine identity", func() error {
123			loaded, err := s.Load()
124			if err == nil {
125				result = loaded
126				return nil
127			}
128			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
129				return err
130			}
131			generate := s.generate
132			if generate == nil {

134			}
135			candidate := generate()
136			if err := Validate(candidate); err != nil {
137				return fmt.Errorf("generate machine identity: %w", err)
138			}
139			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {
140				return err
141			}
142			result = candidate
143			return nil
144		})
145		return result, err
146	}

148	func (s *Store) write(id string) error {
149		if err := Validate(id); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		directory := filepath.Dir(s.Path)
153		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
154			return err
155		}

157		if err != nil {
158			return fmt.Errorf("create machine identity temp file: %w", err)
159		}

161		defer os.Remove(name)
162		if err := setPrivateMode(name, 0o600); err != nil {
163			_ = temporary.Close()
164			return err
165		}
166		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)
167		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
168		if err := encoder.Encode(document{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, MachineID: id}); err != nil {
169			_ = temporary.Close()
170			return fmt.Errorf("encode machine identity: %w", err)
171		}
172		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
173			_ = temporary.Close()
174			return fmt.Errorf("sync machine identity: %w", err)
175		}
176		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
177			return fmt.Errorf("close machine identity: %w", err)
178		}
179		if err := replaceFile(name, s.Path); err != nil {
180			return fmt.Errorf("publish machine identity: %w", err)
181		}
182		if err := syncDirectory(directory); err != nil {

184		}

186	}

14	const (

16		administratorsSID = "S-1-5-32-544"
17	)

19	// setPrivateMode installs a protected DACL. Windows os.FileMode permission
20	// bits only model the read-only attribute and cannot establish privacy.
21	func setPrivateMode(path string, want fs.FileMode) error {
22		inheritance := ""
23		switch want.Perm() {
24		case 0o600:
25		case 0o700:
26			inheritance = "OICI"
27		default:
28			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported private Windows mode %04o", want.Perm())
29		}
30		current, _, err := privateSIDs()
31		if err != nil {
32			return err
33		}
34		ace := func(sid string) string {
35			return fmt.Sprintf("(A;%s;GA;;;%s)", inheritance, sid)
36		}
37		descriptor, err := windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString("D:P" + ace(current) + ace(localSystemSID) + ace(administratorsSID))
38		if err != nil {
39			return fmt.Errorf("build private Windows security descriptor: %w", err)
40		}
41		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
42		if err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("read private Windows DACL: %w", err)
44		}
45		if dacl == nil {
46			return fmt.Errorf("private Windows security descriptor has no DACL")
47		}
48		err = windows.SetNamedSecurityInfo(
49			path,
50			windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT,
51			windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
52			nil,
53			nil,
54			dacl,
55			nil,
56		)
57		runtime.KeepAlive(descriptor)
58		if err != nil {
59			return fmt.Errorf("set private Windows DACL: %w", err)
60		}
61		return nil
62	}
63
64	func privateModeMatches(path string, _ fs.FileMode, _ fs.FileMode) (bool, error) {
65		current, allowed, err := privateSIDs()
66		if err != nil {
67			return false, err
68		}
69		descriptor, err := windows.GetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
70		if err != nil {
71			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner and DACL: %w", err)
72		}
73		owner, _, err := descriptor.Owner()
74		if err != nil {
75			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner: %w", err)
76		}
77		if !privateSIDAllowed(owner, allowed) {
78			return false, nil
79		}
80		control, _, err := descriptor.Control()
81		if err != nil {
82			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows security descriptor control: %w", err)
83		}
84		if control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED == 0 {
85			return false, nil
86		}
87		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
88		if err != nil {
89			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL: %w", err)
90		}
91		if dacl == nil {
92			return false, nil
93		}
94		seenCurrent := false
95		for index := uint16(0); index < dacl.AceCount; index++ {
96			var ace *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
97			if err := windows.GetAce(dacl, uint32(index), &ace); err != nil {
98				return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL entry %d: %w", index, err)
99			}
100			switch ace.Header.AceType {
101			case windows.ACCESS_DENIED_ACE_TYPE:
102				continue
103			case windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE_TYPE:
104			default:
105				return false, nil
106			}
107			sid := (*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&ace.SidStart))
108			value := sid.String()
109			if _, ok := allowed[value]; !ok {
110				return false, nil
111			}
112			if value == current {
113				seenCurrent = true
114			}
115		}
116		return seenCurrent, nil
117	}
118
119	func privateSIDAllowed(sid *windows.SID, allowed map[string]struct{}) bool {
120		if sid == nil {
121			return false
122		}
123		_, ok := allowed[sid.String()]
124		return ok
125	}
126
127	func privateSIDs() (string, map[string]struct{}, error) {
128		user, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
129		if err != nil {
130			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("read current Windows user: %w", err)
131		}

19	// setPrivateMode installs a protected DACL. Windows os.FileMode permission
20	// bits only model the read-only attribute and cannot establish privacy.
21	func setPrivateMode(path string, want fs.FileMode) error {

23		switch want.Perm() {
24		case 0o600:
25		case 0o700:
26			inheritance = "OICI"

29		}
30		current, _, err := privateSIDs()
31		if err != nil {

33		}
34		ace := func(sid string) string {
35			return fmt.Sprintf("(A;%s;GA;;;%s)", inheritance, sid)
36		}
37		descriptor, err := windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString("D:P" + ace(current) + ace(localSystemSID) + ace(administratorsSID))
38		if err != nil {
39			return fmt.Errorf("build private Windows security descriptor: %w", err)
40		}
41		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
42		if err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("read private Windows DACL: %w", err)
44		}
45		if dacl == nil {
46			return fmt.Errorf("private Windows security descriptor has no DACL")
47		}
48		err = windows.SetNamedSecurityInfo(
49			path,
50			windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT,
51			windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
52			nil,
53			nil,
54			dacl,
55			nil,
56		)
57		runtime.KeepAlive(descriptor)
58		if err != nil {
59			return fmt.Errorf("set private Windows DACL: %w", err)
60		}
61		return nil
62	}

64	func privateModeMatches(path string, _ fs.FileMode, _ fs.FileMode) (bool, error) {
65		current, allowed, err := privateSIDs()
66		if err != nil {
67			return false, err
68		}
69		descriptor, err := windows.GetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
70		if err != nil {
71			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner and DACL: %w", err)
72		}
73		owner, _, err := descriptor.Owner()
74		if err != nil {
75			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner: %w", err)
76		}
77		if !privateSIDAllowed(owner, allowed) {
78			return false, nil
79		}
80		control, _, err := descriptor.Control()
81		if err != nil {
82			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows security descriptor control: %w", err)
83		}
84		if control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED == 0 {
85			return false, nil
86		}
87		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
88		if err != nil {
89			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL: %w", err)
90		}
91		if dacl == nil {
92			return false, nil
93		}
94		seenCurrent := false
95		for index := uint16(0); index < dacl.AceCount; index++ {
96			var ace *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
97			if err := windows.GetAce(dacl, uint32(index), &ace); err != nil {
98				return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL entry %d: %w", index, err)
99			}
100			switch ace.Header.AceType {
101			case windows.ACCESS_DENIED_ACE_TYPE:
102				continue
103			case windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE_TYPE:
104			default:
105				return false, nil
106			}
107			sid := (*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&ace.SidStart))
108			value := sid.String()
109			if _, ok := allowed[value]; !ok {
110				return false, nil
111			}
112			if value == current {
113				seenCurrent = true
114			}
115		}
116		return seenCurrent, nil
117	}

122		}

125	}

+// ImportConflictError describes why an exact-ID import could not be reconciled.
+// ExistingID names the local owner when Field is a target location path.
+type ImportConflictError struct {
+	ID         string
+	ExistingID string
+	Field      string
+	Reason     string

+
+func (e *ImportConflictError) Error() string {
+	detail := e.Reason
+	if detail == "" {
+		detail = "imported value disagrees with durable state"
+	}
+	if e.ExistingID != "" && e.ExistingID != e.ID {

+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf("catalog asset %s: %s: %v", e.ID, detail, ErrConflict)
+}

+// Import writes a transported note with its exact durable identity and
+// timestamps. Path is always derived from the validated repository and note IDs;
+// a source Path is never trusted. An identical revision is an idempotent replay,
+// while reusing an ID for different content is a conflict. Import changes only
+// Markdown source data and deliberately does not update or rebuild the FTS cache.
+func (s *Store) Import(ctx context.Context, source *Note) (*Note, error) {
+	if s == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("import into nil note store")
+	}
+	if source == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("import nil note")
+	}
+	if ctx == nil {
+		ctx = context.Background()
+	}
+
+	candidate := clone(source)
+	candidate.Path = ""
+	if candidate.SchemaVersion == 0 {
+		candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
+	}
+	originalRevision := source.Revision()
+	candidate.Normalize()
+	if candidate.Revision() != originalRevision {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("import note %s must already be normalized to preserve its revision: %w",
+			source.ID, ErrInvalid)
+	}
+	if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	s.mu.Lock()
+	defer s.mu.Unlock()
+	var imported *Note
+	err := s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
+		target, err := s.confinedImportPath(candidate.RepositoryID, candidate.ID)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		current, err := s.importedNoteByID(candidate.ID)
+		switch {
+		case err == nil:
+			if current.Revision() != candidate.Revision() {
+				return fmt.Errorf("note %s already exists with different content: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
+			}
+			if filepath.Clean(current.Path) != filepath.Clean(target) {
+				return fmt.Errorf("note %s exists outside its imported repository path: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
+			}
+			imported = clone(current)
+			return nil
+		case !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
+			return err
+		}
+
+		candidate.Path = target
+		if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		imported = clone(candidate)
+		return nil
+	})
+	return imported, err
+}
+
+func (s *Store) confinedImportPath(repositoryID, id string) (string, error) {
+	root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
+	}
+	repositoryDir := filepath.Join(root, repositoryID)
+	if info, err := os.Lstat(repositoryDir); err == nil {
+		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
+			return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository directory %s is a symlink: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
+		}
+		if !info.IsDir() {
+			return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository path %s is not a directory: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
+		}
+	} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect note repository directory %s: %w", repositoryID, err)
+	}
+
+	path := filepath.Join(repositoryDir, id+".md")
+	if info, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
+		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+			return "", fmt.Errorf("note path %s is not a regular file: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
+		}
+	} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect note path %s: %w", id, err)
+	}
+	confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("confine imported note path: %w", err)
+	}
+	return confined, nil
+}
+
+// importedNoteByID performs the global uniqueness lookup used by Import while
+// refusing to read through symlinks or accept legacy files nested more deeply
+// than the one-repository-directory layout.
+func (s *Store) importedNoteByID(id string) (*Note, error) {
+	paths, err := s.notePaths("")
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
+	}
+	var match string
+	for _, path := range paths {
+		if strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md") != id {
+			continue
+		}
+		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect existing note %s: %w", id, err)
+		}
+		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is not a regular file: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
+		}
+		confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("confine existing note %s: %w", id, err)
+		}
+		relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, confined)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("relativize existing note %s: %w", id, err)
+		}
+		parts := strings.Split(filepath.Clean(relative), string(filepath.Separator))
+		if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] != id+".md" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is outside the repository note layout: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
+		}
+		if match != "" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate note ID %s: %w", id, ErrConflict)
+		}
+		match = confined
+	}
+	if match == "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
+	}
+	return s.read(match)
+}

10	func openRegularForRead(root *os.Root, name string) (*os.File, error) {

+func rejectImportedPathOwner(entries []*Entry, importedID, host string, target Location) error {

+	for _, entry := range entries {

+		if err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize catalog asset %s location on host %s: %w", entry.ID, host, err)

+		ownedSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ownedPaths))
+		for _, path := range ownedPaths {
+			ownedSet[path] = struct{}{}

+func canonicalLocationPaths(location Location) ([]string, error) {

+		{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
+		{"real_path", location.RealPath},
+		{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},

+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(fields))

+		if field.value == "" {

+func mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, bool, error) {
+	if current.SchemaVersion != incoming.SchemaVersion {
+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "schema_version", "schema versions differ")
+	}
+	if current.Kind != incoming.Kind {
+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "kind",
+			fmt.Sprintf("durable kind %q differs from imported kind %q", current.Kind, incoming.Kind))
+	}
+	if current.Name != incoming.Name {
+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "name",
+			fmt.Sprintf("durable name %q differs from imported name %q", current.Name, incoming.Name))
+	}
+
+	merged := current.Clone()
+	changed := false
+
+	currentSummary := strings.TrimSpace(merged.Note)
+	incomingSummary := strings.TrimSpace(incoming.Note)
+	switch {
+	case currentSummary != "" && incomingSummary != "" && merged.Note != incoming.Note:
+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "note", "nonempty summaries differ")
+	case currentSummary == "" && incomingSummary != "":
+		merged.Note = incoming.Note
+		changed = true
+	}
+
+	tags := NormalizeTags(append(append([]string(nil), merged.Tags...), incoming.Tags...))
+	if !slices.Equal(merged.Tags, tags) {
+		merged.Tags = tags
+		changed = true
+	}
+
+	switch {
+	case merged.RemoteIdentity != "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "" && merged.RemoteIdentity != incoming.RemoteIdentity:
+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "remote_identity",
+			fmt.Sprintf("durable identity %q differs from imported identity %q", merged.RemoteIdentity, incoming.RemoteIdentity))
+	case merged.RemoteIdentity == "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "":
+		merged.RemoteIdentity = incoming.RemoteIdentity
+		changed = true
+	}
+
+	switch {
+	case merged.Experiment == nil && incoming.Experiment != nil:
+		value := *incoming.Experiment
+		merged.Experiment = &value
+		changed = true
+	case merged.Experiment != nil && incoming.Experiment != nil && !experimentsEqual(*merged.Experiment, *incoming.Experiment):
+		return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "experiment", "experiment metadata differs")
+	}
+
+	if value := earlierTime(merged.Created, incoming.Created); !value.Equal(merged.Created) {
+		merged.Created = value
+		changed = true
+	}
+	if value := earlierTime(merged.Discovered, incoming.Discovered); !value.Equal(merged.Discovered) {
+		merged.Discovered = value
+		changed = true
+	}
+	if value := laterTime(merged.LastOpened, incoming.LastOpened); !value.Equal(merged.LastOpened) {
+		merged.LastOpened = value
+		changed = true
+	}
+	if value := laterTime(merged.Updated, incoming.Updated); !value.Equal(merged.Updated) {
+		merged.Updated = value
+		changed = true
+	}
+
+	previous, exists := merged.LocationFor(host)
+	if !exists || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) || !previous.Updated.Equal(location.Updated) {
+		if merged.Locations == nil {
+			merged.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
+		}
+		merged.Locations[host] = location
+		changed = true
+	}
+	merged.Normalize()
+	if err := merged.Validate(); err != nil {
+		return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("validate merged catalog asset %s: %w", merged.ID, err)
+	}
+	return merged, changed, nil
+}
+
+func experimentsEqual(left, right Experiment) bool {
+	return left.Phase == right.Phase &&
+		left.Slug == right.Slug &&
+		left.OriginURL == right.OriginURL &&
+		left.Started.Equal(right.Started) &&
+		left.OriginalPath == right.OriginalPath &&
+		left.DeprecatedAt.Equal(right.DeprecatedAt) &&
+		left.DeprecatedPath == right.DeprecatedPath &&
+		left.GraduatedAt.Equal(right.GraduatedAt) &&
+		left.GraduatedPath == right.GraduatedPath
+}
+
+func earlierTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
+	if left.IsZero() || !right.IsZero() && right.Before(left) {
+		return right
+	}
+	return left
+}
+
+func laterTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
+	if right.After(left) {
+		return right
+	}
+	return left
+}

+// PortablePathLimits bounds the encoded path, each encoded component, and path
+// depth. Zero means unbounded for that field; negative values are invalid.
+// File-count and byte-size ceilings live in safefile because they describe a
+// collection of files rather than a path.
+type PortablePathLimits struct {
+	MaxPathBytes      int
+	MaxComponentBytes int
+	MaxDepth          int
+}
+
+// ValidatePortableSlashPath accepts only a non-empty, clean, slash-separated
+// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects
+// Git metadata aliases, platform-specific separators and volumes, Windows
+// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
+// invalid UTF-8.
+func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
+	if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if value == "" {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path is empty: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains a backslash path separator: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" || driveQualified(value) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path %q is absolute, drive-qualified, or UNC: %w", value, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if limits.MaxPathBytes > 0 && len(value) > limits.MaxPathBytes {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(value), limits.MaxPathBytes, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	components := strings.Split(value, "/")
+	if limits.MaxDepth > 0 && len(components) > limits.MaxDepth {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path has %d components; maximum is %d: %w", len(components), limits.MaxDepth, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	for _, component := range components {
+		if component == ".." {
+			return fmt.Errorf("path contains parent traversal: %w", ErrTraversal)
+		}
+		if err := ValidatePortableComponent(component, limits.MaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q: %w", component, err)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ValidatePortableComponent applies the per-component part of
+// ValidatePortableSlashPath. maxBytes may be zero for no size limit.
+func ValidatePortableComponent(component string, maxBytes int) error {
+	if maxBytes < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("negative component limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if !utf8.ValidString(component) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("component contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", err, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if maxBytes > 0 && len(component) > maxBytes {
+		return fmt.Errorf("component is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(component), maxBytes, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if strings.IndexFunc(component, isPortableControl) >= 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component contains control characters: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	windowsAlias := strings.TrimRight(component, ". ")
+	if strings.EqualFold(windowsAlias, ".git") {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains reserved Git metadata: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if windowsAlias != component {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q has a trailing dot or space and is not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q contains characters that are not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if windowsReservedName(component) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q is a reserved Windows device name: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ValidatePortablePathSet validates every path and rejects collisions at any
+// component boundary after Unicode normalization and full Unicode case folding.
+// Exact duplicate paths are left to the caller's type/cardinality policy.
+func ValidatePortablePathSet(paths []string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
+	type collisionNode struct {
+		spelling string
+		first    string
+		children map[string]*collisionNode
+	}
+	root := &collisionNode{children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
+	for _, value := range paths {
+		if err := ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, limits); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("portable path %q: %w", value, err)
+		}
+		current := root
+		for _, component := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
+			key := portableCollisionKey(component)
+			next, exists := current.children[key]
+			if exists && next.spelling != component {
+				return fmt.Errorf("paths %q and %q collide on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems at %q and %q: %w",
+					next.first, value, next.spelling, component, ErrPathCollision)
+			}
+			if !exists {
+				next = &collisionNode{spelling: component, first: value, children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
+				current.children[key] = next
+			}
+			current = next
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func portableCollisionKey(component string) string {
+	return norm.NFC.String(cases.Fold().String(norm.NFC.String(component)))
+}
+
+func isPortableControl(r rune) bool {
+	return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
+}
+
+func windowsReservedName(component string) bool {
+	base := component
+	if dot := strings.IndexByte(base, '.'); dot >= 0 {
+		base = base[:dot]
+	}
+	base = strings.TrimRight(base, " ")
+	upper := strings.ToUpper(base)
+	switch upper {
+	case "CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", "CONIN$", "CONOUT$", "CLOCK$":
+		return true
+	}
+	if len([]rune(upper)) != 4 {
+		return false
+	}
+	runes := []rune(upper)
+	prefix := string(runes[:3])
+	if prefix != "COM" && prefix != "LPT" {
+		return false
+	}
+	last := runes[3]
+	return last >= '1' && last <= '9' || last == '¹' || last == '²' || last == '³'
+}

+// runSSHCommand starts SSH before writing an askpass secret. Starting first is
+// load-bearing: a secret larger than the pipe capacity must remain cancellable
+// through the command context instead of blocking before SSH exists.
+func runSSHCommand(cmd *exec.Cmd, password string) error {
+	if password == "" {
+		return cmd.Run()
+	}
+	executable, err := os.Executable()
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	cmd.ExtraFiles = []*os.File{reader}
+	cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
+		askpassMarker+"=1", askpassFD+"=3", "SSH_ASKPASS="+executable,
+		"SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force", "DISPLAY=dev-fleet")
+	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
+		_ = reader.Close()
+		_ = writer.Close()
+		return err
+	}
+	// The child owns its inherited descriptor after Start; closing the parent
+	// copy lets an early SSH exit interrupt a blocked write.
+	readerCloseErr := reader.Close()
+	writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		_, writeErr := io.Copy(writer, strings.NewReader(password+"\n"))
+		writeDone <- errors.Join(writeErr, writer.Close())
+	}()
+	waitErr := cmd.Wait()
+	// A descendant could retain the inherited read descriptor after SSH exits.
+	// Close our writer so that cannot strand the write goroutine.
+	_ = writer.Close()
+	writeErr := <-writeDone
+	return errors.Join(waitErr, readerCloseErr, writeErr)
+}

+type captureBuffer struct {
+	limit    int64
+	buffer   bytes.Buffer
+	exceeded bool
+}
+
+func newCaptureBuffer(limit int64) *captureBuffer {
+	return &captureBuffer{limit: limit}
+}
+
+func (b *captureBuffer) Write(value []byte) (int, error) {
+	remaining := b.limit - int64(b.buffer.Len())
+	if remaining > 0 {
+		keep := int64(len(value))
+		if keep > remaining {
+			keep = remaining
+		}
+		_, _ = b.buffer.Write(value[:int(keep)])
+	}
+	if int64(len(value)) > remaining {
+		b.exceeded = true
+	}
+	// Consume excess output without retaining it. The command timeout still
+	// bounds a peer that writes forever, while the parent process stays bounded.
+	return len(value), nil
+}
+
+func (b *captureBuffer) Bytes() []byte {
+	return append([]byte(nil), b.buffer.Bytes()...)
+}
+
+func (b *captureBuffer) Exceeded() bool { return b.exceeded }
+
+func effectiveLimit(configured, fallback int64) int64 {
+	if configured <= 0 {
+		return fallback
+	}
+	return configured
+}
+
+func captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr *captureBuffer) string {
+	streams := make([]string, 0, 2)
+	if stdout.Exceeded() {
+		streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stdout exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stdout.limit))
+	}
+	if stderr.Exceeded() {
+		streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stderr exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stderr.limit))
+	}
+	return "fleet transport: remote " + strings.Join(streams, " and ")
+}
+
+func boundedBytes(value []byte, limit int64) []byte {
+	if int64(len(value)) > limit {
+		value = value[:int(limit)]
+	}
+	return append([]byte(nil), value...)
+}
+
+func appendBounded(current, suffix []byte, limit int64) []byte {
+	if int64(len(current)) >= limit {
+		return append([]byte(nil), current...)
+	}
+	available := limit - int64(len(current))
+	if int64(len(suffix)) > available {
+		suffix = suffix[:int(available)]
+	}
+	return append(append([]byte(nil), current...), suffix...)
+}
+
+func localTransportFailure(message string) Result {
+	return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}

+// Import writes a transported note with its exact durable identity and
+// timestamps. Path is always derived from the validated repository and note IDs;
+// a source Path is never trusted. An identical revision is an idempotent replay,
+// while reusing an ID for different content is a conflict. Import changes only
+// Markdown source data and deliberately does not update or rebuild the FTS cache.
+func (s *Store) Import(ctx context.Context, source *Note) (*Note, error) {
+	if s == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("import into nil note store")
+	}
+	if source == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("import nil note")
+	}
+	if ctx == nil {
+		ctx = context.Background()
+	}
+
+	candidate := clone(source)
+	candidate.Path = ""
+	if candidate.SchemaVersion == 0 {
+		candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
+	}
+	originalRevision := source.Revision()
+	candidate.Normalize()
+	if candidate.Revision() != originalRevision {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("import note %s must already be normalized to preserve its revision: %w",
+			source.ID, ErrInvalid)
+	}
+	if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	s.mu.Lock()
+	defer s.mu.Unlock()
+	var imported *Note
+	err := s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
+		target, err := s.confinedImportPath(candidate.RepositoryID, candidate.ID)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		current, err := s.importedNoteByID(candidate.ID)
+		switch {
+		case err == nil:
+			if current.Revision() != candidate.Revision() {
+				return fmt.Errorf("note %s already exists with different content: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
+			}
+			if filepath.Clean(current.Path) != filepath.Clean(target) {
+				return fmt.Errorf("note %s exists outside its imported repository path: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
+			}
+			imported = clone(current)
+			return nil
+		case !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
+			return err
+		}
+
+		candidate.Path = target
+		if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		imported = clone(candidate)
+		return nil
+	})
+	return imported, err
+}

+func (s *Store) confinedImportPath(repositoryID, id string) (string, error) {
+	root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
+	}
+	repositoryDir := filepath.Join(root, repositoryID)
+	if info, err := os.Lstat(repositoryDir); err == nil {
+		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
+			return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository directory %s is a symlink: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
+		}
+		if !info.IsDir() {
+			return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository path %s is not a directory: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
+		}
+	} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect note repository directory %s: %w", repositoryID, err)
+	}
+
+	path := filepath.Join(repositoryDir, id+".md")
+	if info, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
+		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+			return "", fmt.Errorf("note path %s is not a regular file: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
+		}
+	} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect note path %s: %w", id, err)
+	}
+	confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("confine imported note path: %w", err)
+	}
+	return confined, nil
+}
+
+// importedNoteByID performs the global uniqueness lookup used by Import while
+// refusing to read through symlinks or accept legacy files nested more deeply
+// than the one-repository-directory layout.
+func (s *Store) importedNoteByID(id string) (*Note, error) {
+	paths, err := s.notePaths("")
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
+	}
+	var match string
+	for _, path := range paths {
+		if strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md") != id {
+			continue
+		}
+		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect existing note %s: %w", id, err)
+		}
+		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is not a regular file: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
+		}
+		confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("confine existing note %s: %w", id, err)
+		}
+		relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, confined)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("relativize existing note %s: %w", id, err)
+		}
+		parts := strings.Split(filepath.Clean(relative), string(filepath.Separator))
+		if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] != id+".md" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is outside the repository note layout: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
+		}
+		if match != "" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate note ID %s: %w", id, ErrConflict)
+		}
+		match = confined
+	}
+	if match == "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
+	}
+	return s.read(match)

123		if reason == "" || len(reason) > 128 {

125		}
126		for _, character := range reason {

135	// DecodeStrict reads exactly one bounded JSON value, rejects unknown fields,
136	// and requires EOF after optional JSON whitespace.
137	func DecodeStrict(reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
138		if reader == nil || target == nil {
139			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a reader and target")
140		}
141		if maxBytes <= 0 {
142			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a positive limit")
143		}
144		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maxBytes+1))
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("read fleet protocol: %w", err)
147		}
148		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
149			return fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
150		}
151		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
152		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
153		if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
154			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol: %w", err)
155		}
156		var extra any
157		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
158			if err == nil {
159				return errors.New("decode fleet protocol: multiple JSON values")
160			}
161			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol trailing data: %w", err)
162		}
163		return nil
164	}
165
166	// MarshalBounded encodes one protocol value and enforces the matching bound
167	// before it can be handed to Transport.
168	func MarshalBounded(value any, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
169		if maxBytes <= 0 {
170			return nil, errors.New("fleet protocol encode requires a positive limit")
171		}
172		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode fleet protocol: %w", err)
175		}
176		if int64(len(data))+1 > maxBytes {
177			return nil, fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
178		}
179		return append(data, '\n'), nil
180	}
181
182	// UnmarshalStrict applies DecodeStrict to an in-memory transport response.
183	func UnmarshalStrict(data []byte, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
184		return DecodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(data), maxBytes, target)
185	}
