205				}
206				if err := validateClaimKeySet(*state, canonical, token, claimKind); err != nil {
207					return false, err
208				}
209				for _, key := range canonical {
210					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
211					if record == nil {
212						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s has no active %s: %w", key.subject(), claimKind, ErrEpochMismatch)
213					}
214					var claim *Claim
215					if claimKind == "reservation" {
216						claim = record.Reservation
217					} else {
218						claim = record.Fence
219					}
220					if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
221						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s does not hold operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
222					}
223				}
224				epoch, err := allocateEpoch(state)
225				if err != nil {
226					return false, err
227				}
228				advanced = epoch
229				now := canonicalTime(a.clock())
230				for _, key := range canonical {
231					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
232					record.Epoch = epoch
233					if claimKind == "reservation" {
234						record.Reservation = nil
235					} else {
236						record.Fence = nil
237					}
238					if terminal != "" {
239						record.Tombstones = append(record.Tombstones, Tombstone{Kind: terminal, Token: token, AdvancedEpoch: epoch, CreatedAt: now})
240					}
241				}
242				return true, nil
243			})
244		})
245		return advanced, err
246	}
247
248	// WithMutation runs an ordinary mutator only when no requested key is reserved
249	// or fenced. A branch key automatically includes its repository ancestor so a
250	// repository fence covers every branch. The locks remain held until operation
251	// returns.
252	func (a *Authority) WithMutation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func() error) error {
253		return a.WithGuard(ctx, keys, nil, operation)
254	}
255
256	// WithGuard permits the exact owner of an active reservation or fence to work
257	// while rejecting stale, returned, and mismatched tokens. A nil token is an
258	// ordinary mutation guard and includes repository ancestors. It is
259	// non-reentrant: operation must not reacquire an overlapping key.
260	func (a *Authority) WithGuard(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token *Token, operation func() error) error {
261		if a == nil {
262			return errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
263		}
264		if operation == nil {
265			return errors.New("operation lease guard requires an operation")
266		}
267		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool)
272		if token != nil {
273			if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
274				return err
275			}
276		} else {
277			for _, key := range claimed {
278				if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
279					repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
280				}
281			}
282		}
283		return a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func(locked []Key) error {
284			checked := locked
285			if token != nil {
286				// Repository ancestors participate in draining but are not part of a
287				// branch-scoped token's ownership claim.
288				checked = claimed
289			}
290			if err := a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
291				matched := 0
292				for _, key := range checked {
293					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
294					if record == nil {
295						if token != nil {
296							return fmt.Errorf("%s has no operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
297						}
298						continue
299					}
300					if token != nil && hasTerminal(*record, *token) {
301						return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrReturned)
302					}
303					claim, kind := activeClaim(*record)
304					if claim == nil {
305						if token != nil {
306							return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is no longer active on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrEpochMismatch)
307						}
308						continue
309					}
310					if token == nil || !claim.Token.matches(*token) {
311						return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
312					}
313					matched++
314				}
315				if token != nil && matched != len(checked) {
316					return fmt.Errorf("operation %s does not own the complete key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrEpochMismatch)
317				}
318				if token != nil {
319					if err := validateGuardKeySet(state, claimed, *token); err != nil {
320						return err
321					}
322				}
323				if token == nil {
324					for _, record := range state.Records {
325						if record.Key.Scope != ScopeBranch || !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
326							continue
327						}
328						if claim, kind := activeClaim(record); claim != nil {
329							return &BlockedError{Key: record.Key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
330						}
331					}
332				}
333				return nil
334			}); err != nil {
335				return err
336			}
337			return operation()
338		})
339	}
340
341	// Inspect returns records for the requested keys while holding those key locks.
342	// Untouched keys are represented with Epoch zero and are never persisted.
343	func (a *Authority) Inspect(ctx context.Context, keys []Key) ([]Record, error) {
344		if a == nil {
345			return nil, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
346		}
347		var result []Record
348		err := a.withKeyLocks(ctx, keys, func(canonical []Key) error {
349			return a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
350				result = make([]Record, 0, len(canonical))
351				for _, key := range canonical {
352					if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
353						result = append(result, cloneRecord(*record))
354					} else {
355						result = append(result, Record{Key: key})
356					}
357				}
358				return nil
359			})
360		})
361		return result, err
362	}
363
364	func mutationKeys(keys []Key) []Key {
365		expanded := append([]Key(nil), keys...)
366		for _, key := range keys {
367			if key.Scope == ScopeBranch {
368				expanded = append(expanded, RepositoryKey(key.Repository))
369			}
370		}
371		return expanded
372	}
373
374	func (a *Authority) withKeyLocks(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func([]Key) error) error {
375		canonical, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
376		if err != nil {
377			return err
378		}
379		if ctx == nil {
380			ctx = context.Background()
381		}
382		if err := a.ensureLayout(); err != nil {
383			return err
384		}
385		var acquire func(int) error
386		acquire = func(index int) error {
387			if index == len(canonical) {
388				return operation(canonical)
389			}
390			directory := a.keyLockDir(canonical[index])
391			if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
392				return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation key lock: %w", err)
393			}
394			return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease key", func() error { return acquire(index + 1) })
395		}
396		return acquire(0)
397	}
398
399	func (a *Authority) updateState(ctx context.Context, mutate func(*Snapshot) (bool, error)) error {
400		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
401			state, err := a.loadState()
402			if err != nil {
403				return err
404			}
405			changed, err := mutate(&state)
406			if err != nil || !changed {
407				return err
408			}
409			return a.writeState(state)
410		})
411	}
412
413	func (a *Authority) readState(ctx context.Context, read func(Snapshot) error) error {
414		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
415			state, err := a.loadState()
416			if err != nil {
417				return err
418			}
419			return read(state)
420		})
421	}
422
423	func (a *Authority) withStateLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
424		directory := filepath.Join(a.root, ".authority")
425		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
426			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation authority lock: %w", err)
427		}
428		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease authority", operation)
429	}
430
431	func (a *Authority) ensureLayout() error {
432		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
433			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation lease root: %w", err)
434		}
435		if err := ensurePrivateDir(filepath.Join(a.root, ".keys")); err != nil {
436			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation lease key root: %w", err)
437		}
438		return nil
439	}
440
441	func (a *Authority) keyLockDir(key Key) string {
442		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(key.canonical()))
443		return filepath.Join(a.root, ".keys", hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]))
444	}
445
446	func (a *Authority) statePath() string { return filepath.Join(a.root, stateFilename) }
447
448	func (a *Authority) loadState() (Snapshot, error) {
449		path := a.statePath()
450		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
451		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
452			return Snapshot{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}, nil
453		}
454		if err != nil {
455			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state: %w", err)
456		}
457		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
458			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s is not a regular file", path)
459		}
460		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
461		if err != nil {
462			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state permissions: %w", err)
463		}
464		if !private {
465			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
466		}
467		file, err := os.Open(path)
468		if err != nil {
469			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("open operation lease state: %w", err)
470		}
471		defer file.Close()
472		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
473		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
474		var state Snapshot
475		if err := decoder.Decode(&state); err != nil {
476			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state: %w", err)
477		}
478		var extra any
479		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
480			if err == nil {
481				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("decode operation lease state: multiple JSON values")
482			}
483			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state trailing data: %w", err)
484		}
485		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
486			return Snapshot{}, err
487		}
488		canonical := canonicalSnapshot(state)
489		encodedState, _ := json.Marshal(state)
490		encodedCanonical, _ := json.Marshal(canonical)
491		if string(encodedState) != string(encodedCanonical) {
492			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("operation lease state is not in canonical order")
493		}
494		return state, nil
495	}
496
497	func (a *Authority) writeState(state Snapshot) error {
498		state = canonicalSnapshot(state)
499		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
500			return err
501		}
502		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
503			return err
504		}
505		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(a.root, ".authority-*.tmp")
506		if err != nil {
507			return fmt.Errorf("create operation lease state temp file: %w", err)
508		}
509		name := temporary.Name()
510		defer os.Remove(name)
511		if err := setPrivateMode(name, 0o600); err != nil {
512			_ = temporary.Close()
513			return err
514		}
515		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)
516		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
517		if err := encoder.Encode(state); err != nil {
518			_ = temporary.Close()
519			return fmt.Errorf("encode operation lease state: %w", err)
520		}
521		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
522			_ = temporary.Close()
523			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease state: %w", err)
524		}
525		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
526			return fmt.Errorf("close operation lease state: %w", err)
527		}
528		if err := replaceFile(name, a.statePath()); err != nil {
529			return fmt.Errorf("publish operation lease state: %w", err)
530		}
531		if err := syncDirectory(a.root); err != nil {
532			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease directory: %w", err)
533		}
534		return nil
535	}
536
537	func validateSnapshot(state Snapshot) error {
538		if state.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
539			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease schema_version %d: want %d", state.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
540		}
541		bindings := make(map[string]string, len(state.Bindings))
542		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
543			if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
544				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease binding: %w", err)
545			}
546			if _, exists := bindings[binding.OperationID]; exists {
547				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease repeats binding %s", binding.OperationID)
548			}
549			bindings[binding.OperationID] = binding.Digest
550		}
551		type activeSignature struct {
552			Token     Token
553			MachineID string
554			Kind      string
555		}
556		activeOperations := make(map[string]activeSignature)
557		terminalOperations := make(map[string]Tombstone)
558		seenKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(state.Records))
559		var maxRecordEpoch uint64
560		for _, record := range state.Records {
561			if err := record.Key.Validate(); err != nil {
562				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease record: %w", err)
563			}
564			canonicalKey := record.Key.canonical()
565			if _, exists := seenKeys[canonicalKey]; exists {
566				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease state repeats key %s", record.Key.subject())
567			}
568			seenKeys[canonicalKey] = struct{}{}
569			if record.Epoch == 0 || record.Epoch > state.LastEpoch {
570				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has invalid epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), record.Epoch)
571			}
572			if record.Epoch > maxRecordEpoch {
573				maxRecordEpoch = record.Epoch
574			}
575			if record.Reservation != nil && record.Fence != nil {
576				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has both reservation and fence", record.Key.subject())
577			}
578			for _, named := range []struct {
579				name  string
580				claim *Claim
581			}{{"reservation", record.Reservation}, {"fence", record.Fence}} {
582				if named.claim == nil {
583					continue
584				}
585				if err := named.claim.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
586					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s: %w", named.name, record.Key.subject(), err)
587				}
588				if digest, exists := bindings[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != named.claim.Token.Digest {
589					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no matching permanent binding", named.name, record.Key.subject())
590				}
591				if named.claim.Token.Epoch != record.Epoch {
592					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has epoch %d, record has %d", named.name, record.Key.subject(), named.claim.Token.Epoch, record.Epoch)
593				}
594				if named.claim.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
595					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no created_at", named.name, record.Key.subject())
596				}
597				if named.claim.MachineID != "" {
598					if err := machineid.Validate(named.claim.MachineID); err != nil {
599						return err
600					}
601				}
602				signature := activeSignature{Token: named.claim.Token, MachineID: named.claim.MachineID, Kind: named.name}
603				if prior, exists := activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; exists {
604					if !prior.Token.matches(signature.Token) || prior.MachineID != signature.MachineID || prior.Kind != signature.Kind {
605						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent active claims", named.claim.Token.OperationID)
606					}
607				} else {
608					activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID] = signature
609				}
610			}
611			seenTombstones := make(map[string]struct{}, len(record.Tombstones))
612			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
613				switch tombstone.Kind {
614				case TombstoneAborted, TombstoneReturned:
615				default:
616					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has unknown tombstone kind %q", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.Kind)
617				}
618				if err := tombstone.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
619					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s: %w", record.Key.subject(), err)
620				}
621				if digest, exists := bindings[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != tombstone.Token.Digest {
622					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no matching permanent binding", record.Key.subject())
623				}
624				if tombstone.AdvancedEpoch <= tombstone.Token.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > record.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > state.LastEpoch {
625					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has invalid advanced epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.AdvancedEpoch)
626				}
627				if tombstone.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
628					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no created_at", record.Key.subject())
629				}
630				if prior, exists := terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; exists {
631					if !prior.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || prior.Kind != tombstone.Kind || prior.AdvancedEpoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
632						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent terminal records", tombstone.Token.OperationID)
633					}
634				} else {
635					terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID] = tombstone
636				}
637				identity := fmt.Sprintf("%s\x00%s\x00%d", tombstone.Token.OperationID, tombstone.Token.Digest, tombstone.Token.Epoch)
638				if _, exists := seenTombstones[identity]; exists {
639					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s repeats a terminal token", record.Key.subject())
640				}
641				seenTombstones[identity] = struct{}{}
642				if record.Reservation != nil && record.Reservation.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || record.Fence != nil && record.Fence.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) {
643					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has a terminal token still active", record.Key.subject())
644				}
645			}
646		}
647		if state.LastEpoch != maxRecordEpoch {
648			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease last_epoch %d does not match latest record epoch %d", state.LastEpoch, maxRecordEpoch)
649		}
650		for operationID := range activeOperations {
651			if _, terminal := terminalOperations[operationID]; terminal {
652				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s is both active and terminal", operationID)
653			}
654		}
655		return nil
656	}
657
658	func canonicalSnapshot(state Snapshot) Snapshot {
659		result := Snapshot{
660			SchemaVersion: state.SchemaVersion,
661			LastEpoch:     state.LastEpoch,
662			Bindings:      append([]Binding(nil), state.Bindings...),
663			Records:       make([]Record, len(state.Records)),
664		}
665		sort.Slice(result.Bindings, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Bindings[i].OperationID < result.Bindings[j].OperationID })
666		for index, record := range state.Records {
667			result.Records[index] = cloneRecord(record)
668			if result.Records[index].Reservation != nil {
669				result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt)
670			}
671			if result.Records[index].Fence != nil {
672				result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt)
673			}
674			for tombstoneIndex := range result.Records[index].Tombstones {
675				result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt)
676			}
677			sort.Slice(result.Records[index].Tombstones, func(i, j int) bool {
678				left, right := result.Records[index].Tombstones[i], result.Records[index].Tombstones[j]
679				if left.Token.Epoch != right.Token.Epoch {
680					return left.Token.Epoch < right.Token.Epoch
681				}
682				if left.Token.OperationID != right.Token.OperationID {
683					return left.Token.OperationID < right.Token.OperationID
684				}
685				if left.Token.Digest != right.Token.Digest {
686					return left.Token.Digest < right.Token.Digest
687				}
688				return left.Kind < right.Kind
689			})
690		}
691		sort.Slice(result.Records, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Records[i].Key.canonical() < result.Records[j].Key.canonical() })
692		return result
693	}
694
695	func cloneRecord(record Record) Record {
696		result := record
697		if record.Reservation != nil {
698			copy := *record.Reservation
699			result.Reservation = &copy
700		}
701		if record.Fence != nil {
702			copy := *record.Fence
703			result.Fence = &copy
704		}
705		result.Tombstones = append([]Tombstone(nil), record.Tombstones...)
706		return result
707	}
708
709	func findRecord(records []Record, key Key) *Record {
710		canonical := key.canonical()
711		for index := range records {
712			if records[index].Key.canonical() == canonical {
713				return &records[index]
714			}
715		}
716		return nil
717	}
718
719	func ensureRecord(state *Snapshot, key Key) *Record {
720		if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
721			return record
722		}
723		state.Records = append(state.Records, Record{Key: key})
724		return &state.Records[len(state.Records)-1]
725	}
726
727	func allocateEpoch(state *Snapshot) (uint64, error) {
728		if state.LastEpoch == math.MaxUint64 {
729			return 0, errors.New("operation lease epoch exhausted")
730		}
731		state.LastEpoch++
732		return state.LastEpoch, nil
733	}
734
735	func activeClaim(record Record) (*Claim, string) {
736		if record.Reservation != nil {
737			return record.Reservation, "reservation"
738		}
739		if record.Fence != nil {
740			return record.Fence, "fence"
741		}
742		return nil, ""
743	}
744
745	func hasTerminal(record Record, token Token) bool {
746		for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
747			if tombstone.Token.matches(token) {
748				return true
749			}
750		}
751		return false
752	}
753
754	func ensureBinding(state *Snapshot, request Request) bool {
755		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
756			if binding.OperationID == request.OperationID {
757				return false
758			}
759		}
760		state.Bindings = append(state.Bindings, Binding{OperationID: request.OperationID, Digest: request.Digest})
761		return true
762	}
763
764	func checkOperationReuse(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
765		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
766			if binding.OperationID != request.OperationID {
767				continue
768			}
769			if binding.Digest != request.Digest {
770				return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was permanently bound to another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
771			}
772			break
773		}
774		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
775		for _, key := range keys {
776			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
777		}
778		for _, record := range state.Records {
779			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
780				if tombstone.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
781					continue
782				}
783				if tombstone.Token.Digest != request.Digest {
784					return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was used with another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
785				}
786				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal: %w", request.OperationID, ErrReturned)
787			}
788			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)
789			if claim == nil || claim.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
790				continue
791			}
792			if claim.Token.Digest != request.Digest {

794			}
795			if _, exists := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !exists {

797			}
798		}

800	}

802	func checkHierarchyClaims(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
803		requestedKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
804		requestedRepositories := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))

811			}
812		}
813		for _, record := range state.Records {

816				continue
817			}

819				continue
820			}
821			if _, sameRepository := requestedRepositories[record.Key.Repository]; !sameRepository {
822				continue
823			}
824			if record.Key.Scope != ScopeRepository && !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
825				continue
826			}
827			return blockedOrConflict(record.Key, kind, *claim, request)
828		}
829		return nil
830	}

832	func blockedOrConflict(key Key, kind string, claim Claim, request Request) error {

835		}

843		}
844		matched := 0

846			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)

852			}
853			matched++

857		}

869			if claimKind == "reservation" {
870				claim = record.Reservation
871			} else {
872				claim = record.Fence
873			}
874			if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
875				continue
876			}
877			if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
878				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d owns a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
879			}
880			matched++
881		}

884		}

888	func matchingTerminal(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token, kind TombstoneKind) (uint64, bool, error) {
889		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
890		for _, key := range keys {
891			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
892		}
893		var epoch uint64
894		matched := 0
895		for _, record := range state.Records {
896			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
897				if !tombstone.Token.matches(token) {
898					continue
899				}
900				if tombstone.Kind != kind {
901					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d ended as %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, tombstone.Kind, ErrReturned)
902				}
903				if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
904					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
905				}
906				if epoch == 0 {
907					epoch = tombstone.AdvancedEpoch
908				} else if epoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
909					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s has inconsistent terminal epochs: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
910				}
911				matched++
912				break
913			}
914		}
915		if matched == 0 {
916			return 0, false, nil
917		}
918		if matched != len(keys) {
919			return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal on only part of the key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
920		}
921		return epoch, true, nil
922	}

924	func ensurePrivateDir(path string) error {
925		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
926			return err
927		}

930			return err
931		}
932		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
933			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a private directory", path)
934		}
935		if err := setPrivateMode(path, 0o700); err != nil {
936			return err
937		}
938		info, err = os.Lstat(path)
939		if err != nil {
940			return err
941		}
942		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o700)
943		if err != nil {
944			return fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease directory permissions: %w", err)
945		}
946		if !private {
947			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease directory %s permissions are not private (want 0700 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
948		}
949		return nil
950	}

118	func (k Key) Validate() error {
119		if err := validateIdentity("repository identity", k.Repository); err != nil {
120			return err
121		}
122		switch k.Scope {
123		case ScopeRepository:
124			if k.Branch != "" {

126			}
127		case ScopeBranch:

133		}
134		return nil

140	}

149	func (r Request) Validate() error {

151			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation id %q", r.OperationID)
152		}
153		if !assessment.ValidFingerprint(r.Digest) {
154			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has invalid digest %q", r.OperationID, r.Digest)
155		}
156		if r.MachineID != "" {
157			if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
158				return err
159			}
160		}
161		return nil
162	}

166	}

168	func (t Token) Validate() error {
169		if err := (Request{OperationID: t.OperationID, Digest: t.Digest}).Validate(); err != nil {
170			return err
171		}
172		if t.Epoch == 0 {
173			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has zero lease epoch", t.OperationID)
174		}
175		return nil
176	}
177
178	func (t Token) matches(other Token) bool {
179		return t.OperationID == other.OperationID && t.Digest == other.Digest && t.Epoch == other.Epoch
180	}
181
182	func (t Token) sameOperation(request Request) bool {
183		return t.OperationID == request.OperationID && t.Digest == request.Digest
184	}
185
186	// CanonicalKeys validates, deduplicates, and sorts keys in the one order used
187	// by every multi-key acquisition.
188	func CanonicalKeys(keys []Key) ([]Key, error) {
189		if len(keys) == 0 {
190			return nil, errors.New("operation lease requires at least one key")
191		}
192		unique := make(map[string]Key, len(keys))
193		for _, key := range keys {
194			if err := key.Validate(); err != nil {
195				return nil, err
196			}
197			unique[key.canonical()] = key
198		}
199		canonical := make([]Key, 0, len(unique))
200		for _, key := range unique {
201			canonical = append(canonical, key)
202		}
203		sort.Slice(canonical, func(i, j int) bool { return canonical[i].canonical() < canonical[j].canonical() })
204		return canonical, nil
205	}
206
207	func validateIdentity(name, value string) error {
208		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
209			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
210		}
211		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
212			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
213		}
214		for _, char := range value {
215			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
216				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
217			}
218		}
219		return nil
220	}

1	// Package safefile provides held-root filesystem operations for untrusted
2	// relative paths. It keeps traversal relative to os.Root handles, rejects links
3	// and special files, revalidates filesystem identity, and detects observable
4	// source mutation while reading.
5	package safefile
6
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"io/fs"
13		"os"
14
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
16	)
17
18	var (
19		// ErrChanged reports that a named root, child, or file no longer identifies
20		// the object observed by the caller.
21		ErrChanged = errors.New("filesystem object changed")
22		// ErrUnsafeType reports a symlink, reparse point, directory, or other
23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.
24		ErrUnsafeType = errors.New("unsafe filesystem object type")
25		// ErrFileLimit reports a regular file whose bytes exceed the read policy.
26		ErrFileLimit = errors.New("file size limit exceeded")
27	)
28
29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}
63

135	// ReadStableRegular reads one child file while proving that the directory name,
136	// opened descriptor, and final directory name all identify the expected regular
137	// file with unchanged observable metadata. maxBytes must be non-negative; zero
138	// means unbounded. Supplying the FileInfo from an earlier directory listing
139	// detects replacement or mutation between selection and opening.
140	func ReadStableRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
141		if root == nil {
142			return nil, nil, errors.New("read stable file: nil root")
143		}
144		if maxBytes < 0 {
145			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("negative maximum file size: %w", ErrFileLimit)
146		}
147		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
148			return nil, nil, err
149		}
150		before, err := root.Lstat(name)
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, nil, err
153		}
154		if expected == nil {
155			expected = before
156		}
157		if unsafeLink(before) || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
158			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is not a regular file: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
159		}
160		if !sameStableSourceState(expected, before) {
161			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed before opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
162		}
163		if maxBytes > 0 && before.Size() > maxBytes {
164			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", before.Size(), maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
165		}
166
167		file, err := openRegularForRead(root, name)
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, nil, err
170		}
171		defer file.Close()
172		opened, err := file.Stat()
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, nil, err
175		}
176		if unsafeLink(opened) || !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(expected, opened) {
177			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
178		}
179		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, nil, err
182		}
183		if unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, current) {
184			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
185		}
186
187		data, err := readAllContext(ctx, file, maxBytes)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, nil, err
190		}
191		after, err := file.Stat()
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, nil, err
194		}
195		current, err = root.Lstat(name)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, nil, err
198		}
199		if unsafeLink(after) || unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, after) ||
200			!sameStableSourceState(after, current) || after.Size() != int64(len(data)) {
201			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed during read: %w", ErrChanged)
202		}
203		return data, opened, nil
204	}

206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}
213
214	func sameStableSourceState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
215		return SameFileState(left, right) && samePlatformState(left, right)
216	}
217
218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}
243
244	func unsafeLink(info fs.FileInfo) bool {
245		return info != nil && (info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || isReparsePoint(info))
246	}

220	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
221		for len(data) > 0 {

223				return err
224			}
225			written, err := writer.Write(data)
226			if err != nil {
227				return err
228			}
229			if written == 0 {
230				return io.ErrShortWrite
231			}
232			data = data[written:]
233		}
234		return context.Cause(ctx)

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15		"unicode"
16		"unicode/utf8"
17
18		"golang.org/x/text/cases"
19		"golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm"
20	)
21
22	var (
23		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
24		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
25		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
26		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
27		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
28		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
29		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
30		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
31		// ErrNotPortable reports a relative path that cannot be represented safely
32		// and with the same meaning on supported Unix and Windows filesystems.
33		ErrNotPortable = errors.New("path is not portable")
34		// ErrPathCollision reports distinct spellings that identify the same path on
35		// a case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystem.
36		ErrPathCollision = errors.New("portable path collision")
37		// ErrPathLimit reports a portable path that exceeds an explicit policy limit.
38		ErrPathLimit = errors.New("portable path limit exceeded")
39	)
40
41	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
42	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
43	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
44	// before creating or moving anything into it.
45	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
46		if path == "" {
47			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
48		}
49		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
50		if err != nil {
51			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
52		}
53		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
54
55		probe := absolute
56		var missing []string
57		for {
58			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
59			if err == nil {
60				slices.Reverse(missing)
61				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
62				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
63			}
64			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
65				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
66			}
67			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
68			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
69			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
70			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
71			// still-missing suffix.
72			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
73				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
74				if readErr != nil {
75					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
76				}
77				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
78					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
79				}
80				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
81					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
82				}
83				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
84				if resolveErr != nil {
85					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
86				}
87				slices.Reverse(missing)
88				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
89				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
90			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
91				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
92			}
93			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
94			if parent == probe {
95				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
96			}
97			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
98			probe = parent
99		}
100	}
101
102	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
103	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
104	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
105	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
106		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
107			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
108		}
109		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
110		if err != nil {
111			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
112		}
113		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
114		if err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
116		}
117
118		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
119		if err != nil {
120			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
121			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
122			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
123			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
124		}
125		switch {
126		case rel == ".":
127			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
128		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
129			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
130		default:
131			return canonicalCandidate, nil
132		}
133	}
134
135	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
136	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
137	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
138		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
139		if err == nil {
140			return true, nil
141		}
142		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
143			return false, nil
144		}
145		return false, err
146	}
147
148	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
149	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
150		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
151		if err != nil {
152			return false, err
153		}
154		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
155		if err != nil {
156			return false, err
157		}
158		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
159			return true, nil
160		}
161		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
162	}

164	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
165	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
166	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
167	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
168		switch {
169		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
170			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
171		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
172			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
173		case component == "." || component == "..":
174			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
175		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
176			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
177		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
178			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
179		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
180			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
181		default:
182			return nil
183		}
184	}

186	// PortablePathLimits bounds the encoded path, each encoded component, and path
187	// depth. Zero means unbounded for that field; negative values are invalid.
188	// File-count and byte-size ceilings live in safefile because they describe a
189	// collection of files rather than a path.
190	type PortablePathLimits struct {
191		MaxPathBytes      int
192		MaxComponentBytes int
193		MaxDepth          int
194	}
195
196	// ValidatePortableSlashPath accepts only a non-empty, clean, slash-separated
197	// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects
198	// Git metadata aliases, platform-specific separators and volumes, Windows
199	// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
200	// invalid UTF-8.
201	func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
202		if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
203			return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
204		}
205		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
206			return fmt.Errorf("path contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
207		}
208		if value == "" {
209			return fmt.Errorf("path is empty: %w", ErrNotPortable)
210		}
211		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
212			return fmt.Errorf("path contains a backslash path separator: %w", ErrNotPortable)
213		}
214		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" || driveQualified(value) {
215			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is absolute, drive-qualified, or UNC: %w", value, ErrNotPortable)
216		}
217		if limits.MaxPathBytes > 0 && len(value) > limits.MaxPathBytes {
218			return fmt.Errorf("path is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(value), limits.MaxPathBytes, ErrPathLimit)
219		}
220		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
221		if limits.MaxDepth > 0 && len(components) > limits.MaxDepth {
222			return fmt.Errorf("path has %d components; maximum is %d: %w", len(components), limits.MaxDepth, ErrPathLimit)
223		}
224		for _, component := range components {
225			if component == ".." {
226				return fmt.Errorf("path contains parent traversal: %w", ErrTraversal)
227			}
228			if err := ValidatePortableComponent(component, limits.MaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
229				return fmt.Errorf("path component %q: %w", component, err)
230			}
231		}
232		return nil
233	}
234
235	// ValidatePortableComponent applies the per-component part of
236	// ValidatePortableSlashPath. maxBytes may be zero for no size limit.
237	func ValidatePortableComponent(component string, maxBytes int) error {
238		if maxBytes < 0 {
239			return fmt.Errorf("negative component limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
240		}
241		if !utf8.ValidString(component) {
242			return fmt.Errorf("component contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
243		}
244		if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
245			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", err, ErrNotPortable)
246		}
247		if maxBytes > 0 && len(component) > maxBytes {
248			return fmt.Errorf("component is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(component), maxBytes, ErrPathLimit)
249		}
250		if strings.IndexFunc(component, isPortableControl) >= 0 {
251			return fmt.Errorf("path component contains control characters: %w", ErrNotPortable)
252		}
253		windowsAlias := strings.TrimRight(component, ". ")
254		if strings.EqualFold(windowsAlias, ".git") {
255			return fmt.Errorf("path contains reserved Git metadata: %w", ErrNotPortable)
256		}
257		if windowsAlias != component {
258			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q has a trailing dot or space and is not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
259		}
260		if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) {
261			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q contains characters that are not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
262		}
263		if windowsReservedName(component) {
264			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q is a reserved Windows device name: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
265		}
266		return nil
267	}

269	// ValidatePortablePathSet validates every path and rejects collisions at any
270	// component boundary after Unicode normalization and full Unicode case folding.
271	// Exact duplicate paths are left to the caller's type/cardinality policy.
272	func ValidatePortablePathSet(paths []string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
273		type collisionNode struct {
274			spelling string
275			first    string
276			children map[string]*collisionNode
277		}
278		root := &collisionNode{children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
279		for _, value := range paths {
280			if err := ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, limits); err != nil {
281				return fmt.Errorf("portable path %q: %w", value, err)
282			}
283			current := root
284			for _, component := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
285				key := portableCollisionKey(component)
286				next, exists := current.children[key]
287				if exists && next.spelling != component {
288					return fmt.Errorf("paths %q and %q collide on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems at %q and %q: %w",
289						next.first, value, next.spelling, component, ErrPathCollision)
290				}
291				if !exists {
292					next = &collisionNode{spelling: component, first: value, children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
293					current.children[key] = next
294				}
295				current = next
296			}
297		}
298		return nil
299	}

19	// ValidateLocalFilePattern validates the deliberately small cross-platform
20	// grammar accepted by [local_files]. Literal path components use portable slash
21	// paths; '*' and '?' match within one component and a component equal to '**'
22	// matches zero or more components. Character classes, escaping, volumes, and
23	// platform-specific separators are intentionally unsupported.
24	func ValidateLocalFilePattern(value string) error {
25		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
26			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is required and must be trimmed")
27		}
28		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
29			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is not valid UTF-8")
30		}
31		if len(value) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes {
32			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is %d bytes; maximum is %d", len(value), safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes)
33		}
34		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
35			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must use '/' separators")
36		}
37		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasSuffix(value, "/") || strings.Contains(value, "//") {
38			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must be a clean repository-relative slash path")
39		}
40		if strings.ContainsAny(value, "[]{}") {
41			return fmt.Errorf("pattern supports only '*', '?' and whole-component '**' wildcards")
42		}
43		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
44		if len(components) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth {
45			return fmt.Errorf("pattern has %d components; maximum is %d", len(components), safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth)
46		}
47		for _, component := range components {
48			if localFileDependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)] {
49				return fmt.Errorf("pattern enters dependency directory %q", component)
50			}
51			if component == "**" {
52				continue
53			}
54			if strings.Contains(component, "**") {
55				return fmt.Errorf("'**' must occupy a complete path component")
56			}
57			placeholder := strings.NewReplacer("*", "x", "?", "x").Replace(component)
58			if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(placeholder, safefile.CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
59				return fmt.Errorf("component %q: %w", component, err)
60			}
61			for _, r := range component {
62				if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
63					return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a control character", component)
64				}
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}

1	// Package safefile provides held-root filesystem operations for untrusted
2	// relative paths. It keeps traversal relative to os.Root handles, rejects links
3	// and special files, revalidates filesystem identity, and detects observable
4	// source mutation while reading.
5	package safefile
6

19		// ErrChanged reports that a named root, child, or file no longer identifies
20		// the object observed by the caller.
21		ErrChanged = errors.New("filesystem object changed")
22		// ErrUnsafeType reports a symlink, reparse point, directory, or other
23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.
24		ErrUnsafeType = errors.New("unsafe filesystem object type")
25		// ErrFileLimit reports a regular file whose bytes exceed the read policy.
26		ErrFileLimit = errors.New("file size limit exceeded")

29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}

135	// ReadStableRegular reads one child file while proving that the directory name,
136	// opened descriptor, and final directory name all identify the expected regular
137	// file with unchanged observable metadata. maxBytes must be non-negative; zero
138	// means unbounded. Supplying the FileInfo from an earlier directory listing
139	// detects replacement or mutation between selection and opening.
140	func ReadStableRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
141		if root == nil {
142			return nil, nil, errors.New("read stable file: nil root")
143		}
144		if maxBytes < 0 {
145			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("negative maximum file size: %w", ErrFileLimit)
146		}
147		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
148			return nil, nil, err
149		}
150		before, err := root.Lstat(name)
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, nil, err
153		}
154		if expected == nil {
155			expected = before
156		}
157		if unsafeLink(before) || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
158			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is not a regular file: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
159		}
160		if !sameStableSourceState(expected, before) {
161			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed before opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
162		}
163		if maxBytes > 0 && before.Size() > maxBytes {
164			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", before.Size(), maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
165		}
166
167		file, err := openRegularForRead(root, name)
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, nil, err
170		}
171		defer file.Close()
172		opened, err := file.Stat()
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, nil, err
175		}
176		if unsafeLink(opened) || !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(expected, opened) {
177			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
178		}
179		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, nil, err
182		}
183		if unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, current) {
184			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
185		}
186
187		data, err := readAllContext(ctx, file, maxBytes)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, nil, err
190		}
191		after, err := file.Stat()
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, nil, err
194		}
195		current, err = root.Lstat(name)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, nil, err
198		}
199		if unsafeLink(after) || unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, after) ||
200			!sameStableSourceState(after, current) || after.Size() != int64(len(data)) {
201			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed during read: %w", ErrChanged)
202		}
203		return data, opened, nil
204	}

206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}
213
214	func sameStableSourceState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
215		return SameFileState(left, right) && samePlatformState(left, right)
216	}
217
218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}
243
244	func unsafeLink(info fs.FileInfo) bool {
245		return info != nil && (info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || isReparsePoint(info))
246	}

31	// CreateNoClobber stages data in an unguessable owner-private file, syncs it,
32	// applies finalMode, and atomically hard-links it to the absent destination.
33	// The hard-link publication is same-directory and cannot replace an existing
34	// path. This generic helper exists so callers such as repotemplate can preserve
35	// intentional public modes; secret-bearing callers should use
36	// CreatePrivateNoClobber.
37	func CreateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
38		if root == nil {
39			return nil, errors.New("atomic create: nil root")
40		}
41		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
42			return nil, err
43		}

89	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS

91	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
92	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.

174		if writer == nil {
175			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
176		}
177		keep := true
178		defer func() {
179			if keep {
180				_ = writer.Close()
181				_ = root.Remove(name)
182			}
183		}()
184		if err := writeAllContext(ctx, writer, data); err != nil {
185			return "", nil, err
186		}
187		if err := writer.Chmod(finalMode.Perm()); err != nil {
188			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("set staged file mode: %w", err)
189		}
190		if err := writer.Sync(); err != nil {
191			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("sync staged file: %w", err)
192		}
193		opened, err := writer.Stat()
194		if err != nil {
195			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect staged file: %w", err)
196		}
197		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
198			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("close staged file: %w", err)
199		}
200		keep = false
201		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
202		if err != nil {
203			_ = root.Remove(name)
204			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("reopen staged file name: %w", err)
205		}
206		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(opened, current) {
207			_ = root.Remove(name)
208			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("staging file changed before publication: %w", ErrChanged)
209		}
210		return name, current, nil
211	}
212
213	func validateTargetName(name string) error {
214		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
215			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
216		}
217		return nil
218	}
219
220	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
221		for len(data) > 0 {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return err
224			}
225			written, err := writer.Write(data)
226			if err != nil {
227				return err
228			}
229			if written == 0 {
230				return io.ErrShortWrite
231			}
232			data = data[written:]
233		}
234		return context.Cause(ctx)
235	}
236
237	func randomStageName() (string, error) {
238		var random [16]byte
239		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
240			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
241		}
242		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
243	}

35	// Limits is the reusable compiled policy for portable file manifests. Every
36	// field is required and must be no greater than the corresponding compiled
37	// ceiling, allowing host configuration to lower limits without weakening them.
38	type Limits struct {

40		MaxFileBytes      int64

43		MaxComponentBytes int

47	// DefaultLimits returns the maximum policy supported by this binary.
48	func DefaultLimits() Limits {
49		return Limits{
50			MaxFiles:          CompiledMaxFiles,
51			MaxFileBytes:      CompiledMaxFileBytes,
52			MaxTotalBytes:     CompiledMaxTotalBytes,
53			MaxPathBytes:      CompiledMaxPathBytes,
54			MaxComponentBytes: CompiledMaxComponentBytes,
55			MaxPathDepth:      CompiledMaxPathDepth,
56		}
57	}

59	// Validate rejects incomplete policy and values above the compiled ceilings.
60	func (limits Limits) Validate() error {
61		maximum := DefaultLimits()
62		switch {
63		case limits.MaxFiles <= 0 || limits.MaxFiles > maximum.MaxFiles:
64			return fmt.Errorf("max files %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxFiles, maximum.MaxFiles, ErrInvalidLimits)
65		case limits.MaxFileBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxFileBytes > maximum.MaxFileBytes:
66			return fmt.Errorf("max file bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxFileBytes, maximum.MaxFileBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
67		case limits.MaxTotalBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxTotalBytes > maximum.MaxTotalBytes:
68			return fmt.Errorf("max total bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxTotalBytes, maximum.MaxTotalBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
69		case limits.MaxPathBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxPathBytes > maximum.MaxPathBytes:
70			return fmt.Errorf("max path bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxPathBytes, maximum.MaxPathBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
71		case limits.MaxComponentBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes > maximum.MaxComponentBytes:
72			return fmt.Errorf("max component bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxComponentBytes, maximum.MaxComponentBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
73		case limits.MaxPathDepth <= 0 || limits.MaxPathDepth > maximum.MaxPathDepth:
74			return fmt.Errorf("max path depth %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxPathDepth, maximum.MaxPathDepth, ErrInvalidLimits)
75		default:

96	// ValidateManifest enforces a validated limits policy over the complete file
97	// set, including exact duplicates and portable case/normalization collisions.
98	func ValidateManifest(files []Metadata, limits Limits) error {
99		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
100			return err
101		}
102		if len(files) > limits.MaxFiles {
103			return fmt.Errorf("manifest has %d files; maximum is %d: %w", len(files), limits.MaxFiles, ErrManifestLimit)
104		}
105		paths := make([]string, 0, len(files))
106		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(files))
107		var total int64
108		for _, file := range files {
109			if file.Size < 0 {
110				return fmt.Errorf("file %q has negative size: %w", file.Path, ErrManifestLimit)
111			}
112			if file.Size > limits.MaxFileBytes {
113				return fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", file.Path, file.Size, limits.MaxFileBytes, ErrManifestLimit)
114			}
115			if _, exists := seen[file.Path]; exists {
116				return fmt.Errorf("path %q appears more than once: %w", file.Path, ErrDuplicatePath)
117			}
118			seen[file.Path] = struct{}{}
119			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
120			if file.Size > limits.MaxTotalBytes-total {
121				return fmt.Errorf("manifest exceeds %d total bytes: %w", limits.MaxTotalBytes, ErrManifestLimit)
122			}
123			total += file.Size
124		}
125		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
126			return err
127		}
128		return nil
129	}

256			subject = lastSubject

276			}
277			if !assigned {
278				out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, t)
279			}
280		}
281		for i := range out.Checkouts {
282			sort.SliceStable(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
283				return out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[a].ID < out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[b].ID
284			})
285		}
286		sort.SliceStable(out.OtherTasks, func(i, j int) bool {
287			return out.OtherTasks[i].ID < out.OtherTasks[j].ID
288		})

291	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
292	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
293	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
294	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
295		for _, session := range sessions {
296			assigned := map[int]bool{}
297			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
298				best, bestLen := -1, -1
299				for i := range out.Checkouts {
300					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Repo, i, out.Checkouts[i]) {
301						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
302							best, bestLen = i, len(filepath.Clean(root))
303						}
304					}
305				}
306				if best >= 0 {
307					assigned[best] = true
308				}
309			}
310			for i := range assigned {
311				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
312			}
313		}
314	}
315
316	func checkoutRoots(r repo.Repo, index int, checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
317		roots := []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
318		if index == 0 && r.RealPath != "" && !samePath(r.RealPath, r.Path) {
319			roots = append(roots, r.RealPath)
320		}
321		return roots
322	}
323
324	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
325		if root == "" || path == "" {
326			return false
327		}
328		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
329		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
330			return false
331		}
332		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
333	}
334
335	func samePath(a, b string) bool {
336		return a != "" && b != "" && normalizePath(a) == normalizePath(b)
337	}
338
339	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
340	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
341	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
342	// is not sufficient.
343	func normalizePath(path string) string {
344		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
345		cur := clean
346		for {
347			if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
348				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
349				if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
350					return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
351				}
352				return filepath.Clean(real)
353			}
354			parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
355			if parent == cur {
356				return clean
357			}
358			cur = parent
359		}
360	}

362	// FormatRepoContext renders the deterministic Markdown used by both the CLI
363	// and the TUI's yy binding. checkoutIndex < 0 means the whole repository.
364	func FormatRepoContext(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
365		var b strings.Builder
366		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
367			checkout := c.Checkouts[checkoutIndex]
368			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev worktree context: %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout))
369			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, false)
370			return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
371		}
372
373		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev repo context: %s\n\n", c.Repo.Display())
374		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Repository: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Display())
375		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Main path: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Path)
376		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Linked worktrees: %d\n", c.WorktreeCount)
377		if c.Runtime != "" && c.Runtime != "none" {
378			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime: `%s`\n", c.Runtime)
379		}
380		if c.WorktreeErr != nil {
381			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Worktree inventory error: %s\n", c.WorktreeErr)
382		}
383		if c.RuntimeErr != nil {
384			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime inventory error: %s\n", c.RuntimeErr)
385		}
386		if c.TaskErr != nil {
387			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Task inventory error: %s\n", c.TaskErr)
388		}
389		b.WriteString("\n## Checkouts\n")
390		for i, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
391			b.WriteString("\n")
392			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, i == 0)
393		}
394		if len(c.OtherTasks) > 0 {
395			b.WriteString("\n## Other tracked tasks\n\n")
396			for _, t := range c.OtherTasks {
397				writeTaskMarkdown(&b, t)
398			}
399		}
400		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
401	}
402
403	func writeCheckoutMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, c RepoContext, checkout RepoCheckout, canonical bool) {
404		label := string(checkout.Ownership)
405		if canonical {
406			label = "canonical"
407		}
408		fmt.Fprintf(b, "### %s — %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout), label)
409		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Path: `%s`\n", checkout.Worktree.Path)
410		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Branch: `%s`\n", displayBranch(checkout))
411		if checkout.Worktree.Bare {
412			b.WriteString("- Git: bare repository\n")
413		} else if checkout.PathErr != nil {
414			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.PathErr)
415		} else if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
416			b.WriteString("- Git: unavailable (checkout path is missing)\n")
417		} else if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
418			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.StatusErr)
419		} else {
420			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: %s", checkout.Status.Summary())
421			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
422				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", checkout.Status.Breakdown())
423			}
424			b.WriteString("\n")
425			if checkout.Status.Upstream != "" {
426				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Upstream: `%s`\n", checkout.Status.Upstream)
427			} else {
428				b.WriteString("- Upstream: not published\n")
429			}
430		}
431		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
432			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)
433			if reason == "" {
434				reason = "no reason recorded"
435			}
436			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: locked — %s\n", reason)
437		}
438		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || checkout.PathErr == nil && !checkout.Exists {
439			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)
440			if reason == "" {
441				reason = "checkout path is missing"
442			}
443			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: prunable — %s\n", reason)
444		}
445		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
446			if c.RuntimeErr != nil {
447				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: unavailable (%s)\n", c.RuntimeErr)
448			} else {
449				b.WriteString("- Runtime: closed\n")
450			}
451		} else {
452			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
453				status := session.AgentStatus
454				if status == "" {
455					status = "unknown"
456				}
457				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: `%s %s` (%s)\n", c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
458				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
459					fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Agent sessions: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
460				}
461			}
462		}
463		if len(checkout.Tasks) == 0 {
464			if c.TaskErr != nil {
465				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: unavailable (%s)\n", c.TaskErr)
466			} else {
467				b.WriteString("- Task: untracked\n")
468			}
469		} else {
470			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
471				writeTaskMarkdown(b, t)
472			}
473		}
474	}
475
476	func writeTaskMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, t *task.Task) {
477		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: `%s` — %s", t.ID, t.State)
478		if t.Next != "" {
479			fmt.Fprintf(b, "; next: %s", t.Next)
480		}
481		b.WriteString("\n")
482		if t.AgentSession != "" {
483			fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Recorded agent: `%s`\n", t.AgentSession)
484		}
485	}
486
487	func displayBranch(checkout RepoCheckout) string {
488		if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
489			return branch
490		}
491		if checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached {
492			return "(detached HEAD)"
493		}
494		return "(unknown branch)"
495	}
496
497	func markdownCodes(values []string) string {
498		quoted := make([]string, 0, len(values))
499		for _, value := range values {
500			quoted = append(quoted, "`"+value+"`")
501		}
502		return strings.Join(quoted, ", ")
503	}
504
505	// FormatSessions renders the ys payload. checkoutIndex < 0 selects the whole
506	// repository; otherwise it selects one checkout.
507	func FormatSessions(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
508		indices := make([]int, 0, len(c.Checkouts))
509		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
510			indices = append(indices, checkoutIndex)
511		} else {
512			for i := range c.Checkouts {
513				indices = append(indices, i)
514			}
515		}
516		var b strings.Builder
517		for _, i := range indices {
518			checkout := c.Checkouts[i]
519			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
520				status := session.AgentStatus
521				if status == "" {
522					status = "unknown"
523				}
524				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s %s` (%s)\n",
525					checkout.Worktree.Path, c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
526				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
527					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - agents: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
528				}
529			}
530		}
531		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
532	}
533
534	// LinkedWorktreePaths returns the yw payload: absolute linked-worktree paths,
535	// one per line. The canonical checkout is intentionally excluded because WT
536	// counts linked worktrees only.
537	func LinkedWorktreePaths(c RepoContext) string {
538		paths := make([]string, 0, len(c.Linked()))
539		for _, checkout := range c.Linked() {
540			paths = append(paths, checkout.Worktree.Path)
541		}
542		return strings.Join(paths, "\n")
543	}

135	// DecodeStrict reads exactly one bounded JSON value, rejects unknown fields,
136	// and requires EOF after optional JSON whitespace.
137	func DecodeStrict(reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
138		if reader == nil || target == nil {
139			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a reader and target")
140		}
141		if maxBytes <= 0 {
142			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a positive limit")
143		}
144		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maxBytes+1))
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("read fleet protocol: %w", err)
147		}
148		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
149			return fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
150		}
151		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
152		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
153		if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
154			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol: %w", err)
155		}
156		var extra any
157		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
158			if err == nil {
159				return errors.New("decode fleet protocol: multiple JSON values")
160			}
161			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol trailing data: %w", err)
162		}
163		return nil
164	}
165
166	// MarshalBounded encodes one protocol value and enforces the matching bound
167	// before it can be handed to Transport.
168	func MarshalBounded(value any, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
169		if maxBytes <= 0 {
170			return nil, errors.New("fleet protocol encode requires a positive limit")
171		}
172		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode fleet protocol: %w", err)
175		}
176		if int64(len(data))+1 > maxBytes {
177			return nil, fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
178		}
179		return append(data, '\n'), nil
180	}
181
182	// UnmarshalStrict applies DecodeStrict to an in-memory transport response.
183	func UnmarshalStrict(data []byte, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
184		return DecodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(data), maxBytes, target)
185	}

31	// MaybeServeAskpass turns the dev executable into a one-shot SSH_ASKPASS

33	func MaybeServeAskpass() (bool, int) {

199	// runSSHCommand starts SSH before writing an askpass secret. Starting first is
200	// load-bearing: a secret larger than the pipe capacity must remain cancellable
201	// through the command context instead of blocking before SSH exists.
202	func runSSHCommand(cmd *exec.Cmd, password string) error {
203		if password == "" {
204			return cmd.Run()
205		}
206		executable, err := os.Executable()
207		if err != nil {
208			return err
209		}
210		reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
211		if err != nil {
212			return err
213		}
214		cmd.ExtraFiles = []*os.File{reader}
215		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
216			askpassMarker+"=1", askpassFD+"=3", "SSH_ASKPASS="+executable,
217			"SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force", "DISPLAY=dev-fleet")
218		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
219			_ = reader.Close()
220			_ = writer.Close()
221			return err
222		}
223		// The child owns its inherited descriptor after Start; closing the parent
224		// copy lets an early SSH exit interrupt a blocked write.
225		readerCloseErr := reader.Close()
226		writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
227		go func() {
228			_, writeErr := io.Copy(writer, strings.NewReader(password+"\n"))
229			writeDone <- errors.Join(writeErr, writer.Close())
230		}()
231		waitErr := cmd.Wait()
232		// A descendant could retain the inherited read descriptor after SSH exits.
233		// Close our writer so that cannot strand the write goroutine.
234		_ = writer.Close()
235		writeErr := <-writeDone
236		return errors.Join(waitErr, readerCloseErr, writeErr)
237	}

239	func sshArgs(host Host, pty, password bool) []string {
