286		for index, arg := range args {
287			quotedArgs[index] = shellQuote(arg)
288		}
289		joined := strings.Join(quotedArgs, " ")
290		if devPath != "auto" {
291			return "exec " + shellQuote(devconfig.Expand(devPath)) + " " + joined
292		}
293		path := `PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:/opt/homebrew/bin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/snap/bin:$PATH"`
294		return path + "; export PATH; command -v dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 127; exec dev " + joined
295	}
296
297	func shellQuote(value string) string {
298		return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'"
299	}
300
301	func permissionDenied(stderr []byte) bool {
302		return strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(stderr)), "permission denied")
303	}
304
305	func (t Transport) resolvePassword(host Host) (string, error) {
306		source := host.SSHLoginPasswordSource
307		switch host.PasswordKind() {
308		case "plain":
309			return source.Value, nil
310		case "bitwarden":
311			cmd := exec.Command("bw", "get", "password", source.Item)
312			out, err := cmd.Output()
313			if err != nil {
314				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve Bitwarden SSH password for %s: %w", host.Name, err)
315			}
316			return strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), nil
317		case "prompt":
318			promptPasswordMu.Lock()
319			defer promptPasswordMu.Unlock()
320			writer := t.Err
321			if writer == nil {
322				writer = os.Stderr
323			}
324			fmt.Fprintf(writer, "SSH password for %s: ", host.Name)
325			terminal, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
326			if err != nil {
327				return "", fmt.Errorf("open terminal for SSH password: %w", err)
328			}
329			defer terminal.Close()
330			password, err := term.ReadPassword(terminal.Fd())
331			fmt.Fprintln(writer)
332			if err != nil {
333				return "", err
334			}
335			return string(password), nil
336		default:
337			return "", nil
338		}
339	}
340
341	type captureBuffer struct {
342		limit    int64
343		buffer   bytes.Buffer
344		exceeded bool
345	}
346
347	func newCaptureBuffer(limit int64) *captureBuffer {
348		return &captureBuffer{limit: limit}
349	}
350
351	func (b *captureBuffer) Write(value []byte) (int, error) {
352		remaining := b.limit - int64(b.buffer.Len())
353		if remaining > 0 {
354			keep := int64(len(value))
355			if keep > remaining {
356				keep = remaining
357			}
358			_, _ = b.buffer.Write(value[:int(keep)])
359		}
360		if int64(len(value)) > remaining {
361			b.exceeded = true
362		}
363		// Consume excess output without retaining it. The command timeout still
364		// bounds a peer that writes forever, while the parent process stays bounded.
365		return len(value), nil
366	}
367
368	func (b *captureBuffer) Bytes() []byte {
369		return append([]byte(nil), b.buffer.Bytes()...)
370	}
371
372	func (b *captureBuffer) Exceeded() bool { return b.exceeded }
373
374	func effectiveLimit(configured, fallback int64) int64 {
375		if configured <= 0 {
376			return fallback
377		}
378		return configured
379	}
380
381	func captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr *captureBuffer) string {
382		streams := make([]string, 0, 2)
383		if stdout.Exceeded() {
384			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stdout exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stdout.limit))
385		}
386		if stderr.Exceeded() {
387			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stderr exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stderr.limit))
388		}
389		return "fleet transport: remote " + strings.Join(streams, " and ")
390	}
391
392	func boundedBytes(value []byte, limit int64) []byte {
393		if int64(len(value)) > limit {
394			value = value[:int(limit)]
395		}
396		return append([]byte(nil), value...)
397	}
398
399	func appendBounded(current, suffix []byte, limit int64) []byte {
400		if int64(len(current)) >= limit {
401			return append([]byte(nil), current...)
402		}
403		available := limit - int64(len(current))
404		if int64(len(suffix)) > available {
405			suffix = suffix[:int(available)]
406		}
407		return append(append([]byte(nil), current...), suffix...)
408	}
409
410	func localTransportFailure(message string) Result {
411		return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}
412	}

15
16	type cacheFile struct {
17		Version    int       `json:"version"`
18		EndpointID string    `json:"endpoint_id"`
19		FetchedAt  time.Time `json:"fetched_at"`
20		Snapshot   Snapshot  `json:"snapshot"`
21	}
22
23	func CacheRoot() string { return filepath.Join(devconfig.CacheHome(), "dev", "fleet", "v1") }
24
25	func cachePath(host Host) string {
26		name := devconfig.Slug(host.Name)
27		return filepath.Join(CacheRoot(), name+".json")
28	}
29
30	func EndpointID(host Host) string {
31		parts := []string{host.Name, host.MachineID, host.SSHAlias, host.Hostname, host.User, strconv.Itoa(host.Port), host.IdentityFile, host.DevPath}
32		parts = append(parts, time.Duration(host.ConnectTimeout.Duration).String(), time.Duration(host.CommandTimeout.Duration).String())
33		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
34		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
35	}
36
37	func SaveCache(host Host, snapshot Snapshot) error {
38		path := cachePath(host)
39		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
40			return err
41		}
42		payload := cacheFile{Version: 1, EndpointID: EndpointID(host), FetchedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Snapshot: snapshot}
43		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(payload, "", "  ")
44		if err != nil {
45			return err
46		}
47		data = append(data, '\n')
48		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".fleet-*.tmp")
49		if err != nil {
50			return err
51		}
52		name := temporary.Name()
53		defer os.Remove(name)
54		if _, err := temporary.Write(data); err != nil {
55			_ = temporary.Close()
56			return err
57		}
58		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
59			return err
60		}
61		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o600); err != nil {
62			return err
63		}
64		return os.Rename(name, path)
65	}
66
67	func LoadCache(host Host) (Snapshot, time.Time, bool) {
68		data, err := os.ReadFile(cachePath(host))
69		if err != nil {
70			return Snapshot{}, time.Time{}, false
71		}
72		var payload cacheFile
73		if json.Unmarshal(data, &payload) != nil || payload.Version != 1 || payload.EndpointID != EndpointID(host) || payload.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
74			return Snapshot{}, time.Time{}, false
75		}
76		if payload.Snapshot.SchemaVersion != SnapshotSchemaVersion {
77			return Snapshot{}, time.Time{}, false
78		}
79		return payload.Snapshot, payload.FetchedAt, true
80	}

49	}

58	func DefaultConfig() Config {
59		return Config{
60			SchemaVersion: ConfigSchemaVersion,
61			Defaults: Defaults{
62				ConnectTimeout: devconfig.Duration{Duration: 15 * time.Second},
63				CommandTimeout: devconfig.Duration{Duration: 5 * time.Minute},
64				CacheTTL:       devconfig.Duration{Duration: 15 * time.Minute},
65				MaxParallel:    4,
66				DevPath:        "auto",
67			},
68		}
69	}

71	func ConfigFile() string {

73	}

75	func LoadConfig(path string) (Config, error) {
76		cfg := DefaultConfig()
77		if path == "" {
78			path = ConfigFile()
79		}
80		metadata, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
81		switch {
82		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
83			return cfg, nil
84		case err != nil:
85			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
86		}
87		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
88			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: unknown field(s): %v", path, undecoded)
89		}
90		cfg.Source = path
91		cfg.ApplyDefaults()
92		if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
93			return cfg, err
94		}
95		return cfg, nil
96	}
97
98	func (c *Config) ApplyDefaults() {
99		for index := range c.Hosts {
100			host := &c.Hosts[index]
101			if host.DevPath == "" {
102				host.DevPath = c.Defaults.DevPath
103			}
104			if host.ConnectTimeout.Duration == 0 {
105				host.ConnectTimeout = c.Defaults.ConnectTimeout
106			}
107			if host.CommandTimeout.Duration == 0 {
108				host.CommandTimeout = c.Defaults.CommandTimeout
109			}
110		}
111	}
112
113	func (c Config) Validate() error {
114		if c.SchemaVersion != ConfigSchemaVersion {
115			return fmt.Errorf("remotes schema_version %d: want %d", c.SchemaVersion, ConfigSchemaVersion)
116		}
117		if c.Defaults.MaxParallel <= 0 {
118			return errors.New("defaults.max_parallel must be positive")
119		}
120		if c.Defaults.ConnectTimeout.Duration <= 0 || c.Defaults.CommandTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
121			return errors.New("default timeouts must be positive")
122		}
123		seen := map[string]bool{}
124		for index, host := range c.Hosts {
125			if strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) == "" || host.Name != strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) {
126				return fmt.Errorf("hosts[%d].name is required and must be trimmed", index)
127			}
128			if seen[host.Name] {
129				return fmt.Errorf("duplicate host name %q", host.Name)
130			}
131			seen[host.Name] = true
132			if host.MachineID != "" {
133				if err := machineid.Validate(host.MachineID); err != nil {
134					return fmt.Errorf("host %q: %w", host.Name, err)
135				}
136			}
137			if host.SSHAlias == "" && host.Hostname == "" {
138				return fmt.Errorf("host %q must define ssh_alias or hostname", host.Name)
139			}
140			if host.Port < 0 || host.Port > 65535 {
141				return fmt.Errorf("host %q port %d is invalid", host.Name, host.Port)
142			}
143			if host.ConnectTimeout.Duration <= 0 || host.CommandTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
144				return fmt.Errorf("host %q timeouts must be positive", host.Name)
145			}
146			if host.DevPath != "" && host.DevPath != "auto" && !filepath.IsAbs(devconfig.Expand(host.DevPath)) {
147				return fmt.Errorf("host %q dev_path must be auto or absolute", host.Name)
148			}
149			if err := validatePasswordSource(host.Name, host.SSHLoginPasswordSource); err != nil {
150				return err
151			}
152		}
153		return nil
154	}
155
156	func validatePasswordSource(host string, source PasswordSource) error {
157		kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(source.Type))
158		if kind == "" {
159			kind = "none"
160		}
161		switch kind {
162		case "none", "prompt":
163			return nil
164		case "plain":
165			if source.Value == "" {
166				return fmt.Errorf("host %q plain ssh_login_password_source requires value", host)
167			}
168		case "bitwarden":
169			if source.Item == "" {
170				return fmt.Errorf("host %q bitwarden ssh_login_password_source requires item", host)
171			}
172		default:
173			return fmt.Errorf("host %q ssh_login_password_source.type %q: want none, plain, prompt or bitwarden", host, source.Type)
174		}
175		return nil
176	}
177
178	func (h Host) PasswordKind() string {
179		kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(h.SSHLoginPasswordSource.Type))
180		if kind == "" {
181			return "none"
182		}
183		return kind
184	}

186	func (h Host) Destination() string {
187		if h.SSHAlias != "" {
188			return h.SSHAlias
189		}
190		if h.User != "" {
191			return h.User + "@" + h.Hostname
192		}
193		return h.Hostname
194	}
195
196	func CheckPrivateMode(path string, cfg Config) error {
197		needsPrivate := false
198		for _, host := range cfg.Hosts {
199			if host.PasswordKind() == "plain" {
200				needsPrivate = true
201				break
202			}
203		}
204		if !needsPrivate {
205			return nil
206		}
207		info, err := os.Stat(path)
208		if err != nil {
209			return err
210		}
211		if info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
212			return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a plaintext SSH password and must have mode 0600", path)
213		}
214		return nil
215	}

115	func resolveFleetOpenRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, request fleet.OpenRequest) (repo.Repo, error) {
116		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
117		if err != nil {
118			return repo.Repo{}, err
119		}
120		var matches []repo.Repo
121		wantedIdentity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(request.RemoteIdentity)
122		for _, repository := range repositories {
123			if request.Path != "" && (sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.Path) || sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.RealPath)) {
124				return repository, nil
125			}
126			if wantedIdentity == "" {
127				continue
128			}
129			topology, topologyErr := gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
130			if topologyErr == nil && matchingSnapshotIdentity(topology, wantedIdentity) {
131				matches = append(matches, repository)
132			}
133		}
134		if len(matches) == 1 {
135			return matches[0], nil
136		}
137		if len(matches) > 1 {

139		}
140		return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is no longer discoverable", request.Name)

146				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == identity {
147					return true
148				}
149			}
150		}
151		return false
152	}

186				encoded := encodeOpenRequest(request)
187				transport := fleet.Transport{Err: app.Err}
188				if live.Snapshot.Runtime == "herdr" && host.SSHAlias != "" && host.PasswordKind() == "none" {
189					prepared := transport.Run(ctxOf(), *host, []string{"fleet", "_open-herdr", "--request", encoded}, nil, false)
190					if prepared.ExitCode == 0 {
191						process := exec.CommandContext(ctxOf(), "herdr", "--remote", host.SSHAlias)
192						process.Stdin, process.Stdout, process.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
193						if err := process.Run(); err == nil {
194							return nil
195						} else {
196							app.warnf("Herdr remote attach failed; falling back to SSH: %v", err)
197						}
198					}
199				}
200				return transport.Interactive(ctxOf(), *host, []string{"fleet", "_shell", "--request", encoded}, live.PasswordAuth)
201			},
202		}
203	}
204
205	func selectFleetRepository(repositories []fleet.RepoSnapshot, query string) (fleet.RepoSnapshot, error) {
206		for _, repository := range repositories {
207			if query == repository.Name || query == repository.Display || query == repository.Path {
208				return repository, nil
209			}
210			for _, identity := range repository.RemoteIdentities {
211				if query == identity {
212					return repository, nil
213				}
214			}
215		}
216		needle := strings.ToLower(query)
217		var matches []fleet.RepoSnapshot
218		for _, repository := range repositories {
219			haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{repository.Name, repository.Display, repository.Path, strings.Join(repository.RemoteIdentities, " ")}, " "))
220			if strings.Contains(haystack, needle) {
221				matches = append(matches, repository)
222			}
223		}
224		switch len(matches) {
225		case 1:
226			return matches[0], nil
227		case 0:
228			return fleet.RepoSnapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("remote repository %q not found", query)
229		default:
230			return fleet.RepoSnapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("remote repository %q is ambiguous", query)
231		}
232	}

250	func newFleetSyncCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
251		var hostNames []string
252		var push, jsonOut bool
253		var remoteName string
254		cmd := &cobra.Command{
255			Use:   "sync <repo>",
256			Short: "Push optionally, then safely fast-forward clean matching checkouts",
257			Long: `Synchronize one branch through its Git remote.
258
259	The source checkout must be clean. Without --push, its HEAD must already equal
260	the fetched upstream. Targets fetch the matching remote and fast-forward only a
261	clean checkout of the same branch. Different branches are never switched;
262	ahead, dirty, divergent and ambiguous clones are reported without modification.`,
263			Args: cobra.ExactArgs(1),
264			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
265				request, source, err := prepareFleetSync(ctxOf(), app, args[0], remoteName, push)
266				if err != nil {
267					return err
268				}
269				cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
270				if err != nil {
271					return err
272				}
273				selected := map[string]bool{}
274				for _, name := range hostNames {
275					selected[name] = true
276				}
277				hosts := make([]fleet.Host, 0, len(cfg.Hosts))
278				found := map[string]bool{}
279				for _, host := range cfg.Hosts {
280					found[host.Name] = true
281					if len(selected) == 0 || selected[host.Name] {
282						hosts = append(hosts, host)
283					}
284				}
285				for name := range selected {
286					if !found[name] {
287						return fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
288					}
289				}
290				results := syncFleetHosts(ctxOf(), hosts, cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel, request)
291				if jsonOut {
292					payload := struct {
293						Source  fleet.SyncResult   `json:"source"`
294						Targets []fleet.SyncResult `json:"targets"`
295					}{Source: source, Targets: results}
296					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
297					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
298					if err := encoder.Encode(payload); err != nil {
299						return err
300					}
301				} else {
302					renderFleetSync(app, source, results)
303				}
304				for _, result := range results {
305					if !result.Success() {
306						return errors.New("fleet sync could not verify every managed checkout")
307					}
308				}
309				return nil
310			},
311		}
312		flags := cmd.Flags()
313		flags.BoolVar(&push, "push", false, "push the source branch before fan-out")
314		flags.StringVar(&remoteName, "remote", "", "Git remote to publish/check (default: upstream, then origin)")
315		flags.StringSliceVar(&hostNames, "host", nil, "only these configured host names")
316		flags.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit JSON results")
317		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeRepos(app)
318		return cmd
319	}

321	func prepareFleetSync(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref, requestedRemote string, push bool) (fleet.SyncRequest, fleet.SyncResult, error) {
322		repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
323		if err != nil {
324			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
325		}
326		if repository.Bare {
327			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%s is bare and has no checkout to publish", repository.Display())
328		}
329		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Path)
330		if err != nil {
331			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
332		}
333		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
334			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, errors.New("fleet sync requires an attached branch")
335		}
336		if status.Dirty() || status.Conflicted > 0 {
337			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("source checkout must be clean (%s)", status.Summary())
338		}
339		remote := requestedRemote
340		if remote == "" && status.Upstream != "" {
341			remote, _, _ = strings.Cut(status.Upstream, "/")
342		}
343		if remote == "" {
344			remote = "origin"
345		}
346		remoteURL := gitx.Remote(ctx, repository.Path, remote)
347		identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(remoteURL)
348		if identity == "" {
349			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("remote %q has no cross-host identity", remote)
350		}
351		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "fetch", "--prune", "--quiet", remote); err != nil {
352			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
353		}
354		if push {
355			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "push", "--set-upstream", remote, status.Branch); err != nil {
356				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", status.Branch, err)
357			}
358		} else {
359			remoteOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", remote+"/"+status.Branch+"^{commit}")
360			if err != nil {
361				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("fetched %s/%s is unavailable", remote, status.Branch)
362			}
363			head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
364			if err != nil {
365				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
366			}
367			if head != remoteOID {
368				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("source HEAD does not equal %s/%s after fetch; push or reconcile it first", remote, status.Branch)
369			}
370		}
371		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
372		if err != nil {
373			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
374		}
375		request := fleet.SyncRequest{RemoteIdentity: identity, Branch: status.Branch, ExpectedOID: head}
376		source := fleet.SyncResult{
377			Host: config.Hostname(), State: fleet.SyncCurrent, Repo: repository.Display(), Path: repository.Path,
378			Branch: status.Branch, Remote: remote, BeforeOID: head, AfterOID: head, ExpectedOID: head,
379		}
380		return request, source, nil
381	}
382
383	func syncFleetHosts(ctx context.Context, hosts []fleet.Host, maxParallel int, request fleet.SyncRequest) []fleet.SyncResult {
384		if maxParallel <= 0 {
385			maxParallel = 4
386		}
387		results := make([]fleet.SyncResult, len(hosts))
388		sem := make(chan struct{}, maxParallel)
389		var wg sync.WaitGroup
390		requestJSON, _ := json.Marshal(request)
391		for index, host := range hosts {
392			wg.Add(1)
393			go func(index int, host fleet.Host) {
394				defer wg.Done()
395				sem <- struct{}{}
396				defer func() { <-sem }()
397				transport := fleet.Transport{Err: os.Stderr}
398				response := transport.Run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_sync"}, requestJSON, false)
399				result := fleet.SyncResult{Host: host.Name, Branch: request.Branch, ExpectedOID: request.ExpectedOID}
400				switch {
401				case response.ExitCode == 0:
402					if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Stdout, &result); err != nil {
403						result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncFailed, "remote dev returned invalid sync JSON"
404					}
405					result.Host = host.Name
406				case response.TimedOut || response.ExitCode == 124:
407					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncTimeout, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
408				case response.ExitCode == 127:
409					result.State = fleet.SyncNoDev
410				case response.ExitCode == 255:
411					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncUnreachable, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
412				default:
413					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncIncompatible, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
414				}
415				results[index] = result
416			}(index, host)
417		}
418		wg.Wait()
419		return results
420	}
421
422	func renderFleetSync(app *App, source fleet.SyncResult, targets []fleet.SyncResult) {
423		style := app.outStyle()
424		table := app.newTable("HOST", "STATE", "REPO", "BRANCH", "PATH", "DETAIL")
425		table.Add(source.Host, style.hostState(string(source.State)), source.Repo, source.Branch, config.Contract(source.Path), style.dim("source"))
426		for _, result := range targets {
427			table.Add(result.Host, style.hostState(string(result.State)), dash(result.Repo), dash(result.Branch),
428				config.Contract(result.Path), style.warning(truncate(result.Error, 64)))
429		}
430		table.Render(app.Out)
431	}

447	func localFleetSnapshot(ctx context.Context, app *App) (fleet.Snapshot, error) {
448		rt := app.Runtime()
449		rows, err := collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, rt, repoCollectOptions{})
450		if err != nil {
451			return fleet.Snapshot{}, err
452		}
453		repositories := make([]fleet.RepoSnapshot, 0, len(rows))
454		for _, row := range rows {
455			counts := fleet.TaskCounts{}
456			for _, tracked := range row.Tasks {
457				switch tracked.State {
458				case task.Hot:
459					counts.Hot++
460				case task.Warm:
461					counts.Warm++
462				case task.Cold:
463					counts.Cold++
464				case task.Done:
465					counts.Done++
466				}
467			}
468			identities := remoteIdentities(row)
469			repositories = append(repositories, fleet.RepoSnapshot{
470				Name: row.Repo.Name, Display: row.Repo.Display(), Category: row.Repo.Category,
471				Path: row.Repo.Path, RealPath: row.Repo.RealPath, RemoteIdentities: identities,
472				Branch: row.Status.Branch, Status: row.Status, LastActivity: row.LastActivity,
473				Worktrees: row.Worktrees, Tasks: counts, Live: row.Live, Runtime: row.Runtime,
474				RuntimeHandle: row.RuntimeHandle, AgentStatus: row.RuntimeStatus, Topology: row.Topology,
475			})
476		}
477		return fleet.Snapshot{
478			SchemaVersion: fleet.SnapshotSchemaVersion,
479			Host:          config.Hostname(),
480			DevVersion:    versionFromBuild(),
481			GeneratedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
482			Runtime:       rt.Name(),
483			Repositories:  repositories,
484		}, nil
485	}
486
487	func remoteIdentities(row tui.RepoRow) []string {
488		seen := map[string]bool{}
489		var identities []string
490		for _, remote := range row.Topology.Remotes {
491			for _, raw := range append(append([]string{}, remote.FetchURLs...), remote.PushURLs...) {
492				identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw)
493				if identity != "" && !seen[identity] {
494					seen[identity] = true
495					identities = append(identities, identity)
496				}
497			}
498		}
499		sort.Strings(identities)
500		return identities
501	}

519	type fleetCollectOptions struct {
520		CachedOnly bool
521		Hosts      map[string]bool
522	}
523
524	func collectFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, options fleetCollectOptions) ([]fleet.HostResult, fleet.Config, error) {
525		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
526		if err != nil {
527			return nil, cfg, err
528		}
529		local, err := localFleetSnapshot(ctx, app)
530		if err != nil {
531			return nil, cfg, err
532		}
533		var results []fleet.HostResult
534		if len(options.Hosts) == 0 || options.Hosts[local.Host] {
535			results = append(results, fleet.HostResult{Name: local.Host, Local: true, State: fleet.HostOK, Snapshot: &local})
536		}
537		selected := make([]fleet.Host, 0, len(cfg.Hosts))
538		found := map[string]bool{local.Host: true}
539		for _, host := range cfg.Hosts {
540			found[host.Name] = true
541			if len(options.Hosts) > 0 && !options.Hosts[host.Name] {
542				continue
543			}
544			selected = append(selected, host)
545		}
546		for name := range options.Hosts {
547			if !found[name] {
548				return nil, cfg, fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
549			}
550		}
551		remoteResults := make([]fleet.HostResult, len(selected))
552		sem := make(chan struct{}, cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel)
553		var wg sync.WaitGroup
554		for index, host := range selected {
555			wg.Add(1)
556			go func(index int, host fleet.Host) {
557				defer wg.Done()
558				sem <- struct{}{}
559				defer func() { <-sem }()
560				remoteResults[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, options.CachedOnly)
561			}(index, host)
562		}
563		wg.Wait()
564		return append(results, remoteResults...), cfg, nil
565	}
566
567	func collectFleetHost(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, cachedOnly bool) fleet.HostResult {
568		endpointID := fleet.EndpointID(host)
569		cached, cachedAt, haveCache := fleet.LoadCache(host)
570		if cachedOnly {
571			if haveCache {
572				return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostStale, Snapshot: &cached, CachedAt: &cachedAt, FromCache: true, EndpointID: endpointID}
573			}
574			return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "no cached snapshot", EndpointID: endpointID}
575		}
576		transport := fleet.Transport{Err: os.Stderr}
577		result := transport.Run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_snapshot"}, nil, false)
578		if result.ExitCode == 0 {
579			var snapshot fleet.Snapshot
580			if err := json.Unmarshal(result.Stdout, &snapshot); err == nil && snapshot.SchemaVersion == fleet.SnapshotSchemaVersion {
581				_ = fleet.SaveCache(host, snapshot)
582				return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostOK, Snapshot: &snapshot, PasswordAuth: result.UsedPassword, EndpointID: endpointID}
583			}
584			return cachedFleetFailure(host, fleet.HostInvalid, "remote dev returned invalid snapshot JSON", cached, cachedAt, haveCache)
585		}
586		state := fleet.HostIncompatible
587		detail := strings.TrimSpace(string(result.Stderr))
588		switch {
589		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
590			state = fleet.HostTimeout
591		case result.ExitCode == 127:
592			state = fleet.HostNoDev
593		case result.ExitCode == 255:
594			state = fleet.HostUnreachable
595		case strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(detail), "unknown command"):
596			state = fleet.HostIncompatible
597		}
598		if detail == "" {
599			detail = fmt.Sprintf("remote command exited %d", result.ExitCode)
600		}
601		return cachedFleetFailure(host, state, detail, cached, cachedAt, haveCache)
602	}
603
604	func cachedFleetFailure(host fleet.Host, state fleet.HostState, detail string, cached fleet.Snapshot, cachedAt time.Time, haveCache bool) fleet.HostResult {
605		if haveCache && state != fleet.HostNoDev {
606			return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostStale, Snapshot: &cached, CachedAt: &cachedAt, FromCache: true, Error: detail, EndpointID: fleet.EndpointID(host)}
607		}
608		return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: state, Error: detail, EndpointID: fleet.EndpointID(host)}
609	}

611	func newFleetListCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
612		var hostNames []string
613		var repoQuery string
614		var jsonOut, cachedOnly, strict bool
615		cmd := &cobra.Command{
616			Use:   "list",
617			Short: "List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts",
618			Args:  cobra.NoArgs,
619			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
620				selected := map[string]bool{}
621				for _, name := range hostNames {
622					selected[name] = true
623				}
624				results, _, err := collectFleet(ctxOf(), app, fleetCollectOptions{CachedOnly: cachedOnly, Hosts: selected})
625				if err != nil {
626					return err
627				}
628				if jsonOut {
629					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
630					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
631					if err := encoder.Encode(results); err != nil {
632						return err

647		flags.BoolVar(&cachedOnly, "cached", false, "do not contact remote hosts")
648		flags.BoolVar(&strict, "strict", false, "fail when a host is unreachable or incompatible")
649		return cmd

652	// fleetLive keeps the placeholder neutral: an em dash means "no runtime here",
653	// which is not a success worth painting green.
654	func fleetLive(style cliStyle, live string) string {
655		if live == "" {
656			return "—"
657		}
658		return style.success(live)
659	}
660
661	func renderFleetList(app *App, results []fleet.HostResult, query string) {
662		style := app.outStyle()
663		table := app.newTable("HOST", "STATE", "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "LATEST", "PATH")
664		needle := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
665		for _, result := range results {
666			if result.Snapshot == nil || len(result.Snapshot.Repositories) == 0 {
667				table.Add(result.Name, style.hostState(string(result.State)), "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", "—",
668					style.warning(truncate(result.Error, 42)))
669				continue
670			}
671			for _, repository := range result.Snapshot.Repositories {
672				haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{repository.Name, repository.Display, repository.Branch, repository.Path, strings.Join(repository.RemoteIdentities, " ")}, " "))
673				if needle != "" && !strings.Contains(haystack, needle) {
674					continue
675				}
676				live := ""
677				if repository.Live {
678					live = repository.Runtime
679					if repository.AgentStatus != "" {
680						live += ":" + repository.AgentStatus
681					}
682				}
683				latest := "—"
684				if !repository.LastActivity.IsZero() {
685					latest = humanAge(time.Since(repository.LastActivity))
686				}
687				table.Add(result.Name, style.hostState(string(result.State)), truncate(repository.Display, 28), truncate(repository.Branch, 22),
688					style.git(repository.Status.Summary()), fleetLive(style, live), fleetTaskSummary(repository.Tasks),
689					style.dim(latest), config.Contract(repository.Path))
690			}
691		}
692		table.Render(app.Out)
693	}
694
695	func fleetRows(results []fleet.HostResult) []tui.FleetRow {
696		var rows []tui.FleetRow
697		for _, result := range results {
698			if result.Snapshot == nil || len(result.Snapshot.Repositories) == 0 {
699				rows = append(rows, tui.FleetRow{Host: result.Name, Local: result.Local, State: result.State, Error: result.Error, FromCache: result.FromCache})
700				continue
701			}
702			for index := range result.Snapshot.Repositories {
703				repository := result.Snapshot.Repositories[index]
704				rows = append(rows, tui.FleetRow{
705					Host: result.Name, Local: result.Local, State: result.State, Repository: &repository,
706					Error: result.Error, FromCache: result.FromCache,
707				})
708			}
709		}
710		return rows
711	}
712
713	func cachedFleetRows(app *App) []tui.FleetRow {
714		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
715		if err != nil {
716			return nil
717		}
718		var results []fleet.HostResult
719		for _, host := range cfg.Hosts {
720			snapshot, cachedAt, ok := fleet.LoadCache(host)
721			if !ok || (cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration > 0 && time.Since(cachedAt) > cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration) {
722				continue
723			}
724			results = append(results, fleet.HostResult{
725				Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostStale, Snapshot: &snapshot,
726				CachedAt: &cachedAt, FromCache: true,
727			})
728		}
729		return fleetRows(results)
730	}
731
732	func fleetTaskSummary(counts fleet.TaskCounts) string {
733		var parts []string
734		for _, item := range []struct {
735			icon string
736			n    int
737		}{{"🔥", counts.Hot}, {"🌤", counts.Warm}, {"❄", counts.Cold}, {"✓", counts.Done}} {
738			if item.n > 0 {

880				return err
881			}
882			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "wrote %s\n", config.Contract(path))
883			return nil
884		}}
885		cmd.Flags().BoolVarP(&force, "force", "f", false, "overwrite an existing file")
886		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&stdout, "stdout", false, "print without writing")
887		return cmd

890	// fleetConfigEditorProcess builds the editor invocation for remotes.toml,
891	// seeding the starter file when there is none. The TUI runs the same command
892	// under tea.ExecProcess, so the two entry points cannot drift.
893	func fleetConfigEditorProcess(app *App, editor string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
894		path := fleetConfigPath(app)
895		if _, err := os.Stat(path); os.IsNotExist(err) {
896			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
897				return nil, err
898			}
899			// 0600: remotes.toml may carry a plaintext SSH password.
900			if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(fleetStarterConfig), 0o600); err != nil {
901				return nil, err
902			}
903		}
904		chosen, err := resolveEditor(editor)
905		if err != nil {
906			return nil, err
907		}
908		process := exec.Command(shellPath(), "-c", chosen+" "+shellQuote(path))
909		process.Stdin, process.Stdout, process.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
910		return process, nil
911	}

238	func fleetFilesHost(cfg fleet.Config, name string) (fleet.Host, error) {
239		var selected *fleet.Host
240		for index := range cfg.Hosts {
241			if cfg.Hosts[index].Name == name {
242				if selected != nil {
243					return fleet.Host{}, errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one target")
244				}
245				copy := cfg.Hosts[index]
246				selected = &copy
247			}
248		}
249		if selected == nil {
250			return fleet.Host{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
251		}
252		return *selected, nil
253	}

255	func fleetFilePatterns(project projectconfig.Result, adHoc []string) []localfiles.Pattern {
256		var patterns []localfiles.Pattern
257		if project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include != nil {
258			source, _ := project.SourceFor("local_files.include")
259			for _, value := range *project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include {
260				patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: source})
261			}
262		}
263		for _, value := range adHoc {
264			patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: "--file"})
265		}
266		return patterns
267	}

269	func resolveFleetFilesSource(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (string, gitx.Status, string, string, error) {
270		checkout := ""
271		if ref == "" {
272			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
273			if err != nil {
274				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
275			}
276			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
277			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
278				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
279			}
280			checkout = gitRepo.Root
281		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
282			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
283				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
284				if discoverErr != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
285					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
286				}
287				checkout = gitRepo.Root
288			}
289		}
290		if checkout == "" {
291			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
292			if err != nil {
293				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
294			}
295			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
296			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
297				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
298			}
299			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
300		}
301		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
302		if err != nil {
303			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
304		}
305		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
306			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
307		}
308		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
309		if err != nil {
310			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
311		}
312		identity, err := sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
313		if err != nil {
314			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
315		}
316		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil
317	}
318
319	func sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
320		var preferred []string
321		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
322			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
323		}
324		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
325		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
326		if err != nil {
327			return "", err
328		}
329		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
330		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
331		for _, remote := range preferred {
332			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
333				continue
334			}
335			seenRemote[remote] = true
336			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
337			if err != nil {
338				continue
339			}
340			identitySet := map[string]bool{}
341			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
342				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
343					identitySet[identity] = true
344				}
345			}
346			if len(identitySet) == 1 {
347				for identity := range identitySet {
348					return identity, nil
349				}
350			}
351		}
352		return "", errors.New("source checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
353	}

355	func renderFleetFilesReport(app *App, report localfiles.Report, jsonOutput bool) error {

366		return nil
367	}

11		return os.Chmod(path, want.Perm())

14	func privateModeMatches(_ string, mode, want fs.FileMode) (bool, error) {
15		return mode.Perm() == want.Perm(), nil
16	}

19		return os.Rename(source, destination)

14	const (

16		administratorsSID = "S-1-5-32-544"
17	)

19	// setPrivateMode installs a protected DACL. Windows os.FileMode permission
20	// bits only model the read-only attribute and cannot establish privacy.
21	func setPrivateMode(path string, want fs.FileMode) error {
22		inheritance := ""
23		switch want.Perm() {
24		case 0o600:
25		case 0o700:
26			inheritance = "OICI"
27		default:
28			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported private Windows mode %04o", want.Perm())
29		}
30		current, _, err := privateSIDs()
31		if err != nil {
32			return err
33		}
34		ace := func(sid string) string {
35			return fmt.Sprintf("(A;%s;GA;;;%s)", inheritance, sid)
36		}
37		descriptor, err := windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString("D:P" + ace(current) + ace(localSystemSID) + ace(administratorsSID))
38		if err != nil {
39			return fmt.Errorf("build private Windows security descriptor: %w", err)
40		}
41		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
42		if err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("read private Windows DACL: %w", err)
44		}
45		if dacl == nil {
46			return fmt.Errorf("private Windows security descriptor has no DACL")
47		}
48		err = windows.SetNamedSecurityInfo(
49			path,
50			windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT,
51			windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
52			nil,
53			nil,
54			dacl,
55			nil,
56		)
57		runtime.KeepAlive(descriptor)
58		if err != nil {
59			return fmt.Errorf("set private Windows DACL: %w", err)
60		}
61		return nil
62	}
63
64	func privateModeMatches(path string, _ fs.FileMode, _ fs.FileMode) (bool, error) {
65		current, allowed, err := privateSIDs()
66		if err != nil {
67			return false, err
68		}
69		descriptor, err := windows.GetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
70		if err != nil {
71			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner and DACL: %w", err)
72		}
73		owner, _, err := descriptor.Owner()
74		if err != nil {
75			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner: %w", err)
76		}
77		if !privateSIDAllowed(owner, allowed) {
78			return false, nil
79		}
80		control, _, err := descriptor.Control()
81		if err != nil {
82			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows security descriptor control: %w", err)
83		}
84		if control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED == 0 {
85			return false, nil
86		}
87		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
88		if err != nil {
89			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL: %w", err)
90		}
91		if dacl == nil {
92			return false, nil
93		}
94		seenCurrent := false
95		for index := uint16(0); index < dacl.AceCount; index++ {

97			if err := windows.GetAce(dacl, uint32(index), &ace); err != nil {

186	// CanonicalKeys validates, deduplicates, and sorts keys in the one order used
187	// by every multi-key acquisition.
188	func CanonicalKeys(keys []Key) ([]Key, error) {
189		if len(keys) == 0 {
190			return nil, errors.New("operation lease requires at least one key")
191		}
192		unique := make(map[string]Key, len(keys))
193		for _, key := range keys {
194			if err := key.Validate(); err != nil {
195				return nil, err
196			}
197			unique[key.canonical()] = key
198		}
199		canonical := make([]Key, 0, len(unique))
200		for _, key := range unique {
201			canonical = append(canonical, key)
202		}
203		sort.Slice(canonical, func(i, j int) bool { return canonical[i].canonical() < canonical[j].canonical() })
204		return canonical, nil
205	}

52			nil,
53			nil,

169			Branch    string `json:"branch"`
170			Head      string `json:"head"`
171		}{"dev-local-files-checkout-v1", checkout.commonDir, checkout.root, checkout.branch, checkout.head})
172		return checkout, nil
173	}
174
175	func checkoutHasIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, wanted string) (bool, error) {
176		names, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
177		if err != nil {
178			return false, err
179		}
180		for _, name := range strings.Fields(names) {
181			// Repository identity is established from fetch URLs. A push-only match
182			// can name a different mirror or publication target and must not authorize
183			// writing local files into an otherwise unrelated clone.
184			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", name)
185			if err != nil {
186				continue
187			}
188			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
189				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
190					return true, nil
191				}
192			}
193		}
194		return false, nil
195	}
196
197	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
198		if s == nil {
199			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
200		}
201		if s.platform() == "windows" {
202			return PlanResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
203		}
204		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
205			return PlanResponse{}, err
206		}
207		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
208		if err != nil {
209			return PlanResponse{}, err
210		}
211		if id != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
212			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
213		}
214		hostLimits := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
215		if err := hostLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
216			return PlanResponse{}, err
217		}
218		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(hostLimits, request.Limits)
219		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
220			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("plan limits do not match target policy")
221		}
222		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, request.Binding)
223		if err != nil {
224			return PlanResponse{}, err
225		}
226		response := PlanResponse{
227			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
228			RequestID: request.RequestID, ManifestDigest: request.ManifestDigest,
229			TargetMachine: id, TargetCheckout: checkout.id,
230		}
231		for _, spec := range request.Files {
232			planned := PlanFile{PublicFile: spec.public(StateFailed)}
233			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
234				planned.State = stateForError(err)
235				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
236				continue
237			}
238			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, request.SafeLimits(), true)
239			if err != nil {
240				planned.State = stateForError(err)
241				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
242				continue
243			}
244			targetMode := ""
245			if observed.exists {
246				targetMode = fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm())
247			}
248			switch {
249			case !observed.exists:
250				planned.State, planned.Action = StateReady, actionCreate
251			case observed.digest == spec.SHA256 && targetMode == spec.Mode:
252				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateCurrent, actionCurrent, observed.digest, targetMode
253			case request.Replace:
254				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateReady, actionReplace, observed.digest, targetMode
255			default:
256				planned.State, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateBlockedConflict, observed.digest, targetMode
257			}
258			response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
259		}
260		response.PlanDigest = planDigest(request, response)
261		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
262			return PlanResponse{}, err
263		}
264		return response, nil
265	}
266

17	var ErrPlanBlocked = errors.New("portable-file plan is blocked")
18
19	type SourceOptions struct {
20		Checkout string
21		Binding  Binding
22		Patterns []Pattern
23		Limits   safefile.Limits
24		Replace  bool
25		// RequestID is a focused-test seam. Production leaves it empty.
26		RequestID string
27	}
28
29	// Source is an exact, content-addressed local manifest. It keeps no file bytes;
30	// BuildEnvelope reopens and rehashes each non-current source after target plan.
31	type Source struct {
32		checkout string
33		request  PlanRequest
34	}
35
36	func (s *Source) Request() PlanRequest { return s.request }
37
38	func PrepareSource(ctx context.Context, options SourceOptions) (*Source, Report, error) {
39		if err := options.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
40			return nil, Report{}, err
41		}
42		if err := options.Binding.Validate(); err != nil {
43			return nil, Report{}, err
44		}
45		paths, err := Expand(options.Checkout, options.Patterns, options.Limits)
46		if err != nil {
47			return nil, Report{}, err
48		}
49		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, options.Limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
50			return nil, Report{}, err
51		}
52		requestID := options.RequestID
53		if requestID == "" {
54			requestID = uuid.NewString()
55		}
56		request := PlanRequest{
57			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
58			RequestID: requestID, Binding: options.Binding, Limits: limitsToWire(options.Limits),
59			Replace: options.Replace,
60		}
61		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}
62		blocked := false
63		for _, path := range paths {
64			public := PublicFile{Path: path, Mode: "0600", State: StateFailed}
65			observed, observeErr := observePath(ctx, options.Checkout, path, options.Limits, true)
66			if observeErr != nil {
67				public.State = stateForError(observeErr)
68				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
69				blocked = true
70				continue
71			}
72			if !observed.exists {
73				public.State = StateMissing
74				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
75				blocked = true
76				continue
77			}
78			public.Size = observed.info.Size()
79			if observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0 {
80				public.Mode = "0700"
81			}
82			if eligibilityErr := proveGitEligibility(ctx, options.Checkout, path); eligibilityErr != nil {
83				public.State = stateForError(eligibilityErr)
84				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
85				blocked = true
86				continue
87			}
88			public.State = StateReady
89			report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
90			request.Files = append(request.Files, FileSpec{
91				Path: path, Size: observed.info.Size(), Mode: public.Mode, SHA256: observed.digest,
92			})
93		}
94		report.Files = sortedPublic(report.Files)
95		if blocked {
96			return nil, report, ErrPlanBlocked
97		}
98		sort.Slice(request.Files, func(i, j int) bool { return request.Files[i].Path < request.Files[j].Path })
99		request.ManifestDigest = manifestDigest(request)
100		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
101			return nil, report, err
102		}
103		return &Source{checkout: options.Checkout, request: request}, report, nil
104	}
105
106	// BuildEnvelope performs the source-side apply revalidation and includes bytes
107	// only for target actions that create or explicitly replace a file.
108	func (s *Source) BuildEnvelope(ctx context.Context, plan PlanResponse, retainForEvict bool) (ApplyEnvelope, error) {
109		if s == nil {
110			return ApplyEnvelope{}, errors.New("build local-files envelope from nil source")
111		}
112		if err := plan.Validate(s.request); err != nil {
113			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
114		}
115		envelope := ApplyEnvelope{
116			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
117			Request: s.request, Plan: plan, RetainForEvict: retainForEvict,
118		}
119		for index, planned := range plan.Files {
120			if planned.Action == actionCurrent {
121				continue
122			}
123			if planned.Action != actionCreate && planned.Action != actionReplace {
124				return ApplyEnvelope{}, ErrPlanBlocked
125			}
126			spec := s.request.Files[index]
127			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
128				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
129			}
130			observed, err := observePath(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path, s.request.SafeLimits(), true)
131			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 ||
132				(observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0) != spec.executable() {
133				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
134			}
135			envelope.Payloads = append(envelope.Payloads, Payload{
136				Path: spec.Path, Content: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(observed.data),
137			})
138		}
139		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
140			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
141		}
142		return envelope, nil
143	}
144
145	func (e ApplyEnvelope) Validate() error {
146		if e.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || e.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
147			return errors.New("unsupported local-files apply protocol")
148		}
149		if err := e.Request.Validate(); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		if err := e.Plan.Validate(e.Request); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		expected := map[string]FileSpec{}
156		for index, planned := range e.Plan.Files {
157			if planned.Action == actionCreate || planned.Action == actionReplace {
158				expected[e.Request.Files[index].Path] = e.Request.Files[index]
159			}
160		}
161		if len(e.Payloads) != len(expected) {
162			return errors.New("apply payload count does not match target actions")
163		}
164		seen := map[string]bool{}
165		var total int64
166		for index, payload := range e.Payloads {
167			if index > 0 && e.Payloads[index-1].Path >= payload.Path {
168				return errors.New("apply payload paths must be unique and sorted")
169			}
170			spec, ok := expected[payload.Path]
171			if !ok || seen[payload.Path] {
172				return fmt.Errorf("unexpected apply payload for %q", payload.Path)
173			}
174			seen[payload.Path] = true
175			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
176			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
177				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q is not canonical base64", payload.Path)
178			}
179			if int64(len(decoded)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(decoded) != spec.SHA256 {
180				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q does not match its manifest", payload.Path)
181			}
182			if int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes || int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxTotalBytes-total {
183				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q exceeds negotiated limits", payload.Path)
184			}
185			total += int64(len(decoded))
186		}
187		return nil
188	}
189
190	func stateForError(err error) State {
191		switch {
192		case errors.Is(err, ErrUnsafe), errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrUnsafeType), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrNotPortable), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrPathCollision):
193			return StateBlockedUnsafe
194		case errors.Is(err, ErrIneligible):
195			return StateBlockedIneligible
196		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
197			return StateMissing
198		default:
199			return StateFailed
200		}
201	}
202
203	func limitsToWire(limits safefile.Limits) fleet.FileLimits {
204		return fleet.FileLimits{
205			MaxFiles: limits.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: limits.MaxFileBytes,
206			MaxTotalBytes: limits.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: limits.MaxPathBytes,
207			MaxComponentBytes: limits.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: limits.MaxPathDepth,
208		}
209	}
210
211	// NegotiateLimits takes the lower value for every policy field and validates
212	// both sides against this binary's compiled ceilings.
213	func NegotiateLimits(local safefile.Limits, remote fleet.FileLimits) (safefile.Limits, error) {
214		if err := local.Validate(); err != nil {
215			return safefile.Limits{}, err
216		}
217		remoteLimits := safefile.Limits{
218			MaxFiles: remote.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: remote.MaxFileBytes,
219			MaxTotalBytes: remote.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: remote.MaxPathBytes,
220			MaxComponentBytes: remote.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: remote.MaxPathDepth,
221		}
222		if err := remoteLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
223			return safefile.Limits{}, err
224		}
225		result := safefile.Limits{
226			MaxFiles:          min(local.MaxFiles, remoteLimits.MaxFiles),
227			MaxFileBytes:      min(local.MaxFileBytes, remoteLimits.MaxFileBytes),
228			MaxTotalBytes:     min(local.MaxTotalBytes, remoteLimits.MaxTotalBytes),
229			MaxPathBytes:      min(local.MaxPathBytes, remoteLimits.MaxPathBytes),
230			MaxComponentBytes: min(local.MaxComponentBytes, remoteLimits.MaxComponentBytes),
231			MaxPathDepth:      min(local.MaxPathDepth, remoteLimits.MaxPathDepth),
232		}
233		return result, result.Validate()
234	}

290		Context          inventory.RepoContext
291		SelectedCheckout int
292		SelectionErr     error
293		Topology         gitx.RecoveryTopology

301	// Build joins live local facts with optional external observations. It performs
302	// no probes and never places raw Git endpoints in the returned report.
303	func Build(input BuildInput) (Report, error) {
304		now := input.GeneratedAt
305		if now.IsZero() {
306			now = time.Now().UTC()
307		}
308		now = now.Round(0).UTC()
309
310		report := Report{
311			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion,
312			GeneratedAt:   now,
313			Repository: Repository{
314				Name: input.Context.Repo.Name, Display: input.Context.Repo.Display(),
315				Path: input.Context.Repo.Path, RealPath: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.RealPath),
316				CommonDir: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.CommonDir),
317				Bare:      input.Context.Repo.Bare, HasGit: input.Context.Repo.HasGit,
318			},
319			Sources:      []Source{},
320			Capabilities: []Capability{},
321			Remotes:      []Remote{},
322			Errors:       []CollectionError{},
323		}
324
325		report.Local = buildLocalFacts(input, &report.Errors)
326		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(report.Local.Checkouts) {
327			checkout := report.Local.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout]
328			report.SelectedCheckout = &CheckoutSelection{
329				Index: checkout.Index, Path: checkout.Path, Branch: checkout.Branch,
330				Canonical: checkout.Canonical, Ownership: checkout.Ownership,
331			}
332		} else {
333			message := "selected checkout is not present in the local checkout inventory"
334			if input.SelectionErr != nil {
335				message = cleanError(input.SelectionErr)
336			}
337			report.Errors = append(report.Errors, CollectionError{
338				Code: "selection-unavailable", Scope: "local", Subject: "selected-checkout", Message: message,
339			})
340		}
341
342		localIdentities := privateRemoteIdentities(input.Topology)
343		report.Remotes, report.Forge, report.Errors = buildRemoteFacts(now, input, report.Errors)
344		report.Fleet, report.Errors = buildFleetFacts(now, input.Fleet, localIdentities, report.Errors)
345
346		sources := buildSources(now, input, report)
347		report.Sources = sources
348		report.Capabilities = buildCapabilities(input, report)
349
350		readiness := AssessLocal(input.Context, input.SelectedCheckout, input.Hostname)
351		sourceMap := make(map[string]assessment.Source, len(sources))
352		for _, source := range sources {
353			sourceMap[source.ID] = source.assessmentSource()
354		}
355		gates := []assessment.Gate{
356			readinessGate("checkout-readiness", readiness.Checkout, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.checkout")),
357			readinessGate("task-readiness", readiness.Task, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.tasks", "local.runtime")),
358			readinessGate("worktree-readiness", readiness.Worktree, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.worktrees", "local.runtime")),
359			{
360				Code: "whole-clone-eviction", Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate,
361				Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{
362					Code: "recovery-proof-unavailable", Subject: "repository",
363					Detail:      "whole-clone eviction is not assessed by the context profile",
364					Remediation: "create and restore-verify a recovery receipt before eviction",
365				}},
366			},
367		}
368		assessmentReport, err := assessment.NewReport(assessment.ProfileCheap, now, gates)
369		if err != nil {
370			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("seal repository context assessment: %w", err)
371		}
372		report.Assessment = assessmentReport
373
374		sort.Slice(report.Errors, func(i, j int) bool {
375			left, right := report.Errors[i], report.Errors[j]
376			return strings.Join([]string{left.Scope, left.Code, left.Subject, left.Message}, "\x00") <
377				strings.Join([]string{right.Scope, right.Code, right.Subject, right.Message}, "\x00")
378		})
379		return report, nil
380	}
381
382	func buildLocalFacts(input BuildInput, reportErrors *[]CollectionError) LocalFacts {
383		context := input.Context
384		local := LocalFacts{
385			Checkouts:                          make([]CheckoutFacts, 0, len(context.Checkouts)),
386			OtherTasks:                         []TaskFacts{},
387			ObservedLinkedWorktreeAdminEntries: context.WorktreeCount,
388			CheckoutsComplete:                  context.WorktreeErr == nil,
389			TaskInventoryComplete:              context.TaskErr == nil,
390			Runtimes:                           []RuntimeFacts{},
391		}
392		if context.WorktreeErr == nil {
393			count := context.WorktreeCount
394			local.LinkedWorktreeCount = &count
395		} else {
396			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("worktree-inventory-failed", "local", "worktrees", context.WorktreeErr))
397		}
398		if context.TaskErr != nil {
399			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-inventory-failed", "local", "tasks", context.TaskErr))
400		}
401
402		for index, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
403			facts := CheckoutFacts{
404				Index: index, Path: checkout.Worktree.Path, Canonical: index == 0,
405				Ownership: checkout.Ownership, Locked: checkout.Worktree.Locked,
406				LockedReason:   optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)),
407				Prunable:       checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
408				PrunableReason: optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)),
409				Branch:         optionalString(checkout.Branch()), Head: optionalString(checkout.Worktree.Head),
410				LastActivity: optionalTime(checkout.LastActivity), LastCommit: optionalTime(checkout.LastCommit),
411				LastSubject: optionalString(checkout.LastSubject), Sessions: []RuntimeSession{}, Tasks: []TaskFacts{},
412			}
413			switch {
414			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
415				facts.State = "error"
416				facts.PathError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.PathErr))
417				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-path-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.PathErr))
418			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
419				facts.State = "missing"
420				exists := false
421				facts.Exists = &exists
422			case checkout.Worktree.Bare || index == 0 && context.Repo.Bare:
423				facts.State = "bare"
424				exists := true
425				facts.Exists = &exists
426				detached := false
427				facts.Detached = &detached
428			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
429				facts.State = "error"
430				exists := true
431				facts.Exists = &exists
432				facts.StatusError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.StatusErr))
433				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-status-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.StatusErr))
434			default:
435				facts.State = "available"
436				exists := true
437				facts.Exists = &exists
438				status := checkout.Status
439				facts.Status = &status
440				detached := checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached
441				facts.Detached = &detached
442			}
443			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
444				facts.Tasks = append(facts.Tasks, taskFacts(tracked))
445				if tracked != nil {
446					if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
447						*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
448					}
449				}
450			}
451			local.Checkouts = append(local.Checkouts, facts)
452		}
453		for _, tracked := range context.OtherTasks {
454			local.OtherTasks = append(local.OtherTasks, taskFacts(tracked))
455			if tracked != nil {
456				if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
457					*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
458				}
459			}
460		}
461
462		runtimes := input.Runtimes
463		if len(runtimes) == 0 && (context.Runtime != "" || context.RuntimeErr != nil || len(context.Sessions()) > 0) {
464			runtimes = []RuntimeInput{{
465				Backend: context.Runtime, Available: context.RuntimeErr == nil,
466				Sessions: context.Sessions(), Err: context.RuntimeErr,
467			}}
468		}
469		for runtimeIndex, observed := range runtimes {
470			backend := strings.TrimSpace(observed.Backend)
471			if backend == "" {
472				backend = fmt.Sprintf("unknown-%d", runtimeIndex+1)
473			}
474			runtimeFacts := RuntimeFacts{
475				Backend: backend, Available: observed.Available,
476				SourceID: "local.runtime", Sessions: []RuntimeSession{},
477			}
478			if observed.Err != nil {
479				runtimeFacts.Error = optionalString(cleanError(observed.Err))
480				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("runtime-inventory-failed", "local", "runtime:"+safeIdentifier(backend), observed.Err))
481			}
482			for _, session := range observed.Sessions {
483				indices := sessionCheckoutIndices(context, session)
484				if len(indices) == 0 {
485					continue
486				}
487				projected := RuntimeSession{
488					Backend: backend, Handle: session.Handle, Label: optionalString(session.Label),
489					AgentStatus:   optionalString(session.AgentStatus),
490					AgentSessions: append([]string{}, session.AgentSessions...),
491					Focused:       session.Focused, Checkouts: indices,
492				}
493				sort.Strings(projected.AgentSessions)
494				runtimeFacts.Sessions = append(runtimeFacts.Sessions, projected)
495				for _, checkoutIndex := range indices {
496					if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(local.Checkouts) {
497						local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions = append(local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions, projected)
498					}
499				}
500			}
501			sortRuntimeSessions(runtimeFacts.Sessions)
502			local.Runtimes = append(local.Runtimes, runtimeFacts)
503		}
504		sort.Slice(local.Runtimes, func(i, j int) bool { return local.Runtimes[i].Backend < local.Runtimes[j].Backend })
505		for index := range local.Checkouts {
506			sortRuntimeSessions(local.Checkouts[index].Sessions)
507		}
508		return local
509	}

511	func buildRemoteFacts(now time.Time, input BuildInput, reportErrors []CollectionError) ([]Remote, ForgeFacts, []CollectionError) {
512		forgeFacts := ForgeFacts{Error: optionalError(input.Forge.Err)}
513		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
514			sourceID := "forge.inventory"
515			forgeFacts.SourceID = &sourceID
516			records := len(input.Forge.Records)
517			forgeFacts.RecordsConsidered = &records
518			complete := input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete
519			forgeFacts.Complete = &complete
520		} else if input.Forge.Err != nil {
521			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-unavailable", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
522		}
523		if input.Forge.Err != nil && !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
524			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-partial", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
525		}
526		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
527			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("remote-topology-failed", "local", "remotes", input.TopologyErr))
528			if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
529				zero := 0
530				forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &zero
531			}
532			return []Remote{}, forgeFacts, reportErrors
533		}
534
535		recordsByIdentity := forgeRecordsByIdentity(input.Forge.Records)
536		currentUpstream := ""
537		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(input.Context.Checkouts) {
538			status := input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].Status
539			if input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].StatusErr == nil && status.Upstream != "" {
540				currentUpstream, _, _ = strings.Cut(status.Upstream, "/")
541			}
542		}
543		matchedRecords := map[string]struct{}{}
544		remotes := make([]Remote, 0, len(input.Topology.Remotes))
545		for _, observed := range input.Topology.Remotes {
546			remote := Remote{Name: observed.Name, Roles: remoteRoles(observed.Name, currentUpstream), Fetch: []RemoteEndpoint{}, Push: []RemoteEndpoint{}}
547			for index, raw := range observed.FetchURLs {
548				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
549				remote.Fetch = append(remote.Fetch, endpoint)
550				for _, key := range matched {
551					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
552				}
553				if endpointErr != nil {
554					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
555						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.fetch.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
556					})
557				}
558			}
559			for index, raw := range observed.PushURLs {
560				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
561				remote.Push = append(remote.Push, endpoint)
562				for _, key := range matched {
563					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
564				}
565				if endpointErr != nil {
566					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
567						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.push.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
568					})
569				}
570			}
571			remotes = append(remotes, remote)
572		}
573		if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
574			matches := len(matchedRecords)
575			forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &matches
576		}
577		return remotes, forgeFacts, reportErrors
578	}
579
580	type endpointBuildError struct {
581		Code    string
582		Message string
583	}
584
585	func buildRemoteEndpoint(raw string, records map[string][]forge.RemoteRepo, forgeAvailable, exactForge bool) (RemoteEndpoint, []string, *endpointBuildError) {
586		transport, displayIdentity, displayOK := publicEndpointIdentity(raw)
587		forgeMatch := "unavailable"
588		if forgeAvailable {
589			forgeMatch = "none"
590		}
591		endpoint := RemoteEndpoint{Transport: transport, Identity: optionalString(displayIdentity), ForgeMatch: forgeMatch}
592		privateIdentity := privateRemoteIdentity(raw)
593		if !displayOK {
594			message := "endpoint has no display-safe cross-host identity"
595			endpoint.Error = &message
596			return endpoint, nil, &endpointBuildError{Code: "remote-identity-unavailable", Message: message}
597		}
598
599		candidates := dedupeForgeRecords(records[privateIdentity])
600		var exact *forge.RemoteRepo
601		matched := []string{}
602		switch len(candidates) {
603		case 1:
604			if exactForge {
605				exact = &candidates[0]
606			}
607			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "exact"
608			matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidates[0]))
609		case 0:
610			if forgeAvailable {
611				endpoint.ForgeMatch = "none"
612			}
613		default:
614			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "ambiguous"
615			message := fmt.Sprintf("normalized endpoint identity matches %d forge records", len(candidates))
616			endpoint.Error = &message
617			for _, candidate := range candidates {
618				matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidate))
619			}
620			if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw}); ok {
621				endpoint.WebURL = &web
622			}
623			return endpoint, matched, &endpointBuildError{Code: "forge-match-ambiguous", Message: message}
624		}
625		if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw, Exact: exact}); ok {
626			endpoint.WebURL = &web
627		}
628		return endpoint, matched, nil
629	}

631	func buildFleetFacts(now time.Time, input FleetInput, localIdentities map[string]struct{}, reportErrors []CollectionError) (FleetFacts, []CollectionError) {
632		facts := FleetFacts{Coverage: FleetCoverageConfiguredHostsOnly, Hosts: []FleetHostObservation{}, Error: optionalError(input.Err)}
633		if !input.Configured {
634			if input.Err == nil {
635				facts.Error = optionalString("fleet configuration was not collected")
636			}
637			if facts.Error != nil {
638				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-config-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "configuration", Message: *facts.Error})
639			}
640			return facts, reportErrors
641		}
642		count := len(input.ConfiguredHostNames)
643		facts.ConfiguredHosts = &count
644		results := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
645		for _, result := range input.Results {
646			if _, exists := results[result.Name]; !exists {
647				results[result.Name] = result
648			}
649		}
650		for index, name := range input.ConfiguredHostNames {
651			result, found := results[name]
652			if !found {
653				result = fleet.HostResult{Name: name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "configured host produced no observation"}
654			}
655			host := FleetHostObservation{
656				Name: name, State: result.State, CachedAt: optionalTimeValue(result.CachedAt),
657				Match: FleetMatchUnavailable, Repositories: []FleetRepository{}, Error: optionalString(cleanText(result.Error)),
658			}
659			if result.Snapshot != nil {
660				matches := matchingFleetRepositories(result.Snapshot.Repositories, localIdentities)
661				for _, matched := range matches {
662					host.Repositories = append(host.Repositories, fleetRepositoryFacts(matched))
663				}
664				switch {
665				case len(localIdentities) == 0:
666					host.Match = FleetMatchUnavailable
667					if host.Error == nil {
668						host.Error = optionalString("local repository has no normalized remote identity")
669					}
670				case len(matches) == 0:
671					host.Match = FleetMatchNotFound
672				case len(matches) == 1:
673					host.Match = FleetMatchExact
674				default:
675					host.Match = FleetMatchAmbiguous
676					message := fmt.Sprintf("%d repositories on this host share a local normalized remote identity", len(matches))
677					if host.Error == nil {
678						host.Error = &message
679					}
680					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-match-ambiguous", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: message})
681				}
682
683				observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
684				if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
685					observedAt = *result.CachedAt
686				}
687				if !observedAt.IsZero() {
688					sourceID := fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index)
689					host.SourceID = &sourceID
690				}
691			}
692			if result.Error != "" || result.Snapshot == nil {
693				message := result.Error
694				if message == "" {
695					message = "host produced no repository snapshot"
696				}
697				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-host-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: cleanText(message)})
698			}
699			facts.Hosts = append(facts.Hosts, host)
700		}
701		return facts, reportErrors
702	}
703
704	func buildSources(now time.Time, input BuildInput, report Report) []Source {
705		sources := []Source{}
706		selectedFacts := any(nil)
707		checkoutCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessUnknown
708		if report.SelectedCheckout != nil {
709			selectedFacts = report.Local.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
710			checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessComplete
711			selected := input.Context.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
712			if selected.PathErr != nil || selected.StatusErr != nil {
713				checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
714			}
715		}
716		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.checkout", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, checkoutCompleteness, now, now, selectedFacts))
717
718		taskCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
719		if input.Context.TaskErr != nil {
720			taskCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
721		}
722		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.tasks", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, taskCompleteness, now, now, struct {
723			Checkouts  []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
724			OtherTasks []TaskFacts     `json:"other_tasks"`
725		}{report.Local.Checkouts, report.Local.OtherTasks}))
726
727		worktreeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
728		if input.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
729			worktreeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
730		}
731		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.worktrees", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, worktreeCompleteness, now, now, struct {
732			Count     *int            `json:"count"`
733			Checkouts []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
734		}{report.Local.LinkedWorktreeCount, report.Local.Checkouts}))
735
736		runtimeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
737		if len(report.Local.Runtimes) == 0 {
738			runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
739		}
740		for _, observed := range report.Local.Runtimes {
741			if observed.Error != nil {
742				runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
743			}
744		}
745		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.runtime", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, runtimeCompleteness, now, now, report.Local.Runtimes))
746
747		remoteCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
748		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
749			remoteCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
750		}
751		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.remotes", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, remoteCompleteness, now, now, report.Remotes))
752
753		if input.Fleet.Configured {
754			sources = append(sources, newSource("local.fleet-config", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, assessment.CompletenessComplete, now, now, input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames))
755		}
756		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
757			freshness := input.Forge.Freshness
758			if freshness == "" {
759				freshness = assessment.FreshnessUnknown
760			}
761			completeness := input.Forge.Completeness
762			if completeness == "" {
763				completeness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
764			}
765			sources = append(sources, newSource("forge.inventory", input.Forge.Authority, freshness, completeness, input.Forge.ObservedAt, now, struct {
766				Remotes []Remote   `json:"remotes"`
767				Forge   ForgeFacts `json:"forge"`
768			}{report.Remotes, report.Forge}))
769		}
770		resultByName := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
771		for _, result := range input.Fleet.Results {
772			resultByName[result.Name] = result
773		}
774		for index, name := range input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames {
775			result, ok := resultByName[name]
776			if !ok || result.Snapshot == nil || index >= len(report.Fleet.Hosts) {
777				continue
778			}
779			observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
780			if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
781				observedAt = *result.CachedAt
782			}
783			if observedAt.IsZero() {
784				continue
785			}
786			authority := assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive
787			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
788			if result.FromCache {
789				authority = assessment.AuthorityCache
790				if input.Fleet.CacheTTL > 0 && now.Sub(observedAt) > input.Fleet.CacheTTL {
791					freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
792				}
793			}
794			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
795			if result.Error != "" || result.State != fleet.HostOK && !result.FromCache {
796				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
797			}
798			sources = append(sources, newSource(fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index), authority, freshness, completeness, observedAt, now, report.Fleet.Hosts[index]))
799		}
800		sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool { return sources[i].ID < sources[j].ID })
801		return sources
802	}
