969	func publicEndpointIdentity(raw string) (transport, identity string, ok bool) {
970		if !utf8.ValidString(raw) || containsControl(raw) {
971			return "unknown", "", false
972		}
973		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
974		if trimmed == "" {
975			return "unknown", "", false
976		}
977		redacted := trimmed
978		if parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
979			transport = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
980			parsed.User = nil
981			parsed.RawQuery = ""
982			parsed.ForceQuery = false
983			parsed.Fragment = ""
984			redacted = parsed.String()
985		} else {
986			if index := strings.IndexAny(redacted, "?#"); index >= 0 {
987				redacted = redacted[:index]
988			}
989			colon := strings.IndexByte(redacted, ':')
990			at := strings.LastIndexByte(redacted, '@')
991			if at >= 0 && colon > at {
992				transport = "ssh"
993				redacted = "git@" + redacted[at+1:]
994			} else if filepath.IsAbs(redacted) || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, "~") {
995				transport = "local"
996			} else {
997				transport = "unknown"
998			}
999		}
1000		identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(redacted)
1001		if identity == "" || containsControl(identity) {
1002			return transport, "", false
1003		}
1004		return transport, identity, true
1005	}

1118	// cleanText removes controls and structurally redacts URL/scp-like tokens while
1119	// preserving enough of an error to diagnose which probe failed.
1120	func cleanText(value string) string {
1121		value = strings.Map(func(r rune) rune {
1122			if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
1123				return ' '
1124			}
1125			return r
1126		}, value)
1127		fields := strings.Fields(value)
1128		for index, field := range fields {
1129			fields[index] = redactTextToken(field)
1130		}
1131		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(fields, " "))
1132	}

1134	func redactTextToken(token string) string {
1135		prefix := strings.TrimLeft(token, "([{<\"'")
1136		leading := token[:len(token)-len(prefix)]
1137		core := strings.TrimRight(prefix, ")]}>\"',;.")
1138		trailing := prefix[len(core):]
1139		if parsed, err := url.Parse(core); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
1140			parsed.User = nil
1141			parsed.RawQuery = ""
1142			parsed.ForceQuery = false
1143			parsed.Fragment = ""
1144			return leading + parsed.String() + trailing
1145		}
1146		colon := strings.IndexByte(core, ':')
1147		at := strings.LastIndexByte(core, '@')
1148		if at > 0 && colon > at {
1149			core = "[redacted]@" + core[at+1:]
1150			if query := strings.IndexAny(core, "?#"); query >= 0 {
1151				core = core[:query]
1152			}
1153		}
1154		return leading + core + trailing
1155	}
1156
1157	func containsControl(value string) bool {
1158		return strings.IndexFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
1159			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
1160		}) >= 0
1161	}
1162
1163	func safeIdentifier(value string) string {
1164		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
1165		var b strings.Builder
1166		lastDash := false
1167		for _, r := range value {
1168			if r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' {
1169				b.WriteRune(r)
1170				lastDash = false
1171			} else if !lastDash {
1172				b.WriteByte('-')
1173				lastDash = true
1174			}
1175		}
1176		result := strings.Trim(b.String(), "-")
1177		if result == "" {
1178			return "unknown"
1179		}
1180		return result
1181	}

47	func assessCheckout(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
48		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
49			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the selected checkout is absent from the local inventory", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
50		}
51		checkout := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex]
52		switch {
53		case checkout.Worktree.Bare || context.Repo.Bare:
54			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
55		case checkout.PathErr != nil:
56			return indeterminate("checkout-path-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path could not be inspected", "restore path access and rerun context")
57		case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
58			return blocked("checkout-missing", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path is missing or prunable", "repair or remove the stale worktree registration")
59		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
60			return indeterminate("checkout-status-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "Git status could not be collected", "repair the checkout and rerun context")
61		case checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached || checkout.Branch() == "":
62			return blocked("checkout-detached", "selected-checkout", "the checkout does not have an attached branch", "check out an explicit branch")
63		case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
64			return blocked("checkout-conflicted", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d unmerged path(s)", checkout.Status.Conflicted), "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement")
65		case checkout.Status.Dirty():
66			return blocked("checkout-dirty", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d changed path(s)", checkout.Status.Changed), "commit or deliberately preserve the changes")
67		default:
68			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
69		}
70	}

72	func assessTasks(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) Readiness {

78		}
79		// Transfer/repository readiness covers every non-DONE task attached to the
80		// clone, including cold and branch-only records without a local checkout.
81		// Looking only at the selected checkout can otherwise hide another machine's

91				return
92			}

107		}

127					hasIndeterminate = true
128					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
129						Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task cannot be checked against live runtime state",
130						Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
131					})
132				} else if sessionCount[candidate.ID] == 0 {
133					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
134						Code: "hot-task-runtime-missing", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task has no observed runtime session",
135						Remediation: "resume the task or reconcile its lifecycle state",
136					})
137				}
138			}
139		}
140		if hasReason(reasons, "task-owned-elsewhere") || hasReason(reasons, "hot-task-runtime-missing") {
141			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
142		}
143		if hasIndeterminate {
144			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
145		}
146		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
147	}
148
149	func assessWorktrees(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
150		if context.WorktreeErr != nil {
151			return indeterminate("worktree-inventory-unavailable", "worktrees", "linked worktrees could not be enumerated", "repair Git worktree metadata and rerun context")
152		}
153		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
154			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "worktree scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
155		}
156		indices := []int{}
157		if selectedIndex > 0 {
158			indices = append(indices, selectedIndex)
159		} else {
160			for index := 1; index < len(context.Checkouts); index++ {
161				indices = append(indices, index)
162			}
163		}
164		if len(indices) == 0 {
165			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
166		}
167		var reasons []assessment.Reason
168		hasUnknown := context.RuntimeErr != nil
169		if hasUnknown {
170			reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
171				Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "worktrees",
172				Detail:      "worktree runtime coverage could not be collected",
173				Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
174			})
175		}
176		for _, index := range indices {
177			checkout := context.Checkouts[index]
178			subject := fmt.Sprintf("worktree:%d", index)
179			switch {
180			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
181				hasUnknown = true
182				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-path-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path could not be inspected", Remediation: "restore path access and rerun context"})
183			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
184				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-missing", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path is missing or prunable", Remediation: "repair or remove the stale worktree registration"})
185			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
186				hasUnknown = true
187				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-status-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "Git status could not be collected for the worktree", Remediation: "repair the worktree and rerun context"})
188			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
189				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-locked", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree is locked", Remediation: "verify the lock owner before unlocking it"})
190			case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
191				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-conflicted", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree has unmerged paths", Remediation: "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement"})
192			case checkout.Status.Dirty():
193				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-dirty", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree contains uncommitted changes", Remediation: "commit or deliberately preserve the changes"})
194			case len(checkout.Sessions) > 0:
195				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-runtime-live", Subject: subject, Detail: "a runtime session still covers the worktree", Remediation: "quiesce and close the runtime before retirement"})
196			}
197		}
198		if len(reasons) == 0 {
199			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
200		}
201		if hasKnownBlocker(reasons) {
202			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
203		}
204		if hasUnknown {
205			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
206		}
207		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
208	}
209
210	func blocked(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
211		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
212	}
213
214	func indeterminate(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
215		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
216	}
217
218	func hasReason(reasons []assessment.Reason, code string) bool {
219		for _, reason := range reasons {
220			if reason.Code == code {
221				return true
222			}
223		}
224		return false
225	}
226
227	func hasKnownBlocker(reasons []assessment.Reason) bool {
228		for _, reason := range reasons {
229			switch reason.Code {
230			case "worktree-missing", "worktree-locked", "worktree-conflicted", "worktree-dirty", "worktree-runtime-live":
231				return true
232			}
233		}
234		return false
235	}
236
```

25	func newRepoContextCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
26		var jsonOut, refresh bool
27		cmd := &cobra.Command{
28			Use:   "context [repo]",
29			Short: "Print agent-ready Git, worktree, runtime and task context",
30			Long: `Print a deterministic Markdown handoff or a versioned JSON report for one repository.
31
32	Local Git, task and runtime facts are always collected live. Forge and configured
33	fleet-host observations use their private caches by default and expose provenance,
34	age and collection errors; --refresh may contact forge providers and fleet hosts.
35	With no repository argument, the repository containing the current directory is
36	used, and a linked-worktree current directory remains the selected checkout while
37	the report still covers the whole clone.`,
38			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
39			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
40				ctx := ctxOf()
41				repository, selectedPath, err := resolveRepoContextTarget(ctx, app, args)
42				if err != nil {
43					return err
44				}
45				local := collectLocalRepoContext(ctx, app, repository, selectedPath, true)
46				now := time.Now().UTC()
47				forgeFacts := collectRepoContextForge(ctx, app, refresh, now)
48				fleetFacts := collectRepoContextFleet(ctx, app, refresh)
49				report, err := repocontext.Build(repocontext.BuildInput{
50					GeneratedAt: now, Context: local.Context,
51					SelectedCheckout: local.SelectedCheckout, SelectionErr: local.SelectionErr,
52					Topology: local.Topology, TopologyErr: local.TopologyErr,
53					Runtimes: local.Runtimes, Forge: forgeFacts, Fleet: fleetFacts,
54					Hostname: config.Hostname(),
55				})
56				if err != nil {
57					return err
58				}
59				if jsonOut {
60					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
61					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
62					return encoder.Encode(report)
63				}
64				legacy := inventory.FormatRepoContext(local.Context, -1)
65				fmt.Fprint(app.Out, repocontext.FormatMarkdown(report, legacy))
66				return nil
67			},
68		}
69		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit the additive schema-v1 JSON report")
70		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&refresh, "refresh", false, "refresh external forge and configured fleet observations")
71		return cmd
72	}
73
74	type localRepoContext struct {
75		Context          inventory.RepoContext
76		SelectedCheckout int
77		SelectionErr     error

80		Runtimes         []repocontext.RuntimeInput

83	// collectLocalRepoContext is the single CLI collector used by repo context and
84	// status. It executes only local Git/task/runtime probes; includeTopology adds
85	// repository-wide remote/ref facts but never performs fetch or other network I/O.
86	func collectLocalRepoContext(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, selectedPath string, includeTopology bool) localRepoContext {
87		var (
88			tasks    = []*task.Task{}
89			tasksErr error
90		)
91		if app.Tasks == nil {
92			tasksErr = errors.New("task store is unavailable")
93		} else {
94			listed, diagnostics, err := app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
95			if err != nil {
96				tasksErr = err
97			} else {
98				tasks = tasksForRepo(listed, repository)
99				for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
100					tasksErr = errors.Join(tasksErr, diagnostic)
101				}
102			}
103		}
104
105		rt := app.Runtime()
106		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
107		local := localRepoContext{
108			Context: inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, repository, tasks, sessions, rt.Name()),
109			Runtimes: []repocontext.RuntimeInput{{
110				Backend: rt.Name(), Available: rt.Available(), Sessions: sessions, Err: runtimeErr,
111			}},
112			SelectedCheckout: -1,
113		}
114		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
115		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
116		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
117			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
118		} else {
119			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
120		}
121		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
122			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
123		}
124		return local
125	}

127	func resolveRepoContextTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (repo.Repo, string, error) {
128		if len(args) == 1 {
129			resolved, _, err := resolveRepoRef(app, args[0])
130			if err != nil {
131				return repo.Repo{}, "", err
132			}
133			return resolved, resolved.Path, nil
134		}
135		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
136		if err != nil {
137			return repo.Repo{}, "", err
138		}
139		discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
140		if err != nil {
141			return repo.Repo{}, "", fmt.Errorf("%s is not a git repository — pass a repo", config.Contract(cwd))
142		}
143		selectedPath := discovered.Root
144		if selectedPath == "" {
145			selectedPath = discovered.MainRoot
146		}
147		return repo.Repo{
148			Name: discovered.Name, Path: discovered.MainRoot, RealPath: discovered.MainRoot,
149			GitDir: discovered.GitCommonDir, CommonDir: discovered.GitCommonDir,
150			MainRoot: discovered.MainRoot, HasGit: true, Bare: discovered.Bare,
151		}, selectedPath, nil
152	}

154	func collectRepoContextForge(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool, now time.Time) repocontext.ForgeInput {
155		cacheInput := func(cache forge.Cache, collectionErr error) repocontext.ForgeInput {
156			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
157			if forgeCacheStale(cache, app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, now) {
158				freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
159			}
160			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
161			if !cache.Complete || collectionErr != nil {
162				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
163			}
164			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
165				Authority: assessment.AuthorityCache, Freshness: freshness,
166				Completeness: completeness, ObservedAt: cache.FetchedAt,
167				Records: append([]forge.RemoteRepo{}, cache.Repos...),
168				Err:     errors.Join(collectionErr, forgeCacheErrors(cache)),
169			}
170		}
171
172		if !refresh {
173			cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
174			if !ok {
175				return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: errors.New("no cached forge inventory; rerun with --refresh to collect one")}
176			}
177			return cacheInput(cache, nil)
178		}
179
180		rows, collectionErr := collectRemotes(ctx, app)
181		records := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(rows))
182		for _, row := range rows {
183			records = append(records, row.Repo)
184		}
185		if collectionErr == nil {
186			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
187				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
188				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
189				Records: records,
190			}
191		}
192		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
193			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
194			if len(records) > 0 {
195				cached.Records = records
196			}
197			return cached
198		}
199		if len(records) > 0 {
200			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
201				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
202				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
203				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
204			}
205		}
206		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
207	}
208
209	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
210		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
211			return true
212		}
213		if ttl <= 0 {
214			return false
215		}
216		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
217	}
218
219	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
220		var providerErrors []error
221		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
222		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
223		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
224			name := string(kind)
225			kinds = append(kinds, name)
226			byKind[name] = status
227		}
228		sort.Strings(kinds)
229		for _, kind := range kinds {
230			status := byKind[kind]
231			if status.Error != "" {
232				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
233			} else if !status.Complete {
234				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
235			}
236		}
237		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
238	}
239
240	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
241		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
242		if err != nil {
243			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
244		}
245		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
246			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
247			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
248			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
249		}
250		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
251			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
252		}
253		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
254			return input
255		}
256		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
257		if parallel <= 0 {
258			parallel = 1
259		}
260		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
261		var wait sync.WaitGroup
262		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
263			wait.Add(1)
264			go func() {
265				defer wait.Done()
266				semaphore <- struct{}{}
267				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
268				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
269			}()
270		}
271		wait.Wait()
272		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
273			input.Err = err
274		}
275		return input
276	}

1	// Package safefile provides held-root filesystem operations for untrusted
2	// relative paths. It keeps traversal relative to os.Root handles, rejects links
3	// and special files, revalidates filesystem identity, and detects observable
4	// source mutation while reading.
5	package safefile
6
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"io/fs"
13		"os"
14
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
16	)
17
18	var (
19		// ErrChanged reports that a named root, child, or file no longer identifies
20		// the object observed by the caller.
21		ErrChanged = errors.New("filesystem object changed")
22		// ErrUnsafeType reports a symlink, reparse point, directory, or other
23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.
24		ErrUnsafeType = errors.New("unsafe filesystem object type")
25		// ErrFileLimit reports a regular file whose bytes exceed the read policy.
26		ErrFileLimit = errors.New("file size limit exceeded")
27	)
28
29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}
63
64	// OpenChildRoot opens one child directory through parent and proves that its
65	// name still identifies the held directory.
66	func OpenChildRoot(parent *os.Root, name string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
67		if parent == nil {
68			return nil, nil, errors.New("open child root: nil parent")
69		}
70		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
71			return nil, nil, err
72		}
73		before, err := parent.Lstat(name)
74		if err != nil {
75			return nil, nil, err
76		}
77		if unsafeLink(before) {
78			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q is a symlink or reparse point: %w", name, ErrUnsafeType)
79		}
80		if !before.IsDir() {
81			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a directory: %w", name, ErrUnsafeType)
82		}
83		child, err := parent.OpenRoot(name)
84		if err != nil {
85			return nil, nil, err
86		}
87		held, err := child.Stat(".")
88		if err != nil {
89			_ = child.Close()
90			return nil, nil, err
91		}
92		current, err := parent.Lstat(name)
93		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
94			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
95			_ = child.Close()
96			if err != nil {
97				return nil, nil, err
98			}
99			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q changed while opening: %w", name, ErrChanged)
100		}
101		return child, held, nil

104	// VerifyRoot proves that path still names the previously held root directory.
105	func VerifyRoot(path string, expected fs.FileInfo) error {
106		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
107		if err != nil {
108			return err
109		}

111			return fmt.Errorf("root path changed: %w", ErrChanged)

114	}

117	// child directory.
118	func VerifyChildRoot(parent *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo) error {
119		if parent == nil {
120			return errors.New("verify child root: nil parent")
121		}

123			return err
124		}

126		if err != nil {
127			return err
128		}
129		if expected == nil || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() || !os.SameFile(expected, current) {
130			return fmt.Errorf("component %q changed: %w", name, ErrChanged)
131		}

135	// ReadStableRegular reads one child file while proving that the directory name,
136	// opened descriptor, and final directory name all identify the expected regular
137	// file with unchanged observable metadata. maxBytes must be non-negative; zero
138	// means unbounded. Supplying the FileInfo from an earlier directory listing
139	// detects replacement or mutation between selection and opening.
140	func ReadStableRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
141		if root == nil {
142			return nil, nil, errors.New("read stable file: nil root")
143		}
144		if maxBytes < 0 {
145			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("negative maximum file size: %w", ErrFileLimit)
146		}
147		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
148			return nil, nil, err
149		}
150		before, err := root.Lstat(name)
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, nil, err
153		}
154		if expected == nil {
155			expected = before
156		}
157		if unsafeLink(before) || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
158			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is not a regular file: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
159		}
160		if !sameStableSourceState(expected, before) {
161			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed before opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
162		}
163		if maxBytes > 0 && before.Size() > maxBytes {
164			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", before.Size(), maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
165		}
166
167		file, err := openRegularForRead(root, name)
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, nil, err
170		}
171		defer file.Close()
172		opened, err := file.Stat()
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, nil, err
175		}
176		if unsafeLink(opened) || !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(expected, opened) {
177			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
178		}
179		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, nil, err
182		}
183		if unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, current) {
184			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
185		}
186
187		data, err := readAllContext(ctx, file, maxBytes)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, nil, err
190		}
191		after, err := file.Stat()
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, nil, err
194		}
195		current, err = root.Lstat(name)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, nil, err
198		}
199		if unsafeLink(after) || unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, after) ||
200			!sameStableSourceState(after, current) || after.Size() != int64(len(data)) {
201			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed during read: %w", ErrChanged)
202		}
203		return data, opened, nil
204	}
205
206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}
213
214	func sameStableSourceState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
215		return SameFileState(left, right) && samePlatformState(left, right)
216	}
217
218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}
243
244	func unsafeLink(info fs.FileInfo) bool {
245		return info != nil && (info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || isReparsePoint(info))
246	}

22	// OwnerPrivateMode returns 0600, or 0700 when executable content was explicitly
23	// authorized.
24	func OwnerPrivateMode(executable bool) fs.FileMode {
25		if executable {
26			return 0o700
27		}
28		return 0o600
29	}

31	// CreateNoClobber stages data in an unguessable owner-private file, syncs it,
32	// applies finalMode, and atomically hard-links it to the absent destination.
33	// The hard-link publication is same-directory and cannot replace an existing
34	// path. This generic helper exists so callers such as repotemplate can preserve
35	// intentional public modes; secret-bearing callers should use
36	// CreatePrivateNoClobber.
37	func CreateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
38		if root == nil {
39			return nil, errors.New("atomic create: nil root")
40		}
41		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
42			return nil, err
43		}
44		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, err
47		}
48		defer func() {
49			if stagedName != "" {
50				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
51			}
52		}()
53		if err := root.Link(stagedName, name); err != nil {
54			return nil, fmt.Errorf("publish %q without replacement: %w", name, err)
55		}
56		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify published file %q: %w", name, err)
59		}
60		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
61			return nil, fmt.Errorf("published file %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
62		}
63		if err := root.Remove(stagedName); err != nil {
64			return nil, fmt.Errorf("remove staging link for %q: %w", name, err)
65		}
66		stagedName = ""
67		published, err = root.Lstat(name)
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, fmt.Errorf("refresh published file %q: %w", name, err)
70		}
71		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
72			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after creating %q: %w", name, err)
73		}
74		return published, nil
75	}

77	// CreatePrivateNoClobber is CreateNoClobber with a clamped owner-only final
78	// mode. executable is the only way to grant execute permission.
79	func CreatePrivateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
80		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
82		}
83		return CreateNoClobber(ctx, root, name, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
84	}

86	// AtomicReplace stages and syncs data in the target directory, revalidates the
87	// existing regular file against observed, and atomically renames the staged file
88	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
89	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
90	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
91	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
92	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.
93	func AtomicReplace(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
94		if root == nil {
95			return nil, errors.New("atomic replace: nil root")
96		}
97		if observed == nil {
98			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replace %q without observed state: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
99		}
100		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)
107		if err != nil {
108			return nil, err
109		}
110		defer func() {
111			if stagedName != "" {
112				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
113			}
114		}()
115		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
116			return nil, err
117		}
118		if err := root.Rename(stagedName, name); err != nil {
119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("atomically replace %q: %w", name, err)
120		}
121		stagedName = ""
122		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
123		if err != nil {
124			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
125		}
126		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
127			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
128		}
129		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
130			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
131		}
132		return published, nil
133	}
134
135	// AtomicReplacePrivate is AtomicReplace with owner-only final permissions.
136	func AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
137		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
138			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)

143	func verifyReplaceTarget(root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo) error {

154	func stageRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (string, fs.FileInfo, error) {
155		if finalMode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
156			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported final file mode %s", finalMode)
157		}
158		var name string
159		var writer *os.File
160		for attempt := 0; attempt < 32; attempt++ {
161			candidate, err := randomStageName()
162			if err != nil {
163				return "", nil, err
164			}
165			writer, err = root.OpenFile(candidate, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)

168				break

170			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
171				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("create private staging file: %w", err)
172			}
173		}
174		if writer == nil {
175			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
176		}
177		keep := true
178		defer func() {
179			if keep {
180				_ = writer.Close()
181				_ = root.Remove(name)
182			}
183		}()
184		if err := writeAllContext(ctx, writer, data); err != nil {

186		}

188			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("set staged file mode: %w", err)
189		}
190		if err := writer.Sync(); err != nil {
191			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("sync staged file: %w", err)
192		}
193		opened, err := writer.Stat()
194		if err != nil {
195			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect staged file: %w", err)
196		}
197		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
198			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("close staged file: %w", err)
199		}
200		keep = false
201		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
202		if err != nil {
203			_ = root.Remove(name)
204			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("reopen staged file name: %w", err)
205		}
206		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(opened, current) {
207			_ = root.Remove(name)

209		}
210		return name, current, nil
211	}

213	func validateTargetName(name string) error {

215			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
216		}
217		return nil
218	}
219
220	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
221		for len(data) > 0 {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return err
224			}
225			written, err := writer.Write(data)
226			if err != nil {
227				return err
228			}
229			if written == 0 {
230				return io.ErrShortWrite
231			}
232			data = data[written:]
233		}
234		return context.Cause(ctx)
235	}
236
237	func randomStageName() (string, error) {
238		var random [16]byte
239		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
240			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
241		}
242		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
243	}

+// ImportConflictError describes why an exact-ID import could not be reconciled.
+// ExistingID names the local owner when Field is a target location path.
+type ImportConflictError struct {
+	ID         string
+	ExistingID string
+	Field      string
+	Reason     string
+}
+
+func (e *ImportConflictError) Error() string {
+	detail := e.Reason
+	if detail == "" {
+		detail = "imported value disagrees with durable state"
+	}
+	if e.ExistingID != "" && e.ExistingID != e.ID {
+		return fmt.Sprintf("catalog asset %s conflicts with asset %s on %s: %s: %v",
+			e.ID, e.ExistingID, e.Field, detail, ErrConflict)
+	}
+	if e.Field != "" {
+		return fmt.Sprintf("catalog asset %s conflicts on %s: %s: %v", e.ID, e.Field, detail, ErrConflict)
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf("catalog asset %s: %s: %v", e.ID, detail, ErrConflict)
+}
+

+// PortablePathLimits bounds the encoded path, each encoded component, and path
+// depth. Zero means unbounded for that field; negative values are invalid.
+// File-count and byte-size ceilings live in safefile because they describe a
+// collection of files rather than a path.
+type PortablePathLimits struct {
+	MaxPathBytes      int
+	MaxComponentBytes int
+	MaxDepth          int
+}
+
+// ValidatePortableSlashPath accepts only a non-empty, clean, slash-separated
+// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects
+// Git metadata aliases, platform-specific separators and volumes, Windows
+// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
+// invalid UTF-8.
+func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
+	if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if value == "" {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path is empty: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains a backslash path separator: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" || driveQualified(value) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path %q is absolute, drive-qualified, or UNC: %w", value, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if limits.MaxPathBytes > 0 && len(value) > limits.MaxPathBytes {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(value), limits.MaxPathBytes, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	components := strings.Split(value, "/")
+	if limits.MaxDepth > 0 && len(components) > limits.MaxDepth {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path has %d components; maximum is %d: %w", len(components), limits.MaxDepth, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	for _, component := range components {
+		if component == ".." {
+			return fmt.Errorf("path contains parent traversal: %w", ErrTraversal)
+		}
+		if err := ValidatePortableComponent(component, limits.MaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q: %w", component, err)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ValidatePortableComponent applies the per-component part of
+// ValidatePortableSlashPath. maxBytes may be zero for no size limit.
+func ValidatePortableComponent(component string, maxBytes int) error {
+	if maxBytes < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("negative component limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if !utf8.ValidString(component) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("component contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", err, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if maxBytes > 0 && len(component) > maxBytes {
+		return fmt.Errorf("component is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(component), maxBytes, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if strings.IndexFunc(component, isPortableControl) >= 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component contains control characters: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	windowsAlias := strings.TrimRight(component, ". ")
+	if strings.EqualFold(windowsAlias, ".git") {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains reserved Git metadata: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if windowsAlias != component {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q has a trailing dot or space and is not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q contains characters that are not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if windowsReservedName(component) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q is a reserved Windows device name: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ValidatePortablePathSet validates every path and rejects collisions at any
+// component boundary after Unicode normalization and full Unicode case folding.
+// Exact duplicate paths are left to the caller's type/cardinality policy.
+func ValidatePortablePathSet(paths []string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
+	type collisionNode struct {
+		spelling string
+		first    string
+		children map[string]*collisionNode
+	}
+	root := &collisionNode{children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
+	for _, value := range paths {
+		if err := ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, limits); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("portable path %q: %w", value, err)
+		}
+		current := root
+		for _, component := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
+			key := portableCollisionKey(component)
+			next, exists := current.children[key]
+			if exists && next.spelling != component {
+				return fmt.Errorf("paths %q and %q collide on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems at %q and %q: %w",
+					next.first, value, next.spelling, component, ErrPathCollision)
+			}
+			if !exists {
+				next = &collisionNode{spelling: component, first: value, children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
+				current.children[key] = next
+			}
+			current = next
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func portableCollisionKey(component string) string {
+	return norm.NFC.String(cases.Fold().String(norm.NFC.String(component)))
+}
+
+func isPortableControl(r rune) bool {
+	return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
+}
+
+func windowsReservedName(component string) bool {
+	base := component
+	if dot := strings.IndexByte(base, '.'); dot >= 0 {
+		base = base[:dot]
+	}
+	base = strings.TrimRight(base, " ")
+	upper := strings.ToUpper(base)
+	switch upper {
+	case "CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", "CONIN$", "CONOUT$", "CLOCK$":
+		return true
+	}
+	if len([]rune(upper)) != 4 {
+		return false
+	}
+	runes := []rune(upper)
+	prefix := string(runes[:3])
+	if prefix != "COM" && prefix != "LPT" {
+		return false
+	}
+	last := runes[3]
+	return last >= '1' && last <= '9' || last == '¹' || last == '²' || last == '³'
+}

97					case record.Fence != nil:

248	// WithMutation runs an ordinary mutator only when no requested key is reserved
249	// or fenced. A branch key automatically includes its repository ancestor so a

256	// WithGuard permits the exact owner of an active reservation or fence to work

260	func (a *Authority) WithGuard(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token *Token, operation func() error) error {
261		if a == nil {

347		var result []Record
348		err := a.withKeyLocks(ctx, keys, func(canonical []Key) error {
349			return a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
350				result = make([]Record, 0, len(canonical))
351				for _, key := range canonical {
352					if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
353						result = append(result, cloneRecord(*record))
354					} else {
355						result = append(result, Record{Key: key})
356					}
357				}
358				return nil
359			})
360		})
361		return result, err
362	}

364	func mutationKeys(keys []Key) []Key {
365		expanded := append([]Key(nil), keys...)
366		for _, key := range keys {
367			if key.Scope == ScopeBranch {
368				expanded = append(expanded, RepositoryKey(key.Repository))
369			}

374	func (a *Authority) withKeyLocks(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func([]Key) error) error {
375		canonical, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
376		if err != nil {
377			return err
378		}
379		if ctx == nil {
380			ctx = context.Background()
381		}
382		if err := a.ensureLayout(); err != nil {
383			return err
384		}
385		var acquire func(int) error
386		acquire = func(index int) error {
387			if index == len(canonical) {
388				return operation(canonical)
389			}
390			directory := a.keyLockDir(canonical[index])
391			if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
392				return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation key lock: %w", err)
393			}
394			return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease key", func() error { return acquire(index + 1) })
395		}
396		return acquire(0)
397	}

400		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
401			state, err := a.loadState()
402			if err != nil {
403				return err
404			}
405			changed, err := mutate(&state)
406			if err != nil || !changed {
407				return err
408			}
409			return a.writeState(state)
410		})
411	}

448	func (a *Authority) loadState() (Snapshot, error) {
449		path := a.statePath()
450		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
451		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
452			return Snapshot{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}, nil
453		}
454		if err != nil {
455			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state: %w", err)
456		}
457		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
458			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s is not a regular file", path)
459		}
460		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
461		if err != nil {
462			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state permissions: %w", err)
463		}
464		if !private {
465			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
466		}
467		file, err := os.Open(path)
468		if err != nil {
469			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("open operation lease state: %w", err)
470		}
471		defer file.Close()
472		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
473		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
474		var state Snapshot
475		if err := decoder.Decode(&state); err != nil {
476			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state: %w", err)
477		}
478		var extra any
479		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
480			if err == nil {
481				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("decode operation lease state: multiple JSON values")
482			}
483			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state trailing data: %w", err)
484		}
485		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
486			return Snapshot{}, err
487		}
488		canonical := canonicalSnapshot(state)
489		encodedState, _ := json.Marshal(state)
490		encodedCanonical, _ := json.Marshal(canonical)
491		if string(encodedState) != string(encodedCanonical) {
492			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("operation lease state is not in canonical order")
493		}
494		return state, nil
495	}

497	func (a *Authority) writeState(state Snapshot) error {
498		state = canonicalSnapshot(state)
499		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
500			return err
501		}
502		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
503			return err
504		}
505		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(a.root, ".authority-*.tmp")
506		if err != nil {
507			return fmt.Errorf("create operation lease state temp file: %w", err)
508		}
509		name := temporary.Name()
510		defer os.Remove(name)
511		if err := setPrivateMode(name, 0o600); err != nil {
512			_ = temporary.Close()
513			return err
514		}
515		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)
516		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
517		if err := encoder.Encode(state); err != nil {
518			_ = temporary.Close()
519			return fmt.Errorf("encode operation lease state: %w", err)
520		}
521		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
522			_ = temporary.Close()
523			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease state: %w", err)
524		}
525		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
526			return fmt.Errorf("close operation lease state: %w", err)
527		}
528		if err := replaceFile(name, a.statePath()); err != nil {
529			return fmt.Errorf("publish operation lease state: %w", err)
530		}
531		if err := syncDirectory(a.root); err != nil {
532			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease directory: %w", err)
533		}
534		return nil
535	}

537	func validateSnapshot(state Snapshot) error {
538		if state.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
539			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease schema_version %d: want %d", state.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
540		}
541		bindings := make(map[string]string, len(state.Bindings))
542		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
543			if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
544				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease binding: %w", err)
545			}
546			if _, exists := bindings[binding.OperationID]; exists {
547				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease repeats binding %s", binding.OperationID)
548			}
549			bindings[binding.OperationID] = binding.Digest
550		}
551		type activeSignature struct {
552			Token     Token
553			MachineID string
554			Kind      string
555		}
556		activeOperations := make(map[string]activeSignature)
557		terminalOperations := make(map[string]Tombstone)
558		seenKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(state.Records))
559		var maxRecordEpoch uint64
560		for _, record := range state.Records {
561			if err := record.Key.Validate(); err != nil {
562				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease record: %w", err)
563			}
564			canonicalKey := record.Key.canonical()
565			if _, exists := seenKeys[canonicalKey]; exists {
566				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease state repeats key %s", record.Key.subject())
567			}
568			seenKeys[canonicalKey] = struct{}{}
569			if record.Epoch == 0 || record.Epoch > state.LastEpoch {
570				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has invalid epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), record.Epoch)
571			}
572			if record.Epoch > maxRecordEpoch {
573				maxRecordEpoch = record.Epoch
574			}
575			if record.Reservation != nil && record.Fence != nil {
576				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has both reservation and fence", record.Key.subject())
577			}
578			for _, named := range []struct {
579				name  string
580				claim *Claim
581			}{{"reservation", record.Reservation}, {"fence", record.Fence}} {
582				if named.claim == nil {
583					continue
584				}
585				if err := named.claim.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
586					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s: %w", named.name, record.Key.subject(), err)
587				}
588				if digest, exists := bindings[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != named.claim.Token.Digest {
589					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no matching permanent binding", named.name, record.Key.subject())
590				}
591				if named.claim.Token.Epoch != record.Epoch {
592					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has epoch %d, record has %d", named.name, record.Key.subject(), named.claim.Token.Epoch, record.Epoch)
593				}
594				if named.claim.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
595					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no created_at", named.name, record.Key.subject())
596				}
597				if named.claim.MachineID != "" {
598					if err := machineid.Validate(named.claim.MachineID); err != nil {
599						return err
600					}
601				}
602				signature := activeSignature{Token: named.claim.Token, MachineID: named.claim.MachineID, Kind: named.name}
603				if prior, exists := activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; exists {
604					if !prior.Token.matches(signature.Token) || prior.MachineID != signature.MachineID || prior.Kind != signature.Kind {
605						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent active claims", named.claim.Token.OperationID)
606					}
607				} else {
608					activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID] = signature
609				}
610			}
611			seenTombstones := make(map[string]struct{}, len(record.Tombstones))
612			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
613				switch tombstone.Kind {
614				case TombstoneAborted, TombstoneReturned:
615				default:
616					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has unknown tombstone kind %q", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.Kind)
617				}
618				if err := tombstone.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
619					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s: %w", record.Key.subject(), err)
620				}
621				if digest, exists := bindings[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != tombstone.Token.Digest {
622					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no matching permanent binding", record.Key.subject())
623				}
624				if tombstone.AdvancedEpoch <= tombstone.Token.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > record.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > state.LastEpoch {
625					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has invalid advanced epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.AdvancedEpoch)
626				}
627				if tombstone.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
628					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no created_at", record.Key.subject())
629				}
630				if prior, exists := terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; exists {
631					if !prior.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || prior.Kind != tombstone.Kind || prior.AdvancedEpoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
632						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent terminal records", tombstone.Token.OperationID)
633					}
634				} else {
635					terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID] = tombstone
636				}
637				identity := fmt.Sprintf("%s\x00%s\x00%d", tombstone.Token.OperationID, tombstone.Token.Digest, tombstone.Token.Epoch)
638				if _, exists := seenTombstones[identity]; exists {
639					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s repeats a terminal token", record.Key.subject())
640				}
641				seenTombstones[identity] = struct{}{}
642				if record.Reservation != nil && record.Reservation.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || record.Fence != nil && record.Fence.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) {
643					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has a terminal token still active", record.Key.subject())
644				}
645			}
646		}
647		if state.LastEpoch != maxRecordEpoch {
648			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease last_epoch %d does not match latest record epoch %d", state.LastEpoch, maxRecordEpoch)
649		}
650		for operationID := range activeOperations {
651			if _, terminal := terminalOperations[operationID]; terminal {
652				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s is both active and terminal", operationID)
653			}
654		}
655		return nil
656	}

695	func cloneRecord(record Record) Record {

916			return 0, false, nil

918		if matched != len(keys) {
919			return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal on only part of the key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
920		}
921		return epoch, true, nil
922	}

924	func ensurePrivateDir(path string) error {
925		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
926			return err
927		}
928		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
929		if err != nil {
930			return err
931		}
932		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
933			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a private directory", path)
934		}
935		if err := setPrivateMode(path, 0o700); err != nil {
936			return err
937		}
938		info, err = os.Lstat(path)
939		if err != nil {
940			return err
941		}
942		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o700)
943		if err != nil {
944			return fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease directory permissions: %w", err)
945		}
946		if !private {
947			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease directory %s permissions are not private (want 0700 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
948		}

1	package assessment

3	import "fmt"

5	// ReduceOutcomes combines independent requirements using the fail-closed
6	// precedence blocked > indeterminate > eligible > not-applicable. No evidence
7	// is itself indeterminate.
8	func ReduceOutcomes(outcomes ...Outcome) Outcome {
9		if len(outcomes) == 0 {
10			return OutcomeIndeterminate
11		}
12		result := OutcomeNotApplicable
13		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
14			switch outcome {
15			case OutcomeBlocked:
16				return OutcomeBlocked
17			case OutcomeIndeterminate:
18				result = OutcomeIndeterminate
19			case OutcomeEligible:
20				if result == OutcomeNotApplicable {
21					result = OutcomeEligible
22				}
23			case OutcomeNotApplicable:
24			default:
25				return OutcomeIndeterminate
26			}
27		}
28		return result
29	}
30
31	// Reduce applies source-quality policy after reducing requirement outcomes.
32	// Cheap reports retain the observed result for display. Deep reports downgrade
33	// any conclusive result to indeterminate unless every relied-on source is fresh,
34	// complete, and backed by a live authority.
35	func Reduce(profile Profile, sources []Source, outcomes ...Outcome) (Outcome, error) {
36		if err := profile.Validate(); err != nil {
37			return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
38		}
39		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
40			if err := outcome.Validate(); err != nil {
41				return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
42			}
43		}
44		for _, source := range sources {
45			if err := source.Validate(); err != nil {
46				return OutcomeIndeterminate, fmt.Errorf("reduce assessment source: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		result := ReduceOutcomes(outcomes...)
50		if result == OutcomeNotApplicable || result == OutcomeIndeterminate {
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		if len(sources) == 0 {
54			return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
55		}
56		if profile == ProfileDeep {
57			for _, source := range sources {
58				if !source.conclusive() {
59					return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
60				}
61			}
62		}
63		return result, nil
64	}
65

224	// NewReport constructs, canonicalizes, and seals a report.
225	func NewReport(profile Profile, generatedAt time.Time, gates []Gate) (Report, error) {
226		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Profile: profile, GeneratedAt: generatedAt, Gates: gates}
227		if err := report.Seal(); err != nil {
228			return Report{}, err
229		}
230		return report, nil
231	}
232
233	// Seal canonicalizes the report and records a fingerprint over every field
234	// except Fingerprint itself.
235	func (r *Report) Seal() error {
236		if r == nil {
237			return errors.New("seal nil assessment report")
238		}
239		if r.SchemaVersion == 0 {
240			r.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
241		}
242		canonical := r.Canonical()
243		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
244		if err := canonical.validateContent(); err != nil {
245			return err
246		}
247		fingerprint, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
248		if err != nil {
249			return err
250		}
251		canonical.Fingerprint = fingerprint
252		*r = canonical
253		return nil
254	}
255
256	// Validate verifies the schema, policy invariants, canonical fingerprint, and
257	// deterministic ordering of a sealed report.
258	func (r Report) Validate() error {
259		if err := r.validateContent(); err != nil {
260			return err
261		}
262		if !ValidFingerprint(r.Fingerprint) {
263			return fmt.Errorf("invalid report fingerprint %q", r.Fingerprint)
264		}
265		canonical := r.Canonical()
266		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
267		want, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		if r.Fingerprint != want {
272			return fmt.Errorf("assessment fingerprint mismatch: got %s, want %s", r.Fingerprint, want)
273		}
274		if !reportsEqualOrdering(r, r.Canonical()) {
275			return errors.New("assessment report is not in canonical order")
276		}
277		return nil
278	}
279
280	func (r Report) validateContent() error {
281		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
282			return fmt.Errorf("assessment schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
283		}
284		if err := r.Profile.Validate(); err != nil {
285			return err
286		}
287		if r.GeneratedAt.IsZero() {
288			return errors.New("assessment generated_at is required")
289		}
290		seenGates := make(map[string]struct{}, len(r.Gates))
291		for _, gate := range r.Gates {
292			if err := gate.Validate(r.Profile); err != nil {
293				return err
294			}
295			if _, exists := seenGates[gate.Code]; exists {
296				return fmt.Errorf("assessment repeats gate %q", gate.Code)
297			}
298			seenGates[gate.Code] = struct{}{}
299		}
300		return nil
301	}

303	// Canonical returns a deep copy with UTC timestamps and order-insensitive
304	// collections sorted by their complete stable representation.
305	func (r Report) Canonical() Report {
306		result := r
307		result.GeneratedAt = canonicalTime(result.GeneratedAt)
308		result.Gates = make([]Gate, len(r.Gates))
309		copy(result.Gates, r.Gates)
310		for gateIndex := range result.Gates {
311			gate := &result.Gates[gateIndex]
312			gate.Sources = append([]Source(nil), gate.Sources...)
313			for sourceIndex := range gate.Sources {
314				gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt = canonicalTime(gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt)
315			}
316			sort.Slice(gate.Sources, func(i, j int) bool {
317				left, right := gate.Sources[i], gate.Sources[j]
318				return strings.Join([]string{left.ID, string(left.Authority), string(left.Freshness), string(left.Completeness), left.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), left.Fingerprint}, "\x00") <
319					strings.Join([]string{right.ID, string(right.Authority), string(right.Freshness), string(right.Completeness), right.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), right.Fingerprint}, "\x00")
320			})
321			gate.Reasons = append([]Reason(nil), gate.Reasons...)
322			sort.Slice(gate.Reasons, func(i, j int) bool {
323				left, right := gate.Reasons[i], gate.Reasons[j]
324				return strings.Join([]string{left.Code, left.Subject, left.Detail, left.Remediation}, "\x00") <
325					strings.Join([]string{right.Code, right.Subject, right.Detail, right.Remediation}, "\x00")
326			})
327		}
328		sort.Slice(result.Gates, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Gates[i].Code < result.Gates[j].Code })
329		return result
330	}

332	func (r Report) computeFingerprint() (string, error) {
333		payload := struct {
334			SchemaVersion int       `json:"schema_version"`
335			Profile       Profile   `json:"profile"`
336			GeneratedAt   time.Time `json:"generated_at"`
337			Gates         []Gate    `json:"gates"`
338		}{r.SchemaVersion, r.Profile, r.GeneratedAt, r.Gates}
339		encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
340		if err != nil {
341			return "", fmt.Errorf("encode assessment fingerprint: %w", err)
342		}
343		return FingerprintBytes(encoded), nil
344	}
345
346	// Decode reads exactly one strict schema-v1 report and verifies its seal.
347	func Decode(reader io.Reader) (Report, error) {
348		if reader == nil {
349			return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment from nil reader")
350		}
351		decoder := json.NewDecoder(reader)
352		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
353		var report Report
354		if err := decoder.Decode(&report); err != nil {
355			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment: %w", err)
356		}
357		var extra any
358		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
359			if err == nil {
360				return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment: multiple JSON values")
361			}
362			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment trailing data: %w", err)
363		}
364		if err := report.Validate(); err != nil {
365			return Report{}, err
366		}
367		return report, nil
368	}
369
370	func FingerprintBytes(value []byte) string {
371		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
372		return fingerprintPrefix + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
373	}
374
375	func ValidFingerprint(value string) bool {
376		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix) || len(value) != len(fingerprintPrefix)+sha256.Size*2 {
377			return false
378		}
379		digest := strings.TrimPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix)
380		if digest != strings.ToLower(digest) {
381			return false
382		}
383		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(digest)
384		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size
385	}
386
387	func validateText(name, value string, required bool) error {
388		if value == "" {
389			if required {
390				return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
391			}
392			return nil
393		}
394		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
395			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
396		}
397		if value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
398			return fmt.Errorf("%s must be trimmed", name)
399		}
400		for _, char := range value {
401			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
402				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
403			}
404		}
405		return nil
406	}
407
408	func canonicalTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
409		if value.IsZero() {
410			return value
411		}
412		return value.Round(0).UTC()
413	}
414
415	func reportsEqualOrdering(left, right Report) bool {
416		leftJSON, leftErr := json.Marshal(left)
417		rightJSON, rightErr := json.Marshal(right)
418		return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && string(leftJSON) == string(rightJSON)
419	}

156	func validatePasswordSource(host string, source PasswordSource) error {

161		switch kind {
162		case "none", "prompt":
163			return nil
164		case "plain":

166				return fmt.Errorf("host %q plain ssh_login_password_source requires value", host)
167			}

171			}
172		default:

174		}

196	func CheckPrivateMode(path string, cfg Config) error {

201				break
202			}
203		}

213		}

281				if file.TargetMode != "" && !validFileMode(file.TargetMode) {
282					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an invalid target mode", spec.Path)
283				}
284			default:
285				return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an unknown action", spec.Path)
286			}
287		}
288		if !validDigest(r.PlanDigest) || r.PlanDigest != planDigest(request, r) {
289			return errors.New("plan response digest does not match")
290		}
291		return nil
292	}
293
294	type Payload struct {
295		Path    string `json:"path"`
296		Content string `json:"content_base64"`
297	}
298
299	type ApplyEnvelope struct {
300		SchemaVersion   int          `json:"schema_version"`
301		ProtocolVersion int          `json:"protocol_version"`
302		Request         PlanRequest  `json:"request"`
303		Plan            PlanResponse `json:"plan"`
304		RetainForEvict  bool         `json:"retain_for_evict"`
305		Payloads        []Payload    `json:"payloads"`
306	}
307
308	type ApplyResponse struct {
309		SchemaVersion   int          `json:"schema_version"`
310		ProtocolVersion int          `json:"protocol_version"`
311		RequestID       string       `json:"request_id"`
312		PlanDigest      string       `json:"plan_digest"`
313		Files           []PublicFile `json:"files"`
314	}
315
316	func (r ApplyResponse) PublicReport() Report {
317		return Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Files: append([]PublicFile(nil), r.Files...)}
318	}
319
320	func (r ApplyResponse) Validate(request PlanRequest, plan PlanResponse) error {
321		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || r.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion ||
322			r.RequestID != request.RequestID || r.PlanDigest != plan.PlanDigest || len(r.Files) != len(request.Files) {
323			return errors.New("apply response binding does not match plan")
324		}
325		for index, file := range r.Files {
326			spec := request.Files[index]
327			if file.Path != spec.Path || file.Size != spec.Size || file.Mode != spec.Mode || !file.State.validResult() {
328				return fmt.Errorf("apply response metadata for %q does not match plan", spec.Path)
329			}
330			expected := StateCurrent
331			switch plan.Files[index].Action {
332			case actionCreate:
333				expected = StateCreated
334			case actionReplace:
335				expected = StateReplaced
336			case actionCurrent:
337			default:
338				return fmt.Errorf("apply response action for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
339			}
340			if file.State != expected {
341				return fmt.Errorf("apply response state for %q does not match plan", spec.Path)
342			}
343		}
344		return nil
345	}
346
347	func manifestDigest(request PlanRequest) string {
348		payload := struct {
349			Domain    string           `json:"domain"`
350			RequestID string           `json:"request_id"`
351			Binding   Binding          `json:"binding"`
352			Limits    fleet.FileLimits `json:"limits"`
353			Replace   bool             `json:"replace"`
354			Files     []FileSpec       `json:"files"`
355		}{"dev-local-files-manifest-v1", request.RequestID, request.Binding, request.Limits, request.Replace, request.Files}
356		return digestJSON(payload)
357	}
358
359	func planDigest(request PlanRequest, response PlanResponse) string {
360		files := append([]PlanFile(nil), response.Files...)
361		payload := struct {
362			Domain         string     `json:"domain"`
363			ManifestDigest string     `json:"manifest_digest"`
364			TargetMachine  string     `json:"target_machine_id"`
365			TargetCheckout string     `json:"target_checkout_id"`
366			Files          []PlanFile `json:"files"`
367		}{"dev-local-files-plan-v1", request.ManifestDigest, response.TargetMachine, response.TargetCheckout, files}
368		return digestJSON(payload)
369	}
370
371	func digestJSON(value any) string {
372		data, _ := json.Marshal(value)
373		digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
374		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
375	}
376
377	func digestBytes(value []byte) string {
378		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
379		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
380	}
381
382	func validDigest(value string) bool {
383		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != len("sha256:")+sha256.Size*2 {
384			return false
385		}
386		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"))
387		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size && value == strings.ToLower(value)
388	}
389
390	func validOID(value string) bool {
391		if len(value) != 40 && len(value) != 64 || value != strings.ToLower(value) {
392			return false
393		}
394		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
395		return err == nil
396	}
397
398	func validFileMode(value string) bool {
399		if len(value) != 4 {
400			return false
401		}
402		mode, err := strconv.ParseUint(value, 8, 12)
403		return err == nil && mode <= 0o777
404	}
405
406	func validateText(name, value string) error {
407		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
408			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
409		}
410		for _, r := range value {
411			if unicode.IsControl(r) {
412				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
413			}
414		}
415		return nil
416	}
417
418	func sortedPublic(files []PublicFile) []PublicFile {
419		result := append([]PublicFile(nil), files...)
420		sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].Path < result[j].Path })
421		return result
422	}

1	package localfiles

3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6
7		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/fleet"
8	)
9
10	var (
11		ErrNoRemoteDev     = errors.New("target does not provide a compatible dev protocol")
12		ErrUnreachable     = errors.New("target host is unreachable")
13		ErrRemoteTimeout   = errors.New("target protocol timed out")
14		ErrMachinePin      = errors.New("target machine ID does not match the configured host pin")
15		ErrMachineUnpinned = errors.New("mutating local-file apply requires host.machine_id")
16	)
17
18	type Runner interface {
19		RunWithOptions(context.Context, fleet.Host, []string, []byte, fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result
20	}
21
22	type Client struct{ Runner Runner }
23
24	func (c Client) run(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, maxResponse int64) ([]byte, error) {
25		if c.Runner == nil {
26			return nil, errors.New("local-files client has no fleet transport")
27		}
28		// Capability and plan are read-only. Apply is permanently bound to its
29		// request ID and plan digest by the target journal, so an authentication-only
30		// retry cannot duplicate an unbound mutation.
31		result := c.Runner.RunWithOptions(ctx, host, args, stdin, fleet.RunOptions{Retry: fleet.RetryAuthentication})
32		if int64(len(result.Stdout)) > maxResponse {
33			return nil, errors.New("target protocol response exceeded its bound")
34		}
35		if result.ExitCode == 0 && result.CaptureError == "" {
36			return result.Stdout, nil
37		}
38		switch {
39		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
40			return nil, ErrRemoteTimeout
41		case result.ExitCode == 127:
42			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
43		case result.ExitCode == 255:
44			return nil, ErrUnreachable
45		default:
46			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
47		}
48	}
49
50	// Identify performs the content-free capability exchange without enforcing the
51	// configured machine pin. It exists for explicit onboarding and diagnostics;
52	// mutating or payload-bearing callers must use Probe.
53	func (c Client) Identify(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
54		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
55		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
56		if err != nil {
57			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
58		}
59		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_capability"}, body, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
60		if err != nil {
61			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
62		}
63		var response fleet.CapabilityResponse
64		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes, &response); err != nil {
65			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
66		}
67		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
68			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
69		}
70		return response, nil
71	}
72
73	func (c Client) Probe(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
74		response, err := c.Identify(ctx, host)
75		if err != nil {
76			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
77		}
78		if host.MachineID != "" && host.MachineID != response.MachineID {
79			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
80		}
81		if !response.Supported {
82			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, errors.New("target does not support local-file payloads")
83		}
84		return response, nil
85	}
86
87	func (c Client) Plan(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
88		if capability.MachineID != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
89			return PlanResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
90		}
91		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
92			return PlanResponse{}, err
93		}
94		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
95		if err != nil {
96			return PlanResponse{}, err
97		}
98		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-plan"}, body, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
99		if err != nil {
100			return PlanResponse{}, err
101		}
102		var response PlanResponse
103		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes, &response); err != nil {
104			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
105		}
106		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
107			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
108		}
109		return response, nil
110	}
111
112	func (c Client) Apply(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
113		if host.MachineID == "" {
114			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachineUnpinned
115		}
116		if host.MachineID != capability.MachineID || envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine != capability.MachineID {
117			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
118		}
119		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
120			return ApplyResponse{}, err
121		}
122		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(envelope, MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes)
123		if err != nil {
124			return ApplyResponse{}, err
125		}
126		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-apply"}, body, MaxApplyResponseBytes)
127		if err != nil {
128			return ApplyResponse{}, err
129		}
130		var response ApplyResponse
131		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxApplyResponseBytes, &response); err != nil {
132			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
133		}
134		if err := response.Validate(envelope.Request, envelope.Plan); err != nil {
135			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
136		}
137		return response, nil
138	}

1	package localfiles
