3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6
7		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/fleet"
8	)
9
10	var (
11		ErrNoRemoteDev     = errors.New("target does not provide a compatible dev protocol")
12		ErrUnreachable     = errors.New("target host is unreachable")
13		ErrRemoteTimeout   = errors.New("target protocol timed out")
14		ErrMachinePin      = errors.New("target machine ID does not match the configured host pin")
15		ErrMachineUnpinned = errors.New("mutating local-file apply requires host.machine_id")
16	)
17
18	type Runner interface {
19		RunWithOptions(context.Context, fleet.Host, []string, []byte, fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result
20	}
21
22	type Client struct{ Runner Runner }
23
24	func (c Client) run(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, maxResponse int64) ([]byte, error) {
25		if c.Runner == nil {
26			return nil, errors.New("local-files client has no fleet transport")
27		}
28		// Capability and plan are read-only. Apply is permanently bound to its
29		// request ID and plan digest by the target journal, so an authentication-only
30		// retry cannot duplicate an unbound mutation.
31		result := c.Runner.RunWithOptions(ctx, host, args, stdin, fleet.RunOptions{Retry: fleet.RetryAuthentication})
32		if int64(len(result.Stdout)) > maxResponse {
33			return nil, errors.New("target protocol response exceeded its bound")
34		}
35		if result.ExitCode == 0 && result.CaptureError == "" {
36			return result.Stdout, nil
37		}
38		switch {
39		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
40			return nil, ErrRemoteTimeout
41		case result.ExitCode == 127:
42			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
43		case result.ExitCode == 255:
44			return nil, ErrUnreachable
45		default:
46			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
47		}
48	}
49
50	// Identify performs the content-free capability exchange without enforcing the
51	// configured machine pin. It exists for explicit onboarding and diagnostics;
52	// mutating or payload-bearing callers must use Probe.
53	func (c Client) Identify(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
54		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
55		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
56		if err != nil {
57			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
58		}
59		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_capability"}, body, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
60		if err != nil {
61			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
62		}
63		var response fleet.CapabilityResponse
64		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes, &response); err != nil {
65			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
66		}
67		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
68			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
69		}
70		return response, nil
71	}
72
73	func (c Client) Probe(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
74		response, err := c.Identify(ctx, host)
75		if err != nil {
76			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
77		}
78		if host.MachineID != "" && host.MachineID != response.MachineID {
79			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
80		}
81		if !response.Supported {
82			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, errors.New("target does not support local-file payloads")
83		}
84		return response, nil
85	}
86
87	func (c Client) Plan(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
88		if capability.MachineID != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
89			return PlanResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
90		}
91		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
92			return PlanResponse{}, err
93		}
94		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
95		if err != nil {
96			return PlanResponse{}, err
97		}
98		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-plan"}, body, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
99		if err != nil {
100			return PlanResponse{}, err
101		}
102		var response PlanResponse
103		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes, &response); err != nil {
104			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
105		}
106		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
107			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
108		}
109		return response, nil
110	}
111
112	func (c Client) Apply(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
113		if host.MachineID == "" {
114			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachineUnpinned
115		}
116		if host.MachineID != capability.MachineID || envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine != capability.MachineID {
117			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
118		}
119		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
120			return ApplyResponse{}, err
121		}
122		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(envelope, MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes)
123		if err != nil {
124			return ApplyResponse{}, err
125		}
126		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-apply"}, body, MaxApplyResponseBytes)
127		if err != nil {
128			return ApplyResponse{}, err
129		}
130		var response ApplyResponse
131		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxApplyResponseBytes, &response); err != nil {
132			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
133		}
134		if err := response.Validate(envelope.Request, envelope.Plan); err != nil {
135			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
136		}
137		return response, nil
138	}

25		// RequestID is a focused-test seam. Production leaves it empty.

29	// Source is an exact, content-addressed local manifest. It keeps no file bytes;
30	// BuildEnvelope reopens and rehashes each non-current source after target plan.
31	type Source struct {
32		checkout string
33		request  PlanRequest
34	}

36	func (s *Source) Request() PlanRequest { return s.request }

38	func PrepareSource(ctx context.Context, options SourceOptions) (*Source, Report, error) {
39		if err := options.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
40			return nil, Report{}, err
41		}
42		if err := options.Binding.Validate(); err != nil {
43			return nil, Report{}, err
44		}
45		paths, err := Expand(options.Checkout, options.Patterns, options.Limits)
46		if err != nil {
47			return nil, Report{}, err
48		}
49		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, options.Limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
50			return nil, Report{}, err
51		}
52		requestID := options.RequestID
53		if requestID == "" {
54			requestID = uuid.NewString()
55		}
56		request := PlanRequest{
57			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
58			RequestID: requestID, Binding: options.Binding, Limits: limitsToWire(options.Limits),
59			Replace: options.Replace,
60		}
61		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}
62		blocked := false
63		for _, path := range paths {
64			public := PublicFile{Path: path, Mode: "0600", State: StateFailed}
65			observed, observeErr := observePath(ctx, options.Checkout, path, options.Limits, true)
66			if observeErr != nil {
67				public.State = stateForError(observeErr)
68				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
69				blocked = true
70				continue
71			}
72			if !observed.exists {
73				public.State = StateMissing
74				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
75				blocked = true
76				continue
77			}
78			public.Size = observed.info.Size()
79			if observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0 {
80				public.Mode = "0700"
81			}
82			if eligibilityErr := proveGitEligibility(ctx, options.Checkout, path); eligibilityErr != nil {
83				public.State = stateForError(eligibilityErr)
84				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
85				blocked = true
86				continue
87			}
88			public.State = StateReady
89			report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
90			request.Files = append(request.Files, FileSpec{
91				Path: path, Size: observed.info.Size(), Mode: public.Mode, SHA256: observed.digest,
92			})
93		}
94		report.Files = sortedPublic(report.Files)
95		if blocked {
96			return nil, report, ErrPlanBlocked
97		}
98		sort.Slice(request.Files, func(i, j int) bool { return request.Files[i].Path < request.Files[j].Path })
99		request.ManifestDigest = manifestDigest(request)
100		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
101			return nil, report, err
102		}
103		return &Source{checkout: options.Checkout, request: request}, report, nil
104	}

106	// BuildEnvelope performs the source-side apply revalidation and includes bytes
107	// only for target actions that create or explicitly replace a file.
108	func (s *Source) BuildEnvelope(ctx context.Context, plan PlanResponse, retainForEvict bool) (ApplyEnvelope, error) {
109		if s == nil {
110			return ApplyEnvelope{}, errors.New("build local-files envelope from nil source")
111		}
112		if err := plan.Validate(s.request); err != nil {
113			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
114		}
115		envelope := ApplyEnvelope{
116			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
117			Request: s.request, Plan: plan, RetainForEvict: retainForEvict,
118		}
119		for index, planned := range plan.Files {
120			if planned.Action == actionCurrent {
121				continue
122			}
123			if planned.Action != actionCreate && planned.Action != actionReplace {
124				return ApplyEnvelope{}, ErrPlanBlocked
125			}
126			spec := s.request.Files[index]
127			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
128				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
129			}
130			observed, err := observePath(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path, s.request.SafeLimits(), true)
131			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 ||
132				(observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0) != spec.executable() {
133				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
134			}
135			envelope.Payloads = append(envelope.Payloads, Payload{
136				Path: spec.Path, Content: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(observed.data),
137			})
138		}
139		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
140			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
141		}
142		return envelope, nil
143	}
144
145	func (e ApplyEnvelope) Validate() error {
146		if e.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || e.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
147			return errors.New("unsupported local-files apply protocol")
148		}
149		if err := e.Request.Validate(); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		if err := e.Plan.Validate(e.Request); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		expected := map[string]FileSpec{}
156		for index, planned := range e.Plan.Files {
157			if planned.Action == actionCreate || planned.Action == actionReplace {
158				expected[e.Request.Files[index].Path] = e.Request.Files[index]
159			}
160		}
161		if len(e.Payloads) != len(expected) {
162			return errors.New("apply payload count does not match target actions")
163		}
164		seen := map[string]bool{}
165		var total int64
166		for index, payload := range e.Payloads {
167			if index > 0 && e.Payloads[index-1].Path >= payload.Path {
168				return errors.New("apply payload paths must be unique and sorted")
169			}
170			spec, ok := expected[payload.Path]
171			if !ok || seen[payload.Path] {
172				return fmt.Errorf("unexpected apply payload for %q", payload.Path)
173			}
174			seen[payload.Path] = true
175			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
176			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
177				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q is not canonical base64", payload.Path)
178			}
179			if int64(len(decoded)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(decoded) != spec.SHA256 {
180				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q does not match its manifest", payload.Path)
181			}
182			if int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes || int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxTotalBytes-total {
183				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q exceeds negotiated limits", payload.Path)
184			}
185			total += int64(len(decoded))
186		}
187		return nil
188	}

190	func stateForError(err error) State {
191		switch {
192		case errors.Is(err, ErrUnsafe), errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrUnsafeType), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrNotPortable), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrPathCollision):
193			return StateBlockedUnsafe
194		case errors.Is(err, ErrIneligible):
195			return StateBlockedIneligible
196		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
197			return StateMissing
198		default:
199			return StateFailed
200		}
201	}

203	func limitsToWire(limits safefile.Limits) fleet.FileLimits {
204		return fleet.FileLimits{
205			MaxFiles: limits.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: limits.MaxFileBytes,
206			MaxTotalBytes: limits.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: limits.MaxPathBytes,
207			MaxComponentBytes: limits.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: limits.MaxPathDepth,
208		}
209	}

211	// NegotiateLimits takes the lower value for every policy field and validates
212	// both sides against this binary's compiled ceilings.
213	func NegotiateLimits(local safefile.Limits, remote fleet.FileLimits) (safefile.Limits, error) {
214		if err := local.Validate(); err != nil {
215			return safefile.Limits{}, err
216		}
217		remoteLimits := safefile.Limits{
218			MaxFiles: remote.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: remote.MaxFileBytes,
219			MaxTotalBytes: remote.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: remote.MaxPathBytes,
220			MaxComponentBytes: remote.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: remote.MaxPathDepth,
221		}
222		if err := remoteLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
223			return safefile.Limits{}, err
224		}
225		result := safefile.Limits{
226			MaxFiles:          min(local.MaxFiles, remoteLimits.MaxFiles),
227			MaxFileBytes:      min(local.MaxFileBytes, remoteLimits.MaxFileBytes),
228			MaxTotalBytes:     min(local.MaxTotalBytes, remoteLimits.MaxTotalBytes),
229			MaxPathBytes:      min(local.MaxPathBytes, remoteLimits.MaxPathBytes),
230			MaxComponentBytes: min(local.MaxComponentBytes, remoteLimits.MaxComponentBytes),
231			MaxPathDepth:      min(local.MaxPathDepth, remoteLimits.MaxPathDepth),
232		}
233		return result, result.Validate()
234	}

101	func (s *Service) resolveTarget(ctx context.Context, binding Binding) (targetCheckout, error) {
102		if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
103			return targetCheckout{}, err
104		}
105		options := repo.DefaultOptions()
106		if s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth > 0 {
107			options.MaxDepth = s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth
108		}
109		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, s.Config.DiscoveryRoots(), options)
110		if err != nil {
111			return targetCheckout{}, err
112		}
113		type candidate struct {
114			path      string
115			commonDir string
116		}
117		var candidates []candidate
118		for _, repository := range repositories {
119			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
120				continue
121			}
122			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
123			if err != nil {
124				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect discovered target repository: %w", err)
125			}
126			matched, err := checkoutHasIdentity(ctx, gitRepo.Root, binding.RemoteIdentity)
127			if err != nil {
128				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect target repository fetch identities: %w", err)
129			}
130			if !matched {
131				continue
132			}
133			candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: gitRepo.Root, commonDir: gitRepo.GitCommonDir})
134		}
135		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].commonDir < candidates[j].commonDir })
136		switch len(candidates) {
137		case 0:
138			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAbsent}
139		case 1:
140		default:
141			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAmbiguous}
142		}
143		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidates[0].path, binding.Branch)
144		if err != nil {
145			return targetCheckout{}, err
146		}
147		if !checkedOut || worktree.Bare || worktree.Prunable {
148			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetFetchedOnly}
149		}
150		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
151		if err != nil {
152			return targetCheckout{}, err
153		}
154		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
155		if err != nil {
156			return targetCheckout{}, err
157		}
158		if status.Detached || status.Branch != binding.Branch || head != binding.HeadOID || worktree.Head != binding.HeadOID {
159			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetStale}
160		}
161		checkout := targetCheckout{
162			root: worktree.Path, commonDir: candidates[0].commonDir,
163			identity: binding.RemoteIdentity, branch: binding.Branch, head: head,
164		}
165		checkout.id = digestJSON(struct {
166			Domain    string `json:"domain"`
167			CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
168			Root      string `json:"root"`
169			Branch    string `json:"branch"`
170			Head      string `json:"head"`
171		}{"dev-local-files-checkout-v1", checkout.commonDir, checkout.root, checkout.branch, checkout.head})
172		return checkout, nil
173	}
174
175	func checkoutHasIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, wanted string) (bool, error) {
176		names, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
177		if err != nil {
178			return false, err
179		}
180		for _, name := range strings.Fields(names) {
181			// Repository identity is established from fetch URLs. A push-only match
182			// can name a different mirror or publication target and must not authorize
183			// writing local files into an otherwise unrelated clone.
184			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", name)
185			if err != nil {
186				continue
187			}
188			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
189				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
190					return true, nil
191				}
192			}
193		}
194		return false, nil
195	}
196
197	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
198		if s == nil {
199			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
200		}
201		if s.platform() == "windows" {
202			return PlanResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
203		}
204		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
205			return PlanResponse{}, err
206		}
207		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
208		if err != nil {
209			return PlanResponse{}, err
210		}
211		if id != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
212			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
213		}
214		hostLimits := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
215		if err := hostLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
216			return PlanResponse{}, err
217		}
218		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(hostLimits, request.Limits)
219		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
220			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("plan limits do not match target policy")
221		}
222		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, request.Binding)
223		if err != nil {
224			return PlanResponse{}, err
225		}
226		response := PlanResponse{
227			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
228			RequestID: request.RequestID, ManifestDigest: request.ManifestDigest,
229			TargetMachine: id, TargetCheckout: checkout.id,
230		}
231		for _, spec := range request.Files {
232			planned := PlanFile{PublicFile: spec.public(StateFailed)}
233			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
234				planned.State = stateForError(err)
235				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
236				continue
237			}
238			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, request.SafeLimits(), true)
239			if err != nil {
240				planned.State = stateForError(err)
241				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
242				continue
243			}
244			targetMode := ""
245			if observed.exists {
246				targetMode = fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm())
247			}
248			switch {
249			case !observed.exists:
250				planned.State, planned.Action = StateReady, actionCreate
251			case observed.digest == spec.SHA256 && targetMode == spec.Mode:
252				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateCurrent, actionCurrent, observed.digest, targetMode
253			case request.Replace:
254				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateReady, actionReplace, observed.digest, targetMode
255			default:
256				planned.State, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateBlockedConflict, observed.digest, targetMode
257			}
258			response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
259		}
260		response.PlanDigest = planDigest(request, response)
261		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
262			return PlanResponse{}, err
263		}
264		return response, nil
265	}

26		// A maximum raw payload is 32 MiB; JSON base64 plus bounded metadata fits in
27		// 48 MiB. Both client transport and target decoder enforce this ceiling.
28		MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes int64 = 48 << 20
29		MaxApplyResponseBytes int64 = 2 << 20

36		StateCurrent           State = "current"

38		StateBlockedIneligible State = "blocked-ineligible"
39		StateBlockedUnsafe     State = "blocked-unsafe"
40		StateMissing           State = "missing"
41		StateFailed            State = "failed"
42		StateCreated           State = "created"
43		StateReplaced          State = "replaced"
44		StateRolledBack        State = "rolled-back"

47
48	func (s State) validPlan() bool {
49		switch s {
50		case StateReady, StateCurrent, StateBlockedConflict, StateBlockedIneligible,
51			StateBlockedUnsafe, StateMissing, StateFailed:
52			return true
53		default:
54			return false
55		}
56	}
57
58	func (s State) validResult() bool {
59		return s.validPlan() || s == StateCreated || s == StateReplaced || s == StateRolledBack || s == StateReconcile

80			case StateReady, StateCurrent, StateCreated, StateReplaced:
81			default:
82				return false
83			}
84		}

139	func validateFileSpecs(files []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
140		metadata := make([]safefile.Metadata, len(files))
141		for index, file := range files {
142			if index > 0 && files[index-1].Path >= file.Path {
143				return errors.New("file manifest paths must be unique and sorted")

241	func (r PlanResponse) Validate(request PlanRequest) error {
242		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {

245		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || r.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion ||
246			r.RequestID != request.RequestID || r.ManifestDigest != request.ManifestDigest ||
247			r.TargetMachine != request.Binding.TargetMachine {

273				}

276					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q omits a required action", spec.Path)
277				}

280				}

323			return errors.New("apply response binding does not match plan")

325		for index, file := range r.Files {

328				return fmt.Errorf("apply response metadata for %q does not match plan", spec.Path)

330			expected := StateCurrent
331			switch plan.Files[index].Action {
332			case actionCreate:
333				expected = StateCreated
334			case actionReplace:
335				expected = StateReplaced
336			case actionCurrent:
337			default:
338				return fmt.Errorf("apply response action for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
339			}
340			if file.State != expected {
341				return fmt.Errorf("apply response state for %q does not match plan", spec.Path)
342			}
343		}

1	// Package safefile provides held-root filesystem operations for untrusted
2	// relative paths. It keeps traversal relative to os.Root handles, rejects links
3	// and special files, revalidates filesystem identity, and detects observable
4	// source mutation while reading.
5	package safefile
6
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"io/fs"

16	)

18	var (
19		// ErrChanged reports that a named root, child, or file no longer identifies
20		// the object observed by the caller.
21		ErrChanged = errors.New("filesystem object changed")
22		// ErrUnsafeType reports a symlink, reparse point, directory, or other
23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.
24		ErrUnsafeType = errors.New("unsafe filesystem object type")
25		// ErrFileLimit reports a regular file whose bytes exceed the read policy.
26		ErrFileLimit = errors.New("file size limit exceeded")
27	)
28
29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}
63
64	// OpenChildRoot opens one child directory through parent and proves that its
65	// name still identifies the held directory.
66	func OpenChildRoot(parent *os.Root, name string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {

95			_ = child.Close()

99			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q changed while opening: %w", name, ErrChanged)
100		}

121		}

130			return fmt.Errorf("component %q changed: %w", name, ErrChanged)

135	// ReadStableRegular reads one child file while proving that the directory name,
136	// opened descriptor, and final directory name all identify the expected regular
137	// file with unchanged observable metadata. maxBytes must be non-negative; zero
138	// means unbounded. Supplying the FileInfo from an earlier directory listing
139	// detects replacement or mutation between selection and opening.
140	func ReadStableRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
141		if root == nil {
142			return nil, nil, errors.New("read stable file: nil root")
143		}
144		if maxBytes < 0 {
145			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("negative maximum file size: %w", ErrFileLimit)
146		}
147		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
148			return nil, nil, err
149		}
150		before, err := root.Lstat(name)
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, nil, err
153		}
154		if expected == nil {
155			expected = before
156		}
157		if unsafeLink(before) || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
158			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is not a regular file: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
159		}
160		if !sameStableSourceState(expected, before) {
161			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed before opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
162		}
163		if maxBytes > 0 && before.Size() > maxBytes {
164			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", before.Size(), maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
165		}
166
167		file, err := openRegularForRead(root, name)
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, nil, err
170		}
171		defer file.Close()
172		opened, err := file.Stat()
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, nil, err
175		}
176		if unsafeLink(opened) || !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(expected, opened) {
177			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
178		}
179		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, nil, err
182		}
183		if unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, current) {
184			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
185		}
186
187		data, err := readAllContext(ctx, file, maxBytes)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, nil, err
190		}
191		after, err := file.Stat()
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, nil, err
194		}
195		current, err = root.Lstat(name)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, nil, err
198		}
199		if unsafeLink(after) || unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, after) ||
200			!sameStableSourceState(after, current) || after.Size() != int64(len(data)) {
201			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed during read: %w", ErrChanged)
202		}
203		return data, opened, nil
204	}

206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}
213
214	func sameStableSourceState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
215		return SameFileState(left, right) && samePlatformState(left, right)
216	}

218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}
243
244	func unsafeLink(info fs.FileInfo) bool {
245		return info != nil && (info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || isReparsePoint(info))
246	}

24	// AmbiguousMatchError reports records that cannot be safely distinguished. A

32	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Error() string {
33		reason := e.Reason
34		if reason == "" {
35			reason = "multiple records match"
36		}
37		return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (%s)", ErrAmbiguous, reason, strings.Join(e.CandidateIDs, ", "))

42	// Observation is live repository identity gathered from discovery. Path is the
43	// navigation path, RealPath its physical target, and either common-dir field may
44	// carry Git's shared administrative directory. CommonDir matches repo.Repo;
45	// GitCommonDir is accepted for callers using gitx.Repo terminology.
46	type Observation struct {

52		Name           string

56	// Registry adds live matching and lazy repository persistence to a Store.
57	type Registry struct {
58		store *Store

60	}
61
62	// NewRegistry returns a registry backed by store.
63	func NewRegistry(store *Store) *Registry { return &Registry{store: store} }
64
65	// Store exposes the durable store for callers that need lower-level APIs.
66	func (r *Registry) Store() *Store {
67		if r == nil {
68			return nil
69		}
70		return r.store
71	}
72
73	// List returns every readable catalog entry and reports skipped records through
74	// the Store's configured diagnostic sink.

76		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
77			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
78		}
79		return r.store.List()

82	// Get loads one entry by stable catalog ID.
83	func (r *Registry) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {

85			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
86		}
87		return r.store.Get(id)

92		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
93			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
94		}

100	// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
101	// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
102	// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
103	func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
104		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
105		if err != nil {
106			return nil, err
107		}

134				return matchErr
135			}
136
137			entry := &Entry{
138				Kind:           KindRepository,
139				Name:           normalized.Name,
140				RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
141				Locations: map[string]Location{
142					normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
143				},
144			}
145			if err := r.store.CreateUnderLock(entry); err != nil {
146				return err
147			}
148			result = entry.Clone()
149			return nil
150		})
151		return result, err
152	}

154	// Patch applies an atomic catalog mutation.
155	func (r *Registry) Patch(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
156		return r.Update(id, mutate)
157	}
158
159	// Attach explicitly records observation as id's present location. Explicit
160	// attachment may update a changed remote because the caller supplied the stable
161	// catalog identity rather than asking the remote hint to choose one.
162	func (r *Registry) Attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
163		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, err
166		}
167		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
168			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
169		}
170		r.mu.Lock()
171		defer r.mu.Unlock()
172		var result *Entry
173		err = r.store.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
174			var attachErr error
175			result, attachErr = r.attachUnderLock(id, normalized)
176			return attachErr
177		})
178		return result, err
179	}
180
181	func (r *Registry) attachUnderLock(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
182		return r.store.UpdateUnderLock(id, func(entry *Entry) error {
183			if observation.RemoteIdentity != "" {
184				entry.RemoteIdentity = observation.RemoteIdentity
185			}
186			location := locationFromObservation(observation)
187			if previous, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host); ok && location.GitCommonDir == "" &&
188				intersects(canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath),
189					canonicalValues(previous.CurrentPath, previous.RestorePath, previous.RealPath)) {
190				location.GitCommonDir = previous.GitCommonDir
191			}
192			return entry.SetLocation(observation.Host, location)
193		})
194	}
195
196	// FindByPath performs only exact host+canonical-path matching; it never falls
197	// back to a remote identity.
198	func (r *Registry) FindByPath(host, path string) (*Entry, error) {
199		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, Path: path}, false)
200		if err != nil {
201			return nil, err
202		}
203		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
204		if err != nil {
205			return nil, err
206		}
207		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
208		if len(matches) == 0 && len(diagnostics) > 0 {
209			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
210		}
211		if len(matches) > 0 {
212			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
213		}
214		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
215	}
216
217	// FindByCommonDir performs exact host+Git-common-directory matching.
218	func (r *Registry) FindByCommonDir(host, commonDir string) (*Entry, error) {
219		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, CommonDir: commonDir}, false)
220		if err != nil {
221			return nil, err
222		}
223		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
224		if err != nil {
225			return nil, err
226		}
227		matches := exactMatches(entries, normalized)
228		if len(matches) == 0 && len(diagnostics) > 0 {
229			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
230		}
231		if len(matches) > 0 {
232			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
233		}
234		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
235	}
236
237	type matchMethod int
238
239	const (
240		matchNone matchMethod = iota
241		matchExact
242		matchRemote
243	)
244
245	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
246		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
247		if err != nil {
248			return nil, matchNone, err
249		}
250		if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
251			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
252			entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
253			return entry, matchExact, err
254		}
255		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
256			return nil, matchNone, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
257		}
258		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
259			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
260		}
261
262		var remoteMatches []*Entry
263		for _, entry := range entries {
264			if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
265				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
266			}
267		}
268		Sort(remoteMatches)
269		switch len(remoteMatches) {
270		case 0:
271			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
272		case 1:
273			if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
274				return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
275			}
276			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
277				"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
278		default:
279			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
280				"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
281		}
282	}
283
284	func (r *Registry) entriesWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
285		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
286			return nil, nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
287		}
288		return r.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
289	}
290
291	func incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics []Diagnostic) error {
292		errorsToJoin := make([]error, 1, len(diagnostics)+1)
293		errorsToJoin[0] = ErrIncompleteCatalog
294		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
295			errorsToJoin = append(errorsToJoin, diagnostic)
296		}
297		return errors.Join(errorsToJoin...)
298	}
299
300	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
301		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
302		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
303		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
304		for _, entry := range entries {
305			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
306			if !ok {
307				continue
308			}
309			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
310			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
311			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
312			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
313				matched[entry.ID] = entry
314			}
315		}
316		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
317		for _, entry := range matched {
318			out = append(out, entry)
319		}
320		Sort(out)
321		return out
322	}
323
324	func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {
325		switch len(matches) {
326		case 0:
327			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
328		case 1:
329			return matches[0], nil
330		default:
331			return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
332		}
333	}
334
335	func ambiguous(observation Observation, entries []*Entry, reason string) error {
336		ids := make([]string, len(entries))
337		for i, entry := range entries {
338			ids[i] = entry.ID
339		}
340		sort.Strings(ids)
341		return &AmbiguousMatchError{Observation: observation, CandidateIDs: ids, Reason: reason}
342	}
343
344	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
345		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
346		if !ok {
347			return true
348		}
349		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
350		// A navigation symlink may disappear while its physical clone or Git common
351		// directory remains, so every stored identity path must be absent before the
352		// remote can be treated as relocation evidence. Archives also deliberately
353		// block relocation while their bytes remain.
354		for _, path := range []string{
355			location.CurrentPath,
356			location.RestorePath,
357			location.RealPath,
358			location.GitCommonDir,
359		} {
360			if path == "" {
361				continue
362			}
363			if pathMayStillExist(path) {
364				return false
365			}
366		}
367		return true
368	}
369
370	func pathMayStillExist(path string) bool {
371		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
372			// Lstat deliberately counts a dangling symlink as existing evidence.
373			return true
374		}
375		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
376		if err != nil {
377			return true
378		}
379		_, err = os.Stat(canonical)
380		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
381	}
382
383	func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {
384		currentPath := observation.Path
385		if currentPath == "" {
386			currentPath = observation.RealPath
387		}
388		return Location{
389			State:        LocationPresent,
390			CurrentPath:  currentPath,
391			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
392			GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
393		}
394	}
395
396	func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
397		observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
398		observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
399		if observation.Host == "" {
400			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
401		}
402
403		commonDir := observation.CommonDir
404		if commonDir == "" {
405			commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
406		} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
407			left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
408			right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
409			if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
410				return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
411			}
412		}
413
414		var err error
415		canonicalPath := ""
416		if observation.Path != "" {
417			observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
418			if err != nil {
419				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
420			}
421			canonicalPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
422			if err != nil {
423				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
424			}
425		}
426		if observation.RealPath != "" {
427			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
428			if err != nil {
429				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
430			}
431			if canonicalPath != "" && canonicalPath != observation.RealPath {
432				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Path and RealPath disagree: %q != %q",
433					canonicalPath, observation.RealPath)
434			}
435		} else {
436			observation.RealPath = canonicalPath
437		}
438		if commonDir != "" {
439			observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
440			if err != nil {
441				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
442			}
443		}
444		observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
445		observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)
446
447		if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
448			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
449		}
450		if requireLocation {
451			path := observation.Path
452			if path == "" {
453				path = observation.RealPath
454			}
455			info, statErr := os.Stat(path)
456			if statErr != nil {
457				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q: %w", path, statErr)
458			}
459			if !info.IsDir() {
460				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q is not a directory", path)
461			}
462			if observation.CommonDir != "" {
463				commonInfo, commonErr := os.Stat(observation.CommonDir)
464				if commonErr != nil {
465					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q: %w",
466						observation.CommonDir, commonErr)
467				}
468				if !commonInfo.IsDir() {
469					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q is not a directory",
470						observation.CommonDir)
471				}
472			}
473		}
474		if observation.Name == "" {
475			path := observation.Path
476			if path == "" {
477				path = observation.RealPath
478			}
479			if path != "" {
480				observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
481			}
482		}
483		if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
484			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
485		}
486		return observation, nil
487	}
488
489	func absoluteClean(path string) (string, error) {
490		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
491		if err != nil {
492			return "", err
493		}
494		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
495	}
496
497	func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
498		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
499		for _, value := range values {
500			if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {
501				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
502			}
503		}
504		return out
505	}
506
507	func canonicalValue(value string) string {
508		if value == "" {
509			return ""
510		}
511		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
512		if err != nil {
513			return ""
514		}
515		return canonical
516	}
517
518	func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
519		for value := range left {
520			if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
521				return true
522			}
523		}
524		return false
525	}

527	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
528	// stable host/path key. Hosts are case-insensitive, but paths are preserved
529	// because arbitrary Git servers may use a case-sensitive repository namespace.
530	// The result remains only a hint for matching.
531	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
532		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
533		if identity == "" {
534			return ""
535		}
536		if azure := normalizeAzureDevOpsRemoteIdentity(identity); azure != "" {
537			return azure
538		}
539		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
540			if strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file") {
541				return ""
542			}
543			if parsed.Host != "" {
544				return remoteIdentityKey(parsed.Host, parsed.EscapedPath())
545			}
546		}
547		if looksLikeLocalRemote(identity) {
548			return ""
549		}
550
551		afterUser := identity
552		user := ""
553		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(afterUser, '@'); at >= 0 {
554			user, afterUser = afterUser[:at], afterUser[at+1:]
555			// A colon in an scp-like user prefix is a password/token separator,
556			// not a stable SSH username. Reject the identity rather than persisting
557			// credential material in catalog keys, reports, or protocol journals.
558			if strings.Contains(user, ":") {
559				return ""
560			}
561		}
562		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
563			if user != "" && !strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && !strings.HasPrefix(remotePath, "/") {
564				remotePath = "~" + user + "/" + remotePath
565			}
566			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
567		}
568
569		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
570		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
571			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
572		}
573		return ""
574	}
575
576	func normalizeAzureDevOpsRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
577		if kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(identity); kind == forge.AzureDevOps && name != "" {
578			return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + name
579		}
580
581		// Records written before Azure support already contain the generic
582		// host/path form. Recognize it so existing catalog entries migrate on read.
583		trimmed := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSpace(identity), ".git"), "/")
584		parts := strings.Split(trimmed, "/")
585		decode := func(values []string) ([]string, bool) {
586			out := make([]string, len(values))
587			for i, value := range values {
588				decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(value)
589				if err != nil || decoded == "" || strings.Contains(decoded, "/") {
590					return nil, false
591				}
592				out[i] = decoded
593			}
594			return out, true
595		}
596		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "dev.azure.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[3], "_git") {
597			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{parts[1], parts[2], parts[4]}); ok {
598				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
599			}
600		}
601		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "ssh.dev.azure.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[1], "v3") {
602			if decoded, ok := decode(parts[2:]); ok {
603				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
604			}
605		}
606		if len(parts) >= 4 && strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(parts[0]), ".visualstudio.com") &&
607			!strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[len(parts)-2], "_git") {
608			organization := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.ToLower(parts[0]), ".visualstudio.com")
609			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{organization, parts[len(parts)-3], parts[len(parts)-1]}); ok {
610				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
611			}
612		}
613		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com") &&
614			strings.HasPrefix(parts[1], "~") && strings.EqualFold(parts[3], "_ssh") {
615			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{strings.TrimPrefix(parts[1], "~"), parts[2], parts[4]}); ok {
616				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
617			}
618		}
619		return ""
620	}
621
622	func looksLikeLocalRemote(identity string) bool {
623		if filepath.IsAbs(identity) || strings.HasPrefix(identity, `\\`) {
624			return true
625		}
626		for _, prefix := range []string{"./", "../", "~/", `.\`, `..\`, `~\`} {
627			if strings.HasPrefix(identity, prefix) {
628				return true
629			}
630		}
631		if len(identity) >= 2 && identity[1] == ':' {
632			letter := identity[0]
633			if letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z' {
634				return true
635			}
636		}
637		return !strings.ContainsAny(identity, `/\:@`)
638	}
639
640	func splitSCPLike(identity string) (string, string, bool) {
641		if strings.HasPrefix(identity, "[") {
642			if end := strings.Index(identity, "]:"); end >= 0 {
643				return identity[:end+1], identity[end+2:], true
644			}
645		}
646		colon := strings.IndexByte(identity, ':')
647		if colon <= 0 || strings.ContainsAny(identity[:colon], `/\\`) {
648			return "", "", false
649		}
650		return identity[:colon], identity[colon+1:], true
651	}
652
653	func remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath string) string {
654		host = strings.ToLower(strings.Trim(host, "/"))
655		remotePath = trimGitSuffix(strings.Trim(remotePath, "/"))
656		if host == "" || remotePath == "" {
657			return ""
658		}
659		return host + "/" + remotePath
660	}
661
662	func trimGitSuffix(value string) string {
663		return strings.TrimSuffix(value, ".git")
664	}

1	// Package task stores the small amount of state git cannot answer: which
2	// change streams exist, what state each is in, which machine owns it, and what
3	// the next action is. Everything else — branch, dirty, ahead/behind, whether a
4	// worktree exists — is derived live and deliberately not stored here.
5	package task
6
7	import (
8		"crypto/sha256"
9		"encoding/binary"
10		"encoding/hex"
11		"fmt"
12		"strings"
13		"time"
14	)
15
16	// State is where a change stream sits in its lifecycle.
17	type State string
18
19	const (
20		// Hot: worktree and branch exist, a runtime session is open, actively worked on.
21		Hot State = "hot"
22		// Warm: worktree and branch kept, runtime closed. Back within days.
23		Warm State = "warm"
24		// Cold: committed and pushed, worktree removed. Reconstructible anywhere.
25		Cold State = "cold"
26		// Done: merged. Kept only until the entry is reaped.
27		Done State = "done"
28	)
29
30	// States lists the lifecycle in order, for help text and validation.
31	var States = []State{Hot, Warm, Cold, Done}
32
33	// ParseState validates a user-supplied state name.
34	func ParseState(s string) (State, error) {
35		got := State(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s)))
36		for _, valid := range States {
37			if got == valid {
38				return got, nil
39			}
40		}
41		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown state %q: want one of %s", s, JoinStates(", "))
42	}
43
44	// JoinStates renders the valid state names.
45	func JoinStates(sep string) string {
46		parts := make([]string, len(States))
47		for i, s := range States {
48			parts[i] = string(s)
49		}
50		return strings.Join(parts, sep)
51	}
52
53	// Icon is the glyph shown in the inventory.
54	func (s State) Icon() string {
55		switch s {
56		case Hot:
57			return "🔥"
58		case Warm:
59			return "🌤"
60		case Cold:
61			return "❄️"
62		case Done:
63			return "✅"
64		}
65		return "?"
66	}
67
68	// Label is the uppercase column form.
69	func (s State) Label() string { return strings.ToUpper(string(s)) }
70
71	// CheckoutMode is how a task occupies the repository filesystem.
72	type CheckoutMode string
73
74	const (
75		// ModeWorktree owns a linked worktree and branch.
76		ModeWorktree CheckoutMode = "worktree"
77		// ModeBranch uses a short-lived branch in the canonical checkout.
78		ModeBranch CheckoutMode = "branch"
79		// ModeDirect tracks ad-hoc work on the branch already checked out in the
80		// canonical repo — usually main — without creating a branch or worktree.
81		ModeDirect CheckoutMode = "direct"
82	)
83
84	// Task is one change stream. Field names are the TOML keys.
85	type Task struct {
86		// ID is derived from repo and branch; it is the filename stem and is not
87		// stored inside the file.
88		ID string `toml:"-"`
89
90		// Name is the human label ("atp security recovery").
91		Name string `toml:"name"`
92		// Repo is the repository's display name.
93		Repo string `toml:"repo"`
94		// RepoPath is the main checkout, the directory git commands run in.
95		RepoPath string `toml:"repo_path"`
96		// Branch is the change stream's identity — the one durable handle that
97		// survives every machine, worktree and runtime.
98		Branch string `toml:"branch"`
99		// Base is the ref the branch was created from, recorded so `dev done` can
100		// integrate without re-guessing.
101		Base string `toml:"base"`
102		// WorktreePath is the linked checkout, empty when the task works directly
103		// in the main checkout or has gone cold.
104		WorktreePath string `toml:"worktree_path"`
105		// Mode says whether this task uses a worktree, a branch in the canonical
106		// checkout, or the current branch directly. Older entries infer it.
107		Mode CheckoutMode `toml:"mode"`
108
109		State State `toml:"state"`
110		// Owner is the hostname that last held this task hot. One writer per
111		// branch at a time avoids two machines diverging the same history.
112		Owner string `toml:"owner"`
113		// Next is the single most valuable field in the file: what to do when you
114		// come back. Without it, parking a task still loses the thread.
115		Next string   `toml:"next"`
116		Note string   `toml:"note"`
117		Tags []string `toml:"tags"`
118
119		// AgentSession reserves a resumable agent context ("claude:<uuid>"). The
120		// production start/park/resume flow does not yet capture or attach it.
121		AgentSession string `toml:"agent_session"`
122		// RuntimeHandle is the last known runtime session id (e.g. a Herdr
123		// workspace id). RuntimeName records which backend owns that opaque handle.
124		// Both are advisory and must be revalidated against live checkout coverage.
125		RuntimeHandle string `toml:"runtime_handle"`
126		RuntimeName   string `toml:"runtime_name"`
127
128		Created time.Time `toml:"created"`
129		Updated time.Time `toml:"updated"`
130
131		// storedRevision is populated only by Store after a successful read/write.
132		// It never enters TOML or Revision and lets legacy Save callers participate
133		// in compare-and-swap without adding a persisted field older binaries erase.
134		storedRevision string
135	}
136
137	// Revision returns a deterministic fingerprint of the task identity and every
138	// field represented by its TOML record. It is deliberately computed rather
139	// than persisted: older dev binaries can continue to read and rewrite task
140	// files without erasing a revision field they do not know about.
141	func (t Task) Revision() string {
142		hash := sha256.New()
143		writeString := func(value string) {
144			var length [8]byte
145			binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(value)))
146			_, _ = hash.Write(length[:])
147			_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(value))
148		}
149		writeTime := func(value time.Time) {
150			writeString(value.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano))
151		}
152
153		writeString("dev-task-revision-v1")
154		writeString(t.ID)
155		writeString(t.Name)
156		writeString(t.Repo)
157		writeString(t.RepoPath)
158		writeString(t.Branch)
159		writeString(t.Base)
160		writeString(t.WorktreePath)
161		writeString(string(t.Mode))
162		writeString(string(t.State))
163		writeString(t.Owner)
164		writeString(t.Next)
165		writeString(t.Note)
166		writeString(fmt.Sprint(len(t.Tags)))
167		for _, tag := range t.Tags {
168			writeString(tag)
169		}
170		writeString(t.AgentSession)
171		writeString(t.RuntimeHandle)
172		writeString(t.RuntimeName)
173		writeTime(t.Created)
174		writeTime(t.Updated)
175
176		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
177	}
178
179	// EffectiveMode returns the explicit mode, or infers a legacy task. Before
180	// modes were recorded, a path meant worktree and no path meant a canonical
181	// branch task; direct mode is never guessed because it changes integration
182	// semantics and must be explicit.
183	func (t Task) EffectiveMode() CheckoutMode {
184		if t.Mode != "" {
185			return t.Mode
186		}
187		if t.WorktreePath != "" {
188			return ModeWorktree
189		}
190		return ModeBranch
191	}
192
193	// Title is the display name, falling back to the branch when unnamed.
194	func (t Task) Title() string {
195		if t.Name != "" {
196			return t.Name
197		}
198		return t.Branch
199	}
200
201	// OwnedBy reports whether host is this task's owner. An empty owner means
202	// unclaimed, which counts as owned by anyone.
203	func (t Task) OwnedBy(host string) bool { return t.Owner == "" || t.Owner == host }
204
205	// Validate rejects a task that could not be acted on later.
206	func (t Task) Validate() error {
207		if t.ID != "" {
208			if err := ValidateID(t.ID); err != nil {
209				return fmt.Errorf("task ID: %w", err)
210			}
211		}
212		switch {
213		case t.Repo == "":
214			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo is required", t.ID)
215		case t.Branch == "":
216			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: branch is required", t.ID)
217		case t.RepoPath == "":
218			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo_path is required", t.ID)
219		}
220		if _, err := ParseState(string(t.State)); err != nil {
221			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
222		}
223		switch t.Mode {
224		case "", ModeWorktree, ModeBranch, ModeDirect:
225		default:
226			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: unknown mode %q", t.ID, t.Mode)
227		}
228		return nil
229	}
230

211	type RecoveryRepositoryFacts struct {
212		Root      string `json:"root,omitempty"`
213		GitDir    string `json:"git_dir"`
214		CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
215		Bare      bool   `json:"bare"`
216
217		Shallow           bool `json:"shallow"`
218		PartialClone      bool `json:"partial_clone"`
219		Promisor          bool `json:"promisor"`
220		LFSConfigured     bool `json:"lfs_configured"`
221		PromisorPackFiles int  `json:"promisor_pack_files"`
222
223		GitDirOutsideRoot        bool `json:"git_dir_outside_root"`
224		CommonDirOutsideMainRoot bool `json:"common_dir_outside_main_root"`
225		SharedCommonDir          bool `json:"shared_common_dir"`
226
227		PromisorRemotes []string            `json:"promisor_remotes"`
228		Alternates      []RecoveryAlternate `json:"alternates"`
229	}

231	// RecoveryAdminRootKind identifies which Git administrative root was walked.
232	type RecoveryAdminRootKind string
233
234	const (
235		RecoveryAdminGitDir    RecoveryAdminRootKind = "git-dir"
236		RecoveryAdminCommonDir RecoveryAdminRootKind = "common-dir"
237	)

239	// RecoveryAdminEntry is held-root metadata for every Git administrative entry.
240	// Digest exists only for a stably read regular file. Error explains why bytes
241	// are unavailable for links, special files, or unreadable entries.
242	type RecoveryAdminEntry struct {
243		Path   string            `json:"path"`
244		Type   RecoveryEntryType `json:"type"`
245		Size   int64             `json:"size"`
246		Mode   uint32            `json:"mode"`
247		Digest string            `json:"digest,omitempty"`
248		Error  string            `json:"error,omitempty"`
249	}
250
251	// RecoveryAdminRoot is a complete recursive view of one private Git
252	// administrative root.
253	type RecoveryAdminRoot struct {
254		Kind         RecoveryAdminRootKind `json:"kind"`
255		Path         string                `json:"path"`
256		Completeness RecoveryCompleteness  `json:"completeness"`
257		Entries      []RecoveryAdminEntry  `json:"entries"`
258	}
