260	// RecoverySnapshot is a read-only, content-free public description of ordinary
261	// Git state. Raw regular-file bodies are retained only in private maps and are
262	// available as defensive copies to the later recovery artifact builder.
263	type RecoverySnapshot struct {
264		Completeness RecoveryCompleteness       `json:"completeness"`
265		ObjectFormat string                     `json:"object_format,omitempty"`
266		Repository   RecoveryRepositoryFacts    `json:"repository"`
267		Refs         []RecoveryRef              `json:"refs"`
268		Worktrees    []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot `json:"worktrees"`
269		AdminRoots   []RecoveryAdminRoot        `json:"admin_roots"`
270		Findings     []RecoveryFinding          `json:"findings"`
271
272		trackedBytes map[string][]byte
273		adminBytes   map[string][]byte
274	}
275
276	// RawTrackedBytes returns a defensive copy of the raw working-tree bytes for a
277	// stably read materialized regular file.
278	func (snapshot RecoverySnapshot) RawTrackedBytes(worktreePath, relativePath string) ([]byte, bool) {
279		data, ok := snapshot.trackedBytes[recoveryTrackedKey(worktreePath, relativePath)]
280		if !ok {
281			return nil, false
282		}
283		return bytes.Clone(data), true
284	}
285
286	// RawAdminBytes returns a defensive copy of one stably read regular Git
287	// administrative file.
288	func (snapshot RecoverySnapshot) RawAdminBytes(root RecoveryAdminRootKind, relativePath string) ([]byte, bool) {
289		data, ok := snapshot.adminBytes[recoveryAdminKey(root, relativePath)]
290		if !ok {
291			return nil, false
292		}
293		return bytes.Clone(data), true
294	}
295
296	// HasBlockingFindings reports whether collection found either unsupported data
297	// topology or incomplete evidence. It is descriptive and does not itself grant
298	// any reclaim or eviction authorization.
299	func (snapshot RecoverySnapshot) HasBlockingFindings() bool {
300		for _, finding := range snapshot.Findings {
301			if finding.Blocking {
302				return true
303			}
304		}
305		return false
306	}
307
308	// RecoverySnapshotOf captures refs, registered worktrees, every worktree index
309	// and materialized tracked file, private Git administration, and unsupported
310	// storage topologies without modifying Git state. Ordinary probe failures are
311	// retained in Findings and produce a partial snapshot; cancellation is retained
312	// and also returned to the caller.
313	func RecoverySnapshotOf(ctx context.Context, dir string) (RecoverySnapshot, error) {
314		snapshot := RecoverySnapshot{
315			Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete,
316			Refs:         []RecoveryRef{},
317			Worktrees:    []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{},
318			AdminRoots:   []RecoveryAdminRoot{},
319			Findings:     []RecoveryFinding{},
320			trackedBytes: make(map[string][]byte),
321			adminBytes:   make(map[string][]byte),
322		}
323		collector := recoveryCollector{ctx: ctx, snapshot: &snapshot}
324		if err := collector.contextError("repository", dir); err != nil {
325			collector.finalize()
326			return snapshot, err
327		}
328
329		repository, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
330		if err != nil {
331			if cancelErr := collector.failure("repository-probe-failed", "repository", dir, err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
332				collector.finalize()
333				return snapshot, cancelErr
334			}
335			snapshot.Completeness = RecoveryCompletenessUnknown
336			collector.finalize()
337			return snapshot, err
338		}
339		snapshot.Repository = RecoveryRepositoryFacts{
340			Root:            repository.Root,
341			GitDir:          filepath.Clean(repository.GitDir),
342			CommonDir:       filepath.Clean(repository.GitCommonDir),
343			Bare:            repository.Bare,
344			PromisorRemotes: []string{},
345			Alternates:      []RecoveryAlternate{},
346		}
347
348		if err := collector.collectObjectFormat(repository); err != nil {
349			collector.finalize()
350			return snapshot, err
351		}
352		if err := collector.collectRefs(repository); err != nil {
353			collector.finalize()
354			return snapshot, err
355		}
356		if err := collector.collectRepositoryConfig(repository); err != nil {
357			collector.finalize()
358			return snapshot, err
359		}
360		if err := collector.collectShallow(repository); err != nil {
361			collector.finalize()
362			return snapshot, err
363		}
364		if err := collector.collectWorktreeList(repository); err != nil {
365			collector.finalize()
366			return snapshot, err
367		}
368		collector.collectStoragePlacement(repository)
369
370		for index := range snapshot.Worktrees {
371			if err := collector.collectWorktree(repository, &snapshot.Worktrees[index]); err != nil {
372				collector.finalize()
373				return snapshot, err
374			}
375		}
376		if err := collector.collectAdminRoots(repository); err != nil {
377			collector.finalize()
378			return snapshot, err
379		}
380		collector.collectObjectStoreFeatures(repository)
381		collector.finalize()
382		return snapshot, nil
383	}
384
385	type recoveryCollector struct {
386		ctx            context.Context
387		snapshot       *RecoverySnapshot
388		cancelRecorded bool
389	}
390
391	func (collector *recoveryCollector) contextError(scope, subject string) error {
392		if cause := context.Cause(collector.ctx); cause != nil {
393			if !collector.cancelRecorded {
394				collector.cancelRecorded = true
395				collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
396					Code: "collection-cancelled", Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure,
397					Scope: scope, Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: cause.Error(),
398				})
399			}
400			collector.markPartial(nil)
401			return cause
402		}
403		return nil
404	}
405
406	func (collector *recoveryCollector) failure(code, scope, subject string, err error, local *RecoveryCompleteness) error {
407		if cause := context.Cause(collector.ctx); cause != nil || errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
408			if cause == nil {
409				cause = err
410			}
411			if !collector.cancelRecorded {
412				collector.cancelRecorded = true
413				collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
414					Code: "collection-cancelled", Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure,
415					Scope: scope, Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: cause.Error(),
416				})
417			}
418			collector.markPartial(local)
419			return cause
420		}
421		collector.markPartial(local)
422		collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
423			Code: code, Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure, Scope: scope,
424			Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: recoveryCleanText(err.Error()),
425		})
426		return nil
427	}
428
429	func (collector *recoveryCollector) blocker(code, scope, subject, message string) {
430		collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
431			Code: code, Kind: RecoveryFindingBlocker, Scope: scope,
432			Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: message,
433		})
434	}
435
436	func (collector *recoveryCollector) addFinding(finding RecoveryFinding) {
437		finding.Code = recoveryIdentifier(finding.Code)
438		finding.Scope = recoveryIdentifier(finding.Scope)
439		finding.Subject = recoveryCleanSubject(finding.Subject)
440		finding.Message = recoveryCleanText(finding.Message)
441		collector.snapshot.Findings = append(collector.snapshot.Findings, finding)
442	}
443
444	func (collector *recoveryCollector) markPartial(local *RecoveryCompleteness) {
445		if collector.snapshot.Completeness != RecoveryCompletenessUnknown {
446			collector.snapshot.Completeness = RecoveryCompletenessPartial
447		}
448		if local != nil && *local != RecoveryCompletenessUnknown {
449			*local = RecoveryCompletenessPartial
450		}
451	}
452
453	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectObjectFormat(repository Repo) error {
454		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
455			"rev-parse", "--show-object-format=storage")
456		if err != nil {
457			if cancelErr := collector.failure("object-format-probe-failed", "object-format", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
458				return cancelErr
459			}
460		}
461		format := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
462		if format == "" {
463			if err == nil {
464				_ = collector.failure("object-format-parse-failed", "object-format", "repository", errors.New("Git returned an empty object format"), nil)
465			}
466			return nil
467		}
468		if strings.ContainsAny(format, "\x00\r\n \t") {
469			_ = collector.failure("object-format-parse-failed", "object-format", "repository", fmt.Errorf("unexpected object format %q", format), nil)
470			return nil
471		}
472		collector.snapshot.ObjectFormat = format
473		return nil
474	}
475
476	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectRefs(repository Repo) error {
477		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
478			"for-each-ref", "--sort=refname", "--format=%(refname)%00%(objectname)%00%(objecttype)%00", "refs")
479		if err != nil {
480			if cancelErr := collector.failure("refs-probe-failed", "refs", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
481				return cancelErr
482			}
483		}
484		refs, parseErr := parseRecoveryRefs(output)
485		collector.snapshot.Refs = refs
486		if parseErr != nil {
487			_ = collector.failure("refs-parse-failed", "refs", "repository", parseErr, nil)
488		}
489		return nil
490	}
491
492	func parseRecoveryRefs(output []byte) ([]RecoveryRef, error) {
493		refs := []RecoveryRef{}
494		var parseErrors []error
495		for recordIndex, record := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{'\n'}) {
496			record = bytes.TrimSuffix(record, []byte{'\r'})
497			if len(record) == 0 {
498				continue
499			}
500			fields := bytes.Split(record, []byte{0})
501			if len(fields) == 4 && len(fields[3]) == 0 {
502				fields = fields[:3]
503			}
504			if len(fields) != 3 {
505				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d has %d fields", recordIndex, len(fields)))
506				continue
507			}
508			name, oid, objectType := string(fields[0]), string(fields[1]), string(fields[2])
509			if !utf8.ValidString(name) || !strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/") || oid == "" || objectType == "" {
510				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d is invalid", recordIndex))
511				continue
512			}
513			refs = append(refs, RecoveryRef{Name: name, OID: oid, ObjectType: objectType, Kind: recoveryRefKind(name)})
514		}
515		sort.Slice(refs, func(i, j int) bool { return refs[i].Name < refs[j].Name })
516		return refs, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
517	}
518
519	func recoveryRefKind(name string) RecoveryRefKind {
520		switch {
521		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/heads/"):
522			return RecoveryRefHead
523		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/tags/"):
524			return RecoveryRefTag
525		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/notes/"):
526			return RecoveryRefNote
527		case name == "refs/stash":
528			return RecoveryRefStash
529		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/remotes/"):
530			return RecoveryRefRemote
531		default:
532			return RecoveryRefOther
533		}
534	}
535
536	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectRepositoryConfig(repository Repo) error {
537		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
538			"config", "--null", "--local", "--list")
539		if err != nil {
540			if cancelErr := collector.failure("config-probe-failed", "repository-config", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
541				return cancelErr
542			}
543		}
544		var parseErrors []error
545		promisorRemotes := map[string]struct{}{}
546		for recordIndex, record := range recoveryNULRecords(output) {
547			newline := bytes.IndexByte(record, '\n')
548			if newline < 1 {
549				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("config record %d has no key/value separator", recordIndex))
550				continue
551			}
552			key := strings.ToLower(string(record[:newline]))
553			value := string(record[newline+1:])
554			switch {
555			case key == "extensions.partialclone":
556				if strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
557					collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
558					promisorRemotes[strings.TrimSpace(value)] = struct{}{}
559				}
560			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "remote.") && strings.HasSuffix(key, ".promisor"):
561				remote := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "remote."), ".promisor")
562				parsed, boolErr := recoveryGitBool(value)
563				if boolErr != nil {
564					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("config %s: %w", key, boolErr))
565					continue
566				}
567				if parsed {
568					collector.snapshot.Repository.Promisor = true
569					collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
570					promisorRemotes[remote] = struct{}{}
571				}
572			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "remote.") && strings.HasSuffix(key, ".partialclonefilter"):
573				remote := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "remote."), ".partialclonefilter")
574				collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
575				promisorRemotes[remote] = struct{}{}
576			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "filter.lfs."):
577				collector.snapshot.Repository.LFSConfigured = true
578			}
579		}
580		for remote := range promisorRemotes {
581			if remote != "" {
582				collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes = append(collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes, remote)
583			}
584		}
585		sort.Strings(collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes)
586		if parseErr := errors.Join(parseErrors...); parseErr != nil {
587			_ = collector.failure("config-parse-failed", "repository-config", "repository", parseErr, nil)
588		}
589		return nil
590	}
591
592	func recoveryGitBool(value string) (bool, error) {
593		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
594		case "true", "yes", "on", "1":
595			return true, nil
596		case "false", "no", "off", "0", "":
597			return false, nil
598		default:
599			return false, fmt.Errorf("invalid Git boolean %q", value)
600		}
601	}
602
603	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectShallow(repository Repo) error {
604		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
605			"rev-parse", "--is-shallow-repository")
606		if err != nil {
607			if cancelErr := collector.failure("shallow-probe-failed", "object-store", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
608				return cancelErr
609			}
610			return nil
611		}
612		shallow, parseErr := strconv.ParseBool(strings.TrimSpace(string(output)))
613		if parseErr != nil {
614			_ = collector.failure("shallow-parse-failed", "object-store", "repository", parseErr, nil)
615			return nil
616		}
617		collector.snapshot.Repository.Shallow = shallow
618		if shallow {
619			collector.blocker("shallow-repository", "object-store", "repository", "repository history is shallow")
620		}
621		return nil
622	}
623
624	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectWorktreeList(repository Repo) error {
625		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
626			"worktree", "list", "--porcelain", "-z")
627		if err != nil {
628			if cancelErr := collector.failure("worktrees-probe-failed", "worktrees", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
629				return cancelErr
630			}
631		}
632		worktrees, parseErr := parseRecoveryWorktrees(output)
633		if parseErr != nil {
634			_ = collector.failure("worktrees-parse-failed", "worktrees", "repository", parseErr, nil)
635		}
636		if len(worktrees) == 0 && repository.Root != "" {
637			worktrees = append(worktrees, RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{
638				Path: repository.Root, GitDir: repository.GitDir, Bare: repository.Bare,
639				Main: true, Presence: RecoveryPresenceUnknown, Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessPartial,
640			})
641			if err == nil && parseErr == nil {
642				_ = collector.failure("worktrees-parse-failed", "worktrees", "repository", errors.New("Git returned no worktrees"), &worktrees[0].Completeness)
643			}
644		}
645		collector.snapshot.Worktrees = worktrees
646		return nil
647	}
648
649	func parseRecoveryWorktrees(output []byte) ([]RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot, error) {
650		worktrees := []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{}
651		var current *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot
652		var parseErrors []error
653		flush := func() {
654			if current == nil {
655				return
656			}
657			if current.Path == "" {
658				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, errors.New("worktree record has no path"))
659			} else {
660				current.Main = len(worktrees) == 0
661				worktrees = append(worktrees, *current)
662			}
663			current = nil
664		}
665		for fieldIndex, raw := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{0}) {
666			if len(raw) == 0 {
667				flush()
668				continue
669			}
670			keyBytes, valueBytes, hasValue := bytes.Cut(raw, []byte{' '})
671			key, value := string(keyBytes), ""
672			if hasValue {
673				value = string(valueBytes)
674			}
675			if key == "worktree" {
676				flush()
677				current = &RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{
678					Path: value, Presence: RecoveryPresenceUnknown, Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete,
679					Operations: []RecoveryOperation{}, IndexEntries: []RecoveryIndexEntry{},
680					TrackedFiles: []RecoveryTrackedFile{}, DirtyPaths: []RecoveryDirtyPath{},
681					UntrackedPaths: []string{}, IgnoredPaths: []string{}, LFSPaths: []RecoveryLFSPath{},
682					Submodules: []RecoverySubmodule{}, NestedRepositories: []RecoveryNestedRepository{},
683				}
684				continue
685			}
686			if current == nil {
687				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("worktree field %d precedes a worktree path", fieldIndex))
688				continue
689			}
690			switch key {
691			case "HEAD":
692				current.Head = value
693			case "branch":
694				current.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(value, "refs/heads/")
695			case "detached":
696				current.Detached = true
697			case "bare":
698				current.Bare = true
699			case "locked":
700				current.Locked, current.LockedReason = true, value
701			case "prunable":
702				current.Prunable, current.PrunableReason = true, value
703			}
704		}
705		flush()
706		return worktrees, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
707	}
708
709	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectWorktree(repository Repo, worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
710		if worktree == nil {
711			return nil
712		}
713		if err := collector.contextError("worktree", worktree.Path); err != nil {
714			return err
715		}
716		info, err := os.Lstat(worktree.Path)
717		switch {
718		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
719			worktree.Presence = RecoveryPresenceMissing
720			collector.blocker("worktree-missing", "worktree", worktree.Path, "registered worktree root is missing")
721			return nil
722		case err != nil:
723			worktree.Presence = RecoveryPresenceUnknown
724			return collector.failure("worktree-root-probe-failed", "worktree", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness)
725		case info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.IsDir():
726			worktree.Presence = RecoveryPresencePresent
727			collector.markPartial(&worktree.Completeness)
728			collector.blocker("unsafe-worktree-root", "worktree", worktree.Path, "registered worktree root is not a stable directory")
729			return nil
730		default:
731			worktree.Presence = RecoveryPresencePresent
732		}
733		if worktree.Locked {
734			collector.blocker("worktree-locked", "worktree", worktree.Path, "registered worktree is locked")
735		}
736		if worktree.Prunable {
737			collector.blocker("worktree-prunable", "worktree", worktree.Path, "registered worktree is prunable")
738		}
739
740		gitDirOutput, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil, "rev-parse", "--absolute-git-dir")
741		if err != nil {
742			if cancelErr := collector.failure("worktree-git-dir-probe-failed", "worktree", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
743				return cancelErr
744			}
745		} else {
746			worktree.GitDir = filepath.Clean(strings.TrimSpace(string(gitDirOutput)))
747			if worktree.GitDir == "." || !filepath.IsAbs(worktree.GitDir) {
748				_ = collector.failure("worktree-git-dir-parse-failed", "worktree", worktree.Path,
749					errors.New("Git returned a non-absolute worktree git directory"), &worktree.Completeness)
750				worktree.GitDir = ""
751			}
752		}
753		if worktree.GitDir == "" {
754			worktree.GitDir = filepath.Clean(repository.GitDir)
755		}
756		if err := collector.collectOperations(worktree); err != nil {
757			return err
758		}
759		if worktree.Bare || repository.Bare {
760			return nil
761		}
762		if err := collector.collectSparseConfig(worktree); err != nil {
763			return err
764		}
765		if err := collector.collectIndex(worktree); err != nil {
766			return err
767		}
768		submodules := collector.collectSubmodules(worktree)
769		if err := collector.collectStatus(worktree); err != nil {
770			return err
771		}
772		if err := collector.collectIgnored(worktree); err != nil {
773			return err
774		}
775		if err := collector.collectTrackedFiles(worktree); err != nil {
776			return err
777		}
778		if err := collector.collectLFS(worktree); err != nil {
779			return err
780		}
781		return collector.collectNestedRepositories(worktree, submodules)
782	}
783
784	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectOperations(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
785		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(worktree.GitDir)
786		if err != nil {
787			return collector.failure("worktree-git-dir-open-failed", "git-operation", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness)
788		}
789		defer root.Close()
790		for _, name := range []string{"MERGE_HEAD", "CHERRY_PICK_HEAD", "REVERT_HEAD", "rebase-merge", "rebase-apply", "sequencer"} {
791			info, statErr := root.Lstat(name)
792			if errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
793				continue
794			}
795			if statErr != nil {
796				if cancelErr := collector.failure("git-operation-probe-failed", "git-operation", worktree.Path+":"+name, statErr, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
797					return cancelErr
798				}
799				continue
800			}
801			worktree.Operations = append(worktree.Operations, RecoveryOperation{Name: name, Type: recoveryEntryType(info)})
802			collector.blocker("git-operation-active", "git-operation", worktree.Path+":"+name, "Git operation marker is present")
803		}
804		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(worktree.GitDir, rootInfo); err != nil {
805			return collector.failure("worktree-git-dir-changed", "git-operation", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness)
806		}
807		return nil
808	}
809
810	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectTrackedFiles(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
811		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(worktree.Path)
812		if err != nil {
813			return collector.failure("worktree-root-open-failed", "tracked-files", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness)
814		}
815		defer root.Close()
816		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
817		for _, indexEntry := range worktree.IndexEntries {
818			if _, exists := seen[indexEntry.Path]; exists {
819				continue
820			}
821			seen[indexEntry.Path] = struct{}{}
822			if indexEntry.Mode == "160000" || indexEntry.Mode == "040000" {
823				continue
824			}
825			tracked := RecoveryTrackedFile{Path: indexEntry.Path, Type: RecoveryEntryMissing}
826			info, statErr := recoveryLstatRelative(root, indexEntry.Path)
827			if errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
828				worktree.TrackedFiles = append(worktree.TrackedFiles, tracked)
829				continue
830			}
831			if statErr != nil {
832				tracked.Type = RecoveryEntryUnreadable
833				tracked.Error = recoveryCleanText(statErr.Error())
834				worktree.TrackedFiles = append(worktree.TrackedFiles, tracked)
835				if cancelErr := collector.failure("tracked-path-probe-failed", "tracked-file", worktree.Path+":"+indexEntry.Path, statErr, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
836					return cancelErr
837				}
838				continue
839			}
840			tracked.Materialized = true
841			tracked.Type = recoveryEntryType(info)
842			tracked.Size = info.Size()
843			tracked.Mode = uint32(info.Mode())
844			if tracked.Type != RecoveryEntryRegular {
845				tracked.Error = "materialized tracked path is not a regular file"
846				worktree.TrackedFiles = append(worktree.TrackedFiles, tracked)
847				collector.blocker("tracked-path-unsupported-type", "tracked-file", worktree.Path+":"+indexEntry.Path, tracked.Error)
848				continue
849			}
850			data, readInfo, readErr := recoveryReadRelative(collector.ctx, root, indexEntry.Path, info, recoveryMaxCaptureSize)
851			if readErr != nil {
852				tracked.Type = RecoveryEntryUnreadable
853				tracked.Error = recoveryCleanText(readErr.Error())
854				worktree.TrackedFiles = append(worktree.TrackedFiles, tracked)
855				if cancelErr := collector.failure("tracked-file-read-failed", "tracked-file", worktree.Path+":"+indexEntry.Path, readErr, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
856					return cancelErr
857				}
858				continue
859			}
860			tracked.Size = readInfo.Size()
861			tracked.Mode = uint32(readInfo.Mode())
862			tracked.Digest = recoveryDigest(data)
863			collector.snapshot.trackedBytes[recoveryTrackedKey(worktree.Path, indexEntry.Path)] = bytes.Clone(data)
864			worktree.TrackedFiles = append(worktree.TrackedFiles, tracked)
865		}
866		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(worktree.Path, rootInfo); err != nil {
867			return collector.failure("worktree-root-changed", "tracked-files", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness)
868		}
869		return nil
870	}
871
872	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectNestedRepositories(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot, submodules map[string]struct{}) error {
873		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(worktree.Path)
874		if err != nil {
875			return collector.failure("worktree-root-open-failed", "nested-repositories", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness)
876		}
877		defer root.Close()
878		walkErr := fs.WalkDir(root.FS(), ".", func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
879			if err := collector.contextError("nested-repositories", worktree.Path); err != nil {
880				return err
881			}
882			if walkErr != nil {
883				_ = collector.failure("nested-repository-walk-failed", "nested-repositories", worktree.Path+":"+path, walkErr, &worktree.Completeness)
884				if entry != nil && entry.IsDir() {
885					return fs.SkipDir
886				}
887				return nil
888			}
889			if path == "." {
890				return nil
891			}
892			relative := filepath.ToSlash(path)
893			if relative == ".git" {
894				if entry.IsDir() {
895					return fs.SkipDir
896				}
897				return nil
898			}
899			if entry.Name() != ".git" {
900				return nil
901			}
902			parent := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(relative))
903			if _, isSubmodule := submodules[parent]; isSubmodule {
904				if entry.IsDir() {
905					return fs.SkipDir
906				}
907				return nil
908			}
909			// WalkDir never follows symlink entries. The already-walked parent chain is
910			// therefore confined, while Root.Lstat lets us inspect the reserved .git
911			// marker name that portable payload validation intentionally rejects.
912			info, err := root.Lstat(relative)
913			if err != nil {
914				_ = collector.failure("nested-repository-marker-probe-failed", "nested-repositories", worktree.Path+":"+parent, err, &worktree.Completeness)
915				return nil
916			}
917			worktree.NestedRepositories = append(worktree.NestedRepositories, RecoveryNestedRepository{
918				Path: parent, MarkerType: recoveryEntryType(info),
919			})
920			collector.blocker("nested-repository", "nested-repositories", worktree.Path+":"+parent, "nested repository requires independent recovery proof")
921			if entry.IsDir() {
922				return fs.SkipDir
923			}
924			return nil
925		})
926		if walkErr != nil {
927			if cancelErr := collector.failure("nested-repository-walk-failed", "nested-repositories", worktree.Path, walkErr, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
928				return cancelErr
929			}
930		}
931		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(worktree.Path, rootInfo); err != nil {
932			return collector.failure("worktree-root-changed", "nested-repositories", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness)
933		}
934		return nil
935	}

937	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectAdminRoots(repository Repo) error {
938		roots := []struct {
939			kind RecoveryAdminRootKind
940			path string
941		}{{RecoveryAdminCommonDir, repository.GitCommonDir}}
942		if filepath.Clean(repository.GitDir) != filepath.Clean(repository.GitCommonDir) {
943			roots = append(roots, struct {
944				kind RecoveryAdminRootKind
945				path string
946			}{RecoveryAdminGitDir, repository.GitDir})
947		}
948		for _, candidate := range roots {
949			if err := collector.collectAdminRoot(candidate.kind, filepath.Clean(candidate.path)); err != nil {
950				return err
951			}
952		}
953		return nil
954	}

956	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectAdminRoot(kind RecoveryAdminRootKind, path string) error {
957		result := RecoveryAdminRoot{Kind: kind, Path: path, Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete, Entries: []RecoveryAdminEntry{}}
958		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(path)
959		if err != nil {
960			if cancelErr := collector.failure("admin-root-open-failed", "git-admin", string(kind), err, &result.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
961				collector.snapshot.AdminRoots = append(collector.snapshot.AdminRoots, result)
962				return cancelErr
963			}
964			collector.snapshot.AdminRoots = append(collector.snapshot.AdminRoots, result)
965			return nil
966		}
967		defer root.Close()
968		walkErr := fs.WalkDir(root.FS(), ".", func(relative string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
969			if err := collector.contextError("git-admin", path); err != nil {
970				return err
971			}
972			if relative == "." {
973				return nil
974			}
975			relative = filepath.ToSlash(relative)
976			admin := RecoveryAdminEntry{Path: relative, Type: RecoveryEntryUnreadable}
977			if walkErr != nil {
978				admin.Error = recoveryCleanText(walkErr.Error())
979				result.Entries = append(result.Entries, admin)
980				_ = collector.failure("admin-entry-walk-failed", "git-admin", string(kind)+":"+relative, walkErr, &result.Completeness)
981				if entry != nil && entry.IsDir() {
982					return fs.SkipDir
983				}
984				return nil
985			}
986			info, statErr := recoveryLstatRelative(root, relative)
987			if statErr != nil {
988				admin.Error = recoveryCleanText(statErr.Error())
989				result.Entries = append(result.Entries, admin)
990				_ = collector.failure("admin-entry-probe-failed", "git-admin", string(kind)+":"+relative, statErr, &result.Completeness)
991				return nil
992			}
993			admin.Type = recoveryEntryType(info)
994			admin.Size = info.Size()
995			admin.Mode = uint32(info.Mode())
996			if admin.Type == RecoveryEntryRegular {
997				data, readInfo, readErr := recoveryReadRelative(collector.ctx, root, relative, info, recoveryMaxCaptureSize)
998				if readErr != nil {
999					admin.Type = RecoveryEntryUnreadable
1000					admin.Error = recoveryCleanText(readErr.Error())
1001					_ = collector.failure("admin-entry-read-failed", "git-admin", string(kind)+":"+relative, readErr, &result.Completeness)
1002				} else {
1003					admin.Size = readInfo.Size()
1004					admin.Mode = uint32(readInfo.Mode())
1005					admin.Digest = recoveryDigest(data)
1006					collector.snapshot.adminBytes[recoveryAdminKey(kind, relative)] = bytes.Clone(data)
1007				}
1008			} else if admin.Type == RecoveryEntrySymlink || admin.Type == RecoveryEntrySpecial {
1009				admin.Error = "Git administrative entry has an unsupported filesystem type"
1010				collector.blocker("admin-entry-unsupported-type", "git-admin", string(kind)+":"+relative, admin.Error)
1011			}
1012			result.Entries = append(result.Entries, admin)
1013			return nil
1014		})
1015		if walkErr != nil {
1016			if cancelErr := collector.failure("admin-root-walk-failed", "git-admin", string(kind), walkErr, &result.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
1017				collector.snapshot.AdminRoots = append(collector.snapshot.AdminRoots, result)
1018				return cancelErr
1019			}
1020		}
1021		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(path, rootInfo); err != nil {
1022			_ = collector.failure("admin-root-changed", "git-admin", string(kind), err, &result.Completeness)
1023		}
1024		collector.snapshot.AdminRoots = append(collector.snapshot.AdminRoots, result)
1025		return nil
1026	}
1027
1028	type recoveryHeldRoot struct {
1029		parent *os.Root
1030		name   string
1031		info   fs.FileInfo
1032		root   *os.Root
1033	}
1034
1035	func recoveryOpenParent(root *os.Root, relative string) (*os.Root, []recoveryHeldRoot, string, error) {
1036		relative = filepath.ToSlash(relative)
1037		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(relative, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
1038			return nil, nil, "", err
1039		}
1040		parts := strings.Split(relative, "/")
1041		current := root
1042		held := make([]recoveryHeldRoot, 0, len(parts)-1)
1043		for _, component := range parts[:len(parts)-1] {
1044			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(current, component)
1045			if err != nil {
1046				recoveryCloseHeld(held)
1047				return nil, nil, "", err
1048			}
1049			held = append(held, recoveryHeldRoot{parent: current, name: component, info: info, root: child})
1050			current = child
1051		}
1052		return current, held, parts[len(parts)-1], nil
1053	}
1054
1055	func recoveryCloseHeld(held []recoveryHeldRoot) error {
1056		var result error
1057		for index := len(held) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
1058			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(held[index].parent, held[index].name, held[index].info))
1059			result = errors.Join(result, held[index].root.Close())
1060		}
1061		return result
1062	}
1063
1064	func recoveryLstatRelative(root *os.Root, relative string) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
1065		parent, held, name, err := recoveryOpenParent(root, relative)
1066		if err != nil {
1067			return nil, err
1068		}
1069		info, statErr := parent.Lstat(name)
1070		closeErr := recoveryCloseHeld(held)
1071		return info, errors.Join(statErr, closeErr)
1072	}
1073
1074	func recoveryReadRelative(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, relative string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
1075		parent, held, name, err := recoveryOpenParent(root, relative)
1076		if err != nil {
1077			return nil, nil, err
1078		}
1079		data, info, readErr := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, parent, name, expected, maxBytes)
1080		closeErr := recoveryCloseHeld(held)
1081		return data, info, errors.Join(readErr, closeErr)
1082	}
1083
1084	func recoveryEntryType(info fs.FileInfo) RecoveryEntryType {
1085		if info == nil {
1086			return RecoveryEntryUnreadable
1087		}
1088		switch {
1089		case info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0:
1090			return RecoveryEntrySymlink
1091		case info.IsDir():
1092			return RecoveryEntryDirectory
1093		case info.Mode().IsRegular():
1094			return RecoveryEntryRegular
1095		default:
1096			return RecoveryEntrySpecial
1097		}
1098	}

1100	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectStoragePlacement(repository Repo) {
1101		facts := &collector.snapshot.Repository
1102		if repository.Root != "" {
1103			inside, err := pathx.Contains(repository.Root, repository.GitDir)
1104			if err != nil {
1105				_ = collector.failure("git-dir-placement-probe-failed", "storage", "git-dir", err, nil)
1106			} else {
1107				facts.GitDirOutsideRoot = !inside
1108			}
1109		}
1110		mainRoot := repository.Root
1111		for _, worktree := range collector.snapshot.Worktrees {
1112			if worktree.Main && worktree.Path != "" {
1113				mainRoot = worktree.Path
1114				break
1115			}
1116		}
1117		if mainRoot != "" {
1118			inside, err := pathx.Contains(mainRoot, repository.GitCommonDir)
1119			if err != nil {
1120				_ = collector.failure("common-dir-placement-probe-failed", "storage", "common-dir", err, nil)
1121			} else {
1122				facts.CommonDirOutsideMainRoot = !inside
1123				if !inside {
1124					collector.blocker("external-common-directory", "storage", "common-dir", "Git common directory is outside the main worktree root")
1125				}
1126			}
1127		}
1128		facts.SharedCommonDir = repository.GitDir != repository.GitCommonDir || len(collector.snapshot.Worktrees) > 1
1129	}

1131	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectIndex(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
1132		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil,
1133			"ls-files", "--stage", "-v", "-z", "--sparse", "--full-name")
1134		if err != nil {
1135			if cancelErr := collector.failure("index-probe-failed", "index", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
1136				return cancelErr
1137			}
1138		}
1139		entries, parseErr := parseRecoveryIndex(output)
1140		worktree.IndexEntries = entries
1141		if parseErr != nil {
1142			_ = collector.failure("index-parse-failed", "index", worktree.Path, parseErr, &worktree.Completeness)
1143		}
1144		for _, entry := range entries {
1145			if entry.Mode == "040000" {
1146				worktree.SparseIndex = true
1147			}
1148		}
1149		return nil
1150	}
1151
1152	func parseRecoveryIndex(output []byte) ([]RecoveryIndexEntry, error) {
1153		entries := []RecoveryIndexEntry{}
1154		var parseErrors []error
1155		for recordIndex, record := range recoveryNULRecords(output) {
1156			header, pathBytes, ok := bytes.Cut(record, []byte{'\t'})
1157			if !ok || len(pathBytes) == 0 || !utf8.Valid(pathBytes) {
1158				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has an invalid path field", recordIndex))
1159				continue
1160			}
1161			fields := strings.Fields(string(header))
1162			if len(fields) != 4 || len(fields[0]) != 1 {
1163				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has an invalid header", recordIndex))
1164				continue
1165			}
1166			if _, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(fields[1], 8, 32); modeErr != nil {
1167				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d mode %q: %w", recordIndex, fields[1], modeErr))
1168				continue
1169			}
1170			stage, stageErr := strconv.Atoi(fields[3])
1171			if stageErr != nil || stage < 0 || stage > 3 {
1172				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has invalid stage %q", recordIndex, fields[3]))
1173				continue
1174			}
1175			tag := fields[0][0]
1176			upper := tag
1177			if upper >= 'a' && upper <= 'z' {
1178				upper -= 'a' - 'A'
1179			}
1180			entries = append(entries, RecoveryIndexEntry{
1181				Path: string(pathBytes), Mode: fields[1], OID: fields[2], Stage: stage, Tag: fields[0],
1182				AssumeUnchanged: tag >= 'a' && tag <= 'z', SkipWorktree: upper == 'S',
1183			})
1184		}
1185		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
1186			if entries[i].Path != entries[j].Path {
1187				return entries[i].Path < entries[j].Path
1188			}
1189			if entries[i].Stage != entries[j].Stage {
1190				return entries[i].Stage < entries[j].Stage
1191			}
1192			return entries[i].Mode < entries[j].Mode
1193		})
1194		return entries, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
1195	}
1196
1197	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectSparseConfig(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
1198		probes := []struct {
1199			key    string
1200			target *bool
1201		}{
1202			{"core.sparseCheckout", &worktree.SparseCheckout},
1203			{"core.sparseCheckoutCone", &worktree.SparseCone},
1204			{"index.sparse", &worktree.SparseIndex},
1205		}
1206		for _, probe := range probes {
1207			output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil,
1208				"config", "--bool", "--default=false", "--get", probe.key)
1209			if err != nil {
1210				if cancelErr := collector.failure("sparse-config-probe-failed", "sparse", worktree.Path+":"+probe.key, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
1211					return cancelErr
1212				}
1213				continue
1214			}
1215			value, boolErr := recoveryGitBool(string(output))
1216			if boolErr != nil {
1217				_ = collector.failure("sparse-config-parse-failed", "sparse", worktree.Path+":"+probe.key, boolErr, &worktree.Completeness)
1218				continue
1219			}
1220			*probe.target = *probe.target || value
1221		}
1222		if worktree.SparseCheckout {
1223			collector.blocker("sparse-checkout", "sparse", worktree.Path, "worktree uses sparse checkout")
1224		}
1225		if worktree.SparseIndex {
1226			collector.blocker("sparse-index", "sparse", worktree.Path, "worktree index contains sparse directory state")
1227		}
1228		return nil
1229	}
1230
1231	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectStatus(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
1232		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil,
1233			"status", "--porcelain=v2", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
1234		if err != nil {
1235			if cancelErr := collector.failure("status-probe-failed", "status", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
1236				return cancelErr
1237			}
1238		}
1239		dirty, untracked, parseErr := parseRecoveryStatus(output)
1240		worktree.DirtyPaths, worktree.UntrackedPaths = dirty, untracked
1241		if parseErr != nil {
1242			_ = collector.failure("status-parse-failed", "status", worktree.Path, parseErr, &worktree.Completeness)
1243		}
1244		return nil
1245	}
1246
1247	func parseRecoveryStatus(output []byte) ([]RecoveryDirtyPath, []string, error) {
1248		records := recoveryNULRecords(output)
1249		dirty := []RecoveryDirtyPath{}
1250		untracked := []string{}
1251		var parseErrors []error
1252		for index := 0; index < len(records); index++ {
1253			record := string(records[index])
1254			if record == "" {
1255				continue
1256			}
1257			switch record[0] {
1258			case '1', '2':
1259				fields := strings.Fields(record)
1260				path := statusPath(record)
1261				if len(fields) < 2 || len(fields[1]) != 2 || path == "" {
1262					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("status record %d is malformed", index))
1263					continue
1264				}
1265				change := RecoveryDirtyPath{
1266					Path: path, Kind: "ordinary", IndexStatus: string(fields[1][0]), WorktreeStatus: string(fields[1][1]),
1267				}
1268				if record[0] == '2' {
1269					change.Kind = "rename-or-copy"
1270					if index+1 >= len(records) {
1271						parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("rename status record %d has no source path", index))
1272					} else {
1273						index++
1274						change.OldPath = string(records[index])
1275					}
1276				}
1277				dirty = append(dirty, change)
1278			case 'u':
1279				fields := strings.Fields(record)
1280				path := statusPath(record)
1281				if len(fields) < 2 || len(fields[1]) != 2 || path == "" {
1282					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("unmerged status record %d is malformed", index))
1283					continue
1284				}
1285				dirty = append(dirty, RecoveryDirtyPath{
1286					Path: path, Kind: "unmerged", IndexStatus: string(fields[1][0]), WorktreeStatus: string(fields[1][1]),
1287				})
1288			case '?':
1289				path := strings.TrimPrefix(record, "? ")
1290				if path == record || path == "" {
1291					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("untracked status record %d is malformed", index))
1292					continue
1293				}
1294				untracked = append(untracked, path)
1295			case '#':
1296				// Branch headers are allowed if a future caller adds --branch.
1297			default:
1298				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("unknown status record %d type %q", index, record[0]))
1299			}
1300		}
1301		sort.Slice(dirty, func(i, j int) bool {

1334	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectLFS(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {

1376				}

1381					fmt.Errorf("Git returned %d attribute fields, want a multiple of three", len(values)), &worktree.Completeness)
1382				continue
1383			}
1384			for field := 0; field < len(values); field += 3 {
1385				path, attribute, value := string(values[field]), string(values[field+1]), string(values[field+2])

1388				}

1390				if fact == nil {
1391					fact = &RecoveryLFSPath{Path: path}
1392					byPath[path] = fact

1394				if probe.cached {

1396				} else {
1397					fact.WorktreeAttributes = true
1398				}
1399			}
1400		}
1401		for _, path := range ordered {
1402			if fact := byPath[path]; fact != nil {
1403				worktree.LFSPaths = append(worktree.LFSPaths, *fact)
1404				collector.blocker("lfs-path", "lfs", worktree.Path+":"+path, "path is governed by the Git LFS filter")

1536	func recoveryGit(ctx context.Context, dir string, input []byte, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
1537		if cause := context.Cause(ctx); cause != nil {
1538			return nil, cause
1539		}
1540		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
1541		command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
1542		command.Dir = dir
1543		command.Env = recoveryEnvironment()
1544		if input != nil {
1545			command.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(input)
1546		}
1547		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
1548		command.Stdout = &stdout
1549		command.Stderr = &stderr
1550		if err := command.Run(); err != nil {
1551			if cause := context.Cause(ctx); cause != nil {
1552				return stdout.Bytes(), cause
1553			}
1554			return stdout.Bytes(), &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
1555		}
1556		return stdout.Bytes(), nil
1557	}
1558
1559	func recoveryEnvironment() []string {
1560		environment := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+1)
1561		for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
1562			key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
1563			if key != "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS" {
1564				environment = append(environment, entry)
1565			}
1566		}
1567		return append(environment, "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0")
1568	}

1570	func recoveryNULRecords(output []byte) [][]byte {
1571		if len(output) == 0 {
1572			return nil
1573		}
1574		records := bytes.Split(output, []byte{0})
1575		if len(records) > 0 && len(records[len(records)-1]) == 0 {
1576			records = records[:len(records)-1]
1577		}
1578		return records
1579	}

1581	func recoveryDigest(data []byte) string {
1582		digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
1583		return recoveryDigestPrefix + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])

1594	func recoveryCleanText(value string) string {
1595		value = strings.ToValidUTF8(value, "�")
1596		value = strings.Map(func(character rune) rune {
1597			if unicode.IsControl(character) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, character) {
1598				return ' '
1599			}
1600			return character
1601		}, value)
1602		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(strings.Fields(value), " "))
1603	}

1605	func recoveryCleanSubject(value string) string {
1606		value = recoveryCleanText(value)
1607		if value == "" {
1608			return "unknown"
1609		}
1610		return value
1611	}

1613	func recoveryIdentifier(value string) string {
1614		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
1615		var result strings.Builder
1616		lastDash := false
1617		for _, character := range value {
1618			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '.' || character == '/' || character == ':' || character == '_' {
1619				result.WriteRune(character)
1620				lastDash = false
1621				continue
1622			}
1623			if !lastDash {
1624				result.WriteByte('-')
1625				lastDash = true
1626			}
1627		}
1628		identifier := strings.Trim(result.String(), "-./:_")
1629		if identifier == "" {
1630			return "unknown"
1631		}
1632		return identifier
1633	}

64	func (a *Authority) activate(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, request Request, fence bool) (Token, error) {
65		if a == nil {

94					switch {
95					case record.Reservation != nil:

97					case record.Fence != nil:
98						claims[index], claimKinds[index] = record.Fence, "fence"
99					}
100				}
101
102				allSameKind := true
103				var existing Token
104				for index, claim := range claims {
105					wantedKind := "reservation"
106					if fence {
107						wantedKind = "fence"
108					}
109					if claim == nil || claimKinds[index] != wantedKind || !claim.Token.sameOperation(request) || claim.MachineID != request.MachineID {

229				now := canonicalTime(a.clock())
230				for _, key := range canonical {
231					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
232					record.Epoch = epoch
233					if claimKind == "reservation" {
234						record.Reservation = nil
235					} else {
236						record.Fence = nil
237					}
238					if terminal != "" {
239						record.Tombstones = append(record.Tombstones, Tombstone{Kind: terminal, Token: token, AdvancedEpoch: epoch, CreatedAt: now})
240					}
241				}
242				return true, nil
243			})
244		})
245		return advanced, err
246	}
247
248	// WithMutation runs an ordinary mutator only when no requested key is reserved
249	// or fenced. A branch key automatically includes its repository ancestor so a
250	// repository fence covers every branch. The locks remain held until operation
251	// returns.
252	func (a *Authority) WithMutation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func() error) error {
253		return a.WithGuard(ctx, keys, nil, operation)
254	}
255
256	// WithGuard permits the exact owner of an active reservation or fence to work
257	// while rejecting stale, returned, and mismatched tokens. A nil token is an
258	// ordinary mutation guard and includes repository ancestors. It is
259	// non-reentrant: operation must not reacquire an overlapping key.
260	func (a *Authority) WithGuard(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token *Token, operation func() error) error {
261		if a == nil {
262			return errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
263		}
264		if operation == nil {
265			return errors.New("operation lease guard requires an operation")
266		}
267		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool)
272		if token != nil {
273			if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
274				return err
275			}
276		} else {
277			for _, key := range claimed {
278				if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
279					repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
280				}
281			}
282		}
283		return a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func(locked []Key) error {
284			checked := locked
285			if token != nil {
286				// Repository ancestors participate in draining but are not part of a
287				// branch-scoped token's ownership claim.
288				checked = claimed
289			}
290			if err := a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
291				matched := 0
292				for _, key := range checked {
293					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
294					if record == nil {
295						if token != nil {
296							return fmt.Errorf("%s has no operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
297						}
298						continue
299					}
300					if token != nil && hasTerminal(*record, *token) {
301						return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrReturned)
302					}
303					claim, kind := activeClaim(*record)
304					if claim == nil {
305						if token != nil {
306							return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is no longer active on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrEpochMismatch)
307						}
308						continue
309					}
310					if token == nil || !claim.Token.matches(*token) {
311						return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
312					}
313					matched++
314				}
315				if token != nil && matched != len(checked) {
316					return fmt.Errorf("operation %s does not own the complete key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrEpochMismatch)
317				}
318				if token != nil {
319					if err := validateGuardKeySet(state, claimed, *token); err != nil {
320						return err
321					}
322				}
323				if token == nil {
324					for _, record := range state.Records {
325						if record.Key.Scope != ScopeBranch || !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
326							continue
327						}
328						if claim, kind := activeClaim(record); claim != nil {
329							return &BlockedError{Key: record.Key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
330						}
331					}
332				}
333				return nil
334			}); err != nil {
335				return err
336			}
337			return operation()
338		})
339	}
340
341	// Inspect returns records for the requested keys while holding those key locks.
342	// Untouched keys are represented with Epoch zero and are never persisted.
343	func (a *Authority) Inspect(ctx context.Context, keys []Key) ([]Record, error) {
344		if a == nil {
345			return nil, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
346		}
347		var result []Record
348		err := a.withKeyLocks(ctx, keys, func(canonical []Key) error {
349			return a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
350				result = make([]Record, 0, len(canonical))
351				for _, key := range canonical {
352					if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
353						result = append(result, cloneRecord(*record))
354					} else {
355						result = append(result, Record{Key: key})
356					}
357				}
358				return nil
359			})
360		})
361		return result, err
362	}
363
364	func mutationKeys(keys []Key) []Key {
365		expanded := append([]Key(nil), keys...)
366		for _, key := range keys {
367			if key.Scope == ScopeBranch {
368				expanded = append(expanded, RepositoryKey(key.Repository))
369			}
370		}
371		return expanded
372	}
373
374	func (a *Authority) withKeyLocks(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func([]Key) error) error {
375		canonical, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
376		if err != nil {
377			return err
378		}
379		if ctx == nil {
380			ctx = context.Background()
381		}
382		if err := a.ensureLayout(); err != nil {
383			return err
384		}
385		var acquire func(int) error
386		acquire = func(index int) error {
387			if index == len(canonical) {
388				return operation(canonical)
389			}
390			directory := a.keyLockDir(canonical[index])
391			if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
392				return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation key lock: %w", err)
393			}
394			return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease key", func() error { return acquire(index + 1) })
395		}
396		return acquire(0)
397	}
398
399	func (a *Authority) updateState(ctx context.Context, mutate func(*Snapshot) (bool, error)) error {
400		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
401			state, err := a.loadState()
402			if err != nil {
403				return err
404			}
405			changed, err := mutate(&state)
406			if err != nil || !changed {
407				return err
408			}
409			return a.writeState(state)
410		})
411	}
412
413	func (a *Authority) readState(ctx context.Context, read func(Snapshot) error) error {
414		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
415			state, err := a.loadState()
416			if err != nil {
417				return err
418			}
419			return read(state)
420		})
421	}
422
423	func (a *Authority) withStateLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
424		directory := filepath.Join(a.root, ".authority")
425		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
426			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation authority lock: %w", err)
427		}
428		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease authority", operation)
429	}
430
431	func (a *Authority) ensureLayout() error {
432		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
433			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation lease root: %w", err)
434		}
435		if err := ensurePrivateDir(filepath.Join(a.root, ".keys")); err != nil {
436			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation lease key root: %w", err)
437		}
438		return nil
439	}
440
441	func (a *Authority) keyLockDir(key Key) string {
442		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(key.canonical()))
443		return filepath.Join(a.root, ".keys", hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]))
444	}
445
446	func (a *Authority) statePath() string { return filepath.Join(a.root, stateFilename) }
447
448	func (a *Authority) loadState() (Snapshot, error) {
449		path := a.statePath()
450		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
451		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
452			return Snapshot{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}, nil
453		}
454		if err != nil {
455			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state: %w", err)
456		}
457		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
458			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s is not a regular file", path)
459		}
460		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
461		if err != nil {
462			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state permissions: %w", err)
463		}
464		if !private {
465			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
466		}
467		file, err := os.Open(path)
468		if err != nil {
469			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("open operation lease state: %w", err)
470		}
471		defer file.Close()
472		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
473		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
474		var state Snapshot
475		if err := decoder.Decode(&state); err != nil {
476			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state: %w", err)
477		}
478		var extra any
479		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
480			if err == nil {
481				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("decode operation lease state: multiple JSON values")
482			}
483			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state trailing data: %w", err)
484		}
485		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
486			return Snapshot{}, err
487		}
488		canonical := canonicalSnapshot(state)
489		encodedState, _ := json.Marshal(state)
490		encodedCanonical, _ := json.Marshal(canonical)
491		if string(encodedState) != string(encodedCanonical) {
492			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("operation lease state is not in canonical order")
493		}
494		return state, nil
495	}
496
497	func (a *Authority) writeState(state Snapshot) error {
498		state = canonicalSnapshot(state)
499		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
500			return err
501		}
502		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
503			return err
504		}
505		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(a.root, ".authority-*.tmp")
506		if err != nil {
507			return fmt.Errorf("create operation lease state temp file: %w", err)
508		}
509		name := temporary.Name()
510		defer os.Remove(name)
511		if err := setPrivateMode(name, 0o600); err != nil {
512			_ = temporary.Close()
513			return err
514		}
515		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)
516		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
517		if err := encoder.Encode(state); err != nil {
518			_ = temporary.Close()
519			return fmt.Errorf("encode operation lease state: %w", err)
520		}
521		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
522			_ = temporary.Close()
523			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease state: %w", err)
524		}
525		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
526			return fmt.Errorf("close operation lease state: %w", err)
527		}
528		if err := replaceFile(name, a.statePath()); err != nil {
529			return fmt.Errorf("publish operation lease state: %w", err)
530		}
531		if err := syncDirectory(a.root); err != nil {
532			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease directory: %w", err)
533		}
534		return nil
535	}
536
537	func validateSnapshot(state Snapshot) error {
538		if state.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
539			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease schema_version %d: want %d", state.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
540		}
541		bindings := make(map[string]string, len(state.Bindings))
542		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
543			if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
544				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease binding: %w", err)
545			}
546			if _, exists := bindings[binding.OperationID]; exists {
547				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease repeats binding %s", binding.OperationID)
548			}
549			bindings[binding.OperationID] = binding.Digest
550		}
551		type activeSignature struct {
552			Token     Token
553			MachineID string
554			Kind      string
555		}
556		activeOperations := make(map[string]activeSignature)
557		terminalOperations := make(map[string]Tombstone)
558		seenKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(state.Records))
559		var maxRecordEpoch uint64
560		for _, record := range state.Records {
561			if err := record.Key.Validate(); err != nil {
562				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease record: %w", err)
563			}
564			canonicalKey := record.Key.canonical()
565			if _, exists := seenKeys[canonicalKey]; exists {
566				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease state repeats key %s", record.Key.subject())
567			}
568			seenKeys[canonicalKey] = struct{}{}
569			if record.Epoch == 0 || record.Epoch > state.LastEpoch {
570				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has invalid epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), record.Epoch)
571			}
572			if record.Epoch > maxRecordEpoch {
573				maxRecordEpoch = record.Epoch
574			}
575			if record.Reservation != nil && record.Fence != nil {
576				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has both reservation and fence", record.Key.subject())
577			}
578			for _, named := range []struct {
579				name  string
580				claim *Claim
581			}{{"reservation", record.Reservation}, {"fence", record.Fence}} {
582				if named.claim == nil {
583					continue
584				}
585				if err := named.claim.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
586					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s: %w", named.name, record.Key.subject(), err)
587				}
588				if digest, exists := bindings[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != named.claim.Token.Digest {
589					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no matching permanent binding", named.name, record.Key.subject())
590				}
591				if named.claim.Token.Epoch != record.Epoch {
592					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has epoch %d, record has %d", named.name, record.Key.subject(), named.claim.Token.Epoch, record.Epoch)
593				}
594				if named.claim.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
595					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no created_at", named.name, record.Key.subject())
596				}
597				if named.claim.MachineID != "" {
598					if err := machineid.Validate(named.claim.MachineID); err != nil {
599						return err
600					}
601				}
602				signature := activeSignature{Token: named.claim.Token, MachineID: named.claim.MachineID, Kind: named.name}
603				if prior, exists := activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; exists {
604					if !prior.Token.matches(signature.Token) || prior.MachineID != signature.MachineID || prior.Kind != signature.Kind {
605						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent active claims", named.claim.Token.OperationID)
606					}
607				} else {
608					activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID] = signature
609				}
610			}
611			seenTombstones := make(map[string]struct{}, len(record.Tombstones))
612			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
613				switch tombstone.Kind {
614				case TombstoneAborted, TombstoneReturned:
615				default:
616					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has unknown tombstone kind %q", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.Kind)
617				}
618				if err := tombstone.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
619					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s: %w", record.Key.subject(), err)
620				}
621				if digest, exists := bindings[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != tombstone.Token.Digest {
622					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no matching permanent binding", record.Key.subject())
623				}
624				if tombstone.AdvancedEpoch <= tombstone.Token.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > record.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > state.LastEpoch {
625					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has invalid advanced epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.AdvancedEpoch)
626				}
627				if tombstone.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
628					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no created_at", record.Key.subject())
629				}
630				if prior, exists := terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; exists {
631					if !prior.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || prior.Kind != tombstone.Kind || prior.AdvancedEpoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
632						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent terminal records", tombstone.Token.OperationID)
633					}
634				} else {
635					terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID] = tombstone
636				}
637				identity := fmt.Sprintf("%s\x00%s\x00%d", tombstone.Token.OperationID, tombstone.Token.Digest, tombstone.Token.Epoch)
638				if _, exists := seenTombstones[identity]; exists {
639					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s repeats a terminal token", record.Key.subject())
640				}
641				seenTombstones[identity] = struct{}{}
642				if record.Reservation != nil && record.Reservation.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || record.Fence != nil && record.Fence.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) {
643					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has a terminal token still active", record.Key.subject())
644				}
645			}
646		}
647		if state.LastEpoch != maxRecordEpoch {
648			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease last_epoch %d does not match latest record epoch %d", state.LastEpoch, maxRecordEpoch)
649		}
650		for operationID := range activeOperations {
651			if _, terminal := terminalOperations[operationID]; terminal {
652				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s is both active and terminal", operationID)
653			}
654		}
655		return nil
656	}
657
658	func canonicalSnapshot(state Snapshot) Snapshot {
659		result := Snapshot{
660			SchemaVersion: state.SchemaVersion,
661			LastEpoch:     state.LastEpoch,
662			Bindings:      append([]Binding(nil), state.Bindings...),
663			Records:       make([]Record, len(state.Records)),
664		}
665		sort.Slice(result.Bindings, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Bindings[i].OperationID < result.Bindings[j].OperationID })
666		for index, record := range state.Records {
667			result.Records[index] = cloneRecord(record)
668			if result.Records[index].Reservation != nil {
669				result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt)
670			}
671			if result.Records[index].Fence != nil {
672				result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt)
673			}
674			for tombstoneIndex := range result.Records[index].Tombstones {
675				result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt)
676			}
677			sort.Slice(result.Records[index].Tombstones, func(i, j int) bool {
678				left, right := result.Records[index].Tombstones[i], result.Records[index].Tombstones[j]
679				if left.Token.Epoch != right.Token.Epoch {
680					return left.Token.Epoch < right.Token.Epoch
681				}
682				if left.Token.OperationID != right.Token.OperationID {
683					return left.Token.OperationID < right.Token.OperationID
684				}
685				if left.Token.Digest != right.Token.Digest {
686					return left.Token.Digest < right.Token.Digest
687				}
688				return left.Kind < right.Kind
689			})
690		}
691		sort.Slice(result.Records, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Records[i].Key.canonical() < result.Records[j].Key.canonical() })
692		return result
693	}
694
695	func cloneRecord(record Record) Record {
696		result := record
697		if record.Reservation != nil {
698			copy := *record.Reservation
699			result.Reservation = &copy
700		}
701		if record.Fence != nil {
702			copy := *record.Fence
703			result.Fence = &copy
704		}
705		result.Tombstones = append([]Tombstone(nil), record.Tombstones...)
706		return result
707	}
708
709	func findRecord(records []Record, key Key) *Record {
710		canonical := key.canonical()
711		for index := range records {
712			if records[index].Key.canonical() == canonical {
713				return &records[index]
714			}
715		}
716		return nil
717	}
718
719	func ensureRecord(state *Snapshot, key Key) *Record {
720		if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
721			return record
722		}
723		state.Records = append(state.Records, Record{Key: key})
724		return &state.Records[len(state.Records)-1]
725	}
726
727	func allocateEpoch(state *Snapshot) (uint64, error) {
728		if state.LastEpoch == math.MaxUint64 {
729			return 0, errors.New("operation lease epoch exhausted")
730		}
731		state.LastEpoch++
732		return state.LastEpoch, nil
733	}
734
735	func activeClaim(record Record) (*Claim, string) {
736		if record.Reservation != nil {
737			return record.Reservation, "reservation"
738		}
739		if record.Fence != nil {
740			return record.Fence, "fence"
741		}
742		return nil, ""
743	}
744
745	func hasTerminal(record Record, token Token) bool {
746		for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
747			if tombstone.Token.matches(token) {
748				return true
749			}
750		}
751		return false
752	}
753
754	func ensureBinding(state *Snapshot, request Request) bool {
755		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
756			if binding.OperationID == request.OperationID {
757				return false
758			}
759		}
760		state.Bindings = append(state.Bindings, Binding{OperationID: request.OperationID, Digest: request.Digest})
761		return true
762	}
763
764	func checkOperationReuse(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
765		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
766			if binding.OperationID != request.OperationID {
767				continue
768			}
769			if binding.Digest != request.Digest {
770				return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was permanently bound to another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
771			}
772			break
773		}
774		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
775		for _, key := range keys {
776			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
777		}
778		for _, record := range state.Records {
779			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
780				if tombstone.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
781					continue
782				}
783				if tombstone.Token.Digest != request.Digest {
784					return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was used with another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
785				}
786				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal: %w", request.OperationID, ErrReturned)
787			}
788			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)
789			if claim == nil || claim.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
790				continue
791			}
792			if claim.Token.Digest != request.Digest {
793				return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s is active with another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
794			}
795			if _, exists := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !exists {
796				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s is active on a different key set: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
797			}
798		}
799		return nil
800	}
801
802	func checkHierarchyClaims(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
803		requestedKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
804		requestedRepositories := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
805		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool, len(keys))
806		for _, key := range keys {
807			requestedKeys[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
808			requestedRepositories[key.Repository] = struct{}{}
809			if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
810				repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
811			}
812		}
813		for _, record := range state.Records {
814			claim, kind := activeClaim(record)
815			if claim == nil {
816				continue
817			}
818			if _, requested := requestedKeys[record.Key.canonical()]; requested {
819				continue
820			}
821			if _, sameRepository := requestedRepositories[record.Key.Repository]; !sameRepository {
822				continue
823			}
824			if record.Key.Scope != ScopeRepository && !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
825				continue
826			}
827			return blockedOrConflict(record.Key, kind, *claim, request)
828		}
829		return nil
830	}

832	func blockedOrConflict(key Key, kind string, claim Claim, request Request) error {
833		if claim.Token.OperationID == request.OperationID {
834			return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s conflicts with its active %s: %w", request.OperationID, kind, ErrConflict)
835		}
836		return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
837	}

839	func validateGuardKeySet(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token) error {
840		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
841		for _, key := range keys {
842			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
843		}
844		matched := 0
845		for _, record := range state.Records {
846			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)
847			if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
848				continue
849			}
850			if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
851				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d owns a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
852			}
853			matched++
854		}
855		if matched != len(keys) {
856			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d does not own the exact guard key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
857		}
858		return nil
859	}

861	func validateClaimKeySet(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token, claimKind string) error {
862		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
863		for _, key := range keys {
864			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
865		}
866		matched := 0
867		for _, record := range state.Records {
868			var claim *Claim
869			if claimKind == "reservation" {
870				claim = record.Reservation
871			} else {
872				claim = record.Fence
873			}
874			if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
875				continue
876			}
877			if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
878				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d owns a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
879			}
880			matched++
881		}
882		if matched != len(keys) {
883			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d does not own the exact key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
884		}
885		return nil
886	}

888	func matchingTerminal(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token, kind TombstoneKind) (uint64, bool, error) {
889		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
890		for _, key := range keys {
891			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
892		}
893		var epoch uint64
894		matched := 0
895		for _, record := range state.Records {
896			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
897				if !tombstone.Token.matches(token) {
898					continue
899				}
900				if tombstone.Kind != kind {
901					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d ended as %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, tombstone.Kind, ErrReturned)
902				}
903				if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
904					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
905				}
906				if epoch == 0 {
907					epoch = tombstone.AdvancedEpoch
908				} else if epoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
909					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s has inconsistent terminal epochs: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
910				}
911				matched++
912				break
913			}
914		}
915		if matched == 0 {
916			return 0, false, nil
917		}
918		if matched != len(keys) {
919			return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal on only part of the key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
920		}
921		return epoch, true, nil
922	}

924	func ensurePrivateDir(path string) error {
925		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
926			return err
927		}
928		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
929		if err != nil {
930			return err
931		}
932		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
933			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a private directory", path)
934		}
935		if err := setPrivateMode(path, 0o700); err != nil {
936			return err
937		}
938		info, err = os.Lstat(path)
939		if err != nil {
940			return err
941		}
942		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o700)
943		if err != nil {
944			return fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease directory permissions: %w", err)
945		}
946		if !private {
947			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease directory %s permissions are not private (want 0700 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
948		}
949		return nil
950	}

89	// Prepare validates and reads a template source. A live local Git worktree is
90	// filtered through Git so tracked files (including tracked ignored files) and
91	// untracked non-ignored files are retained without copying ignored secrets. A
92	// ref or non-local source is checked out into an isolated repository first.
93	func Prepare(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Snapshot, error) {
94		request.Source = strings.TrimSpace(request.Source)
95		request.Ref = strings.TrimSpace(request.Ref)
96		request.Subdir = strings.TrimSpace(request.Subdir)
97		if request.Source == "" {
98			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("template source is required")
99		}
100		if strings.HasPrefix(request.Ref, "-") {
101			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template ref %q must not start with '-'", request.Ref)
102		}
103		subdir, err := cleanSubdir(request.Subdir)
104		if err != nil {
105			return Snapshot{}, err
106		}
107
108		local := config.Expand(request.Source)
109		info, statErr := os.Lstat(local)
110		localSource := statErr == nil
111		if statErr == nil {
112			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
113				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source %q is a symlink", repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source))
114			}
115			if !info.IsDir() {
116				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source %q is not a directory", repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source))
117			}
118		} else if !errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
119			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect template source %q: %v", repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source),
120				repo.RedactCloneError(statErr, request.Source, local))
121		}
122		if localSource && request.Ref == "" {
123			return snapshotDirectory(ctx, repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source), local, "", "", subdir, snapshotSource{
124				local: true,
125				live:  true,
126			})
127		}
128
129		checkout, resolvedRef, cleanup, err := checkoutGitSource(ctx, request.Source, request.Ref)
130		if err != nil {
131			return Snapshot{}, err
132		}
133		defer cleanup()
134		return snapshotDirectory(ctx, repo.RedactCloneRef(request.Source), checkout, request.Ref, resolvedRef, subdir, snapshotSource{
135			local: localSource,
136		})
137	}
