139	func checkoutGitSource(ctx context.Context, source, ref string) (string, string, func(), error) {
140		parent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "dev-repo-template-*")
141		if err != nil {
142			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("create template checkout: %w", err)
143		}
144		cleanup := func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(parent) }
145		checkout := filepath.Join(parent, "source")
146		normalized := repo.NormalizeCloneRef(source)
147		safeSource := repo.RedactCloneRef(source)
148		redact := func(err error) error { return repo.RedactCloneError(err, source, normalized) }
149		if ref == "" {
150			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, parent, "clone", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--", normalized, checkout); err != nil {
151				cleanup()
152				return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("clone template source %q: %v", safeSource, redact(err))
153			}
154			resolved, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
155			if err != nil {
156				cleanup()
157				return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("resolve template HEAD: %v", redact(err))
158			}
159			return checkout, resolved, cleanup, nil
160		}
161
162		if err := os.Mkdir(checkout, 0o755); err != nil {
163			cleanup()
164			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("create template checkout: %w", err)
165		}
166		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "init", "--quiet"); err != nil {
167			cleanup()
168			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("initialize template checkout: %v", redact(err))
169		}
170		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "add", "--", "origin", normalized); err != nil {
171			cleanup()
172			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("configure template source %q: %v", safeSource, redact(err))
173		}
174		checkoutTarget := "FETCH_HEAD"
175		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "fetch", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "origin", ref); err != nil {
176			if _, exactErr := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "fetch", "--quiet", "origin", ref); exactErr != nil {
177				if _, fullErr := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "fetch", "--quiet", "origin"); fullErr != nil {
178					cleanup()
179					joined := errors.Join(err, exactErr, fullErr)
180					return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("fetch template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(joined))
181				}
182				checkoutTarget = ref
183			}
184		}
185		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", checkoutTarget); err != nil && checkoutTarget == ref {
186			if _, remoteErr := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", "origin/"+ref); remoteErr != nil {
187				cleanup()
188				return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("checkout template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(errors.Join(err, remoteErr)))
189			}
190		} else if err != nil {
191			cleanup()
192			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("checkout template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(err))
193		}
194		resolved, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
195		if err != nil {
196			cleanup()
197			return "", "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("resolve template ref %q: %v", ref, redact(err))
198		}
199		return checkout, resolved, cleanup, nil
200	}

202	func snapshotDirectory(ctx context.Context, sourceLabel, rootPath, ref, commit, subdir string, source snapshotSource) (Snapshot, error) {
203		root, rootInfo, err := openNamedRoot(rootPath)
204		if err != nil {
205			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve template source %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
206		}
207		defer root.Close()
208
209		selected := root
210		selectedInfo := rootInfo
211		selectedPath := rootPath
212		if subdir != "" {
213			selected, selectedInfo, err = openRelativeRoot(root, subdir)
214			if err != nil {
215				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template subdirectory %q: %w", subdir, err)
216			}
217			defer selected.Close()
218			selectedPath = filepath.Join(rootPath, filepath.FromSlash(subdir))
219		}
220
221		snapshot := Snapshot{
222			Source: sourceLabel, Ref: ref, Commit: commit, Subdir: subdir,
223			Local: source.local, Live: source.live,
224		}
225		if source.live {
226			paths, filtered, err := liveGitPaths(ctx, selectedPath)
227			if err != nil {
228				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("list live template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
229			}
230			if err := verifyNamedRoot(selectedPath, selectedInfo); err != nil {
231				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source changed while listing: %w", err)
232			}
233			snapshot.GitFiltered = filtered
234			if filtered {
235				tree, err := buildSelectionTree(paths)
236				if err != nil {
237					return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
238				}
239				if _, err := snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx, selected, tree, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
240					return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
241				}
242			} else if err := snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, selected, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
243				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
244			}
245		} else if err := snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, selected, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
246			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
247		}
248		if err := verifyNamedRoot(selectedPath, selectedInfo); err != nil {
249			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source changed during snapshot: %w", err)
250		}
251		if err := finalizeSnapshot(&snapshot); err != nil {
252			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
253		}
254		return snapshot, nil
255	}

261	func openRelativeRoot(base *os.Root, relative string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
262		current := base
263		owned := false
264		for _, component := range strings.Split(relative, "/") {
265			next, _, err := openChildRoot(current, component)
266			if err != nil {
267				if owned {
268					current.Close()
269				}
270				return nil, nil, err
271			}
272			if owned {
273				current.Close()
274			}
275			current, owned = next, true
276		}
277		info, err := current.Stat(".")
278		if err != nil {
279			current.Close()
280			return nil, nil, err
281		}
282		return current, info, nil
283	}

297	func liveGitPaths(ctx context.Context, root string) ([]string, bool, error) {
298		if _, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, root); err != nil {
299			if errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
300				return nil, false, nil
301			}
302			return nil, false, err
303		}
304		selected := map[string]bool{}
305		tracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "ls-files", "-z", "--stage", "--", ".")
306		if err != nil {
307			return nil, false, err
308		}
309		for _, record := range splitNUL(tracked) {
310			tab := strings.IndexByte(record, '\t')
311			if tab < 0 {
312				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("unexpected git ls-files record %q", record)
313			}
314			header, path := record[:tab], record[tab+1:]
315			fields := strings.Fields(header)
316			if len(fields) < 1 {
317				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("unexpected git ls-files record %q", record)
318			}
319			if fields[0] == "160000" {
320				continue
321			}
322			selected[path] = true
323		}
324		untracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "ls-files", "-z", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "--", ".")
325		if err != nil {
326			return nil, false, err
327		}
328		for _, path := range splitNUL(untracked) {
329			selected[path] = true
330		}
331		paths := make([]string, 0, len(selected))
332		for path := range selected {
333			cleaned, err := validateSnapshotPath(path)
334			if err != nil {
335				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q: %w", path, err)
336			}
337			paths = append(paths, cleaned)
338		}
339		sort.Strings(paths)
340		return paths, true, nil
341	}
342
343	func splitNUL(value string) []string {
344		value = strings.TrimSuffix(value, "\x00")
345		if value == "" {
346			return nil
347		}
348		return strings.Split(value, "\x00")
349	}

351	type selectionNode struct {
352		leaf     bool
353		children map[string]*selectionNode
354	}

356	func buildSelectionTree(paths []string) (*selectionNode, error) {
357		root := &selectionNode{children: map[string]*selectionNode{}}
358		for _, path := range paths {
359			current := root
360			components := strings.Split(path, "/")
361			for index, component := range components {
362				if current.leaf {
363					return nil, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q is below another selected file", path)
364				}
365				if current.children[component] == nil {
366					current.children[component] = &selectionNode{children: map[string]*selectionNode{}}
367				}
368				current = current.children[component]
369				if index == len(components)-1 {
370					if len(current.children) > 0 {
371						return nil, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q is the parent of another selected path", path)
372					}
373					current.leaf = true
374				}
375			}
376		}
377		return root, nil
378	}

380	func snapshotWholeRoot(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, relative string, snapshot *Snapshot) error {
381		if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
382			return err
383		}
384		directory, err := root.Open(".")
385		if err != nil {
386			return err
387		}
388		defer directory.Close()
389		before, err := directory.Stat()
390		if err != nil {
391			return err
392		}
393		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(-1)
394		if err != nil {
395			return err
396		}
397		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
398		for _, entry := range entries {
399			name := entry.Name()
400			if strings.EqualFold(name, ".git") {
401				continue
402			}
403			if err := validateSnapshotComponent(name); err != nil {
404				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
405			}
406			info, err := root.Lstat(name)
407			if err != nil {
408				return fmt.Errorf("inspect template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
409			}
410			path := joinRelative(relative, name)
411			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
412				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a symlink", path)
413			}
414			switch {
415			case info.IsDir():
416				child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
417				if err != nil {
418					return fmt.Errorf("open template directory %q: %w", path, err)
419				}
420				snapshot.Directories = append(snapshot.Directories, Directory{Path: path, Mode: held.Mode().Perm()})
421				err = snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, child, path, snapshot)
422				verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
423				closeErr := child.Close()
424				if err != nil {
425					return err
426				}
427				if verifyErr != nil {
428					return verifyErr
429				}
430				if closeErr != nil {
431					return closeErr
432				}
433			case info.Mode().IsRegular():
434				data, opened, err := readStableRootFile(ctx, root, name, info)
435				if err != nil {
436					return fmt.Errorf("read template file %q: %w", path, err)
437				}
438				snapshot.Files = append(snapshot.Files, File{Path: path, Mode: opened.Mode().Perm(), Data: data})
439			default:
440				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a special file (%s)", path, info.Mode().Type())
441			}
442		}
443		after, err := directory.Stat()
444		if err != nil {
445			return err
446		}
447		if !stableInfo(before, after) {
448			return errors.New("source directory changed during snapshot")
449		}
450		return nil
451	}

453	func snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, node *selectionNode, relative string, snapshot *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
454		if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {

461		names := make([]string, 0, len(node.children))
462		for name := range node.children {
463			names = append(names, name)
464		}
465		sort.Strings(names)
466		included := false
467		for _, name := range names {
468			childNode := node.children[name]
469			info, err := root.Lstat(name)
470			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && childNode.leaf && len(childNode.children) == 0 {
471				continue
472			}
473			if err != nil {
474				return false, fmt.Errorf("inspect selected template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
475			}
476			path := joinRelative(relative, name)
477			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
478				return false, fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a symlink", path)
479			}
480			if len(childNode.children) > 0 {
481				if childNode.leaf || !info.IsDir() {
482					return false, fmt.Errorf("selected Git path %q is not a directory tree", path)
483				}
484				child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
485				if err != nil {
486					return false, fmt.Errorf("open selected template directory %q: %w", path, err)
487				}
488				childIncluded, walkErr := snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx, child, childNode, path, snapshot)
489				verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
490				closeErr := child.Close()
491				if walkErr != nil {
492					return false, walkErr
493				}
494				if verifyErr != nil {
495					return false, verifyErr
496				}
497				if closeErr != nil {
498					return false, closeErr
499				}
500				if childIncluded {
501					snapshot.Directories = append(snapshot.Directories, Directory{Path: path, Mode: held.Mode().Perm()})
502					included = true
503				}
504				continue
505			}
506			if !childNode.leaf || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
507				return false, fmt.Errorf("selected Git path %q is not a regular file", path)
508			}
509			data, opened, err := readStableRootFile(ctx, root, name, info)
510			if err != nil {
511				return false, fmt.Errorf("read selected template file %q: %w", path, err)
512			}
513			snapshot.Files = append(snapshot.Files, File{Path: path, Mode: opened.Mode().Perm(), Data: data})
514			included = true
515		}
516		after, err := root.Stat(".")
517		if err != nil {
518			return false, err
519		}
520		if !stableInfo(before, after) {
521			return false, errors.New("source directory changed during snapshot")
522		}
523		return included, nil
524	}

526	func readStableRootFile(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
527		return safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, root, name, expected, 0)

534	// Summary returns a content-free description suitable for user-facing plans.
535	func (snapshot Snapshot) Summary() Summary {
536		preview, truncated := snapshotPathPreview(snapshot)
537		return Summary{
538			Source: snapshot.Source, Ref: snapshot.Ref, Commit: snapshot.Commit, Subdir: snapshot.Subdir,
539			Local: snapshot.Local, Live: snapshot.Live, GitFiltered: snapshot.GitFiltered,
540			Files: len(snapshot.Files), Directories: len(snapshot.Directories),
541			PathPreview: preview, PathPreviewTruncated: truncated,
542		}
543	}

545	func snapshotPathPreview(snapshot Snapshot) ([]string, bool) {
546		paths := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Files)+len(snapshot.Directories))
547		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
548			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
549		}
550		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
551			paths = append(paths, directory.Path+"/")
552		}
553		sort.Strings(paths)
554		truncated := len(paths) > pathPreviewLimit
555		if truncated {
556			paths = paths[:pathPreviewLimit]
557		}
558		return append([]string(nil), paths...), truncated
559	}

561	// Apply writes a prepared snapshot into a newly initialized, otherwise empty
562	// repository. All traversal and creation stays relative to a held os.Root, and
563	// file permissions are applied through the opened file descriptor.
564	func (snapshot Snapshot) Apply(destination string) (ApplyResult, error) {
565		result := ApplyResult{Summary: snapshot.Summary()}
566		if err := validateSnapshot(snapshot); err != nil {
567			return result, err
568		}
569		root, rootInfo, err := openNamedRoot(destination)
570		if err != nil {
571			return result, fmt.Errorf("resolve template destination: %w", err)
572		}
573		defer root.Close()
574		entries, err := readRootEntries(root)
575		if err != nil {
576			return result, fmt.Errorf("inspect template destination: %w", err)
577		}
578		gitMetadata := false
579		for _, entry := range entries {
580			if entry.Name() == ".git" {
581				info, err := root.Lstat(entry.Name())
582				if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.IsDir() {
583					return result, errors.New("template destination has unsafe Git metadata")
584				}
585				gitMetadata = true
586				continue
587			}
588			return result, fmt.Errorf("template destination is not a new repository: %q already exists", entry.Name())
589		}
590		if !gitMetadata {
591			return result, errors.New("template destination is not an initialized Git repository")
592		}
593
594		tree, err := buildApplyTree(snapshot)
595		if err != nil {
596			return result, err
597		}
598		if err := applyTree(root, tree, &result); err != nil {
599			return result, err
600		}
601		if err := verifyNamedRoot(destination, rootInfo); err != nil {
602			return result, fmt.Errorf("template destination changed during apply: %w", err)
603		}
604		return result, nil
605	}
606
607	func readRootEntries(root *os.Root) ([]os.DirEntry, error) {
608		directory, err := root.Open(".")
609		if err != nil {
610			return nil, err
611		}
612		defer directory.Close()
613		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(-1)
614		if err != nil {
615			return nil, err
616		}
617		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
618		return entries, nil
619	}

621	type applyNode struct {
622		directory *Directory
623		file      *File
624		children  map[string]*applyNode
625	}
626
627	func buildApplyTree(snapshot Snapshot) (*applyNode, error) {
628		root := &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
629		add := func(path string) *applyNode {
630			current := root
631			for _, component := range strings.Split(path, "/") {
632				if current.children[component] == nil {
633					current.children[component] = &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
634				}
635				current = current.children[component]
636			}
637			return current
638		}
639		for index := range snapshot.Directories {
640			directory := &snapshot.Directories[index]
641			add(directory.Path).directory = directory
642		}
643		for index := range snapshot.Files {
644			file := &snapshot.Files[index]
645			add(file.Path).file = file
646		}
647		return root, nil
648	}
649
650	func applyTree(root *os.Root, node *applyNode, result *ApplyResult) error {
651		names := make([]string, 0, len(node.children))
652		for name := range node.children {
653			names = append(names, name)
654		}
655		sort.Strings(names)
656		for _, name := range names {
657			childNode := node.children[name]
658			if childNode.file != nil {
659				if err := writeRootFile(root, name, *childNode.file); err != nil {
660					return fmt.Errorf("create template file %q: %w", childNode.file.Path, err)
661				}
662				result.AppliedFiles++
663				continue
664			}
665			if err := root.Mkdir(name, 0o700); err != nil {
666				return fmt.Errorf("create template directory %q: %w", name, err)
667			}
668			child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
669			if err != nil {
670				return fmt.Errorf("open created template directory %q: %w", name, err)
671			}
672			walkErr := applyTree(child, childNode, result)
673			mode := fs.FileMode(0o755)
674			if childNode.directory != nil {
675				mode = childNode.directory.Mode.Perm()
676				result.AppliedDirectories++
677			}
678			chmodErr := chmodRootDirectory(child, mode)
679			verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
680			closeErr := child.Close()
681			if walkErr != nil {
682				return walkErr
683			}
684			if chmodErr != nil {
685				return fmt.Errorf("set template directory mode %q: %w", name, chmodErr)
686			}
687			if verifyErr != nil {
688				return verifyErr
689			}
690			if closeErr != nil {
691				return closeErr
692			}
693		}
694		return nil
695	}
696
697	func writeRootFile(root *os.Root, name string, file File) error {
698		_, err := safefile.CreateNoClobber(context.Background(), root, name, file.Data, file.Mode.Perm())
699		return err
700	}
701
702	func chmodRootDirectory(root *os.Root, mode fs.FileMode) error {
703		directory, err := root.Open(".")
704		if err != nil {
705			return err
706		}
707		defer directory.Close()
708		return directory.Chmod(mode.Perm())
709	}

711	func finalizeSnapshot(snapshot *Snapshot) error {
712		sort.SliceStable(snapshot.Files, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Files[i].Path < snapshot.Files[j].Path })
713		sort.SliceStable(snapshot.Directories, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Directories[i].Path < snapshot.Directories[j].Path })
714		return validateSnapshot(*snapshot)
715	}

717	func validateSnapshot(snapshot Snapshot) error {
718		paths := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Directories)+len(snapshot.Files))
719		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
720			paths = append(paths, directory.Path)
721		}
722		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
723			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
724		}
725		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
726			return fmt.Errorf("template paths: %w", err)
727		}
728
729		types := make(map[string]string, len(paths))
730		validate := func(relative, kind string, mode fs.FileMode) error {
731			cleaned, err := validateSnapshotPath(relative)
732			if err != nil || cleaned != relative {
733				if err == nil {
734					err = errors.New("path is not a clean relative path")
735				}
736				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q: %w", kind, relative, err)
737			}
738			if mode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
739				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q has unsupported mode %s", kind, relative, mode)
740			}
741			if previous, exists := types[relative]; exists {
742				return fmt.Errorf("template path %q is declared as both %s and %s", relative, previous, kind)
743			}
744			for parent := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(relative))); parent != "."; parent = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(parent))) {
745				if types[parent] == "file" {
746					return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q is below file %q", kind, relative, parent)
747				}
748			}
749			types[relative] = kind
750			return nil
751		}
752		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
753			if err := validate(directory.Path, "directory", directory.Mode); err != nil {
754				return err
755			}
756		}
757		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
758			if err := validate(file.Path, "file", file.Mode); err != nil {
759				return err
760			}
761			prefix := file.Path + "/"
762			for existing := range types {
763				if strings.HasPrefix(existing, prefix) {
764					return fmt.Errorf("template file %q is the parent of %q", file.Path, existing)
765				}
766			}
767		}
768		return nil
769	}
770
771	func cleanSubdir(value string) (string, error) {
772		if value == "" || value == "." {
773			return "", nil
774		}
775		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
776			return "", fmt.Errorf("template subdirectory %q: %w", value, err)
777		}
778		return value, nil
779	}

785		return value, nil

10	func samePlatformState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
11		leftStat, leftOK := left.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
12		rightStat, rightOK := right.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
13		if !leftOK || !rightOK {
14			return leftOK == rightOK
15		}
16		return leftStat.Ctimespec.Sec == rightStat.Ctimespec.Sec &&
17			leftStat.Ctimespec.Nsec == rightStat.Ctimespec.Nsec
18	}

10	func openRegularForRead(root *os.Root, name string) (*os.File, error) {
11		// O_NONBLOCK prevents a regular-to-FIFO rename race from hanging the
12		// process. O_NOFOLLOW rejects a final-component link before post-open
13		// identity checks run.
14		return root.OpenFile(name, os.O_RDONLY|syscall.O_NONBLOCK|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW, 0)
15	}

3	import (

9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/safefile"
11	)
12
13	var localFileDependencyComponents = map[string]bool{
14		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "vendor": true,
15		"__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "target": true, ".terraform": true,
16		"dist": true, "build": true, ".next": true,
17	}
18
19	// ValidateLocalFilePattern validates the deliberately small cross-platform
20	// grammar accepted by [local_files]. Literal path components use portable slash
21	// paths; '*' and '?' match within one component and a component equal to '**'
22	// matches zero or more components. Character classes, escaping, volumes, and
23	// platform-specific separators are intentionally unsupported.
24	func ValidateLocalFilePattern(value string) error {
25		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
26			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is required and must be trimmed")
27		}
28		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
29			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is not valid UTF-8")
30		}
31		if len(value) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes {
32			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is %d bytes; maximum is %d", len(value), safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes)
33		}
34		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
35			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must use '/' separators")
36		}
37		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasSuffix(value, "/") || strings.Contains(value, "//") {
38			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must be a clean repository-relative slash path")
39		}
40		if strings.ContainsAny(value, "[]{}") {
41			return fmt.Errorf("pattern supports only '*', '?' and whole-component '**' wildcards")
42		}
43		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
44		if len(components) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth {
45			return fmt.Errorf("pattern has %d components; maximum is %d", len(components), safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth)
46		}
47		for _, component := range components {
48			if localFileDependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)] {
49				return fmt.Errorf("pattern enters dependency directory %q", component)
50			}
51			if component == "**" {
52				continue
53			}
54			if strings.Contains(component, "**") {
55				return fmt.Errorf("'**' must occupy a complete path component")
56			}
57			placeholder := strings.NewReplacer("*", "x", "?", "x").Replace(component)
58			if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(placeholder, safefile.CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
59				return fmt.Errorf("component %q: %w", component, err)
60			}
61			for _, r := range component {
62				if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
63					return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a control character", component)
64				}
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}
69

12	// Readiness is one cheap, local-only context projection. It intentionally
13	// carries no authority to mutate; the full Report binds the same result to
14	// point-in-time evidence sources.
15	type Readiness struct {
16		Outcome assessment.Outcome
17		Reasons []assessment.Reason
18	}
19
20	// LocalReadiness keeps independently actionable checkout, task, and worktree
21	// scopes separate. There is deliberately no global safe boolean.
22	type LocalReadiness struct {
23		Checkout Readiness
24		Task     Readiness
25		Worktree Readiness
26	}
27
28	// Summary is the compact status/TUI projection.
29	func (r LocalReadiness) Summary() string {
30		return strings.Join([]string{
31			"checkout " + string(r.Checkout.Outcome),
32			"task " + string(r.Task.Outcome),
33			"worktree " + string(r.Worktree.Outcome),
34		}, " · ")
35	}

37	// AssessLocal derives readiness from facts already collected by inventory. It
38	// does not run Git, inspect a runtime, or contact a forge/fleet host.
39	func AssessLocal(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) LocalReadiness {
40		return LocalReadiness{
41			Checkout: assessCheckout(context, selectedIndex),
42			Task:     assessTasks(context, selectedIndex, hostname),
43			Worktree: assessWorktrees(context, selectedIndex),
44		}
45	}
46
47	func assessCheckout(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
48		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
49			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the selected checkout is absent from the local inventory", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
50		}
51		checkout := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex]
52		switch {
53		case checkout.Worktree.Bare || context.Repo.Bare:
54			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
55		case checkout.PathErr != nil:
56			return indeterminate("checkout-path-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path could not be inspected", "restore path access and rerun context")
57		case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
58			return blocked("checkout-missing", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path is missing or prunable", "repair or remove the stale worktree registration")
59		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
60			return indeterminate("checkout-status-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "Git status could not be collected", "repair the checkout and rerun context")
61		case checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached || checkout.Branch() == "":
62			return blocked("checkout-detached", "selected-checkout", "the checkout does not have an attached branch", "check out an explicit branch")
63		case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
64			return blocked("checkout-conflicted", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d unmerged path(s)", checkout.Status.Conflicted), "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement")
65		case checkout.Status.Dirty():
66			return blocked("checkout-dirty", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d changed path(s)", checkout.Status.Changed), "commit or deliberately preserve the changes")
67		default:
68			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
69		}
70	}
71
72	func assessTasks(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) Readiness {
73		if context.TaskErr != nil {
74			return indeterminate("task-inventory-unavailable", "task-inventory", "task records could not be collected", "repair the task store and rerun context")
75		}
76		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
77			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "task scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
78		}
79		// Transfer/repository readiness covers every non-DONE task attached to the
80		// clone, including cold and branch-only records without a local checkout.
81		// Looking only at the selected checkout can otherwise hide another machine's
82		// ownership claim and incorrectly report not-applicable.
83		active := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(context.OtherTasks)+len(context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Tasks))
84		sessionCount := map[string]int{}
85		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
86		add := func(candidate *task.Task, sessions int) {
87			if candidate == nil || candidate.State == task.Done {
88				return
89			}
90			if _, exists := seen[candidate.ID]; exists {
91				return
92			}
93			seen[candidate.ID] = struct{}{}
94			active = append(active, candidate)
95			sessionCount[candidate.ID] = sessions
96		}
97		for _, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
98			for _, candidate := range checkout.Tasks {
99				add(candidate, len(checkout.Sessions))
100			}
101		}
102		for _, candidate := range context.OtherTasks {
103			add(candidate, 0)
104		}
105		if len(active) == 0 {
106			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
107		}
108		var reasons []assessment.Reason
109		hasIndeterminate := false
110		for _, candidate := range active {
111			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
112				hasIndeterminate = true
113				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
114					Code: "task-record-invalid", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task record is invalid",
115					Remediation: "repair or recreate the task record",
116				})
117				continue
118			}
119			if hostname != "" && candidate.Owner != "" && candidate.Owner != hostname {
120				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
121					Code: "task-owned-elsewhere", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task is owned by another machine",
122					Remediation: "complete an explicit ownership handoff before writing",
123				})
124			}
125			if candidate.State == task.Hot {
126				if context.RuntimeErr != nil {
127					hasIndeterminate = true
128					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
129						Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task cannot be checked against live runtime state",
130						Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
131					})
132				} else if sessionCount[candidate.ID] == 0 {
133					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
134						Code: "hot-task-runtime-missing", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task has no observed runtime session",
135						Remediation: "resume the task or reconcile its lifecycle state",
136					})
137				}
138			}
139		}
140		if hasReason(reasons, "task-owned-elsewhere") || hasReason(reasons, "hot-task-runtime-missing") {
141			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
142		}
143		if hasIndeterminate {
144			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
145		}
146		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
147	}
148
149	func assessWorktrees(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
150		if context.WorktreeErr != nil {
151			return indeterminate("worktree-inventory-unavailable", "worktrees", "linked worktrees could not be enumerated", "repair Git worktree metadata and rerun context")
152		}
153		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
154			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "worktree scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
155		}
156		indices := []int{}
157		if selectedIndex > 0 {
158			indices = append(indices, selectedIndex)
159		} else {
160			for index := 1; index < len(context.Checkouts); index++ {
161				indices = append(indices, index)
162			}
163		}
164		if len(indices) == 0 {
165			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
166		}
167		var reasons []assessment.Reason
168		hasUnknown := context.RuntimeErr != nil
169		if hasUnknown {
170			reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
171				Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "worktrees",
172				Detail:      "worktree runtime coverage could not be collected",
173				Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
174			})
175		}
176		for _, index := range indices {
177			checkout := context.Checkouts[index]
178			subject := fmt.Sprintf("worktree:%d", index)
179			switch {
180			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
181				hasUnknown = true
182				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-path-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path could not be inspected", Remediation: "restore path access and rerun context"})
183			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
184				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-missing", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path is missing or prunable", Remediation: "repair or remove the stale worktree registration"})
185			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
186				hasUnknown = true
187				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-status-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "Git status could not be collected for the worktree", Remediation: "repair the worktree and rerun context"})
188			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
189				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-locked", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree is locked", Remediation: "verify the lock owner before unlocking it"})
190			case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
191				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-conflicted", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree has unmerged paths", Remediation: "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement"})
192			case checkout.Status.Dirty():
193				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-dirty", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree contains uncommitted changes", Remediation: "commit or deliberately preserve the changes"})
194			case len(checkout.Sessions) > 0:
195				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-runtime-live", Subject: subject, Detail: "a runtime session still covers the worktree", Remediation: "quiesce and close the runtime before retirement"})
196			}
197		}
198		if len(reasons) == 0 {
199			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
200		}
201		if hasKnownBlocker(reasons) {
202			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
203		}
204		if hasUnknown {
205			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
206		}
207		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
208	}
209
210	func blocked(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
211		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
212	}
213
214	func indeterminate(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
215		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
216	}
217
218	func hasReason(reasons []assessment.Reason, code string) bool {
219		for _, reason := range reasons {
220			if reason.Code == code {
221				return true
222			}
223		}
224		return false

105	// WithLock runs operation while holding the catalog's cross-process advisory
106	// lock. It is intended for short read-match-write transactions; expensive
107	// discovery belongs before the lock. The operating system releases the lock if
108	// the process exits unexpectedly.
109	func (s *Store) WithLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
110		if s == nil {
111			return errors.New("lock nil catalog store")
112		}
113		if operation == nil {
114			return errors.New("catalog lock requires an operation")
115		}
116		s.mu.Lock()

135			return errors.New("create nil catalog entry")

138			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog asset: ID is assigned by the store")

146			now := s.now()

148			if candidate.Created.IsZero() {
149				candidate.Created = now
150			}
151			if candidate.Discovered.IsZero() {
152				candidate.Discovered = now
153			}
154			candidate.Updated = now
155			prepareNewNested(candidate, now)
156			candidate.Normalize()
157			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
158				return nil, err
159			}
160			return candidate, nil
161		}
162		candidate, err := prepare()
163		if err != nil {
164			return err
165		}
166		for range 32 {
167			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
168				candidate, err = prepare()
169				if err != nil {
170					return err
171				}
172				continue
173			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
174				return fmt.Errorf("check catalog ID %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
175			}
176			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
177				return err
178			}
179			*entry = *candidate

181		}

183	}

208	// Import merges portable metadata for an exact stable ID and records location as
209	// host's local view. Source locations are deliberately ignored: only the caller-
210	// supplied target location may claim a path on this machine. Move intents and
211	// recovery receipts are host-owned lifecycle authority and cannot be imported.
212	// The complete read-check-write transaction runs under the catalog's advisory
213	// lock so concurrent processes cannot claim the same target path.

216			return nil, errors.New("import into nil catalog store")
217		}
218		if source == nil {
219			return nil, errors.New("import nil catalog entry")
220		}
221		if source.MoveIntent != nil {
222			return nil, importConflict(source.ID, source.ID, "move_intent", "host-local move authority cannot be imported")
223		}
224		if source.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
225			return nil, importConflict(source.ID, source.ID, "recovery_receipt", "recovery authority cannot be imported before target verification")
226		}
227		if err := validateLocationForSet(host, location); err != nil {
228			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog import target location: %w", err)
229		}
230
231		incoming := source.Clone()
232		if incoming.SchemaVersion == 0 {
233			incoming.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
234		}
235		incoming.Locations = nil
236		incoming.RecoveryReceipt = nil
237		incoming.MoveIntent = nil
238		incoming.Normalize()
239
240		// Validate all source-owned fields before locking or creating the store. A
241		// zero location timestamp is allowed at the API boundary and is stamped only
242		// after the lock is held so a replay can retain the first import's timestamp.
243		validationLocation := location
244		if validationLocation.Updated.IsZero() {
245			validationLocation.Updated = incoming.Updated
246		}
247		incoming.Locations = map[string]Location{host: validationLocation}
248		if err := incoming.Validate(); err != nil {
249			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate imported catalog asset %s: %w", incoming.ID, err)
250		}
251
252		var imported *Entry
253		err := s.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
254			entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
255			if err != nil {
256				return err
257			}
258			if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
259				return incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
260			}
261
262			var current *Entry
263			for _, entry := range entries {
264				if entry.ID == incoming.ID {
265					current = entry
266					break
267				}
268			}
269			if current != nil && current.MoveIntent != nil {
270				return importConflict(current.ID, current.ID, "move_intent",
271					fmt.Sprintf("target has a pending %s move", current.MoveIntent.Operation))
272			}
273
274			targetLocation := location
275			if targetLocation.Updated.IsZero() {
276				if previous, ok := currentLocation(current, host); ok && !locationPayloadChanged(previous, targetLocation) {
277					targetLocation.Updated = previous.Updated
278				} else {
279					targetLocation.Updated = s.now()
280				}
281			} else if previous, ok := currentLocation(current, host); ok &&
282				!locationPayloadChanged(previous, targetLocation) && previous.Updated.After(targetLocation.Updated) {
283				// Replaying an older observation of the same path must not move the
284				// target's location timestamp backwards.
285				targetLocation.Updated = previous.Updated
286			}
287			if err := validateLocation(host, targetLocation); err != nil {
288				return fmt.Errorf("catalog import target location: %w", err)
289			}
290			if err := rejectImportedPathOwner(entries, incoming.ID, host, targetLocation); err != nil {
291				return err
292			}
293
294			if current == nil {
295				created := incoming.Clone()
296				created.Locations = map[string]Location{host: targetLocation}
297				if err := created.Validate(); err != nil {
298					return fmt.Errorf("validate imported catalog asset %s: %w", created.ID, err)
299				}
300				if err := s.writeAtomic(created); err != nil {
301					return err
302				}
303				imported = created.Clone()
304				return nil
305			}
306
307			merged, changed, err := mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming, host, targetLocation)
308			if err != nil {
309				return err
310			}
311			if !changed {
312				imported = current.Clone()
313				return nil
314			}
315			if err := s.writeAtomic(merged); err != nil {
316				return err
317			}
318			imported = merged.Clone()
319			return nil
320		})
321		return imported, err
322	}
323
324	func importConflict(id, existingID, field, reason string) error {
325		return &ImportConflictError{ID: id, ExistingID: existingID, Field: field, Reason: reason}
326	}
327
328	func currentLocation(entry *Entry, host string) (Location, bool) {
329		if entry == nil {
330			return Location{}, false
331		}
332		return entry.LocationFor(host)
333	}
334
335	func rejectImportedPathOwner(entries []*Entry, importedID, host string, target Location) error {
336		targetPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(target)
337		if err != nil {
338			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize imported location on host %s: %w", host, err)
339		}
340		for _, entry := range entries {
341			if entry.ID == importedID {
342				continue
343			}
344			owned, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
345			if !ok {
346				continue
347			}
348			ownedPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(owned)
349			if err != nil {
350				return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize catalog asset %s location on host %s: %w", entry.ID, host, err)
351			}
352			ownedSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ownedPaths))
353			for _, path := range ownedPaths {
354				ownedSet[path] = struct{}{}
355			}
356			for _, path := range targetPaths {
357				if _, exists := ownedSet[path]; exists {
358					return importConflict(importedID, entry.ID, "location",
359						fmt.Sprintf("target path %q on host %s is already owned", path, host))
360				}
361			}
362		}
363		return nil
364	}
365
366	func canonicalLocationPaths(location Location) ([]string, error) {
367		fields := []struct {
368			name  string
369			value string
370		}{
371			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
372			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
373			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
374			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
375		}
376		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(fields))
377		for _, field := range fields {
378			if field.value == "" {
379				continue
380			}
381			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(field.value)
382			if err != nil {
383				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s %q: %w", field.name, field.value, err)
384			}
385			seen[canonical] = struct{}{}
386		}
387		paths := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
388		for path := range seen {
389			paths = append(paths, path)
390		}
391		sort.Strings(paths)
392		return paths, nil
393	}
394
395	func mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, bool, error) {
396		if current.SchemaVersion != incoming.SchemaVersion {
397			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "schema_version", "schema versions differ")
398		}
399		if current.Kind != incoming.Kind {
400			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "kind",
401				fmt.Sprintf("durable kind %q differs from imported kind %q", current.Kind, incoming.Kind))
402		}
403		if current.Name != incoming.Name {
404			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "name",
405				fmt.Sprintf("durable name %q differs from imported name %q", current.Name, incoming.Name))
406		}
407
408		merged := current.Clone()
409		changed := false
410
411		currentSummary := strings.TrimSpace(merged.Note)
412		incomingSummary := strings.TrimSpace(incoming.Note)
413		switch {
414		case currentSummary != "" && incomingSummary != "" && merged.Note != incoming.Note:
415			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "note", "nonempty summaries differ")
416		case currentSummary == "" && incomingSummary != "":
417			merged.Note = incoming.Note
418			changed = true
419		}
420
421		tags := NormalizeTags(append(append([]string(nil), merged.Tags...), incoming.Tags...))
422		if !slices.Equal(merged.Tags, tags) {
423			merged.Tags = tags
424			changed = true
425		}
426
427		switch {
428		case merged.RemoteIdentity != "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "" && merged.RemoteIdentity != incoming.RemoteIdentity:
429			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "remote_identity",
430				fmt.Sprintf("durable identity %q differs from imported identity %q", merged.RemoteIdentity, incoming.RemoteIdentity))
431		case merged.RemoteIdentity == "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "":
432			merged.RemoteIdentity = incoming.RemoteIdentity
433			changed = true
434		}
435
436		switch {
437		case merged.Experiment == nil && incoming.Experiment != nil:
438			value := *incoming.Experiment
439			merged.Experiment = &value
440			changed = true
441		case merged.Experiment != nil && incoming.Experiment != nil && !experimentsEqual(*merged.Experiment, *incoming.Experiment):
442			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "experiment", "experiment metadata differs")
443		}
444
445		if value := earlierTime(merged.Created, incoming.Created); !value.Equal(merged.Created) {
446			merged.Created = value
447			changed = true
448		}
449		if value := earlierTime(merged.Discovered, incoming.Discovered); !value.Equal(merged.Discovered) {
450			merged.Discovered = value
451			changed = true
452		}
453		if value := laterTime(merged.LastOpened, incoming.LastOpened); !value.Equal(merged.LastOpened) {
454			merged.LastOpened = value
455			changed = true
456		}
457		if value := laterTime(merged.Updated, incoming.Updated); !value.Equal(merged.Updated) {
458			merged.Updated = value
459			changed = true
460		}
461
462		previous, exists := merged.LocationFor(host)
463		if !exists || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) || !previous.Updated.Equal(location.Updated) {
464			if merged.Locations == nil {
465				merged.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
466			}
467			merged.Locations[host] = location
468			changed = true
469		}
470		merged.Normalize()
471		if err := merged.Validate(); err != nil {
472			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("validate merged catalog asset %s: %w", merged.ID, err)
473		}
474		return merged, changed, nil
475	}
476
477	func experimentsEqual(left, right Experiment) bool {
478		return left.Phase == right.Phase &&
479			left.Slug == right.Slug &&
480			left.OriginURL == right.OriginURL &&
481			left.Started.Equal(right.Started) &&
482			left.OriginalPath == right.OriginalPath &&
483			left.DeprecatedAt.Equal(right.DeprecatedAt) &&
484			left.DeprecatedPath == right.DeprecatedPath &&
485			left.GraduatedAt.Equal(right.GraduatedAt) &&
486			left.GraduatedPath == right.GraduatedPath
487	}
488
489	func earlierTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
490		if left.IsZero() || !right.IsZero() && right.Before(left) {
491			return right
492		}
493		return left
494	}
495
496	func laterTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
497		if right.After(left) {
498			return right
499		}
500		return left
501	}
502
503	// Get loads one asset by exact ID.
504	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
505		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
506			return nil, err
507		}
508		return s.get(id)
509	}
510
511	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
512		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
513		if err != nil {
514			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
515				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
516			}
517			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
518		}
519		var header struct {
520			SchemaVersion int `toml:"schema_version"`
521		}
522		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &header); err != nil {
523			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
524		}
525		if header.SchemaVersion != 0 && header.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
526			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: header.SchemaVersion}
527		}
528
529		var entry Entry
530		metadata, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &entry)
531		if err != nil {
532			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
533		}
534		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
535			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: unknown field(s): %v", id, undecoded)
536		}
537		entry.ID = id
538		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
539		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
540		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
541			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
542		}
543		entry.Normalize()
544		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
545			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
546		}
547		return &entry, nil
548	}
549
550	// List loads every valid record in deterministic ID order. Per-record failures
551	// are skipped and sent to the configured diagnostic sink; directory-level
552	// failures are returned.
553	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
554		entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
555		if err != nil {
556			return nil, err
557		}
558		s.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
559		return entries, nil
560	}
561
562	func (s *Store) reportDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
563		if s.diagnostics == nil {
564			return
565		}
566		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
567			s.diagnostics(diagnostic)
568		}
569	}
570
571	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
572	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
573	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
574		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
575		if err != nil {
576			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
577				return nil, nil, nil
578			}
579			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
580		}
581
582		var entries []*Entry
583		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
584		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
585			name := directoryEntry.Name()
586			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
587				continue
588			}
589			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
590			entry, err := s.Get(id)
591			if err != nil {
592				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
593				continue
594			}
595			entries = append(entries, entry)
596		}
597		Sort(entries)
598		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
599		return entries, diagnostics, nil
600	}
601
602	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
603	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
604	// immutable.
605	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
606		var result *Entry
607		err := s.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
608			var err error
609			result, err = s.UpdateUnderLock(id, mutate)
610			return err
611		})
612		return result, err
613	}
614
615	// UpdateUnderLock is the non-reentrant form used only inside Store.WithLock.
616	// Calling it without that transaction guard is a programming error.
617	func (s *Store) UpdateUnderLock(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
618		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
619			return nil, err
620		}
621		if mutate == nil {
622			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
623		}
624		current, err := s.get(id)
625		if err != nil {
626			return nil, err
627		}
628		updated := current.Clone()
629		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
630			return nil, err
631		}
632		if updated.ID != current.ID {
633			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
634		}
635		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
636			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
637		}
638		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
639			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
640		}
641		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
642			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
643		}
644
645		now := s.now()
646		updated.Updated = now
647		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
648		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)
649		updated.Normalize()
650		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
651			return nil, err
652		}
653		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
654			return nil, err
655		}
656		return updated.Clone(), nil
657	}
658
659	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
660	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
661		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
662			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
663		})
664	}
665
666	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
667		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
668		if err != nil {
669			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
670		}
671		name := temporary.Name()
672		defer os.Remove(name)
673
674		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
675			_ = temporary.Close()
676			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
677		}
678		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
679			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
680		}
681		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
682			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
683		}
684		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
685			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
686		}
687		return nil
688	}
689
690	func (s *Store) nextID() string {
691		if s.generateID == nil {
692			return uuid.NewString()
693		}
694		return s.generateID()
695	}
696
697	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
698		if s.clock == nil {
699			return time.Now().UTC()
700		}
701		return s.clock().UTC()
702	}
703
704	func prepareNewNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
705		if entry.Experiment != nil {
706			if entry.Experiment.Phase == "" {
707				entry.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
708			}
709			if entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
710				entry.Experiment.Started = now
711			}
712		}
713		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
714			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
715				location.Updated = now
716				entry.Locations[host] = location
717			}
718		}
719		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
720			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
721		}
722		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
723			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
724		}
725	}
726
727	func prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
728		if current.Experiment == nil && updated.Experiment != nil {
729			if updated.Experiment.Phase == "" {
730				updated.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
731			}
732			if updated.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
733				updated.Experiment.Started = now
734			}
735		}
736		if updated.RecoveryReceipt != nil && updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() &&
737			(current.RecoveryReceipt == nil || recoveryPayloadChanged(*current.RecoveryReceipt, *updated.RecoveryReceipt)) {
738			updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
739		}
740		if updated.MoveIntent != nil && updated.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() &&
741			(current.MoveIntent == nil || moveIntentPayloadChanged(*current.MoveIntent, *updated.MoveIntent)) {
742			updated.MoveIntent.Started = now
743		}
744	}
745
746	func recoveryPayloadChanged(left, right RecoveryReceipt) bool {
747		left.Created = time.Time{}
748		right.Created = time.Time{}
749		return left != right
750	}
751
752	func moveIntentPayloadChanged(left, right MoveIntent) bool {
753		left.Started = time.Time{}
754		right.Started = time.Time{}
755		return left != right
756	}
757
758	func stampChangedLocations(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
759		for host, location := range updated.Locations {
760			previous, existed := current.Locations[host]
761			if !existed || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) {
762				location.Updated = now
763			} else {
764				// Updated is store-owned metadata. A mutation that did not change this
765				// host's location must not make it look newly observed.
766				location.Updated = previous.Updated
767			}
768			updated.Locations[host] = location
769		}
770	}
771
772	func locationPayloadChanged(left, right Location) bool {
773		left.Updated = time.Time{}
774		right.Updated = time.Time{}
775		return left != right
776	}

40	// Store is a directory of one-TOML-file-per-task.
41	//
42	// One file per task, rather than a single registry document, is a deliberate
43	// choice: the state directory is meant to be syncable across machines (it can
44	// simply be a git repo), and a shared central file would conflict on every
45	// parallel edit while separate files merge cleanly.
46	type Store struct{ Dir string }
47
48	// NewStore returns a store rooted at dir.
49	func NewStore(dir string) *Store { return &Store{Dir: dir} }

51	// ImportOutcome reports what ImportExact observed or changed.
52	type ImportOutcome string
53
54	const (
55		// ImportCreated means no task used the imported ID and a file was created.
56		ImportCreated ImportOutcome = "created"
57		// ImportIdentical means the same ID and semantic content were already stored.
58		ImportIdentical ImportOutcome = "identical"
59		// ImportConflict means the ID already held different semantic content.
60		ImportConflict ImportOutcome = "conflict"
61	)

68	// ValidateID checks that id can be used as exactly one visible filename stem.
69	func ValidateID(id string) error {
70		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {
71			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrInvalidID)
72		}
73		return nil

76	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
77	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
78		clean := func(s string) string {
79			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
80			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
81				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
82			}
83			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
84		}
85		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
86		if r == "" {
87			r = "repo"
88		}
89		if b == "" {
90			b = "branch"
91		}
92		return r + "__" + b
93	}
94
95	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }

97	// Save creates a task or updates one read by this Store. Existing-task writes
98	// compare the task's private loaded revision under the cross-process lock, so
99	// legacy callers cannot silently overwrite a newer process's mutation.
100	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {
101		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
102		if err != nil {
103			return err
104		}
105		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
106			current, currentErr := s.get(candidate.ID)
107			switch {
108			case currentErr == nil:
109				if candidate.storedRevision == "" || candidate.storedRevision != current.Revision() {
110					return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
111				}
112				if !candidate.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
113					return fmt.Errorf("task %s changed its creation time: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
114				}
115			case errors.Is(currentErr, ErrNotFound):
116				if candidate.storedRevision != "" {
117					return fmt.Errorf("task %s was removed after it was read: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
118				}
119			default:
120				return currentErr
121			}
122			stampForSave(candidate)
123			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
124				return err
125			}
126			candidate.storedRevision = candidate.Revision()
127			return nil
128		})
129		if err != nil {
130			return err
131		}
132		*t = *candidate
133		return nil
134	}
135
136	// ReplaceDone starts a new task generation under an existing stable ID only
137	// while the exact observed record is still DONE. It resets Created/Updated and
138	// rejects a concurrent restart instead of weakening ordinary Save CAS.
139	func (s *Store) ReplaceDone(t *Task, expectedRevision string) error {
140		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
141		if err != nil {
142			return err
143		}
144		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
145			current, err := s.get(candidate.ID)
146			if err != nil {
147				return err
148			}
149			if expectedRevision == "" || current.State != Done || current.Revision() != expectedRevision {
150				return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
151			}
152			candidate.Created = time.Time{}
153			candidate.Updated = time.Time{}
154			stampForSave(candidate)
155			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
156				return err
157			}
158			candidate.storedRevision = candidate.Revision()
159			return nil
160		})
161		if err != nil {
162			return err
163		}
164		*t = *candidate
165		return nil
166	}
167
168	// SaveIfRevision writes t only while the stored task still has
169	// expectedRevision. The comparison and replacement happen under one
170	// cross-process lock so a stale writer cannot overwrite a newer mutation.
171	func (s *Store) SaveIfRevision(t *Task, expectedRevision string) error {
172		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
173		if err != nil {
174			return err
175		}
176		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
177			current, err := s.get(candidate.ID)
178			if err != nil {
179				return err
180			}
181			if expectedRevision == "" || current.Revision() != expectedRevision || !candidate.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
182				return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
183			}
184			stampForSave(candidate)
185			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
186				return err
187			}
188			candidate.storedRevision = candidate.Revision()
189			return nil
190		})
191		if err != nil {
192			return err
193		}
194		*t = *candidate
195		return nil
196	}

198	// ImportExact creates t under its supplied ID without changing any semantic
199	// field or timestamp. Replaying identical content is a no-op; reusing an ID
200	// for different content reports ImportConflict and ErrConflict.
201	func (s *Store) ImportExact(t *Task) (ImportOutcome, error) {
202		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, false)
203		if err != nil {
204			return "", err
205		}
206		var outcome ImportOutcome
207		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
208			current, err := s.get(candidate.ID)
209			switch {
210			case err == nil && current.Revision() == candidate.Revision():
211				outcome = ImportIdentical
212				return nil
213			case err == nil:
214				outcome = ImportConflict
215				return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
216			case !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
217				return err
218			}
219			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
220				return err
221			}
222			outcome = ImportCreated
223			return nil
224		})
225		return outcome, err
226	}

228	// Get loads one task by its exact id.
229	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Task, error) {

231			return nil, err

233		return s.get(id)

236	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Task, error) {
237		var t Task
238		if _, err := toml.DecodeFile(s.path(id), &t); err != nil {
239			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
240				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
241			}
242			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read task %s: %w", id, err)
243		}
244		t.ID = id
245		if err := t.Validate(); err != nil {
246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate task %s: %w", id, err)
247		}
248		t.storedRevision = t.Revision()
249		return &t, nil

252	func prepareCandidate(t *Task, deriveID bool) (*Task, error) {
253		if t == nil {
254			return nil, errors.New("save nil task")
255		}
256		candidate := *t
257		candidate.Tags = append([]string(nil), t.Tags...)
258		if candidate.ID == "" && deriveID {
259			candidate.ID = MakeID(candidate.Repo, candidate.Branch)
260		}
261		if candidate.ID == "" {
262			return nil, fmt.Errorf("task import requires an exact ID: %w", ErrInvalidID)
263		}
264		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
265			return nil, err
266		}
267		return &candidate, nil
268	}

270	func stampForSave(t *Task) {
271		now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
272		if t.Created.IsZero() {
273			t.Created = now
274		}
275		t.Updated = now
276	}

278	func (s *Store) withMutationLock(operation func() error) error {
279		if s == nil {
280			return errors.New("mutate nil task store")
281		}
282		return lockx.WithDir(context.Background(), s.Dir, "task store", operation)
283	}

285	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(t *Task) error {
286		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
287			return fmt.Errorf("create task state directory: %w", err)
288		}
289		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+t.ID+".*.tmp")
290		if err != nil {
291			return fmt.Errorf("create task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
292		}
293		name := tmp.Name()
294		defer os.Remove(name)
295		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o644); err != nil {
296			_ = tmp.Close()
297			return fmt.Errorf("set task %s file mode: %w", t.ID, err)
298		}
299		if err := toml.NewEncoder(tmp).Encode(t); err != nil {
300			_ = tmp.Close()
301			return fmt.Errorf("encode task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
302		}
303		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
304			_ = tmp.Close()
305			return fmt.Errorf("sync task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
306		}
307		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
308			return fmt.Errorf("close task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
309		}
310		if err := replaceFile(name, s.path(t.ID)); err != nil {
311			return fmt.Errorf("replace task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
312		}
313		if err := errors.Join(syncDirectory(s.Dir), syncDirectory(filepath.Dir(s.Dir))); err != nil {
314			return fmt.Errorf("sync task %s directory: %w", t.ID, err)
315		}
316		return nil
317	}
318
319	// List loads every valid task, sorted by state (hot first) then most recent.
320	// It retains the historical warning behavior; completeness-sensitive callers
321	// should use ListWithDiagnostics instead of treating a partial list as whole.
322	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Task, error) {
323		tasks, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
324		if err != nil {
325			return nil, err
326		}
327		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
328			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: %s\n", diagnostic.Error())
329		}
330		return tasks, nil
331	}
332
333	// ListWithDiagnostics returns every valid task plus deterministic per-record
334	// errors. A corrupt record never hides valid work and never silently satisfies
335	// an inventory-completeness gate.
336	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Task, []Diagnostic, error) {
337		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
338		if err != nil {
339			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
340				return nil, nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
341			}
342			return nil, nil, err
343		}
344		var tasks []*Task
345		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
346		for _, entry := range entries {
347			name := entry.Name()
348			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
349				continue
350			}
351			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
352			tracked, err := s.Get(id)
353			if err != nil {
354				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
355				continue
356			}
357			tasks = append(tasks, tracked)
358		}
359		Sort(tasks)
360		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
361		return tasks, diagnostics, nil
362	}
363
364	// Delete removes a task entry under the mutation lock. It never touches git
365	// state.
366	func (s *Store) Delete(id string) error {
367		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
368			return err
369		}
370		return s.withMutationLock(func() error {
371			err := os.Remove(s.path(id))
372			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
373				return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
374			}
375			if err != nil {
376				return err
377			}
378			if err := syncDirectory(s.Dir); err != nil {
379				return fmt.Errorf("sync task directory after deleting %s: %w", id, err)
380			}
381			return nil
382		})
383	}
384
385	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
386	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
387	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather
388	// than a silent pick.
389	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
390		if ref == "" {
391			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty task reference: %w", ErrNotFound)
392		}
393		all, err := s.List()
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, err
396		}
397		for _, t := range all {
398			if t.ID == ref || t.Branch == ref {
399				return t, nil
400			}
401		}
402		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
403		var hits []*Task
404		for _, t := range all {
405			hay := strings.ToLower(t.ID + " " + t.Name + " " + t.Branch + " " + t.Repo)
406			if strings.Contains(hay, needle) {
407				hits = append(hits, t)
408			}
409		}
410		switch len(hits) {
411		case 1:
412			return hits[0], nil
413		case 0:
414			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", ref, ErrNotFound)
415		default:
416			names := make([]string, len(hits))
417			for i, t := range hits {
418				names[i] = t.ID
419			}
420			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))
421		}
422	}
423
424	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
425	//
426	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
427	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
428	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
429	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
430	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
431	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
432		all, err := s.List()
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, err
435		}
436		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
437			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
438		}
439		var best *Task
440		var bestLen int
441		for _, t := range all {
442			root := t.WorktreePath
443			if root == "" {
444				root = t.RepoPath
445			}
446			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
447				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
448			}
449		}
450		if best == nil {
451			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
452		}
453		return best, nil
454	}
455
456	// stateRank orders states so the inventory reads as an attention queue.
457	func stateRank(s State) int {
458		switch s {
459		case Hot:
460			return 0
461		case Warm:
462			return 1
463		case Cold:
464			return 2
465		case Done:
466			return 3
467		}
468		return 4
469	}
470
471	// Sort orders tasks hot-first, then by most recently updated.
472	func Sort(ts []*Task) {
473		sort.SliceStable(ts, func(i, j int) bool {
474			ri, rj := stateRank(ts[i].State), stateRank(ts[j].State)
475			if ri != rj {
476				return ri < rj
477			}
478			if !ts[i].Updated.Equal(ts[j].Updated) {
479				return ts[i].Updated.After(ts[j].Updated)
480			}
481			return ts[i].ID < ts[j].ID
482		})
483	}

371	func digestJSON(value any) string {
372		data, _ := json.Marshal(value)
373		digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
374		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
375	}
376
377	func digestBytes(value []byte) string {
378		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
379		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
380	}

382	func validDigest(value string) bool {
383		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != len("sha256:")+sha256.Size*2 {
384			return false
385		}
386		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"))
387		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size && value == strings.ToLower(value)
388	}
389
390	func validOID(value string) bool {
391		if len(value) != 40 && len(value) != 64 || value != strings.ToLower(value) {
392			return false
393		}
394		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
395		return err == nil
396	}

398	func validFileMode(value string) bool {
399		if len(value) != 4 {
400			return false
401		}
402		mode, err := strconv.ParseUint(value, 8, 12)
403		return err == nil && mode <= 0o777
404	}

406	func validateText(name, value string) error {

408			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
409		}
410		for _, r := range value {
411			if unicode.IsControl(r) {
412				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
413			}
414		}
415		return nil
416	}
