239	func preflightApply(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope) ([]preflightFile, error) {
240		payloads := map[string][]byte{}
241		for _, payload := range envelope.Payloads {
242			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
243			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
244				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode canonical payload for %q", payload.Path)
245			}
246			payloads[payload.Path] = decoded
247		}
248		files := make([]preflightFile, len(envelope.Request.Files))
249		for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
250			planned := envelope.Plan.Files[index]
251			if planned.Action == "" {
252				return nil, ErrPlanBlocked
253			}
254			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
255				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
256			}
257			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
258			if err != nil {
259				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
260			}
261			file := preflightFile{spec: spec, planned: planned, before: observed}
262			switch planned.Action {
263			case actionCurrent:
264				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
265					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q is no longer current: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
266				}
267				file.content = observed.data
268			case actionCreate:
269				if observed.exists {
270					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q appeared after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
271				}
272				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
273			case actionReplace:
274				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != planned.TargetSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
275					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed before replacement: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
276				}
277				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
278			default:
279				return nil, errors.New("invalid local-files target action")
280			}
281			if int64(len(file.content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(file.content) != spec.SHA256 {
282				return nil, fmt.Errorf("content for %q no longer matches the plan", spec.Path)
283			}
284			files[index] = file
285		}
286		return files, nil
287	}

289	func (s *Service) failAndRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal, cause error) error {
290		value.Phase = phaseReconcile
291		_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
292		if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, value); err != nil {
293			value.Phase = phaseReconcile
294			_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
295			return errors.New("local-files apply failed and requires reconciliation")
296		}
297		value.Phase = phaseRolledBack
298		for index := range value.Files {
299			if value.Files[index].Action != actionCurrent {
300				value.Files[index].State = StateRolledBack
301				value.Files[index].Published = false
302			}
303		}
304		if err := store.writeJournal(*value); err != nil {
305			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but journal finalization failed")
306		}
307		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
308			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
309		}
310		return fmt.Errorf("local-files apply failed and was rolled back: %w", cause)
311	}
312
313	func (s *Service) rollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal) error {
314		for index := len(value.Files) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
315			entry := &value.Files[index]
316			if entry.Action == actionCurrent {
317				continue
318			}
319			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
320			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
321				return err
322			}
323			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
324			if err != nil {
325				return err
326			}
327			switch entry.Action {
328			case actionCreate:
329				if !observed.exists {
330					continue
331				}
332				if observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
333					return errors.New("created target changed before rollback")
334				}
335				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
336				if err != nil {
337					return err
338				}
339				err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(spec.Path))
340				err = errors.Join(err, syncHeldRoot(parent.parent), parent.close())
341				if err != nil {
342					return err
343				}
344			case actionReplace:
345				if observed.exists && observed.digest == entry.OldSHA256 {
346					continue
347				}
348				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
349					return errors.New("replacement target changed before rollback")
350				}
351				oldContent, err := store.readBlob(index, true, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
352				if err != nil || digestBytes(oldContent) != entry.OldSHA256 {
353					return errors.New("replacement rollback blob is unavailable")
354				}
355				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
356				if err != nil {
357					return err
358				}
359				current, err := parent.parent.Lstat(pathBase(spec.Path))
360				oldMode, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(entry.OldMode, 8, 12)
361				err = errors.Join(err, modeErr)
362				if err == nil {
363					_, err = safefile.AtomicReplace(ctx, parent.parent, pathBase(spec.Path), current, oldContent, fs.FileMode(oldMode))
364				}
365				err = errors.Join(err, parent.close())
366				if err != nil {
367					return err
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		// Empty parent directories are intentionally retained. A path alone cannot
372		// prove that a directory still has the identity created by this operation;
373		// deleting it after a crash could remove another process's replacement.
374		return verifyRollback(ctx, checkout.root, envelope, *value)
375	}
376
377	func verifyRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope, value journal) error {
378		for index, entry := range value.Files {
379			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
380			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
381			if err != nil {
382				return err
383			}
384			switch entry.Action {
385			case actionCurrent:
386				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != envelope.Plan.Files[index].TargetMode {
387					return errors.New("current target changed during rollback")
388				}
389			case actionCreate:
390				if observed.exists {
391					return errors.New("created target remains after rollback")
392				}
393			case actionReplace:
394				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != entry.OldSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != entry.OldMode {
395					return errors.New("replacement target was not restored")
396				}
397			}
398		}
399		return nil
400	}

402	func (s *Service) verifyCompleted(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value journal) (ApplyResponse, error) {
403		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
404			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files journal no longer matches the checkout")
405		}
406		if value.RetainForEvict {
407			for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
408				content, err := store.readBlob(index, false, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
409				if err != nil || int64(len(content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(content) != spec.SHA256 {
410					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("retained local-files recovery blob is unavailable")
411				}
412			}
413		} else if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
414			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
415		}
416		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
417	}
418
419	func verifyAllCurrent(ctx context.Context, checkout string, specs []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
420		for _, spec := range specs {
421			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
422				return err
423			}
424			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, limits, true)
425			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size {
426				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q failed post-write verification", spec.Path)
427			}
428			if fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != spec.Mode {
429				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q permissions do not match the manifest", spec.Path)
430			}
431		}
432		return nil
433	}
434
435	func responseFromJournal(value journal) ApplyResponse {
436		files := make([]PublicFile, len(value.Files))
437		for index, entry := range value.Files {
438			files[index] = PublicFile{Path: entry.Path, Size: entry.Size, Mode: entry.Mode, State: entry.State}
439		}
440		return ApplyResponse{
441			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
442			RequestID: value.RequestID, PlanDigest: value.PlanDigest, Files: files,
443		}
444	}
445
446	func (s *Service) fault(point, path string) error {
447		if s.Fault == nil {
448			return nil
449		}
450		return s.Fault(point, path)
451	}

453	type heldParent struct {
454		checkout string
455		rootInfo fs.FileInfo
456		root     *os.Root
457		parent   *os.Root
458		roots    []*os.Root
459		edges    []heldEdge
460	}
461
462	type heldEdge struct {
463		parent *os.Root
464		name   string
465		info   fs.FileInfo
466	}
467
468	func openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath string, create bool) (*heldParent, error) {
469		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
470			return nil, err
471		}
472		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		held := &heldParent{checkout: checkout, rootInfo: rootInfo, root: root, parent: root, roots: []*os.Root{root}}
477		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
478		prefix := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1)
479		for _, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
480			prefix = append(prefix, component)
481			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
482			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
483				if err := held.parent.Mkdir(component, 0o700); err != nil {
484					_ = held.close()
485					return nil, err
486				}
487				child, info, err = safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
488			}
489			if err != nil {
490				_ = held.close()
491				return nil, err
492			}
493			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
494				_ = child.Close()
495				_ = held.close()
496				return nil, ErrUnsafe
497			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
498				_ = child.Close()
499				_ = held.close()
500				return nil, err
501			}
502			held.edges = append(held.edges, heldEdge{parent: held.parent, name: component, info: info})
503			held.roots = append(held.roots, child)
504			held.parent = child
505		}
506		return held, nil
507	}
508
509	func (h *heldParent) close() error {
510		if h == nil {
511			return nil
512		}
513		var result error
514		for index := len(h.edges) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
515			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(h.edges[index].parent, h.edges[index].name, h.edges[index].info))
516		}
517		result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyRoot(h.checkout, h.rootInfo))
518		for index := len(h.roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
519			result = errors.Join(result, h.roots[index].Close())
520		}
521		h.roots = nil
522		return result
523	}
524
525	func syncHeldRoot(root *os.Root) error {
526		file, err := root.Open(".")
527		if err != nil {
528			return err
529		}
530		defer file.Close()
531		return file.Sync()
532	}
533
534	func pathBase(slashPath string) string {
535		parts := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
536		return parts[len(parts)-1]
537	}

51	// Reserve creates a blocking pre-publication claim. Repeating the exact
52	// operation and key set is idempotent; reusing an operation ID with a different
53	// digest is a conflict.
54	func (a *Authority) Reserve(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, request Request) (Token, error) {
55		return a.activate(ctx, keys, request, false)
56	}

58	// Fence drains existing cooperative guards and durably prevents new ordinary
59	// mutations. It can promote an exact reservation or create a direct fence.
60	func (a *Authority) Fence(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, request Request) (Token, error) {
61		return a.activate(ctx, keys, request, true)

64	func (a *Authority) activate(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, request Request, fence bool) (Token, error) {
65		if a == nil {
66			return Token{}, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
67		}
68		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
69			return Token{}, err
70		}
71		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
72		if err != nil {
73			return Token{}, err
74		}
75		var result Token
76		err = a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func([]Key) error {
77			return a.updateState(ctx, func(state *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
78				if err := checkOperationReuse(*state, claimed, request); err != nil {
79					return false, err
80				}
81				bindingAdded := ensureBinding(state, request)
82				if err := checkHierarchyClaims(*state, claimed, request); err != nil {
83					return false, err
84				}
85				canonical := claimed
86
87				claims := make([]*Claim, len(canonical))
88				claimKinds := make([]string, len(canonical))
89				for index, key := range canonical {
90					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
91					if record == nil {
92						continue
93					}
94					switch {
95					case record.Reservation != nil:
96						claims[index], claimKinds[index] = record.Reservation, "reservation"
97					case record.Fence != nil:
98						claims[index], claimKinds[index] = record.Fence, "fence"
99					}
100				}
101
102				allSameKind := true
103				var existing Token
104				for index, claim := range claims {
105					wantedKind := "reservation"
106					if fence {
107						wantedKind = "fence"
108					}
109					if claim == nil || claimKinds[index] != wantedKind || !claim.Token.sameOperation(request) || claim.MachineID != request.MachineID {
110						allSameKind = false
111						break
112					}
113					if index == 0 {
114						existing = claim.Token
115					} else if !existing.matches(claim.Token) {
116						return false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s has inconsistent epochs: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
117					}
118				}
119				if allSameKind {
120					result = existing
121					return bindingAdded, nil
122				}
123
124				promoteReservation := fence
125				anyClaim := false
126				for index, claim := range claims {
127					if claim == nil {
128						promoteReservation = false
129						continue
130					}
131					anyClaim = true
132					if claimKinds[index] != "reservation" || !claim.Token.sameOperation(request) || claim.MachineID != request.MachineID {
133						return false, blockedOrConflict(canonical[index], claimKinds[index], *claim, request)
134					}
135				}
136				if anyClaim && !promoteReservation {
137					return false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s only owns part of the requested key set: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
138				}
139
140				epoch, err := allocateEpoch(state)
141				if err != nil {
142					return false, err
143				}
144				result = Token{OperationID: request.OperationID, Digest: request.Digest, Epoch: epoch}
145				now := canonicalTime(a.clock())
146				for _, key := range canonical {
147					record := ensureRecord(state, key)
148					record.Epoch = epoch
149					claim := &Claim{Token: result, MachineID: request.MachineID, CreatedAt: now}
150					if fence {
151						record.Reservation = nil
152						record.Fence = claim
153					} else {
154						record.Reservation = claim
155						record.Fence = nil
156					}
157				}
158				return true, nil
159			})
160		})
161		return result, err
162	}

164	// ReleaseReservation clears an exact reservation and advances the authority
165	// epoch. It is non-terminal; AbortReservation should be used for a terminal
166	// pre-fence cancellation.
167	func (a *Authority) ReleaseReservation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token) (uint64, error) {
168		return a.finishClaim(ctx, keys, token, "reservation", "")
169	}

171	// AbortReservation clears an exact reservation and retains a permanent
172	// terminal tombstone so delayed prepare replays cannot recreate it.
173	func (a *Authority) AbortReservation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token) (uint64, error) {
174		return a.finishClaim(ctx, keys, token, "reservation", TombstoneAborted)
175	}

177	// Return clears an exact fence and retains a permanent terminal tombstone so
178	// delayed accepts carrying the old epoch fail closed.
179	func (a *Authority) Return(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token) (uint64, error) {
180		return a.finishClaim(ctx, keys, token, "fence", TombstoneReturned)

183	func (a *Authority) finishClaim(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token, claimKind string, terminal TombstoneKind) (uint64, error) {
184		if a == nil {
185			return 0, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
186		}
187		if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
188			return 0, err
189		}
190		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
191		if err != nil {
192			return 0, err
193		}
194		var advanced uint64
195		err = a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func([]Key) error {
196			return a.updateState(ctx, func(state *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
197				canonical := claimed
198				if terminal != "" {
199					if epoch, found, err := matchingTerminal(*state, canonical, token, terminal); err != nil {
200						return false, err
201					} else if found {
202						advanced = epoch
203						return false, nil
204					}
205				}
206				if err := validateClaimKeySet(*state, canonical, token, claimKind); err != nil {
207					return false, err
208				}
209				for _, key := range canonical {
210					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
211					if record == nil {
212						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s has no active %s: %w", key.subject(), claimKind, ErrEpochMismatch)
213					}
214					var claim *Claim
215					if claimKind == "reservation" {
216						claim = record.Reservation
217					} else {
218						claim = record.Fence
219					}
220					if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
221						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s does not hold operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
222					}
223				}
224				epoch, err := allocateEpoch(state)
225				if err != nil {
226					return false, err
227				}
228				advanced = epoch
229				now := canonicalTime(a.clock())
230				for _, key := range canonical {
231					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
232					record.Epoch = epoch
233					if claimKind == "reservation" {
234						record.Reservation = nil
235					} else {
236						record.Fence = nil
237					}
238					if terminal != "" {
239						record.Tombstones = append(record.Tombstones, Tombstone{Kind: terminal, Token: token, AdvancedEpoch: epoch, CreatedAt: now})
240					}
241				}
242				return true, nil
243			})
244		})
245		return advanced, err
246	}

248	// WithMutation runs an ordinary mutator only when no requested key is reserved
249	// or fenced. A branch key automatically includes its repository ancestor so a
250	// repository fence covers every branch. The locks remain held until operation
251	// returns.
252	func (a *Authority) WithMutation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func() error) error {
253		return a.WithGuard(ctx, keys, nil, operation)
254	}
255
256	// WithGuard permits the exact owner of an active reservation or fence to work
257	// while rejecting stale, returned, and mismatched tokens. A nil token is an
258	// ordinary mutation guard and includes repository ancestors. It is
259	// non-reentrant: operation must not reacquire an overlapping key.
260	func (a *Authority) WithGuard(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token *Token, operation func() error) error {
261		if a == nil {
262			return errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
263		}
264		if operation == nil {
265			return errors.New("operation lease guard requires an operation")
266		}
267		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool)
272		if token != nil {
273			if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
274				return err
275			}
276		} else {
277			for _, key := range claimed {
278				if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
279					repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
280				}
281			}
282		}
283		return a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func(locked []Key) error {
284			checked := locked
285			if token != nil {
286				// Repository ancestors participate in draining but are not part of a
287				// branch-scoped token's ownership claim.
288				checked = claimed
289			}
290			if err := a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
291				matched := 0
292				for _, key := range checked {
293					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
294					if record == nil {
295						if token != nil {
296							return fmt.Errorf("%s has no operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
297						}
298						continue
299					}
300					if token != nil && hasTerminal(*record, *token) {
301						return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrReturned)
302					}
303					claim, kind := activeClaim(*record)
304					if claim == nil {
305						if token != nil {
306							return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is no longer active on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrEpochMismatch)
307						}
308						continue
309					}
310					if token == nil || !claim.Token.matches(*token) {
311						return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
312					}
313					matched++
314				}
315				if token != nil && matched != len(checked) {
316					return fmt.Errorf("operation %s does not own the complete key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrEpochMismatch)
317				}
318				if token != nil {
319					if err := validateGuardKeySet(state, claimed, *token); err != nil {
320						return err
321					}
322				}
323				if token == nil {
324					for _, record := range state.Records {
325						if record.Key.Scope != ScopeBranch || !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
326							continue
327						}
328						if claim, kind := activeClaim(record); claim != nil {
329							return &BlockedError{Key: record.Key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
330						}
331					}
332				}
333				return nil
334			}); err != nil {
335				return err
336			}
337			return operation()
338		})
339	}

341	// Inspect returns records for the requested keys while holding those key locks.
342	// Untouched keys are represented with Epoch zero and are never persisted.
343	func (a *Authority) Inspect(ctx context.Context, keys []Key) ([]Record, error) {
344		if a == nil {
345			return nil, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
346		}
347		var result []Record
348		err := a.withKeyLocks(ctx, keys, func(canonical []Key) error {
349			return a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
350				result = make([]Record, 0, len(canonical))
351				for _, key := range canonical {
352					if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
353						result = append(result, cloneRecord(*record))
354					} else {
355						result = append(result, Record{Key: key})
356					}
357				}
358				return nil
359			})
360		})
361		return result, err
362	}

364	func mutationKeys(keys []Key) []Key {
365		expanded := append([]Key(nil), keys...)
366		for _, key := range keys {
367			if key.Scope == ScopeBranch {
368				expanded = append(expanded, RepositoryKey(key.Repository))
369			}
370		}
371		return expanded
372	}

374	func (a *Authority) withKeyLocks(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func([]Key) error) error {
375		canonical, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
376		if err != nil {
377			return err
378		}
379		if ctx == nil {
380			ctx = context.Background()
381		}
382		if err := a.ensureLayout(); err != nil {
383			return err
384		}
385		var acquire func(int) error
386		acquire = func(index int) error {
387			if index == len(canonical) {
388				return operation(canonical)
389			}
390			directory := a.keyLockDir(canonical[index])
391			if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
392				return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation key lock: %w", err)
393			}
394			return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease key", func() error { return acquire(index + 1) })
395		}
396		return acquire(0)
397	}

399	func (a *Authority) updateState(ctx context.Context, mutate func(*Snapshot) (bool, error)) error {
400		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
401			state, err := a.loadState()
402			if err != nil {
403				return err
404			}
405			changed, err := mutate(&state)
406			if err != nil || !changed {
407				return err
408			}
409			return a.writeState(state)
410		})
411	}
412
413	func (a *Authority) readState(ctx context.Context, read func(Snapshot) error) error {
414		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
415			state, err := a.loadState()
416			if err != nil {
417				return err
418			}
419			return read(state)
420		})
421	}

423	func (a *Authority) withStateLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
424		directory := filepath.Join(a.root, ".authority")
425		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
426			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation authority lock: %w", err)
427		}
428		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease authority", operation)
429	}

431	func (a *Authority) ensureLayout() error {
432		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
433			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation lease root: %w", err)
434		}
435		if err := ensurePrivateDir(filepath.Join(a.root, ".keys")); err != nil {
436			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation lease key root: %w", err)
437		}
438		return nil
439	}

441	func (a *Authority) keyLockDir(key Key) string {
442		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(key.canonical()))
443		return filepath.Join(a.root, ".keys", hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]))
444	}

446	func (a *Authority) statePath() string { return filepath.Join(a.root, stateFilename) }

448	func (a *Authority) loadState() (Snapshot, error) {
449		path := a.statePath()
450		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
451		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
452			return Snapshot{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}, nil
453		}
454		if err != nil {
455			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state: %w", err)
456		}
457		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
458			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s is not a regular file", path)
459		}
460		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
461		if err != nil {
462			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state permissions: %w", err)
463		}
464		if !private {
465			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
466		}
467		file, err := os.Open(path)
468		if err != nil {
469			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("open operation lease state: %w", err)
470		}
471		defer file.Close()
472		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
473		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
474		var state Snapshot
475		if err := decoder.Decode(&state); err != nil {
476			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state: %w", err)
477		}
478		var extra any
479		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
480			if err == nil {
481				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("decode operation lease state: multiple JSON values")
482			}
483			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state trailing data: %w", err)
484		}
485		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
486			return Snapshot{}, err
487		}
488		canonical := canonicalSnapshot(state)
489		encodedState, _ := json.Marshal(state)
490		encodedCanonical, _ := json.Marshal(canonical)
491		if string(encodedState) != string(encodedCanonical) {
492			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("operation lease state is not in canonical order")
493		}
494		return state, nil
495	}

497	func (a *Authority) writeState(state Snapshot) error {
498		state = canonicalSnapshot(state)
499		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
500			return err
501		}
502		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
503			return err
504		}
505		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(a.root, ".authority-*.tmp")
506		if err != nil {
507			return fmt.Errorf("create operation lease state temp file: %w", err)
508		}
509		name := temporary.Name()
510		defer os.Remove(name)
511		if err := setPrivateMode(name, 0o600); err != nil {
512			_ = temporary.Close()
513			return err
514		}
515		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)
516		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
517		if err := encoder.Encode(state); err != nil {
518			_ = temporary.Close()
519			return fmt.Errorf("encode operation lease state: %w", err)
520		}
521		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
522			_ = temporary.Close()
523			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease state: %w", err)
524		}
525		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
526			return fmt.Errorf("close operation lease state: %w", err)
527		}
528		if err := replaceFile(name, a.statePath()); err != nil {
529			return fmt.Errorf("publish operation lease state: %w", err)
530		}
531		if err := syncDirectory(a.root); err != nil {
532			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease directory: %w", err)
533		}
534		return nil
535	}

537	func validateSnapshot(state Snapshot) error {
538		if state.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
539			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease schema_version %d: want %d", state.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
540		}
541		bindings := make(map[string]string, len(state.Bindings))
542		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
543			if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
544				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease binding: %w", err)
545			}
546			if _, exists := bindings[binding.OperationID]; exists {
547				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease repeats binding %s", binding.OperationID)
548			}
549			bindings[binding.OperationID] = binding.Digest
550		}
551		type activeSignature struct {
552			Token     Token
553			MachineID string
554			Kind      string
555		}
556		activeOperations := make(map[string]activeSignature)
557		terminalOperations := make(map[string]Tombstone)
558		seenKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(state.Records))
559		var maxRecordEpoch uint64
560		for _, record := range state.Records {
561			if err := record.Key.Validate(); err != nil {
562				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease record: %w", err)
563			}
564			canonicalKey := record.Key.canonical()
565			if _, exists := seenKeys[canonicalKey]; exists {
566				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease state repeats key %s", record.Key.subject())
567			}
568			seenKeys[canonicalKey] = struct{}{}
569			if record.Epoch == 0 || record.Epoch > state.LastEpoch {
570				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has invalid epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), record.Epoch)
571			}
572			if record.Epoch > maxRecordEpoch {
573				maxRecordEpoch = record.Epoch
574			}
575			if record.Reservation != nil && record.Fence != nil {
576				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has both reservation and fence", record.Key.subject())
577			}
578			for _, named := range []struct {
579				name  string
580				claim *Claim
581			}{{"reservation", record.Reservation}, {"fence", record.Fence}} {
582				if named.claim == nil {
583					continue
584				}
585				if err := named.claim.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
586					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s: %w", named.name, record.Key.subject(), err)
587				}
588				if digest, exists := bindings[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != named.claim.Token.Digest {
589					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no matching permanent binding", named.name, record.Key.subject())
590				}
591				if named.claim.Token.Epoch != record.Epoch {
592					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has epoch %d, record has %d", named.name, record.Key.subject(), named.claim.Token.Epoch, record.Epoch)
593				}
594				if named.claim.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
595					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no created_at", named.name, record.Key.subject())
596				}
597				if named.claim.MachineID != "" {
598					if err := machineid.Validate(named.claim.MachineID); err != nil {
599						return err
600					}
601				}
602				signature := activeSignature{Token: named.claim.Token, MachineID: named.claim.MachineID, Kind: named.name}
603				if prior, exists := activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; exists {
604					if !prior.Token.matches(signature.Token) || prior.MachineID != signature.MachineID || prior.Kind != signature.Kind {
605						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent active claims", named.claim.Token.OperationID)
606					}
607				} else {
608					activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID] = signature
609				}
610			}
611			seenTombstones := make(map[string]struct{}, len(record.Tombstones))
612			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
613				switch tombstone.Kind {
614				case TombstoneAborted, TombstoneReturned:
615				default:
616					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has unknown tombstone kind %q", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.Kind)
617				}
618				if err := tombstone.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
619					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s: %w", record.Key.subject(), err)
620				}
621				if digest, exists := bindings[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != tombstone.Token.Digest {
622					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no matching permanent binding", record.Key.subject())
623				}
624				if tombstone.AdvancedEpoch <= tombstone.Token.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > record.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > state.LastEpoch {
625					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has invalid advanced epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.AdvancedEpoch)
626				}
627				if tombstone.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
628					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no created_at", record.Key.subject())
629				}
630				if prior, exists := terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; exists {
631					if !prior.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || prior.Kind != tombstone.Kind || prior.AdvancedEpoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
632						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent terminal records", tombstone.Token.OperationID)
633					}
634				} else {
635					terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID] = tombstone
636				}
637				identity := fmt.Sprintf("%s\x00%s\x00%d", tombstone.Token.OperationID, tombstone.Token.Digest, tombstone.Token.Epoch)
638				if _, exists := seenTombstones[identity]; exists {
639					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s repeats a terminal token", record.Key.subject())
640				}
641				seenTombstones[identity] = struct{}{}
642				if record.Reservation != nil && record.Reservation.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || record.Fence != nil && record.Fence.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) {
643					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has a terminal token still active", record.Key.subject())
644				}
645			}
646		}
647		if state.LastEpoch != maxRecordEpoch {
648			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease last_epoch %d does not match latest record epoch %d", state.LastEpoch, maxRecordEpoch)
649		}
650		for operationID := range activeOperations {
651			if _, terminal := terminalOperations[operationID]; terminal {
652				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s is both active and terminal", operationID)
653			}
654		}
655		return nil
656	}
657
658	func canonicalSnapshot(state Snapshot) Snapshot {
659		result := Snapshot{
660			SchemaVersion: state.SchemaVersion,
661			LastEpoch:     state.LastEpoch,
662			Bindings:      append([]Binding(nil), state.Bindings...),
663			Records:       make([]Record, len(state.Records)),
664		}
665		sort.Slice(result.Bindings, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Bindings[i].OperationID < result.Bindings[j].OperationID })
666		for index, record := range state.Records {
667			result.Records[index] = cloneRecord(record)
668			if result.Records[index].Reservation != nil {
669				result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt)
670			}
671			if result.Records[index].Fence != nil {
672				result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt)
673			}
674			for tombstoneIndex := range result.Records[index].Tombstones {
675				result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt)
676			}
677			sort.Slice(result.Records[index].Tombstones, func(i, j int) bool {
678				left, right := result.Records[index].Tombstones[i], result.Records[index].Tombstones[j]
679				if left.Token.Epoch != right.Token.Epoch {
680					return left.Token.Epoch < right.Token.Epoch
681				}
682				if left.Token.OperationID != right.Token.OperationID {
683					return left.Token.OperationID < right.Token.OperationID
684				}
685				if left.Token.Digest != right.Token.Digest {
686					return left.Token.Digest < right.Token.Digest
687				}
688				return left.Kind < right.Kind
689			})
690		}
691		sort.Slice(result.Records, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Records[i].Key.canonical() < result.Records[j].Key.canonical() })
692		return result
693	}
694
695	func cloneRecord(record Record) Record {
696		result := record
697		if record.Reservation != nil {
698			copy := *record.Reservation
699			result.Reservation = &copy
700		}
701		if record.Fence != nil {
702			copy := *record.Fence
703			result.Fence = &copy
704		}
705		result.Tombstones = append([]Tombstone(nil), record.Tombstones...)
706		return result
707	}
708
709	func findRecord(records []Record, key Key) *Record {
710		canonical := key.canonical()
711		for index := range records {
712			if records[index].Key.canonical() == canonical {
713				return &records[index]
714			}
715		}
716		return nil
717	}
718
719	func ensureRecord(state *Snapshot, key Key) *Record {
720		if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
721			return record
722		}
723		state.Records = append(state.Records, Record{Key: key})
724		return &state.Records[len(state.Records)-1]
725	}

727	func allocateEpoch(state *Snapshot) (uint64, error) {
728		if state.LastEpoch == math.MaxUint64 {
729			return 0, errors.New("operation lease epoch exhausted")
730		}
731		state.LastEpoch++
732		return state.LastEpoch, nil
733	}

735	func activeClaim(record Record) (*Claim, string) {
736		if record.Reservation != nil {
737			return record.Reservation, "reservation"
738		}
739		if record.Fence != nil {
740			return record.Fence, "fence"
741		}
742		return nil, ""

748				return true
749			}

754	func ensureBinding(state *Snapshot, request Request) bool {
755		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
756			if binding.OperationID == request.OperationID {
757				return false
758			}
759		}
760		state.Bindings = append(state.Bindings, Binding{OperationID: request.OperationID, Digest: request.Digest})
761		return true

764	func checkOperationReuse(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
765		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
766			if binding.OperationID != request.OperationID {
767				continue
768			}
769			if binding.Digest != request.Digest {
770				return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was permanently bound to another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
771			}
772			break
773		}
774		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
775		for _, key := range keys {
776			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
777		}
778		for _, record := range state.Records {
779			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
780				if tombstone.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
781					continue
782				}
783				if tombstone.Token.Digest != request.Digest {
784					return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was used with another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
785				}
786				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal: %w", request.OperationID, ErrReturned)
787			}
788			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)
789			if claim == nil || claim.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
790				continue
791			}
792			if claim.Token.Digest != request.Digest {
793				return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s is active with another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
794			}
795			if _, exists := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !exists {
796				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s is active on a different key set: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
797			}
798		}
799		return nil
800	}
801
802	func checkHierarchyClaims(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
803		requestedKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
804		requestedRepositories := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
805		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool, len(keys))
806		for _, key := range keys {
807			requestedKeys[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
808			requestedRepositories[key.Repository] = struct{}{}
809			if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
810				repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
811			}
812		}
813		for _, record := range state.Records {
814			claim, kind := activeClaim(record)
815			if claim == nil {
816				continue
817			}
818			if _, requested := requestedKeys[record.Key.canonical()]; requested {
819				continue
820			}
821			if _, sameRepository := requestedRepositories[record.Key.Repository]; !sameRepository {
822				continue
823			}
824			if record.Key.Scope != ScopeRepository && !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
825				continue
826			}
827			return blockedOrConflict(record.Key, kind, *claim, request)
828		}
829		return nil
830	}
831
832	func blockedOrConflict(key Key, kind string, claim Claim, request Request) error {
833		if claim.Token.OperationID == request.OperationID {
834			return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s conflicts with its active %s: %w", request.OperationID, kind, ErrConflict)
835		}
836		return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
837	}

839	func validateGuardKeySet(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token) error {
840		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
841		for _, key := range keys {
842			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
843		}
844		matched := 0
845		for _, record := range state.Records {
846			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)
847			if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
848				continue
849			}
850			if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
851				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d owns a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
852			}
853			matched++
854		}
855		if matched != len(keys) {
856			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d does not own the exact guard key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
857		}
858		return nil
859	}
860
861	func validateClaimKeySet(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token, claimKind string) error {
862		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
863		for _, key := range keys {
864			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
865		}
866		matched := 0
867		for _, record := range state.Records {
868			var claim *Claim
869			if claimKind == "reservation" {
870				claim = record.Reservation
871			} else {
872				claim = record.Fence
873			}
874			if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
875				continue
876			}
877			if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
878				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d owns a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
879			}
880			matched++
881		}
882		if matched != len(keys) {
883			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d does not own the exact key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
884		}
885		return nil
886	}

888	func matchingTerminal(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token, kind TombstoneKind) (uint64, bool, error) {
889		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
890		for _, key := range keys {
891			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
892		}
893		var epoch uint64
894		matched := 0
895		for _, record := range state.Records {
896			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
897				if !tombstone.Token.matches(token) {
898					continue
899				}
900				if tombstone.Kind != kind {
901					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d ended as %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, tombstone.Kind, ErrReturned)
902				}
903				if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
904					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
905				}
906				if epoch == 0 {
907					epoch = tombstone.AdvancedEpoch
908				} else if epoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
909					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s has inconsistent terminal epochs: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
910				}
911				matched++
912				break
913			}
914		}
915		if matched == 0 {
916			return 0, false, nil
917		}
918		if matched != len(keys) {
919			return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal on only part of the key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
920		}
921		return epoch, true, nil
922	}

924	func ensurePrivateDir(path string) error {
925		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
926			return err
927		}
928		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
929		if err != nil {
930			return err
931		}
932		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
933			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a private directory", path)
934		}
935		if err := setPrivateMode(path, 0o700); err != nil {
936			return err
937		}
938		info, err = os.Lstat(path)
939		if err != nil {
940			return err
941		}
942		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o700)
943		if err != nil {
944			return fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease directory permissions: %w", err)
945		}
946		if !private {
947			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease directory %s permissions are not private (want 0700 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
948		}
949		return nil
950	}

952	func canonicalTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
953		return value.Round(0).UTC()
954	}

32	// applies finalMode, and atomically hard-links it to the absent destination.
33	// The hard-link publication is same-directory and cannot replace an existing
34	// path. This generic helper exists so callers such as repotemplate can preserve
35	// intentional public modes; secret-bearing callers should use
36	// CreatePrivateNoClobber.
37	func CreateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {

77	// CreatePrivateNoClobber is CreateNoClobber with a clamped owner-only final
78	// mode. executable is the only way to grant execute permission.
79	func CreatePrivateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {

87	// existing regular file against observed, and atomically renames the staged file
88	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
89	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
90	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
91	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
92	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.
93	func AtomicReplace(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
94		if root == nil {
95			return nil, errors.New("atomic replace: nil root")
96		}
97		if observed == nil {
98			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replace %q without observed state: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
99		}
100		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)
107		if err != nil {
108			return nil, err
109		}
110		defer func() {
111			if stagedName != "" {
112				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
113			}
114		}()
115		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
116			return nil, err
117		}
118		if err := root.Rename(stagedName, name); err != nil {
119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("atomically replace %q: %w", name, err)
120		}
121		stagedName = ""
122		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
123		if err != nil {
124			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
125		}
126		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
127			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
128		}
129		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
130			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
131		}
132		return published, nil
133	}
134
135	// AtomicReplacePrivate is AtomicReplace with owner-only final permissions.
136	func AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
137		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
138			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
139		}
140		return AtomicReplace(ctx, root, name, observed, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
141	}
142
143	func verifyReplaceTarget(root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo) error {
144		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("inspect replacement target %q: %w: %w", name, err, ErrReplaceTarget)
147		}
148		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(observed, current) {
149			return fmt.Errorf("replacement target %q changed or is not a regular file: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
150		}
151		return nil
152	}
153
154	func stageRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (string, fs.FileInfo, error) {
155		if finalMode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
156			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported final file mode %s", finalMode)
157		}
158		var name string
159		var writer *os.File
160		for attempt := 0; attempt < 32; attempt++ {
161			candidate, err := randomStageName()
162			if err != nil {
163				return "", nil, err
164			}
165			writer, err = root.OpenFile(candidate, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
166			if err == nil {
167				name = candidate
168				break
169			}
170			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
171				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("create private staging file: %w", err)
172			}
173		}
174		if writer == nil {
175			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
176		}
177		keep := true
178		defer func() {
179			if keep {
180				_ = writer.Close()
181				_ = root.Remove(name)
182			}
183		}()
184		if err := writeAllContext(ctx, writer, data); err != nil {
185			return "", nil, err
186		}
187		if err := writer.Chmod(finalMode.Perm()); err != nil {
188			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("set staged file mode: %w", err)
189		}
190		if err := writer.Sync(); err != nil {
191			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("sync staged file: %w", err)
192		}
193		opened, err := writer.Stat()
194		if err != nil {
195			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect staged file: %w", err)
196		}
197		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
198			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("close staged file: %w", err)
199		}
200		keep = false
201		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
202		if err != nil {
203			_ = root.Remove(name)
204			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("reopen staged file name: %w", err)
205		}
206		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(opened, current) {
207			_ = root.Remove(name)
208			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("staging file changed before publication: %w", ErrChanged)
209		}
210		return name, current, nil
211	}
212
213	func validateTargetName(name string) error {
214		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
215			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
216		}
217		return nil
218	}
219
220	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
221		for len(data) > 0 {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return err
224			}
225			written, err := writer.Write(data)
226			if err != nil {
227				return err
228			}
229			if written == 0 {
230				return io.ErrShortWrite
231			}
232			data = data[written:]
233		}
234		return context.Cause(ctx)
235	}
236
237	func randomStageName() (string, error) {
238		var random [16]byte
239		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
240			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
241		}
242		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
243	}

43	func NewStore(dir string, options ...StoreOption) *Store {

53	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, repositoryID, repositoryName, body string, tags []string) (*Note, error) {
54		if ctx == nil {
55			ctx = context.Background()
56		}
57		n := &Note{
58			SchemaVersion: CurrentSchemaVersion,
59			RepositoryID:  repositoryID,
60			Repository:    repositoryName,
61			Body:          body,
62			Tags:          tags,
63		}
64		n.Normalize()
65		if n.Body == "" {
66			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create note: body is empty: %w", ErrInvalid)
67		}
68
69		s.mu.Lock()
70		defer s.mu.Unlock()
71		var created *Note
72		err := s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
73			for range 32 {
74				candidate := *n
75				candidate.ID = s.nextID()
76				now := s.now()
77				candidate.Created, candidate.Updated = now, now
78				if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
79					return err
80				}
81				path := s.path(candidate.RepositoryID, candidate.ID)
82				if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
83					continue
84				} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
85					return err
86				}
87				candidate.Path = path
88				if err := s.writeAtomic(&candidate); err != nil {
89					return err
90				}
91				created = clone(&candidate)
92				return nil
93			}
94			return errors.New("generate unique note ID: too many collisions")
95		})
96		return created, err
97	}

99	// Import writes a transported note with its exact durable identity and
100	// timestamps. Path is always derived from the validated repository and note IDs;
101	// a source Path is never trusted. An identical revision is an idempotent replay,
102	// while reusing an ID for different content is a conflict. Import changes only
103	// Markdown source data and deliberately does not update or rebuild the FTS cache.
104	func (s *Store) Import(ctx context.Context, source *Note) (*Note, error) {
105		if s == nil {
106			return nil, errors.New("import into nil note store")
107		}
108		if source == nil {
109			return nil, errors.New("import nil note")
110		}
111		if ctx == nil {
112			ctx = context.Background()
113		}
114
115		candidate := clone(source)
116		candidate.Path = ""
117		if candidate.SchemaVersion == 0 {
118			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
119		}
120		originalRevision := source.Revision()
121		candidate.Normalize()
122		if candidate.Revision() != originalRevision {
123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("import note %s must already be normalized to preserve its revision: %w",
124				source.ID, ErrInvalid)
125		}
126		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
127			return nil, err
128		}
129
130		s.mu.Lock()
131		defer s.mu.Unlock()
132		var imported *Note
133		err := s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
134			target, err := s.confinedImportPath(candidate.RepositoryID, candidate.ID)
135			if err != nil {
136				return err
137			}
138			current, err := s.importedNoteByID(candidate.ID)
139			switch {
140			case err == nil:
141				if current.Revision() != candidate.Revision() {
142					return fmt.Errorf("note %s already exists with different content: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
143				}
144				if filepath.Clean(current.Path) != filepath.Clean(target) {
145					return fmt.Errorf("note %s exists outside its imported repository path: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
146				}
147				imported = clone(current)
148				return nil
149			case !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
150				return err
151			}
152
153			candidate.Path = target
154			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
155				return err
156			}
157			imported = clone(candidate)
158			return nil
159		})
160		return imported, err
161	}
162
163	func (s *Store) confinedImportPath(repositoryID, id string) (string, error) {
164		root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
165		if err != nil {
166			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
167		}
168		repositoryDir := filepath.Join(root, repositoryID)
169		if info, err := os.Lstat(repositoryDir); err == nil {
170			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
171				return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository directory %s is a symlink: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
172			}
173			if !info.IsDir() {
174				return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository path %s is not a directory: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
175			}
176		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
177			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect note repository directory %s: %w", repositoryID, err)
178		}
179
180		path := filepath.Join(repositoryDir, id+".md")
181		if info, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
182			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
183				return "", fmt.Errorf("note path %s is not a regular file: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
184			}
185		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
186			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect note path %s: %w", id, err)
187		}
188		confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
189		if err != nil {
190			return "", fmt.Errorf("confine imported note path: %w", err)
191		}
192		return confined, nil
193	}
194
195	// importedNoteByID performs the global uniqueness lookup used by Import while
196	// refusing to read through symlinks or accept legacy files nested more deeply
197	// than the one-repository-directory layout.
198	func (s *Store) importedNoteByID(id string) (*Note, error) {
199		paths, err := s.notePaths("")
200		if err != nil {
201			return nil, err
202		}
203		root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
204		if err != nil {
205			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
206		}
207		var match string
208		for _, path := range paths {
209			if strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md") != id {
210				continue
211			}
212			info, err := os.Lstat(path)
213			if err != nil {
214				return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect existing note %s: %w", id, err)
215			}
216			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
217				return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is not a regular file: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
218			}
219			confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
220			if err != nil {
221				return nil, fmt.Errorf("confine existing note %s: %w", id, err)
222			}
223			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, confined)
224			if err != nil {
225				return nil, fmt.Errorf("relativize existing note %s: %w", id, err)
226			}
227			parts := strings.Split(filepath.Clean(relative), string(filepath.Separator))
228			if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] != id+".md" {
229				return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is outside the repository note layout: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
230			}
231			if match != "" {
232				return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate note ID %s: %w", id, ErrConflict)
233			}
234			match = confined
235		}
236		if match == "" {
237			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
238		}
239		return s.read(match)
240	}
241
242	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Note, error) {
243		if id == "" {
244			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty note ID: %w", ErrNotFound)
245		}
246		paths, err := s.notePaths("")
247		if err != nil {
248			return nil, err
249		}
250		var match string
251		for _, path := range paths {
252			if strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md") == id {
253				if match != "" {
254					return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate note ID %s", id)
255				}
256				match = path
257			}
258		}
259		if match == "" {
260			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
261		}
262		return s.read(match)
263	}
264
265	// List returns notes newest-first. Empty repositoryID means all repositories.
266	func (s *Store) List(repositoryID string) ([]*Note, error) {
267		paths, err := s.notePaths(repositoryID)
268		if err != nil {
269			return nil, err
270		}
271		notes := make([]*Note, 0, len(paths))
272		for _, path := range paths {
273			n, err := s.read(path)
274			if err != nil {
275				if s.diagnostics != nil {
276					s.diagnostics(path, err)
277				}
278				continue
279			}
280			notes = append(notes, n)
281		}
282		Sort(notes)
283		return notes, nil
284	}

286	// Update replaces body/tags while preserving identity, repository and Created.
287	func (s *Store) Update(ctx context.Context, id, expectedRevision, body string, tags []string) (*Note, error) {
288		if ctx == nil {
289			ctx = context.Background()
290		}
291		s.mu.Lock()
292		defer s.mu.Unlock()
293		var updated *Note
294		err := s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
295			current, err := s.Get(id)
296			if err != nil {
297				return err
298			}
299			if expectedRevision == "" || current.Revision() != expectedRevision {
300				return fmt.Errorf("note %s: %w", id, ErrConflict)
301			}
302			candidate := *current
303			candidate.Body, candidate.Tags, candidate.Updated = body, tags, s.now()
304			candidate.Normalize()
305			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
306				return err
307			}
308			if err := s.writeAtomic(&candidate); err != nil {
309				return err
310			}
311			updated = clone(&candidate)
312			return nil
313		})
314		return updated, err
315	}
316
317	func (s *Store) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
318		if ctx == nil {
319			ctx = context.Background()
320		}
321		s.mu.Lock()
322		defer s.mu.Unlock()
323		return s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
324			n, err := s.Get(id)
325			if err != nil {
326				return err
327			}
328			dir := filepath.Dir(n.Path)
329			if err := os.Remove(n.Path); err != nil {
330				return err
331			}
332			if err := syncNoteDir(dir); err != nil {
333				return err
334			}
335			// Empty repository directories are noise and carry no identity of their own.
336			if err := os.Remove(dir); err == nil {
337				return syncNoteDir(filepath.Dir(dir))
338			}
339			return nil
340		})
341	}

343	func (s *Store) Path(repositoryID string) string {
344		if repositoryID == "" {
345			return s.Dir
346		}
347		return filepath.Join(s.Dir, repositoryID)
348	}

350	func Sort(notes []*Note) {
351		sort.SliceStable(notes, func(i, j int) bool {
352			if !notes[i].Created.Equal(notes[j].Created) {
353				return notes[i].Created.After(notes[j].Created)
354			}
355			return notes[i].ID < notes[j].ID
356		})
357	}
358
359	func (s *Store) read(path string) (*Note, error) {
360		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
361		if err != nil {
362			return nil, err
363		}
364		meta, body, err := split(data)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", filepath.Base(path), err)
367		}
368		var n Note
369		md, err := toml.Decode(string(meta), &n)
370		if err != nil {
371			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode %s frontmatter: %w", filepath.Base(path), err)
372		}
373		if unknown := md.Undecoded(); len(unknown) > 0 {
374			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode %s: unknown field(s): %v", filepath.Base(path), unknown)
375		}
376		n.Body, n.Path = string(body), path
377		n.Normalize()
378		if err := n.Validate(); err != nil {
379			return nil, err
380		}
381		if want := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md"); n.ID != want {
382			return nil, fmt.Errorf("note ID %s does not match filename %s: %w", n.ID, want, ErrInvalid)
383		}
384		if want := filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(path)); n.RepositoryID != want {
385			return nil, fmt.Errorf("repository ID %s does not match directory %s: %w", n.RepositoryID, want, ErrRepository)
386		}
387		return &n, nil
388	}
389
390	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(n *Note) error {
391		dir := filepath.Dir(n.Path)
392		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o700); err != nil {
393			return err
394		}
395		for _, privateDir := range []string{filepath.Dir(dir), dir} {
396			if err := os.Chmod(privateDir, 0o700); err != nil {
397				return fmt.Errorf("set private note directory mode: %w", err)
398			}
399		}
400		var front bytes.Buffer
401		if err := toml.NewEncoder(&front).Encode(n); err != nil {
402			return err
403		}
404		content := delimiter + "\n" + front.String() + delimiter + "\n\n" + n.Body
405		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, "."+n.ID+".*.tmp")
406		if err != nil {
407			return err
408		}
409		name := tmp.Name()
410		defer os.Remove(name)
411		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
412			_ = tmp.Close()
413			return fmt.Errorf("set private note temp file mode: %w", err)
414		}
415		if _, err := tmp.WriteString(content); err != nil {
416			_ = tmp.Close()
417			return err
418		}
419		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
420			_ = tmp.Close()
421			return fmt.Errorf("sync note temp file: %w", err)
422		}
423		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
424			return err
425		}
426		if err := os.Rename(name, n.Path); err != nil {
427			return err
428		}
429		// Sync both the note directory (rename entry) and its parent (new
430		// repository directory) before reporting durable success.
431		return errors.Join(syncNoteDir(dir), syncNoteDir(filepath.Dir(dir)))
432	}
433
434	func split(data []byte) ([]byte, []byte, error) {
435		if !bytes.HasPrefix(data, []byte(delimiter+"\n")) {
436			return nil, nil, errors.New("missing opening +++ frontmatter delimiter")
437		}
438		rest := data[len(delimiter)+1:]
439		marker := []byte("\n" + delimiter + "\n")
440		i := bytes.Index(rest, marker)
441		if i < 0 {
442			return nil, nil, errors.New("missing closing +++ frontmatter delimiter")
443		}
444		meta := rest[:i]
445		body := rest[i+len(marker):]
446		body = bytes.TrimPrefix(body, []byte("\n"))
447		return meta, body, nil
448	}
449
450	func (s *Store) notePaths(repositoryID string) ([]string, error) {
451		root := s.Dir
452		if repositoryID != "" {
453			root = filepath.Join(root, repositoryID)
454		}
455		var paths []string
456		err := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
457			if err != nil {
458				if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
459					return nil
460				}
461				return err
462			}
463			if entry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
464				return nil
465			}
466			paths = append(paths, path)
467			return nil
468		})
469		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
470			return nil, nil
471		}
472		sort.Strings(paths)
473		return paths, err
474	}
475
476	func (s *Store) path(repositoryID, id string) string {
477		return filepath.Join(s.Dir, repositoryID, id+".md")
478	}
479
480	func (s *Store) nextID() string {
481		if s.generateID == nil {
482			return uuid.NewString()
483		}
484		return s.generateID()
485	}

487	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
488		if s.clock == nil {
489			return time.Now().UTC()
490		}
491		return s.clock().UTC()
492	}

494	func clone(n *Note) *Note {
495		if n == nil {
496			return nil
497		}
498		out := *n
499		out.Tags = append([]string(nil), n.Tags...)
500		return &out
501	}
502
503	func (s *Store) withFileLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) (err error) {
504		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o700); err != nil {
505			return err
506		}
507		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(s.Dir)
508		if err != nil {
509			return err
510		}
511		canonical, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absolute)
512		if err != nil {
513			return err
514		}
515		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonical), "."+filepath.Base(canonical)+".lock")
516		lock, err := acquireNoteFileLock(ctx, lockPath)
517		if err != nil {
518			return err
519		}
520		defer func() { err = errors.Join(err, lock.Close()) }()
521		return operation()
522	}
