511	func buildRemoteFacts(now time.Time, input BuildInput, reportErrors []CollectionError) ([]Remote, ForgeFacts, []CollectionError) {
512		forgeFacts := ForgeFacts{Error: optionalError(input.Forge.Err)}
513		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
514			sourceID := "forge.inventory"
515			forgeFacts.SourceID = &sourceID
516			records := len(input.Forge.Records)
517			forgeFacts.RecordsConsidered = &records
518			complete := input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete
519			forgeFacts.Complete = &complete
520		} else if input.Forge.Err != nil {
521			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-unavailable", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
522		}
523		if input.Forge.Err != nil && !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
524			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-partial", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
525		}
526		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
527			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("remote-topology-failed", "local", "remotes", input.TopologyErr))
528			if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
529				zero := 0
530				forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &zero
531			}
532			return []Remote{}, forgeFacts, reportErrors
533		}
534
535		recordsByIdentity := forgeRecordsByIdentity(input.Forge.Records)
536		currentUpstream := ""
537		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(input.Context.Checkouts) {
538			status := input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].Status
539			if input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].StatusErr == nil && status.Upstream != "" {
540				currentUpstream, _, _ = strings.Cut(status.Upstream, "/")
541			}
542		}
543		matchedRecords := map[string]struct{}{}
544		remotes := make([]Remote, 0, len(input.Topology.Remotes))
545		for _, observed := range input.Topology.Remotes {
546			remote := Remote{Name: observed.Name, Roles: remoteRoles(observed.Name, currentUpstream), Fetch: []RemoteEndpoint{}, Push: []RemoteEndpoint{}}
547			for index, raw := range observed.FetchURLs {
548				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
549				remote.Fetch = append(remote.Fetch, endpoint)
550				for _, key := range matched {
551					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
552				}
553				if endpointErr != nil {
554					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
555						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.fetch.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
556					})
557				}
558			}
559			for index, raw := range observed.PushURLs {
560				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
561				remote.Push = append(remote.Push, endpoint)
562				for _, key := range matched {
563					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
564				}
565				if endpointErr != nil {
566					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
567						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.push.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
568					})
569				}
570			}
571			remotes = append(remotes, remote)
572		}
573		if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
574			matches := len(matchedRecords)
575			forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &matches
576		}
577		return remotes, forgeFacts, reportErrors
578	}
579
580	type endpointBuildError struct {
581		Code    string
582		Message string
583	}
584
585	func buildRemoteEndpoint(raw string, records map[string][]forge.RemoteRepo, forgeAvailable, exactForge bool) (RemoteEndpoint, []string, *endpointBuildError) {
586		transport, displayIdentity, displayOK := publicEndpointIdentity(raw)
587		forgeMatch := "unavailable"
588		if forgeAvailable {
589			forgeMatch = "none"
590		}
591		endpoint := RemoteEndpoint{Transport: transport, Identity: optionalString(displayIdentity), ForgeMatch: forgeMatch}
592		privateIdentity := privateRemoteIdentity(raw)
593		if !displayOK {
594			message := "endpoint has no display-safe cross-host identity"
595			endpoint.Error = &message
596			return endpoint, nil, &endpointBuildError{Code: "remote-identity-unavailable", Message: message}
597		}
598
599		candidates := dedupeForgeRecords(records[privateIdentity])
600		var exact *forge.RemoteRepo
601		matched := []string{}
602		switch len(candidates) {
603		case 1:
604			if exactForge {
605				exact = &candidates[0]
606			}
607			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "exact"
608			matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidates[0]))
609		case 0:
610			if forgeAvailable {
611				endpoint.ForgeMatch = "none"
612			}
613		default:
614			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "ambiguous"
615			message := fmt.Sprintf("normalized endpoint identity matches %d forge records", len(candidates))
616			endpoint.Error = &message
617			for _, candidate := range candidates {
618				matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidate))
619			}
620			if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw}); ok {
621				endpoint.WebURL = &web
622			}
623			return endpoint, matched, &endpointBuildError{Code: "forge-match-ambiguous", Message: message}
624		}
625		if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw, Exact: exact}); ok {
626			endpoint.WebURL = &web
627		}
628		return endpoint, matched, nil
629	}
630
631	func buildFleetFacts(now time.Time, input FleetInput, localIdentities map[string]struct{}, reportErrors []CollectionError) (FleetFacts, []CollectionError) {
632		facts := FleetFacts{Coverage: FleetCoverageConfiguredHostsOnly, Hosts: []FleetHostObservation{}, Error: optionalError(input.Err)}
633		if !input.Configured {
634			if input.Err == nil {
635				facts.Error = optionalString("fleet configuration was not collected")
636			}
637			if facts.Error != nil {
638				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-config-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "configuration", Message: *facts.Error})
639			}
640			return facts, reportErrors
641		}
642		count := len(input.ConfiguredHostNames)
643		facts.ConfiguredHosts = &count
644		results := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
645		for _, result := range input.Results {
646			if _, exists := results[result.Name]; !exists {
647				results[result.Name] = result
648			}
649		}
650		for index, name := range input.ConfiguredHostNames {
651			result, found := results[name]
652			if !found {
653				result = fleet.HostResult{Name: name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "configured host produced no observation"}
654			}
655			host := FleetHostObservation{
656				Name: name, State: result.State, CachedAt: optionalTimeValue(result.CachedAt),
657				Match: FleetMatchUnavailable, Repositories: []FleetRepository{}, Error: optionalString(cleanText(result.Error)),
658			}
659			if result.Snapshot != nil {
660				matches := matchingFleetRepositories(result.Snapshot.Repositories, localIdentities)
661				for _, matched := range matches {
662					host.Repositories = append(host.Repositories, fleetRepositoryFacts(matched))
663				}
664				switch {
665				case len(localIdentities) == 0:
666					host.Match = FleetMatchUnavailable
667					if host.Error == nil {
668						host.Error = optionalString("local repository has no normalized remote identity")
669					}
670				case len(matches) == 0:
671					host.Match = FleetMatchNotFound
672				case len(matches) == 1:
673					host.Match = FleetMatchExact
674				default:
675					host.Match = FleetMatchAmbiguous
676					message := fmt.Sprintf("%d repositories on this host share a local normalized remote identity", len(matches))
677					if host.Error == nil {
678						host.Error = &message
679					}
680					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-match-ambiguous", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: message})
681				}
682
683				observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
684				if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
685					observedAt = *result.CachedAt
686				}
687				if !observedAt.IsZero() {
688					sourceID := fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index)
689					host.SourceID = &sourceID
690				}
691			}
692			if result.Error != "" || result.Snapshot == nil {
693				message := result.Error
694				if message == "" {
695					message = "host produced no repository snapshot"
696				}
697				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-host-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: cleanText(message)})
698			}
699			facts.Hosts = append(facts.Hosts, host)
700		}
701		return facts, reportErrors
702	}
703
704	func buildSources(now time.Time, input BuildInput, report Report) []Source {
705		sources := []Source{}
706		selectedFacts := any(nil)
707		checkoutCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessUnknown
708		if report.SelectedCheckout != nil {
709			selectedFacts = report.Local.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
710			checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessComplete
711			selected := input.Context.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
712			if selected.PathErr != nil || selected.StatusErr != nil {
713				checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
714			}
715		}
716		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.checkout", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, checkoutCompleteness, now, now, selectedFacts))
717
718		taskCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
719		if input.Context.TaskErr != nil {
720			taskCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
721		}
722		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.tasks", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, taskCompleteness, now, now, struct {
723			Checkouts  []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
724			OtherTasks []TaskFacts     `json:"other_tasks"`
725		}{report.Local.Checkouts, report.Local.OtherTasks}))
726
727		worktreeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
728		if input.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
729			worktreeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
730		}
731		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.worktrees", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, worktreeCompleteness, now, now, struct {
732			Count     *int            `json:"count"`
733			Checkouts []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
734		}{report.Local.LinkedWorktreeCount, report.Local.Checkouts}))
735
736		runtimeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
737		if len(report.Local.Runtimes) == 0 {
738			runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
739		}
740		for _, observed := range report.Local.Runtimes {
741			if observed.Error != nil {
742				runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
743			}
744		}
745		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.runtime", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, runtimeCompleteness, now, now, report.Local.Runtimes))
746
747		remoteCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
748		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
749			remoteCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
750		}
751		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.remotes", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, remoteCompleteness, now, now, report.Remotes))
752
753		if input.Fleet.Configured {
754			sources = append(sources, newSource("local.fleet-config", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, assessment.CompletenessComplete, now, now, input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames))
755		}
756		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
757			freshness := input.Forge.Freshness
758			if freshness == "" {
759				freshness = assessment.FreshnessUnknown
760			}
761			completeness := input.Forge.Completeness
762			if completeness == "" {
763				completeness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
764			}
765			sources = append(sources, newSource("forge.inventory", input.Forge.Authority, freshness, completeness, input.Forge.ObservedAt, now, struct {
766				Remotes []Remote   `json:"remotes"`
767				Forge   ForgeFacts `json:"forge"`
768			}{report.Remotes, report.Forge}))
769		}
770		resultByName := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
771		for _, result := range input.Fleet.Results {
772			resultByName[result.Name] = result
773		}
774		for index, name := range input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames {
775			result, ok := resultByName[name]
776			if !ok || result.Snapshot == nil || index >= len(report.Fleet.Hosts) {
777				continue
778			}
779			observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
780			if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
781				observedAt = *result.CachedAt
782			}
783			if observedAt.IsZero() {
784				continue
785			}
786			authority := assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive
787			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
788			if result.FromCache {
789				authority = assessment.AuthorityCache
790				if input.Fleet.CacheTTL > 0 && now.Sub(observedAt) > input.Fleet.CacheTTL {
791					freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
792				}
793			}
794			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
795			if result.Error != "" || result.State != fleet.HostOK && !result.FromCache {
796				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
797			}
798			sources = append(sources, newSource(fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index), authority, freshness, completeness, observedAt, now, report.Fleet.Hosts[index]))
799		}
800		sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool { return sources[i].ID < sources[j].ID })
801		return sources
802	}

969	func publicEndpointIdentity(raw string) (transport, identity string, ok bool) {
970		if !utf8.ValidString(raw) || containsControl(raw) {
971			return "unknown", "", false
972		}
973		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
974		if trimmed == "" {
975			return "unknown", "", false
976		}
977		redacted := trimmed
978		if parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
979			transport = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
980			parsed.User = nil
981			parsed.RawQuery = ""
982			parsed.ForceQuery = false
983			parsed.Fragment = ""
984			redacted = parsed.String()
985		} else {
986			if index := strings.IndexAny(redacted, "?#"); index >= 0 {
987				redacted = redacted[:index]
988			}
989			colon := strings.IndexByte(redacted, ':')
990			at := strings.LastIndexByte(redacted, '@')
991			if at >= 0 && colon > at {
992				transport = "ssh"
993				redacted = "git@" + redacted[at+1:]
994			} else if filepath.IsAbs(redacted) || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, "~") {
995				transport = "local"
996			} else {
997				transport = "unknown"
998			}
999		}
1000		identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(redacted)
1001		if identity == "" || containsControl(identity) {
1002			return transport, "", false
1003		}
1004		return transport, identity, true
1005	}

1118	// cleanText removes controls and structurally redacts URL/scp-like tokens while
1119	// preserving enough of an error to diagnose which probe failed.
1120	func cleanText(value string) string {
1121		value = strings.Map(func(r rune) rune {
1122			if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
1123				return ' '
1124			}
1125			return r
1126		}, value)
1127		fields := strings.Fields(value)
1128		for index, field := range fields {
1129			fields[index] = redactTextToken(field)
1130		}
1131		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(fields, " "))
1132	}
1133
1134	func redactTextToken(token string) string {
1135		prefix := strings.TrimLeft(token, "([{<\"'")
1136		leading := token[:len(token)-len(prefix)]
1137		core := strings.TrimRight(prefix, ")]}>\"',;.")
1138		trailing := prefix[len(core):]
1139		if parsed, err := url.Parse(core); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
1140			parsed.User = nil
1141			parsed.RawQuery = ""
1142			parsed.ForceQuery = false
1143			parsed.Fragment = ""
1144			return leading + parsed.String() + trailing
1145		}
1146		colon := strings.IndexByte(core, ':')
1147		at := strings.LastIndexByte(core, '@')
1148		if at > 0 && colon > at {
1149			core = "[redacted]@" + core[at+1:]
1150			if query := strings.IndexAny(core, "?#"); query >= 0 {
1151				core = core[:query]
1152			}
1153		}
1154		return leading + core + trailing
1155	}
1156
1157	func containsControl(value string) bool {
1158		return strings.IndexFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
1159			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
1160		}) >= 0
1161	}
1162
1163	func safeIdentifier(value string) string {
1164		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
1165		var b strings.Builder
1166		lastDash := false
1167		for _, r := range value {
1168			if r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' {
1169				b.WriteRune(r)
1170				lastDash = false
1171			} else if !lastDash {
1172				b.WriteByte('-')
1173				lastDash = true
1174			}
1175		}
1176		result := strings.Trim(b.String(), "-")
1177		if result == "" {
1178			return "unknown"
1179		}
1180		return result
1181	}

47	func assessCheckout(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
48		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
49			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the selected checkout is absent from the local inventory", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
50		}
51		checkout := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex]
52		switch {
53		case checkout.Worktree.Bare || context.Repo.Bare:
54			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
55		case checkout.PathErr != nil:
56			return indeterminate("checkout-path-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path could not be inspected", "restore path access and rerun context")
57		case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
58			return blocked("checkout-missing", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path is missing or prunable", "repair or remove the stale worktree registration")
59		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
60			return indeterminate("checkout-status-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "Git status could not be collected", "repair the checkout and rerun context")
61		case checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached || checkout.Branch() == "":
62			return blocked("checkout-detached", "selected-checkout", "the checkout does not have an attached branch", "check out an explicit branch")
63		case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
64			return blocked("checkout-conflicted", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d unmerged path(s)", checkout.Status.Conflicted), "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement")
65		case checkout.Status.Dirty():
66			return blocked("checkout-dirty", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d changed path(s)", checkout.Status.Changed), "commit or deliberately preserve the changes")
67		default:
68			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
69		}
70	}

72	func assessTasks(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) Readiness {
73		if context.TaskErr != nil {
74			return indeterminate("task-inventory-unavailable", "task-inventory", "task records could not be collected", "repair the task store and rerun context")
75		}
76		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
77			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "task scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
78		}
79		// Transfer/repository readiness covers every non-DONE task attached to the
80		// clone, including cold and branch-only records without a local checkout.
81		// Looking only at the selected checkout can otherwise hide another machine's
82		// ownership claim and incorrectly report not-applicable.
83		active := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(context.OtherTasks)+len(context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Tasks))

87			if candidate == nil || candidate.State == task.Done {
88				return
89			}
90			if _, exists := seen[candidate.ID]; exists {
91				return
92			}
93			seen[candidate.ID] = struct{}{}
94			active = append(active, candidate)
95			sessionCount[candidate.ID] = sessions
96		}
97		for _, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
98			for _, candidate := range checkout.Tasks {
99				add(candidate, len(checkout.Sessions))
100			}
101		}
102		for _, candidate := range context.OtherTasks {
103			add(candidate, 0)
104		}
105		if len(active) == 0 {
106			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
107		}
108		var reasons []assessment.Reason
109		hasIndeterminate := false
110		for _, candidate := range active {
111			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
112				hasIndeterminate = true
113				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
114					Code: "task-record-invalid", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task record is invalid",
115					Remediation: "repair or recreate the task record",

117				continue
118			}
119			if hostname != "" && candidate.Owner != "" && candidate.Owner != hostname {
120				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
121					Code: "task-owned-elsewhere", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task is owned by another machine",
122					Remediation: "complete an explicit ownership handoff before writing",
123				})
124			}
125			if candidate.State == task.Hot {
126				if context.RuntimeErr != nil {
127					hasIndeterminate = true
128					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{

130						Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",

142		}

144			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
145		}
146		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
147	}
148
149	func assessWorktrees(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
150		if context.WorktreeErr != nil {
151			return indeterminate("worktree-inventory-unavailable", "worktrees", "linked worktrees could not be enumerated", "repair Git worktree metadata and rerun context")
152		}
153		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
154			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "worktree scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
155		}
156		indices := []int{}
157		if selectedIndex > 0 {
158			indices = append(indices, selectedIndex)
159		} else {
160			for index := 1; index < len(context.Checkouts); index++ {
161				indices = append(indices, index)
162			}
163		}
164		if len(indices) == 0 {
165			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
166		}
167		var reasons []assessment.Reason
168		hasUnknown := context.RuntimeErr != nil
169		if hasUnknown {
170			reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
171				Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "worktrees",
172				Detail:      "worktree runtime coverage could not be collected",
173				Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
174			})
175		}
176		for _, index := range indices {
177			checkout := context.Checkouts[index]
178			subject := fmt.Sprintf("worktree:%d", index)
179			switch {
180			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
181				hasUnknown = true
182				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-path-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path could not be inspected", Remediation: "restore path access and rerun context"})
183			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
184				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-missing", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path is missing or prunable", Remediation: "repair or remove the stale worktree registration"})
185			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
186				hasUnknown = true
187				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-status-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "Git status could not be collected for the worktree", Remediation: "repair the worktree and rerun context"})
188			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
189				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-locked", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree is locked", Remediation: "verify the lock owner before unlocking it"})
190			case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
191				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-conflicted", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree has unmerged paths", Remediation: "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement"})
192			case checkout.Status.Dirty():
193				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-dirty", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree contains uncommitted changes", Remediation: "commit or deliberately preserve the changes"})
194			case len(checkout.Sessions) > 0:
195				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-runtime-live", Subject: subject, Detail: "a runtime session still covers the worktree", Remediation: "quiesce and close the runtime before retirement"})
196			}
197		}
198		if len(reasons) == 0 {
199			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
200		}
201		if hasKnownBlocker(reasons) {
202			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
203		}
204		if hasUnknown {
205			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
206		}
207		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
208	}
209
210	func blocked(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
211		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
212	}
213
214	func indeterminate(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
215		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
216	}
217
218	func hasReason(reasons []assessment.Reason, code string) bool {
219		for _, reason := range reasons {
220			if reason.Code == code {
221				return true
222			}
223		}
224		return false
225	}
226
227	func hasKnownBlocker(reasons []assessment.Reason) bool {
228		for _, reason := range reasons {
229			switch reason.Code {
230			case "worktree-missing", "worktree-locked", "worktree-conflicted", "worktree-dirty", "worktree-runtime-live":
231				return true
232			}
233		}
234		return false
235	}

1	package assessment

3	import "fmt"

5	// ReduceOutcomes combines independent requirements using the fail-closed
6	// precedence blocked > indeterminate > eligible > not-applicable. No evidence
7	// is itself indeterminate.
8	func ReduceOutcomes(outcomes ...Outcome) Outcome {
9		if len(outcomes) == 0 {
10			return OutcomeIndeterminate
11		}
12		result := OutcomeNotApplicable
13		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
14			switch outcome {
15			case OutcomeBlocked:
16				return OutcomeBlocked
17			case OutcomeIndeterminate:
18				result = OutcomeIndeterminate
19			case OutcomeEligible:
20				if result == OutcomeNotApplicable {
21					result = OutcomeEligible
22				}
23			case OutcomeNotApplicable:
24			default:
25				return OutcomeIndeterminate
26			}
27		}
28		return result
29	}
30
31	// Reduce applies source-quality policy after reducing requirement outcomes.
32	// Cheap reports retain the observed result for display. Deep reports downgrade
33	// any conclusive result to indeterminate unless every relied-on source is fresh,
34	// complete, and backed by a live authority.
35	func Reduce(profile Profile, sources []Source, outcomes ...Outcome) (Outcome, error) {
36		if err := profile.Validate(); err != nil {
37			return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
38		}
39		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
40			if err := outcome.Validate(); err != nil {
41				return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
42			}
43		}
44		for _, source := range sources {
45			if err := source.Validate(); err != nil {
46				return OutcomeIndeterminate, fmt.Errorf("reduce assessment source: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		result := ReduceOutcomes(outcomes...)
50		if result == OutcomeNotApplicable || result == OutcomeIndeterminate {
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		if len(sources) == 0 {
54			return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
55		}
56		if profile == ProfileDeep {
57			for _, source := range sources {
58				if !source.conclusive() {
59					return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
60				}
61			}
62		}
63		return result, nil
64	}

16	const maxWalkEntries = 200_000

18	var dependencyComponents = map[string]struct{}{
19		"node_modules": {}, ".venv": {}, "venv": {}, "vendor": {},
20		"__pycache__": {}, ".tox": {}, "target": {}, ".terraform": {},

24	// Expand resolves validated project and --file patterns locally into a sorted,
25	// duplicate-free list of exact slash paths. It never follows links or descends
26	// into Git metadata, nested repositories, submodules, or dependency trees.
27	func Expand(root string, patterns []Pattern, limits safefile.Limits) ([]string, error) {
28		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
29			return nil, err
30		}
31		if len(patterns) == 0 {
32			return nil, errors.New("no local-file patterns were configured or passed with --file")
33		}
34		for _, pattern := range patterns {
35			if err := projectconfig.ValidateLocalFilePattern(pattern.Value); err != nil {
36				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s: %w", patternSource(pattern), err)
37			}
38			for _, component := range strings.Split(pattern.Value, "/") {
39				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
40					return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s enters dependency directory %q", patternSource(pattern), component)
41				}
42			}
43		}
44		rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(root)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect source checkout: %w", err)
47		}
48		if !rootInfo.IsDir() || rootInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
49			return nil, errors.New("source checkout is not a held regular directory")
50		}
51
52		matches := map[string]struct{}{}
53		matchedPatterns := make([]bool, len(patterns))
54		visited := 0
55		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
56			if walkErr != nil {
57				return walkErr
58			}
59			if filename == root {
60				return nil
61			}
62			visited++
63			if visited > maxWalkEntries {
64				return fmt.Errorf("source checkout exceeds %d entries while expanding local-file patterns", maxWalkEntries)
65			}
66			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, filename)
67			if err != nil {
68				return err
69			}
70			slash := filepath.ToSlash(relative)
71			components := strings.Split(slash, "/")
72			base := strings.ToLower(components[len(components)-1])
73			if entry.IsDir() {
74				if base == ".git" {
75					return filepath.SkipDir
76				}
77				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[base]; blocked {
78					for _, pattern := range patterns {
79						if matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
80							return fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern enters dependency directory %q", slash)
81						}
82					}
83					return filepath.SkipDir
84				}
85				if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(filename, ".git")); err == nil {
86					return filepath.SkipDir
87				} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
88					return fmt.Errorf("inspect nested repository boundary %s: %w", slash, err)
89				}
90			}
91			matched := false
92			for index, pattern := range patterns {
93				if !entry.IsDir() && matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
94					matchedPatterns[index] = true
95					matched = true
96				}
97			}
98			if matched {
99				matches[slash] = struct{}{}
100			}
101			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 && entry.IsDir() {
102				return filepath.SkipDir
103			}
104			return nil
105		})
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, err
108		}
109		for index, matched := range matchedPatterns {
110			if !matched {
111				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s matched no source path", patternSource(patterns[index]))
112			}
113		}
114		paths := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
115		for path := range matches {
116			paths = append(paths, path)
117		}
118		sort.Strings(paths)
119		if len(paths) > limits.MaxFiles {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("patterns expanded to %d paths; maximum is %d", len(paths), limits.MaxFiles)
121		}
122		return paths, nil
123	}
124
125	func patternSource(pattern Pattern) string {
126		if strings.TrimSpace(pattern.Source) == "" {
127			return "explicit input"
128		}
129		return pattern.Source
130	}
131
132	func matchPattern(pattern, candidate string) bool {
133		patternParts := strings.Split(pattern, "/")
134		candidateParts := strings.Split(candidate, "/")
135		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
136		memo := map[key]bool{}
137		seen := map[key]bool{}
138		var match func(int, int) bool
139		match = func(patternIndex, candidateIndex int) bool {
140			state := key{patternIndex, candidateIndex}
141			if seen[state] {
142				return memo[state]
143			}
144			seen[state] = true
145			var result bool
146			switch {
147			case patternIndex == len(patternParts):
148				result = candidateIndex == len(candidateParts)
149			case patternParts[patternIndex] == "**":
150				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex) ||
151					candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && match(patternIndex, candidateIndex+1)
152			case candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && matchComponent(patternParts[patternIndex], candidateParts[candidateIndex]):
153				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex+1)
154			}
155			memo[state] = result
156			return result
157		}
158		return match(0, 0)
159	}
160
161	func matchComponent(pattern, candidate string) bool {
162		p, c := []rune(pattern), []rune(candidate)
163		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
164		memo := map[key]bool{}
165		seen := map[key]bool{}
166		var match func(int, int) bool
167		match = func(pi, ci int) bool {
168			state := key{pi, ci}
169			if seen[state] {
170				return memo[state]
171			}
172			seen[state] = true
173			var result bool
174			switch {
175			case pi == len(p):
176				result = ci == len(c)
177			case p[pi] == '*':
178				result = match(pi+1, ci) || ci < len(c) && match(pi, ci+1)
179			case ci < len(c) && (p[pi] == '?' || p[pi] == c[ci]):
180				result = match(pi+1, ci+1)
181			}
182			memo[state] = result
183			return result
184		}
185		return match(0, 0)
186	}
187
188	func hasDependencyComponent(path string) bool {
189		for _, component := range strings.Split(path, "/") {
190			if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
191				return true
192			}
193		}
194		return false
195	}

1	package gitx
2
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"os"
6		"path/filepath"
7		"strings"
8	)
9
10	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
11	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
12	type Repo struct {
13		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
14		Root string
15		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory. A linked worktree has
16		// its own entry below the shared common directory.
17		GitDir string
18		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
19		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
20		GitCommonDir string
21		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
22		Name string
23		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
24		// the main checkout.
25		IsLinkedWorktree bool
26		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
27		MainRoot string
28		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
29		Bare bool
30	}
31
32	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
33	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
34
35	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
36	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
37		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
38		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
39		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
40			"rev-parse",
41			"--path-format=absolute",
42			"--show-toplevel",
43			"--git-dir",
44			"--git-common-dir",
45			"--is-bare-repository",
46		)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Repo{}, err
49		}
50		f := lines(out)
51		r := Repo{}
52		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
53		switch len(f) {
54		case 4:
55			r.Root = f[0]
56			r.GitDir = f[1]
57			r.GitCommonDir = f[2]
58			r.Bare = f[3] == "true"
59		case 3:
60			r.GitDir = f[0]
61			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
62			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
63		default:
64			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
65		}
66
67		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
68		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
69		if r.Bare {
70			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
71		} else if r.GitDir == r.GitCommonDir {
72			// A normal checkout may use --separate-git-dir, so the common directory's
73			// parent is not necessarily the working-tree root.
74			r.MainRoot = r.Root
75		} else {
76			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
77		}
78		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.GitDir != r.GitCommonDir
79		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
80		if r.Bare {
81			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
82			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
83			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
84				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
85			}
86		}
87		return r, nil
88	}
89
90	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
91	// a full Discover.
92	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
93		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
94		return err == nil
95	}
96
97	// DefaultBranch resolves the repository's default branch — origin/HEAD when the
98	// remote advertises it, else the first of main/master that exists locally.
99	// Returns "" when nothing can be determined, which callers must treat as
100	// "ask the user" rather than guessing.
101	func DefaultBranch(ctx context.Context, dir string) string {
102		if out, err := run(ctx, dir, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"); err == nil {
103			if _, b, ok := strings.Cut(out, "/"); ok {
104				return b
105			}
106		}
107		for _, cand := range []string{"main", "master", "trunk", "develop"} {
108			if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+cand); err == nil {
109				return cand
110			}
111		}
112		return ""
113	}
114
115	// Remote returns the push URL of the named remote ("origin" when empty).
116	func Remote(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) string {
117		if name == "" {
118			name = "origin"
119		}
120		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "remote", "get-url", name)
121		if err != nil {
122			return ""
123		}
124		return out
125	}
126
127	// RemoteFromConfig reads one remote URL directly from a Git common directory.
128	// It is the zero-process path used by whole-machine inventory, where spawning
129	// `git remote get-url` once per repo dominated startup. Includes and URL
130	// rewriting are deliberately not evaluated; callers that need Git's complete
131	// semantics should use Remote instead.
132	func RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, name string) string {
133		if commonDir == "" {
134			return ""
135		}
136		if name == "" {
137			name = "origin"
138		}
139		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(commonDir, "config"))
140		if err != nil {
141			return ""
142		}
143		want := `remote "` + name + `"`
144		section := ""
145		for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
146			line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
147			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || strings.HasPrefix(line, ";") {
148				continue
149			}
150			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.HasSuffix(line, "]") {
151				section = strings.TrimSpace(line[1 : len(line)-1])
152				continue
153			}
154			if section != want {
155				continue
156			}
157			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
158			if ok && strings.TrimSpace(key) == "url" {
159				return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), `"`)
160			}
161		}
162		return ""
163	}
164

2
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"fmt"
6		"sort"

8
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
10		devconfig "github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
11		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/repo"
13	)
14
15	type SyncRequest struct {
16		RemoteIdentity string `json:"remote_identity"`
17		Branch         string `json:"branch"`
18		ExpectedOID    string `json:"expected_oid"`
19	}
20
21	type SyncState string
22
23	const (
24		SyncUpdated      SyncState = "updated"
25		SyncCurrent      SyncState = "already-current"
26		SyncFetched      SyncState = "fetched-only"
27		SyncAbsent       SyncState = "absent"
28		SyncNoDev        SyncState = "no-dev"
29		SyncUnreachable  SyncState = "unreachable"
30		SyncTimeout      SyncState = "timeout"
31		SyncDirty        SyncState = "blocked-dirty"
32		SyncAhead        SyncState = "blocked-ahead"
33		SyncDiverged     SyncState = "blocked-diverged"
34		SyncAmbiguous    SyncState = "ambiguous"
35		SyncIncompatible SyncState = "incompatible"
36		SyncFailed       SyncState = "failed"
37	)
38
39	type SyncResult struct {
40		Host        string    `json:"host"`
41		State       SyncState `json:"state"`
42		Repo        string    `json:"repo,omitempty"`
43		Path        string    `json:"path,omitempty"`
44		Branch      string    `json:"branch,omitempty"`
45		Remote      string    `json:"remote,omitempty"`
46		BeforeOID   string    `json:"before_oid,omitempty"`
47		AfterOID    string    `json:"after_oid,omitempty"`
48		ExpectedOID string    `json:"expected_oid,omitempty"`
49		Error       string    `json:"error,omitempty"`
50	}
51
52	func (r SyncResult) Ignored() bool { return r.State == SyncAbsent || r.State == SyncNoDev }
53
54	func (r SyncResult) Success() bool {
55		switch r.State {
56		case SyncUpdated, SyncCurrent, SyncFetched, SyncAbsent, SyncNoDev:
57			return true
58		default:
59			return false
60		}
61	}
62
63	type syncCandidate struct {
64		repository repo.Repo
65		remote     string
66	}
67
68	func ApplySync(ctx context.Context, cfg devconfig.Config, request SyncRequest) SyncResult {
69		result := SyncResult{Host: devconfig.Hostname(), Branch: request.Branch, ExpectedOID: request.ExpectedOID}
70		request.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(request.RemoteIdentity)
71		if request.RemoteIdentity == "" || request.Branch == "" || request.ExpectedOID == "" {
72			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, "sync request requires remote identity, branch and expected OID"
73			return result
74		}
75		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
76		if err != nil {
77			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
78			return result
79		}
80		var candidates []syncCandidate
81		for _, repository := range repositories {
82			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
83				continue
84			}
85			topology, topologyErr := gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
86			if topologyErr != nil {
87				continue
88			}
89			if remote := matchingRemoteAt(ctx, repository.Path, topology, request.RemoteIdentity); remote != "" {
90				candidates = append(candidates, syncCandidate{repository: repository, remote: remote})
91			}
92		}
93		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].repository.Path < candidates[j].repository.Path })
94		switch len(candidates) {
95		case 0:
96			result.State = SyncAbsent
97			return result
98		case 1:
99		default:
100			result.State = SyncAmbiguous
101			paths := make([]string, len(candidates))
102			for index, candidate := range candidates {
103				paths[index] = candidate.repository.Path
104			}
105			result.Error = "remote identity matches multiple clones: " + strings.Join(paths, ", ")
106			return result
107		}
108		candidate := candidates[0]
109		result.Repo, result.Path, result.Remote = candidate.repository.Display(), candidate.repository.Path, candidate.remote
110		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "fetch", "--prune", "--quiet", candidate.remote); err != nil {
111			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
112			return result
113		}
114		remoteRef := candidate.remote + "/" + request.Branch
115		remoteOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", remoteRef+"^{commit}")
116		if err != nil {
117			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, fmt.Sprintf("remote branch %s is unavailable after fetch: %v", remoteRef, err)
118			return result
119		}
120		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", request.ExpectedOID, remoteOID); err != nil {
121			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, "fetched remote branch does not contain the source commit"
122			return result
123		}
124		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, request.Branch)
125		if err != nil {
126			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
127			return result
128		}
129		if !checkedOut {
130			result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncFetched, remoteOID
131			return result
132		}
133		result.Path = worktree.Path
134		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
135		if err != nil {
136			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
137			return result
138		}
139		if status.Dirty() || status.Conflicted > 0 {
140			result.State, result.Error = SyncDirty, status.Summary()
141			return result
142		}
143		localOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
144		if err != nil {
145			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
146			return result
147		}
148		result.BeforeOID = localOID
149		if localOID == remoteOID {
150			result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncCurrent, localOID
151			return result
152		}
153		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", localOID, remoteOID); err != nil {
154			if _, aheadErr := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", remoteOID, localOID); aheadErr == nil {
155				result.State, result.Error = SyncAhead, "checked-out branch contains commits not on the fetched remote"
156			} else {
157				result.State, result.Error = SyncDiverged, "checked-out branch diverged; rebase or merge manually"
158			}
159			return result
160		}
161		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge", "--ff-only", remoteRef); err != nil {
162			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
163			return result
164		}
165		after, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
166		if err != nil || after != remoteOID {
167			result.State = SyncFailed
168			result.Error = "fast-forward completed without reaching the fetched remote revision"
169			return result
170		}
171		result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncUpdated, after
172		return result
173	}
174
175	func matchingRemote(topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) string {
176		var names []string
177		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
178			matched := false
179			for _, raw := range append(append([]string{}, remote.FetchURLs...), remote.PushURLs...) {
180				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == identity {
181					matched = true
182					break
183				}
184			}
185			if matched {
186				names = append(names, remote.Name)
187			}
188		}
189		sort.Strings(names)
190		if len(names) == 0 {
191			return ""
192		}
193		return names[0]
194	}
195
196	func matchingRemoteAt(ctx context.Context, path string, topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) string {
197		var names []string
198		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
199			matched := false
200			for _, key := range []string{"remote." + remote.Name + ".url", "remote." + remote.Name + ".pushurl"} {
201				raw, err := gitx.Run(ctx, path, "config", "--get-all", key)
202				if err != nil {
203					continue
204				}
205				for _, value := range strings.Split(raw, "\n") {
206					if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(value) == identity {
207						matched = true
208						break
209					}
210				}
211				if matched {
212					break
213				}
214			}
215			if matched {
216				names = append(names, remote.Name)
217			}
218		}
219		if len(names) == 0 {
220			return matchingRemote(topology, identity)
221		}
222		sort.Strings(names)
223		return names[0]
224	}

97	// CheckoutIndexForPath returns the most-specific checkout containing path. It
98	// uses the same symlink-aware matching as runtime assignment, so a current
99	// directory under a nested linked worktree never resolves to the canonical
100	// checkout merely because that checkout is its lexical parent.
101	func (c RepoContext) CheckoutIndexForPath(path string) (int, bool) {
102		best, bestLen := -1, -1
103		for index := range c.Checkouts {
104			for _, root := range checkoutRoots(c.Repo, index, c.Checkouts[index]) {
105				if pathContains(root, path) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
106					best, bestLen = index, len(filepath.Clean(root))
107				}
108			}
109		}
110		return best, best >= 0
111	}

113	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout

115	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
116		seen := map[string]bool{}
117		var out []runtime.Session
118		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {

120				key := session.Handle

123				}
124				if seen[key] {
125					continue
126				}
127				seen[key] = true

134	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository.
135	// Repositories with no linked-worktree admin entries deliberately skip
136	// `git worktree list`; this keeps the common whole-machine inventory path fast.
137	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
138		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
139
140		out := RepoContext{Repo: r, Runtime: runtimeName}
141		mainExists, mainPathErr := pathIsDir(r.Path)
142		main := RepoCheckout{
143			Worktree: gitx.Worktree{Path: r.Path, Main: true},
144			Exists:   mainExists, PathErr: mainPathErr, Ownership: CheckoutCanonical,
145		}
146		if r.Bare {
147			main.Worktree.Bare = true
148		} else {
149			main.Status, main.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
150			main.Worktree.Branch = main.Status.Branch
151			main.Worktree.Detached = main.Status.Detached
152			main.LastActivity, main.LastCommit, main.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, r.Path, main.Status)
153		}
154		out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, main)
155
156		out.WorktreeCount, out.WorktreeErr = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
157		if out.WorktreeErr == nil && out.WorktreeCount > 0 {
158			worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
159			if err != nil {
160				out.WorktreeErr = err
161			} else {
162				out.WorktreeCount = 0
163				for _, w := range worktrees {
164					if w.Main {
165						continue
166					}
167					exists, pathErr := pathIsDir(w.Path)
168					checkout := RepoCheckout{
169						Worktree: w, Exists: exists, PathErr: pathErr, Ownership: CheckoutExternal,
170					}
171					if checkout.Exists && checkout.PathErr == nil && !w.Prunable {
172						checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, w.Path)
173						checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, w.Path, checkout.Status)
174					}
175					if IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
176						checkout.Ownership = CheckoutEphemeral
177					}
178					out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
179					out.WorktreeCount++
180				}
181			}
182		}
183
184		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
185		assignSessions(&out, sessions)
186		for _, checkout := range out.Checkouts {
187			if checkout.LastActivity.After(out.LastActivity) {
188				out.LastActivity = checkout.LastActivity
189			}
190			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
191				if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
192					out.LastActivity = t.Updated
193				}
194			}
195		}
196		for _, t := range out.OtherTasks {
197			if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
198				out.LastActivity = t.Updated
199			}
200		}
201		return out
202	}

247	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
248		latest := status.LatestChange
249		var commit time.Time
250		var subject string
251		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
252			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
253			if commit.After(latest) {
254				latest = commit
255			}
256			subject = lastSubject
257		}
258		return latest, commit, subject
259	}

261	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
262		for _, t := range tasks {
263			assigned := false
264			if t.WorktreePath != "" {
265				for i := 1; i < len(out.Checkouts); i++ {
266					if samePath(t.WorktreePath, out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path) {
267						out.Checkouts[i].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, t)
268						out.Checkouts[i].Ownership = CheckoutDev
269						assigned = true
270						break
271					}
272				}
273			} else if len(out.Checkouts) > 0 && t.Branch == out.Checkouts[0].Branch() {
274				out.Checkouts[0].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[0].Tasks, t)
275				assigned = true
276			}
277			if !assigned {
278				out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, t)
279			}
280		}
281		for i := range out.Checkouts {
282			sort.SliceStable(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
283				return out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[a].ID < out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[b].ID
284			})
285		}
286		sort.SliceStable(out.OtherTasks, func(i, j int) bool {
287			return out.OtherTasks[i].ID < out.OtherTasks[j].ID
288		})
289	}

291	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
292	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
293	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
294	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
295		for _, session := range sessions {
296			assigned := map[int]bool{}
297			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
298				best, bestLen := -1, -1
299				for i := range out.Checkouts {
300					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Repo, i, out.Checkouts[i]) {
301						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
302							best, bestLen = i, len(filepath.Clean(root))
303						}
304					}
305				}
306				if best >= 0 {
307					assigned[best] = true
308				}
309			}
310			for i := range assigned {
311				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
312			}
313		}
314	}

316	func checkoutRoots(r repo.Repo, index int, checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
317		roots := []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
318		if index == 0 && r.RealPath != "" && !samePath(r.RealPath, r.Path) {
319			roots = append(roots, r.RealPath)
320		}
321		return roots
322	}

324	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
325		if root == "" || path == "" {
326			return false
327		}
328		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
329		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
330			return false
331		}
332		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
333	}
334
335	func samePath(a, b string) bool {
336		return a != "" && b != "" && normalizePath(a) == normalizePath(b)
337	}
338
339	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
340	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
341	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
342	// is not sufficient.
343	func normalizePath(path string) string {
344		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
345		cur := clean
346		for {
347			if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
348				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
349				if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
350					return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
351				}
352				return filepath.Clean(real)
353			}
354			parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
355			if parent == cur {
356				return clean
357			}
358			cur = parent
359		}
360	}

403	func writeCheckoutMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, c RepoContext, checkout RepoCheckout, canonical bool) {
404		label := string(checkout.Ownership)
405		if canonical {
406			label = "canonical"
407		}
408		fmt.Fprintf(b, "### %s — %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout), label)
409		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Path: `%s`\n", checkout.Worktree.Path)
410		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Branch: `%s`\n", displayBranch(checkout))
411		if checkout.Worktree.Bare {
412			b.WriteString("- Git: bare repository\n")
413		} else if checkout.PathErr != nil {
414			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.PathErr)
415		} else if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
416			b.WriteString("- Git: unavailable (checkout path is missing)\n")
417		} else if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
418			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.StatusErr)
419		} else {
420			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: %s", checkout.Status.Summary())
421			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
422				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", checkout.Status.Breakdown())
423			}
424			b.WriteString("\n")
425			if checkout.Status.Upstream != "" {
426				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Upstream: `%s`\n", checkout.Status.Upstream)
427			} else {
428				b.WriteString("- Upstream: not published\n")
429			}
430		}
431		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
432			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)
433			if reason == "" {
434				reason = "no reason recorded"
435			}
436			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: locked — %s\n", reason)
437		}
438		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || checkout.PathErr == nil && !checkout.Exists {
439			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)
440			if reason == "" {
441				reason = "checkout path is missing"
442			}
443			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: prunable — %s\n", reason)
444		}
445		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
446			if c.RuntimeErr != nil {
447				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: unavailable (%s)\n", c.RuntimeErr)
448			} else {
449				b.WriteString("- Runtime: closed\n")
450			}
451		} else {
452			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
453				status := session.AgentStatus
454				if status == "" {
455					status = "unknown"
456				}
457				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: `%s %s` (%s)\n", c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
458				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
459					fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Agent sessions: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
460				}
461			}
462		}
463		if len(checkout.Tasks) == 0 {
464			if c.TaskErr != nil {
465				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: unavailable (%s)\n", c.TaskErr)
466			} else {
467				b.WriteString("- Task: untracked\n")
468			}
469		} else {
470			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
471				writeTaskMarkdown(b, t)
472			}
473		}
474	}

505	// FormatSessions renders the ys payload. checkoutIndex < 0 selects the whole
506	// repository; otherwise it selects one checkout.
507	func FormatSessions(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
508		indices := make([]int, 0, len(c.Checkouts))
509		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
510			indices = append(indices, checkoutIndex)
511		} else {
512			for i := range c.Checkouts {
513				indices = append(indices, i)
514			}
515		}
516		var b strings.Builder
517		for _, i := range indices {
518			checkout := c.Checkouts[i]
519			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
520				status := session.AgentStatus
521				if status == "" {
522					status = "unknown"
523				}
524				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s %s` (%s)\n",
525					checkout.Worktree.Path, c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
526				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
527					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - agents: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
528				}
529			}
530		}
531		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
532	}
533
534	// LinkedWorktreePaths returns the yw payload: absolute linked-worktree paths,
535	// one per line. The canonical checkout is intentionally excluded because WT
536	// counts linked worktrees only.
537	func LinkedWorktreePaths(c RepoContext) string {
538		paths := make([]string, 0, len(c.Linked()))
539		for _, checkout := range c.Linked() {
540			paths = append(paths, checkout.Worktree.Path)
541		}
542		return strings.Join(paths, "\n")
543	}

26	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
27		if s == nil {
28			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
29		}
30		if s.platform() == "windows" {
31			return ApplyResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
32		}
33		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
34		if err != nil {
35			return ApplyResponse{}, err
36		}
37		// This check intentionally precedes envelope validation. The hidden command
38		// performs the same capability check before reading stdin at all.
39		if id != envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine {
40			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
41		}
42		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
43			return ApplyResponse{}, err
44		}
45		authority := s.Authority
46		if authority == nil {
47			authority = lease.New("")
48		}
49		key := lease.BranchKey(envelope.Request.Binding.RemoteIdentity, envelope.Request.Binding.Branch)
50		var response ApplyResponse
51		err = authority.WithMutation(ctx, []lease.Key{key}, func() error {
52			var applyErr error
53			response, applyErr = s.applyUnderLease(ctx, envelope)
54			return applyErr
55		})
56		return response, err

230	func (s *Service) validateNegotiatedLimits(request PlanRequest) error {
231		host := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
232		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(host, request.Limits)
233		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
234			return errors.New("apply limits do not match target policy")
235		}

239	func preflightApply(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope) ([]preflightFile, error) {
240		payloads := map[string][]byte{}
241		for _, payload := range envelope.Payloads {
242			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
243			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
244				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode canonical payload for %q", payload.Path)
245			}
246			payloads[payload.Path] = decoded
247		}
248		files := make([]preflightFile, len(envelope.Request.Files))
249		for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
250			planned := envelope.Plan.Files[index]
251			if planned.Action == "" {
252				return nil, ErrPlanBlocked
253			}
254			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
255				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
256			}
257			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
258			if err != nil {
259				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
260			}
261			file := preflightFile{spec: spec, planned: planned, before: observed}
262			switch planned.Action {
263			case actionCurrent:
264				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
265					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q is no longer current: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
266				}
267				file.content = observed.data
268			case actionCreate:
269				if observed.exists {
270					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q appeared after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
271				}
272				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
273			case actionReplace:
274				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != planned.TargetSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
275					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed before replacement: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
276				}
277				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
278			default:
279				return nil, errors.New("invalid local-files target action")
280			}
281			if int64(len(file.content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(file.content) != spec.SHA256 {
282				return nil, fmt.Errorf("content for %q no longer matches the plan", spec.Path)
283			}
284			files[index] = file
285		}
286		return files, nil
287	}

289	func (s *Service) failAndRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal, cause error) error {
290		value.Phase = phaseReconcile
291		_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
292		if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, value); err != nil {
293			value.Phase = phaseReconcile
294			_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
295			return errors.New("local-files apply failed and requires reconciliation")
296		}
297		value.Phase = phaseRolledBack
298		for index := range value.Files {
299			if value.Files[index].Action != actionCurrent {
300				value.Files[index].State = StateRolledBack
301				value.Files[index].Published = false
302			}
303		}
304		if err := store.writeJournal(*value); err != nil {
305			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but journal finalization failed")
306		}
307		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
308			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
309		}
310		return fmt.Errorf("local-files apply failed and was rolled back: %w", cause)
311	}

313	func (s *Service) rollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal) error {
314		for index := len(value.Files) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
315			entry := &value.Files[index]
316			if entry.Action == actionCurrent {
317				continue
318			}
319			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
320			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
321				return err
322			}
323			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
324			if err != nil {
325				return err
326			}
327			switch entry.Action {
328			case actionCreate:
329				if !observed.exists {
330					continue
331				}
332				if observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
333					return errors.New("created target changed before rollback")
334				}
335				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
336				if err != nil {
337					return err
338				}
339				err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(spec.Path))
340				err = errors.Join(err, syncHeldRoot(parent.parent), parent.close())
341				if err != nil {
342					return err
343				}
344			case actionReplace:
345				if observed.exists && observed.digest == entry.OldSHA256 {
346					continue
347				}
348				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
349					return errors.New("replacement target changed before rollback")
350				}
351				oldContent, err := store.readBlob(index, true, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
352				if err != nil || digestBytes(oldContent) != entry.OldSHA256 {
353					return errors.New("replacement rollback blob is unavailable")
354				}
355				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
356				if err != nil {
357					return err
358				}
359				current, err := parent.parent.Lstat(pathBase(spec.Path))
360				oldMode, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(entry.OldMode, 8, 12)
361				err = errors.Join(err, modeErr)
362				if err == nil {
363					_, err = safefile.AtomicReplace(ctx, parent.parent, pathBase(spec.Path), current, oldContent, fs.FileMode(oldMode))
364				}
365				err = errors.Join(err, parent.close())
366				if err != nil {
367					return err
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		// Empty parent directories are intentionally retained. A path alone cannot
372		// prove that a directory still has the identity created by this operation;
373		// deleting it after a crash could remove another process's replacement.
374		return verifyRollback(ctx, checkout.root, envelope, *value)
375	}
376
377	func verifyRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope, value journal) error {
378		for index, entry := range value.Files {
379			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
380			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
381			if err != nil {
382				return err
383			}
384			switch entry.Action {
385			case actionCurrent:
386				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != envelope.Plan.Files[index].TargetMode {
387					return errors.New("current target changed during rollback")
388				}
389			case actionCreate:
390				if observed.exists {
391					return errors.New("created target remains after rollback")
392				}
393			case actionReplace:
394				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != entry.OldSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != entry.OldMode {
395					return errors.New("replacement target was not restored")
396				}
397			}
398		}
399		return nil
400	}

402	func (s *Service) verifyCompleted(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value journal) (ApplyResponse, error) {
403		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
404			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files journal no longer matches the checkout")
405		}
406		if value.RetainForEvict {
407			for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
408				content, err := store.readBlob(index, false, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
409				if err != nil || int64(len(content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(content) != spec.SHA256 {
410					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("retained local-files recovery blob is unavailable")
411				}
412			}
413		} else if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
414			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
415		}
416		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
417	}

419	func verifyAllCurrent(ctx context.Context, checkout string, specs []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
420		for _, spec := range specs {
421			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
422				return err
423			}
424			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, limits, true)
425			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size {
426				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q failed post-write verification", spec.Path)
427			}
428			if fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != spec.Mode {
429				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q permissions do not match the manifest", spec.Path)
430			}
431		}
432		return nil
433	}
434
435	func responseFromJournal(value journal) ApplyResponse {
436		files := make([]PublicFile, len(value.Files))
437		for index, entry := range value.Files {
438			files[index] = PublicFile{Path: entry.Path, Size: entry.Size, Mode: entry.Mode, State: entry.State}
439		}
440		return ApplyResponse{
441			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
442			RequestID: value.RequestID, PlanDigest: value.PlanDigest, Files: files,
443		}
444	}

446	func (s *Service) fault(point, path string) error {

448			return nil
449		}
450		return s.Fault(point, path)

468	func openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath string, create bool) (*heldParent, error) {
469		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
470			return nil, err
471		}
472		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		held := &heldParent{checkout: checkout, rootInfo: rootInfo, root: root, parent: root, roots: []*os.Root{root}}
477		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
478		prefix := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1)
479		for _, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
480			prefix = append(prefix, component)
481			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
482			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
483				if err := held.parent.Mkdir(component, 0o700); err != nil {
484					_ = held.close()
485					return nil, err
486				}
487				child, info, err = safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
488			}
489			if err != nil {
490				_ = held.close()
491				return nil, err
492			}
493			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
494				_ = child.Close()
495				_ = held.close()
496				return nil, ErrUnsafe
497			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
498				_ = child.Close()
499				_ = held.close()
500				return nil, err
501			}
502			held.edges = append(held.edges, heldEdge{parent: held.parent, name: component, info: info})
503			held.roots = append(held.roots, child)
504			held.parent = child
505		}
506		return held, nil
507	}
508
509	func (h *heldParent) close() error {
510		if h == nil {
511			return nil
512		}
513		var result error
514		for index := len(h.edges) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
515			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(h.edges[index].parent, h.edges[index].name, h.edges[index].info))
516		}
517		result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyRoot(h.checkout, h.rootInfo))
518		for index := len(h.roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
519			result = errors.Join(result, h.roots[index].Close())
520		}
521		h.roots = nil
522		return result
523	}
524
525	func syncHeldRoot(root *os.Root) error {
526		file, err := root.Open(".")
527		if err != nil {
528			return err
529		}
530		defer file.Close()
531		return file.Sync()
532	}
533
534	func pathBase(slashPath string) string {
535		parts := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
536		return parts[len(parts)-1]
537	}

126	func (s *operationStore) discardUninitialized(expected fs.FileInfo) error {
127		walkErr := filepath.WalkDir(s.operation, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
128			if walkErr != nil {
129				return walkErr
130			}
131			if path == s.operation {
132				return nil
133			}
134			relative, err := filepath.Rel(s.operation, path)
135			if err != nil {
136				return err
137			}
138			relative = filepath.ToSlash(relative)
139			info, err := entry.Info()
140			if err != nil {
141				return err
142			}
143			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
144				return errors.New("unjournaled local-files store contains an unsafe entry")
145			}
146			parts := strings.Split(relative, "/")
147			switch {
148			case len(parts) == 1 && parts[0] == "manifest.json" && info.Mode().IsRegular():
149				return nil
150			case len(parts) == 1 && (parts[0] == "blobs" || parts[0] == "rollback") && info.IsDir():
151				return nil
152			case len(parts) == 1 && strings.HasPrefix(parts[0], ".dev-safefile-") && info.Mode().IsRegular():
153				return nil
154			case len(parts) == 2 && (parts[0] == "blobs" || parts[0] == "rollback") && info.Mode().IsRegular():
155				if isOperationBlobName(parts[1]) || strings.HasPrefix(parts[1], ".dev-safefile-") {
156					return nil
157				}
158			}
159			return errors.New("unjournaled local-files store contains an unknown entry")
160		})
161		if walkErr != nil {
162			return fmt.Errorf("inspect unjournaled local-files store: %w", walkErr)
163		}
164		current, err := os.Lstat(s.operation)

167		}

212	func validateJournal(value journal) error {
213		if value.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || value.RequestID == "" || !validDigest(value.PlanDigest) || !validDigest(value.ManifestDigest) {
214			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal binding")
215		}
216		switch value.Phase {
217		case phaseStaged, phaseApplying, phaseCompleted, phaseRolledBack, phaseReconcile:
218		default:
219			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal phase")
220		}
221		for index, file := range value.Files {
222			if index > 0 && value.Files[index-1].Path >= file.Path {
223				return errors.New("local-files journal paths are not sorted")
224			}
225			switch file.Action {
226			case actionCurrent, actionCreate, actionReplace:
227			default:
228				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid action")
229			}
230			if !file.State.validResult() {
231				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid result state")
232			}
233			if file.Size < 0 || file.Mode != "0600" && file.Mode != "0700" {
234				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid public metadata")
235			}
236			if file.Action == actionReplace && (!validDigest(file.OldSHA256) || !validFileMode(file.OldMode)) {
237				return errors.New("local-files replacement journal lacks rollback binding")
238			}
239		}
240		return nil
241	}
