```text
627	func buildApplyTree(snapshot Snapshot) (*applyNode, error) {
628		root := &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
629		add := func(path string) *applyNode {
630			current := root
631			for _, component := range strings.Split(path, "/") {
632				if current.children[component] == nil {
633					current.children[component] = &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
634				}
635				current = current.children[component]
636			}
637			return current
638		}
639		for index := range snapshot.Directories {
640			directory := &snapshot.Directories[index]
641			add(directory.Path).directory = directory
642		}
643		for index := range snapshot.Files {
644			file := &snapshot.Files[index]
645			add(file.Path).file = file
646		}
647		return root, nil
648	}
649
650	func applyTree(root *os.Root, node *applyNode, result *ApplyResult) error {
651		names := make([]string, 0, len(node.children))
652		for name := range node.children {
653			names = append(names, name)
654		}
655		sort.Strings(names)
656		for _, name := range names {
657			childNode := node.children[name]
658			if childNode.file != nil {
659				if err := writeRootFile(root, name, *childNode.file); err != nil {
660					return fmt.Errorf("create template file %q: %w", childNode.file.Path, err)
661				}
662				result.AppliedFiles++
663				continue
664			}
665			if err := root.Mkdir(name, 0o700); err != nil {
666				return fmt.Errorf("create template directory %q: %w", name, err)
667			}
668			child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
669			if err != nil {
670				return fmt.Errorf("open created template directory %q: %w", name, err)
671			}
672			walkErr := applyTree(child, childNode, result)
673			mode := fs.FileMode(0o755)
674			if childNode.directory != nil {
675				mode = childNode.directory.Mode.Perm()
676				result.AppliedDirectories++
677			}
678			chmodErr := chmodRootDirectory(child, mode)
679			verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
680			closeErr := child.Close()
681			if walkErr != nil {
682				return walkErr
683			}
684			if chmodErr != nil {
685				return fmt.Errorf("set template directory mode %q: %w", name, chmodErr)
686			}
687			if verifyErr != nil {
688				return verifyErr
689			}
690			if closeErr != nil {
691				return closeErr
692			}
693		}
694		return nil
695	}
696
697	func writeRootFile(root *os.Root, name string, file File) error {
698		_, err := safefile.CreateNoClobber(context.Background(), root, name, file.Data, file.Mode.Perm())
699		return err
700	}
701
702	func chmodRootDirectory(root *os.Root, mode fs.FileMode) error {
703		directory, err := root.Open(".")
704		if err != nil {
705			return err
706		}
707		defer directory.Close()
708		return directory.Chmod(mode.Perm())
709	}

711	func finalizeSnapshot(snapshot *Snapshot) error {
712		sort.SliceStable(snapshot.Files, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Files[i].Path < snapshot.Files[j].Path })
713		sort.SliceStable(snapshot.Directories, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Directories[i].Path < snapshot.Directories[j].Path })
714		return validateSnapshot(*snapshot)
715	}
716
717	func validateSnapshot(snapshot Snapshot) error {
718		paths := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Directories)+len(snapshot.Files))
719		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
720			paths = append(paths, directory.Path)
721		}
722		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
723			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
724		}
725		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
726			return fmt.Errorf("template paths: %w", err)
727		}
728
729		types := make(map[string]string, len(paths))
730		validate := func(relative, kind string, mode fs.FileMode) error {
731			cleaned, err := validateSnapshotPath(relative)
732			if err != nil || cleaned != relative {
733				if err == nil {
734					err = errors.New("path is not a clean relative path")
735				}
736				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q: %w", kind, relative, err)
737			}
738			if mode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
739				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q has unsupported mode %s", kind, relative, mode)
740			}
741			if previous, exists := types[relative]; exists {
742				return fmt.Errorf("template path %q is declared as both %s and %s", relative, previous, kind)
743			}
744			for parent := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(relative))); parent != "."; parent = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(parent))) {
745				if types[parent] == "file" {
746					return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q is below file %q", kind, relative, parent)
747				}
748			}
749			types[relative] = kind
750			return nil
751		}
752		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
753			if err := validate(directory.Path, "directory", directory.Mode); err != nil {
754				return err
755			}
756		}
757		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
758			if err := validate(file.Path, "file", file.Mode); err != nil {
759				return err
760			}
761			prefix := file.Path + "/"
762			for existing := range types {
763				if strings.HasPrefix(existing, prefix) {
764					return fmt.Errorf("template file %q is the parent of %q", file.Path, existing)
765				}
766			}
767		}
768		return nil
769	}
770
771	func cleanSubdir(value string) (string, error) {
772		if value == "" || value == "." {
773			return "", nil
774		}
775		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
776			return "", fmt.Errorf("template subdirectory %q: %w", value, err)
777		}
778		return value, nil
779	}
780
781	func validateSnapshotPath(value string) (string, error) {
782		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
783			return "", err
784		}
785		return value, nil
786	}
```

```text
146			parts := strings.Split(relative, "/")
147			switch {
148			case len(parts) == 1 && parts[0] == "manifest.json" && info.Mode().IsRegular():
149				return nil
150			case len(parts) == 1 && (parts[0] == "blobs" || parts[0] == "rollback") && info.IsDir():
151				return nil
152			case len(parts) == 1 && strings.HasPrefix(parts[0], ".dev-safefile-") && info.Mode().IsRegular():
153				return nil
154			case len(parts) == 2 && (parts[0] == "blobs" || parts[0] == "rollback") && info.Mode().IsRegular():
155				if isOperationBlobName(parts[1]) || strings.HasPrefix(parts[1], ".dev-safefile-") {
156					return nil
157				}
158			}
159			return errors.New("unjournaled local-files store contains an unknown entry")
160		})
161		if walkErr != nil {
162			return fmt.Errorf("inspect unjournaled local-files store: %w", walkErr)
163		}
164		current, err := os.Lstat(s.operation)
165		if err != nil || !os.SameFile(expected, current) || !current.IsDir() || current.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
166			return errors.New("unjournaled local-files store changed during inspection")
167		}
168		if err := os.RemoveAll(s.operation); err != nil {
169			return fmt.Errorf("remove unjournaled local-files store: %w", err)
170		}
171		return syncDirectoryPath(s.root)
172	}

178		for _, character := range value {
179			if character < '0' || character > '9' {
180				return false

182		}
183		return true

197	func (s *operationStore) loadJournal() (journal, error) {
198		data, err := readPrivateFile(s.journalPath(), 2<<20)
199		if err != nil {
200			return journal{}, err
201		}
202		var value journal
203		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(data, 2<<20, &value); err != nil {
204			return journal{}, fmt.Errorf("decode local-files journal: %w", err)
205		}
206		if err := validateJournal(value); err != nil {
207			return journal{}, err
208		}
209		return value, nil
210	}

212	func validateJournal(value journal) error {
213		if value.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || value.RequestID == "" || !validDigest(value.PlanDigest) || !validDigest(value.ManifestDigest) {
214			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal binding")
215		}
216		switch value.Phase {
217		case phaseStaged, phaseApplying, phaseCompleted, phaseRolledBack, phaseReconcile:
218		default:
219			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal phase")
220		}
221		for index, file := range value.Files {
222			if index > 0 && value.Files[index-1].Path >= file.Path {
223				return errors.New("local-files journal paths are not sorted")
224			}
225			switch file.Action {
226			case actionCurrent, actionCreate, actionReplace:
227			default:
228				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid action")
229			}
230			if !file.State.validResult() {
231				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid result state")
232			}
233			if file.Size < 0 || file.Mode != "0600" && file.Mode != "0700" {
234				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid public metadata")
235			}
236			if file.Action == actionReplace && (!validDigest(file.OldSHA256) || !validFileMode(file.OldMode)) {
237				return errors.New("local-files replacement journal lacks rollback binding")
238			}
239		}
240		return nil
241	}

243	func (s *operationStore) writeJournal(value journal) error {
244		if err := validateJournal(value); err != nil {
245			return err
246		}
247		return writePrivateJSON(s.journalPath(), value)

263	func (s *operationStore) writeBlob(filename string, content []byte, executable bool) error {
264		if existing, err := readPrivateFile(filename, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes); err == nil {
265			if digestBytes(existing) != digestBytes(content) {
266				return errors.New("existing local-files blob does not match operation")
267			}
268			return nil
269		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
270			return err
271		}
272		parentPath := filepath.Dir(filename)
273		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(parentPath)
274		if err != nil {
275			return err
276		}
277		defer root.Close()
278		name := filepath.Base(filename)
279		if _, err := safefile.CreatePrivateNoClobber(context.Background(), root, name, content, executable); err != nil {
280			return err
281		}
282		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(parentPath, rootInfo); err != nil {
283			return err
284		}
285		readback, err := readPrivateFile(filename, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
286		if err != nil || digestBytes(readback) != digestBytes(content) {
287			return errors.New("local-files blob failed post-write verification")
288		}
289		return nil
290	}

317	func syncDirectoryPath(path string) error {
318		directory, err := os.Open(path)
319		if err != nil {
320			return err
321		}
322		return errors.Join(directory.Sync(), directory.Close())

325	func ensurePrivateDirectory(path string) error {
326		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
327			return err
328		}
329		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
330		if err != nil {
331			return err
332		}
333		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
334			return errors.New("local-files state path is not a directory")
335		}
336		if err := os.Chmod(path, 0o700); err != nil {
337			return err
338		}
339		info, err = os.Lstat(path)
340		if err != nil || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
341			return errors.New("local-files state directory is not owner-private")
342		}
343		return nil
344	}

346	func writePrivateJSON(path string, value any) error {
347		parentPath := filepath.Dir(path)
348		if err := ensurePrivateDirectory(parentPath); err != nil {
349			return err
350		}
351		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
352		if err != nil {
353			return err
354		}
355		data = append(data, '\n')
356		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(parentPath)
357		if err != nil {
358			return err
359		}
360		defer root.Close()
361		name := filepath.Base(path)
362		current, statErr := root.Lstat(name)
363		switch {
364		case errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist):
365			_, err = safefile.CreatePrivateNoClobber(context.Background(), root, name, data, false)
366		case statErr != nil:
367			return statErr
368		case !current.Mode().IsRegular() || current.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || current.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0:
369			return errors.New("local-files state file is not a private regular file")
370		default:
371			_, err = safefile.AtomicReplacePrivate(context.Background(), root, name, current, data, false)
372		}
373		if err != nil {
374			return err
375		}
376		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(parentPath, rootInfo); err != nil {
377			return err
378		}
379		readback, err := readPrivateFile(path, 2<<20)
380		if err != nil || string(readback) != string(data) {
381			return errors.New("local-files state file failed post-write verification")
382		}
383		return nil
384	}

386	func readPrivateFile(path string, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
387		parentPath := filepath.Dir(path)
388		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(parentPath)
389		if err != nil {
390			return nil, err
391		}
392		defer root.Close()
393		name := filepath.Base(path)
394		info, err := root.Lstat(name)
395		if err != nil {
396			return nil, err
397		}
398		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
399			return nil, errors.New("local-files state file is not a private regular file")
400		}
401		data, _, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(context.Background(), root, name, info, maxBytes)
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, err
404		}
405		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(parentPath, rootInfo); err != nil {
406			return nil, err
407		}
408		return data, nil
409	}
```

```text
186	// CanonicalKeys validates, deduplicates, and sorts keys in the one order used
187	// by every multi-key acquisition.
188	func CanonicalKeys(keys []Key) ([]Key, error) {
189		if len(keys) == 0 {
190			return nil, errors.New("operation lease requires at least one key")
191		}
192		unique := make(map[string]Key, len(keys))
193		for _, key := range keys {
194			if err := key.Validate(); err != nil {
195				return nil, err
196			}
197			unique[key.canonical()] = key
198		}
199		canonical := make([]Key, 0, len(unique))
200		for _, key := range unique {
201			canonical = append(canonical, key)
202		}
203		sort.Slice(canonical, func(i, j int) bool { return canonical[i].canonical() < canonical[j].canonical() })
204		return canonical, nil
205	}

213		}
214		for _, char := range value {
215			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
216				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
217			}
218		}
219		return nil
220	}
```

```text
12	const unsafeRemoteLabel = "<unsafe remote>"

14	// RedactRemoteRef returns a terminal-safe remote reference for public display.
15	// URL userinfo, query, and fragment components are removed structurally. SSH
16	// usernames such as git@host remain visible, while an scp-like prefix containing
17	// a password/token separator is redacted. Invalid UTF-8, controls, malformed
18	// explicit URLs, and encoded path controls are replaced by a fixed label.
19	func RedactRemoteRef(ref string) string {
20		if !utf8.ValidString(ref) || strings.IndexFunc(ref, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
21			return unsafeRemoteLabel
22		}
23		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
24		if ref == "" {
25			return ""
26		}
27		parsed, err := url.Parse(ref)
28		explicitURL := strings.Contains(ref, "://")
29		if explicitURL && (err != nil || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" && !strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file")) {
30			return unsafeRemoteLabel
31		}
32		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && (explicitURL || parsed.Host != "" || strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file")) {
33			path, unescapeErr := url.PathUnescape(parsed.EscapedPath())
34			if unescapeErr != nil || !utf8.ValidString(path) || strings.IndexFunc(path, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
35				return unsafeRemoteLabel
36			}
37			parsed.User = nil
38			parsed.RawQuery = ""
39			parsed.ForceQuery = false
40			parsed.Fragment = ""
41			parsed.RawFragment = ""
42			redacted := parsed.String()
43			if !utf8.ValidString(redacted) || strings.IndexFunc(redacted, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
44				return unsafeRemoteLabel
45			}
46			return redacted
47		}
48		if err != nil && strings.Contains(ref, "://") {
49			return unsafeRemoteLabel
50		}
51
52		at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@')
53		if at > 0 && strings.Contains(ref[:at], ":") {
54			return "***@" + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[at+1:])
55		}
56		if at > 0 {
57			colon := strings.IndexByte(ref[at+1:], ':')
58			if colon >= 0 {
59				colon += at + 1
60				return ref[:colon+1] + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[colon+1:])
61			}
62		}
63		if colon := strings.IndexByte(ref, ':'); colon > 0 && !strings.ContainsAny(ref[:colon], `/\\`) && !isDrivePrefix(ref[:colon+1]) {
64			return ref[:colon+1] + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[colon+1:])
65		}
66		return ref
67	}

104			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(ref)
105			if trimmed != "" && trimmed != ref {
106				message = strings.ReplaceAll(message, trimmed, RedactCloneRef(trimmed))

109		return errors.New(message)
```

```text
 func tasksForRepo(tasks []*task.Task, r repo.Repo) []*task.Task {
    var out []*task.Task
    for _, t := range tasks {
        if sameCleanPath(t.RepoPath, r.Path) || sameCleanPath(t.RepoPath, r.RealPath) {
            out = append(out, t)
        }
    }
    return out

 // NewService validates and normalizes the injected service dependencies.
 func NewService(config ServiceConfig) (*Service, error) {
    store := config.Store
    registry := config.Registry
    if store == nil && registry != nil {
        store = registry.Store()
    }
    if registry == nil && store != nil {
        registry = catalog.NewRegistry(store)
    }
    if store == nil || registry == nil {
        return nil, errors.New("experiment service requires a catalog registry and store")
    }
    if registry.Store() != store {
        return nil, errors.New("experiment service registry and store do not share a catalog")
    }

    triesRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.TriesRoot, "tries root")
    if err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    projectRoot, err := absoluteRoot(config.ProjectRoot, "project root")
    if err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    host := strings.TrimSpace(config.Host)
    if host == "" || host != config.Host || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
        return nil, errors.New("experiment service host is required and must be normalized")
    }
    clock := config.Clock
    if clock == nil {
        clock = time.Now
    }
    workers := config.MaxEnrichment
    if workers <= 0 {
        workers = 4
    }

    s := &Service{
        registry: registry, store: store,
        triesRoot: triesRoot, projectRoot: projectRoot, host: host,
        clock: clock, workers: workers,
        gitRun: gitx.Run, gitDiscover: gitx.Discover,
        gitStatus: gitx.StatusOf, gitLastCommit: gitx.LastCommit,
        worktrees: gitx.Worktrees,
        rename:    renameExclusive, moveWorktree: gitx.MoveWorktree,
        sameFilesystem: sameFilesystem,
        getwd:          os.Getwd,
    }

+	// non-reentrant forms so the outer read-check-write transaction remains one
+	// cross-process critical section.
+	s.catalogCreate = store.CreateUnderLock
+	s.catalogUpdate = store.UpdateUnderLock
    applyHooks(s, config.Hooks)
    return s, nil
 }

 func applyHooks(service *Service, hooks Hooks) {
    if hooks.GitRun != nil {
        service.gitRun = hooks.GitRun
    }
    if hooks.GitDiscover != nil {
        service.gitDiscover = hooks.GitDiscover
    }
    if hooks.GitStatus != nil {
        service.gitStatus = hooks.GitStatus
    }
    if hooks.GitLastCommit != nil {
        service.gitLastCommit = hooks.GitLastCommit
    }
    if hooks.GitWorktrees != nil {
        service.worktrees = hooks.GitWorktrees
    }
    if hooks.Rename != nil {
        service.rename = hooks.Rename
    }
    if hooks.MoveWorktree != nil {
        service.moveWorktree = hooks.MoveWorktree
    }
    if hooks.SameFilesystem != nil {

    }
    if hooks.Getwd != nil {

    }
    if hooks.CatalogCreate != nil {

    }

        service.catalogUpdate = hooks.CatalogUpdate
    }
 }

 func absoluteRoot(root, label string) (string, error) {
    if strings.TrimSpace(root) == "" {
        return "", fmt.Errorf("experiment service %s is required", label)
    }
    absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
    if err != nil {
        return "", fmt.Errorf("make %s absolute: %w", label, err)
    }
    return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
 }

 func (s *Service) now() time.Time { return s.clock().UTC() }

    }
    return nil
 }

    }
    sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
        left, right := strings.ToLower(candidates[i].Basename), strings.ToLower(candidates[j].Basename)
        if left != right {
            return left < right
        }
        if candidates[i].Basename != candidates[j].Basename {
            return candidates[i].Basename < candidates[j].Basename
        }
        return candidates[i].ID < candidates[j].ID
    })
    return candidates
 }
```

```text
175		return nil
176	}

178	func (t Token) matches(other Token) bool {
179		return t.OperationID == other.OperationID && t.Digest == other.Digest && t.Epoch == other.Epoch
180	}
181
182	func (t Token) sameOperation(request Request) bool {
183		return t.OperationID == request.OperationID && t.Digest == request.Digest
184	}

186	// CanonicalKeys validates, deduplicates, and sorts keys in the one order used
187	// by every multi-key acquisition.
188	func CanonicalKeys(keys []Key) ([]Key, error) {
189		if len(keys) == 0 {
190			return nil, errors.New("operation lease requires at least one key")
191		}
192		unique := make(map[string]Key, len(keys))
193		for _, key := range keys {
194			if err := key.Validate(); err != nil {
195				return nil, err
196			}
197			unique[key.canonical()] = key
198		}
199		canonical := make([]Key, 0, len(unique))
200		for _, key := range unique {
201			canonical = append(canonical, key)
202		}
203		sort.Slice(canonical, func(i, j int) bool { return canonical[i].canonical() < canonical[j].canonical() })
204		return canonical, nil
205	}
206
207	func validateIdentity(name, value string) error {
208		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
209			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
210		}
211		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
212			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
213		}
214		for _, char := range value {
215			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
216				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
217			}
218		}
219		return nil
220	}
```

```text
449		path := a.statePath()
450		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
451		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
452			return Snapshot{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}, nil

455			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state: %w", err)
456		}
457		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
458			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s is not a regular file", path)
459		}
460		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
461		if err != nil {
462			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state permissions: %w", err)
463		}
464		if !private {
465			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
466		}
467		file, err := os.Open(path)
468		if err != nil {
469			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("open operation lease state: %w", err)
470		}
471		defer file.Close()
472		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
473		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
474		var state Snapshot
475		if err := decoder.Decode(&state); err != nil {
476			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state: %w", err)
477		}
478		var extra any
479		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
480			if err == nil {
481				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("decode operation lease state: multiple JSON values")
482			}
483			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state trailing data: %w", err)
484		}
485		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
486			return Snapshot{}, err
487		}
488		canonical := canonicalSnapshot(state)
489		encodedState, _ := json.Marshal(state)
490		encodedCanonical, _ := json.Marshal(canonical)
491		if string(encodedState) != string(encodedCanonical) {
492			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("operation lease state is not in canonical order")
493		}
494		return state, nil
495	}

497	func (a *Authority) writeState(state Snapshot) error {
```

```text
537	func validateSnapshot(state Snapshot) error {
538		if state.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
539			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease schema_version %d: want %d", state.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
540		}
541		bindings := make(map[string]string, len(state.Bindings))
542		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
543			if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
544				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease binding: %w", err)
545			}
546			if _, exists := bindings[binding.OperationID]; exists {
547				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease repeats binding %s", binding.OperationID)
548			}
549			bindings[binding.OperationID] = binding.Digest
550		}
551		type activeSignature struct {
552			Token     Token
553			MachineID string
554			Kind      string
555		}
556		activeOperations := make(map[string]activeSignature)
557		terminalOperations := make(map[string]Tombstone)
558		seenKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(state.Records))
559		var maxRecordEpoch uint64
560		for _, record := range state.Records {
561			if err := record.Key.Validate(); err != nil {
562				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease record: %w", err)
563			}
564			canonicalKey := record.Key.canonical()
565			if _, exists := seenKeys[canonicalKey]; exists {
566				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease state repeats key %s", record.Key.subject())
567			}
568			seenKeys[canonicalKey] = struct{}{}
569			if record.Epoch == 0 || record.Epoch > state.LastEpoch {
570				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has invalid epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), record.Epoch)
571			}
572			if record.Epoch > maxRecordEpoch {
573				maxRecordEpoch = record.Epoch
574			}
575			if record.Reservation != nil && record.Fence != nil {

658	func canonicalSnapshot(state Snapshot) Snapshot {
659		result := Snapshot{
660			SchemaVersion: state.SchemaVersion,
661			LastEpoch:     state.LastEpoch,
662			Bindings:      append([]Binding(nil), state.Bindings...),
663			Records:       make([]Record, len(state.Records)),
664		}
665		sort.Slice(result.Bindings, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Bindings[i].OperationID < result.Bindings[j].OperationID })
666		for index, record := range state.Records {
667			result.Records[index] = cloneRecord(record)
668			if result.Records[index].Reservation != nil {
669				result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt)
670			}
671			if result.Records[index].Fence != nil {
672				result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt)
673			}
674			for tombstoneIndex := range result.Records[index].Tombstones {
675				result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt)
676			}
677			sort.Slice(result.Records[index].Tombstones, func(i, j int) bool {
678				left, right := result.Records[index].Tombstones[i], result.Records[index].Tombstones[j]
679				if left.Token.Epoch != right.Token.Epoch {
680					return left.Token.Epoch < right.Token.Epoch
681				}
682				if left.Token.OperationID != right.Token.OperationID {
683					return left.Token.OperationID < right.Token.OperationID
684				}
685				if left.Token.Digest != right.Token.Digest {
686					return left.Token.Digest < right.Token.Digest
687				}
688				return left.Kind < right.Kind
689			})
690		}
691		sort.Slice(result.Records, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Records[i].Key.canonical() < result.Records[j].Key.canonical() })
692		return result
693	}

695	func cloneRecord(record Record) Record {
696		result := record
697		if record.Reservation != nil {
698			copy := *record.Reservation
699			result.Reservation = &copy
700		}
701		if record.Fence != nil {
702			copy := *record.Fence
703			result.Fence = &copy
704		}
705		result.Tombstones = append([]Tombstone(nil), record.Tombstones...)
706		return result
707	}

714			}
715		}

802	func checkHierarchyClaims(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {

820			}
```

```text
14		ErrMachinePin      = errors.New("target machine ID does not match the configured host pin")
15		ErrMachineUnpinned = errors.New("mutating local-file apply requires host.machine_id")
16	)
17
18	type Runner interface {
19		RunWithOptions(context.Context, fleet.Host, []string, []byte, fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result
20	}
21
22	type Client struct{ Runner Runner }
23
24	func (c Client) run(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, maxResponse int64) ([]byte, error) {
25		if c.Runner == nil {
26			return nil, errors.New("local-files client has no fleet transport")
27		}
28		// Capability and plan are read-only. Apply is permanently bound to its
29		// request ID and plan digest by the target journal, so an authentication-only
30		// retry cannot duplicate an unbound mutation.
31		result := c.Runner.RunWithOptions(ctx, host, args, stdin, fleet.RunOptions{Retry: fleet.RetryAuthentication})
32		if int64(len(result.Stdout)) > maxResponse {
33			return nil, errors.New("target protocol response exceeded its bound")
34		}
35		if result.ExitCode == 0 && result.CaptureError == "" {
36			return result.Stdout, nil
37		}
38		switch {
39		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
40			return nil, ErrRemoteTimeout
41		case result.ExitCode == 127:
42			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
43		case result.ExitCode == 255:
44			return nil, ErrUnreachable
45		default:
46			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
47		}
48	}
49
50	// Identify performs the content-free capability exchange without enforcing the
51	// configured machine pin. It exists for explicit onboarding and diagnostics;
52	// mutating or payload-bearing callers must use Probe.
53	func (c Client) Identify(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
54		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
55		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
56		if err != nil {
57			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
58		}
59		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_capability"}, body, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
60		if err != nil {
61			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
62		}
63		var response fleet.CapabilityResponse
64		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes, &response); err != nil {
65			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
66		}
67		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
68			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
69		}
70		return response, nil
71	}
72
73	func (c Client) Probe(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
74		response, err := c.Identify(ctx, host)
75		if err != nil {
76			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
77		}
78		if host.MachineID != "" && host.MachineID != response.MachineID {
79			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
80		}
81		if !response.Supported {
82			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, errors.New("target does not support local-file payloads")
83		}
84		return response, nil
85	}
86
87	func (c Client) Plan(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
88		if capability.MachineID != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
89			return PlanResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
90		}
91		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
92			return PlanResponse{}, err
93		}
94		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
95		if err != nil {
96			return PlanResponse{}, err
97		}
98		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-plan"}, body, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
99		if err != nil {
100			return PlanResponse{}, err
101		}
102		var response PlanResponse
103		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes, &response); err != nil {
104			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
105		}
106		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
107			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
108		}
109		return response, nil
110	}
111
112	func (c Client) Apply(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
113		if host.MachineID == "" {
114			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachineUnpinned
115		}
116		if host.MachineID != capability.MachineID || envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine != capability.MachineID {
117			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
118		}
119		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
120			return ApplyResponse{}, err
121		}
122		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(envelope, MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes)
123		if err != nil {
124			return ApplyResponse{}, err
125		}
126		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-apply"}, body, MaxApplyResponseBytes)
127		if err != nil {
128			return ApplyResponse{}, err
129		}
130		var response ApplyResponse
131		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxApplyResponseBytes, &response); err != nil {
132			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
133		}
134		if err := response.Validate(envelope.Request, envelope.Plan); err != nil {
135			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
136		}
137		return response, nil
138	}
139
```

```text
371	func digestJSON(value any) string {
372		data, _ := json.Marshal(value)
373		digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
374		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
375	}
376
377	func digestBytes(value []byte) string {
378		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
379		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
380	}

382	func validDigest(value string) bool {
383		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != len("sha256:")+sha256.Size*2 {
384			return false
385		}
386		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"))
387		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size && value == strings.ToLower(value)
388	}
389
390	func validOID(value string) bool {
391		if len(value) != 40 && len(value) != 64 || value != strings.ToLower(value) {
392			return false
393		}
394		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
395		return err == nil
396	}
397
398	func validFileMode(value string) bool {
399		if len(value) != 4 {
400			return false
401		}
402		mode, err := strconv.ParseUint(value, 8, 12)
403		return err == nil && mode <= 0o777
404	}

408			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
409		}
410		for _, r := range value {
411			if unicode.IsControl(r) {
412				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
413			}
414		}
415		return nil
416	}
```

```text
1028	type recoveryHeldRoot struct {
1029		parent *os.Root
1030		name   string

1034
1035	func recoveryOpenParent(root *os.Root, relative string) (*os.Root, []recoveryHeldRoot, string, error) {
1036		relative = filepath.ToSlash(relative)
1037		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(relative, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
1038			return nil, nil, "", err
1039		}
1040		parts := strings.Split(relative, "/")
1041		current := root
1042		held := make([]recoveryHeldRoot, 0, len(parts)-1)
1043		for _, component := range parts[:len(parts)-1] {
1044			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(current, component)
1045			if err != nil {
1046				recoveryCloseHeld(held)
1047				return nil, nil, "", err
1048			}
1049			held = append(held, recoveryHeldRoot{parent: current, name: component, info: info, root: child})
1050			current = child
1051		}
1052		return current, held, parts[len(parts)-1], nil
1053	}
1054
1055	func recoveryCloseHeld(held []recoveryHeldRoot) error {
1056		var result error
1057		for index := len(held) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
1058			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(held[index].parent, held[index].name, held[index].info))
1059			result = errors.Join(result, held[index].root.Close())
1060		}
1061		return result
1062	}
1063
1064	func recoveryLstatRelative(root *os.Root, relative string) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
1065		parent, held, name, err := recoveryOpenParent(root, relative)
1066		if err != nil {
1067			return nil, err
1068		}
1069		info, statErr := parent.Lstat(name)
1070		closeErr := recoveryCloseHeld(held)
1071		return info, errors.Join(statErr, closeErr)
1072	}
1073
1074	func recoveryReadRelative(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, relative string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
1075		parent, held, name, err := recoveryOpenParent(root, relative)
1076		if err != nil {
1077			return nil, nil, err
1078		}
1079		data, info, readErr := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, parent, name, expected, maxBytes)
1080		closeErr := recoveryCloseHeld(held)
1081		return data, info, errors.Join(readErr, closeErr)
1082	}
1083
1084	func recoveryEntryType(info fs.FileInfo) RecoveryEntryType {
1085		if info == nil {
1086			return RecoveryEntryUnreadable
1087		}
1088		switch {
1089		case info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0:
1090			return RecoveryEntrySymlink
1091		case info.IsDir():
1092			return RecoveryEntryDirectory
1093		case info.Mode().IsRegular():
1094			return RecoveryEntryRegular
1095		default:
1096			return RecoveryEntrySpecial
1097		}
1098	}
```

```text
495				_ = held.close()
496				return nil, ErrUnsafe
497			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
498				_ = child.Close()
499				_ = held.close()
500				return nil, err
501			}
502			held.edges = append(held.edges, heldEdge{parent: held.parent, name: component, info: info})
503			held.roots = append(held.roots, child)
504			held.parent = child
505		}
506		return held, nil
507	}
508
509	func (h *heldParent) close() error {
510		if h == nil {
511			return nil
512		}
513		var result error
514		for index := len(h.edges) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
515			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(h.edges[index].parent, h.edges[index].name, h.edges[index].info))
516		}
517		result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyRoot(h.checkout, h.rootInfo))
518		for index := len(h.roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
519			result = errors.Join(result, h.roots[index].Close())
520		}
521		h.roots = nil
522		return result
523	}
524
525	func syncHeldRoot(root *os.Root) error {
526		file, err := root.Open(".")
527		if err != nil {
528			return err
529		}
530		defer file.Close()
531		return file.Sync()
532	}
533
534	func pathBase(slashPath string) string {
535		parts := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
536		return parts[len(parts)-1]
537	}
```

```text
29	func observePath(ctx context.Context, checkout, slashPath string, limits safefile.Limits, read bool) (observation, error) {
30		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {

32		}
33		if hasDependencyComponent(slashPath) {

35		}
36		held, err := openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath, false)
37		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
38			return observation{exists: false}, nil
39		}
40		if err != nil {
41			return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("open path %q: %w: %w", slashPath, err, ErrUnsafe)
42		}
43		finish := func(result observation, operationErr error) (observation, error) {
44			closeErr := held.close()
45			if operationErr != nil {
46				return observation{}, errors.Join(operationErr, closeErr)

48			if closeErr != nil {

50			}
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		name := pathBase(slashPath)
54		info, err := held.parent.Lstat(name)
55		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
56			return finish(observation{exists: false}, nil)
57		}
58		if err != nil {
59			return finish(observation{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect path %q: %w", slashPath, err))
60		}

75	func proveGitEligibility(ctx context.Context, checkout, slashPath string) error {

78		}
79		literal := ":(literal)" + slashPath
80		tracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "ls-files", "-z", "--", literal)
81		if err != nil {
82			return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git tracking for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
83		}
84		if tracked != "" {
85			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is tracked: %w", slashPath, ErrIneligible)
86		}
87		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
88		for index := range components {
89			prefix := strings.Join(components[:index+1], "/")
90			staged, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z", "--", ":(literal)"+prefix)
91			if err != nil {
92				return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git mode for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
93			}
94			for _, record := range strings.Split(staged, "\x00") {
95				if strings.HasPrefix(record, "160000 ") {
96					return fmt.Errorf("path %q crosses a submodule: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe)
97				}
98			}
99		}
100		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "check-ignore", "--no-index", "--quiet", "--", slashPath)
101		if err == nil {
102			return nil
103		}
104		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
105		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 {
106			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is not ignored on this host: %w", slashPath, ErrIneligible)
107		}
108		return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git ignore status for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
109	}
```

```text
24	// Expand resolves validated project and --file patterns locally into a sorted,
25	// duplicate-free list of exact slash paths. It never follows links or descends
26	// into Git metadata, nested repositories, submodules, or dependency trees.
27	func Expand(root string, patterns []Pattern, limits safefile.Limits) ([]string, error) {
28		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
29			return nil, err
30		}
31		if len(patterns) == 0 {
32			return nil, errors.New("no local-file patterns were configured or passed with --file")
33		}
34		for _, pattern := range patterns {
35			if err := projectconfig.ValidateLocalFilePattern(pattern.Value); err != nil {
36				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s: %w", patternSource(pattern), err)
37			}
38			for _, component := range strings.Split(pattern.Value, "/") {
39				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
40					return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s enters dependency directory %q", patternSource(pattern), component)
41				}
42			}
43		}
44		rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(root)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect source checkout: %w", err)
47		}
48		if !rootInfo.IsDir() || rootInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
49			return nil, errors.New("source checkout is not a held regular directory")
50		}
51
52		matches := map[string]struct{}{}
53		matchedPatterns := make([]bool, len(patterns))
54		visited := 0
55		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
56			if walkErr != nil {
57				return walkErr
58			}
59			if filename == root {
60				return nil
61			}
62			visited++
63			if visited > maxWalkEntries {
64				return fmt.Errorf("source checkout exceeds %d entries while expanding local-file patterns", maxWalkEntries)
65			}
66			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, filename)
67			if err != nil {
68				return err
69			}
70			slash := filepath.ToSlash(relative)
71			components := strings.Split(slash, "/")
72			base := strings.ToLower(components[len(components)-1])
73			if entry.IsDir() {
74				if base == ".git" {
75					return filepath.SkipDir
76				}
77				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[base]; blocked {
78					for _, pattern := range patterns {
79						if matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
80							return fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern enters dependency directory %q", slash)
81						}
82					}
83					return filepath.SkipDir
84				}
85				if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(filename, ".git")); err == nil {
86					return filepath.SkipDir
87				} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
88					return fmt.Errorf("inspect nested repository boundary %s: %w", slash, err)
89				}
90			}
91			matched := false
92			for index, pattern := range patterns {
93				if !entry.IsDir() && matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
94					matchedPatterns[index] = true
95					matched = true
96				}
97			}
98			if matched {
99				matches[slash] = struct{}{}
100			}
101			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 && entry.IsDir() {
102				return filepath.SkipDir
103			}
104			return nil
105		})
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, err
108		}
109		for index, matched := range matchedPatterns {
110			if !matched {
111				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s matched no source path", patternSource(patterns[index]))
112			}
113		}
114		paths := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
115		for path := range matches {
116			paths = append(paths, path)
117		}
118		sort.Strings(paths)
119		if len(paths) > limits.MaxFiles {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("patterns expanded to %d paths; maximum is %d", len(paths), limits.MaxFiles)
121		}
122		return paths, nil
123	}

125	func patternSource(pattern Pattern) string {
126		if strings.TrimSpace(pattern.Source) == "" {
127			return "explicit input"
128		}
129		return pattern.Source

132	func matchPattern(pattern, candidate string) bool {
133		patternParts := strings.Split(pattern, "/")
134		candidateParts := strings.Split(candidate, "/")
135		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
136		memo := map[key]bool{}
137		seen := map[key]bool{}
138		var match func(int, int) bool
139		match = func(patternIndex, candidateIndex int) bool {
140			state := key{patternIndex, candidateIndex}
141			if seen[state] {
142				return memo[state]
143			}
144			seen[state] = true
145			var result bool
146			switch {
147			case patternIndex == len(patternParts):
148				result = candidateIndex == len(candidateParts)
149			case patternParts[patternIndex] == "**":
150				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex) ||
151					candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && match(patternIndex, candidateIndex+1)
152			case candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && matchComponent(patternParts[patternIndex], candidateParts[candidateIndex]):
153				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex+1)
154			}
155			memo[state] = result
156			return result
157		}
158		return match(0, 0)
159	}
160
161	func matchComponent(pattern, candidate string) bool {
162		p, c := []rune(pattern), []rune(candidate)
163		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
164		memo := map[key]bool{}
165		seen := map[key]bool{}
166		var match func(int, int) bool
167		match = func(pi, ci int) bool {
168			state := key{pi, ci}
169			if seen[state] {
170				return memo[state]
171			}
172			seen[state] = true
173			var result bool
174			switch {
175			case pi == len(p):
176				result = ci == len(c)
177			case p[pi] == '*':
178				result = match(pi+1, ci) || ci < len(c) && match(pi, ci+1)
179			case ci < len(c) && (p[pi] == '?' || p[pi] == c[ci]):
180				result = match(pi+1, ci+1)
181			}
182			memo[state] = result
183			return result
184		}
185		return match(0, 0)
186	}

191				return true
192			}
193		}
194		return false
195	}
```

```text
1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15		"unicode"
16		"unicode/utf8"
17
18		"golang.org/x/text/cases"
19		"golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm"
20	)
21
22	var (
23		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
24		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
25		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
26		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
27		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
28		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
29		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
30		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
31		// ErrNotPortable reports a relative path that cannot be represented safely
32		// and with the same meaning on supported Unix and Windows filesystems.
33		ErrNotPortable = errors.New("path is not portable")
34		// ErrPathCollision reports distinct spellings that identify the same path on
35		// a case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystem.
36		ErrPathCollision = errors.New("portable path collision")
37		// ErrPathLimit reports a portable path that exceeds an explicit policy limit.
38		ErrPathLimit = errors.New("portable path limit exceeded")
39	)
40
41	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
42	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
43	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
44	// before creating or moving anything into it.
45	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
46		if path == "" {
47			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
48		}
49		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
50		if err != nil {
51			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
52		}
53		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
54
55		probe := absolute
56		var missing []string
57		for {
58			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
59			if err == nil {
60				slices.Reverse(missing)
61				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
62				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
63			}
64			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
65				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
66			}
67			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
68			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
69			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
70			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
71			// still-missing suffix.
72			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
73				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
74				if readErr != nil {
75					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
76				}
77				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
78					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
79				}
80				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
81					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
82				}
83				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
84				if resolveErr != nil {
85					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
86				}
87				slices.Reverse(missing)
88				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
89				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
90			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
91				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
92			}
93			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
94			if parent == probe {
95				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
96			}
97			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
98			probe = parent
99		}
100	}
101
102	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
103	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
104	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
105	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
106		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
107			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
108		}
109		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
110		if err != nil {
111			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
112		}
113		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
114		if err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
116		}
117
118		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
119		if err != nil {
120			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
121			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
122			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
123			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
124		}
125		switch {
126		case rel == ".":
127			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
128		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
129			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
130		default:
131			return canonicalCandidate, nil
132		}
133	}
134
135	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
136	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
137	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
138		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
139		if err == nil {
140			return true, nil
141		}
142		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
143			return false, nil
144		}
145		return false, err
146	}
147
148	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
149	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
150		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
151		if err != nil {
152			return false, err
153		}
154		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
155		if err != nil {
156			return false, err
157		}
158		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
159			return true, nil
160		}
161		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
162	}
163
164	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
165	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
166	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
167	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
168		switch {
169		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
170			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
171		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
172			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
173		case component == "." || component == "..":
174			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
175		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
176			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
177		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
178			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
179		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
180			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
181		default:
182			return nil
183		}
184	}
185
186	// PortablePathLimits bounds the encoded path, each encoded component, and path
187	// depth. Zero means unbounded for that field; negative values are invalid.
188	// File-count and byte-size ceilings live in safefile because they describe a
189	// collection of files rather than a path.
190	type PortablePathLimits struct {
191		MaxPathBytes      int
192		MaxComponentBytes int
193		MaxDepth          int
194	}
195
196	// ValidatePortableSlashPath accepts only a non-empty, clean, slash-separated
197	// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects
198	// Git metadata aliases, platform-specific separators and volumes, Windows
199	// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
200	// invalid UTF-8.
201	func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
202		if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
203			return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
204		}
205		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
206			return fmt.Errorf("path contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
207		}
208		if value == "" {
209			return fmt.Errorf("path is empty: %w", ErrNotPortable)
210		}
211		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
212			return fmt.Errorf("path contains a backslash path separator: %w", ErrNotPortable)
213		}
214		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" || driveQualified(value) {
215			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is absolute, drive-qualified, or UNC: %w", value, ErrNotPortable)
216		}
217		if limits.MaxPathBytes > 0 && len(value) > limits.MaxPathBytes {
218			return fmt.Errorf("path is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(value), limits.MaxPathBytes, ErrPathLimit)
219		}
220		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
221		if limits.MaxDepth > 0 && len(components) > limits.MaxDepth {
222			return fmt.Errorf("path has %d components; maximum is %d: %w", len(components), limits.MaxDepth, ErrPathLimit)
223		}
224		for _, component := range components {
225			if component == ".." {
226				return fmt.Errorf("path contains parent traversal: %w", ErrTraversal)
227			}
228			if err := ValidatePortableComponent(component, limits.MaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
229				return fmt.Errorf("path component %q: %w", component, err)
230			}
231		}
232		return nil
233	}

235	// ValidatePortableComponent applies the per-component part of
236	// ValidatePortableSlashPath. maxBytes may be zero for no size limit.
237	func ValidatePortableComponent(component string, maxBytes int) error {
238		if maxBytes < 0 {
239			return fmt.Errorf("negative component limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
240		}
241		if !utf8.ValidString(component) {
242			return fmt.Errorf("component contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
243		}
244		if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
245			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", err, ErrNotPortable)
246		}
247		if maxBytes > 0 && len(component) > maxBytes {
248			return fmt.Errorf("component is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(component), maxBytes, ErrPathLimit)
249		}
250		if strings.IndexFunc(component, isPortableControl) >= 0 {
251			return fmt.Errorf("path component contains control characters: %w", ErrNotPortable)
252		}
253		windowsAlias := strings.TrimRight(component, ". ")
254		if strings.EqualFold(windowsAlias, ".git") {
255			return fmt.Errorf("path contains reserved Git metadata: %w", ErrNotPortable)
256		}
257		if windowsAlias != component {
258			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q has a trailing dot or space and is not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
259		}
260		if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) {
261			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q contains characters that are not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
262		}
263		if windowsReservedName(component) {
264			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q is a reserved Windows device name: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
265		}
266		return nil
267	}
268
269	// ValidatePortablePathSet validates every path and rejects collisions at any
270	// component boundary after Unicode normalization and full Unicode case folding.
271	// Exact duplicate paths are left to the caller's type/cardinality policy.
272	func ValidatePortablePathSet(paths []string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
273		type collisionNode struct {
274			spelling string
275			first    string
276			children map[string]*collisionNode
277		}
278		root := &collisionNode{children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
279		for _, value := range paths {
280			if err := ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, limits); err != nil {
281				return fmt.Errorf("portable path %q: %w", value, err)
282			}
283			current := root
284			for _, component := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
285				key := portableCollisionKey(component)
286				next, exists := current.children[key]
287				if exists && next.spelling != component {
288					return fmt.Errorf("paths %q and %q collide on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems at %q and %q: %w",
289						next.first, value, next.spelling, component, ErrPathCollision)
290				}
291				if !exists {
292					next = &collisionNode{spelling: component, first: value, children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
293					current.children[key] = next
294				}
295				current = next
296			}
297		}
298		return nil
299	}
300
301	func portableCollisionKey(component string) string {
302		return norm.NFC.String(cases.Fold().String(norm.NFC.String(component)))
303	}
304
305	func isPortableControl(r rune) bool {
306		return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
307	}
308
309	func windowsReservedName(component string) bool {
310		base := component
311		if dot := strings.IndexByte(base, '.'); dot >= 0 {
312			base = base[:dot]
313		}
314		base = strings.TrimRight(base, " ")
315		upper := strings.ToUpper(base)
316		switch upper {
317		case "CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", "CONIN$", "CONOUT$", "CLOCK$":
318			return true
319		}
320		if len([]rune(upper)) != 4 {
321			return false
322		}
323		runes := []rune(upper)
324		prefix := string(runes[:3])
325		if prefix != "COM" && prefix != "LPT" {
326			return false
327		}
328		last := runes[3]
329		return last >= '1' && last <= '9' || last == '¹' || last == '²' || last == '³'
330	}
331
332	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
333	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
334	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
335	// single component.
336	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
337		if len(components) == 0 {
338			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
339		}
340		for i, component := range components {
341			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
342				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
343			}
344		}
345		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
346		if err != nil {
347			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
348		}
349		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
350	}
351
352	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
353		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
354			return false
355		}
356		letter := component[0]
357		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
358	}
359
360	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
361		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
362			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
363		}) {
364			if component == ".." {
365				return true
366			}
367		}
368		return false
369	}
```

```text
291	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific

293	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
294	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
295		for _, session := range sessions {

316	func checkoutRoots(r repo.Repo, index int, checkout RepoCheckout) []string {

324	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
325		if root == "" || path == "" {
326			return false
327		}
328		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
329		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
330			return false
331		}
332		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
333	}

335	func samePath(a, b string) bool {
336		return a != "" && b != "" && normalizePath(a) == normalizePath(b)
337	}

339	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
340	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
341	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
342	// is not sufficient.
343	func normalizePath(path string) string {
344		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
345		cur := clean
346		for {
347			if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
348				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
349				if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
350					return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
351				}
352				return filepath.Clean(real)
353			}
354			parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
355			if parent == cur {
356				return clean
357			}
358			cur = parent
359		}
```

21:+  every exact path is untracked, ignored, regular, portable, bounded, and bound to the
22:+  same fetch identity, attached branch, and commit; apply additionally requires the
23:+  pinned target machine. Differing target bytes require a separate `--replace`;
24:+  `--yes` never implies replacement.
25:+
26:+### Fixed
27:+
28:+- Task writes now carry an in-memory revision from read to write, so existing
29:+  lifecycle callers cannot silently overwrite a concurrent process's newer task
30:+  record. Catalog create, update, import, and experiment reconciliation share one
31:+  cross-process transaction lock, while corrupt task records make repository-context
32:+  inventory explicitly incomplete instead of disappearing behind a warning.
33:+- Portable-file retries now recover an interrupted store both before and after the
34:+  first journal write. The operation binding is durable before manifests or payloads,
35:+  rollback never guesses ownership of parent directories, target discovery errors fail
36:+  closed, and credential-bearing SCP-like remote prefixes cannot enter catalog keys,
37:+  protocol journals, or repository-context output.

122:+and exact commit. Both Git configurations must classify every selected path as

146:+description: Inventory repositories over SSH, pin remote machine identity, safely fast-forward branches, and explicitly transfer bounded ignored files with dev fleet.
150:+verified_on: 2026-08-31
158:-A remote fleet is a list of other hosts, each running its own `dev` binary against its own `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, its own scan roots, its own task registry, and its own runtime. `dev fleet` never centralizes or takes ownership of that state — it only asks each host's `dev` for a read-only snapshot over SSH and reports what comes back. A host with no `dev` installed, or an unreachable host, degrades that one row; it never blocks the rest of the fleet.
159:+A remote fleet is a list of other hosts, each running its own `dev` binary against its own `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, its own scan roots, its own task registry, and its own runtime. Inventory stays decentralized: each host's `dev` produces its own read-only snapshot over SSH, and one unreachable host never blocks the remaining rows. Mutation is confined to separately named commands such as `fleet sync` and `fleet files --apply`; neither makes this machine authoritative for the target's paths, task registry, or runtime.
167:+# Add only after `dev fleet machine-id lab` and independent verification.
168:+machine_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
177:+`schema_version = 1` is required. `[defaults]` supplies `connect_timeout`, `command_timeout`, `cache_ttl`, `max_parallel` (fan-out concurrency), and `dev_path` (`"auto"` searches `PATH`); each `[[hosts]]` entry inherits any of these it does not set explicitly. A host needs `name` plus either `ssh_alias` (preferred — it reuses `~/.ssh/config`'s `ProxyJump`, `IdentityAgent`, and host-key policy exactly like a plain `ssh` invocation) or `hostname` (optionally with `user`, `port`, `identity_file`). The optional `machine_id` is a durable UUID pin: read-only inventory can warn or proceed without it, but mutating portable-file apply requires an exact match. `ssh_login_password_source.type` is one of `none` (default), `prompt`, `plain` (inline `value`), or `bitwarden` (`item` looked up with the `bw` CLI). A config file with a `plain` password must be mode `0600`, or `dev fleet` refuses to load it.
178:+
179:+Discover a target UUID with `dev fleet machine-id <host>`, verify it through an independent channel on that machine, then copy it into `remotes.toml`. The command is read-only and reports `unpinned`, `match`, or `mismatch`; it never edits configuration on your behalf.
186: | `dev fleet status` | `--json`, `--strict` | Probe configured hosts and report snapshot health |
187:+| `dev fleet machine-id <host>` | `--json` | Show the observed durable UUID and compare the configured pin |
189:+| `dev fleet files [repo-or-path]` | `--to <host>`, `--file <pattern>` (repeatable), `--apply`, `--replace`, `--yes`, `--json` | Plan or apply one-way transfer of explicit ignored files |
195: `--repo` on `list` filters by name, remote identity, branch, or path; `--cached` answers entirely from the last saved snapshot with no network activity; `--strict` turns an unreachable/timeout/incompatible/invalid host into a non-zero exit for both `list` and `status`. `sync <repo>` resolves `<repo>` locally like any other repository reference; without `--push` its `HEAD` must already equal the fetched upstream, and `--remote` picks which Git remote identifies the repository across hosts (default: the branch's upstream remote, then `origin`).
197:-`dev fleet` also registers four hidden commands (`_snapshot`, `_sync`, `_open-herdr`, `_shell`) that exist only to be invoked by `dev fleet` itself on the far end of an SSH connection — they are the wire protocol, not a user-facing surface.
198:+## Explicit portable local files
199:+
200:+A repository may propose export candidates separately from worktree provisioning:
201:+
202:+```toml
203:+# .dev-cli/config.toml
204:+version = 1
205:+
206:+[local_files]
207:+include = [".env", ".mcp/**"]
208:+```
209:+
210:+`[worktree].include` is local provisioning policy and is never inherited here.
211:+`[local_files].include` also grants no standing permission: an explicit invocation
212:+must select exactly one target, and repeatable `--file` adds ad-hoc patterns for
213:+that invocation only. Patterns expand on the source into sorted exact paths;
214:+no glob crosses the wire.
215:+
216:+```bash
217:+dev fleet files api --to lab                    # report only
218:+dev fleet files api --to lab --apply --yes      # create absent target files
219:+dev fleet files api --to lab --replace --apply  # authorize differing bytes separately
220:+```
221:+
222:+The source and target must already resolve to one clone with the same normalized
223:+**fetch** identity, attached branch, and exact commit. A push-only URL match is
224:+insufficient. Both hosts independently prove every exact path is untracked and
225:+ignored under their own Git configuration. Only regular files pass: no
226:+symlinks/reparse points, directories, sockets, devices, FIFOs, `.git`, nested
227:+repositories, or submodule boundaries. Compiled ceilings are 128 files,
228:+8 MiB per file, 32 MiB total, with bounded path length/depth; host policy may
229:+lower but never raise them.
230:+
231:+Plan is the default and sends no file body. Apply additionally requires the
232:+configured `machine_id` to match the content-free capability probe. Missing files
233:+are atomically created owner-only; identical files are no-ops; differing bytes
234:+block unless `--replace` was present in the displayed plan. Replacement binds the
235:+observed target digest/mode, retains a private rollback copy, revalidates both
236:+roots, and rolls back file changes on failure. `--yes` only answers confirmation
237:+and never implies replacement. Public human/JSON output contains path, size,
238:+mode, and state—never content or hashes.
239:+
240:+The transaction journal is durable before manifest/payload staging, so an
241:+interrupted request ID can resume or reconcile. Rollback intentionally leaves an
242:+empty parent directory when its post-crash identity cannot be proven; deleting
243:+another process's replacement would be worse. Native Windows payload transfer is
244:+capability-blocked before content is sent.
245:+
246:+This command is not repository/task ownership transfer, clone acquisition,
247:+provisioning, backup, restore, or eviction. It never switches a branch, copies
248:+task/catalog/note state, watches for changes, propagates deletions, or removes the
249:+source.
250:+
251:+`dev fleet` also registers bounded hidden capability/file commands in addition to
252:+`_snapshot`, `_sync`, `_open-herdr`, and `_shell`. They exist only for the two
253:+`dev` processes to invoke over SSH; they are wire protocols, not user-facing
254:+surfaces.
259:+Every fleet command reaches a host by shelling out to the system `ssh` binary with `ConnectTimeout`, `ServerAliveInterval=15`, and `ServerAliveCountMax=2`, and first attempts `BatchMode=yes` — key or agent authentication only, exactly like a script-friendly `ssh` call. Fixed protocols use non-PTY `-T` and disable agent, X11, local-command, and all port forwarding while retaining the user's normal host-key policy. `dev fleet open` separately allocates a PTY (`-t`) for its interactive login shell.
267:-Each successful probe writes a per-host JSON snapshot under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json`. That cache is a disposable accelerator, not durable data: it is fingerprinted with an "endpoint ID" derived from the host's connection fields and timeouts, so editing a host's `ssh_alias`, `hostname`, `user`, `identity_file`, `dev_path`, or timeouts automatically invalidates its old cache the next time `dev` reads it. `dev cache list` shows its path, size, and age; `dev cache clear fleet` (or `dev cache clear all`) removes it outright. There is nothing to "rebuild" explicitly — the next `dev fleet list`, `dev fleet status`, or TUI FLEET reload regenerates it from a fresh probe.
268:+Each successful probe writes a per-host JSON snapshot under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json`. That cache is a disposable accelerator, not durable data: it is fingerprinted with an "endpoint ID" derived from the host's connection fields and timeouts, so editing a host's `machine_id`, `ssh_alias`, `hostname`, `user`, `identity_file`, `dev_path`, or timeouts automatically invalidates its old cache the next time `dev` reads it. `dev cache list` shows its path, size, and age; `dev cache clear fleet` (or `dev cache clear all`) removes it outright. There is nothing to "rebuild" explicitly — the next `dev fleet list`, `dev fleet status`, or TUI FLEET reload regenerates it from a fresh probe.
270: The cache exists so an unreachable, timed-out, incompatible, or invalid-response host can still report its last known state (marked `stale`, with `FromCache` set) instead of vanishing from the listing; `--cached` uses only this cache and never touches the network. Each remote host's own `config.toml`, task registry, and repository paths remain authoritative on that host — the cache only ever holds a read-only snapshot of them.

```text
238	func fleetFilesHost(cfg fleet.Config, name string) (fleet.Host, error) {
239		var selected *fleet.Host
240		for index := range cfg.Hosts {
241			if cfg.Hosts[index].Name == name {
242				if selected != nil {
243					return fleet.Host{}, errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one target")
244				}
245				copy := cfg.Hosts[index]
246				selected = &copy
247			}
248		}
249		if selected == nil {
250			return fleet.Host{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
251		}
252		return *selected, nil
253	}

255	func fleetFilePatterns(project projectconfig.Result, adHoc []string) []localfiles.Pattern {
256		var patterns []localfiles.Pattern
257		if project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include != nil {
258			source, _ := project.SourceFor("local_files.include")
259			for _, value := range *project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include {
260				patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: source})
261			}
262		}
263		for _, value := range adHoc {
264			patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: "--file"})
265		}

269	func resolveFleetFilesSource(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (string, gitx.Status, string, string, error) {
270		checkout := ""
271		if ref == "" {
272			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
273			if err != nil {
274				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
275			}
276			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
277			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
278				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
279			}
280			checkout = gitRepo.Root
281		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
282			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
283				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
284				if discoverErr != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
285					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
286				}
287				checkout = gitRepo.Root
288			}
289		}
290		if checkout == "" {
291			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
292			if err != nil {
293				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
294			}
295			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
296			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
297				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
298			}
299			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
300		}
301		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
302		if err != nil {
303			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
304		}
305		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
306			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
307		}
308		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
309		if err != nil {
310			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
311		}
312		identity, err := sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
313		if err != nil {
314			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
315		}
316		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil
317	}
318
319	func sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
320		var preferred []string
321		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
322			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
323		}
324		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
325		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
326		if err != nil {
327			return "", err
328		}
329		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
330		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
331		for _, remote := range preferred {
332			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
333				continue
334			}
335			seenRemote[remote] = true
336			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
337			if err != nil {
338				continue
339			}
340			identitySet := map[string]bool{}
341			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
342				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
343					identitySet[identity] = true
344				}
345			}
346			if len(identitySet) == 1 {
347				for identity := range identitySet {
348					return identity, nil
349				}
350			}
351		}
352		return "", errors.New("source checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
353	}

355	func renderFleetFilesReport(app *App, report localfiles.Report, jsonOutput bool) error {
356		if jsonOutput {
357			encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
358			encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
359			return encoder.Encode(report)
360		}
361		table := app.newTable("PATH", "SIZE", "MODE", "STATE")
362		for _, file := range report.Files {
363			table.Add(file.Path, fmt.Sprintf("%d", file.Size), file.Mode, string(file.State))
364		}
365		table.Render(app.Out)
366		return nil
367	}
```

```text
40	// Store is a directory of one-TOML-file-per-task.
41	//
42	// One file per task, rather than a single registry document, is a deliberate
43	// choice: the state directory is meant to be syncable across machines (it can
44	// simply be a git repo), and a shared central file would conflict on every
45	// parallel edit while separate files merge cleanly.
46	type Store struct{ Dir string }

48	// NewStore returns a store rooted at dir.

51	// ImportOutcome reports what ImportExact observed or changed.

53
54	const (

56		ImportCreated ImportOutcome = "created"
57		// ImportIdentical means the same ID and semantic content were already stored.

59		// ImportConflict means the ID already held different semantic content.

68	// ValidateID checks that id can be used as exactly one visible filename stem.
69	func ValidateID(id string) error {
70		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {
71			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrInvalidID)
72		}
```
