76	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
77	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
78		clean := func(s string) string {
79			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
80			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
81				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
82			}
83			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
84		}
85		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
86		if r == "" {
87			r = "repo"
88		}
89		if b == "" {
90			b = "branch"
91		}
92		return r + "__" + b
93	}

97	// Save creates a task or updates one read by this Store. Existing-task writes
98	// compare the task's private loaded revision under the cross-process lock, so
99	// legacy callers cannot silently overwrite a newer process's mutation.
100	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {
101		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
102		if err != nil {
103			return err
104		}
105		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
106			current, currentErr := s.get(candidate.ID)
107			switch {
108			case currentErr == nil:
109				if candidate.storedRevision == "" || candidate.storedRevision != current.Revision() {
110					return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
111				}
112				if !candidate.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
113					return fmt.Errorf("task %s changed its creation time: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
114				}
115			case errors.Is(currentErr, ErrNotFound):
116				if candidate.storedRevision != "" {
117					return fmt.Errorf("task %s was removed after it was read: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
118				}
119			default:
120				return currentErr
121			}
122			stampForSave(candidate)
123			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
124				return err
125			}
126			candidate.storedRevision = candidate.Revision()
127			return nil
128		})
129		if err != nil {
130			return err
131		}
132		*t = *candidate
133		return nil
134	}

136	// ReplaceDone starts a new task generation under an existing stable ID only
137	// while the exact observed record is still DONE. It resets Created/Updated and
138	// rejects a concurrent restart instead of weakening ordinary Save CAS.
139	func (s *Store) ReplaceDone(t *Task, expectedRevision string) error {
140		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
141		if err != nil {
142			return err
143		}
144		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
145			current, err := s.get(candidate.ID)
146			if err != nil {
147				return err
148			}
149			if expectedRevision == "" || current.State != Done || current.Revision() != expectedRevision {
150				return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
151			}
152			candidate.Created = time.Time{}
153			candidate.Updated = time.Time{}
154			stampForSave(candidate)
155			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
156				return err
157			}
158			candidate.storedRevision = candidate.Revision()
159			return nil
160		})
161		if err != nil {
162			return err
163		}
164		*t = *candidate
165		return nil
166	}

198	// ImportExact creates t under its supplied ID without changing any semantic
199	// field or timestamp. Replaying identical content is a no-op; reusing an ID
200	// for different content reports ImportConflict and ErrConflict.
201	func (s *Store) ImportExact(t *Task) (ImportOutcome, error) {
202		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, false)
203		if err != nil {
204			return "", err
205		}
206		var outcome ImportOutcome
207		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
208			current, err := s.get(candidate.ID)
209			switch {
210			case err == nil && current.Revision() == candidate.Revision():
211				outcome = ImportIdentical
212				return nil
213			case err == nil:
214				outcome = ImportConflict
215				return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
216			case !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
217				return err
218			}
219			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
220				return err
221			}
222			outcome = ImportCreated
223			return nil
224		})
225		return outcome, err
226	}

252	func prepareCandidate(t *Task, deriveID bool) (*Task, error) {
253		if t == nil {
254			return nil, errors.New("save nil task")
255		}
256		candidate := *t
257		candidate.Tags = append([]string(nil), t.Tags...)
258		if candidate.ID == "" && deriveID {
259			candidate.ID = MakeID(candidate.Repo, candidate.Branch)
260		}
261		if candidate.ID == "" {
262			return nil, fmt.Errorf("task import requires an exact ID: %w", ErrInvalidID)
263		}
264		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
265			return nil, err
266		}
267		return &candidate, nil
268	}

278	func (s *Store) withMutationLock(operation func() error) error {
279		if s == nil {
280			return errors.New("mutate nil task store")
281		}
282		return lockx.WithDir(context.Background(), s.Dir, "task store", operation)

285	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(t *Task) error {
286		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
287			return fmt.Errorf("create task state directory: %w", err)
288		}
289		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+t.ID+".*.tmp")
290		if err != nil {
291			return fmt.Errorf("create task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
292		}
293		name := tmp.Name()
294		defer os.Remove(name)
295		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o644); err != nil {
296			_ = tmp.Close()
297			return fmt.Errorf("set task %s file mode: %w", t.ID, err)
298		}
299		if err := toml.NewEncoder(tmp).Encode(t); err != nil {
300			_ = tmp.Close()
301			return fmt.Errorf("encode task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
302		}
303		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
304			_ = tmp.Close()
305			return fmt.Errorf("sync task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
306		}
307		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
308			return fmt.Errorf("close task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
309		}
310		if err := replaceFile(name, s.path(t.ID)); err != nil {
311			return fmt.Errorf("replace task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
312		}
313		if err := errors.Join(syncDirectory(s.Dir), syncDirectory(filepath.Dir(s.Dir))); err != nil {
314			return fmt.Errorf("sync task %s directory: %w", t.ID, err)
315		}
316		return nil
317	}

319	// List loads every valid task, sorted by state (hot first) then most recent.
320	// It retains the historical warning behavior; completeness-sensitive callers
321	// should use ListWithDiagnostics instead of treating a partial list as whole.
322	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Task, error) {
323		tasks, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
324		if err != nil {
325			return nil, err
326		}
327		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
328			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: %s\n", diagnostic.Error())
329		}
330		return tasks, nil
331	}
332
333	// ListWithDiagnostics returns every valid task plus deterministic per-record
334	// errors. A corrupt record never hides valid work and never silently satisfies
335	// an inventory-completeness gate.
336	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Task, []Diagnostic, error) {
337		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
338		if err != nil {
339			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
340				return nil, nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
341			}
342			return nil, nil, err
343		}
344		var tasks []*Task
345		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
346		for _, entry := range entries {
347			name := entry.Name()
348			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
349				continue
350			}
351			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
352			tracked, err := s.Get(id)
353			if err != nil {
354				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
355				continue
356			}
357			tasks = append(tasks, tracked)
358		}
359		Sort(tasks)
360		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
361		return tasks, diagnostics, nil
362	}
363
364	// Delete removes a task entry under the mutation lock. It never touches git
365	// state.
366	func (s *Store) Delete(id string) error {
367		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
368			return err
369		}
370		return s.withMutationLock(func() error {
371			err := os.Remove(s.path(id))
372			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
373				return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
374			}
375			if err != nil {
376				return err
377			}
378			if err := syncDirectory(s.Dir); err != nil {
379				return fmt.Errorf("sync task directory after deleting %s: %w", id, err)
380			}

208	// Import merges portable metadata for an exact stable ID and records location as
209	// host's local view. Source locations are deliberately ignored: only the caller-

211	// recovery receipts are host-owned lifecycle authority and cannot be imported.
212	// The complete read-check-write transaction runs under the catalog's advisory
213	// lock so concurrent processes cannot claim the same target path.
214	func (s *Store) Import(ctx context.Context, source *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, error) {

241		// zero location timestamp is allowed at the API boundary and is stamped only
242		// after the lock is held so a replay can retain the first import's timestamp.
243		validationLocation := location
244		if validationLocation.Updated.IsZero() {
245			validationLocation.Updated = incoming.Updated
246		}
247		incoming.Locations = map[string]Location{host: validationLocation}

335	func rejectImportedPathOwner(entries []*Entry, importedID, host string, target Location) error {
336		targetPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(target)
337		if err != nil {
338			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize imported location on host %s: %w", host, err)
339		}
340		for _, entry := range entries {
341			if entry.ID == importedID {
342				continue
343			}
344			owned, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
345			if !ok {
346				continue
347			}
348			ownedPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(owned)
349			if err != nil {
350				return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize catalog asset %s location on host %s: %w", entry.ID, host, err)
351			}
352			ownedSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ownedPaths))
353			for _, path := range ownedPaths {
354				ownedSet[path] = struct{}{}
355			}
356			for _, path := range targetPaths {
357				if _, exists := ownedSet[path]; exists {
358					return importConflict(importedID, entry.ID, "location",
359						fmt.Sprintf("target path %q on host %s is already owned", path, host))
360				}
361			}
362		}
363		return nil
364	}

366	func canonicalLocationPaths(location Location) ([]string, error) {
367		fields := []struct {
368			name  string
369			value string
370		}{
371			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
372			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
373			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
374			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
375		}
376		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(fields))
377		for _, field := range fields {
378			if field.value == "" {
379				continue
380			}
381			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(field.value)
382			if err != nil {
383				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s %q: %w", field.name, field.value, err)
384			}
385			seen[canonical] = struct{}{}
386		}
387		paths := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
388		for path := range seen {
389			paths = append(paths, path)
390		}
391		sort.Strings(paths)
392		return paths, nil
393	}

395	func mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, bool, error) {
396		if current.SchemaVersion != incoming.SchemaVersion {
397			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "schema_version", "schema versions differ")
398		}
399		if current.Kind != incoming.Kind {
400			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "kind",
401				fmt.Sprintf("durable kind %q differs from imported kind %q", current.Kind, incoming.Kind))
402		}
403		if current.Name != incoming.Name {
404			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "name",
405				fmt.Sprintf("durable name %q differs from imported name %q", current.Name, incoming.Name))
406		}
407
408		merged := current.Clone()
409		changed := false
410
411		currentSummary := strings.TrimSpace(merged.Note)
412		incomingSummary := strings.TrimSpace(incoming.Note)
413		switch {
414		case currentSummary != "" && incomingSummary != "" && merged.Note != incoming.Note:
415			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "note", "nonempty summaries differ")
416		case currentSummary == "" && incomingSummary != "":
417			merged.Note = incoming.Note
418			changed = true
419		}
420
421		tags := NormalizeTags(append(append([]string(nil), merged.Tags...), incoming.Tags...))
422		if !slices.Equal(merged.Tags, tags) {
423			merged.Tags = tags
424			changed = true
425		}
426
427		switch {
428		case merged.RemoteIdentity != "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "" && merged.RemoteIdentity != incoming.RemoteIdentity:
429			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "remote_identity",
430				fmt.Sprintf("durable identity %q differs from imported identity %q", merged.RemoteIdentity, incoming.RemoteIdentity))
431		case merged.RemoteIdentity == "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "":
432			merged.RemoteIdentity = incoming.RemoteIdentity
433			changed = true
434		}
435
436		switch {
437		case merged.Experiment == nil && incoming.Experiment != nil:
438			value := *incoming.Experiment
439			merged.Experiment = &value
440			changed = true
441		case merged.Experiment != nil && incoming.Experiment != nil && !experimentsEqual(*merged.Experiment, *incoming.Experiment):
442			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "experiment", "experiment metadata differs")
443		}
444
445		if value := earlierTime(merged.Created, incoming.Created); !value.Equal(merged.Created) {
446			merged.Created = value
447			changed = true
448		}
449		if value := earlierTime(merged.Discovered, incoming.Discovered); !value.Equal(merged.Discovered) {
450			merged.Discovered = value
451			changed = true
452		}
453		if value := laterTime(merged.LastOpened, incoming.LastOpened); !value.Equal(merged.LastOpened) {
454			merged.LastOpened = value
455			changed = true
456		}
457		if value := laterTime(merged.Updated, incoming.Updated); !value.Equal(merged.Updated) {
458			merged.Updated = value
459			changed = true
460		}
461
462		previous, exists := merged.LocationFor(host)
463		if !exists || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) || !previous.Updated.Equal(location.Updated) {
464			if merged.Locations == nil {
465				merged.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
466			}
467			merged.Locations[host] = location
468			changed = true
469		}
470		merged.Normalize()
471		if err := merged.Validate(); err != nil {
472			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("validate merged catalog asset %s: %w", merged.ID, err)
473		}
474		return merged, changed, nil
475	}

477	func experimentsEqual(left, right Experiment) bool {
478		return left.Phase == right.Phase &&
479			left.Slug == right.Slug &&
480			left.OriginURL == right.OriginURL &&
481			left.Started.Equal(right.Started) &&
482			left.OriginalPath == right.OriginalPath &&
483			left.DeprecatedAt.Equal(right.DeprecatedAt) &&
484			left.DeprecatedPath == right.DeprecatedPath &&
485			left.GraduatedAt.Equal(right.GraduatedAt) &&
486			left.GraduatedPath == right.GraduatedPath
487	}
488
489	func earlierTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
490		if left.IsZero() || !right.IsZero() && right.Before(left) {
491			return right
492		}
493		return left
494	}
495
496	func laterTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
497		if right.After(left) {
498			return right
499		}
500		return left
501	}

99	// Import writes a transported note with its exact durable identity and
100	// timestamps. Path is always derived from the validated repository and note IDs;
101	// a source Path is never trusted. An identical revision is an idempotent replay,
102	// while reusing an ID for different content is a conflict. Import changes only
103	// Markdown source data and deliberately does not update or rebuild the FTS cache.
104	func (s *Store) Import(ctx context.Context, source *Note) (*Note, error) {
105		if s == nil {
106			return nil, errors.New("import into nil note store")
107		}

142					return fmt.Errorf("note %s already exists with different content: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
143				}
144				if filepath.Clean(current.Path) != filepath.Clean(target) {
145					return fmt.Errorf("note %s exists outside its imported repository path: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)

155				return err
156			}
157			imported = clone(candidate)
158			return nil
159		})

161	}

163	func (s *Store) confinedImportPath(repositoryID, id string) (string, error) {
164		root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
165		if err != nil {
166			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
167		}
168		repositoryDir := filepath.Join(root, repositoryID)
169		if info, err := os.Lstat(repositoryDir); err == nil {
170			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
171				return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository directory %s is a symlink: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
172			}
173			if !info.IsDir() {
174				return "", fmt.Errorf("note repository path %s is not a directory: %w", repositoryID, ErrRepository)
175			}

184			}

186			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect note path %s: %w", id, err)
187		}
188		confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
189		if err != nil {
190			return "", fmt.Errorf("confine imported note path: %w", err)
191		}
192		return confined, nil
193	}

195	// importedNoteByID performs the global uniqueness lookup used by Import while

197	// than the one-repository-directory layout.
198	func (s *Store) importedNoteByID(id string) (*Note, error) {
199		paths, err := s.notePaths("")
200		if err != nil {

203		root, err := pathx.Canonical(s.Dir)
204		if err != nil {
205			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize note store: %w", err)
206		}
207		var match string
208		for _, path := range paths {
209			if strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md") != id {
210				continue
211			}
212			info, err := os.Lstat(path)
213			if err != nil {
214				return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect existing note %s: %w", id, err)
215			}
216			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
217				return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is not a regular file: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
218			}
219			confined, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, path)
220			if err != nil {

222			}
223			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, confined)
224			if err != nil {

226			}

236		if match == "" {

238		}
239		return s.read(match)

33	// ParseState validates a user-supplied state name.
34	func ParseState(s string) (State, error) {
35		got := State(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s)))
36		for _, valid := range States {
37			if got == valid {

39			}
40		}
41		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown state %q: want one of %s", s, JoinStates(", "))

141	func (t Task) Revision() string {
142		hash := sha256.New()
143		writeString := func(value string) {

146			_, _ = hash.Write(length[:])

155		writeString(t.Name)

170		writeString(t.AgentSession)
171		writeString(t.RuntimeHandle)
172		writeString(t.RuntimeName)

492	func parseRecoveryRefs(output []byte) ([]RecoveryRef, error) {
493		refs := []RecoveryRef{}
494		var parseErrors []error
495		for recordIndex, record := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{'\n'}) {
496			record = bytes.TrimSuffix(record, []byte{'\r'})
497			if len(record) == 0 {
498				continue
499			}
500			fields := bytes.Split(record, []byte{0})
501			if len(fields) == 4 && len(fields[3]) == 0 {
502				fields = fields[:3]
503			}
504			if len(fields) != 3 {
505				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d has %d fields", recordIndex, len(fields)))
506				continue
507			}
508			name, oid, objectType := string(fields[0]), string(fields[1]), string(fields[2])
509			if !utf8.ValidString(name) || !strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/") || oid == "" || objectType == "" {
510				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d is invalid", recordIndex))
511				continue
512			}
513			refs = append(refs, RecoveryRef{Name: name, OID: oid, ObjectType: objectType, Kind: recoveryRefKind(name)})
514		}
515		sort.Slice(refs, func(i, j int) bool { return refs[i].Name < refs[j].Name })
516		return refs, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
517	}

519	func recoveryRefKind(name string) RecoveryRefKind {
520		switch {
521		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/heads/"):
522			return RecoveryRefHead
523		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/tags/"):
524			return RecoveryRefTag
525		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/notes/"):
526			return RecoveryRefNote
527		case name == "refs/stash":
528			return RecoveryRefStash
529		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/remotes/"):
530			return RecoveryRefRemote
531		default:
532			return RecoveryRefOther
533		}
534	}

649	func parseRecoveryWorktrees(output []byte) ([]RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot, error) {
650		worktrees := []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{}
651		var current *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot
652		var parseErrors []error
653		flush := func() {
654			if current == nil {
655				return
656			}
657			if current.Path == "" {
658				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, errors.New("worktree record has no path"))
659			} else {
660				current.Main = len(worktrees) == 0
661				worktrees = append(worktrees, *current)
662			}
663			current = nil
664		}
665		for fieldIndex, raw := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{0}) {
666			if len(raw) == 0 {
667				flush()
668				continue
669			}
670			keyBytes, valueBytes, hasValue := bytes.Cut(raw, []byte{' '})
671			key, value := string(keyBytes), ""
672			if hasValue {
673				value = string(valueBytes)
674			}
675			if key == "worktree" {
676				flush()
677				current = &RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{
678					Path: value, Presence: RecoveryPresenceUnknown, Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete,
679					Operations: []RecoveryOperation{}, IndexEntries: []RecoveryIndexEntry{},
680					TrackedFiles: []RecoveryTrackedFile{}, DirtyPaths: []RecoveryDirtyPath{},
681					UntrackedPaths: []string{}, IgnoredPaths: []string{}, LFSPaths: []RecoveryLFSPath{},
682					Submodules: []RecoverySubmodule{}, NestedRepositories: []RecoveryNestedRepository{},
683				}
684				continue
685			}
686			if current == nil {
687				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("worktree field %d precedes a worktree path", fieldIndex))
688				continue
689			}
690			switch key {
691			case "HEAD":
692				current.Head = value
693			case "branch":
694				current.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(value, "refs/heads/")
695			case "detached":
696				current.Detached = true
697			case "bare":
698				current.Bare = true
699			case "locked":
700				current.Locked, current.LockedReason = true, value
701			case "prunable":
702				current.Prunable, current.PrunableReason = true, value
703			}
704		}
705		flush()
706		return worktrees, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
707	}

1035	func recoveryOpenParent(root *os.Root, relative string) (*os.Root, []recoveryHeldRoot, string, error) {
1036		relative = filepath.ToSlash(relative)
1037		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(relative, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
1038			return nil, nil, "", err
1039		}
1040		parts := strings.Split(relative, "/")
1041		current := root
1042		held := make([]recoveryHeldRoot, 0, len(parts)-1)
1043		for _, component := range parts[:len(parts)-1] {
1044			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(current, component)
1045			if err != nil {
1046				recoveryCloseHeld(held)
1047				return nil, nil, "", err
1048			}
1049			held = append(held, recoveryHeldRoot{parent: current, name: component, info: info, root: child})
1050			current = child
1051		}
1052		return current, held, parts[len(parts)-1], nil
1053	}

1055	func recoveryCloseHeld(held []recoveryHeldRoot) error {
1056		var result error
1057		for index := len(held) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
1058			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(held[index].parent, held[index].name, held[index].info))
1059			result = errors.Join(result, held[index].root.Close())
1060		}
1061		return result
1062	}

1064	func recoveryLstatRelative(root *os.Root, relative string) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
1065		parent, held, name, err := recoveryOpenParent(root, relative)

1068		}
1069		info, statErr := parent.Lstat(name)
1070		closeErr := recoveryCloseHeld(held)

1152	func parseRecoveryIndex(output []byte) ([]RecoveryIndexEntry, error) {
1153		entries := []RecoveryIndexEntry{}
1154		var parseErrors []error
1155		for recordIndex, record := range recoveryNULRecords(output) {
1156			header, pathBytes, ok := bytes.Cut(record, []byte{'\t'})
1157			if !ok || len(pathBytes) == 0 || !utf8.Valid(pathBytes) {
1158				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has an invalid path field", recordIndex))
1159				continue
1160			}
1161			fields := strings.Fields(string(header))
1162			if len(fields) != 4 || len(fields[0]) != 1 {
1163				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has an invalid header", recordIndex))
1164				continue
1165			}
1166			if _, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(fields[1], 8, 32); modeErr != nil {
1167				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d mode %q: %w", recordIndex, fields[1], modeErr))
1168				continue
1169			}
1170			stage, stageErr := strconv.Atoi(fields[3])
1171			if stageErr != nil || stage < 0 || stage > 3 {
1172				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has invalid stage %q", recordIndex, fields[3]))
1173				continue
1174			}
1175			tag := fields[0][0]
1176			upper := tag
1177			if upper >= 'a' && upper <= 'z' {
1178				upper -= 'a' - 'A'
1179			}
1180			entries = append(entries, RecoveryIndexEntry{
1181				Path: string(pathBytes), Mode: fields[1], OID: fields[2], Stage: stage, Tag: fields[0],
1182				AssumeUnchanged: tag >= 'a' && tag <= 'z', SkipWorktree: upper == 'S',
1183			})
1184		}
1185		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
1186			if entries[i].Path != entries[j].Path {
1187				return entries[i].Path < entries[j].Path
1188			}
1189			if entries[i].Stage != entries[j].Stage {
1190				return entries[i].Stage < entries[j].Stage
1191			}
1192			return entries[i].Mode < entries[j].Mode
1193		})
1194		return entries, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
1195	}

1247	func parseRecoveryStatus(output []byte) ([]RecoveryDirtyPath, []string, error) {
1248		records := recoveryNULRecords(output)
1249		dirty := []RecoveryDirtyPath{}
1250		untracked := []string{}
1251		var parseErrors []error
1252		for index := 0; index < len(records); index++ {
1253			record := string(records[index])
1254			if record == "" {
1255				continue
1256			}
1257			switch record[0] {
1258			case '1', '2':
1259				fields := strings.Fields(record)
1260				path := statusPath(record)
1261				if len(fields) < 2 || len(fields[1]) != 2 || path == "" {
1262					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("status record %d is malformed", index))
1263					continue
1264				}
1265				change := RecoveryDirtyPath{
1266					Path: path, Kind: "ordinary", IndexStatus: string(fields[1][0]), WorktreeStatus: string(fields[1][1]),
1267				}
1268				if record[0] == '2' {
1269					change.Kind = "rename-or-copy"
1270					if index+1 >= len(records) {
1271						parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("rename status record %d has no source path", index))
1272					} else {
1273						index++
1274						change.OldPath = string(records[index])
1275					}
1276				}
1277				dirty = append(dirty, change)
1278			case 'u':
1279				fields := strings.Fields(record)
1280				path := statusPath(record)
1281				if len(fields) < 2 || len(fields[1]) != 2 || path == "" {
1282					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("unmerged status record %d is malformed", index))
1283					continue
1284				}
1285				dirty = append(dirty, RecoveryDirtyPath{
1286					Path: path, Kind: "unmerged", IndexStatus: string(fields[1][0]), WorktreeStatus: string(fields[1][1]),
1287				})
1288			case '?':
1289				path := strings.TrimPrefix(record, "? ")
1290				if path == record || path == "" {
1291					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("untracked status record %d is malformed", index))
1292					continue
1293				}
1294				untracked = append(untracked, path)
1295			case '#':
1296				// Branch headers are allowed if a future caller adds --branch.
1297			default:
1298				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("unknown status record %d type %q", index, record[0]))
1299			}
1300		}
1301		sort.Slice(dirty, func(i, j int) bool {
1302			return strings.Join([]string{dirty[i].Path, dirty[i].OldPath, dirty[i].Kind}, "\x00") <
1303				strings.Join([]string{dirty[j].Path, dirty[j].OldPath, dirty[j].Kind}, "\x00")
1304		})
1305		sort.Strings(untracked)
1306		return dirty, untracked, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
1307	}

1536	func recoveryGit(ctx context.Context, dir string, input []byte, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
1537		if cause := context.Cause(ctx); cause != nil {
1538			return nil, cause
1539		}
1540		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
1541		command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
1542		command.Dir = dir
1543		command.Env = recoveryEnvironment()
1544		if input != nil {
1545			command.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(input)
1546		}
1547		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
1548		command.Stdout = &stdout
1549		command.Stderr = &stderr
1550		if err := command.Run(); err != nil {
1551			if cause := context.Cause(ctx); cause != nil {
1552				return stdout.Bytes(), cause
1553			}
1554			return stdout.Bytes(), &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
1555		}
1556		return stdout.Bytes(), nil
1557	}

5	// ReduceOutcomes combines independent requirements using the fail-closed
6	// precedence blocked > indeterminate > eligible > not-applicable. No evidence
7	// is itself indeterminate.
8	func ReduceOutcomes(outcomes ...Outcome) Outcome {
9		if len(outcomes) == 0 {
10			return OutcomeIndeterminate
11		}
12		result := OutcomeNotApplicable
13		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
14			switch outcome {
15			case OutcomeBlocked:
16				return OutcomeBlocked
17			case OutcomeIndeterminate:
18				result = OutcomeIndeterminate
19			case OutcomeEligible:
20				if result == OutcomeNotApplicable {
21					result = OutcomeEligible
22				}
23			case OutcomeNotApplicable:
24			default:
25				return OutcomeIndeterminate
26			}
27		}
28		return result
29	}
30
31	// Reduce applies source-quality policy after reducing requirement outcomes.
32	// Cheap reports retain the observed result for display. Deep reports downgrade
33	// any conclusive result to indeterminate unless every relied-on source is fresh,
34	// complete, and backed by a live authority.
35	func Reduce(profile Profile, sources []Source, outcomes ...Outcome) (Outcome, error) {
36		if err := profile.Validate(); err != nil {
37			return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
38		}
39		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
40			if err := outcome.Validate(); err != nil {
41				return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
42			}
43		}
44		for _, source := range sources {
45			if err := source.Validate(); err != nil {
46				return OutcomeIndeterminate, fmt.Errorf("reduce assessment source: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		result := ReduceOutcomes(outcomes...)
50		if result == OutcomeNotApplicable || result == OutcomeIndeterminate {
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		if len(sources) == 0 {
54			return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
55		}
56		if profile == ProfileDeep {
57			for _, source := range sources {
58				if !source.conclusive() {
59					return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
60				}
61			}
62		}
63		return result, nil
64	}
65

224	// NewReport constructs, canonicalizes, and seals a report.
225	func NewReport(profile Profile, generatedAt time.Time, gates []Gate) (Report, error) {
226		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Profile: profile, GeneratedAt: generatedAt, Gates: gates}
227		if err := report.Seal(); err != nil {
228			return Report{}, err
229		}
230		return report, nil
231	}

233	// Seal canonicalizes the report and records a fingerprint over every field
234	// except Fingerprint itself.
235	func (r *Report) Seal() error {
236		if r == nil {
237			return errors.New("seal nil assessment report")
238		}
239		if r.SchemaVersion == 0 {
240			r.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
241		}
242		canonical := r.Canonical()
243		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
244		if err := canonical.validateContent(); err != nil {
245			return err
246		}
247		fingerprint, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
248		if err != nil {
249			return err
250		}
251		canonical.Fingerprint = fingerprint
252		*r = canonical
253		return nil
254	}
255
256	// Validate verifies the schema, policy invariants, canonical fingerprint, and
257	// deterministic ordering of a sealed report.
258	func (r Report) Validate() error {
259		if err := r.validateContent(); err != nil {
260			return err
261		}
262		if !ValidFingerprint(r.Fingerprint) {
263			return fmt.Errorf("invalid report fingerprint %q", r.Fingerprint)
264		}
265		canonical := r.Canonical()
266		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
267		want, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		if r.Fingerprint != want {
272			return fmt.Errorf("assessment fingerprint mismatch: got %s, want %s", r.Fingerprint, want)
273		}
274		if !reportsEqualOrdering(r, r.Canonical()) {
275			return errors.New("assessment report is not in canonical order")
276		}
277		return nil
278	}

280	func (r Report) validateContent() error {
281		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
282			return fmt.Errorf("assessment schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
283		}
284		if err := r.Profile.Validate(); err != nil {
285			return err
286		}
287		if r.GeneratedAt.IsZero() {
288			return errors.New("assessment generated_at is required")
289		}
290		seenGates := make(map[string]struct{}, len(r.Gates))
291		for _, gate := range r.Gates {
292			if err := gate.Validate(r.Profile); err != nil {
293				return err
294			}
295			if _, exists := seenGates[gate.Code]; exists {
296				return fmt.Errorf("assessment repeats gate %q", gate.Code)
297			}
298			seenGates[gate.Code] = struct{}{}
299		}
300		return nil
301	}

303	// Canonical returns a deep copy with UTC timestamps and order-insensitive
304	// collections sorted by their complete stable representation.
305	func (r Report) Canonical() Report {
306		result := r
307		result.GeneratedAt = canonicalTime(result.GeneratedAt)
308		result.Gates = make([]Gate, len(r.Gates))
309		copy(result.Gates, r.Gates)
310		for gateIndex := range result.Gates {
311			gate := &result.Gates[gateIndex]
312			gate.Sources = append([]Source(nil), gate.Sources...)
313			for sourceIndex := range gate.Sources {
314				gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt = canonicalTime(gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt)
315			}
316			sort.Slice(gate.Sources, func(i, j int) bool {
317				left, right := gate.Sources[i], gate.Sources[j]
318				return strings.Join([]string{left.ID, string(left.Authority), string(left.Freshness), string(left.Completeness), left.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), left.Fingerprint}, "\x00") <
319					strings.Join([]string{right.ID, string(right.Authority), string(right.Freshness), string(right.Completeness), right.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), right.Fingerprint}, "\x00")
320			})
321			gate.Reasons = append([]Reason(nil), gate.Reasons...)
322			sort.Slice(gate.Reasons, func(i, j int) bool {
323				left, right := gate.Reasons[i], gate.Reasons[j]
324				return strings.Join([]string{left.Code, left.Subject, left.Detail, left.Remediation}, "\x00") <
325					strings.Join([]string{right.Code, right.Subject, right.Detail, right.Remediation}, "\x00")
326			})
327		}
328		sort.Slice(result.Gates, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Gates[i].Code < result.Gates[j].Code })
329		return result
330	}

332	func (r Report) computeFingerprint() (string, error) {
333		payload := struct {
334			SchemaVersion int       `json:"schema_version"`
335			Profile       Profile   `json:"profile"`
336			GeneratedAt   time.Time `json:"generated_at"`
337			Gates         []Gate    `json:"gates"`
338		}{r.SchemaVersion, r.Profile, r.GeneratedAt, r.Gates}
339		encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
340		if err != nil {
341			return "", fmt.Errorf("encode assessment fingerprint: %w", err)
342		}
343		return FingerprintBytes(encoded), nil
344	}
345
346	// Decode reads exactly one strict schema-v1 report and verifies its seal.
347	func Decode(reader io.Reader) (Report, error) {
348		if reader == nil {
349			return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment from nil reader")
350		}
351		decoder := json.NewDecoder(reader)
352		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
353		var report Report
354		if err := decoder.Decode(&report); err != nil {
355			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment: %w", err)
356		}
357		var extra any
358		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
359			if err == nil {
360				return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment: multiple JSON values")
361			}
362			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment trailing data: %w", err)
363		}
364		if err := report.Validate(); err != nil {
365			return Report{}, err
366		}
367		return report, nil
368	}
369
370	func FingerprintBytes(value []byte) string {
371		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
372		return fingerprintPrefix + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
373	}
374
375	func ValidFingerprint(value string) bool {
376		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix) || len(value) != len(fingerprintPrefix)+sha256.Size*2 {
377			return false
378		}
379		digest := strings.TrimPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix)
380		if digest != strings.ToLower(digest) {
381			return false
382		}
383		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(digest)
384		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size
385	}
386
387	func validateText(name, value string, required bool) error {
388		if value == "" {
389			if required {
390				return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
391			}
392			return nil
393		}
394		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
395			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
396		}
397		if value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
398			return fmt.Errorf("%s must be trimmed", name)
399		}
400		for _, char := range value {
401			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
402				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
403			}
404		}
405		return nil
406	}
407
408	func canonicalTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
409		if value.IsZero() {
410			return value
411		}
412		return value.Round(0).UTC()
413	}
414
415	func reportsEqualOrdering(left, right Report) bool {
416		leftJSON, leftErr := json.Marshal(left)
417		rightJSON, rightErr := json.Marshal(right)
418		return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && string(leftJSON) == string(rightJSON)
419	}

12	// Readiness is one cheap, local-only context projection. It intentionally
13	// carries no authority to mutate; the full Report binds the same result to
14	// point-in-time evidence sources.
15	type Readiness struct {
16		Outcome assessment.Outcome
17		Reasons []assessment.Reason
18	}
19
20	// LocalReadiness keeps independently actionable checkout, task, and worktree
21	// scopes separate. There is deliberately no global safe boolean.
22	type LocalReadiness struct {
23		Checkout Readiness
24		Task     Readiness
25		Worktree Readiness
26	}
27
28	// Summary is the compact status/TUI projection.
29	func (r LocalReadiness) Summary() string {
30		return strings.Join([]string{
31			"checkout " + string(r.Checkout.Outcome),
32			"task " + string(r.Task.Outcome),
33			"worktree " + string(r.Worktree.Outcome),
34		}, " · ")
35	}

37	// AssessLocal derives readiness from facts already collected by inventory. It
38	// does not run Git, inspect a runtime, or contact a forge/fleet host.
39	func AssessLocal(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) LocalReadiness {
40		return LocalReadiness{
41			Checkout: assessCheckout(context, selectedIndex),
42			Task:     assessTasks(context, selectedIndex, hostname),
43			Worktree: assessWorktrees(context, selectedIndex),
44		}
45	}
46
47	func assessCheckout(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
48		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
49			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the selected checkout is absent from the local inventory", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
50		}
51		checkout := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex]
52		switch {
53		case checkout.Worktree.Bare || context.Repo.Bare:
54			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
55		case checkout.PathErr != nil:
56			return indeterminate("checkout-path-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path could not be inspected", "restore path access and rerun context")
57		case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
58			return blocked("checkout-missing", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path is missing or prunable", "repair or remove the stale worktree registration")
59		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
60			return indeterminate("checkout-status-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "Git status could not be collected", "repair the checkout and rerun context")
61		case checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached || checkout.Branch() == "":
62			return blocked("checkout-detached", "selected-checkout", "the checkout does not have an attached branch", "check out an explicit branch")
63		case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
64			return blocked("checkout-conflicted", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d unmerged path(s)", checkout.Status.Conflicted), "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement")
65		case checkout.Status.Dirty():
66			return blocked("checkout-dirty", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d changed path(s)", checkout.Status.Changed), "commit or deliberately preserve the changes")
67		default:
68			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
69		}
70	}
71
72	func assessTasks(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) Readiness {
73		if context.TaskErr != nil {
74			return indeterminate("task-inventory-unavailable", "task-inventory", "task records could not be collected", "repair the task store and rerun context")
75		}
76		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
77			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "task scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
78		}
79		// Transfer/repository readiness covers every non-DONE task attached to the
80		// clone, including cold and branch-only records without a local checkout.
81		// Looking only at the selected checkout can otherwise hide another machine's
82		// ownership claim and incorrectly report not-applicable.
83		active := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(context.OtherTasks)+len(context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Tasks))
84		sessionCount := map[string]int{}
85		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
86		add := func(candidate *task.Task, sessions int) {
87			if candidate == nil || candidate.State == task.Done {
88				return
89			}
90			if _, exists := seen[candidate.ID]; exists {
91				return
92			}
93			seen[candidate.ID] = struct{}{}
94			active = append(active, candidate)
95			sessionCount[candidate.ID] = sessions
96		}
97		for _, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
98			for _, candidate := range checkout.Tasks {
99				add(candidate, len(checkout.Sessions))
100			}
101		}
102		for _, candidate := range context.OtherTasks {
103			add(candidate, 0)
104		}
105		if len(active) == 0 {
106			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
107		}
108		var reasons []assessment.Reason
109		hasIndeterminate := false
110		for _, candidate := range active {
111			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
112				hasIndeterminate = true
113				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
114					Code: "task-record-invalid", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task record is invalid",
115					Remediation: "repair or recreate the task record",
116				})
117				continue
118			}
119			if hostname != "" && candidate.Owner != "" && candidate.Owner != hostname {
120				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
121					Code: "task-owned-elsewhere", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task is owned by another machine",
122					Remediation: "complete an explicit ownership handoff before writing",
123				})
124			}
125			if candidate.State == task.Hot {
126				if context.RuntimeErr != nil {
127					hasIndeterminate = true
128					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
129						Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task cannot be checked against live runtime state",
130						Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
131					})
132				} else if sessionCount[candidate.ID] == 0 {
133					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
134						Code: "hot-task-runtime-missing", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task has no observed runtime session",
135						Remediation: "resume the task or reconcile its lifecycle state",
136					})
137				}
138			}
139		}
140		if hasReason(reasons, "task-owned-elsewhere") || hasReason(reasons, "hot-task-runtime-missing") {
141			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
142		}
143		if hasIndeterminate {
144			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
145		}
146		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
147	}
148
149	func assessWorktrees(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
150		if context.WorktreeErr != nil {
151			return indeterminate("worktree-inventory-unavailable", "worktrees", "linked worktrees could not be enumerated", "repair Git worktree metadata and rerun context")
152		}
153		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
154			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "worktree scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
155		}
156		indices := []int{}
157		if selectedIndex > 0 {
158			indices = append(indices, selectedIndex)
159		} else {
160			for index := 1; index < len(context.Checkouts); index++ {
161				indices = append(indices, index)
162			}
163		}
164		if len(indices) == 0 {
165			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
166		}
167		var reasons []assessment.Reason
168		hasUnknown := context.RuntimeErr != nil
169		if hasUnknown {
170			reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
171				Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "worktrees",
172				Detail:      "worktree runtime coverage could not be collected",
173				Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
174			})
175		}
176		for _, index := range indices {
177			checkout := context.Checkouts[index]
178			subject := fmt.Sprintf("worktree:%d", index)
179			switch {
180			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
181				hasUnknown = true
182				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-path-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path could not be inspected", Remediation: "restore path access and rerun context"})
183			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
184				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-missing", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path is missing or prunable", Remediation: "repair or remove the stale worktree registration"})
185			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
186				hasUnknown = true
187				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-status-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "Git status could not be collected for the worktree", Remediation: "repair the worktree and rerun context"})
188			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
189				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-locked", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree is locked", Remediation: "verify the lock owner before unlocking it"})
190			case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
191				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-conflicted", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree has unmerged paths", Remediation: "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement"})
192			case checkout.Status.Dirty():
193				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-dirty", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree contains uncommitted changes", Remediation: "commit or deliberately preserve the changes"})
194			case len(checkout.Sessions) > 0:
195				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-runtime-live", Subject: subject, Detail: "a runtime session still covers the worktree", Remediation: "quiesce and close the runtime before retirement"})
196			}
197		}
198		if len(reasons) == 0 {
199			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
200		}
201		if hasKnownBlocker(reasons) {
202			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
203		}
204		if hasUnknown {
205			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
206		}
207		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
208	}
209
210	func blocked(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
211		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
212	}
213
214	func indeterminate(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
215		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
216	}
217
218	func hasReason(reasons []assessment.Reason, code string) bool {
219		for _, reason := range reasons {
220			if reason.Code == code {
221				return true
222			}
223		}
224		return false
225	}
226
227	func hasKnownBlocker(reasons []assessment.Reason) bool {
228		for _, reason := range reasons {
229			switch reason.Code {
230			case "worktree-missing", "worktree-locked", "worktree-conflicted", "worktree-dirty", "worktree-runtime-live":
231				return true
232			}
233		}
234		return false
235	}
236

301	// Build joins live local facts with optional external observations. It performs
302	// no probes and never places raw Git endpoints in the returned report.
303	func Build(input BuildInput) (Report, error) {
304		now := input.GeneratedAt
305		if now.IsZero() {
306			now = time.Now().UTC()
307		}
308		now = now.Round(0).UTC()
309
310		report := Report{
311			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion,
312			GeneratedAt:   now,
313			Repository: Repository{

357			readinessGate("task-readiness", readiness.Task, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.tasks", "local.runtime")),
358			readinessGate("worktree-readiness", readiness.Worktree, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.worktrees", "local.runtime")),
359			{

369		if err != nil {
370			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("seal repository context assessment: %w", err)
371		}
372		report.Assessment = assessmentReport

374		sort.Slice(report.Errors, func(i, j int) bool {
375			left, right := report.Errors[i], report.Errors[j]
376			return strings.Join([]string{left.Scope, left.Code, left.Subject, left.Message}, "\x00") <
377				strings.Join([]string{right.Scope, right.Code, right.Subject, right.Message}, "\x00")
378		})

382	func buildLocalFacts(input BuildInput, reportErrors *[]CollectionError) LocalFacts {
383		context := input.Context
384		local := LocalFacts{
385			Checkouts:                          make([]CheckoutFacts, 0, len(context.Checkouts)),
386			OtherTasks:                         []TaskFacts{},
387			ObservedLinkedWorktreeAdminEntries: context.WorktreeCount,
388			CheckoutsComplete:                  context.WorktreeErr == nil,
389			TaskInventoryComplete:              context.TaskErr == nil,
390			Runtimes:                           []RuntimeFacts{},
391		}
392		if context.WorktreeErr == nil {
393			count := context.WorktreeCount
394			local.LinkedWorktreeCount = &count
395		} else {
396			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("worktree-inventory-failed", "local", "worktrees", context.WorktreeErr))
397		}
398		if context.TaskErr != nil {
399			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-inventory-failed", "local", "tasks", context.TaskErr))
400		}
401
402		for index, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
403			facts := CheckoutFacts{
404				Index: index, Path: checkout.Worktree.Path, Canonical: index == 0,
405				Ownership: checkout.Ownership, Locked: checkout.Worktree.Locked,
406				LockedReason:   optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)),
407				Prunable:       checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
408				PrunableReason: optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)),
409				Branch:         optionalString(checkout.Branch()), Head: optionalString(checkout.Worktree.Head),
410				LastActivity: optionalTime(checkout.LastActivity), LastCommit: optionalTime(checkout.LastCommit),
411				LastSubject: optionalString(checkout.LastSubject), Sessions: []RuntimeSession{}, Tasks: []TaskFacts{},
412			}
413			switch {
414			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
415				facts.State = "error"
416				facts.PathError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.PathErr))
417				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-path-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.PathErr))
418			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
419				facts.State = "missing"
420				exists := false
421				facts.Exists = &exists
422			case checkout.Worktree.Bare || index == 0 && context.Repo.Bare:
423				facts.State = "bare"
424				exists := true
425				facts.Exists = &exists
426				detached := false
427				facts.Detached = &detached
428			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
429				facts.State = "error"
430				exists := true
431				facts.Exists = &exists
432				facts.StatusError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.StatusErr))
433				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-status-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.StatusErr))
434			default:
435				facts.State = "available"
436				exists := true
437				facts.Exists = &exists
438				status := checkout.Status
439				facts.Status = &status
440				detached := checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached
441				facts.Detached = &detached
442			}
443			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
444				facts.Tasks = append(facts.Tasks, taskFacts(tracked))
445				if tracked != nil {
446					if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
447						*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
448					}
449				}
450			}
451			local.Checkouts = append(local.Checkouts, facts)
452		}
453		for _, tracked := range context.OtherTasks {
454			local.OtherTasks = append(local.OtherTasks, taskFacts(tracked))
455			if tracked != nil {
456				if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
457					*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
458				}
459			}
460		}
461
462		runtimes := input.Runtimes
463		if len(runtimes) == 0 && (context.Runtime != "" || context.RuntimeErr != nil || len(context.Sessions()) > 0) {
464			runtimes = []RuntimeInput{{
465				Backend: context.Runtime, Available: context.RuntimeErr == nil,
466				Sessions: context.Sessions(), Err: context.RuntimeErr,
467			}}
468		}
469		for runtimeIndex, observed := range runtimes {
470			backend := strings.TrimSpace(observed.Backend)
471			if backend == "" {
472				backend = fmt.Sprintf("unknown-%d", runtimeIndex+1)
473			}
474			runtimeFacts := RuntimeFacts{
475				Backend: backend, Available: observed.Available,
476				SourceID: "local.runtime", Sessions: []RuntimeSession{},
477			}
478			if observed.Err != nil {
479				runtimeFacts.Error = optionalString(cleanError(observed.Err))
480				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("runtime-inventory-failed", "local", "runtime:"+safeIdentifier(backend), observed.Err))
481			}
482			for _, session := range observed.Sessions {
483				indices := sessionCheckoutIndices(context, session)
484				if len(indices) == 0 {
485					continue
486				}
487				projected := RuntimeSession{
488					Backend: backend, Handle: session.Handle, Label: optionalString(session.Label),
489					AgentStatus:   optionalString(session.AgentStatus),
490					AgentSessions: append([]string{}, session.AgentSessions...),
491					Focused:       session.Focused, Checkouts: indices,
492				}
493				sort.Strings(projected.AgentSessions)
494				runtimeFacts.Sessions = append(runtimeFacts.Sessions, projected)
495				for _, checkoutIndex := range indices {
496					if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(local.Checkouts) {
497						local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions = append(local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions, projected)
498					}
499				}
500			}
501			sortRuntimeSessions(runtimeFacts.Sessions)
502			local.Runtimes = append(local.Runtimes, runtimeFacts)
503		}
504		sort.Slice(local.Runtimes, func(i, j int) bool { return local.Runtimes[i].Backend < local.Runtimes[j].Backend })
505		for index := range local.Checkouts {
506			sortRuntimeSessions(local.Checkouts[index].Sessions)
507		}
508		return local
509	}

585	func buildRemoteEndpoint(raw string, records map[string][]forge.RemoteRepo, forgeAvailable, exactForge bool) (RemoteEndpoint, []string, *endpointBuildError) {
586		transport, displayIdentity, displayOK := publicEndpointIdentity(raw)
587		forgeMatch := "unavailable"
588		if forgeAvailable {
589			forgeMatch = "none"
590		}
591		endpoint := RemoteEndpoint{Transport: transport, Identity: optionalString(displayIdentity), ForgeMatch: forgeMatch}
592		privateIdentity := privateRemoteIdentity(raw)
593		if !displayOK {
594			message := "endpoint has no display-safe cross-host identity"
595			endpoint.Error = &message
596			return endpoint, nil, &endpointBuildError{Code: "remote-identity-unavailable", Message: message}
597		}
598
599		candidates := dedupeForgeRecords(records[privateIdentity])
600		var exact *forge.RemoteRepo
601		matched := []string{}
602		switch len(candidates) {
603		case 1:
604			if exactForge {
605				exact = &candidates[0]
606			}
607			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "exact"
608			matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidates[0]))
609		case 0:
610			if forgeAvailable {
611				endpoint.ForgeMatch = "none"
612			}
613		default:
614			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "ambiguous"
615			message := fmt.Sprintf("normalized endpoint identity matches %d forge records", len(candidates))
616			endpoint.Error = &message
617			for _, candidate := range candidates {
618				matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidate))
619			}
620			if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw}); ok {
621				endpoint.WebURL = &web
622			}
623			return endpoint, matched, &endpointBuildError{Code: "forge-match-ambiguous", Message: message}
624		}
625		if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw, Exact: exact}); ok {
626			endpoint.WebURL = &web
627		}
628		return endpoint, matched, nil
629	}

631	func buildFleetFacts(now time.Time, input FleetInput, localIdentities map[string]struct{}, reportErrors []CollectionError) (FleetFacts, []CollectionError) {
632		facts := FleetFacts{Coverage: FleetCoverageConfiguredHostsOnly, Hosts: []FleetHostObservation{}, Error: optionalError(input.Err)}
633		if !input.Configured {
634			if input.Err == nil {
635				facts.Error = optionalString("fleet configuration was not collected")
636			}
637			if facts.Error != nil {
638				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-config-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "configuration", Message: *facts.Error})
639			}
640			return facts, reportErrors
641		}
642		count := len(input.ConfiguredHostNames)
643		facts.ConfiguredHosts = &count
644		results := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
645		for _, result := range input.Results {
646			if _, exists := results[result.Name]; !exists {
647				results[result.Name] = result
648			}
649		}
650		for index, name := range input.ConfiguredHostNames {
651			result, found := results[name]
652			if !found {
653				result = fleet.HostResult{Name: name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "configured host produced no observation"}
654			}
655			host := FleetHostObservation{
656				Name: name, State: result.State, CachedAt: optionalTimeValue(result.CachedAt),
657				Match: FleetMatchUnavailable, Repositories: []FleetRepository{}, Error: optionalString(cleanText(result.Error)),
658			}
659			if result.Snapshot != nil {
660				matches := matchingFleetRepositories(result.Snapshot.Repositories, localIdentities)
661				for _, matched := range matches {
662					host.Repositories = append(host.Repositories, fleetRepositoryFacts(matched))
663				}
664				switch {
665				case len(localIdentities) == 0:
666					host.Match = FleetMatchUnavailable
667					if host.Error == nil {
668						host.Error = optionalString("local repository has no normalized remote identity")
669					}
670				case len(matches) == 0:
671					host.Match = FleetMatchNotFound
672				case len(matches) == 1:
673					host.Match = FleetMatchExact
674				default:
675					host.Match = FleetMatchAmbiguous
676					message := fmt.Sprintf("%d repositories on this host share a local normalized remote identity", len(matches))
677					if host.Error == nil {
678						host.Error = &message
679					}
680					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-match-ambiguous", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: message})
681				}
682
683				observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
684				if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
685					observedAt = *result.CachedAt
686				}
687				if !observedAt.IsZero() {
688					sourceID := fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index)
689					host.SourceID = &sourceID
690				}
691			}
692			if result.Error != "" || result.Snapshot == nil {
693				message := result.Error
694				if message == "" {
695					message = "host produced no repository snapshot"
696				}
697				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-host-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: cleanText(message)})
698			}
699			facts.Hosts = append(facts.Hosts, host)
700		}
701		return facts, reportErrors
702	}

732			Count     *int            `json:"count"`

735
736		runtimeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete

743			}
744		}
745		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.runtime", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, runtimeCompleteness, now, now, report.Local.Runtimes))

747		remoteCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete

753		if input.Fleet.Configured {

755		}
756		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
757			freshness := input.Forge.Freshness
758			if freshness == "" {
759				freshness = assessment.FreshnessUnknown
760			}
761			completeness := input.Forge.Completeness
762			if completeness == "" {
763				completeness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
764			}
765			sources = append(sources, newSource("forge.inventory", input.Forge.Authority, freshness, completeness, input.Forge.ObservedAt, now, struct {
766				Remotes []Remote   `json:"remotes"`
767				Forge   ForgeFacts `json:"forge"`
768			}{report.Remotes, report.Forge}))
769		}
770		resultByName := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
771		for _, result := range input.Fleet.Results {
772			resultByName[result.Name] = result
773		}
774		for index, name := range input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames {
775			result, ok := resultByName[name]
776			if !ok || result.Snapshot == nil || index >= len(report.Fleet.Hosts) {
777				continue
778			}
779			observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
780			if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
781				observedAt = *result.CachedAt
782			}
783			if observedAt.IsZero() {
784				continue
785			}
786			authority := assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive
787			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
788			if result.FromCache {

790				if input.Fleet.CacheTTL > 0 && now.Sub(observedAt) > input.Fleet.CacheTTL {

797			}
798			sources = append(sources, newSource(fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index), authority, freshness, completeness, observedAt, now, report.Fleet.Hosts[index]))
799		}

801		return sources
802	}

969	func publicEndpointIdentity(raw string) (transport, identity string, ok bool) {
970		if !utf8.ValidString(raw) || containsControl(raw) {
971			return "unknown", "", false
972		}
973		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
974		if trimmed == "" {
975			return "unknown", "", false
976		}
977		redacted := trimmed
978		if parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
979			transport = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
980			parsed.User = nil
981			parsed.RawQuery = ""
982			parsed.ForceQuery = false
983			parsed.Fragment = ""
984			redacted = parsed.String()
985		} else {
986			if index := strings.IndexAny(redacted, "?#"); index >= 0 {
987				redacted = redacted[:index]
988			}
989			colon := strings.IndexByte(redacted, ':')
990			at := strings.LastIndexByte(redacted, '@')
991			if at >= 0 && colon > at {
992				transport = "ssh"
993				redacted = "git@" + redacted[at+1:]
994			} else if filepath.IsAbs(redacted) || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, "~") {
995				transport = "local"
996			} else {
997				transport = "unknown"
998			}
999		}
1000		identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(redacted)
1001		if identity == "" || containsControl(identity) {
1002			return transport, "", false
1003		}
1004		return transport, identity, true
1005	}

1118	// cleanText removes controls and structurally redacts URL/scp-like tokens while
1119	// preserving enough of an error to diagnose which probe failed.
1120	func cleanText(value string) string {
1121		value = strings.Map(func(r rune) rune {
1122			if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
1123				return ' '
1124			}
1125			return r
1126		}, value)
1127		fields := strings.Fields(value)
1128		for index, field := range fields {
1129			fields[index] = redactTextToken(field)
1130		}
1131		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(fields, " "))
1132	}

1134	func redactTextToken(token string) string {
1135		prefix := strings.TrimLeft(token, "([{<\"'")
1136		leading := token[:len(token)-len(prefix)]
1137		core := strings.TrimRight(prefix, ")]}>\"',;.")
1138		trailing := prefix[len(core):]
1139		if parsed, err := url.Parse(core); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
1140			parsed.User = nil
1141			parsed.RawQuery = ""
1142			parsed.ForceQuery = false
1143			parsed.Fragment = ""
1144			return leading + parsed.String() + trailing
1145		}
1146		colon := strings.IndexByte(core, ':')
1147		at := strings.LastIndexByte(core, '@')
1148		if at > 0 && colon > at {
1149			core = "[redacted]@" + core[at+1:]
1150			if query := strings.IndexAny(core, "?#"); query >= 0 {
1151				core = core[:query]
1152			}
1153		}
1154		return leading + core + trailing
1155	}
1156
1157	func containsControl(value string) bool {
1158		return strings.IndexFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
1159			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
1160		}) >= 0
1161	}
1162
1163	func safeIdentifier(value string) string {
1164		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
1165		var b strings.Builder
1166		lastDash := false
1167		for _, r := range value {
1168			if r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' {
1169				b.WriteRune(r)
1170				lastDash = false
1171			} else if !lastDash {
1172				b.WriteByte('-')
1173				lastDash = true
1174			}
1175		}
1176		result := strings.Trim(b.String(), "-")
1177		if result == "" {
1178			return "unknown"
1179		}
1180		return result
1181	}

83	// collectLocalRepoContext is the single CLI collector used by repo context and
84	// status. It executes only local Git/task/runtime probes; includeTopology adds
85	// repository-wide remote/ref facts but never performs fetch or other network I/O.
86	func collectLocalRepoContext(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, selectedPath string, includeTopology bool) localRepoContext {
87		var (
88			tasks    = []*task.Task{}
89			tasksErr error
90		)
91		if app.Tasks == nil {
92			tasksErr = errors.New("task store is unavailable")
93		} else {
94			listed, diagnostics, err := app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
95			if err != nil {
96				tasksErr = err
97			} else {
98				tasks = tasksForRepo(listed, repository)
99				for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
100					tasksErr = errors.Join(tasksErr, diagnostic)
101				}
102			}
103		}
104
105		rt := app.Runtime()
106		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
107		local := localRepoContext{
108			Context: inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, repository, tasks, sessions, rt.Name()),
109			Runtimes: []repocontext.RuntimeInput{{
110				Backend: rt.Name(), Available: rt.Available(), Sessions: sessions, Err: runtimeErr,
111			}},
112			SelectedCheckout: -1,
113		}
114		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
115		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
116		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
117			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
118		} else {
119			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
120		}
121		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
122			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
123		}
124		return local
125	}

185		if collectionErr == nil {
186			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
187				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
188				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
189				Records: records,
190			}
191		}
192		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
193			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
194			if len(records) > 0 {
195				cached.Records = records
196			}
197			return cached
198		}
199		if len(records) > 0 {
200			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
201				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
202				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
203				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
204			}
205		}
206		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
207	}
208
209	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
210		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
211			return true
212		}
213		if ttl <= 0 {
214			return false
215		}
216		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
217	}
218
219	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
220		var providerErrors []error
221		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
222		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
223		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
224			name := string(kind)
225			kinds = append(kinds, name)
226			byKind[name] = status
227		}
228		sort.Strings(kinds)
229		for _, kind := range kinds {
230			status := byKind[kind]
231			if status.Error != "" {
232				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
233			} else if !status.Complete {
234				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
235			}
236		}
237		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
238	}
239
240	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
241		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
242		if err != nil {
243			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
244		}
245		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
246			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
247			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
248			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
249		}
250		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
251			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
252		}
253		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
254			return input
255		}
256		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
257		if parallel <= 0 {
258			parallel = 1
259		}
260		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
261		var wait sync.WaitGroup
262		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
263			wait.Add(1)
264			go func() {
265				defer wait.Done()
266				semaphore <- struct{}{}
267				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
268				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
269			}()
270		}
271		wait.Wait()
272		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
273			input.Err = err
274		}
275		return input
276	}

8	// FormatMarkdown extends the legacy deterministic handoff with additive safe

11	func FormatMarkdown(report Report, legacy string) string {

24

26		for _, gate := range report.Assessment.Gates {

28			if len(gate.Reasons) > 0 {
29				fmt.Fprintf(&b, " — %s", gate.Reasons[0].Detail)
30			}
31			b.WriteString("\n")
32		}
33

35		if len(report.Remotes) == 0 {

37		}

40			if len(remote.Roles) > 0 {

42				for index, role := range remote.Roles {
43					roles[index] = string(role)
44				}
45				fmt.Fprintf(&b, " — %s", strings.Join(roles, ", "))
46			}
47			b.WriteString("\n")
48			writeEndpoints(&b, "fetch", remote.Fetch)
49			writeEndpoints(&b, "push", remote.Push)
50		}
51
52		b.WriteString("\n## Fleet observations\n\n")
53		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Coverage: **%s**\n", report.Fleet.Coverage)
54		if report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts == nil {
55			b.WriteString("- Configured hosts: unavailable\n")
56		} else {
57			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Configured hosts: %d\n", *report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts)
58		}
59		if len(report.Fleet.Hosts) == 0 && report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts != nil && *report.Fleet.ConfiguredHosts == 0 {

70					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "; %s (%s, %s old)", source.Authority, source.Freshness, humanAge(source.AgeSeconds))
71				}
72			}

74				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "; `%s` on `%s`", host.Repositories[0].Display, host.Repositories[0].Path)
75			} else if len(host.Repositories) > 1 {
76				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "; %d exact-identity candidates", len(host.Repositories))
77			}

93	func writeEndpoints(b *strings.Builder, kind string, endpoints []RemoteEndpoint) {
94		if len(endpoints) == 0 {
95			fmt.Fprintf(b, "\n- %s: unavailable\n", kind)
96			return
97		}
98		for _, endpoint := range endpoints {
99			fmt.Fprintf(b, "\n- %s: ", kind)
100			if endpoint.Identity != nil {
101				fmt.Fprintf(b, "`%s`", *endpoint.Identity)
102			} else {
103				b.WriteString("unavailable")
104			}
105			if endpoint.WebURL != nil {
106				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s (%s, %s)", endpoint.WebURL.URL, endpoint.WebURL.Provider, endpoint.WebURL.Source)
107			}
108			if endpoint.Error != nil {
109				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", *endpoint.Error)
110			}
111			b.WriteString("\n")
112		}
113	}
114
115	func humanAge(seconds int64) string {
116		switch {
117		case seconds < 60:
118			return fmt.Sprintf("%ds", seconds)
119		case seconds < 3600:
120			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", seconds/60)
121		case seconds < 86400:
122			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", seconds/3600)
123		default:
124			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", seconds/86400)
125		}
126	}

58	func (e *ImportConflictError) Error() string {

200	// ValidateID checks that id can be used as exactly one visible filename stem.
201	func ValidateID(id string) error {
202		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {

208	// NormalizeTags trims, lowercases, deduplicates and sorts tags. Sorting makes
209	// persisted output deterministic regardless of the order in which callers add
210	// labels.
211	func NormalizeTags(tags []string) []string {
212		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(tags))
213		for _, tag := range tags {
214			tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
215			if tag != "" {
216				seen[tag] = struct{}{}
217			}
218		}
219		out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
220		for tag := range seen {
221			out = append(out, tag)
222		}
223		sort.Strings(out)
224		return out
225	}

227	// Normalize applies the lossless normalizations stores use before validation.

229		if e == nil {
230			return
231		}
232		e.Name = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
233		e.Tags = NormalizeTags(e.Tags)
234		e.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RemoteIdentity)
235		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
236			e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity)
237		}
238	}

406	func validateLocationValue(host string, location Location, requireUpdated bool) error {
407		if err := validateHostValue("location host", host); err != nil {
408			return err
409		}
410		fields := []struct {
411			name  string
412			value string
413		}{
414			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
415			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
416			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
417			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
418		}
419		for _, field := range fields {
420			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
421				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
422			}
423		}
424		if requireUpdated && location.Updated.IsZero() {
425			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: updated timestamp is required", host)
426		}
427		switch location.State {
428		case LocationPresent:
429			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
430				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
431			}
432		case LocationArchived:
433			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
434				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
435			}
436		case LocationEvicted:
437			if location.RestorePath == "" {
438				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
439			}
440		default:
441			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
442		}
443		return nil
444	}

487		if err := validateStringFields("move intent", []struct {
488			name  string
489			value string
490		}{
491			{"operation", intent.Operation},
492			{"source_path", intent.SourcePath},
493			{"destination_path", intent.DestinationPath},
494		}); err != nil {
495			return err
496		}
497		if filepath.Clean(intent.SourcePath) == filepath.Clean(intent.DestinationPath) {
498			return errors.New("move intent source and destination are identical")
499		}
500		return nil
501	}

503	func validateHostValue(name, host string) error {
504		if host == "" {
505			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
506		}

519				return fmt.Errorf("%s %s contains NUL", scope, field.name)

112	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
113	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
114	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
115	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
116		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
117		if err != nil {
118			return nil, err
119		}
120		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
121			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
122		}
123
124		r.mu.Lock()
125		defer r.mu.Unlock()
126		var result *Entry
127		err = r.store.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
128			matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
129			if matchErr == nil {
130				result, matchErr = r.attachUnderLock(matched.ID, normalized)
131				return matchErr

134				return matchErr

137			entry := &Entry{
138				Kind:           KindRepository,
139				Name:           normalized.Name,
140				RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
141				Locations: map[string]Location{
142					normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
143				},

147			}

149			return nil
150		})

181	func (r *Registry) attachUnderLock(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
