245	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
246		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
247		if err != nil {
248			return nil, matchNone, err
249		}
250		if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
251			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
252			entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
253			return entry, matchExact, err
254		}
255		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
256			return nil, matchNone, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
257		}
258		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
259			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
260		}
261
262		var remoteMatches []*Entry
263		for _, entry := range entries {
264			if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
265				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
266			}
267		}
268		Sort(remoteMatches)
269		switch len(remoteMatches) {
270		case 0:
271			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
272		case 1:
273			if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
274				return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
275			}
276			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
277				"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
278		default:
279			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
280				"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
281		}
282	}

291	func incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics []Diagnostic) error {

294		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {

300	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
301		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
302		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
303		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
304		for _, entry := range entries {
305			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
306			if !ok {
307				continue
308			}
309			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
310			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
311			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
312			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
313				matched[entry.ID] = entry
314			}
315		}
316		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
317		for _, entry := range matched {
318			out = append(out, entry)
319		}
320		Sort(out)
321		return out
322	}

324	func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {

327			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
328		case 1:
329			return matches[0], nil
330		default:
331			return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
332		}

344	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
345		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
346		if !ok {
347			return true
348		}
349		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
350		// A navigation symlink may disappear while its physical clone or Git common
351		// directory remains, so every stored identity path must be absent before the
352		// remote can be treated as relocation evidence. Archives also deliberately
353		// block relocation while their bytes remain.
354		for _, path := range []string{
355			location.CurrentPath,
356			location.RestorePath,
357			location.RealPath,
358			location.GitCommonDir,
359		} {
360			if path == "" {
361				continue
362			}
363			if pathMayStillExist(path) {
364				return false
365			}
366		}
367		return true
368	}
369
370	func pathMayStillExist(path string) bool {
371		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
372			// Lstat deliberately counts a dangling symlink as existing evidence.
373			return true
374		}
375		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
376		if err != nil {
377			return true
378		}
379		_, err = os.Stat(canonical)
380		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
381	}

383	func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {

386			currentPath = observation.RealPath
387		}
388		return Location{
389			State:        LocationPresent,
390			CurrentPath:  currentPath,
391			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
392			GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
393		}
394	}

396	func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
397		observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
398		observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
399		if observation.Host == "" {
400			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
401		}
402
403		commonDir := observation.CommonDir
404		if commonDir == "" {
405			commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
406		} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
407			left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
408			right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
409			if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
410				return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
411			}
412		}
413
414		var err error
415		canonicalPath := ""
416		if observation.Path != "" {
417			observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
418			if err != nil {
419				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
420			}
421			canonicalPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
422			if err != nil {
423				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
424			}
425		}
426		if observation.RealPath != "" {
427			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
428			if err != nil {
429				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
430			}
431			if canonicalPath != "" && canonicalPath != observation.RealPath {
432				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Path and RealPath disagree: %q != %q",
433					canonicalPath, observation.RealPath)
434			}
435		} else {
436			observation.RealPath = canonicalPath
437		}
438		if commonDir != "" {
439			observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
440			if err != nil {
441				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
442			}
443		}
444		observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
445		observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)
446
447		if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
448			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
449		}
450		if requireLocation {
451			path := observation.Path
452			if path == "" {
453				path = observation.RealPath
454			}
455			info, statErr := os.Stat(path)
456			if statErr != nil {
457				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q: %w", path, statErr)
458			}
459			if !info.IsDir() {
460				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q is not a directory", path)
461			}
462			if observation.CommonDir != "" {
463				commonInfo, commonErr := os.Stat(observation.CommonDir)
464				if commonErr != nil {
465					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q: %w",
466						observation.CommonDir, commonErr)
467				}
468				if !commonInfo.IsDir() {
469					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q is not a directory",
470						observation.CommonDir)
471				}
472			}
473		}
474		if observation.Name == "" {
475			path := observation.Path
476			if path == "" {
477				path = observation.RealPath
478			}
479			if path != "" {
480				observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
481			}
482		}
483		if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
484			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
485		}
486		return observation, nil
487	}

497	func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
498		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))

500			if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {

518	func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
519		for value := range left {
520			if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
521				return true
522			}
523		}
524		return false

527	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
528	// stable host/path key. Hosts are case-insensitive, but paths are preserved
529	// because arbitrary Git servers may use a case-sensitive repository namespace.
530	// The result remains only a hint for matching.
531	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
532		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
533		if identity == "" {
534			return ""
535		}
536		if azure := normalizeAzureDevOpsRemoteIdentity(identity); azure != "" {
537			return azure
538		}
539		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
540			if strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file") {
541				return ""
542			}
543			if parsed.Host != "" {
544				return remoteIdentityKey(parsed.Host, parsed.EscapedPath())
545			}
546		}
547		if looksLikeLocalRemote(identity) {
548			return ""
549		}
550
551		afterUser := identity
552		user := ""
553		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(afterUser, '@'); at >= 0 {
554			user, afterUser = afterUser[:at], afterUser[at+1:]
555			// A colon in an scp-like user prefix is a password/token separator,
556			// not a stable SSH username. Reject the identity rather than persisting
557			// credential material in catalog keys, reports, or protocol journals.
558			if strings.Contains(user, ":") {
559				return ""
560			}
561		}
562		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
563			if user != "" && !strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && !strings.HasPrefix(remotePath, "/") {
564				remotePath = "~" + user + "/" + remotePath
565			}
566			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
567		}
568
569		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
570		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
571			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
572		}
573		return ""
574	}
575
576	func normalizeAzureDevOpsRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
577		if kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(identity); kind == forge.AzureDevOps && name != "" {
578			return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + name
579		}
580
581		// Records written before Azure support already contain the generic
582		// host/path form. Recognize it so existing catalog entries migrate on read.
583		trimmed := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSpace(identity), ".git"), "/")
584		parts := strings.Split(trimmed, "/")
585		decode := func(values []string) ([]string, bool) {
586			out := make([]string, len(values))
587			for i, value := range values {
588				decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(value)
589				if err != nil || decoded == "" || strings.Contains(decoded, "/") {
590					return nil, false
591				}
592				out[i] = decoded
593			}
594			return out, true
595		}
596		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "dev.azure.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[3], "_git") {
597			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{parts[1], parts[2], parts[4]}); ok {
598				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
599			}
600		}
601		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "ssh.dev.azure.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[1], "v3") {
602			if decoded, ok := decode(parts[2:]); ok {
603				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
604			}
605		}
606		if len(parts) >= 4 && strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(parts[0]), ".visualstudio.com") &&
607			!strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[len(parts)-2], "_git") {
608			organization := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.ToLower(parts[0]), ".visualstudio.com")
609			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{organization, parts[len(parts)-3], parts[len(parts)-1]}); ok {
610				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
611			}
612		}
613		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com") &&
614			strings.HasPrefix(parts[1], "~") && strings.EqualFold(parts[3], "_ssh") {
615			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{strings.TrimPrefix(parts[1], "~"), parts[2], parts[4]}); ok {
616				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
617			}
618		}
619		return ""
620	}
621
622	func looksLikeLocalRemote(identity string) bool {
623		if filepath.IsAbs(identity) || strings.HasPrefix(identity, `\\`) {
624			return true
625		}
626		for _, prefix := range []string{"./", "../", "~/", `.\`, `..\`, `~\`} {
627			if strings.HasPrefix(identity, prefix) {
628				return true
629			}
630		}
631		if len(identity) >= 2 && identity[1] == ':' {
632			letter := identity[0]
633			if letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z' {
634				return true
635			}
636		}
637		return !strings.ContainsAny(identity, `/\:@`)
638	}
639
640	func splitSCPLike(identity string) (string, string, bool) {
641		if strings.HasPrefix(identity, "[") {
642			if end := strings.Index(identity, "]:"); end >= 0 {
643				return identity[:end+1], identity[end+2:], true
644			}
645		}
646		colon := strings.IndexByte(identity, ':')
647		if colon <= 0 || strings.ContainsAny(identity[:colon], `/\\`) {
648			return "", "", false
649		}
650		return identity[:colon], identity[colon+1:], true
651	}
652
653	func remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath string) string {
654		host = strings.ToLower(strings.Trim(host, "/"))
655		remotePath = trimGitSuffix(strings.Trim(remotePath, "/"))
656		if host == "" || remotePath == "" {
657			return ""
658		}
659		return host + "/" + remotePath
660	}
661
662	func trimGitSuffix(value string) string {
663		return strings.TrimSuffix(value, ".git")
664	}

105	// WithLock runs operation while holding the catalog's cross-process advisory
106	// lock. It is intended for short read-match-write transactions; expensive
107	// discovery belongs before the lock. The operating system releases the lock if
108	// the process exits unexpectedly.
109	func (s *Store) WithLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
110		if s == nil {
111			return errors.New("lock nil catalog store")
112		}
113		if operation == nil {
114			return errors.New("catalog lock requires an operation")
115		}
116		s.mu.Lock()
117		defer s.mu.Unlock()
118		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "catalog", operation)
119	}

124	func (s *Store) Create(entry *Entry) error {
125		if err := s.validateCreateInput(entry); err != nil {
126			return err
127		}
128		return s.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error { return s.CreateUnderLock(entry) })

131	// CreateUnderLock is the non-reentrant form used only inside Store.WithLock.
132	// Calling it without that transaction guard is a programming error.
133	func (s *Store) CreateUnderLock(entry *Entry) error {
134		if entry == nil {
135			return errors.New("create nil catalog entry")
136		}
137		if entry.ID != "" {
138			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog asset: ID is assigned by the store")
139		}
140		prepare := func() (*Entry, error) {
141			candidate := entry.Clone()
142			candidate.ID = s.nextID()
143			if err := ValidateID(candidate.ID); err != nil {
144				return nil, fmt.Errorf("generated catalog ID: %w", err)
145			}
146			now := s.now()
147			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
148			if candidate.Created.IsZero() {
149				candidate.Created = now
150			}
151			if candidate.Discovered.IsZero() {
152				candidate.Discovered = now
153			}
154			candidate.Updated = now
155			prepareNewNested(candidate, now)
156			candidate.Normalize()
157			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
158				return nil, err
159			}
160			return candidate, nil
161		}
162		candidate, err := prepare()
163		if err != nil {
164			return err
165		}
166		for range 32 {
167			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
168				candidate, err = prepare()
169				if err != nil {
170					return err
171				}
172				continue
173			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
174				return fmt.Errorf("check catalog ID %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
175			}
176			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
177				return err
178			}
179			*entry = *candidate
180			return nil
181		}
182		return fmt.Errorf("generate unique catalog ID: %w", ErrAlreadyExists)
183	}

208	// Import merges portable metadata for an exact stable ID and records location as
209	// host's local view. Source locations are deliberately ignored: only the caller-
210	// supplied target location may claim a path on this machine. Move intents and
211	// recovery receipts are host-owned lifecycle authority and cannot be imported.
212	// The complete read-check-write transaction runs under the catalog's advisory
213	// lock so concurrent processes cannot claim the same target path.
214	func (s *Store) Import(ctx context.Context, source *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, error) {
215		if s == nil {
216			return nil, errors.New("import into nil catalog store")
217		}
218		if source == nil {
219			return nil, errors.New("import nil catalog entry")
220		}
221		if source.MoveIntent != nil {
222			return nil, importConflict(source.ID, source.ID, "move_intent", "host-local move authority cannot be imported")
223		}
224		if source.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
225			return nil, importConflict(source.ID, source.ID, "recovery_receipt", "recovery authority cannot be imported before target verification")
226		}
227		if err := validateLocationForSet(host, location); err != nil {
228			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog import target location: %w", err)
229		}
230
231		incoming := source.Clone()
232		if incoming.SchemaVersion == 0 {
233			incoming.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
234		}
235		incoming.Locations = nil
236		incoming.RecoveryReceipt = nil
237		incoming.MoveIntent = nil
238		incoming.Normalize()
239
240		// Validate all source-owned fields before locking or creating the store. A
241		// zero location timestamp is allowed at the API boundary and is stamped only
242		// after the lock is held so a replay can retain the first import's timestamp.
243		validationLocation := location
244		if validationLocation.Updated.IsZero() {
245			validationLocation.Updated = incoming.Updated
246		}
247		incoming.Locations = map[string]Location{host: validationLocation}
248		if err := incoming.Validate(); err != nil {
249			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate imported catalog asset %s: %w", incoming.ID, err)
250		}
251
252		var imported *Entry
253		err := s.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
254			entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
255			if err != nil {
256				return err
257			}
258			if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
259				return incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
260			}
261
262			var current *Entry
263			for _, entry := range entries {
264				if entry.ID == incoming.ID {
265					current = entry
266					break
267				}
268			}
269			if current != nil && current.MoveIntent != nil {
270				return importConflict(current.ID, current.ID, "move_intent",
271					fmt.Sprintf("target has a pending %s move", current.MoveIntent.Operation))
272			}
273
274			targetLocation := location
275			if targetLocation.Updated.IsZero() {
276				if previous, ok := currentLocation(current, host); ok && !locationPayloadChanged(previous, targetLocation) {
277					targetLocation.Updated = previous.Updated
278				} else {
279					targetLocation.Updated = s.now()
280				}
281			} else if previous, ok := currentLocation(current, host); ok &&
282				!locationPayloadChanged(previous, targetLocation) && previous.Updated.After(targetLocation.Updated) {
283				// Replaying an older observation of the same path must not move the
284				// target's location timestamp backwards.
285				targetLocation.Updated = previous.Updated
286			}
287			if err := validateLocation(host, targetLocation); err != nil {
288				return fmt.Errorf("catalog import target location: %w", err)
289			}
290			if err := rejectImportedPathOwner(entries, incoming.ID, host, targetLocation); err != nil {
291				return err
292			}
293
294			if current == nil {
295				created := incoming.Clone()
296				created.Locations = map[string]Location{host: targetLocation}
297				if err := created.Validate(); err != nil {
298					return fmt.Errorf("validate imported catalog asset %s: %w", created.ID, err)
299				}
300				if err := s.writeAtomic(created); err != nil {
301					return err
302				}
303				imported = created.Clone()
304				return nil
305			}
306
307			merged, changed, err := mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming, host, targetLocation)
308			if err != nil {
309				return err
310			}
311			if !changed {
312				imported = current.Clone()
313				return nil
314			}
315			if err := s.writeAtomic(merged); err != nil {
316				return err
317			}
318			imported = merged.Clone()
319			return nil
320		})
321		return imported, err
322	}

328	func currentLocation(entry *Entry, host string) (Location, bool) {

335	func rejectImportedPathOwner(entries []*Entry, importedID, host string, target Location) error {
336		targetPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(target)
337		if err != nil {
338			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize imported location on host %s: %w", host, err)
339		}
340		for _, entry := range entries {
341			if entry.ID == importedID {
342				continue
343			}
344			owned, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
345			if !ok {
346				continue
347			}
348			ownedPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(owned)
349			if err != nil {
350				return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize catalog asset %s location on host %s: %w", entry.ID, host, err)
351			}
352			ownedSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ownedPaths))
353			for _, path := range ownedPaths {
354				ownedSet[path] = struct{}{}
355			}
356			for _, path := range targetPaths {
357				if _, exists := ownedSet[path]; exists {
358					return importConflict(importedID, entry.ID, "location",
359						fmt.Sprintf("target path %q on host %s is already owned", path, host))
360				}
361			}
362		}
363		return nil
364	}
365
366	func canonicalLocationPaths(location Location) ([]string, error) {
367		fields := []struct {
368			name  string
369			value string
370		}{
371			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
372			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
373			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
374			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
375		}
376		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(fields))
377		for _, field := range fields {
378			if field.value == "" {
379				continue
380			}
381			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(field.value)
382			if err != nil {
383				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s %q: %w", field.name, field.value, err)
384			}
385			seen[canonical] = struct{}{}
386		}
387		paths := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
388		for path := range seen {
389			paths = append(paths, path)
390		}
391		sort.Strings(paths)
392		return paths, nil
393	}

395	func mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, bool, error) {
396		if current.SchemaVersion != incoming.SchemaVersion {
397			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "schema_version", "schema versions differ")
398		}
399		if current.Kind != incoming.Kind {
400			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "kind",
401				fmt.Sprintf("durable kind %q differs from imported kind %q", current.Kind, incoming.Kind))
402		}
403		if current.Name != incoming.Name {
404			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "name",
405				fmt.Sprintf("durable name %q differs from imported name %q", current.Name, incoming.Name))
406		}
407
408		merged := current.Clone()
409		changed := false
410
411		currentSummary := strings.TrimSpace(merged.Note)
412		incomingSummary := strings.TrimSpace(incoming.Note)
413		switch {
414		case currentSummary != "" && incomingSummary != "" && merged.Note != incoming.Note:
415			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "note", "nonempty summaries differ")
416		case currentSummary == "" && incomingSummary != "":
417			merged.Note = incoming.Note
418			changed = true
419		}
420
421		tags := NormalizeTags(append(append([]string(nil), merged.Tags...), incoming.Tags...))
422		if !slices.Equal(merged.Tags, tags) {
423			merged.Tags = tags
424			changed = true
425		}
426
427		switch {
428		case merged.RemoteIdentity != "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "" && merged.RemoteIdentity != incoming.RemoteIdentity:
429			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "remote_identity",
430				fmt.Sprintf("durable identity %q differs from imported identity %q", merged.RemoteIdentity, incoming.RemoteIdentity))
431		case merged.RemoteIdentity == "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "":
432			merged.RemoteIdentity = incoming.RemoteIdentity
433			changed = true
434		}
435
436		switch {
437		case merged.Experiment == nil && incoming.Experiment != nil:
438			value := *incoming.Experiment
439			merged.Experiment = &value
440			changed = true
441		case merged.Experiment != nil && incoming.Experiment != nil && !experimentsEqual(*merged.Experiment, *incoming.Experiment):
442			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "experiment", "experiment metadata differs")
443		}
444
445		if value := earlierTime(merged.Created, incoming.Created); !value.Equal(merged.Created) {
446			merged.Created = value
447			changed = true
448		}
449		if value := earlierTime(merged.Discovered, incoming.Discovered); !value.Equal(merged.Discovered) {
450			merged.Discovered = value
451			changed = true
452		}
453		if value := laterTime(merged.LastOpened, incoming.LastOpened); !value.Equal(merged.LastOpened) {
454			merged.LastOpened = value
455			changed = true
456		}
457		if value := laterTime(merged.Updated, incoming.Updated); !value.Equal(merged.Updated) {
458			merged.Updated = value
459			changed = true
460		}
461
462		previous, exists := merged.LocationFor(host)
463		if !exists || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) || !previous.Updated.Equal(location.Updated) {
464			if merged.Locations == nil {
465				merged.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
466			}
467			merged.Locations[host] = location
468			changed = true
469		}
470		merged.Normalize()
471		if err := merged.Validate(); err != nil {
472			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("validate merged catalog asset %s: %w", merged.ID, err)
473		}
474		return merged, changed, nil
475	}

477	func experimentsEqual(left, right Experiment) bool {
478		return left.Phase == right.Phase &&
479			left.Slug == right.Slug &&
480			left.OriginURL == right.OriginURL &&
481			left.Started.Equal(right.Started) &&
482			left.OriginalPath == right.OriginalPath &&
483			left.DeprecatedAt.Equal(right.DeprecatedAt) &&
484			left.DeprecatedPath == right.DeprecatedPath &&
485			left.GraduatedAt.Equal(right.GraduatedAt) &&
486			left.GraduatedPath == right.GraduatedPath

489	func earlierTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
490		if left.IsZero() || !right.IsZero() && right.Before(left) {
491			return right
492		}
493		return left
494	}
495
496	func laterTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
497		if right.After(left) {
498			return right
499		}
500		return left
501	}

503	// Get loads one asset by exact ID.
504	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
505		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
506			return nil, err
507		}
508		return s.get(id)
509	}
510
511	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
512		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
513		if err != nil {
514			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
515				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
516			}
517			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
518		}
519		var header struct {
520			SchemaVersion int `toml:"schema_version"`
521		}
522		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &header); err != nil {
523			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
524		}
525		if header.SchemaVersion != 0 && header.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
526			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: header.SchemaVersion}
527		}
528
529		var entry Entry
530		metadata, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &entry)
531		if err != nil {
532			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
533		}
534		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
535			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: unknown field(s): %v", id, undecoded)
536		}
537		entry.ID = id
538		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
539		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
540		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
541			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
542		}
543		entry.Normalize()
544		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
545			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
546		}
547		return &entry, nil
548	}
549
550	// List loads every valid record in deterministic ID order. Per-record failures
551	// are skipped and sent to the configured diagnostic sink; directory-level
552	// failures are returned.
553	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
554		entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
555		if err != nil {
556			return nil, err
557		}
558		s.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
559		return entries, nil
560	}
561
562	func (s *Store) reportDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
563		if s.diagnostics == nil {
564			return
565		}
566		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
567			s.diagnostics(diagnostic)
568		}
569	}
570
571	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
572	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
573	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
574		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
575		if err != nil {
576			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
577				return nil, nil, nil
578			}
579			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
580		}
581
582		var entries []*Entry
583		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
584		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
585			name := directoryEntry.Name()
586			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
587				continue
588			}
589			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
590			entry, err := s.Get(id)
591			if err != nil {
592				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
593				continue
594			}
595			entries = append(entries, entry)
596		}
597		Sort(entries)
598		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
599		return entries, diagnostics, nil
600	}
601
602	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
603	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
604	// immutable.
605	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
606		var result *Entry
607		err := s.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
608			var err error
609			result, err = s.UpdateUnderLock(id, mutate)
610			return err
611		})
612		return result, err
613	}
614
615	// UpdateUnderLock is the non-reentrant form used only inside Store.WithLock.
616	// Calling it without that transaction guard is a programming error.
617	func (s *Store) UpdateUnderLock(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
618		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
619			return nil, err
620		}
621		if mutate == nil {
622			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
623		}
624		current, err := s.get(id)
625		if err != nil {
626			return nil, err
627		}
628		updated := current.Clone()
629		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
630			return nil, err
631		}
632		if updated.ID != current.ID {
633			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
634		}
635		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
636			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
637		}
638		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
639			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
640		}
641		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
642			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
643		}
644
645		now := s.now()
646		updated.Updated = now
647		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
648		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)
649		updated.Normalize()
650		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
651			return nil, err
652		}
653		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
654			return nil, err
655		}
656		return updated.Clone(), nil
657	}
658
659	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
660	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
661		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
662			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
663		})
664	}
665
666	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
667		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
668		if err != nil {
669			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
670		}
671		name := temporary.Name()
672		defer os.Remove(name)
673
674		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
675			_ = temporary.Close()
676			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
677		}
678		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
679			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
680		}
681		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
682			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
683		}
684		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
685			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
686		}
687		return nil
688	}
689
690	func (s *Store) nextID() string {
691		if s.generateID == nil {
692			return uuid.NewString()
693		}
694		return s.generateID()
695	}
696
697	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
698		if s.clock == nil {
699			return time.Now().UTC()
700		}
701		return s.clock().UTC()
702	}
703
704	func prepareNewNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
705		if entry.Experiment != nil {
706			if entry.Experiment.Phase == "" {
707				entry.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
708			}
709			if entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
710				entry.Experiment.Started = now
711			}
712		}
713		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
714			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
715				location.Updated = now
716				entry.Locations[host] = location
717			}
718		}
719		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
720			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
721		}
722		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
723			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
724		}
725	}
726
727	func prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
728		if current.Experiment == nil && updated.Experiment != nil {
729			if updated.Experiment.Phase == "" {
730				updated.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
731			}
732			if updated.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
733				updated.Experiment.Started = now
734			}
735		}
736		if updated.RecoveryReceipt != nil && updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() &&
737			(current.RecoveryReceipt == nil || recoveryPayloadChanged(*current.RecoveryReceipt, *updated.RecoveryReceipt)) {
738			updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
739		}
740		if updated.MoveIntent != nil && updated.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() &&
741			(current.MoveIntent == nil || moveIntentPayloadChanged(*current.MoveIntent, *updated.MoveIntent)) {
742			updated.MoveIntent.Started = now
743		}
744	}
745
746	func recoveryPayloadChanged(left, right RecoveryReceipt) bool {
747		left.Created = time.Time{}
748		right.Created = time.Time{}
749		return left != right
750	}
751
752	func moveIntentPayloadChanged(left, right MoveIntent) bool {
753		left.Started = time.Time{}
754		right.Started = time.Time{}
755		return left != right
756	}
757
758	func stampChangedLocations(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
759		for host, location := range updated.Locations {
760			previous, existed := current.Locations[host]
761			if !existed || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) {
762				location.Updated = now
763			} else {
764				// Updated is store-owned metadata. A mutation that did not change this
765				// host's location must not make it look newly observed.
766				location.Updated = previous.Updated
767			}
768			updated.Locations[host] = location
769		}
770	}
771
772	func locationPayloadChanged(left, right Location) bool {
773		left.Updated = time.Time{}
774		right.Updated = time.Time{}
775		return left != right
776	}

130	func parseForgeEndpoint(raw string) (forgeEndpoint, bool) {
131		if !safeRawURLText(raw) {
132			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
133		}
134		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
135		if raw == "" {
136			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
137		}
138		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
139			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
140			if err != nil || u.Opaque != "" || u.Hostname() == "" || !validWebHost(u.Hostname()) {
141				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
142			}
143			host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
144			segments, ok := decodeURLPath(u.EscapedPath())
145			if !ok {
146				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
147			}
148			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
149			case "https":
150				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
151					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
152				}
153				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "https", host: host, segments: segments}, true
154			case "ssh":
155				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22" || u.User == nil || u.User.Username() != "git" {
156					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
157				}
158				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
159					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
160				}
161				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: host, segments: segments}, true
162			default:
163				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
164			}
165		}
166
167		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
168		if at <= 0 || raw[:at] != "git" {
169			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
170		}
171		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
172		if colon < 0 {
173			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
174		}
175		colon += at + 1
176		host := raw[at+1 : colon]
177		if host == "" || strings.ContainsAny(host, `/\\[]:`) || !validWebHost(host) {
178			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
179		}
180		path := stripQueryFragment(raw[colon+1:])
181		segments, ok := decodeURLPath(path)
182		if !ok {
183			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
184		}
185		return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: strings.ToLower(host), segments: segments}, true
186	}

188	func parseSafeHTTPS(raw string) (host string, segments []string, safeURL string, ok bool) {

193		if err != nil || !strings.EqualFold(u.Scheme, "https") || u.Opaque != "" || u.Hostname() == "" || !validWebHost(u.Hostname()) {
194			return "", nil, "", false

196		if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {

199		segments, ok = decodeURLPath(u.EscapedPath())

203		host = strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())

207	func decodeURLPath(path string) ([]string, bool) {
208		path = strings.Trim(path, "/")
209		if path == "" {
210			return nil, false
211		}
212		rawSegments := strings.Split(path, "/")
213		segments := make([]string, 0, len(rawSegments))
214		for _, raw := range rawSegments {
215			if raw == "" || hasEncodedSeparator(raw) {
216				return nil, false
217			}
218			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(raw)
219			if err != nil || decoded == "" || decoded == "." || decoded == ".." || !utf8.ValidString(decoded) ||
220				strings.ContainsAny(decoded, `/\\`) || hasEncodedSeparator(decoded) || containsControl(decoded) {
221				return nil, false
222			}
223			segments = append(segments, decoded)
224		}
225		return segments, true
226	}

233		result[len(result)-1] = strings.TrimSuffix(result[len(result)-1], ".git")
234		if result[len(result)-1] == "" {

238	}

245		case GitLab:

266	func hasEncodedSeparator(value string) bool {
267		current := value
268		for depth := 0; depth < 8; depth++ {
269			lower := strings.ToLower(current)
270			if strings.Contains(lower, "%2f") || strings.Contains(lower, "%5c") {
271				return true
272			}
273			if !strings.ContainsRune(current, '%') {
274				return false
275			}

283		// ambiguous across clients with different decode counts.
284		return true
285	}

394	func validWebHost(host string) bool {
395		if host == "" || strings.HasSuffix(host, ".") || !utf8.ValidString(host) {

397		}
398		for _, r := range host {

400				return false
401			}
402		}
403		for _, label := range strings.Split(host, ".") {
404			if label == "" || strings.HasPrefix(label, "-") || strings.HasSuffix(label, "-") {
405				return false
406			}
407		}

1	// Package forge wraps the GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps CLIs. All are optional: every
2	// entry point degrades to plain git, because a workflow that hard-depends on a
3	// forge CLI being installed and authenticated stops working on exactly the
4	// machines where you most need it.
5	package forge
6
7	import (
8		"bytes"
9		"context"
10		"errors"
11		"fmt"
12		"net/url"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16		"sync"
17		"time"
18
19		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
20	)
21
22	// Kind identifies a forge.
23	type Kind string
24
25	const (
26		// GitHub is served by the gh CLI.
27		GitHub Kind = "github"
28		// GitLab is served by the glab CLI.
29		GitLab Kind = "gitlab"
30		// AzureDevOps is served by Azure CLI's azure-devops extension.
31		AzureDevOps Kind = "azure-devops"
32		// Unknown is any other host, or none.
33		Unknown Kind = "unknown"

232	// Probe checks installation and authentication without turning an optional
233	// integration into a command failure. GitHub and GitLab are intentionally
234	// probed against the host their create commands will use in a repository-less
235	// working directory.
236	func Probe(ctx context.Context, kind Kind) Readiness {
237		f, err := For(kind)
238		if err != nil {
239			return Readiness{
240				Forge: kind, Status: ReadinessUnsupported,
241				Detail: err.Error(), Action: "use a supported forge or add the remote with git",
242			}
243		}
244		return ProbeForge(ctx, f)
245	}

247	// ProbeForge is Probe for an already-selected adapter.
248	func ProbeForge(ctx context.Context, f Forge) Readiness {
249		result := Readiness{Forge: f.Kind(), Bin: f.Bin()}
250		if !f.Available() {
251			result.Status = ReadinessMissingCLI
252			result.Detail = fmt.Sprintf("%s is not installed", f.Bin())
253			result.Action = installAndLoginAction(f.Kind())
254			return result
255		}
256		result.Installed = true
257
258		args, action, ok := authProbe(f.Kind())
259		if !ok {
260			result.Status = ReadinessUnsupported
261			result.Detail = fmt.Sprintf("%s authentication probing is not supported", f.Kind())
262			return result
263		}
264		probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
265		defer cancel()
266		if _, err := probeRunner(probeCtx, f.Bin(), "", args...); err != nil {
267			if probeCtx.Err() != nil {
268				result.Status = ReadinessProbeFailed
269				result.Detail = probeCtx.Err().Error()
270				result.Action = "run `" + f.Bin() + " auth status` to diagnose the provider CLI"
271				return result
272			}
273			result.Status = ReadinessUnauthenticated
274			result.Detail = err.Error()
275			result.Action = action
276			return result
277		}
278		result.Status = ReadinessReady
279		result.Authenticated = true
280		return result
281	}

283	// ProbeAll returns readiness in stable wizard display order.
284	func ProbeAll(ctx context.Context) []Readiness {
285		kinds := []Kind{GitHub, GitLab}
286		results := make([]Readiness, len(kinds))
287		var wg sync.WaitGroup
288		for i, kind := range kinds {
289			wg.Add(1)
290			go func() {
291				defer wg.Done()
292				results[i] = Probe(ctx, kind)
293			}()
294		}
295		wg.Wait()
296		return results
297	}

331	type repoTarget struct {
332		name       string
333		namespace  string
334		fullName   string
335		visibility Visibility
336		remoteName string
337	}
338
339	func resolveRepoRequest(req RepoRequest) (repoTarget, error) {
340		fullName := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.FullName), "/")
341		name := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.Name), "/")
342		namespace := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(req.Namespace), "/")
343		if fullName == "" {
344			fullName = name
345			if namespace != "" && !strings.Contains(name, "/") {
346				fullName = namespace + "/" + name
347			}
348		}
349		if fullName == "" {
350			return repoTarget{}, errors.New("repository name is required")
351		}
352		if strings.Contains(fullName, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(fullName, "git@") {
353			return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("repository name %q must not be a URL", fullName)
354		}
355		parts := strings.Split(fullName, "/")
356		for _, part := range parts {
357			if part == "" || part == "." || part == ".." {
358				return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid repository name %q", fullName)
359			}
360		}
361		name = parts[len(parts)-1]
362		if len(parts) > 1 {
363			namespace = strings.Join(parts[:len(parts)-1], "/")
364		}
365
366		visibility := req.Visibility
367		if visibility == "" {
368			if req.Private {
369				visibility = VisibilityPrivate
370			} else {
371				visibility = VisibilityPublic
372			}
373		}
374		switch visibility {
375		case VisibilityPublic, VisibilityPrivate, VisibilityInternal:
376		default:
377			return repoTarget{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported repository visibility %q", visibility)
378		}
379		remoteName := strings.TrimSpace(req.RemoteName)
380		if remoteName == "" {
381			remoteName = "origin"
382		}
383		return repoTarget{
384			name: name, namespace: namespace, fullName: fullName,
385			visibility: visibility, remoteName: remoteName,
386		}, nil
387	}
388
389	func visibilityFlag(visibility Visibility) string { return "--" + string(visibility) }

391	func createRepoResult(kind Kind, target repoTarget, out string, allowFallback bool) CreateRepoResult {
392		webURL := lastHTTPURL(out)
393		fullName := target.fullName
394		if parsed, err := url.Parse(webURL); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
395			if path := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/"); path != "" {
396				fullName = path
397			}
398		}
399		if webURL == "" && allowFallback && strings.Contains(fullName, "/") {
400			host := defaultForgeHost(kind)
401			if host != "" {
402				webURL = "https://" + host + "/" + fullName
403			}
404		}
405		webURL = strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimRight(webURL, "/"), ".git")
406		cloneURL := ""
407		sshURL := ""
408		if parsed, err := url.Parse(webURL); err == nil && parsed.Host != "" {
409			path := strings.Trim(strings.TrimSuffix(parsed.Path, ".git"), "/")
410			cloneURL = strings.TrimRight(webURL, "/") + ".git"
411			sshURL = "git@" + parsed.Host + ":" + path + ".git"
412		}
413		name := target.name
414		if slash := strings.LastIndex(fullName, "/"); slash >= 0 {
415			name = fullName[slash+1:]
416		}
417		return CreateRepoResult{
418			Forge: kind, Name: name, FullName: fullName, URL: webURL,
419			CloneURL: cloneURL, SSHURL: sshURL, RemoteURL: cloneURL,
420			RemoteName: target.remoteName,
421		}
422	}
423
424	func defaultForgeHost(kind Kind) string {
425		switch kind {
426		case GitHub:
427			if host := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("GH_HOST")); host != "" {
428				return host
429			}
430			return "github.com"
431		case GitLab:
432			if host := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST")); host != "" {
433				return host
434			}
435			return "gitlab.com"
436		default:
437			return ""
438		}
439	}

441	type cliRunner func(context.Context, string, string, ...string) (string, error)
442
443	// Separate hooks keep readiness and publishing tests platform-independent;
444	// production uses the same subprocess runner as the legacy adapter methods.
445	var (
446		probeRunner   cliRunner = run
447		publishRunner cliRunner = runCombined
448		lookupPath              = exec.LookPath
449	)
450
451	// run executes a forge CLI, streaming stderr through so the user sees the
452	// CLI's own authentication prompts and error messages verbatim.
453	func run(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
454		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
455		cmd.Dir = dir
456		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
457		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
458		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
459		cmd.Stdin = os.Stdin
460		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
461			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
462			if detail != "" {
463				return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
464					bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
465			}
466			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
467		}
468		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
469	}
470
471	// runCombined is used for non-interactive publishing because gh/glab versions
472	// differ on whether the created repository URL is written to stdout or stderr.
473	// Stdin is deliberately left closed so a supposedly complete publish request
474	// cannot unexpectedly drop into a second provider-owned wizard.
475	func runCombined(ctx context.Context, bin, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
476		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...)
477		cmd.Dir = dir
478		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
479		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
480		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
481		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
482			detail := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
483			if detail != "" {
484				return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %s: %w",
485					bin, strings.Join(args, " "), detail, err)
486			}
487			return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), fmt.Errorf("%s %s: %w", bin, strings.Join(args, " "), err)
488		}
489		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()) + "\n" + strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())), nil
490	}
491
492	func have(bin string) bool {
493		_, err := lookupPath(bin)
494		return err == nil
495	}
496
497	func lastHTTPURL(out string) string {
498		var found string
499		for _, field := range strings.Fields(out) {
500			candidate := strings.Trim(field, "<>()[]{}\"',;.")
501			if strings.HasPrefix(candidate, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(candidate, "https://") {
502				found = candidate
503			}
504		}
505		return found
506	}
507
508	// IdentityFromURL returns a forge and decoded owner/name identity for a
509	// structurally valid HTTPS or SSH Git remote. Query, fragment, and userinfo are
510	// never part of the returned identity.
511	func IdentityFromURL(raw string) (Kind, string) {
512		if identity, _, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(raw); ok {
513			return AzureDevOps, identity
514		}
515		endpoint, ok := parseForgeEndpoint(raw)
516		if !ok {
517			return Unknown, ""
518		}
519		kind := webHostPolicy(WebURLRequest{}).identityProvider(endpoint.host)
520		if kind == Unknown || !validRepositorySegments(kind, endpoint.segments) {
521			return Unknown, ""
522		}
523		segments := stripGitSuffix(endpoint.segments)
524		if segments == nil {
525			return Unknown, ""
526		}
527		return kind, strings.Join(segments, "/")
528	}

80			return "", err

83			"--source-branch", req.Head, "--target-branch", req.Base}
84		if req.Title != "" {
85			args = append(args, "--title", req.Title)
86		}
87		if req.Body != "" {

89		}
90		if req.Draft {
91			args = append(args, "--draft", "true")
92		}
93		if req.Web {
94			args = append(args, "--open")

96		args = append(args, "--query", "{pullRequestId:pullRequestId,remoteUrl:repository.remoteUrl}",
97			"--output", "json", "--only-show-errors")
98		out, err := run(ctx, "az", dir, args...)
99		if err != nil {

103			PullRequestID int    `json:"pullRequestId"`
104			RemoteURL     string `json:"remoteUrl"`
105		}

107			return "", fmt.Errorf("decode az repos pr create: %w", err)
108		}
109		if result.PullRequestID <= 0 {
110			return "", errors.New("decode az repos pr create: response has no pullRequestId")

113		if !ok {
114			return "", fmt.Errorf("decode az repos pr create: unrecognized repository remote %q", result.RemoteURL)
115		}
116		return strings.TrimRight(repoURL, "/") + "/pullrequest/" + fmt.Sprint(result.PullRequestID), nil

128	func (a *az) CloneURL(ref string) string { return ref }
129
130	// ListRepos queries every configured organization/project concurrently. Azure
131	// CLI already returns every repository in the selected team project.
132	func (a *az) ListRepos(ctx context.Context) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
133		if len(a.targets) == 0 {
134			return nil, errors.New("Azure DevOps remote inventory needs at least one [[forge.azure_devops]] target")
135		}
136		if err := a.ensureExtension(ctx); err != nil {
137			return nil, err
138		}
139		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
140		defer cancel()
141
142		type result struct {
143			repos []RemoteRepo
144			err   error
145		}
146		ch := make(chan result, len(a.targets))
147		var wg sync.WaitGroup
148		for _, target := range a.targets {
149			target := target
150			wg.Add(1)
151			go func() {
152				defer wg.Done()
153				out, err := run(ctx, "az", "", "repos", "list", "--detect", "false",
154					"--organization", target.Organization, "--project", target.Project,
155					"--output", "json", "--only-show-errors")
156				if err != nil {
157					ch <- result{err: fmt.Errorf("Azure DevOps %s / %s: %w", target.Organization, target.Project, err)}
158					return
159				}
160				repos, err := parseAzureDevOpsRepos(out)
161				if err != nil {
162					err = fmt.Errorf("Azure DevOps %s / %s: %w", target.Organization, target.Project, err)
163				}
164				ch <- result{repos: repos, err: err}
165			}()
166		}
167		wg.Wait()
168		close(ch)
169
170		var repos []RemoteRepo
171		var errs []error
172		for item := range ch {
173			repos = append(repos, item.repos...)
174			if item.err != nil {
175				errs = append(errs, item.err)
176			}
177		}
178		sort.Slice(repos, func(i, j int) bool { return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label() })
179		unique := repos[:0]
180		seen := map[string]bool{}
181		for _, repo := range repos {
182			key := strings.ToLower(repo.Label())
183			if seen[key] {
184				continue
185			}
186			seen[key] = true
187			unique = append(unique, repo)
188		}
189		return unique, errors.Join(errs...)
190	}
191
192	func parseAzureDevOpsRepos(out string) ([]RemoteRepo, error) {
193		var raw []struct {
194			Name          string `json:"name"`
195			DefaultBranch string `json:"defaultBranch"`
196			IsFork        bool   `json:"isFork"`
197			RemoteURL     string `json:"remoteUrl"`
198			SSHURL        string `json:"sshUrl"`
199			Project       struct {
200				Name       string `json:"name"`
201				Visibility string `json:"visibility"`
202			} `json:"project"`
203		}
204		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &raw); err != nil {
205			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode az repos list: %w", err)
206		}
207		repos := make([]RemoteRepo, 0, len(raw))
208		for _, item := range raw {
209			identity, webURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(item.RemoteURL)
210			if !ok {
211				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode az repos list: unrecognized remoteUrl %q", item.RemoteURL)
212			}
213			repos = append(repos, RemoteRepo{
214				Forge: AzureDevOps, Name: item.Name, FullName: identity,
215				URL: webURL, CloneURL: webURL, SSHURL: item.SSHURL,
216				Visibility:    strings.ToLower(item.Project.Visibility),
217				DefaultBranch: strings.TrimPrefix(item.DefaultBranch, "refs/heads/"),
218				Fork:          item.IsFork,
219			})
220		}
221		return repos, nil
222	}
223
224	// parseAzureDevOpsRemote returns the provider identity and browser-safe HTTPS
225	// repository URL for supported Azure DevOps Services clone URL forms.
226	func parseAzureDevOpsRemote(raw string) (identity, webURL string, ok bool) {
227		if !safeRawURLText(raw) {
228			return "", "", false
229		}
230		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
231		if raw == "" {
232			return "", "", false
233		}
234		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
235			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
236			if err != nil || u.Fragment != "" || u.RawQuery != "" {
237				return "", "", false
238			}
239			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
240			case "https":
241				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
242					return "", "", false
243				}
244				return parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u)
245			case "ssh":
246				if u.User == nil || (u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22") {
247					return "", "", false
248				}
249				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
250					return "", "", false
251				}
252				return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(u.User.Username(), strings.ToLower(u.Hostname()), escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath()))
253			default:
254				return "", "", false
255			}
256		}
257		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
258		if at <= 0 {
259			return "", "", false
260		}
261		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
262		if colon < 0 {
263			return "", "", false
264		}
265		colon += at + 1
266		path := raw[colon+1:]
267		if strings.ContainsAny(path, "?#") {
268			return "", "", false
269		}
270		return parseAzureDevOpsSSH(raw[:at], strings.ToLower(raw[at+1:colon]), decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(path, "/"), "/")))
271	}
272
273	func parseAzureDevOpsHTTPS(u *url.URL) (string, string, bool) {
274		if u.User != nil {
275			if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
276				return "", "", false
277			}
278		}
279		host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
280		segments := escapedSegments(u.EscapedPath())
281		var organization, project, repo string
282		switch {
283		case host == "dev.azure.com":
284			if len(segments) != 4 || !strings.EqualFold(segments[2], "_git") {
285				return "", "", false
286			}
287			organization, project, repo = segments[0], segments[1], segments[3]
288			if u.User != nil && !strings.EqualFold(u.User.Username(), organization) {
289				return "", "", false
290			}
291		case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com") && host != "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com":
292			if u.User != nil {
293				return "", "", false
294			}
295			switch {
296			case len(segments) == 3 && strings.EqualFold(segments[1], "_git"):
297				project, repo = segments[0], segments[2]
298			case len(segments) == 4 && strings.EqualFold(segments[0], "DefaultCollection") && strings.EqualFold(segments[2], "_git"):
299				project, repo = segments[1], segments[3]
300			default:
301				return "", "", false
302			}
303			organization = strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")
304		default:
305			return "", "", false
306		}
307		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
308		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
309			return "", "", false
310		}
311		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
312		webURL := azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo)
313		return identity, webURL, true
314	}
315
316	func parseAzureDevOpsSSH(user, host string, segments []string) (string, string, bool) {
317		var organization, project, repo string
318		switch {
319		case host == "ssh.dev.azure.com" && strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && len(segments) == 4 && strings.EqualFold(segments[0], "v3"):
320			organization, project, repo = segments[1], segments[2], segments[3]
321			host = "dev.azure.com"
322		case host == "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com" && len(segments) == 3 && strings.EqualFold(segments[1], "_ssh"):
323			organization, project, repo = user, segments[0], segments[2]
324			host = strings.ToLower(organization) + ".visualstudio.com"
325			if !validWebHost(host) {
326				return "", "", false
327			}
328		default:
329			return "", "", false
330		}
331		repo = strings.TrimSuffix(repo, ".git")
332		if organization == "" || project == "" || repo == "" {
333			return "", "", false
334		}
335		identity := strings.Join([]string{organization, project, repo}, "/")
336		return identity, azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo), true
337	}
338
339	func azureDevOpsWebURL(host, organization, project, repo string) string {
340		if host == "dev.azure.com" {
341			return "https://dev.azure.com/" + url.PathEscape(organization) + "/" + url.PathEscape(project) + "/_git/" + url.PathEscape(repo)
342		}
343		return "https://" + host + "/" + url.PathEscape(project) + "/_git/" + url.PathEscape(repo)
344	}
345
346	func escapedSegments(path string) []string {
347		return decodeSegments(strings.Split(strings.Trim(path, "/"), "/"))
348	}
349
350	func decodeSegments(segments []string) []string {
351		if len(segments) == 1 && segments[0] == "" {
352			return nil
353		}
354		out := make([]string, 0, len(segments))
355		for _, segment := range segments {
356			if segment == "" || hasEncodedSeparator(segment) {
357				return nil
358			}
359			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(segment)
360			if err != nil || decoded == "" || decoded == "." || decoded == ".." || !safeRawURLText(decoded) ||
361				strings.ContainsAny(decoded, `/\\`) || hasEncodedSeparator(decoded) {
362				return nil
363			}
364			out = append(out, decoded)
365		}
366		return out
367	}

243	// unmergedBranches lists local branches carrying commits the default branch
244	// does not — unfinished work that would otherwise be invisible to dev.
245	func unmergedBranches(ctx context.Context, repoPath string) []string {
246		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repoPath)
247		if base == "" {
248			return nil
249		}
250		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname:short)", "refs/heads/")
251		if err != nil {
252			return nil
253		}
254		var branches []string
255		for _, b := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
256			b = strings.TrimSpace(b)
257			if b == "" || b == base || inventory.IsEphemeralWorktree("", b) {
258				continue
259			}
260			// Contained in the base means the work has already landed.
261			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", b, base); err == nil {
262				continue
263			}
264			branches = append(branches, b)
265		}
266		return branches
267	}

17			return nil
18		}
19		excludePane, err := callerPaneID(ctx, rt)
20		if err != nil {
21			return fmt.Errorf("resolve the current runtime pane before claiming %s: %w", config.Contract(checkout), err)

64	func checkoutAgentActivities(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, checkout, excludePane string) ([]runtime.AgentActivity, error) {

90	func canonicalWorktreeRoot(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, bool) {
91		if dir == "" {
92			return "", false
93		}
94		repo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, dir)
95		if err != nil || repo.Root == "" {
96			return "", false
97		}
98		root := filepath.Clean(repo.Root)
99		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(root); err == nil {
100			root = filepath.Clean(resolved)
101		}
102		return root, true
103	}

130	// StatusOf reads the porcelain v2 status of the checkout at dir. Porcelain v2
131	// is the documented machine-readable format: it reports branch, upstream and
132	// ahead/behind in the same pass as the file states, so one process gives dev
133	// everything it needs.
134	func StatusOf(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Status, error) {
135		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=normal", "-z")
136		if err != nil {

138		}

142	func statusFromOutput(dir, out string) Status {
143		var s Status
144		for _, rec := range nulLines(out) {
145			if rec == "" {
146				continue
147			}
148			switch rec[0] {
149			case '#':
150				parseBranchHeader(rec, &s)
151			case '1', '2':
152				// "1 XY ..." ordinary change, "2 XY ..." rename/copy. X is
153				// staged, Y unstaged. This record is one unique changed path even
154				// when both sides are non-dot.
155				f := strings.Fields(rec)
156				if len(f) < 2 || len(f[1]) < 2 {
157					continue
158				}
159				s.Changed++
160				x, y := f[1][0], f[1][1]
161				if x != '.' {
162					s.Staged++
163				}
164				if y != '.' {
165					s.Unstaged++
166				}
167				classifyChange(x, &s)
168				classifyChange(y, &s)
169				updateLatestChange(dir, statusPath(rec), &s)
170			case 'u':
171				s.Changed++
172				s.Conflicted++
173				updateLatestChange(dir, statusPath(rec), &s)
174			case '?':
175				s.Changed++
176				s.Untracked++
177				updateLatestChange(dir, strings.TrimPrefix(rec, "? "), &s)
178			}
179		}
180		return s
181	}

183	// statusPath extracts the final pathname from a porcelain-v2 record while
184	// preserving spaces in it. Rename records have one extra score field; their
185	// old path arrives as the next NUL record and is intentionally ignored.
186	func statusPath(rec string) string {
187		if rec == "" {
188			return ""
189		}
190		var fields int
191		switch rec[0] {
192		case '1':
193			fields = 9
194		case '2':
195			fields = 10
196		case 'u':
197			fields = 11
198		default:
199			return ""
200		}
201		parts := strings.SplitN(rec, " ", fields)
202		if len(parts) != fields {
203			return ""
204		}
205		return parts[fields-1]
206	}

645			add(file.Path).file = file

650	func applyTree(root *os.Root, node *applyNode, result *ApplyResult) error {
651		names := make([]string, 0, len(node.children))

654		}
655		sort.Strings(names)
656		for _, name := range names {
657			childNode := node.children[name]
658			if childNode.file != nil {
659				if err := writeRootFile(root, name, *childNode.file); err != nil {
660					return fmt.Errorf("create template file %q: %w", childNode.file.Path, err)
661				}
662				result.AppliedFiles++
663				continue
664			}
665			if err := root.Mkdir(name, 0o700); err != nil {
666				return fmt.Errorf("create template directory %q: %w", name, err)
667			}
668			child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
669			if err != nil {
670				return fmt.Errorf("open created template directory %q: %w", name, err)
671			}
672			walkErr := applyTree(child, childNode, result)
673			mode := fs.FileMode(0o755)
674			if childNode.directory != nil {
675				mode = childNode.directory.Mode.Perm()
676				result.AppliedDirectories++
677			}
678			chmodErr := chmodRootDirectory(child, mode)
679			verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
680			closeErr := child.Close()
681			if walkErr != nil {

683			}
684			if chmodErr != nil {
685				return fmt.Errorf("set template directory mode %q: %w", name, chmodErr)

689			}
690			if closeErr != nil {

692			}
693		}
694		return nil
695	}

    if err != nil {

    }

 `./docs/guides/remote-fleet.md`

```text
1	---
2	description: Inventory repositories over SSH, pin remote machine identity, safely fast-forward branches, and explicitly transfer bounded ignored files with dev fleet.
3	authority: project
4	status: stable
5	verified_on: 2026-08-31
6	---
7
8	# Remote repository fleet
9
10	`dev fleet` fans out over SSH to other machines running their own `dev`, so you can see and open their repositories and safely propagate a branch, without merging their independent configuration into this machine's view.
11
12	## What a fleet is
13
14	A remote fleet is a list of other hosts, each running its own `dev` binary against its own `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, its own scan roots, its own task registry, and its own runtime. Inventory stays decentralized: each host's `dev` produces its own read-only snapshot over SSH, and one unreachable host never blocks the remaining rows. Mutation is confined to separately named commands such as `fleet sync` and `fleet files --apply`; neither makes this machine authoritative for the target's paths, task registry, or runtime.
15
16	This is a different concept from the REMOTE TUI view and publishing/PR flows,
17	which use `gh` or `glab` for GitHub/GitLab repository publication and PRs, plus
18	the Azure CLI for Azure DevOps inventory and PRs. Fleet talks to *your own
19	machines* about *your own local checkouts* on those machines.
20
21	## Configure hosts
22
23	```bash
24	dev fleet config init
25	dev fleet config edit
26	dev fleet config show
27	dev fleet config path
28	```
29
30	Hosts live in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` (override the path with the global `--remotes <path>` flag). `config init` writes a starter file (`--force` to overwrite, `--stdout` to print without writing); `config edit` opens it in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` (`--editor` overrides); `config show` prints the effective configuration with any plaintext password redacted; `config path` prints the resolved path.
31
32	```toml
33	schema_version = 1
34
35	[defaults]
36	connect_timeout = "15s"
37	command_timeout = "5m"
38	cache_ttl = "15m"
39	max_parallel = 4
40	dev_path = "auto"
41
42	[[hosts]]
43	name = "lab"
44	ssh_alias = "lab"
45	# Add only after `dev fleet machine-id lab` and independent verification.
46	machine_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
47
48	[[hosts]]
49	name = "vps"
50	hostname = "203.0.113.10"
51	user = "dev"
52	port = 22
53	identity_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
54	ssh_login_password_source = { type = "bitwarden", item = "ssh-vps-login" }
55	```
56
57	`schema_version = 1` is required. `[defaults]` supplies `connect_timeout`, `command_timeout`, `cache_ttl`, `max_parallel` (fan-out concurrency), and `dev_path` (`"auto"` searches `PATH`); each `[[hosts]]` entry inherits any of these it does not set explicitly. A host needs `name` plus either `ssh_alias` (preferred — it reuses `~/.ssh/config`'s `ProxyJump`, `IdentityAgent`, and host-key policy exactly like a plain `ssh` invocation) or `hostname` (optionally with `user`, `port`, `identity_file`). The optional `machine_id` is a durable UUID pin: read-only inventory can warn or proceed without it, but mutating portable-file apply requires an exact match. `ssh_login_password_source.type` is one of `none` (default), `prompt`, `plain` (inline `value`), or `bitwarden` (`item` looked up with the `bw` CLI). A config file with a `plain` password must be mode `0600`, or `dev fleet` refuses to load it.
58
59	Discover a target UUID with `dev fleet machine-id <host>`, verify it through an independent channel on that machine, then copy it into `remotes.toml`. The command is read-only and reports `unpinned`, `match`, or `mismatch`; it never edits configuration on your behalf.
60
61	## `dev fleet` commands
62
63	| Command | Flags | Purpose |
64	|---|---|---|
65	| `dev fleet list` | `--host <name>` (repeatable), `--repo <query>`, `--json`, `--cached`, `--strict` | List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts |
66	| `dev fleet status` | `--json`, `--strict` | Probe configured hosts and report snapshot health |
67	| `dev fleet machine-id <host>` | `--json` | Show the observed durable UUID and compare the configured pin |
68	| `dev fleet sync <repo>` | `--push`, `--remote <name>`, `--host <name>` (repeatable), `--json` | Push optionally, then safely fast-forward clean matching checkouts |
69	| `dev fleet files [repo-or-path]` | `--to <host>`, `--file <pattern>` (repeatable), `--apply`, `--replace`, `--yes`, `--json` | Plan or apply one-way transfer of explicit ignored files |
70	| `dev fleet open <host> <repo>` | — | Open a remote repository through Herdr or an SSH login shell |
71	| `dev fleet config init` | `-f`/`--force`, `--stdout` | Write a starter `remotes.toml` |
72	| `dev fleet config edit` | `--editor <cmd>` | Open `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` |
73	| `dev fleet config show` | — | Print the effective configuration (passwords redacted) |
74	| `dev fleet config path` | — | Print the resolved `remotes.toml` path |
75
76	`--repo` on `list` filters by name, remote identity, branch, or path; `--cached` answers entirely from the last saved snapshot with no network activity; `--strict` turns an unreachable/timeout/incompatible/invalid host into a non-zero exit for both `list` and `status`. `sync <repo>` resolves `<repo>` locally like any other repository reference; without `--push` its `HEAD` must already equal the fetched upstream, and `--remote` picks which Git remote identifies the repository across hosts (default: the branch's upstream remote, then `origin`).
77
78	## Explicit portable local files
79
80	A repository may propose export candidates separately from worktree provisioning:
81
82	```toml
83	# .dev-cli/config.toml
84	version = 1
85
86	[local_files]
87	include = [".env", ".mcp/**"]
88	```
89
90	`[worktree].include` is local provisioning policy and is never inherited here.
91	`[local_files].include` also grants no standing permission: an explicit invocation
92	must select exactly one target, and repeatable `--file` adds ad-hoc patterns for
93	that invocation only. Patterns expand on the source into sorted exact paths;
94	no glob crosses the wire.
95
96	```bash
97	dev fleet files api --to lab                    # report only
98	dev fleet files api --to lab --apply --yes      # create absent target files
99	dev fleet files api --to lab --replace --apply  # authorize differing bytes separately
100	```
101
102	The source and target must already resolve to one clone with the same normalized
103	**fetch** identity, attached branch, and exact commit. A push-only URL match is
104	insufficient. Both hosts independently prove every exact path is untracked and
105	ignored under their own Git configuration. Only regular files pass: no
106	symlinks/reparse points, directories, sockets, devices, FIFOs, `.git`, nested
107	repositories, or submodule boundaries. Compiled ceilings are 128 files,
108	8 MiB per file, 32 MiB total, with bounded path length/depth; host policy may
109	lower but never raise them.
110
111	Plan is the default and sends no file body. Apply additionally requires the
112	configured `machine_id` to match the content-free capability probe. Missing files
113	are atomically created owner-only; identical files are no-ops; differing bytes
114	block unless `--replace` was present in the displayed plan. Replacement binds the
115	observed target digest/mode, retains a private rollback copy, revalidates both
116	roots, and rolls back file changes on failure. `--yes` only answers confirmation
117	and never implies replacement. Public human/JSON output contains path, size,
118	mode, and state—never content or hashes.
119
120	The transaction journal is durable before manifest/payload staging, so an
121	interrupted request ID can resume or reconcile. Rollback intentionally leaves an
122	empty parent directory when its post-crash identity cannot be proven; deleting
123	another process's replacement would be worse. Native Windows payload transfer is
124	capability-blocked before content is sent.
125
126	This command is not repository/task ownership transfer, clone acquisition,
127	provisioning, backup, restore, or eviction. It never switches a branch, copies
128	task/catalog/note state, watches for changes, propagates deletions, or removes the
129	source.
130
131	`dev fleet` also registers bounded hidden capability/file commands in addition to
132	`_snapshot`, `_sync`, `_open-herdr`, and `_shell`. They exist only for the two
133	`dev` processes to invoke over SSH; they are wire protocols, not user-facing
134	surfaces.
135
136	## Transport and authentication
137
138	Every fleet command reaches a host by shelling out to the system `ssh` binary with `ConnectTimeout`, `ServerAliveInterval=15`, and `ServerAliveCountMax=2`, and first attempts `BatchMode=yes` — key or agent authentication only, exactly like a script-friendly `ssh` call. Fixed protocols use non-PTY `-T` and disable agent, X11, local-command, and all port forwarding while retaining the user's normal host-key policy. `dev fleet open` separately allocates a PTY (`-t`) for its interactive login shell.
139
140	If that attempt is rejected with "permission denied" and the host defines a `ssh_login_password_source`, `dev` retries once with password authentication. The password itself never touches argv or the environment: `dev` re-executes itself as a one-shot `SSH_ASKPASS` helper, and the secret is handed to that helper over an inherited file descriptor. `prompt` reads a hidden password from `/dev/tty` at run time; `plain` and `bitwarden` resolve it from the config file or from `bw get password <item>` respectively.
141
142	On the remote side, `dev_path = "auto"` (the default) searches common install locations (`~/.local/bin`, `~/go/bin`, mise shims, Homebrew/Linuxbrew, `/usr/local/bin`, `/snap/bin`) and then `PATH`, exiting `127` if no `dev` is found; an explicit absolute `dev_path` skips that search and execs it directly.
143
144	## What's cached vs. durable
145
146	`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` is durable, user-authored configuration, on the same footing as `config.toml` — `dev fleet config init`/`edit` manage it, and nothing regenerates it automatically.
147
148	Each successful probe writes a per-host JSON snapshot under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json`. That cache is a disposable accelerator, not durable data: it is fingerprinted with an "endpoint ID" derived from the host's connection fields and timeouts, so editing a host's `machine_id`, `ssh_alias`, `hostname`, `user`, `identity_file`, `dev_path`, or timeouts automatically invalidates its old cache the next time `dev` reads it. `dev cache list` shows its path, size, and age; `dev cache clear fleet` (or `dev cache clear all`) removes it outright. There is nothing to "rebuild" explicitly — the next `dev fleet list`, `dev fleet status`, or TUI FLEET reload regenerates it from a fresh probe.
149
150	The cache exists so an unreachable, timed-out, incompatible, or invalid-response host can still report its last known state (marked `stale`, with `FromCache` set) instead of vanishing from the listing; `--cached` uses only this cache and never touches the network. Each remote host's own `config.toml`, task registry, and repository paths remain authoritative on that host — the cache only ever holds a read-only snapshot of them.
151
152	## Fleet in the TUI
153
154	FLEET is one of the TUI's six views (`TASKS`, `REPOS`, `FLEET`, `TRY`, `REMOTE`, `SKILLS`, switched with `tab`/`h`/`l`). Like REMOTE, it loads lazily — nothing is fetched until the view is first opened — but it seeds itself from any cached snapshots that are still within `defaults.cache_ttl` so the first render is not empty. `r` forces a live reload of every configured host.
155
156	Its table shows `HOST`, `STATE`, `REPO`, `BRANCH`, `GIT`, `LIVE`, `TASKS`, and `PATH`. `enter` opens the selected repository: for a local host row this is an ordinary local open; for a remote row `dev` prefers native Herdr remoting when that host's snapshot reports the `herdr` runtime and the host connects through `ssh_alias` with no password step, and otherwise falls back to an interactive SSH login shell in the repository's directory. Git changes are read-only in this view — FLEET is for inspecting and opening work, not editing it in place.
157
158	`e` opens `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` — the file this view is about, rather than dev's own `config.toml`, which `e` opens everywhere else. On leaving the editor `dev` reparses the file before using it. A parse failure, an unknown field, or a permissions problem on a file holding a plaintext password is reported and the previous rows are kept, so a typo cannot silently drop a host from the fleet. A file that parses triggers an immediate live reload of every configured host.
159
160	## Degrading gracefully
161
162	Every host is probed independently, so one bad host never fails the fleet as a whole. Per-host states are `ok`, `stale` (cache reused, optionally with an error explaining why), `no-dev` (the remote has no `dev` on its `PATH` — reported, not an error), `unreachable` (SSH itself failed), `timeout`, `incompatible` (an old or unrecognized remote `dev`), and `invalid-response` (malformed snapshot JSON). `ok` and a clean `no-dev` never fail `--strict`; every other state does, including a `stale` result that carries an error.
163
164	Separately, forge integration is optional: `gh` and `glab` enable GitHub/GitLab
165	inventory, publication, and pull/merge requests, while `az` enables Azure
166	DevOps inventory and pull requests. `dev doctor` reports missing CLIs as
167	warnings. Local Git workflows remain available, but an explicit non-interactive
168	publication request fails with login/install guidance instead of silently
169	changing its meaning. Azure DevOps inventory is additionally opt-in and stays
170	disabled until `forge.azure_devops` targets are configured.
171

104	func (e *BlockedError) Error() string {
