```text
118	func (k Key) Validate() error {
119		if err := validateIdentity("repository identity", k.Repository); err != nil {
120			return err
121		}
122		switch k.Scope {
123		case ScopeRepository:
124			if k.Branch != "" {
125				return errors.New("repository lease key must not name a branch")
126			}
127		case ScopeBranch:
128			if err := validateIdentity("branch", k.Branch); err != nil {
129				return err
130			}
131		default:
132			return fmt.Errorf("unknown lease scope %q", k.Scope)
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
137	func (k Key) canonical() string {
138		// Length prefixes keep arbitrary valid identities unambiguous.
139		return fmt.Sprintf("%08x:%s:%s:%08x:%s", len(k.Repository), k.Repository, k.Scope, len(k.Branch), k.Branch)
140	}

145		}
146		return k.Repository
147	}

149	func (r Request) Validate() error {
150		if !operationIDPattern.MatchString(r.OperationID) {
151			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation id %q", r.OperationID)
152		}
153		if !assessment.ValidFingerprint(r.Digest) {
154			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has invalid digest %q", r.OperationID, r.Digest)
155		}
156		if r.MachineID != "" {
157			if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
158				return err
159			}
160		}
161		return nil
162	}
163
164	func (b Binding) Validate() error {
165		return (Request{OperationID: b.OperationID, Digest: b.Digest}).Validate()
166	}
167
168	func (t Token) Validate() error {
169		if err := (Request{OperationID: t.OperationID, Digest: t.Digest}).Validate(); err != nil {
170			return err
171		}
172		if t.Epoch == 0 {
173			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has zero lease epoch", t.OperationID)
174		}
175		return nil
176	}
177
178	func (t Token) matches(other Token) bool {
179		return t.OperationID == other.OperationID && t.Digest == other.Digest && t.Epoch == other.Epoch
180	}
181
182	func (t Token) sameOperation(request Request) bool {
183		return t.OperationID == request.OperationID && t.Digest == request.Digest
184	}
185
186	// CanonicalKeys validates, deduplicates, and sorts keys in the one order used
187	// by every multi-key acquisition.
188	func CanonicalKeys(keys []Key) ([]Key, error) {
189		if len(keys) == 0 {
190			return nil, errors.New("operation lease requires at least one key")
191		}
192		unique := make(map[string]Key, len(keys))
193		for _, key := range keys {
194			if err := key.Validate(); err != nil {
195				return nil, err
196			}
197			unique[key.canonical()] = key
198		}
199		canonical := make([]Key, 0, len(unique))
200		for _, key := range unique {
201			canonical = append(canonical, key)
202		}
203		sort.Slice(canonical, func(i, j int) bool { return canonical[i].canonical() < canonical[j].canonical() })
204		return canonical, nil
205	}
206
207	func validateIdentity(name, value string) error {
208		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
209			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
210		}
211		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
212			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
213		}
214		for _, char := range value {
215			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
216				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
217			}
218		}
219		return nil
220	}
```

```text
658	func canonicalSnapshot(state Snapshot) Snapshot {
659		result := Snapshot{
660			SchemaVersion: state.SchemaVersion,
661			LastEpoch:     state.LastEpoch,
662			Bindings:      append([]Binding(nil), state.Bindings...),
663			Records:       make([]Record, len(state.Records)),
664		}
665		sort.Slice(result.Bindings, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Bindings[i].OperationID < result.Bindings[j].OperationID })
666		for index, record := range state.Records {
667			result.Records[index] = cloneRecord(record)
668			if result.Records[index].Reservation != nil {
669				result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt)
670			}
671			if result.Records[index].Fence != nil {
672				result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt)
673			}
674			for tombstoneIndex := range result.Records[index].Tombstones {
675				result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt)
676			}
677			sort.Slice(result.Records[index].Tombstones, func(i, j int) bool {
678				left, right := result.Records[index].Tombstones[i], result.Records[index].Tombstones[j]
679				if left.Token.Epoch != right.Token.Epoch {
680					return left.Token.Epoch < right.Token.Epoch
681				}
682				if left.Token.OperationID != right.Token.OperationID {
683					return left.Token.OperationID < right.Token.OperationID
684				}
685				if left.Token.Digest != right.Token.Digest {
686					return left.Token.Digest < right.Token.Digest
687				}
688				return left.Kind < right.Kind
689			})
690		}
691		sort.Slice(result.Records, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Records[i].Key.canonical() < result.Records[j].Key.canonical() })
692		return result
693	}
```

```text
717	func validateSnapshot(snapshot Snapshot) error {
718		paths := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Directories)+len(snapshot.Files))
719		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
720			paths = append(paths, directory.Path)
721		}
722		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
723			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
724		}
725		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
726			return fmt.Errorf("template paths: %w", err)
727		}
728
729		types := make(map[string]string, len(paths))
730		validate := func(relative, kind string, mode fs.FileMode) error {
731			cleaned, err := validateSnapshotPath(relative)
732			if err != nil || cleaned != relative {
733				if err == nil {
734					err = errors.New("path is not a clean relative path")
735				}
736				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q: %w", kind, relative, err)
737			}
738			if mode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
739				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q has unsupported mode %s", kind, relative, mode)
740			}
741			if previous, exists := types[relative]; exists {
742				return fmt.Errorf("template path %q is declared as both %s and %s", relative, previous, kind)
743			}
744			for parent := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(relative))); parent != "."; parent = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(parent))) {
745				if types[parent] == "file" {
746					return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q is below file %q", kind, relative, parent)
747				}
748			}
749			types[relative] = kind
750			return nil
751		}
752		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
753			if err := validate(directory.Path, "directory", directory.Mode); err != nil {
754				return err
755			}
756		}
757		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
758			if err := validate(file.Path, "file", file.Mode); err != nil {
759				return err
760			}
761			prefix := file.Path + "/"
762			for existing := range types {
763				if strings.HasPrefix(existing, prefix) {
764					return fmt.Errorf("template file %q is the parent of %q", file.Path, existing)
765				}
766			}
767		}
768		return nil
769	}
```

```text
205	func selectFleetRepository(repositories []fleet.RepoSnapshot, query string) (fleet.RepoSnapshot, error) {
206		for _, repository := range repositories {
207			if query == repository.Name || query == repository.Display || query == repository.Path {
208				return repository, nil
209			}
210			for _, identity := range repository.RemoteIdentities {
211				if query == identity {
212					return repository, nil
213				}
214			}
215		}
216		needle := strings.ToLower(query)
217		var matches []fleet.RepoSnapshot
218		for _, repository := range repositories {
219			haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{repository.Name, repository.Display, repository.Path, strings.Join(repository.RemoteIdentities, " ")}, " "))
220			if strings.Contains(haystack, needle) {
221				matches = append(matches, repository)
222			}
223		}
224		switch len(matches) {
225		case 1:
226			return matches[0], nil
227		case 0:
228			return fleet.RepoSnapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("remote repository %q not found", query)
229		default:
230			return fleet.RepoSnapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("remote repository %q is ambiguous", query)
231		}
232	}

321	func prepareFleetSync(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref, requestedRemote string, push bool) (fleet.SyncRequest, fleet.SyncResult, error) {
322		repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
323		if err != nil {
324			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
325		}
326		if repository.Bare {
327			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%s is bare and has no checkout to publish", repository.Display())
328		}
329		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Path)
330		if err != nil {
331			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
332		}
333		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
334			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, errors.New("fleet sync requires an attached branch")
335		}
336		if status.Dirty() || status.Conflicted > 0 {
337			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("source checkout must be clean (%s)", status.Summary())
338		}
339		remote := requestedRemote
340		if remote == "" && status.Upstream != "" {
341			remote, _, _ = strings.Cut(status.Upstream, "/")
342		}
343		if remote == "" {
344			remote = "origin"
345		}
346		remoteURL := gitx.Remote(ctx, repository.Path, remote)
347		identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(remoteURL)
348		if identity == "" {
349			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("remote %q has no cross-host identity", remote)
350		}
351		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "fetch", "--prune", "--quiet", remote); err != nil {
352			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
353		}
354		if push {
355			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "push", "--set-upstream", remote, status.Branch); err != nil {
356				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", status.Branch, err)
357			}
358		} else {
359			remoteOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", remote+"/"+status.Branch+"^{commit}")
360			if err != nil {
361				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("fetched %s/%s is unavailable", remote, status.Branch)
362			}
363			head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
364			if err != nil {
365				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
366			}
367			if head != remoteOID {
368				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("source HEAD does not equal %s/%s after fetch; push or reconcile it first", remote, status.Branch)
369			}
370		}
371		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
372		if err != nil {
373			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
374		}
375		request := fleet.SyncRequest{RemoteIdentity: identity, Branch: status.Branch, ExpectedOID: head}
376		source := fleet.SyncResult{
377			Host: config.Hostname(), State: fleet.SyncCurrent, Repo: repository.Display(), Path: repository.Path,
378			Branch: status.Branch, Remote: remote, BeforeOID: head, AfterOID: head, ExpectedOID: head,
379		}
380		return request, source, nil
381	}

383	func syncFleetHosts(ctx context.Context, hosts []fleet.Host, maxParallel int, request fleet.SyncRequest) []fleet.SyncResult {
384		if maxParallel <= 0 {
385			maxParallel = 4
386		}
387		results := make([]fleet.SyncResult, len(hosts))
388		sem := make(chan struct{}, maxParallel)
389		var wg sync.WaitGroup
390		requestJSON, _ := json.Marshal(request)
391		for index, host := range hosts {
392			wg.Add(1)
393			go func(index int, host fleet.Host) {
394				defer wg.Done()
395				sem <- struct{}{}
396				defer func() { <-sem }()
397				transport := fleet.Transport{Err: os.Stderr}
398				response := transport.Run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_sync"}, requestJSON, false)
399				result := fleet.SyncResult{Host: host.Name, Branch: request.Branch, ExpectedOID: request.ExpectedOID}
400				switch {
401				case response.ExitCode == 0:
402					if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Stdout, &result); err != nil {
403						result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncFailed, "remote dev returned invalid sync JSON"
404					}
405					result.Host = host.Name
406				case response.TimedOut || response.ExitCode == 124:
407					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncTimeout, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
408				case response.ExitCode == 127:
409					result.State = fleet.SyncNoDev
410				case response.ExitCode == 255:
411					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncUnreachable, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
412				default:
413					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncIncompatible, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
414				}
415				results[index] = result
416			}(index, host)
417		}
418		wg.Wait()
419		return results
420	}

422	func renderFleetSync(app *App, source fleet.SyncResult, targets []fleet.SyncResult) {
423		style := app.outStyle()
424		table := app.newTable("HOST", "STATE", "REPO", "BRANCH", "PATH", "DETAIL")
425		table.Add(source.Host, style.hostState(string(source.State)), source.Repo, source.Branch, config.Contract(source.Path), style.dim("source"))
426		for _, result := range targets {
427			table.Add(result.Host, style.hostState(string(result.State)), dash(result.Repo), dash(result.Branch),
428				config.Contract(result.Path), style.warning(truncate(result.Error, 64)))
429		}
430		table.Render(app.Out)
431	}
```

```text
209	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
210		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
211			return true
212		}
213		if ttl <= 0 {
214			return false
215		}
216		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
217	}
218
219	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
220		var providerErrors []error
221		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
222		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
223		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
224			name := string(kind)
225			kinds = append(kinds, name)
226			byKind[name] = status
227		}
228		sort.Strings(kinds)
229		for _, kind := range kinds {
230			status := byKind[kind]
231			if status.Error != "" {
232				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
233			} else if !status.Complete {
234				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
235			}
236		}
237		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
238	}

240	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
241		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
242		if err != nil {
243			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
244		}
245		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
246			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
247			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
248			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
249		}
250		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
251			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
252		}
253		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
254			return input
255		}
256		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
257		if parallel <= 0 {
258			parallel = 1
259		}
260		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
261		var wait sync.WaitGroup
262		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
263			wait.Add(1)
264			go func() {
265				defer wait.Done()
266				semaphore <- struct{}{}
267				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
268				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
269			}()
270		}
271		wait.Wait()
272		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
273			input.Err = err
274		}
275		return input
276	}
```

```text
319	func sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
320		var preferred []string
321		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
322			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
323		}
324		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
325		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
326		if err != nil {
327			return "", err
328		}
329		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
330		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
331		for _, remote := range preferred {
332			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
333				continue
334			}
335			seenRemote[remote] = true
336			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
337			if err != nil {
338				continue
339			}
340			identitySet := map[string]bool{}
341			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
342				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
343					identitySet[identity] = true
344				}
345			}
346			if len(identitySet) == 1 {
347				for identity := range identitySet {
348					return identity, nil
349				}
350			}
351		}
352		return "", errors.New("source checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
353	}
```

```text
383	func syncFleetHosts(ctx context.Context, hosts []fleet.Host, maxParallel int, request fleet.SyncRequest) []fleet.SyncResult {
384		if maxParallel <= 0 {
385			maxParallel = 4
386		}
387		results := make([]fleet.SyncResult, len(hosts))
388		sem := make(chan struct{}, maxParallel)
389		var wg sync.WaitGroup
390		requestJSON, _ := json.Marshal(request)
391		for index, host := range hosts {
392			wg.Add(1)
393			go func(index int, host fleet.Host) {
394				defer wg.Done()
395				sem <- struct{}{}
396				defer func() { <-sem }()
397				transport := fleet.Transport{Err: os.Stderr}
398				response := transport.Run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_sync"}, requestJSON, false)
399				result := fleet.SyncResult{Host: host.Name, Branch: request.Branch, ExpectedOID: request.ExpectedOID}
400				switch {
401				case response.ExitCode == 0:
402					if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Stdout, &result); err != nil {
403						result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncFailed, "remote dev returned invalid sync JSON"
404					}
405					result.Host = host.Name
406				case response.TimedOut || response.ExitCode == 124:
407					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncTimeout, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
408				case response.ExitCode == 127:
409					result.State = fleet.SyncNoDev
410				case response.ExitCode == 255:
411					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncUnreachable, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
412				default:
413					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncIncompatible, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
414				}
415				results[index] = result
416			}(index, host)
417		}
418		wg.Wait()
419		return results
420	}

541			if len(options.Hosts) > 0 && !options.Hosts[host.Name] {
542				continue
543			}
544			selected = append(selected, host)
545		}
546		for name := range options.Hosts {
547			if !found[name] {
548				return nil, cfg, fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
549			}
550		}
551		remoteResults := make([]fleet.HostResult, len(selected))
552		sem := make(chan struct{}, cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel)

561			}(index, host)
562		}

567	func collectFleetHost(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, cachedOnly bool) fleet.HostResult {
568		endpointID := fleet.EndpointID(host)
569		cached, cachedAt, haveCache := fleet.LoadCache(host)
570		if cachedOnly {
571			if haveCache {
572				return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostStale, Snapshot: &cached, CachedAt: &cachedAt, FromCache: true, EndpointID: endpointID}
573			}
574			return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "no cached snapshot", EndpointID: endpointID}
575		}
576		transport := fleet.Transport{Err: os.Stderr}
577		result := transport.Run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_snapshot"}, nil, false)
578		if result.ExitCode == 0 {
579			var snapshot fleet.Snapshot
580			if err := json.Unmarshal(result.Stdout, &snapshot); err == nil && snapshot.SchemaVersion == fleet.SnapshotSchemaVersion {
581				_ = fleet.SaveCache(host, snapshot)
582				return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostOK, Snapshot: &snapshot, PasswordAuth: result.UsedPassword, EndpointID: endpointID}
583			}
584			return cachedFleetFailure(host, fleet.HostInvalid, "remote dev returned invalid snapshot JSON", cached, cachedAt, haveCache)
585		}
586		state := fleet.HostIncompatible
587		detail := strings.TrimSpace(string(result.Stderr))
588		switch {
589		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
590			state = fleet.HostTimeout
591		case result.ExitCode == 127:
592			state = fleet.HostNoDev
593		case result.ExitCode == 255:
594			state = fleet.HostUnreachable
595		case strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(detail), "unknown command"):
596			state = fleet.HostIncompatible
597		}
598		if detail == "" {
599			detail = fmt.Sprintf("remote command exited %d", result.ExitCode)
600		}
601		return cachedFleetFailure(host, state, detail, cached, cachedAt, haveCache)
602	}
603
604	func cachedFleetFailure(host fleet.Host, state fleet.HostState, detail string, cached fleet.Snapshot, cachedAt time.Time, haveCache bool) fleet.HostResult {
605		if haveCache && state != fleet.HostNoDev {
606			return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostStale, Snapshot: &cached, CachedAt: &cachedAt, FromCache: true, Error: detail, EndpointID: fleet.EndpointID(host)}
607		}
608		return fleet.HostResult{Name: host.Name, State: state, Error: detail, EndpointID: fleet.EndpointID(host)}
609	}
```

```text
1	# Changelog
2
3	All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.
4
5	The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and releases use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
6
7	## [Unreleased]
8
9	### Added
10
11	- `dev repo context [repo]` now has an additive schema-v1 `--json` report and an
12	  explicit `--refresh` path. Local checkout, Git, task, worktree, and runtime facts
13	  stay live and network-free; optional forge and configured-fleet observations carry
14	  source, age, freshness, completeness, and collection errors. Remote endpoints are
15	  structurally sanitized before public output, and readiness remains split by scope
16	  instead of collapsing unknown evidence into a global safe value.
17	- `dev fleet machine-id <host>` exposes the remote host's non-secret durable machine
18	  UUID and compares it with the optional `machine_id` pin in `remotes.toml`.
19	  `dev fleet files [repo-or-path] --to <host>` plans a one-way transfer of explicitly
20	  allowlisted ignored files and mutates only with `--apply`; both hosts must prove
21	  every exact path is untracked, ignored, regular, portable, bounded, and bound to the
22	  same fetch identity, attached branch, and commit; apply additionally requires the
23	  pinned target machine. Differing target bytes require a separate `--replace`;
24	  `--yes` never implies replacement.
25
26	### Fixed
27
28	- Task writes now carry an in-memory revision from read to write, so existing
29	  lifecycle callers cannot silently overwrite a concurrent process's newer task
30	  record. Catalog create, update, import, and experiment reconciliation share one
31	  cross-process transaction lock, while corrupt task records make repository-context
32	  inventory explicitly incomplete instead of disappearing behind a warning.
33	- Portable-file retries now recover an interrupted store both before and after the
34	  first journal write. The operation binding is durable before manifests or payloads,
35	  rollback never guesses ownership of parent directories, target discovery errors fail
36	  closed, and credential-bearing SCP-like remote prefixes cannot enter catalog keys,
37	  protocol journals, or repository-context output.
38
39	## [0.2.1] - 2026-08-30
40
41	### Added
42
43	- `dev repo new` now has a confirmed interactive repository-bootstrap wizard, with
44	  `dev repo create` as an alias; `dev repo clone` can optionally apply the same setup,
45	  and `dev repo setup` safely merges preset files into an existing clean checkout.
46	  A clear Git URL, local Git path, or owner/repository argument to `new`/`create` is
47	  acquired as a clone, preserving its history and remote. The no-argument wizard
48	  detects the same references. Its default-no “Customize preset and template options?”
49	  gate keeps the normal `agent-ready` path short while still exposing every detailed
50	  question on request.
51	  Presets live in versioned `scaffolds.toml`, support typed inputs, safe templates,
52	  phased hooks, project skills with setup entrypoints, optional GitHub/GitLab
53	  publication, and explicit stay/cd/runtime/start handoffs. The two recommended
54	  agent skills use reviewed built-in project initializers instead of executing
55	  newly downloaded setup code. Skills with the same source and agent targets are
56	  installed in one provider invocation; the history initializer also adds
57	  `.specstory/.gitignore` rules for machine-local identity/statistics while keeping
58	  session history trackable; existing custom content is preserved and missing managed
59	  rules are appended.
60	- `dev repo new` can seed a new Git history from a safe snapshot of a local directory,
61	  local repository, Git URL, or owner/repository reference. `--template-ref` selects a
62	  branch, tag, or commit and `--template-subdir` selects one confined folder; preset
63	  `template`, `template_ref`, and `template_subdir` fields support catalog repositories
64	  containing several starters. Source `.git` metadata is excluded, and symlinks,
65	  special files, and path traversal are rejected. Plans redact URL userinfo, preview
66	  selected paths, and warn when a local live snapshot is not pinned to a commit.
67	- Repository bootstrap now has `--check-in <auto|commit|stage|none>`. `stage` leaves
68	  generated changes staged for review and seeds lazygit's worktree-local pending
69	  message as a best-effort convenience for lowercase `c`; staged setup cannot be
70	  published, and the `start` handoff still requires committed setup. Presets can set
71	  `initial_check_in`, and project setup defaults can set `repo.setup.check_in`. A draft
72	  write failure is a warning after staging succeeds; it never rolls the index back.
73	- TTY text prompts in the repository, task-start, and finish wizards now use an inline
74	  editor with cursor movement, Home/End, Delete/Backspace, and Esc/Ctrl-C cancellation
75	  instead of inserting raw arrow-key escape sequences. Buffered non-TTY input retains
76	  its script/test behavior.
77	- Repositories may commit allowlisted `.dev-cli/config.toml` and
78	  `.dev-cli/scaffolds.toml` overrides. Host paths/runtime/state remain global, while
79	  executable project configuration is content-hash trusted locally before it can run;
80	  legacy `.dev.toml` worktree settings remain compatible.
81
82	- Releases now publish `windows/amd64` and `windows/arm64` `.zip` archives alongside the
83	  Unix `.tar.gz` set, all covered by `SHA256SUMS`. `dev` builds and runs on Windows; core
84	  repository, task and worktree commands work. There is no tmux, Zellij or Herdr there, so
85	  the runtime backend is always `none`, and `dev fleet open` starts a child shell rather than
86	  replacing the process. Shell integration is `dev shell-init powershell`, which passes the
87	  directory back through a `DEV_SHELL_CD_FILE` temp file since Windows cannot inherit
88	  file descriptor 3. CI now includes `windows-latest` (build, `go vet` and `skill sync --check`
89	  are enforced; the domain test suites run advisory-only until each POSIX assumption is guarded).
90	- `dev upgrade` downloads the newest release for this platform, verifies it against the
```

```text
144						matchedItems[index] = itemFromEntry(entry, probe.live)
145					}
146					ambiguous := &AmbiguousError{Ref: probe.live.CurrentPath, Candidates: candidatesOf(matchedItems)}
147					items = append(items, s.transientItem(probe, ambiguous))
148					diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{
149						Path: probe.live.CurrentPath, Operation: "match catalog try", Err: ambiguous,
150					})
151				}
152			}
153			return nil
154		})
155
156		items = deduplicateItems(items)
157		sortItemsByName(items)
158		sortDiagnostics(diagnostics)
159		return items, diagnostics, lockErr
```

```text
591	func (s *Service) probeDirectory(ctx context.Context, path string) directoryProbe {
592		probe := directoryProbe{}
593		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
594			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "inspect try", Err: err}
595			return probe
596		}
597		info, err := os.Stat(path)
598		if err != nil {
599			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "stat try", Err: err}
600			return probe
601		}
602		if !info.IsDir() {
603			return probe
604		}
605		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
606		if err != nil {
607			probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: path, Operation: "canonicalize try", Err: err}
608			return probe
609		}
610		probe.valid = true
611		probe.live = LiveFacts{Present: true, CurrentPath: canonical, RealPath: canonical}
612		_, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(canonical, ".git"))
613		probe.gitMarker = markerErr == nil || !errors.Is(markerErr, fs.ErrNotExist)
614
615		repository, discoverErr := s.gitDiscover(ctx, canonical)
616		if discoverErr != nil {
617			if probe.gitMarker || !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
618				probe.live.DiscoverError = discoverErr
619				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "discover Git try", Err: discoverErr}
620			}
621			return probe
622		}
623		repositoryRoot := repository.Root
624		if repository.Bare {
625			repositoryRoot = repository.MainRoot
626		}
627		canonicalRoot, rootErr := pathx.Canonical(repositoryRoot)
628		if rootErr != nil || !samePath(canonicalRoot, canonical) {
629			// A TriesRoot may itself be inside a repository. Its child directories are
630			// not independent Git Tries merely because rev-parse walks to that parent.
631			return probe
632		}
633		repository.Root = canonicalRoot
634		if repository.MainRoot != "" {
635			if canonicalMain, mainErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.MainRoot); mainErr == nil {
636				repository.MainRoot = canonicalMain
637			}
638		}
639		if repository.GitCommonDir != "" {
640			commonDir, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
641			if commonErr != nil {
642				probe.live.DiscoverError = commonErr
643				probe.diagnostic = &Diagnostic{Path: canonical, Operation: "canonicalize Git common directory", Err: commonErr}
644				repository.GitCommonDir = ""
645			} else {
646				repository.GitCommonDir = commonDir
647			}
648		}
649		probe.live.Repo = &repository
650		probe.originURL = gitx.RemoteFromConfig(repository.GitCommonDir, "origin")
651		return probe
652	}

670				item.Live.LastCommitSubject = subject
```

```text
58	func (s *Service) updatePhase(ctx context.Context, id string, phase catalog.ExperimentPhase) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
59		var updated *catalog.Entry
60		err := s.store.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
61			current, err := s.store.Get(id)
62			if err != nil {
63				return err
64			}
65			if !eligibleTryRecord(current) {
66				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
67			}
68			if current.MoveIntent != nil {
69				return fmt.Errorf("try %s has a pending %s move", id, current.MoveIntent.Operation)
70			}
71			if current.Experiment.Phase == phase {
72				updated = current
73				return nil
74			}
75			now := s.now()
76			updated, err = s.catalogUpdate(id, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {
77				if !eligibleTryRecord(entry) {
78					return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
79				}
80				if entry.MoveIntent != nil {
81					return fmt.Errorf("try %s has a pending %s move", id, entry.MoveIntent.Operation)
82				}
83				switch phase {
84				case catalog.PhaseDeprecated:
85					if entry.Experiment.Phase != catalog.PhaseActive {
86						return fmt.Errorf("try %s cannot transition from %s to deprecated", id, entry.Experiment.Phase)
87					}
88					entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseDeprecated
89					entry.Experiment.DeprecatedAt = now
90					if location, ok := entry.LocationFor(s.host); ok {
91						entry.Experiment.DeprecatedPath = location.CurrentPath
92					}
93					if entry.Experiment.DeprecatedPath == "" {
94						entry.Experiment.DeprecatedPath = entry.Experiment.OriginalPath
95					}
96				case catalog.PhaseActive:
97					if entry.Experiment.Phase != catalog.PhaseDeprecated {
98						return fmt.Errorf("try %s cannot transition from %s to active", id, entry.Experiment.Phase)
99					}
100					entry.Experiment.Phase = catalog.PhaseActive
101				default:
102					return fmt.Errorf("unsupported experiment phase %q", phase)
103				}
104				return nil
105			})
106			return err
107		})
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, fmt.Errorf("transition try %s to %s: %w", id, phase, err)
110		}
111		return updated, nil
112	}

115	func (s *Service) Patch(ctx context.Context, request PatchRequest) (Item, []Diagnostic, error) {
116		item, diagnostics, err := s.ResolveWithOptions(ctx, request.Ref, ResolveOptions{
117			IncludeDeprecated: true,

119			IncludeEvicted:    true,
120			IncludeGraduated:  true,

124		}
125		remove := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.RemoveTags)
126		add := catalog.NormalizeTags(request.AddTags)

128		err = s.store.WithLock(ctx, func() error {

130			updated, updateErr = s.catalogUpdate(item.ID, func(entry *catalog.Entry) error {

133				}
134				if entry.MoveIntent != nil {
135					return fmt.Errorf("try %s has a pending %s move", entry.ID, entry.MoveIntent.Operation)
136				}

138				for _, tag := range entry.Tags {
139					if !slices.Contains(remove, strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))) {
140						kept = append(kept, tag)
141					}
142				}
143				entry.Tags = append(kept, add...)
144				if request.Note != nil {
145					entry.Note = *request.Note
146				}
147				return nil
148			})
149			return updateErr
150		})
151		if err != nil {
152			return Item{}, diagnostics, fmt.Errorf("mark try %s: %w", request.Ref, err)
153		}
154		return s.itemForEntry(ctx, updated), diagnostics, nil
155	}

157	// Attach explicitly associates an existing catalog ID with one visible Try
158	// directory. Corrupt catalog state blocks the attachment because an unreadable
159	// record may already own the path or Git common directory.
160	func (s *Service) Attach(ctx context.Context, id, path string) (Item, error) {
161		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
162		if err != nil {
163			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("attach try path: %w", err)
164		}
165		if err := s.validateVisibleTryPath(canonical); err != nil {
166			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("attach try path: %w", err)
167		}
168		probe := s.probeDirectory(ctx, canonical)
169		if !probe.valid {
170			if probe.diagnostic != nil {
171				return Item{}, probe.diagnostic
172			}
173			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("attach try path %s: not a directory", canonical)
174		}
175
176		var updated *catalog.Entry
177		err = s.store.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
178			entry, getErr := s.store.Get(id)
179			if getErr != nil {
180				return getErr
181			}
182			if !eligibleTryRecord(entry) {
183				return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
184			}
185			if entry.MoveIntent != nil {
186				return fmt.Errorf("try %s has a pending %s move", id, entry.MoveIntent.Operation)
187			}
188			if location, located := entry.LocationFor(s.host); located && !samePath(location.CurrentPath, canonical) {
189				switch location.State {
190				case catalog.LocationArchived:
191					return fmt.Errorf("try %s is archived on this host; use restore instead of attach", id)
192				case catalog.LocationEvicted:
193					return fmt.Errorf("try %s is evicted on this host and cannot be attached without recovery", id)
194				case catalog.LocationPresent:
195					if exists, statErr := pathExists(location.CurrentPath); statErr != nil {
196						return statErr
197					} else if exists {
198						return fmt.Errorf("try %s is still present at %s", id, location.CurrentPath)
199					}
200				}
201			}
202			entries, diagnostics, listErr := s.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
203			if listErr != nil {
204				return listErr
205			}
206			if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
207				return incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
208			}
209			for _, matched := range matchingEntries(entries, s.host, probe) {
210				if matched.ID != id {
211					return fmt.Errorf("attach %s: path or Git common directory already belongs to catalog asset %s", id, matched.ID)
212				}
213			}
214			updated, getErr = s.catalogUpdate(id, func(candidate *catalog.Entry) error {
215				if !eligibleTryRecord(candidate) {
216					return &NotFoundError{Ref: id, Root: s.triesRoot}
217				}
218				if candidate.MoveIntent != nil {
219					return fmt.Errorf("try %s has a pending %s move", id, candidate.MoveIntent.Operation)
220				}
221				previous, _ := candidate.LocationFor(s.host)
222				if probe.originURL != "" {
223					candidate.Experiment.OriginURL = probe.originURL
224					candidate.RemoteIdentity = remoteIdentityFromOrigin(probe.originURL)
225				}
226				return candidate.SetLocation(s.host, locationFromProbe(probe, previous))
227			})
228			return getErr
229		})
230		if err != nil {
231			return Item{}, fmt.Errorf("attach try %s: %w", id, err)
232		}
233		return s.itemForEntry(ctx, updated), nil
234	}
```

```text
1050	// collectRemotes aggregates configured forge CLIs, caches the normalised response, then
1051	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
1052	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
1053	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1054		type result struct {
1055			kind  forge.Kind
1056			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1057			err   error
1058		}
1059		providers := configuredForges(app)
1060		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1061		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1062		available := 0
1063		var unavailable []error
1064		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1065		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1066		for _, f := range providers {
1067			if !f.Available() {
1068				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1069				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1070				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1071					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1072					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1073					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())
1074				}
1075				continue
1076			}
1077			expected[f.Kind()] = true
1078			available++
1079			wg.Add(1)
1080			go func(f forge.Forge) {
1081				defer wg.Done()
1082				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx)
1083				ch <- result{kind: f.Kind(), repos: r, err: err}
1084			}(f)
1085		}
1086		wg.Wait()
1087		close(ch)
1088		if available == 0 {
1089			if cached, _, ok := cachedRemotesAny(ctx, app); ok {
1090				if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1091					return cached, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1092				}
1093				return cached, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1094			}
1095			if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1096				return nil, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1097			}
1098			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1099		}
1100
1101		old, _ := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1102		byProvider := map[forge.Kind][]forge.RemoteRepo{}
1103		statuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1104		for _, r := range old.Repos {
```

```text
49	func tasksForRepo(tasks []*task.Task, r repo.Repo) []*task.Task {
50		var out []*task.Task
51		for _, t := range tasks {
52			if sameCleanPath(t.RepoPath, r.Path) || sameCleanPath(t.RepoPath, r.RealPath) {
53				out = append(out, t)
54			}
55		}
56		return out
57	}
58
59	func sameCleanPath(a, b string) bool {
60		return a != "" && b != "" && filepath.Clean(a) == filepath.Clean(b)
61	}

64	func resolveRepoRef(app *App, ref string) (repo.Repo, []repo.Repo, error) {
65		return repo.Resolve(ctxOf(), app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
66	}

68	func newRepoListCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
69		var (
70			category          string
71			dirtyOnly         bool
72			long              bool
73			jsonOut           bool
74			includeTries      bool
75			noRemote          bool
76			localOnly         bool
77			multipleRemotes   bool
78			multipleUpstreams bool
79			sizes             bool
80			refreshSizes      bool
81		)
82		cmd := &cobra.Command{
83			Use:     "list",
84			Aliases: []string{"ls"},
85			Short:   "List every repository under the scan roots",
86			Args:    cobra.NoArgs,
87			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
88				ctx := ctxOf()
89				// Reuse the TUI's bounded-parallel collector. The old serial
90				// status/worktree/remote loop measured 4.2s over 56 repos.
91				rows, err := collectReposWithOptions(ctx, app, runtime.None{}, repoCollectOptions{
92					IncludeTries: includeTries,
93				})
94				if err != nil {
95					return err
96				}
97				filtered := make([]tui.RepoRow, 0, len(rows))
98				for _, row := range rows {
99					if category != "" && !strings.EqualFold(row.Repo.Category, category) {
100						continue
101					}
102					if dirtyOnly && !row.Status.Dirty() {
103						continue
104					}
105					if noRemote && (row.TopologyErr != nil || row.Topology.HasRemote()) {
106						continue
107					}
108					if localOnly && (row.TopologyErr != nil || len(row.Topology.LocalOnlyBranches) == 0) {
109						continue
110					}
111					if multipleRemotes && (row.TopologyErr != nil || !row.Topology.MultipleRemotes()) {
112						continue
113					}
114					if multipleUpstreams && (row.TopologyErr != nil || !row.Topology.MultipleUpstreams()) {
115						continue
116					}
117					filtered = append(filtered, row)
118				}
119				if sizes || refreshSizes {
120					measureRepoRows(ctx, app, filtered, refreshSizes)
121				}
122				if jsonOut {
123					encoded := make([]repoListJSONRow, 0, len(filtered))
124					for _, row := range filtered {
125						encoded = append(encoded, makeRepoListJSONRow(row))
126					}
127					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
128					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
129					return encoder.Encode(encoded)
130				}
131				if len(filtered) == 0 {
132					if len(rows) == 0 {
133						fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "No repositories under %s\n",
134							strings.Join(contractAll(app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots()), ", "))
135					} else {
136						fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No repositories match that filter.")
137					}
138					return nil
139				}
140
141				headings := []string{"REPO"}
142				if includeTries {
143					headings = append(headings, "KIND")
144				}
145				headings = append(headings, "CATEGORY", "BRANCH", "GIT", "REMOTE")
146				if sizes || refreshSizes {
147					headings = append(headings, "SIZE")
148				}
149				headings = append(headings, "LATEST", "WT", "PATH")
150				t := app.newTable(headings...)
151				style := app.outStyle()
152				for _, row := range filtered {
153					r := row.Repo
154					branch, gitCol := row.Status.Branch, row.Status.Summary()
155					if r.Bare {
156						branch, gitCol = "(bare)", "—"
157					}
158					wtCount := ""
159					if row.Worktrees > 0 {
160						wtCount = fmt.Sprintf("%d", row.Worktrees)
161					}
162					latest := "—"
163					if !row.LastActivity.IsZero() {
164						latest = humanAge(time.Since(row.LastActivity))
165					}
166					path := ""
167					if long {
168						path = config.Contract(r.Path)
169					}
170					remoteColumn := row.Topology.Summary()
171					if row.TopologyErr != nil {
172						remoteColumn = "?"
173					}
174					values := []string{truncate(r.Name, 28)}
175					if includeTries {
176						kind := catalog.KindRepository
177						if row.Asset != nil {
178							kind = row.Asset.Kind
179						}
180						values = append(values, string(kind))
181					}
182					values = append(values, dash(r.Category), truncate(branch, 24), style.git(gitCol), style.git(truncate(remoteColumn, 28)))
183					if sizes || refreshSizes {
184						values = append(values, sizeColumn(row.Usage, row.SizeError))
185					}
186					values = append(values, latest, dash(wtCount), path)
187					t.Add(values...)
188				}
189				t.Render(app.Out)
190				return nil
191			},
192		}
193		f := cmd.Flags()
194		f.StringVarP(&category, "category", "c", "", "only this category")
195		f.BoolVar(&dirtyOnly, "dirty", false, "only repositories with uncommitted changes")
196		f.BoolVarP(&long, "long", "l", false, "show full paths")
197		f.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit stable JSON")
198		f.BoolVar(&includeTries, "include-tries", false, "include active and deprecated Try repositories")
199		f.BoolVar(&noRemote, "no-remote", false, "only repositories with no configured Git remote")
200		f.BoolVar(&localOnly, "local-only", false, "only repositories with a branch lacking a remote-backed upstream")
201		f.BoolVar(&multipleRemotes, "multiple-remotes", false, "only repositories with multiple configured remotes")
202		f.BoolVar(&multipleUpstreams, "multiple-upstreams", false, "only repositories whose branches track multiple remotes")
203		f.BoolVar(&sizes, "sizes", false, "measure logical checkout/private/shared Git bytes")
204		f.BoolVar(&refreshSizes, "refresh-sizes", false, "ignore the size cache and measure again")
205		return cmd
206	}

208	func newRepoMarkCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
209		var add, remove []string
210		var note string
211		cmd := &cobra.Command{
212			Use:   "mark <repo>",
213			Short: "Add catalog tags or update a repository note",
214			Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
215			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
216				if len(add) == 0 && len(remove) == 0 && !cmd.Flags().Changed("note") {
217					return fmt.Errorf("mark requires --add, --remove, or --note")
218				}
219				repository, _, err := resolveRepoRef(app, args[0])
220				if err != nil {
221					return err
222				}
223				var noteValue *string
224				if cmd.Flags().Changed("note") {
225					noteValue = &note
226				}
227				marked, err := patchRepositoryCatalog(ctxOf(), app, repository, add, remove, noteValue)
228				if err != nil {
229					return fmt.Errorf("mark repository %s: %w", repository.Display(), err)
230				}
231				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s\n  path  %s\n  tags  %s\n  note  %s\n",
232					repository.Display(), config.Contract(repository.Path),
233					dash(strings.Join(marked.Tags, ", ")), dash(marked.Note))
234				return nil
235			},
236		}
237		flags := cmd.Flags()
238		flags.StringArrayVar(&add, "add", nil, "tag to add (repeatable)")
239		flags.StringArrayVar(&remove, "remove", nil, "tag to remove (repeatable)")
240		flags.StringVar(&note, "note", "", "replace the note; pass an empty value to clear it")
241		return cmd
242	}
243
244	func patchRepositoryCatalog(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, add, remove []string, note *string) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
245		commonDir := repository.CommonDir
246		realPath := repository.RealPath
247		if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path); discoverErr == nil {
248			if commonDir == "" {
249				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
250			}
251			if realPath == "" {
252				realPath = discovered.Root
253			}
254		}
255		observation := catalog.Observation{
256			Host: config.Hostname(), Path: repository.Path, RealPath: realPath,
257			CommonDir: commonDir, Name: repository.Name,
258			RemoteIdentity: gitx.RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, "origin"),
259		}
260		add = catalog.NormalizeTags(add)
261		remove = catalog.NormalizeTags(remove)
262		entry, err := app.Registry.EnsureRepository(observation)
263		if err != nil {
264			return nil, err
265		}
266		return app.Registry.Patch(entry.ID, func(candidate *catalog.Entry) error {
267			kept := make([]string, 0, len(candidate.Tags)+len(add))
268			for _, tag := range candidate.Tags {
269				if !slices.Contains(remove, tag) {
270					kept = append(kept, tag)
271				}
272			}
273			candidate.Tags = append(kept, add...)
274			if note != nil {
275				candidate.Note = *note
276			}
277			return nil
278		})
279	}

281	type repoListJSONRow struct {
282		Name         string               `json:"name"`
283		Display      string               `json:"display"`
284		Kind         catalog.Kind         `json:"kind"`
285		Category     string               `json:"category,omitempty"`
286		Path         string               `json:"path"`
287		RealPath     string               `json:"real_path,omitempty"`
288		Symlink      bool                 `json:"symlink"`
289		Bare         bool                 `json:"bare"`
290		HasGit       bool                 `json:"has_git"`
291		Branch       string               `json:"branch,omitempty"`
292		Git          repoListJSONGit      `json:"git"`
293		Recovery     repoListJSONRecovery `json:"recovery"`
294		Size         *diskusage.Usage     `json:"size"`
295		SizeError    string               `json:"size_error,omitempty"`
296		LastActivity *string              `json:"last_activity"`
297		Worktrees    int                  `json:"worktrees"`
298		Notes        repoListJSONNotes    `json:"notes"`
299		Asset        *repoListJSONAsset   `json:"asset,omitempty"`

302	type repoListJSONGit struct {
303		Dirty     bool `json:"dirty"`
304		Changed   int  `json:"changed"`
305		Staged    int  `json:"staged"`
306		Unstaged  int  `json:"unstaged"`
307		Untracked int  `json:"untracked"`

315		LocalOnlyBranches []string              `json:"local_only_branches,omitempty"`
316		UpstreamRemotes   []string              `json:"upstream_remotes,omitempty"`
317		NoRemote          bool                  `json:"no_remote"`
318		MultipleRemotes   bool                  `json:"multiple_remotes"`
319		MultipleUpstreams bool                  `json:"multiple_upstreams"`
320		Error             string                `json:"error,omitempty"`
321	}

323	type repoListJSONNotes struct {
324		Count         int     `json:"count"`

330	type repoListJSONAsset struct {
331		ID    string                  `json:"id"`
332		Kind  catalog.Kind            `json:"kind"`

334		Tags  []string                `json:"tags"`
335		Note  string                  `json:"note"`
336	}
337
338	func makeRepoListJSONRow(row tui.RepoRow) repoListJSONRow {
339		kind := catalog.KindRepository
340		if row.Asset != nil {
341			kind = row.Asset.Kind
342		}
343		result := repoListJSONRow{
344			Name: row.Repo.Name, Display: row.Repo.Display(), Kind: kind,
345			Category: row.Repo.Category, Path: row.Repo.Path, RealPath: row.Repo.RealPath,
346			Symlink: row.Repo.Symlink, Bare: row.Repo.Bare, HasGit: row.Repo.HasGit,
347			Branch: row.Status.Branch,
348			Git: repoListJSONGit{
349				Dirty: row.Status.Dirty(), Changed: row.Status.Changed,
350				Staged: row.Status.Staged, Unstaged: row.Status.Unstaged,
351				Untracked: row.Status.Untracked, Ahead: row.Status.Ahead, Behind: row.Status.Behind,
352			},
353			Recovery: repoListJSONRecovery{
354				Remotes:           append([]gitx.RemoteInfo{}, row.Topology.Remotes...),
355				Branches:          append([]gitx.BranchUpstream{}, row.Topology.Branches...),
356				LocalOnlyBranches: append([]string(nil), row.Topology.LocalOnlyBranches...),
357				UpstreamRemotes:   append([]string(nil), row.Topology.UpstreamRemotes...),
358				NoRemote:          row.TopologyErr == nil && !row.Topology.HasRemote(),
359				MultipleRemotes:   row.Topology.MultipleRemotes(),
360				MultipleUpstreams: row.Topology.MultipleUpstreams(),
361			},
362			LastActivity: rfc3339Value(row.LastActivity), Worktrees: row.Worktrees,
363			Notes: repoListJSONNotes{Count: row.NoteCount},
364		}
365		if row.LatestNote != nil {
366			result.Notes.LatestID = row.LatestNote.ID
367			result.Notes.LatestPreview = row.LatestNote.Preview(120)
368			result.Notes.LatestUpdated = rfc3339Value(row.LatestNote.Updated)
369		}
370		if row.TopologyErr != nil {
371			result.Recovery.Error = row.TopologyErr.Error()
372		}
373		if row.Usage != nil {
374			usage := *row.Usage
375			result.Size = &usage
376		}
377		if row.SizeError != nil {
378			result.SizeError = row.SizeError.Error()
379		}
380		if row.Asset != nil {
381			asset := &repoListJSONAsset{
382				ID: row.Asset.ID, Kind: row.Asset.Kind,
383				Tags: append([]string{}, row.Asset.Tags...), Note: row.Asset.Note,
384			}
385			if row.Asset.Experiment != nil {
386				asset.Phase = row.Asset.Experiment.Phase
387			}
388			result.Asset = asset
389		}
390		return result
391	}

424	func newRepoSyncCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
425		var all bool
426		cmd := &cobra.Command{
427			Use:   "sync [repo]",
428			Short: "Fetch and prune, reporting what moved",
429			Long: `Fetch from origin and prune deleted remote-tracking refs.
430
431	Deliberately not a pull: dev reports how each branch stands and leaves the
432	decision to you, because a pull that quietly merges or rebases is how a
433	history gets a shape nobody intended.`,
434			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
435			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
436				ctx := ctxOf()
437				var targets []repo.Repo
438				switch {
439				case all:
440					var err error
441					targets, err = repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
442					if err != nil {
443						return err
444					}
445				case len(args) == 1:
446					r, _, err := resolveRepoRef(app, args[0])
447					if err != nil {
448						return err
449					}
450					targets = []repo.Repo{r}
451				default:
452					path, name, err := repoContext(app, "")
453					if err != nil {
454						return err
455					}
456					targets = []repo.Repo{{Name: name, Path: path}}
457				}
458
459				t := app.newTable("REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "NOTE")
460				style := app.outStyle()
461				for _, r := range targets {
462					if r.Bare {
463						continue
464					}
465					note := ""
466					if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, r.Path, "fetch", "--prune", "--quiet", "origin"); err != nil {
467						note = "fetch failed (no remote?)"
468					}
469					st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
470					if err != nil {
471						continue
472					}
473					if note == "" {
474						switch {
475						case st.Behind > 0 && st.Ahead > 0:
476							note = "diverged — rebase or merge explicitly"
477						case st.Behind > 0 && !st.Dirty():
478							note = "behind — git pull --ff-only"
479						case st.Behind > 0:
480							note = "behind, and dirty — commit first"
481						case st.Ahead > 0:
482							note = "unpushed commits"
483						}
484					}
485					noteCell := note
486					if note != "" {
487						noteCell = style.warning(note)
488					}
489					t.Add(truncate(r.Name, 28), truncate(st.Branch, 24), style.git(st.Summary()), noteCell)
490				}
491				t.Render(app.Out)
492				return nil
493			},
494		}
495		cmd.Flags().BoolVarP(&all, "all", "a", false, "every repository under the scan roots")
496		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeRepos(app)
497		return cmd
498	}

500	// repoNameFromRef derives a directory name from a clone reference.
501	func repoNameFromRef(ref string) string {
502		ref = strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(ref, "/"), ".git")
503		if i := strings.LastIndexAny(ref, "/:\\"); i >= 0 {
504			return ref[i+1:]
505		}
506		return ref
507	}
508
509	func contractAll(paths []string) []string {
510		out := make([]string, len(paths))
511		for i, p := range paths {
512			out[i] = config.Contract(p)
513		}
514		return out
515	}

517	func newRepoRemoteCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
518		var (
519			jsonOut    bool
520			cachedOnly bool
521			refresh    bool
522			visibility string
523			limit      int
524		)
525		cmd := &cobra.Command{
526			Use:     "remote [query]",
527			Aliases: []string{"search"},
528			Short:   "List and search repositories visible through configured forge CLIs",
529			Long: `Combine repositories visible to authenticated gh and glab CLIs with any
530	configured Azure DevOps organization/project targets, and mark those already cloned
531	under paths.scan_roots.
532
533	The TUI exposes the same data in its REMOTE tab and filters it live with /.
534	This command is the non-interactive form for scripts, pipes and terminals where
535	a full-screen UI is not wanted. Fresh complete cache is reused automatically;
536	use --cached for an offline result or --refresh to force synchronization. The
537	cache is private, and forge.cache_ttl decides when it needs refresh.`,
538			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
539			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
540				var (
541					rows []tui.RemoteRow
542					err  error
543				)
544				if cachedOnly && refresh {
545					return fmt.Errorf("--cached cannot be combined with --refresh")
546				}
547				visibility = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(visibility))
548				switch visibility {
549				case "", "public", "private", "internal":
550				default:
551					return fmt.Errorf("unknown --visibility %q: want public, private or internal", visibility)
552				}
553				if cachedOnly {
554					var ok bool
555					var cache forge.Cache
556					rows, cache, ok = cachedRemotesAny(ctxOf(), app)
557					if !ok {
558						return fmt.Errorf("no remote cache; run `dev repo remote --refresh` once online")
559					}
560					if !cache.Fresh(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration) {
561						app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh`")
562					}
563				} else if !refresh {
564					var ok bool
565					rows, ok = cachedRemotes(ctxOf(), app)
566					if !ok {
567						rows, err = collectRemotes(ctxOf(), app)
568					}
569				} else {
570					rows, err = collectRemotes(ctxOf(), app)
571				}
572				// Partial results are useful when one forge is authenticated and
573				// the other is not. Render them, then report the partial failure.
574				if len(rows) == 0 && err != nil {
575					return err
576				}
577				query := ""
578				if len(args) == 1 {
579					query = strings.ToLower(args[0])
580				}
581				var filtered []tui.RemoteRow
582				for _, r := range rows {
583					if visibility != "" && !strings.EqualFold(r.Repo.Visibility, visibility) {
584						continue
585					}
586					hay := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
587						string(r.Repo.Forge), r.Repo.FullName, r.Repo.Description,
588						r.Repo.Visibility, r.LocalName,
589					}, " "))
590					matched := true
591					for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
592						if !strings.Contains(hay, term) {
593							matched = false
594							break
595						}
596					}
597					if matched {
598						filtered = append(filtered, r)
599					}
600				}
601				sort.SliceStable(filtered, func(i, j int) bool {
602					if !filtered[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.Equal(filtered[j].Repo.UpdatedAt) {
603						return filtered[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.After(filtered[j].Repo.UpdatedAt)
604					}
605					return filtered[i].Repo.Label() < filtered[j].Repo.Label()
606				})
607				if limit > 0 && len(filtered) > limit {
608					filtered = filtered[:limit]
609				}
610
611				if jsonOut {
612					enc := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
613					enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
614					if encodeErr := enc.Encode(filtered); encodeErr != nil {
615						return encodeErr
616					}
617				} else {
618					t := app.newTable("FORGE", "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "LOCAL", "UPDATED", "DESCRIPTION")
619					style := app.outStyle()
620					for _, r := range filtered {
621						local := "—"
622						if r.LocalPath != "" {
623							local = style.success(config.Contract(r.LocalPath))
624						}
625						updated := "—"
626						if !r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
627							updated = r.Repo.UpdatedAt.Format("2006-01-02")
628						}
629						t.Add(string(r.Repo.Forge), truncate(r.Repo.FullName, 36),
630							strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility), truncate(local, 30), updated,
631							truncate(r.Repo.Description, 50))
632					}
633					if t.Len() == 0 {
634						fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No remote repositories match that query.")
635					} else {
636						t.Render(app.Out)
637					}
638				}
639				if err != nil {
640					app.warnf("partial remote results: %v", err)
641				}
642				return nil
643			},
644		}
645		f := cmd.Flags()
646		f.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit JSON")
647		f.BoolVar(&cachedOnly, "cached", false, "use the XDG cache without querying forge providers")
648		f.BoolVar(&refresh, "refresh", false, "force a complete forge inventory refresh")
649		f.StringVar(&visibility, "visibility", "", "filter visibility: public, private or internal")
650		f.IntVar(&limit, "limit", 0, "maximum matching repositories to render (0 for all)")
651		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "visibility", fixedCompletions("public", "private", "internal"))
652		return cmd
653	}
654
```

```text
83	// collectLocalRepoContext is the single CLI collector used by repo context and
84	// status. It executes only local Git/task/runtime probes; includeTopology adds
85	// repository-wide remote/ref facts but never performs fetch or other network I/O.
86	func collectLocalRepoContext(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, selectedPath string, includeTopology bool) localRepoContext {
87		var (
88			tasks    = []*task.Task{}
89			tasksErr error
90		)
91		if app.Tasks == nil {
92			tasksErr = errors.New("task store is unavailable")
93		} else {
94			listed, diagnostics, err := app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
95			if err != nil {
96				tasksErr = err
97			} else {
98				tasks = tasksForRepo(listed, repository)
99				for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
100					tasksErr = errors.Join(tasksErr, diagnostic)
101				}
102			}
103		}
104
105		rt := app.Runtime()
106		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
107		local := localRepoContext{
108			Context: inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, repository, tasks, sessions, rt.Name()),
109			Runtimes: []repocontext.RuntimeInput{{
110				Backend: rt.Name(), Available: rt.Available(), Sessions: sessions, Err: runtimeErr,
111			}},
112			SelectedCheckout: -1,
113		}
114		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
115		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
116		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
117			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
118		} else {
119			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
120		}
121		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
122			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
123		}
124		return local
125	}

127	func resolveRepoContextTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (repo.Repo, string, error) {
128		if len(args) == 1 {
129			resolved, _, err := resolveRepoRef(app, args[0])
130			if err != nil {
131				return repo.Repo{}, "", err
132			}
133			return resolved, resolved.Path, nil
134		}
135		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
136		if err != nil {
137			return repo.Repo{}, "", err
138		}
139		discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
140		if err != nil {
141			return repo.Repo{}, "", fmt.Errorf("%s is not a git repository — pass a repo", config.Contract(cwd))
142		}
143		selectedPath := discovered.Root
144		if selectedPath == "" {
145			selectedPath = discovered.MainRoot
146		}
147		return repo.Repo{
148			Name: discovered.Name, Path: discovered.MainRoot, RealPath: discovered.MainRoot,
149			GitDir: discovered.GitCommonDir, CommonDir: discovered.GitCommonDir,
150			MainRoot: discovered.MainRoot, HasGit: true, Bare: discovered.Bare,
151		}, selectedPath, nil
152	}

154	func collectRepoContextForge(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool, now time.Time) repocontext.ForgeInput {
155		cacheInput := func(cache forge.Cache, collectionErr error) repocontext.ForgeInput {
156			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
157			if forgeCacheStale(cache, app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, now) {
158				freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
159			}
160			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
161			if !cache.Complete || collectionErr != nil {
162				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
163			}
164			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
165				Authority: assessment.AuthorityCache, Freshness: freshness,
166				Completeness: completeness, ObservedAt: cache.FetchedAt,
167				Records: append([]forge.RemoteRepo{}, cache.Repos...),
168				Err:     errors.Join(collectionErr, forgeCacheErrors(cache)),
169			}
170		}
171
172		if !refresh {
173			cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
174			if !ok {
175				return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: errors.New("no cached forge inventory; rerun with --refresh to collect one")}
176			}
177			return cacheInput(cache, nil)
178		}
179
180		rows, collectionErr := collectRemotes(ctx, app)
181		records := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(rows))
182		for _, row := range rows {
183			records = append(records, row.Repo)
184		}
185		if collectionErr == nil {
186			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
187				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
188				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
189				Records: records,
190			}
191		}
192		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
193			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
194			if len(records) > 0 {
195				cached.Records = records
196			}
197			return cached
198		}
199		if len(records) > 0 {
200			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
201				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
202				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
203				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
204			}
205		}
206		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
207	}
208
209	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
210		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
211			return true
212		}
213		if ttl <= 0 {
214			return false
215		}
216		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
217	}
218
219	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
220		var providerErrors []error
221		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
222		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
223		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
224			name := string(kind)
225			kinds = append(kinds, name)
226			byKind[name] = status
227		}
228		sort.Strings(kinds)
229		for _, kind := range kinds {
230			status := byKind[kind]
231			if status.Error != "" {
232				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
233			} else if !status.Complete {
234				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
235			}
236		}
237		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
238	}
239
240	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
241		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
242		if err != nil {
243			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
244		}
245		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
246			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
247			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
248			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
249		}
250		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
251			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
252		}
253		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
254			return input
255		}
256		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
257		if parallel <= 0 {
258			parallel = 1
259		}
260		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
261		var wait sync.WaitGroup
262		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
263			wait.Add(1)
264			go func() {
265				defer wait.Done()
266				semaphore <- struct{}{}
267				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
268				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
269			}()
270		}
271		wait.Wait()
272		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
273			input.Err = err
274		}
275		return input
276	}
```

```text
319	// Load reads config.toml over the defaults. A missing file is not an error —
320	// dev must be useful with zero setup. A malformed file is, because silently
321	// falling back to defaults would send worktrees to the wrong volume.
322	func Load(path string) (Config, error) {
323		cfg := Default()
324		if path == "" {
325			path = ConfigFile()
326		}
327		md, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
328		switch {
329		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
330			return cfg, nil
331		case err != nil:
332			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
333		}
334		if undecoded := md.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
335			// Unknown keys are usually typos ("worktree_dir" vs "worktree_root").
336			// Warn rather than fail so a newer config still works on an older dev.
337			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: unknown key(s) in %s: %v\n", path, undecoded)
338		}
339		cfg.Source = path
340		return cfg, cfg.Validate()
341	}

405			"latest": true, "worktrees": true, "tasks": true, "notes": true,
406			"category": true, "path": true,

409			if !validColumns[column] {
410				return fmt.Errorf("tui.repos.columns[%d] %q: unknown column", i, column)
411			}
412		}
413		switch c.EffectiveRepoSort() {
414		case "activity", "latest", "name", "git", "size", "tasks":
415		default:
416			return fmt.Errorf("tui.repos.sort %q: want activity, latest, name, git, size or tasks", c.TUI.Repos.Sort)
417		}

438	func validAzureDevOpsOrganization(raw string) bool {
439		u, err := url.Parse(raw)
440		if err != nil || !strings.EqualFold(u.Scheme, "https") || u.User != nil ||
441			u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" || u.Port() != "" {
442			return false
443		}
444		host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
445		segments := strings.FieldsFunc(u.Path, func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' })
446		switch {
447		case host == "dev.azure.com":
448			return len(segments) == 1
449		case strings.HasSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com"):
450			organization := strings.TrimSuffix(host, ".visualstudio.com")
451			return organization != "" && organization != "vs-ssh" && len(segments) == 0
452		default:
453			return false
454		}
455	}

508	// DiscoveryRoots returns exact repositories first, followed by recursive scan
509	// roots. repo.Discover recognises when a supplied root is itself a repository.
510	func (c Config) DiscoveryRoots() []string {

512		out := make([]string, 0, len(c.Paths.RepoPaths)+len(c.Paths.ScanRoots))
513		for _, roots := range [][]string{c.RepoPaths(), c.ScanRoots()} {
514			for _, root := range roots {
515				clean := filepath.Clean(root)
516				if clean == "" || seen[clean] {
517					continue
518				}
519				seen[clean] = true
520				out = append(out, clean)
521			}
522		}
523		return out
524	}
```

```text
24	// TrustRecord intentionally stores no command, script, config bytes, or
25	// display metadata. Approval is tied only to canonical repository identity
26	// and the exact execution-bearing content digest.
27	type TrustRecord struct {

29		ExecutionHash string    `json:"execution_hash"`
30		ApprovedAt    time.Time `json:"approved_at"`

38	// TrustStore is a private, local JSON trust database. Path should live under
39	// dev's host state directory, never inside the repository.
40	type TrustStore struct {
41		Path  string
42		Clock func() time.Time
43
44		mu sync.Mutex
45	}

47	// NewTrustStore returns a store at path.

50	}

52	// CanonicalRepoIdentity returns Git's canonical common directory when path is
53	// a repository, making every linked worktree share one trust identity. A
54	// not-yet-initialized project falls back to its canonical physical root.
55	func CanonicalRepoIdentity(ctx context.Context, repoRoot string) (string, error) {
56		root, err := pathx.Canonical(repoRoot)
57		if err != nil {
58			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize repository: %w", err)
59		}
60		info, err := os.Stat(root)
61		if err != nil {
62			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect repository %s: %w", root, err)
63		}
64		if !info.IsDir() {
65			return "", fmt.Errorf("repository path %s is not a directory", root)
66		}
67		if ctx == nil {
68			ctx = context.Background()
69		}
70		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, root)
71		if errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
72			return root, nil
73		}
74		if err != nil {
75			return "", fmt.Errorf("discover repository identity: %w", err)
76		}
77		identity, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
78		if err != nil {
79			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory: %w", err)
80		}
81		return identity, nil
82	}

84	// Approve trusts hash for repoRoot. A new approval replaces every older hash
85	// for that repository, so changing and later reverting executable config still
86	// requires a fresh explicit approval.
87	func (s *TrustStore) Approve(ctx context.Context, repoRoot, hash string) (TrustRecord, error) {
88		if err := validateExecutionHash(hash); err != nil {
89			return TrustRecord{}, err
90		}
91		identity, err := CanonicalRepoIdentity(ctx, repoRoot)
92		if err != nil {
93			return TrustRecord{}, err
94		}
95		record := TrustRecord{Repository: identity, ExecutionHash: hash, ApprovedAt: s.now()}
96
97		s.mu.Lock()
98		defer s.mu.Unlock()
99		records, err := s.loadLocked()
100		if err != nil {
101			return TrustRecord{}, err
102		}
103		kept := records[:0]
104		for _, existing := range records {
105			if existing.Repository != identity {
106				kept = append(kept, existing)
107			}
108		}
109		records = append(kept, record)
110		if err := s.saveLocked(records); err != nil {
111			return TrustRecord{}, err
112		}
113		return record, nil
114	}

116	// Check reports whether the exact current repository identity and hash are

118	func (s *TrustStore) Check(ctx context.Context, repoRoot, hash string) (bool, error) {
119		if err := validateExecutionHash(hash); err != nil {
120			return false, err
121		}
122		identity, err := CanonicalRepoIdentity(ctx, repoRoot)
123		if err != nil {
124			return false, err
125		}

129		if err != nil {
130			return false, err
131		}
132		for _, record := range records {

168	// List returns a stable snapshot sorted by canonical repository and hash.
169	func (s *TrustStore) List() ([]TrustRecord, error) {
170		s.mu.Lock()
171		defer s.mu.Unlock()
172		records, err := s.loadLocked()
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, err
175		}
176		out := append([]TrustRecord(nil), records...)
177		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
178			if out[i].Repository != out[j].Repository {
179				return out[i].Repository < out[j].Repository
180			}
181			return out[i].ExecutionHash < out[j].ExecutionHash
182		})

186	func (s *TrustStore) loadLocked() ([]TrustRecord, error) {
187		if s == nil || s.Path == "" {
188			return nil, fmt.Errorf("project config trust store path is empty")
189		}
190		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.Path)
191		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
192			return nil, nil
193		}
194		if err != nil {
195			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read project config trust store: %w", err)
196		}
197		var file trustFile
198		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &file); err != nil {
199			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode project config trust store: %w", err)
200		}
201		if file.Version != TrustStoreVersion {
202			return nil, fmt.Errorf("project config trust store version %d is unsupported", file.Version)
203		}
204		seen := map[string]bool{}
205		for index, record := range file.Records {
206			if !filepath.IsAbs(record.Repository) || filepath.Clean(record.Repository) != record.Repository {
207				return nil, fmt.Errorf("project config trust record %d has a non-canonical repository identity", index)
208			}
209			if err := validateExecutionHash(record.ExecutionHash); err != nil {
210				return nil, fmt.Errorf("project config trust record %d: %w", index, err)
211			}
212			if record.ApprovedAt.IsZero() {
213				return nil, fmt.Errorf("project config trust record %d has no approval time", index)
214			}
215			key := record.Repository + "\x00" + record.ExecutionHash
216			if seen[key] {
217				return nil, fmt.Errorf("project config trust store contains duplicate record %d", index)
218			}
219			seen[key] = true
220		}
221		return file.Records, nil
222	}
```

```text
197	// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects

199	// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
200	// invalid UTF-8.
201	func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
202		if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
203			return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
204		}

210		}
```

```text
406	func validateLocationValue(host string, location Location, requireUpdated bool) error {

439			}

442		}
```

```text
666	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
667		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
668		if err != nil {
669			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
670		}
671		name := temporary.Name()
672		defer os.Remove(name)
673
674		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
675			_ = temporary.Close()

677		}
678		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {

682			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
683		}

685			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
686		}
687		return nil
688	}
```

```text
132			return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}
133		}
134		timeout := host.CommandTimeout.Duration

139		defer cancel()

160	func (t Transport) runAttempt(ctx context.Context, host Host, remoteArgs []string, stdin []byte, pty bool, password string) Result {

162		args = append(args, host.Destination(), remoteCommand(host, remoteArgs))

164		cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(stdin)

166		stderr := newCaptureBuffer(effectiveLimit(t.StderrLimit, DefaultStderrLimit))
167		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = stdout, stderr
168		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LC_ALL=C")
169		err := runSSHCommand(cmd, password)

171		if stdout.Exceeded() || stderr.Exceeded() {
172			message := captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr)
173			result.ExitCode = 125
174			result.CaptureError = message
175			result.TransportError = message
176			result.Stderr = appendBounded(result.Stderr, []byte("\n"+message), effectiveLimit(t.StderrLimit, DefaultStderrLimit))

181		}
182		var exitErr *exec.ExitError

199	// runSSHCommand starts SSH before writing an askpass secret. Starting first is
200	// load-bearing: a secret larger than the pipe capacity must remain cancellable
201	// through the command context instead of blocking before SSH exists.
202	func runSSHCommand(cmd *exec.Cmd, password string) error {
203		if password == "" {
204			return cmd.Run()
205		}
206		executable, err := os.Executable()
207		if err != nil {
208			return err
209		}
210		reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
211		if err != nil {
212			return err
213		}
214		cmd.ExtraFiles = []*os.File{reader}
215		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
216			askpassMarker+"=1", askpassFD+"=3", "SSH_ASKPASS="+executable,
217			"SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force", "DISPLAY=dev-fleet")
218		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
219			_ = reader.Close()
220			_ = writer.Close()
221			return err
222		}
223		// The child owns its inherited descriptor after Start; closing the parent
224		// copy lets an early SSH exit interrupt a blocked write.
225		readerCloseErr := reader.Close()
226		writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
227		go func() {
228			_, writeErr := io.Copy(writer, strings.NewReader(password+"\n"))
229			writeDone <- errors.Join(writeErr, writer.Close())
230		}()
231		waitErr := cmd.Wait()
232		// A descendant could retain the inherited read descriptor after SSH exits.
233		// Close our writer so that cannot strand the write goroutine.
234		_ = writer.Close()
235		writeErr := <-writeDone
236		return errors.Join(waitErr, readerCloseErr, writeErr)
237	}

322				writer = os.Stderr

324			fmt.Fprintf(writer, "SSH password for %s: ", host.Name)
325			terminal, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
326			if err != nil {
327				return "", fmt.Errorf("open terminal for SSH password: %w", err)
328			}
329			defer terminal.Close()
330			password, err := term.ReadPassword(terminal.Fd())
331			fmt.Fprintln(writer)
332			if err != nil {
333				return "", err
334			}
335			return string(password), nil
336		default:
337			return "", nil
338		}
339	}
```
