341	type captureBuffer struct {
342		limit    int64
343		buffer   bytes.Buffer
344		exceeded bool
345	}
346
347	func newCaptureBuffer(limit int64) *captureBuffer {
348		return &captureBuffer{limit: limit}
349	}
350
351	func (b *captureBuffer) Write(value []byte) (int, error) {
352		remaining := b.limit - int64(b.buffer.Len())
353		if remaining > 0 {
354			keep := int64(len(value))
355			if keep > remaining {
356				keep = remaining
357			}
358			_, _ = b.buffer.Write(value[:int(keep)])
359		}
360		if int64(len(value)) > remaining {
361			b.exceeded = true
362		}
363		// Consume excess output without retaining it. The command timeout still
364		// bounds a peer that writes forever, while the parent process stays bounded.
365		return len(value), nil
366	}
367
368	func (b *captureBuffer) Bytes() []byte {
369		return append([]byte(nil), b.buffer.Bytes()...)
370	}
371
372	func (b *captureBuffer) Exceeded() bool { return b.exceeded }
373
374	func effectiveLimit(configured, fallback int64) int64 {
375		if configured <= 0 {
376			return fallback
377		}
378		return configured
379	}
380
381	func captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr *captureBuffer) string {
382		streams := make([]string, 0, 2)
383		if stdout.Exceeded() {
384			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stdout exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stdout.limit))
385		}
386		if stderr.Exceeded() {
387			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stderr exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stderr.limit))
388		}
389		return "fleet transport: remote " + strings.Join(streams, " and ")
390	}
391
392	func boundedBytes(value []byte, limit int64) []byte {
393		if int64(len(value)) > limit {
394			value = value[:int(limit)]
395		}
396		return append([]byte(nil), value...)
397	}
398
399	func appendBounded(current, suffix []byte, limit int64) []byte {
400		if int64(len(current)) >= limit {
401			return append([]byte(nil), current...)
402		}
403		available := limit - int64(len(current))
404		if int64(len(suffix)) > available {
405			suffix = suffix[:int(available)]
406		}
407		return append(append([]byte(nil), current...), suffix...)
408	}
409
410	func localTransportFailure(message string) Result {
411		return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}
412	}

112	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
113	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
114	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
115	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
116		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
117		if err != nil {
118			return nil, err
119		}
120		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
121			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
122		}
123
124		r.mu.Lock()
125		defer r.mu.Unlock()
126		var result *Entry
127		err = r.store.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
128			matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
129			if matchErr == nil {
130				result, matchErr = r.attachUnderLock(matched.ID, normalized)
131				return matchErr
132			}
133			if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
134				return matchErr
135			}
136
137			entry := &Entry{
138				Kind:           KindRepository,
139				Name:           normalized.Name,
140				RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
141				Locations: map[string]Location{
142					normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
143				},
144			}
145			if err := r.store.CreateUnderLock(entry); err != nil {
146				return err
147			}
148			result = entry.Clone()
149			return nil
150		})
151		return result, err
152	}

181	func (r *Registry) attachUnderLock(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
182		return r.store.UpdateUnderLock(id, func(entry *Entry) error {
183			if observation.RemoteIdentity != "" {
184				entry.RemoteIdentity = observation.RemoteIdentity

186			location := locationFromObservation(observation)
187			if previous, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host); ok && location.GitCommonDir == "" &&

189					canonicalValues(previous.CurrentPath, previous.RestorePath, previous.RealPath)) {
190				location.GitCommonDir = previous.GitCommonDir

193		})

237	type matchMethod int

239	const (
240		matchNone matchMethod = iota
241		matchExact

245	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
246		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
247		if err != nil {
248			return nil, matchNone, err
249		}
250		if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
251			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
252			entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
253			return entry, matchExact, err
254		}
255		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
256			return nil, matchNone, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
257		}
258		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
259			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
260		}
261
262		var remoteMatches []*Entry
263		for _, entry := range entries {
264			if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
265				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
266			}
267		}
268		Sort(remoteMatches)
269		switch len(remoteMatches) {
270		case 0:
271			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
272		case 1:
273			if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
274				return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
275			}
276			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
277				"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
278		default:
279			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
280				"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
281		}
282	}

291	func incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics []Diagnostic) error {
292		errorsToJoin := make([]error, 1, len(diagnostics)+1)
293		errorsToJoin[0] = ErrIncompleteCatalog
294		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
295			errorsToJoin = append(errorsToJoin, diagnostic)

300	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
301		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
302		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
303		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
304		for _, entry := range entries {
305			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
306			if !ok {
307				continue
308			}
309			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
310			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
311			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
312			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
313				matched[entry.ID] = entry
314			}
315		}
316		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
317		for _, entry := range matched {
318			out = append(out, entry)
319		}
320		Sort(out)
321		return out
322	}

324	func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {

326		case 0:
327			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
328		case 1:
329			return matches[0], nil
330		default:
331			return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
332		}
333	}

344	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
345		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
346		if !ok {
347			return true
348		}
349		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
350		// A navigation symlink may disappear while its physical clone or Git common
351		// directory remains, so every stored identity path must be absent before the
352		// remote can be treated as relocation evidence. Archives also deliberately
353		// block relocation while their bytes remain.
354		for _, path := range []string{
355			location.CurrentPath,
356			location.RestorePath,
357			location.RealPath,
358			location.GitCommonDir,
359		} {
360			if path == "" {
361				continue
362			}
363			if pathMayStillExist(path) {
364				return false
365			}
366		}
367		return true
368	}
369
370	func pathMayStillExist(path string) bool {
371		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
372			// Lstat deliberately counts a dangling symlink as existing evidence.
373			return true
374		}
375		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
376		if err != nil {
377			return true
378		}
379		_, err = os.Stat(canonical)
380		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
381	}

383	func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {
384		currentPath := observation.Path
385		if currentPath == "" {
386			currentPath = observation.RealPath
387		}
388		return Location{
389			State:        LocationPresent,
390			CurrentPath:  currentPath,
391			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
392			GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
393		}
394	}

396	func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
397		observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
398		observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
399		if observation.Host == "" {
400			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
401		}
402
403		commonDir := observation.CommonDir
404		if commonDir == "" {
405			commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
406		} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
407			left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
408			right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
409			if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
410				return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
411			}
412		}
413
414		var err error
415		canonicalPath := ""
416		if observation.Path != "" {
417			observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
418			if err != nil {
419				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
420			}
421			canonicalPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
422			if err != nil {
423				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
424			}
425		}
426		if observation.RealPath != "" {
427			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
428			if err != nil {
429				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
430			}
431			if canonicalPath != "" && canonicalPath != observation.RealPath {
432				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Path and RealPath disagree: %q != %q",
433					canonicalPath, observation.RealPath)
434			}
435		} else {
436			observation.RealPath = canonicalPath
437		}
438		if commonDir != "" {
439			observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
440			if err != nil {
441				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
442			}
443		}
444		observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
445		observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)
446
447		if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
448			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
449		}
450		if requireLocation {
451			path := observation.Path
452			if path == "" {
453				path = observation.RealPath
454			}
455			info, statErr := os.Stat(path)
456			if statErr != nil {
457				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q: %w", path, statErr)
458			}
459			if !info.IsDir() {
460				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q is not a directory", path)
461			}
462			if observation.CommonDir != "" {
463				commonInfo, commonErr := os.Stat(observation.CommonDir)
464				if commonErr != nil {
465					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q: %w",
466						observation.CommonDir, commonErr)
467				}
468				if !commonInfo.IsDir() {
469					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q is not a directory",
470						observation.CommonDir)
471				}
472			}
473		}
474		if observation.Name == "" {
475			path := observation.Path
476			if path == "" {
477				path = observation.RealPath
478			}
479			if path != "" {
480				observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
481			}
482		}
483		if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
484			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
485		}
486		return observation, nil
487	}

492			return "", err
493		}
494		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil

497	func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
498		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
499		for _, value := range values {
500			if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {
501				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
502			}
503		}
504		return out

507	func canonicalValue(value string) string {
508		if value == "" {
509			return ""
510		}
511		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
512		if err != nil {
513			return ""
514		}
515		return canonical
516	}

518	func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
519		for value := range left {
520			if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
521				return true
522			}
523		}
524		return false
525	}

527	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
528	// stable host/path key. Hosts are case-insensitive, but paths are preserved
529	// because arbitrary Git servers may use a case-sensitive repository namespace.
530	// The result remains only a hint for matching.
531	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
532		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
533		if identity == "" {
534			return ""
535		}
536		if azure := normalizeAzureDevOpsRemoteIdentity(identity); azure != "" {
537			return azure
538		}
539		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
540			if strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file") {
541				return ""
542			}
543			if parsed.Host != "" {
544				return remoteIdentityKey(parsed.Host, parsed.EscapedPath())
545			}
546		}
547		if looksLikeLocalRemote(identity) {
548			return ""
549		}
550
551		afterUser := identity
552		user := ""
553		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(afterUser, '@'); at >= 0 {
554			user, afterUser = afterUser[:at], afterUser[at+1:]
555			// A colon in an scp-like user prefix is a password/token separator,
556			// not a stable SSH username. Reject the identity rather than persisting
557			// credential material in catalog keys, reports, or protocol journals.
558			if strings.Contains(user, ":") {
559				return ""
560			}
561		}
562		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
563			if user != "" && !strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && !strings.HasPrefix(remotePath, "/") {
564				remotePath = "~" + user + "/" + remotePath
565			}
566			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
567		}
568
569		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
570		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
571			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
572		}
573		return ""
574	}
575
576	func normalizeAzureDevOpsRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {

586			out := make([]string, len(values))
587			for i, value := range values {
588				decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(value)
589				if err != nil || decoded == "" || strings.Contains(decoded, "/") {

591				}

593			}

598				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")

602			if decoded, ok := decode(parts[2:]); ok {
603				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
604			}
605		}
606		if len(parts) >= 4 && strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(parts[0]), ".visualstudio.com") &&
607			!strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com") && strings.EqualFold(parts[len(parts)-2], "_git") {
608			organization := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.ToLower(parts[0]), ".visualstudio.com")
609			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{organization, parts[len(parts)-3], parts[len(parts)-1]}); ok {
610				return string(forge.AzureDevOps) + "/" + strings.Join(decoded, "/")
611			}
612		}
613		if len(parts) == 5 && strings.EqualFold(parts[0], "vs-ssh.visualstudio.com") &&

615			if decoded, ok := decode([]string{strings.TrimPrefix(parts[1], "~"), parts[2], parts[4]}); ok {

618		}

622	func looksLikeLocalRemote(identity string) bool {
623		if filepath.IsAbs(identity) || strings.HasPrefix(identity, `\\`) {
624			return true
625		}
626		for _, prefix := range []string{"./", "../", "~/", `.\`, `..\`, `~\`} {
627			if strings.HasPrefix(identity, prefix) {
628				return true
629			}
630		}
631		if len(identity) >= 2 && identity[1] == ':' {
632			letter := identity[0]
633			if letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z' {
634				return true
635			}
636		}
637		return !strings.ContainsAny(identity, `/\:@`)
638	}

640	func splitSCPLike(identity string) (string, string, bool) {
641		if strings.HasPrefix(identity, "[") {
642			if end := strings.Index(identity, "]:"); end >= 0 {
643				return identity[:end+1], identity[end+2:], true
644			}
645		}
646		colon := strings.IndexByte(identity, ':')
647		if colon <= 0 || strings.ContainsAny(identity[:colon], `/\\`) {
648			return "", "", false
649		}
650		return identity[:colon], identity[colon+1:], true
651	}

653	func remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath string) string {
654		host = strings.ToLower(strings.Trim(host, "/"))
655		remotePath = trimGitSuffix(strings.Trim(remotePath, "/"))
656		if host == "" || remotePath == "" {
657			return ""
658		}
659		return host + "/" + remotePath
660	}

662	func trimGitSuffix(value string) string {
663		return strings.TrimSuffix(value, ".git")
664	}

```text
570	Going cold is safe because **the branch is the identity and the directory is a
571	cache**. `dev park --cold` refuses unless the branch is pushed, and `dev resume`
572	rebuilds the checkout from `origin/<branch>`. Once that holds, the local
573	filesystem stops being a graveyard of half-finished worktrees.
574
575	## Rich Git state
576
577	Every inventory surface uses the same compact, starship-like status:
578
579	```text
580	⇕⇡3⇣2 =1 +4 !2 ?3
581	```
582
583	- `⇡` / `⇣` / `⇕` — ahead, behind, diverged
584	- `=` — conflicted paths
585	- `+` — staged paths
586	- `!` — unstaged paths
587	- `?` — untracked paths
588
589	`dev status` and the TUI detail pane also show the unique changed-path total
590	and type breakdown (added / modified / deleted / renamed). A path staged and
591	then modified again is one changed path, while correctly appearing in both the
592	staged and unstaged categories. JSON output exposes all counts separately.
593
594	## Worktree ownership
595
596	Three mechanisms create git worktrees. `dev` takes one position so nobody has
597	to improvise:
598
599	| Kind | Owner | Where | Lifetime |
600	|---|---|---|---|
601	| Feature, fix, experiment, cross-machine handoff | **`dev`** | `~/Worktrees/<repo>/<slug>` | until external `dev retire` |
602	| Harness-owned turn-scoped subagent isolation | **Claude Code** | `.claude/worktrees/` (gitignored) | owned by that harness; no history-relocation guarantee |
603	| `herdr worktree create` | **not used** — `dev` runs `git worktree add`, then `herdr worktree open --path …` | — | — |
604

35	// Limits is the reusable compiled policy for portable file manifests. Every
36	// field is required and must be no greater than the corresponding compiled
37	// ceiling, allowing host configuration to lower limits without weakening them.
38	type Limits struct {

43		MaxComponentBytes int

47	// DefaultLimits returns the maximum policy supported by this binary.
48	func DefaultLimits() Limits {
49		return Limits{
50			MaxFiles:          CompiledMaxFiles,
51			MaxFileBytes:      CompiledMaxFileBytes,
52			MaxTotalBytes:     CompiledMaxTotalBytes,
53			MaxPathBytes:      CompiledMaxPathBytes,
54			MaxComponentBytes: CompiledMaxComponentBytes,
55			MaxPathDepth:      CompiledMaxPathDepth,
56		}
57	}

59	// Validate rejects incomplete policy and values above the compiled ceilings.
60	func (limits Limits) Validate() error {
61		maximum := DefaultLimits()
62		switch {
63		case limits.MaxFiles <= 0 || limits.MaxFiles > maximum.MaxFiles:
64			return fmt.Errorf("max files %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxFiles, maximum.MaxFiles, ErrInvalidLimits)
65		case limits.MaxFileBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxFileBytes > maximum.MaxFileBytes:
66			return fmt.Errorf("max file bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxFileBytes, maximum.MaxFileBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
67		case limits.MaxTotalBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxTotalBytes > maximum.MaxTotalBytes:
68			return fmt.Errorf("max total bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxTotalBytes, maximum.MaxTotalBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
69		case limits.MaxPathBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxPathBytes > maximum.MaxPathBytes:
70			return fmt.Errorf("max path bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxPathBytes, maximum.MaxPathBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)

72			return fmt.Errorf("max component bytes %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxComponentBytes, maximum.MaxComponentBytes, ErrInvalidLimits)
73		case limits.MaxPathDepth <= 0 || limits.MaxPathDepth > maximum.MaxPathDepth:
74			return fmt.Errorf("max path depth %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxPathDepth, maximum.MaxPathDepth, ErrInvalidLimits)
75		default:
76			return nil
77		}

96	// ValidateManifest enforces a validated limits policy over the complete file
97	// set, including exact duplicates and portable case/normalization collisions.
98	func ValidateManifest(files []Metadata, limits Limits) error {
99		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
100			return err
101		}
102		if len(files) > limits.MaxFiles {
103			return fmt.Errorf("manifest has %d files; maximum is %d: %w", len(files), limits.MaxFiles, ErrManifestLimit)
104		}
105		paths := make([]string, 0, len(files))
106		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(files))
107		var total int64
108		for _, file := range files {
109			if file.Size < 0 {
110				return fmt.Errorf("file %q has negative size: %w", file.Path, ErrManifestLimit)
111			}
112			if file.Size > limits.MaxFileBytes {
113				return fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", file.Path, file.Size, limits.MaxFileBytes, ErrManifestLimit)
114			}
115			if _, exists := seen[file.Path]; exists {
116				return fmt.Errorf("path %q appears more than once: %w", file.Path, ErrDuplicatePath)
117			}
118			seen[file.Path] = struct{}{}
119			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
120			if file.Size > limits.MaxTotalBytes-total {
121				return fmt.Errorf("manifest exceeds %d total bytes: %w", limits.MaxTotalBytes, ErrManifestLimit)
122			}
123			total += file.Size
124		}
125		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
126			return err
127		}
128		return nil
129	}

2	// relative paths. It keeps traversal relative to os.Root handles, rejects links
3	// and special files, revalidates filesystem identity, and detects observable
4	// source mutation while reading.

20		// the object observed by the caller.

22		// ErrUnsafeType reports a symlink, reparse point, directory, or other
23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.

29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}

206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}

218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}

37	func CreateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {

128		}
129		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
130			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)

135	// AtomicReplacePrivate is AtomicReplace with owner-only final permissions.
136	func AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
137		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
138			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
139		}
140		return AtomicReplace(ctx, root, name, observed, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
141	}
142
143	func verifyReplaceTarget(root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo) error {
144		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("inspect replacement target %q: %w: %w", name, err, ErrReplaceTarget)
147		}
148		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(observed, current) {
149			return fmt.Errorf("replacement target %q changed or is not a regular file: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
150		}
151		return nil
152	}
153
154	func stageRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (string, fs.FileInfo, error) {
155		if finalMode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
156			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported final file mode %s", finalMode)
157		}
158		var name string
159		var writer *os.File
160		for attempt := 0; attempt < 32; attempt++ {
161			candidate, err := randomStageName()
162			if err != nil {
163				return "", nil, err
164			}
165			writer, err = root.OpenFile(candidate, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
166			if err == nil {
167				name = candidate
168				break
169			}
170			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
171				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("create private staging file: %w", err)
172			}
173		}
174		if writer == nil {
175			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
176		}
177		keep := true
178		defer func() {
179			if keep {
180				_ = writer.Close()
181				_ = root.Remove(name)
182			}
183		}()
184		if err := writeAllContext(ctx, writer, data); err != nil {
185			return "", nil, err
186		}
187		if err := writer.Chmod(finalMode.Perm()); err != nil {
188			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("set staged file mode: %w", err)
189		}
190		if err := writer.Sync(); err != nil {
191			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("sync staged file: %w", err)
192		}
193		opened, err := writer.Stat()
194		if err != nil {
195			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect staged file: %w", err)
196		}
197		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
198			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("close staged file: %w", err)
199		}
200		keep = false
201		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
202		if err != nil {
203			_ = root.Remove(name)
204			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("reopen staged file name: %w", err)
205		}
206		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(opened, current) {
207			_ = root.Remove(name)
208			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("staging file changed before publication: %w", ErrChanged)
209		}
210		return name, current, nil
211	}
212
213	func validateTargetName(name string) error {
214		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
215			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
216		}
217		return nil
218	}
219
220	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
221		for len(data) > 0 {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return err
224			}
225			written, err := writer.Write(data)
226			if err != nil {
227				return err
228			}
229			if written == 0 {
230				return io.ErrShortWrite
231			}
232			data = data[written:]
233		}
234		return context.Cause(ctx)
235	}
236
237	func randomStageName() (string, error) {
238		var random [16]byte
239		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
240			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
241		}
242		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
243	}

17	// Manager creates and removes worktrees according to the configured policy.
18	type Manager struct {
19		Cfg config.Config
20		// Runtime surfaces a new checkout in the multiplexer. May be nil.
21		Runtime runtime.Runtime
22		Log     io.Writer
23	}
24
25	// CreateRequest describes one worktree to create.
26	type CreateRequest struct {
27		// RepoPath is the main checkout that owns the worktree.
28		RepoPath string
29		// RepoName is used in the path template and as the session label.
30		RepoName string
31		// Branch is the change stream. Created from Base when it does not exist.
32		Branch string
33		// Base is the ref a new branch starts from.
34		//
35		// Passing this explicitly matters more than it looks: without a base, git
36		// branches from the current HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on
37		// feature/A silently inherits feature/A's commits.
38		Base string
39		// Category feeds the path template.
40		Category string
41		// Path overrides the templated location entirely.
42		Path string
43		// Label names the runtime session.
44		Label string
45		// NoProvision skips dependency install and gitignored-file copying.
46		NoProvision bool
47		// NoRuntime skips surfacing the checkout in the multiplexer.
48		NoRuntime bool
49		// Focus opens the runtime session focused.
50		Focus bool
51	}
52
53	// CreateResult reports what was created.
54	type CreateResult struct {
55		Path          string
56		Branch        string
57		BranchCreated bool
58		Provision     Result
59		Runtime       runtime.OpenResult
60		RuntimeName   string
61	}
62
63	// ErrExists reports a worktree that is already checked out for that branch.
64	type ErrExists struct {
65		Branch string
66		Path   string
67	}
68
69	func (e *ErrExists) Error() string {
70		return fmt.Sprintf("branch %s is already checked out at %s", e.Branch, e.Path)
71	}
72
73	func (m *Manager) logf(format string, args ...any) {
74		if m.Log != nil {
75			fmt.Fprintf(m.Log, format+"\n", args...)
76		}
77	}
78
79	// Create adds a linked worktree, provisions it and surfaces it in the runtime.
80	func (m *Manager) Create(ctx context.Context, req CreateRequest) (*CreateResult, error) {
81		if req.Branch == "" {
82			return nil, errors.New("branch is required")
83		}
84		repo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, req.RepoPath)
85		if err != nil {
86			return nil, err
87		}
88		// Always operate from the main checkout: creating a worktree from inside
89		// another worktree works, but the relative paths and the base ref get
90		// confusing fast.
91		repoPath := repo.MainRoot
92		if req.RepoName == "" {
93			req.RepoName = repo.Name
94		}
95
96		// Git refuses to check one branch out twice, so an existing worktree for
97		// this branch is a reuse, not an error the user needs to resolve.
98		if existing, ok, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, repoPath, req.Branch); err == nil && ok {
99			return nil, &ErrExists{Branch: req.Branch, Path: existing.Path}
100		}
101
102		path := req.Path
103		if path == "" {
104			path, err = m.Cfg.WorktreePathFor(req.RepoName, repoPath, req.Branch, req.Category)
105			if err != nil {
106				return nil, err
107			}
108		} else {
109			path = config.Expand(path)
110		}
111		if err := ValidateTarget(path, repoPath); err != nil {
112			return nil, err
113		}
114
115		base := req.Base
116		branchExisted := gitx.BranchExists(ctx, repoPath, req.Branch)
117		if !branchExisted {
118			if base == "" {
119				base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repoPath)
120			}
121			if base != "" && !gitx.RefExists(ctx, repoPath, base) {
122				return nil, fmt.Errorf("base ref %q does not exist in %s", base, repoPath)
123			}
124		}
125		var provisionSettings Settings
126		if !req.NoProvision {
127			provisionSettings, err = SettingsForTrusted(ctx, m.Cfg, repoPath)
128			if err != nil {
129				return nil, err
130			}
131		}
132
133		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
134			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create worktree parent: %w", err)
135		}
136		if err := gitx.AddWorktree(ctx, repoPath, path, req.Branch, base); err != nil {
137			return nil, err
138		}
139		m.logf("worktree %s -> %s", req.Branch, config.Contract(path))
140
141		res := &CreateResult{Path: path, Branch: req.Branch, BranchCreated: !branchExisted}
142
143		if !req.NoProvision {
144			// Trusted settings fold in the repository's portable project config.
145			p := &Provisioner{
146				Settings: provisionSettings,
147				Timeout:  provisionSettings.ProvisionTimeout,
148				Log:      m.Log,
149			}
150			pr, err := p.Provision(ctx, repoPath, path)
151			if err != nil {
152				// The checkout exists and is usable; provisioning is best-effort.
153				m.logf("warning: provisioning: %v", err)
154			}
155			res.Provision = pr
156		}
157
158		if !req.NoRuntime && m.Runtime != nil {
159			label := req.Label
160			if label == "" {
161				label = req.RepoName + "/" + req.Branch
162			}
163			opened, err := m.surface(ctx, path, label)
164			if err != nil {
165				m.logf("warning: could not open a runtime session: %v", err)
166			} else {
167				res.Runtime = opened
168				res.RuntimeName = m.Runtime.Name()
169			}
170		}
171		return res, nil
172	}
173
174	// surface registers the checkout with the runtime. When the backend
175	// understands git worktrees it is asked to open it as one, which is what makes
176	// the checkout appear grouped under its parent repo with its own branch and
177	// ahead/behind row rather than as an unrelated directory.
178	func (m *Manager) surface(ctx context.Context, path, label string) (runtime.OpenResult, error) {
179		if wo, ok := m.Runtime.(runtime.WorktreeOpener); ok {
180			return wo.OpenWorktree(ctx, path, label)
181		}
182		return m.Runtime.Open(ctx, path, label)
183	}
184
185	// ValidateTarget refuses locations that would cause trouble later. It performs
186	// no writes, so callers can show a confirmed creation preview before invoking
187	// Manager.Create; Create repeats the check to remain race-safe.
188	func ValidateTarget(path, repoPath string) error {
189		if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
190			if !info.IsDir() {
191				return fmt.Errorf("%s exists and is not a directory", path)
192			}
193			entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
194			if err != nil {
195				return err
196			}
197			if len(entries) > 0 {
198				return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists and is not empty", config.Contract(path))
199			}
200		}
201		// A worktree nested inside another checkout means every indexer, file
202		// watcher and ripgrep run in the outer repo sees a second copy of the
203		// tree. dev keeps checkouts as siblings under the worktree root instead.
204		if path == repoPath || strings.HasPrefix(path, repoPath+string(filepath.Separator)) {
205			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to create a worktree inside the repository (%s); "+
206				"set paths.worktree_path to a location outside %s",
207				config.Contract(path), config.Contract(repoPath))
208		}
209		return nil
210	}
211
212	// RemoveRequest describes a worktree removal.
213	type RemoveRequest struct {
214		RepoPath string
215		Path     string
216		// Force allows removing a checkout with uncommitted changes. dev never
217		// sets this on its own: losing uncommitted work is exactly the outcome the
218		// tool exists to prevent.
219		Force bool
220		// RuntimeHandle is closed before the checkout is removed, so the
221		// multiplexer is not left pointing at a deleted directory.
222		RuntimeHandle string
223	}
224
225	// Remove deletes a worktree checkout. It never deletes the branch — that stays
226	// a separate, explicit decision, matching git's own separation.
227	func (m *Manager) Remove(ctx context.Context, req RemoveRequest) error {
228		if req.RuntimeHandle != "" && m.Runtime != nil {
229			if err := m.Runtime.Close(ctx, req.RuntimeHandle); err != nil {
230				return fmt.Errorf("close runtime session %s before removing checkout: %w", req.RuntimeHandle, err)
231			}
232		}
233		if _, err := os.Stat(req.Path); errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
234			// The directory is already gone; clear git's administrative entry.
235			return gitx.PruneWorktrees(ctx, req.RepoPath)
236		}
237		if err := gitx.RemoveWorktree(ctx, req.RepoPath, req.Path, req.Force); err != nil {
238			return err
239		}
240		m.logf("removed worktree %s", config.Contract(req.Path))
241		return nil
242	}
243
244	// DirtyCheck reports whether a checkout has uncommitted work, so callers can
245	// refuse to remove it without an explicit --force.
246	func DirtyCheck(ctx context.Context, path string) (bool, gitx.Status, error) {
247		st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, path)
248		if err != nil {
249			return false, st, err
250		}
251		return st.Dirty(), st, nil
252	}

```text
1	// Package wt creates, provisions and removes the linked worktrees dev owns.
2	//
3	// Ownership, stated once so agents and humans stop improvising: dev owns every
4	// worktree a person might come back to tomorrow — features, fixes, experiments,
5	// cross-machine handoffs — and places them at the configured path template.
6	// Claude Code's `.claude/worktrees/` stays for harness-owned, turn-scoped
7	// subagent isolation. dev never calls `herdr worktree create`, because
8	// the path policy has to hold on machines without herdr; it creates the
9	// worktree with git and asks herdr only to *open* it.
10	package wt
11
12	import (
13		"bufio"
14		"context"
15		"errors"
16		"fmt"
17		"io"
18		"os"
19		"os/exec"
20		"path/filepath"
21		"strings"
22		"time"
23	)
24
25	// Provisioner brings a fresh checkout up to a working state.
26	//
27	// A worktree is a clean checkout: no node_modules, no .venv, and none of the
28	// gitignored env files the project needs. Without this step every new worktree
29	// starts broken, which is the commonest reason people give up on worktrees.
30	type Provisioner struct {
31		Settings Settings
32		Timeout  time.Duration
33		// Log receives progress lines; nil discards them.
34		Log io.Writer
35	}
36
37	// Result records what provisioning did, so callers can report it honestly.
38	type Result struct {
39		Copied  []string
40		Linked  []string
41		Ran     []string
42		Skipped []string
43		// Failures are non-fatal: a failed `npm ci` leaves a usable checkout the
44		// user can fix by hand, so it is reported rather than rolled back.
45		Failures []error
46	}
47
48	func (p *Provisioner) logf(format string, args ...any) {
49		if p.Log != nil {
50			fmt.Fprintf(p.Log, format+"\n", args...)
51		}
52	}
53
54	// Provision brings dst up to a working state, using src as the source of
55	// gitignored files and any copied dependency trees.
56	func (p *Provisioner) Provision(ctx context.Context, src, dst string) (Result, error) {
57		plan := BuildPlan(ctx, p.Settings, src)
58		return p.Apply(ctx, plan, src, dst)
59	}
60
61	// Apply executes a plan. Splitting this from BuildPlan is what lets
62	// `dev wt plan` show exactly what would happen without doing any of it.
63	func (p *Provisioner) Apply(ctx context.Context, plan Plan, src, dst string) (Result, error) {
64		var res Result
65		for _, w := range plan.Warnings {
66			p.logf("warning: %s", w)
67		}
68
69		for _, step := range plan.Steps {
70			if step.Skipped {
71				res.Skipped = append(res.Skipped, step.What+" ("+step.Why+")")
72				continue
73			}
74			switch step.Kind {
75			case StepCopyFile:
76				if err := p.copyFileStep(src, dst, step.What); err != nil {
77					switch {
78					case errors.Is(err, errAlreadyPresent):
79						res.Skipped = append(res.Skipped, step.What+" (already present)")
80					case errors.Is(err, errSourceMissing):
81						res.Skipped = append(res.Skipped, step.What+" (source disappeared)")
82					default:
83						res.Failures = append(res.Failures, err)
84					}
85					continue
86				}
87				res.Copied = append(res.Copied, step.What)
88				p.logf("copied %s", step.What)
89
90			case StepCopyDir:
91				from, to := filepath.Join(src, step.What), filepath.Join(dst, step.What)
92				if _, err := os.Lstat(to); err == nil {
93					res.Skipped = append(res.Skipped, step.What+" (already present)")
94					continue
95				}
96				p.logf("copying %s …", step.What)
97				if err := copyTree(from, to); err != nil {
98					res.Failures = append(res.Failures, fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w", step.What, err))
99					continue
100				}
101				res.Copied = append(res.Copied, step.What+"/")
102				p.logf("copied %s", step.What)
103
104			case StepLinkDir:
105				if err := p.linkStep(src, dst, step.What); err != nil {
106					if errors.Is(err, errAlreadyPresent) {
107						res.Skipped = append(res.Skipped, step.What+" (already present)")
108						continue
109					}
110					res.Failures = append(res.Failures, err)
111					continue
112				}
113				res.Linked = append(res.Linked, step.What)
114				p.logf("linked %s", step.What)
115
116			case StepRun:
117				p.logf("running: %s", step.What)
118				if err := p.runShell(ctx, dst, step.What); err != nil {
119					res.Failures = append(res.Failures, err)
120					continue
121				}
122				res.Ran = append(res.Ran, step.What)
123			}
124		}
125		return res, nil
126	}
127
128	var (
129		errAlreadyPresent = errors.New("already present")
130		errSourceMissing  = errors.New("source disappeared")
131	)
132
133	func (p *Provisioner) copyFileStep(src, dst, rel string) error {
134		from, to := filepath.Join(src, rel), filepath.Join(dst, rel)
135		info, err := os.Lstat(from)
136		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
137			return errSourceMissing
138		}
139		if err != nil {
140			return err
141		}
142		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
143			return fmt.Errorf("copy %s: refusing non-regular source", rel)
144		}
145		if err := rejectSymlinkParents(dst, filepath.Dir(to)); err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w", rel, err)
147		}
148		if _, err := os.Lstat(to); err == nil {
149			return errAlreadyPresent // never clobber what the checkout already has
150		} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
151			return err
152		}
153		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(to), 0o755); err != nil {
154			return err
155		}
156		if err := rejectSymlinkParents(dst, filepath.Dir(to)); err != nil {
157			return fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w", rel, err)
158		}
159		if err := copyFile(from, to, info); err != nil {
160			return fmt.Errorf("copy %s: %w", rel, err)
161		}
162		return nil
163	}
164
165	func (p *Provisioner) linkStep(src, dst, rel string) error {
166		target, link := filepath.Join(src, rel), filepath.Join(dst, rel)
167		if _, err := os.Stat(target); err != nil {
168			return fmt.Errorf("link %s: not present in the source checkout", rel)
169		}
170		if _, err := os.Lstat(link); err == nil {
171			return errAlreadyPresent
172		}
173		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(link), 0o755); err != nil {
174			return err
175		}
176		if err := os.Symlink(target, link); err != nil {
177			return fmt.Errorf("link %s: %w", rel, err)
178		}
179		return nil
180	}
181
182	func (p *Provisioner) runShell(ctx context.Context, dir, command string) error {
183		timeout := p.Timeout
184		if timeout <= 0 {
185			timeout = 10 * time.Minute
186		}
187		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
188		defer cancel()
189
190		shell := os.Getenv("SHELL")
191		if shell == "" {
192			shell = "/bin/sh"
193		}
194		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, shell, "-c", command)
195		cmd.Dir = dir
196		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = p.Log, p.Log
197		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
198			if ctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded {
199				return fmt.Errorf("post_create %q timed out after %s", command, timeout)
200			}
201			return fmt.Errorf("post_create %q: %w", command, err)
202		}
203		return nil
204	}
205
206	func rejectSymlinkParents(root, parent string) error {
207		rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, parent)
208		if err != nil || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
209			return errors.New("destination escapes worktree")
210		}
211		current := filepath.Clean(root)
212		if rel == "." {
213			return nil
214		}
215		for _, part := range strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)) {
216			current = filepath.Join(current, part)
217			info, err := os.Lstat(current)
218			switch {
219			case errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist):
220				continue
221			case err != nil:
222				return err
223			case info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0:
224				return fmt.Errorf("destination parent %s is a symlink", current)
225			case !info.IsDir():
226				return fmt.Errorf("destination parent %s is not a directory", current)
227			}
228		}
229		return nil
230	}
231
232	func copyFile(from, to string, expected os.FileInfo) error {
233		in, err := os.Open(from)
234		if err != nil {
235			return err
236		}
237		defer in.Close()
238		opened, err := in.Stat()
239		if err != nil {
240			return err
241		}
242		if !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(expected, opened) {
243			return errors.New("source changed after validation")
244		}
245		out, err := os.OpenFile(to, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, expected.Mode().Perm())
246		if err != nil {
247			return err
248		}
249		defer out.Close()
250		w := bufio.NewWriter(out)
251		if _, err := io.Copy(w, in); err != nil {
252			return err
253		}
254		return w.Flush()
255	}
256
257	// copyTree duplicates a directory.
258	//
259	// Symlinks are recreated rather than followed: a pnpm node_modules is a farm
260	// of links into a global store, and dereferencing them would turn a 200MB
261	// copy into several gigabytes of duplicated packages.
262	func copyTree(from, to string) error {
263		return filepath.Walk(from, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
264			if err != nil {
265				return err
266			}
267			rel, err := filepath.Rel(from, path)
268			if err != nil {
269				return err
270			}
271			target := filepath.Join(to, rel)
272
273			switch {
274			case info.IsDir():
275				return os.MkdirAll(target, info.Mode().Perm())
276			case info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0:
277				dest, err := os.Readlink(path)
278				if err != nil {
279					return err
280				}
281				if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target), 0o755); err != nil {
282					return err
283				}
284				os.Remove(target)
285				return os.Symlink(dest, target)
286			case info.Mode().IsRegular():
287				if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target), 0o755); err != nil {
288					return err
289				}
290				return copyFile(path, target, info)
291			}
292			return nil // sockets, devices and the like have no place in a checkout
293		})
294	}

33	// WebURL is a plain, display-safe HTTPS repository URL with derivation
34	// metadata. URL never contains userinfo, query, or fragment components.
35	type WebURL struct {

42	// WebURLRequest supplies a Git remote plus, when available, the exact live
43	// forge inventory record matched to it. Additional host lists identify trusted
44	// enterprise web hosts and authorize matching SSH-host transforms. Environment-
45	// configured GH_HOST and GITLAB_HOST values are included automatically.
46	type WebURLRequest struct {

53	// DeriveWebURL returns a display-safe browser URL when the evidence can be
54	// mapped without guessing. Evidence order is exact RemoteRepo URL, strict Azure
55	// mapping, then literal/configured GitHub or GitLab endpoints. Unknown SSH
56	// aliases, local paths, file URLs, unsupported schemes/ports, controls, and
57	// ambiguous encoded separators return unavailable.
58	func DeriveWebURL(request WebURLRequest) (WebURL, bool) {
59		if request.Exact != nil {
60			if result, ok := webURLFromExact(*request.Exact); ok {
61				return result, true
62			}
63		}
64		if _, rawURL, ok := parseAzureDevOpsRemote(request.Remote); ok {
65			if _, _, safeURL, ok := parseSafeHTTPS(rawURL); ok {
66				return WebURL{
67					URL: safeURL, Provider: AzureDevOps,
68					Source: WebURLSourceAzureRemote, Confidence: WebURLConfidenceStrict,
69				}, true
70			}
71		}
72
73		endpoint, ok := parseForgeEndpoint(request.Remote)
74		if !ok {
75			return WebURL{}, false
76		}
77		hosts := webHostPolicy(request)
78		provider := hosts.provider(endpoint.host, endpoint.transport == "ssh")
79		if provider == Unknown || !validRepositorySegments(provider, endpoint.segments) {
80			return WebURL{}, false
81		}
82		segments := stripGitSuffix(endpoint.segments)
83		if segments == nil {
84			return WebURL{}, false
85		}
86		return WebURL{
87			URL: buildHTTPSURL(endpoint.host, segments), Provider: provider,
88			Source: WebURLSourceGitRemote, Confidence: WebURLConfidenceConservative,
89		}, true

92	func webURLFromExact(repo RemoteRepo) (WebURL, bool) {

95			if !ok || repo.FullName == "" || identity != repo.FullName {
96				return WebURL{}, false

124	type forgeEndpoint struct {
125		transport string
126		host      string
127		segments  []string
128	}

130	func parseForgeEndpoint(raw string) (forgeEndpoint, bool) {
131		if !safeRawURLText(raw) {
132			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
133		}
134		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
135		if raw == "" {
136			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
137		}
138		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
139			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
140			if err != nil || u.Opaque != "" || u.Hostname() == "" || !validWebHost(u.Hostname()) {
141				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
142			}
143			host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
144			segments, ok := decodeURLPath(u.EscapedPath())
145			if !ok {
146				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
147			}
148			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
149			case "https":
150				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
151					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
152				}
153				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "https", host: host, segments: segments}, true
154			case "ssh":
155				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22" || u.User == nil || u.User.Username() != "git" {
156					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
157				}
158				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
159					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
160				}
161				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: host, segments: segments}, true
162			default:
163				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
164			}
165		}
166
167		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
168		if at <= 0 || raw[:at] != "git" {
169			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
170		}
171		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
172		if colon < 0 {
173			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
174		}
175		colon += at + 1
176		host := raw[at+1 : colon]
177		if host == "" || strings.ContainsAny(host, `/\\[]:`) || !validWebHost(host) {
178			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
179		}
180		path := stripQueryFragment(raw[colon+1:])
181		segments, ok := decodeURLPath(path)
182		if !ok {
183			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
184		}
185		return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: strings.ToLower(host), segments: segments}, true
186	}

188	func parseSafeHTTPS(raw string) (host string, segments []string, safeURL string, ok bool) {
189		if !safeRawURLText(raw) {
190			return "", nil, "", false
191		}
192		u, err := url.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(raw))
193		if err != nil || !strings.EqualFold(u.Scheme, "https") || u.Opaque != "" || u.Hostname() == "" || !validWebHost(u.Hostname()) {
194			return "", nil, "", false
195		}
196		if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
197			return "", nil, "", false
198		}
199		segments, ok = decodeURLPath(u.EscapedPath())
200		if !ok {
201			return "", nil, "", false
202		}
203		host = strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
204		return host, segments, buildHTTPSURL(host, segments), true
205	}
206
207	func decodeURLPath(path string) ([]string, bool) {
208		path = strings.Trim(path, "/")
209		if path == "" {
210			return nil, false
211		}
212		rawSegments := strings.Split(path, "/")
213		segments := make([]string, 0, len(rawSegments))
214		for _, raw := range rawSegments {
215			if raw == "" || hasEncodedSeparator(raw) {
216				return nil, false
217			}
218			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(raw)
219			if err != nil || decoded == "" || decoded == "." || decoded == ".." || !utf8.ValidString(decoded) ||
220				strings.ContainsAny(decoded, `/\\`) || hasEncodedSeparator(decoded) || containsControl(decoded) {
221				return nil, false
222			}
223			segments = append(segments, decoded)
224		}
225		return segments, true
226	}
227
228	func stripGitSuffix(segments []string) []string {
229		if len(segments) == 0 {
230			return nil
231		}
232		result := append([]string(nil), segments...)
233		result[len(result)-1] = strings.TrimSuffix(result[len(result)-1], ".git")
234		if result[len(result)-1] == "" {
235			return nil
236		}
237		return result
238	}
239
240	func validRepositorySegments(provider Kind, segments []string) bool {
241		segments = stripGitSuffix(segments)
242		switch provider {
243		case GitHub:
244			return len(segments) == 2
245		case GitLab:
246			return len(segments) >= 2
247		default:
248			return false
249		}
250	}
251
252	func buildHTTPSURL(host string, segments []string) string {
253		return (&url.URL{Scheme: "https", Host: strings.ToLower(host), Path: "/" + strings.Join(segments, "/")}).String()
254	}
255
256	func safeRawURLText(value string) bool {
257		return utf8.ValidString(value) && !containsControl(value)
258	}
259
260	func containsControl(value string) bool {
261		return strings.IndexFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
262			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
263		}) >= 0
264	}
265
266	func hasEncodedSeparator(value string) bool {
267		current := value
268		for depth := 0; depth < 8; depth++ {
269			lower := strings.ToLower(current)
270			if strings.Contains(lower, "%2f") || strings.Contains(lower, "%5c") {
271				return true
272			}
273			if !strings.ContainsRune(current, '%') {
274				return false
275			}
276			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(current)
277			if err != nil || decoded == current {
278				return false
279			}
280			current = decoded
281		}
282		// Deeply nested escaping is unnecessary for repository identities and is
283		// ambiguous across clients with different decode counts.
284		return true
285	}
286
287	func stripQueryFragment(value string) string {
288		if index := strings.IndexAny(value, "?#"); index >= 0 {
289			return value[:index]
290		}
291		return value
292	}
293
294	type hostPolicy struct {
295		github map[string]struct{}
296		gitlab map[string]struct{}
297	}
298
299	func webHostPolicy(request WebURLRequest) hostPolicy {
300		policy := hostPolicy{github: map[string]struct{}{}, gitlab: map[string]struct{}{}}
301		for _, host := range append([]string{"github.com", os.Getenv("GH_HOST")}, request.GitHubHosts...) {
302			if normalized, ok := normalizeConfiguredHost(host); ok {
303				policy.github[normalized] = struct{}{}
304			}
305		}
306		for _, host := range append([]string{"gitlab.com", os.Getenv("GITLAB_HOST")}, request.GitLabHosts...) {
307			if normalized, ok := normalizeConfiguredHost(host); ok {
308				policy.gitlab[normalized] = struct{}{}
309			}
310		}
311		return policy
312	}
313
314	func (policy hostPolicy) provider(host string, ssh bool) Kind {
315		host = strings.ToLower(host)
316		if configured, decided := policy.configuredProvider(host); decided {
317			return configured
318		}
319		if ssh {
320			// An unconfigured SSH hostname may be an alias whose real web host is
321			// unrelated. Only explicit web-host configuration or public defaults can
322			// authorize an SSH transform.
323			return Unknown
324		}
325		return literalForgeHost(host)
326	}
327
328	func (policy hostPolicy) identityProvider(host string) Kind {
329		host = strings.ToLower(host)
330		if configured, decided := policy.configuredProvider(host); decided {
331			return configured
332		}
333		// Legacy identity classification may recognize provider-named enterprise
334		// hosts. Unlike DeriveWebURL, this does not manufacture a browser hostname.
335		return literalForgeHost(host)
336	}
337
338	func (policy hostPolicy) configuredProvider(host string) (Kind, bool) {
339		_, github := policy.github[host]
340		_, gitlab := policy.gitlab[host]
341		switch {
342		case github && gitlab:
343			return Unknown, true
344		case github:
345			return GitHub, true
346		case gitlab:
347			return GitLab, true
348		default:
349			return Unknown, false
350		}
351	}
352
353	func literalForgeHost(host string) Kind {
354		switch {
355		case host == "github.com", strings.HasPrefix(host, "github."):
356			return GitHub
357		case host == "gitlab.com", strings.HasPrefix(host, "gitlab."):
358			return GitLab
359		default:
360			return Unknown
361		}
362	}
363
364	func normalizeConfiguredHost(raw string) (string, bool) {
365		if !safeRawURLText(raw) {
366			return "", false
367		}
368		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
369		if raw == "" {
370			return "", false
371		}
372		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
373			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
374			if err != nil || !strings.EqualFold(u.Scheme, "https") || u.User != nil || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" ||
375				u.Path != "" && u.Path != "/" || u.Hostname() == "" || u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
376				return "", false
377			}
378			raw = u.Hostname()
379		} else if strings.ContainsAny(raw, `/\\@?#`) {
380			return "", false
381		} else {
382			u, err := url.Parse("//" + raw)
383			if err != nil || u.Hostname() == "" || u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
384				return "", false
385			}
386			raw = u.Hostname()
387		}
388		if !validWebHost(raw) || !strings.Contains(raw, ".") {
389			return "", false
390		}
391		return strings.ToLower(raw), true
392	}
393
394	func validWebHost(host string) bool {
395		if host == "" || strings.HasSuffix(host, ".") || !utf8.ValidString(host) {
396			return false
397		}
398		for _, r := range host {
399			if r > unicode.MaxASCII || !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' || r == '-' || r == '.') {
400				return false
401			}
402		}
403		for _, label := range strings.Split(host, ".") {
404			if label == "" || strings.HasPrefix(label, "-") || strings.HasSuffix(label, "-") {
405				return false
406			}
407		}
408		return true
409	}
410

1	// Package lockx provides a cross-platform advisory lock over a directory.
2	//
3	// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction
4	// code need to serialize mutations, and neither should have to depend on the
5	// other to get a lock.
6	package lockx
7
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"errors"
11		"fmt"
12		"os"
13		"path/filepath"
14	)
15
16	// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir. The lock file
17	// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
18	// directory being protected. label names the caller in wrapped errors.
19	func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
20		if operation == nil {
21			return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
22		}
23		if ctx == nil {
24			ctx = context.Background()
25		}
26		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
27			return fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
28		}
29		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
32		}
33		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
34		if err != nil {
35			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
36		}
37		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
38		lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
41		}
42		defer func() {
43			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
44				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", label, releaseErr))
45			}
46		}()
47		return operation()
48	}

561	// Apply writes a prepared snapshot into a newly initialized, otherwise empty
562	// repository. All traversal and creation stays relative to a held os.Root, and
563	// file permissions are applied through the opened file descriptor.
564	func (snapshot Snapshot) Apply(destination string) (ApplyResult, error) {
565		result := ApplyResult{Summary: snapshot.Summary()}
566		if err := validateSnapshot(snapshot); err != nil {
567			return result, err
568		}
569		root, rootInfo, err := openNamedRoot(destination)
570		if err != nil {
571			return result, fmt.Errorf("resolve template destination: %w", err)
572		}
573		defer root.Close()
574		entries, err := readRootEntries(root)
575		if err != nil {
576			return result, fmt.Errorf("inspect template destination: %w", err)
577		}
578		gitMetadata := false
579		for _, entry := range entries {
580			if entry.Name() == ".git" {
581				info, err := root.Lstat(entry.Name())
582				if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.IsDir() {
583					return result, errors.New("template destination has unsafe Git metadata")
584				}
585				gitMetadata = true
586				continue
587			}
588			return result, fmt.Errorf("template destination is not a new repository: %q already exists", entry.Name())
589		}
590		if !gitMetadata {
591			return result, errors.New("template destination is not an initialized Git repository")
592		}
593
594		tree, err := buildApplyTree(snapshot)
595		if err != nil {
596			return result, err
597		}
598		if err := applyTree(root, tree, &result); err != nil {
599			return result, err
600		}
601		if err := verifyNamedRoot(destination, rootInfo); err != nil {
602			return result, fmt.Errorf("template destination changed during apply: %w", err)
603		}
604		return result, nil
605	}

607	func readRootEntries(root *os.Root) ([]os.DirEntry, error) {
608		directory, err := root.Open(".")
609		if err != nil {
610			return nil, err
611		}
612		defer directory.Close()
613		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(-1)
614		if err != nil {
615			return nil, err
616		}
617		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
618		return entries, nil
619	}

622		directory *Directory
623		file      *File
624		children  map[string]*applyNode
625	}

627	func buildApplyTree(snapshot Snapshot) (*applyNode, error) {
628		root := &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
629		add := func(path string) *applyNode {
630			current := root
631			for _, component := range strings.Split(path, "/") {
632				if current.children[component] == nil {
633					current.children[component] = &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
634				}
635				current = current.children[component]
636			}
637			return current
638		}
639		for index := range snapshot.Directories {
640			directory := &snapshot.Directories[index]
641			add(directory.Path).directory = directory
642		}
643		for index := range snapshot.Files {
644			file := &snapshot.Files[index]
645			add(file.Path).file = file
646		}
647		return root, nil
648	}
649
650	func applyTree(root *os.Root, node *applyNode, result *ApplyResult) error {
651		names := make([]string, 0, len(node.children))
652		for name := range node.children {
653			names = append(names, name)
654		}
655		sort.Strings(names)
656		for _, name := range names {
657			childNode := node.children[name]
658			if childNode.file != nil {
659				if err := writeRootFile(root, name, *childNode.file); err != nil {
660					return fmt.Errorf("create template file %q: %w", childNode.file.Path, err)
661				}
662				result.AppliedFiles++
663				continue
664			}
665			if err := root.Mkdir(name, 0o700); err != nil {
666				return fmt.Errorf("create template directory %q: %w", name, err)
667			}
668			child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
669			if err != nil {
670				return fmt.Errorf("open created template directory %q: %w", name, err)
671			}
672			walkErr := applyTree(child, childNode, result)
673			mode := fs.FileMode(0o755)
674			if childNode.directory != nil {
675				mode = childNode.directory.Mode.Perm()
676				result.AppliedDirectories++
677			}
678			chmodErr := chmodRootDirectory(child, mode)
679			verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
680			closeErr := child.Close()
681			if walkErr != nil {
682				return walkErr
683			}
684			if chmodErr != nil {
685				return fmt.Errorf("set template directory mode %q: %w", name, chmodErr)
686			}
687			if verifyErr != nil {
688				return verifyErr
689			}
690			if closeErr != nil {
691				return closeErr
692			}
693		}
694		return nil
695	}

697	func writeRootFile(root *os.Root, name string, file File) error {
698		_, err := safefile.CreateNoClobber(context.Background(), root, name, file.Data, file.Mode.Perm())
699		return err

702	func chmodRootDirectory(root *os.Root, mode fs.FileMode) error {
703		directory, err := root.Open(".")
704		if err != nil {
705			return err
706		}
707		defer directory.Close()
708		return directory.Chmod(mode.Perm())

711	func finalizeSnapshot(snapshot *Snapshot) error {

713		sort.SliceStable(snapshot.Directories, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Directories[i].Path < snapshot.Directories[j].Path })
714		return validateSnapshot(*snapshot)

130	func parseForgeEndpoint(raw string) (forgeEndpoint, bool) {
131		if !safeRawURLText(raw) {
132			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
133		}
134		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
135		if raw == "" {
136			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
137		}
138		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
139			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
140			if err != nil || u.Opaque != "" || u.Hostname() == "" || !validWebHost(u.Hostname()) {
141				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
142			}
143			host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
144			segments, ok := decodeURLPath(u.EscapedPath())
145			if !ok {
146				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
147			}
148			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
149			case "https":
150				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
151					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
152				}
153				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "https", host: host, segments: segments}, true
154			case "ssh":
155				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22" || u.User == nil || u.User.Username() != "git" {
156					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
157				}
158				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
159					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
160				}
161				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: host, segments: segments}, true
162			default:
163				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
164			}
165		}
166
167		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
168		if at <= 0 || raw[:at] != "git" {
169			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
170		}
171		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
172		if colon < 0 {
173			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
174		}
175		colon += at + 1
176		host := raw[at+1 : colon]
177		if host == "" || strings.ContainsAny(host, `/\\[]:`) || !validWebHost(host) {
178			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
179		}
180		path := stripQueryFragment(raw[colon+1:])
181		segments, ok := decodeURLPath(path)
182		if !ok {
183			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
184		}

14	// RedactRemoteRef returns a terminal-safe remote reference for public display.
15	// URL userinfo, query, and fragment components are removed structurally. SSH
16	// usernames such as git@host remain visible, while an scp-like prefix containing
17	// a password/token separator is redacted. Invalid UTF-8, controls, malformed
18	// explicit URLs, and encoded path controls are replaced by a fixed label.
19	func RedactRemoteRef(ref string) string {
20		if !utf8.ValidString(ref) || strings.IndexFunc(ref, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
21			return unsafeRemoteLabel
22		}
23		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
24		if ref == "" {
25			return ""
26		}
27		parsed, err := url.Parse(ref)
28		explicitURL := strings.Contains(ref, "://")
29		if explicitURL && (err != nil || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" && !strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file")) {
30			return unsafeRemoteLabel
31		}
32		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && (explicitURL || parsed.Host != "" || strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file")) {
33			path, unescapeErr := url.PathUnescape(parsed.EscapedPath())
34			if unescapeErr != nil || !utf8.ValidString(path) || strings.IndexFunc(path, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
35				return unsafeRemoteLabel
36			}
37			parsed.User = nil
38			parsed.RawQuery = ""
39			parsed.ForceQuery = false
40			parsed.Fragment = ""
41			parsed.RawFragment = ""
42			redacted := parsed.String()
43			if !utf8.ValidString(redacted) || strings.IndexFunc(redacted, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
44				return unsafeRemoteLabel
45			}
46			return redacted
47		}
48		if err != nil && strings.Contains(ref, "://") {
49			return unsafeRemoteLabel
50		}
51
52		at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@')
53		if at > 0 && strings.Contains(ref[:at], ":") {
54			return "***@" + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[at+1:])
55		}
56		if at > 0 {
57			colon := strings.IndexByte(ref[at+1:], ':')
58			if colon >= 0 {
59				colon += at + 1
60				return ref[:colon+1] + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[colon+1:])
61			}
62		}
63		if colon := strings.IndexByte(ref, ':'); colon > 0 && !strings.ContainsAny(ref[:colon], `/\\`) && !isDrivePrefix(ref[:colon+1]) {
64			return ref[:colon+1] + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[colon+1:])
65		}
66		return ref
67	}

92	func RedactCloneError(err error, refs ...string) error {
93		if err == nil {
94			return nil
95		}
96		message := err.Error()
97		refs = append([]string(nil), refs...)
98		sort.SliceStable(refs, func(i, j int) bool { return len(refs[i]) > len(refs[j]) })

105			if trimmed != "" && trimmed != ref {

107			}
108		}
109		return errors.New(message)

278				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
279			}
280			checkout = gitRepo.Root
281		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
282			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
283				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)

285					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
286				}

289		}

291			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)

293				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
294			}
295			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
296			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
297				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
298			}
299			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
300		}
301		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
302		if err != nil {
303			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
304		}
305		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
306			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
307		}
308		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")

311		}
312		identity, err := sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
313		if err != nil {

315		}
316		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil

319	func sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
320		var preferred []string
321		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
322			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
323		}
324		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
325		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
326		if err != nil {
327			return "", err
328		}
329		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
330		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
331		for _, remote := range preferred {
332			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
333				continue
334			}
335			seenRemote[remote] = true
336			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
337			if err != nil {
338				continue
339			}
340			identitySet := map[string]bool{}
341			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
342				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
343					identitySet[identity] = true
344				}
345			}
346			if len(identitySet) == 1 {
347				for identity := range identitySet {
348					return identity, nil
349				}
350			}
351		}
352		return "", errors.New("source checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
353	}

115	func resolveFleetOpenRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, request fleet.OpenRequest) (repo.Repo, error) {
116		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
117		if err != nil {
118			return repo.Repo{}, err
119		}
120		var matches []repo.Repo
121		wantedIdentity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(request.RemoteIdentity)
122		for _, repository := range repositories {
123			if request.Path != "" && (sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.Path) || sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.RealPath)) {
124				return repository, nil
125			}
126			if wantedIdentity == "" {
127				continue
128			}
129			topology, topologyErr := gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
130			if topologyErr == nil && matchingSnapshotIdentity(topology, wantedIdentity) {
131				matches = append(matches, repository)
132			}
133		}
134		if len(matches) == 1 {
135			return matches[0], nil
136		}
137		if len(matches) > 1 {
138			return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("remote identity matches multiple repositories")
139		}
140		return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is no longer discoverable", request.Name)
141	}
142
143	func matchingSnapshotIdentity(topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) bool {
144		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
145			for _, raw := range append(append([]string{}, remote.FetchURLs...), remote.PushURLs...) {
146				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == identity {
147					return true
148				}
149			}
150		}
151		return false
152	}

44	// Plan is everything provisioning would do to a new worktree of a repository,
45	// computed without touching anything.
46	//
47	// Making this inspectable matters more than it looks: a worktree that comes up
48	// broken is the single most common reason people stop using worktrees at all,
49	// and "what will this actually do" is not answerable from the config alone —
50	// it depends on which lockfiles exist, which tools are installed, and which
51	// files are genuinely gitignored.
52	type Plan struct {
53		RepoPath   string
54		Ecosystems []Ecosystem
55		Steps      []Step

57		// someone: an unsound strategy that was downgraded, a missing tool.

62	func (p Plan) Runnable() []Step {
63		var out []Step
64		for _, s := range p.Steps {
65			if !s.Skipped {
66				out = append(out, s)
67			}
68		}

86	// SettingsFor resolves effective provisioning settings without enforcing

88	func SettingsFor(cfg config.Config, repoPath string) Settings {
89		s := Settings{
90			Include:          cfg.Worktree.Include,
91			Link:             cfg.Worktree.Link,
92			Cmds:             cfg.Worktree.PostCreate,
93			Strategy:         Reinstall,
94			Strategies:       map[string]string{},
95			ProvisionTimeout: cfg.Worktree.ProvisionTimeout.Duration,
96		}
97		if v, ok := ParseStrategy(cfg.Worktree.Strategy); ok {
98			s.Strategy = v
99		}
100		for k, v := range cfg.Worktree.Strategies {
101			s.Strategies[k] = v
102		}
103		if o, ok := LoadRepoOverride(repoPath); ok {
104			if len(o.Worktree.Include) > 0 {
105				s.Include = o.Worktree.Include
106			}
107			if len(o.Worktree.Link) > 0 {
108				s.Link = o.Worktree.Link
109			}
110			if o.Worktree.PostCreate != nil {
111				s.Cmds = *o.Worktree.PostCreate
112			}
113			if o.Worktree.Strategy != "" {
114				// Keep an invalid value so strategyFor can report it in the plan
115				// instead of silently turning a repo-local typo into reinstall.
116				s.Strategy = Strategy(o.Worktree.Strategy)
117			}
118			for k, v := range o.Worktree.Strategies {
119				s.Strategies[k] = v
120			}
121		}
122		// The directory-based project config supersedes the legacy .dev.toml while
123		// retaining the same deliberately narrow provisioning surface.
124		if project, err := projectconfig.Load(repoPath, nil); err == nil && project.ConfigPresent {
125			o := project.Effective.Worktree
126			if o.Include != nil {
127				s.Include = append([]string(nil), (*o.Include)...)
128			}
129			if o.Link != nil {
130				s.Link = append([]string(nil), (*o.Link)...)
131			}
132			if o.PostCreate != nil {
133				s.Cmds = *o.PostCreate
134			}
135			if o.Strategy != nil {
136				s.Strategy = Strategy(*o.Strategy)
137			}
138			if o.Strategies != nil {
139				for k, v := range *o.Strategies {
140					s.Strategies[k] = v
141				}
142			}
143			if o.ProvisionTimeout != nil {
144				s.ProvisionTimeout = o.ProvisionTimeout.Duration
145			}

150	// SettingsForTrusted resolves provisioning settings and refuses executable
151	// commands from the new project config until their exact content hash has been
152	// approved locally. Legacy .dev.toml retains its compatibility behavior.
153	func SettingsForTrusted(ctx context.Context, cfg config.Config, repoPath string) (Settings, error) {
154		project, err := projectconfig.Load(repoPath, nil)
155		if err != nil {
156			return Settings{}, err
157		}
158		if project.ConfigPresent && project.RequiresTrust() && project.Effective.Worktree.PostCreate != nil {
159			store := projectconfig.NewTrustStore(filepath.Join(cfg.StateDir(), "trust", "project-config-v1.json"))
160			trusted, err := store.Check(ctx, repoPath, project.ExecutionHash)
161			if err != nil {
162				return Settings{}, err
163			}
164			if !trusted {
165				return Settings{}, fmt.Errorf("project worktree setup is executable and not trusted; review it, then run dev config trust %s --yes", config.Contract(repoPath))
166			}
167		}
168		return SettingsFor(cfg, repoPath), nil
169	}
