+// PortablePathLimits bounds the encoded path, each encoded component, and path
+// depth. Zero means unbounded for that field; negative values are invalid.
+// File-count and byte-size ceilings live in safefile because they describe a
+// collection of files rather than a path.
+type PortablePathLimits struct {
+	MaxPathBytes      int
+	MaxComponentBytes int
+	MaxDepth          int
+}
+
+// ValidatePortableSlashPath accepts only a non-empty, clean, slash-separated
+// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects
+// Git metadata aliases, platform-specific separators and volumes, Windows
+// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
+// invalid UTF-8.
+func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
+	if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if value == "" {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path is empty: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains a backslash path separator: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" || driveQualified(value) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path %q is absolute, drive-qualified, or UNC: %w", value, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if limits.MaxPathBytes > 0 && len(value) > limits.MaxPathBytes {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(value), limits.MaxPathBytes, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	components := strings.Split(value, "/")
+	if limits.MaxDepth > 0 && len(components) > limits.MaxDepth {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path has %d components; maximum is %d: %w", len(components), limits.MaxDepth, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	for _, component := range components {
+		if component == ".." {
+			return fmt.Errorf("path contains parent traversal: %w", ErrTraversal)
+		}
+		if err := ValidatePortableComponent(component, limits.MaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q: %w", component, err)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ValidatePortableComponent applies the per-component part of
+// ValidatePortableSlashPath. maxBytes may be zero for no size limit.
+func ValidatePortableComponent(component string, maxBytes int) error {
+	if maxBytes < 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("negative component limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if !utf8.ValidString(component) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("component contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", err, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if maxBytes > 0 && len(component) > maxBytes {
+		return fmt.Errorf("component is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(component), maxBytes, ErrPathLimit)
+	}
+	if strings.IndexFunc(component, isPortableControl) >= 0 {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component contains control characters: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	windowsAlias := strings.TrimRight(component, ". ")
+	if strings.EqualFold(windowsAlias, ".git") {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path contains reserved Git metadata: %w", ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if windowsAlias != component {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q has a trailing dot or space and is not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q contains characters that are not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	if windowsReservedName(component) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("path component %q is a reserved Windows device name: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ValidatePortablePathSet validates every path and rejects collisions at any
+// component boundary after Unicode normalization and full Unicode case folding.
+// Exact duplicate paths are left to the caller's type/cardinality policy.
+func ValidatePortablePathSet(paths []string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
+	type collisionNode struct {
+		spelling string
+		first    string
+		children map[string]*collisionNode
+	}
+	root := &collisionNode{children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
+	for _, value := range paths {
+		if err := ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, limits); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("portable path %q: %w", value, err)
+		}
+		current := root
+		for _, component := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
+			key := portableCollisionKey(component)
+			next, exists := current.children[key]
+			if exists && next.spelling != component {
+				return fmt.Errorf("paths %q and %q collide on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems at %q and %q: %w",
+					next.first, value, next.spelling, component, ErrPathCollision)
+			}
+			if !exists {
+				next = &collisionNode{spelling: component, first: value, children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
+				current.children[key] = next
+			}
+			current = next
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func portableCollisionKey(component string) string {
+	return norm.NFC.String(cases.Fold().String(norm.NFC.String(component)))
+}
+
+func isPortableControl(r rune) bool {
+	return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
+}

+func windowsReservedName(component string) bool {
+	base := component
+	if dot := strings.IndexByte(base, '.'); dot >= 0 {
+		base = base[:dot]
+	}
+	base = strings.TrimRight(base, " ")
+	upper := strings.ToUpper(base)
+	switch upper {
+	case "CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", "CONIN$", "CONOUT$", "CLOCK$":
+		return true

+	if len([]rune(upper)) != 4 {
+		return false
+	}
+	runes := []rune(upper)
+	prefix := string(runes[:3])

+		return false
+	}
+	last := runes[3]
+	return last >= '1' && last <= '9' || last == '¹' || last == '²' || last == '³'

301	// Build joins live local facts with optional external observations. It performs
302	// no probes and never places raw Git endpoints in the returned report.
303	func Build(input BuildInput) (Report, error) {
304		now := input.GeneratedAt
305		if now.IsZero() {
306			now = time.Now().UTC()
307		}
308		now = now.Round(0).UTC()
309
310		report := Report{
311			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion,
312			GeneratedAt:   now,
313			Repository: Repository{
314				Name: input.Context.Repo.Name, Display: input.Context.Repo.Display(),
315				Path: input.Context.Repo.Path, RealPath: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.RealPath),
316				CommonDir: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.CommonDir),
317				Bare:      input.Context.Repo.Bare, HasGit: input.Context.Repo.HasGit,
318			},
319			Sources:      []Source{},
320			Capabilities: []Capability{},
321			Remotes:      []Remote{},
322			Errors:       []CollectionError{},
323		}
324
325		report.Local = buildLocalFacts(input, &report.Errors)
326		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(report.Local.Checkouts) {
327			checkout := report.Local.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout]
328			report.SelectedCheckout = &CheckoutSelection{
329				Index: checkout.Index, Path: checkout.Path, Branch: checkout.Branch,
330				Canonical: checkout.Canonical, Ownership: checkout.Ownership,
331			}
332		} else {
333			message := "selected checkout is not present in the local checkout inventory"
334			if input.SelectionErr != nil {
335				message = cleanError(input.SelectionErr)
336			}
337			report.Errors = append(report.Errors, CollectionError{
338				Code: "selection-unavailable", Scope: "local", Subject: "selected-checkout", Message: message,
339			})
340		}
341
342		localIdentities := privateRemoteIdentities(input.Topology)
343		report.Remotes, report.Forge, report.Errors = buildRemoteFacts(now, input, report.Errors)
344		report.Fleet, report.Errors = buildFleetFacts(now, input.Fleet, localIdentities, report.Errors)
345
346		sources := buildSources(now, input, report)
347		report.Sources = sources
348		report.Capabilities = buildCapabilities(input, report)
349
350		readiness := AssessLocal(input.Context, input.SelectedCheckout, input.Hostname)
351		sourceMap := make(map[string]assessment.Source, len(sources))
352		for _, source := range sources {
353			sourceMap[source.ID] = source.assessmentSource()
354		}
355		gates := []assessment.Gate{
356			readinessGate("checkout-readiness", readiness.Checkout, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.checkout")),
357			readinessGate("task-readiness", readiness.Task, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.tasks", "local.runtime")),
358			readinessGate("worktree-readiness", readiness.Worktree, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.worktrees", "local.runtime")),
359			{
360				Code: "whole-clone-eviction", Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate,
361				Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{
362					Code: "recovery-proof-unavailable", Subject: "repository",
363					Detail:      "whole-clone eviction is not assessed by the context profile",
364					Remediation: "create and restore-verify a recovery receipt before eviction",
365				}},
366			},
367		}
368		assessmentReport, err := assessment.NewReport(assessment.ProfileCheap, now, gates)
369		if err != nil {
370			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("seal repository context assessment: %w", err)
371		}
372		report.Assessment = assessmentReport
373
374		sort.Slice(report.Errors, func(i, j int) bool {
375			left, right := report.Errors[i], report.Errors[j]
376			return strings.Join([]string{left.Scope, left.Code, left.Subject, left.Message}, "\x00") <
377				strings.Join([]string{right.Scope, right.Code, right.Subject, right.Message}, "\x00")
378		})
379		return report, nil
380	}

382	func buildLocalFacts(input BuildInput, reportErrors *[]CollectionError) LocalFacts {
383		context := input.Context
384		local := LocalFacts{
385			Checkouts:                          make([]CheckoutFacts, 0, len(context.Checkouts)),
386			OtherTasks:                         []TaskFacts{},
387			ObservedLinkedWorktreeAdminEntries: context.WorktreeCount,
388			CheckoutsComplete:                  context.WorktreeErr == nil,
389			TaskInventoryComplete:              context.TaskErr == nil,
390			Runtimes:                           []RuntimeFacts{},
391		}
392		if context.WorktreeErr == nil {
393			count := context.WorktreeCount
394			local.LinkedWorktreeCount = &count
395		} else {
396			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("worktree-inventory-failed", "local", "worktrees", context.WorktreeErr))
397		}
398		if context.TaskErr != nil {
399			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-inventory-failed", "local", "tasks", context.TaskErr))
400		}
401
402		for index, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
403			facts := CheckoutFacts{
404				Index: index, Path: checkout.Worktree.Path, Canonical: index == 0,
405				Ownership: checkout.Ownership, Locked: checkout.Worktree.Locked,
406				LockedReason:   optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)),
407				Prunable:       checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
408				PrunableReason: optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)),
409				Branch:         optionalString(checkout.Branch()), Head: optionalString(checkout.Worktree.Head),
410				LastActivity: optionalTime(checkout.LastActivity), LastCommit: optionalTime(checkout.LastCommit),
411				LastSubject: optionalString(checkout.LastSubject), Sessions: []RuntimeSession{}, Tasks: []TaskFacts{},
412			}
413			switch {
414			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
415				facts.State = "error"
416				facts.PathError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.PathErr))
417				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-path-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.PathErr))
418			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
419				facts.State = "missing"
420				exists := false
421				facts.Exists = &exists
422			case checkout.Worktree.Bare || index == 0 && context.Repo.Bare:
423				facts.State = "bare"
424				exists := true
425				facts.Exists = &exists
426				detached := false
427				facts.Detached = &detached
428			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
429				facts.State = "error"
430				exists := true
431				facts.Exists = &exists
432				facts.StatusError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.StatusErr))
433				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-status-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.StatusErr))
434			default:
435				facts.State = "available"
436				exists := true
437				facts.Exists = &exists
438				status := checkout.Status
439				facts.Status = &status
440				detached := checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached
441				facts.Detached = &detached
442			}
443			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
444				facts.Tasks = append(facts.Tasks, taskFacts(tracked))
445				if tracked != nil {
446					if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
447						*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
448					}
449				}
450			}
451			local.Checkouts = append(local.Checkouts, facts)
452		}
453		for _, tracked := range context.OtherTasks {
454			local.OtherTasks = append(local.OtherTasks, taskFacts(tracked))
455			if tracked != nil {
456				if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
457					*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
458				}
459			}
460		}
461
462		runtimes := input.Runtimes
463		if len(runtimes) == 0 && (context.Runtime != "" || context.RuntimeErr != nil || len(context.Sessions()) > 0) {
464			runtimes = []RuntimeInput{{
465				Backend: context.Runtime, Available: context.RuntimeErr == nil,
466				Sessions: context.Sessions(), Err: context.RuntimeErr,
467			}}
468		}
469		for runtimeIndex, observed := range runtimes {
470			backend := strings.TrimSpace(observed.Backend)
471			if backend == "" {
472				backend = fmt.Sprintf("unknown-%d", runtimeIndex+1)
473			}
474			runtimeFacts := RuntimeFacts{
475				Backend: backend, Available: observed.Available,
476				SourceID: "local.runtime", Sessions: []RuntimeSession{},
477			}
478			if observed.Err != nil {
479				runtimeFacts.Error = optionalString(cleanError(observed.Err))
480				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("runtime-inventory-failed", "local", "runtime:"+safeIdentifier(backend), observed.Err))
481			}
482			for _, session := range observed.Sessions {
483				indices := sessionCheckoutIndices(context, session)
484				if len(indices) == 0 {
485					continue
486				}
487				projected := RuntimeSession{
488					Backend: backend, Handle: session.Handle, Label: optionalString(session.Label),
489					AgentStatus:   optionalString(session.AgentStatus),
490					AgentSessions: append([]string{}, session.AgentSessions...),
491					Focused:       session.Focused, Checkouts: indices,
492				}
493				sort.Strings(projected.AgentSessions)
494				runtimeFacts.Sessions = append(runtimeFacts.Sessions, projected)
495				for _, checkoutIndex := range indices {
496					if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(local.Checkouts) {
497						local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions = append(local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions, projected)
498					}
499				}
500			}
501			sortRuntimeSessions(runtimeFacts.Sessions)
502			local.Runtimes = append(local.Runtimes, runtimeFacts)
503		}
504		sort.Slice(local.Runtimes, func(i, j int) bool { return local.Runtimes[i].Backend < local.Runtimes[j].Backend })
505		for index := range local.Checkouts {
506			sortRuntimeSessions(local.Checkouts[index].Sessions)
507		}
508		return local
509	}

546			remote := Remote{Name: observed.Name, Roles: remoteRoles(observed.Name, currentUpstream), Fetch: []RemoteEndpoint{}, Push: []RemoteEndpoint{}}
547			for index, raw := range observed.FetchURLs {
548				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
549				remote.Fetch = append(remote.Fetch, endpoint)
550				for _, key := range matched {
551					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
552				}
553				if endpointErr != nil {
554					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
555						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.fetch.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
556					})
557				}
558			}
559			for index, raw := range observed.PushURLs {
560				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
561				remote.Push = append(remote.Push, endpoint)
562				for _, key := range matched {
563					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
564				}
565				if endpointErr != nil {
566					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
567						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.push.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
568					})
569				}
570			}
571			remotes = append(remotes, remote)
572		}
573		if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
574			matches := len(matchedRecords)
575			forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &matches
576		}
577		return remotes, forgeFacts, reportErrors
578	}

585	func buildRemoteEndpoint(raw string, records map[string][]forge.RemoteRepo, forgeAvailable, exactForge bool) (RemoteEndpoint, []string, *endpointBuildError) {
586		transport, displayIdentity, displayOK := publicEndpointIdentity(raw)
587		forgeMatch := "unavailable"
588		if forgeAvailable {
589			forgeMatch = "none"
590		}
591		endpoint := RemoteEndpoint{Transport: transport, Identity: optionalString(displayIdentity), ForgeMatch: forgeMatch}
592		privateIdentity := privateRemoteIdentity(raw)
593		if !displayOK {
594			message := "endpoint has no display-safe cross-host identity"
595			endpoint.Error = &message
596			return endpoint, nil, &endpointBuildError{Code: "remote-identity-unavailable", Message: message}
597		}
598
599		candidates := dedupeForgeRecords(records[privateIdentity])
600		var exact *forge.RemoteRepo
601		matched := []string{}
602		switch len(candidates) {
603		case 1:
604			if exactForge {
605				exact = &candidates[0]
606			}
607			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "exact"
608			matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidates[0]))
609		case 0:
610			if forgeAvailable {
611				endpoint.ForgeMatch = "none"
612			}
613		default:
614			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "ambiguous"
615			message := fmt.Sprintf("normalized endpoint identity matches %d forge records", len(candidates))
616			endpoint.Error = &message
617			for _, candidate := range candidates {
618				matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidate))
619			}
620			if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw}); ok {
621				endpoint.WebURL = &web
622			}
623			return endpoint, matched, &endpointBuildError{Code: "forge-match-ambiguous", Message: message}
624		}
625		if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw, Exact: exact}); ok {
626			endpoint.WebURL = &web
627		}
628		return endpoint, matched, nil
629	}

631	func buildFleetFacts(now time.Time, input FleetInput, localIdentities map[string]struct{}, reportErrors []CollectionError) (FleetFacts, []CollectionError) {
632		facts := FleetFacts{Coverage: FleetCoverageConfiguredHostsOnly, Hosts: []FleetHostObservation{}, Error: optionalError(input.Err)}
633		if !input.Configured {
634			if input.Err == nil {
635				facts.Error = optionalString("fleet configuration was not collected")
636			}
637			if facts.Error != nil {
638				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-config-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "configuration", Message: *facts.Error})
639			}
640			return facts, reportErrors
641		}
642		count := len(input.ConfiguredHostNames)
643		facts.ConfiguredHosts = &count
644		results := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
645		for _, result := range input.Results {
646			if _, exists := results[result.Name]; !exists {
647				results[result.Name] = result
648			}
649		}
650		for index, name := range input.ConfiguredHostNames {
651			result, found := results[name]
652			if !found {
653				result = fleet.HostResult{Name: name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "configured host produced no observation"}
654			}
655			host := FleetHostObservation{
656				Name: name, State: result.State, CachedAt: optionalTimeValue(result.CachedAt),
657				Match: FleetMatchUnavailable, Repositories: []FleetRepository{}, Error: optionalString(cleanText(result.Error)),
658			}
659			if result.Snapshot != nil {
660				matches := matchingFleetRepositories(result.Snapshot.Repositories, localIdentities)
661				for _, matched := range matches {
662					host.Repositories = append(host.Repositories, fleetRepositoryFacts(matched))
663				}
664				switch {
665				case len(localIdentities) == 0:
666					host.Match = FleetMatchUnavailable
667					if host.Error == nil {
668						host.Error = optionalString("local repository has no normalized remote identity")
669					}
670				case len(matches) == 0:
671					host.Match = FleetMatchNotFound
672				case len(matches) == 1:
673					host.Match = FleetMatchExact
674				default:
675					host.Match = FleetMatchAmbiguous
676					message := fmt.Sprintf("%d repositories on this host share a local normalized remote identity", len(matches))
677					if host.Error == nil {
678						host.Error = &message
679					}
680					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-match-ambiguous", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: message})
681				}
682
683				observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
684				if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
685					observedAt = *result.CachedAt
686				}
687				if !observedAt.IsZero() {
688					sourceID := fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index)
689					host.SourceID = &sourceID
690				}
691			}
692			if result.Error != "" || result.Snapshot == nil {
693				message := result.Error
694				if message == "" {
695					message = "host produced no repository snapshot"
696				}
697				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-host-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: cleanText(message)})
698			}
699			facts.Hosts = append(facts.Hosts, host)
700		}
701		return facts, reportErrors
702	}

969	func publicEndpointIdentity(raw string) (transport, identity string, ok bool) {
970		if !utf8.ValidString(raw) || containsControl(raw) {
971			return "unknown", "", false
972		}
973		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
974		if trimmed == "" {
975			return "unknown", "", false
976		}
977		redacted := trimmed
978		if parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
979			transport = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
980			parsed.User = nil
981			parsed.RawQuery = ""
982			parsed.ForceQuery = false
983			parsed.Fragment = ""
984			redacted = parsed.String()
985		} else {
986			if index := strings.IndexAny(redacted, "?#"); index >= 0 {
987				redacted = redacted[:index]
988			}
989			colon := strings.IndexByte(redacted, ':')
990			at := strings.LastIndexByte(redacted, '@')
991			if at >= 0 && colon > at {
992				transport = "ssh"
993				redacted = "git@" + redacted[at+1:]
994			} else if filepath.IsAbs(redacted) || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, "~") {
995				transport = "local"
996			} else {
997				transport = "unknown"
998			}
999		}
1000		identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(redacted)
1001		if identity == "" || containsControl(identity) {
1002			return transport, "", false
1003		}
1004		return transport, identity, true
1005	}

+// runSSHCommand starts SSH before writing an askpass secret. Starting first is
+// load-bearing: a secret larger than the pipe capacity must remain cancellable
+// through the command context instead of blocking before SSH exists.
+func runSSHCommand(cmd *exec.Cmd, password string) error {
+	if password == "" {
+		return cmd.Run()
+	}
+	executable, err := os.Executable()
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	cmd.ExtraFiles = []*os.File{reader}
+	cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
+		askpassMarker+"=1", askpassFD+"=3", "SSH_ASKPASS="+executable,
+		"SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force", "DISPLAY=dev-fleet")
+	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
+		_ = reader.Close()
+		_ = writer.Close()
+		return err
+	}
+	// The child owns its inherited descriptor after Start; closing the parent
+	// copy lets an early SSH exit interrupt a blocked write.
+	readerCloseErr := reader.Close()
+	writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		_, writeErr := io.Copy(writer, strings.NewReader(password+"\n"))
+		writeDone <- errors.Join(writeErr, writer.Close())
+	}()
+	waitErr := cmd.Wait()
+	// A descendant could retain the inherited read descriptor after SSH exits.
+	// Close our writer so that cannot strand the write goroutine.
+	_ = writer.Close()
+	writeErr := <-writeDone
+	return errors.Join(waitErr, readerCloseErr, writeErr)

+type captureBuffer struct {
+	limit    int64
+	buffer   bytes.Buffer
+	exceeded bool
+}
+
+func newCaptureBuffer(limit int64) *captureBuffer {
+	return &captureBuffer{limit: limit}
+}
+
+func (b *captureBuffer) Write(value []byte) (int, error) {
+	remaining := b.limit - int64(b.buffer.Len())
+	if remaining > 0 {
+		keep := int64(len(value))
+		if keep > remaining {
+			keep = remaining
+		}
+		_, _ = b.buffer.Write(value[:int(keep)])
+	}
+	if int64(len(value)) > remaining {
+		b.exceeded = true
+	}
+	// Consume excess output without retaining it. The command timeout still
+	// bounds a peer that writes forever, while the parent process stays bounded.
+	return len(value), nil
+}
+
+func (b *captureBuffer) Bytes() []byte {
+	return append([]byte(nil), b.buffer.Bytes()...)
+}
+
+func (b *captureBuffer) Exceeded() bool { return b.exceeded }
+
+func effectiveLimit(configured, fallback int64) int64 {
+	if configured <= 0 {
+		return fallback
+	}
+	return configured
+}
+
+func captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr *captureBuffer) string {
+	streams := make([]string, 0, 2)
+	if stdout.Exceeded() {
+		streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stdout exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stdout.limit))
+	}
+	if stderr.Exceeded() {
+		streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stderr exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stderr.limit))
+	}
+	return "fleet transport: remote " + strings.Join(streams, " and ")
+}
+
+func boundedBytes(value []byte, limit int64) []byte {
+	if int64(len(value)) > limit {
+		value = value[:int(limit)]
+	}
+	return append([]byte(nil), value...)
+}
+
+func appendBounded(current, suffix []byte, limit int64) []byte {
+	if int64(len(current)) >= limit {
+		return append([]byte(nil), current...)
+	}
+	available := limit - int64(len(current))
+	if int64(len(suffix)) > available {
+		suffix = suffix[:int(available)]
+	}
+	return append(append([]byte(nil), current...), suffix...)
+}
+
+func localTransportFailure(message string) Result {
+	return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}

1	// Package note stores timestamped repository thoughts as ordinary Markdown
2	// files. SQLite indexes them for search, but the files are the durable source
3	// of truth: readable without dev, syncable without database merge conflicts,
4	// and recoverable after every cache is deleted.
5	package note
6
7	import (
8		"crypto/sha256"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"strings"
12		"time"
13
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
15	)
16
17	const CurrentSchemaVersion = 1
18
19	var (
20		ErrNotFound   = errors.New("note not found")
21		ErrConflict   = errors.New("note changed since it was opened")
22		ErrInvalid    = errors.New("invalid note")
23		ErrRepository = errors.New("invalid note repository")
24	)
25
26	// ImportConflictError describes a transported note ID already bound to
27	// different durable content. Revisions identify the conflict without exposing
28	// the private note body.
29	type ImportConflictError struct {
30		ID               string
31		ExistingRevision string
32		ImportedRevision string
33		Reason           string
34	}
35
36	func (e *ImportConflictError) Error() string {
37		reason := e.Reason
38		if reason == "" {
39			reason = "same ID has different durable content"
40		}
41		return fmt.Sprintf("note %s import conflict: %s: %v", e.ID, reason, ErrConflict)
42	}
43
44	func (e *ImportConflictError) Unwrap() error { return ErrConflict }
45
46	// Note is one timestamped thought attached to a stable catalog asset ID.
47	type Note struct {
48		SchemaVersion int       `toml:"schema_version" json:"schema_version"`
49		ID            string    `toml:"id" json:"id"`
50		RepositoryID  string    `toml:"repository_id" json:"repository_id"`
51		Repository    string    `toml:"repository" json:"repository"`
52		Created       time.Time `toml:"created" json:"created"`
53		Updated       time.Time `toml:"updated" json:"updated"`
54		Tags          []string  `toml:"tags" json:"tags"`
55
56		Body string `toml:"-" json:"body"`
57		Path string `toml:"-" json:"path,omitempty"`
58	}
59
60	func (n *Note) Normalize() {
61		if n == nil {
62			return
63		}
64		n.Repository = strings.TrimSpace(n.Repository)
65		n.Body = normalizeBody(n.Body)
66		n.Tags = catalog.NormalizeTags(n.Tags)
67	}
68
69	func (n Note) Validate() error {
70		if n.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
71			return fmt.Errorf("note %s schema version %d: %w", n.ID, n.SchemaVersion, ErrInvalid)
72		}
73		if err := catalog.ValidateID(n.ID); err != nil {
74			return fmt.Errorf("note ID: %w", err)
75		}
76		if err := catalog.ValidateID(n.RepositoryID); err != nil {
77			return fmt.Errorf("repository ID: %w: %w", err, ErrRepository)
78		}
79		if strings.TrimSpace(n.Repository) == "" {
80			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: repository name is required: %w", n.ID, ErrRepository)
81		}
82		if strings.TrimSpace(n.Body) == "" {
83			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: body is empty: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
84		}
85		if n.Created.IsZero() || n.Updated.IsZero() {
86			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: created and updated are required: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
87		}
88		if n.Updated.Before(n.Created) {
89			return fmt.Errorf("note %s: updated precedes created: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
90		}
91		return nil
92	}
93
94	// Revision fingerprints every field an editor is allowed to preserve or
95	// replace. Update compares it while holding the mutation lock, preventing a
96	// stale editor session from silently overwriting another process's changes.
97	func (n Note) Revision() string {
98		payload := strings.Join([]string{
99			n.ID, n.RepositoryID, n.Repository,
100			n.Created.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
101			n.Updated.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
102			strings.Join(n.Tags, "\x00"), n.Body,
103		}, "\x00")
104		return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(payload)))
105	}
106
107	// Preview returns the first non-empty body line, collapsed and truncated.
108	func (n Note) Preview(limit int) string {
109		line := ""
110		for _, candidate := range strings.Split(n.Body, "\n") {
111			if strings.TrimSpace(candidate) != "" {
112				line = strings.Join(strings.Fields(candidate), " ")
113				break
114			}
115		}
116		if limit <= 0 || len([]rune(line)) <= limit {
117			return line
118		}
119		runes := []rune(line)
120		return string(runes[:limit-1]) + "…"
121	}
122
123	func normalizeBody(body string) string {
124		body = strings.ReplaceAll(body, "\r\n", "\n")
125		body = strings.TrimSpace(body)
126		if body == "" {
127			return ""
128		}
129		return body + "\n"
130	}

238	func fleetFilesHost(cfg fleet.Config, name string) (fleet.Host, error) {
239		var selected *fleet.Host
240		for index := range cfg.Hosts {
241			if cfg.Hosts[index].Name == name {
242				if selected != nil {
243					return fleet.Host{}, errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one target")
244				}
245				copy := cfg.Hosts[index]
246				selected = &copy
247			}
248		}
249		if selected == nil {
250			return fleet.Host{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
251		}
252		return *selected, nil
253	}

255	func fleetFilePatterns(project projectconfig.Result, adHoc []string) []localfiles.Pattern {
256		var patterns []localfiles.Pattern
257		if project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include != nil {
258			source, _ := project.SourceFor("local_files.include")
259			for _, value := range *project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include {
260				patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: source})
261			}
262		}
263		for _, value := range adHoc {
264			patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: "--file"})
265		}
266		return patterns
267	}

269	func resolveFleetFilesSource(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (string, gitx.Status, string, string, error) {
270		checkout := ""
271		if ref == "" {
272			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
273			if err != nil {
274				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
275			}
276			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
277			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
278				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
279			}
280			checkout = gitRepo.Root
281		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
282			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
283				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
284				if discoverErr != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
285					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
286				}
287				checkout = gitRepo.Root
288			}
289		}
290		if checkout == "" {
291			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
292			if err != nil {
293				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
294			}
295			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
296			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
297				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
298			}
299			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
300		}
301		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
302		if err != nil {
303			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
304		}
305		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
306			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
307		}
308		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
309		if err != nil {
310			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
311		}
312		identity, err := sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
313		if err != nil {
314			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
315		}
316		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil
317	}
318
319	func sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
320		var preferred []string
321		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
322			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
323		}
324		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
325		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
326		if err != nil {
327			return "", err
328		}
329		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
330		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
331		for _, remote := range preferred {
332			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
333				continue
334			}
335			seenRemote[remote] = true
336			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
337			if err != nil {
338				continue
339			}
340			identitySet := map[string]bool{}
341			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
342				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
343					identitySet[identity] = true
344				}
345			}
346			if len(identitySet) == 1 {
347				for identity := range identitySet {
348					return identity, nil
349				}
350			}
351		}
352		return "", errors.New("source checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
353	}

366		return nil
367	}

15		// protocols. Feature protocol versions evolve independently inside it.
16		ProtocolSchemaVersion = 1

18		LocalFilesProtocolVersion = 1

23	var ErrProtocolLimit = errors.New("fleet protocol size limit exceeded")

25	// FileLimits is the wire representation of a target's downward-clamped
26	// portable-file policy. It deliberately does not carry include patterns.
27	type FileLimits struct {
28		MaxFiles          int   `json:"max_files"`
29		MaxFileBytes      int64 `json:"max_file_bytes"`
30		MaxTotalBytes     int64 `json:"max_total_bytes"`

36	func (l FileLimits) Validate() error {
37		switch {
38		case l.MaxFiles <= 0:
39			return errors.New("max_files must be positive")
40		case l.MaxFileBytes <= 0:
41			return errors.New("max_file_bytes must be positive")
42		case l.MaxTotalBytes <= 0:
43			return errors.New("max_total_bytes must be positive")
44		case l.MaxPathBytes <= 0:

51			return nil

55	// CapabilityRequest is content-free and is always exchanged before any
56	// feature payload.

58		SchemaVersion   int    `json:"schema_version"`
59		Feature         string `json:"feature"`
60		ProtocolVersion int    `json:"protocol_version"`
61	}

63	func LocalFilesCapabilityRequest() CapabilityRequest {

70	func (r CapabilityRequest) Validate() error {
71		if r.SchemaVersion != ProtocolSchemaVersion {
72			return fmt.Errorf("capability schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, ProtocolSchemaVersion)
73		}
74		if r.Feature != "local-files" {
75			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported capability feature %q", r.Feature)
76		}
77		if r.ProtocolVersion != LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
78			return fmt.Errorf("local-files protocol_version %d: want %d", r.ProtocolVersion, LocalFilesProtocolVersion)
79		}

83	// CapabilityResponse contains only non-secret host facts. Unsupported native
84	// platforms return a stable reason before the caller constructs a payload.
85	type CapabilityResponse struct {
86		SchemaVersion   int        `json:"schema_version"`
87		Feature         string     `json:"feature"`
88		ProtocolVersion int        `json:"protocol_version"`
89		MachineID       string     `json:"machine_id"`
90		Platform        string     `json:"platform"`
91		Supported       bool       `json:"supported"`
92		Reason          string     `json:"reason,omitempty"`
93		Limits          FileLimits `json:"limits"`

96	func (r CapabilityResponse) Validate(request CapabilityRequest) error {
97		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
98			return err
99		}
100		if r.SchemaVersion != request.SchemaVersion || r.Feature != request.Feature || r.ProtocolVersion != request.ProtocolVersion {
101			return errors.New("capability response does not match the request")
102		}
103		if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
104			return err
105		}
106		if r.Platform == "" {
107			return errors.New("capability response has no platform")
108		}
109		if r.Supported {
110			if r.Reason != "" {
111				return errors.New("supported capability must not include a reason")
112			}
113			if err := r.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
114				return fmt.Errorf("capability limits: %w", err)
115			}
116		} else if !validCapabilityReason(r.Reason) {
117			return errors.New("unsupported capability has no valid reason code")
118		}
119		return nil
120	}
121
122	func validCapabilityReason(reason string) bool {
123		if reason == "" || len(reason) > 128 {
124			return false
125		}
126		for _, character := range reason {
127			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '-' {
128				continue
129			}
130			return false
131		}
132		return true
133	}

135	// DecodeStrict reads exactly one bounded JSON value, rejects unknown fields,
136	// and requires EOF after optional JSON whitespace.
137	func DecodeStrict(reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
138		if reader == nil || target == nil {
139			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a reader and target")
140		}
141		if maxBytes <= 0 {
142			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a positive limit")
143		}
144		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maxBytes+1))
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("read fleet protocol: %w", err)
147		}
148		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
149			return fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
150		}
151		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
152		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
153		if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
154			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol: %w", err)
155		}
156		var extra any
157		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
158			if err == nil {
159				return errors.New("decode fleet protocol: multiple JSON values")
160			}
161			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol trailing data: %w", err)
162		}
163		return nil
164	}
165
166	// MarshalBounded encodes one protocol value and enforces the matching bound
167	// before it can be handed to Transport.
168	func MarshalBounded(value any, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
169		if maxBytes <= 0 {
170			return nil, errors.New("fleet protocol encode requires a positive limit")
171		}
172		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode fleet protocol: %w", err)
175		}
176		if int64(len(data))+1 > maxBytes {
177			return nil, fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
178		}
179		return append(data, '\n'), nil
180	}
181
182	// UnmarshalStrict applies DecodeStrict to an in-memory transport response.
183	func UnmarshalStrict(data []byte, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
184		return DecodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(data), maxBytes, target)
185	}

31	// MaybeServeAskpass turns the dev executable into a one-shot SSH_ASKPASS
32	// helper. The password arrives through an inherited descriptor, never argv.
33	func MaybeServeAskpass() (bool, int) {
34		if os.Getenv(askpassMarker) != "1" {
35			return false, 0
36		}
37		fd, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv(askpassFD))
38		if err != nil || fd < 3 {
39			return true, 2
40		}
41		file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), "dev-fleet-askpass")
42		if file == nil {
43			return true, 2
44		}
45		defer file.Close()
46		password, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 64*1024))
47		if err != nil {
48			return true, 2
49		}
50		password = bytes.TrimSuffix(password, []byte{'\n'})
51		_, err = os.Stdout.Write(append(password, '\n'))
52		if err != nil {
53			return true, 2
54		}
55		return true, 0
56	}

87	// Interactive replaces the caller's terminal with an SSH PTY for a fixed dev
88	// helper command. Password sources use the same descriptor-backed askpass path
89	// as non-interactive probes.
90	func (t Transport) Interactive(ctx context.Context, host Host, remoteArgs []string, usePassword bool) error {
91		password := ""
92		if usePassword && host.PasswordKind() != "none" {
93			resolved, err := t.resolvePassword(host)
94			if err != nil {
95				return err
96			}
97			password = resolved
98		}
99		args := sshArgs(host, true, password != "")

103		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LC_ALL=C")
104		return runSSHCommand(cmd, password)

108	// Run preserves the v0.2 fleet behavior: retry once with the configured
109	// password only when SSH exits 255 with an authentication-denial diagnostic.

122	func (t Transport) run(ctx context.Context, host Host, remoteArgs []string, stdin []byte, pty bool, options RunOptions) Result {
123		if options.Retry == "" {
124			options.Retry = RetryNever
125		}
126		if options.Retry != RetryNever && options.Retry != RetryAuthentication {
127			return localTransportFailure(fmt.Sprintf("fleet transport: unknown retry policy %q", options.Retry))
128		}
129		stdinLimit := effectiveLimit(t.StdinLimit, DefaultStdinLimit)
130		if int64(len(stdin)) > stdinLimit {
131			message := fmt.Sprintf("fleet transport: stdin exceeds %d-byte limit", stdinLimit)
132			return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}
133		}
134		timeout := host.CommandTimeout.Duration
135		if timeout <= 0 {
136			timeout = 5 * time.Minute
137		}
138		commandCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
139		defer cancel()
140
141		first := t.runAttempt(commandCtx, host, remoteArgs, stdin, pty, "")
142		if options.Retry != RetryAuthentication || first.CaptureError != "" || first.ExitCode != 255 || host.PasswordKind() == "none" || !permissionDenied(first.Stderr) {
143			first.TimedOut = first.TimedOut || errors.Is(commandCtx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded)
144			return first
145		}
146		password, err := t.resolvePassword(host)
147		if err != nil {
148			message := "fleet transport: " + err.Error()
149			first.TransportError = message
150			first.Stderr = boundedBytes([]byte(message), effectiveLimit(t.StderrLimit, DefaultStderrLimit))
151			return first
152		}
153		second := t.runAttempt(commandCtx, host, remoteArgs, stdin, pty, password)
154		second.UsedPassword = true
155		second.Attempts = first.Attempts + second.Attempts
156		second.TimedOut = second.TimedOut || errors.Is(commandCtx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded)
157		return second
158	}

160	func (t Transport) runAttempt(ctx context.Context, host Host, remoteArgs []string, stdin []byte, pty bool, password string) Result {
161		args := sshArgs(host, pty, password != "")
162		args = append(args, host.Destination(), remoteCommand(host, remoteArgs))
163		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "ssh", args...)
164		cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(stdin)
165		stdout := newCaptureBuffer(effectiveLimit(t.StdoutLimit, DefaultStdoutLimit))
166		stderr := newCaptureBuffer(effectiveLimit(t.StderrLimit, DefaultStderrLimit))
167		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = stdout, stderr
168		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LC_ALL=C")
169		err := runSSHCommand(cmd, password)
170		result := Result{Stdout: stdout.Bytes(), Stderr: stderr.Bytes(), ExitCode: 0, Attempts: 1}
171		if stdout.Exceeded() || stderr.Exceeded() {
172			message := captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr)
173			result.ExitCode = 125
174			result.CaptureError = message
175			result.TransportError = message
176			result.Stderr = appendBounded(result.Stderr, []byte("\n"+message), effectiveLimit(t.StderrLimit, DefaultStderrLimit))
177			return result
178		}
179		if err == nil {
180			return result
181		}
182		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
183		if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || errors.Is(ctx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded) {
184			result.ExitCode, result.TimedOut = 124, true
185		} else if errors.As(err, &exitErr) {
186			result.ExitCode = exitErr.ExitCode()
187			if result.ExitCode < 0 {
188				result.ExitCode = 255
189			}
190		} else {
191			result.ExitCode = 255
192			if len(result.Stderr) == 0 {
193				result.Stderr = []byte(err.Error())
194			}
195		}
196		return result
197	}

199	// runSSHCommand starts SSH before writing an askpass secret. Starting first is
200	// load-bearing: a secret larger than the pipe capacity must remain cancellable
201	// through the command context instead of blocking before SSH exists.
202	func runSSHCommand(cmd *exec.Cmd, password string) error {
203		if password == "" {
204			return cmd.Run()
205		}
206		executable, err := os.Executable()
207		if err != nil {
208			return err
209		}
210		reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
211		if err != nil {
212			return err
213		}
214		cmd.ExtraFiles = []*os.File{reader}
215		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
216			askpassMarker+"=1", askpassFD+"=3", "SSH_ASKPASS="+executable,
217			"SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force", "DISPLAY=dev-fleet")
218		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
219			_ = reader.Close()
220			_ = writer.Close()
221			return err
222		}
223		// The child owns its inherited descriptor after Start; closing the parent
224		// copy lets an early SSH exit interrupt a blocked write.
225		readerCloseErr := reader.Close()
226		writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
227		go func() {
228			_, writeErr := io.Copy(writer, strings.NewReader(password+"\n"))
229			writeDone <- errors.Join(writeErr, writer.Close())
230		}()
231		waitErr := cmd.Wait()
232		// A descendant could retain the inherited read descriptor after SSH exits.
233		// Close our writer so that cannot strand the write goroutine.
234		_ = writer.Close()
235		writeErr := <-writeDone
236		return errors.Join(waitErr, readerCloseErr, writeErr)
237	}

239	func sshArgs(host Host, pty, password bool) []string {
240		connect := host.ConnectTimeout.Duration
241		if connect <= 0 {
242			connect = 15 * time.Second
243		}
244		seconds := int(connect.Round(time.Second) / time.Second)
245		if seconds < 1 {
246			seconds = 1
247		}
248		args := []string{"-o", "ConnectTimeout=" + strconv.Itoa(seconds), "-o", "ServerAliveInterval=15", "-o", "ServerAliveCountMax=2"}
249		if password {
250			args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=no", "-o", "PubkeyAuthentication=no", "-o", "PreferredAuthentications=keyboard-interactive,password", "-o", "NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1")
251		} else {
252			args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=yes")
253		}
254		if pty {
255			args = append(args, "-t")
256		} else {
257			// A fixed protocol command never needs a TTY or client-side forwarding.
258			// Do not add host-key overrides here: OpenSSH's configured strict host-key
259			// verification remains authoritative.
260			args = append(args,
261				"-T",
262				"-o", "ClearAllForwardings=yes",
263				"-o", "ForwardAgent=no",
264				"-o", "ForwardX11=no",
265				"-o", "PermitLocalCommand=no",
266			)
267		}
268		if host.User != "" && host.SSHAlias != "" {
269			args = append(args, "-l", host.User)
270		}
271		if host.Port > 0 {
272			args = append(args, "-p", strconv.Itoa(host.Port))
273		}
274		if host.IdentityFile != "" && !password {
275			args = append(args, "-i", devconfig.Expand(host.IdentityFile))
276		}
277		return args
278	}

280	func remoteCommand(host Host, args []string) string {
281		devPath := host.DevPath
282		if devPath == "" {
283			devPath = "auto"
284		}
285		quotedArgs := make([]string, len(args))
286		for index, arg := range args {
287			quotedArgs[index] = shellQuote(arg)
288		}
289		joined := strings.Join(quotedArgs, " ")
290		if devPath != "auto" {
291			return "exec " + shellQuote(devconfig.Expand(devPath)) + " " + joined
292		}
293		path := `PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:/opt/homebrew/bin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/snap/bin:$PATH"`
294		return path + "; export PATH; command -v dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 127; exec dev " + joined
295	}
296
297	func shellQuote(value string) string {
298		return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'"
299	}
300
301	func permissionDenied(stderr []byte) bool {
302		return strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(stderr)), "permission denied")
303	}

305	func (t Transport) resolvePassword(host Host) (string, error) {
306		source := host.SSHLoginPasswordSource
307		switch host.PasswordKind() {
308		case "plain":
309			return source.Value, nil
310		case "bitwarden":
311			cmd := exec.Command("bw", "get", "password", source.Item)
312			out, err := cmd.Output()
313			if err != nil {
314				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve Bitwarden SSH password for %s: %w", host.Name, err)
315			}
316			return strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), nil
317		case "prompt":
318			promptPasswordMu.Lock()
319			defer promptPasswordMu.Unlock()
320			writer := t.Err
321			if writer == nil {
322				writer = os.Stderr
323			}
324			fmt.Fprintf(writer, "SSH password for %s: ", host.Name)
325			terminal, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
326			if err != nil {
327				return "", fmt.Errorf("open terminal for SSH password: %w", err)
328			}
329			defer terminal.Close()
330			password, err := term.ReadPassword(terminal.Fd())
331			fmt.Fprintln(writer)
332			if err != nil {
333				return "", err
334			}
335			return string(password), nil
336		default:
337			return "", nil
338		}
339	}

341	type captureBuffer struct {
342		limit    int64
343		buffer   bytes.Buffer
344		exceeded bool
345	}
346
347	func newCaptureBuffer(limit int64) *captureBuffer {
348		return &captureBuffer{limit: limit}
349	}
350
351	func (b *captureBuffer) Write(value []byte) (int, error) {
352		remaining := b.limit - int64(b.buffer.Len())
353		if remaining > 0 {
354			keep := int64(len(value))
355			if keep > remaining {
356				keep = remaining
357			}
358			_, _ = b.buffer.Write(value[:int(keep)])
359		}
360		if int64(len(value)) > remaining {
361			b.exceeded = true
362		}
363		// Consume excess output without retaining it. The command timeout still
364		// bounds a peer that writes forever, while the parent process stays bounded.
365		return len(value), nil
366	}
367
368	func (b *captureBuffer) Bytes() []byte {
369		return append([]byte(nil), b.buffer.Bytes()...)
370	}
371
372	func (b *captureBuffer) Exceeded() bool { return b.exceeded }
373
374	func effectiveLimit(configured, fallback int64) int64 {
375		if configured <= 0 {
376			return fallback
377		}
378		return configured
379	}
380
381	func captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr *captureBuffer) string {
382		streams := make([]string, 0, 2)
383		if stdout.Exceeded() {
384			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stdout exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stdout.limit))
385		}
386		if stderr.Exceeded() {
387			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stderr exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stderr.limit))
388		}
389		return "fleet transport: remote " + strings.Join(streams, " and ")
390	}
391
392	func boundedBytes(value []byte, limit int64) []byte {
393		if int64(len(value)) > limit {
394			value = value[:int(limit)]
395		}
396		return append([]byte(nil), value...)
397	}
398
399	func appendBounded(current, suffix []byte, limit int64) []byte {
400		if int64(len(current)) >= limit {
401			return append([]byte(nil), current...)
402		}
403		available := limit - int64(len(current))
404		if int64(len(suffix)) > available {
405			suffix = suffix[:int(available)]
406		}
407		return append(append([]byte(nil), current...), suffix...)
408	}
409
410	func localTransportFailure(message string) Result {
411		return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}
412	}

130	func parseForgeEndpoint(raw string) (forgeEndpoint, bool) {
131		if !safeRawURLText(raw) {
132			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
133		}
134		raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
135		if raw == "" {
136			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
137		}
138		if strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
139			u, err := url.Parse(raw)
140			if err != nil || u.Opaque != "" || u.Hostname() == "" || !validWebHost(u.Hostname()) {
141				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
142			}
143			host := strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
144			segments, ok := decodeURLPath(u.EscapedPath())
145			if !ok {
146				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
147			}
148			switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
149			case "https":
150				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
151					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
152				}
153				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "https", host: host, segments: segments}, true
154			case "ssh":
155				if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "22" || u.User == nil || u.User.Username() != "git" {
156					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
157				}
158				if _, hasPassword := u.User.Password(); hasPassword {
159					return forgeEndpoint{}, false
160				}
161				return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: host, segments: segments}, true
162			default:
163				return forgeEndpoint{}, false
164			}
165		}
166
167		at := strings.IndexByte(raw, '@')
168		if at <= 0 || raw[:at] != "git" {
169			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
170		}
171		colon := strings.IndexByte(raw[at+1:], ':')
172		if colon < 0 {
173			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
174		}
175		colon += at + 1
176		host := raw[at+1 : colon]
177		if host == "" || strings.ContainsAny(host, `/\\[]:`) || !validWebHost(host) {
178			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
179		}
180		path := stripQueryFragment(raw[colon+1:])
181		segments, ok := decodeURLPath(path)
182		if !ok {
183			return forgeEndpoint{}, false
184		}
185		return forgeEndpoint{transport: "ssh", host: strings.ToLower(host), segments: segments}, true
186	}

188	func parseSafeHTTPS(raw string) (host string, segments []string, safeURL string, ok bool) {
189		if !safeRawURLText(raw) {
190			return "", nil, "", false
191		}
192		u, err := url.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(raw))
193		if err != nil || !strings.EqualFold(u.Scheme, "https") || u.Opaque != "" || u.Hostname() == "" || !validWebHost(u.Hostname()) {
194			return "", nil, "", false
195		}
196		if u.Port() != "" && u.Port() != "443" {
197			return "", nil, "", false
198		}
199		segments, ok = decodeURLPath(u.EscapedPath())
200		if !ok {
201			return "", nil, "", false
202		}
203		host = strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
204		return host, segments, buildHTTPSURL(host, segments), true

207	func decodeURLPath(path string) ([]string, bool) {
208		path = strings.Trim(path, "/")
209		if path == "" {
210			return nil, false
211		}
212		rawSegments := strings.Split(path, "/")
213		segments := make([]string, 0, len(rawSegments))
214		for _, raw := range rawSegments {
215			if raw == "" || hasEncodedSeparator(raw) {
216				return nil, false
217			}
218			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(raw)
219			if err != nil || decoded == "" || decoded == "." || decoded == ".." || !utf8.ValidString(decoded) ||
220				strings.ContainsAny(decoded, `/\\`) || hasEncodedSeparator(decoded) || containsControl(decoded) {
221				return nil, false
222			}
223			segments = append(segments, decoded)
224		}
225		return segments, true
226	}
227
228	func stripGitSuffix(segments []string) []string {
229		if len(segments) == 0 {
230			return nil
231		}
232		result := append([]string(nil), segments...)
233		result[len(result)-1] = strings.TrimSuffix(result[len(result)-1], ".git")
234		if result[len(result)-1] == "" {
235			return nil
236		}
237		return result
238	}

240	func validRepositorySegments(provider Kind, segments []string) bool {
241		segments = stripGitSuffix(segments)
242		switch provider {
243		case GitHub:
244			return len(segments) == 2
245		case GitLab:
246			return len(segments) >= 2
247		default:

249		}
250	}

252	func buildHTTPSURL(host string, segments []string) string {
253		return (&url.URL{Scheme: "https", Host: strings.ToLower(host), Path: "/" + strings.Join(segments, "/")}).String()

256	func safeRawURLText(value string) bool {
257		return utf8.ValidString(value) && !containsControl(value)

259
260	func containsControl(value string) bool {
261		return strings.IndexFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
262			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
263		}) >= 0
264	}
265
266	func hasEncodedSeparator(value string) bool {
267		current := value
268		for depth := 0; depth < 8; depth++ {
269			lower := strings.ToLower(current)
270			if strings.Contains(lower, "%2f") || strings.Contains(lower, "%5c") {
271				return true
272			}
273			if !strings.ContainsRune(current, '%') {
274				return false
275			}
276			decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(current)
277			if err != nil || decoded == current {
278				return false
279			}
280			current = decoded
281		}
282		// Deeply nested escaping is unnecessary for repository identities and is
283		// ambiguous across clients with different decode counts.
284		return true
285	}
286
287	func stripQueryFragment(value string) string {
288		if index := strings.IndexAny(value, "?#"); index >= 0 {
289			return value[:index]
290		}
291		return value
292	}

394	func validWebHost(host string) bool {
395		if host == "" || strings.HasSuffix(host, ".") || !utf8.ValidString(host) {
396			return false
397		}
398		for _, r := range host {
399			if r > unicode.MaxASCII || !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' || r == '-' || r == '.') {
400				return false
401			}
402		}
403		for _, label := range strings.Split(host, ".") {
404			if label == "" || strings.HasPrefix(label, "-") || strings.HasSuffix(label, "-") {
405				return false
406			}
407		}
408		return true

58	func (s *Store) Load() (string, error) {
59		if s == nil || s.Path == "" {
60			return "", errors.New("load machine identity from nil store")
61		}
62		if err := checkPrivateDir(filepath.Dir(s.Path)); err != nil {
63			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity directory: %w", err)
64		}
65		info, err := os.Lstat(s.Path)
66		if err != nil {
67			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity: %w", err)
68		}
69		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
70			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity %s is not a regular file", s.Path)
71		}
72		private, err := privateModeMatches(s.Path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
73		if err != nil {
74			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity permissions: %w", err)
75		}
76		if !private {
77			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", s.Path)
78		}
79		file, err := os.Open(s.Path)
80		if err != nil {
81			return "", fmt.Errorf("open machine identity: %w", err)
82		}
83		defer file.Close()
84		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
85		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
86		var payload document
87		if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
88			return "", fmt.Errorf("decode machine identity: %w", err)

115			return "", fmt.Errorf("prepare machine identity directory: %w", err)

119			return "", fmt.Errorf("prepare machine identity lock: %w", err)
120		}
121		var result string

123			loaded, err := s.Load()

166		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)

206	func checkPrivateDir(path string) error {
207		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
208		if err != nil {
209			return err
210		}
211		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
212			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a private directory", path)
213		}
214		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o700)
215		if err != nil {
216			return fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity directory permissions: %w", err)
217		}
218		if !private {
219			return fmt.Errorf("machine identity directory %s permissions are not private (want 0700 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
220		}
221		return nil
222	}

43	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination

45	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
46		if path == "" {
47			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
48		}
49		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
50		if err != nil {
51			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
52		}
53		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)

57		for {
58			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
59			if err == nil {
60				slices.Reverse(missing)
61				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
62				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
63			}

66			}

68			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
69			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
70			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
71			// still-missing suffix.
72			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {

105	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
106		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {

108		}
109		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)

8	)

10	var (
11		ErrNoRemoteDev     = errors.New("target does not provide a compatible dev protocol")
12		ErrUnreachable     = errors.New("target host is unreachable")
13		ErrRemoteTimeout   = errors.New("target protocol timed out")
14		ErrMachinePin      = errors.New("target machine ID does not match the configured host pin")
15		ErrMachineUnpinned = errors.New("mutating local-file apply requires host.machine_id")
16	)
17
18	type Runner interface {
19		RunWithOptions(context.Context, fleet.Host, []string, []byte, fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result
20	}
21
22	type Client struct{ Runner Runner }
23
24	func (c Client) run(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, maxResponse int64) ([]byte, error) {
25		if c.Runner == nil {
26			return nil, errors.New("local-files client has no fleet transport")
27		}
28		// Capability and plan are read-only. Apply is permanently bound to its
29		// request ID and plan digest by the target journal, so an authentication-only
30		// retry cannot duplicate an unbound mutation.
31		result := c.Runner.RunWithOptions(ctx, host, args, stdin, fleet.RunOptions{Retry: fleet.RetryAuthentication})
32		if int64(len(result.Stdout)) > maxResponse {
33			return nil, errors.New("target protocol response exceeded its bound")
34		}
35		if result.ExitCode == 0 && result.CaptureError == "" {
36			return result.Stdout, nil
37		}
38		switch {
39		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
40			return nil, ErrRemoteTimeout
41		case result.ExitCode == 127:
42			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
43		case result.ExitCode == 255:
44			return nil, ErrUnreachable
45		default:
46			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
47		}
48	}
49
50	// Identify performs the content-free capability exchange without enforcing the
51	// configured machine pin. It exists for explicit onboarding and diagnostics;
52	// mutating or payload-bearing callers must use Probe.
53	func (c Client) Identify(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
54		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
55		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
56		if err != nil {
57			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
58		}
59		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_capability"}, body, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
60		if err != nil {
61			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
62		}
63		var response fleet.CapabilityResponse
64		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes, &response); err != nil {
65			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
66		}
67		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
68			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
69		}
70		return response, nil
71	}
72
73	func (c Client) Probe(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
74		response, err := c.Identify(ctx, host)
75		if err != nil {
76			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
77		}
78		if host.MachineID != "" && host.MachineID != response.MachineID {
79			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
80		}
81		if !response.Supported {
82			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, errors.New("target does not support local-file payloads")
83		}
84		return response, nil
85	}
86
87	func (c Client) Plan(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
88		if capability.MachineID != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
89			return PlanResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
90		}
91		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
92			return PlanResponse{}, err
93		}
94		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
95		if err != nil {
96			return PlanResponse{}, err
97		}
98		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-plan"}, body, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
99		if err != nil {
100			return PlanResponse{}, err
101		}
102		var response PlanResponse
103		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes, &response); err != nil {
104			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
105		}
106		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
107			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
108		}
109		return response, nil
110	}
111
112	func (c Client) Apply(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
113		if host.MachineID == "" {
114			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachineUnpinned
115		}
116		if host.MachineID != capability.MachineID || envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine != capability.MachineID {
117			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
118		}
119		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
120			return ApplyResponse{}, err
121		}
122		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(envelope, MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes)
123		if err != nil {
124			return ApplyResponse{}, err
125		}
126		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-apply"}, body, MaxApplyResponseBytes)
127		if err != nil {
128			return ApplyResponse{}, err
129		}
130		var response ApplyResponse
131		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxApplyResponseBytes, &response); err != nil {
132			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
133		}
134		if err := response.Validate(envelope.Request, envelope.Plan); err != nil {
135			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
136		}
137		return response, nil
138	}

28		MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes int64 = 48 << 20
29		MaxApplyResponseBytes int64 = 2 << 20

32	type State string
33
34	const (
35		StateReady             State = "ready"
36		StateCurrent           State = "current"
37		StateBlockedConflict   State = "blocked-conflict"
38		StateBlockedIneligible State = "blocked-ineligible"
39		StateBlockedUnsafe     State = "blocked-unsafe"
40		StateMissing           State = "missing"
41		StateFailed            State = "failed"
42		StateCreated           State = "created"
43		StateReplaced          State = "replaced"
44		StateRolledBack        State = "rolled-back"
45		StateReconcile         State = "reconcile"
46	)
47
48	func (s State) validPlan() bool {
49		switch s {
50		case StateReady, StateCurrent, StateBlockedConflict, StateBlockedIneligible,
51			StateBlockedUnsafe, StateMissing, StateFailed:
52			return true
53		default:
54			return false
55		}
56	}
57
58	func (s State) validResult() bool {
59		return s.validPlan() || s == StateCreated || s == StateReplaced || s == StateRolledBack || s == StateReconcile
60	}

62	// PublicFile is the complete public per-file surface. Digests, content,

64	type PublicFile struct {

67		Mode  string `json:"mode"`
68		State State  `json:"state"`

76
77	func (r Report) Successful() bool {
78		for _, file := range r.Files {
79			switch file.State {
80			case StateReady, StateCurrent, StateCreated, StateReplaced:
81			default:
82				return false
83			}
84		}
85		return len(r.Files) > 0
86	}

103	func (b Binding) Validate() error {
104		if b.RemoteIdentity == "" || b.RemoteIdentity != catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(b.RemoteIdentity) {
105			return errors.New("binding has no canonical remote identity")

139	func validateFileSpecs(files []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
140		metadata := make([]safefile.Metadata, len(files))
141		for index, file := range files {
142			if index > 0 && files[index-1].Path >= file.Path {
143				return errors.New("file manifest paths must be unique and sorted")
144			}

241	func (r PlanResponse) Validate(request PlanRequest) error {
242		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {

246			r.RequestID != request.RequestID || r.ManifestDigest != request.ManifestDigest ||
247			r.TargetMachine != request.Binding.TargetMachine {

259				return fmt.Errorf("plan response metadata for %q does not match request", spec.Path)
260			}
261			switch file.Action {
262			case actionCurrent:

265				}
266			case actionCreate:
267				if file.State != StateReady || file.TargetSHA256 != "" || file.TargetMode != "" {
268					return fmt.Errorf("plan response create observation for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
269				}
270			case actionReplace:
271				if !request.Replace || file.State != StateReady || !validDigest(file.TargetSHA256) || !validFileMode(file.TargetMode) {
272					return fmt.Errorf("plan response replace observation for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
273				}
274			case "":
275				if file.State == StateReady || file.State == StateCurrent {
276					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q omits a required action", spec.Path)
277				}
278				if file.TargetSHA256 != "" && !validDigest(file.TargetSHA256) {
279					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an invalid target digest", spec.Path)
280				}
281				if file.TargetMode != "" && !validFileMode(file.TargetMode) {
282					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an invalid target mode", spec.Path)
283				}
284			default:
285				return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an unknown action", spec.Path)
286			}
287		}
288		if !validDigest(r.PlanDigest) || r.PlanDigest != planDigest(request, r) {
289			return errors.New("plan response digest does not match")
290		}
291		return nil
292	}

321		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || r.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion ||
322			r.RequestID != request.RequestID || r.PlanDigest != plan.PlanDigest || len(r.Files) != len(request.Files) {

329			}
330			expected := StateCurrent
331			switch plan.Files[index].Action {
332			case actionCreate:
333				expected = StateCreated
334			case actionReplace:
335				expected = StateReplaced
336			case actionCurrent:
337			default:
338				return fmt.Errorf("apply response action for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
339			}

342			}

350			RequestID string           `json:"request_id"`
351			Binding   Binding          `json:"binding"`
352			Limits    fleet.FileLimits `json:"limits"`

355		}{"dev-local-files-manifest-v1", request.RequestID, request.Binding, request.Limits, request.Replace, request.Files}

360		files := append([]PlanFile(nil), response.Files...)
361		payload := struct {
362			Domain         string     `json:"domain"`
363			ManifestDigest string     `json:"manifest_digest"`
364			TargetMachine  string     `json:"target_machine_id"`
365			TargetCheckout string     `json:"target_checkout_id"`
366			Files          []PlanFile `json:"files"`
367		}{"dev-local-files-plan-v1", request.ManifestDigest, response.TargetMachine, response.TargetCheckout, files}

371	func digestJSON(value any) string {
372		data, _ := json.Marshal(value)
373		digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
374		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
375	}
376
377	func digestBytes(value []byte) string {
378		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
379		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
380	}

382	func validDigest(value string) bool {
383		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != len("sha256:")+sha256.Size*2 {
384			return false
385		}
386		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"))
387		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size && value == strings.ToLower(value)
388	}
389
390	func validOID(value string) bool {
391		if len(value) != 40 && len(value) != 64 || value != strings.ToLower(value) {
392			return false
393		}
394		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
395		return err == nil
396	}
397
398	func validFileMode(value string) bool {
399		if len(value) != 4 {
400			return false
401		}
402		mode, err := strconv.ParseUint(value, 8, 12)
403		return err == nil && mode <= 0o777
404	}

406	func validateText(name, value string) error {
407		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
408			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
409		}
410		for _, r := range value {
411			if unicode.IsControl(r) {
412				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
413			}
414		}
415		return nil
416	}

24	// Expand resolves validated project and --file patterns locally into a sorted,
25	// duplicate-free list of exact slash paths. It never follows links or descends
26	// into Git metadata, nested repositories, submodules, or dependency trees.
27	func Expand(root string, patterns []Pattern, limits safefile.Limits) ([]string, error) {
28		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
29			return nil, err
30		}
31		if len(patterns) == 0 {
32			return nil, errors.New("no local-file patterns were configured or passed with --file")
33		}
34		for _, pattern := range patterns {
35			if err := projectconfig.ValidateLocalFilePattern(pattern.Value); err != nil {
36				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s: %w", patternSource(pattern), err)
37			}
38			for _, component := range strings.Split(pattern.Value, "/") {
39				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
40					return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s enters dependency directory %q", patternSource(pattern), component)
41				}
42			}
43		}
44		rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(root)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect source checkout: %w", err)
47		}
48		if !rootInfo.IsDir() || rootInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
49			return nil, errors.New("source checkout is not a held regular directory")
50		}
51
52		matches := map[string]struct{}{}
53		matchedPatterns := make([]bool, len(patterns))
54		visited := 0
55		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
56			if walkErr != nil {
57				return walkErr
58			}
59			if filename == root {
60				return nil
61			}
62			visited++
63			if visited > maxWalkEntries {
64				return fmt.Errorf("source checkout exceeds %d entries while expanding local-file patterns", maxWalkEntries)
65			}
66			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, filename)
67			if err != nil {
68				return err
69			}
70			slash := filepath.ToSlash(relative)
71			components := strings.Split(slash, "/")
72			base := strings.ToLower(components[len(components)-1])
73			if entry.IsDir() {
74				if base == ".git" {
75					return filepath.SkipDir
76				}
77				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[base]; blocked {
78					for _, pattern := range patterns {
79						if matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
80							return fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern enters dependency directory %q", slash)
81						}
82					}
83					return filepath.SkipDir
84				}
85				if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(filename, ".git")); err == nil {
86					return filepath.SkipDir
87				} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
88					return fmt.Errorf("inspect nested repository boundary %s: %w", slash, err)
89				}
90			}
91			matched := false
92			for index, pattern := range patterns {
93				if !entry.IsDir() && matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
94					matchedPatterns[index] = true
95					matched = true
96				}
97			}
98			if matched {
99				matches[slash] = struct{}{}
100			}
101			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 && entry.IsDir() {
102				return filepath.SkipDir
103			}
104			return nil
105		})
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, err
108		}
109		for index, matched := range matchedPatterns {
110			if !matched {
111				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s matched no source path", patternSource(patterns[index]))
112			}
113		}
114		paths := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
115		for path := range matches {
116			paths = append(paths, path)
117		}
118		sort.Strings(paths)
119		if len(paths) > limits.MaxFiles {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("patterns expanded to %d paths; maximum is %d", len(paths), limits.MaxFiles)
121		}
122		return paths, nil
123	}

125	func patternSource(pattern Pattern) string {
126		if strings.TrimSpace(pattern.Source) == "" {
127			return "explicit input"
128		}
129		return pattern.Source
130	}
