132	func matchPattern(pattern, candidate string) bool {
133		patternParts := strings.Split(pattern, "/")
134		candidateParts := strings.Split(candidate, "/")
135		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
136		memo := map[key]bool{}
137		seen := map[key]bool{}
138		var match func(int, int) bool
139		match = func(patternIndex, candidateIndex int) bool {
140			state := key{patternIndex, candidateIndex}
141			if seen[state] {
142				return memo[state]
143			}
144			seen[state] = true
145			var result bool
146			switch {
147			case patternIndex == len(patternParts):
148				result = candidateIndex == len(candidateParts)
149			case patternParts[patternIndex] == "**":
150				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex) ||
151					candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && match(patternIndex, candidateIndex+1)
152			case candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && matchComponent(patternParts[patternIndex], candidateParts[candidateIndex]):
153				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex+1)
154			}
155			memo[state] = result
156			return result
157		}
158		return match(0, 0)
159	}
160
161	func matchComponent(pattern, candidate string) bool {
162		p, c := []rune(pattern), []rune(candidate)
163		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
164		memo := map[key]bool{}
165		seen := map[key]bool{}
166		var match func(int, int) bool
167		match = func(pi, ci int) bool {
168			state := key{pi, ci}
169			if seen[state] {
170				return memo[state]
171			}
172			seen[state] = true
173			var result bool
174			switch {
175			case pi == len(p):
176				result = ci == len(c)
177			case p[pi] == '*':
178				result = match(pi+1, ci) || ci < len(c) && match(pi, ci+1)
179			case ci < len(c) && (p[pi] == '?' || p[pi] == c[ci]):
180				result = match(pi+1, ci+1)
181			}
182			memo[state] = result
183			return result
184		}
185		return match(0, 0)
186	}
187

190			if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
191				return true
192			}
193		}
194		return false
195	}

74	type localRepoContext struct {
75		Context          inventory.RepoContext
76		SelectedCheckout int

83	// collectLocalRepoContext is the single CLI collector used by repo context and
84	// status. It executes only local Git/task/runtime probes; includeTopology adds
85	// repository-wide remote/ref facts but never performs fetch or other network I/O.
86	func collectLocalRepoContext(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, selectedPath string, includeTopology bool) localRepoContext {
87		var (
88			tasks    = []*task.Task{}
89			tasksErr error
90		)
91		if app.Tasks == nil {
92			tasksErr = errors.New("task store is unavailable")
93		} else {
94			listed, diagnostics, err := app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
95			if err != nil {
96				tasksErr = err
97			} else {
98				tasks = tasksForRepo(listed, repository)
99				for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
100					tasksErr = errors.Join(tasksErr, diagnostic)
101				}
102			}
103		}
104
105		rt := app.Runtime()
106		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
107		local := localRepoContext{
108			Context: inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, repository, tasks, sessions, rt.Name()),
109			Runtimes: []repocontext.RuntimeInput{{
110				Backend: rt.Name(), Available: rt.Available(), Sessions: sessions, Err: runtimeErr,
111			}},
112			SelectedCheckout: -1,
113		}
114		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
115		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
116		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
117			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
118		} else {
119			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
120		}
121		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
122			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
123		}
124		return local
125	}

154	func collectRepoContextForge(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool, now time.Time) repocontext.ForgeInput {
155		cacheInput := func(cache forge.Cache, collectionErr error) repocontext.ForgeInput {
156			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
157			if forgeCacheStale(cache, app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, now) {
158				freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
159			}
160			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
161			if !cache.Complete || collectionErr != nil {
162				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
163			}
164			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
165				Authority: assessment.AuthorityCache, Freshness: freshness,
166				Completeness: completeness, ObservedAt: cache.FetchedAt,
167				Records: append([]forge.RemoteRepo{}, cache.Repos...),
168				Err:     errors.Join(collectionErr, forgeCacheErrors(cache)),
169			}
170		}
171
172		if !refresh {
173			cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
174			if !ok {
175				return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: errors.New("no cached forge inventory; rerun with --refresh to collect one")}
176			}
177			return cacheInput(cache, nil)
178		}
179
180		rows, collectionErr := collectRemotes(ctx, app)
181		records := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(rows))
182		for _, row := range rows {
183			records = append(records, row.Repo)
184		}
185		if collectionErr == nil {
186			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
187				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
188				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
189				Records: records,
190			}
191		}
192		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
193			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
194			if len(records) > 0 {
195				cached.Records = records
196			}
197			return cached
198		}
199		if len(records) > 0 {
200			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
201				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
202				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
203				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
204			}
205		}
206		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
207	}
208
209	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
210		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
211			return true
212		}
213		if ttl <= 0 {
214			return false
215		}
216		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
217	}
218
219	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
220		var providerErrors []error
221		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
222		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
223		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
224			name := string(kind)
225			kinds = append(kinds, name)
226			byKind[name] = status
227		}
228		sort.Strings(kinds)
229		for _, kind := range kinds {
230			status := byKind[kind]
231			if status.Error != "" {
232				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
233			} else if !status.Complete {
234				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
235			}
236		}
237		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
238	}

240	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
241		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
242		if err != nil {
243			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
244		}
245		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
246			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
247			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
248			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
249		}
250		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
251			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
252		}
253		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
254			return input
255		}
256		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
257		if parallel <= 0 {
258			parallel = 1
259		}
260		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
261		var wait sync.WaitGroup
262		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
263			wait.Add(1)
264			go func() {
265				defer wait.Done()
266				semaphore <- struct{}{}
267				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
268				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
269			}()
270		}
271		wait.Wait()
272		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
273			input.Err = err
274		}
275		return input
276	}

269	func resolveFleetFilesSource(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (string, gitx.Status, string, string, error) {
270		checkout := ""
271		if ref == "" {
272			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
273			if err != nil {
274				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
275			}
276			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
277			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
278				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
279			}
280			checkout = gitRepo.Root
281		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
282			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
283				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
284				if discoverErr != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
285					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
286				}
287				checkout = gitRepo.Root
288			}
289		}
290		if checkout == "" {
291			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
292			if err != nil {
293				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
294			}
295			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
296			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
297				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
298			}
299			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
300		}
301		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
302		if err != nil {
303			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
304		}
305		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
306			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
307		}
308		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
309		if err != nil {
310			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
311		}
312		identity, err := sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
313		if err != nil {
314			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
315		}
316		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil
317	}

319	func sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
320		var preferred []string
321		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
322			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
323		}
324		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
325		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
326		if err != nil {
327			return "", err
328		}
329		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
330		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
331		for _, remote := range preferred {
332			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
333				continue
334			}
335			seenRemote[remote] = true
336			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
337			if err != nil {
338				continue
339			}
340			identitySet := map[string]bool{}
341			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
342				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
343					identitySet[identity] = true
344				}
345			}
346			if len(identitySet) == 1 {
347				for identity := range identitySet {
348					return identity, nil
349				}
350			}
351		}
352		return "", errors.New("source checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
353	}

115	func resolveFleetOpenRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, request fleet.OpenRequest) (repo.Repo, error) {
116		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
117		if err != nil {
118			return repo.Repo{}, err
119		}
120		var matches []repo.Repo
121		wantedIdentity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(request.RemoteIdentity)
122		for _, repository := range repositories {
123			if request.Path != "" && (sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.Path) || sameCleanPath(request.Path, repository.RealPath)) {
124				return repository, nil
125			}
126			if wantedIdentity == "" {
127				continue
128			}
129			topology, topologyErr := gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
130			if topologyErr == nil && matchingSnapshotIdentity(topology, wantedIdentity) {
131				matches = append(matches, repository)
132			}
133		}
134		if len(matches) == 1 {
135			return matches[0], nil
136		}
137		if len(matches) > 1 {
138			return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("remote identity matches multiple repositories")
139		}
140		return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is no longer discoverable", request.Name)

 func tasksForRepo(tasks []*task.Task, r repo.Repo) []*task.Task {
    var out []*task.Task
    for _, t := range tasks {
        if sameCleanPath(t.RepoPath, r.Path) || sameCleanPath(t.RepoPath, r.RealPath) {
            out = append(out, t)
        }
    }
    return out
 }

 func sameCleanPath(a, b string) bool {
    return a != "" && b != "" && filepath.Clean(a) == filepath.Clean(b)
 }

    return repo.Resolve(ctxOf(), app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
 }

204	// IsEphemeralWorktree recognises turn-scoped checkouts owned by an agent
205	// harness. They stay visible, but the label prevents an agent from treating

210			strings.HasPrefix(branch, "worktree-")

213	func linkedAdminCount(commonDir string) (int, error) {
214		if commonDir == "" {
215			return 0, nil
216		}
217		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(commonDir, "worktrees"))

221			}
222			return 0, err

224		n := 0

233	func pathIsDir(path string) (bool, error) {
234		info, err := os.Stat(path)

236			if os.IsNotExist(err) {

247	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
248		latest := status.LatestChange
249		var commit time.Time
250		var subject string
251		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
252			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
253			if commit.After(latest) {
254				latest = commit
255			}
256			subject = lastSubject
257		}
258		return latest, commit, subject
259	}

261	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
262		for _, t := range tasks {
263			assigned := false
264			if t.WorktreePath != "" {
265				for i := 1; i < len(out.Checkouts); i++ {
266					if samePath(t.WorktreePath, out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path) {
267						out.Checkouts[i].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, t)
268						out.Checkouts[i].Ownership = CheckoutDev
269						assigned = true
270						break
271					}
272				}
273			} else if len(out.Checkouts) > 0 && t.Branch == out.Checkouts[0].Branch() {
274				out.Checkouts[0].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[0].Tasks, t)
275				assigned = true
276			}
277			if !assigned {
278				out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, t)
279			}
280		}
281		for i := range out.Checkouts {
282			sort.SliceStable(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
283				return out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[a].ID < out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[b].ID
284			})
285		}
286		sort.SliceStable(out.OtherTasks, func(i, j int) bool {
287			return out.OtherTasks[i].ID < out.OtherTasks[j].ID
288		})
289	}

291	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
292	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
293	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
294	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
295		for _, session := range sessions {
296			assigned := map[int]bool{}
297			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
298				best, bestLen := -1, -1
299				for i := range out.Checkouts {
300					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Repo, i, out.Checkouts[i]) {
301						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
302							best, bestLen = i, len(filepath.Clean(root))
303						}
304					}
305				}
306				if best >= 0 {
307					assigned[best] = true
308				}
309			}
310			for i := range assigned {
311				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
312			}
313		}
314	}

316	func checkoutRoots(r repo.Repo, index int, checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
317		roots := []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
318		if index == 0 && r.RealPath != "" && !samePath(r.RealPath, r.Path) {
319			roots = append(roots, r.RealPath)
320		}
321		return roots
322	}
323
324	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
325		if root == "" || path == "" {
326			return false
327		}
328		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
329		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
330			return false
331		}
332		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
333	}
334
335	func samePath(a, b string) bool {
336		return a != "" && b != "" && normalizePath(a) == normalizePath(b)
337	}
338
339	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
340	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
341	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
342	// is not sufficient.
343	func normalizePath(path string) string {
344		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
345		cur := clean
346		for {
347			if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
348				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
349				if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
350					return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
351				}
352				return filepath.Clean(real)
353			}
354			parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
355			if parent == cur {
356				return clean
357			}
358			cur = parent
359		}
360	}

373		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev repo context: %s\n\n", c.Repo.Display())

// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository.
// Repositories with no linked-worktree admin entries deliberately skip
// `git worktree list`; this keeps the common whole-machine inventory path fast.
func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
    sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {

    out := RepoContext{Repo: r, Runtime: runtimeName}
    main := RepoCheckout{
        Worktree: gitx.Worktree{Path: r.Path, Main: true},
        Exists:   pathIsDir(r.Path), Ownership: CheckoutCanonical,
    }
    if r.Bare {
        main.Worktree.Bare = true
    } else {
        main.Status, main.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
        main.Worktree.Branch = main.Status.Branch
        main.Worktree.Detached = main.Status.Detached
        main.LastActivity, main.LastCommit, main.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, r.Path, main.Status)
    }
    out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, main)

    out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
    if !r.Bare && out.WorktreeCount > 0 {
        worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
        if err != nil {
            out.WorktreeErr = err
        } else {
            out.WorktreeCount = 0
            for _, w := range worktrees {
                if w.Main {
                    continue
                }
                checkout := RepoCheckout{
                    Worktree: w, Exists: pathIsDir(w.Path), Ownership: CheckoutExternal,
                }
                if checkout.Exists && !w.Prunable {
                    checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, w.Path)
                    checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, w.Path, checkout.Status)
                }
                if IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
                    checkout.Ownership = CheckoutEphemeral
                }
                out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
                out.WorktreeCount++
            }
        }

**Analyzing CLI behavior**

So, I’m looking at the CLI overrides with a transport stdin set to MaxApply 48. It appears this doesn’t impact the localfiles command. I’m thinking client tests might have different defaults. The command line is setting a limit of 48, while MachineID caps it. There might be some older command defaults, and the localfiles library may conflict if used with the transport. I question whether we should drop something, given that MaxApply can be 48. Additionally, there are some other bugs in the CLI.

I see that the Apply command needs a pin, while report-only can work without one, which is okay. The capability for remote processing occurs before the project file is read, so that’s a good sign. It’s neat that `sourceRemoteIdentity` can retrieve the remote name safely, but I'm considering how multiple identities can affect upstream remotes. I’m thinking about the config method and whether the `localfiles` Plan response can block exit. It seems that hidden commands can return responses even when blocked, which is interesting. There might be errors with hidden commands outputting to stderr due to Cobra, with the client mapping them generically. Using the `--replace` flag without `--apply` allows plans to differ while still reporting success, which is expected. However, it looks like both `--apply` and the current plan still need a machine pin, even if there are no changes.

31	// RepoCheckout is one checkout in a repository context. The first checkout is
32	// always the canonical checkout; the rest are linked worktrees in Git order.
33	type RepoCheckout struct {
34		Worktree gitx.Worktree
35		Status   gitx.Status
36		// StatusErr is retained so a prunable or unreadable checkout can remain
37		// visible without pretending its Git state was successfully inspected.
38		StatusErr error
39		// PathErr distinguishes an unreadable checkout path from a checkout which is
40		// conclusively missing. Callers must not turn either case into a clean Git
41		// status.

47		Sessions     []runtime.Session

50	}
51
52	// Branch returns the named branch, falling back to the live status for the
53	// synthetic canonical checkout.
54	func (c RepoCheckout) Branch() string {
55		if c.Worktree.Branch != "" {
56			return c.Worktree.Branch
57		}
58		return c.Status.Branch
59	}

61	// RepoContext is the complete operational context for one discovered repo.
62	type RepoContext struct {
63		Repo repo.Repo
64		// Checkouts contains the canonical checkout followed by linked worktrees.
65		Checkouts []RepoCheckout
66		// OtherTasks are tracked branches which are not checked out here (for
67		// example cold or branch-only tasks on another branch).
68		OtherTasks []*task.Task

71		// mislabel unavailable observations as a closed runtime or an untracked task.
72		RuntimeErr error

81	// Main returns the canonical checkout.
82	func (c RepoContext) Main() (RepoCheckout, bool) {
83		if len(c.Checkouts) == 0 {
84			return RepoCheckout{}, false
85		}
86		return c.Checkouts[0], true
87	}
88
89	// Linked returns only linked worktrees.
90	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
91		if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
92			return nil
93		}
94		return c.Checkouts[1:]
95	}

97	// CheckoutIndexForPath returns the most-specific checkout containing path. It
98	// uses the same symlink-aware matching as runtime assignment, so a current
99	// directory under a nested linked worktree never resolves to the canonical
100	// checkout merely because that checkout is its lexical parent.
101	func (c RepoContext) CheckoutIndexForPath(path string) (int, bool) {
102		best, bestLen := -1, -1
103		for index := range c.Checkouts {
104			for _, root := range checkoutRoots(c.Repo, index, c.Checkouts[index]) {
105				if pathContains(root, path) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
106					best, bestLen = index, len(filepath.Clean(root))
107				}
108			}
109		}
110		return best, best >= 0
111	}

113	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
114	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
115	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
116		seen := map[string]bool{}
117		var out []runtime.Session
118		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
119			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
120				key := session.Handle
121				if key == "" {
122					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
123				}
124				if seen[key] {
125					continue
126				}
127				seen[key] = true
128				out = append(out, session)
129			}
130		}
131		return out
132	}

154		out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, main)
155
156		out.WorktreeCount, out.WorktreeErr = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
157		if out.WorktreeErr == nil && out.WorktreeCount > 0 {
158			worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
159			if err != nil {
160				out.WorktreeErr = err
161			} else {
162				out.WorktreeCount = 0
163				for _, w := range worktrees {
164					if w.Main {
165						continue
166					}
167					exists, pathErr := pathIsDir(w.Path)
168					checkout := RepoCheckout{
169						Worktree: w, Exists: exists, PathErr: pathErr, Ownership: CheckoutExternal,
170					}
171					if checkout.Exists && checkout.PathErr == nil && !w.Prunable {
172						checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, w.Path)
173						checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, w.Path, checkout.Status)
174					}
175					if IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
176						checkout.Ownership = CheckoutEphemeral
177					}
178					out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
179					out.WorktreeCount++
180				}
181			}
182		}
183
184		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
185		assignSessions(&out, sessions)
186		for _, checkout := range out.Checkouts {
187			if checkout.LastActivity.After(out.LastActivity) {
188				out.LastActivity = checkout.LastActivity
189			}
190			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
191				if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
192					out.LastActivity = t.Updated
193				}
194			}
195		}
196		for _, t := range out.OtherTasks {
197			if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
198				out.LastActivity = t.Updated
199			}
200		}
201		return out
202	}
203
204	// IsEphemeralWorktree recognises turn-scoped checkouts owned by an agent
205	// harness. They stay visible, but the label prevents an agent from treating
206	// them like durable dev-owned work.
207	func IsEphemeralWorktree(path, branch string) bool {
208		slashPath := filepath.ToSlash(path)
209		return strings.Contains(slashPath, "/.claude/worktrees/") ||
210			strings.HasPrefix(branch, "worktree-")
211	}
212
213	func linkedAdminCount(commonDir string) (int, error) {
214		if commonDir == "" {
215			return 0, nil
216		}
217		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(commonDir, "worktrees"))
218		if err != nil {
219			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
220				return 0, nil
221			}
222			return 0, err
223		}
224		n := 0
225		for _, entry := range entries {
226			if entry.IsDir() {
227				n++
228			}
229		}
230		return n, nil
231	}
232
233	func pathIsDir(path string) (bool, error) {
234		info, err := os.Stat(path)
235		if err != nil {
236			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
237				return false, nil
238			}
239			return false, err
240		}
241		if !info.IsDir() {
242			return false, fmt.Errorf("checkout path is not a directory")
243		}
244		return true, nil
245	}
246
247	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
248		latest := status.LatestChange
249		var commit time.Time
250		var subject string
251		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
252			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
253			if commit.After(latest) {
254				latest = commit
255			}
256			subject = lastSubject
257		}
258		return latest, commit, subject
259	}
260
261	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
262		for _, t := range tasks {
263			assigned := false
264			if t.WorktreePath != "" {
265				for i := 1; i < len(out.Checkouts); i++ {
266					if samePath(t.WorktreePath, out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path) {
267						out.Checkouts[i].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, t)
268						out.Checkouts[i].Ownership = CheckoutDev
269						assigned = true
270						break
271					}
272				}
273			} else if len(out.Checkouts) > 0 && t.Branch == out.Checkouts[0].Branch() {
274				out.Checkouts[0].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[0].Tasks, t)
275				assigned = true
276			}
277			if !assigned {
278				out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, t)
279			}
280		}

83	// collectLocalRepoContext is the single CLI collector used by repo context and
84	// status. It executes only local Git/task/runtime probes; includeTopology adds
85	// repository-wide remote/ref facts but never performs fetch or other network I/O.
86	func collectLocalRepoContext(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, selectedPath string, includeTopology bool) localRepoContext {

88			tasks    = []*task.Task{}
89			tasksErr error

91		if app.Tasks == nil {
92			tasksErr = errors.New("task store is unavailable")
93		} else {

109			Runtimes: []repocontext.RuntimeInput{{

111			}},
112			SelectedCheckout: -1,
113		}
114		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
115		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
116		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
117			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
118		} else {
119			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
120		}
121		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
122			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)

127	func resolveRepoContextTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (repo.Repo, string, error) {

154	func collectRepoContextForge(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool, now time.Time) repocontext.ForgeInput {
155		cacheInput := func(cache forge.Cache, collectionErr error) repocontext.ForgeInput {
156			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
157			if forgeCacheStale(cache, app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, now) {
158				freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
159			}
160			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
161			if !cache.Complete || collectionErr != nil {
162				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
163			}
164			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
165				Authority: assessment.AuthorityCache, Freshness: freshness,
166				Completeness: completeness, ObservedAt: cache.FetchedAt,
167				Records: append([]forge.RemoteRepo{}, cache.Repos...),
168				Err:     errors.Join(collectionErr, forgeCacheErrors(cache)),
169			}
170		}
171
172		if !refresh {
173			cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
174			if !ok {
175				return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: errors.New("no cached forge inventory; rerun with --refresh to collect one")}
176			}
177			return cacheInput(cache, nil)
178		}
179
180		rows, collectionErr := collectRemotes(ctx, app)
181		records := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(rows))
182		for _, row := range rows {
183			records = append(records, row.Repo)
184		}
185		if collectionErr == nil {
186			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
187				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
188				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
189				Records: records,
190			}
191		}
192		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
193			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
194			if len(records) > 0 {
195				cached.Records = records
196			}
197			return cached
198		}
199		if len(records) > 0 {
200			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
201				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
202				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
203				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
204			}
205		}
206		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
207	}
208
209	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
210		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
211			return true
212		}
213		if ttl <= 0 {
214			return false
215		}
216		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
217	}
218
219	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
220		var providerErrors []error
221		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
222		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
223		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
224			name := string(kind)
225			kinds = append(kinds, name)
226			byKind[name] = status
227		}
228		sort.Strings(kinds)
229		for _, kind := range kinds {
230			status := byKind[kind]
231			if status.Error != "" {
232				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
233			} else if !status.Complete {
234				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
235			}
236		}
237		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
238	}
239
240	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
241		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
242		if err != nil {
243			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
244		}
245		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
246			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
247			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
248			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
249		}
250		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
251			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
252		}
253		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
254			return input
255		}
256		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
257		if parallel <= 0 {
258			parallel = 1
259		}
260		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
261		var wait sync.WaitGroup
262		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
263			wait.Add(1)
264			go func() {
265				defer wait.Done()
266				semaphore <- struct{}{}
267				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
268				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
269			}()
270		}
271		wait.Wait()
272		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
273			input.Err = err
274		}
275		return input
276	}

385	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
386	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
387	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather
388	// than a silent pick.
389	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
390		if ref == "" {
391			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty task reference: %w", ErrNotFound)
392		}
393		all, err := s.List()
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, err
396		}
397		for _, t := range all {
398			if t.ID == ref || t.Branch == ref {
399				return t, nil
400			}
401		}
402		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
403		var hits []*Task
404		for _, t := range all {
405			hay := strings.ToLower(t.ID + " " + t.Name + " " + t.Branch + " " + t.Repo)
406			if strings.Contains(hay, needle) {
407				hits = append(hits, t)
408			}
409		}
410		switch len(hits) {
411		case 1:
412			return hits[0], nil
413		case 0:
414			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", ref, ErrNotFound)
415		default:
416			names := make([]string, len(hits))
417			for i, t := range hits {
418				names[i] = t.ID
419			}
420			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))
421		}
422	}

424	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
425	//
426	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
427	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
428	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
429	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
430	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
431	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
432		all, err := s.List()
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, err
435		}
436		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
437			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
438		}
439		var best *Task
440		var bestLen int
441		for _, t := range all {
442			root := t.WorktreePath
443			if root == "" {
444				root = t.RepoPath
445			}
446			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
447				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
448			}
449		}
450		if best == nil {
451			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
452		}
453		return best, nil
454	}

# Rejected Candidate: Pre-existing trust-hash coverage gap

- **File:** `/Users/david/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-remote-transfer/internal/projectconfig/load.go:269-335,438-550`
- **Related sink:** `/Users/david/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-remote-transfer/internal/wt/provision.go:116-119,182-203`
- **Trust check:** `/Users/david/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-remote-transfer/internal/projectconfig/trust.go:116-137`
- **Severity:** High if evaluated as an existing vulnerability; **not reportable against this diff**
- **Category:** `arbitrary_code_execution` / `trust_approval_bypass`
- **Confidence:** 10/10
- **New in diff:** **No. The feature branch neither introduces nor worsens this behavior.**

## Assessment

The underlying exploit is concrete. `executionHash` includes the unchanged command string, but `collectCommandFileCandidate` fails to bind executable repository content for forms including:

- `sh setup.sh`, because `setup.sh` contains no slash and fails `looksLikeLocalExecutionPath`.
- `bash -c './setup.sh'`, because processing stops upon encountering `-c`.
- `python -m module`, because processing stops upon encountering `-m`.

An attacker controlling repository commits can initially provide an innocuous `setup.sh` or Python module. After the user approves the repository’s execution hash, the attacker changes only that file while leaving `.dev-cli/config.toml` and its command unchanged. The resulting `ExecutionHash` remains approved by `TrustStore.Check`, and subsequent worktree provisioning executes the changed content through `shell -c` with the new checkout as its working directory, yielding arbitrary code execution as the user.

## Baseline comparison

The main baseline checkout is `/Users/david/Documents/Program/dev-cli` and its HEAD references `refs/heads/main`. It contains the same implementation verbatim:

- Baseline `executionHash`: `/Users/david/Documents/Program/dev-cli/internal/projectconfig/load.go:263-329`
- Baseline candidate collection: `/Users/david/Documents/Program/dev-cli/internal/projectconfig/load.go:432-544`
- Feature equivalents: lines `269-335` and `438-550`

The only observed difference is a six-line offset from unrelated preceding changes. The trust check and shell execution behavior also already exist in baseline.

## Recommended fix

Treat shell commands as capable of consuming arbitrary repository content rather than attempting incomplete dependency inference. Bind approval to the exact target Git tree/commit being provisioned, or hash the entire repository-controlled execution input set. Alternatively, restrict post-create commands to a structured, explicitly declared executable plus declared hashed inputs, and reject shell indirection or unsupported interpreter forms.

**Decision:** Reject from the current security review because it is pre-existing behavior, despite the underlying user-level code-execution impact.

311	// retained in Findings and produce a partial snapshot; cancellation is retained

313	func RecoverySnapshotOf(ctx context.Context, dir string) (RecoverySnapshot, error) {
314		snapshot := RecoverySnapshot{
315			Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete,
316			Refs:         []RecoveryRef{},
317			Worktrees:    []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{},

319			Findings:     []RecoveryFinding{},

322		}
323		collector := recoveryCollector{ctx: ctx, snapshot: &snapshot}
324		if err := collector.contextError("repository", dir); err != nil {
325			collector.finalize()
326			return snapshot, err
327		}
328
329		repository, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
330		if err != nil {
331			if cancelErr := collector.failure("repository-probe-failed", "repository", dir, err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
332				collector.finalize()
333				return snapshot, cancelErr
334			}
335			snapshot.Completeness = RecoveryCompletenessUnknown
336			collector.finalize()
337			return snapshot, err
338		}
339		snapshot.Repository = RecoveryRepositoryFacts{
340			Root:            repository.Root,
341			GitDir:          filepath.Clean(repository.GitDir),
342			CommonDir:       filepath.Clean(repository.GitCommonDir),
343			Bare:            repository.Bare,
344			PromisorRemotes: []string{},
345			Alternates:      []RecoveryAlternate{},
346		}
347
348		if err := collector.collectObjectFormat(repository); err != nil {
349			collector.finalize()
350			return snapshot, err
351		}
352		if err := collector.collectRefs(repository); err != nil {
353			collector.finalize()
354			return snapshot, err
355		}
356		if err := collector.collectRepositoryConfig(repository); err != nil {
357			collector.finalize()
358			return snapshot, err
359		}
360		if err := collector.collectShallow(repository); err != nil {
361			collector.finalize()
362			return snapshot, err
363		}
364		if err := collector.collectWorktreeList(repository); err != nil {
365			collector.finalize()
366			return snapshot, err
367		}
368		collector.collectStoragePlacement(repository)
369
370		for index := range snapshot.Worktrees {
371			if err := collector.collectWorktree(repository, &snapshot.Worktrees[index]); err != nil {
372				collector.finalize()
373				return snapshot, err
374			}
375		}
376		if err := collector.collectAdminRoots(repository); err != nil {
377			collector.finalize()
378			return snapshot, err
379		}
380		collector.collectObjectStoreFeatures(repository)
381		collector.finalize()
382		return snapshot, nil

391	func (collector *recoveryCollector) contextError(scope, subject string) error {
392		if cause := context.Cause(collector.ctx); cause != nil {
393			if !collector.cancelRecorded {
394				collector.cancelRecorded = true
395				collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
396					Code: "collection-cancelled", Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure,
397					Scope: scope, Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: cause.Error(),
398				})
399			}
400			collector.markPartial(nil)
401			return cause
402		}
403		return nil
404	}

406	func (collector *recoveryCollector) failure(code, scope, subject string, err error, local *RecoveryCompleteness) error {
407		if cause := context.Cause(collector.ctx); cause != nil || errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
408			if cause == nil {
409				cause = err
410			}
411			if !collector.cancelRecorded {
412				collector.cancelRecorded = true
413				collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
414					Code: "collection-cancelled", Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure,
415					Scope: scope, Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: cause.Error(),
416				})
417			}

421		collector.markPartial(local)
422		collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
423			Code: code, Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure, Scope: scope,
424			Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: recoveryCleanText(err.Error()),
425		})
426		return nil
427	}

492	func parseRecoveryRefs(output []byte) ([]RecoveryRef, error) {
493		refs := []RecoveryRef{}
494		var parseErrors []error
495		for recordIndex, record := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{'\n'}) {
496			record = bytes.TrimSuffix(record, []byte{'\r'})
497			if len(record) == 0 {
498				continue
499			}
500			fields := bytes.Split(record, []byte{0})
501			if len(fields) == 4 && len(fields[3]) == 0 {
502				fields = fields[:3]
503			}
504			if len(fields) != 3 {
505				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d has %d fields", recordIndex, len(fields)))
506				continue
507			}
508			name, oid, objectType := string(fields[0]), string(fields[1]), string(fields[2])
509			if !utf8.ValidString(name) || !strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/") || oid == "" || objectType == "" {
510				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d is invalid", recordIndex))
511				continue
512			}
513			refs = append(refs, RecoveryRef{Name: name, OID: oid, ObjectType: objectType, Kind: recoveryRefKind(name)})
514		}
515		sort.Slice(refs, func(i, j int) bool { return refs[i].Name < refs[j].Name })
516		return refs, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
517	}
518
519	func recoveryRefKind(name string) RecoveryRefKind {
520		switch {
521		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/heads/"):
522			return RecoveryRefHead
523		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/tags/"):
524			return RecoveryRefTag
525		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/notes/"):
526			return RecoveryRefNote
527		case name == "refs/stash":
528			return RecoveryRefStash
529		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/remotes/"):
530			return RecoveryRefRemote
531		default:
532			return RecoveryRefOther
533		}
534	}

536	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectRepositoryConfig(repository Repo) error {
537		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
538			"config", "--null", "--local", "--list")
539		if err != nil {
540			if cancelErr := collector.failure("config-probe-failed", "repository-config", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
541				return cancelErr
542			}
543		}
544		var parseErrors []error
545		promisorRemotes := map[string]struct{}{}
546		for recordIndex, record := range recoveryNULRecords(output) {
547			newline := bytes.IndexByte(record, '\n')
548			if newline < 1 {
549				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("config record %d has no key/value separator", recordIndex))
550				continue
551			}
552			key := strings.ToLower(string(record[:newline]))
553			value := string(record[newline+1:])
554			switch {
555			case key == "extensions.partialclone":
556				if strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
557					collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
558					promisorRemotes[strings.TrimSpace(value)] = struct{}{}
559				}
560			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "remote.") && strings.HasSuffix(key, ".promisor"):
561				remote := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "remote."), ".promisor")
562				parsed, boolErr := recoveryGitBool(value)
563				if boolErr != nil {
564					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("config %s: %w", key, boolErr))
565					continue
566				}
567				if parsed {
568					collector.snapshot.Repository.Promisor = true
569					collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
570					promisorRemotes[remote] = struct{}{}
571				}
572			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "remote.") && strings.HasSuffix(key, ".partialclonefilter"):
573				remote := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "remote."), ".partialclonefilter")
574				collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
575				promisorRemotes[remote] = struct{}{}
576			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "filter.lfs."):
577				collector.snapshot.Repository.LFSConfigured = true
578			}
579		}
580		for remote := range promisorRemotes {
581			if remote != "" {
582				collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes = append(collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes, remote)
583			}
584		}
585		sort.Strings(collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes)
586		if parseErr := errors.Join(parseErrors...); parseErr != nil {
587			_ = collector.failure("config-parse-failed", "repository-config", "repository", parseErr, nil)
588		}
589		return nil
590	}
591
592	func recoveryGitBool(value string) (bool, error) {
593		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
594		case "true", "yes", "on", "1":
595			return true, nil
596		case "false", "no", "off", "0", "":
597			return false, nil
598		default:
599			return false, fmt.Errorf("invalid Git boolean %q", value)
600		}
601	}

640			})

649	func parseRecoveryWorktrees(output []byte) ([]RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot, error) {
650		worktrees := []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{}
651		var current *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot
652		var parseErrors []error
653		flush := func() {
654			if current == nil {
655				return
656			}
657			if current.Path == "" {
658				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, errors.New("worktree record has no path"))
659			} else {
660				current.Main = len(worktrees) == 0
661				worktrees = append(worktrees, *current)
662			}
663			current = nil
664		}
665		for fieldIndex, raw := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{0}) {
666			if len(raw) == 0 {
667				flush()
668				continue
669			}
670			keyBytes, valueBytes, hasValue := bytes.Cut(raw, []byte{' '})
671			key, value := string(keyBytes), ""
672			if hasValue {
673				value = string(valueBytes)
674			}
675			if key == "worktree" {
676				flush()
677				current = &RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{
678					Path: value, Presence: RecoveryPresenceUnknown, Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete,
679					Operations: []RecoveryOperation{}, IndexEntries: []RecoveryIndexEntry{},
680					TrackedFiles: []RecoveryTrackedFile{}, DirtyPaths: []RecoveryDirtyPath{},
681					UntrackedPaths: []string{}, IgnoredPaths: []string{}, LFSPaths: []RecoveryLFSPath{},
682					Submodules: []RecoverySubmodule{}, NestedRepositories: []RecoveryNestedRepository{},
683				}
684				continue
685			}
686			if current == nil {
687				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("worktree field %d precedes a worktree path", fieldIndex))
688				continue
689			}
690			switch key {
691			case "HEAD":
692				current.Head = value
693			case "branch":
694				current.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(value, "refs/heads/")
695			case "detached":
696				current.Detached = true
697			case "bare":
698				current.Bare = true
699			case "locked":
700				current.Locked, current.LockedReason = true, value
701			case "prunable":
702				current.Prunable, current.PrunableReason = true, value
703			}
704		}
705		flush()
706		return worktrees, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
707	}

709	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectWorktree(repository Repo, worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
710		if worktree == nil {
711			return nil
712		}
713		if err := collector.contextError("worktree", worktree.Path); err != nil {
714			return err
715		}
716		info, err := os.Lstat(worktree.Path)
717		switch {
718		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
719			worktree.Presence = RecoveryPresenceMissing
720			collector.blocker("worktree-missing", "worktree", worktree.Path, "registered worktree root is missing")
721			return nil
722		case err != nil:
723			worktree.Presence = RecoveryPresenceUnknown
724			return collector.failure("worktree-root-probe-failed", "worktree", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness)
725		case info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.IsDir():
726			worktree.Presence = RecoveryPresencePresent
727			collector.markPartial(&worktree.Completeness)
728			collector.blocker("unsafe-worktree-root", "worktree", worktree.Path, "registered worktree root is not a stable directory")
729			return nil
730		default:
731			worktree.Presence = RecoveryPresencePresent
732		}
733		if worktree.Locked {
734			collector.blocker("worktree-locked", "worktree", worktree.Path, "registered worktree is locked")
735		}
736		if worktree.Prunable {
737			collector.blocker("worktree-prunable", "worktree", worktree.Path, "registered worktree is prunable")
738		}
739
740		gitDirOutput, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, worktree.Path, nil, "rev-parse", "--absolute-git-dir")
741		if err != nil {
742			if cancelErr := collector.failure("worktree-git-dir-probe-failed", "worktree", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness); cancelErr != nil {
743				return cancelErr
744			}
745		} else {
746			worktree.GitDir = filepath.Clean(strings.TrimSpace(string(gitDirOutput)))
747			if worktree.GitDir == "." || !filepath.IsAbs(worktree.GitDir) {
748				_ = collector.failure("worktree-git-dir-parse-failed", "worktree", worktree.Path,
749					errors.New("Git returned a non-absolute worktree git directory"), &worktree.Completeness)
750				worktree.GitDir = ""
751			}
752		}
753		if worktree.GitDir == "" {
754			worktree.GitDir = filepath.Clean(repository.GitDir)
755		}
756		if err := collector.collectOperations(worktree); err != nil {
757			return err
758		}
759		if worktree.Bare || repository.Bare {
760			return nil
761		}
762		if err := collector.collectSparseConfig(worktree); err != nil {
763			return err
764		}
765		if err := collector.collectIndex(worktree); err != nil {
766			return err
767		}
768		submodules := collector.collectSubmodules(worktree)
769		if err := collector.collectStatus(worktree); err != nil {
770			return err
771		}
772		if err := collector.collectIgnored(worktree); err != nil {
773			return err
774		}
775		if err := collector.collectTrackedFiles(worktree); err != nil {
776			return err
777		}
778		if err := collector.collectLFS(worktree); err != nil {
779			return err
780		}
781		return collector.collectNestedRepositories(worktree, submodules)
782	}

784	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectOperations(worktree *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot) error {
785		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(worktree.GitDir)
786		if err != nil {
787			return collector.failure("worktree-git-dir-open-failed", "git-operation", worktree.Path, err, &worktree.Completeness)

1035	func recoveryOpenParent(root *os.Root, relative string) (*os.Root, []recoveryHeldRoot, string, error) {
1036		relative = filepath.ToSlash(relative)
1037		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(relative, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
1038			return nil, nil, "", err
1039		}
1040		parts := strings.Split(relative, "/")
1041		current := root
1042		held := make([]recoveryHeldRoot, 0, len(parts)-1)
1043		for _, component := range parts[:len(parts)-1] {
1044			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(current, component)
1045			if err != nil {
1046				recoveryCloseHeld(held)
1047				return nil, nil, "", err
1048			}
1049			held = append(held, recoveryHeldRoot{parent: current, name: component, info: info, root: child})
1050			current = child
1051		}
1052		return current, held, parts[len(parts)-1], nil
1053	}

1055	func recoveryCloseHeld(held []recoveryHeldRoot) error {
1056		var result error
1057		for index := len(held) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
1058			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(held[index].parent, held[index].name, held[index].info))
1059			result = errors.Join(result, held[index].root.Close())
1060		}
1061		return result
1062	}

1064	func recoveryLstatRelative(root *os.Root, relative string) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
1065		parent, held, name, err := recoveryOpenParent(root, relative)
1066		if err != nil {
1067			return nil, err
1068		}
1069		info, statErr := parent.Lstat(name)
1070		closeErr := recoveryCloseHeld(held)
1071		return info, errors.Join(statErr, closeErr)
1072	}

1074	func recoveryReadRelative(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, relative string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
1075		parent, held, name, err := recoveryOpenParent(root, relative)
1076		if err != nil {
1077			return nil, nil, err
1078		}
1079		data, info, readErr := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, parent, name, expected, maxBytes)
1080		closeErr := recoveryCloseHeld(held)
1081		return data, info, errors.Join(readErr, closeErr)
1082	}

1084	func recoveryEntryType(info fs.FileInfo) RecoveryEntryType {
1085		if info == nil {

1087		}
1088		switch {
1089		case info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0:
1090			return RecoveryEntrySymlink
1091		case info.IsDir():
1092			return RecoveryEntryDirectory
1093		case info.Mode().IsRegular():
1094			return RecoveryEntryRegular
1095		default:
1096			return RecoveryEntrySpecial
1097		}
1098	}

1152	func parseRecoveryIndex(output []byte) ([]RecoveryIndexEntry, error) {
1153		entries := []RecoveryIndexEntry{}
1154		var parseErrors []error
1155		for recordIndex, record := range recoveryNULRecords(output) {
1156			header, pathBytes, ok := bytes.Cut(record, []byte{'\t'})
1157			if !ok || len(pathBytes) == 0 || !utf8.Valid(pathBytes) {
1158				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has an invalid path field", recordIndex))
1159				continue
1160			}
1161			fields := strings.Fields(string(header))
1162			if len(fields) != 4 || len(fields[0]) != 1 {
1163				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has an invalid header", recordIndex))
1164				continue
1165			}
1166			if _, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(fields[1], 8, 32); modeErr != nil {
1167				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d mode %q: %w", recordIndex, fields[1], modeErr))
1168				continue
1169			}
1170			stage, stageErr := strconv.Atoi(fields[3])
1171			if stageErr != nil || stage < 0 || stage > 3 {
1172				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("index record %d has invalid stage %q", recordIndex, fields[3]))
1173				continue
1174			}
1175			tag := fields[0][0]
1176			upper := tag
1177			if upper >= 'a' && upper <= 'z' {
1178				upper -= 'a' - 'A'
1179			}
1180			entries = append(entries, RecoveryIndexEntry{
1181				Path: string(pathBytes), Mode: fields[1], OID: fields[2], Stage: stage, Tag: fields[0],
1182				AssumeUnchanged: tag >= 'a' && tag <= 'z', SkipWorktree: upper == 'S',
1183			})
1184		}
1185		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
1186			if entries[i].Path != entries[j].Path {
1187				return entries[i].Path < entries[j].Path
1188			}
1189			if entries[i].Stage != entries[j].Stage {
1190				return entries[i].Stage < entries[j].Stage
1191			}
1192			return entries[i].Mode < entries[j].Mode
1193		})
1194		return entries, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
1195	}

1404				collector.blocker("lfs-path", "lfs", worktree.Path+":"+path, "path is governed by the Git LFS filter")

1536	func recoveryGit(ctx context.Context, dir string, input []byte, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
1537		if cause := context.Cause(ctx); cause != nil {
1538			return nil, cause
1539		}
1540		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
1541		command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
1542		command.Dir = dir
1543		command.Env = recoveryEnvironment()
1544		if input != nil {
1545			command.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(input)
1546		}
1547		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
1548		command.Stdout = &stdout
1549		command.Stderr = &stderr
1550		if err := command.Run(); err != nil {
1551			if cause := context.Cause(ctx); cause != nil {
1552				return stdout.Bytes(), cause
1553			}
1554			return stdout.Bytes(), &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
1555		}
1556		return stdout.Bytes(), nil
1557	}

1559	func recoveryEnvironment() []string {
1560		environment := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+1)
1561		for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
1562			key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
1563			if key != "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS" {
1564				environment = append(environment, entry)
1565			}
1566		}
1567		return append(environment, "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0")
1568	}

1570	func recoveryNULRecords(output []byte) [][]byte {
1571		if len(output) == 0 {
1572			return nil
1573		}
1574		records := bytes.Split(output, []byte{0})
1575		if len(records) > 0 && len(records[len(records)-1]) == 0 {
1576			records = records[:len(records)-1]
1577		}
1578		return records
1579	}

1594	func recoveryCleanText(value string) string {
1595		value = strings.ToValidUTF8(value, "�")
1596		value = strings.Map(func(character rune) rune {
1597			if unicode.IsControl(character) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, character) {
1598				return ' '
1599			}
1600			return character
1601		}, value)
1602		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(strings.Fields(value), " "))

1613	func recoveryIdentifier(value string) string {
1614		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
1615		var result strings.Builder
1616		lastDash := false
1617		for _, character := range value {
1618			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '.' || character == '/' || character == ':' || character == '_' {
1619				result.WriteRune(character)
1620				lastDash = false
1621				continue
1622			}
1623			if !lastDash {
1624				result.WriteByte('-')
1625				lastDash = true
1626			}
1627		}
1628		identifier := strings.Trim(result.String(), "-./:_")
1629		if identifier == "" {
1630			return "unknown"
1631		}
1632		return identifier
1633	}

369			value string
370		}{
371			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
372			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
373			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
374			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
375		}
376		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(fields))
377		for _, field := range fields {
378			if field.value == "" {
379				continue
380			}
381			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(field.value)
382			if err != nil {
383				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s %q: %w", field.name, field.value, err)
384			}
385			seen[canonical] = struct{}{}
386		}
387		paths := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
388		for path := range seen {
389			paths = append(paths, path)
390		}
391		sort.Strings(paths)
392		return paths, nil
393	}
394
395	func mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, bool, error) {
396		if current.SchemaVersion != incoming.SchemaVersion {
397			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "schema_version", "schema versions differ")
398		}
399		if current.Kind != incoming.Kind {
400			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "kind",
401				fmt.Sprintf("durable kind %q differs from imported kind %q", current.Kind, incoming.Kind))
402		}
403		if current.Name != incoming.Name {
404			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "name",
405				fmt.Sprintf("durable name %q differs from imported name %q", current.Name, incoming.Name))
406		}
407
408		merged := current.Clone()
409		changed := false
410
411		currentSummary := strings.TrimSpace(merged.Note)
412		incomingSummary := strings.TrimSpace(incoming.Note)
413		switch {
414		case currentSummary != "" && incomingSummary != "" && merged.Note != incoming.Note:
415			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "note", "nonempty summaries differ")
416		case currentSummary == "" && incomingSummary != "":
417			merged.Note = incoming.Note
418			changed = true
419		}
420
421		tags := NormalizeTags(append(append([]string(nil), merged.Tags...), incoming.Tags...))
422		if !slices.Equal(merged.Tags, tags) {
423			merged.Tags = tags
424			changed = true
425		}
426
427		switch {
428		case merged.RemoteIdentity != "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "" && merged.RemoteIdentity != incoming.RemoteIdentity:
429			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "remote_identity",
430				fmt.Sprintf("durable identity %q differs from imported identity %q", merged.RemoteIdentity, incoming.RemoteIdentity))
431		case merged.RemoteIdentity == "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "":
432			merged.RemoteIdentity = incoming.RemoteIdentity
433			changed = true
434		}
435
436		switch {
437		case merged.Experiment == nil && incoming.Experiment != nil:
438			value := *incoming.Experiment
439			merged.Experiment = &value
440			changed = true
441		case merged.Experiment != nil && incoming.Experiment != nil && !experimentsEqual(*merged.Experiment, *incoming.Experiment):
442			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "experiment", "experiment metadata differs")
443		}
444
445		if value := earlierTime(merged.Created, incoming.Created); !value.Equal(merged.Created) {
446			merged.Created = value
447			changed = true
448		}
449		if value := earlierTime(merged.Discovered, incoming.Discovered); !value.Equal(merged.Discovered) {
450			merged.Discovered = value
451			changed = true
452		}
453		if value := laterTime(merged.LastOpened, incoming.LastOpened); !value.Equal(merged.LastOpened) {
454			merged.LastOpened = value
455			changed = true
456		}
457		if value := laterTime(merged.Updated, incoming.Updated); !value.Equal(merged.Updated) {
458			merged.Updated = value
459			changed = true
460		}
461
462		previous, exists := merged.LocationFor(host)
463		if !exists || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) || !previous.Updated.Equal(location.Updated) {
464			if merged.Locations == nil {
465				merged.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
466			}
467			merged.Locations[host] = location
468			changed = true
469		}
470		merged.Normalize()
471		if err := merged.Validate(); err != nil {
472			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("validate merged catalog asset %s: %w", merged.ID, err)
473		}
474		return merged, changed, nil
475	}
476
477	func experimentsEqual(left, right Experiment) bool {
478		return left.Phase == right.Phase &&
479			left.Slug == right.Slug &&
480			left.OriginURL == right.OriginURL &&
481			left.Started.Equal(right.Started) &&
482			left.OriginalPath == right.OriginalPath &&
483			left.DeprecatedAt.Equal(right.DeprecatedAt) &&
484			left.DeprecatedPath == right.DeprecatedPath &&
485			left.GraduatedAt.Equal(right.GraduatedAt) &&
486			left.GraduatedPath == right.GraduatedPath
487	}
488
489	func earlierTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
490		if left.IsZero() || !right.IsZero() && right.Before(left) {
491			return right
492		}
493		return left
494	}
495
496	func laterTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
497		if right.After(left) {
498			return right
499		}
500		return left
501	}
502
503	// Get loads one asset by exact ID.
504	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
505		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
506			return nil, err
507		}
508		return s.get(id)
509	}

88	// WorktreeFor finds the worktree checked out on branch, if any. Git refuses to
89	// check the same branch out twice, so at most one can match.
90	func WorktreeFor(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) (Worktree, bool, error) {
91		list, err := Worktrees(ctx, dir)
92		if err != nil {
93			return Worktree{}, false, err
94		}
95		for _, w := range list {
96			if w.Branch == branch {
97				return w, true, nil
98			}
99		}
100		return Worktree{}, false, nil
101	}
102
103	// AddWorktree creates a linked worktree at path.
104	//
105	// When branch already exists it is checked out; otherwise it is created from
106	// base. Passing an explicit base matters: without one git branches from the
107	// *current* HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on feature/A would
108	// silently inherit feature/A's commits.
109	func AddWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path, branch, base string) error {
110		exists := BranchExists(ctx, dir, branch)
111		args := []string{"worktree", "add"}
112		if exists {
113			args = append(args, path, branch)
114		} else {
115			args = append(args, "-b", branch, path)
116			if base != "" {
117				args = append(args, base)
118			}
119		}
120		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
121		return err
122	}
123
124	// MoveWorktree relocates a linked worktree through Git so the shared
125	// administrative metadata keeps pointing at the checkout's new path. dir may
126	// be any checkout of the same repository.
127	func MoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, source, destination string) error {
128		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "move", source, destination)
129		return err
130	}
131
132	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
133	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
134	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
135		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
136		if err != nil {
137			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current directory before removing worktree: %w", err)
138		}
139		inside, err := pathx.Contains(path, cwd)

183	// statusPath extracts the final pathname from a porcelain-v2 record while
184	// preserving spaces in it. Rename records have one extra score field; their
185	// old path arrives as the next NUL record and is intentionally ignored.
186	func statusPath(rec string) string {
187		if rec == "" {
188			return ""
189		}
190		var fields int
191		switch rec[0] {
192		case '1':
193			fields = 9
194		case '2':
195			fields = 10
196		case 'u':
197			fields = 11
198		default:
199			return ""
200		}
201		parts := strings.SplitN(rec, " ", fields)
202		if len(parts) != fields {
203			return ""
204		}

 // listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
 // render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
 // chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
 // Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
 func (m Model) listHeight() int {
    // Header + its blank line, table header, blank before detail, blank before
    // footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and terminal width.
    fixed := 2 + 1 + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
    h := m.height - fixed
    if h < 3 {
        return 3
    }
    // A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
    if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
        h--
    }
    return h
 }

 func lineCount(s string) int {
    s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\n")
    if s == "" {
        return 0
    }
    return strings.Count(s, "\n") + 1
 }

92		}

94		filtered := out[:0]
95		for _, l := range out {

97				filtered = append(filtered, l)
98			}
99		}
100		return filtered

108		}

10	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
11	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
12	type Repo struct {
13		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
14		Root string
15		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory. A linked worktree has
16		// its own entry below the shared common directory.
17		GitDir string
18		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
19		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
20		GitCommonDir string
21		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
22		Name string
23		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
24		// the main checkout.
25		IsLinkedWorktree bool
26		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
27		MainRoot string
28		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
29		Bare bool
30	}
31
32	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
33	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
34
35	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
36	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
37		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
38		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
39		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
40			"rev-parse",
41			"--path-format=absolute",
42			"--show-toplevel",
43			"--git-dir",
44			"--git-common-dir",
45			"--is-bare-repository",
46		)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Repo{}, err
49		}
50		f := lines(out)
51		r := Repo{}
52		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
53		switch len(f) {
54		case 4:
55			r.Root = f[0]
56			r.GitDir = f[1]
57			r.GitCommonDir = f[2]
58			r.Bare = f[3] == "true"
59		case 3:
60			r.GitDir = f[0]
61			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
62			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
63		default:
64			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
65		}
66
67		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
68		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
69		if r.Bare {
70			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
71		} else if r.GitDir == r.GitCommonDir {
72			// A normal checkout may use --separate-git-dir, so the common directory's
73			// parent is not necessarily the working-tree root.
74			r.MainRoot = r.Root
75		} else {
76			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
77		}
78		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.GitDir != r.GitCommonDir
79		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
80		if r.Bare {
81			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
82			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
83			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
84				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
85			}
86		}
87		return r, nil
88	}
89
90	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
91	// a full Discover.
92	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
93		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
94		return err == nil
95	}

1	// Package gitx wraps the git porcelain commands dev depends on. Every helper
2	// shells out to git rather than linking a Go implementation: git is already a
3	// hard dependency, its porcelain formats are stable and documented, and this
4	// keeps dev's behaviour identical to what the user sees when they run the same
5	// command by hand.
6	package gitx
7
8	import (
9		"bytes"
10		"context"
11		"errors"
12		"fmt"
13		"os"
14		"os/exec"
15		"strings"
16	)
17
18	// ErrNotARepo is returned when a directory is not inside a git working tree.
19	var ErrNotARepo = errors.New("not a git repository")
20
21	// Error carries the failing command and git's own stderr, which is almost
22	// always more useful than the exit status alone.
23	type Error struct {
24		Args   []string
25		Dir    string
26		Stderr string
27		Err    error
28	}
29
30	func (e *Error) Error() string {
31		msg := strings.TrimSpace(e.Stderr)
32		if msg == "" {
33			msg = e.Err.Error()
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("git %s: %s", strings.Join(e.Args, " "), msg)
36	}
37
38	func (e *Error) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }
39
40	// run executes git in dir and returns trimmed stdout.
41	func run(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
42		return runEnv(ctx, dir, nil, args...)
43	}
44
45	// runEnv executes git with task-scoped environment overrides. It is used for
46	// alternate-index analysis that must never touch the user's real index.
47	func runEnv(ctx context.Context, dir string, overrides []string, args ...string) (string, error) {
48		// -c core.quotepath=false keeps non-ASCII paths readable rather than
49		// octal-escaped, which matters for the Chinese-named files in these repos.
50		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
51		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
52		cmd.Dir = dir
53		if len(overrides) > 0 {
54			keys := make(map[string]bool, len(overrides))
55			for _, override := range overrides {
56				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(override, "=")
57				keys[key] = true
58			}
59			env := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+len(overrides))
60			for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
61				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
62				if !keys[key] {
63					env = append(env, entry)
64				}
65			}
66			env = append(env, overrides...)
67			cmd.Env = env
68		}
69		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
70		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
71		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
72		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
73			gerr := &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
74			if strings.Contains(gerr.Stderr, "not a git repository") {
75				return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", dir, ErrNotARepo)
76			}
77			return "", gerr
78		}

    root := t.TempDir()

    catalogDir := filepath.Join(root, "assets")
    gate := filepath.Join(root, "start")

    commands := make([]*exec.Cmd, 6)
    for index := range commands {

            "DEV_EXPERIMENT_RECONCILE_GATE="+gate,
            "DEV_EXPERIMENT_CATALOG_DIR="+catalogDir,
            "DEV_EXPERIMENT_TRIES_ROOT="+triesRoot,
            "DEV_EXPERIMENT_PROJECT_ROOT="+projectRoot,
        )
        command.Stdout = os.Stdout
        command.Stderr = os.Stderr

120				return currentErr

125			}

128		})

122	func (t Transport) run(ctx context.Context, host Host, remoteArgs []string, stdin []byte, pty bool, options RunOptions) Result {
123		if options.Retry == "" {
124			options.Retry = RetryNever
125		}
126		if options.Retry != RetryNever && options.Retry != RetryAuthentication {
127			return localTransportFailure(fmt.Sprintf("fleet transport: unknown retry policy %q", options.Retry))
128		}
129		stdinLimit := effectiveLimit(t.StdinLimit, DefaultStdinLimit)
130		if int64(len(stdin)) > stdinLimit {
131			message := fmt.Sprintf("fleet transport: stdin exceeds %d-byte limit", stdinLimit)
132			return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}
133		}
134		timeout := host.CommandTimeout.Duration
135		if timeout <= 0 {
136			timeout = 5 * time.Minute
137		}
138		commandCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
139		defer cancel()
140
141		first := t.runAttempt(commandCtx, host, remoteArgs, stdin, pty, "")
142		if options.Retry != RetryAuthentication || first.CaptureError != "" || first.ExitCode != 255 || host.PasswordKind() == "none" || !permissionDenied(first.Stderr) {
143			first.TimedOut = first.TimedOut || errors.Is(commandCtx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded)
144			return first
145		}
146		password, err := t.resolvePassword(host)

149			first.TransportError = message
150			first.Stderr = boundedBytes([]byte(message), effectiveLimit(t.StderrLimit, DefaultStderrLimit))
151			return first
152		}
153		second := t.runAttempt(commandCtx, host, remoteArgs, stdin, pty, password)
154		second.UsedPassword = true
155		second.Attempts = first.Attempts + second.Attempts
156		second.TimedOut = second.TimedOut || errors.Is(commandCtx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded)
157		return second

195		}

519	func runGit(t *testing.T, directory string, args ...string) string {

199	// runSSHCommand starts SSH before writing an askpass secret. Starting first is
200	// load-bearing: a secret larger than the pipe capacity must remain cancellable
201	// through the command context instead of blocking before SSH exists.
202	func runSSHCommand(cmd *exec.Cmd, password string) error {
203		if password == "" {
204			return cmd.Run()
205		}
206		executable, err := os.Executable()
207		if err != nil {
208			return err
209		}
210		reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
211		if err != nil {
212			return err
213		}
214		cmd.ExtraFiles = []*os.File{reader}
215		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
216			askpassMarker+"=1", askpassFD+"=3", "SSH_ASKPASS="+executable,
217			"SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force", "DISPLAY=dev-fleet")
218		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
219			_ = reader.Close()
220			_ = writer.Close()
221			return err
222		}
223		// The child owns its inherited descriptor after Start; closing the parent
224		// copy lets an early SSH exit interrupt a blocked write.
225		readerCloseErr := reader.Close()
226		writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
227		go func() {
228			_, writeErr := io.Copy(writer, strings.NewReader(password+"\n"))
229			writeDone <- errors.Join(writeErr, writer.Close())
230		}()
231		waitErr := cmd.Wait()
232		// A descendant could retain the inherited read descriptor after SSH exits.
233		// Close our writer so that cannot strand the write goroutine.
234		_ = writer.Close()
235		writeErr := <-writeDone
236		return errors.Join(waitErr, readerCloseErr, writeErr)
237	}
238
239	func sshArgs(host Host, pty, password bool) []string {
240		connect := host.ConnectTimeout.Duration
241		if connect <= 0 {
242			connect = 15 * time.Second
243		}
244		seconds := int(connect.Round(time.Second) / time.Second)
245		if seconds < 1 {
246			seconds = 1
247		}
248		args := []string{"-o", "ConnectTimeout=" + strconv.Itoa(seconds), "-o", "ServerAliveInterval=15", "-o", "ServerAliveCountMax=2"}
249		if password {
250			args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=no", "-o", "PubkeyAuthentication=no", "-o", "PreferredAuthentications=keyboard-interactive,password", "-o", "NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1")
251		} else {
252			args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=yes")
253		}
