502	 # Remote repository fleet
503
504	 `dev fleet` fans out over SSH to other machines running their own `dev`, so you can see and open their repositories and safely propagate a branch, without merging their independent configuration into this machine's view.
505
506	 ## What a fleet is
507
508	-A remote fleet is a list of other hosts, each running its own `dev` binary against its own `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, its own scan roots, its own task registry, and its own runtime. `dev fleet` never centralizes or takes ownership of that state — it only asks each host's `dev` for a read-only snapshot over SSH and reports what comes back. A host with no `dev` installed, or an unreachable host, degrades that one row; it never blocks the rest of the fleet.
509	+A remote fleet is a list of other hosts, each running its own `dev` binary against its own `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, its own scan roots, its own task registry, and its own runtime. Inventory stays decentralized: each host's `dev` produces its own read-only snapshot over SSH, and one unreachable host never blocks the remaining rows. Mutation is confined to separately named commands such as `fleet sync` and `fleet files --apply`; neither makes this machine authoritative for the target's paths, task registry, or runtime.
510
511	 This is a different concept from the REMOTE TUI view and publishing/PR flows,
512	 which use `gh` or `glab` for GitHub/GitLab repository publication and PRs, plus
513	 the Azure CLI for Azure DevOps inventory and PRs. Fleet talks to *your own
514	 machines* about *your own local checkouts* on those machines.
515
516	 ## Configure hosts
517
518	 ```bash
519	 dev fleet config init
520	 dev fleet config edit
521	 dev fleet config show
522	 dev fleet config path
523	 ```
524
525	 Hosts live in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` (override the path with the global `--remotes <path>` flag). `config init` writes a starter file (`--force` to overwrite, `--stdout` to print without writing); `config edit` opens it in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` (`--editor` overrides); `config show` prints the effective configuration with any plaintext password redacted; `config path` prints the resolved path.
526
527	 ```toml
528	 schema_version = 1
529
530	 [defaults]
531	 connect_timeout = "15s"
532	 command_timeout = "5m"
533	 cache_ttl = "15m"
534	 max_parallel = 4
535	 dev_path = "auto"
536
537	 [[hosts]]
538	 name = "lab"
539	 ssh_alias = "lab"
540	+# Add only after `dev fleet machine-id lab` and independent verification.
541	+machine_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
542
543	 [[hosts]]
544	 name = "vps"
545	 hostname = "203.0.113.10"
546	 user = "dev"
547	 port = 22
548	 identity_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
549	 ssh_login_password_source = { type = "bitwarden", item = "ssh-vps-login" }
550	 ```
551
552	-`schema_version = 1` is required. `[defaults]` supplies `connect_timeout`, `command_timeout`, `cache_ttl`, `max_parallel` (fan-out concurrency), and `dev_path` (`"auto"` searches `PATH`); each `[[hosts]]` entry inherits any of these it does not set explicitly. A host needs `name` plus either `ssh_alias` (preferred — it reuses `~/.ssh/config`'s `ProxyJump`, `IdentityAgent`, and host-key policy exactly like a plain `ssh` invocation) or `hostname` (optionally with `user`, `port`, `identity_file`). `ssh_login_password_source.type` is one of `none` (default), `prompt`, `plain` (inline `value`), or `bitwarden` (`item` looked up with the `bw` CLI). A config file with a `plain` password must be mode `0600`, or `dev fleet` refuses to load it.
553	+`schema_version = 1` is required. `[defaults]` supplies `connect_timeout`, `command_timeout`, `cache_ttl`, `max_parallel` (fan-out concurrency), and `dev_path` (`"auto"` searches `PATH`); each `[[hosts]]` entry inherits any of these it does not set explicitly. A host needs `name` plus either `ssh_alias` (preferred — it reuses `~/.ssh/config`'s `ProxyJump`, `IdentityAgent`, and host-key policy exactly like a plain `ssh` invocation) or `hostname` (optionally with `user`, `port`, `identity_file`). The optional `machine_id` is a durable UUID pin: read-only inventory can warn or proceed without it, but mutating portable-file apply requires an exact match. `ssh_login_password_source.type` is one of `none` (default), `prompt`, `plain` (inline `value`), or `bitwarden` (`item` looked up with the `bw` CLI). A config file with a `plain` password must be mode `0600`, or `dev fleet` refuses to load it.
554	+
555	+Discover a target UUID with `dev fleet machine-id <host>`, verify it through an independent channel on that machine, then copy it into `remotes.toml`. The command is read-only and reports `unpinned`, `match`, or `mismatch`; it never edits configuration on your behalf.
556
557	 ## `dev fleet` commands
558
559	 | Command | Flags | Purpose |
560	 |---|---|---|
561	 | `dev fleet list` | `--host <name>` (repeatable), `--repo <query>`, `--json`, `--cached`, `--strict` | List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts |
562	 | `dev fleet status` | `--json`, `--strict` | Probe configured hosts and report snapshot health |
563	+| `dev fleet machine-id <host>` | `--json` | Show the observed durable UUID and compare the configured pin |
564	 | `dev fleet sync <repo>` | `--push`, `--remote <name>`, `--host <name>` (repeatable), `--json` | Push optionally, then safely fast-forward clean matching checkouts |
565	+| `dev fleet files [repo-or-path]` | `--to <host>`, `--file <pattern>` (repeatable), `--apply`, `--replace`, `--yes`, `--json` | Plan or apply one-way transfer of explicit ignored files |
566	 | `dev fleet open <host> <repo>` | — | Open a remote repository through Herdr or an SSH login shell |
567	 | `dev fleet config init` | `-f`/`--force`, `--stdout` | Write a starter `remotes.toml` |
568	 | `dev fleet config edit` | `--editor <cmd>` | Open `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` |
569	 | `dev fleet config show` | — | Print the effective configuration (passwords redacted) |
570	 | `dev fleet config path` | — | Print the resolved `remotes.toml` path |
571
572	 `--repo` on `list` filters by name, remote identity, branch, or path; `--cached` answers entirely from the last saved snapshot with no network activity; `--strict` turns an unreachable/timeout/incompatible/invalid host into a non-zero exit for both `list` and `status`. `sync <repo>` resolves `<repo>` locally like any other repository reference; without `--push` its `HEAD` must already equal the fetched upstream, and `--remote` picks which Git remote identifies the repository across hosts (default: the branch's upstream remote, then `origin`).
573
574	-`dev fleet` also registers four hidden commands (`_snapshot`, `_sync`, `_open-herdr`, `_shell`) that exist only to be invoked by `dev fleet` itself on the far end of an SSH connection — they are the wire protocol, not a user-facing surface.
575	+## Explicit portable local files
576	+
577	+A repository may propose export candidates separately from worktree provisioning:
578	+
579	+```toml
580	+# .dev-cli/config.toml
581	+version = 1
582	+
583	+[local_files]
584	+include = [".env", ".mcp/**"]
585	+```
586	+
587	+`[worktree].include` is local provisioning policy and is never inherited here.
588	+`[local_files].include` also grants no standing permission: an explicit invocation
589	+must select exactly one target, and repeatable `--file` adds ad-hoc patterns for
590	+that invocation only. Patterns expand on the source into sorted exact paths;
591	+no glob crosses the wire.
592	+
593	+```bash
594	+dev fleet files api --to lab                    # report only
595	+dev fleet files api --to lab --apply --yes      # create absent target files
596	+dev fleet files api --to lab --replace --apply  # authorize differing bytes separately
597	+```
598	+
599	+The source and target must already resolve to one clone with the same normalized
600	+**fetch** identity, attached branch, and exact commit. A push-only URL match is
601	+insufficient. Both hosts independently prove every exact path is untracked and
602	+ignored under their own Git configuration. Only regular files pass: no
603	+symlinks/reparse points, directories, sockets, devices, FIFOs, `.git`, nested
604	+repositories, or submodule boundaries. Compiled ceilings are 128 files,
605	+8 MiB per file, 32 MiB total, with bounded path length/depth; host policy may
606	+lower but never raise them.
607	+
608	+Plan is the default and sends no file body. Apply additionally requires the
609	+configured `machine_id` to match the content-free capability probe. Missing files
610	+are atomically created owner-only; identical files are no-ops; differing bytes
611	+block unless `--replace` was present in the displayed plan. Replacement binds the
612	+observed target digest/mode, retains a private rollback copy, revalidates both
613	+roots, and rolls back file changes on failure. `--yes` only answers confirmation
614	+and never implies replacement. Public human/JSON output contains path, size,
615	+mode, and state—never content or hashes.
616	+
617	+The transaction journal is durable before manifest/payload staging, so an
618	+interrupted request ID can resume or reconcile. Rollback intentionally leaves an
619	+empty parent directory when its post-crash identity cannot be proven; deleting
620	+another process's replacement would be worse. Native Windows payload transfer is
621	+capability-blocked before content is sent.
622	+
623	+This command is not repository/task ownership transfer, clone acquisition,
624	+provisioning, backup, restore, or eviction. It never switches a branch, copies
625	+task/catalog/note state, watches for changes, propagates deletions, or removes the
626	+source.
627	+
628	+`dev fleet` also registers bounded hidden capability/file commands in addition to
629	+`_snapshot`, `_sync`, `_open-herdr`, and `_shell`. They exist only for the two
630	+`dev` processes to invoke over SSH; they are wire protocols, not user-facing
631	+surfaces.
632
633	 ## Transport and authentication
634
635	-Every fleet command reaches a host by shelling out to the system `ssh` binary with `ConnectTimeout`, `ServerAliveInterval=15`, and `ServerAliveCountMax=2`, and first attempts `BatchMode=yes` — key or agent authentication only, exactly like a script-friendly `ssh` call. `dev fleet open` additionally allocates a PTY (`-t`) for its interactive login shell.
636	+Every fleet command reaches a host by shelling out to the system `ssh` binary with `ConnectTimeout`, `ServerAliveInterval=15`, and `ServerAliveCountMax=2`, and first attempts `BatchMode=yes` — key or agent authentication only, exactly like a script-friendly `ssh` call. Fixed protocols use non-PTY `-T` and disable agent, X11, local-command, and all port forwarding while retaining the user's normal host-key policy. `dev fleet open` separately allocates a PTY (`-t`) for its interactive login shell.
637
638	 If that attempt is rejected with "permission denied" and the host defines a `ssh_login_password_source`, `dev` retries once with password authentication. The password itself never touches argv or the environment: `dev` re-executes itself as a one-shot `SSH_ASKPASS` helper, and the secret is handed to that helper over an inherited file descriptor. `prompt` reads a hidden password from `/dev/tty` at run time; `plain` and `bitwarden` resolve it from the config file or from `bw get password <item>` respectively.
639
640	 On the remote side, `dev_path = "auto"` (the default) searches common install locations (`~/.local/bin`, `~/go/bin`, mise shims, Homebrew/Linuxbrew, `/usr/local/bin`, `/snap/bin`) and then `PATH`, exiting `127` if no `dev` is found; an explicit absolute `dev_path` skips that search and execs it directly.
641
642	 ## What's cached vs. durable
643
644	 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` is durable, user-authored configuration, on the same footing as `config.toml` — `dev fleet config init`/`edit` manage it, and nothing regenerates it automatically.
645
646	-Each successful probe writes a per-host JSON snapshot under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json`. That cache is a disposable accelerator, not durable data: it is fingerprinted with an "endpoint ID" derived from the host's connection fields and timeouts, so editing a host's `ssh_alias`, `hostname`, `user`, `identity_file`, `dev_path`, or timeouts automatically invalidates its old cache the next time `dev` reads it. `dev cache list` shows its path, size, and age; `dev cache clear fleet` (or `dev cache clear all`) removes it outright. There is nothing to "rebuild" explicitly — the next `dev fleet list`, `dev fleet status`, or TUI FLEET reload regenerates it from a fresh probe.
647	+Each successful probe writes a per-host JSON snapshot under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json`. That cache is a disposable accelerator, not durable data: it is fingerprinted with an "endpoint ID" derived from the host's connection fields and timeouts, so editing a host's `machine_id`, `ssh_alias`, `hostname`, `user`, `identity_file`, `dev_path`, or timeouts automatically invalidates its old cache the next time `dev` reads it. `dev cache list` shows its path, size, and age; `dev cache clear fleet` (or `dev cache clear all`) removes it outright. There is nothing to "rebuild" explicitly — the next `dev fleet list`, `dev fleet status`, or TUI FLEET reload regenerates it from a fresh probe.
648
649	 The cache exists so an unreachable, timed-out, incompatible, or invalid-response host can still report its last known state (marked `stale`, with `FromCache` set) instead of vanishing from the listing; `--cached` uses only this cache and never touches the network. Each remote host's own `config.toml`, task registry, and repository paths remain authoritative on that host — the cache only ever holds a read-only snapshot of them.
650
651	 ## Fleet in the TUI
652
653	 FLEET is one of the TUI's six views (`TASKS`, `REPOS`, `FLEET`, `TRY`, `REMOTE`, `SKILLS`, switched with `tab`/`h`/`l`). Like REMOTE, it loads lazily — nothing is fetched until the view is first opened — but it seeds itself from any cached snapshots that are still within `defaults.cache_ttl` so the first render is not empty. `r` forces a live reload of every configured host.
654
655	 Its table shows `HOST`, `STATE`, `REPO`, `BRANCH`, `GIT`, `LIVE`, `TASKS`, and `PATH`. `enter` opens the selected repository: for a local host row this is an ordinary local open; for a remote row `dev` prefers native Herdr remoting when that host's snapshot reports the `herdr` runtime and the host connects through `ssh_alias` with no password step, and otherwise falls back to an interactive SSH login shell in the repository's directory. Git changes are read-only in this view — FLEET is for inspecting and opening work, not editing it in place.
656
657	 `e` opens `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` — the file this view is about, rather than dev's own `config.toml`, which `e` opens everywhere else. On leaving the editor `dev` reparses the file before using it. A parse failure, an unknown field, or a permissions problem on a file holding a plaintext password is reported and the previous rows are kept, so a typo cannot silently drop a host from the fleet. A file that parses triggers an immediate live reload of every configured host.
658
659	 ## Degrading gracefully
660
661	 Every host is probed independently, so one bad host never fails the fleet as a whole. Per-host states are `ok`, `stale` (cache reused, optionally with an error explaining why), `no-dev` (the remote has no `dev` on its `PATH` — reported, not an error), `unreachable` (SSH itself failed), `timeout`, `incompatible` (an old or unrecognized remote `dev`), and `invalid-response` (malformed snapshot JSON). `ok` and a clean `no-dev` never fail `--strict`; every other state does, including a `stale` result that carries an error.
662
663	 Separately, forge integration is optional: `gh` and `glab` enable GitHub/GitLab
664	 inventory, publication, and pull/merge requests, while `az` enables Azure
665	 DevOps inventory and pull requests. `dev doctor` reports missing CLIs as
666	 warnings. Local Git workflows remain available, but an explicit non-interactive
667	 publication request fails with login/install guidance instead of silently
668	 changing its meaning. Azure DevOps inventory is additionally opt-in and stays
669	 disabled until `forge.azure_devops` targets are configured.
670

706	 # Remote repository fleet
707
708	 !!! note "術語規則"
709	     有公認中文譯名且本文使用中文時，首次以「中文 (English original)」呈現。產品名稱與 Git／CLI／agent domain terms 可直接保留英文；沒有公認譯名不得自創。程式碼、API／tool 名稱、CLI flag、套件名與路徑一律不翻譯。
710
711	 `dev fleet` 透過 SSH 連到其他執行自己 `dev` 的機器，讓你能查看並開啟它們的 repository、安全地傳播 branch，而不會把它們各自獨立的設定合併進這台機器的視角。
712
713	 ## Fleet 是什麼
714
715	-Remote fleet 是一份其他 host 的清單，每個 host 都執行自己的 `dev` binary，使用自己的 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`、自己的 scan roots、自己的 task registry 與自己的 runtime。`dev fleet` 從不集中管理或取得那份 state 的 ownership，它只會透過 SSH 向每個 host 的 `dev` 要一份 read-only snapshot，並回報收到的結果。沒有安裝 `dev` 的 host，或無法連線的 host，只會讓那一列 degrade；不會擋住 fleet 其餘部分。
716	+Remote fleet 是一份其他 host 的清單，每個 host 都執行自己的 `dev` binary，使用自己的 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`、自己的 scan roots、自己的 task registry 與自己的 runtime。Inventory 維持 decentralized：每個 host 的 `dev` 透過 SSH 產生自己的 read-only snapshot，一個 unreachable host 不會擋住其他 rows。Mutation 只存在於分開命名的 commands，例如 `fleet sync` 與 `fleet files --apply`；兩者都不會讓這台機器成為 target paths、task registry 或 runtime 的 authority。
717
718	 這與 REMOTE TUI view 及 publishing/PR flow 是不同概念——GitHub/GitLab
719	 repository publishing 與 PR 使用 `gh` 或 `glab`，Azure DevOps inventory 與 PR
720	 則使用 Azure CLI。Fleet 溝通的對象是*你自己的機器*上*你自己的 local
721	 checkout*。
722
723	 ## 設定 hosts
724
725	 ```bash
726	 dev fleet config init
727	 dev fleet config edit
728	 dev fleet config show
729	 dev fleet config path
730	 ```
731
732	 Host 設定放在 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml`（可用全域 `--remotes <path>` flag 覆寫路徑）。`config init` 會寫入一份 starter file（`--force` 覆寫既有檔案、`--stdout` 只印出不寫入）；`config edit` 會用 `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` 開啟它（`--editor` 可覆寫）；`config show` 印出目前生效的設定，明文密碼會被遮蔽；`config path` 印出解析後的路徑。
733
734	 ```toml
735	 schema_version = 1
736
737	 [defaults]
738	 connect_timeout = "15s"
739	 command_timeout = "5m"
740	 cache_ttl = "15m"
741	 max_parallel = 4
742	 dev_path = "auto"
743
744	 [[hosts]]
745	 name = "lab"
746	 ssh_alias = "lab"
747	+# 執行 dev fleet machine-id lab 並透過獨立管道驗證後才加入：
748	+machine_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
749
750	 [[hosts]]
751	 name = "vps"
752	 hostname = "203.0.113.10"
753	 user = "dev"
754	 port = 22
755	 identity_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
756	 ssh_login_password_source = { type = "bitwarden", item = "ssh-vps-login" }
757	 ```
758
759	-`schema_version = 1` 為必填。`[defaults]` 提供 `connect_timeout`、`command_timeout`、`cache_ttl`、`max_parallel`（fan-out 並行度）與 `dev_path`（`"auto"` 會搜尋 `PATH`）；每個 `[[hosts]]` 項目未明確設定的欄位都會沿用這些預設值。一個 host 需要 `name`，並搭配 `ssh_alias`（優先——它會沿用 `~/.ssh/config` 的 `ProxyJump`、`IdentityAgent` 與 host-key policy，行為與單純的 `ssh` 呼叫完全一致）或 `hostname`（可搭配 `user`、`port`、`identity_file`）其中之一。`ssh_login_password_source.type` 可為 `none`（預設）、`prompt`、`plain`（內嵌 `value`）或 `bitwarden`（用 `item` 透過 `bw` CLI 查詢）。設定檔若含 `plain` 密碼，檔案權限必須是 `0600`，否則 `dev fleet` 會拒絕載入。
760	+`schema_version = 1` 為必填。`[defaults]` 提供 `connect_timeout`、`command_timeout`、`cache_ttl`、`max_parallel`（fan-out 並行度）與 `dev_path`（`"auto"` 會搜尋 `PATH`）；每個 `[[hosts]]` 項目未明確設定的欄位都會沿用這些預設值。一個 host 需要 `name`，並搭配 `ssh_alias`（優先——它會沿用 `~/.ssh/config` 的 `ProxyJump`、`IdentityAgent` 與 host-key policy，行為與單純的 `ssh` 呼叫完全一致）或 `hostname`（可搭配 `user`、`port`、`identity_file`）其中之一。Optional `machine_id` 是 durable UUID pin：read-only inventory 可在未設定時警告或繼續，但 mutating portable-file apply 必須 exact match。`ssh_login_password_source.type` 可為 `none`（預設）、`prompt`、`plain`（內嵌 `value`）或 `bitwarden`（用 `item` 透過 `bw` CLI 查詢）。設定檔若含 `plain` 密碼，檔案權限必須是 `0600`，否則 `dev fleet` 會拒絕載入。
761	+
762	+用 `dev fleet machine-id <host>` 取得 target UUID，在該機器上透過獨立管道驗證後，再複製到 `remotes.toml`。這個 command 是 read-only，只會回報 `unpinned`、`match` 或 `mismatch`，絕不代替使用者修改設定。
763
764	 ## `dev fleet` 指令
765
766	 | Command | Flags | Purpose |
767	 |---|---|---|
768	 | `dev fleet list` | `--host <name>`（可重複）、`--repo <query>`、`--json`、`--cached`、`--strict` | List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts |
769	 | `dev fleet status` | `--json`、`--strict` | Probe configured hosts and report snapshot health |
770	+| `dev fleet machine-id <host>` | `--json` | 顯示 observed durable UUID 並比較 configured pin |
771	 | `dev fleet sync <repo>` | `--push`、`--remote <name>`、`--host <name>`（可重複）、`--json` | Push optionally, then safely fast-forward clean matching checkouts |
772	+| `dev fleet files [repo-or-path]` | `--to <host>`、`--file <pattern>`（可重複）、`--apply`、`--replace`、`--yes`、`--json` | Plan 或 apply 明確 ignored files 的 one-way transfer |
773	 | `dev fleet open <host> <repo>` | — | Open a remote repository through Herdr or an SSH login shell |
774	 | `dev fleet config init` | `-f`/`--force`、`--stdout` | Write a starter `remotes.toml` |
775	 | `dev fleet config edit` | `--editor <cmd>` | Open `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` |
776	 | `dev fleet config show` | — | Print the effective configuration (passwords redacted) |
777	 | `dev fleet config path` | — | Print the resolved `remotes.toml` path |
778
779	 `list` 的 `--repo` 會依 name、remote identity、branch 或 path 過濾；`--cached` 完全依最後一次儲存的 snapshot 回答，不會有任何 network activity；`--strict` 會讓 `list` 與 `status` 在 host 為 unreachable/timeout/incompatible/invalid 時回傳非零結果。`sync <repo>` 對 `<repo>` 的解析方式與其他 repository reference 相同；沒有 `--push` 時，其 `HEAD` 必須已等於 fetch 後的 upstream；`--remote` 決定用哪個 Git remote 在各 host 間識別這個 repository（預設：branch 的 upstream remote，其次是 `origin`）。
780
781	-`dev fleet` 還註冊了四個 hidden command（`_snapshot`、`_sync`、`_open-herdr`、`_shell`），它們的存在只是為了讓 `dev fleet` 在 SSH 連線的另一端自行呼叫——這是 wire protocol，不是給使用者直接使用的介面。
782	+## 明確 portable local files
783	+
784	+Repository 可用與 worktree provisioning 分離的設定提出 export candidates：
785	+
786	+```toml
787	+# .dev-cli/config.toml
788	+version = 1
789	+
790	+[local_files]
791	+include = [".env", ".mcp/**"]
792	+```
793	+
794	+`[worktree].include` 是 local provisioning policy，絕不會被這裡繼承。
795	+`[local_files].include` 也不代表 standing permission：每次都必須用 explicit invocation
796	+選擇恰好一個 target，repeatable `--file` 只為該次 invocation 加入 ad-hoc pattern。
797	+Patterns 會在 source 展開成 sorted exact paths；wire 上不傳 glob。
798	+
799	+```bash
800	+dev fleet files api --to lab                    # 只產生 report
801	+dev fleet files api --to lab --apply --yes      # 建立 target 不存在的 files
802	+dev fleet files api --to lab --replace --apply  # 分開授權不同 bytes
803	+```
804	+
805	+Source 與 target 必須已解析到一個具有相同 normalized **fetch** identity、attached
806	+branch 與 exact commit 的 clone；只有 push URL 相同不足以授權。兩端依自己的 Git
807	+configuration 分別證明每個 exact path 都是 untracked 且 ignored。只有 regular files
808	+可通過：不接受 symlink/reparse point、directory、socket、device、FIFO、`.git`、nested
809	+repository 或 submodule boundary。Compiled ceilings 是 128 files、每個 8 MiB、合計
810	+32 MiB，且 path length/depth 有界；host policy 只能調低，不能提高。
811	+
812	+預設 plan，不送 file body。Apply 另外要求 configured `machine_id` 與 content-free
813	+capability probe 一致。Target 不存在時以 owner-only mode atomic create；內容相同是
814	+no-op；內容不同預設 blocked，只有 displayed plan 明確帶 `--replace` 才可取代。
815	+Replacement 綁定 observed target digest/mode、保留 private rollback copy、重驗兩端
816	+roots，失敗時 rollback file changes。`--yes` 只回答 confirmation，絕不隱含
817	+replacement。Public human/JSON output 只有 path、size、mode 與 state，不含 content
818	+或 hash。
819	+
820	+Transaction journal 會先於 manifest/payload staging durable，因此 interrupted request ID
821	+可 resume 或 reconcile。Rollback 在 crash 後無法證明空 parent directory identity 時會
822	+刻意保留它；刪到其他 process 的 replacement 更糟。Native Windows payload transfer
823	+會在 content 傳送前被 capability-block。
824	+
825	+這個 command 不是 repository/task ownership transfer、clone acquisition、provisioning、
826	+backup、restore 或 eviction；它不會 switch branch、複製 task/catalog/note state、監看
827	+變更、傳播 deletion，或移除 source。
828	+
829	+`dev fleet` 除了 `_snapshot`、`_sync`、`_open-herdr` 與 `_shell`，也註冊 bounded hidden
830	+capability/file commands。它們只供兩端 `dev` 透過 SSH 互相呼叫，是 wire protocols，
831	+不是 user-facing surface。
832
833	 ## Transport 與認證
834
835	-每個 fleet command 都透過呼叫系統的 `ssh` binary 連到 host，帶上 `ConnectTimeout`、`ServerAliveInterval=15`、`ServerAliveCountMax=2`，並且第一次嘗試一律用 `BatchMode=yes`——只用 key 或 agent authentication，行為就像一次適合腳本化的 `ssh` 呼叫。`dev fleet open` 另外會為它的 interactive login shell 配置 PTY（`-t`）。
836	+每個 fleet command 都透過呼叫系統的 `ssh` binary 連到 host，帶上 `ConnectTimeout`、`ServerAliveInterval=15`、`ServerAliveCountMax=2`，並且第一次嘗試一律用 `BatchMode=yes`——只用 key 或 agent authentication，行為就像一次適合腳本化的 `ssh` 呼叫。Fixed protocols 使用 non-PTY `-T`，並停用 agent、X11、local-command 與所有 port forwarding，同時保留使用者原本的 host-key policy。`dev fleet open` 則另外為 interactive login shell 配置 PTY（`-t`）。
837
838	 若該次嘗試因 "permission denied" 被拒絕，且該 host 設定了 `ssh_login_password_source`，`dev` 會再重試一次、改用密碼驗證。密碼本身不會出現在 argv 或環境變數中：`dev` 會把自己重新以一次性的 `SSH_ASKPASS` helper 執行，密碼透過一個繼承的 file descriptor 交給那個 helper。`prompt` 會在執行當下從 `/dev/tty` 讀取隱藏輸入；`plain` 與 `bitwarden` 則分別從設定檔或 `bw get password <item>` 取得。
839
840	 在遠端那一側，預設的 `dev_path = "auto"` 會搜尋常見安裝位置（`~/.local/bin`、`~/go/bin`、mise shims、Homebrew/Linuxbrew、`/usr/local/bin`、`/snap/bin`）再查 `PATH`，找不到 `dev` 就以 `127` 結束；明確指定絕對路徑的 `dev_path` 則會跳過搜尋，直接 exec 該路徑。
841
842	 ## 哪些是 cache、哪些是 durable
843
844	 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` 是 durable、由使用者撰寫的設定，與 `config.toml` 地位相同——由 `dev fleet config init`/`edit` 管理，不會被自動重新產生。
845
846	-每次成功探測都會在 `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json` 寫入該 host 的 JSON snapshot。這份 cache 是可拋棄的加速機制，不是 durable data：它會依 host 的連線欄位與 timeout 產生一個「endpoint ID」指紋，因此修改 host 的 `ssh_alias`、`hostname`、`user`、`identity_file`、`dev_path` 或 timeout，下次 `dev` 讀取時會自動讓舊 cache 失效。`dev cache list` 會顯示它的路徑、大小與存在時間；`dev cache clear fleet`（或 `dev cache clear all`）可直接移除它。沒有需要手動「重建」的步驟——下一次 `dev fleet list`、`dev fleet status` 或 TUI 的 FLEET reload 就會用一次新的探測重新產生它。
847	+每次成功探測都會在 `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json` 寫入該 host 的 JSON snapshot。這份 cache 是可拋棄的加速機制，不是 durable data：它會依 host 的連線欄位與 timeout 產生一個「endpoint ID」指紋，因此修改 host 的 `machine_id`、`ssh_alias`、`hostname`、`user`、`identity_file`、`dev_path` 或 timeout，下次 `dev` 讀取時會自動讓舊 cache 失效。`dev cache list` 會顯示它的路徑、大小與存在時間；`dev cache clear fleet`（或 `dev cache clear all`）可直接移除它。沒有需要手動「重建」的步驟——下一次 `dev fleet list`、`dev fleet status` 或 TUI 的 FLEET reload 就會用一次新的探測重新產生它。
848
849	 這份 cache 存在的目的，是讓 unreachable、timeout、incompatible 或 invalid-response 的 host 仍能回報上一次已知的狀態（標記為 `stale`，並設定 `FromCache`），而不是直接從清單消失；`--cached` 只會使用這份 cache，完全不連網路。每個 remote host 自己的 `config.toml`、task registry 與 repository path，在該 host 上仍是唯一權威來源——cache 只保存它們的 read-only snapshot。
850
851	 ## TUI 中的 FLEET
852
853	 FLEET 是 TUI 六個 view 之一（`TASKS`、`REPOS`、`FLEET`、`TRY`、`REMOTE`、`SKILLS`，用 `tab`/`h`/`l` 切換）。與 REMOTE 一樣採延遲載入——view 第一次開啟前不會抓取任何資料——但它會先用仍在 `defaults.cache_ttl` 期限內的 cached snapshot 填入畫面，讓初次顯示不是空的。`r` 會強制對所有已設定的 host 做一次 live reload。
854
855	 它的表格欄位是 `HOST`、`STATE`、`REPO`、`BRANCH`、`GIT`、`LIVE`、`TASKS`、`PATH`。`enter` 會開啟選取的 repository：local host 的列是一般的 local open；remote 的列則是，當該 host 的 snapshot 回報 `herdr` runtime，且該 host 透過 `ssh_alias` 連線、不需要密碼步驟時，優先使用原生 Herdr remoting，否則退回在該 repository 目錄下開啟 interactive SSH login shell。這個 view 中 Git 的變更是唯讀的——FLEET 是用來檢視與開啟工作，不是在原地編輯它。
856
857	 `e` 會用 `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` 開啟 `remotes.toml`——也就是這個 view 實際對應的檔案，而不是其他 view 中 `e` 所開啟的 dev 自身 `config.toml`。離開編輯器後，`dev` 會先重新解析該檔案才使用它。解析失敗、出現未知欄位，或含有明文密碼的檔案權限有問題時，都會被回報並保留原本的資料列，因此打錯字不會安靜地讓某台 host 從 fleet 中消失。檔案解析成功則會立即對所有已設定的 host 觸發一次 live reload。
858
859	 ## 優雅降級
860
861	 每個 host 都是獨立探測的，所以一個壞掉的 host 不會讓整個 fleet 失敗。每個 host 的狀態有 `ok`、`stale`（重用 cache，可能附帶說明原因的 error）、`no-dev`（remote 的 `PATH` 上沒有 `dev`——僅回報，不視為 error）、`unreachable`（SSH 本身失敗）、`timeout`、`incompatible`（remote 的 `dev` 版本過舊或無法辨識）與 `invalid-response`（snapshot JSON 格式不正確）。`ok` 與乾淨的 `no-dev` 不會讓 `--strict` 失敗；其餘狀態都會，包括帶有 error 的 `stale` 結果。
862
863	 另一方面，forge integration 是 optional：`gh` 與 `glab` 提供 GitHub/GitLab
864	 inventory、publishing 與 pull/merge request；`az` 提供 Azure DevOps inventory 與
865	 pull request。缺少 CLI 時，`dev doctor` 只回報 warning，local Git workflow 仍可用；
866	 但 explicit non-interactive publication request 會附 login/install 指引失敗，不會靜默
867	 改變操作意義。Azure DevOps inventory 還額外是 opt-in：未設定
868	 `forge.azure_devops` targets 前一律停用。
869

1068	 ### Best practices
1069
1070	 Source: https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/best-practices/
1071
1072	 > A concise checklist for safe Git, worktree, and coding-agent collaboration with dev-cli.
1073
1074	 Use this page as the short operating policy. Follow the links only when a decision needs more detail.
1075
1076	 ## The checklist
1077
1078	 1. **Start from a known base.** Fetch first and name the intended default-branch commit or base branch.
1079	 2. **Create one branch per independent change stream.** Keep unrelated changes and competing approaches separate.
1080	 3. **Choose worktrees by mutation boundary, not agent count.** Read-only researchers and writers with clearly disjoint files can share a checkout; overlapping or unknown mutation needs separate branches and worktrees.
1081	 4. **Use one integration owner.** Assign file ownership, dependency order, merge order, and the final test responsibility before parallel work starts.
1082	 5. **Provision from an allowlist.** Copy only explicitly listed files that Git confirms are ignored. Prefer reinstalling dependencies unless the ecosystem makes copying sound.
1083	-6. **Keep one writer per branch.** Across machines, push the branch and transfer ownership before another writer resumes it.
1084	-7. **Checkpoint before handoff.** Commit and push recoverable work, and record a concrete `--next` action. Use temporary `wip:` commits on a feature branch rather than stash for cross-machine work.
1085	-8. **Review the integrated result.** Worker-local tests are not enough; run the complete relevant suite after changes are combined.
1086	-9. **Clean up only recoverable state.** Do not remove dirty, untracked, unpushed, or locked worktrees. Removing a worktree must not silently delete its branch.
1087	-10. **Label the authority.** Keep Git semantics, current product behavior, experimental harness behavior, project policy, and historical advice visibly distinct.
1088	+6. **Authorize export separately.** A local worktree include is not off-machine permission. Use a separate portable-file allowlist, inspect the report, independently verify the target UUID, and never let `--yes` imply replacement.
1089	+7. **Keep one writer per branch.** Across machines, push the branch and transfer ownership before another writer resumes it.
1090	+8. **Checkpoint before handoff.** Commit and push recoverable work, and record a concrete `--next` action. Use temporary `wip:` commits on a feature branch rather than stash for cross-machine work.
1091	+9. **Review the integrated result.** Worker-local tests are not enough; run the complete relevant suite after changes are combined.
1092	+10. **Clean up only recoverable state.** Do not remove dirty, untracked, unpushed, or locked worktrees. Removing a worktree must not silently delete its branch.
1093	+11. **Label the authority.** Keep Git semantics, current product behavior, experimental harness behavior, project policy, and historical advice visibly distinct.
1094
1095	 ## Pick the smallest safe topology
1096
1097	 | Situation | Branches | Worktrees | Coordination |
1098	 |---|---:|---:|---|
1099	 | One small reversible change | 0 or 1 | current checkout | one writer |
1100	 | One feature, disjoint files | 1 | 1 | panes/subagents with explicit file owners |
1101	 | Research plus implementation | 1 | 1 | read-only researcher, one writer |
1102	 | Competing implementations | one per approach | one per approach | compare, keep one, remove the rest safely |
1103	 | Unknown or overlapping mutation | one per writer/stream | one per writer/stream | integration owner and ordered merges |
1104	 | Large repeatable analysis | as required by write boundaries | isolated where needed | Dynamic Workflow plus verification stages |
1105
1106	 A worktree is not a coordination system. It prevents working-directory collisions; it does not assign ownership or isolate ports, databases, caches, hooks, shared refs, or deployment targets.

1131	 ### Remote repository fleet
1132
1133	 Source: https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/guides/remote-fleet/
1134
1135	-> Inventory repositories, tasks, and live runtime activity across SSH-reachable machines with dev fleet, and safely fast-forward a branch between them.
1136	+> Inventory repositories over SSH, pin remote machine identity, safely fast-forward branches, and explicitly transfer bounded ignored files with dev fleet.
1137
1138	 `dev fleet` fans out over SSH to other machines running their own `dev`, so you can see and open their repositories and safely propagate a branch, without merging their independent configuration into this machine's view.
1139
1140	 ## What a fleet is
1141
1142	-A remote fleet is a list of other hosts, each running its own `dev` binary against its own `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, its own scan roots, its own task registry, and its own runtime. `dev fleet` never centralizes or takes ownership of that state — it only asks each host's `dev` for a read-only snapshot over SSH and reports what comes back. A host with no `dev` installed, or an unreachable host, degrades that one row; it never blocks the rest of the fleet.
1143	+A remote fleet is a list of other hosts, each running its own `dev` binary against its own `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, its own scan roots, its own task registry, and its own runtime. Inventory stays decentralized: each host's `dev` produces its own read-only snapshot over SSH, and one unreachable host never blocks the remaining rows. Mutation is confined to separately named commands such as `fleet sync` and `fleet files --apply`; neither makes this machine authoritative for the target's paths, task registry, or runtime.
1144
1145	 This is a different concept from the REMOTE TUI view and publishing/PR flows,
1146	 which use `gh` or `glab` for GitHub/GitLab repository publication and PRs, plus
1147	 the Azure CLI for Azure DevOps inventory and PRs. Fleet talks to *your own
1148	 machines* about *your own local checkouts* on those machines.
1149
1150	 ## Configure hosts
1151
1152	 ```bash
1153	 dev fleet config init
1154	 dev fleet config edit
1155	 dev fleet config show
1156	 dev fleet config path
1157	 ```
1158
1159	 Hosts live in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` (override the path with the global `--remotes <path>` flag). `config init` writes a starter file (`--force` to overwrite, `--stdout` to print without writing); `config edit` opens it in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` (`--editor` overrides); `config show` prints the effective configuration with any plaintext password redacted; `config path` prints the resolved path.
1160
1161	 ```toml

1163
1164	 [defaults]
1165	 connect_timeout = "15s"
1166	 command_timeout = "5m"
1167	 cache_ttl = "15m"
1168	 max_parallel = 4
1169	 dev_path = "auto"
1170
1171	 [[hosts]]
1172	 name = "lab"
1173	 ssh_alias = "lab"
1174	+# Add only after `dev fleet machine-id lab` and independent verification.
1175	+machine_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
1176
1177	 [[hosts]]
1178	 name = "vps"
1179	 hostname = "203.0.113.10"
1180	 user = "dev"
1181	 port = 22
1182	 identity_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
1183	 ssh_login_password_source = { type = "bitwarden", item = "ssh-vps-login" }
1184	 ```

1186	-`schema_version = 1` is required. `[defaults]` supplies `connect_timeout`, `command_timeout`, `cache_ttl`, `max_parallel` (fan-out concurrency), and `dev_path` (`"auto"` searches `PATH`); each `[[hosts]]` entry inherits any of these it does not set explicitly. A host needs `name` plus either `ssh_alias` (preferred — it reuses `~/.ssh/config`'s `ProxyJump`, `IdentityAgent`, and host-key policy exactly like a plain `ssh` invocation) or `hostname` (optionally with `user`, `port`, `identity_file`). `ssh_login_password_source.type` is one of `none` (default), `prompt`, `plain` (inline `value`), or `bitwarden` (`item` looked up with the `bw` CLI). A config file with a `plain` password must be mode `0600`, or `dev fleet` refuses to load it.

1191	 ## `dev fleet` commands
1192
1193	 | Command | Flags | Purpose |
1194	 |---|---|---|
1195	 | `dev fleet list` | `--host <name>` (repeatable), `--repo <query>`, `--json`, `--cached`, `--strict` | List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts |
1196	 | `dev fleet status` | `--json`, `--strict` | Probe configured hosts and report snapshot health |
1197	+| `dev fleet machine-id <host>` | `--json` | Show the observed durable UUID and compare the configured pin |
1198	 | `dev fleet sync <repo>` | `--push`, `--remote <name>`, `--host <name>` (repeatable), `--json` | Push optionally, then safely fast-forward clean matching checkouts |
1199	+| `dev fleet files [repo-or-path]` | `--to <host>`, `--file <pattern>` (repeatable), `--apply`, `--replace`, `--yes`, `--json` | Plan or apply one-way transfer of explicit ignored files |
1200	 | `dev fleet open <host> <repo>` | — | Open a remote repository through Herdr or an SSH login shell |
1201	 | `dev fleet config init` | `-f`/`--force`, `--stdout` | Write a starter `remotes.toml` |
1202	 | `dev fleet config edit` | `--editor <cmd>` | Open `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` |
1203	 | `dev fleet config show` | — | Print the effective configuration (passwords redacted) |
1204	 | `dev fleet config path` | — | Print the resolved `remotes.toml` path |
1205
1206	 `--repo` on `list` filters by name, remote identity, branch, or path; `--cached` answers entirely from the last saved snapshot with no network activity; `--strict` turns an unreachable/timeout/incompatible/invalid host into a non-zero exit for both `list` and `status`. `sync <repo>` resolves `<repo>` locally like any other repository reference; without `--push` its `HEAD` must already equal the fetched upstream, and `--remote` picks which Git remote identifies the repository across hosts (default: the branch's upstream remote, then `origin`).
1207
1208	-`dev fleet` also registers four hidden commands (`_snapshot`, `_sync`, `_open-herdr`, `_shell`) that exist only to be invoked by `dev fleet` itself on the far end of an SSH connection — they are the wire protocol, not a user-facing surface.
1209	+## Explicit portable local files
1210	+
1211	+A repository may propose export candidates separately from worktree provisioning:
1212	+
1213	+```toml
1214	+# .dev-cli/config.toml
1215	+version = 1
1216	+
1217	+[local_files]
1218	+include = [".env", ".mcp/**"]
1219	+```
1220	+
1221	+`[worktree].include` is local provisioning policy and is never inherited here.
1222	+`[local_files].include` also grants no standing permission: an explicit invocation
1223	+must select exactly one target, and repeatable `--file` adds ad-hoc patterns for
1224	+that invocation only. Patterns expand on the source into sorted exact paths;
1225	+no glob crosses the wire.
1226	+
1227	+```bash
1228	+dev fleet files api --to lab                    # report only
1229	+dev fleet files api --to lab --apply --yes      # create absent target files
1230	+dev fleet files api --to lab --replace --apply  # authorize differing bytes separately
1231	+```
1232	+
1233	+The source and target must already resolve to one clone with the same normalized
1234	+**fetch** identity, attached branch, and exact commit. A push-only URL match is
1235	+insufficient. Both hosts independently prove every exact path is untracked and
1236	+ignored under their own Git configuration. Only regular files pass: no
1237	+symlinks/reparse points, directories, sockets, devices, FIFOs, `.git`, nested
1238	+repositories, or submodule boundaries. Compiled ceilings are 128 files,
1239	+8 MiB per file, 32 MiB total, with bounded path length/depth; host policy may
1240	+lower but never raise them.
1241	+
1242	+Plan is the default and sends no file body. Apply additionally requires the
1243	+configured `machine_id` to match the content-free capability probe. Missing files
1244	+are atomically created owner-only; identical files are no-ops; differing bytes
1245	+block unless `--replace` was present in the displayed plan. Replacement binds the
1246	+observed target digest/mode, retains a private rollback copy, revalidates both
1247	+roots, and rolls back file changes on failure. `--yes` only answers confirmation
1248	+and never implies replacement. Public human/JSON output contains path, size,
1249	+mode, and state—never content or hashes.
1250	+
1251	+The transaction journal is durable before manifest/payload staging, so an
1252	+interrupted request ID can resume or reconcile. Rollback intentionally leaves an
1253	+empty parent directory when its post-crash identity cannot be proven; deleting
1254	+another process's replacement would be worse. Native Windows payload transfer is
1255	+capability-blocked before content is sent.
1256	+
1257	+This command is not repository/task ownership transfer, clone acquisition,
1258	+provisioning, backup, restore, or eviction. It never switches a branch, copies
1259	+task/catalog/note state, watches for changes, propagates deletions, or removes the
1260	+source.
1261	+
1262	+`dev fleet` also registers bounded hidden capability/file commands in addition to
1263	+`_snapshot`, `_sync`, `_open-herdr`, and `_shell`. They exist only for the two
1264	+`dev` processes to invoke over SSH; they are wire protocols, not user-facing
1265	+surfaces.
1266
1267	 ## Transport and authentication
1268
1269	-Every fleet command reaches a host by shelling out to the system `ssh` binary with `ConnectTimeout`, `ServerAliveInterval=15`, and `ServerAliveCountMax=2`, and first attempts `BatchMode=yes` — key or agent authentication only, exactly like a script-friendly `ssh` call. `dev fleet open` additionally allocates a PTY (`-t`) for its interactive login shell.
1270	+Every fleet command reaches a host by shelling out to the system `ssh` binary with `ConnectTimeout`, `ServerAliveInterval=15`, and `ServerAliveCountMax=2`, and first attempts `BatchMode=yes` — key or agent authentication only, exactly like a script-friendly `ssh` call. Fixed protocols use non-PTY `-T` and disable agent, X11, local-command, and all port forwarding while retaining the user's normal host-key policy. `dev fleet open` separately allocates a PTY (`-t`) for its interactive login shell.
1271
1272	 If that attempt is rejected with "permission denied" and the host defines a `ssh_login_password_source`, `dev` retries once with password authentication. The password itself never touches argv or the environment: `dev` re-executes itself as a one-shot `SSH_ASKPASS` helper, and the secret is handed to that helper over an inherited file descriptor. `prompt` reads a hidden password from `/dev/tty` at run time; `plain` and `bitwarden` resolve it from the config file or from `bw get password <item>` respectively.
1273
1274	 On the remote side, `dev_path = "auto"` (the default) searches common install locations (`~/.local/bin`, `~/go/bin`, mise shims, Homebrew/Linuxbrew, `/usr/local/bin`, `/snap/bin`) and then `PATH`, exiting `127` if no `dev` is found; an explicit absolute `dev_path` skips that search and execs it directly.
1275
1276	 ## What's cached vs. durable
1277
1278	 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` is durable, user-authored configuration, on the same footing as `config.toml` — `dev fleet config init`/`edit` manage it, and nothing regenerates it automatically.
1279
1280	-Each successful probe writes a per-host JSON snapshot under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json`. That cache is a disposable accelerator, not durable data: it is fingerprinted with an "endpoint ID" derived from the host's connection fields and timeouts, so editing a host's `ssh_alias`, `hostname`, `user`, `identity_file`, `dev_path`, or timeouts automatically invalidates its old cache the next time `dev` reads it. `dev cache list` shows its path, size, and age; `dev cache clear fleet` (or `dev cache clear all`) removes it outright. There is nothing to "rebuild" explicitly — the next `dev fleet list`, `dev fleet status`, or TUI FLEET reload regenerates it from a fresh probe.
1281	+Each successful probe writes a per-host JSON snapshot under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json`. That cache is a disposable accelerator, not durable data: it is fingerprinted with an "endpoint ID" derived from the host's connection fields and timeouts, so editing a host's `machine_id`, `ssh_alias`, `hostname`, `user`, `identity_file`, `dev_path`, or timeouts automatically invalidates its old cache the next time `dev` reads it. `dev cache list` shows its path, size, and age; `dev cache clear fleet` (or `dev cache clear all`) removes it outright. There is nothing to "rebuild" explicitly — the next `dev fleet list`, `dev fleet status`, or TUI FLEET reload regenerates it from a fresh probe.
1282
1283	 The cache exists so an unreachable, timed-out, incompatible, or invalid-response host can still report its last known state (marked `stale`, with `FromCache` set) instead of vanishing from the listing; `--cached` uses only this cache and never touches the network. Each remote host's own `config.toml`, task registry, and repository paths remain authoritative on that host — the cache only ever holds a read-only snapshot of them.
1284
1285	 ## Fleet in the TUI
1286
1287	 FLEET is one of the TUI's six views (`TASKS`, `REPOS`, `FLEET`, `TRY`, `REMOTE`, `SKILLS`, switched with `tab`/`h`/`l`). Like REMOTE, it loads lazily — nothing is fetched until the view is first opened — but it seeds itself from any cached snapshots that are still within `defaults.cache_ttl` so the first render is not empty. `r` forces a live reload of every configured host.
1288
1289	 Its table shows `HOST`, `STATE`, `REPO`, `BRANCH`, `GIT`, `LIVE`, `TASKS`, and `PATH`. `enter` opens the selected repository: for a local host row this is an ordinary local open; for a remote row `dev` prefers native Herdr remoting when that host's snapshot reports the `herdr` runtime and the host connects through `ssh_alias` with no password step, and otherwise falls back to an interactive SSH login shell in the repository's directory. Git changes are read-only in this view — FLEET is for inspecting and opening work, not editing it in place.
1290
1291	 `e` opens `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` — the file this view is about, rather than dev's own `config.toml`, which `e` opens everywhere else. On leaving the editor `dev` reparses the file before using it. A parse failure, an unknown field, or a permissions problem on a file holding a plaintext password is reported and the previous rows are kept, so a typo cannot silently drop a host from the fleet. A file that parses triggers an immediate live reload of every configured host.
1292
1293	 ## Degrading gracefully
1294
1295	 Every host is probed independently, so one bad host never fails the fleet as a whole. Per-host states are `ok`, `stale` (cache reused, optionally with an error explaining why), `no-dev` (the remote has no `dev` on its `PATH` — reported, not an error), `unreachable` (SSH itself failed), `timeout`, `incompatible` (an old or unrecognized remote `dev`), and `invalid-response` (malformed snapshot JSON). `ok` and a clean `no-dev` never fail `--strict`; every other state does, including a `stale` result that carries an error.
1296
1297	 Separately, forge integration is optional: `gh` and `glab` enable GitHub/GitLab
1298	 inventory, publication, and pull/merge requests, while `az` enables Azure
1299	 DevOps inventory and pull requests. `dev doctor` reports missing CLIs as
1300	 warnings. Local Git workflows remain available, but an explicit non-interactive
1301	 publication request fails with login/install guidance instead of silently
1302	 changing its meaning. Azure DevOps inventory is additionally opt-in and stays
1303	 disabled until `forge.azure_devops` targets are configured.

1754	 | rich grouped runtime and agent activity | Herdr server + CLI | `auto` tries tmux, then Zellij, then none |
1755	 | named terminal session | tmux or compatible Zellij | `none` preserves core behavior and shell navigation |
1756	 | GitHub pull requests/remotes | `gh` authenticated | branch still pushes when Git works; browser/manual flow may be needed |

1760	 | setup-capable project skills | skills provider plus the entrypoint interpreter | unselected skills are skipped; selected required setup fails before scaffold mutation when its interpreter is unavailable; a clone acquired first is retained |
1761	 | staged lazygit message prefill | a lazygit version that reads `LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT` | files remain staged and dev prints the suggested message; normal Git commit remains available |
1762	 | worktree dependency setup | ecosystem manager (`uv`, npm, Cargo, etc.) | plan reports the missing tool and keeps the checkout |
1763	+| remote portable-file plan/apply | Git, SSH target running a compatible `dev`, matching existing clone/branch/commit; apply also needs a verified machine UUID pin | fails before content is sent or leaves the target unchanged; no clone/task fallback is inferred |
1764	 | interactive dashboard | terminal input/output | bare `dev` prints the plain task list when piped |
1765	 | repository-note search | linked `modernc.org/sqlite` with FTS5 | no external `sqlite3` executable is required |
1766	 | terminal multiplexing on Windows | tmux/Zellij/Herdr (POSIX only) | Windows always uses the `none` backend; `dev shell-init powershell` still moves the shell |

1769	 ## Confirmed project limitations
1770
1771	 ### Note search and filesystem durability vary by text and platform
1772
1773	 Latin note queries use term-wise prefix FTS and SQLite ranking. Non-ASCII queries use literal term-wise substring matching because SQLite's `unicode61` tokenizer does not segment arbitrary CJK substrings; those results do not use the same FTS ranking.
1774
1775	 Note writes sync the file and atomically rename it on every supported platform. Unix also syncs the containing directory after rename/delete. The Windows implementation cannot provide that directory-fsync step, so a sudden power loss has a narrower durability guarantee there. Concurrent mutations by cooperating `dev` processes are serialized and each Markdown replacement is atomic; arbitrary external writers do not participate in that lock.
1776
1777	 ### Pull-request completion is not tracked automatically
1778
1779	 `dev done --pr` pushes and opens a pull/merge request, then leaves the task, runtime, and worktree unchanged because review owns integration. Current `dev sweep` does not query the forge to infer that a request later merged. Verify integration and finish/reconcile deliberately; do not assume remote merge implies local DONE.
1780
1781	 ### Agent session capture is reserved, not wired
1782
1783	 The task schema has an `AgentSession` field and Herdr inventory can expose live agent session IDs. The production start/park/resume path does not yet capture or attach that ID. Treat the field and live inventory as observability/future integration, not a promise that `dev resume` restores the coding-agent conversation.

1805	+### Portable files are not project transfer or backup
1806	+
1807	+`dev fleet files` moves only explicitly selected, bounded files that both hosts prove are untracked and ignored. Private transaction staging is not a user-facing backup/restore promise.

1811	 ### Windows is a build target, not a full-feature platform
1812
1813	 `dev` compiles and runs on `windows/amd64` and `windows/arm64`, and every release ships a `.zip` for each. Core repository, task and worktree operations work. What differs:
1814
1815	 - There is no tmux, Zellij or Herdr, so the runtime backend is always `none`. Grouped runtime/agent activity and named sessions are unavailable; the `cd` directive and PowerShell wrapper still work.
1816	 - Shell integration is `dev shell-init powershell`. POSIX shells hand the directory back on file descriptor 3; PowerShell cannot inherit it, so the wrapper passes a temp-file path in `DEV_SHELL_CD_FILE` instead.
1817	 - `dev fleet open` starts a child shell (`%COMSPEC%`) rather than replacing the process, because Windows has no `exec(2)`.
1818	+- `dev fleet machine-id` can perform its content-free probe, but native `fleet files` payload apply is capability-blocked before content is sent.
1819	 - The domain test suites still assume a POSIX filesystem in places, so Windows CI runs the tests advisory-only while compilation, `go vet` and the build are enforced.
1820
1821	 ### Direct mode has a smaller lifecycle
1822
1823	 A direct task uses the canonical checkout and cannot go COLD, because cold cleanup would remove a directory the repository needs. Use branch-only or worktree mode for cross-machine reconstruction.

1827	 These were historical gaps and should not be reintroduced as limitations:

1829	 - `dev repo new|create`, `repo clone`, and `repo setup` share a preset-driven bootstrap pipeline. A plain explicit `repo new NAME` remains minimal, while a clear Git URL, local Git path, or owner/name routes through clone acquisition and preserves source history/remote. The no-argument wizard detects the same reference in its first field; for a new repository, a default-no customization gate keeps the normal `agent-ready` flow concise. Text fields use a TTY inline editor, so cursor keys edit rather than inserting raw escape bytes; non-TTY readers retain line-oriented behavior.
1830	 - `repo new` can snapshot a local directory/repository or Git source at an optional branch, tag, or commit and confined subdirectory into a fresh history. An unpinned local Git tree includes tracked plus untracked non-ignored files; a non-Git directory includes its full current tree. Source `.git` metadata is excluded, URL userinfo is redacted, unsafe file types/paths fail before destination creation, and held root/file handles confine mutable-path races. Human plans preview paths and warn when the snapshot is live; presets can select catalog-repository subfolders.
1831	 - Repository setup supports `--check-in=commit|stage|none` (`auto` for preset compatibility). Staged setup runs before-commit setup and `git add -A` without an `after_commit` phase, cannot publish or hand off to `start`, and may prefill lazygit lowercase `c` as described above.

1833	 - Project `.dev-cli/config.toml` and `.dev-cli/scaffolds.toml` are constrained to portable setup policy. Executable project configuration is keyed to the canonical Git common directory and an exact content hash; a changed hash is untrusted until approved again.

1842	 - `dev done` opens an interactive finish wizard on a TTY when `--ff`/`--pr` are both omitted, analyzing a dirty checkout against the base (commit, discard, or cancel) instead of rejecting any uncommitted change outright; a non-interactive caller still passes an explicit `--dirty` policy and `--yes` for a destructive discard.

1958	 ## Checklist
1959
1960	 1. **從已知 base 開始。** 先 fetch，並明確指出預期的 default-branch commit 或 base branch。
1961	 2. **每條獨立變更流 (change stream) 建立一個 branch。** 不相關改動和互斥方案要分開。
1962	 3. **依變動邊界 (mutation boundary) 決定 worktree，不要依 agent 數量。** Read-only researcher 與檔案範圍明確分離的 writer 可以共用 checkout；重疊或未知範圍則要分 branch 與 worktree。
1963	 4. **指定唯一 integration owner。** 平行工作開始前，先分配 file ownership、dependency order、merge order 與最後測試責任。
1964	 5. **只從 allowlist 佈建。** 只複製明確列出且 Git 確認為 ignored 的檔案；除非 ecosystem 證明 copy 安全，否則重新安裝 dependencies。
1965	-6. **每個 branch 同時只有一位 writer。** 跨機器時先 push branch 並移交 ownership，另一位 writer 才 resume。
1966	-7. **Handoff 前建立 checkpoint。** Commit、push 可復原工作並留下具體 `--next`；跨機器工作優先使用 feature branch 上的暫時 `wip:` commit，不要用 stash。
1967	-8. **檢查整合後的結果。** 每個 worker 的局部測試不夠；組合所有變更後要跑完整相關 suite。
1968	-9. **只有可復原時才清理。** Dirty、untracked、unpushed 或 locked worktree 都不能移除；移除 worktree 不得偷偷刪 branch。
1969	-10. **標明 authority。** Git 語義、現行產品行為、experimental harness 行為、project policy 與歷史建議必須分開。
1970	+6. **分開授權 export。** Local worktree include 不代表 off-machine permission。使用獨立 portable-file allowlist、先看 report、透過獨立管道驗證 target UUID，且不能讓 `--yes` 隱含 replacement。
1971	+7. **每個 branch 同時只有一位 writer。** 跨機器時先 push branch 並移交 ownership，另一位 writer 才 resume。
1972	+8. **Handoff 前建立 checkpoint。** Commit、push 可復原工作並留下具體 `--next`；跨機器工作優先使用 feature branch 上的暫時 `wip:` commit，不要用 stash。
1973	+9. **檢查整合後的結果。** 每個 worker 的局部測試不夠；組合所有變更後要跑完整相關 suite。
1974	+10. **只有可復原時才清理。** Dirty、untracked、unpushed 或 locked worktree 都不能移除；移除 worktree 不得偷偷刪 branch。
1975	+11. **標明 authority。** Git 語義、現行產品行為、experimental harness 行為、project policy 與歷史建議必須分開。

1977	 ## 選擇最小且安全的 topology
1978
1979	 | 情境 | Branch | Worktree | 協調方式 |
1980	 |---|---:|---:|---|
1981	 | 一個小型可逆變更 | 0 或 1 | 目前 checkout | 一位 writer |
1982	 | 同一 feature、檔案互不重疊 | 1 | 1 | pane/subagent 加明確 file owner |
1983	 | Research 加 implementation | 1 | 1 | read-only researcher、一位 writer |
1984	 | 互斥實作方案 | 每方案一個 | 每方案一個 | 比較後留一個，其餘安全移除 |
1985	 | 未知或重疊寫入 | 每位 writer／stream 一個 | 每位 writer／stream 一個 | integration owner 與有順序的 merges |
1986	 | 大型可重跑分析 | 依寫入邊界決定 | 必要處隔離 | Dynamic Workflow 加 verification stage |

2025	 ## Fleet 是什麼
2026
2027	-Remote fleet 是一份其他 host 的清單，每個 host 都執行自己的 `dev` binary，使用自己的 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`、自己的 scan roots、自己的 task registry 與自己的 runtime。`dev fleet` 從不集中管理或取得那份 state 的 ownership，它只會透過 SSH 向每個 host 的 `dev` 要一份 read-only snapshot，並回報收到的結果。沒有安裝 `dev` 的 host，或無法連線的 host，只會讓那一列 degrade；不會擋住 fleet 其餘部分。
2028	+Remote fleet 是一份其他 host 的清單，每個 host 都執行自己的 `dev` binary，使用自己的 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`、自己的 scan roots、自己的 task registry 與自己的 runtime。Inventory 維持 decentralized：每個 host 的 `dev` 透過 SSH 產生自己的 read-only snapshot，一個 unreachable host 不會擋住其他 rows。Mutation 只存在於分開命名的 commands，例如 `fleet sync` 與 `fleet files --apply`；兩者都不會讓這台機器成為 target paths、task registry 或 runtime 的 authority。
2029
2030	 這與 REMOTE TUI view 及 publishing/PR flow 是不同概念——GitHub/GitLab
2031	 repository publishing 與 PR 使用 `gh` 或 `glab`，Azure DevOps inventory 與 PR
2032	 則使用 Azure CLI。Fleet 溝通的對象是*你自己的機器*上*你自己的 local
2033	 checkout*。

2035	 ## 設定 hosts
2036
2037	 ```bash
2038	 dev fleet config init
2039	 dev fleet config edit
2040	 dev fleet config show
2041	 dev fleet config path
2042	 ```
2043
2044	 Host 設定放在 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml`（可用全域 `--remotes <path>` flag 覆寫路徑）。`config init` 會寫入一份 starter file（`--force` 覆寫既有檔案、`--stdout` 只印出不寫入）；`config edit` 會用 `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` 開啟它（`--editor` 可覆寫）；`config show` 印出目前生效的設定，明文密碼會被遮蔽；`config path` 印出解析後的路徑。
2045
2046	 ```toml
2047	 schema_version = 1
2048
2049	 [defaults]
2050	 connect_timeout = "15s"
2051	 command_timeout = "5m"
2052	 cache_ttl = "15m"
2053	 max_parallel = 4
2054	 dev_path = "auto"
2055
2056	 [[hosts]]
2057	 name = "lab"
2058	 ssh_alias = "lab"
2059	+# 執行 dev fleet machine-id lab 並透過獨立管道驗證後才加入：
2060	+machine_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
2061
2062	 [[hosts]]
2063	 name = "vps"
2064	 hostname = "203.0.113.10"
2065	 user = "dev"
2066	 port = 22
2067	 identity_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
2068	 ssh_login_password_source = { type = "bitwarden", item = "ssh-vps-login" }
2069	 ```
2070
2071	-`schema_version = 1` 為必填。`[defaults]` 提供 `connect_timeout`、`command_timeout`、`cache_ttl`、`max_parallel`（fan-out 並行度）與 `dev_path`（`"auto"` 會搜尋 `PATH`）；每個 `[[hosts]]` 項目未明確設定的欄位都會沿用這些預設值。一個 host 需要 `name`，並搭配 `ssh_alias`（優先——它會沿用 `~/.ssh/config` 的 `ProxyJump`、`IdentityAgent` 與 host-key policy，行為與單純的 `ssh` 呼叫完全一致）或 `hostname`（可搭配 `user`、`port`、`identity_file`）其中之一。`ssh_login_password_source.type` 可為 `none`（預設）、`prompt`、`plain`（內嵌 `value`）或 `bitwarden`（用 `item` 透過 `bw` CLI 查詢）。設定檔若含 `plain` 密碼，檔案權限必須是 `0600`，否則 `dev fleet` 會拒絕載入。
2072	+`schema_version = 1` 為必填。`[defaults]` 提供 `connect_timeout`、`command_timeout`、`cache_ttl`、`max_parallel`（fan-out 並行度）與 `dev_path`（`"auto"` 會搜尋 `PATH`）；每個 `[[hosts]]` 項目未明確設定的欄位都會沿用這些預設值。一個 host 需要 `name`，並搭配 `ssh_alias`（優先——它會沿用 `~/.ssh/config` 的 `ProxyJump`、`IdentityAgent` 與 host-key policy，行為與單純的 `ssh` 呼叫完全一致）或 `hostname`（可搭配 `user`、`port`、`identity_file`）其中之一。Optional `machine_id` 是 durable UUID pin：read-only inventory 可在未設定時警告或繼續，但 mutating portable-file apply 必須 exact match。`ssh_login_password_source.type` 可為 `none`（預設）、`prompt`、`plain`（內嵌 `value`）或 `bitwarden`（用 `item` 透過 `bw` CLI 查詢）。設定檔若含 `plain` 密碼，檔案權限必須是 `0600`，否則 `dev fleet` 會拒絕載入。

2076	 ## `dev fleet` 指令
2077
2078	 | Command | Flags | Purpose |
2079	 |---|---|---|
2080	 | `dev fleet list` | `--host <name>`（可重複）、`--repo <query>`、`--json`、`--cached`、`--strict` | List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts |
2081	 | `dev fleet status` | `--json`、`--strict` | Probe configured hosts and report snapshot health |
2082	+| `dev fleet machine-id <host>` | `--json` | 顯示 observed durable UUID 並比較 configured pin |
2083	 | `dev fleet sync <repo>` | `--push`、`--remote <name>`、`--host <name>`（可重複）、`--json` | Push optionally, then safely fast-forward clean matching checkouts |
2084	+| `dev fleet files [repo-or-path]` | `--to <host>`、`--file <pattern>`（可重複）、`--apply`、`--replace`、`--yes`、`--json` | Plan 或 apply 明確 ignored files 的 one-way transfer |
2085	 | `dev fleet open <host> <repo>` | — | Open a remote repository through Herdr or an SSH login shell |
2086	 | `dev fleet config init` | `-f`/`--force`、`--stdout` | Write a starter `remotes.toml` |
2087	 | `dev fleet config edit` | `--editor <cmd>` | Open `remotes.toml` in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` |
2088	 | `dev fleet config show` | — | Print the effective configuration (passwords redacted) |
2089	 | `dev fleet config path` | — | Print the resolved `remotes.toml` path |
2090
2091	 `list` 的 `--repo` 會依 name、remote identity、branch 或 path 過濾；`--cached` 完全依最後一次儲存的 snapshot 回答，不會有任何 network activity；`--strict` 會讓 `list` 與 `status` 在 host 為 unreachable/timeout/incompatible/invalid 時回傳非零結果。`sync <repo>` 對 `<repo>` 的解析方式與其他 repository reference 相同；沒有 `--push` 時，其 `HEAD` 必須已等於 fetch 後的 upstream；`--remote` 決定用哪個 Git remote 在各 host 間識別這個 repository（預設：branch 的 upstream remote，其次是 `origin`）。
2092
2093	-`dev fleet` 還註冊了四個 hidden command（`_snapshot`、`_sync`、`_open-herdr`、`_shell`），它們的存在只是為了讓 `dev fleet` 在 SSH 連線的另一端自行呼叫——這是 wire protocol，不是給使用者直接使用的介面。
2094	+## 明確 portable local files
2095	+
2096	+Repository 可用與 worktree provisioning 分離的設定提出 export candidates：
2097	+
2098	+```toml
2099	+# .dev-cli/config.toml
2100	+version = 1
2101	+
2102	+[local_files]
2103	+include = [".env", ".mcp/**"]
2104	+```
2105	+
2106	+`[worktree].include` 是 local provisioning policy，絕不會被這裡繼承。
2107	+`[local_files].include` 也不代表 standing permission：每次都必須用 explicit invocation
2108	+選擇恰好一個 target，repeatable `--file` 只為該次 invocation 加入 ad-hoc pattern。
2109	+Patterns 會在 source 展開成 sorted exact paths；wire 上不傳 glob。
2110	+
2111	+```bash
2112	+dev fleet files api --to lab                    # 只產生 report
2113	+dev fleet files api --to lab --apply --yes      # 建立 target 不存在的 files
2114	+dev fleet files api --to lab --replace --apply  # 分開授權不同 bytes
2115	+```
2116	+
2117	+Source 與 target 必須已解析到一個具有相同 normalized **fetch** identity、attached
2118	+branch 與 exact commit 的 clone；只有 push URL 相同不足以授權。兩端依自己的 Git
2119	+configuration 分別證明每個 exact path 都是 untracked 且 ignored。只有 regular files
2120	+可通過：不接受 symlink/reparse point、directory、socket、device、FIFO、`.git`、nested
2121	+repository 或 submodule boundary。Compiled ceilings 是 128 files、每個 8 MiB、合計
2122	+32 MiB，且 path length/depth 有界；host policy 只能調低，不能提高。
2123	+
2124	+預設 plan，不送 file body。Apply 另外要求 configured `machine_id` 與 content-free
2125	+capability probe 一致。Target 不存在時以 owner-only mode atomic create；內容相同是
2126	+no-op；內容不同預設 blocked，只有 displayed plan 明確帶 `--replace` 才可取代。
2127	+Replacement 綁定 observed target digest/mode、保留 private rollback copy、重驗兩端
2128	+roots，失敗時 rollback file changes。`--yes` 只回答 confirmation，絕不隱含
2129	+replacement。Public human/JSON output 只有 path、size、mode 與 state，不含 content
2130	+或 hash。
2131	+
2132	+Transaction journal 會先於 manifest/payload staging durable，因此 interrupted request ID
2133	+可 resume 或 reconcile。Rollback 在 crash 後無法證明空 parent directory identity 時會
2134	+刻意保留它；刪到其他 process 的 replacement 更糟。Native Windows payload transfer
2135	+會在 content 傳送前被 capability-block。
2136	+
2137	+這個 command 不是 repository/task ownership transfer、clone acquisition、provisioning、
2138	+backup、restore 或 eviction；它不會 switch branch、複製 task/catalog/note state、監看
2139	+變更、傳播 deletion，或移除 source。
2140	+
2141	+`dev fleet` 除了 `_snapshot`、`_sync`、`_open-herdr` 與 `_shell`，也註冊 bounded hidden
2142	+capability/file commands。它們只供兩端 `dev` 透過 SSH 互相呼叫，是 wire protocols，
2143	+不是 user-facing surface。

2145	 ## Transport 與認證
2146
2147	-每個 fleet command 都透過呼叫系統的 `ssh` binary 連到 host，帶上 `ConnectTimeout`、`ServerAliveInterval=15`、`ServerAliveCountMax=2`，並且第一次嘗試一律用 `BatchMode=yes`——只用 key 或 agent authentication，行為就像一次適合腳本化的 `ssh` 呼叫。`dev fleet open` 另外會為它的 interactive login shell 配置 PTY（`-t`）。
2148	+每個 fleet command 都透過呼叫系統的 `ssh` binary 連到 host，帶上 `ConnectTimeout`、`ServerAliveInterval=15`、`ServerAliveCountMax=2`，並且第一次嘗試一律用 `BatchMode=yes`——只用 key 或 agent authentication，行為就像一次適合腳本化的 `ssh` 呼叫。Fixed protocols 使用 non-PTY `-T`，並停用 agent、X11、local-command 與所有 port forwarding，同時保留使用者原本的 host-key policy。`dev fleet open` 則另外為 interactive login shell 配置 PTY（`-t`）。
2149
2150	 若該次嘗試因 "permission denied" 被拒絕，且該 host 設定了 `ssh_login_password_source`，`dev` 會再重試一次、改用密碼驗證。密碼本身不會出現在 argv 或環境變數中：`dev` 會把自己重新以一次性的 `SSH_ASKPASS` helper 執行，密碼透過一個繼承的 file descriptor 交給那個 helper。`prompt` 會在執行當下從 `/dev/tty` 讀取隱藏輸入；`plain` 與 `bitwarden` 則分別從設定檔或 `bw get password <item>` 取得。
2151
2152	 在遠端那一側，預設的 `dev_path = "auto"` 會搜尋常見安裝位置（`~/.local/bin`、`~/go/bin`、mise shims、Homebrew/Linuxbrew、`/usr/local/bin`、`/snap/bin`）再查 `PATH`，找不到 `dev` 就以 `127` 結束；明確指定絕對路徑的 `dev_path` 則會跳過搜尋，直接 exec 該路徑。
2153
2154	 ## 哪些是 cache、哪些是 durable
2155
2156	 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/remotes.toml` 是 durable、由使用者撰寫的設定，與 `config.toml` 地位相同——由 `dev fleet config init`/`edit` 管理，不會被自動重新產生。
2157
2158	-每次成功探測都會在 `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json` 寫入該 host 的 JSON snapshot。這份 cache 是可拋棄的加速機制，不是 durable data：它會依 host 的連線欄位與 timeout 產生一個「endpoint ID」指紋，因此修改 host 的 `ssh_alias`、`hostname`、`user`、`identity_file`、`dev_path` 或 timeout，下次 `dev` 讀取時會自動讓舊 cache 失效。`dev cache list` 會顯示它的路徑、大小與存在時間；`dev cache clear fleet`（或 `dev cache clear all`）可直接移除它。沒有需要手動「重建」的步驟——下一次 `dev fleet list`、`dev fleet status` 或 TUI 的 FLEET reload 就會用一次新的探測重新產生它。
2159	+每次成功探測都會在 `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/fleet/v1/<host-name-slug>.json` 寫入該 host 的 JSON snapshot。這份 cache 是可拋棄的加速機制，不是 durable data：它會依 host 的連線欄位與 timeout 產生一個「endpoint ID」指紋，因此修改 host 的 `machine_id`、`ssh_alias`、`hostname`、`user`、`identity_file`、`dev_path` 或 timeout，下次 `dev` 讀取時會自動讓舊 cache 失效。`dev cache list` 會顯示它的路徑、大小與存在時間；`dev cache clear fleet`（或 `dev cache clear all`）可直接移除它。沒有需要手動「重建」的步驟——下一次 `dev fleet list`、`dev fleet status` 或 TUI 的 FLEET reload 就會用一次新的探測重新產生它。
2160
2161	 這份 cache 存在的目的，是讓 unreachable、timeout、incompatible 或 invalid-response 的 host 仍能回報上一次已知的狀態（標記為 `stale`，並設定 `FromCache`），而不是直接從清單消失；`--cached` 只會使用這份 cache，完全不連網路。每個 remote host 自己的 `config.toml`、task registry 與 repository path，在該 host 上仍是唯一權威來源——cache 只保存它們的 read-only snapshot。
2162
2163	 ## TUI 中的 FLEET
2164
2165	 FLEET 是 TUI 六個 view 之一（`TASKS`、`REPOS`、`FLEET`、`TRY`、`REMOTE`、`SKILLS`，用 `tab`/`h`/`l` 切換）。與 REMOTE 一樣採延遲載入——view 第一次開啟前不會抓取任何資料——但它會先用仍在 `defaults.cache_ttl` 期限內的 cached snapshot 填入畫面，讓初次顯示不是空的。`r` 會強制對所有已設定的 host 做一次 live reload。
2166
2167	 它的表格欄位是 `HOST`、`STATE`、`REPO`、`BRANCH`、`GIT`、`LIVE`、`TASKS`、`PATH`。`enter` 會開啟選取的 repository：local host 的列是一般的 local open；remote 的列則是，當該 host 的 snapshot 回報 `herdr` runtime，且該 host 透過 `ssh_alias` 連線、不需要密碼步驟時，優先使用原生 Herdr remoting，否則退回在該 repository 目錄下開啟 interactive SSH login shell。這個 view 中 Git 的變更是唯讀的——FLEET 是用來檢視與開啟工作，不是在原地編輯它。
2168
2169	 `e` 會用 `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR` 開啟 `remotes.toml`——也就是這個 view 實際對應的檔案，而不是其他 view 中 `e` 所開啟的 dev 自身 `config.toml`。離開編輯器後，`dev` 會先重新解析該檔案才使用它。解析失敗、出現未知欄位，或含有明文密碼的檔案權限有問題時，都會被回報並保留原本的資料列，因此打錯字不會安靜地讓某台 host 從 fleet 中消失。檔案解析成功則會立即對所有已設定的 host 觸發一次 live reload。
2170
2171	 ## 優雅降級
2172
2173	 每個 host 都是獨立探測的，所以一個壞掉的 host 不會讓整個 fleet 失敗。每個 host 的狀態有 `ok`、`stale`（重用 cache，可能附帶說明原因的 error）、`no-dev`（remote 的 `PATH` 上沒有 `dev`——僅回報，不視為 error）、`unreachable`（SSH 本身失敗）、`timeout`、`incompatible`（remote 的 `dev` 版本過舊或無法辨識）與 `invalid-response`（snapshot JSON 格式不正確）。`ok` 與乾淨的 `no-dev` 不會讓 `--strict` 失敗；其餘狀態都會，包括帶有 error 的 `stale` 結果。
2174
2175	 另一方面，forge integration 是 optional：`gh` 與 `glab` 提供 GitHub/GitLab
2176	 inventory、publishing 與 pull/merge request；`az` 提供 Azure DevOps inventory 與
2177	 pull request。缺少 CLI 時，`dev doctor` 只回報 warning，local Git workflow 仍可用；
2178	 但 explicit non-interactive publication request 會附 login/install 指引失敗，不會靜默
2179	 改變操作意義。Azure DevOps inventory 還額外是 opt-in：未設定
2180	 `forge.azure_devops` targets 前一律停用。

2625	 ## dev-cli capability matrix
2626
2627	 | Capability | Dependency | 缺少時 |
2628	 |---|---|---|
2629	 | 核心 repository/task/worktree 操作 | Git | 無法使用；Git 是唯一 hard runtime dependency |
2630	 | grouped runtime 與 agent activity | Herdr server + CLI | `auto` 改試 tmux、Zellij，最後 none |
2631	 | named terminal session | tmux 或相容 Zellij | `none` 保留核心 behavior 與 shell navigation |
2632	 | GitHub pull requests/remotes | authenticated `gh` | Git 可用時 branch 仍能 push，可能需 browser/manual flow |
2633	 | GitLab merge requests/remotes | authenticated `glab` | 同樣 graceful fallback |
2634	 | repository bootstrap publishing | authenticated `gh` 或 `glab` | local repository/scaffold 仍可使用；wizard 會說明如何 login |
2635	 | remote repository snapshot template | Git，加上 source 所需的 network/authentication | validation 會在建立 destination 前失敗，rendered URL userinfo 會 redact；local template 仍可使用 |
2636	 | setup-capable project skills | skills provider 與 entrypoint interpreter | 未選取的 skill 會跳過；selected required setup 若缺少 interpreter，會在 scaffold mutation 前失敗；先取得的 clone 會保留 |
2637	 | staged lazygit message prefill | 會讀取 `LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT` 的 lazygit version | files 仍保持 staged，dev 會印出建議 message；一般 Git commit 仍可使用 |
2638	 | worktree dependency setup | ecosystem manager（`uv`、npm、Cargo 等） | plan 回報 missing tool 並保留 checkout |
2639	+| remote portable-file plan/apply | Git、執行相容 `dev` 的 SSH target、matching existing clone/branch/commit；apply 另需 verified machine UUID pin | content 傳送前失敗或保持 target 不變；不推斷 clone/task fallback |
2640	 | interactive dashboard | terminal input/output | 透過 pipe 執行 bare `dev` 時輸出 plain task list |
2641	 | repository-note search | linked `modernc.org/sqlite` 與 FTS5 | 不需要外部 `sqlite3` executable |
2642	 | Windows 上的 terminal multiplexing | tmux/Zellij/Herdr（僅 POSIX） | Windows 一律使用 `none` backend；`dev shell-init powershell` 仍能移動 shell |
2643	 | in-place self-update | standalone install（非 Homebrew/Scoop/`go install`） | `dev upgrade` 改為印出對應套件管理器的升級指令 |

2645	 ## 已確認的專案限制
2646
2647	 ### Note search 與 filesystem durability 依文字及平台而異
2648
2649	 Latin note query 使用 term-wise prefix FTS 與 SQLite ranking。Non-ASCII query 改用 literal term-wise substring matching，因為 SQLite 的 `unicode61` tokenizer 不會切分任意 CJK substrings；這些結果不使用相同的 FTS ranking。
2650
2651	 所有支援平台的 note write 都會 sync file 並 atomic rename。Unix 也會在 rename/delete 後 sync containing directory。Windows implementation 無法提供 directory-fsync 步驟，因此 sudden power loss 時的 durability guarantee 較窄。Cooperating `dev` processes 的 concurrent mutations 會被 serialized，且每次 Markdown replacement 都是 atomic；任意 external writer 不會參與這個 lock。
2652
2653	 ### Pull request completion 不會自動追蹤
2654
2655	 `dev done --pr` push 並建立 pull/merge request，之後保留 task、runtime 與 worktree，因為 integration 由 review 負責。目前 `dev sweep` 不會 query forge 推斷 request 後來已 merge。請驗證 integration 後再刻意 finish/reconcile；不能假設 remote merge 代表 local DONE。
2656
2657	 ### Agent session capture 只有保留欄位，尚未接線
2658
2659	 Task schema 有 `AgentSession`，Herdr inventory 也能顯示 live agent session ID；production start/park/resume path 尚未 capture 或 attach 該 ID。這個欄位與 live inventory 只能視為 observability/future integration，不能承諾 `dev resume` 會恢復 coding-agent conversation。
2660
2661	 ### Built-in forge cache TTL 與 generated config 不同
2662
2663	 `dev config init` 會寫 `forge.cache_ttl = "15m"`。沒有 config file 時，目前 built-in `Forge.CacheTTL` 的 zero value 代表既有 valid cache 不會因 age 被拒絕；explicit `r` 仍會 refresh。Freshness 重要時請執行 `config init` 或設定 TTL。
2664
2665	 較舊的 generated config 可能包含 `forge.remote_limit = 100`。此欄位仍可解析，
2666	 但 forge inventory 現在會完整 pagination，因此不再限制 synchronization。
2667	 `dev config init` 不再寫入它；`dev repo remote --limit` 只在完整 inventory 搜尋
2668	 完成後限制 rendered matches。
2669
2670	 ### Lazygit staged-message prefill 是 best effort
2671
2672	 `repo --check-in=stage` 會在正確的 worktree Git directory 寫入 pending message。
2673	 [Lazygit v0.59.0 的小寫 `c` 會使用該
2674	 檔案](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/blob/v0.59.0/pkg/gui/controllers/helpers/working_tree_helper.go#L191-L216)，但這是 lazygit implementation detail，不是 Git
2675	 interface；大寫 `C` 與一般 `git commit` 不會讀取它。Dev 不會覆寫內容不同的既有
2676	 draft。Draft write failure 只會產生 warning；staging 仍視為成功且不會 rollback。若
2677	 upstream integration 日後改變，staged index 與已印出的 message 仍是 recovery path。
2678
2679	+### Portable files 不是 project transfer 或 backup
2680	+
2681	+`dev fleet files` 只會傳送 explicit selected、bounded，且兩端都證明為 untracked 與 ignored 的 files。它不會取得 missing clone、轉移 task ownership/catalog/notes、執行 worktree provisioning、監看後續變更、傳播 deletion、移除 source bytes、建立 remote-backup receipt、驗證 restore，或授權 eviction。Private transaction staging 不是 user-facing backup/restore promise。
2682	+
2683	+Source 與 target 必須已依 fetch identity、attached branch 與 exact commit 相符；apply 另外需要 verified `machine_id` pin。Native Windows payload 在 ACL、reparse-point、held-root 與 atomic replacement guarantees 完成並測試前保持 disabled；machine identity diagnostics 仍是 content-free。
2684	+
2685	 ### Windows 是 build target，不是 full-feature 平台
2686
2687	 `dev` 可在 `windows/amd64` 與 `windows/arm64` 編譯並執行，每個 release 都會附各自的 `.zip`。核心的 repository、task 與 worktree 操作可用。差異：
2688
2689	 - 沒有 tmux、Zellij 或 Herdr，因此 runtime backend 一律是 `none`。Grouped runtime/agent activity 與 named session 無法使用；`cd` 指令與 PowerShell wrapper 仍可運作。
2690	 - Shell integration 是 `dev shell-init powershell`。POSIX shell 透過 file descriptor 3 回傳目錄；PowerShell 無法繼承它，wrapper 改用 `DEV_SHELL_CD_FILE` 傳入 temp-file path。
2691	 - `dev fleet open` 會啟動子 shell（`%COMSPEC%`），而非取代 process，因為 Windows 沒有 `exec(2)`。
2692	+- `dev fleet machine-id` 可執行 content-free probe，但 native `fleet files` payload apply 會在 content 傳送前被 capability-block。
2693	 - Domain test suites 仍有部分假設 POSIX filesystem，因此 Windows CI 的 test 僅供參考，compilation、`go vet` 與 build 則為強制項。
2694
2695	 ### Direct mode 的 lifecycle 較小
2696
2697	 Direct task 使用 canonical checkout，不能進入 COLD，因為 cold cleanup 會移除 repository 必需的 directory。需要跨機器 reconstruction 時使用 branch-only 或 worktree mode。
2698

2709	+- `dev fleet machine-id` 回報 observed UUID，不修改設定。`dev fleet files` 預設 report-only，使用獨立 `[local_files]` allowlist，在 content 前協商只能調低的 limits，並要求 explicit apply/replacement controls 與 matching target pin。
2710
2711	 - `dev start --focus` 會在 non-JSON creation 後 activate runtime。
2712	 - TUI navigation 會拒絕開啟 checkout 不存在的 COLD task，並要求使用 `dev resume`。
2713	 - Runtime handle 現在保存 backend provenance，cleanup 前會重新驗證。
2714	 - `auto` runtime selection 已在 tmux 與 none 之間加入 Zellij。
2715
2716	 - `dev done` 在省略 `--ff`/`--pr` 且為 TTY 時會開啟 interactive finish wizard，把 dirty checkout 拿去跟 base 比較（commit、discard 或 cancel），不再直接拒絕任何 uncommitted change；non-interactive caller 仍須明確傳入 `--dirty` policy，且 destructive discard 需要 `--yes`。
2717	 - Human-readable output 現在具備 semantic color（`--color auto|always|never`），在 `NO_COLOR` 已設定、`TERM=dumb`，或 stdout/stderr 不是 terminal 時會自動停用。
2718	 - `dev done` 只記錄 MERGED：它不會關閉呼叫端 runtime、移除 worktree 或刪除 branch。Cleanup 已移交 `dev retire`，後者必須從目標 workspace 之外執行，會拒絕 active agent 與 mixed-purpose workspace，並在每次關閉 runtime 之後重新驗證 Git state。`dev done --delete-branch` 現在會直接報錯並指向 `dev retire --delete-branch`，`--keep-worktree` 則以 no-op 警告。
2719	 - `dev sweep --merged-worktrees` 直接從 Git 列舉 linked worktrees，而非從 task registry，因此 branch 已被 base 包含的 unmanaged worktree 也能被 retire。Containment 本身絕不等於許可；dirty state、未 finalize 的 artifact、進行中的 Git operation 與 runtime 拒絕條件都仍會阻擋，且未加 `--delete-branches` 時 branch 一律保留。
2720	 - `dev sweep` 會把 branch 已不存在於 Git 的 branch-backed task 視為 dead，並提供 reap 該 record 的建議。這種 task 無法 finish、resume 或 retire，因為這些路徑都必須先解析 branch；在 `--apply` 之前該建議仍只是報告。
2721	 - 未知 command 會被回報，而不是被丟棄。`dev` 關閉了 cobra 自己的 error 輸出，先前又額外略過所有訊息開頭為 `unknown command` 的 error，因此打錯 command 時兩個 stream 都沒有任何輸出。現在會把訊息、cobra 的「Did you mean this?」建議，以及指向 `--help` 的提示寫到 stderr，exit status 為 1。
2722	 - 對 command family 傳入多餘的 argument 現在是 error，而不是安靜地印出 help。`dev wt bogus` 過去會印出 `dev wt` help 並 exit 0，因為 family 本身沒有 `Run`；現在每個 family node 都會回報未知 subcommand 並 exit 1，而單獨執行 family 仍會印出 help 並 exit 0。
2723	 - Argument 數量與 flag 錯誤會印出該 command 的 usage block。該 block 是否上色仍由 `--color` 決定。
2724	 - 每個 command family 的 help 都附上 ASCII orientation diagram 與 `See also: dev help <topic>` 指引，且 `dev help <command>` 會把 command 名稱或 alias 解析成對應 topic，因此 `dev help wt` 會連到 worktrees 頁面。
2725	 - Semantic color 已覆蓋所有 human-readable 介面，包含 interactive dashboard：`dev --color never`、`NO_COLOR` 與 `TERM=dumb` 現在也會關閉 dashboard 的顏色，先前並不會。
2726	 - `dev sweep` 會 reap repository 目錄已不存在的 task。這種 record 先前無法被 binary 中任何 command 觸及：`done`、`resume`、`park` 與 `retire` 都會先解析 repository，dead-branch 規則排除 direct mode，stale-worktree 規則又需要有記錄的 worktree path。若有 live runtime session 則不會提出此建議，且 reap 只移除 dev 的 intent record。
2727	 - `dev sweep` 會回報 task 記錄中存在、但 Git 未註冊，且只包含 agent artifact 目錄的 checkout。只有在其中每個檔案都與 repository 既有檔案 byte-identical 時才提議移除；其餘一律回報為 salvage 工作，即使加上 `--apply` 也絕不移除。
2728	 - `dev sweep` 會處理 worktree 仍在磁碟上的 cold task。Inventory 一直有為 `dev ls` 與 dashboard 計算這項 drift，但 sweep 從未讀取它，因此只能顯示、無法處理。
2729	 - `dev retire <path>` 會 reap 對應的 task record。先前只有 by-task 形式會設定 task identity，因此以 path 退休同一個 checkout 會留下 record；DONE 狀態與 identity 檢查維持不變。

2827	 ### Overview

2829	 - [dev-cli](https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/): Use dev-cli to keep Git change streams durable while worktrees, runtimes, and coding agents remain replaceable.
2830	 - [Getting started](https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/getting-started/): Install dev-cli, initialize a machine, and run one change stream from start through integration.

2835	 - [Isolation boundaries and glossary](https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/concepts/isolation-glossary/): Distinguish branches, worktrees, runtimes, agent contexts, tasks, and the shared state each leaves exposed.

2840	 - [Development journal](https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/guides/dev-journal/): Generate daily, weekly, or long-range development journals for people, scripts, and AI agents.
2841	 - [Worktrees and provisioning](https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/guides/worktrees-provisioning/): Choose the owner and location of each worktree, then provision ignored files and dependencies safely.
2842	 - [Parallel agents and runtimes](https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/guides/parallel-agents-runtimes/): Coordinate several coding agents around change-stream ownership, explicit mutation boundaries, and replaceable runtimes.
2843	-- [Remote repository fleet](https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/guides/remote-fleet/): Inventory repositories, tasks, and live runtime activity across SSH-reachable machines with dev fleet, and safely fast-forward a branch between them.

2845	 - [Agent-safe retirement](https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/guides/agent-safe-retirement/): Retire an integrated dev-cli worktree and runtime safely, from outside the workspace being removed.
2846	 - [TUI, repositories, quick notes, and bootstrap](https://daviddwlee84.github.io/dev-cli/guides/tui-repos-bootstrap/): Navigate tasks, repositories, experiments, remotes, and agent skills in the TUI; capture repository quick notes; inventory or adopt existing work safely.
