222		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
223		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
224			name := string(kind)
225			kinds = append(kinds, name)
226			byKind[name] = status
227		}
228		sort.Strings(kinds)
229		for _, kind := range kinds {
230			status := byKind[kind]
231			if status.Error != "" {
232				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
233			} else if !status.Complete {
234				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
235			}
236		}
237		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
238	}

237				return false, nil
238			}
239			return false, err
240		}
241		if !info.IsDir() {
242			return false, fmt.Errorf("checkout path is not a directory")
243		}
244		return true, nil
245	}
246
247	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
248		latest := status.LatestChange
249		var commit time.Time
250		var subject string
251		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
252			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
253			if commit.After(latest) {
254				latest = commit
255			}
256			subject = lastSubject
257		}
258		return latest, commit, subject
259	}
260
261	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
262		for _, t := range tasks {
263			assigned := false
264			if t.WorktreePath != "" {
265				for i := 1; i < len(out.Checkouts); i++ {
266					if samePath(t.WorktreePath, out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path) {
267						out.Checkouts[i].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, t)
268						out.Checkouts[i].Ownership = CheckoutDev
269						assigned = true
270						break
271					}
272				}
273			} else if len(out.Checkouts) > 0 && t.Branch == out.Checkouts[0].Branch() {
274				out.Checkouts[0].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[0].Tasks, t)
275				assigned = true
276			}
277			if !assigned {
278				out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, t)
279			}
280		}
281		for i := range out.Checkouts {
282			sort.SliceStable(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
283				return out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[a].ID < out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[b].ID
284			})
285		}
286		sort.SliceStable(out.OtherTasks, func(i, j int) bool {
287			return out.OtherTasks[i].ID < out.OtherTasks[j].ID
288		})
289	}
290
291	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
292	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
293	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
294	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
295		for _, session := range sessions {
296			assigned := map[int]bool{}
297			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
298				best, bestLen := -1, -1
299				for i := range out.Checkouts {
300					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Repo, i, out.Checkouts[i]) {
301						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
302							best, bestLen = i, len(filepath.Clean(root))
303						}
304					}
305				}
306				if best >= 0 {
307					assigned[best] = true
308				}
309			}
310			for i := range assigned {
311				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
312			}
313		}
314	}
315
316	func checkoutRoots(r repo.Repo, index int, checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
317		roots := []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
318		if index == 0 && r.RealPath != "" && !samePath(r.RealPath, r.Path) {
319			roots = append(roots, r.RealPath)
320		}
321		return roots
322	}
323
324	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
325		if root == "" || path == "" {
326			return false
327		}
328		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
329		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
330			return false
331		}
332		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
333	}
334
335	func samePath(a, b string) bool {
336		return a != "" && b != "" && normalizePath(a) == normalizePath(b)
337	}
338
339	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
340	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
341	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
342	// is not sufficient.
343	func normalizePath(path string) string {
344		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
345		cur := clean
346		for {
347			if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
348				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
349				if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
350					return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
351				}
352				return filepath.Clean(real)
353			}
354			parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
355			if parent == cur {
356				return clean
357			}
358			cur = parent
359		}
360	}

362	// FormatRepoContext renders the deterministic Markdown used by both the CLI
363	// and the TUI's yy binding. checkoutIndex < 0 means the whole repository.
364	func FormatRepoContext(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
365		var b strings.Builder
366		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
367			checkout := c.Checkouts[checkoutIndex]
368			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev worktree context: %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout))
369			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, false)

1	# Changelog
2
3	All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.
4
5	The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and releases use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
6
7	## [Unreleased]
8
9	### Added
10
11	- `dev repo context [repo]` now has an additive schema-v1 `--json` report and an
12	  explicit `--refresh` path. Local checkout, Git, task, worktree, and runtime facts
13	  stay live and network-free; optional forge and configured-fleet observations carry
14	  source, age, freshness, completeness, and collection errors. Remote endpoints are
15	  structurally sanitized before public output, and readiness remains split by scope
16	  instead of collapsing unknown evidence into a global safe value.
17	- `dev fleet machine-id <host>` exposes the remote host's non-secret durable machine
18	  UUID and compares it with the optional `machine_id` pin in `remotes.toml`.
19	  `dev fleet files [repo-or-path] --to <host>` plans a one-way transfer of explicitly
20	  allowlisted ignored files and mutates only with `--apply`; both hosts must prove
21	  every exact path is untracked, ignored, regular, portable, bounded, and bound to the
22	  same fetch identity, attached branch, and commit; apply additionally requires the
23	  pinned target machine. Differing target bytes require a separate `--replace`;
24	  `--yes` never implies replacement.
25
26	### Fixed
27
28	- Task writes now carry an in-memory revision from read to write, so existing
29	  lifecycle callers cannot silently overwrite a concurrent process's newer task
30	  record. Catalog create, update, import, and experiment reconciliation share one
31	  cross-process transaction lock, while corrupt task records make repository-context
32	  inventory explicitly incomplete instead of disappearing behind a warning.
33	- Portable-file retries now recover an interrupted store both before and after the
34	  first journal write. The operation binding is durable before manifests or payloads,
35	  rollback never guesses ownership of parent directories, target discovery errors fail
36	  closed, and credential-bearing SCP-like remote prefixes cannot enter catalog keys,
37	  protocol journals, or repository-context output.
38
39	## [0.2.1] - 2026-08-30
40
41	### Added
42
43	- `dev repo new` now has a confirmed interactive repository-bootstrap wizard, with
44	  `dev repo create` as an alias; `dev repo clone` can optionally apply the same setup,
45	  and `dev repo setup` safely merges preset files into an existing clean checkout.
46	  A clear Git URL, local Git path, or owner/repository argument to `new`/`create` is
47	  acquired as a clone, preserving its history and remote. The no-argument wizard
48	  detects the same references. Its default-no “Customize preset and template options?”
49	  gate keeps the normal `agent-ready` path short while still exposing every detailed
50	  question on request.
51	  Presets live in versioned `scaffolds.toml`, support typed inputs, safe templates,
52	  phased hooks, project skills with setup entrypoints, optional GitHub/GitLab
53	  publication, and explicit stay/cd/runtime/start handoffs. The two recommended
54	  agent skills use reviewed built-in project initializers instead of executing
55	  newly downloaded setup code. Skills with the same source and agent targets are
56	  installed in one provider invocation; the history initializer also adds
57	  `.specstory/.gitignore` rules for machine-local identity/statistics while keeping
58	  session history trackable; existing custom content is preserved and missing managed
59	  rules are appended.
60	- `dev repo new` can seed a new Git history from a safe snapshot of a local directory,
61	  local repository, Git URL, or owner/repository reference. `--template-ref` selects a
62	  branch, tag, or commit and `--template-subdir` selects one confined folder; preset
63	  `template`, `template_ref`, and `template_subdir` fields support catalog repositories
64	  containing several starters. Source `.git` metadata is excluded, and symlinks,
65	  special files, and path traversal are rejected. Plans redact URL userinfo, preview
66	  selected paths, and warn when a local live snapshot is not pinned to a commit.
67	- Repository bootstrap now has `--check-in <auto|commit|stage|none>`. `stage` leaves
68	  generated changes staged for review and seeds lazygit's worktree-local pending
69	  message as a best-effort convenience for lowercase `c`; staged setup cannot be
70	  published, and the `start` handoff still requires committed setup. Presets can set
71	  `initial_check_in`, and project setup defaults can set `repo.setup.check_in`. A draft
72	  write failure is a warning after staging succeeds; it never rolls the index back.
73	- TTY text prompts in the repository, task-start, and finish wizards now use an inline
74	  editor with cursor movement, Home/End, Delete/Backspace, and Esc/Ctrl-C cancellation
75	  instead of inserting raw arrow-key escape sequences. Buffered non-TTY input retains

105	**What downstream gets.** Every release from `v0.2.0` forward publishes platform binaries and `SHA256SUMS` alongside the GitHub release, and `dev doctor` reports the running version so a user can compare without leaving the terminal. A release that ships neither leaves `dev --version` as the only signal, which is what the freshness work exists to fix.
106
107	For a release:
108
109	1. Move the relevant `[Unreleased]` entries into `## [x.y.z] - YYYY-MM-DD` and update comparison links.
110	2. Update version-pinned install examples when the documented recommended release changes.
111	3. Push `main` first. `release.yml` asserts the tagged commit is an ancestor of `origin/main`, so a tag pushed ahead of its branch fails validation.
112	4. Tag the exact commit on `main` as `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`; never move or reuse a published tag. Never push `backup/*` or `rescue/*` tags — a tag reachable from a commit that predates the `--match` filter breaks the workflow's `./dev --version` assertion.
113	5. Let `.github/workflows/release.yml` run CI, verify `./dev --version`, build the platform matrix, and create the GitHub release.
114
115	Stable release tags only are accepted by the current workflow; prerelease tags are not supported.
116
117	## Keep implementation, skill, and docs aligned
118
119	`internal/skill/dev-cli/` is shipped product surface, not incidental prose: `internal/skill/skill.go` embeds the entire tree in the binary. A code change is incomplete when the bundled skill or public documentation still describes old behavior.
120
121	| Change | Required synchronization |
122	|---|---|
123	| Cobra command name, `Use`, `Short`, flag, or global option | Run `make skill-sync`, inspect `internal/skill/dev-cli/references/commands.md`, then run `make skill-check`. Never edit the generated block by hand. |
124	| Task modes/states/defaults or lifecycle preconditions | Update `SKILL.md`, `references/task-lifecycle.md`, README, embedded help, relevant English and zh-TW workflow/mental-model/compatibility pages, and transition tests. |
125	| Worktree placement, provisioning, include rules, strategies, or safety checks | Update `references/worktree-ownership.md`, README/public worktree docs, config examples, and focused `wt` tests. |
126	| Runtime protocol, fallback order, activation, agent collision, exact-pane launch, or cleanup behavior | Update `references/runtime-herdr.md`, `references/parallel-agents.md`, compatibility docs, and runtime/lifecycle tests. Keep the boundary clear: `dev start` prepares a checkout/runtime surface; it does not launch an agent. |
127	| Bootstrap scan/layout/index/move behavior | Update `references/bootstrap.md`, public bootstrap docs, and bootstrap tests. |
128	| Config fields/defaults or structured output | Update generated command help where applicable, authored reference pages and both locales, examples, and compatibility tests. |
129	| Quick-note storage, identity, search, structured output, or TUI behavior | Update README, embedded help, `SKILL.md`, `references/notes.md`, and paired English/zh-TW mental-model, workflow, TUI, commands/config, compatibility, and freshness pages. |
130	| Any user-visible feature or fix | Update `CHANGELOG.md`; update README/help/MkDocs/skill wherever they make the affected claim. |
131
132	`make skill-check` proves only that generated command syntax matches the Cobra tree. It cannot detect drift in lifecycle semantics, JSON schemas, safety claims, examples, README, embedded help, or authored skill references; review those manually. Because the skill is compiled with `go:embed`, rebuild after any skill edit before testing the bundled output.
133
134	English and zh-TW MkDocs pages are maintained as a pair. Run the strict documentation checks above after changing either locale, navigation, snippets, or freshness metadata.

567	func collectFleetHost(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, cachedOnly bool) fleet.HostResult {

2	// Its default authority lives in private XDG state, outside repository roots.
3	package lease

22

24		ScopeRepository Scope = "repository"
25		ScopeBranch     Scope = "branch"
26	)

32	}

36		Digest      string `json:"digest"`

38	}
39
40	// Binding permanently associates an idempotency ID with one manifest digest.
41	type Binding struct {
42		OperationID string `json:"operation_id"`
43		Digest      string `json:"digest"`
44	}
45
46	type Token struct {
47		OperationID string `json:"operation_id"`

50	}

57

62		TombstoneReturned TombstoneKind = "returned"
63	)
64
65	type Tombstone struct {
66		Kind          TombstoneKind `json:"kind"`
67		Token         Token         `json:"token"`
68		AdvancedEpoch uint64        `json:"advanced_epoch"`
69		CreatedAt     time.Time     `json:"created_at"`
70	}
71
72	// Record is the durable state for one canonical operation key. At most one of
73	// Reservation and Fence can be active.
74	type Record struct {
75		Key         Key         `json:"key"`
76		Epoch       uint64      `json:"epoch"`
77		Reservation *Claim      `json:"reservation,omitempty"`
78		Fence       *Claim      `json:"fence,omitempty"`

81

84		LastEpoch     uint64    `json:"last_epoch"`
85		Bindings      []Binding `json:"bindings"`
86		Records       []Record  `json:"records"`
87	}
88
89	var (
90		ErrBlocked       = errors.New("operation lease blocked")
91		ErrConflict      = errors.New("operation lease conflict")
92		ErrEpochMismatch = errors.New("operation lease epoch mismatch")
93		ErrReturned      = errors.New("operation lease token is terminal")
94
95		operationIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)
96	)
97
98	type BlockedError struct {
99		Key         Key
100		Kind        string
101		OperationID string
102	}
103
104	func (e *BlockedError) Error() string {
105		return fmt.Sprintf("%s lease for %s is blocked by %s operation %s", e.Key.Scope, e.Key.subject(), e.Kind, e.OperationID)
106	}
107
108	func (e *BlockedError) Unwrap() error { return ErrBlocked }
109
110	func RepositoryKey(repository string) Key {
111		return Key{Repository: repository, Scope: ScopeRepository}
112	}
113
114	func BranchKey(repository, branch string) Key {
115		return Key{Repository: repository, Scope: ScopeBranch, Branch: branch}
116	}
117
118	func (k Key) Validate() error {
119		if err := validateIdentity("repository identity", k.Repository); err != nil {
120			return err
121		}
122		switch k.Scope {
123		case ScopeRepository:
124			if k.Branch != "" {
125				return errors.New("repository lease key must not name a branch")
126			}
127		case ScopeBranch:
128			if err := validateIdentity("branch", k.Branch); err != nil {
129				return err
130			}
131		default:
132			return fmt.Errorf("unknown lease scope %q", k.Scope)
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
137	func (k Key) canonical() string {
138		// Length prefixes keep arbitrary valid identities unambiguous.
139		return fmt.Sprintf("%08x:%s:%s:%08x:%s", len(k.Repository), k.Repository, k.Scope, len(k.Branch), k.Branch)
140	}
141
142	func (k Key) subject() string {
143		if k.Scope == ScopeBranch {
144			return k.Repository + " branch " + k.Branch
145		}
146		return k.Repository
147	}
148
149	func (r Request) Validate() error {
150		if !operationIDPattern.MatchString(r.OperationID) {
151			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation id %q", r.OperationID)
152		}
153		if !assessment.ValidFingerprint(r.Digest) {
154			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has invalid digest %q", r.OperationID, r.Digest)
155		}
156		if r.MachineID != "" {
157			if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
158				return err
159			}
160		}
161		return nil
162	}
163
164	func (b Binding) Validate() error {
165		return (Request{OperationID: b.OperationID, Digest: b.Digest}).Validate()
166	}
167
168	func (t Token) Validate() error {
169		if err := (Request{OperationID: t.OperationID, Digest: t.Digest}).Validate(); err != nil {
170			return err
171		}
172		if t.Epoch == 0 {
173			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has zero lease epoch", t.OperationID)
174		}
175		return nil
176	}
177
178	func (t Token) matches(other Token) bool {
179		return t.OperationID == other.OperationID && t.Digest == other.Digest && t.Epoch == other.Epoch
180	}
181
182	func (t Token) sameOperation(request Request) bool {
183		return t.OperationID == request.OperationID && t.Digest == request.Digest
184	}
185
186	// CanonicalKeys validates, deduplicates, and sorts keys in the one order used
187	// by every multi-key acquisition.
188	func CanonicalKeys(keys []Key) ([]Key, error) {
189		if len(keys) == 0 {
190			return nil, errors.New("operation lease requires at least one key")
191		}
192		unique := make(map[string]Key, len(keys))
193		for _, key := range keys {
194			if err := key.Validate(); err != nil {
195				return nil, err
196			}
197			unique[key.canonical()] = key
198		}
199		canonical := make([]Key, 0, len(unique))
200		for _, key := range unique {
201			canonical = append(canonical, key)
202		}
203		sort.Slice(canonical, func(i, j int) bool { return canonical[i].canonical() < canonical[j].canonical() })
204		return canonical, nil
205	}
206
207	func validateIdentity(name, value string) error {
208		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
209			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
210		}
211		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
212			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
213		}
214		for _, char := range value {
215			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
216				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
217			}
218		}
219		return nil
220	}
221

183	func (a *Authority) finishClaim(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token, claimKind string, terminal TombstoneKind) (uint64, error) {

235					} else {

248	// WithMutation runs an ordinary mutator only when no requested key is reserved
249	// or fenced. A branch key automatically includes its repository ancestor so a
250	// repository fence covers every branch. The locks remain held until operation

252	func (a *Authority) WithMutation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func() error) error {

256	// WithGuard permits the exact owner of an active reservation or fence to work
257	// while rejecting stale, returned, and mismatched tokens. A nil token is an
258	// ordinary mutation guard and includes repository ancestors. It is

260	func (a *Authority) WithGuard(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token *Token, operation func() error) error {

374	func (a *Authority) withKeyLocks(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func([]Key) error) error {

399	func (a *Authority) updateState(ctx context.Context, mutate func(*Snapshot) (bool, error)) error {

401			state, err := a.loadState()
402			if err != nil {
403				return err
404			}
405			changed, err := mutate(&state)
406			if err != nil || !changed {
407				return err
408			}
409			return a.writeState(state)
410		})
411	}

413	func (a *Authority) readState(ctx context.Context, read func(Snapshot) error) error {
414		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
415			state, err := a.loadState()
416			if err != nil {
417				return err
418			}
419			return read(state)
420		})
421	}

423	func (a *Authority) withStateLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {

425		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
426			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation authority lock: %w", err)
427		}

429	}

446	func (a *Authority) statePath() string { return filepath.Join(a.root, stateFilename) }

448	func (a *Authority) loadState() (Snapshot, error) {
449		path := a.statePath()
450		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
451		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
452			return Snapshot{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}, nil
453		}
454		if err != nil {
455			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state: %w", err)
456		}
457		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
458			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s is not a regular file", path)
459		}
460		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
461		if err != nil {
462			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state permissions: %w", err)
463		}
464		if !private {
465			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
466		}
467		file, err := os.Open(path)
468		if err != nil {
469			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("open operation lease state: %w", err)
470		}
471		defer file.Close()
472		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
473		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
474		var state Snapshot
475		if err := decoder.Decode(&state); err != nil {
476			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state: %w", err)
477		}
478		var extra any
479		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
480			if err == nil {
481				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("decode operation lease state: multiple JSON values")
482			}
483			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state trailing data: %w", err)
484		}
485		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
486			return Snapshot{}, err
487		}
488		canonical := canonicalSnapshot(state)
489		encodedState, _ := json.Marshal(state)
490		encodedCanonical, _ := json.Marshal(canonical)
491		if string(encodedState) != string(encodedCanonical) {
492			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("operation lease state is not in canonical order")
493		}
494		return state, nil
495	}
496
497	func (a *Authority) writeState(state Snapshot) error {
498		state = canonicalSnapshot(state)
499		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
500			return err
501		}
502		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
503			return err
504		}
505		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(a.root, ".authority-*.tmp")
506		if err != nil {
507			return fmt.Errorf("create operation lease state temp file: %w", err)
508		}
509		name := temporary.Name()
510		defer os.Remove(name)
511		if err := setPrivateMode(name, 0o600); err != nil {
512			_ = temporary.Close()
513			return err
514		}
515		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)
516		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
517		if err := encoder.Encode(state); err != nil {
518			_ = temporary.Close()
519			return fmt.Errorf("encode operation lease state: %w", err)
520		}
521		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
522			_ = temporary.Close()
523			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease state: %w", err)
524		}
525		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
526			return fmt.Errorf("close operation lease state: %w", err)
527		}
528		if err := replaceFile(name, a.statePath()); err != nil {
529			return fmt.Errorf("publish operation lease state: %w", err)
530		}
531		if err := syncDirectory(a.root); err != nil {
532			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease directory: %w", err)
533		}
534		return nil
535	}

537	func validateSnapshot(state Snapshot) error {
538		if state.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
539			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease schema_version %d: want %d", state.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
540		}
541		bindings := make(map[string]string, len(state.Bindings))
542		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
543			if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
544				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease binding: %w", err)
545			}
546			if _, exists := bindings[binding.OperationID]; exists {
547				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease repeats binding %s", binding.OperationID)
548			}
549			bindings[binding.OperationID] = binding.Digest
550		}
551		type activeSignature struct {
552			Token     Token
553			MachineID string
554			Kind      string
555		}
556		activeOperations := make(map[string]activeSignature)
557		terminalOperations := make(map[string]Tombstone)
558		seenKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(state.Records))
559		var maxRecordEpoch uint64
560		for _, record := range state.Records {
561			if err := record.Key.Validate(); err != nil {
562				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease record: %w", err)
563			}
564			canonicalKey := record.Key.canonical()
565			if _, exists := seenKeys[canonicalKey]; exists {
566				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease state repeats key %s", record.Key.subject())
567			}
568			seenKeys[canonicalKey] = struct{}{}
569			if record.Epoch == 0 || record.Epoch > state.LastEpoch {
570				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has invalid epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), record.Epoch)
571			}
572			if record.Epoch > maxRecordEpoch {
573				maxRecordEpoch = record.Epoch
574			}
575			if record.Reservation != nil && record.Fence != nil {
576				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has both reservation and fence", record.Key.subject())
577			}
578			for _, named := range []struct {
579				name  string
580				claim *Claim
581			}{{"reservation", record.Reservation}, {"fence", record.Fence}} {
582				if named.claim == nil {
583					continue
584				}
585				if err := named.claim.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
586					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s: %w", named.name, record.Key.subject(), err)
587				}
588				if digest, exists := bindings[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != named.claim.Token.Digest {
589					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no matching permanent binding", named.name, record.Key.subject())
590				}
591				if named.claim.Token.Epoch != record.Epoch {
592					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has epoch %d, record has %d", named.name, record.Key.subject(), named.claim.Token.Epoch, record.Epoch)
593				}
594				if named.claim.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
595					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no created_at", named.name, record.Key.subject())
596				}
597				if named.claim.MachineID != "" {
598					if err := machineid.Validate(named.claim.MachineID); err != nil {
599						return err
600					}
601				}
602				signature := activeSignature{Token: named.claim.Token, MachineID: named.claim.MachineID, Kind: named.name}
603				if prior, exists := activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; exists {
604					if !prior.Token.matches(signature.Token) || prior.MachineID != signature.MachineID || prior.Kind != signature.Kind {
605						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent active claims", named.claim.Token.OperationID)
606					}
607				} else {
608					activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID] = signature
609				}
610			}
611			seenTombstones := make(map[string]struct{}, len(record.Tombstones))
612			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
613				switch tombstone.Kind {
614				case TombstoneAborted, TombstoneReturned:
615				default:
616					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has unknown tombstone kind %q", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.Kind)
617				}
618				if err := tombstone.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
619					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s: %w", record.Key.subject(), err)
620				}
621				if digest, exists := bindings[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != tombstone.Token.Digest {
622					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no matching permanent binding", record.Key.subject())
623				}
624				if tombstone.AdvancedEpoch <= tombstone.Token.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > record.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > state.LastEpoch {
625					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has invalid advanced epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.AdvancedEpoch)
626				}
627				if tombstone.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
628					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no created_at", record.Key.subject())
629				}
630				if prior, exists := terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; exists {
631					if !prior.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || prior.Kind != tombstone.Kind || prior.AdvancedEpoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
632						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent terminal records", tombstone.Token.OperationID)
633					}
634				} else {
635					terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID] = tombstone
636				}
637				identity := fmt.Sprintf("%s\x00%s\x00%d", tombstone.Token.OperationID, tombstone.Token.Digest, tombstone.Token.Epoch)
638				if _, exists := seenTombstones[identity]; exists {
639					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s repeats a terminal token", record.Key.subject())
640				}
641				seenTombstones[identity] = struct{}{}
642				if record.Reservation != nil && record.Reservation.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || record.Fence != nil && record.Fence.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) {
643					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has a terminal token still active", record.Key.subject())
644				}
645			}
646		}
647		if state.LastEpoch != maxRecordEpoch {
648			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease last_epoch %d does not match latest record epoch %d", state.LastEpoch, maxRecordEpoch)
649		}
650		for operationID := range activeOperations {
651			if _, terminal := terminalOperations[operationID]; terminal {
652				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s is both active and terminal", operationID)
653			}
654		}
655		return nil
656	}
657
658	func canonicalSnapshot(state Snapshot) Snapshot {
659		result := Snapshot{
660			SchemaVersion: state.SchemaVersion,
661			LastEpoch:     state.LastEpoch,
662			Bindings:      append([]Binding(nil), state.Bindings...),
663			Records:       make([]Record, len(state.Records)),
664		}
665		sort.Slice(result.Bindings, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Bindings[i].OperationID < result.Bindings[j].OperationID })
666		for index, record := range state.Records {
667			result.Records[index] = cloneRecord(record)
668			if result.Records[index].Reservation != nil {
669				result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt)
670			}
671			if result.Records[index].Fence != nil {
672				result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt)
673			}
674			for tombstoneIndex := range result.Records[index].Tombstones {
675				result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt)
676			}
677			sort.Slice(result.Records[index].Tombstones, func(i, j int) bool {
678				left, right := result.Records[index].Tombstones[i], result.Records[index].Tombstones[j]
679				if left.Token.Epoch != right.Token.Epoch {
680					return left.Token.Epoch < right.Token.Epoch
681				}
682				if left.Token.OperationID != right.Token.OperationID {
683					return left.Token.OperationID < right.Token.OperationID
684				}
685				if left.Token.Digest != right.Token.Digest {
686					return left.Token.Digest < right.Token.Digest
687				}
688				return left.Kind < right.Kind
689			})
690		}
691		sort.Slice(result.Records, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Records[i].Key.canonical() < result.Records[j].Key.canonical() })
692		return result
693	}
694
695	func cloneRecord(record Record) Record {
696		result := record
697		if record.Reservation != nil {
698			copy := *record.Reservation
699			result.Reservation = &copy
700		}
701		if record.Fence != nil {
702			copy := *record.Fence
703			result.Fence = &copy
704		}
705		result.Tombstones = append([]Tombstone(nil), record.Tombstones...)
706		return result
707	}
708
709	func findRecord(records []Record, key Key) *Record {
710		canonical := key.canonical()
711		for index := range records {
712			if records[index].Key.canonical() == canonical {
713				return &records[index]
714			}
715		}
716		return nil
717	}
718
719	func ensureRecord(state *Snapshot, key Key) *Record {
720		if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
721			return record
722		}
723		state.Records = append(state.Records, Record{Key: key})
724		return &state.Records[len(state.Records)-1]
725	}

727	func allocateEpoch(state *Snapshot) (uint64, error) {
728		if state.LastEpoch == math.MaxUint64 {
729			return 0, errors.New("operation lease epoch exhausted")
730		}
731		state.LastEpoch++
732		return state.LastEpoch, nil
733	}

735	func activeClaim(record Record) (*Claim, string) {
736		if record.Reservation != nil {
737			return record.Reservation, "reservation"
738		}
739		if record.Fence != nil {
740			return record.Fence, "fence"
741		}
742		return nil, ""
743	}

745	func hasTerminal(record Record, token Token) bool {
746		for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
747			if tombstone.Token.matches(token) {
748				return true
749			}
750		}
751		return false
752	}

754	func ensureBinding(state *Snapshot, request Request) bool {
755		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
756			if binding.OperationID == request.OperationID {
757				return false
758			}
759		}
760		state.Bindings = append(state.Bindings, Binding{OperationID: request.OperationID, Digest: request.Digest})
761		return true
762	}

764	func checkOperationReuse(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
765		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
766			if binding.OperationID != request.OperationID {
767				continue
768			}
769			if binding.Digest != request.Digest {
770				return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was permanently bound to another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
771			}
772			break
773		}
774		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
775		for _, key := range keys {
776			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
777		}
778		for _, record := range state.Records {
779			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
780				if tombstone.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
781					continue
782				}
783				if tombstone.Token.Digest != request.Digest {
784					return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was used with another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
785				}
786				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal: %w", request.OperationID, ErrReturned)
787			}
788			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)
789			if claim == nil || claim.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
790				continue
791			}
792			if claim.Token.Digest != request.Digest {
793				return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s is active with another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
794			}
795			if _, exists := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !exists {
796				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s is active on a different key set: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
797			}
798		}
799		return nil
800	}
801
802	func checkHierarchyClaims(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
803		requestedKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
804		requestedRepositories := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
805		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool, len(keys))
806		for _, key := range keys {
807			requestedKeys[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
808			requestedRepositories[key.Repository] = struct{}{}
809			if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
810				repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
811			}
812		}
813		for _, record := range state.Records {
814			claim, kind := activeClaim(record)
815			if claim == nil {
816				continue
817			}
818			if _, requested := requestedKeys[record.Key.canonical()]; requested {
819				continue
820			}
821			if _, sameRepository := requestedRepositories[record.Key.Repository]; !sameRepository {
822				continue
823			}
824			if record.Key.Scope != ScopeRepository && !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
825				continue
826			}
827			return blockedOrConflict(record.Key, kind, *claim, request)
828		}
829		return nil
830	}
831
832	func blockedOrConflict(key Key, kind string, claim Claim, request Request) error {
833		if claim.Token.OperationID == request.OperationID {
834			return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s conflicts with its active %s: %w", request.OperationID, kind, ErrConflict)
835		}
836		return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
837	}
838
839	func validateGuardKeySet(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token) error {
840		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
841		for _, key := range keys {
842			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
843		}
844		matched := 0
845		for _, record := range state.Records {
846			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)
847			if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
848				continue
849			}
850			if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
851				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d owns a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
852			}
853			matched++
854		}
855		if matched != len(keys) {
856			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d does not own the exact guard key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
857		}
858		return nil
859	}
860
861	func validateClaimKeySet(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token, claimKind string) error {
862		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
863		for _, key := range keys {
864			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
865		}
866		matched := 0
867		for _, record := range state.Records {
868			var claim *Claim
869			if claimKind == "reservation" {
870				claim = record.Reservation
871			} else {
872				claim = record.Fence
873			}
874			if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
875				continue
876			}
877			if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
878				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d owns a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
879			}
880			matched++
881		}
882		if matched != len(keys) {
883			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d does not own the exact key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
884		}
885		return nil
886	}
887
888	func matchingTerminal(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token, kind TombstoneKind) (uint64, bool, error) {
889		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
890		for _, key := range keys {
891			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
892		}
893		var epoch uint64
894		matched := 0
895		for _, record := range state.Records {
896			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
897				if !tombstone.Token.matches(token) {
898					continue
899				}
900				if tombstone.Kind != kind {
901					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d ended as %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, tombstone.Kind, ErrReturned)
902				}
903				if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
904					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
905				}
906				if epoch == 0 {
907					epoch = tombstone.AdvancedEpoch
908				} else if epoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
909					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s has inconsistent terminal epochs: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
910				}
911				matched++
912				break
913			}
914		}
915		if matched == 0 {
916			return 0, false, nil
917		}
918		if matched != len(keys) {
919			return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal on only part of the key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
920		}
921		return epoch, true, nil
922	}

924	func ensurePrivateDir(path string) error {
925		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
926			return err
927		}
928		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
929		if err != nil {
930			return err
931		}
932		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
933			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a private directory", path)
934		}
935		if err := setPrivateMode(path, 0o700); err != nil {
936			return err
937		}
938		info, err = os.Lstat(path)
939		if err != nil {
940			return err
941		}
942		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o700)
943		if err != nil {
944			return fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease directory permissions: %w", err)
945		}
946		if !private {
947			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease directory %s permissions are not private (want 0700 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
948		}
949		return nil
950	}

952	func canonicalTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
953		return value.Round(0).UTC()
954	}

16		administratorsSID = "S-1-5-32-544"
17	)

19	// setPrivateMode installs a protected DACL. Windows os.FileMode permission
20	// bits only model the read-only attribute and cannot establish privacy.
21	func setPrivateMode(path string, want fs.FileMode) error {
22		inheritance := ""
23		switch want.Perm() {
24		case 0o600:
25		case 0o700:
26			inheritance = "OICI"
27		default:
28			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported private Windows mode %04o", want.Perm())
29		}
30		current, _, err := privateSIDs()
31		if err != nil {
32			return err
33		}
34		ace := func(sid string) string {
35			return fmt.Sprintf("(A;%s;GA;;;%s)", inheritance, sid)
36		}
37		descriptor, err := windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString("D:P" + ace(current) + ace(localSystemSID) + ace(administratorsSID))
38		if err != nil {
39			return fmt.Errorf("build private Windows security descriptor: %w", err)
40		}
41		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
42		if err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("read private Windows DACL: %w", err)
44		}
45		if dacl == nil {
46			return fmt.Errorf("private Windows security descriptor has no DACL")
47		}
48		err = windows.SetNamedSecurityInfo(
49			path,
50			windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT,
51			windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
52			nil,
53			nil,
54			dacl,
55			nil,
56		)
57		runtime.KeepAlive(descriptor)
58		if err != nil {
59			return fmt.Errorf("set private Windows DACL: %w", err)
60		}
61		return nil
62	}
63
64	func privateModeMatches(path string, _ fs.FileMode, _ fs.FileMode) (bool, error) {
65		current, allowed, err := privateSIDs()
66		if err != nil {
67			return false, err
68		}
69		descriptor, err := windows.GetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
70		if err != nil {
71			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner and DACL: %w", err)
72		}
73		owner, _, err := descriptor.Owner()
74		if err != nil {
75			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner: %w", err)
76		}
77		if !privateSIDAllowed(owner, allowed) {
78			return false, nil
79		}
80		control, _, err := descriptor.Control()
81		if err != nil {
82			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows security descriptor control: %w", err)
83		}
84		if control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED == 0 {
85			return false, nil
86		}
87		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
88		if err != nil {
89			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL: %w", err)
90		}
91		if dacl == nil {
92			return false, nil
93		}
94		seenCurrent := false
95		for index := uint16(0); index < dacl.AceCount; index++ {
96			var ace *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
97			if err := windows.GetAce(dacl, uint32(index), &ace); err != nil {
98				return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL entry %d: %w", index, err)
99			}
100			switch ace.Header.AceType {
101			case windows.ACCESS_DENIED_ACE_TYPE:
102				continue
103			case windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE_TYPE:
104			default:
105				return false, nil
106			}
107			sid := (*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&ace.SidStart))
108			value := sid.String()
109			if _, ok := allowed[value]; !ok {
110				return false, nil
111			}
112			if value == current {
113				seenCurrent = true
114			}
115		}
116		return seenCurrent, nil
117	}
118
119	func privateSIDAllowed(sid *windows.SID, allowed map[string]struct{}) bool {
120		if sid == nil {
121			return false
122		}
123		_, ok := allowed[sid.String()]
124		return ok
125	}
126
127	func privateSIDs() (string, map[string]struct{}, error) {
128		user, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
129		if err != nil {
130			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("read current Windows user: %w", err)
131		}
132		current := user.User.Sid.String()
133		if current == "" {
134			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("current Windows user has an invalid SID")
135		}
136		return current, map[string]struct{}{
137			current:           {},
138			localSystemSID:    {},
139			administratorsSID: {},
140		}, nil
141	}
142
143	func replaceFile(source, destination string) error {
144		from, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(source)
145		if err != nil {
146			return err
147		}
148		to, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(destination)
149		if err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		return windows.MoveFileEx(from, to, windows.MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING|windows.MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)
153	}
154
155	// MoveFileEx with MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH durably publishes the replacement.
156	// Windows does not expose a portable directory fsync through os.File.
157	func syncDirectory(string) error { return nil }

101	func (s *Service) resolveTarget(ctx context.Context, binding Binding) (targetCheckout, error) {
102		if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
103			return targetCheckout{}, err
104		}
105		options := repo.DefaultOptions()
106		if s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth > 0 {
107			options.MaxDepth = s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth
108		}
109		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, s.Config.DiscoveryRoots(), options)
110		if err != nil {
111			return targetCheckout{}, err
112		}
113		type candidate struct {
114			path      string
115			commonDir string
116		}
117		var candidates []candidate
118		for _, repository := range repositories {
119			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
120				continue
121			}
122			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
123			if err != nil {
124				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect discovered target repository: %w", err)
125			}
126			matched, err := checkoutHasIdentity(ctx, gitRepo.Root, binding.RemoteIdentity)
127			if err != nil {
128				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect target repository fetch identities: %w", err)
129			}
130			if !matched {
131				continue
132			}
133			candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: gitRepo.Root, commonDir: gitRepo.GitCommonDir})
134		}
135		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].commonDir < candidates[j].commonDir })
136		switch len(candidates) {
137		case 0:
138			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAbsent}
139		case 1:
140		default:
141			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAmbiguous}
142		}
143		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidates[0].path, binding.Branch)
144		if err != nil {
145			return targetCheckout{}, err
146		}
147		if !checkedOut || worktree.Bare || worktree.Prunable {
148			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetFetchedOnly}
149		}
150		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
151		if err != nil {
152			return targetCheckout{}, err
153		}
154		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
155		if err != nil {
156			return targetCheckout{}, err
157		}
158		if status.Detached || status.Branch != binding.Branch || head != binding.HeadOID || worktree.Head != binding.HeadOID {
159			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetStale}
160		}
161		checkout := targetCheckout{
162			root: worktree.Path, commonDir: candidates[0].commonDir,
163			identity: binding.RemoteIdentity, branch: binding.Branch, head: head,
164		}
165		checkout.id = digestJSON(struct {
166			Domain    string `json:"domain"`
167			CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
168			Root      string `json:"root"`
169			Branch    string `json:"branch"`
170			Head      string `json:"head"`
171		}{"dev-local-files-checkout-v1", checkout.commonDir, checkout.root, checkout.branch, checkout.head})
172		return checkout, nil
173	}

175	func checkoutHasIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, wanted string) (bool, error) {
176		names, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
177		if err != nil {
178			return false, err
179		}
180		for _, name := range strings.Fields(names) {
181			// Repository identity is established from fetch URLs. A push-only match
182			// can name a different mirror or publication target and must not authorize
183			// writing local files into an otherwise unrelated clone.
184			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", name)
185			if err != nil {
186				continue
187			}
188			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
189				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
190					return true, nil
191				}
192			}
193		}
194		return false, nil
195	}

197	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
198		if s == nil {
199			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
200		}
201		if s.platform() == "windows" {
202			return PlanResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
203		}
204		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
205			return PlanResponse{}, err
206		}
207		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
208		if err != nil {
209			return PlanResponse{}, err
210		}
211		if id != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
212			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
213		}
214		hostLimits := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
215		if err := hostLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
216			return PlanResponse{}, err
217		}
218		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(hostLimits, request.Limits)
219		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
220			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("plan limits do not match target policy")
221		}
222		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, request.Binding)
223		if err != nil {
224			return PlanResponse{}, err
225		}
226		response := PlanResponse{
227			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
228			RequestID: request.RequestID, ManifestDigest: request.ManifestDigest,
229			TargetMachine: id, TargetCheckout: checkout.id,
230		}
231		for _, spec := range request.Files {
232			planned := PlanFile{PublicFile: spec.public(StateFailed)}
233			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
234				planned.State = stateForError(err)
235				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
236				continue
237			}
238			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, request.SafeLimits(), true)
239			if err != nil {
240				planned.State = stateForError(err)
241				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
242				continue
243			}
244			targetMode := ""
245			if observed.exists {
246				targetMode = fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm())
247			}
248			switch {
249			case !observed.exists:
250				planned.State, planned.Action = StateReady, actionCreate
251			case observed.digest == spec.SHA256 && targetMode == spec.Mode:
252				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateCurrent, actionCurrent, observed.digest, targetMode
253			case request.Replace:

255			default:
256				planned.State, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateBlockedConflict, observed.digest, targetMode
257			}
258			response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
259		}
260		response.PlanDigest = planDigest(request, response)
261		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
262			return PlanResponse{}, err
263		}
264		return response, nil
265	}

145	func (e ApplyEnvelope) Validate() error {

147			return errors.New("unsupported local-files apply protocol")

164		seen := map[string]bool{}
165		var total int64
166		for index, payload := range e.Payloads {
167			if index > 0 && e.Payloads[index-1].Path >= payload.Path {
168				return errors.New("apply payload paths must be unique and sorted")
169			}
170			spec, ok := expected[payload.Path]
171			if !ok || seen[payload.Path] {
172				return fmt.Errorf("unexpected apply payload for %q", payload.Path)
173			}
174			seen[payload.Path] = true
175			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
176			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
177				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q is not canonical base64", payload.Path)
178			}
179			if int64(len(decoded)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(decoded) != spec.SHA256 {
180				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q does not match its manifest", payload.Path)
181			}
182			if int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes || int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxTotalBytes-total {
183				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q exceeds negotiated limits", payload.Path)
184			}
185			total += int64(len(decoded))
186		}
187		return nil
188	}
189
190	func stateForError(err error) State {
191		switch {
192		case errors.Is(err, ErrUnsafe), errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrUnsafeType), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrNotPortable), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrPathCollision):
193			return StateBlockedUnsafe
194		case errors.Is(err, ErrIneligible):
195			return StateBlockedIneligible
196		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
197			return StateMissing
198		default:
199			return StateFailed
200		}
201	}
202
203	func limitsToWire(limits safefile.Limits) fleet.FileLimits {
204		return fleet.FileLimits{
205			MaxFiles: limits.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: limits.MaxFileBytes,
206			MaxTotalBytes: limits.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: limits.MaxPathBytes,
207			MaxComponentBytes: limits.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: limits.MaxPathDepth,
208		}
209	}

26	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {

33		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)

35			return ApplyResponse{}, err
36		}

38		// performs the same capability check before reading stdin at all.
39		if id != envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine {
40			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
41		}
42		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
43			return ApplyResponse{}, err
44		}
45		authority := s.Authority
46		if authority == nil {
47			authority = lease.New("")
48		}
49		key := lease.BranchKey(envelope.Request.Binding.RemoteIdentity, envelope.Request.Binding.Branch)

51		err = authority.WithMutation(ctx, []lease.Key{key}, func() error {

239	func preflightApply(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope) ([]preflightFile, error) {
240		payloads := map[string][]byte{}
241		for _, payload := range envelope.Payloads {
242			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
243			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
244				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode canonical payload for %q", payload.Path)
245			}
246			payloads[payload.Path] = decoded
247		}
248		files := make([]preflightFile, len(envelope.Request.Files))
249		for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
250			planned := envelope.Plan.Files[index]
251			if planned.Action == "" {
252				return nil, ErrPlanBlocked
253			}
254			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
255				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
256			}
257			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
258			if err != nil {
259				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
260			}
261			file := preflightFile{spec: spec, planned: planned, before: observed}
262			switch planned.Action {
263			case actionCurrent:
264				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
265					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q is no longer current: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
266				}
267				file.content = observed.data
268			case actionCreate:
269				if observed.exists {
270					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q appeared after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
271				}
272				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
273			case actionReplace:
274				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != planned.TargetSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
275					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed before replacement: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
276				}
277				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
278			default:
279				return nil, errors.New("invalid local-files target action")
280			}
281			if int64(len(file.content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(file.content) != spec.SHA256 {
282				return nil, fmt.Errorf("content for %q no longer matches the plan", spec.Path)
283			}
284			files[index] = file
285		}
286		return files, nil
287	}

289	func (s *Service) failAndRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal, cause error) error {
290		value.Phase = phaseReconcile
291		_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
292		if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, value); err != nil {
293			value.Phase = phaseReconcile
294			_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
295			return errors.New("local-files apply failed and requires reconciliation")
296		}
297		value.Phase = phaseRolledBack
298		for index := range value.Files {
299			if value.Files[index].Action != actionCurrent {
300				value.Files[index].State = StateRolledBack
301				value.Files[index].Published = false
302			}
303		}
304		if err := store.writeJournal(*value); err != nil {
305			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but journal finalization failed")
306		}
307		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
308			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
309		}
310		return fmt.Errorf("local-files apply failed and was rolled back: %w", cause)
311	}

313	func (s *Service) rollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal) error {
314		for index := len(value.Files) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
315			entry := &value.Files[index]
316			if entry.Action == actionCurrent {
317				continue
318			}
319			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
320			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
321				return err
322			}
323			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
324			if err != nil {
325				return err
326			}
327			switch entry.Action {
328			case actionCreate:
329				if !observed.exists {
330					continue
331				}
332				if observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
333					return errors.New("created target changed before rollback")
334				}
335				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
336				if err != nil {
337					return err
338				}
339				err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(spec.Path))
340				err = errors.Join(err, syncHeldRoot(parent.parent), parent.close())
341				if err != nil {
342					return err
343				}
344			case actionReplace:
345				if observed.exists && observed.digest == entry.OldSHA256 {
346					continue
347				}
348				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
349					return errors.New("replacement target changed before rollback")
350				}
351				oldContent, err := store.readBlob(index, true, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
352				if err != nil || digestBytes(oldContent) != entry.OldSHA256 {
353					return errors.New("replacement rollback blob is unavailable")
354				}
355				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
356				if err != nil {
357					return err
358				}
359				current, err := parent.parent.Lstat(pathBase(spec.Path))
360				oldMode, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(entry.OldMode, 8, 12)
361				err = errors.Join(err, modeErr)
362				if err == nil {
363					_, err = safefile.AtomicReplace(ctx, parent.parent, pathBase(spec.Path), current, oldContent, fs.FileMode(oldMode))
364				}
365				err = errors.Join(err, parent.close())
366				if err != nil {
367					return err
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		// Empty parent directories are intentionally retained. A path alone cannot
372		// prove that a directory still has the identity created by this operation;
373		// deleting it after a crash could remove another process's replacement.
374		return verifyRollback(ctx, checkout.root, envelope, *value)
375	}

377	func verifyRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope, value journal) error {
378		for index, entry := range value.Files {
379			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
380			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
381			if err != nil {
382				return err
383			}
384			switch entry.Action {
385			case actionCurrent:
386				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != envelope.Plan.Files[index].TargetMode {
387					return errors.New("current target changed during rollback")
388				}
389			case actionCreate:
390				if observed.exists {
391					return errors.New("created target remains after rollback")
392				}
393			case actionReplace:
394				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != entry.OldSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != entry.OldMode {
395					return errors.New("replacement target was not restored")
396				}
397			}
398		}
399		return nil
400	}
401
402	func (s *Service) verifyCompleted(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value journal) (ApplyResponse, error) {
403		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
404			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files journal no longer matches the checkout")
405		}
406		if value.RetainForEvict {
407			for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
408				content, err := store.readBlob(index, false, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
409				if err != nil || int64(len(content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(content) != spec.SHA256 {
410					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("retained local-files recovery blob is unavailable")
411				}
412			}
413		} else if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
414			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
415		}
416		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
417	}
418
419	func verifyAllCurrent(ctx context.Context, checkout string, specs []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
420		for _, spec := range specs {
421			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
422				return err
423			}
424			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, limits, true)
425			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size {
426				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q failed post-write verification", spec.Path)
427			}
428			if fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != spec.Mode {
429				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q permissions do not match the manifest", spec.Path)
430			}
431		}
432		return nil
433	}
434
435	func responseFromJournal(value journal) ApplyResponse {
436		files := make([]PublicFile, len(value.Files))
437		for index, entry := range value.Files {
438			files[index] = PublicFile{Path: entry.Path, Size: entry.Size, Mode: entry.Mode, State: entry.State}
439		}
440		return ApplyResponse{
441			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
442			RequestID: value.RequestID, PlanDigest: value.PlanDigest, Files: files,
443		}
444	}

446	func (s *Service) fault(point, path string) error {
447		if s.Fault == nil {
448			return nil
449		}
450		return s.Fault(point, path)
451	}

468	func openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath string, create bool) (*heldParent, error) {
469		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
470			return nil, err
471		}
472		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		held := &heldParent{checkout: checkout, rootInfo: rootInfo, root: root, parent: root, roots: []*os.Root{root}}
477		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
478		prefix := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1)
479		for _, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
480			prefix = append(prefix, component)
481			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
482			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
483				if err := held.parent.Mkdir(component, 0o700); err != nil {
484					_ = held.close()
485					return nil, err
486				}
487				child, info, err = safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
488			}
489			if err != nil {
490				_ = held.close()
491				return nil, err
492			}
493			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
494				_ = child.Close()
495				_ = held.close()
496				return nil, ErrUnsafe
497			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
498				_ = child.Close()
499				_ = held.close()
500				return nil, err

25		TargetFetchedOnly  TargetCode = "target-branch-not-checked-out"

27		TargetIncompatible TargetCode = "target-incompatible"

43	func NewService(cfg devconfig.Config) *Service {
44		return &Service{Config: cfg, Authority: lease.New(""), Platform: runtime.GOOS, LoadMachineID: machineid.LoadOrCreate}

47	func (s *Service) platform() string {
48		if s != nil && s.Platform != "" {
49			return s.Platform
50		}
51		return runtime.GOOS

54	func (s *Service) machineID(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
55		if s == nil {
56			return "", errors.New("nil local-files service")
57		}
58		load := s.LoadMachineID
59		if load == nil {
60			load = machineid.LoadOrCreate
61		}
62		return load(ctx)

65	func (s *Service) Capability(ctx context.Context, request fleet.CapabilityRequest) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
66		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
67			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
68		}
69		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
70		if err != nil {
71			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
72		}
73		limits := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
74		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
75			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("local-files host limits: %w", err)
76		}
77		response := fleet.CapabilityResponse{
78			SchemaVersion: request.SchemaVersion, Feature: request.Feature,
79			ProtocolVersion: request.ProtocolVersion, MachineID: id,
80			Platform: s.platform(), Limits: limitsToWire(limits), Supported: true,
81		}
82		if response.Platform == "windows" {
83			response.Supported = false
84			response.Reason = "native-windows-acl-transport-disabled"
85		}
86		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
87			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
88		}
89		return response, nil
90	}

92	type targetCheckout struct {
93		root      string
94		commonDir string
95		identity  string
96		branch    string
97		head      string
98		id        string
99	}
100
101	func (s *Service) resolveTarget(ctx context.Context, binding Binding) (targetCheckout, error) {
102		if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
103			return targetCheckout{}, err
104		}
105		options := repo.DefaultOptions()
106		if s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth > 0 {
107			options.MaxDepth = s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth
108		}
109		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, s.Config.DiscoveryRoots(), options)
110		if err != nil {
111			return targetCheckout{}, err
112		}
113		type candidate struct {
114			path      string
115			commonDir string
116		}
117		var candidates []candidate
118		for _, repository := range repositories {
119			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
120				continue
121			}
122			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
123			if err != nil {
124				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect discovered target repository: %w", err)
125			}
126			matched, err := checkoutHasIdentity(ctx, gitRepo.Root, binding.RemoteIdentity)
127			if err != nil {
128				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect target repository fetch identities: %w", err)
129			}
130			if !matched {
131				continue
132			}
133			candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: gitRepo.Root, commonDir: gitRepo.GitCommonDir})
134		}
135		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].commonDir < candidates[j].commonDir })
136		switch len(candidates) {
137		case 0:
138			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAbsent}
139		case 1:
140		default:
141			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAmbiguous}
142		}
143		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidates[0].path, binding.Branch)
144		if err != nil {
145			return targetCheckout{}, err
146		}
147		if !checkedOut || worktree.Bare || worktree.Prunable {
148			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetFetchedOnly}
149		}
150		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
151		if err != nil {
152			return targetCheckout{}, err
153		}
154		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
155		if err != nil {
156			return targetCheckout{}, err
157		}
158		if status.Detached || status.Branch != binding.Branch || head != binding.HeadOID || worktree.Head != binding.HeadOID {
159			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetStale}
160		}
161		checkout := targetCheckout{
162			root: worktree.Path, commonDir: candidates[0].commonDir,
163			identity: binding.RemoteIdentity, branch: binding.Branch, head: head,
164		}
165		checkout.id = digestJSON(struct {
166			Domain    string `json:"domain"`
167			CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
168			Root      string `json:"root"`
169			Branch    string `json:"branch"`
170			Head      string `json:"head"`
171		}{"dev-local-files-checkout-v1", checkout.commonDir, checkout.root, checkout.branch, checkout.head})
172		return checkout, nil
173	}
174
175	func checkoutHasIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, wanted string) (bool, error) {
176		names, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
177		if err != nil {
178			return false, err
179		}
180		for _, name := range strings.Fields(names) {
181			// Repository identity is established from fetch URLs. A push-only match
182			// can name a different mirror or publication target and must not authorize
183			// writing local files into an otherwise unrelated clone.
184			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", name)
185			if err != nil {
186				continue
187			}
188			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
189				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
190					return true, nil
191				}
192			}
193		}
194		return false, nil
195	}
196
197	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
198		if s == nil {
199			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
200		}
201		if s.platform() == "windows" {
202			return PlanResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
203		}
204		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
205			return PlanResponse{}, err
206		}
207		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
208		if err != nil {
209			return PlanResponse{}, err
210		}
211		if id != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
212			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
213		}
214		hostLimits := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
215		if err := hostLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
216			return PlanResponse{}, err
217		}
218		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(hostLimits, request.Limits)
219		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
220			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("plan limits do not match target policy")
221		}
222		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, request.Binding)
223		if err != nil {
224			return PlanResponse{}, err
225		}
226		response := PlanResponse{
227			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
228			RequestID: request.RequestID, ManifestDigest: request.ManifestDigest,
229			TargetMachine: id, TargetCheckout: checkout.id,
230		}
231		for _, spec := range request.Files {
232			planned := PlanFile{PublicFile: spec.public(StateFailed)}
233			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
234				planned.State = stateForError(err)
235				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
236				continue
237			}
238			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, request.SafeLimits(), true)
239			if err != nil {
240				planned.State = stateForError(err)
241				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
242				continue
243			}
244			targetMode := ""
245			if observed.exists {
246				targetMode = fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm())
247			}
248			switch {
249			case !observed.exists:
250				planned.State, planned.Action = StateReady, actionCreate
251			case observed.digest == spec.SHA256 && targetMode == spec.Mode:
252				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateCurrent, actionCurrent, observed.digest, targetMode
253			case request.Replace:
254				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateReady, actionReplace, observed.digest, targetMode
255			default:
256				planned.State, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateBlockedConflict, observed.digest, targetMode
257			}
258			response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
259		}
260		response.PlanDigest = planDigest(request, response)
261		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
262			return PlanResponse{}, err
263		}
264		return response, nil
265	}

130	// StatusOf reads the porcelain v2 status of the checkout at dir. Porcelain v2
131	// is the documented machine-readable format: it reports branch, upstream and
132	// ahead/behind in the same pass as the file states, so one process gives dev
133	// everything it needs.
134	func StatusOf(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Status, error) {
135		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=normal", "-z")
136		if err != nil {
137			return Status{}, err
138		}
139		return statusFromOutput(dir, out), nil
140	}
141
142	func statusFromOutput(dir, out string) Status {
143		var s Status
144		for _, rec := range nulLines(out) {
145			if rec == "" {
146				continue
147			}
148			switch rec[0] {
149			case '#':
150				parseBranchHeader(rec, &s)
151			case '1', '2':
152				// "1 XY ..." ordinary change, "2 XY ..." rename/copy. X is
153				// staged, Y unstaged. This record is one unique changed path even
154				// when both sides are non-dot.
155				f := strings.Fields(rec)
156				if len(f) < 2 || len(f[1]) < 2 {
157					continue
158				}
159				s.Changed++
160				x, y := f[1][0], f[1][1]
161				if x != '.' {
162					s.Staged++
163				}
164				if y != '.' {
165					s.Unstaged++
166				}
167				classifyChange(x, &s)
168				classifyChange(y, &s)
169				updateLatestChange(dir, statusPath(rec), &s)

21		Binding  Binding
22		Patterns []Pattern

24		Replace  bool
25		// RequestID is a focused-test seam. Production leaves it empty.

29	// Source is an exact, content-addressed local manifest. It keeps no file bytes;
30	// BuildEnvelope reopens and rehashes each non-current source after target plan.
31	type Source struct {
32		checkout string
33		request  PlanRequest
34	}

36	func (s *Source) Request() PlanRequest { return s.request }
37
38	func PrepareSource(ctx context.Context, options SourceOptions) (*Source, Report, error) {
39		if err := options.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
40			return nil, Report{}, err
41		}
42		if err := options.Binding.Validate(); err != nil {
43			return nil, Report{}, err
44		}
45		paths, err := Expand(options.Checkout, options.Patterns, options.Limits)
46		if err != nil {
47			return nil, Report{}, err
48		}
49		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, options.Limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
50			return nil, Report{}, err
51		}
52		requestID := options.RequestID
53		if requestID == "" {
54			requestID = uuid.NewString()
55		}
56		request := PlanRequest{
57			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
58			RequestID: requestID, Binding: options.Binding, Limits: limitsToWire(options.Limits),
59			Replace: options.Replace,
60		}
61		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}
62		blocked := false
63		for _, path := range paths {
64			public := PublicFile{Path: path, Mode: "0600", State: StateFailed}
65			observed, observeErr := observePath(ctx, options.Checkout, path, options.Limits, true)
66			if observeErr != nil {
67				public.State = stateForError(observeErr)
68				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
69				blocked = true
70				continue
71			}
72			if !observed.exists {
73				public.State = StateMissing
74				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
75				blocked = true
76				continue
77			}
78			public.Size = observed.info.Size()
79			if observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0 {
80				public.Mode = "0700"
81			}
82			if eligibilityErr := proveGitEligibility(ctx, options.Checkout, path); eligibilityErr != nil {
83				public.State = stateForError(eligibilityErr)
84				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
85				blocked = true
86				continue
87			}
88			public.State = StateReady
89			report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
90			request.Files = append(request.Files, FileSpec{
91				Path: path, Size: observed.info.Size(), Mode: public.Mode, SHA256: observed.digest,
92			})
93		}
94		report.Files = sortedPublic(report.Files)
95		if blocked {
96			return nil, report, ErrPlanBlocked
97		}
98		sort.Slice(request.Files, func(i, j int) bool { return request.Files[i].Path < request.Files[j].Path })
99		request.ManifestDigest = manifestDigest(request)
100		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
101			return nil, report, err
102		}
103		return &Source{checkout: options.Checkout, request: request}, report, nil
104	}
