106	// BuildEnvelope performs the source-side apply revalidation and includes bytes
107	// only for target actions that create or explicitly replace a file.
108	func (s *Source) BuildEnvelope(ctx context.Context, plan PlanResponse, retainForEvict bool) (ApplyEnvelope, error) {
109		if s == nil {
110			return ApplyEnvelope{}, errors.New("build local-files envelope from nil source")
111		}
112		if err := plan.Validate(s.request); err != nil {
113			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
114		}
115		envelope := ApplyEnvelope{
116			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
117			Request: s.request, Plan: plan, RetainForEvict: retainForEvict,
118		}
119		for index, planned := range plan.Files {
120			if planned.Action == actionCurrent {
121				continue
122			}
123			if planned.Action != actionCreate && planned.Action != actionReplace {
124				return ApplyEnvelope{}, ErrPlanBlocked
125			}
126			spec := s.request.Files[index]
127			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
128				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
129			}
130			observed, err := observePath(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path, s.request.SafeLimits(), true)
131			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 ||
132				(observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0) != spec.executable() {
133				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
134			}
135			envelope.Payloads = append(envelope.Payloads, Payload{
136				Path: spec.Path, Content: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(observed.data),
137			})
138		}
139		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
140			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
141		}
142		return envelope, nil
143	}
144
145	func (e ApplyEnvelope) Validate() error {
146		if e.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || e.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
147			return errors.New("unsupported local-files apply protocol")
148		}
149		if err := e.Request.Validate(); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		if err := e.Plan.Validate(e.Request); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		expected := map[string]FileSpec{}
156		for index, planned := range e.Plan.Files {
157			if planned.Action == actionCreate || planned.Action == actionReplace {
158				expected[e.Request.Files[index].Path] = e.Request.Files[index]
159			}
160		}
161		if len(e.Payloads) != len(expected) {
162			return errors.New("apply payload count does not match target actions")
163		}
164		seen := map[string]bool{}
165		var total int64
166		for index, payload := range e.Payloads {
167			if index > 0 && e.Payloads[index-1].Path >= payload.Path {
168				return errors.New("apply payload paths must be unique and sorted")
169			}
170			spec, ok := expected[payload.Path]
171			if !ok || seen[payload.Path] {
172				return fmt.Errorf("unexpected apply payload for %q", payload.Path)
173			}
174			seen[payload.Path] = true
175			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
176			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
177				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q is not canonical base64", payload.Path)
178			}
179			if int64(len(decoded)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(decoded) != spec.SHA256 {
180				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q does not match its manifest", payload.Path)
181			}
182			if int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes || int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxTotalBytes-total {
183				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q exceeds negotiated limits", payload.Path)
184			}
185			total += int64(len(decoded))
186		}
187		return nil
188	}
189
190	func stateForError(err error) State {
191		switch {
192		case errors.Is(err, ErrUnsafe), errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrUnsafeType), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrNotPortable), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrPathCollision):
193			return StateBlockedUnsafe
194		case errors.Is(err, ErrIneligible):
195			return StateBlockedIneligible
196		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
197			return StateMissing
198		default:
199			return StateFailed
200		}
201	}
202
203	func limitsToWire(limits safefile.Limits) fleet.FileLimits {
204		return fleet.FileLimits{
205			MaxFiles: limits.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: limits.MaxFileBytes,
206			MaxTotalBytes: limits.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: limits.MaxPathBytes,
207			MaxComponentBytes: limits.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: limits.MaxPathDepth,
208		}
209	}
210
211	// NegotiateLimits takes the lower value for every policy field and validates
212	// both sides against this binary's compiled ceilings.
213	func NegotiateLimits(local safefile.Limits, remote fleet.FileLimits) (safefile.Limits, error) {
214		if err := local.Validate(); err != nil {
215			return safefile.Limits{}, err
216		}
217		remoteLimits := safefile.Limits{
218			MaxFiles: remote.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: remote.MaxFileBytes,
219			MaxTotalBytes: remote.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: remote.MaxPathBytes,
220			MaxComponentBytes: remote.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: remote.MaxPathDepth,
221		}
222		if err := remoteLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
223			return safefile.Limits{}, err
224		}
225		result := safefile.Limits{
226			MaxFiles:          min(local.MaxFiles, remoteLimits.MaxFiles),
227			MaxFileBytes:      min(local.MaxFileBytes, remoteLimits.MaxFileBytes),
228			MaxTotalBytes:     min(local.MaxTotalBytes, remoteLimits.MaxTotalBytes),
229			MaxPathBytes:      min(local.MaxPathBytes, remoteLimits.MaxPathBytes),
230			MaxComponentBytes: min(local.MaxComponentBytes, remoteLimits.MaxComponentBytes),
231			MaxPathDepth:      min(local.MaxPathDepth, remoteLimits.MaxPathDepth),
232		}
233		return result, result.Validate()
234	}

1	package localfiles
2
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6
7		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/fleet"
8	)
9
10	var (
11		ErrNoRemoteDev     = errors.New("target does not provide a compatible dev protocol")
12		ErrUnreachable     = errors.New("target host is unreachable")
13		ErrRemoteTimeout   = errors.New("target protocol timed out")
14		ErrMachinePin      = errors.New("target machine ID does not match the configured host pin")
15		ErrMachineUnpinned = errors.New("mutating local-file apply requires host.machine_id")
16	)
17
18	type Runner interface {
19		RunWithOptions(context.Context, fleet.Host, []string, []byte, fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result
20	}
21
22	type Client struct{ Runner Runner }
23
24	func (c Client) run(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, maxResponse int64) ([]byte, error) {
25		if c.Runner == nil {
26			return nil, errors.New("local-files client has no fleet transport")
27		}
28		// Capability and plan are read-only. Apply is permanently bound to its
29		// request ID and plan digest by the target journal, so an authentication-only
30		// retry cannot duplicate an unbound mutation.
31		result := c.Runner.RunWithOptions(ctx, host, args, stdin, fleet.RunOptions{Retry: fleet.RetryAuthentication})
32		if int64(len(result.Stdout)) > maxResponse {
33			return nil, errors.New("target protocol response exceeded its bound")
34		}
35		if result.ExitCode == 0 && result.CaptureError == "" {
36			return result.Stdout, nil
37		}
38		switch {
39		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
40			return nil, ErrRemoteTimeout
41		case result.ExitCode == 127:
42			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
43		case result.ExitCode == 255:
44			return nil, ErrUnreachable
45		default:
46			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
47		}
48	}
49
50	// Identify performs the content-free capability exchange without enforcing the
51	// configured machine pin. It exists for explicit onboarding and diagnostics;
52	// mutating or payload-bearing callers must use Probe.
53	func (c Client) Identify(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
54		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
55		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
56		if err != nil {
57			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
58		}
59		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_capability"}, body, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
60		if err != nil {
61			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
62		}
63		var response fleet.CapabilityResponse
64		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes, &response); err != nil {
65			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
66		}
67		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
68			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
69		}
70		return response, nil
71	}
72
73	func (c Client) Probe(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
74		response, err := c.Identify(ctx, host)
75		if err != nil {
76			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
77		}
78		if host.MachineID != "" && host.MachineID != response.MachineID {
79			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
80		}
81		if !response.Supported {
82			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, errors.New("target does not support local-file payloads")
83		}
84		return response, nil
85	}
86
87	func (c Client) Plan(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
88		if capability.MachineID != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
89			return PlanResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
90		}
91		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
92			return PlanResponse{}, err
93		}
94		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
95		if err != nil {
96			return PlanResponse{}, err
97		}
98		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-plan"}, body, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
99		if err != nil {
100			return PlanResponse{}, err
101		}
102		var response PlanResponse
103		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes, &response); err != nil {
104			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
105		}
106		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
107			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
108		}
109		return response, nil
110	}
111
112	func (c Client) Apply(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
113		if host.MachineID == "" {
114			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachineUnpinned
115		}
116		if host.MachineID != capability.MachineID || envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine != capability.MachineID {
117			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
118		}
119		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
120			return ApplyResponse{}, err
121		}
122		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(envelope, MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes)
123		if err != nil {
124			return ApplyResponse{}, err
125		}
126		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-apply"}, body, MaxApplyResponseBytes)
127		if err != nil {
128			return ApplyResponse{}, err
129		}
130		var response ApplyResponse
131		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxApplyResponseBytes, &response); err != nil {
132			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
133		}
134		if err := response.Validate(envelope.Request, envelope.Plan); err != nil {
135			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
136		}
137		return response, nil
138	}

101	func (s *Service) resolveTarget(ctx context.Context, binding Binding) (targetCheckout, error) {
102		if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
103			return targetCheckout{}, err
104		}
105		options := repo.DefaultOptions()
106		if s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth > 0 {
107			options.MaxDepth = s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth
108		}
109		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, s.Config.DiscoveryRoots(), options)
110		if err != nil {
111			return targetCheckout{}, err
112		}
113		type candidate struct {
114			path      string
115			commonDir string
116		}
117		var candidates []candidate
118		for _, repository := range repositories {
119			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
120				continue
121			}
122			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
123			if err != nil {
124				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect discovered target repository: %w", err)
125			}
126			matched, err := checkoutHasIdentity(ctx, gitRepo.Root, binding.RemoteIdentity)
127			if err != nil {
128				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect target repository fetch identities: %w", err)
129			}
130			if !matched {
131				continue
132			}
133			candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: gitRepo.Root, commonDir: gitRepo.GitCommonDir})
134		}
135		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].commonDir < candidates[j].commonDir })
136		switch len(candidates) {
137		case 0:
138			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAbsent}
139		case 1:
140		default:
141			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAmbiguous}
142		}
143		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidates[0].path, binding.Branch)
144		if err != nil {
145			return targetCheckout{}, err
146		}
147		if !checkedOut || worktree.Bare || worktree.Prunable {
148			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetFetchedOnly}
149		}
150		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
151		if err != nil {
152			return targetCheckout{}, err
153		}
154		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
155		if err != nil {
156			return targetCheckout{}, err
157		}
158		if status.Detached || status.Branch != binding.Branch || head != binding.HeadOID || worktree.Head != binding.HeadOID {
159			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetStale}
160		}
161		checkout := targetCheckout{
162			root: worktree.Path, commonDir: candidates[0].commonDir,
163			identity: binding.RemoteIdentity, branch: binding.Branch, head: head,
164		}
165		checkout.id = digestJSON(struct {
166			Domain    string `json:"domain"`
167			CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
168			Root      string `json:"root"`
169			Branch    string `json:"branch"`
170			Head      string `json:"head"`
171		}{"dev-local-files-checkout-v1", checkout.commonDir, checkout.root, checkout.branch, checkout.head})
172		return checkout, nil
173	}

175	func checkoutHasIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, wanted string) (bool, error) {
176		names, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
177		if err != nil {
178			return false, err
179		}
180		for _, name := range strings.Fields(names) {
181			// Repository identity is established from fetch URLs. A push-only match
182			// can name a different mirror or publication target and must not authorize
183			// writing local files into an otherwise unrelated clone.
184			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", name)
185			if err != nil {
186				continue
187			}
188			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
189				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
190					return true, nil
191				}
192			}
193		}
194		return false, nil
195	}

197	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
198		if s == nil {
199			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
200		}
201		if s.platform() == "windows" {
202			return PlanResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
203		}
204		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
205			return PlanResponse{}, err
206		}
207		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
208		if err != nil {
209			return PlanResponse{}, err
210		}
211		if id != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
212			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
213		}
214		hostLimits := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
215		if err := hostLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
216			return PlanResponse{}, err
217		}
218		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(hostLimits, request.Limits)
219		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
220			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("plan limits do not match target policy")
221		}
222		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, request.Binding)
223		if err != nil {
224			return PlanResponse{}, err
225		}
226		response := PlanResponse{
227			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
228			RequestID: request.RequestID, ManifestDigest: request.ManifestDigest,
229			TargetMachine: id, TargetCheckout: checkout.id,
230		}
231		for _, spec := range request.Files {
232			planned := PlanFile{PublicFile: spec.public(StateFailed)}
233			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
234				planned.State = stateForError(err)
235				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
236				continue
237			}
238			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, request.SafeLimits(), true)
239			if err != nil {
240				planned.State = stateForError(err)
241				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
242				continue
243			}
244			targetMode := ""
245			if observed.exists {
246				targetMode = fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm())
247			}
248			switch {
249			case !observed.exists:
250				planned.State, planned.Action = StateReady, actionCreate
251			case observed.digest == spec.SHA256 && targetMode == spec.Mode:
252				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateCurrent, actionCurrent, observed.digest, targetMode
253			case request.Replace:
254				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateReady, actionReplace, observed.digest, targetMode
255			default:
256				planned.State, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateBlockedConflict, observed.digest, targetMode
257			}
258			response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
259		}
260		response.PlanDigest = planDigest(request, response)
261		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
262			return PlanResponse{}, err
263		}
264		return response, nil
265	}

24	// Expand resolves validated project and --file patterns locally into a sorted,
25	// duplicate-free list of exact slash paths. It never follows links or descends
26	// into Git metadata, nested repositories, submodules, or dependency trees.
27	func Expand(root string, patterns []Pattern, limits safefile.Limits) ([]string, error) {
28		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
29			return nil, err
30		}
31		if len(patterns) == 0 {
32			return nil, errors.New("no local-file patterns were configured or passed with --file")
33		}
34		for _, pattern := range patterns {
35			if err := projectconfig.ValidateLocalFilePattern(pattern.Value); err != nil {
36				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s: %w", patternSource(pattern), err)
37			}
38			for _, component := range strings.Split(pattern.Value, "/") {
39				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
40					return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s enters dependency directory %q", patternSource(pattern), component)
41				}
42			}
43		}
44		rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(root)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect source checkout: %w", err)
47		}
48		if !rootInfo.IsDir() || rootInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
49			return nil, errors.New("source checkout is not a held regular directory")
50		}
51
52		matches := map[string]struct{}{}
53		matchedPatterns := make([]bool, len(patterns))
54		visited := 0
55		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
56			if walkErr != nil {
57				return walkErr
58			}
59			if filename == root {
60				return nil
61			}
62			visited++
63			if visited > maxWalkEntries {
64				return fmt.Errorf("source checkout exceeds %d entries while expanding local-file patterns", maxWalkEntries)
65			}
66			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, filename)
67			if err != nil {
68				return err
69			}
70			slash := filepath.ToSlash(relative)
71			components := strings.Split(slash, "/")
72			base := strings.ToLower(components[len(components)-1])
73			if entry.IsDir() {
74				if base == ".git" {
75					return filepath.SkipDir
76				}
77				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[base]; blocked {
78					for _, pattern := range patterns {
79						if matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
80							return fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern enters dependency directory %q", slash)
81						}
82					}
83					return filepath.SkipDir
84				}
85				if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(filename, ".git")); err == nil {
86					return filepath.SkipDir
87				} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
88					return fmt.Errorf("inspect nested repository boundary %s: %w", slash, err)
89				}
90			}
91			matched := false
92			for index, pattern := range patterns {
93				if !entry.IsDir() && matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
94					matchedPatterns[index] = true
95					matched = true
96				}
97			}
98			if matched {
99				matches[slash] = struct{}{}
100			}
101			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 && entry.IsDir() {
102				return filepath.SkipDir
103			}
104			return nil
105		})
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, err
108		}
109		for index, matched := range matchedPatterns {
110			if !matched {
111				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s matched no source path", patternSource(patterns[index]))
112			}
113		}
114		paths := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
115		for path := range matches {
116			paths = append(paths, path)
117		}
118		sort.Strings(paths)
119		if len(paths) > limits.MaxFiles {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("patterns expanded to %d paths; maximum is %d", len(paths), limits.MaxFiles)
121		}
122		return paths, nil
123	}

125	func patternSource(pattern Pattern) string {
126		if strings.TrimSpace(pattern.Source) == "" {
127			return "explicit input"
128		}
129		return pattern.Source
130	}

132	func matchPattern(pattern, candidate string) bool {
133		patternParts := strings.Split(pattern, "/")
134		candidateParts := strings.Split(candidate, "/")
135		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
136		memo := map[key]bool{}
137		seen := map[key]bool{}
138		var match func(int, int) bool
139		match = func(patternIndex, candidateIndex int) bool {
140			state := key{patternIndex, candidateIndex}
141			if seen[state] {
142				return memo[state]
143			}
144			seen[state] = true
145			var result bool
146			switch {
147			case patternIndex == len(patternParts):
148				result = candidateIndex == len(candidateParts)
149			case patternParts[patternIndex] == "**":
150				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex) ||
151					candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && match(patternIndex, candidateIndex+1)
152			case candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && matchComponent(patternParts[patternIndex], candidateParts[candidateIndex]):
153				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex+1)
154			}
155			memo[state] = result
156			return result
157		}
158		return match(0, 0)
159	}
160
161	func matchComponent(pattern, candidate string) bool {
162		p, c := []rune(pattern), []rune(candidate)
163		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
164		memo := map[key]bool{}
165		seen := map[key]bool{}
166		var match func(int, int) bool
167		match = func(pi, ci int) bool {
168			state := key{pi, ci}
169			if seen[state] {
170				return memo[state]
171			}
172			seen[state] = true
173			var result bool
174			switch {
175			case pi == len(p):
176				result = ci == len(c)
177			case p[pi] == '*':
178				result = match(pi+1, ci) || ci < len(c) && match(pi, ci+1)
179			case ci < len(c) && (p[pi] == '?' || p[pi] == c[ci]):
180				result = match(pi+1, ci+1)
181			}
182			memo[state] = result
183			return result
184		}
185		return match(0, 0)
186	}

190			if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
191				return true
192			}
193		}
194		return false
195	}

13	var localFileDependencyComponents = map[string]bool{
14		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "vendor": true,
15		"__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "target": true, ".terraform": true,
16		"dist": true, "build": true, ".next": true,

19	// ValidateLocalFilePattern validates the deliberately small cross-platform
20	// grammar accepted by [local_files]. Literal path components use portable slash
21	// paths; '*' and '?' match within one component and a component equal to '**'
22	// matches zero or more components. Character classes, escaping, volumes, and
23	// platform-specific separators are intentionally unsupported.
24	func ValidateLocalFilePattern(value string) error {
25		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
26			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is required and must be trimmed")
27		}
28		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
29			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is not valid UTF-8")
30		}
31		if len(value) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes {
32			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is %d bytes; maximum is %d", len(value), safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes)
33		}
34		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
35			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must use '/' separators")
36		}
37		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasSuffix(value, "/") || strings.Contains(value, "//") {
38			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must be a clean repository-relative slash path")
39		}
40		if strings.ContainsAny(value, "[]{}") {
41			return fmt.Errorf("pattern supports only '*', '?' and whole-component '**' wildcards")
42		}
43		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
44		if len(components) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth {
45			return fmt.Errorf("pattern has %d components; maximum is %d", len(components), safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth)
46		}
47		for _, component := range components {
48			if localFileDependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)] {
49				return fmt.Errorf("pattern enters dependency directory %q", component)
50			}
51			if component == "**" {
52				continue
53			}
54			if strings.Contains(component, "**") {
55				return fmt.Errorf("'**' must occupy a complete path component")
56			}
57			placeholder := strings.NewReplacer("*", "x", "?", "x").Replace(component)
58			if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(placeholder, safefile.CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
59				return fmt.Errorf("component %q: %w", component, err)
60			}
61			for _, r := range component {
62				if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
63					return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a control character", component)
64				}
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}

34	// FilePaths are the fixed project configuration paths below one canonical
35	// repository root.
36	type FilePaths struct {

42	// ResolvePaths canonicalizes repoRoot and proves both fixed files remain below
43	// it. This also rejects a .dev-cli directory or file symlink that escapes the
44	// repository.
45	func ResolvePaths(repoRoot string) (FilePaths, error) {
46		root, err := pathx.Canonical(repoRoot)
47		if err != nil {
48			return FilePaths{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize repository root: %w", err)
49		}
50		configPath, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, filepath.Join(root, DirectoryName, ConfigFilename))
51		if err != nil {
52			return FilePaths{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve %s: %w", ConfigRelativePath, err)
53		}
54		scaffoldsPath, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, filepath.Join(root, DirectoryName, ScaffoldsFilename))
55		if err != nil {
56			return FilePaths{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve %s: %w", ScaffoldsRelativePath, err)
57		}
58		return FilePaths{Root: root, Config: configPath, Scaffolds: scaffoldsPath}, nil
59	}

61	// ConfigPath returns the canonical fixed project config path.
62	func ConfigPath(repoRoot string) (string, error) {
63		paths, err := ResolvePaths(repoRoot)
64		return paths.Config, err
65	}

67	// ScaffoldsPath returns the canonical fixed project scaffold path.

172	func (o Override) validate() error {
173		w := o.Worktree
174		validStrategy := func(value string) bool {
175			switch value {
176			case "reinstall", "copy", "link", "skip":
177				return true
178			default:
179				return false
180			}
181		}
182		if w.Strategy != nil && !validStrategy(*w.Strategy) {
183			return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategy %q: want reinstall, copy, link or skip", *w.Strategy)
184		}
185		if w.Strategies != nil {
186			for ecosystem, strategy := range *w.Strategies {
187				if strings.TrimSpace(ecosystem) == "" {
188					return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategies contains an empty ecosystem name")
189				}
190				if !validStrategy(strategy) {
191					return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategies.%s %q: want reinstall, copy, link or skip", ecosystem, strategy)
192				}
193			}
194		}
195		if w.ProvisionTimeout != nil && w.ProvisionTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
196			return fmt.Errorf("worktree.provision_timeout must be positive")
197		}
198		if w.Link != nil {
199			for index, value := range *w.Link {
200				if err := validateRelativePath(value); err != nil {
201					return fmt.Errorf("worktree.link[%d]: %w", index, err)
202				}
203			}
204		}
205		if o.LocalFiles.Include != nil {
206			for index, value := range *o.LocalFiles.Include {
207				if err := ValidateLocalFilePattern(value); err != nil {
208					return fmt.Errorf("local_files.include[%d]: %w", index, err)
209				}
210			}
211		}
212		setup := o.Repo.Setup
213		if setup.Preset != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*setup.Preset) == "" {
214			return fmt.Errorf("repo.setup.preset must not be empty")
215		}
216		if setup.Handoff != nil {
217			switch *setup.Handoff {
218			case "stay", "cd", "open", "start":
219			default:
220				return fmt.Errorf("repo.setup.handoff %q: want stay, cd, open or start", *setup.Handoff)
221			}
222		}
223		if setup.CheckIn != nil {
224			switch *setup.CheckIn {
225			case "commit", "stage", "none":
226			default:
227				return fmt.Errorf("repo.setup.check_in %q: want commit, stage or none", *setup.CheckIn)
228			}
229		}
230		if setup.CheckIn != nil && setup.Commit != nil {
231			return fmt.Errorf("repo.setup cannot set both check_in and commit")
232		}
233		return nil
234	}
235
236	func validateRelativePath(value string) error {
237		if value == "" {
238			return fmt.Errorf("path must not be empty")
239		}
240		if filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" {
241			return fmt.Errorf("path %q must be repository-relative", value)
242		}
243		for _, part := range strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' || r == '\\' }) {
244			if part == ".." {
245				return fmt.Errorf("path %q contains parent traversal", value)
246			}
247		}
248		if filepath.Clean(value) == "." {
249			return fmt.Errorf("path %q names the repository root", value)
250		}
251		return nil
252	}

643			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
644				return cmp > 0
645			}
646			return cmp < 0
647		})
648		return out
649	}

651	// visibleTries applies structured experiment filters and keeps sorting local to
652	// the view so repository ordering remains independent.
653	func (m Model) visibleTries() []TryRow {
654		out := make([]TryRow, 0, len(m.tries))
655		for _, row := range m.tries {
656			if row.matches(m.filter) {
657				out = append(out, row)
658			}
659		}
660		sortBy := m.trySort
661		if sortBy == "" {
662			sortBy = "activity"
663		}
664		sortTryRows(out, sortBy, m.tryReverse)
665		return out
666	}

668	type repoItem struct {
669		Repo          RepoRow
670		CheckoutIndex int // -1 is the repository parent; 1+ is a linked worktree
671	}
672
673	func (i repoItem) child() bool { return i.CheckoutIndex > 0 }
674
675	func (i repoItem) checkout() (inventory.RepoCheckout, bool) {
676		if i.CheckoutIndex < 0 || i.CheckoutIndex >= len(i.Repo.Context.Checkouts) {
677			return inventory.RepoCheckout{}, false
678		}
679		return i.Repo.Context.Checkouts[i.CheckoutIndex], true
680	}
681
682	// visibleRepoItems flattens expanded worktrees under their sorted parent.
683	// Children never participate in repo sorting and therefore cannot drift away
684	// from the repository they belong to.
685	func (m Model) visibleRepoItems() []repoItem {
686		repos := m.visibleRepos()
687		out := make([]repoItem, 0, len(repos))
688		for _, r := range repos {
689			out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: -1})
690			if !m.repoExpanded(r) {
691				continue
692			}
693			for i := 1; i < len(r.Context.Checkouts); i++ {
694				out = append(out, repoItem{Repo: r, CheckoutIndex: i})
695			}
696		}
697		return out
698	}

700	func repoKey(r RepoRow) string {
701		if r.Repo.CommonDir != "" {
702			return r.Repo.CommonDir
703		}
704		return r.Repo.Path
705	}
706
707	func (m Model) repoExpanded(r RepoRow) bool {
708		key := repoKey(r)
709		for _, expanded := range m.expandedRepos {
710			if expanded == key {
711				return true
712			}
713		}
714		return false
715	}
716
717	func (m *Model) toggleRepo(r RepoRow) {
718		key := repoKey(r)
719		for i, expanded := range m.expandedRepos {
720			if expanded == key {
721				m.expandedRepos = append(append([]string(nil), m.expandedRepos[:i]...), m.expandedRepos[i+1:]...)
722				return
723			}
724		}
725		m.expandedRepos = append(append([]string(nil), m.expandedRepos...), key)
726	}

106	// BuildEnvelope performs the source-side apply revalidation and includes bytes
107	// only for target actions that create or explicitly replace a file.
108	func (s *Source) BuildEnvelope(ctx context.Context, plan PlanResponse, retainForEvict bool) (ApplyEnvelope, error) {
109		if s == nil {
110			return ApplyEnvelope{}, errors.New("build local-files envelope from nil source")
111		}
112		if err := plan.Validate(s.request); err != nil {
113			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
114		}
115		envelope := ApplyEnvelope{
116			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
117			Request: s.request, Plan: plan, RetainForEvict: retainForEvict,
118		}
119		for index, planned := range plan.Files {
120			if planned.Action == actionCurrent {
121				continue
122			}
123			if planned.Action != actionCreate && planned.Action != actionReplace {
124				return ApplyEnvelope{}, ErrPlanBlocked
125			}
126			spec := s.request.Files[index]
127			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
128				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
129			}
130			observed, err := observePath(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path, s.request.SafeLimits(), true)
131			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 ||
132				(observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0) != spec.executable() {
133				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
134			}
135			envelope.Payloads = append(envelope.Payloads, Payload{
136				Path: spec.Path, Content: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(observed.data),
137			})
138		}
139		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
140			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
141		}
142		return envelope, nil
143	}

145	func (e ApplyEnvelope) Validate() error {
146		if e.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || e.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
147			return errors.New("unsupported local-files apply protocol")
148		}
149		if err := e.Request.Validate(); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		if err := e.Plan.Validate(e.Request); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		expected := map[string]FileSpec{}
156		for index, planned := range e.Plan.Files {
157			if planned.Action == actionCreate || planned.Action == actionReplace {
158				expected[e.Request.Files[index].Path] = e.Request.Files[index]
159			}
160		}
161		if len(e.Payloads) != len(expected) {
162			return errors.New("apply payload count does not match target actions")
163		}
164		seen := map[string]bool{}
165		var total int64
166		for index, payload := range e.Payloads {
167			if index > 0 && e.Payloads[index-1].Path >= payload.Path {
168				return errors.New("apply payload paths must be unique and sorted")
169			}
170			spec, ok := expected[payload.Path]
171			if !ok || seen[payload.Path] {
172				return fmt.Errorf("unexpected apply payload for %q", payload.Path)
173			}
174			seen[payload.Path] = true
175			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
176			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
177				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q is not canonical base64", payload.Path)
178			}
179			if int64(len(decoded)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(decoded) != spec.SHA256 {
180				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q does not match its manifest", payload.Path)
181			}
182			if int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes || int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxTotalBytes-total {
183				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q exceeds negotiated limits", payload.Path)
184			}
185			total += int64(len(decoded))
186		}
187		return nil
188	}

190	func stateForError(err error) State {
191		switch {
192		case errors.Is(err, ErrUnsafe), errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrUnsafeType), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrNotPortable), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrPathCollision):
193			return StateBlockedUnsafe
194		case errors.Is(err, ErrIneligible):
195			return StateBlockedIneligible
196		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
197			return StateMissing
198		default:
199			return StateFailed
200		}
201	}
202
203	func limitsToWire(limits safefile.Limits) fleet.FileLimits {
204		return fleet.FileLimits{
205			MaxFiles: limits.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: limits.MaxFileBytes,
206			MaxTotalBytes: limits.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: limits.MaxPathBytes,
207			MaxComponentBytes: limits.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: limits.MaxPathDepth,
208		}
209	}

211	// NegotiateLimits takes the lower value for every policy field and validates
212	// both sides against this binary's compiled ceilings.
213	func NegotiateLimits(local safefile.Limits, remote fleet.FileLimits) (safefile.Limits, error) {
214		if err := local.Validate(); err != nil {
215			return safefile.Limits{}, err
216		}
217		remoteLimits := safefile.Limits{
218			MaxFiles: remote.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: remote.MaxFileBytes,
219			MaxTotalBytes: remote.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: remote.MaxPathBytes,
220			MaxComponentBytes: remote.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: remote.MaxPathDepth,
221		}
222		if err := remoteLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
223			return safefile.Limits{}, err
224		}
225		result := safefile.Limits{
226			MaxFiles:          min(local.MaxFiles, remoteLimits.MaxFiles),
227			MaxFileBytes:      min(local.MaxFileBytes, remoteLimits.MaxFileBytes),
228			MaxTotalBytes:     min(local.MaxTotalBytes, remoteLimits.MaxTotalBytes),
229			MaxPathBytes:      min(local.MaxPathBytes, remoteLimits.MaxPathBytes),
230			MaxComponentBytes: min(local.MaxComponentBytes, remoteLimits.MaxComponentBytes),
231			MaxPathDepth:      min(local.MaxPathDepth, remoteLimits.MaxPathDepth),
232		}
233		return result, result.Validate()
234	}

13	var localFileDependencyComponents = map[string]bool{
14		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "vendor": true,
15		"__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "target": true, ".terraform": true,
16		"dist": true, "build": true, ".next": true,
17	}
18
19	// ValidateLocalFilePattern validates the deliberately small cross-platform
20	// grammar accepted by [local_files]. Literal path components use portable slash
21	// paths; '*' and '?' match within one component and a component equal to '**'
22	// matches zero or more components. Character classes, escaping, volumes, and
23	// platform-specific separators are intentionally unsupported.
24	func ValidateLocalFilePattern(value string) error {
25		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
26			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is required and must be trimmed")
27		}
28		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
29			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is not valid UTF-8")
30		}
31		if len(value) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes {
32			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is %d bytes; maximum is %d", len(value), safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes)
33		}
34		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
35			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must use '/' separators")
36		}
37		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasSuffix(value, "/") || strings.Contains(value, "//") {
38			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must be a clean repository-relative slash path")
39		}
40		if strings.ContainsAny(value, "[]{}") {
41			return fmt.Errorf("pattern supports only '*', '?' and whole-component '**' wildcards")
42		}
43		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
44		if len(components) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth {
45			return fmt.Errorf("pattern has %d components; maximum is %d", len(components), safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth)
46		}
47		for _, component := range components {
48			if localFileDependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)] {
49				return fmt.Errorf("pattern enters dependency directory %q", component)
50			}
51			if component == "**" {
52				continue
53			}
54			if strings.Contains(component, "**") {
55				return fmt.Errorf("'**' must occupy a complete path component")
56			}
57			placeholder := strings.NewReplacer("*", "x", "?", "x").Replace(component)
58			if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(placeholder, safefile.CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
59				return fmt.Errorf("component %q: %w", component, err)
60			}
61			for _, r := range component {
62				if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
63					return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a control character", component)
64				}
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}
69

75	func tomlQuote(value string) string {
76		quoted := "'"
77		for _, r := range value {
78			if r == '\'' {
79				quoted += "''"
80			} else {
81				quoted += string(r)
82			}
83		}
84		return quoted + "'"
85	}

188	// Execute runs the CLI and maps errors to exit codes. SilenceErrors and
189	// SilenceUsage are set on the root, so nothing reaches the terminal unless it
190	// is printed here; ExecuteC hands back the command that failed so a usage
191	// mistake can be answered with that command's usage rather than the root's.
192	func Execute() int {
193		sweepStaleUpgradeArtifacts()
194		root := NewRootCommand()
195		cmd, err := root.ExecuteC()
196		if err == nil {
197			return 0
198		}
199		style := styleForWriter(os.Stderr, colorModeFromArgs(os.Args[1:]))
200		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, style.danger("dev:")+" "+err.Error())
201		if cmd != nil && wantsUsage(err) {
202			fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, renderCobraHelp(cmd.UsageString(), style))
203		}
204		return 1
205	}

101	func (s *Service) resolveTarget(ctx context.Context, binding Binding) (targetCheckout, error) {
102		if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
103			return targetCheckout{}, err
104		}
105		options := repo.DefaultOptions()
106		if s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth > 0 {
107			options.MaxDepth = s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth
108		}
109		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, s.Config.DiscoveryRoots(), options)
110		if err != nil {
111			return targetCheckout{}, err
112		}
113		type candidate struct {
114			path      string
115			commonDir string
116		}
117		var candidates []candidate
118		for _, repository := range repositories {
119			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
120				continue
121			}
122			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
123			if err != nil {
124				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect discovered target repository: %w", err)
125			}
126			matched, err := checkoutHasIdentity(ctx, gitRepo.Root, binding.RemoteIdentity)
127			if err != nil {
128				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect target repository fetch identities: %w", err)
129			}
130			if !matched {
131				continue
132			}
133			candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: gitRepo.Root, commonDir: gitRepo.GitCommonDir})
134		}
135		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].commonDir < candidates[j].commonDir })
136		switch len(candidates) {
137		case 0:
138			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAbsent}
139		case 1:
140		default:
141			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAmbiguous}
142		}
143		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidates[0].path, binding.Branch)
144		if err != nil {
145			return targetCheckout{}, err
146		}
147		if !checkedOut || worktree.Bare || worktree.Prunable {
148			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetFetchedOnly}
149		}
150		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")

152			return targetCheckout{}, err
153		}

155		if err != nil {
156			return targetCheckout{}, err

135			return matches[0], nil
136		}
137		if len(matches) > 1 {

139		}
140		return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("repository %q is no longer discoverable", request.Name)
141	}

383	func syncFleetHosts(ctx context.Context, hosts []fleet.Host, maxParallel int, request fleet.SyncRequest) []fleet.SyncResult {
384		if maxParallel <= 0 {
385			maxParallel = 4
386		}
387		results := make([]fleet.SyncResult, len(hosts))
388		sem := make(chan struct{}, maxParallel)
389		var wg sync.WaitGroup
390		requestJSON, _ := json.Marshal(request)
391		for index, host := range hosts {
392			wg.Add(1)
393			go func(index int, host fleet.Host) {
394				defer wg.Done()
395				sem <- struct{}{}
396				defer func() { <-sem }()
397				transport := fleet.Transport{Err: os.Stderr}
398				response := transport.Run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_sync"}, requestJSON, false)
399				result := fleet.SyncResult{Host: host.Name, Branch: request.Branch, ExpectedOID: request.ExpectedOID}
400				switch {
401				case response.ExitCode == 0:
402					if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Stdout, &result); err != nil {
403						result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncFailed, "remote dev returned invalid sync JSON"
404					}
405					result.Host = host.Name
406				case response.TimedOut || response.ExitCode == 124:
407					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncTimeout, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
408				case response.ExitCode == 127:
409					result.State = fleet.SyncNoDev
410				case response.ExitCode == 255:
411					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncUnreachable, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
412				default:
413					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncIncompatible, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
414				}
415				results[index] = result
416			}(index, host)
417		}
418		wg.Wait()
419		return results
420	}

68	func ApplySync(ctx context.Context, cfg devconfig.Config, request SyncRequest) SyncResult {
69		result := SyncResult{Host: devconfig.Hostname(), Branch: request.Branch, ExpectedOID: request.ExpectedOID}
70		request.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(request.RemoteIdentity)
71		if request.RemoteIdentity == "" || request.Branch == "" || request.ExpectedOID == "" {
72			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, "sync request requires remote identity, branch and expected OID"
73			return result
74		}
75		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
76		if err != nil {
77			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
78			return result
79		}
80		var candidates []syncCandidate
81		for _, repository := range repositories {
82			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
83				continue
84			}
85			topology, topologyErr := gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
86			if topologyErr != nil {
87				continue
88			}
89			if remote := matchingRemoteAt(ctx, repository.Path, topology, request.RemoteIdentity); remote != "" {
90				candidates = append(candidates, syncCandidate{repository: repository, remote: remote})
91			}
92		}
93		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].repository.Path < candidates[j].repository.Path })
94		switch len(candidates) {
95		case 0:
96			result.State = SyncAbsent
97			return result
98		case 1:
99		default:
100			result.State = SyncAmbiguous
101			paths := make([]string, len(candidates))
102			for index, candidate := range candidates {
103				paths[index] = candidate.repository.Path
104			}
105			result.Error = "remote identity matches multiple clones: " + strings.Join(paths, ", ")
106			return result
107		}
108		candidate := candidates[0]
109		result.Repo, result.Path, result.Remote = candidate.repository.Display(), candidate.repository.Path, candidate.remote
110		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "fetch", "--prune", "--quiet", candidate.remote); err != nil {
111			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
112			return result
113		}
114		remoteRef := candidate.remote + "/" + request.Branch
115		remoteOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", remoteRef+"^{commit}")
116		if err != nil {
117			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, fmt.Sprintf("remote branch %s is unavailable after fetch: %v", remoteRef, err)
118			return result
119		}
120		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", request.ExpectedOID, remoteOID); err != nil {
121			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, "fetched remote branch does not contain the source commit"
122			return result
123		}
124		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, request.Branch)
125		if err != nil {
126			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
127			return result
128		}
129		if !checkedOut {
130			result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncFetched, remoteOID
131			return result
132		}
133		result.Path = worktree.Path
134		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
135		if err != nil {
136			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
137			return result
138		}
139		if status.Dirty() || status.Conflicted > 0 {
140			result.State, result.Error = SyncDirty, status.Summary()
141			return result
142		}
143		localOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
144		if err != nil {
145			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
146			return result
147		}
148		result.BeforeOID = localOID
149		if localOID == remoteOID {
150			result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncCurrent, localOID
151			return result
152		}
153		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", localOID, remoteOID); err != nil {
154			if _, aheadErr := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", remoteOID, localOID); aheadErr == nil {
155				result.State, result.Error = SyncAhead, "checked-out branch contains commits not on the fetched remote"
156			} else {

158			}

161		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge", "--ff-only", remoteRef); err != nil {
162			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()

165		after, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
166		if err != nil || after != remoteOID {
167			result.State = SyncFailed
168			result.Error = "fast-forward completed without reaching the fetched remote revision"
169			return result
170		}
171		result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncUpdated, after
172		return result

147			return errors.New("unsupported local-files apply protocol")

149		if err := e.Request.Validate(); err != nil {

163		}
164		seen := map[string]bool{}

172				return fmt.Errorf("unexpected apply payload for %q", payload.Path)

175			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)

177				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q is not canonical base64", payload.Path)

184			}
185			total += int64(len(decoded))
186		}

26	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
27		if s == nil {
28			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
29		}
30		if s.platform() == "windows" {
31			return ApplyResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
32		}
33		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
34		if err != nil {
35			return ApplyResponse{}, err
36		}
37		// This check intentionally precedes envelope validation. The hidden command
38		// performs the same capability check before reading stdin at all.
39		if id != envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine {
40			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
41		}
42		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
43			return ApplyResponse{}, err
44		}
45		authority := s.Authority
46		if authority == nil {
47			authority = lease.New("")
48		}
49		key := lease.BranchKey(envelope.Request.Binding.RemoteIdentity, envelope.Request.Binding.Branch)
50		var response ApplyResponse
51		err = authority.WithMutation(ctx, []lease.Key{key}, func() error {
52			var applyErr error
53			response, applyErr = s.applyUnderLease(ctx, envelope)
54			return applyErr
55		})
56		return response, err
57	}

218			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
219		}
220		value.Phase = phaseCompleted
221		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
222			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
223		}
224		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(envelope.RetainForEvict); err != nil {
225			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("local-files apply completed but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
226		}
227		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
228	}

230	func (s *Service) validateNegotiatedLimits(request PlanRequest) error {
231		host := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
232		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(host, request.Limits)
233		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
234			return errors.New("apply limits do not match target policy")
235		}
236		return nil
237	}

239	func preflightApply(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope) ([]preflightFile, error) {
240		payloads := map[string][]byte{}
241		for _, payload := range envelope.Payloads {
242			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
243			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
244				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode canonical payload for %q", payload.Path)
245			}
246			payloads[payload.Path] = decoded
247		}
248		files := make([]preflightFile, len(envelope.Request.Files))
249		for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
250			planned := envelope.Plan.Files[index]
251			if planned.Action == "" {
252				return nil, ErrPlanBlocked
253			}
254			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
255				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
256			}
257			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
258			if err != nil {
259				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
260			}
261			file := preflightFile{spec: spec, planned: planned, before: observed}
262			switch planned.Action {
263			case actionCurrent:
264				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
265					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q is no longer current: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
266				}
267				file.content = observed.data
268			case actionCreate:
269				if observed.exists {
270					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q appeared after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
271				}
272				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
273			case actionReplace:
274				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != planned.TargetSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
275					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed before replacement: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
276				}
277				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
278			default:
279				return nil, errors.New("invalid local-files target action")
280			}
281			if int64(len(file.content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(file.content) != spec.SHA256 {
282				return nil, fmt.Errorf("content for %q no longer matches the plan", spec.Path)
283			}
284			files[index] = file
285		}

12	// Cache is the on-disk forge inventory. It exists for UI latency, not as a
13	// source of truth: the REMOTE tab should open instantly, and r refreshes it.
14	type Cache struct {
15		Version   int                     `json:"version,omitempty"`
16		FetchedAt time.Time               `json:"fetched_at"`
17		Complete  bool                    `json:"complete,omitempty"`
18		Providers map[Kind]ProviderStatus `json:"providers,omitempty"`
19		Repos     []RemoteRepo            `json:"repos"`
20	}
21
22	const CacheVersion = 2
23
24	type ProviderStatus struct {
25		FetchedAt time.Time `json:"fetched_at,omitempty"`
26		Complete  bool      `json:"complete"`
27		Error     string    `json:"error,omitempty"`
28	}
29
30	// LoadCache returns only a fresh, complete cache. TUI callers that can label
31	// stale rows while refreshing use LoadCacheAny instead.
32	func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool) {
33		c, ok := LoadCacheAny(path)
34		if !ok || !c.Fresh(maxAge) {
35			return Cache{}, false
36		}
37		return c, true
38	}
39
40	// LoadCacheAny returns a cache regardless of age or completeness. This powers
41	// stale-while-revalidate UI behavior; callers must inspect Fresh/Complete.
42	func LoadCacheAny(path string) (Cache, bool) {
43		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return Cache{}, false
46		}
47		var c Cache
48		if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) != nil || c.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
49			return Cache{}, false
50		}
51		if c.Version == 0 {
52			// Version 1 caches were valid snapshots but capped per provider, so they
53			// are useful for instant display and must immediately be refreshed.
54			c.Complete = false
55		}
56		return c, true
57	}
58
59	func (c Cache) Fresh(maxAge time.Duration) bool {
60		if c.Version != CacheVersion || !c.Complete {
61			return false
62		}
63		if maxAge <= 0 {
64			return true
65		}
66		if len(c.Providers) == 0 {
67			return time.Since(c.FetchedAt) <= maxAge
68		}
69		for _, provider := range c.Providers {
70			if !provider.Complete || provider.Error != "" || provider.FetchedAt.IsZero() || time.Since(provider.FetchedAt) > maxAge {
71				return false
72			}
73		}
74		return true
75	}
76
77	// SaveCache atomically replaces the cache. A partial forge response may be
78	// cached — its FetchedAt still says exactly when it was observed.
79	func SaveCache(path string, repos []RemoteRepo) error {
80		now := time.Now().UTC()
81		providers := map[Kind]ProviderStatus{}
82		for _, repo := range repos {
83			providers[repo.Forge] = ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
84		}
85		return SaveCacheState(path, Cache{Version: CacheVersion, FetchedAt: now, Complete: true, Providers: providers, Repos: repos})
86	}
87
88	// SaveCacheState atomically replaces the versioned inventory cache.
89	func SaveCacheState(path string, cache Cache) error {
90		if path == "" {
91			return errors.New("empty cache path")
92		}
93		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
94			return err
95		}
96		if cache.Version == 0 {
97			cache.Version = CacheVersion
98		}
99		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
100			cache.FetchedAt = time.Now().UTC()
101		}
102		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(cache, "", "  ")
103		if err != nil {
104			return err
105		}
106		b = append(b, '\n')
107		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".remotes-*.tmp")
108		if err != nil {
109			return err
110		}
111		name := tmp.Name()
112		defer os.Remove(name)
113		if _, err := tmp.Write(b); err != nil {
114			tmp.Close()
115			return err
116		}
117		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
118			return err
119		}
120		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o600); err != nil {
121			return err
122		}
123		return os.Rename(name, path)
124	}
125
126	// CacheExists reports whether any cache file exists, even stale. Used only for
127	// diagnostics.
128	func CacheExists(path string) bool {
129		_, err := os.Stat(path)
130		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
131	}

4		"context"
5		"errors"

7		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/fleet"
8	)
9
10	var (
11		ErrNoRemoteDev     = errors.New("target does not provide a compatible dev protocol")
12		ErrUnreachable     = errors.New("target host is unreachable")
13		ErrRemoteTimeout   = errors.New("target protocol timed out")
14		ErrMachinePin      = errors.New("target machine ID does not match the configured host pin")
15		ErrMachineUnpinned = errors.New("mutating local-file apply requires host.machine_id")
16	)
17
18	type Runner interface {
19		RunWithOptions(context.Context, fleet.Host, []string, []byte, fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result
20	}
21
22	type Client struct{ Runner Runner }
23
24	func (c Client) run(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, maxResponse int64) ([]byte, error) {
25		if c.Runner == nil {
26			return nil, errors.New("local-files client has no fleet transport")
27		}
28		// Capability and plan are read-only. Apply is permanently bound to its
29		// request ID and plan digest by the target journal, so an authentication-only
30		// retry cannot duplicate an unbound mutation.
31		result := c.Runner.RunWithOptions(ctx, host, args, stdin, fleet.RunOptions{Retry: fleet.RetryAuthentication})
32		if int64(len(result.Stdout)) > maxResponse {
33			return nil, errors.New("target protocol response exceeded its bound")
34		}
35		if result.ExitCode == 0 && result.CaptureError == "" {
36			return result.Stdout, nil
37		}
38		switch {
39		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
40			return nil, ErrRemoteTimeout
41		case result.ExitCode == 127:
42			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
43		case result.ExitCode == 255:
44			return nil, ErrUnreachable
45		default:
46			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
47		}
48	}
49
50	// Identify performs the content-free capability exchange without enforcing the
51	// configured machine pin. It exists for explicit onboarding and diagnostics;
52	// mutating or payload-bearing callers must use Probe.
53	func (c Client) Identify(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
54		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
55		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
56		if err != nil {
57			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
58		}
59		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_capability"}, body, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
60		if err != nil {
61			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
62		}
63		var response fleet.CapabilityResponse
64		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes, &response); err != nil {
65			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
66		}
67		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
68			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
69		}
70		return response, nil
71	}
72
73	func (c Client) Probe(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
74		response, err := c.Identify(ctx, host)
75		if err != nil {
76			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
77		}
78		if host.MachineID != "" && host.MachineID != response.MachineID {
79			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
80		}
81		if !response.Supported {
82			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, errors.New("target does not support local-file payloads")
83		}
84		return response, nil
85	}
86
87	func (c Client) Plan(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
88		if capability.MachineID != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
89			return PlanResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
90		}
91		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
92			return PlanResponse{}, err
93		}
94		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
95		if err != nil {
96			return PlanResponse{}, err
97		}
98		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-plan"}, body, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
99		if err != nil {
100			return PlanResponse{}, err
101		}
102		var response PlanResponse
103		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes, &response); err != nil {
104			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
105		}
106		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
107			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
108		}
109		return response, nil
110	}
111
112	func (c Client) Apply(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
113		if host.MachineID == "" {
114			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachineUnpinned
115		}
116		if host.MachineID != capability.MachineID || envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine != capability.MachineID {
117			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
118		}
119		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
120			return ApplyResponse{}, err
121		}
122		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(envelope, MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes)
123		if err != nil {
124			return ApplyResponse{}, err
125		}
126		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-apply"}, body, MaxApplyResponseBytes)
127		if err != nil {
128			return ApplyResponse{}, err
129		}
130		var response ApplyResponse
131		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxApplyResponseBytes, &response); err != nil {
132			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
133		}
134		if err := response.Validate(envelope.Request, envelope.Plan); err != nil {
135			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
136		}
137		return response, nil
138	}

14	const (

16		administratorsSID = "S-1-5-32-544"
17	)
18
19	// setPrivateMode installs a protected DACL. Windows os.FileMode permission
20	// bits only model the read-only attribute and cannot establish privacy.
21	func setPrivateMode(path string, want fs.FileMode) error {
22		inheritance := ""
23		switch want.Perm() {
24		case 0o600:
25		case 0o700:
26			inheritance = "OICI"
27		default:
28			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported private Windows mode %04o", want.Perm())
29		}
30		current, _, err := privateSIDs()
31		if err != nil {
32			return err
33		}
34		ace := func(sid string) string {
35			return fmt.Sprintf("(A;%s;GA;;;%s)", inheritance, sid)
36		}
37		descriptor, err := windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString("D:P" + ace(current) + ace(localSystemSID) + ace(administratorsSID))
38		if err != nil {
39			return fmt.Errorf("build private Windows security descriptor: %w", err)
40		}
41		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
42		if err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("read private Windows DACL: %w", err)
44		}
45		if dacl == nil {
46			return fmt.Errorf("private Windows security descriptor has no DACL")
47		}
48		err = windows.SetNamedSecurityInfo(
49			path,
50			windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT,
51			windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
52			nil,
53			nil,
54			dacl,
55			nil,
56		)
57		runtime.KeepAlive(descriptor)
58		if err != nil {
59			return fmt.Errorf("set private Windows DACL: %w", err)
60		}
61		return nil
62	}
63
64	func privateModeMatches(path string, _ fs.FileMode, _ fs.FileMode) (bool, error) {
65		current, allowed, err := privateSIDs()
66		if err != nil {
67			return false, err
68		}
69		descriptor, err := windows.GetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
70		if err != nil {
71			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner and DACL: %w", err)
72		}
73		owner, _, err := descriptor.Owner()
74		if err != nil {
75			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner: %w", err)
76		}
77		if !privateSIDAllowed(owner, allowed) {
78			return false, nil
79		}
80		control, _, err := descriptor.Control()
81		if err != nil {
82			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows security descriptor control: %w", err)
83		}
84		if control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED == 0 {
85			return false, nil
86		}
87		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
88		if err != nil {
89			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL: %w", err)
90		}
91		if dacl == nil {
92			return false, nil
93		}
94		seenCurrent := false
95		for index := uint16(0); index < dacl.AceCount; index++ {
96			var ace *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
97			if err := windows.GetAce(dacl, uint32(index), &ace); err != nil {
98				return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL entry %d: %w", index, err)
99			}
100			switch ace.Header.AceType {
101			case windows.ACCESS_DENIED_ACE_TYPE:
102				continue
103			case windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE_TYPE:
104			default:
105				return false, nil
106			}
107			sid := (*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&ace.SidStart))
108			value := sid.String()
109			if _, ok := allowed[value]; !ok {
110				return false, nil
111			}
112			if value == current {
113				seenCurrent = true
114			}
115		}
116		return seenCurrent, nil
117	}
118
119	func privateSIDAllowed(sid *windows.SID, allowed map[string]struct{}) bool {
120		if sid == nil {
121			return false
122		}
123		_, ok := allowed[sid.String()]
124		return ok
125	}
126
127	func privateSIDs() (string, map[string]struct{}, error) {
128		user, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
129		if err != nil {
130			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("read current Windows user: %w", err)
131		}
132		current := user.User.Sid.String()
133		if current == "" {
134			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("current Windows user has an invalid SID")
135		}
136		return current, map[string]struct{}{
137			current:           {},
138			localSystemSID:    {},
139			administratorsSID: {},
140		}, nil
141	}
142
143	func replaceFile(source, destination string) error {
144		from, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(source)
145		if err != nil {
146			return err
147		}
148		to, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(destination)
149		if err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		return windows.MoveFileEx(from, to, windows.MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING|windows.MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)
153	}
154
155	// MoveFileEx with MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH durably publishes the replacement.
156	// Windows does not expose a portable directory fsync through os.File.
157	func syncDirectory(string) error { return nil }

The collector is serial for Git: each existing checkout executes `StatusOf` and then `LastCommit` inside one loop, yielding two Git processes per checkout plus one `git worktree list`. 50	// List implements Runtime. Zellij's short session list contains names only;
51	// dump-layout is its native read API for each session's root cwd.
52	func (z *Zellij) List(ctx context.Context) ([]Session, error) {
53		out, err := z.run(ctx, "list-sessions", "--short", "--no-formatting")
54		if err != nil {
55			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "No active zellij sessions found") ||
56				strings.Contains(err.Error(), "No active sessions") {
57				return nil, nil
58			}
59			return nil, err
60		}
61		var sessions []Session
62		for _, name := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
63			name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
64			if name == "" {
65				continue
66			}
67			layout, err := z.run(ctx, "--session", name, "action", "dump-layout")
68			if err != nil {
69				return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect zellij session %s: %w", name, err)
70			}
71			dirs := []string(nil)
72			if match := zellijLayoutCWD.FindStringSubmatch(layout); len(match) == 2 {
73				cwd := match[1]
74				if strings.HasPrefix(cwd, `"`) {
75					if decoded, err := strconv.Unquote(cwd); err == nil {
76						cwd = decoded
77					}
78				}
79				if cwd != "" {
80					dirs = []string{cwd}
81				}
82			}
83			sessions = append(sessions, Session{Handle: name, Label: name, Dirs: dirs})
84		}
85		return sessions, nil
86	}

238	func fleetFilesHost(cfg fleet.Config, name string) (fleet.Host, error) {
239		var selected *fleet.Host
240		for index := range cfg.Hosts {
241			if cfg.Hosts[index].Name == name {
242				if selected != nil {
243					return fleet.Host{}, errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one target")
244				}
245				copy := cfg.Hosts[index]
246				selected = &copy
247			}
248		}
249		if selected == nil {
250			return fleet.Host{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
251		}
252		return *selected, nil
253	}
254
255	func fleetFilePatterns(project projectconfig.Result, adHoc []string) []localfiles.Pattern {
256		var patterns []localfiles.Pattern
257		if project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include != nil {
258			source, _ := project.SourceFor("local_files.include")
259			for _, value := range *project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include {
260				patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: source})
261			}
262		}
263		for _, value := range adHoc {
264			patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: "--file"})
265		}
266		return patterns
267	}

271		if ref == "" {
272			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
273			if err != nil {
274				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
275			}
276			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
277			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
278				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
279			}
