114			return fmt.Errorf("unknown assessment outcome %q", o)
115		}
116	}
117
118	func (p Profile) Validate() error {
119		switch p {
120		case ProfileCheap, ProfileDeep:
121			return nil
122		default:
123			return fmt.Errorf("unknown assessment profile %q", p)
124		}
125	}
126
127	func (s Source) Validate() error {
128		if !identifierPattern.MatchString(s.ID) {
129			return fmt.Errorf("invalid evidence source id %q", s.ID)
130		}
131		switch s.Authority {
132		case AuthorityLocalLive, AuthorityRemoteLive, AuthorityDerivedLive, AuthorityCache:
133		default:
134			return fmt.Errorf("source %s has unknown authority %q", s.ID, s.Authority)
135		}
136		switch s.Freshness {
137		case FreshnessFresh, FreshnessStale, FreshnessUnknown:
138		default:
139			return fmt.Errorf("source %s has unknown freshness %q", s.ID, s.Freshness)
140		}
141		switch s.Completeness {
142		case CompletenessComplete, CompletenessPartial, CompletenessUnknown:
143		default:
144			return fmt.Errorf("source %s has unknown completeness %q", s.ID, s.Completeness)
145		}
146		if s.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
147			return fmt.Errorf("source %s observed_at is required", s.ID)
148		}
149		if !ValidFingerprint(s.Fingerprint) {
150			return fmt.Errorf("source %s has invalid fingerprint %q", s.ID, s.Fingerprint)
151		}
152		return nil
153	}
154
155	func (s Source) conclusive() bool {
156		if s.Freshness != FreshnessFresh || s.Completeness != CompletenessComplete {
157			return false
158		}
159		switch s.Authority {
160		case AuthorityLocalLive, AuthorityRemoteLive, AuthorityDerivedLive:
161			return true
162		default:
163			return false
164		}
165	}
166
167	func (r Reason) Validate() error {
168		if !identifierPattern.MatchString(r.Code) {
169			return fmt.Errorf("invalid reason code %q", r.Code)
170		}
171		if err := validateText("reason subject", r.Subject, true); err != nil {
172			return fmt.Errorf("reason %s: %w", r.Code, err)
173		}
174		if err := validateText("reason detail", r.Detail, true); err != nil {
175			return fmt.Errorf("reason %s: %w", r.Code, err)
176		}
177		if err := validateText("reason remediation", r.Remediation, false); err != nil {
178			return fmt.Errorf("reason %s: %w", r.Code, err)
179		}
180		return nil
181	}
182
183	func (g Gate) Validate(profile Profile) error {
184		if err := profile.Validate(); err != nil {
185			return err
186		}
187		if !identifierPattern.MatchString(g.Code) {
188			return fmt.Errorf("invalid gate code %q", g.Code)
189		}
190		if err := g.Outcome.Validate(); err != nil {
191			return fmt.Errorf("gate %s: %w", g.Code, err)
192		}
193		seenSources := make(map[string]struct{}, len(g.Sources))
194		for _, source := range g.Sources {
195			if err := source.Validate(); err != nil {
196				return fmt.Errorf("gate %s: %w", g.Code, err)
197			}
198			if _, exists := seenSources[source.ID]; exists {
199				return fmt.Errorf("gate %s repeats source %q", g.Code, source.ID)
200			}
201			seenSources[source.ID] = struct{}{}
202		}
203		for _, reason := range g.Reasons {
204			if err := reason.Validate(); err != nil {
205				return fmt.Errorf("gate %s: %w", g.Code, err)
206			}
207		}
208		if (g.Outcome == OutcomeEligible || g.Outcome == OutcomeBlocked) && len(g.Sources) == 0 {
209			return fmt.Errorf("gate %s outcome %s requires evidence", g.Code, g.Outcome)
210		}
211		if (g.Outcome == OutcomeBlocked || g.Outcome == OutcomeIndeterminate) && len(g.Reasons) == 0 {
212			return fmt.Errorf("gate %s outcome %s requires a reason", g.Code, g.Outcome)
213		}
214		if profile == ProfileDeep && (g.Outcome == OutcomeEligible || g.Outcome == OutcomeBlocked) {
215			for _, source := range g.Sources {
216				if !source.conclusive() {
217					return fmt.Errorf("gate %s has conclusive outcome %s from non-conclusive source %s", g.Code, g.Outcome, source.ID)
218				}
219			}
220		}
221		return nil
222	}
223
224	// NewReport constructs, canonicalizes, and seals a report.
225	func NewReport(profile Profile, generatedAt time.Time, gates []Gate) (Report, error) {
226		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Profile: profile, GeneratedAt: generatedAt, Gates: gates}
227		if err := report.Seal(); err != nil {
228			return Report{}, err
229		}
230		return report, nil
231	}
232
233	// Seal canonicalizes the report and records a fingerprint over every field
234	// except Fingerprint itself.
235	func (r *Report) Seal() error {
236		if r == nil {
237			return errors.New("seal nil assessment report")
238		}
239		if r.SchemaVersion == 0 {
240			r.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
241		}
242		canonical := r.Canonical()
243		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
244		if err := canonical.validateContent(); err != nil {
245			return err
246		}
247		fingerprint, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
248		if err != nil {
249			return err
250		}
251		canonical.Fingerprint = fingerprint
252		*r = canonical
253		return nil
254	}
255
256	// Validate verifies the schema, policy invariants, canonical fingerprint, and
257	// deterministic ordering of a sealed report.
258	func (r Report) Validate() error {
259		if err := r.validateContent(); err != nil {
260			return err
261		}
262		if !ValidFingerprint(r.Fingerprint) {
263			return fmt.Errorf("invalid report fingerprint %q", r.Fingerprint)
264		}
265		canonical := r.Canonical()
266		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
267		want, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		if r.Fingerprint != want {
272			return fmt.Errorf("assessment fingerprint mismatch: got %s, want %s", r.Fingerprint, want)
273		}
274		if !reportsEqualOrdering(r, r.Canonical()) {
275			return errors.New("assessment report is not in canonical order")
276		}
277		return nil
278	}
279
280	func (r Report) validateContent() error {
281		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
282			return fmt.Errorf("assessment schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
283		}
284		if err := r.Profile.Validate(); err != nil {
285			return err
286		}
287		if r.GeneratedAt.IsZero() {
288			return errors.New("assessment generated_at is required")
289		}
290		seenGates := make(map[string]struct{}, len(r.Gates))
291		for _, gate := range r.Gates {
292			if err := gate.Validate(r.Profile); err != nil {
293				return err
294			}
295			if _, exists := seenGates[gate.Code]; exists {
296				return fmt.Errorf("assessment repeats gate %q", gate.Code)
297			}
298			seenGates[gate.Code] = struct{}{}
299		}
300		return nil
301	}
302
303	// Canonical returns a deep copy with UTC timestamps and order-insensitive
304	// collections sorted by their complete stable representation.
305	func (r Report) Canonical() Report {
306		result := r
307		result.GeneratedAt = canonicalTime(result.GeneratedAt)
308		result.Gates = make([]Gate, len(r.Gates))
309		copy(result.Gates, r.Gates)
310		for gateIndex := range result.Gates {
311			gate := &result.Gates[gateIndex]
312			gate.Sources = append([]Source(nil), gate.Sources...)
313			for sourceIndex := range gate.Sources {
314				gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt = canonicalTime(gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt)
315			}
316			sort.Slice(gate.Sources, func(i, j int) bool {
317				left, right := gate.Sources[i], gate.Sources[j]
318				return strings.Join([]string{left.ID, string(left.Authority), string(left.Freshness), string(left.Completeness), left.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), left.Fingerprint}, "\x00") <
319					strings.Join([]string{right.ID, string(right.Authority), string(right.Freshness), string(right.Completeness), right.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), right.Fingerprint}, "\x00")
320			})
321			gate.Reasons = append([]Reason(nil), gate.Reasons...)
322			sort.Slice(gate.Reasons, func(i, j int) bool {
323				left, right := gate.Reasons[i], gate.Reasons[j]
324				return strings.Join([]string{left.Code, left.Subject, left.Detail, left.Remediation}, "\x00") <
325					strings.Join([]string{right.Code, right.Subject, right.Detail, right.Remediation}, "\x00")
326			})
327		}
328		sort.Slice(result.Gates, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Gates[i].Code < result.Gates[j].Code })
329		return result
330	}
331
332	func (r Report) computeFingerprint() (string, error) {
333		payload := struct {
334			SchemaVersion int       `json:"schema_version"`
335			Profile       Profile   `json:"profile"`
336			GeneratedAt   time.Time `json:"generated_at"`
337			Gates         []Gate    `json:"gates"`
338		}{r.SchemaVersion, r.Profile, r.GeneratedAt, r.Gates}
339		encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
340		if err != nil {
341			return "", fmt.Errorf("encode assessment fingerprint: %w", err)
342		}
343		return FingerprintBytes(encoded), nil
344	}
345
346	// Decode reads exactly one strict schema-v1 report and verifies its seal.
347	func Decode(reader io.Reader) (Report, error) {
348		if reader == nil {
349			return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment from nil reader")
350		}
351		decoder := json.NewDecoder(reader)
352		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
353		var report Report
354		if err := decoder.Decode(&report); err != nil {
355			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment: %w", err)
356		}
357		var extra any
358		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
359			if err == nil {
360				return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment: multiple JSON values")
361			}
362			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment trailing data: %w", err)
363		}
364		if err := report.Validate(); err != nil {
365			return Report{}, err
366		}
367		return report, nil
368	}
369
370	func FingerprintBytes(value []byte) string {
371		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
372		return fingerprintPrefix + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
373	}
374
375	func ValidFingerprint(value string) bool {
376		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix) || len(value) != len(fingerprintPrefix)+sha256.Size*2 {
377			return false
378		}
379		digest := strings.TrimPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix)
380		if digest != strings.ToLower(digest) {
381			return false
382		}
383		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(digest)
384		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size
385	}
386
387	func validateText(name, value string, required bool) error {
388		if value == "" {
389			if required {
390				return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
391			}
392			return nil
393		}
394		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
395			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
396		}
397		if value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
398			return fmt.Errorf("%s must be trimmed", name)
399		}
400		for _, char := range value {
401			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
402				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
403			}
404		}
405		return nil
406	}
407
408	func canonicalTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
409		if value.IsZero() {
410			return value
411		}
412		return value.Round(0).UTC()
413	}
414
415	func reportsEqualOrdering(left, right Report) bool {
416		leftJSON, leftErr := json.Marshal(left)
417		rightJSON, rightErr := json.Marshal(right)
418		return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && string(leftJSON) == string(rightJSON)
419	}

1	package assessment

3	import "fmt"

5	// ReduceOutcomes combines independent requirements using the fail-closed
6	// precedence blocked > indeterminate > eligible > not-applicable. No evidence
7	// is itself indeterminate.
8	func ReduceOutcomes(outcomes ...Outcome) Outcome {
9		if len(outcomes) == 0 {
10			return OutcomeIndeterminate
11		}
12		result := OutcomeNotApplicable
13		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
14			switch outcome {
15			case OutcomeBlocked:
16				return OutcomeBlocked
17			case OutcomeIndeterminate:
18				result = OutcomeIndeterminate
19			case OutcomeEligible:
20				if result == OutcomeNotApplicable {
21					result = OutcomeEligible
22				}
23			case OutcomeNotApplicable:
24			default:
25				return OutcomeIndeterminate
26			}
27		}
28		return result
29	}
30
31	// Reduce applies source-quality policy after reducing requirement outcomes.
32	// Cheap reports retain the observed result for display. Deep reports downgrade
33	// any conclusive result to indeterminate unless every relied-on source is fresh,
34	// complete, and backed by a live authority.
35	func Reduce(profile Profile, sources []Source, outcomes ...Outcome) (Outcome, error) {
36		if err := profile.Validate(); err != nil {
37			return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
38		}
39		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
40			if err := outcome.Validate(); err != nil {
41				return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
42			}
43		}
44		for _, source := range sources {
45			if err := source.Validate(); err != nil {
46				return OutcomeIndeterminate, fmt.Errorf("reduce assessment source: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		result := ReduceOutcomes(outcomes...)
50		if result == OutcomeNotApplicable || result == OutcomeIndeterminate {
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		if len(sources) == 0 {
54			return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
55		}
56		if profile == ProfileDeep {
57			for _, source := range sources {
58				if !source.conclusive() {
59					return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
60				}
61			}
62		}
63		return result, nil
64	}

301	// Build joins live local facts with optional external observations. It performs
302	// no probes and never places raw Git endpoints in the returned report.
303	func Build(input BuildInput) (Report, error) {
304		now := input.GeneratedAt
305		if now.IsZero() {
306			now = time.Now().UTC()
307		}
308		now = now.Round(0).UTC()
309
310		report := Report{
311			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion,
312			GeneratedAt:   now,
313			Repository: Repository{
314				Name: input.Context.Repo.Name, Display: input.Context.Repo.Display(),
315				Path: input.Context.Repo.Path, RealPath: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.RealPath),
316				CommonDir: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.CommonDir),
317				Bare:      input.Context.Repo.Bare, HasGit: input.Context.Repo.HasGit,
318			},
319			Sources:      []Source{},
320			Capabilities: []Capability{},
321			Remotes:      []Remote{},
322			Errors:       []CollectionError{},
323		}
324
325		report.Local = buildLocalFacts(input, &report.Errors)
326		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(report.Local.Checkouts) {
327			checkout := report.Local.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout]
328			report.SelectedCheckout = &CheckoutSelection{
329				Index: checkout.Index, Path: checkout.Path, Branch: checkout.Branch,
330				Canonical: checkout.Canonical, Ownership: checkout.Ownership,
331			}
332		} else {
333			message := "selected checkout is not present in the local checkout inventory"
334			if input.SelectionErr != nil {
335				message = cleanError(input.SelectionErr)
336			}
337			report.Errors = append(report.Errors, CollectionError{
338				Code: "selection-unavailable", Scope: "local", Subject: "selected-checkout", Message: message,
339			})
340		}
341
342		localIdentities := privateRemoteIdentities(input.Topology)
343		report.Remotes, report.Forge, report.Errors = buildRemoteFacts(now, input, report.Errors)
344		report.Fleet, report.Errors = buildFleetFacts(now, input.Fleet, localIdentities, report.Errors)
345
346		sources := buildSources(now, input, report)
347		report.Sources = sources
348		report.Capabilities = buildCapabilities(input, report)
349
350		readiness := AssessLocal(input.Context, input.SelectedCheckout, input.Hostname)
351		sourceMap := make(map[string]assessment.Source, len(sources))
352		for _, source := range sources {
353			sourceMap[source.ID] = source.assessmentSource()
354		}
355		gates := []assessment.Gate{
356			readinessGate("checkout-readiness", readiness.Checkout, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.checkout")),
357			readinessGate("task-readiness", readiness.Task, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.tasks", "local.runtime")),
358			readinessGate("worktree-readiness", readiness.Worktree, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.worktrees", "local.runtime")),
359			{
360				Code: "whole-clone-eviction", Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate,
361				Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{
362					Code: "recovery-proof-unavailable", Subject: "repository",
363					Detail:      "whole-clone eviction is not assessed by the context profile",
364					Remediation: "create and restore-verify a recovery receipt before eviction",
365				}},
366			},
367		}
368		assessmentReport, err := assessment.NewReport(assessment.ProfileCheap, now, gates)
369		if err != nil {
370			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("seal repository context assessment: %w", err)
371		}
372		report.Assessment = assessmentReport
373
374		sort.Slice(report.Errors, func(i, j int) bool {
375			left, right := report.Errors[i], report.Errors[j]
376			return strings.Join([]string{left.Scope, left.Code, left.Subject, left.Message}, "\x00") <
377				strings.Join([]string{right.Scope, right.Code, right.Subject, right.Message}, "\x00")
378		})
379		return report, nil
380	}
381
382	func buildLocalFacts(input BuildInput, reportErrors *[]CollectionError) LocalFacts {
383		context := input.Context
384		local := LocalFacts{
385			Checkouts:                          make([]CheckoutFacts, 0, len(context.Checkouts)),
386			OtherTasks:                         []TaskFacts{},
387			ObservedLinkedWorktreeAdminEntries: context.WorktreeCount,
388			CheckoutsComplete:                  context.WorktreeErr == nil,
389			TaskInventoryComplete:              context.TaskErr == nil,
390			Runtimes:                           []RuntimeFacts{},
391		}
392		if context.WorktreeErr == nil {
393			count := context.WorktreeCount
394			local.LinkedWorktreeCount = &count
395		} else {
396			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("worktree-inventory-failed", "local", "worktrees", context.WorktreeErr))
397		}
398		if context.TaskErr != nil {
399			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-inventory-failed", "local", "tasks", context.TaskErr))
400		}
401
402		for index, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
403			facts := CheckoutFacts{
404				Index: index, Path: checkout.Worktree.Path, Canonical: index == 0,
405				Ownership: checkout.Ownership, Locked: checkout.Worktree.Locked,
406				LockedReason:   optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)),
407				Prunable:       checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
408				PrunableReason: optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)),
409				Branch:         optionalString(checkout.Branch()), Head: optionalString(checkout.Worktree.Head),
410				LastActivity: optionalTime(checkout.LastActivity), LastCommit: optionalTime(checkout.LastCommit),
411				LastSubject: optionalString(checkout.LastSubject), Sessions: []RuntimeSession{}, Tasks: []TaskFacts{},
412			}
413			switch {
414			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
415				facts.State = "error"
416				facts.PathError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.PathErr))
417				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-path-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.PathErr))
418			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
419				facts.State = "missing"
420				exists := false
421				facts.Exists = &exists
422			case checkout.Worktree.Bare || index == 0 && context.Repo.Bare:
423				facts.State = "bare"
424				exists := true
425				facts.Exists = &exists
426				detached := false
427				facts.Detached = &detached
428			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
429				facts.State = "error"
430				exists := true
431				facts.Exists = &exists
432				facts.StatusError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.StatusErr))
433				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-status-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.StatusErr))
434			default:
435				facts.State = "available"
436				exists := true
437				facts.Exists = &exists
438				status := checkout.Status
439				facts.Status = &status
440				detached := checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached
441				facts.Detached = &detached
442			}
443			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
444				facts.Tasks = append(facts.Tasks, taskFacts(tracked))
445				if tracked != nil {
446					if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
447						*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
448					}
449				}
450			}
451			local.Checkouts = append(local.Checkouts, facts)
452		}
453		for _, tracked := range context.OtherTasks {
454			local.OtherTasks = append(local.OtherTasks, taskFacts(tracked))
455			if tracked != nil {
456				if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
457					*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
458				}
459			}
460		}
461
462		runtimes := input.Runtimes
463		if len(runtimes) == 0 && (context.Runtime != "" || context.RuntimeErr != nil || len(context.Sessions()) > 0) {
464			runtimes = []RuntimeInput{{
465				Backend: context.Runtime, Available: context.RuntimeErr == nil,
466				Sessions: context.Sessions(), Err: context.RuntimeErr,
467			}}
468		}
469		for runtimeIndex, observed := range runtimes {
470			backend := strings.TrimSpace(observed.Backend)
471			if backend == "" {
472				backend = fmt.Sprintf("unknown-%d", runtimeIndex+1)
473			}
474			runtimeFacts := RuntimeFacts{
475				Backend: backend, Available: observed.Available,
476				SourceID: "local.runtime", Sessions: []RuntimeSession{},
477			}
478			if observed.Err != nil {
479				runtimeFacts.Error = optionalString(cleanError(observed.Err))
480				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("runtime-inventory-failed", "local", "runtime:"+safeIdentifier(backend), observed.Err))
481			}
482			for _, session := range observed.Sessions {
483				indices := sessionCheckoutIndices(context, session)
484				if len(indices) == 0 {
485					continue
486				}
487				projected := RuntimeSession{
488					Backend: backend, Handle: session.Handle, Label: optionalString(session.Label),
489					AgentStatus:   optionalString(session.AgentStatus),
490					AgentSessions: append([]string{}, session.AgentSessions...),
491					Focused:       session.Focused, Checkouts: indices,
492				}
493				sort.Strings(projected.AgentSessions)
494				runtimeFacts.Sessions = append(runtimeFacts.Sessions, projected)
495				for _, checkoutIndex := range indices {
496					if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(local.Checkouts) {
497						local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions = append(local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions, projected)
498					}
499				}
500			}
501			sortRuntimeSessions(runtimeFacts.Sessions)
502			local.Runtimes = append(local.Runtimes, runtimeFacts)
503		}
504		sort.Slice(local.Runtimes, func(i, j int) bool { return local.Runtimes[i].Backend < local.Runtimes[j].Backend })
505		for index := range local.Checkouts {
506			sortRuntimeSessions(local.Checkouts[index].Sessions)
507		}
508		return local
509	}

511	func buildRemoteFacts(now time.Time, input BuildInput, reportErrors []CollectionError) ([]Remote, ForgeFacts, []CollectionError) {
512		forgeFacts := ForgeFacts{Error: optionalError(input.Forge.Err)}
513		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
514			sourceID := "forge.inventory"
515			forgeFacts.SourceID = &sourceID
516			records := len(input.Forge.Records)
517			forgeFacts.RecordsConsidered = &records
518			complete := input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete
519			forgeFacts.Complete = &complete
520		} else if input.Forge.Err != nil {
521			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-unavailable", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
522		}
523		if input.Forge.Err != nil && !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
524			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-partial", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
525		}
526		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
527			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("remote-topology-failed", "local", "remotes", input.TopologyErr))
528			if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
529				zero := 0
530				forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &zero
531			}
532			return []Remote{}, forgeFacts, reportErrors
533		}
534
535		recordsByIdentity := forgeRecordsByIdentity(input.Forge.Records)
536		currentUpstream := ""
537		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(input.Context.Checkouts) {
538			status := input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].Status
539			if input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].StatusErr == nil && status.Upstream != "" {
540				currentUpstream, _, _ = strings.Cut(status.Upstream, "/")
541			}
542		}
543		matchedRecords := map[string]struct{}{}
544		remotes := make([]Remote, 0, len(input.Topology.Remotes))
545		for _, observed := range input.Topology.Remotes {
546			remote := Remote{Name: observed.Name, Roles: remoteRoles(observed.Name, currentUpstream), Fetch: []RemoteEndpoint{}, Push: []RemoteEndpoint{}}
547			for index, raw := range observed.FetchURLs {
548				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
549				remote.Fetch = append(remote.Fetch, endpoint)
550				for _, key := range matched {
551					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
552				}
553				if endpointErr != nil {
554					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
555						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.fetch.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
556					})
557				}
558			}
559			for index, raw := range observed.PushURLs {
560				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
561				remote.Push = append(remote.Push, endpoint)
562				for _, key := range matched {
563					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
564				}
565				if endpointErr != nil {
566					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
567						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.push.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
568					})
569				}
570			}
571			remotes = append(remotes, remote)
572		}
573		if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
574			matches := len(matchedRecords)
575			forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &matches
576		}
577		return remotes, forgeFacts, reportErrors
578	}
579
580	type endpointBuildError struct {
581		Code    string
582		Message string
583	}
584
585	func buildRemoteEndpoint(raw string, records map[string][]forge.RemoteRepo, forgeAvailable, exactForge bool) (RemoteEndpoint, []string, *endpointBuildError) {
586		transport, displayIdentity, displayOK := publicEndpointIdentity(raw)
587		forgeMatch := "unavailable"
588		if forgeAvailable {
589			forgeMatch = "none"
590		}
591		endpoint := RemoteEndpoint{Transport: transport, Identity: optionalString(displayIdentity), ForgeMatch: forgeMatch}
592		privateIdentity := privateRemoteIdentity(raw)
593		if !displayOK {
594			message := "endpoint has no display-safe cross-host identity"
595			endpoint.Error = &message
596			return endpoint, nil, &endpointBuildError{Code: "remote-identity-unavailable", Message: message}
597		}
598
599		candidates := dedupeForgeRecords(records[privateIdentity])
600		var exact *forge.RemoteRepo
601		matched := []string{}
602		switch len(candidates) {
603		case 1:
604			if exactForge {
605				exact = &candidates[0]
606			}
607			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "exact"
608			matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidates[0]))
609		case 0:
610			if forgeAvailable {
611				endpoint.ForgeMatch = "none"
612			}
613		default:
614			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "ambiguous"
615			message := fmt.Sprintf("normalized endpoint identity matches %d forge records", len(candidates))
616			endpoint.Error = &message
617			for _, candidate := range candidates {
618				matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidate))
619			}
620			if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw}); ok {
621				endpoint.WebURL = &web
622			}
623			return endpoint, matched, &endpointBuildError{Code: "forge-match-ambiguous", Message: message}
624		}
625		if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw, Exact: exact}); ok {
626			endpoint.WebURL = &web
627		}
628		return endpoint, matched, nil
629	}

631	func buildFleetFacts(now time.Time, input FleetInput, localIdentities map[string]struct{}, reportErrors []CollectionError) (FleetFacts, []CollectionError) {
632		facts := FleetFacts{Coverage: FleetCoverageConfiguredHostsOnly, Hosts: []FleetHostObservation{}, Error: optionalError(input.Err)}
633		if !input.Configured {
634			if input.Err == nil {
635				facts.Error = optionalString("fleet configuration was not collected")
636			}
637			if facts.Error != nil {
638				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-config-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "configuration", Message: *facts.Error})
639			}
640			return facts, reportErrors
641		}
642		count := len(input.ConfiguredHostNames)
643		facts.ConfiguredHosts = &count
644		results := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
645		for _, result := range input.Results {
646			if _, exists := results[result.Name]; !exists {
647				results[result.Name] = result
648			}
649		}
650		for index, name := range input.ConfiguredHostNames {
651			result, found := results[name]
652			if !found {
653				result = fleet.HostResult{Name: name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "configured host produced no observation"}
654			}
655			host := FleetHostObservation{
656				Name: name, State: result.State, CachedAt: optionalTimeValue(result.CachedAt),
657				Match: FleetMatchUnavailable, Repositories: []FleetRepository{}, Error: optionalString(cleanText(result.Error)),
658			}
659			if result.Snapshot != nil {
660				matches := matchingFleetRepositories(result.Snapshot.Repositories, localIdentities)
661				for _, matched := range matches {
662					host.Repositories = append(host.Repositories, fleetRepositoryFacts(matched))
663				}
664				switch {
665				case len(localIdentities) == 0:
666					host.Match = FleetMatchUnavailable
667					if host.Error == nil {
668						host.Error = optionalString("local repository has no normalized remote identity")
669					}
670				case len(matches) == 0:
671					host.Match = FleetMatchNotFound
672				case len(matches) == 1:
673					host.Match = FleetMatchExact
674				default:
675					host.Match = FleetMatchAmbiguous
676					message := fmt.Sprintf("%d repositories on this host share a local normalized remote identity", len(matches))
677					if host.Error == nil {
678						host.Error = &message
679					}
680					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-match-ambiguous", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: message})
681				}
682
683				observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
684				if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
685					observedAt = *result.CachedAt
686				}
687				if !observedAt.IsZero() {
688					sourceID := fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index)
689					host.SourceID = &sourceID
690				}
691			}
692			if result.Error != "" || result.Snapshot == nil {
693				message := result.Error
694				if message == "" {
695					message = "host produced no repository snapshot"
696				}
697				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-host-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: cleanText(message)})
698			}
699			facts.Hosts = append(facts.Hosts, host)
700		}
701		return facts, reportErrors
702	}
703
704	func buildSources(now time.Time, input BuildInput, report Report) []Source {
705		sources := []Source{}
706		selectedFacts := any(nil)
707		checkoutCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessUnknown
708		if report.SelectedCheckout != nil {
709			selectedFacts = report.Local.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
710			checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessComplete
711			selected := input.Context.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
712			if selected.PathErr != nil || selected.StatusErr != nil {
713				checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
714			}
715		}
716		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.checkout", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, checkoutCompleteness, now, now, selectedFacts))
717
718		taskCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
719		if input.Context.TaskErr != nil {
720			taskCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
721		}
722		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.tasks", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, taskCompleteness, now, now, struct {
723			Checkouts  []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
724			OtherTasks []TaskFacts     `json:"other_tasks"`
725		}{report.Local.Checkouts, report.Local.OtherTasks}))
726
727		worktreeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
728		if input.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
729			worktreeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
730		}
731		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.worktrees", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, worktreeCompleteness, now, now, struct {
732			Count     *int            `json:"count"`
733			Checkouts []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
734		}{report.Local.LinkedWorktreeCount, report.Local.Checkouts}))
735
736		runtimeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
737		if len(report.Local.Runtimes) == 0 {
738			runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
739		}
740		for _, observed := range report.Local.Runtimes {
741			if observed.Error != nil {
742				runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
743			}
744		}
745		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.runtime", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, runtimeCompleteness, now, now, report.Local.Runtimes))
746
747		remoteCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
748		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
749			remoteCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
750		}
751		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.remotes", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, remoteCompleteness, now, now, report.Remotes))
752
753		if input.Fleet.Configured {
754			sources = append(sources, newSource("local.fleet-config", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, assessment.CompletenessComplete, now, now, input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames))
755		}
756		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
757			freshness := input.Forge.Freshness
758			if freshness == "" {
759				freshness = assessment.FreshnessUnknown
760			}
761			completeness := input.Forge.Completeness
762			if completeness == "" {
763				completeness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
764			}
765			sources = append(sources, newSource("forge.inventory", input.Forge.Authority, freshness, completeness, input.Forge.ObservedAt, now, struct {
766				Remotes []Remote   `json:"remotes"`
767				Forge   ForgeFacts `json:"forge"`
768			}{report.Remotes, report.Forge}))
769		}
770		resultByName := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
771		for _, result := range input.Fleet.Results {
772			resultByName[result.Name] = result
773		}
774		for index, name := range input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames {
775			result, ok := resultByName[name]
776			if !ok || result.Snapshot == nil || index >= len(report.Fleet.Hosts) {
777				continue
778			}
779			observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
780			if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
781				observedAt = *result.CachedAt
782			}
783			if observedAt.IsZero() {
784				continue
785			}
786			authority := assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive
787			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
788			if result.FromCache {
789				authority = assessment.AuthorityCache
790				if input.Fleet.CacheTTL > 0 && now.Sub(observedAt) > input.Fleet.CacheTTL {
791					freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
792				}
793			}
794			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
795			if result.Error != "" || result.State != fleet.HostOK && !result.FromCache {
796				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
797			}
798			sources = append(sources, newSource(fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index), authority, freshness, completeness, observedAt, now, report.Fleet.Hosts[index]))
799		}
800		sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool { return sources[i].ID < sources[j].ID })
801		return sources
802	}

969	func publicEndpointIdentity(raw string) (transport, identity string, ok bool) {
970		if !utf8.ValidString(raw) || containsControl(raw) {
971			return "unknown", "", false
972		}
973		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
974		if trimmed == "" {
975			return "unknown", "", false
976		}
977		redacted := trimmed
978		if parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
979			transport = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
980			parsed.User = nil
981			parsed.RawQuery = ""
982			parsed.ForceQuery = false
983			parsed.Fragment = ""
984			redacted = parsed.String()
985		} else {
986			if index := strings.IndexAny(redacted, "?#"); index >= 0 {
987				redacted = redacted[:index]
988			}
989			colon := strings.IndexByte(redacted, ':')
990			at := strings.LastIndexByte(redacted, '@')
991			if at >= 0 && colon > at {
992				transport = "ssh"
993				redacted = "git@" + redacted[at+1:]
994			} else if filepath.IsAbs(redacted) || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, "~") {
995				transport = "local"
996			} else {
997				transport = "unknown"
998			}
999		}
1000		identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(redacted)
1001		if identity == "" || containsControl(identity) {
1002			return transport, "", false
1003		}
1004		return transport, identity, true
1005	}

1118	// cleanText removes controls and structurally redacts URL/scp-like tokens while
1119	// preserving enough of an error to diagnose which probe failed.
1120	func cleanText(value string) string {
1121		value = strings.Map(func(r rune) rune {
1122			if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
1123				return ' '
1124			}
1125			return r
1126		}, value)
1127		fields := strings.Fields(value)
1128		for index, field := range fields {
1129			fields[index] = redactTextToken(field)
1130		}
1131		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(fields, " "))
1132	}
1133
1134	func redactTextToken(token string) string {
1135		prefix := strings.TrimLeft(token, "([{<\"'")
1136		leading := token[:len(token)-len(prefix)]
1137		core := strings.TrimRight(prefix, ")]}>\"',;.")
1138		trailing := prefix[len(core):]
1139		if parsed, err := url.Parse(core); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
1140			parsed.User = nil
1141			parsed.RawQuery = ""
1142			parsed.ForceQuery = false
1143			parsed.Fragment = ""
1144			return leading + parsed.String() + trailing
1145		}
1146		colon := strings.IndexByte(core, ':')
1147		at := strings.LastIndexByte(core, '@')
1148		if at > 0 && colon > at {
1149			core = "[redacted]@" + core[at+1:]
1150			if query := strings.IndexAny(core, "?#"); query >= 0 {
1151				core = core[:query]
1152			}
1153		}
1154		return leading + core + trailing
1155	}
1156
1157	func containsControl(value string) bool {
1158		return strings.IndexFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
1159			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
1160		}) >= 0
1161	}
1162
1163	func safeIdentifier(value string) string {
1164		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
1165		var b strings.Builder
1166		lastDash := false
1167		for _, r := range value {
1168			if r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' {
1169				b.WriteRune(r)
1170				lastDash = false
1171			} else if !lastDash {
1172				b.WriteByte('-')
1173				lastDash = true
1174			}
1175		}
1176		result := strings.Trim(b.String(), "-")
1177		if result == "" {
1178			return "unknown"
1179		}
1180		return result
1181	}

47	func assessCheckout(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
48		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
49			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the selected checkout is absent from the local inventory", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
50		}
51		checkout := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex]
52		switch {
53		case checkout.Worktree.Bare || context.Repo.Bare:
54			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
55		case checkout.PathErr != nil:
56			return indeterminate("checkout-path-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path could not be inspected", "restore path access and rerun context")
57		case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
58			return blocked("checkout-missing", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path is missing or prunable", "repair or remove the stale worktree registration")
59		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
60			return indeterminate("checkout-status-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "Git status could not be collected", "repair the checkout and rerun context")
61		case checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached || checkout.Branch() == "":
62			return blocked("checkout-detached", "selected-checkout", "the checkout does not have an attached branch", "check out an explicit branch")
63		case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
64			return blocked("checkout-conflicted", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d unmerged path(s)", checkout.Status.Conflicted), "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement")
65		case checkout.Status.Dirty():
66			return blocked("checkout-dirty", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d changed path(s)", checkout.Status.Changed), "commit or deliberately preserve the changes")
67		default:
68			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
69		}
70	}

72	func assessTasks(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) Readiness {
73		if context.TaskErr != nil {
74			return indeterminate("task-inventory-unavailable", "task-inventory", "task records could not be collected", "repair the task store and rerun context")
75		}
76		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
77			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "task scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
78		}
79		// Transfer/repository readiness covers every non-DONE task attached to the
80		// clone, including cold and branch-only records without a local checkout.
81		// Looking only at the selected checkout can otherwise hide another machine's
82		// ownership claim and incorrectly report not-applicable.
83		active := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(context.OtherTasks)+len(context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Tasks))
84		sessionCount := map[string]int{}

87			if candidate == nil || candidate.State == task.Done {
88				return
89			}
90			if _, exists := seen[candidate.ID]; exists {
91				return
92			}
93			seen[candidate.ID] = struct{}{}
94			active = append(active, candidate)
95			sessionCount[candidate.ID] = sessions
96		}
97		for _, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
98			for _, candidate := range checkout.Tasks {
99				add(candidate, len(checkout.Sessions))
100			}
101		}
102		for _, candidate := range context.OtherTasks {
103			add(candidate, 0)
104		}
105		if len(active) == 0 {
106			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
107		}
108		var reasons []assessment.Reason
109		hasIndeterminate := false
110		for _, candidate := range active {
111			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
112				hasIndeterminate = true
113				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{

115					Remediation: "repair or recreate the task record",

117				continue
118			}
119			if hostname != "" && candidate.Owner != "" && candidate.Owner != hostname {
120				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
121					Code: "task-owned-elsewhere", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task is owned by another machine",
122					Remediation: "complete an explicit ownership handoff before writing",
123				})
124			}
125			if candidate.State == task.Hot {
126				if context.RuntimeErr != nil {
127					hasIndeterminate = true
128					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
129						Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task cannot be checked against live runtime state",
130						Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
131					})
132				} else if sessionCount[candidate.ID] == 0 {
133					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
134						Code: "hot-task-runtime-missing", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task has no observed runtime session",
135						Remediation: "resume the task or reconcile its lifecycle state",
136					})
137				}
138			}
139		}
140		if hasReason(reasons, "task-owned-elsewhere") || hasReason(reasons, "hot-task-runtime-missing") {
141			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
142		}
143		if hasIndeterminate {
144			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
145		}
146		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
147	}
148
149	func assessWorktrees(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
150		if context.WorktreeErr != nil {
151			return indeterminate("worktree-inventory-unavailable", "worktrees", "linked worktrees could not be enumerated", "repair Git worktree metadata and rerun context")
152		}
153		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
154			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "worktree scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
155		}
156		indices := []int{}
157		if selectedIndex > 0 {
158			indices = append(indices, selectedIndex)
159		} else {
160			for index := 1; index < len(context.Checkouts); index++ {
161				indices = append(indices, index)
162			}
163		}
164		if len(indices) == 0 {
165			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
166		}
167		var reasons []assessment.Reason
168		hasUnknown := context.RuntimeErr != nil
169		if hasUnknown {
170			reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
171				Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "worktrees",
172				Detail:      "worktree runtime coverage could not be collected",
173				Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
174			})
175		}
176		for _, index := range indices {
177			checkout := context.Checkouts[index]
178			subject := fmt.Sprintf("worktree:%d", index)
179			switch {
180			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
181				hasUnknown = true
182				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-path-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path could not be inspected", Remediation: "restore path access and rerun context"})
183			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
184				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-missing", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path is missing or prunable", Remediation: "repair or remove the stale worktree registration"})
185			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
186				hasUnknown = true
187				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-status-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "Git status could not be collected for the worktree", Remediation: "repair the worktree and rerun context"})
188			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
189				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-locked", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree is locked", Remediation: "verify the lock owner before unlocking it"})
190			case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
191				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-conflicted", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree has unmerged paths", Remediation: "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement"})
192			case checkout.Status.Dirty():
193				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-dirty", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree contains uncommitted changes", Remediation: "commit or deliberately preserve the changes"})
194			case len(checkout.Sessions) > 0:
195				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-runtime-live", Subject: subject, Detail: "a runtime session still covers the worktree", Remediation: "quiesce and close the runtime before retirement"})
196			}
197		}
198		if len(reasons) == 0 {
199			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
200		}
201		if hasKnownBlocker(reasons) {
202			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
203		}
204		if hasUnknown {
205			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
206		}
207		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
208	}
209
210	func blocked(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
211		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
212	}
213
214	func indeterminate(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
215		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
216	}
217
218	func hasReason(reasons []assessment.Reason, code string) bool {
219		for _, reason := range reasons {
220			if reason.Code == code {
221				return true
222			}
223		}
224		return false
225	}
226
227	func hasKnownBlocker(reasons []assessment.Reason) bool {
228		for _, reason := range reasons {
229			switch reason.Code {
230			case "worktree-missing", "worktree-locked", "worktree-conflicted", "worktree-dirty", "worktree-runtime-live":
231				return true
232			}
233		}
234		return false
235	}

25	func newRepoContextCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
26		var jsonOut, refresh bool
27		cmd := &cobra.Command{
28			Use:   "context [repo]",
29			Short: "Print agent-ready Git, worktree, runtime and task context",
30			Long: `Print a deterministic Markdown handoff or a versioned JSON report for one repository.
31
32	Local Git, task and runtime facts are always collected live. Forge and configured
33	fleet-host observations use their private caches by default and expose provenance,
34	age and collection errors; --refresh may contact forge providers and fleet hosts.
35	With no repository argument, the repository containing the current directory is
36	used, and a linked-worktree current directory remains the selected checkout while
37	the report still covers the whole clone.`,
38			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
39			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
40				ctx := ctxOf()
41				repository, selectedPath, err := resolveRepoContextTarget(ctx, app, args)
42				if err != nil {
43					return err
44				}
45				local := collectLocalRepoContext(ctx, app, repository, selectedPath, true)
46				now := time.Now().UTC()
47				forgeFacts := collectRepoContextForge(ctx, app, refresh, now)
48				fleetFacts := collectRepoContextFleet(ctx, app, refresh)
49				report, err := repocontext.Build(repocontext.BuildInput{
50					GeneratedAt: now, Context: local.Context,
51					SelectedCheckout: local.SelectedCheckout, SelectionErr: local.SelectionErr,
52					Topology: local.Topology, TopologyErr: local.TopologyErr,
53					Runtimes: local.Runtimes, Forge: forgeFacts, Fleet: fleetFacts,
54					Hostname: config.Hostname(),
55				})
56				if err != nil {
57					return err
58				}
59				if jsonOut {
60					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
61					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
62					return encoder.Encode(report)
63				}
64				legacy := inventory.FormatRepoContext(local.Context, -1)
65				fmt.Fprint(app.Out, repocontext.FormatMarkdown(report, legacy))
66				return nil
67			},
68		}
69		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit the additive schema-v1 JSON report")
70		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&refresh, "refresh", false, "refresh external forge and configured fleet observations")
71		return cmd
72	}

111			}},
112			SelectedCheckout: -1,
113		}
114		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
115		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
116		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
117			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
118		} else {
119			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
120		}
121		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
122			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
123		}
124		return local
125	}

1498		snapshot := collector.snapshot
1499		sort.Slice(snapshot.Refs, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Refs[i].Name < snapshot.Refs[j].Name })
1500		for index := range snapshot.Worktrees {
1501			worktree := &snapshot.Worktrees[index]

1503			sort.Slice(worktree.IndexEntries, func(i, j int) bool {

1510			sort.Strings(worktree.UntrackedPaths)
1511			sort.Strings(worktree.IgnoredPaths)
1512			sort.Slice(worktree.LFSPaths, func(i, j int) bool { return worktree.LFSPaths[i].Path < worktree.LFSPaths[j].Path })
1513			sort.Slice(worktree.Submodules, func(i, j int) bool {

1516				}

1536	func recoveryGit(ctx context.Context, dir string, input []byte, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
1537		if cause := context.Cause(ctx); cause != nil {
1538			return nil, cause
1539		}
1540		full := append([]string{"-c", "core.quotepath=false"}, args...)
1541		command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", full...)
1542		command.Dir = dir
1543		command.Env = recoveryEnvironment()
1544		if input != nil {
1545			command.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(input)
1546		}
1547		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
1548		command.Stdout = &stdout
1549		command.Stderr = &stderr
1550		if err := command.Run(); err != nil {
1551			if cause := context.Cause(ctx); cause != nil {
1552				return stdout.Bytes(), cause
1553			}
1554			return stdout.Bytes(), &Error{Args: args, Dir: dir, Stderr: stderr.String(), Err: err}
1555		}
1556		return stdout.Bytes(), nil
1557	}
1558
1559	func recoveryEnvironment() []string {
1560		environment := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+1)
1561		for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
1562			key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
1563			if key != "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS" {
1564				environment = append(environment, entry)
1565			}
1566		}
1567		return append(environment, "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0")
1568	}

14		// CompiledMaxFileBytes is the maximum size of one portable file.
15		CompiledMaxFileBytes int64 = 8 << 20
16		// CompiledMaxTotalBytes is the maximum aggregate portable payload size.
17		CompiledMaxTotalBytes int64 = 32 << 20
18		// CompiledMaxPathBytes bounds a slash-separated portable relative path.
19		CompiledMaxPathBytes = 4096
20		// CompiledMaxComponentBytes bounds one portable path component.
21		CompiledMaxComponentBytes = 255
22		// CompiledMaxPathDepth bounds portable path nesting.
23		CompiledMaxPathDepth = 64

29		// ErrManifestLimit reports a manifest that exceeds its validated policy.
30		ErrManifestLimit = errors.New("safe-file manifest limit exceeded")
31		// ErrDuplicatePath reports the same exact portable path more than once.
32		ErrDuplicatePath = errors.New("duplicate safe-file path")
33	)

35	// Limits is the reusable compiled policy for portable file manifests. Every
36	// field is required and must be no greater than the corresponding compiled
37	// ceiling, allowing host configuration to lower limits without weakening them.
38	type Limits struct {
39		MaxFiles          int
40		MaxFileBytes      int64
41		MaxTotalBytes     int64
42		MaxPathBytes      int
43		MaxComponentBytes int
44		MaxPathDepth      int
45	}
46
47	// DefaultLimits returns the maximum policy supported by this binary.
48	func DefaultLimits() Limits {
49		return Limits{
50			MaxFiles:          CompiledMaxFiles,
51			MaxFileBytes:      CompiledMaxFileBytes,
52			MaxTotalBytes:     CompiledMaxTotalBytes,
53			MaxPathBytes:      CompiledMaxPathBytes,
54			MaxComponentBytes: CompiledMaxComponentBytes,
55			MaxPathDepth:      CompiledMaxPathDepth,
56		}
57	}
58
59	// Validate rejects incomplete policy and values above the compiled ceilings.
60	func (limits Limits) Validate() error {
61		maximum := DefaultLimits()
62		switch {
63		case limits.MaxFiles <= 0 || limits.MaxFiles > maximum.MaxFiles:
64			return fmt.Errorf("max files %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxFiles, maximum.MaxFiles, ErrInvalidLimits)

74			return fmt.Errorf("max path depth %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxPathDepth, maximum.MaxPathDepth, ErrInvalidLimits)
75		default:
76			return nil
77		}

133			}

138			}

142			case "push":

154			sort.Strings(remote.FetchURLs)
155			sort.Strings(remote.PushURLs)

25		SyncCurrent      SyncState = "already-current"
26		SyncFetched      SyncState = "fetched-only"
27		SyncAbsent       SyncState = "absent"
28		SyncNoDev        SyncState = "no-dev"
29		SyncUnreachable  SyncState = "unreachable"
30		SyncTimeout      SyncState = "timeout"
31		SyncDirty        SyncState = "blocked-dirty"
32		SyncAhead        SyncState = "blocked-ahead"
33		SyncDiverged     SyncState = "blocked-diverged"
34		SyncAmbiguous    SyncState = "ambiguous"

52	func (r SyncResult) Ignored() bool { return r.State == SyncAbsent || r.State == SyncNoDev }
53
54	func (r SyncResult) Success() bool {
55		switch r.State {
56		case SyncUpdated, SyncCurrent, SyncFetched, SyncAbsent, SyncNoDev:
57			return true
58		default:
59			return false
60		}
61	}

66	}

68	func ApplySync(ctx context.Context, cfg devconfig.Config, request SyncRequest) SyncResult {
69		result := SyncResult{Host: devconfig.Hostname(), Branch: request.Branch, ExpectedOID: request.ExpectedOID}
70		request.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(request.RemoteIdentity)
71		if request.RemoteIdentity == "" || request.Branch == "" || request.ExpectedOID == "" {
72			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, "sync request requires remote identity, branch and expected OID"
73			return result
74		}
75		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
76		if err != nil {
77			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
78			return result
79		}
80		var candidates []syncCandidate
81		for _, repository := range repositories {
82			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
83				continue
84			}
85			topology, topologyErr := gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
86			if topologyErr != nil {
87				continue
88			}
89			if remote := matchingRemoteAt(ctx, repository.Path, topology, request.RemoteIdentity); remote != "" {
90				candidates = append(candidates, syncCandidate{repository: repository, remote: remote})
91			}
92		}
93		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].repository.Path < candidates[j].repository.Path })
94		switch len(candidates) {
95		case 0:
96			result.State = SyncAbsent
97			return result
98		case 1:
99		default:
100			result.State = SyncAmbiguous
101			paths := make([]string, len(candidates))
102			for index, candidate := range candidates {
103				paths[index] = candidate.repository.Path
104			}
105			result.Error = "remote identity matches multiple clones: " + strings.Join(paths, ", ")
106			return result
107		}
108		candidate := candidates[0]
109		result.Repo, result.Path, result.Remote = candidate.repository.Display(), candidate.repository.Path, candidate.remote
110		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "fetch", "--prune", "--quiet", candidate.remote); err != nil {
111			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
112			return result
113		}
114		remoteRef := candidate.remote + "/" + request.Branch
115		remoteOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", remoteRef+"^{commit}")
116		if err != nil {
117			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, fmt.Sprintf("remote branch %s is unavailable after fetch: %v", remoteRef, err)
118			return result
119		}
120		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", request.ExpectedOID, remoteOID); err != nil {
121			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, "fetched remote branch does not contain the source commit"
122			return result
123		}
124		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, request.Branch)
125		if err != nil {
126			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
127			return result
128		}
129		if !checkedOut {
130			result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncFetched, remoteOID
131			return result
132		}
133		result.Path = worktree.Path
134		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
135		if err != nil {
136			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
137			return result
138		}
139		if status.Dirty() || status.Conflicted > 0 {
140			result.State, result.Error = SyncDirty, status.Summary()
141			return result
142		}
143		localOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
144		if err != nil {
145			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
146			return result
147		}
148		result.BeforeOID = localOID
149		if localOID == remoteOID {
150			result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncCurrent, localOID
151			return result
152		}
153		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", localOID, remoteOID); err != nil {
154			if _, aheadErr := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", remoteOID, localOID); aheadErr == nil {
155				result.State, result.Error = SyncAhead, "checked-out branch contains commits not on the fetched remote"
156			} else {
157				result.State, result.Error = SyncDiverged, "checked-out branch diverged; rebase or merge manually"
158			}
159			return result
160		}
161		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge", "--ff-only", remoteRef); err != nil {
162			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
163			return result
164		}
165		after, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
166		if err != nil || after != remoteOID {
167			result.State = SyncFailed
168			result.Error = "fast-forward completed without reaching the fetched remote revision"
169			return result
170		}
171		result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncUpdated, after
172		return result
173	}

175	func matchingRemote(topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) string {
176		var names []string
177		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
178			matched := false
179			for _, raw := range append(append([]string{}, remote.FetchURLs...), remote.PushURLs...) {
180				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == identity {
181					matched = true
182					break
183				}
184			}
185			if matched {
186				names = append(names, remote.Name)
187			}
188		}
189		sort.Strings(names)
190		if len(names) == 0 {
191			return ""
192		}
193		return names[0]
194	}
195
196	func matchingRemoteAt(ctx context.Context, path string, topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) string {
197		var names []string
198		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
199			matched := false
200			for _, key := range []string{"remote." + remote.Name + ".url", "remote." + remote.Name + ".pushurl"} {
201				raw, err := gitx.Run(ctx, path, "config", "--get-all", key)
202				if err != nil {
203					continue
204				}
205				for _, value := range strings.Split(raw, "\n") {
206					if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(value) == identity {
207						matched = true
208						break
209					}
210				}
211				if matched {
212					break
213				}
214			}
215			if matched {
216				names = append(names, remote.Name)
217			}
218		}
219		if len(names) == 0 {
220			return matchingRemote(topology, identity)
221		}
222		sort.Strings(names)
223		return names[0]
224	}

321	func prepareFleetSync(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref, requestedRemote string, push bool) (fleet.SyncRequest, fleet.SyncResult, error) {
322		repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
323		if err != nil {
324			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
325		}
326		if repository.Bare {
327			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%s is bare and has no checkout to publish", repository.Display())
328		}
329		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Path)
330		if err != nil {
331			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
332		}
333		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
334			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, errors.New("fleet sync requires an attached branch")
335		}
336		if status.Dirty() || status.Conflicted > 0 {
337			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("source checkout must be clean (%s)", status.Summary())
338		}
339		remote := requestedRemote
340		if remote == "" && status.Upstream != "" {
341			remote, _, _ = strings.Cut(status.Upstream, "/")
342		}
343		if remote == "" {
344			remote = "origin"
345		}
346		remoteURL := gitx.Remote(ctx, repository.Path, remote)
347		identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(remoteURL)
348		if identity == "" {
349			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("remote %q has no cross-host identity", remote)
350		}
351		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "fetch", "--prune", "--quiet", remote); err != nil {
352			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
353		}
354		if push {
355			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "push", "--set-upstream", remote, status.Branch); err != nil {
356				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", status.Branch, err)
357			}
358		} else {
359			remoteOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", remote+"/"+status.Branch+"^{commit}")
360			if err != nil {
361				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("fetched %s/%s is unavailable", remote, status.Branch)
362			}
363			head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
364			if err != nil {
365				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
366			}
367			if head != remoteOID {
368				return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, fmt.Errorf("source HEAD does not equal %s/%s after fetch; push or reconcile it first", remote, status.Branch)
369			}
370		}
371		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
372		if err != nil {
373			return fleet.SyncRequest{}, fleet.SyncResult{}, err
374		}
375		request := fleet.SyncRequest{RemoteIdentity: identity, Branch: status.Branch, ExpectedOID: head}
376		source := fleet.SyncResult{
377			Host: config.Hostname(), State: fleet.SyncCurrent, Repo: repository.Display(), Path: repository.Path,
378			Branch: status.Branch, Remote: remote, BeforeOID: head, AfterOID: head, ExpectedOID: head,
379		}
380		return request, source, nil
381	}

383	func syncFleetHosts(ctx context.Context, hosts []fleet.Host, maxParallel int, request fleet.SyncRequest) []fleet.SyncResult {
384		if maxParallel <= 0 {
385			maxParallel = 4
386		}
387		results := make([]fleet.SyncResult, len(hosts))
388		sem := make(chan struct{}, maxParallel)
389		var wg sync.WaitGroup
390		requestJSON, _ := json.Marshal(request)
391		for index, host := range hosts {
392			wg.Add(1)
393			go func(index int, host fleet.Host) {
394				defer wg.Done()
395				sem <- struct{}{}
396				defer func() { <-sem }()
397				transport := fleet.Transport{Err: os.Stderr}
398				response := transport.Run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_sync"}, requestJSON, false)
399				result := fleet.SyncResult{Host: host.Name, Branch: request.Branch, ExpectedOID: request.ExpectedOID}
400				switch {
401				case response.ExitCode == 0:
402					if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Stdout, &result); err != nil {
403						result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncFailed, "remote dev returned invalid sync JSON"
404					}
405					result.Host = host.Name
406				case response.TimedOut || response.ExitCode == 124:
407					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncTimeout, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
408				case response.ExitCode == 127:
409					result.State = fleet.SyncNoDev
410				case response.ExitCode == 255:
411					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncUnreachable, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
412				default:
413					result.State, result.Error = fleet.SyncIncompatible, strings.TrimSpace(string(response.Stderr))
414				}
415				results[index] = result
416			}(index, host)
417		}
418		wg.Wait()
419		return results
420	}
421
422	func renderFleetSync(app *App, source fleet.SyncResult, targets []fleet.SyncResult) {
423		style := app.outStyle()
424		table := app.newTable("HOST", "STATE", "REPO", "BRANCH", "PATH", "DETAIL")
425		table.Add(source.Host, style.hostState(string(source.State)), source.Repo, source.Branch, config.Contract(source.Path), style.dim("source"))
426		for _, result := range targets {
427			table.Add(result.Host, style.hostState(string(result.State)), dash(result.Repo), dash(result.Branch),
428				config.Contract(result.Path), style.warning(truncate(result.Error, 64)))
429		}
430		table.Render(app.Out)
431	}
432

434		cfg, err := fleet.LoadConfig(app.remotesPath)

16	func newParkCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
17		var (
18			next            string
19			note            string
20			wip             bool
21			push            bool
22			cold            bool
23			keepRT          bool
24			closeUnknown    bool
25			assumeNoRuntime bool
26			timeout         time.Duration
27		)
28		cmd := &cobra.Command{
29			Use:   "park [task]",
30			Short: "Stop working on a task without losing the thread",
31			Long: `Park the current task (or the one named) so its runtime session can close.
32
33	Parking is the missing move that makes a crowded sidebar shrink. It records
34	what to do next, optionally checkpoints uncommitted work, and closes the
35	runtime session — while leaving the branch and the worktree exactly where they
36	are. Closing a session is not abandoning a task.
37
38	  warm (default)  worktree and branch stay; session closes. Back within days.
39	  cold (--cold)   work is committed and pushed, session closed, worktree
40	                  removed. Reconstruct it anywhere later with dev resume.
41
42	--cold and --keep-session are incompatible: a runtime cannot stay pointed at a
43	checkout that cold parking removes.
44
45	A checkpoint commit is preferred over git stash: a stash is invisible in the
46	log, easy to forget, and cannot be pushed — so it can never reach another
47	machine, which is exactly what parking needs to support.`,
48			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
49			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
50				ctx := ctxOf()
51				if cold && keepRT {
52					return fmt.Errorf("--cold and --keep-session cannot be combined: a session must not remain pointed at a removed checkout")
53				}
54				t, err := resolveTask(app, args)
55				if err != nil {
56					return err
57				}
58
59				mode := t.EffectiveMode()
60				if cold && mode == task.ModeDirect {
61					return fmt.Errorf("direct task %s uses the canonical checkout on %s, so it cannot go cold; "+
62						"park it warm or finish it", t.Title(), t.Branch)
63				}
64				target := task.Warm
65				if cold {
66					target = task.Cold
67				}
68				checkout := checkoutOf(t)
69
70				if next != "" {
71					t.Next = next
72				}
73				if note != "" {
74					t.Note = note
75				}
76				if t.Next == "" {
77					app.warnf("no next action recorded — `dev park --next \"...\"` is what makes resuming cheap")
78				}
79
80				// Checkpoint before anything is closed or removed.
81				if _, statErr := os.Stat(checkout); statErr == nil {
82					st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
83					if err != nil {
84						return err
85					}
86					switch {
87					case wip && st.Dirty():
88						msg := "wip: checkpoint"
89						if t.Next != "" {
90							msg = "wip: checkpoint — " + t.Next
91						}
92						made, err := gitx.WipCommit(ctx, checkout, msg)
93						if err != nil {
94							return err
95						}
96						if made {
97							fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", app.outStyle().label("committed"), msg)
98						}
99					case st.Dirty() && cold:
100						return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes; going cold removes the worktree.\n"+
101							"Commit them, or re-run with --wip to checkpoint automatically",
102							config.Contract(checkout))
103					case st.Dirty():
104						app.warnf("%s has uncommitted changes (kept in place; --wip checkpoints them)",
105							config.Contract(checkout))
106					}
107
108					if push {
109						if err := pushBranch(ctx, app, checkout, t.Branch); err != nil {
110							return err
111						}
112					}
113					if cold {
114						st, err = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
115						if err != nil {
116							return err
117						}
118						if !st.Published() || st.Ahead > 0 {
119							return fmt.Errorf("%s is not fully pushed (%s); a cold task must be reconstructible "+
120								"from the remote.\nRun `dev park --cold --push`", t.Branch, st.Summary())
121						}
122					}
123				}
124
125				rt := runtimeForTask(app, t)
126				if cold && t.WorktreePath != "" {
127					if err := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, t.WorktreePath); err != nil {
128						return err
129					}
130					if err := safeRemoveWorktree(ctx, rt, t.RepoPath, t.WorktreePath, false,
131						closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, timeout); err != nil {
132						return err
133					}
134					// The path is cleared, but the branch stays: that is what makes
135					// the task reconstructible rather than lost.
136					t.WorktreePath = ""
137					clearTaskRuntime(t)
138				} else if !keepRT && t.RuntimeHandle != "" {
139					inspection, inspectErr := retirement.Inspect(ctx, rt, checkout, retirement.Options{})
140					if inspectErr != nil {
141						return inspectErr
142					}
143					if inspection.CallerContained {
144						app.warnf("runtime left active because the caller is inside it; exit normally, then let sweep reconcile")
145					} else {
146						closed, closeErr := retirement.CloseAndWait(ctx, rt, checkout, retirement.Options{
147							CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
148						})
149						if closeErr != nil {
150							return closeErr
151						}
152						if closed.ClosedSessions > 0 {
153							fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %d %s session(s)\n", app.outStyle().label("closed"), closed.ClosedSessions, rt.Name())
154						}
155						clearTaskRuntime(t)
156					}
157				}
158				if cold && mode == task.ModeBranch {
159					// Free the canonical checkout for other work. The branch remains
160					// local + remote and resume switches back to it.
161					base := t.Base
162					if base == "" {

164					}
165					if base == "" {
166						return fmt.Errorf("task is pushed, but its base branch is unknown")
167					}
168					if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, t.RepoPath, "switch", base); err != nil {
169						return fmt.Errorf("task is pushed, but could not switch canonical checkout back to %s: %w",
170							base, err)
171					}
172				}
173
174				t.State = target
175				t.Owner = config.Hostname()
176				if err := app.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
177					return err
178				}
179				style := app.outStyle()
180				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s is %s", target.Icon(), t.Title(), style.taskStateFor(string(target), target.Label()))
181				if t.Next != "" {
182					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, " — %s %s", style.label("next:"), t.Next)
183				}
184				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out)
185				return nil
186			},
187		}
188		f := cmd.Flags()
189		f.StringVarP(&next, "next", "n", "", "what to do when you come back")
190		f.StringVar(&note, "note", "", "free-form note")
191		f.BoolVar(&wip, "wip", false, "checkpoint uncommitted work as a wip: commit")

193		f.BoolVar(&cold, "cold", false, "go cold: remove the worktree after confirming everything is pushed")

195		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow external closure of unknown runtime status")
196		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails")
197		f.DurationVar(&timeout, "timeout", 5*time.Second, "maximum time to wait for runtime closure")
198		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Hot, task.Warm)
199		return cmd
200	}

202	// pushBranch publishes a branch, setting upstream on first push.
203	func pushBranch(ctx context.Context, app *App, dir, branch string) error {
204		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", branch); err != nil {
205			return fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", branch, err)
206		}
207		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     origin/%s\n", app.outStyle().label("pushed"), branch)
208		return nil
209	}
210
211	// resolveTask picks the task an argument names, or infers it from the current
212	// directory when no argument is given.
213	func resolveTask(app *App, args []string) (*task.Task, error) {
214		if len(args) == 1 {
215			return app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
216		}
217		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
218		if err != nil {
219			return nil, err
220		}
221		t, err := app.Tasks.FindByWorktree(cwd)
222		if err != nil {
223			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no task for %s — name one explicitly, or run this inside a task's checkout",
224				config.Contract(cwd))
225		}
226		return t, nil
227	}
