14	func newResumeCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
15		var (
16			noProvision bool
17			fetch       bool
18			force       bool
19		)
20		cmd := &cobra.Command{
21			Use:   "resume <task>",
22			Short: "Pick a task back up, rebuilding whatever is missing",
23			Long: `Make a parked task hot again.
24
25	Warm tasks still have their worktree, so this just reopens a runtime session.
26	Cold tasks do not: the worktree is rebuilt from the branch, which is why going
27	cold is safe in the first place — the branch, not the directory, is the task's
28	identity.
29
30	If the task is owned by another machine, resuming here takes ownership. Two
31	machines writing the same branch is the one way to make this workflow produce
32	a conflict, so dev asks before doing it.`,
33			Args: cobra.ExactArgs(1),
34			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
35				ctx := ctxOf()
36				t, err := app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
37				if err != nil {
38					return err
39				}
40
41				host := config.Hostname()
42				if !t.OwnedBy(host) && !force {
43					return fmt.Errorf("task %s is owned by %s.\n"+
44						"Make sure that machine has pushed its work, then re-run with --force to take ownership",
45						t.ID, t.Owner)
46				}
47
48				if fetch {
49					if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, t.RepoPath, "fetch", "--prune", "origin"); err != nil {
50						app.warnf("fetch failed: %v", err)
51					}
52				}
53
54				rt := runtimeForTask(app, t)
55				mode := t.EffectiveMode()
56				checkout := checkoutOf(t)
57
58				switch mode {
59				case task.ModeWorktree:
60					_, statErr := os.Stat(checkout)
61					if t.WorktreePath != "" && statErr == nil {
62						if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, checkout); err != nil {
63							return err
64						}
65					}
66					// Rebuild the worktree when it is gone — the cold-to-hot path.
67					if t.WorktreePath == "" || statErr != nil {
68						base := t.Base
69						// Prefer the published branch: a cold task's work lives on
70						// the remote, and a stale local ref could drop it.
71						if remote := "origin/" + t.Branch; gitx.RefExists(ctx, t.RepoPath, remote) {
72							base = remote
73						}
74						m := &wt.Manager{Cfg: app.Cfg, Runtime: rt, Log: app.Err}
75						res, err := m.Create(ctx, wt.CreateRequest{
76							RepoPath: t.RepoPath, RepoName: t.Repo, Branch: t.Branch,
77							Base: base, Label: worktreeRuntimeLabel(t.Repo, t.Branch), NoProvision: noProvision,
78						})
79						if err != nil {
80							var exists *wt.ErrExists
81							if asError(err, &exists) {
82								t.WorktreePath = exists.Path
83								if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, exists.Path); err != nil {
84									return err
85								}
86							} else {
87								return err
88							}
89						} else {
90							t.WorktreePath = res.Path
91							setTaskRuntime(t, rt, res.Runtime)
92							reportProvision(app, res)
93							fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s    %s\n", app.outStyle().label("rebuilt"), config.Contract(res.Path))
94						}
95						checkout = t.WorktreePath
96					}
97
98				case task.ModeBranch:
99					checkout = t.RepoPath
100					if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, checkout); err != nil {
101						return err
102					}
103					st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
104					if err != nil {
105						return err
106					}
107					if st.Branch != t.Branch {
108						if st.Dirty() {
109							return fmt.Errorf("cannot switch the canonical checkout from %s to %s: %s",
110								st.Branch, t.Branch, st.Breakdown())
111						}
112						if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "switch", t.Branch); err != nil {
113							return err
114						}
115					}
116
117				case task.ModeDirect:
118					checkout = t.RepoPath
119					if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, checkout); err != nil {
120						return err
121					}
122					st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
123					if err != nil {
124						return err
125					}
126					if st.Branch != t.Branch {
127						return fmt.Errorf("direct task %s tracks %s, but the canonical checkout is on %s; "+
128							"switch back explicitly or start a worktree task", t.Title(), t.Branch, st.Branch)
129					}
130				}
131				if t.RuntimeHandle != "" {
132					live, err := runtimeHandleCovers(ctx, rt, t.RuntimeHandle, checkout)
133					if err != nil {
134						return fmt.Errorf("validate saved %s runtime session %s: %w", rt.Name(), t.RuntimeHandle, err)
135					}
136					if !live {
137						clearTaskRuntime(t)
138					}
139				}
140				if t.RuntimeHandle == "" {
141					label := t.Title()
142					if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
143						label = worktreeRuntimeLabel(t.Repo, t.Branch)
144					}
145					opened, err := openCheckout(ctx, rt, checkout, label)
146					if err != nil {
147						app.warnf("could not open a runtime session: %v", err)
148					}
149					setTaskRuntime(t, rt, opened)
150				}
151
152				t.State = task.Hot
153				t.Owner = host
154				if err := app.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
155					return err
156				}
157				annotate(app, rt, t)
158
159				style := app.outStyle()
160				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s  %s on %s (%s)\n",
161					task.Hot.Icon(), t.Title(), t.Repo, t.Branch, style.dim(string(mode)))
162				if t.Next != "" {
163					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s      %s\n", style.label("next"), t.Next)
164				}
165				if t.AgentSession != "" {
166					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %s (resumable)\n", style.label("agent"), t.AgentSession)
167				}
168				if st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout); err == nil {
169					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s       %s\n", style.label("git"), style.git(st.Summary()))
170					if st.Behind > 0 {
171						app.warnf("branch is %d behind upstream — `git pull --ff-only` before you start", st.Behind)
172					}
173				}
174				if rt.Name() == "none" {
175					return app.cdDirective(checkout)
176				}
177				return activateRuntime(ctx, rt, t.RuntimeHandle)
178			},
179		}
180		f := cmd.Flags()
181		f.BoolVar(&noProvision, "no-provision", false, "skip dependency install when rebuilding a worktree")
182		f.BoolVar(&fetch, "fetch", true, "fetch from origin first")
183		f.BoolVar(&force, "force", false, "take ownership of a task owned by another machine")
184		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Warm, task.Cold)
185		return cmd
186	}

14	func newDoneCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

29			Use:   "done [task]",

31			Long: `Finish integration while leaving runtime and filesystem cleanup to an
32	external coordinator.
33
34	  --ff       rebase onto the base and fast-forward it locally. Use when the
35	             branch's commits are worth keeping in the base's history.
36	  --pr       push and open a pull/merge request with the detected forge CLI,
37	             leaving the merge to review and CI.
38	  --merged   verify an externally merged branch against --base-ref, for a merge
39	             performed outside dev.
40
41	For branch/worktree tasks, omitting every mode opens a finish wizard on an
42	interactive terminal. A non-interactive caller still gets a report and must
43	pass a mode explicitly. Direct tasks need no integration mode.
44
45	A dirty checkout is analyzed against the base, not rejected as one opaque
46	condition. Interactive use can commit everything, discard everything, or
47	cancel. Unique content requires typing DROP before discard. Scripts select an
48	explicit --dirty policy; destructive discard also requires --yes.
49
50	A successful local or externally verified merge records DONE, meaning MERGED
51	with cleanup possibly pending. It never closes the invoking runtime, removes a
52	worktree, or deletes a branch. Run dev retire later from outside the workspace.`,
53			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
54			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
55				modes := 0
56				for _, selected := range []bool{ff, pr, merged} {
57					if selected {
58						modes++
59					}
60				}
61				if modes > 1 {
62					return fmt.Errorf("--ff, --pr and --merged are alternatives; pick one")
63				}
64				if !merged && (baseRef != "" || confirmSquash != "") {
65					return fmt.Errorf("--base-ref and --confirm-squash require --merged")
66				}

69				}
70				if keepWorktree {

72				}
73				integration := doneIntegrationNone
74				switch {

76					integration = doneIntegrationFF
77				case pr:
78					integration = doneIntegrationPR
79				case merged:
80					integration = doneIntegrationMerged
81				}

100		// Both remain accepted so existing scripts fail loudly with a pointer to
101		// dev retire rather than silently skipping cleanup they still expect.
102		f.BoolVar(&keepWorktree, "keep-worktree", false, "deprecated: worktrees are always kept until dev retire")
103		f.BoolVar(&deleteBranch, "delete-branch", false, "deprecated here: use dev retire --delete-branch")
104		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Hot, task.Warm)
105		return cmd
106	}
107
108	// fastForward rebases the task branch onto its base and then moves the base
109	// forward, producing a linear history with no merge commit.
110	//
111	// merge --ff-only is the guardrail: if the rebase did not actually put the
112	// branch ahead of the base, the merge fails loudly instead of quietly creating
113	// a merge commit the user did not ask for.
114	func fastForward(ctx context.Context, app *App, t *task.Task, checkout, base string) error {
115		relation, err := gitx.AnalyzeFinish(ctx, checkout, base, t.Branch)
116		if err != nil {
117			return err
118		}
119		if relation.Relation.Contained() {
120			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   integrated  %s is already contained in %s\n", t.Branch, base)
121			return nil
122		}
123		if relation.Relation.BaseOnly > 0 {
124			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   rebasing   %s onto %s\n", t.Branch, base)
125			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rebase", base); err != nil {
126				return fmt.Errorf("%w\n\nThe rebase left conflicts to resolve in %s.\n"+
127					"Fix them, `git rebase --continue`, then re-run dev done --ff",
128					err, config.Contract(checkout))
129			}
130		}
131		// The base branch lives in the main checkout, not the worktree.
132		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   merging    %s into %s (fast-forward only)\n", t.Branch, base)
133		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, t.RepoPath, "switch", base); err != nil {
134			return err
135		}
136		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, t.RepoPath, "merge", "--ff-only", t.Branch); err != nil {
137			return fmt.Errorf("%w\n\n%s could not be fast-forwarded. Something else moved it; "+
138				"rebase again or integrate by hand", err, base)
139		}
140		return nil
141	}
142
143	// deleteMergedBranch removes a branch only when git agrees its commits are already
144	// contained in the base — the check that makes cleanup safe.
145	func deleteMergedBranch(ctx context.Context, app *App, repoPath, branch, base string) error {
146		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", branch, base); err != nil {
147			return fmt.Errorf("keeping branch %s: it has commits not in %s", branch, base)
148		}
149		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "branch", "-d", branch); err != nil {
150			return fmt.Errorf("could not delete %s: %w", branch, err)
151		}
152		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   deleted    branch %s\n", branch)
153		return nil
154	}
155
156	// openPR pushes the branch and asks the forge CLI to open a pull/merge
157	// request. When no forge CLI is available dev prints the push result and the
158	// URL to open by hand, rather than failing: the branch being published is the
159	// part that actually matters.
160	func openPR(ctx context.Context, app *App, t *task.Task, checkout, base string) error {
161		if err := pushBranch(ctx, app, checkout, t.Branch); err != nil {
162			return err
163		}
164		kind := forge.Detect(ctx, t.RepoPath)
165		f, err := forge.For(kind)
166		if err != nil || !f.Available() {
167			app.warnf("no forge CLI for this remote — the branch is pushed; open the request in your browser")
168			return nil
169		}
170		url, err := f.CreatePR(ctx, checkout, forge.PRRequest{
171			Base: base, Head: t.Branch, Fill: true,
172		})
173		if err != nil {
174			return err
175		}
176		if url != "" {
177			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   opened     %s\n", url)
178		}
179		return nil
180	}

291		_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
292		if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, value); err != nil {
293			value.Phase = phaseReconcile

377	func verifyRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope, value journal) error {
378		for index, entry := range value.Files {
379			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
380			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
381			if err != nil {
382				return err
383			}

12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/safefile"
14		"github.com/google/uuid"
15	)
16
17	var ErrPlanBlocked = errors.New("portable-file plan is blocked")
18
19	type SourceOptions struct {
20		Checkout string
21		Binding  Binding
22		Patterns []Pattern
23		Limits   safefile.Limits
24		Replace  bool
25		// RequestID is a focused-test seam. Production leaves it empty.
26		RequestID string
27	}
28
29	// Source is an exact, content-addressed local manifest. It keeps no file bytes;
30	// BuildEnvelope reopens and rehashes each non-current source after target plan.
31	type Source struct {
32		checkout string
33		request  PlanRequest
34	}
35
36	func (s *Source) Request() PlanRequest { return s.request }
37
38	func PrepareSource(ctx context.Context, options SourceOptions) (*Source, Report, error) {
39		if err := options.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
40			return nil, Report{}, err
41		}
42		if err := options.Binding.Validate(); err != nil {
43			return nil, Report{}, err
44		}
45		paths, err := Expand(options.Checkout, options.Patterns, options.Limits)
46		if err != nil {
47			return nil, Report{}, err
48		}
49		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, options.Limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
50			return nil, Report{}, err
51		}
52		requestID := options.RequestID
53		if requestID == "" {
54			requestID = uuid.NewString()
55		}
56		request := PlanRequest{
57			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
58			RequestID: requestID, Binding: options.Binding, Limits: limitsToWire(options.Limits),
59			Replace: options.Replace,
60		}
61		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}
62		blocked := false
63		for _, path := range paths {
64			public := PublicFile{Path: path, Mode: "0600", State: StateFailed}
65			observed, observeErr := observePath(ctx, options.Checkout, path, options.Limits, true)
66			if observeErr != nil {
67				public.State = stateForError(observeErr)
68				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
69				blocked = true
70				continue
71			}
72			if !observed.exists {
73				public.State = StateMissing
74				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
75				blocked = true
76				continue
77			}
78			public.Size = observed.info.Size()
79			if observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0 {
80				public.Mode = "0700"
81			}
82			if eligibilityErr := proveGitEligibility(ctx, options.Checkout, path); eligibilityErr != nil {
83				public.State = stateForError(eligibilityErr)
84				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
85				blocked = true
86				continue
87			}
88			public.State = StateReady
89			report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
90			request.Files = append(request.Files, FileSpec{
91				Path: path, Size: observed.info.Size(), Mode: public.Mode, SHA256: observed.digest,
92			})
93		}
94		report.Files = sortedPublic(report.Files)
95		if blocked {
96			return nil, report, ErrPlanBlocked
97		}
98		sort.Slice(request.Files, func(i, j int) bool { return request.Files[i].Path < request.Files[j].Path })
99		request.ManifestDigest = manifestDigest(request)
100		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
101			return nil, report, err
102		}
103		return &Source{checkout: options.Checkout, request: request}, report, nil
104	}
105
106	// BuildEnvelope performs the source-side apply revalidation and includes bytes
107	// only for target actions that create or explicitly replace a file.
108	func (s *Source) BuildEnvelope(ctx context.Context, plan PlanResponse, retainForEvict bool) (ApplyEnvelope, error) {
109		if s == nil {
110			return ApplyEnvelope{}, errors.New("build local-files envelope from nil source")
111		}
112		if err := plan.Validate(s.request); err != nil {
113			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
114		}
115		envelope := ApplyEnvelope{
116			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
117			Request: s.request, Plan: plan, RetainForEvict: retainForEvict,
118		}
119		for index, planned := range plan.Files {
120			if planned.Action == actionCurrent {
121				continue
122			}
123			if planned.Action != actionCreate && planned.Action != actionReplace {
124				return ApplyEnvelope{}, ErrPlanBlocked
125			}
126			spec := s.request.Files[index]
127			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
128				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
129			}
130			observed, err := observePath(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path, s.request.SafeLimits(), true)
131			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 ||
132				(observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0) != spec.executable() {
133				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
134			}
135			envelope.Payloads = append(envelope.Payloads, Payload{
136				Path: spec.Path, Content: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(observed.data),
137			})
138		}
139		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
140			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
141		}
142		return envelope, nil
143	}
144
145	func (e ApplyEnvelope) Validate() error {
146		if e.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || e.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
147			return errors.New("unsupported local-files apply protocol")
148		}
149		if err := e.Request.Validate(); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		if err := e.Plan.Validate(e.Request); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		expected := map[string]FileSpec{}
156		for index, planned := range e.Plan.Files {
157			if planned.Action == actionCreate || planned.Action == actionReplace {
158				expected[e.Request.Files[index].Path] = e.Request.Files[index]
159			}
160		}
161		if len(e.Payloads) != len(expected) {
162			return errors.New("apply payload count does not match target actions")
163		}
164		seen := map[string]bool{}
165		var total int64
166		for index, payload := range e.Payloads {
167			if index > 0 && e.Payloads[index-1].Path >= payload.Path {
168				return errors.New("apply payload paths must be unique and sorted")
169			}
170			spec, ok := expected[payload.Path]
171			if !ok || seen[payload.Path] {
172				return fmt.Errorf("unexpected apply payload for %q", payload.Path)
173			}
174			seen[payload.Path] = true
175			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
176			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
177				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q is not canonical base64", payload.Path)
178			}
179			if int64(len(decoded)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(decoded) != spec.SHA256 {
180				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q does not match its manifest", payload.Path)
181			}
182			if int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes || int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxTotalBytes-total {
183				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q exceeds negotiated limits", payload.Path)
184			}
185			total += int64(len(decoded))
186		}
187		return nil
188	}
189
190	func stateForError(err error) State {
191		switch {
192		case errors.Is(err, ErrUnsafe), errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrUnsafeType), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrNotPortable), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrPathCollision):
193			return StateBlockedUnsafe
194		case errors.Is(err, ErrIneligible):
195			return StateBlockedIneligible
196		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
197			return StateMissing
198		default:
199			return StateFailed
200		}
201	}
202
203	func limitsToWire(limits safefile.Limits) fleet.FileLimits {
204		return fleet.FileLimits{
205			MaxFiles: limits.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: limits.MaxFileBytes,
206			MaxTotalBytes: limits.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: limits.MaxPathBytes,
207			MaxComponentBytes: limits.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: limits.MaxPathDepth,
208		}
209	}
210
211	// NegotiateLimits takes the lower value for every policy field and validates
212	// both sides against this binary's compiled ceilings.
213	func NegotiateLimits(local safefile.Limits, remote fleet.FileLimits) (safefile.Limits, error) {
214		if err := local.Validate(); err != nil {
215			return safefile.Limits{}, err
216		}
217		remoteLimits := safefile.Limits{
218			MaxFiles: remote.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: remote.MaxFileBytes,
219			MaxTotalBytes: remote.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: remote.MaxPathBytes,
220			MaxComponentBytes: remote.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: remote.MaxPathDepth,
221		}
222		if err := remoteLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
223			return safefile.Limits{}, err
224		}
225		result := safefile.Limits{
226			MaxFiles:          min(local.MaxFiles, remoteLimits.MaxFiles),
227			MaxFileBytes:      min(local.MaxFileBytes, remoteLimits.MaxFileBytes),
228			MaxTotalBytes:     min(local.MaxTotalBytes, remoteLimits.MaxTotalBytes),
229			MaxPathBytes:      min(local.MaxPathBytes, remoteLimits.MaxPathBytes),
230			MaxComponentBytes: min(local.MaxComponentBytes, remoteLimits.MaxComponentBytes),
231			MaxPathDepth:      min(local.MaxPathDepth, remoteLimits.MaxPathDepth),
232		}
233		return result, result.Validate()
234	}

10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/machineid"

12
13	const (
14		// ProtocolSchemaVersion is the outer schema shared by new bounded fleet
15		// protocols. Feature protocol versions evolve independently inside it.
16		ProtocolSchemaVersion = 1
17		// LocalFilesProtocolVersion is the first portable local-file protocol.
18		LocalFilesProtocolVersion = 1
19		// MaxCapabilityBytes bounds either side of capability negotiation.
20		MaxCapabilityBytes int64 = 16 << 10
21	)
22
23	var ErrProtocolLimit = errors.New("fleet protocol size limit exceeded")
24
25	// FileLimits is the wire representation of a target's downward-clamped
26	// portable-file policy. It deliberately does not carry include patterns.
27	type FileLimits struct {
28		MaxFiles          int   `json:"max_files"`
29		MaxFileBytes      int64 `json:"max_file_bytes"`
30		MaxTotalBytes     int64 `json:"max_total_bytes"`
31		MaxPathBytes      int   `json:"max_path_bytes"`
32		MaxComponentBytes int   `json:"max_component_bytes"`
33		MaxPathDepth      int   `json:"max_path_depth"`
34	}
35
36	func (l FileLimits) Validate() error {
37		switch {
38		case l.MaxFiles <= 0:
39			return errors.New("max_files must be positive")
40		case l.MaxFileBytes <= 0:
41			return errors.New("max_file_bytes must be positive")
42		case l.MaxTotalBytes <= 0:
43			return errors.New("max_total_bytes must be positive")
44		case l.MaxPathBytes <= 0:
45			return errors.New("max_path_bytes must be positive")
46		case l.MaxComponentBytes <= 0:
47			return errors.New("max_component_bytes must be positive")
48		case l.MaxPathDepth <= 0:
49			return errors.New("max_path_depth must be positive")
50		default:
51			return nil
52		}
53	}
54
55	// CapabilityRequest is content-free and is always exchanged before any
56	// feature payload.
57	type CapabilityRequest struct {
58		SchemaVersion   int    `json:"schema_version"`
59		Feature         string `json:"feature"`
60		ProtocolVersion int    `json:"protocol_version"`
61	}
62
63	func LocalFilesCapabilityRequest() CapabilityRequest {
64		return CapabilityRequest{
65			SchemaVersion: ProtocolSchemaVersion, Feature: "local-files",
66			ProtocolVersion: LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
67		}
68	}
69
70	func (r CapabilityRequest) Validate() error {
71		if r.SchemaVersion != ProtocolSchemaVersion {
72			return fmt.Errorf("capability schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, ProtocolSchemaVersion)
73		}
74		if r.Feature != "local-files" {
75			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported capability feature %q", r.Feature)
76		}
77		if r.ProtocolVersion != LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
78			return fmt.Errorf("local-files protocol_version %d: want %d", r.ProtocolVersion, LocalFilesProtocolVersion)
79		}
80		return nil
81	}
82
83	// CapabilityResponse contains only non-secret host facts. Unsupported native
84	// platforms return a stable reason before the caller constructs a payload.
85	type CapabilityResponse struct {
86		SchemaVersion   int        `json:"schema_version"`
87		Feature         string     `json:"feature"`
88		ProtocolVersion int        `json:"protocol_version"`
89		MachineID       string     `json:"machine_id"`
90		Platform        string     `json:"platform"`
91		Supported       bool       `json:"supported"`
92		Reason          string     `json:"reason,omitempty"`
93		Limits          FileLimits `json:"limits"`
94	}
95
96	func (r CapabilityResponse) Validate(request CapabilityRequest) error {
97		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
98			return err
99		}
100		if r.SchemaVersion != request.SchemaVersion || r.Feature != request.Feature || r.ProtocolVersion != request.ProtocolVersion {
101			return errors.New("capability response does not match the request")
102		}
103		if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
104			return err
105		}
106		if r.Platform == "" {
107			return errors.New("capability response has no platform")
108		}
109		if r.Supported {
110			if r.Reason != "" {
111				return errors.New("supported capability must not include a reason")
112			}
113			if err := r.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
114				return fmt.Errorf("capability limits: %w", err)
115			}
116		} else if !validCapabilityReason(r.Reason) {
117			return errors.New("unsupported capability has no valid reason code")
118		}
119		return nil
120	}
121
122	func validCapabilityReason(reason string) bool {
123		if reason == "" || len(reason) > 128 {
124			return false
125		}
126		for _, character := range reason {
127			if character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '-' {
128				continue
129			}
130			return false
131		}
132		return true
133	}
134
135	// DecodeStrict reads exactly one bounded JSON value, rejects unknown fields,
136	// and requires EOF after optional JSON whitespace.
137	func DecodeStrict(reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
138		if reader == nil || target == nil {
139			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a reader and target")
140		}
141		if maxBytes <= 0 {
142			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a positive limit")
143		}
144		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maxBytes+1))
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("read fleet protocol: %w", err)
147		}
148		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
149			return fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
150		}
151		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
152		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
153		if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
154			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol: %w", err)
155		}
156		var extra any
157		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
158			if err == nil {
159				return errors.New("decode fleet protocol: multiple JSON values")
160			}
161			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol trailing data: %w", err)
162		}
163		return nil
164	}
165
166	// MarshalBounded encodes one protocol value and enforces the matching bound
167	// before it can be handed to Transport.
168	func MarshalBounded(value any, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
169		if maxBytes <= 0 {
170			return nil, errors.New("fleet protocol encode requires a positive limit")
171		}
172		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode fleet protocol: %w", err)
175		}
176		if int64(len(data))+1 > maxBytes {
177			return nil, fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
178		}
179		return append(data, '\n'), nil
180	}
181
182	// UnmarshalStrict applies DecodeStrict to an in-memory transport response.
183	func UnmarshalStrict(data []byte, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
184		return DecodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(data), maxBytes, target)
185	}

171				source, sourceReport, err := localfiles.PrepareSource(ctxOf(), localfiles.SourceOptions{

176					},
177					Patterns: patterns, Limits: limits, Replace: replace,
178				})
179				if err != nil {

183						}
184					}

198				if !apply {

200				}
201				if jsonOutput && !yes {

204				if !yes {

211					if !confirm(app, bufio.NewReader(app.In), fmt.Sprintf("apply %d portable file(s) to %s", len(planReport.Files), host.Name)) {

213						return nil
214					}
215				}
216				envelope, err := source.BuildEnvelope(ctxOf(), plan, false)
217				if err != nil {
218					return err
219				}
220				result, err := client.Apply(ctxOf(), host, capability, envelope)
221				if err != nil {
222					return err
223				}
224				return renderFleetFilesReport(app, result.PublicReport(), jsonOutput)
225			},

238	func fleetFilesHost(cfg fleet.Config, name string) (fleet.Host, error) {
239		var selected *fleet.Host
240		for index := range cfg.Hosts {
241			if cfg.Hosts[index].Name == name {
242				if selected != nil {
243					return fleet.Host{}, errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one target")
244				}
245				copy := cfg.Hosts[index]
246				selected = &copy
247			}
248		}
249		if selected == nil {
250			return fleet.Host{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
251		}
252		return *selected, nil
253	}

255	func fleetFilePatterns(project projectconfig.Result, adHoc []string) []localfiles.Pattern {

258			source, _ := project.SourceFor("local_files.include")

269	func resolveFleetFilesSource(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (string, gitx.Status, string, string, error) {
270		checkout := ""
271		if ref == "" {
272			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
273			if err != nil {
274				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
275			}
276			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
277			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
278				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
279			}
280			checkout = gitRepo.Root
281		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
282			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
283				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
284				if discoverErr != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
285					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
286				}
287				checkout = gitRepo.Root
288			}
289		}
290		if checkout == "" {
291			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
292			if err != nil {
293				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
294			}
295			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
296			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
297				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
298			}
299			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
300		}
301		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
302		if err != nil {
303			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
304		}
305		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
306			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
307		}
308		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
309		if err != nil {
310			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
311		}
312		identity, err := sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
313		if err != nil {
314			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
315		}
316		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil
317	}
318
319	func sourceRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
320		var preferred []string
321		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
322			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
323		}
324		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
325		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
326		if err != nil {
327			return "", err
328		}
329		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
330		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
331		for _, remote := range preferred {
332			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
333				continue
334			}
335			seenRemote[remote] = true
336			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
337			if err != nil {
338				continue
339			}
340			identitySet := map[string]bool{}
341			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
342				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
343					identitySet[identity] = true
344				}
345			}
346			if len(identitySet) == 1 {
347				for identity := range identitySet {
348					return identity, nil
349				}
350			}
351		}
352		return "", errors.New("source checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
353	}

355	func renderFleetFilesReport(app *App, report localfiles.Report, jsonOutput bool) error {
356		if jsonOutput {
357			encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
358			encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
359			return encoder.Encode(report)
360		}
361		table := app.newTable("PATH", "SIZE", "MODE", "STATE")
362		for _, file := range report.Files {
363			table.Add(file.Path, fmt.Sprintf("%d", file.Size), file.Mode, string(file.State))
364		}
365		table.Render(app.Out)
366		return nil
367	}

83	// collectLocalRepoContext is the single CLI collector used by repo context and
84	// status. It executes only local Git/task/runtime probes; includeTopology adds
85	// repository-wide remote/ref facts but never performs fetch or other network I/O.
86	func collectLocalRepoContext(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, selectedPath string, includeTopology bool) localRepoContext {
87		var (
88			tasks    = []*task.Task{}
89			tasksErr error
90		)
91		if app.Tasks == nil {
92			tasksErr = errors.New("task store is unavailable")
93		} else {
94			listed, diagnostics, err := app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
95			if err != nil {
96				tasksErr = err
97			} else {
98				tasks = tasksForRepo(listed, repository)
99				for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
100					tasksErr = errors.Join(tasksErr, diagnostic)
101				}
102			}
103		}
104
105		rt := app.Runtime()
106		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
107		local := localRepoContext{
108			Context: inventory.CollectRepoContext(ctx, repository, tasks, sessions, rt.Name()),
109			Runtimes: []repocontext.RuntimeInput{{
110				Backend: rt.Name(), Available: rt.Available(), Sessions: sessions, Err: runtimeErr,
111			}},
112			SelectedCheckout: -1,
113		}
114		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
115		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
116		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
117			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
118		} else {
119			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
120		}
121		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
122			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
123		}
124		return local
125	}

154	func collectRepoContextForge(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool, now time.Time) repocontext.ForgeInput {
155		cacheInput := func(cache forge.Cache, collectionErr error) repocontext.ForgeInput {
156			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
157			if forgeCacheStale(cache, app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, now) {
158				freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
159			}
160			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
161			if !cache.Complete || collectionErr != nil {
162				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
163			}
164			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
165				Authority: assessment.AuthorityCache, Freshness: freshness,
166				Completeness: completeness, ObservedAt: cache.FetchedAt,
167				Records: append([]forge.RemoteRepo{}, cache.Repos...),
168				Err:     errors.Join(collectionErr, forgeCacheErrors(cache)),
169			}
170		}
171
172		if !refresh {
173			cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
174			if !ok {
175				return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: errors.New("no cached forge inventory; rerun with --refresh to collect one")}
176			}
177			return cacheInput(cache, nil)
178		}
179
180		rows, collectionErr := collectRemotes(ctx, app)
181		records := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(rows))
182		for _, row := range rows {
183			records = append(records, row.Repo)
184		}
185		if collectionErr == nil {
186			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
187				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
188				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
189				Records: records,
190			}
191		}
192		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
193			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
194			if len(records) > 0 {
195				cached.Records = records
196			}
197			return cached
198		}
199		if len(records) > 0 {
200			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
201				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
202				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
203				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
204			}
205		}
206		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
207	}

209	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
210		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
211			return true
212		}
213		if ttl <= 0 {
214			return false
215		}
216		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
217	}

219	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
220		var providerErrors []error
221		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
222		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
223		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
224			name := string(kind)
225			kinds = append(kinds, name)
226			byKind[name] = status
227		}
228		sort.Strings(kinds)
229		for _, kind := range kinds {
230			status := byKind[kind]
231			if status.Error != "" {
232				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
233			} else if !status.Complete {
234				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
235			}
236		}
237		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
238	}

26	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {

30		if s.platform() == "windows" {
31			return ApplyResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
32		}
33		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
34		if err != nil {
35			return ApplyResponse{}, err
36		}
37		// This check intentionally precedes envelope validation. The hidden command
38		// performs the same capability check before reading stdin at all.
39		if id != envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine {
40			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
41		}
42		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
43			return ApplyResponse{}, err
44		}
45		authority := s.Authority
46		if authority == nil {
47			authority = lease.New("")
48		}
49		key := lease.BranchKey(envelope.Request.Binding.RemoteIdentity, envelope.Request.Binding.Branch)
50		var response ApplyResponse
51		err = authority.WithMutation(ctx, []lease.Key{key}, func() error {
52			var applyErr error
53			response, applyErr = s.applyUnderLease(ctx, envelope)
54			return applyErr
55		})

230	func (s *Service) validateNegotiatedLimits(request PlanRequest) error {
231		host := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
232		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(host, request.Limits)
233		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
234			return errors.New("apply limits do not match target policy")
235		}
236		return nil

239	func preflightApply(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope) ([]preflightFile, error) {
240		payloads := map[string][]byte{}
241		for _, payload := range envelope.Payloads {
242			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
243			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
244				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode canonical payload for %q", payload.Path)
245			}
246			payloads[payload.Path] = decoded
247		}
248		files := make([]preflightFile, len(envelope.Request.Files))
249		for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
250			planned := envelope.Plan.Files[index]
251			if planned.Action == "" {
252				return nil, ErrPlanBlocked
253			}
254			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
255				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
256			}
257			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
258			if err != nil {
259				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
260			}
261			file := preflightFile{spec: spec, planned: planned, before: observed}
262			switch planned.Action {
263			case actionCurrent:
264				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
265					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q is no longer current: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
266				}
267				file.content = observed.data
268			case actionCreate:
269				if observed.exists {
270					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q appeared after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
271				}
272				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
273			case actionReplace:
274				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != planned.TargetSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
275					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed before replacement: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
276				}
277				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
278			default:
279				return nil, errors.New("invalid local-files target action")
280			}
281			if int64(len(file.content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(file.content) != spec.SHA256 {
282				return nil, fmt.Errorf("content for %q no longer matches the plan", spec.Path)
283			}
284			files[index] = file
285		}
286		return files, nil
287	}

289	func (s *Service) failAndRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal, cause error) error {
290		value.Phase = phaseReconcile
291		_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
292		if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, value); err != nil {
293			value.Phase = phaseReconcile
294			_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
295			return errors.New("local-files apply failed and requires reconciliation")
296		}
297		value.Phase = phaseRolledBack
298		for index := range value.Files {
299			if value.Files[index].Action != actionCurrent {
300				value.Files[index].State = StateRolledBack
301				value.Files[index].Published = false
302			}
303		}
304		if err := store.writeJournal(*value); err != nil {
305			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but journal finalization failed")
306		}
307		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
308			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
309		}
310		return fmt.Errorf("local-files apply failed and was rolled back: %w", cause)
311	}
312
313	func (s *Service) rollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal) error {
314		for index := len(value.Files) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
315			entry := &value.Files[index]
316			if entry.Action == actionCurrent {
317				continue
318			}
319			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
320			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
321				return err
322			}
323			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
324			if err != nil {
325				return err
326			}
327			switch entry.Action {
328			case actionCreate:
329				if !observed.exists {
330					continue
331				}
332				if observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
333					return errors.New("created target changed before rollback")
334				}
335				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
336				if err != nil {
337					return err
338				}
339				err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(spec.Path))
340				err = errors.Join(err, syncHeldRoot(parent.parent), parent.close())
341				if err != nil {
342					return err
343				}
344			case actionReplace:
345				if observed.exists && observed.digest == entry.OldSHA256 {
346					continue
347				}
348				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 {
349					return errors.New("replacement target changed before rollback")
350				}
351				oldContent, err := store.readBlob(index, true, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
352				if err != nil || digestBytes(oldContent) != entry.OldSHA256 {
353					return errors.New("replacement rollback blob is unavailable")
354				}
355				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
356				if err != nil {
357					return err
358				}
359				current, err := parent.parent.Lstat(pathBase(spec.Path))
360				oldMode, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(entry.OldMode, 8, 12)
361				err = errors.Join(err, modeErr)
362				if err == nil {
363					_, err = safefile.AtomicReplace(ctx, parent.parent, pathBase(spec.Path), current, oldContent, fs.FileMode(oldMode))
364				}
365				err = errors.Join(err, parent.close())
366				if err != nil {
367					return err
368				}
369			}
370		}
371		// Empty parent directories are intentionally retained. A path alone cannot
372		// prove that a directory still has the identity created by this operation;
373		// deleting it after a crash could remove another process's replacement.
374		return verifyRollback(ctx, checkout.root, envelope, *value)
375	}
376
377	func verifyRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope, value journal) error {
378		for index, entry := range value.Files {
379			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
380			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
381			if err != nil {
382				return err
383			}
384			switch entry.Action {
385			case actionCurrent:
386				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != envelope.Plan.Files[index].TargetMode {
387					return errors.New("current target changed during rollback")
388				}
389			case actionCreate:
390				if observed.exists {
391					return errors.New("created target remains after rollback")
392				}
393			case actionReplace:
394				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != entry.OldSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != entry.OldMode {
395					return errors.New("replacement target was not restored")
396				}
397			}
398		}
399		return nil
400	}
401
402	func (s *Service) verifyCompleted(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value journal) (ApplyResponse, error) {
403		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
404			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files journal no longer matches the checkout")
405		}
406		if value.RetainForEvict {
407			for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
408				content, err := store.readBlob(index, false, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
409				if err != nil || int64(len(content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(content) != spec.SHA256 {
410					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("retained local-files recovery blob is unavailable")
411				}
412			}
413		} else if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
414			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
415		}
416		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
417	}
418
419	func verifyAllCurrent(ctx context.Context, checkout string, specs []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
420		for _, spec := range specs {
421			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
422				return err
423			}
424			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, limits, true)
425			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size {
426				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q failed post-write verification", spec.Path)
427			}
428			if fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != spec.Mode {
429				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q permissions do not match the manifest", spec.Path)
430			}
431		}
432		return nil
433	}
434
435	func responseFromJournal(value journal) ApplyResponse {
436		files := make([]PublicFile, len(value.Files))
437		for index, entry := range value.Files {
438			files[index] = PublicFile{Path: entry.Path, Size: entry.Size, Mode: entry.Mode, State: entry.State}
439		}
440		return ApplyResponse{
441			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
442			RequestID: value.RequestID, PlanDigest: value.PlanDigest, Files: files,
443		}
444	}

446	func (s *Service) fault(point, path string) error {
447		if s.Fault == nil {

453	type heldParent struct {
454		checkout string
455		rootInfo fs.FileInfo
456		root     *os.Root
457		parent   *os.Root
458		roots    []*os.Root
459		edges    []heldEdge
460	}

462	type heldEdge struct {
463		parent *os.Root
464		name   string
465		info   fs.FileInfo
466	}
467
468	func openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath string, create bool) (*heldParent, error) {
469		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
470			return nil, err
471		}
472		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		held := &heldParent{checkout: checkout, rootInfo: rootInfo, root: root, parent: root, roots: []*os.Root{root}}
477		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
478		prefix := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1)
479		for _, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
480			prefix = append(prefix, component)
481			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
482			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
483				if err := held.parent.Mkdir(component, 0o700); err != nil {
484					_ = held.close()
485					return nil, err
486				}
487				child, info, err = safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
488			}
489			if err != nil {
490				_ = held.close()
491				return nil, err
492			}
493			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
494				_ = child.Close()
495				_ = held.close()
496				return nil, ErrUnsafe
497			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
498				_ = child.Close()
499				_ = held.close()
500				return nil, err
501			}
502			held.edges = append(held.edges, heldEdge{parent: held.parent, name: component, info: info})
503			held.roots = append(held.roots, child)
504			held.parent = child
505		}
506		return held, nil
507	}
508
509	func (h *heldParent) close() error {
510		if h == nil {
511			return nil
512		}
513		var result error
514		for index := len(h.edges) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
515			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(h.edges[index].parent, h.edges[index].name, h.edges[index].info))
516		}
517		result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyRoot(h.checkout, h.rootInfo))
518		for index := len(h.roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
519			result = errors.Join(result, h.roots[index].Close())
520		}
521		h.roots = nil
522		return result
523	}
524
525	func syncHeldRoot(root *os.Root) error {
526		file, err := root.Open(".")
527		if err != nil {
528			return err
529		}
530		defer file.Close()
531		return file.Sync()
532	}

536		return parts[len(parts)-1]
537	}

30	// LoadCache returns only a fresh, complete cache. TUI callers that can label

32	func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool) {
33		c, ok := LoadCacheAny(path)

40	// LoadCacheAny returns a cache regardless of age or completeness. This powers
41	// stale-while-revalidate UI behavior; callers must inspect Fresh/Complete.
42	func LoadCacheAny(path string) (Cache, bool) {
43		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return Cache{}, false
46		}
47		var c Cache
48		if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) != nil || c.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
49			return Cache{}, false
50		}
51		if c.Version == 0 {
52			// Version 1 caches were valid snapshots but capped per provider, so they
53			// are useful for instant display and must immediately be refreshed.
54			c.Complete = false
55		}
56		return c, true
57	}
58
59	func (c Cache) Fresh(maxAge time.Duration) bool {
60		if c.Version != CacheVersion || !c.Complete {
61			return false
62		}
63		if maxAge <= 0 {
64			return true
65		}
66		if len(c.Providers) == 0 {
67			return time.Since(c.FetchedAt) <= maxAge
68		}
69		for _, provider := range c.Providers {
70			if !provider.Complete || provider.Error != "" || provider.FetchedAt.IsZero() || time.Since(provider.FetchedAt) > maxAge {
71				return false
72			}
73		}
74		return true
75	}

77	// SaveCache atomically replaces the cache. A partial forge response may be
78	// cached — its FetchedAt still says exactly when it was observed.
79	func SaveCache(path string, repos []RemoteRepo) error {
80		now := time.Now().UTC()
81		providers := map[Kind]ProviderStatus{}
82		for _, repo := range repos {
83			providers[repo.Forge] = ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
84		}
85		return SaveCacheState(path, Cache{Version: CacheVersion, FetchedAt: now, Complete: true, Providers: providers, Repos: repos})
86	}

88	// SaveCacheState atomically replaces the versioned inventory cache.
89	func SaveCacheState(path string, cache Cache) error {
90		if path == "" {
91			return errors.New("empty cache path")
92		}
93		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
94			return err
95		}
96		if cache.Version == 0 {
97			cache.Version = CacheVersion
98		}
99		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
100			cache.FetchedAt = time.Now().UTC()
101		}
102		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(cache, "", "  ")
103		if err != nil {
104			return err
105		}
106		b = append(b, '\n')
107		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".remotes-*.tmp")
108		if err != nil {
109			return err
110		}
111		name := tmp.Name()
112		defer os.Remove(name)
113		if _, err := tmp.Write(b); err != nil {
114			tmp.Close()
115			return err
116		}
117		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
118			return err
119		}
120		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o600); err != nil {
121			return err
122		}
123		return os.Rename(name, path)
124	}

27	Documentation uses the same sequence as CI:

37
38	## Architecture
39
40	The executable path is deliberately shallow:
41
42	```text
43	cmd/dev/main.go
44	  -> cli.Execute()
45	  -> cli.NewRootCommandWithIO()
46	  -> App.Load()
47	  -> Cobra command handler
48	  -> domain package(s)
49	```
50
51	`internal/cli` assembles commands, parses flags, invokes services, and renders output. Keep policy out of command handlers; it belongs in independently testable domain packages:
52
53	- `config` owns defaults, TOML overlays, validation, and XDG paths.
54	- `gitx` is the Git porcelain boundary and canonicalizes repository identity through the shared Git common directory.
55	- `task` persists only human intent Git cannot derive: task mode/state, owner, next action, and runtime hints.
56	- `wt` owns managed linked-worktree creation, placement, provisioning plans, and safe removal. Runtimes never create or manage Git worktrees; they surface checkout or experiment paths selected and validated by the calling `dev` flow, including managed, external, or adopted worktrees and non-Git Try directories.
57	- `runtime` abstracts Herdr, tmux, Zellij, and the no-multiplexer backend. Handles are backend-qualified hints and must be checked against live checkout coverage before reuse.
58	- `repo` discovers and deduplicates repositories; `inventory` joins repositories, Git state, tasks, worktrees, and live runtime data. CLI listings and the TUI consume this joined view.
59	- `catalog` stores stable repository/Try identity and personal metadata. `experiment` owns Try creation, archive/restore, and graduation, including intent records and rollback/reconciliation around moves.

97	// Save creates a task or updates one read by this Store. Existing-task writes
98	// compare the task's private loaded revision under the cross-process lock, so
99	// legacy callers cannot silently overwrite a newer process's mutation.
100	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {
101		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
102		if err != nil {
103			return err
104		}
105		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
106			current, currentErr := s.get(candidate.ID)
107			switch {
108			case currentErr == nil:
109				if candidate.storedRevision == "" || candidate.storedRevision != current.Revision() {
110					return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
111				}
112				if !candidate.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
113					return fmt.Errorf("task %s changed its creation time: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
114				}
115			case errors.Is(currentErr, ErrNotFound):
116				if candidate.storedRevision != "" {
117					return fmt.Errorf("task %s was removed after it was read: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
118				}
119			default:
120				return currentErr
121			}
122			stampForSave(candidate)
123			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
124				return err
125			}
126			candidate.storedRevision = candidate.Revision()
127			return nil
128		})
129		if err != nil {
130			return err
131		}
132		*t = *candidate
133		return nil
134	}

136	// ReplaceDone starts a new task generation under an existing stable ID only

139	func (s *Store) ReplaceDone(t *Task, expectedRevision string) error {
140		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
141		if err != nil {
142			return err
143		}

148		var out []suggestion

150		// A task whose repository is gone cannot be finished, resumed, parked or
151		// retired: every one of those resolves the repository first, and `dev done`

153		// function reaches it either — the dead-branch rule below excludes direct
154		// mode, and the stale-worktree rule needs a recorded worktree path. Left
155		// alone, the record is unreachable by any command in the binary.
156		//

158		// commits and the remote are untouched. A live session proves the directory
159		// is there, so it is the one condition that rules this out.
160		if t.RepoPath != "" && !r.Live() && !dirExists(t.RepoPath) {
161			out = append(out, suggestion{
162				row:    r,
163				reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository %s no longer exists", config.Contract(t.RepoPath)),
164				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s (Git keeps any work; this drops only dev's record)", t.ID),
165				apply:  func() error { return app.Tasks.Delete(t.ID) },
166			})
167			return out
168		}
169
170		out = append(out, orphanSuggestions(app, r)...)
171
172		switch {
173		// A hot task with no live session is the commonest drift: the session was
174		// closed (or the machine rebooted) without parking.
175		case t.State == task.Hot && !r.Live():
176			out = append(out, suggestion{
177				row:    r,
178				reason: fmt.Sprintf("hot but no live session, idle %s", humanAge(r.Age())),
179				action: fmt.Sprintf("mark %s warm", t.ID),
180				apply: func() error {
181					t.State = task.Warm
182					return app.Tasks.Save(t)
183				},
184			})
185
186		// A warm task nobody has touched in weeks is a candidate for cold: keeping
187		// the worktree costs disk and clutters every listing.
188		case t.State == task.Warm && r.Age() > stale:
189			reason := fmt.Sprintf("warm and untouched for %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
190			if r.Status.Dirty() {
191				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but has uncommitted work",
192					action: "commit or `dev park --wip` before going cold — not changed automatically"})
193				break
194			}
195			if !r.Status.Synced() {
196				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + fmt.Sprintf(", not pushed (%s)", r.Status.Summary()),
197					action: fmt.Sprintf("push %s so it can go cold: dev park %s --cold --push", t.Branch, t.ID)})
198				break
199			}
200			out = append(out, suggestion{
201				row:    r,
202				reason: reason + ", clean and pushed",
203				action: fmt.Sprintf("go cold: remove %s (branch and remote keep the work)", config.Contract(r.Checkout)),
204				apply: func() error {
205					if t.WorktreePath != "" {
206						if err := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, t.WorktreePath); err != nil {
207							return err
208						}
209						if err := safeRemoveWorktree(ctx, runtimeForTask(app, t), t.RepoPath, t.WorktreePath,
210							false, false, false, 5*time.Second); err != nil {
211							return err
212						}
213						t.WorktreePath = ""
214					}
215					t.State = task.Cold
216					clearTaskRuntime(t)
217					return app.Tasks.Save(t)
218				},
219			})
220
221		// DONE means integrated; runtime/worktree cleanup is a separate,
222		// externally coordinated retirement step.
223		case t.State == task.Done:
224			action := fmt.Sprintf("retire runtime/worktree for %s", t.ID)
225			if retireOptions.deleteBranches && t.Branch != "" && t.Branch != t.Base {
226				action += fmt.Sprintf(" and delete %s", t.Branch)
227			}
228			out = append(out, suggestion{
229				row:    r,
230				reason: "merged, cleanup pending",
231				action: action,
232				apply: func() error {
233					if err := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, checkoutOf(t)); err != nil {
234						return err
235					}
236					target, rt, err := retirementTargetForTask(ctx, app, t)
237					if err != nil {
238						return err
239					}
240					service := &retirement.Service{Runtime: rt, Tasks: app.Tasks}
241					_, err = service.Retire(ctx, retirement.Request{
242						Target: target,
243						Safety: retirement.Options{
244							CloseUnknown: retireOptions.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: retireOptions.assumeNoRuntime,
245						},
246						DeleteBranch: retireOptions.deleteBranches,
247					})
248					return err
249				},
250			})
251		}
252
253		// A branch-backed task whose branch git no longer has is dead: the branch
254		// was deleted after integration, so the record holds intent for work that
255		// no longer exists anywhere. It cannot be finished, resumed, or retired,
256		// because every one of those paths resolves the branch first.
257		noCheckout := t.WorktreePath == "" || r.WorktreeMissing
258		if noCheckout && t.Branch != "" && t.RepoPath != "" &&
259			t.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeDirect && !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, t.RepoPath, t.Branch) {
260			out = append(out, suggestion{
261				row:    r,
262				reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch %s no longer exists", t.Branch),
263				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s", t.ID),
264				apply:  func() error { return app.Tasks.Delete(t.ID) },
265			})
266			return out
267		}
268
269		// A cold task keeps no checkout by definition: that is what going cold
270		// means. One still on disk is drift inventory already reports and nothing
271		// could act on.
272		if t.State == task.Cold && t.WorktreePath != "" && r.CheckoutExists && !r.WorktreeMissing &&
273			!r.Live() && !r.Status.Dirty() && r.Status.Synced() {
274			out = append(out, suggestion{
275				row:    r,
276				reason: "cold, but its worktree is still on disk",
277				action: fmt.Sprintf("remove %s (branch and remote keep the work)", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
278				apply: func() error {
279					if err := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, t.WorktreePath); err != nil {
280						return err
281					}
282					if err := safeRemoveWorktree(ctx, runtimeForTask(app, t), t.RepoPath, t.WorktreePath,
283						false, false, false, 5*time.Second); err != nil {
284						return err
285					}
286					t.WorktreePath = ""
287					clearTaskRuntime(t)
288					return app.Tasks.Save(t)
289				},
290			})
291		}
292
293		// Drift that is independent of the lifecycle stage.
294		if r.WorktreeMissing && t.WorktreePath != "" {
295			wtPath := t.WorktreePath
296			out = append(out, suggestion{
297				row:    r,
298				reason: "records a worktree that git no longer knows about",
299				action: fmt.Sprintf("clear the stale worktree path %s", config.Contract(wtPath)),
300				apply: func() error {
301					if err := gitx.PruneWorktrees(ctx, t.RepoPath); err != nil {
302						return err
303					}
304					t.WorktreePath = ""
305					if t.State == task.Hot || t.State == task.Warm {
306						t.State = task.Cold
307					}
308					return app.Tasks.Save(t)
309				},
310			})
311		}
312		return out
313	}

239	func preflightApply(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope) ([]preflightFile, error) {
240		payloads := map[string][]byte{}
241		for _, payload := range envelope.Payloads {
242			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
243			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
244				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode canonical payload for %q", payload.Path)
245			}
246			payloads[payload.Path] = decoded
247		}
248		files := make([]preflightFile, len(envelope.Request.Files))
249		for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
250			planned := envelope.Plan.Files[index]
251			if planned.Action == "" {
252				return nil, ErrPlanBlocked
253			}
254			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
255				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
256			}
257			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
258			if err != nil {
259				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
260			}
261			file := preflightFile{spec: spec, planned: planned, before: observed}
262			switch planned.Action {
263			case actionCurrent:
264				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
265					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q is no longer current: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
266				}
267				file.content = observed.data
268			case actionCreate:
269				if observed.exists {
270					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q appeared after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
271				}
272				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
273			case actionReplace:
274				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != planned.TargetSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
275					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed before replacement: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
276				}
277				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
278			default:
279				return nil, errors.New("invalid local-files target action")
280			}
281			if int64(len(file.content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(file.content) != spec.SHA256 {
282				return nil, fmt.Errorf("content for %q no longer matches the plan", spec.Path)
283			}
284			files[index] = file
285		}
286		return files, nil
287	}

289	func (s *Service) failAndRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal, cause error) error {
290		value.Phase = phaseReconcile
291		_ = store.writeJournal(*value)

293			value.Phase = phaseReconcile
294			_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
295			return errors.New("local-files apply failed and requires reconciliation")
296		}
297		value.Phase = phaseRolledBack
298		for index := range value.Files {
299			if value.Files[index].Action != actionCurrent {
300				value.Files[index].State = StateRolledBack
301				value.Files[index].Published = false
302			}
303		}
304		if err := store.writeJournal(*value); err != nil {
305			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but journal finalization failed")
306		}
307		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
308			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
309		}
310		return fmt.Errorf("local-files apply failed and was rolled back: %w", cause)
311	}

97	// Save creates a task or updates one read by this Store. Existing-task writes
98	// compare the task's private loaded revision under the cross-process lock, so
99	// legacy callers cannot silently overwrite a newer process's mutation.
100	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {
101		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
102		if err != nil {
103			return err
104		}
105		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
106			current, currentErr := s.get(candidate.ID)
107			switch {
108			case currentErr == nil:
109				if candidate.storedRevision == "" || candidate.storedRevision != current.Revision() {
110					return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
111				}
112				if !candidate.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
113					return fmt.Errorf("task %s changed its creation time: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
114				}
115			case errors.Is(currentErr, ErrNotFound):
116				if candidate.storedRevision != "" {
117					return fmt.Errorf("task %s was removed after it was read: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
118				}
119			default:
120				return currentErr
121			}
122			stampForSave(candidate)
123			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
124				return err
125			}
126			candidate.storedRevision = candidate.Revision()
127			return nil
128		})
129		if err != nil {
130			return err
131		}
132		*t = *candidate
133		return nil
134	}

2	// change streams exist, what state each is in, which machine owns it, and what
3	// the next action is. Everything else — branch, dirty, ahead/behind, whether a
4	// worktree exists — is derived live and deliberately not stored here.

16	// State is where a change stream sits in its lifecycle.
17	type State string
18
19	const (
20		// Hot: worktree and branch exist, a runtime session is open, actively worked on.
21		Hot State = "hot"
22		// Warm: worktree and branch kept, runtime closed. Back within days.
23		Warm State = "warm"
24		// Cold: committed and pushed, worktree removed. Reconstructible anywhere.
25		Cold State = "cold"
26		// Done: merged. Kept only until the entry is reaped.
27		Done State = "done"
28	)
29
30	// States lists the lifecycle in order, for help text and validation.
31	var States = []State{Hot, Warm, Cold, Done}
32
33	// ParseState validates a user-supplied state name.
34	func ParseState(s string) (State, error) {
35		got := State(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s)))
36		for _, valid := range States {
37			if got == valid {
38				return got, nil
39			}
40		}
41		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown state %q: want one of %s", s, JoinStates(", "))
42	}
43
44	// JoinStates renders the valid state names.
45	func JoinStates(sep string) string {
46		parts := make([]string, len(States))
47		for i, s := range States {
48			parts[i] = string(s)
49		}
50		return strings.Join(parts, sep)
51	}
52
53	// Icon is the glyph shown in the inventory.
54	func (s State) Icon() string {
55		switch s {
56		case Hot:
57			return "🔥"
58		case Warm:
59			return "🌤"
60		case Cold:
61			return "❄️"
62		case Done:
63			return "✅"
64		}
65		return "?"
66	}

97		// survives every machine, worktree and runtime.
98		Branch string `toml:"branch"`
99		// Base is the ref the branch was created from, recorded so `dev done` can
100		// integrate without re-guessing.
101		Base string `toml:"base"`
102		// WorktreePath is the linked checkout, empty when the task works directly
103		// in the main checkout or has gone cold.
104		WorktreePath string `toml:"worktree_path"`
105		// Mode says whether this task uses a worktree, a branch in the canonical
106		// checkout, or the current branch directly. Older entries infer it.
107		Mode CheckoutMode `toml:"mode"`
108
109		State State `toml:"state"`
110		// Owner is the hostname that last held this task hot. One writer per
111		// branch at a time avoids two machines diverging the same history.
112		Owner string `toml:"owner"`
113		// Next is the single most valuable field in the file: what to do when you
114		// come back. Without it, parking a task still loses the thread.
115		Next string   `toml:"next"`
116		Note string   `toml:"note"`
117		Tags []string `toml:"tags"`
118
119		// AgentSession reserves a resumable agent context ("claude:<uuid>"). The
120		// production start/park/resume flow does not yet capture or attach it.
121		AgentSession string `toml:"agent_session"`
122		// RuntimeHandle is the last known runtime session id (e.g. a Herdr
123		// workspace id). RuntimeName records which backend owns that opaque handle.
124		// Both are advisory and must be revalidated against live checkout coverage.
125		RuntimeHandle string `toml:"runtime_handle"`
126		RuntimeName   string `toml:"runtime_name"`
127
128		Created time.Time `toml:"created"`
129		Updated time.Time `toml:"updated"`
130
131		// storedRevision is populated only by Store after a successful read/write.
132		// It never enters TOML or Revision and lets legacy Save callers participate
133		// in compare-and-swap without adding a persisted field older binaries erase.
134		storedRevision string
135	}
136
137	// Revision returns a deterministic fingerprint of the task identity and every
138	// field represented by its TOML record. It is deliberately computed rather
139	// than persisted: older dev binaries can continue to read and rewrite task
140	// files without erasing a revision field they do not know about.
141	func (t Task) Revision() string {
142		hash := sha256.New()
143		writeString := func(value string) {
144			var length [8]byte
145			binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(value)))
146			_, _ = hash.Write(length[:])
147			_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(value))
148		}
149		writeTime := func(value time.Time) {
150			writeString(value.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano))
151		}
152
153		writeString("dev-task-revision-v1")
154		writeString(t.ID)
155		writeString(t.Name)
156		writeString(t.Repo)
157		writeString(t.RepoPath)
158		writeString(t.Branch)
159		writeString(t.Base)
160		writeString(t.WorktreePath)
161		writeString(string(t.Mode))
162		writeString(string(t.State))
163		writeString(t.Owner)
164		writeString(t.Next)
165		writeString(t.Note)
166		writeString(fmt.Sprint(len(t.Tags)))
167		for _, tag := range t.Tags {
168			writeString(tag)
169		}
170		writeString(t.AgentSession)
171		writeString(t.RuntimeHandle)
172		writeString(t.RuntimeName)
173		writeTime(t.Created)
174		writeTime(t.Updated)
175
176		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
177	}
178
179	// EffectiveMode returns the explicit mode, or infers a legacy task. Before
180	// modes were recorded, a path meant worktree and no path meant a canonical

102		if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {

110		if err != nil {
111			return targetCheckout{}, err
112		}
113		type candidate struct {
114			path      string
115			commonDir string
116		}
117		var candidates []candidate
118		for _, repository := range repositories {
119			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
120				continue
121			}
122			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
123			if err != nil {
124				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect discovered target repository: %w", err)
125			}

129			}
130			if !matched {
131				continue
132			}
133			candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: gitRepo.Root, commonDir: gitRepo.GitCommonDir})
134		}
135		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].commonDir < candidates[j].commonDir })
136		switch len(candidates) {
137		case 0:

244	func patchRepositoryCatalog(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, add, remove []string, note *string) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
245		commonDir := repository.CommonDir
246		realPath := repository.RealPath
247		if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path); discoverErr == nil {
248			if commonDir == "" {
249				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
250			}
251			if realPath == "" {
252				realPath = discovered.Root
253			}
254		}
255		observation := catalog.Observation{
256			Host: config.Hostname(), Path: repository.Path, RealPath: realPath,
257			CommonDir: commonDir, Name: repository.Name,
258			RemoteIdentity: gitx.RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, "origin"),
259		}
260		add = catalog.NormalizeTags(add)
261		remove = catalog.NormalizeTags(remove)
262		entry, err := app.Registry.EnsureRepository(observation)
263		if err != nil {
264			return nil, err
265		}
266		return app.Registry.Patch(entry.ID, func(candidate *catalog.Entry) error {
267			kept := make([]string, 0, len(candidate.Tags)+len(add))
268			for _, tag := range candidate.Tags {
269				if !slices.Contains(remove, tag) {
270					kept = append(kept, tag)
271				}
272			}
273			candidate.Tags = append(kept, add...)
274			if note != nil {
275				candidate.Note = *note
276			}
277			return nil
278		})
279	}

162	// MoveIntent is written before a filesystem rename and cleared after the new
163	// location is durable. A surviving intent lets later commands reconcile a move
164	// interrupted between those two points.
165	type MoveIntent struct {
166		Host            string    `toml:"host" json:"host"`
167		Operation       string    `toml:"operation" json:"operation"`
168		SourcePath      string    `toml:"source_path" json:"source_path"`
169		DestinationPath string    `toml:"destination_path" json:"destination_path"`
170		Started         time.Time `toml:"started" json:"started"`
171	}

173	// Entry is one logical asset. ID is the stable filename stem and is deliberately
174	// not duplicated inside the TOML document.
175	type Entry struct {
176		SchemaVersion int      `toml:"schema_version" json:"schema_version"`
177		ID            string   `toml:"-" json:"id"`
178		Kind          Kind     `toml:"kind" json:"kind"`
179		Name          string   `toml:"name" json:"name"`
180		Note          string   `toml:"note" json:"note"`
181		Tags          []string `toml:"tags" json:"tags"`
182
183		// RemoteIdentity is a relocation hint, never sufficient on its own when
184		// several records or live clones could be the observation's owner.
185		RemoteIdentity string `toml:"remote_identity" json:"remote_identity"`
186
187		Experiment      *Experiment         `toml:"experiment,omitempty" json:"experiment,omitempty"`
188		Locations       map[string]Location `toml:"locations" json:"locations"`
189		RecoveryReceipt *RecoveryReceipt    `toml:"recovery_receipt,omitempty" json:"recovery_receipt,omitempty"`
190		MoveIntent      *MoveIntent         `toml:"move_intent,omitempty" json:"move_intent,omitempty"`
191
192		Created    time.Time `toml:"created" json:"created"`
193		Discovered time.Time `toml:"discovered" json:"discovered"`
194		LastOpened time.Time `toml:"last_opened" json:"last_opened"`
195		Updated    time.Time `toml:"updated" json:"updated"`
196	}
