198	var validID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`)
199
200	// ValidateID checks that id can be used as exactly one visible filename stem.
201	func ValidateID(id string) error {
202		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {
203			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrInvalidID)
204		}
205		return nil
206	}
207
208	// NormalizeTags trims, lowercases, deduplicates and sorts tags. Sorting makes
209	// persisted output deterministic regardless of the order in which callers add
210	// labels.
211	func NormalizeTags(tags []string) []string {
212		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(tags))
213		for _, tag := range tags {
214			tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
215			if tag != "" {
216				seen[tag] = struct{}{}
217			}
218		}
219		out := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
220		for tag := range seen {
221			out = append(out, tag)
222		}
223		sort.Strings(out)
224		return out
225	}
226
227	// Normalize applies the lossless normalizations stores use before validation.
228	func (e *Entry) Normalize() {
229		if e == nil {
230			return
231		}
232		e.Name = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
233		e.Tags = NormalizeTags(e.Tags)
234		e.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RemoteIdentity)
235		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
236			e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(e.RecoveryReceipt.RemoteIdentity)
237		}
238	}
239
240	// Title is the human label, falling back to the stable ID for damaged display
241	// data. Persisted entries still require a name during validation.
242	func (e Entry) Title() string {
243		if e.Name != "" {
244			return e.Name
245		}
246		return e.ID
247	}
248
249	// HasTag reports membership after applying the same normalization as storage.
250	func (e Entry) HasTag(tag string) bool {
251		tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
252		return tag != "" && slices.Contains(e.Tags, tag)
253	}
254
255	// LocationFor returns host's location without exposing the map for mutation.
256	func (e Entry) LocationFor(host string) (Location, bool) {
257		location, ok := e.Locations[host]
258		return location, ok
259	}
260
261	// SetLocation validates and records one host location.
262	func (e *Entry) SetLocation(host string, location Location) error {
263		if e == nil {
264			return errors.New("set location on nil catalog entry")
265		}
266		if err := validateLocationForSet(host, location); err != nil {
267			return err
268		}
269		if e.Locations == nil {
270			e.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
271		}
272		e.Locations[host] = location
273		return nil
274	}
275
276	// Clone returns a deep copy suitable for mutation before an atomic update.
277	func (e Entry) Clone() *Entry {
278		clone := e
279		clone.Tags = append([]string(nil), e.Tags...)
280		if e.Experiment != nil {
281			value := *e.Experiment
282			clone.Experiment = &value
283		}
284		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
285			value := *e.RecoveryReceipt
286			clone.RecoveryReceipt = &value
287		}
288		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
289			value := *e.MoveIntent
290			clone.MoveIntent = &value
291		}
292		if e.Locations != nil {
293			clone.Locations = make(map[string]Location, len(e.Locations))
294			for host, location := range e.Locations {
295				clone.Locations[host] = location
296			}
297		}
298		return &clone
299	}

301	// Validate rejects records that later lifecycle operations could not interpret
302	// safely. Store.Create fills identity and timestamps before calling it.
303	func (e Entry) Validate() error {
304		if e.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
305			return &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: e.ID, Version: e.SchemaVersion}
306		}
307		if err := ValidateID(e.ID); err != nil {
308			return err
309		}
310		switch e.Kind {
311		case KindTry:
312			if e.Experiment == nil {
313				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: try kind requires experiment metadata", e.ID)
314			}
315		case KindRepository:
316		default:
317			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown kind %q", e.ID, e.Kind)
318		}
319		if strings.TrimSpace(e.Name) == "" {
320			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: name is required", e.ID)
321		}
322		if !slices.Equal(e.Tags, NormalizeTags(e.Tags)) {
323			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: tags must be normalized lowercase values", e.ID)
324		}
325		if e.Experiment != nil {
326			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
327			case PhaseActive, PhaseDeprecated, PhaseGraduated:
328			default:
329				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: unknown experiment phase %q", e.ID, e.Experiment.Phase)
330			}
331			switch {
332			case e.Kind == KindTry && e.Experiment.Phase == PhaseGraduated:
333				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: graduated experiment must be a repository", e.ID)
334			case e.Kind == KindRepository && e.Experiment.Phase != PhaseGraduated:
335				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: repository experiment history must be graduated", e.ID)
336			}
337			if e.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
338				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment started timestamp is required", e.ID)
339			}
340			if e.Experiment.Slug == "" {
341				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment slug is required", e.ID)
342			}
343			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(e.Experiment.Slug); err != nil {
344				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment slug: %w", e.ID, err)
345			}
346			if e.Experiment.OriginalPath == "" {
347				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: experiment original path is required", e.ID)
348			}
349			switch e.Experiment.Phase {
350			case PhaseDeprecated:
351				if e.Experiment.DeprecatedAt.IsZero() || e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath == "" {
352					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: deprecated experiment requires timestamp and path", e.ID)
353				}
354			case PhaseGraduated:
355				if e.Experiment.GraduatedAt.IsZero() || e.Experiment.GraduatedPath == "" {
356					return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: graduated experiment requires timestamp and path", e.ID)
357				}
358			}
359			if err := validateStringFields("experiment", []struct {
360				name  string
361				value string
362			}{
363				{"slug", e.Experiment.Slug},
364				{"origin_url", e.Experiment.OriginURL},
365				{"original_path", e.Experiment.OriginalPath},
366				{"deprecated_path", e.Experiment.DeprecatedPath},
367				{"graduated_path", e.Experiment.GraduatedPath},
368			}); err != nil {
369				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
370			}
371		}
372		hosts := make([]string, 0, len(e.Locations))
373		for host := range e.Locations {
374			hosts = append(hosts, host)
375		}
376		sort.Strings(hosts)
377		for _, host := range hosts {
378			if err := validateLocation(host, e.Locations[host]); err != nil {
379				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
380			}
381		}
382		if e.RecoveryReceipt != nil {
383			if err := validateRecoveryReceipt(*e.RecoveryReceipt); err != nil {
384				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
385			}
386		}
387		if e.MoveIntent != nil {
388			if err := validateMoveIntent(*e.MoveIntent); err != nil {
389				return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: %w", e.ID, err)
390			}
391		}
392		if e.Created.IsZero() || e.Discovered.IsZero() || e.Updated.IsZero() {
393			return fmt.Errorf("catalog asset %s: created, discovered and updated timestamps are required", e.ID)
394		}
395		return nil
396	}

398	func validateLocation(host string, location Location) error {
399		return validateLocationValue(host, location, true)
400	}
401
402	func validateLocationForSet(host string, location Location) error {
403		return validateLocationValue(host, location, false)
404	}
405
406	func validateLocationValue(host string, location Location, requireUpdated bool) error {
407		if err := validateHostValue("location host", host); err != nil {
408			return err
409		}
410		fields := []struct {
411			name  string
412			value string
413		}{
414			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
415			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
416			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
417			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
418		}
419		for _, field := range fields {
420			if strings.ContainsRune(field.value, '\x00') {
421				return fmt.Errorf("location %s %s contains NUL", host, field.name)
422			}
423		}
424		if requireUpdated && location.Updated.IsZero() {
425			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: updated timestamp is required", host)
426		}
427		switch location.State {
428		case LocationPresent:
429			if location.CurrentPath == "" {
430				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: present state requires current_path", host)
431			}
432		case LocationArchived:
433			if location.CurrentPath == "" || location.RestorePath == "" {
434				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: archived state requires current_path and restore_path", host)
435			}
436		case LocationEvicted:
437			if location.RestorePath == "" {
438				return fmt.Errorf("location %s: evicted state requires restore_path", host)
439			}
440		default:
441			return fmt.Errorf("location %s: unknown state %q", host, location.State)
442		}
443		return nil
444	}
445
446	func validateRecoveryReceipt(receipt RecoveryReceipt) error {
447		if err := validateHostValue("recovery receipt host", receipt.Host); err != nil {
448			return err
449		}
450		if receipt.Method == "" || receipt.Method != strings.TrimSpace(receipt.Method) {
451			return errors.New("recovery receipt method is required and must be normalized")
452		}
453		if receipt.Created.IsZero() || receipt.Verified.IsZero() {
454			return errors.New("recovery receipt requires created and verified timestamps")
455		}
456		fields := []struct {
457			name  string
458			value string
459		}{
460			{"method", receipt.Method},
461			{"source_path", receipt.SourcePath},
462			{"restore_path", receipt.RestorePath},
463			{"remote_identity", receipt.RemoteIdentity},
464			{"remote_name", receipt.RemoteName},
465			{"remote_url", receipt.RemoteURL},
466			{"revision", receipt.Revision},
467			{"refs_digest", receipt.RefsDigest},
468			{"archive_path", receipt.ArchivePath},
469			{"checksum", receipt.Checksum},
470		}
471		return validateStringFields("recovery receipt", fields)
472	}
473
474	func validateMoveIntent(intent MoveIntent) error {
475		if err := validateHostValue("move intent host", intent.Host); err != nil {
476			return err
477		}
478		if intent.Operation == "" || intent.Operation != strings.TrimSpace(intent.Operation) {
479			return errors.New("move intent operation is required and must be normalized")
480		}
481		if intent.Started.IsZero() {
482			return errors.New("move intent started timestamp is required")
483		}
484		if intent.SourcePath == "" || intent.DestinationPath == "" {
485			return errors.New("move intent requires source and destination paths")
486		}
487		if err := validateStringFields("move intent", []struct {
488			name  string
489			value string
490		}{
491			{"operation", intent.Operation},
492			{"source_path", intent.SourcePath},
493			{"destination_path", intent.DestinationPath},
494		}); err != nil {
495			return err
496		}
497		if filepath.Clean(intent.SourcePath) == filepath.Clean(intent.DestinationPath) {
498			return errors.New("move intent source and destination are identical")
499		}
500		return nil
501	}
502
503	func validateHostValue(name, host string) error {
504		if host == "" {
505			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
506		}
507		if host != strings.TrimSpace(host) || strings.ContainsRune(host, '\x00') {
508			return fmt.Errorf("%s %q is not normalized", name, host)
509		}
510		return nil
511	}
512
513	func validateStringFields(scope string, fields []struct {

515		value string
516	}) error {

523	}

90	// NewStore returns a catalog rooted at dir.
91	func NewStore(dir string, options ...StoreOption) *Store {
92		store := &Store{
93			Dir:        dir,
94			generateID: uuid.NewString,
95			clock:      time.Now,

105	// WithLock runs operation while holding the catalog's cross-process advisory
106	// lock. It is intended for short read-match-write transactions; expensive
107	// discovery belongs before the lock. The operating system releases the lock if
108	// the process exits unexpectedly.
109	func (s *Store) WithLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
110		if s == nil {
111			return errors.New("lock nil catalog store")
112		}
113		if operation == nil {
114			return errors.New("catalog lock requires an operation")
115		}
116		s.mu.Lock()
117		defer s.mu.Unlock()
118		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "catalog", operation)
119	}
120	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }

123	// value is updated only after the rename succeeds.
124	func (s *Store) Create(entry *Entry) error {
125		if err := s.validateCreateInput(entry); err != nil {
126			return err
127		}
128		return s.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error { return s.CreateUnderLock(entry) })
129	}

131	// CreateUnderLock is the non-reentrant form used only inside Store.WithLock.
132	// Calling it without that transaction guard is a programming error.
133	func (s *Store) CreateUnderLock(entry *Entry) error {
134		if entry == nil {
135			return errors.New("create nil catalog entry")
136		}
137		if entry.ID != "" {
138			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog asset: ID is assigned by the store")
139		}
140		prepare := func() (*Entry, error) {
141			candidate := entry.Clone()
142			candidate.ID = s.nextID()
143			if err := ValidateID(candidate.ID); err != nil {
144				return nil, fmt.Errorf("generated catalog ID: %w", err)
145			}
146			now := s.now()
147			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
148			if candidate.Created.IsZero() {
149				candidate.Created = now
150			}
151			if candidate.Discovered.IsZero() {
152				candidate.Discovered = now
153			}
154			candidate.Updated = now
155			prepareNewNested(candidate, now)
156			candidate.Normalize()
157			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
158				return nil, err
159			}
160			return candidate, nil
161		}
162		candidate, err := prepare()
163		if err != nil {
164			return err
165		}
166		for range 32 {
167			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
168				candidate, err = prepare()
169				if err != nil {
170					return err
171				}
172				continue
173			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
174				return fmt.Errorf("check catalog ID %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
175			}
176			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
177				return err
178			}
179			*entry = *candidate
180			return nil
181		}
182		return fmt.Errorf("generate unique catalog ID: %w", ErrAlreadyExists)
183	}

208	// Import merges portable metadata for an exact stable ID and records location as
209	// host's local view. Source locations are deliberately ignored: only the caller-
210	// supplied target location may claim a path on this machine. Move intents and
211	// recovery receipts are host-owned lifecycle authority and cannot be imported.
212	// The complete read-check-write transaction runs under the catalog's advisory
213	// lock so concurrent processes cannot claim the same target path.
214	func (s *Store) Import(ctx context.Context, source *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, error) {
215		if s == nil {
216			return nil, errors.New("import into nil catalog store")
217		}
218		if source == nil {
219			return nil, errors.New("import nil catalog entry")

318			imported = merged.Clone()

324	func importConflict(id, existingID, field, reason string) error {
325		return &ImportConflictError{ID: id, ExistingID: existingID, Field: field, Reason: reason}
326	}

328	func currentLocation(entry *Entry, host string) (Location, bool) {
329		if entry == nil {
330			return Location{}, false
331		}
332		return entry.LocationFor(host)
333	}

335	func rejectImportedPathOwner(entries []*Entry, importedID, host string, target Location) error {
336		targetPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(target)
337		if err != nil {
338			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize imported location on host %s: %w", host, err)
339		}
340		for _, entry := range entries {
341			if entry.ID == importedID {
342				continue
343			}
344			owned, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
345			if !ok {
346				continue
347			}
348			ownedPaths, err := canonicalLocationPaths(owned)
349			if err != nil {
350				return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize catalog asset %s location on host %s: %w", entry.ID, host, err)
351			}
352			ownedSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ownedPaths))
353			for _, path := range ownedPaths {
354				ownedSet[path] = struct{}{}
355			}
356			for _, path := range targetPaths {
357				if _, exists := ownedSet[path]; exists {
358					return importConflict(importedID, entry.ID, "location",
359						fmt.Sprintf("target path %q on host %s is already owned", path, host))
360				}
361			}
362		}
363		return nil
364	}
365
366	func canonicalLocationPaths(location Location) ([]string, error) {
367		fields := []struct {
368			name  string
369			value string
370		}{
371			{"current_path", location.CurrentPath},
372			{"restore_path", location.RestorePath},
373			{"real_path", location.RealPath},
374			{"git_common_dir", location.GitCommonDir},
375		}
376		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(fields))
377		for _, field := range fields {
378			if field.value == "" {
379				continue
380			}
381			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(field.value)
382			if err != nil {
383				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s %q: %w", field.name, field.value, err)
384			}
385			seen[canonical] = struct{}{}
386		}
387		paths := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
388		for path := range seen {
389			paths = append(paths, path)
390		}
391		sort.Strings(paths)
392		return paths, nil
393	}

395	func mergeImportedEntry(current, incoming *Entry, host string, location Location) (*Entry, bool, error) {
396		if current.SchemaVersion != incoming.SchemaVersion {
397			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "schema_version", "schema versions differ")
398		}
399		if current.Kind != incoming.Kind {
400			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "kind",
401				fmt.Sprintf("durable kind %q differs from imported kind %q", current.Kind, incoming.Kind))
402		}
403		if current.Name != incoming.Name {
404			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "name",
405				fmt.Sprintf("durable name %q differs from imported name %q", current.Name, incoming.Name))
406		}
407
408		merged := current.Clone()
409		changed := false
410
411		currentSummary := strings.TrimSpace(merged.Note)
412		incomingSummary := strings.TrimSpace(incoming.Note)
413		switch {
414		case currentSummary != "" && incomingSummary != "" && merged.Note != incoming.Note:
415			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "note", "nonempty summaries differ")
416		case currentSummary == "" && incomingSummary != "":
417			merged.Note = incoming.Note
418			changed = true
419		}
420
421		tags := NormalizeTags(append(append([]string(nil), merged.Tags...), incoming.Tags...))
422		if !slices.Equal(merged.Tags, tags) {
423			merged.Tags = tags
424			changed = true
425		}
426
427		switch {
428		case merged.RemoteIdentity != "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "" && merged.RemoteIdentity != incoming.RemoteIdentity:
429			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "remote_identity",
430				fmt.Sprintf("durable identity %q differs from imported identity %q", merged.RemoteIdentity, incoming.RemoteIdentity))
431		case merged.RemoteIdentity == "" && incoming.RemoteIdentity != "":
432			merged.RemoteIdentity = incoming.RemoteIdentity
433			changed = true
434		}
435
436		switch {
437		case merged.Experiment == nil && incoming.Experiment != nil:
438			value := *incoming.Experiment
439			merged.Experiment = &value
440			changed = true
441		case merged.Experiment != nil && incoming.Experiment != nil && !experimentsEqual(*merged.Experiment, *incoming.Experiment):
442			return nil, false, importConflict(incoming.ID, current.ID, "experiment", "experiment metadata differs")
443		}
444
445		if value := earlierTime(merged.Created, incoming.Created); !value.Equal(merged.Created) {
446			merged.Created = value
447			changed = true
448		}
449		if value := earlierTime(merged.Discovered, incoming.Discovered); !value.Equal(merged.Discovered) {
450			merged.Discovered = value
451			changed = true
452		}
453		if value := laterTime(merged.LastOpened, incoming.LastOpened); !value.Equal(merged.LastOpened) {
454			merged.LastOpened = value
455			changed = true
456		}
457		if value := laterTime(merged.Updated, incoming.Updated); !value.Equal(merged.Updated) {
458			merged.Updated = value
459			changed = true
460		}
461
462		previous, exists := merged.LocationFor(host)
463		if !exists || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) || !previous.Updated.Equal(location.Updated) {
464			if merged.Locations == nil {
465				merged.Locations = make(map[string]Location)
466			}
467			merged.Locations[host] = location
468			changed = true
469		}
470		merged.Normalize()
471		if err := merged.Validate(); err != nil {
472			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("validate merged catalog asset %s: %w", merged.ID, err)
473		}
474		return merged, changed, nil
475	}

477	func experimentsEqual(left, right Experiment) bool {
478		return left.Phase == right.Phase &&
479			left.Slug == right.Slug &&
480			left.OriginURL == right.OriginURL &&
481			left.Started.Equal(right.Started) &&
482			left.OriginalPath == right.OriginalPath &&
483			left.DeprecatedAt.Equal(right.DeprecatedAt) &&
484			left.DeprecatedPath == right.DeprecatedPath &&
485			left.GraduatedAt.Equal(right.GraduatedAt) &&
486			left.GraduatedPath == right.GraduatedPath
487	}

489	func earlierTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
490		if left.IsZero() || !right.IsZero() && right.Before(left) {
491			return right
492		}
493		return left
494	}

496	func laterTime(left, right time.Time) time.Time {
497		if right.After(left) {
498			return right
499		}
500		return left
501	}

503	// Get loads one asset by exact ID.
504	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
505		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
506			return nil, err
507		}
508		return s.get(id)
509	}
510
511	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
512		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
513		if err != nil {
514			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
515				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
516			}
517			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
518		}
519		var header struct {
520			SchemaVersion int `toml:"schema_version"`
521		}
522		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &header); err != nil {
523			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
524		}
525		if header.SchemaVersion != 0 && header.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
526			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: header.SchemaVersion}
527		}
528
529		var entry Entry
530		metadata, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &entry)
531		if err != nil {
532			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
533		}
534		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
535			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: unknown field(s): %v", id, undecoded)
536		}
537		entry.ID = id
538		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
539		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
540		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
541			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
542		}
543		entry.Normalize()
544		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
545			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
546		}
547		return &entry, nil
548	}
549
550	// List loads every valid record in deterministic ID order. Per-record failures
551	// are skipped and sent to the configured diagnostic sink; directory-level
552	// failures are returned.
553	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
554		entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
555		if err != nil {
556			return nil, err
557		}
558		s.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
559		return entries, nil
560	}
561
562	func (s *Store) reportDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
563		if s.diagnostics == nil {
564			return
565		}
566		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
567			s.diagnostics(diagnostic)
568		}
569	}
570
571	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
572	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
573	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
574		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
575		if err != nil {
576			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
577				return nil, nil, nil
578			}
579			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
580		}
581
582		var entries []*Entry
583		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
584		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
585			name := directoryEntry.Name()
586			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
587				continue
588			}
589			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
590			entry, err := s.Get(id)
591			if err != nil {
592				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
593				continue
594			}
595			entries = append(entries, entry)
596		}
597		Sort(entries)
598		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
599		return entries, diagnostics, nil
600	}

602	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
603	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
604	// immutable.
605	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
606		var result *Entry
607		err := s.WithLock(context.Background(), func() error {
608			var err error
609			result, err = s.UpdateUnderLock(id, mutate)
610			return err
611		})
612		return result, err
613	}
614
615	// UpdateUnderLock is the non-reentrant form used only inside Store.WithLock.
616	// Calling it without that transaction guard is a programming error.
617	func (s *Store) UpdateUnderLock(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
618		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
619			return nil, err
620		}
621		if mutate == nil {
622			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
623		}
624		current, err := s.get(id)
625		if err != nil {
626			return nil, err
627		}
628		updated := current.Clone()
629		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
630			return nil, err
631		}
632		if updated.ID != current.ID {
633			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
634		}
635		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
636			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
637		}
638		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
639			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
640		}
641		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
642			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
643		}
644
645		now := s.now()
646		updated.Updated = now
647		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
648		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)
649		updated.Normalize()
650		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
651			return nil, err
652		}
653		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
654			return nil, err
655		}
656		return updated.Clone(), nil
657	}
658
659	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
660	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
661		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
662			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
663		})
664	}

666	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
667		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
668		if err != nil {
669			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
670		}
671		name := temporary.Name()
672		defer os.Remove(name)
673
674		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
675			_ = temporary.Close()
676			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
677		}
678		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
679			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
680		}
681		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
682			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
683		}
684		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
685			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
686		}
687		return nil
688	}

692			return uuid.NewString()
693		}
694		return s.generateID()

697	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
698		if s.clock == nil {
699			return time.Now().UTC()
700		}
701		return s.clock().UTC()
702	}

704	func prepareNewNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
705		if entry.Experiment != nil {
706			if entry.Experiment.Phase == "" {
707				entry.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
708			}
709			if entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
710				entry.Experiment.Started = now
711			}
712		}
713		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
714			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
715				location.Updated = now
716				entry.Locations[host] = location
717			}
718		}
719		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
720			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
721		}
722		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
723			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
724		}
725	}
726
727	func prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
728		if current.Experiment == nil && updated.Experiment != nil {
729			if updated.Experiment.Phase == "" {
730				updated.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
731			}
732			if updated.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
733				updated.Experiment.Started = now
734			}
735		}
736		if updated.RecoveryReceipt != nil && updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() &&
737			(current.RecoveryReceipt == nil || recoveryPayloadChanged(*current.RecoveryReceipt, *updated.RecoveryReceipt)) {
738			updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
739		}
740		if updated.MoveIntent != nil && updated.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() &&
741			(current.MoveIntent == nil || moveIntentPayloadChanged(*current.MoveIntent, *updated.MoveIntent)) {
742			updated.MoveIntent.Started = now
743		}
744	}
745
746	func recoveryPayloadChanged(left, right RecoveryReceipt) bool {
747		left.Created = time.Time{}
748		right.Created = time.Time{}
749		return left != right
750	}
751
752	func moveIntentPayloadChanged(left, right MoveIntent) bool {
753		left.Started = time.Time{}
754		right.Started = time.Time{}
755		return left != right
756	}
757
758	func stampChangedLocations(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
759		for host, location := range updated.Locations {
760			previous, existed := current.Locations[host]
761			if !existed || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) {
762				location.Updated = now
763			} else {
764				// Updated is store-owned metadata. A mutation that did not change this
765				// host's location must not make it look newly observed.
766				location.Updated = previous.Updated
767			}
768			updated.Locations[host] = location
769		}
770	}
771
772	func locationPayloadChanged(left, right Location) bool {
773		left.Updated = time.Time{}
774		right.Updated = time.Time{}
775		return left != right
776	}

69			return nil, fmt.Errorf("refresh published file %q: %w", name, err)
70		}
71		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
72			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after creating %q: %w", name, err)
73		}
74		return published, nil
75	}

77	// CreatePrivateNoClobber is CreateNoClobber with a clamped owner-only final
78	// mode. executable is the only way to grant execute permission.
79	func CreatePrivateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
80		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
82		}
83		return CreateNoClobber(ctx, root, name, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
84	}

86	// AtomicReplace stages and syncs data in the target directory, revalidates the
87	// existing regular file against observed, and atomically renames the staged file
88	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
89	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
90	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
91	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
92	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.
93	func AtomicReplace(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
94		if root == nil {
95			return nil, errors.New("atomic replace: nil root")
96		}
97		if observed == nil {
98			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replace %q without observed state: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
99		}
100		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)
107		if err != nil {
108			return nil, err
109		}
110		defer func() {
111			if stagedName != "" {
112				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
113			}
114		}()
115		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
116			return nil, err
117		}
118		if err := root.Rename(stagedName, name); err != nil {
119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("atomically replace %q: %w", name, err)
120		}
121		stagedName = ""
122		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
123		if err != nil {
124			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
125		}
126		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
127			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
128		}
129		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
130			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
131		}
132		return published, nil
133	}
134
135	// AtomicReplacePrivate is AtomicReplace with owner-only final permissions.
136	func AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
137		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
138			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
139		}
140		return AtomicReplace(ctx, root, name, observed, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
141	}
142
143	func verifyReplaceTarget(root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo) error {
144		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("inspect replacement target %q: %w: %w", name, err, ErrReplaceTarget)
147		}
148		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(observed, current) {
149			return fmt.Errorf("replacement target %q changed or is not a regular file: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
150		}
151		return nil
152	}
153
154	func stageRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (string, fs.FileInfo, error) {
155		if finalMode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
156			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported final file mode %s", finalMode)
157		}
158		var name string
159		var writer *os.File
160		for attempt := 0; attempt < 32; attempt++ {
161			candidate, err := randomStageName()
162			if err != nil {
163				return "", nil, err
164			}
165			writer, err = root.OpenFile(candidate, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
166			if err == nil {
167				name = candidate
168				break
169			}
170			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
171				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("create private staging file: %w", err)
172			}
173		}
174		if writer == nil {
175			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
176		}
177		keep := true
178		defer func() {
179			if keep {
180				_ = writer.Close()
181				_ = root.Remove(name)
182			}
183		}()
184		if err := writeAllContext(ctx, writer, data); err != nil {
185			return "", nil, err
186		}
187		if err := writer.Chmod(finalMode.Perm()); err != nil {
188			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("set staged file mode: %w", err)
189		}
190		if err := writer.Sync(); err != nil {
191			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("sync staged file: %w", err)
192		}
193		opened, err := writer.Stat()
194		if err != nil {
195			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect staged file: %w", err)
196		}
197		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
198			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("close staged file: %w", err)
199		}
200		keep = false
201		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
202		if err != nil {
203			_ = root.Remove(name)
204			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("reopen staged file name: %w", err)
205		}
206		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(opened, current) {
207			_ = root.Remove(name)
208			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("staging file changed before publication: %w", ErrChanged)
209		}
210		return name, current, nil
211	}
212
213	func validateTargetName(name string) error {
214		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
215			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
216		}
217		return nil
218	}
219
220	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
221		for len(data) > 0 {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return err
224			}
225			written, err := writer.Write(data)
226			if err != nil {
227				return err
228			}
229			if written == 0 {
230				return io.ErrShortWrite
231			}
232			data = data[written:]
233		}
234		return context.Cause(ctx)
235	}
236
237	func randomStageName() (string, error) {
238		var random [16]byte
239		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
240			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
241		}
242		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
243	}

59	func resolveStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (repo.Repo, error) {
60		if ref != "" {
61			r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
62			return r, err
63		}
64		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
65		if err != nil {
66			return repo.Repo{}, err
67		}
68		g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
69		if err != nil {
70			return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("no repo argument and %s is not a git repository", config.Contract(cwd))
71		}
72		return repo.Repo{
73			Name: g.Name, Path: g.MainRoot, RealPath: g.MainRoot,
74			MainRoot: g.MainRoot, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
75		}, nil
76	}

82		}

86	func buildStartSpecForRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, r repo.Repo, req startRequest) (*startSpec, error) {
87		if r.Bare {
88			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is a bare repository and cannot host a task checkout", r.Display())
89		}
90
91		name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
92		if name == "" && req.Branch != "" && req.Mode != task.ModeDirect {
93			name = req.Branch
94		}
95		if name == "" {
96			return nil, errors.New("give the work a name: dev start <repo> --task <name>")
97		}
98
99		branch, base := strings.TrimSpace(req.Branch), strings.TrimSpace(req.Base)
100		mode := req.Mode
101		if mode == "" {
102			mode = task.ModeWorktree
103		}
104		switch mode {
105		case task.ModeDirect:
106			st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
107			if err != nil {
108				return nil, err
109			}
110			if st.Detached || st.Branch == "" {
111				return nil, errors.New("--direct needs a named branch; this checkout has detached HEAD")
112			}
113			if branch != "" && branch != st.Branch {
114				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--direct tracks the branch already checked out (%s), not --branch %s; "+
115					"omit --branch or use --branch-only", st.Branch, branch)
116			}
117			branch, base = st.Branch, st.Branch
118
119		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeWorktree:
120			if branch == "" {
121				branch = "feat/" + config.Slug(name)
122			}
123			if base == "" {
124				base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, r.Path)
125			}
126			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, r.Path, "check-ref-format", "--branch", branch); err != nil {
127				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid branch %q: %w", branch, err)
128			}
129			if !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, r.Path, branch) {
130				if base == "" {
131					return nil, errors.New("cannot determine a base ref; enter one explicitly")
132				}
133				if !gitx.RefExists(ctx, r.Path, base) {
134					return nil, fmt.Errorf("base ref %q does not exist in %s", base, r.Path)

404			if label == "" || strings.HasPrefix(label, "-") || strings.HasSuffix(label, "-") {

121		stagedName = ""
122		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
123		if err != nil {
124			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
125		}
126		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
127			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
128		}
129		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
130			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
131		}
132		return published, nil
133	}
134
135	// AtomicReplacePrivate is AtomicReplace with owner-only final permissions.
136	func AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
137		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
138			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
139		}
140		return AtomicReplace(ctx, root, name, observed, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
141	}
142
143	func verifyReplaceTarget(root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo) error {
144		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("inspect replacement target %q: %w: %w", name, err, ErrReplaceTarget)
147		}
148		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(observed, current) {
149			return fmt.Errorf("replacement target %q changed or is not a regular file: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
150		}
151		return nil
152	}
153
154	func stageRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (string, fs.FileInfo, error) {
155		if finalMode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
156			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported final file mode %s", finalMode)
157		}
158		var name string
159		var writer *os.File
160		for attempt := 0; attempt < 32; attempt++ {
161			candidate, err := randomStageName()
162			if err != nil {
163				return "", nil, err
164			}
165			writer, err = root.OpenFile(candidate, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
166			if err == nil {
167				name = candidate
168				break
169			}
170			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
171				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("create private staging file: %w", err)
172			}
173		}
174		if writer == nil {
175			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
176		}
177		keep := true
178		defer func() {
179			if keep {
180				_ = writer.Close()
181				_ = root.Remove(name)
182			}
183		}()
184		if err := writeAllContext(ctx, writer, data); err != nil {
185			return "", nil, err
186		}
187		if err := writer.Chmod(finalMode.Perm()); err != nil {
188			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("set staged file mode: %w", err)
189		}
190		if err := writer.Sync(); err != nil {
191			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("sync staged file: %w", err)
192		}
193		opened, err := writer.Stat()
194		if err != nil {
195			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect staged file: %w", err)
196		}
197		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
198			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("close staged file: %w", err)
199		}
200		keep = false
201		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
202		if err != nil {
203			_ = root.Remove(name)
204			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("reopen staged file name: %w", err)
205		}
206		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(opened, current) {
207			_ = root.Remove(name)
208			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("staging file changed before publication: %w", ErrChanged)
209		}
210		return name, current, nil
211	}
212
213	func validateTargetName(name string) error {
214		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
215			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
216		}
217		return nil
218	}
219
220	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
221		for len(data) > 0 {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return err
224			}
225			written, err := writer.Write(data)
226			if err != nil {
227				return err
228			}
229			if written == 0 {
230				return io.ErrShortWrite
231			}
232			data = data[written:]
233		}
234		return context.Cause(ctx)
235	}
236
237	func randomStageName() (string, error) {
238		var random [16]byte
239		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
240			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
241		}
242		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
243	}

14		Root string
15		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory. A linked worktree has
16		// its own entry below the shared common directory.

20		GitCommonDir string
21		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
22		Name string
23		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
24		// the main checkout.
25		IsLinkedWorktree bool
26		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
27		MainRoot string
28		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
29		Bare bool
30	}
31
32	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
33	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
34
35	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
36	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
37		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
38		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
39		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
40			"rev-parse",
41			"--path-format=absolute",
42			"--show-toplevel",
43			"--git-dir",
44			"--git-common-dir",
45			"--is-bare-repository",
46		)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Repo{}, err
49		}
50		f := lines(out)
51		r := Repo{}
52		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
53		switch len(f) {
54		case 4:
55			r.Root = f[0]
56			r.GitDir = f[1]
57			r.GitCommonDir = f[2]
58			r.Bare = f[3] == "true"
59		case 3:
60			r.GitDir = f[0]
61			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
62			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
63		default:
64			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
65		}
66
67		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
68		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
69		if r.Bare {
70			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
71		} else if r.GitDir == r.GitCommonDir {
72			// A normal checkout may use --separate-git-dir, so the common directory's
73			// parent is not necessarily the working-tree root.
74			r.MainRoot = r.Root
75		} else {
76			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
77		}
78		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.GitDir != r.GitCommonDir
79		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
80		if r.Bare {
81			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
82			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
83			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
84				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
85			}
86		}
87		return r, nil
88	}

101	func (s *Service) resolveTarget(ctx context.Context, binding Binding) (targetCheckout, error) {
102		if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
103			return targetCheckout{}, err
104		}
105		options := repo.DefaultOptions()
106		if s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth > 0 {
107			options.MaxDepth = s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth
108		}
109		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, s.Config.DiscoveryRoots(), options)
110		if err != nil {
111			return targetCheckout{}, err
112		}
113		type candidate struct {
114			path      string
115			commonDir string
116		}
117		var candidates []candidate
118		for _, repository := range repositories {
119			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
120				continue
121			}
122			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
123			if err != nil {
124				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect discovered target repository: %w", err)
125			}
126			matched, err := checkoutHasIdentity(ctx, gitRepo.Root, binding.RemoteIdentity)
127			if err != nil {
128				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect target repository fetch identities: %w", err)
129			}
130			if !matched {
131				continue
132			}
133			candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: gitRepo.Root, commonDir: gitRepo.GitCommonDir})
134		}
135		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].commonDir < candidates[j].commonDir })
136		switch len(candidates) {
137		case 0:
138			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAbsent}
139		case 1:
140		default:
141			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAmbiguous}
142		}
143		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidates[0].path, binding.Branch)
144		if err != nil {
145			return targetCheckout{}, err
146		}
147		if !checkedOut || worktree.Bare || worktree.Prunable {
148			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetFetchedOnly}
149		}
150		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
151		if err != nil {
152			return targetCheckout{}, err
153		}
154		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
155		if err != nil {
156			return targetCheckout{}, err
157		}
158		if status.Detached || status.Branch != binding.Branch || head != binding.HeadOID || worktree.Head != binding.HeadOID {
159			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetStale}
160		}
161		checkout := targetCheckout{
162			root: worktree.Path, commonDir: candidates[0].commonDir,
163			identity: binding.RemoteIdentity, branch: binding.Branch, head: head,
164		}
165		checkout.id = digestJSON(struct {
166			Domain    string `json:"domain"`
167			CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
168			Root      string `json:"root"`
169			Branch    string `json:"branch"`
170			Head      string `json:"head"`
171		}{"dev-local-files-checkout-v1", checkout.commonDir, checkout.root, checkout.branch, checkout.head})
172		return checkout, nil
173	}

175	func checkoutHasIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, wanted string) (bool, error) {
176		names, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
177		if err != nil {
178			return false, err
179		}
180		for _, name := range strings.Fields(names) {
181			// Repository identity is established from fetch URLs. A push-only match
182			// can name a different mirror or publication target and must not authorize
183			// writing local files into an otherwise unrelated clone.
184			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", name)
185			if err != nil {
186				continue
187			}
188			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
189				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
190					return true, nil
191				}
192			}
193		}
194		return false, nil
195	}
196
197	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
198		if s == nil {
199			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("nil local-files service")
200		}
201		if s.platform() == "windows" {
202			return PlanResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetIncompatible}
203		}
204		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
205			return PlanResponse{}, err
206		}
207		id, err := s.machineID(ctx)
208		if err != nil {
209			return PlanResponse{}, err
210		}
211		if id != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
212			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("target machine identity changed after capability probe")
213		}
214		hostLimits := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
215		if err := hostLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
216			return PlanResponse{}, err
217		}
218		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(hostLimits, request.Limits)
219		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
220			return PlanResponse{}, errors.New("plan limits do not match target policy")
221		}
222		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, request.Binding)
223		if err != nil {
224			return PlanResponse{}, err
225		}
226		response := PlanResponse{
227			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
228			RequestID: request.RequestID, ManifestDigest: request.ManifestDigest,
229			TargetMachine: id, TargetCheckout: checkout.id,
230		}
231		for _, spec := range request.Files {
232			planned := PlanFile{PublicFile: spec.public(StateFailed)}
233			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
234				planned.State = stateForError(err)
235				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
236				continue
237			}
238			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, request.SafeLimits(), true)
239			if err != nil {
240				planned.State = stateForError(err)
241				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
242				continue
243			}
244			targetMode := ""
245			if observed.exists {
246				targetMode = fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm())
247			}
248			switch {
249			case !observed.exists:
250				planned.State, planned.Action = StateReady, actionCreate
251			case observed.digest == spec.SHA256 && targetMode == spec.Mode:
252				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateCurrent, actionCurrent, observed.digest, targetMode
253			case request.Replace:
254				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateReady, actionReplace, observed.digest, targetMode
255			default:
256				planned.State, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateBlockedConflict, observed.digest, targetMode
257			}
258			response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
259		}
260		response.PlanDigest = planDigest(request, response)
261		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
262			return PlanResponse{}, err
263		}
264		return response, nil
265	}

15	// Target is the live Git/task identity retirement must revalidate before every
16	// destructive stage.
17	type Target struct {
18		TaskID         string
19		RepoPath       string
20		CheckoutPath   string
21		Branch         string
22		Base           string
23		LinkedWorktree bool

26	// Request is one externally coordinated retirement attempt.
27	type Request struct {
28		Target       Target
29		Safety       Options
30		DeleteBranch bool
31	}

33	// Result records which terminal resources were removed.
34	type Result struct {
35		ClosedSessions  int
36		RemovedWorktree bool
37		DeletedBranch   bool
38		DeletedTask     bool
39	}

41	// Service owns cleanup policy; every caller must use a freshly selected runtime.
42	type Service struct {

44		Tasks   *task.Store
45	}

47	// Retire closes live runtime surfaces, waits for them to release the checkout,
48	// then removes only a validated linked worktree and finally its task record.
49	func (s *Service) Retire(ctx context.Context, req Request) (Result, error) {
50		target, err := s.validateTarget(ctx, req.Target)
51		if err != nil {
52			return Result{}, err
53		}
54		inspection, err := CloseAndWait(ctx, s.Runtime, target.CheckoutPath, req.Safety)
55		if err != nil {
56			return Result{}, err
57		}
58		result := Result{ClosedSessions: inspection.ClosedSessions}
59
60		// Reality may change while a runtime is draining. Never carry the earlier
61		// worktree/dirty/ancestry proof across that boundary.
62		target, err = s.validateTarget(ctx, target)
63		if err != nil {
64			return result, fmt.Errorf("revalidate after runtime close: %w", err)
65		}
66		finalInspection, err := Inspect(ctx, s.Runtime, target.CheckoutPath, req.Safety)
67		if err != nil {
68			return result, fmt.Errorf("reinspect after runtime close: %w", err)
69		}
70		if !finalInspection.Ready() || len(finalInspection.Sessions) > 0 {
71			return result, fmt.Errorf("runtime reclaimed the checkout after closure; refusing worktree removal")
72		}
73		if target.LinkedWorktree {
74			if err := gitx.RemoveWorktree(ctx, target.RepoPath, target.CheckoutPath, false); err != nil {
75				return result, err
76			}
77			result.RemovedWorktree = true
78		}
79		if req.DeleteBranch && target.Branch != "" && target.Branch != target.Base && gitx.BranchExists(ctx, target.RepoPath, target.Branch) {
80			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, target.RepoPath, "branch", "-d", target.Branch); err != nil {
81				return result, fmt.Errorf("delete merged branch %s: %w", target.Branch, err)
82			}
83			result.DeletedBranch = true
84		}
85		if target.TaskID != "" && s.Tasks != nil {
86			if err := s.validateTaskIdentity(target); err != nil {
87				return result, fmt.Errorf("revalidate task before deletion: %w", err)
88			}
89			if err := s.Tasks.Delete(target.TaskID); err != nil {
90				return result, fmt.Errorf("delete retired task %s: %w", target.TaskID, err)
91			}
92			result.DeletedTask = true
93		}
94		return result, nil
95	}

97	func (s *Service) validateTarget(ctx context.Context, target Target) (Target, error) {
98		if target.RepoPath == "" || target.CheckoutPath == "" {
99			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("retirement target needs repository and checkout paths")
100		}
101		var err error
102		target.RepoPath, err = pathx.Canonical(target.RepoPath)
103		if err != nil {
104			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize repository: %w", err)
105		}
106		target.CheckoutPath, err = pathx.Canonical(target.CheckoutPath)
107		if err != nil {
108			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize checkout: %w", err)
109		}
110		if target.Base == "" {
111			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("cannot prove integration without a base branch")
112		}
113		if err := s.validateTaskIdentity(target); err != nil {
114			return Target{}, err
115		}
116		if _, statErr := os.Stat(target.CheckoutPath); statErr == nil {
117			if operation, active, operationErr := gitx.InProgress(target.CheckoutPath); operationErr != nil {
118				return Target{}, operationErr
119			} else if active {
120				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("refusing retirement while Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
121			}
122		} else if !errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
123			return Target{}, statErr
124		}
125		if target.LinkedWorktree && target.Branch == "" {
126			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("refusing to retire a detached linked worktree")
127		}
128		if target.Branch != "" && target.Branch != target.Base {
129			if !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, target.RepoPath, target.Branch) {
130				if target.TaskID == "" {
131					return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("branch %s no longer exists; only a persisted done task may reconcile it", target.Branch)
132				}
133			} else if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, target.RepoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", target.Branch, target.Base); err != nil {
134				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("branch %s is not contained in %s", target.Branch, target.Base)
135			}
136		}
137
138		if !target.LinkedWorktree {
139			return target, nil
140		}
141		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, target.RepoPath)
142		if err != nil {
143			return Target{}, err
144		}
145		registered := false
146		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
147			path, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
148			if canonicalErr != nil || path != target.CheckoutPath {
149				continue
150			}
151			registered = true
152			if worktree.Main {
153				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("refusing to retire main checkout %s", target.CheckoutPath)
154			}
155			if worktree.Branch != target.Branch {
156				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("worktree %s is on %s, expected %s", target.CheckoutPath, worktree.Branch, target.Branch)
157			}
158			break
159		}
160		if !registered {
161			if _, statErr := os.Stat(target.CheckoutPath); errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
162				if err := gitx.PruneWorktrees(ctx, target.RepoPath); err != nil {
163					return Target{}, err
164				}
165				target.LinkedWorktree = false
166				return target, nil
167			}
168			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("path %s exists but Git no longer registers it; preserve orphaned artifacts before cleanup", target.CheckoutPath)
169		}
170		dirty, status, err := wtDirty(ctx, target.CheckoutPath)
171		if err != nil {
172			return Target{}, err
173		}
174		if dirty {
175			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("worktree %s is not clean: %s", target.CheckoutPath, status.Breakdown())
176		}
177		return target, nil
178	}
179
180	func (s *Service) validateTaskIdentity(target Target) error {
181		if target.TaskID == "" {
182			return nil
183		}
184		if s.Tasks == nil {
185			return fmt.Errorf("retirement target %s needs its task store for identity revalidation", target.TaskID)
186		}
187		current, err := s.Tasks.Get(target.TaskID)
188		if err != nil {
189			return fmt.Errorf("reload retirement task %s: %w", target.TaskID, err)
190		}
191		if current.State != task.Done {
192			return fmt.Errorf("task %s changed state to %s during retirement", target.TaskID, current.State)
193		}
194		repoPath, err := pathx.Canonical(current.RepoPath)
195		if err != nil {
196			return err
197		}
198		checkoutPath := current.RepoPath
199		if current.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && current.WorktreePath != "" {
200			checkoutPath = current.WorktreePath
201		}
202		checkoutPath, err = pathx.Canonical(checkoutPath)
203		if err != nil {
204			return err
205		}
206		if repoPath != target.RepoPath || checkoutPath != target.CheckoutPath || current.Branch != target.Branch {
207			return fmt.Errorf("task %s checkout identity changed during retirement", target.TaskID)
208		}
209		if current.Base != "" && current.Base != target.Base {
210			return fmt.Errorf("task %s base changed from %s to %s during retirement", target.TaskID, target.Base, current.Base)
211		}
212		return nil
213	}
214
215	func wtDirty(ctx context.Context, path string) (bool, gitx.Status, error) {
216		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, path)
217		if err != nil {
218			return false, status, err
219		}
220		return status.Dirty(), status, nil
221	}

319	// List loads every valid task, sorted by state (hot first) then most recent.
320	// It retains the historical warning behavior; completeness-sensitive callers
321	// should use ListWithDiagnostics instead of treating a partial list as whole.
322	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Task, error) {
323		tasks, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
324		if err != nil {
325			return nil, err
326		}

333	// ListWithDiagnostics returns every valid task plus deterministic per-record
334	// errors. A corrupt record never hides valid work and never silently satisfies
335	// an inventory-completeness gate.
336	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Task, []Diagnostic, error) {
337		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
338		if err != nil {
339			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
340				return nil, nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
341			}
342			return nil, nil, err
343		}
344		var tasks []*Task
345		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
346		for _, entry := range entries {
347			name := entry.Name()
348			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
349				continue
350			}
351			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
352			tracked, err := s.Get(id)
353			if err != nil {
354				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
355				continue
356			}
357			tasks = append(tasks, tracked)
358		}
359		Sort(tasks)
360		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
361		return tasks, diagnostics, nil
362	}

385	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
386	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
387	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather
388	// than a silent pick.
389	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
390		if ref == "" {
391			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty task reference: %w", ErrNotFound)
392		}
393		all, err := s.List()
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, err
396		}
397		for _, t := range all {
398			if t.ID == ref || t.Branch == ref {
399				return t, nil
400			}
401		}
402		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
403		var hits []*Task
404		for _, t := range all {
405			hay := strings.ToLower(t.ID + " " + t.Name + " " + t.Branch + " " + t.Repo)
406			if strings.Contains(hay, needle) {
407				hits = append(hits, t)
408			}
409		}
410		switch len(hits) {
411		case 1:
412			return hits[0], nil
413		case 0:
414			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", ref, ErrNotFound)
415		default:
416			names := make([]string, len(hits))
417			for i, t := range hits {
418				names[i] = t.ID
419			}
420			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))
421		}
422	}

424	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
425	//
426	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
427	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
428	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
429	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
430	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
431	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
432		all, err := s.List()
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, err
435		}
436		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
437			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
438		}
439		var best *Task
440		var bestLen int
441		for _, t := range all {
442			root := t.WorktreePath
443			if root == "" {
444				root = t.RepoPath
445			}
446			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
447				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
448			}
449		}
450		if best == nil {
451			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
452		}
453		return best, nil
454	}

16	const maxWalkEntries = 200_000
17
18	var dependencyComponents = map[string]struct{}{
19		"node_modules": {}, ".venv": {}, "venv": {}, "vendor": {},
20		"__pycache__": {}, ".tox": {}, "target": {}, ".terraform": {},
21		"dist": {}, "build": {}, ".next": {},

24	// Expand resolves validated project and --file patterns locally into a sorted,
25	// duplicate-free list of exact slash paths. It never follows links or descends
26	// into Git metadata, nested repositories, submodules, or dependency trees.
27	func Expand(root string, patterns []Pattern, limits safefile.Limits) ([]string, error) {
28		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
29			return nil, err
30		}
31		if len(patterns) == 0 {
32			return nil, errors.New("no local-file patterns were configured or passed with --file")
33		}
34		for _, pattern := range patterns {
35			if err := projectconfig.ValidateLocalFilePattern(pattern.Value); err != nil {
36				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s: %w", patternSource(pattern), err)
37			}
38			for _, component := range strings.Split(pattern.Value, "/") {
39				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
40					return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s enters dependency directory %q", patternSource(pattern), component)
41				}
42			}
43		}
44		rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(root)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect source checkout: %w", err)
47		}
48		if !rootInfo.IsDir() || rootInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
49			return nil, errors.New("source checkout is not a held regular directory")
50		}
51
52		matches := map[string]struct{}{}
53		matchedPatterns := make([]bool, len(patterns))
54		visited := 0
55		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
56			if walkErr != nil {
57				return walkErr
58			}
59			if filename == root {
60				return nil
61			}
62			visited++
63			if visited > maxWalkEntries {
64				return fmt.Errorf("source checkout exceeds %d entries while expanding local-file patterns", maxWalkEntries)
65			}
66			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, filename)
67			if err != nil {
68				return err
69			}
70			slash := filepath.ToSlash(relative)
71			components := strings.Split(slash, "/")
72			base := strings.ToLower(components[len(components)-1])
73			if entry.IsDir() {
74				if base == ".git" {
75					return filepath.SkipDir
76				}
77				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[base]; blocked {
78					for _, pattern := range patterns {
79						if matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
80							return fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern enters dependency directory %q", slash)
81						}
82					}
83					return filepath.SkipDir
84				}
85				if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(filename, ".git")); err == nil {
86					return filepath.SkipDir
87				} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
88					return fmt.Errorf("inspect nested repository boundary %s: %w", slash, err)
89				}
90			}
91			matched := false
92			for index, pattern := range patterns {
93				if !entry.IsDir() && matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
94					matchedPatterns[index] = true
95					matched = true
96				}
97			}
98			if matched {
99				matches[slash] = struct{}{}
100			}
101			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 && entry.IsDir() {
102				return filepath.SkipDir
103			}
104			return nil
105		})
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, err
108		}
109		for index, matched := range matchedPatterns {
110			if !matched {
111				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s matched no source path", patternSource(patterns[index]))
112			}
113		}
114		paths := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
115		for path := range matches {
116			paths = append(paths, path)
117		}
118		sort.Strings(paths)
119		if len(paths) > limits.MaxFiles {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("patterns expanded to %d paths; maximum is %d", len(paths), limits.MaxFiles)
121		}
122		return paths, nil
123	}
124
125	func patternSource(pattern Pattern) string {
126		if strings.TrimSpace(pattern.Source) == "" {
127			return "explicit input"
128		}
129		return pattern.Source
130	}
131
132	func matchPattern(pattern, candidate string) bool {
133		patternParts := strings.Split(pattern, "/")
134		candidateParts := strings.Split(candidate, "/")
135		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
136		memo := map[key]bool{}
137		seen := map[key]bool{}
138		var match func(int, int) bool
139		match = func(patternIndex, candidateIndex int) bool {
140			state := key{patternIndex, candidateIndex}
141			if seen[state] {
142				return memo[state]
143			}
144			seen[state] = true
145			var result bool
146			switch {
147			case patternIndex == len(patternParts):
148				result = candidateIndex == len(candidateParts)
149			case patternParts[patternIndex] == "**":
150				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex) ||
151					candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && match(patternIndex, candidateIndex+1)
152			case candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && matchComponent(patternParts[patternIndex], candidateParts[candidateIndex]):
153				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex+1)
154			}
155			memo[state] = result
156			return result
157		}
158		return match(0, 0)
159	}
160
161	func matchComponent(pattern, candidate string) bool {
162		p, c := []rune(pattern), []rune(candidate)
163		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
164		memo := map[key]bool{}
165		seen := map[key]bool{}
166		var match func(int, int) bool
167		match = func(pi, ci int) bool {
168			state := key{pi, ci}
169			if seen[state] {
170				return memo[state]
171			}
172			seen[state] = true
173			var result bool
174			switch {
175			case pi == len(p):
176				result = ci == len(c)
177			case p[pi] == '*':
178				result = match(pi+1, ci) || ci < len(c) && match(pi, ci+1)
179			case ci < len(c) && (p[pi] == '?' || p[pi] == c[ci]):
180				result = match(pi+1, ci+1)

53	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, repositoryID, repositoryName, body string, tags []string) (*Note, error) {
54		if ctx == nil {
55			ctx = context.Background()
56		}

59			RepositoryID:  repositoryID,

61			Body:          body,

99	// Import writes a transported note with its exact durable identity and
100	// timestamps. Path is always derived from the validated repository and note IDs;
101	// a source Path is never trusted. An identical revision is an idempotent replay,
102	// while reusing an ID for different content is a conflict. Import changes only

104	func (s *Store) Import(ctx context.Context, source *Note) (*Note, error) {

163	func (s *Store) confinedImportPath(repositoryID, id string) (string, error) {

226			}
227			parts := strings.Split(filepath.Clean(relative), string(filepath.Separator))

229				return nil, fmt.Errorf("existing note %s is outside the repository note layout: %w", id, ErrInvalid)
230			}
231			if match != "" {
232				return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate note ID %s: %w", id, ErrConflict)
233			}
234			match = confined
235		}
236		if match == "" {
237			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
238		}
239		return s.read(match)
240	}

12	const unsafeRemoteLabel = "<unsafe remote>"

14	// RedactRemoteRef returns a terminal-safe remote reference for public display.
15	// URL userinfo, query, and fragment components are removed structurally. SSH
16	// usernames such as git@host remain visible, while an scp-like prefix containing
17	// a password/token separator is redacted. Invalid UTF-8, controls, malformed
18	// explicit URLs, and encoded path controls are replaced by a fixed label.
19	func RedactRemoteRef(ref string) string {
20		if !utf8.ValidString(ref) || strings.IndexFunc(ref, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
21			return unsafeRemoteLabel
22		}
23		ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
24		if ref == "" {
25			return ""
26		}
27		parsed, err := url.Parse(ref)
28		explicitURL := strings.Contains(ref, "://")
29		if explicitURL && (err != nil || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" && !strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file")) {
30			return unsafeRemoteLabel
31		}
32		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && (explicitURL || parsed.Host != "" || strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file")) {
33			path, unescapeErr := url.PathUnescape(parsed.EscapedPath())
34			if unescapeErr != nil || !utf8.ValidString(path) || strings.IndexFunc(path, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
35				return unsafeRemoteLabel
36			}
37			parsed.User = nil
38			parsed.RawQuery = ""
39			parsed.ForceQuery = false
40			parsed.Fragment = ""
41			parsed.RawFragment = ""
42			redacted := parsed.String()
43			if !utf8.ValidString(redacted) || strings.IndexFunc(redacted, isRemoteControl) >= 0 {
44				return unsafeRemoteLabel
45			}
46			return redacted
47		}
48		if err != nil && strings.Contains(ref, "://") {
49			return unsafeRemoteLabel
50		}
51
52		at := strings.LastIndexByte(ref, '@')
53		if at > 0 && strings.Contains(ref[:at], ":") {
54			return "***@" + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[at+1:])
55		}
56		if at > 0 {
57			colon := strings.IndexByte(ref[at+1:], ':')
58			if colon >= 0 {

64			return ref[:colon+1] + stripRemoteQueryFragment(ref[colon+1:])
65		}
66		return ref
67	}

90	// RedactCloneError returns an error whose displayed message cannot echo
91	// credential-bearing clone references passed to Git.
92	func RedactCloneError(err error, refs ...string) error {
93		if err == nil {
94			return nil
95		}
96		message := err.Error()
97		refs = append([]string(nil), refs...)
98		sort.SliceStable(refs, func(i, j int) bool { return len(refs[i]) > len(refs[j]) })
99		for _, ref := range refs {
100			if ref == "" {
101				continue
102			}
103			message = strings.ReplaceAll(message, ref, RedactCloneRef(ref))
104			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(ref)
105			if trimmed != "" && trimmed != ref {
106				message = strings.ReplaceAll(message, trimmed, RedactCloneRef(trimmed))
107			}
108		}
109		return errors.New(message)
110	}

21	func setPrivateMode(path string, want fs.FileMode) error {
22		inheritance := ""
23		switch want.Perm() {
24		case 0o600:
25		case 0o700:
26			inheritance = "OICI"
27		default:
28			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported private Windows mode %04o", want.Perm())
29		}
30		current, _, err := privateSIDs()
31		if err != nil {
32			return err
33		}
34		ace := func(sid string) string {
35			return fmt.Sprintf("(A;%s;GA;;;%s)", inheritance, sid)
36		}
37		descriptor, err := windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString("D:P" + ace(current) + ace(localSystemSID) + ace(administratorsSID))
38		if err != nil {
39			return fmt.Errorf("build private Windows security descriptor: %w", err)
40		}
41		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
42		if err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("read private Windows DACL: %w", err)
44		}
45		if dacl == nil {
46			return fmt.Errorf("private Windows security descriptor has no DACL")
47		}
48		err = windows.SetNamedSecurityInfo(
49			path,
50			windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT,
51			windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
52			nil,
53			nil,
54			dacl,
55			nil,
56		)
57		runtime.KeepAlive(descriptor)
58		if err != nil {
59			return fmt.Errorf("set private Windows DACL: %w", err)
60		}
61		return nil
62	}
63
64	func privateModeMatches(path string, _ fs.FileMode, _ fs.FileMode) (bool, error) {
65		current, allowed, err := privateSIDs()
66		if err != nil {
67			return false, err
68		}
69		descriptor, err := windows.GetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
70		if err != nil {
71			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner and DACL: %w", err)
72		}
73		owner, _, err := descriptor.Owner()
74		if err != nil {
75			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner: %w", err)
76		}
77		if !privateSIDAllowed(owner, allowed) {
78			return false, nil
79		}
80		control, _, err := descriptor.Control()
81		if err != nil {
82			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows security descriptor control: %w", err)
83		}
84		if control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED == 0 {
85			return false, nil
86		}
87		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
88		if err != nil {
89			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL: %w", err)
90		}
91		if dacl == nil {
92			return false, nil
93		}
94		seenCurrent := false
95		for index := uint16(0); index < dacl.AceCount; index++ {
96			var ace *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
97			if err := windows.GetAce(dacl, uint32(index), &ace); err != nil {
98				return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL entry %d: %w", index, err)
99			}
100			switch ace.Header.AceType {
101			case windows.ACCESS_DENIED_ACE_TYPE:
102				continue
103			case windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE_TYPE:
104			default:
105				return false, nil
106			}
107			sid := (*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&ace.SidStart))
108			value := sid.String()
109			if _, ok := allowed[value]; !ok {
110				return false, nil
111			}
112			if value == current {
113				seenCurrent = true
114			}
115		}
116		return seenCurrent, nil
117	}
118
119	func privateSIDAllowed(sid *windows.SID, allowed map[string]struct{}) bool {
120		if sid == nil {
121			return false
122		}
123		_, ok := allowed[sid.String()]
124		return ok
125	}
126
127	func privateSIDs() (string, map[string]struct{}, error) {
128		user, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
129		if err != nil {
130			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("read current Windows user: %w", err)
131		}
132		current := user.User.Sid.String()
133		if current == "" {
134			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("current Windows user has an invalid SID")
135		}
136		return current, map[string]struct{}{
137			current:           {},
138			localSystemSID:    {},
139			administratorsSID: {},
140		}, nil
141	}

143	func replaceFile(source, destination string) error {
144		from, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(source)
145		if err != nil {
146			return err
147		}
148		to, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(destination)
149		if err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		return windows.MoveFileEx(from, to, windows.MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING|windows.MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)
153	}
