44	func (a *Authority) Root() string {
45		if a == nil {
46			return ""
47		}
48		return a.root
49	}
50
51	// Reserve creates a blocking pre-publication claim. Repeating the exact
52	// operation and key set is idempotent; reusing an operation ID with a different
53	// digest is a conflict.
54	func (a *Authority) Reserve(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, request Request) (Token, error) {
55		return a.activate(ctx, keys, request, false)
56	}
57
58	// Fence drains existing cooperative guards and durably prevents new ordinary
59	// mutations. It can promote an exact reservation or create a direct fence.
60	func (a *Authority) Fence(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, request Request) (Token, error) {
61		return a.activate(ctx, keys, request, true)
62	}
63
64	func (a *Authority) activate(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, request Request, fence bool) (Token, error) {
65		if a == nil {
66			return Token{}, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
67		}
68		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
69			return Token{}, err
70		}
71		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
72		if err != nil {
73			return Token{}, err
74		}
75		var result Token
76		err = a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func([]Key) error {
77			return a.updateState(ctx, func(state *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
78				if err := checkOperationReuse(*state, claimed, request); err != nil {
79					return false, err
80				}
81				bindingAdded := ensureBinding(state, request)
82				if err := checkHierarchyClaims(*state, claimed, request); err != nil {
83					return false, err
84				}
85				canonical := claimed
86
87				claims := make([]*Claim, len(canonical))
88				claimKinds := make([]string, len(canonical))
89				for index, key := range canonical {
90					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
91					if record == nil {
92						continue
93					}
94					switch {
95					case record.Reservation != nil:
96						claims[index], claimKinds[index] = record.Reservation, "reservation"
97					case record.Fence != nil:
98						claims[index], claimKinds[index] = record.Fence, "fence"
99					}
100				}
101
102				allSameKind := true
103				var existing Token
104				for index, claim := range claims {
105					wantedKind := "reservation"
106					if fence {
107						wantedKind = "fence"
108					}
109					if claim == nil || claimKinds[index] != wantedKind || !claim.Token.sameOperation(request) || claim.MachineID != request.MachineID {
110						allSameKind = false
111						break
112					}
113					if index == 0 {
114						existing = claim.Token
115					} else if !existing.matches(claim.Token) {
116						return false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s has inconsistent epochs: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
117					}
118				}
119				if allSameKind {
120					result = existing
121					return bindingAdded, nil
122				}
123
124				promoteReservation := fence
125				anyClaim := false
126				for index, claim := range claims {
127					if claim == nil {
128						promoteReservation = false
129						continue
130					}
131					anyClaim = true
132					if claimKinds[index] != "reservation" || !claim.Token.sameOperation(request) || claim.MachineID != request.MachineID {
133						return false, blockedOrConflict(canonical[index], claimKinds[index], *claim, request)
134					}
135				}
136				if anyClaim && !promoteReservation {
137					return false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s only owns part of the requested key set: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
138				}
139
140				epoch, err := allocateEpoch(state)
141				if err != nil {
142					return false, err
143				}
144				result = Token{OperationID: request.OperationID, Digest: request.Digest, Epoch: epoch}
145				now := canonicalTime(a.clock())
146				for _, key := range canonical {
147					record := ensureRecord(state, key)
148					record.Epoch = epoch
149					claim := &Claim{Token: result, MachineID: request.MachineID, CreatedAt: now}
150					if fence {
151						record.Reservation = nil
152						record.Fence = claim
153					} else {
154						record.Reservation = claim
155						record.Fence = nil
156					}
157				}
158				return true, nil
159			})
160		})
161		return result, err
162	}
163
164	// ReleaseReservation clears an exact reservation and advances the authority
165	// epoch. It is non-terminal; AbortReservation should be used for a terminal
166	// pre-fence cancellation.
167	func (a *Authority) ReleaseReservation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token) (uint64, error) {
168		return a.finishClaim(ctx, keys, token, "reservation", "")
169	}
170
171	// AbortReservation clears an exact reservation and retains a permanent
172	// terminal tombstone so delayed prepare replays cannot recreate it.
173	func (a *Authority) AbortReservation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token) (uint64, error) {
174		return a.finishClaim(ctx, keys, token, "reservation", TombstoneAborted)
175	}
176
177	// Return clears an exact fence and retains a permanent terminal tombstone so
178	// delayed accepts carrying the old epoch fail closed.
179	func (a *Authority) Return(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token) (uint64, error) {
180		return a.finishClaim(ctx, keys, token, "fence", TombstoneReturned)
181	}
182
183	func (a *Authority) finishClaim(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token, claimKind string, terminal TombstoneKind) (uint64, error) {
184		if a == nil {
185			return 0, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
186		}
187		if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
188			return 0, err
189		}
190		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
191		if err != nil {
192			return 0, err
193		}
194		var advanced uint64
195		err = a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func([]Key) error {
196			return a.updateState(ctx, func(state *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
197				canonical := claimed
198				if terminal != "" {
199					if epoch, found, err := matchingTerminal(*state, canonical, token, terminal); err != nil {
200						return false, err
201					} else if found {
202						advanced = epoch
203						return false, nil
204					}
205				}
206				if err := validateClaimKeySet(*state, canonical, token, claimKind); err != nil {
207					return false, err
208				}
209				for _, key := range canonical {
210					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
211					if record == nil {
212						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s has no active %s: %w", key.subject(), claimKind, ErrEpochMismatch)
213					}
214					var claim *Claim
215					if claimKind == "reservation" {
216						claim = record.Reservation
217					} else {
218						claim = record.Fence
219					}
220					if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
221						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s does not hold operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
222					}
223				}
224				epoch, err := allocateEpoch(state)
225				if err != nil {
226					return false, err
227				}
228				advanced = epoch
229				now := canonicalTime(a.clock())
230				for _, key := range canonical {
231					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
232					record.Epoch = epoch
233					if claimKind == "reservation" {
234						record.Reservation = nil
235					} else {
236						record.Fence = nil
237					}
238					if terminal != "" {
239						record.Tombstones = append(record.Tombstones, Tombstone{Kind: terminal, Token: token, AdvancedEpoch: epoch, CreatedAt: now})
240					}
241				}
242				return true, nil
243			})
244		})
245		return advanced, err
246	}
247
248	// WithMutation runs an ordinary mutator only when no requested key is reserved
249	// or fenced. A branch key automatically includes its repository ancestor so a
250	// repository fence covers every branch. The locks remain held until operation
251	// returns.
252	func (a *Authority) WithMutation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func() error) error {
253		return a.WithGuard(ctx, keys, nil, operation)
254	}
255
256	// WithGuard permits the exact owner of an active reservation or fence to work
257	// while rejecting stale, returned, and mismatched tokens. A nil token is an
258	// ordinary mutation guard and includes repository ancestors. It is
259	// non-reentrant: operation must not reacquire an overlapping key.
260	func (a *Authority) WithGuard(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token *Token, operation func() error) error {
261		if a == nil {
262			return errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
263		}
264		if operation == nil {
265			return errors.New("operation lease guard requires an operation")
266		}
267		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool)
272		if token != nil {
273			if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
274				return err
275			}
276		} else {
277			for _, key := range claimed {
278				if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
279					repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
280				}
281			}
282		}
283		return a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func(locked []Key) error {
284			checked := locked
285			if token != nil {
286				// Repository ancestors participate in draining but are not part of a
287				// branch-scoped token's ownership claim.
288				checked = claimed
289			}
290			if err := a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
291				matched := 0
292				for _, key := range checked {
293					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
294					if record == nil {
295						if token != nil {
296							return fmt.Errorf("%s has no operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
297						}
298						continue
299					}
300					if token != nil && hasTerminal(*record, *token) {
301						return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrReturned)
302					}
303					claim, kind := activeClaim(*record)
304					if claim == nil {
305						if token != nil {
306							return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is no longer active on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrEpochMismatch)
307						}
308						continue
309					}
310					if token == nil || !claim.Token.matches(*token) {
311						return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
312					}
313					matched++
314				}
315				if token != nil && matched != len(checked) {
316					return fmt.Errorf("operation %s does not own the complete key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrEpochMismatch)
317				}
318				if token != nil {
319					if err := validateGuardKeySet(state, claimed, *token); err != nil {
320						return err
321					}
322				}
323				if token == nil {
324					for _, record := range state.Records {
325						if record.Key.Scope != ScopeBranch || !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
326							continue
327						}
328						if claim, kind := activeClaim(record); claim != nil {
329							return &BlockedError{Key: record.Key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
330						}
331					}
332				}
333				return nil
334			}); err != nil {
335				return err
336			}
337			return operation()
338		})
339	}
340
341	// Inspect returns records for the requested keys while holding those key locks.
342	// Untouched keys are represented with Epoch zero and are never persisted.
343	func (a *Authority) Inspect(ctx context.Context, keys []Key) ([]Record, error) {
344		if a == nil {
345			return nil, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
346		}
347		var result []Record
348		err := a.withKeyLocks(ctx, keys, func(canonical []Key) error {
349			return a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
350				result = make([]Record, 0, len(canonical))
351				for _, key := range canonical {
352					if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
353						result = append(result, cloneRecord(*record))
354					} else {
355						result = append(result, Record{Key: key})
356					}
357				}
358				return nil
359			})
360		})
361		return result, err
362	}
363
364	func mutationKeys(keys []Key) []Key {
365		expanded := append([]Key(nil), keys...)
366		for _, key := range keys {
367			if key.Scope == ScopeBranch {
368				expanded = append(expanded, RepositoryKey(key.Repository))
369			}
370		}
371		return expanded
372	}
373
374	func (a *Authority) withKeyLocks(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func([]Key) error) error {
375		canonical, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
376		if err != nil {
377			return err
378		}
379		if ctx == nil {
380			ctx = context.Background()
381		}
382		if err := a.ensureLayout(); err != nil {
383			return err
384		}
385		var acquire func(int) error
386		acquire = func(index int) error {
387			if index == len(canonical) {
388				return operation(canonical)
389			}
390			directory := a.keyLockDir(canonical[index])
391			if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
392				return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation key lock: %w", err)
393			}
394			return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease key", func() error { return acquire(index + 1) })
395		}
396		return acquire(0)
397	}
398
399	func (a *Authority) updateState(ctx context.Context, mutate func(*Snapshot) (bool, error)) error {
400		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
401			state, err := a.loadState()
402			if err != nil {
403				return err
404			}
405			changed, err := mutate(&state)
406			if err != nil || !changed {
407				return err
408			}
409			return a.writeState(state)
410		})
411	}
412
413	func (a *Authority) readState(ctx context.Context, read func(Snapshot) error) error {
414		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
415			state, err := a.loadState()
416			if err != nil {
417				return err
418			}
419			return read(state)
420		})
421	}
422
423	func (a *Authority) withStateLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
424		directory := filepath.Join(a.root, ".authority")
425		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
426			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation authority lock: %w", err)
427		}
428		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease authority", operation)
429	}
430
431	func (a *Authority) ensureLayout() error {
432		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
433			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation lease root: %w", err)
434		}
435		if err := ensurePrivateDir(filepath.Join(a.root, ".keys")); err != nil {
436			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation lease key root: %w", err)
437		}
438		return nil
439	}
440
441	func (a *Authority) keyLockDir(key Key) string {
442		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(key.canonical()))
443		return filepath.Join(a.root, ".keys", hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]))
444	}
445
446	func (a *Authority) statePath() string { return filepath.Join(a.root, stateFilename) }
447
448	func (a *Authority) loadState() (Snapshot, error) {
449		path := a.statePath()
450		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
451		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
452			return Snapshot{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}, nil
453		}
454		if err != nil {
455			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state: %w", err)
456		}
457		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
458			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s is not a regular file", path)
459		}
460		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
461		if err != nil {
462			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state permissions: %w", err)
463		}
464		if !private {
465			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
466		}
467		file, err := os.Open(path)
468		if err != nil {
469			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("open operation lease state: %w", err)
470		}
471		defer file.Close()
472		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
473		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
474		var state Snapshot
475		if err := decoder.Decode(&state); err != nil {
476			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state: %w", err)
477		}
478		var extra any
479		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
480			if err == nil {
481				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("decode operation lease state: multiple JSON values")
482			}
483			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state trailing data: %w", err)
484		}
485		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
486			return Snapshot{}, err
487		}
488		canonical := canonicalSnapshot(state)
489		encodedState, _ := json.Marshal(state)
490		encodedCanonical, _ := json.Marshal(canonical)
491		if string(encodedState) != string(encodedCanonical) {
492			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("operation lease state is not in canonical order")
493		}
494		return state, nil
495	}
496
497	func (a *Authority) writeState(state Snapshot) error {
498		state = canonicalSnapshot(state)
499		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
500			return err
501		}
502		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
503			return err
504		}
505		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(a.root, ".authority-*.tmp")
506		if err != nil {
507			return fmt.Errorf("create operation lease state temp file: %w", err)
508		}
509		name := temporary.Name()
510		defer os.Remove(name)
511		if err := setPrivateMode(name, 0o600); err != nil {
512			_ = temporary.Close()
513			return err
514		}
515		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)
516		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
517		if err := encoder.Encode(state); err != nil {
518			_ = temporary.Close()
519			return fmt.Errorf("encode operation lease state: %w", err)
520		}
521		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
522			_ = temporary.Close()
523			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease state: %w", err)
524		}
525		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
526			return fmt.Errorf("close operation lease state: %w", err)
527		}
528		if err := replaceFile(name, a.statePath()); err != nil {
529			return fmt.Errorf("publish operation lease state: %w", err)
530		}
531		if err := syncDirectory(a.root); err != nil {
532			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease directory: %w", err)
533		}
534		return nil
535	}
536
537	func validateSnapshot(state Snapshot) error {
538		if state.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
539			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease schema_version %d: want %d", state.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
540		}
541		bindings := make(map[string]string, len(state.Bindings))
542		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
543			if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
544				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease binding: %w", err)
545			}
546			if _, exists := bindings[binding.OperationID]; exists {
547				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease repeats binding %s", binding.OperationID)
548			}
549			bindings[binding.OperationID] = binding.Digest
550		}
551		type activeSignature struct {
552			Token     Token
553			MachineID string
554			Kind      string
555		}
556		activeOperations := make(map[string]activeSignature)
557		terminalOperations := make(map[string]Tombstone)
558		seenKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(state.Records))
559		var maxRecordEpoch uint64
560		for _, record := range state.Records {
561			if err := record.Key.Validate(); err != nil {
562				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease record: %w", err)
563			}
564			canonicalKey := record.Key.canonical()
565			if _, exists := seenKeys[canonicalKey]; exists {
566				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease state repeats key %s", record.Key.subject())
567			}
568			seenKeys[canonicalKey] = struct{}{}
569			if record.Epoch == 0 || record.Epoch > state.LastEpoch {
570				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has invalid epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), record.Epoch)
571			}
572			if record.Epoch > maxRecordEpoch {
573				maxRecordEpoch = record.Epoch
574			}
575			if record.Reservation != nil && record.Fence != nil {
576				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has both reservation and fence", record.Key.subject())
577			}
578			for _, named := range []struct {
579				name  string
580				claim *Claim
581			}{{"reservation", record.Reservation}, {"fence", record.Fence}} {
582				if named.claim == nil {
583					continue
584				}
585				if err := named.claim.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
586					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s: %w", named.name, record.Key.subject(), err)
587				}
588				if digest, exists := bindings[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != named.claim.Token.Digest {
589					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no matching permanent binding", named.name, record.Key.subject())
590				}
591				if named.claim.Token.Epoch != record.Epoch {
592					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has epoch %d, record has %d", named.name, record.Key.subject(), named.claim.Token.Epoch, record.Epoch)
593				}
594				if named.claim.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
595					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no created_at", named.name, record.Key.subject())
596				}
597				if named.claim.MachineID != "" {
598					if err := machineid.Validate(named.claim.MachineID); err != nil {
599						return err
600					}
601				}
602				signature := activeSignature{Token: named.claim.Token, MachineID: named.claim.MachineID, Kind: named.name}
603				if prior, exists := activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; exists {
604					if !prior.Token.matches(signature.Token) || prior.MachineID != signature.MachineID || prior.Kind != signature.Kind {
605						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent active claims", named.claim.Token.OperationID)
606					}
607				} else {
608					activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID] = signature
609				}
610			}
611			seenTombstones := make(map[string]struct{}, len(record.Tombstones))
612			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
613				switch tombstone.Kind {
614				case TombstoneAborted, TombstoneReturned:
615				default:
616					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has unknown tombstone kind %q", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.Kind)
617				}
618				if err := tombstone.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
619					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s: %w", record.Key.subject(), err)
620				}
621				if digest, exists := bindings[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != tombstone.Token.Digest {
622					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no matching permanent binding", record.Key.subject())
623				}
624				if tombstone.AdvancedEpoch <= tombstone.Token.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > record.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > state.LastEpoch {
625					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has invalid advanced epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.AdvancedEpoch)
626				}
627				if tombstone.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
628					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no created_at", record.Key.subject())
629				}
630				if prior, exists := terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; exists {
631					if !prior.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || prior.Kind != tombstone.Kind || prior.AdvancedEpoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
632						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent terminal records", tombstone.Token.OperationID)
633					}
634				} else {
635					terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID] = tombstone
636				}
637				identity := fmt.Sprintf("%s\x00%s\x00%d", tombstone.Token.OperationID, tombstone.Token.Digest, tombstone.Token.Epoch)
638				if _, exists := seenTombstones[identity]; exists {
639					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s repeats a terminal token", record.Key.subject())
640				}
641				seenTombstones[identity] = struct{}{}
642				if record.Reservation != nil && record.Reservation.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || record.Fence != nil && record.Fence.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) {
643					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has a terminal token still active", record.Key.subject())
644				}
645			}
646		}
647		if state.LastEpoch != maxRecordEpoch {
648			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease last_epoch %d does not match latest record epoch %d", state.LastEpoch, maxRecordEpoch)
649		}
650		for operationID := range activeOperations {
651			if _, terminal := terminalOperations[operationID]; terminal {
652				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s is both active and terminal", operationID)
653			}
654		}
655		return nil
656	}
657
658	func canonicalSnapshot(state Snapshot) Snapshot {
659		result := Snapshot{
660			SchemaVersion: state.SchemaVersion,
661			LastEpoch:     state.LastEpoch,
662			Bindings:      append([]Binding(nil), state.Bindings...),
663			Records:       make([]Record, len(state.Records)),
664		}
665		sort.Slice(result.Bindings, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Bindings[i].OperationID < result.Bindings[j].OperationID })
666		for index, record := range state.Records {
667			result.Records[index] = cloneRecord(record)
668			if result.Records[index].Reservation != nil {
669				result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt)
670			}
671			if result.Records[index].Fence != nil {
672				result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt)
673			}
674			for tombstoneIndex := range result.Records[index].Tombstones {
675				result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt)
676			}
677			sort.Slice(result.Records[index].Tombstones, func(i, j int) bool {
678				left, right := result.Records[index].Tombstones[i], result.Records[index].Tombstones[j]
679				if left.Token.Epoch != right.Token.Epoch {
680					return left.Token.Epoch < right.Token.Epoch
681				}
682				if left.Token.OperationID != right.Token.OperationID {
683					return left.Token.OperationID < right.Token.OperationID
684				}
685				if left.Token.Digest != right.Token.Digest {
686					return left.Token.Digest < right.Token.Digest
687				}
688				return left.Kind < right.Kind
689			})
690		}
691		sort.Slice(result.Records, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Records[i].Key.canonical() < result.Records[j].Key.canonical() })
692		return result
693	}
694
695	func cloneRecord(record Record) Record {
696		result := record
697		if record.Reservation != nil {
698			copy := *record.Reservation
699			result.Reservation = &copy
700		}
701		if record.Fence != nil {
702			copy := *record.Fence
703			result.Fence = &copy
704		}
705		result.Tombstones = append([]Tombstone(nil), record.Tombstones...)
706		return result
707	}
708
709	func findRecord(records []Record, key Key) *Record {
710		canonical := key.canonical()
711		for index := range records {
712			if records[index].Key.canonical() == canonical {
713				return &records[index]
714			}
715		}
716		return nil
717	}
718
719	func ensureRecord(state *Snapshot, key Key) *Record {
720		if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
721			return record
722		}
723		state.Records = append(state.Records, Record{Key: key})
724		return &state.Records[len(state.Records)-1]
725	}
726
727	func allocateEpoch(state *Snapshot) (uint64, error) {
728		if state.LastEpoch == math.MaxUint64 {
729			return 0, errors.New("operation lease epoch exhausted")
730		}
731		state.LastEpoch++
732		return state.LastEpoch, nil
733	}
734
735	func activeClaim(record Record) (*Claim, string) {
736		if record.Reservation != nil {
737			return record.Reservation, "reservation"
738		}
739		if record.Fence != nil {
740			return record.Fence, "fence"
741		}
742		return nil, ""
743	}
744
745	func hasTerminal(record Record, token Token) bool {
746		for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
747			if tombstone.Token.matches(token) {
748				return true
749			}
750		}
751		return false
752	}
753
754	func ensureBinding(state *Snapshot, request Request) bool {
755		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
756			if binding.OperationID == request.OperationID {
757				return false
758			}
759		}
760		state.Bindings = append(state.Bindings, Binding{OperationID: request.OperationID, Digest: request.Digest})
761		return true
762	}
763
764	func checkOperationReuse(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
765		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
766			if binding.OperationID != request.OperationID {
767				continue
768			}
769			if binding.Digest != request.Digest {
770				return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was permanently bound to another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
771			}
772			break
773		}
774		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
775		for _, key := range keys {
776			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
777		}
778		for _, record := range state.Records {
779			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
780				if tombstone.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
781					continue
782				}
783				if tombstone.Token.Digest != request.Digest {
784					return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was used with another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
785				}
786				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal: %w", request.OperationID, ErrReturned)
787			}
788			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)
789			if claim == nil || claim.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
790				continue
791			}
792			if claim.Token.Digest != request.Digest {
793				return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s is active with another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
794			}
795			if _, exists := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !exists {
796				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s is active on a different key set: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
797			}
798		}
799		return nil
800	}
801
802	func checkHierarchyClaims(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
803		requestedKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
804		requestedRepositories := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
805		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool, len(keys))
806		for _, key := range keys {
807			requestedKeys[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
808			requestedRepositories[key.Repository] = struct{}{}
809			if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
810				repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
811			}
812		}
813		for _, record := range state.Records {
814			claim, kind := activeClaim(record)
815			if claim == nil {
816				continue
817			}
818			if _, requested := requestedKeys[record.Key.canonical()]; requested {
819				continue
820			}
821			if _, sameRepository := requestedRepositories[record.Key.Repository]; !sameRepository {
822				continue
823			}
824			if record.Key.Scope != ScopeRepository && !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
825				continue
826			}
827			return blockedOrConflict(record.Key, kind, *claim, request)
828		}
829		return nil
830	}
831
832	func blockedOrConflict(key Key, kind string, claim Claim, request Request) error {
833		if claim.Token.OperationID == request.OperationID {
834			return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s conflicts with its active %s: %w", request.OperationID, kind, ErrConflict)
835		}
836		return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
837	}
838
839	func validateGuardKeySet(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token) error {
840		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
841		for _, key := range keys {
842			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
843		}
844		matched := 0
845		for _, record := range state.Records {
846			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)
847			if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
848				continue
849			}
850			if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
851				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d owns a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
852			}
853			matched++
854		}
855		if matched != len(keys) {
856			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d does not own the exact guard key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
857		}
858		return nil
859	}
860
861	func validateClaimKeySet(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token, claimKind string) error {
862		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
863		for _, key := range keys {
864			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
865		}
866		matched := 0
867		for _, record := range state.Records {
868			var claim *Claim
869			if claimKind == "reservation" {
870				claim = record.Reservation
871			} else {
872				claim = record.Fence
873			}
874			if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
875				continue
876			}
877			if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
878				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d owns a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
879			}
880			matched++
881		}
882		if matched != len(keys) {
883			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d does not own the exact key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
884		}
885		return nil
886	}
887
888	func matchingTerminal(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token, kind TombstoneKind) (uint64, bool, error) {
889		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
890		for _, key := range keys {
891			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
892		}
893		var epoch uint64
894		matched := 0
895		for _, record := range state.Records {
896			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
897				if !tombstone.Token.matches(token) {
898					continue
899				}
900				if tombstone.Kind != kind {
901					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d ended as %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, tombstone.Kind, ErrReturned)
902				}
903				if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
904					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
905				}
906				if epoch == 0 {
907					epoch = tombstone.AdvancedEpoch
908				} else if epoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
909					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s has inconsistent terminal epochs: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
910				}
911				matched++
912				break
913			}
914		}
915		if matched == 0 {
916			return 0, false, nil
917		}
918		if matched != len(keys) {
919			return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal on only part of the key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
920		}
921		return epoch, true, nil
922	}
923
924	func ensurePrivateDir(path string) error {
925		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
926			return err
927		}
928		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
929		if err != nil {
930			return err
931		}
932		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
933			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a private directory", path)
934		}
935		if err := setPrivateMode(path, 0o700); err != nil {
936			return err
937		}
938		info, err = os.Lstat(path)
939		if err != nil {
940			return err
941		}
942		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o700)
943		if err != nil {
944			return fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease directory permissions: %w", err)
945		}
946		if !private {
947			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease directory %s permissions are not private (want 0700 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
948		}
949		return nil
950	}
951
952	func canonicalTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
953		return value.Round(0).UTC()
954	}
955

16	type SyncRequest struct {

22	type SyncState string

24	const (
25		SyncUpdated      SyncState = "updated"
26		SyncCurrent      SyncState = "already-current"
27		SyncFetched      SyncState = "fetched-only"
28		SyncAbsent       SyncState = "absent"
29		SyncNoDev        SyncState = "no-dev"
30		SyncUnreachable  SyncState = "unreachable"
31		SyncTimeout      SyncState = "timeout"
32		SyncDirty        SyncState = "blocked-dirty"
33		SyncAhead        SyncState = "blocked-ahead"
34		SyncDiverged     SyncState = "blocked-diverged"
35		SyncAmbiguous    SyncState = "ambiguous"
36		SyncIncompatible SyncState = "incompatible"
37		SyncFailed       SyncState = "failed"
38	)

40	type SyncResult struct {
41		Host        string    `json:"host"`
42		State       SyncState `json:"state"`
43		Repo        string    `json:"repo,omitempty"`
44		Path        string    `json:"path,omitempty"`
45		Branch      string    `json:"branch,omitempty"`

48		AfterOID    string    `json:"after_oid,omitempty"`
49		ExpectedOID string    `json:"expected_oid,omitempty"`
50		Error       string    `json:"error,omitempty"`
51	}
52
53	func (r SyncResult) Ignored() bool { return r.State == SyncAbsent || r.State == SyncNoDev }
54
55	func (r SyncResult) Success() bool {
56		switch r.State {
57		case SyncUpdated, SyncCurrent, SyncFetched, SyncAbsent, SyncNoDev:
58			return true
59		default:
60			return false
61		}
62	}
63
64	type syncCandidate struct {
65		repository repo.Repo
66		remote     string
67	}
68
69	func ApplySync(ctx context.Context, cfg devconfig.Config, request SyncRequest) SyncResult {
70		return ApplySyncWithAuthority(ctx, cfg, request, lease.New(""))
71	}
72
73	// ApplySyncWithAuthority is the injectable form used by concurrency tests. The
74	// production command uses the same durable authority as portable-file apply.
75	func ApplySyncWithAuthority(ctx context.Context, cfg devconfig.Config, request SyncRequest, authority *lease.Authority) SyncResult {
76		result := SyncResult{Host: devconfig.Hostname(), Branch: request.Branch, ExpectedOID: request.ExpectedOID}
77		request.RemoteIdentity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(request.RemoteIdentity)
78		if request.RemoteIdentity == "" || request.Branch == "" || request.ExpectedOID == "" {
79			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, "sync request requires remote identity, branch and expected OID"
80			return result
81		}
82		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
83		if err != nil {
84			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
85			return result
86		}
87		var candidates []syncCandidate
88		for _, repository := range repositories {
89			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
90				continue
91			}
92			topology, topologyErr := gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
93			if topologyErr != nil {
94				continue
95			}
96			if remote := matchingRemoteAt(ctx, repository.Path, topology, request.RemoteIdentity); remote != "" {
97				candidates = append(candidates, syncCandidate{repository: repository, remote: remote})
98			}
99		}
100		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].repository.Path < candidates[j].repository.Path })
101		switch len(candidates) {
102		case 0:
103			result.State = SyncAbsent
104			return result
105		case 1:
106		default:
107			result.State = SyncAmbiguous
108			paths := make([]string, len(candidates))
109			for index, candidate := range candidates {
110				paths[index] = candidate.repository.Path
111			}
112			result.Error = "remote identity matches multiple clones: " + strings.Join(paths, ", ")
113			return result
114		}
115		candidate := candidates[0]
116		result.Repo, result.Path, result.Remote = candidate.repository.Display(), candidate.repository.Path, candidate.remote
117		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "fetch", "--prune", "--quiet", candidate.remote); err != nil {
118			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
119			return result
120		}
121		remoteRef := candidate.remote + "/" + request.Branch
122		remoteOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", remoteRef+"^{commit}")
123		if err != nil {
124			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, fmt.Sprintf("remote branch %s is unavailable after fetch: %v", remoteRef, err)
125			return result
126		}
127		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", request.ExpectedOID, remoteOID); err != nil {
128			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, "fetched remote branch does not contain the source commit"
129			return result
130		}
131		if authority == nil {
132			authority = lease.New("")
133		}
134		keys := []lease.Key{
135			lease.BranchKey(request.RemoteIdentity, request.Branch),
136			lease.BranchKey(lease.GitCommonDirIdentity(candidate.repository.CommonDir), request.Branch),
137		}
138		if err := authority.WithMutation(ctx, keys, func() error {
139			applySyncCheckout(ctx, candidate, request, remoteRef, remoteOID, &result)
140			return nil
141		}); err != nil {
142			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
143		}
144		return result
145	}
146
147	func applySyncCheckout(ctx context.Context, candidate syncCandidate, request SyncRequest, remoteRef, remoteOID string, result *SyncResult) {
148		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, candidate.repository.Path)
149		if err != nil || repository.GitCommonDir != candidate.repository.CommonDir {
150			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, "target clone changed while acquiring operation lease"
151			return
152		}
153		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, request.Branch)
154		if err != nil {
155			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
156			return
157		}
158		if !checkedOut {
159			result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncFetched, remoteOID
160			return
161		}
162		result.Path = worktree.Path
163		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
164		if err != nil {
165			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
166			return
167		}
168		if status.Dirty() || status.Conflicted > 0 {
169			result.State, result.Error = SyncDirty, status.Summary()
170			return
171		}
172		localOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
173		if err != nil {
174			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
175			return
176		}
177		result.BeforeOID = localOID
178		if localOID == remoteOID {
179			result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncCurrent, localOID
180			return
181		}
182		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", localOID, remoteOID); err != nil {
183			if _, aheadErr := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", remoteOID, localOID); aheadErr == nil {
184				result.State, result.Error = SyncAhead, "checked-out branch contains commits not on the fetched remote"
185			} else {
186				result.State, result.Error = SyncDiverged, "checked-out branch diverged; rebase or merge manually"
187			}
188			return
189		}
190		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge", "--ff-only", remoteRef); err != nil {
191			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
192			return
193		}
194		after, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
195		if err != nil || after != remoteOID {
196			result.State = SyncFailed
197			result.Error = "fast-forward completed without reaching the fetched remote revision"
198			return
199		}
200		result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncUpdated, after
201	}
202
203	func matchingRemote(topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) string {
204		var names []string
205		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
206			matched := false
207			for _, raw := range append(append([]string{}, remote.FetchURLs...), remote.PushURLs...) {
208				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == identity {
209					matched = true
210					break
211				}
212			}
213			if matched {
214				names = append(names, remote.Name)
215			}
216		}
217		sort.Strings(names)
218		if len(names) == 0 {
219			return ""
220		}
221		return names[0]
222	}
223
224	func matchingRemoteAt(ctx context.Context, path string, topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) string {
225		var names []string
226		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
227			matched := false
228			for _, key := range []string{"remote." + remote.Name + ".url", "remote." + remote.Name + ".pushurl"} {
229				raw, err := gitx.Run(ctx, path, "config", "--get-all", key)
230				if err != nil {
231					continue
232				}
233				for _, value := range strings.Split(raw, "\n") {
234					if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(value) == identity {
235						matched = true
236						break
237					}
238				}
239				if matched {
240					break
241				}
242			}
243			if matched {
244				names = append(names, remote.Name)
245			}
246		}
247		if len(names) == 0 {
248			return matchingRemote(topology, identity)
249		}
250		sort.Strings(names)
251		return names[0]
252	}

64			return fmt.Errorf("max files %d must be between 1 and %d: %w", limits.MaxFiles, maximum.MaxFiles, ErrInvalidLimits)
65		case limits.MaxFileBytes <= 0 || limits.MaxFileBytes > maximum.MaxFileBytes:

98	func ValidateManifest(files []Metadata, limits Limits) error {
99		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
100			return err
101		}
102		if len(files) > limits.MaxFiles {
103			return fmt.Errorf("manifest has %d files; maximum is %d: %w", len(files), limits.MaxFiles, ErrManifestLimit)
104		}
105		paths := make([]string, 0, len(files))
106		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(files))
107		var total int64
108		for _, file := range files {
109			if file.Size < 0 {
110				return fmt.Errorf("file %q has negative size: %w", file.Path, ErrManifestLimit)
111			}
112			if file.Size > limits.MaxFileBytes {
113				return fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", file.Path, file.Size, limits.MaxFileBytes, ErrManifestLimit)
114			}
115			if _, exists := seen[file.Path]; exists {
116				return fmt.Errorf("path %q appears more than once: %w", file.Path, ErrDuplicatePath)
117			}
118			seen[file.Path] = struct{}{}
119			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
120			if file.Size > limits.MaxTotalBytes-total {
121				return fmt.Errorf("manifest exceeds %d total bytes: %w", limits.MaxTotalBytes, ErrManifestLimit)
122			}
123			total += file.Size
124		}
125		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
126			return err
127		}
128		return nil
129	}

2	// relative paths. It keeps traversal relative to os.Root handles, rejects links
3	// and special files, revalidates filesystem identity, and detects observable
4	// source mutation while reading.

20		// the object observed by the caller.

23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.

29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}

135	// ReadStableRegular reads one child file while proving that the directory name,
136	// opened descriptor, and final directory name all identify the expected regular
137	// file with unchanged observable metadata. maxBytes must be non-negative; zero
138	// means unbounded. Supplying the FileInfo from an earlier directory listing

140	func ReadStableRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {

206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}

214	func sameStableSourceState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
215		return SameFileState(left, right) && samePlatformState(left, right)
216	}

218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}

31	// CreateNoClobber stages data in an unguessable owner-private file, syncs it,
32	// applies finalMode, and atomically hard-links it to the absent destination.
33	// The hard-link publication is same-directory and cannot replace an existing
34	// path. This generic helper exists so callers such as repotemplate can preserve
35	// intentional public modes; secret-bearing callers should use
36	// CreatePrivateNoClobber.
37	func CreateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
38		return createNoClobberWithHooks(ctx, root, name, data, finalMode, createNoClobberHooks{})
39	}

41	type createNoClobberHooks struct {
42		removeStage func(*os.Root, string) error
43		syncRoot    func(*os.Root) error

46	func createNoClobberWithHooks(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode, hooks createNoClobberHooks) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
47		if root == nil {
48			return nil, errors.New("atomic create: nil root")
49		}
50		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
51			return nil, err
52		}
53		removeStage := hooks.removeStage
54		if removeStage == nil {
55			removeStage = func(root *os.Root, name string) error { return root.Remove(name) }
56		}
57		syncDirectory := hooks.syncRoot
58		if syncDirectory == nil {
59			syncDirectory = syncRoot
60		}
61		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)
62		if err != nil {
63			return nil, err
64		}
65		defer func() {
66			if stagedName != "" {
67				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
68			}
69		}()
70		if err := root.Link(stagedName, name); err != nil {
71			return nil, fmt.Errorf("publish %q without replacement: %w", name, err)
72		}
73		rollbackPublication := func(cause error) error {
74			current, statErr := root.Lstat(name)
75			if statErr != nil || unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, current) {
76				return fmt.Errorf("create %q failed after publication; destination ownership is indeterminate: %w",
77					name, errors.Join(cause, statErr, ErrChanged))
78			}
79			removeErr := root.Remove(name)
80			var syncErr error
81			if removeErr == nil {
82				syncErr = syncDirectory(root)
83			}
84			if removeErr != nil {
85				return fmt.Errorf("create %q failed and publication rollback failed: %w", name, errors.Join(cause, removeErr))
86			}
87			return fmt.Errorf("create %q failed after publication and was rolled back: %w", name, errors.Join(cause, syncErr))
88		}
89		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
90		if err != nil {
91			return nil, rollbackPublication(fmt.Errorf("verify published file: %w", err))
92		}
93		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
94			return nil, rollbackPublication(fmt.Errorf("published file does not match staging file: %w", ErrChanged))
95		}
96		if err := removeStage(root, stagedName); err != nil {
97			return nil, rollbackPublication(fmt.Errorf("remove staging link: %w", err))
98		}
99		stagedName = ""
100		published, err = root.Lstat(name)
101		if err != nil {
102			return nil, rollbackPublication(fmt.Errorf("refresh published file: %w", err))
103		}
104		if err := syncDirectory(root); err != nil {
105			return nil, rollbackPublication(fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory: %w", err))
106		}
107		return published, nil
108	}

110	// CreatePrivateNoClobber is CreateNoClobber with a clamped owner-only final
111	// mode. executable is the only way to grant execute permission.
112	func CreatePrivateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {

119	// AtomicReplace stages and syncs data in the target directory, revalidates the

121	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
122	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
123	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
124	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
125	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.
126	func AtomicReplace(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {

131			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replace %q without observed state: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
132		}
133		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
134			return nil, err
135		}
136		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
137			return nil, err
138		}
139		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)
140		if err != nil {
141			return nil, err
142		}
143		defer func() {
144			if stagedName != "" {
145				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
146			}
147		}()
148		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151		if err := root.Rename(stagedName, name); err != nil {
152			return nil, fmt.Errorf("atomically replace %q: %w", name, err)
153		}
154		stagedName = ""
155		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
158		}
159		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
160			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
161		}
162		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
163			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
164		}
165		return published, nil
166	}
167
168	// AtomicReplacePrivate is AtomicReplace with owner-only final permissions.
169	func AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
170		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
171			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
172		}
173		return AtomicReplace(ctx, root, name, observed, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
174	}
175
176	func verifyReplaceTarget(root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo) error {
177		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
178		if err != nil {
179			return fmt.Errorf("inspect replacement target %q: %w: %w", name, err, ErrReplaceTarget)
180		}
181		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(observed, current) {
182			return fmt.Errorf("replacement target %q changed or is not a regular file: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
183		}
184		return nil
185	}
186
187	func stageRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (string, fs.FileInfo, error) {
188		if finalMode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
189			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported final file mode %s", finalMode)
190		}
191		var name string
192		var writer *os.File
193		for attempt := 0; attempt < 32; attempt++ {
194			candidate, err := randomStageName()
195			if err != nil {
196				return "", nil, err
197			}
198			writer, err = root.OpenFile(candidate, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
199			if err == nil {
200				name = candidate
201				break
202			}
203			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
204				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("create private staging file: %w", err)
205			}
206		}
207		if writer == nil {
208			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
209		}
210		keep := true
211		defer func() {
212			if keep {
213				_ = writer.Close()
214				_ = root.Remove(name)
215			}
216		}()
217		if err := writeAllContext(ctx, writer, data); err != nil {
218			return "", nil, err
219		}
220		if err := writer.Chmod(finalMode.Perm()); err != nil {
221			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("set staged file mode: %w", err)
222		}
223		if err := writer.Sync(); err != nil {
224			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("sync staged file: %w", err)
225		}
226		opened, err := writer.Stat()
227		if err != nil {
228			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect staged file: %w", err)
229		}
230		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
231			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("close staged file: %w", err)
232		}
233		keep = false
234		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
235		if err != nil {
236			_ = root.Remove(name)
237			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("reopen staged file name: %w", err)
238		}
239		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(opened, current) {
240			_ = root.Remove(name)
241			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("staging file changed before publication: %w", ErrChanged)
242		}
243		return name, current, nil
244	}
245
246	func validateTargetName(name string) error {
247		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
248			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
249		}
250		return nil
251	}
252
253	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
254		for len(data) > 0 {
255			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
256				return err
257			}
258			written, err := writer.Write(data)
259			if err != nil {
260				return err
261			}
262			if written == 0 {
263				return io.ErrShortWrite
264			}
265			data = data[written:]
266		}
267		return context.Cause(ctx)
268	}
269
270	func randomStageName() (string, error) {
271		var random [16]byte
272		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
273			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
274		}
275		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
276	}

34	// path. This generic helper exists so callers such as repotemplate can preserve

120	// existing regular file against observed, and atomically renames the staged file
121	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
122	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
123	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
124	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
125	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.
126	func AtomicReplace(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
127		if root == nil {
128			return nil, errors.New("atomic replace: nil root")
129		}
130		if observed == nil {
131			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replace %q without observed state: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
132		}
133		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
134			return nil, err
135		}
136		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
137			return nil, err
138		}
139		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode)
140		if err != nil {
141			return nil, err
142		}
143		defer func() {
144			if stagedName != "" {
145				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
146			}
147		}()
148		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151		if err := root.Rename(stagedName, name); err != nil {
152			return nil, fmt.Errorf("atomically replace %q: %w", name, err)
153		}
154		stagedName = ""
155		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
158		}
159		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
160			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
161		}
162		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
163			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
164		}
165		return published, nil
166	}
167
168	// AtomicReplacePrivate is AtomicReplace with owner-only final permissions.
169	func AtomicReplacePrivate(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
170		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
171			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
172		}
173		return AtomicReplace(ctx, root, name, observed, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
174	}
175
176	func verifyReplaceTarget(root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo) error {
177		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
178		if err != nil {
179			return fmt.Errorf("inspect replacement target %q: %w: %w", name, err, ErrReplaceTarget)
180		}
181		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(observed, current) {
182			return fmt.Errorf("replacement target %q changed or is not a regular file: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
183		}
184		return nil
185	}
186
187	func stageRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (string, fs.FileInfo, error) {
188		if finalMode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
189			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported final file mode %s", finalMode)
190		}
191		var name string
192		var writer *os.File
193		for attempt := 0; attempt < 32; attempt++ {
194			candidate, err := randomStageName()
195			if err != nil {
196				return "", nil, err
197			}
198			writer, err = root.OpenFile(candidate, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
199			if err == nil {
200				name = candidate
201				break
202			}
203			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
204				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("create private staging file: %w", err)
205			}
206		}
207		if writer == nil {
208			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
209		}
210		keep := true
211		defer func() {
212			if keep {
213				_ = writer.Close()
214				_ = root.Remove(name)
215			}
216		}()
217		if err := writeAllContext(ctx, writer, data); err != nil {
218			return "", nil, err
219		}
220		if err := writer.Chmod(finalMode.Perm()); err != nil {
221			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("set staged file mode: %w", err)
222		}
223		if err := writer.Sync(); err != nil {
224			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("sync staged file: %w", err)
225		}
226		opened, err := writer.Stat()
227		if err != nil {
228			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect staged file: %w", err)
229		}
230		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
231			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("close staged file: %w", err)
232		}
233		keep = false
234		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
235		if err != nil {
236			_ = root.Remove(name)
237			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("reopen staged file name: %w", err)
238		}
239		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(opened, current) {
240			_ = root.Remove(name)
241			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("staging file changed before publication: %w", ErrChanged)
242		}
243		return name, current, nil
244	}
245
246	func validateTargetName(name string) error {
247		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
248			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
249		}
250		return nil
251	}
252
253	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
254		for len(data) > 0 {
255			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
256				return err
257			}
258			written, err := writer.Write(data)
259			if err != nil {
260				return err
261			}
262			if written == 0 {
263				return io.ErrShortWrite
264			}
265			data = data[written:]
266		}
267		return context.Cause(ctx)
268	}
269
270	func randomStageName() (string, error) {
271		var random [16]byte
272		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
273			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
274		}
275		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
276	}

3	import (

9
10	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
11	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
12	type Repo struct {
13		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
14		Root string
15		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory. A linked worktree has
16		// its own entry below the shared common directory.
17		GitDir string
18		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
19		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
20		GitCommonDir string
21		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
22		Name string
23		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
24		// the main checkout.
25		IsLinkedWorktree bool
26		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
27		MainRoot string
28		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
29		Bare bool
30	}
31
32	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
33	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
34
35	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
36	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
37		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
38		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
39		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
40			"rev-parse",
41			"--path-format=absolute",
42			"--show-toplevel",
43			"--git-dir",
44			"--git-common-dir",
45			"--is-bare-repository",
46		)
47		if err != nil {
48			return Repo{}, err
49		}
50		f := lines(out)
51		r := Repo{}
52		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
53		switch len(f) {
54		case 4:
55			r.Root = f[0]
56			r.GitDir = f[1]
57			r.GitCommonDir = f[2]
58			r.Bare = f[3] == "true"
59		case 3:
60			r.GitDir = f[0]
61			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
62			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
63		default:
64			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
65		}
66
67		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
68		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
69		if r.Bare {
70			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
71		} else if r.GitDir == r.GitCommonDir {
72			// A normal checkout may use --separate-git-dir, so the common directory's
73			// parent is not necessarily the working-tree root.
74			r.MainRoot = r.Root
75		} else {
76			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
77		}
78		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.GitDir != r.GitCommonDir
79		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
80		if r.Bare {
81			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
82			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
83			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
84				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
85			}
86		}
87		return r, nil
88	}
89
90	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
91	// a full Discover.
92	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
93		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
94		return err == nil
95	}
96
97	// DefaultBranch resolves the repository's default branch — origin/HEAD when the
98	// remote advertises it, else the first of main/master that exists locally.
99	// Returns "" when nothing can be determined, which callers must treat as
100	// "ask the user" rather than guessing.
101	func DefaultBranch(ctx context.Context, dir string) string {
102		if out, err := run(ctx, dir, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"); err == nil {
103			if _, b, ok := strings.Cut(out, "/"); ok {
104				return b
105			}
106		}
107		for _, cand := range []string{"main", "master", "trunk", "develop"} {
108			if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+cand); err == nil {
109				return cand
110			}
111		}
112		return ""
113	}
114
115	// Remote returns the push URL of the named remote ("origin" when empty).
116	func Remote(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) string {
117		if name == "" {
118			name = "origin"
119		}
120		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "remote", "get-url", name)
121		if err != nil {
122			return ""
123		}
124		return out
125	}
126
127	// RemoteFromConfig reads one remote URL directly from a Git common directory.
128	// It is the zero-process path used by whole-machine inventory, where spawning
129	// `git remote get-url` once per repo dominated startup. Includes and URL
130	// rewriting are deliberately not evaluated; callers that need Git's complete
131	// semantics should use Remote instead.
132	func RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, name string) string {
133		if commonDir == "" {
134			return ""
135		}
136		if name == "" {
137			name = "origin"
138		}
139		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(commonDir, "config"))
140		if err != nil {
141			return ""
142		}
143		want := `remote "` + name + `"`
144		section := ""
145		for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
146			line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
147			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || strings.HasPrefix(line, ";") {
148				continue
149			}
150			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.HasSuffix(line, "]") {
151				section = strings.TrimSpace(line[1 : len(line)-1])
152				continue
153			}
154			if section != want {
155				continue
156			}
157			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
158			if ok && strings.TrimSpace(key) == "url" {
159				return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), `"`)
160			}
161		}
162		return ""
163	}

33	Parking is the missing move that makes a crowded sidebar shrink. It records

35	runtime session — while leaving the branch and the worktree exactly where they
36	are. Closing a session is not abandoning a task.

39	  cold (--cold)   work is committed and pushed, session closed, worktree
40	                  removed. Reconstruct it anywhere later with dev resume.
41
42	--cold and --keep-session are incompatible: a runtime cannot stay pointed at a
43	checkout that cold parking removes.
44
45	A checkpoint commit is preferred over git stash: a stash is invisible in the

47	machine, which is exactly what parking needs to support.`,

107								fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %s\n", app.outStyle().label("committed"), msg)
108							}
109						case st.Dirty() && cold:
110							return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes; going cold removes the worktree.\n"+
111								"Commit them, or re-run with --wip to checkpoint automatically",
112								config.Contract(checkout))
113						case st.Dirty():
114							app.warnf("%s has uncommitted changes (kept in place; --wip checkpoints them)",
115								config.Contract(checkout))
116						}
117
118						if push {
119							if err := pushBranch(ctx, app, checkout, t.Branch); err != nil {
120								return err
121							}
122						}
123						if cold {
124							st, err = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
125							if err != nil {
126								return err
127							}
128							if !st.Published() || st.Ahead > 0 {
129								return fmt.Errorf("%s is not fully pushed (%s); a cold task must be reconstructible "+
130									"from the remote.\nRun `dev park --cold --push`", t.Branch, st.Summary())
131							}
132						}
133					}
134
135					rt := runtimeForTask(app, t)
136					if cold && t.WorktreePath != "" {
137						if err := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, t.WorktreePath); err != nil {
138							return err
139						}
140						if err := safeRemoveWorktree(ctx, rt, t.RepoPath, t.WorktreePath, false,
141							closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime, timeout); err != nil {
142							return err
143						}
144						// The path is cleared, but the branch stays: that is what makes
145						// the task reconstructible rather than lost.
146						t.WorktreePath = ""
147						clearTaskRuntime(t)
148					} else if !keepRT && t.RuntimeHandle != "" {
149						inspection, inspectErr := retirement.Inspect(ctx, rt, checkout, retirement.Options{})
150						if inspectErr != nil {
151							return inspectErr
152						}
153						if inspection.CallerContained {
154							app.warnf("runtime left active because the caller is inside it; exit normally, then let sweep reconcile")
155						} else {
156							closed, closeErr := retirement.CloseAndWait(ctx, rt, checkout, retirement.Options{
157								CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
158							})
159							if closeErr != nil {
160								return closeErr
161							}
162							if closed.ClosedSessions > 0 {
163								fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     %d %s session(s)\n", app.outStyle().label("closed"), closed.ClosedSessions, rt.Name())
164							}
165							clearTaskRuntime(t)
166						}
167					}
168					if cold && mode == task.ModeBranch {
169						// Free the canonical checkout for other work. The branch remains
170						// local + remote and resume switches back to it.
171						base := t.Base
172						if base == "" {
173							base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, t.RepoPath)
174						}
175						if base == "" {
176							return fmt.Errorf("task is pushed, but its base branch is unknown")
177						}
178						if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, t.RepoPath, "switch", base); err != nil {
179							return fmt.Errorf("task is pushed, but could not switch canonical checkout back to %s: %w",
180								base, err)
181						}
182					}
183
184					t.State = target
185					t.Owner = config.Hostname()
186					if err := app.Tasks.SaveIfRevisionUnderLock(t, expectedRevision); err != nil {
187						return err
188					}
189					style := app.outStyle()
190					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s is %s", target.Icon(), t.Title(), style.taskStateFor(string(target), target.Label()))
191					if t.Next != "" {
192						fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, " — %s %s", style.label("next:"), t.Next)
193					}
194					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out)
195					return nil
196				})
197			},
198		}
199		f := cmd.Flags()
200		f.StringVarP(&next, "next", "n", "", "what to do when you come back")
201		f.StringVar(&note, "note", "", "free-form note")
202		f.BoolVar(&wip, "wip", false, "checkpoint uncommitted work as a wip: commit")
203		f.BoolVar(&push, "push", false, "push the branch so another machine can pick it up")
204		f.BoolVar(&cold, "cold", false, "go cold: remove the worktree after confirming everything is pushed")
205		f.BoolVar(&keepRT, "keep-session", false, "leave the runtime session open")
206		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow external closure of unknown runtime status")
207		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails")
208		f.DurationVar(&timeout, "timeout", 5*time.Second, "maximum time to wait for runtime closure")
209		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Hot, task.Warm)
210		return cmd
211	}

213	// pushBranch publishes a branch, setting upstream on first push.
214	func pushBranch(ctx context.Context, app *App, dir, branch string) error {
215		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, dir, "push", "--set-upstream", "origin", branch); err != nil {
216			return fmt.Errorf("push %s: %w", branch, err)
217		}
218		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s     origin/%s\n", app.outStyle().label("pushed"), branch)
219		return nil
220	}
221
222	// resolveTask picks the task an argument names, or infers it from the current
223	// directory when no argument is given.
224	func resolveTask(app *App, args []string) (*task.Task, error) {
225		if len(args) == 1 {
226			return app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
227		}
228		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
229		if err != nil {
230			return nil, err
231		}
232		t, err := app.Tasks.FindByWorktree(cwd)
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no task for %s — name one explicitly, or run this inside a task's checkout",
235				config.Contract(cwd))
236		}
237		return t, nil
238	}

40	// Store is a directory of one-TOML-file-per-task.
41	//
42	// One file per task, rather than a single registry document, is a deliberate
43	// choice: the state directory is meant to be syncable across machines (it can
44	// simply be a git repo), and a shared central file would conflict on every
45	// parallel edit while separate files merge cleanly.
46	type Store struct{ Dir string }

55		// ImportCreated means no task used the imported ID and a file was created.
56		ImportCreated ImportOutcome = "created"
57		// ImportIdentical means the same ID and semantic content were already stored.
58		ImportIdentical ImportOutcome = "identical"
59		// ImportConflict means the ID already held different semantic content.

68	// ValidateID checks that id can be used as exactly one visible filename stem.
69	func ValidateID(id string) error {
70		if !validID.MatchString(id) || filepath.Base(id) != id || id == "." || id == ".." {
71			return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrInvalidID)
72		}
73		return nil
74	}

76	// MakeID derives the stable filename stem for a repo+branch pair.
77	func MakeID(repo, branch string) string {
78		clean := func(s string) string {
79			s = idUnsafe.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
80			for strings.Contains(s, "--") {
81				s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "--", "-")
82			}
83			return strings.Trim(s, "-._")
84		}
85		r, b := clean(repo), clean(branch)
86		if r == "" {
87			r = "repo"
88		}
89		if b == "" {
90			b = "branch"
91		}
92		return r + "__" + b
93	}

97	// Save creates a task or updates one read by this Store. Existing-task writes
98	// compare the task's private loaded revision under the cross-process lock, so
99	// legacy callers cannot silently overwrite a newer process's mutation.
100	func (s *Store) Save(t *Task) error {
101		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
102		if err != nil {
103			return err
104		}
105		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
106			current, currentErr := s.get(candidate.ID)
107			switch {
108			case currentErr == nil:
109				if candidate.storedRevision == "" || candidate.storedRevision != current.Revision() {
110					return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
111				}
112				if !candidate.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
113					return fmt.Errorf("task %s changed its creation time: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
114				}
115			case errors.Is(currentErr, ErrNotFound):
116				if candidate.storedRevision != "" {
117					return fmt.Errorf("task %s was removed after it was read: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
118				}
119			default:
120				return currentErr
121			}
122			stampForSave(candidate)
123			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
124				return err
125			}
126			candidate.storedRevision = candidate.Revision()
127			return nil
128		})
129		if err != nil {
130			return err
131		}
132		*t = *candidate
133		return nil
134	}

136	// ReplaceDone starts a new task generation under an existing stable ID only
137	// while the exact observed record is still DONE. It resets Created/Updated and
138	// rejects a concurrent restart instead of weakening ordinary Save CAS.
139	func (s *Store) ReplaceDone(t *Task, expectedRevision string) error {
140		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
141		if err != nil {
142			return err

176	// Store.WithMutation. Calling it without that transaction guard is a

179		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, true)
180		if err != nil {
