199	// ImportExact creates t under its supplied ID without changing any semantic
200	// field or timestamp. Replaying identical content is a no-op; reusing an ID
201	// for different content reports ImportConflict and ErrConflict.
202	func (s *Store) ImportExact(t *Task) (ImportOutcome, error) {
203		candidate, err := prepareCandidate(t, false)
204		if err != nil {
205			return "", err
206		}
207		var outcome ImportOutcome
208		err = s.withMutationLock(func() error {
209			current, err := s.get(candidate.ID)
210			switch {
211			case err == nil && current.Revision() == candidate.Revision():
212				outcome = ImportIdentical
213				return nil
214			case err == nil:
215				outcome = ImportConflict
216				return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", candidate.ID, ErrConflict)
217			case !errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
218				return err
219			}
220			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
221				return err
222			}
223			outcome = ImportCreated
224			return nil
225		})
226		return outcome, err
227	}

254	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Task, error) {

257			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {

270	func prepareCandidate(t *Task, deriveID bool) (*Task, error) {
271		if t == nil {
272			return nil, errors.New("save nil task")
273		}
274		candidate := *t
275		candidate.Tags = append([]string(nil), t.Tags...)
276		if candidate.ID == "" && deriveID {
277			candidate.ID = MakeID(candidate.Repo, candidate.Branch)
278		}
279		if candidate.ID == "" {
280			return nil, fmt.Errorf("task import requires an exact ID: %w", ErrInvalidID)
281		}
282		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
283			return nil, err
284		}
285		return &candidate, nil
286	}

296	// WithMutation holds the task store's cross-process lock for a compound
297	// read-side-effect-CAS transaction. The callback must use non-reentrant store
298	// methods such as SaveIfRevisionUnderLock.
299	func (s *Store) WithMutation(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
300		if s == nil {
301			return errors.New("mutate nil task store")
302		}
303		if operation == nil {
304			return errors.New("task store mutation requires an operation")
305		}
306		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "task store", operation)
307	}

309	func (s *Store) withMutationLock(operation func() error) error {
310		return s.WithMutation(context.Background(), operation)
311	}

313	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(t *Task) error {
314		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
315			return fmt.Errorf("create task state directory: %w", err)
316		}
317		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+t.ID+".*.tmp")
318		if err != nil {
319			return fmt.Errorf("create task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
320		}
321		name := tmp.Name()
322		defer os.Remove(name)
323		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o644); err != nil {
324			_ = tmp.Close()
325			return fmt.Errorf("set task %s file mode: %w", t.ID, err)
326		}
327		if err := toml.NewEncoder(tmp).Encode(t); err != nil {
328			_ = tmp.Close()
329			return fmt.Errorf("encode task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
330		}
331		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
332			_ = tmp.Close()
333			return fmt.Errorf("sync task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
334		}
335		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
336			return fmt.Errorf("close task %s temp file: %w", t.ID, err)
337		}
338		if err := replaceFile(name, s.path(t.ID)); err != nil {
339			return fmt.Errorf("replace task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
340		}
341		if err := errors.Join(syncDirectory(s.Dir), syncDirectory(filepath.Dir(s.Dir))); err != nil {
342			return fmt.Errorf("sync task %s directory: %w", t.ID, err)
343		}
344		return nil
345	}

347	// List loads every valid task, sorted by state (hot first) then most recent.
348	// It retains the historical warning behavior; completeness-sensitive callers
349	// should use ListWithDiagnostics instead of treating a partial list as whole.
350	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Task, error) {
351		tasks, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
352		if err != nil {
353			return nil, err
354		}
355		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
356			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: %s\n", diagnostic.Error())
357		}
358		return tasks, nil
359	}
360
361	// ListWithDiagnostics returns every valid task plus deterministic per-record
362	// errors. A corrupt record never hides valid work and never silently satisfies
363	// an inventory-completeness gate.
364	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Task, []Diagnostic, error) {
365		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
366		if err != nil {
367			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
368				return nil, nil, nil // no state yet is a normal, empty inventory
369			}
370			return nil, nil, err
371		}
372		var tasks []*Task
373		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
374		for _, entry := range entries {
375			name := entry.Name()
376			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") {
377				continue
378			}
379			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
380			tracked, err := s.Get(id)
381			if err != nil {
382				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
383				continue
384			}
385			tasks = append(tasks, tracked)
386		}
387		Sort(tasks)
388		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
389		return tasks, diagnostics, nil
390	}

392	// Delete removes a task entry under the mutation lock. It never touches git

394	func (s *Store) Delete(id string) error {

396			return err

398		return s.withMutationLock(func() error {
399			err := os.Remove(s.path(id))
400			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
401				return fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
402			}
403			if err != nil {
404				return err
405			}
406			if err := syncDirectory(s.Dir); err != nil {
407				return fmt.Errorf("sync task directory after deleting %s: %w", id, err)
408			}
409			return nil
410		})
411	}

413	// Resolve finds a task from a loose user-supplied reference: an exact id, an
414	// exact branch, or a unique case-insensitive substring of the id, name or
415	// branch. An ambiguous reference is an error listing the candidates rather
416	// than a silent pick.
417	func (s *Store) Resolve(ref string) (*Task, error) {
418		if ref == "" {
419			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty task reference: %w", ErrNotFound)
420		}
421		all, err := s.List()
422		if err != nil {
423			return nil, err
424		}
425		for _, t := range all {
426			if t.ID == ref || t.Branch == ref {
427				return t, nil
428			}
429		}
430		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
431		var hits []*Task
432		for _, t := range all {
433			hay := strings.ToLower(t.ID + " " + t.Name + " " + t.Branch + " " + t.Repo)
434			if strings.Contains(hay, needle) {
435				hits = append(hits, t)
436			}
437		}
438		switch len(hits) {
439		case 1:
440			return hits[0], nil
441		case 0:
442			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", ref, ErrNotFound)
443		default:
444			names := make([]string, len(hits))
445			for i, t := range hits {
446				names[i] = t.ID
447			}
448			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))
449		}
450	}

452	// FindByWorktree returns the task whose checkout contains dir.
453	//
454	// A task lives at exactly one place: its worktree when it has one, otherwise
455	// the main checkout. A task that has a linked worktree therefore does *not*
456	// claim the main checkout — otherwise standing in the main repo would match
457	// every worktree-based task of that repo. Among candidates, the longest path
458	// match wins so a nested checkout beats its parent.
459	func (s *Store) FindByWorktree(dir string) (*Task, error) {
460		all, err := s.List()
461		if err != nil {
462			return nil, err
463		}
464		under := func(dir, root string) bool {
465			return root != "" && (dir == root || strings.HasPrefix(dir, root+string(filepath.Separator)))
466		}
467		var best *Task
468		var bestLen int
469		for _, t := range all {
470			root := t.WorktreePath
471			if root == "" {
472				root = t.RepoPath
473			}
474			if under(dir, root) && len(root) > bestLen {
475				best, bestLen = t, len(root)
476			}
477		}
478		if best == nil {
479			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", dir, ErrNotFound)
480		}
481		return best, nil
482	}
483
484	// stateRank orders states so the inventory reads as an attention queue.
485	func stateRank(s State) int {
486		switch s {
487		case Hot:
488			return 0
489		case Warm:
490			return 1
491		case Cold:
492			return 2
493		case Done:
494			return 3
495		}
496		return 4
497	}
498
499	// Sort orders tasks hot-first, then by most recently updated.
500	func Sort(ts []*Task) {
501		sort.SliceStable(ts, func(i, j int) bool {
502			ri, rj := stateRank(ts[i].State), stateRank(ts[j].State)
503			if ri != rj {
504				return ri < rj
505			}
506			if !ts[i].Updated.Equal(ts[j].Updated) {
507				return ts[i].Updated.After(ts[j].Updated)
508			}
509			return ts[i].ID < ts[j].ID
510		})
511	}

202	func snapshotDirectory(ctx context.Context, sourceLabel, rootPath, ref, commit, subdir string, source snapshotSource) (Snapshot, error) {
203		root, rootInfo, err := openNamedRoot(rootPath)
204		if err != nil {
205			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("resolve template source %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
206		}
207		defer root.Close()
208
209		selected := root
210		selectedInfo := rootInfo
211		selectedPath := rootPath
212		if subdir != "" {
213			selected, selectedInfo, err = openRelativeRoot(root, subdir)
214			if err != nil {
215				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template subdirectory %q: %w", subdir, err)
216			}
217			defer selected.Close()
218			selectedPath = filepath.Join(rootPath, filepath.FromSlash(subdir))
219		}
220
221		snapshot := Snapshot{
222			Source: sourceLabel, Ref: ref, Commit: commit, Subdir: subdir,
223			Local: source.local, Live: source.live,
224		}
225		if source.live {
226			paths, filtered, err := liveGitPaths(ctx, selectedPath)
227			if err != nil {
228				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("list live template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
229			}
230			if err := verifyNamedRoot(selectedPath, selectedInfo); err != nil {
231				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source changed while listing: %w", err)
232			}
233			snapshot.GitFiltered = filtered
234			if filtered {
235				tree, err := buildSelectionTree(paths)
236				if err != nil {
237					return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
238				}
239				if _, err := snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx, selected, tree, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
240					return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
241				}
242			} else if err := snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, selected, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
243				return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
244			}
245		} else if err := snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, selected, "", &snapshot); err != nil {
246			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
247		}
248		if err := verifyNamedRoot(selectedPath, selectedInfo); err != nil {
249			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("template source changed during snapshot: %w", err)
250		}
251		if err := finalizeSnapshot(&snapshot); err != nil {
252			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("prepare template %q: %w", sourceLabel, err)
253		}
254		return snapshot, nil
255	}

261	func openRelativeRoot(base *os.Root, relative string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
262		current := base
263		owned := false
264		for _, component := range strings.Split(relative, "/") {
265			next, _, err := openChildRoot(current, component)
266			if err != nil {
267				if owned {
268					current.Close()
269				}
270				return nil, nil, err
271			}
272			if owned {
273				current.Close()
274			}
275			current, owned = next, true
276		}
277		info, err := current.Stat(".")
278		if err != nil {
279			current.Close()
280			return nil, nil, err
281		}
282		return current, info, nil
283	}

297	func liveGitPaths(ctx context.Context, root string) ([]string, bool, error) {
298		if _, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, root); err != nil {
299			if errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
300				return nil, false, nil
301			}
302			return nil, false, err
303		}
304		selected := map[string]bool{}
305		tracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "ls-files", "-z", "--stage", "--", ".")
306		if err != nil {
307			return nil, false, err
308		}
309		for _, record := range splitNUL(tracked) {
310			tab := strings.IndexByte(record, '\t')
311			if tab < 0 {
312				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("unexpected git ls-files record %q", record)
313			}
314			header, path := record[:tab], record[tab+1:]
315			fields := strings.Fields(header)
316			if len(fields) < 1 {
317				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("unexpected git ls-files record %q", record)
318			}
319			if fields[0] == "160000" {
320				continue
321			}
322			selected[path] = true
323		}
324		untracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "ls-files", "-z", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "--", ".")
325		if err != nil {
326			return nil, false, err
327		}
328		for _, path := range splitNUL(untracked) {
329			selected[path] = true
330		}
331		paths := make([]string, 0, len(selected))
332		for path := range selected {
333			cleaned, err := validateSnapshotPath(path)
334			if err != nil {
335				return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q: %w", path, err)
336			}
337			paths = append(paths, cleaned)
338		}
339		sort.Strings(paths)
340		return paths, true, nil
341	}
342
343	func splitNUL(value string) []string {
344		value = strings.TrimSuffix(value, "\x00")
345		if value == "" {
346			return nil
347		}
348		return strings.Split(value, "\x00")
349	}
350
351	type selectionNode struct {
352		leaf     bool
353		children map[string]*selectionNode
354	}
355
356	func buildSelectionTree(paths []string) (*selectionNode, error) {
357		root := &selectionNode{children: map[string]*selectionNode{}}
358		for _, path := range paths {
359			current := root
360			components := strings.Split(path, "/")
361			for index, component := range components {
362				if current.leaf {
363					return nil, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q is below another selected file", path)
364				}
365				if current.children[component] == nil {
366					current.children[component] = &selectionNode{children: map[string]*selectionNode{}}
367				}
368				current = current.children[component]
369				if index == len(components)-1 {
370					if len(current.children) > 0 {
371						return nil, fmt.Errorf("Git path %q is the parent of another selected path", path)
372					}
373					current.leaf = true
374				}
375			}
376		}
377		return root, nil
378	}

380	func snapshotWholeRoot(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, relative string, snapshot *Snapshot) error {
381		if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
382			return err
383		}
384		directory, err := root.Open(".")
385		if err != nil {
386			return err
387		}
388		defer directory.Close()
389		before, err := directory.Stat()
390		if err != nil {
391			return err
392		}
393		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(-1)
394		if err != nil {
395			return err
396		}
397		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
398		for _, entry := range entries {
399			name := entry.Name()
400			if strings.EqualFold(name, ".git") {
401				continue
402			}
403			if err := validateSnapshotComponent(name); err != nil {
404				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
405			}
406			info, err := root.Lstat(name)
407			if err != nil {
408				return fmt.Errorf("inspect template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
409			}
410			path := joinRelative(relative, name)
411			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
412				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a symlink", path)
413			}
414			switch {
415			case info.IsDir():
416				child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
417				if err != nil {
418					return fmt.Errorf("open template directory %q: %w", path, err)
419				}
420				snapshot.Directories = append(snapshot.Directories, Directory{Path: path, Mode: held.Mode().Perm()})
421				err = snapshotWholeRoot(ctx, child, path, snapshot)
422				verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
423				closeErr := child.Close()
424				if err != nil {
425					return err
426				}
427				if verifyErr != nil {
428					return verifyErr
429				}
430				if closeErr != nil {
431					return closeErr
432				}
433			case info.Mode().IsRegular():
434				data, opened, err := readStableRootFile(ctx, root, name, info)
435				if err != nil {
436					return fmt.Errorf("read template file %q: %w", path, err)
437				}
438				snapshot.Files = append(snapshot.Files, File{Path: path, Mode: opened.Mode().Perm(), Data: data})
439			default:
440				return fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a special file (%s)", path, info.Mode().Type())
441			}
442		}
443		after, err := directory.Stat()
444		if err != nil {
445			return err
446		}
447		if !stableInfo(before, after) {
448			return errors.New("source directory changed during snapshot")
449		}
450		return nil
451	}

453	func snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, node *selectionNode, relative string, snapshot *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
454		if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
455			return false, err
456		}
457		before, err := root.Stat(".")
458		if err != nil {
459			return false, err
460		}
461		names := make([]string, 0, len(node.children))
462		for name := range node.children {
463			names = append(names, name)
464		}
465		sort.Strings(names)
466		included := false
467		for _, name := range names {
468			childNode := node.children[name]
469			info, err := root.Lstat(name)
470			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && childNode.leaf && len(childNode.children) == 0 {

472			}
473			if err != nil {
474				return false, fmt.Errorf("inspect selected template entry %q: %w", joinRelative(relative, name), err)
475			}
476			path := joinRelative(relative, name)
477			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
478				return false, fmt.Errorf("template entry %q is a symlink", path)
479			}
480			if len(childNode.children) > 0 {
481				if childNode.leaf || !info.IsDir() {

483				}

486					return false, fmt.Errorf("open selected template directory %q: %w", path, err)
487				}
488				childIncluded, walkErr := snapshotSelectedRoot(ctx, child, childNode, path, snapshot)
489				verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
490				closeErr := child.Close()
491				if walkErr != nil {
492					return false, walkErr
493				}
494				if verifyErr != nil {
495					return false, verifyErr
496				}
497				if closeErr != nil {
498					return false, closeErr
499				}
500				if childIncluded {
501					snapshot.Directories = append(snapshot.Directories, Directory{Path: path, Mode: held.Mode().Perm()})
502					included = true
503				}
504				continue
505			}
506			if !childNode.leaf || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
507				return false, fmt.Errorf("selected Git path %q is not a regular file", path)
508			}
509			data, opened, err := readStableRootFile(ctx, root, name, info)
510			if err != nil {
511				return false, fmt.Errorf("read selected template file %q: %w", path, err)
512			}
513			snapshot.Files = append(snapshot.Files, File{Path: path, Mode: opened.Mode().Perm(), Data: data})
514			included = true
515		}
516		after, err := root.Stat(".")
517		if err != nil {
518			return false, err
519		}
520		if !stableInfo(before, after) {
521			return false, errors.New("source directory changed during snapshot")
522		}
523		return included, nil
524	}
525
526	func readStableRootFile(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
527		return safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, root, name, expected, 0)
528	}
529
530	func stableInfo(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
531		return safefile.SameFileState(left, right)
532	}

564	func (snapshot Snapshot) Apply(destination string) (ApplyResult, error) {
565		result := ApplyResult{Summary: snapshot.Summary()}
566		if err := validateSnapshot(snapshot); err != nil {
567			return result, err
568		}
569		root, rootInfo, err := openNamedRoot(destination)
570		if err != nil {
571			return result, fmt.Errorf("resolve template destination: %w", err)
572		}
573		defer root.Close()
574		entries, err := readRootEntries(root)
575		if err != nil {
576			return result, fmt.Errorf("inspect template destination: %w", err)
577		}
578		gitMetadata := false
579		for _, entry := range entries {
580			if entry.Name() == ".git" {
581				info, err := root.Lstat(entry.Name())
582				if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.IsDir() {
583					return result, errors.New("template destination has unsafe Git metadata")
584				}
585				gitMetadata = true
586				continue
587			}
588			return result, fmt.Errorf("template destination is not a new repository: %q already exists", entry.Name())
589		}
590		if !gitMetadata {
591			return result, errors.New("template destination is not an initialized Git repository")
592		}
593
594		tree, err := buildApplyTree(snapshot)
595		if err != nil {
596			return result, err
597		}
598		if err := applyTree(root, tree, &result); err != nil {
599			return result, err
600		}
601		if err := verifyNamedRoot(destination, rootInfo); err != nil {
602			return result, fmt.Errorf("template destination changed during apply: %w", err)
603		}
604		return result, nil
605	}
606
607	func readRootEntries(root *os.Root) ([]os.DirEntry, error) {
608		directory, err := root.Open(".")
609		if err != nil {
610			return nil, err
611		}
612		defer directory.Close()
613		entries, err := directory.ReadDir(-1)
614		if err != nil {
615			return nil, err
616		}
617		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Name() < entries[j].Name() })
618		return entries, nil
619	}
620
621	type applyNode struct {
622		directory *Directory
623		file      *File
624		children  map[string]*applyNode
625	}
626
627	func buildApplyTree(snapshot Snapshot) (*applyNode, error) {
628		root := &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
629		add := func(path string) *applyNode {
630			current := root
631			for _, component := range strings.Split(path, "/") {
632				if current.children[component] == nil {
633					current.children[component] = &applyNode{children: map[string]*applyNode{}}
634				}
635				current = current.children[component]
636			}
637			return current
638		}
639		for index := range snapshot.Directories {
640			directory := &snapshot.Directories[index]
641			add(directory.Path).directory = directory
642		}
643		for index := range snapshot.Files {
644			file := &snapshot.Files[index]
645			add(file.Path).file = file
646		}
647		return root, nil
648	}
649
650	func applyTree(root *os.Root, node *applyNode, result *ApplyResult) error {
651		names := make([]string, 0, len(node.children))
652		for name := range node.children {
653			names = append(names, name)
654		}
655		sort.Strings(names)
656		for _, name := range names {
657			childNode := node.children[name]
658			if childNode.file != nil {
659				if err := writeRootFile(root, name, *childNode.file); err != nil {
660					return fmt.Errorf("create template file %q: %w", childNode.file.Path, err)
661				}
662				result.AppliedFiles++
663				continue
664			}
665			if err := root.Mkdir(name, 0o700); err != nil {
666				return fmt.Errorf("create template directory %q: %w", name, err)
667			}
668			child, held, err := openChildRoot(root, name)
669			if err != nil {
670				return fmt.Errorf("open created template directory %q: %w", name, err)
671			}
672			walkErr := applyTree(child, childNode, result)
673			mode := fs.FileMode(0o755)
674			if childNode.directory != nil {
675				mode = childNode.directory.Mode.Perm()
676				result.AppliedDirectories++
677			}
678			chmodErr := chmodRootDirectory(child, mode)
679			verifyErr := verifyChildRoot(root, name, held)
680			closeErr := child.Close()
681			if walkErr != nil {
682				return walkErr
683			}
684			if chmodErr != nil {
685				return fmt.Errorf("set template directory mode %q: %w", name, chmodErr)
686			}
687			if verifyErr != nil {
688				return verifyErr
689			}
690			if closeErr != nil {
691				return closeErr
692			}
693		}
694		return nil
695	}
696
697	func writeRootFile(root *os.Root, name string, file File) error {
698		_, err := safefile.CreateNoClobber(context.Background(), root, name, file.Data, file.Mode.Perm())
699		return err
700	}
701
702	func chmodRootDirectory(root *os.Root, mode fs.FileMode) error {
703		directory, err := root.Open(".")
704		if err != nil {
705			return err
706		}
707		defer directory.Close()
708		return directory.Chmod(mode.Perm())
709	}
710
711	func finalizeSnapshot(snapshot *Snapshot) error {
712		sort.SliceStable(snapshot.Files, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Files[i].Path < snapshot.Files[j].Path })
713		sort.SliceStable(snapshot.Directories, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshot.Directories[i].Path < snapshot.Directories[j].Path })
714		return validateSnapshot(*snapshot)
715	}
716
717	func validateSnapshot(snapshot Snapshot) error {
718		paths := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Directories)+len(snapshot.Files))
719		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
720			paths = append(paths, directory.Path)
721		}
722		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
723			paths = append(paths, file.Path)
724		}
725		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
726			return fmt.Errorf("template paths: %w", err)
727		}
728
729		types := make(map[string]string, len(paths))
730		validate := func(relative, kind string, mode fs.FileMode) error {
731			cleaned, err := validateSnapshotPath(relative)
732			if err != nil || cleaned != relative {
733				if err == nil {
734					err = errors.New("path is not a clean relative path")
735				}
736				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q: %w", kind, relative, err)
737			}
738			if mode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
739				return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q has unsupported mode %s", kind, relative, mode)
740			}
741			if previous, exists := types[relative]; exists {
742				return fmt.Errorf("template path %q is declared as both %s and %s", relative, previous, kind)
743			}
744			for parent := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(relative))); parent != "."; parent = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(filepath.FromSlash(parent))) {
745				if types[parent] == "file" {
746					return fmt.Errorf("template %s %q is below file %q", kind, relative, parent)
747				}
748			}
749			types[relative] = kind
750			return nil
751		}
752		for _, directory := range snapshot.Directories {
753			if err := validate(directory.Path, "directory", directory.Mode); err != nil {
754				return err
755			}
756		}
757		for _, file := range snapshot.Files {
758			if err := validate(file.Path, "file", file.Mode); err != nil {
759				return err
760			}
761			prefix := file.Path + "/"
762			for existing := range types {
763				if strings.HasPrefix(existing, prefix) {
764					return fmt.Errorf("template file %q is the parent of %q", file.Path, existing)
765				}
766			}
767		}
768		return nil
769	}
770
771	func cleanSubdir(value string) (string, error) {
772		if value == "" || value == "." {
773			return "", nil
774		}
775		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
776			return "", fmt.Errorf("template subdirectory %q: %w", value, err)
777		}
778		return value, nil
779	}
780
781	func validateSnapshotPath(value string) (string, error) {
782		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, pathx.PortablePathLimits{}); err != nil {
783			return "", err
784		}
785		return value, nil
786	}
787
788	func validateSnapshotComponent(component string) error {
789		return pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(component, 0)
790	}
791
792	func joinRelative(parent, name string) string {
793		if parent == "" {
794			return name
795		}
796		return parent + "/" + name
797	}

60	func resolveStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (repo.Repo, error) {
61		if ref != "" {
62			r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
63			return r, err
64		}
65		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
66		if err != nil {
67			return repo.Repo{}, err
68		}
69		g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
70		if err != nil {
71			return repo.Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("no repo argument and %s is not a git repository", config.Contract(cwd))
72		}
73		return repo.Repo{
74			Name: g.Name, Path: g.MainRoot, RealPath: g.MainRoot,
75			MainRoot: g.MainRoot, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
76		}, nil
77	}
78
79	func buildStartSpec(ctx context.Context, app *App, req startRequest) (*startSpec, error) {
80		r, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, req.RepoRef)
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, err
83		}
84		return buildStartSpecForRepository(ctx, app, r, req)
85	}

87	func buildStartSpecForRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, r repo.Repo, req startRequest) (*startSpec, error) {
88		if r.Bare {
89			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is a bare repository and cannot host a task checkout", r.Display())
90		}
91
92		name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
93		if name == "" && req.Branch != "" && req.Mode != task.ModeDirect {
94			name = req.Branch
95		}
96		if name == "" {
97			return nil, errors.New("give the work a name: dev start <repo> --task <name>")
98		}
99
100		branch, base := strings.TrimSpace(req.Branch), strings.TrimSpace(req.Base)
101		mode := req.Mode
102		if mode == "" {
103			mode = task.ModeWorktree
104		}
105		switch mode {
106		case task.ModeDirect:
107			st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
108			if err != nil {
109				return nil, err
110			}
111			if st.Detached || st.Branch == "" {
112				return nil, errors.New("--direct needs a named branch; this checkout has detached HEAD")
113			}
114			if branch != "" && branch != st.Branch {
115				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--direct tracks the branch already checked out (%s), not --branch %s; "+
116					"omit --branch or use --branch-only", st.Branch, branch)
117			}
118			branch, base = st.Branch, st.Branch
119
120		case task.ModeBranch, task.ModeWorktree:
121			if branch == "" {
122				branch = "feat/" + config.Slug(name)
123			}
124			if base == "" {
125				base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, r.Path)
126			}
127			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, r.Path, "check-ref-format", "--branch", branch); err != nil {
128				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid branch %q: %w", branch, err)
129			}
130			if !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, r.Path, branch) {
131				if base == "" {
132					return nil, errors.New("cannot determine a base ref; enter one explicitly")
133				}
134				if !gitx.RefExists(ctx, r.Path, base) {
135					return nil, fmt.Errorf("base ref %q does not exist in %s", base, r.Path)
136				}
137			}
138
139		default:
140			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown start mode %q", mode)
141		}
142
143		id := task.MakeID(r.Name, branch)
144		existing, err := existingTaskForStart(app.Tasks, id)
145		if err != nil {
146			return nil, err
147		}
148		if existing != nil && existing.State != task.Done {
149			return nil, fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s) — use `dev resume %s`",
150				existing.ID, existing.State, existing.ID)
151		}
152
153		spec := &startSpec{
154			RepoPath: r.Path, RepoName: r.Name, Category: r.Category,
155			Name: name, Branch: branch, Base: base, Next: req.Next, Mode: mode,
156			NoProvision: req.NoProvision, Focus: req.Focus,
157		}
158		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
159			if existing, ok, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, r.Path, branch); err != nil {
160				return nil, err
161			} else if ok {
162				return nil, &wt.ErrExists{Branch: branch, Path: existing.Path}
163			}
164			path, err := app.Cfg.WorktreePathFor(r.Name, r.Path, branch, r.Category)
165			if err != nil {
166				return nil, err
167			}
168			if err := wt.ValidateTarget(path, r.Path); err != nil {
169				return nil, err
170			}
171			spec.WorktreePath = path
172		}
173		return spec, nil
174	}

176	func existingTaskForStart(store *task.Store, id string) (*task.Task, error) {
177		existing, err := store.Get(id)
178		if err == nil {
179			return existing, nil
180		}
181		if errors.Is(err, task.ErrNotFound) {
182			return nil, nil
183		}
184		if present, presentErr := store.RecordExists(id); presentErr == nil && present {
185			return nil, err
186		} else if presentErr != nil {
187			// Preserve the established late-save failure behavior for a task-store
188			// path whose existing ancestor is itself not a directory. Any usable store
189			// with an occupied corrupt record fails before external side effects.
190			if taskStoreBlockedByNonDirectory(store.Dir) {
191				return nil, nil
192			}
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return nil, nil
196	}
197
198	func taskStoreBlockedByNonDirectory(path string) bool {
199		for {
200			info, err := os.Lstat(path)
201			if err == nil {
202				return !info.IsDir()
203			}
204			parent := filepath.Dir(path)
205			if parent == path {
206				return false
207			}
208			path = parent
209		}
210	}
211
212	func executeStartSpec(ctx context.Context, app *App, spec *startSpec, log io.Writer) (*startResult, error) {
213		id := task.MakeID(spec.RepoName, spec.Branch)
214		replaceDoneRevision := ""
215		existing, err := existingTaskForStart(app.Tasks, id)
216		if err != nil {
217			return nil, err
218		}
219		switch {
220		case existing != nil && existing.State != task.Done:
221			return nil, fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s) — use `dev resume %s`",
222				existing.ID, existing.State, existing.ID)
223		case existing != nil:
224			replaceDoneRevision = existing.Revision()
225		}
226
227		t := &task.Task{
228			Name: spec.Name, Repo: spec.RepoName, RepoPath: spec.RepoPath,
229			Branch: spec.Branch, Base: spec.Base, Mode: spec.Mode,
230			State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(), Next: spec.Next,
231		}
232		rt := app.Runtime()
233		label := worktreeRuntimeLabel(spec.RepoName, spec.Branch)
234		if spec.Mode == task.ModeDirect {
235			label = spec.RepoName + "/" + spec.Name
236		}
237		result := &startResult{Task: t, Runtime: rt}
238
239		switch spec.Mode {
240		case task.ModeDirect:
241			if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, spec.RepoPath); err != nil {
242				return nil, err
243			}
244			opened, err := rt.Open(ctx, spec.RepoPath, label)
245			if err != nil {
246				app.warnf("could not open a runtime session: %v", err)
247			} else {
248				result.Opened = opened
249			}
250
251		case task.ModeBranch:
252			if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, spec.RepoPath); err != nil {
253				return nil, err
254			}
255			if gitx.BranchExists(ctx, spec.RepoPath, spec.Branch) {
256				if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, spec.RepoPath, "switch", spec.Branch); err != nil {
257					return nil, fmt.Errorf("switch to %s: %w", spec.Branch, err)
258				}
259			} else if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, spec.RepoPath, "switch", "-c", spec.Branch, spec.Base); err != nil {
260				return nil, fmt.Errorf("create and switch to %s from %s: %w", spec.Branch, spec.Base, err)
261			}
262			opened, err := rt.Open(ctx, spec.RepoPath, label)
263			if err != nil {
264				app.warnf("could not open a runtime session: %v", err)
265			} else {
266				result.Opened = opened
267			}
268
269		case task.ModeWorktree:
270			m := &wt.Manager{Cfg: app.Cfg, Runtime: rt, Log: log}
271			created, err := m.Create(ctx, wt.CreateRequest{
272				RepoPath: spec.RepoPath, RepoName: spec.RepoName,
273				Branch: spec.Branch, Base: spec.Base, Category: spec.Category,
274				Path: spec.WorktreePath, Label: label,
275				NoProvision: spec.NoProvision, Focus: spec.Focus,
276			})
277			if err != nil {
278				return nil, err
279			}
280			t.WorktreePath, result.Opened, result.Worktree = created.Path, created.Runtime, created
281		}
282
283		setTaskRuntime(t, rt, result.Opened)
284		if replaceDoneRevision != "" {
285			err = app.Tasks.ReplaceDone(t, replaceDoneRevision)
286		} else {
287			err = app.Tasks.Save(t)
288		}
289		if err != nil {
290			return nil, err
291		}
292		annotate(app, rt, t)
293		return result, nil
294	}

13	var localFileDependencyComponents = map[string]bool{
14		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "vendor": true,
15		"__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "target": true, ".terraform": true,
16		"dist": true, "build": true, ".next": true,

19	// ValidateLocalFilePattern validates the deliberately small cross-platform
20	// grammar accepted by [local_files]. Literal path components use portable slash
21	// paths; '*' and '?' match within one component and a component equal to '**'
22	// matches zero or more components. Character classes, escaping, volumes, and
23	// platform-specific separators are intentionally unsupported.
24	func ValidateLocalFilePattern(value string) error {
25		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
26			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is required and must be trimmed")
27		}
28		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
29			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is not valid UTF-8")
30		}
31		if len(value) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes {
32			return fmt.Errorf("pattern is %d bytes; maximum is %d", len(value), safefile.CompiledMaxPathBytes)
33		}
34		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
35			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must use '/' separators")
36		}
37		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasSuffix(value, "/") || strings.Contains(value, "//") {
38			return fmt.Errorf("pattern must be a clean repository-relative slash path")
39		}
40		if strings.ContainsAny(value, "[]{}") {
41			return fmt.Errorf("pattern supports only '*', '?' and whole-component '**' wildcards")
42		}
43		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
44		if len(components) > safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth {
45			return fmt.Errorf("pattern has %d components; maximum is %d", len(components), safefile.CompiledMaxPathDepth)
46		}
47		for _, component := range components {
48			if localFileDependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)] {
49				return fmt.Errorf("pattern enters dependency directory %q", component)
50			}
51			if component == "**" {
52				continue
53			}
54			if strings.Contains(component, "**") {
55				return fmt.Errorf("'**' must occupy a complete path component")
56			}
57			placeholder := strings.NewReplacer("*", "x", "?", "x").Replace(component)
58			if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(placeholder, safefile.CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
59				return fmt.Errorf("component %q: %w", component, err)
60			}
61			for _, r := range component {
62				if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
63					return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a control character", component)
64				}
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}
69

277			return errors.New("plan response has an invalid checkout identity")
278		}
279		if len(r.Files) != len(request.Files) {
280			return errors.New("plan response file count does not match request")
281		}
282		for index, file := range r.Files {
283			spec := request.Files[index]
284			if file.Path != spec.Path || file.Size != spec.Size || file.Mode != spec.Mode || !file.State.validPlan() {
285				return fmt.Errorf("plan response metadata for %q does not match request", spec.Path)
286			}
287			switch file.Action {
288			case actionCurrent:
289				if file.State != StateCurrent || file.TargetSHA256 != spec.SHA256 || file.TargetMode != spec.Mode {
290					return fmt.Errorf("plan response current observation for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
291				}
292			case actionCreate:
293				if file.State != StateReady || file.TargetSHA256 != "" || file.TargetMode != "" {
294					return fmt.Errorf("plan response create observation for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
295				}
296			case actionReplace:
297				if !request.Replace || file.State != StateReady || !validDigest(file.TargetSHA256) || !validFileMode(file.TargetMode) {
298					return fmt.Errorf("plan response replace observation for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
299				}
300			case "":
301				if file.State == StateReady || file.State == StateCurrent {
302					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q omits a required action", spec.Path)
303				}
304				if file.TargetSHA256 != "" && !validDigest(file.TargetSHA256) {
305					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an invalid target digest", spec.Path)
306				}
307				if file.TargetMode != "" && !validFileMode(file.TargetMode) {
308					return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an invalid target mode", spec.Path)
309				}
310			default:
311				return fmt.Errorf("plan response for %q has an unknown action", spec.Path)
312			}
313		}
314		if !validDigest(r.PlanDigest) || r.PlanDigest != planDigest(request, r) {
315			return errors.New("plan response digest does not match")
316		}
317		return nil
318	}
319
320	type Payload struct {
321		Path    string `json:"path"`
322		Content string `json:"content_base64"`
323	}
324
325	type ApplyEnvelope struct {
326		SchemaVersion   int          `json:"schema_version"`
327		ProtocolVersion int          `json:"protocol_version"`
328		Request         PlanRequest  `json:"request"`
329		Plan            PlanResponse `json:"plan"`
330		RetainForEvict  bool         `json:"retain_for_evict"`
331		Payloads        []Payload    `json:"payloads"`
332	}
333
334	type ApplyResponse struct {
335		SchemaVersion   int          `json:"schema_version"`
336		ProtocolVersion int          `json:"protocol_version"`
337		RequestID       string       `json:"request_id"`
338		PlanDigest      string       `json:"plan_digest"`
339		Files           []PublicFile `json:"files"`
340	}
341
342	func (r ApplyResponse) PublicReport() Report {
343		return Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Files: append([]PublicFile(nil), r.Files...)}
344	}
345
346	func (r ApplyResponse) Validate(request PlanRequest, plan PlanResponse) error {
347		if r.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || r.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion ||
348			r.RequestID != request.RequestID || r.PlanDigest != plan.PlanDigest || len(r.Files) != len(request.Files) {
349			return errors.New("apply response binding does not match plan")
350		}
351		for index, file := range r.Files {
352			spec := request.Files[index]
353			if file.Path != spec.Path || file.Size != spec.Size || file.Mode != spec.Mode || !file.State.validResult() {
354				return fmt.Errorf("apply response metadata for %q does not match plan", spec.Path)
355			}
356			expected := StateCurrent
357			switch plan.Files[index].Action {
358			case actionCreate:
359				expected = StateCreated
360			case actionReplace:
361				expected = StateReplaced
362			case actionCurrent:
363			default:
364				return fmt.Errorf("apply response action for %q is invalid", spec.Path)
365			}
366			if file.State != expected {
367				return fmt.Errorf("apply response state for %q does not match plan", spec.Path)
368			}
369		}
370		return nil
371	}
372
373	func manifestDigest(request PlanRequest) string {
374		payload := struct {
375			Domain    string           `json:"domain"`
376			RequestID string           `json:"request_id"`
377			Binding   Binding          `json:"binding"`
378			Limits    fleet.FileLimits `json:"limits"`
379			Replace   bool             `json:"replace"`
380			Files     []FileSpec       `json:"files"`
381		}{"dev-local-files-manifest-v1", request.RequestID, request.Binding, request.Limits, request.Replace, request.Files}
382		return digestJSON(payload)
383	}
384
385	func planDigest(request PlanRequest, response PlanResponse) string {
386		files := append([]PlanFile(nil), response.Files...)
387		payload := struct {
388			Domain         string     `json:"domain"`
389			ManifestDigest string     `json:"manifest_digest"`
390			TargetMachine  string     `json:"target_machine_id"`
391			TargetCheckout string     `json:"target_checkout_id"`
392			Files          []PlanFile `json:"files"`
393		}{"dev-local-files-plan-v1", request.ManifestDigest, response.TargetMachine, response.TargetCheckout, files}
394		return digestJSON(payload)
395	}
396
397	func digestJSON(value any) string {
398		data, _ := json.Marshal(value)
399		digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
400		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
401	}
402
403	func digestBytes(value []byte) string {
404		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
405		return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
406	}
407
408	func validDigest(value string) bool {
409		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != len("sha256:")+sha256.Size*2 {
410			return false
411		}
412		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"))
413		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size && value == strings.ToLower(value)
414	}
415
416	func validOID(value string) bool {
417		if len(value) != 40 && len(value) != 64 || value != strings.ToLower(value) {
418			return false
419		}
420		_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
421		return err == nil
422	}
423
424	func validFileMode(value string) bool {
425		if len(value) != 4 {
426			return false
427		}
428		mode, err := strconv.ParseUint(value, 8, 12)
429		return err == nil && mode <= 0o777
430	}
431
432	func validateText(name, value string) error {
433		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
434			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
435		}
436		for _, r := range value {
437			if unicode.IsControl(r) {
438				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
439			}
440		}
441		return nil
442	}
443
444	func sortedPublic(files []PublicFile) []PublicFile {
445		result := append([]PublicFile(nil), files...)
446		sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].Path < result[j].Path })
447		return result
448	}

1	package localfiles

3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6
7		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/fleet"
8	)
9
10	var (
11		ErrNoRemoteDev     = errors.New("target does not provide a compatible dev protocol")
12		ErrUnreachable     = errors.New("target host is unreachable")
13		ErrRemoteTimeout   = errors.New("target protocol timed out")
14		ErrMachinePin      = errors.New("target machine ID does not match the configured host pin")
15		ErrMachineUnpinned = errors.New("mutating local-file apply requires host.machine_id")
16	)
17
18	type Runner interface {
19		RunWithOptions(context.Context, fleet.Host, []string, []byte, fleet.RunOptions) fleet.Result
20	}
21
22	type Client struct{ Runner Runner }
23
24	func (c Client) run(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, args []string, stdin []byte, maxResponse int64) ([]byte, error) {
25		if c.Runner == nil {
26			return nil, errors.New("local-files client has no fleet transport")
27		}
28		// Capability and plan are read-only. Apply is permanently bound to its
29		// request ID and plan digest by the target journal, so an authentication-only
30		// retry cannot duplicate an unbound mutation.
31		result := c.Runner.RunWithOptions(ctx, host, args, stdin, fleet.RunOptions{Retry: fleet.RetryAuthentication})
32		if int64(len(result.Stdout)) > maxResponse {
33			return nil, errors.New("target protocol response exceeded its bound")
34		}
35		if result.ExitCode == 0 && result.CaptureError == "" {
36			return result.Stdout, nil
37		}
38		switch {
39		case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode == 124:
40			return nil, ErrRemoteTimeout
41		case result.ExitCode == 127:
42			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
43		case result.ExitCode == 255:
44			return nil, ErrUnreachable
45		default:
46			return nil, ErrNoRemoteDev
47		}
48	}
49
50	// Identify performs the content-free capability exchange without enforcing the
51	// configured machine pin. It exists for explicit onboarding and diagnostics;
52	// mutating or payload-bearing callers must use Probe.
53	func (c Client) Identify(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
54		request := fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest()
55		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
56		if err != nil {
57			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
58		}
59		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_capability"}, body, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
60		if err != nil {
61			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
62		}
63		var response fleet.CapabilityResponse
64		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes, &response); err != nil {
65			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
66		}
67		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
68			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
69		}
70		return response, nil
71	}
72
73	func (c Client) Probe(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host) (fleet.CapabilityResponse, error) {
74		response, err := c.Identify(ctx, host)
75		if err != nil {
76			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, err
77		}
78		if host.MachineID != "" && host.MachineID != response.MachineID {
79			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
80		}
81		if !response.Supported {
82			return fleet.CapabilityResponse{}, errors.New("target does not support local-file payloads")
83		}
84		return response, nil
85	}
86
87	func (c Client) Plan(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, request PlanRequest) (PlanResponse, error) {
88		if capability.MachineID != request.Binding.TargetMachine {
89			return PlanResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
90		}
91		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
92			return PlanResponse{}, err
93		}
94		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(request, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
95		if err != nil {
96			return PlanResponse{}, err
97		}
98		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-plan"}, body, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
99		if err != nil {
100			return PlanResponse{}, err
101		}
102		var response PlanWireResponse
103		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes, &response); err != nil {
104			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
105		}
106		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
107			return PlanResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
108		}
109		if response.ErrorCode != "" {
110			return PlanResponse{}, &TargetError{Code: response.ErrorCode}
111		}
112		return *response.Plan, nil
113	}
114
115	func (c Client) Apply(ctx context.Context, host fleet.Host, capability fleet.CapabilityResponse, envelope ApplyEnvelope) (ApplyResponse, error) {
116		if host.MachineID == "" {
117			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachineUnpinned
118		}
119		if host.MachineID != capability.MachineID || envelope.Request.Binding.TargetMachine != capability.MachineID {
120			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrMachinePin
121		}
122		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
123			return ApplyResponse{}, err
124		}
125		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(envelope, MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes)
126		if err != nil {
127			return ApplyResponse{}, err
128		}
129		responseBody, err := c.run(ctx, host, []string{"fleet", "_files-apply"}, body, MaxApplyResponseBytes)
130		if err != nil {
131			return ApplyResponse{}, err
132		}
133		var response ApplyResponse
134		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(responseBody, MaxApplyResponseBytes, &response); err != nil {
135			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
136		}
137		if err := response.Validate(envelope.Request, envelope.Plan); err != nil {
138			return ApplyResponse{}, ErrNoRemoteDev
139		}
140		return response, nil
141	}

1	package localfiles
2
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"encoding/base64"

8		"io/fs"

11		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/fleet"
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/safefile"
14		"github.com/google/uuid"
15	)
16
17	var ErrPlanBlocked = errors.New("portable-file plan is blocked")
18
19	type SourceOptions struct {
20		Checkout string
21		Binding  Binding
22		Patterns []Pattern
23		Limits   safefile.Limits
24		Replace  bool
25		// RequestID is a focused-test seam. Production leaves it empty.
26		RequestID string
27	}
28
29	// Source is an exact, content-addressed local manifest. It keeps no file bytes;
30	// BuildEnvelope reopens and rehashes each non-current source after target plan.
31	type Source struct {
32		checkout string
33		request  PlanRequest
34	}
35
36	func (s *Source) Request() PlanRequest { return s.request }
37
38	func PrepareSource(ctx context.Context, options SourceOptions) (*Source, Report, error) {
39		if err := options.Limits.Validate(); err != nil {
40			return nil, Report{}, err
41		}
42		if err := options.Binding.Validate(); err != nil {
43			return nil, Report{}, err
44		}
45		if err := verifySourceBinding(ctx, options.Checkout, options.Binding); err != nil {
46			return nil, Report{}, fmt.Errorf("verify source checkout binding: %w", err)
47		}
48		paths, err := Expand(options.Checkout, options.Patterns, options.Limits)
49		if err != nil {
50			return nil, Report{}, err
51		}
52		if err := pathx.ValidatePortablePathSet(paths, options.Limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
53			return nil, Report{}, err
54		}
55		requestID := options.RequestID
56		if requestID == "" {
57			requestID = uuid.NewString()
58		}
59		request := PlanRequest{
60			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
61			RequestID: requestID, Binding: options.Binding, Limits: limitsToWire(options.Limits),
62			Replace: options.Replace,
63		}
64		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}
65		blocked := false
66		for _, path := range paths {
67			public := PublicFile{Path: path, Mode: "0600", State: StateFailed}
68			observed, observeErr := observePath(ctx, options.Checkout, path, options.Limits, true)
69			if observeErr != nil {
70				public.State = stateForError(observeErr)
71				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
72				blocked = true
73				continue
74			}
75			if !observed.exists {
76				public.State = StateMissing
77				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
78				blocked = true
79				continue
80			}
81			public.Size = observed.info.Size()
82			if observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0 {
83				public.Mode = "0700"
84			}
85			if eligibilityErr := proveGitEligibility(ctx, options.Checkout, path); eligibilityErr != nil {
86				public.State = stateForError(eligibilityErr)
87				report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
88				blocked = true
89				continue
90			}
91			public.State = StateReady
92			report.Files = append(report.Files, public)
93			request.Files = append(request.Files, FileSpec{
94				Path: path, Size: observed.info.Size(), Mode: public.Mode, SHA256: observed.digest,
95			})
96		}
97		report.Files = sortedPublic(report.Files)
98		if blocked {
99			return nil, report, ErrPlanBlocked
100		}
101		sort.Slice(request.Files, func(i, j int) bool { return request.Files[i].Path < request.Files[j].Path })
102		request.ManifestDigest = manifestDigest(request)
103		if err := request.Validate(); err != nil {
104			return nil, report, err
105		}
106		return &Source{checkout: options.Checkout, request: request}, report, nil
107	}
108
109	// BuildEnvelope performs the source-side apply revalidation and includes bytes
110	// only for target actions that create or explicitly replace a file.
111	func (s *Source) BuildEnvelope(ctx context.Context, plan PlanResponse, retainForEvict bool) (ApplyEnvelope, error) {
112		if s == nil {
113			return ApplyEnvelope{}, errors.New("build local-files envelope from nil source")
114		}
115		if err := verifySourceBinding(ctx, s.checkout, s.request.Binding); err != nil {
116			return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source checkout changed after planning: %w", err)
117		}
118		if err := plan.Validate(s.request); err != nil {
119			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
120		}
121		envelope := ApplyEnvelope{
122			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
123			Request: s.request, Plan: plan, RetainForEvict: retainForEvict,
124		}
125		for index, planned := range plan.Files {
126			if planned.Action == actionCurrent {
127				continue
128			}
129			if planned.Action != actionCreate && planned.Action != actionReplace {
130				return ApplyEnvelope{}, ErrPlanBlocked
131			}
132			spec := s.request.Files[index]
133			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
134				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
135			}
136			observed, err := observePath(ctx, s.checkout, spec.Path, s.request.SafeLimits(), true)
137			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 ||
138				(observed.info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 != 0) != spec.executable() {
139				return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
140			}
141			envelope.Payloads = append(envelope.Payloads, Payload{
142				Path: spec.Path, Content: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(observed.data),
143			})
144		}
145		if err := verifySourceBinding(ctx, s.checkout, s.request.Binding); err != nil {
146			return ApplyEnvelope{}, fmt.Errorf("source checkout changed while building payload: %w", err)
147		}
148		if err := envelope.Validate(); err != nil {
149			return ApplyEnvelope{}, err
150		}
151		return envelope, nil
152	}
153
154	func (e ApplyEnvelope) Validate() error {
155		if e.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || e.ProtocolVersion != fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion {
156			return errors.New("unsupported local-files apply protocol")
157		}
158		if err := e.Request.Validate(); err != nil {
159			return err
160		}
161		if err := e.Plan.Validate(e.Request); err != nil {
162			return err
163		}
164		expected := map[string]FileSpec{}
165		for index, planned := range e.Plan.Files {
166			if planned.Action == actionCreate || planned.Action == actionReplace {
167				expected[e.Request.Files[index].Path] = e.Request.Files[index]
168			}
169		}
170		if len(e.Payloads) != len(expected) {
171			return errors.New("apply payload count does not match target actions")
172		}
173		seen := map[string]bool{}
174		var total int64
175		for index, payload := range e.Payloads {
176			if index > 0 && e.Payloads[index-1].Path >= payload.Path {
177				return errors.New("apply payload paths must be unique and sorted")
178			}
179			spec, ok := expected[payload.Path]
180			if !ok || seen[payload.Path] {
181				return fmt.Errorf("unexpected apply payload for %q", payload.Path)
182			}
183			seen[payload.Path] = true
184			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
185			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
186				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q is not canonical base64", payload.Path)
187			}
188			if int64(len(decoded)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(decoded) != spec.SHA256 {
189				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q does not match its manifest", payload.Path)
190			}
191			if int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes || int64(len(decoded)) > e.Request.SafeLimits().MaxTotalBytes-total {
192				return fmt.Errorf("payload for %q exceeds negotiated limits", payload.Path)
193			}
194			total += int64(len(decoded))
195		}
196		return nil
197	}
198
199	func stateForError(err error) State {
200		switch {
201		case errors.Is(err, ErrUnsafe), errors.Is(err, safefile.ErrUnsafeType), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrNotPortable), errors.Is(err, pathx.ErrPathCollision):
202			return StateBlockedUnsafe
203		case errors.Is(err, ErrIneligible):
204			return StateBlockedIneligible
205		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
206			return StateMissing
207		default:
208			return StateFailed
209		}
210	}
211
212	func limitsToWire(limits safefile.Limits) fleet.FileLimits {
213		return fleet.FileLimits{
214			MaxFiles: limits.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: limits.MaxFileBytes,
215			MaxTotalBytes: limits.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: limits.MaxPathBytes,
216			MaxComponentBytes: limits.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: limits.MaxPathDepth,
217		}
218	}
219
220	// NegotiateLimits takes the lower value for every policy field and validates
221	// both sides against this binary's compiled ceilings.
222	func NegotiateLimits(local safefile.Limits, remote fleet.FileLimits) (safefile.Limits, error) {
223		if err := local.Validate(); err != nil {
224			return safefile.Limits{}, err
225		}
226		remoteLimits := safefile.Limits{
227			MaxFiles: remote.MaxFiles, MaxFileBytes: remote.MaxFileBytes,
228			MaxTotalBytes: remote.MaxTotalBytes, MaxPathBytes: remote.MaxPathBytes,
229			MaxComponentBytes: remote.MaxComponentBytes, MaxPathDepth: remote.MaxPathDepth,
230		}
231		if err := remoteLimits.Validate(); err != nil {
232			return safefile.Limits{}, err
233		}
234		result := safefile.Limits{
235			MaxFiles:          min(local.MaxFiles, remoteLimits.MaxFiles),
236			MaxFileBytes:      min(local.MaxFileBytes, remoteLimits.MaxFileBytes),
237			MaxTotalBytes:     min(local.MaxTotalBytes, remoteLimits.MaxTotalBytes),
238			MaxPathBytes:      min(local.MaxPathBytes, remoteLimits.MaxPathBytes),
239			MaxComponentBytes: min(local.MaxComponentBytes, remoteLimits.MaxComponentBytes),
240			MaxPathDepth:      min(local.MaxPathDepth, remoteLimits.MaxPathDepth),
241		}
242		return result, result.Validate()
243	}

5		"fmt"
6		"io/fs"
7		"os"
8		"path/filepath"
9		"sort"
10		"strings"
11
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/projectconfig"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/safefile"
14	)
15
16	const maxWalkEntries = 200_000
17
18	var dependencyComponents = map[string]struct{}{
19		"node_modules": {}, ".venv": {}, "venv": {}, "vendor": {},
20		"__pycache__": {}, ".tox": {}, "target": {}, ".terraform": {},
21		"dist": {}, "build": {}, ".next": {},
22	}
23
24	// Expand resolves validated project and --file patterns locally into a sorted,
25	// duplicate-free list of exact slash paths. It never follows links or descends
26	// into Git metadata, nested repositories, submodules, or dependency trees.
27	func Expand(root string, patterns []Pattern, limits safefile.Limits) ([]string, error) {
28		if err := limits.Validate(); err != nil {
29			return nil, err
30		}
31		if len(patterns) == 0 {
32			return nil, errors.New("no local-file patterns were configured or passed with --file")
33		}
34		for _, pattern := range patterns {
35			if err := projectconfig.ValidateLocalFilePattern(pattern.Value); err != nil {
36				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s: %w", patternSource(pattern), err)
37			}
38			for _, component := range strings.Split(pattern.Value, "/") {
39				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
40					return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s enters dependency directory %q", patternSource(pattern), component)
41				}
42			}
43		}
44		rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(root)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect source checkout: %w", err)
47		}
48		if !rootInfo.IsDir() || rootInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
49			return nil, errors.New("source checkout is not a held regular directory")
50		}
51
52		matches := map[string]struct{}{}
53		matchedPatterns := make([]bool, len(patterns))
54		visited := 0
55		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(filename string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
56			if walkErr != nil {
57				return walkErr
58			}
59			if filename == root {
60				return nil
61			}
62			visited++
63			if visited > maxWalkEntries {
64				return fmt.Errorf("source checkout exceeds %d entries while expanding local-file patterns", maxWalkEntries)
65			}
66			relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, filename)
67			if err != nil {
68				return err
69			}
70			slash := filepath.ToSlash(relative)
71			components := strings.Split(slash, "/")
72			base := strings.ToLower(components[len(components)-1])
73			if entry.IsDir() {
74				if base == ".git" {
75					return filepath.SkipDir
76				}
77				if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[base]; blocked {
78					for _, pattern := range patterns {
79						if matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
80							return fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern enters dependency directory %q", slash)
81						}
82					}
83					return filepath.SkipDir
84				}
85				nested, err := nestedRepositoryBoundary(filename)
86				if err != nil {
87					return fmt.Errorf("inspect nested repository boundary %s: %w", slash, err)
88				}
89				if nested {
90					return filepath.SkipDir
91				}
92			}
93			matched := false
94			for index, pattern := range patterns {
95				if !entry.IsDir() && matchPattern(pattern.Value, slash) {
96					matchedPatterns[index] = true
97					matched = true
98				}
99			}
100			if matched {
101				matches[slash] = struct{}{}
102			}
103			if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 && entry.IsDir() {
104				return filepath.SkipDir
105			}
106			return nil
107		})
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111		for index, matched := range matchedPatterns {
112			if !matched {
113				return nil, fmt.Errorf("local-file pattern from %s matched no source path", patternSource(patterns[index]))
114			}
115		}
116		paths := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
117		for path := range matches {
118			paths = append(paths, path)
119		}
120		sort.Strings(paths)
121		if len(paths) > limits.MaxFiles {
122			return nil, fmt.Errorf("patterns expanded to %d paths; maximum is %d", len(paths), limits.MaxFiles)
123		}
124		return paths, nil
125	}
126
127	func nestedRepositoryBoundary(path string) (bool, error) {
128		if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
129			return true, nil
130		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
131			return false, err
132		}
133		// Bare repositories have no .git entry. Their required top-level skeleton
134		// is still a repository boundary and may contain credentials, hooks, refs,
135		// or private objects that must never match a portable-file glob.
136		for _, marker := range []string{"HEAD", "objects", "refs"} {
137			if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, marker)); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
138				return false, nil
139			} else if err != nil {
140				return false, err
141			}
142		}
143		return true, nil
144	}
145
146	func patternSource(pattern Pattern) string {
147		if strings.TrimSpace(pattern.Source) == "" {
148			return "explicit input"
149		}
150		return pattern.Source
151	}
152
153	func matchPattern(pattern, candidate string) bool {
154		patternParts := strings.Split(pattern, "/")
155		candidateParts := strings.Split(candidate, "/")
156		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
157		memo := map[key]bool{}
158		seen := map[key]bool{}
159		var match func(int, int) bool
160		match = func(patternIndex, candidateIndex int) bool {
161			state := key{patternIndex, candidateIndex}
162			if seen[state] {
163				return memo[state]
164			}
165			seen[state] = true
166			var result bool
167			switch {
168			case patternIndex == len(patternParts):
169				result = candidateIndex == len(candidateParts)
170			case patternParts[patternIndex] == "**":
171				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex) ||
172					candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && match(patternIndex, candidateIndex+1)
173			case candidateIndex < len(candidateParts) && matchComponent(patternParts[patternIndex], candidateParts[candidateIndex]):
174				result = match(patternIndex+1, candidateIndex+1)
175			}
176			memo[state] = result
177			return result
178		}
179		return match(0, 0)
180	}
181
182	func matchComponent(pattern, candidate string) bool {
183		p, c := []rune(pattern), []rune(candidate)
184		type key struct{ pattern, candidate int }
185		memo := map[key]bool{}
186		seen := map[key]bool{}
187		var match func(int, int) bool
188		match = func(pi, ci int) bool {
189			state := key{pi, ci}
190			if seen[state] {
191				return memo[state]
192			}
193			seen[state] = true
194			var result bool
195			switch {
196			case pi == len(p):
197				result = ci == len(c)
198			case p[pi] == '*':
199				result = match(pi+1, ci) || ci < len(c) && match(pi, ci+1)
200			case ci < len(c) && (p[pi] == '?' || p[pi] == c[ci]):
201				result = match(pi+1, ci+1)
202			}
203			memo[state] = result
204			return result
205		}
206		return match(0, 0)
207	}
208
209	func hasDependencyComponent(path string) bool {
210		for _, component := range strings.Split(path, "/") {
211			if _, blocked := dependencyComponents[strings.ToLower(component)]; blocked {
212				return true
213			}
214		}
215		return false
216	}
217

13	// FetchRemoteIdentity resolves the one normalized fetch identity used to bind a
14	// portable-file operation. Push URLs are intentionally excluded because they
15	// may name a publication mirror unrelated to the fetched repository.
16	func FetchRemoteIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, branch string) (string, error) {
17		var preferred []string
18		if remote, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "config", "--get", "branch."+branch+".remote"); err == nil && remote != "" && remote != "." {
19			preferred = append(preferred, remote)
20		}
21		preferred = append(preferred, "origin")
22		remotes, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
23		if err != nil {
24			return "", err
25		}
26		preferred = append(preferred, strings.Fields(remotes)...)
27		seenRemote := map[string]bool{}
28		for _, remote := range preferred {
29			if remote == "" || seenRemote[remote] {
30				continue
31			}
32			seenRemote[remote] = true
33			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", remote)
34			if err != nil {
35				continue
36			}
37			identities := map[string]struct{}{}
38			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
39				if identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw); identity != "" {
40					identities[identity] = struct{}{}
41				}
42			}
43			if len(identities) == 1 {
44				for identity := range identities {
45					return identity, nil
46				}
47			}
48		}
49		return "", errors.New("checkout has no unambiguous normalized fetch remote identity")
50	}
51
52	func verifySourceBinding(ctx context.Context, checkout string, binding Binding) error {
53		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
54		if err != nil {
55			return err
56		}
57		if status.Detached || status.Branch != binding.Branch {
58			return fmt.Errorf("source branch changed from %s: %w", binding.Branch, ErrDrift)
59		}
60		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
61		if err != nil {
62			return err
63		}
64		if head != binding.HeadOID {
65			return fmt.Errorf("source HEAD changed from %s: %w", binding.HeadOID, ErrDrift)
66		}
67		identity, err := FetchRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, binding.Branch)
68		if err != nil {
69			return err
70		}
71		if identity != binding.RemoteIdentity {
72			return fmt.Errorf("source fetch identity changed: %w", ErrDrift)
73		}
74		return nil
75	}

1	package localfiles

3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"

8		"os/exec"
9		"strings"
10
11		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/safefile"
14	)
15
16	var (
17		ErrUnsafe     = errors.New("portable file path is unsafe")
18		ErrIneligible = errors.New("portable file is not untracked and ignored")
19		ErrDrift      = errors.New("portable file checkout state changed")
20	)
21
22	type observation struct {
23		exists bool
24		info   fs.FileInfo
25		data   []byte
26		digest string
27	}
28
29	func observePath(ctx context.Context, checkout, slashPath string, limits safefile.Limits, read bool) (observation, error) {
30		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, limits.PathLimits()); err != nil {
31			return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("path %q: %w: %w", slashPath, err, ErrUnsafe)
32		}
33		if hasDependencyComponent(slashPath) {
34			return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("path %q enters a dependency directory: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe)
35		}
36		held, err := openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath, false)
37		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
38			return observation{exists: false}, nil
39		}
40		if err != nil {
41			return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("open path %q: %w: %w", slashPath, err, ErrUnsafe)
42		}
43		finish := func(result observation, operationErr error) (observation, error) {
44			closeErr := held.close()
45			if operationErr != nil {
46				return observation{}, errors.Join(operationErr, closeErr)
47			}
48			if closeErr != nil {
49				return observation{}, fmt.Errorf("verify held path %q: %w", slashPath, closeErr)
50			}
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		name := pathBase(slashPath)
54		info, err := held.parent.Lstat(name)
55		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
56			return finish(observation{exists: false}, nil)
57		}
58		if err != nil {
59			return finish(observation{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect path %q: %w", slashPath, err))
60		}
61		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
62			return finish(observation{}, fmt.Errorf("path %q is not a regular file: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe))
63		}
64		result := observation{exists: true, info: info}
65		if read {
66			data, stable, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, held.parent, name, info, limits.MaxFileBytes)
67			if err != nil {
68				return finish(observation{}, fmt.Errorf("read path %q: %w", slashPath, err))
69			}
70			result.info, result.data, result.digest = stable, data, digestBytes(data)
71		}
72		return finish(result, nil)
73	}
74
75	func proveGitEligibility(ctx context.Context, checkout, slashPath string) error {
76		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
77			return fmt.Errorf("path %q: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe)
78		}
79		literal := ":(literal)" + slashPath
80		tracked, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "ls-files", "-z", "--", literal)
81		if err != nil {
82			return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git tracking for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
83		}
84		if tracked != "" {
85			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is tracked: %w", slashPath, ErrIneligible)
86		}
87		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
88		for index := range components {
89			prefix := strings.Join(components[:index+1], "/")
90			staged, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z", "--", ":(literal)"+prefix)
91			if err != nil {
92				return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git mode for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
93			}
94			for _, record := range strings.Split(staged, "\x00") {
95				if strings.HasPrefix(record, "160000 ") {
96					return fmt.Errorf("path %q crosses a submodule: %w", slashPath, ErrUnsafe)
97				}
98			}
99		}
100		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "check-ignore", "--no-index", "--quiet", "--", slashPath)
101		if err == nil {
102			return nil
103		}
104		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
105		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 {
106			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is not ignored on this host: %w", slashPath, ErrIneligible)
107		}
108		return fmt.Errorf("inspect Git ignore status for %q: %w", slashPath, err)
109	}

110	func (s *Service) resolveTarget(ctx context.Context, binding Binding) (targetCheckout, error) {
111		if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
112			return targetCheckout{}, err
113		}
114		options := repo.DefaultOptions()
115		if s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth > 0 {
116			options.MaxDepth = s.Config.Bootstrap.MaxDepth
117		}
118		repositories, err := repo.Discover(ctx, s.Config.DiscoveryRoots(), options)
119		if err != nil {
120			return targetCheckout{}, err
121		}
122		type candidate struct {
123			path      string
124			commonDir string
125		}
126		var candidates []candidate
127		for _, repository := range repositories {
128			if repository.Bare || !repository.HasGit {
129				continue
130			}
131			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
132			if err != nil {
133				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect discovered target repository: %w", err)
134			}
135			matched, err := checkoutHasIdentity(ctx, gitRepo.Root, binding.RemoteIdentity)
136			if err != nil {
137				return targetCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect target repository fetch identities: %w", err)
138			}
139			if !matched {
140				continue
141			}
142			candidates = append(candidates, candidate{path: gitRepo.Root, commonDir: gitRepo.GitCommonDir})
143		}
144		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return candidates[i].commonDir < candidates[j].commonDir })
145		switch len(candidates) {
146		case 0:
147			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAbsent}
148		case 1:
149		default:
150			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetAmbiguous}
151		}
152		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidates[0].path, binding.Branch)
153		if err != nil {
154			return targetCheckout{}, err
155		}
156		if !checkedOut || worktree.Bare || worktree.Prunable {
157			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetFetchedOnly}
158		}
159		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
160		if err != nil {
161			return targetCheckout{}, err
162		}
163		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
164		if err != nil {
165			return targetCheckout{}, err
166		}
167		if status.Detached || status.Branch != binding.Branch || head != binding.HeadOID || worktree.Head != binding.HeadOID {
168			return targetCheckout{}, &TargetError{Code: TargetStale}
169		}
170		checkout := targetCheckout{
171			root: worktree.Path, commonDir: candidates[0].commonDir,
172			identity: binding.RemoteIdentity, branch: binding.Branch, head: head,
173		}
174		checkout.id = digestJSON(struct {
175			Domain    string `json:"domain"`
176			CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
177			Root      string `json:"root"`
178			Branch    string `json:"branch"`
179			Head      string `json:"head"`
180		}{"dev-local-files-checkout-v1", checkout.commonDir, checkout.root, checkout.branch, checkout.head})
181		return checkout, nil
182	}

184	func checkoutHasIdentity(ctx context.Context, checkout, wanted string) (bool, error) {
185		names, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote")
186		if err != nil {
187			return false, err
188		}
189		for _, name := range strings.Fields(names) {
190			// Repository identity is established from fetch URLs. A push-only match
191			// can name a different mirror or publication target and must not authorize
192			// writing local files into an otherwise unrelated clone.
193			urls, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "remote", "get-url", "--all", name)
194			if err != nil {
195				continue
196			}
197			for _, raw := range strings.Split(urls, "\n") {
198				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == wanted {
199					return true, nil
200				}
201			}
202		}
203		return false, nil
204	}

237			RequestID: request.RequestID, ManifestDigest: request.ManifestDigest,

239		}
240		for _, spec := range request.Files {
241			planned := PlanFile{PublicFile: spec.public(StateFailed)}
242			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
243				planned.State = stateForError(err)
244				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
245				continue
246			}
247			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, request.SafeLimits(), true)
248			if err != nil {
249				planned.State = stateForError(err)
250				response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
251				continue
252			}
253			targetMode := ""
254			if observed.exists {
255				targetMode = fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm())
256			}
257			switch {
258			case !observed.exists:
259				planned.State, planned.Action = StateReady, actionCreate
260			case observed.digest == spec.SHA256 && targetMode == spec.Mode:
261				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateCurrent, actionCurrent, observed.digest, targetMode
262			case request.Replace:
263				planned.State, planned.Action, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateReady, actionReplace, observed.digest, targetMode
264			default:
265				planned.State, planned.TargetSHA256, planned.TargetMode = StateBlockedConflict, observed.digest, targetMode
266			}
267			response.Files = append(response.Files, planned)
268		}
269		response.PlanDigest = planDigest(request, response)
270		if err := response.Validate(request); err != nil {
271			return PlanResponse{}, err
272		}
273		return response, nil

43			return ApplyResponse{}, err

55			lease.BranchKey(lease.GitCommonDirIdentity(checkout.commonDir), envelope.Request.Binding.Branch),
