66	func (s *Service) applyUnderLease(ctx context.Context, envelope ApplyEnvelope, expected targetCheckout) (ApplyResponse, error) {
67		checkout, err := s.resolveTarget(ctx, envelope.Request.Binding)
68		if err != nil {
69			return ApplyResponse{}, err
70		}
71		if checkout.commonDir != expected.commonDir || checkout.id != expected.id {
72			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("target checkout changed while acquiring operation lease")
73		}
74		if checkout.id != envelope.Plan.TargetCheckout {
75			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("target checkout changed after planning")
76		}
77		if err := s.validateNegotiatedLimits(envelope.Request); err != nil {
78			return ApplyResponse{}, err
79		}
80
81		store, exists, err := openOperationStore(s.StoreRoot, envelope.Request.RequestID)
82		if err != nil {
83			return ApplyResponse{}, err
84		}
85		var prior journal
86		if exists {
87			prior, err = store.loadJournal()
88			if err != nil {
89				return ApplyResponse{}, err
90			}
91			if prior.PlanDigest != envelope.Plan.PlanDigest || prior.ManifestDigest != envelope.Request.ManifestDigest ||
92				prior.RetainForEvict != envelope.RetainForEvict {
93				return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("local-files request ID is already bound to another apply")
94			}
95			if prior.Phase == phaseCompleted {
96				return s.verifyCompleted(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, prior)
97			}
98			if prior.Phase == phaseApplying || prior.Phase == phaseReconcile {
99				if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &prior); err != nil {
100					prior.Phase = phaseReconcile
101					_ = store.writeJournal(prior)
102					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("prior local-files apply requires reconciliation")
103				}
104				prior.Phase = phaseRolledBack
105				if err := store.writeJournal(prior); err != nil {
106					return ApplyResponse{}, err
107				}
108			}
109			if prior.Phase == phaseRolledBack {
110				if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
111					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("prior rolled-back local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
112				}
113			}
114		}
115
116		files, err := preflightApply(ctx, checkout.root, envelope)
117		if err != nil {
118			return ApplyResponse{}, err
119		}
120		value := journal{
121			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, RequestID: envelope.Request.RequestID,
122			PlanDigest: envelope.Plan.PlanDigest, ManifestDigest: envelope.Request.ManifestDigest,
123			RetainForEvict: envelope.RetainForEvict, Phase: phaseStaged,
124		}
125		for _, file := range files {
126			entry := journalFile{Path: file.spec.Path, Size: file.spec.Size, Mode: file.spec.Mode, Action: file.planned.Action, State: file.planned.State}

137			}
138			if err := store.ensureOperation(); err != nil {

141			if err := s.fault("after-store-create", ""); err != nil {

146		// A crash from this point is a resumable staged journal, never an opaque
147		// request-ID directory that permanently poisons retries.

151		if err := s.fault("after-journal", ""); err != nil {

153		}
154		if err := store.ensurePayloadLayout(); err != nil {
155			return ApplyResponse{}, err
156		}
157		if err := store.writeManifest(envelope); err != nil {

205			err = errors.Join(err, closeErr)
206			if err != nil {
207				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
208			}
209			// In-process rollback may use this provenance immediately. The durable
210			// journal is intentionally written after the fault seam; a real crash in
211			// that window leaves Published=false and later recovery must preserve any
212			// path whose ownership cannot be proven.
213			value.Files[index].Published = true
214			if file.planned.Action == actionCreate {
215				value.Files[index].State = StateCreated
216			} else {
217				value.Files[index].State = StateReplaced
218			}
219			if err := s.fault("after-publish", file.spec.Path); err != nil {
220				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
221			}
222			if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
223				return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
224			}
225		}
226		if err := s.fault("before-final-verify", ""); err != nil {
227			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
228		}
229		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
230			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
231		}
232		if err := s.fault("before-complete", ""); err != nil {
233			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
234		}
235		value.Phase = phaseCompleted
236		if err := store.writeJournal(value); err != nil {
237			return ApplyResponse{}, s.failAndRollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, &value, err)
238		}
239		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(envelope.RetainForEvict); err != nil {
240			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("local-files apply completed but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
241		}
242		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
243	}

245	func (s *Service) validateNegotiatedLimits(request PlanRequest) error {
246		host := s.Config.LocalFiles.Limits()
247		negotiated, err := NegotiateLimits(host, request.Limits)
248		if err != nil || negotiated != request.SafeLimits() {
249			return errors.New("apply limits do not match target policy")
250		}
251		return nil

254	func preflightApply(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope) ([]preflightFile, error) {
255		payloads := map[string][]byte{}
256		for _, payload := range envelope.Payloads {
257			decoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(payload.Content)
258			if err != nil || base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(decoded) != payload.Content {
259				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode canonical payload for %q", payload.Path)
260			}
261			payloads[payload.Path] = decoded
262		}
263		files := make([]preflightFile, len(envelope.Request.Files))
264		for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
265			planned := envelope.Plan.Files[index]
266			if planned.Action == "" {
267				return nil, ErrPlanBlocked
268			}
269			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
270				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed eligibility: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
271			}
272			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
273			if err != nil {
274				return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
275			}
276			file := preflightFile{spec: spec, planned: planned, before: observed}
277			switch planned.Action {
278			case actionCurrent:
279				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
280					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q is no longer current: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
281				}
282				file.content = observed.data
283			case actionCreate:
284				if observed.exists {
285					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q appeared after planning: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
286				}
287				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
288			case actionReplace:
289				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != planned.TargetSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != planned.TargetMode {
290					return nil, fmt.Errorf("target path %q changed before replacement: %w", spec.Path, ErrDrift)
291				}
292				file.content = payloads[spec.Path]
293			default:
294				return nil, errors.New("invalid local-files target action")
295			}
296			if int64(len(file.content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(file.content) != spec.SHA256 {
297				return nil, fmt.Errorf("content for %q no longer matches the plan", spec.Path)
298			}
299			files[index] = file
300		}
301		return files, nil
302	}
303
304	func (s *Service) failAndRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal, cause error) error {
305		value.Phase = phaseReconcile
306		_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
307		if err := s.rollback(ctx, checkout, envelope, store, value); err != nil {
308			value.Phase = phaseReconcile
309			_ = store.writeJournal(*value)
310			return errors.New("local-files apply failed and requires reconciliation")
311		}
312		value.Phase = phaseRolledBack
313		for index := range value.Files {
314			if value.Files[index].Action != actionCurrent {
315				value.Files[index].State = StateRolledBack
316				value.Files[index].Published = false
317			}
318		}
319		if err := store.writeJournal(*value); err != nil {
320			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but journal finalization failed")
321		}
322		if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
323			return errors.New("local-files apply rolled back but private staging cleanup is incomplete")
324		}
325		return fmt.Errorf("local-files apply failed and was rolled back: %w", cause)
326	}
327
328	func (s *Service) rollback(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value *journal) error {
329		for index := len(value.Files) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
330			entry := &value.Files[index]
331			if entry.Action == actionCurrent {
332				continue
333			}
334			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
335			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path); err != nil {
336				return err
337			}
338			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout.root, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
339			if err != nil {
340				return err
341			}
342			switch entry.Action {
343			case actionCreate:
344				if !entry.Published {
345					if observed.exists {
346						return errors.New("unproven target appeared before create rollback")
347					}
348					continue
349				}
350				if !observed.exists {
351					continue
352				}
353				if observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || observedFileMode(observed) != spec.Mode {
354					return errors.New("created target changed before rollback")
355				}
356				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
357				if err != nil {
358					return err
359				}
360				err = parent.parent.Remove(pathBase(spec.Path))
361				err = errors.Join(err, syncHeldRoot(parent.parent), parent.close())
362				if err != nil {
363					return err
364				}
365			case actionReplace:
366				oldState := observed.exists && observed.digest == entry.OldSHA256 && observedFileMode(observed) == entry.OldMode
367				if !entry.Published {
368					if oldState {
369						continue
370					}
371					return errors.New("replacement publication cannot be proven during rollback")
372				}
373				if oldState {
374					continue
375				}
376				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || observedFileMode(observed) != spec.Mode {
377					return errors.New("replacement target changed before rollback")
378				}
379				oldContent, err := store.readBlob(index, true, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
380				if err != nil || digestBytes(oldContent) != entry.OldSHA256 {
381					return errors.New("replacement rollback blob is unavailable")
382				}
383				parent, err := openHeldParent(checkout.root, spec.Path, false)
384				if err != nil {
385					return err
386				}
387				current, err := parent.parent.Lstat(pathBase(spec.Path))
388				oldMode, modeErr := strconv.ParseUint(entry.OldMode, 8, 12)
389				err = errors.Join(err, modeErr)
390				if err == nil {
391					_, err = safefile.AtomicReplace(ctx, parent.parent, pathBase(spec.Path), current, oldContent, fs.FileMode(oldMode))
392				}
393				err = errors.Join(err, parent.close())
394				if err != nil {
395					return err
396				}
397			}
398		}
399		// Empty parent directories are intentionally retained. A path alone cannot
400		// prove that a directory still has the identity created by this operation;
401		// deleting it after a crash could remove another process's replacement.
402		return verifyRollback(ctx, checkout.root, envelope, *value)
403	}
404
405	func verifyRollback(ctx context.Context, checkout string, envelope ApplyEnvelope, value journal) error {
406		for index, entry := range value.Files {
407			spec := envelope.Request.Files[index]
408			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, envelope.Request.SafeLimits(), true)
409			if err != nil {
410				return err
411			}
412			switch entry.Action {
413			case actionCurrent:
414				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != envelope.Plan.Files[index].TargetMode {
415					return errors.New("current target changed during rollback")
416				}
417			case actionCreate:
418				if observed.exists {
419					return errors.New("created target remains after rollback")
420				}
421			case actionReplace:
422				if !observed.exists || observed.digest != entry.OldSHA256 || fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != entry.OldMode {
423					return errors.New("replacement target was not restored")
424				}
425			}
426		}
427		return nil
428	}
429
430	func (s *Service) verifyCompleted(ctx context.Context, checkout targetCheckout, envelope ApplyEnvelope, store *operationStore, value journal) (ApplyResponse, error) {
431		if err := verifyAllCurrent(ctx, checkout.root, envelope.Request.Files, envelope.Request.SafeLimits()); err != nil {
432			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files journal no longer matches the checkout")
433		}
434		if value.RetainForEvict {
435			for index, spec := range envelope.Request.Files {
436				content, err := store.readBlob(index, false, envelope.Request.SafeLimits().MaxFileBytes)
437				if err != nil || int64(len(content)) != spec.Size || digestBytes(content) != spec.SHA256 {
438					return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("retained local-files recovery blob is unavailable")
439				}
440			}
441		} else if err := store.cleanupPayloads(false); err != nil {
442			return ApplyResponse{}, errors.New("completed local-files staging cleanup is incomplete")
443		}
444		return responseFromJournal(value), nil
445	}

447	func observedFileMode(observed observation) string {
448		if !observed.exists || observed.info == nil {
449			return ""
450		}
451		return fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm())
452	}

454	func verifyAllCurrent(ctx context.Context, checkout string, specs []FileSpec, limits safefile.Limits) error {
455		for _, spec := range specs {
456			if err := proveGitEligibility(ctx, checkout, spec.Path); err != nil {
457				return err
458			}
459			observed, err := observePath(ctx, checkout, spec.Path, limits, true)
460			if err != nil || !observed.exists || observed.digest != spec.SHA256 || observed.info.Size() != spec.Size {
461				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q failed post-write verification", spec.Path)
462			}
463			if fmt.Sprintf("%04o", observed.info.Mode().Perm()) != spec.Mode {
464				return fmt.Errorf("target path %q permissions do not match the manifest", spec.Path)
465			}
466		}
467		return nil
468	}

470	func responseFromJournal(value journal) ApplyResponse {
471		files := make([]PublicFile, len(value.Files))
472		for index, entry := range value.Files {
473			files[index] = PublicFile{Path: entry.Path, Size: entry.Size, Mode: entry.Mode, State: entry.State}
474		}
475		return ApplyResponse{
476			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
477			RequestID: value.RequestID, PlanDigest: value.PlanDigest, Files: files,
478		}
479	}

488	type heldParent struct {
489		checkout string
490		rootInfo fs.FileInfo
491		root     *os.Root
492		parent   *os.Root
493		roots    []*os.Root
494		edges    []heldEdge
495	}
496
497	type heldEdge struct {
498		parent *os.Root
499		name   string
500		info   fs.FileInfo
501	}
502
503	func openHeldParent(checkout, slashPath string, create bool) (*heldParent, error) {
504		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableSlashPath(slashPath, safefile.DefaultLimits().PathLimits()); err != nil {
505			return nil, err
506		}
507		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(checkout)
508		if err != nil {
509			return nil, err
510		}
511		held := &heldParent{checkout: checkout, rootInfo: rootInfo, root: root, parent: root, roots: []*os.Root{root}}
512		components := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
513		prefix := make([]string, 0, len(components)-1)
514		for _, component := range components[:len(components)-1] {
515			prefix = append(prefix, component)
516			child, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
517			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && create {
518				if err := held.parent.Mkdir(component, 0o700); err != nil {
519					_ = held.close()
520					return nil, err
521				}
522				child, info, err = safefile.OpenChildRoot(held.parent, component)
523			}
524			if err != nil {
525				_ = held.close()
526				return nil, err
527			}
528			if _, err := child.Lstat(".git"); err == nil {
529				_ = child.Close()
530				_ = held.close()
531				return nil, ErrUnsafe
532			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
533				_ = child.Close()
534				_ = held.close()
535				return nil, err
536			}
537			held.edges = append(held.edges, heldEdge{parent: held.parent, name: component, info: info})
538			held.roots = append(held.roots, child)
539			held.parent = child
540		}
541		return held, nil
542	}
543
544	func (h *heldParent) close() error {
545		if h == nil {
546			return nil
547		}
548		var result error
549		for index := len(h.edges) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
550			result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyChildRoot(h.edges[index].parent, h.edges[index].name, h.edges[index].info))
551		}
552		result = errors.Join(result, safefile.VerifyRoot(h.checkout, h.rootInfo))
553		for index := len(h.roots) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
554			result = errors.Join(result, h.roots[index].Close())
555		}
556		h.roots = nil
557		return result
558	}
559
560	func syncHeldRoot(root *os.Root) error {
561		file, err := root.Open(".")
562		if err != nil {
563			return err
564		}
565		defer file.Close()
566		return file.Sync()
567	}
568
569	func pathBase(slashPath string) string {
570		parts := strings.Split(slashPath, "/")
571		return parts[len(parts)-1]
572	}

62	func newOperationStore(root, requestID string) (*operationStore, error) {

67		if err != nil {

77	func openOperationStore(root, requestID string) (*operationStore, bool, error) {
78		if root == "" {
79			root = defaultStoreRoot()
80		}
81		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(root)
82		if err != nil {
83			return nil, false, err
84		}
85		store := &operationStore{root: canonical, requestID: requestID, operation: filepath.Join(canonical, requestID)}
86		info, err := os.Lstat(store.operation)
87		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
88			return store, false, nil
89		}
90		if err != nil {
91			return nil, false, err
92		}
93		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
94			return nil, false, errors.New("local-files operation store is not a private directory")
95		}
96		if journalInfo, journalErr := os.Lstat(store.journalPath()); errors.Is(journalErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
97			// Older interrupted builds could stage a manifest and blobs before their
98			// first durable journal write. Publication always followed that write, so a
99			// private store with no journal is safe to discard only after its complete
100			// operation-owned layout has been verified.
101			if err := store.discardUninitialized(info); err != nil {
102				return nil, false, err
103			}
104			return store, false, nil
105		} else if journalErr != nil {
106			return nil, false, journalErr
107		} else if !journalInfo.Mode().IsRegular() || journalInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || journalInfo.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
108			return nil, false, errors.New("local-files journal is not a private regular file")
109		}
110		return store, true, nil
111	}

126	func (s *operationStore) discardUninitialized(expected fs.FileInfo) error {
127		walkErr := filepath.WalkDir(s.operation, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
128			if walkErr != nil {
129				return walkErr
130			}
131			if path == s.operation {
132				return nil
133			}
134			relative, err := filepath.Rel(s.operation, path)
135			if err != nil {
136				return err
137			}
138			relative = filepath.ToSlash(relative)
139			info, err := entry.Info()
140			if err != nil {
141				return err
142			}
143			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
144				return errors.New("unjournaled local-files store contains an unsafe entry")
145			}
146			parts := strings.Split(relative, "/")
147			switch {
148			case len(parts) == 1 && parts[0] == "manifest.json" && info.Mode().IsRegular():
149				return nil
150			case len(parts) == 1 && (parts[0] == "blobs" || parts[0] == "rollback") && info.IsDir():
151				return nil
152			case len(parts) == 1 && strings.HasPrefix(parts[0], ".dev-safefile-") && info.Mode().IsRegular():
153				return nil
154			case len(parts) == 2 && (parts[0] == "blobs" || parts[0] == "rollback") && info.Mode().IsRegular():
155				if isOperationBlobName(parts[1]) || strings.HasPrefix(parts[1], ".dev-safefile-") {
156					return nil
157				}
158			}
159			return errors.New("unjournaled local-files store contains an unknown entry")
160		})
161		if walkErr != nil {
162			return fmt.Errorf("inspect unjournaled local-files store: %w", walkErr)
163		}
164		current, err := os.Lstat(s.operation)
165		if err != nil || !os.SameFile(expected, current) || !current.IsDir() || current.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
166			return errors.New("unjournaled local-files store changed during inspection")
167		}
168		if err := os.RemoveAll(s.operation); err != nil {
169			return fmt.Errorf("remove unjournaled local-files store: %w", err)
170		}
171		return syncDirectoryPath(s.root)
172	}

197	func (s *operationStore) loadJournal() (journal, error) {
198		data, err := readPrivateFile(s.journalPath(), 2<<20)
199		if err != nil {
200			return journal{}, err
201		}
202		var value journal
203		if err := fleet.UnmarshalStrict(data, 2<<20, &value); err != nil {
204			return journal{}, fmt.Errorf("decode local-files journal: %w", err)
205		}
206		if err := validateJournal(value); err != nil {
207			return journal{}, err
208		}
209		return value, nil

212	func validateJournal(value journal) error {
213		if value.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion || value.RequestID == "" || !validDigest(value.PlanDigest) || !validDigest(value.ManifestDigest) {
214			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal binding")
215		}
216		switch value.Phase {
217		case phaseStaged, phaseApplying, phaseCompleted, phaseRolledBack, phaseReconcile:
218		default:
219			return errors.New("invalid local-files journal phase")
220		}
221		for index, file := range value.Files {
222			if index > 0 && value.Files[index-1].Path >= file.Path {
223				return errors.New("local-files journal paths are not sorted")
224			}
225			switch file.Action {
226			case actionCurrent, actionCreate, actionReplace:
227			default:
228				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid action")
229			}
230			if !file.State.validResult() {
231				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid result state")
232			}
233			if file.Size < 0 || file.Mode != "0600" && file.Mode != "0700" {
234				return errors.New("local-files journal has invalid public metadata")
235			}
236			if file.Action == actionReplace && (!validDigest(file.OldSHA256) || !validFileMode(file.OldMode)) {
237				return errors.New("local-files replacement journal lacks rollback binding")
238			}
239		}
240		return nil
241	}

243	func (s *operationStore) writeJournal(value journal) error {
244		if err := validateJournal(value); err != nil {
245			return err
246		}
247		return writePrivateJSON(s.journalPath(), value)
248	}

263	func (s *operationStore) writeBlob(filename string, content []byte, executable bool) error {
264		if existing, err := readPrivateFile(filename, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes); err == nil {
265			if digestBytes(existing) != digestBytes(content) {
266				return errors.New("existing local-files blob does not match operation")
267			}
268			return nil
269		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
270			return err
271		}
272		parentPath := filepath.Dir(filename)
273		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(parentPath)
274		if err != nil {
275			return err
276		}
277		defer root.Close()
278		name := filepath.Base(filename)
279		if _, err := safefile.CreatePrivateNoClobber(context.Background(), root, name, content, executable); err != nil {
280			return err
281		}
282		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(parentPath, rootInfo); err != nil {
283			return err
284		}
285		readback, err := readPrivateFile(filename, safefile.CompiledMaxFileBytes)
286		if err != nil || digestBytes(readback) != digestBytes(content) {
287			return errors.New("local-files blob failed post-write verification")
288		}
289		return nil
290	}

325	func ensurePrivateDirectory(path string) error {
326		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
327			return err
328		}
329		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
330		if err != nil {
331			return err
332		}
333		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
334			return errors.New("local-files state path is not a directory")
335		}
336		if err := os.Chmod(path, 0o700); err != nil {
337			return err
338		}

340		if err != nil || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
341			return errors.New("local-files state directory is not owner-private")
342		}
343		return nil
344	}

346	func writePrivateJSON(path string, value any) error {
347		parentPath := filepath.Dir(path)
348		if err := ensurePrivateDirectory(parentPath); err != nil {
349			return err
350		}
351		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
352		if err != nil {
353			return err
354		}
355		data = append(data, '\n')
356		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(parentPath)
357		if err != nil {
358			return err
359		}
360		defer root.Close()
361		name := filepath.Base(path)
362		current, statErr := root.Lstat(name)
363		switch {
364		case errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist):
365			_, err = safefile.CreatePrivateNoClobber(context.Background(), root, name, data, false)
366		case statErr != nil:
367			return statErr
368		case !current.Mode().IsRegular() || current.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || current.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0:
369			return errors.New("local-files state file is not a private regular file")
370		default:
371			_, err = safefile.AtomicReplacePrivate(context.Background(), root, name, current, data, false)
372		}
373		if err != nil {
374			return err
375		}
376		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(parentPath, rootInfo); err != nil {
377			return err
378		}
379		readback, err := readPrivateFile(path, 2<<20)
380		if err != nil || string(readback) != string(data) {
381			return errors.New("local-files state file failed post-write verification")
382		}
383		return nil
384	}

386	func readPrivateFile(path string, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
387		parentPath := filepath.Dir(path)
388		root, rootInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(parentPath)
389		if err != nil {
390			return nil, err
391		}
392		defer root.Close()
393		name := filepath.Base(path)
394		info, err := root.Lstat(name)
395		if err != nil {
396			return nil, err
397		}
398		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
399			return nil, errors.New("local-files state file is not a private regular file")
400		}
401		data, _, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(context.Background(), root, name, info, maxBytes)
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, err
404		}
405		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(parentPath, rootInfo); err != nil {
406			return nil, err
407		}
408		return data, nil
409	}

183	func (a *Authority) finishClaim(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token Token, claimKind string, terminal TombstoneKind) (uint64, error) {
184		if a == nil {
185			return 0, errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
186		}
187		if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
188			return 0, err
189		}
190		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
191		if err != nil {
192			return 0, err
193		}
194		var advanced uint64
195		err = a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func([]Key) error {
196			return a.updateState(ctx, func(state *Snapshot) (bool, error) {
197				canonical := claimed
198				if terminal != "" {
199					if epoch, found, err := matchingTerminal(*state, canonical, token, terminal); err != nil {
200						return false, err
201					} else if found {
202						advanced = epoch
203						return false, nil
204					}
205				}
206				if err := validateClaimKeySet(*state, canonical, token, claimKind); err != nil {
207					return false, err
208				}
209				for _, key := range canonical {
210					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
211					if record == nil {
212						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s has no active %s: %w", key.subject(), claimKind, ErrEpochMismatch)
213					}
214					var claim *Claim
215					if claimKind == "reservation" {
216						claim = record.Reservation
217					} else {
218						claim = record.Fence
219					}
220					if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
221						return false, fmt.Errorf("%s does not hold operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
222					}
223				}
224				epoch, err := allocateEpoch(state)
225				if err != nil {
226					return false, err
227				}
228				advanced = epoch
229				now := canonicalTime(a.clock())
230				for _, key := range canonical {
231					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
232					record.Epoch = epoch
233					if claimKind == "reservation" {
234						record.Reservation = nil
235					} else {
236						record.Fence = nil
237					}
238					if terminal != "" {
239						record.Tombstones = append(record.Tombstones, Tombstone{Kind: terminal, Token: token, AdvancedEpoch: epoch, CreatedAt: now})
240					}
241				}
242				return true, nil
243			})
244		})
245		return advanced, err
246	}

248	// WithMutation runs an ordinary mutator only when no requested key is reserved
249	// or fenced. A branch key automatically includes its repository ancestor so a
250	// repository fence covers every branch. The locks remain held until operation
251	// returns.
252	func (a *Authority) WithMutation(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func() error) error {

256	// WithGuard permits the exact owner of an active reservation or fence to work
257	// while rejecting stale, returned, and mismatched tokens. A nil token is an
258	// ordinary mutation guard and includes repository ancestors. It is
259	// non-reentrant: operation must not reacquire an overlapping key.
260	func (a *Authority) WithGuard(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, token *Token, operation func() error) error {
261		if a == nil {
262			return errors.New("use nil operation lease authority")
263		}
264		if operation == nil {
265			return errors.New("operation lease guard requires an operation")
266		}
267		claimed, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool)
272		if token != nil {
273			if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
274				return err
275			}
276		} else {
277			for _, key := range claimed {
278				if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
279					repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
280				}
281			}
282		}
283		return a.withKeyLocks(ctx, mutationKeys(claimed), func(locked []Key) error {
284			checked := locked
285			if token != nil {
286				// Repository ancestors participate in draining but are not part of a
287				// branch-scoped token's ownership claim.
288				checked = claimed
289			}
290			if err := a.readState(ctx, func(state Snapshot) error {
291				matched := 0
292				for _, key := range checked {
293					record := findRecord(state.Records, key)
294					if record == nil {
295						if token != nil {
296							return fmt.Errorf("%s has no operation %s epoch %d: %w", key.subject(), token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
297						}
298						continue
299					}
300					if token != nil && hasTerminal(*record, *token) {
301						return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrReturned)
302					}
303					claim, kind := activeClaim(*record)
304					if claim == nil {
305						if token != nil {
306							return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is no longer active on %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, key.subject(), ErrEpochMismatch)
307						}
308						continue
309					}
310					if token == nil || !claim.Token.matches(*token) {
311						return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
312					}
313					matched++
314				}
315				if token != nil && matched != len(checked) {
316					return fmt.Errorf("operation %s does not own the complete key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrEpochMismatch)
317				}
318				if token != nil {
319					if err := validateGuardKeySet(state, claimed, *token); err != nil {
320						return err
321					}
322				}
323				if token == nil {
324					for _, record := range state.Records {
325						if record.Key.Scope != ScopeBranch || !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
326							continue
327						}
328						if claim, kind := activeClaim(record); claim != nil {
329							return &BlockedError{Key: record.Key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
330						}
331					}
332				}
333				return nil
334			}); err != nil {
335				return err
336			}
337			return operation()
338		})
339	}

341	// Inspect returns records for the requested keys while holding those key locks.
342	// Untouched keys are represented with Epoch zero and are never persisted.
343	func (a *Authority) Inspect(ctx context.Context, keys []Key) ([]Record, error) {
344		if a == nil {

374	func (a *Authority) withKeyLocks(ctx context.Context, keys []Key, operation func([]Key) error) error {
375		canonical, err := CanonicalKeys(keys)
376		if err != nil {
377			return err
378		}
379		if ctx == nil {
380			ctx = context.Background()
381		}
382		if err := a.ensureLayout(); err != nil {
383			return err
384		}
385		var acquire func(int) error
386		acquire = func(index int) error {
387			if index == len(canonical) {
388				return operation(canonical)

390			directory := a.keyLockDir(canonical[index])
391			if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
392				return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation key lock: %w", err)
393			}
394			return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease key", func() error { return acquire(index + 1) })
395		}
396		return acquire(0)
397	}
398
399	func (a *Authority) updateState(ctx context.Context, mutate func(*Snapshot) (bool, error)) error {
400		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
401			state, err := a.loadState()
402			if err != nil {
403				return err
404			}
405			changed, err := mutate(&state)
406			if err != nil || !changed {
407				return err
408			}
409			return a.writeState(state)
410		})
411	}
412
413	func (a *Authority) readState(ctx context.Context, read func(Snapshot) error) error {
414		return a.withStateLock(ctx, func() error {
415			state, err := a.loadState()
416			if err != nil {
417				return err
418			}
419			return read(state)
420		})
421	}

423	func (a *Authority) withStateLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) error {
424		directory := filepath.Join(a.root, ".authority")
425		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
426			return fmt.Errorf("prepare operation authority lock: %w", err)
427		}
428		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, directory, "operation lease authority", operation)
429	}

432		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {

446	func (a *Authority) statePath() string { return filepath.Join(a.root, stateFilename) }

448	func (a *Authority) loadState() (Snapshot, error) {
449		path := a.statePath()
450		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
451		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
452			return Snapshot{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion}, nil
453		}
454		if err != nil {
455			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state: %w", err)
456		}
457		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
458			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s is not a regular file", path)
459		}
460		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
461		if err != nil {
462			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease state permissions: %w", err)
463		}
464		if !private {
465			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("operation lease state %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
466		}
467		file, err := os.Open(path)
468		if err != nil {
469			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("open operation lease state: %w", err)
470		}
471		defer file.Close()
472		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
473		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
474		var state Snapshot
475		if err := decoder.Decode(&state); err != nil {
476			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state: %w", err)
477		}
478		var extra any
479		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
480			if err == nil {
481				return Snapshot{}, errors.New("decode operation lease state: multiple JSON values")
482			}
483			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("decode operation lease state trailing data: %w", err)
484		}
485		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
486			return Snapshot{}, err
487		}
488		canonical := canonicalSnapshot(state)
489		encodedState, _ := json.Marshal(state)
490		encodedCanonical, _ := json.Marshal(canonical)
491		if string(encodedState) != string(encodedCanonical) {
492			return Snapshot{}, errors.New("operation lease state is not in canonical order")
493		}
494		return state, nil
495	}
496
497	func (a *Authority) writeState(state Snapshot) error {
498		state = canonicalSnapshot(state)
499		if err := validateSnapshot(state); err != nil {
500			return err
501		}
502		if err := ensurePrivateDir(a.root); err != nil {
503			return err
504		}
505		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(a.root, ".authority-*.tmp")
506		if err != nil {
507			return fmt.Errorf("create operation lease state temp file: %w", err)
508		}
509		name := temporary.Name()
510		defer os.Remove(name)
511		if err := setPrivateMode(name, 0o600); err != nil {
512			_ = temporary.Close()
513			return err
514		}
515		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)
516		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
517		if err := encoder.Encode(state); err != nil {
518			_ = temporary.Close()
519			return fmt.Errorf("encode operation lease state: %w", err)
520		}
521		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
522			_ = temporary.Close()
523			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease state: %w", err)
524		}
525		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
526			return fmt.Errorf("close operation lease state: %w", err)
527		}
528		if err := replaceFile(name, a.statePath()); err != nil {
529			return fmt.Errorf("publish operation lease state: %w", err)
530		}
531		if err := syncDirectory(a.root); err != nil {
532			return fmt.Errorf("sync operation lease directory: %w", err)
533		}
534		return nil
535	}

537	func validateSnapshot(state Snapshot) error {
538		if state.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
539			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease schema_version %d: want %d", state.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
540		}
541		bindings := make(map[string]string, len(state.Bindings))
542		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
543			if err := binding.Validate(); err != nil {
544				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease binding: %w", err)
545			}
546			if _, exists := bindings[binding.OperationID]; exists {
547				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease repeats binding %s", binding.OperationID)
548			}
549			bindings[binding.OperationID] = binding.Digest
550		}
551		type activeSignature struct {
552			Token     Token
553			MachineID string
554			Kind      string
555		}
556		activeOperations := make(map[string]activeSignature)
557		terminalOperations := make(map[string]Tombstone)
558		seenKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(state.Records))
559		var maxRecordEpoch uint64
560		for _, record := range state.Records {
561			if err := record.Key.Validate(); err != nil {
562				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease record: %w", err)
563			}
564			canonicalKey := record.Key.canonical()
565			if _, exists := seenKeys[canonicalKey]; exists {
566				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease state repeats key %s", record.Key.subject())
567			}
568			seenKeys[canonicalKey] = struct{}{}
569			if record.Epoch == 0 || record.Epoch > state.LastEpoch {
570				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has invalid epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), record.Epoch)
571			}
572			if record.Epoch > maxRecordEpoch {
573				maxRecordEpoch = record.Epoch
574			}
575			if record.Reservation != nil && record.Fence != nil {
576				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has both reservation and fence", record.Key.subject())
577			}
578			for _, named := range []struct {
579				name  string
580				claim *Claim
581			}{{"reservation", record.Reservation}, {"fence", record.Fence}} {
582				if named.claim == nil {
583					continue
584				}
585				if err := named.claim.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
586					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s: %w", named.name, record.Key.subject(), err)
587				}
588				if digest, exists := bindings[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != named.claim.Token.Digest {
589					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no matching permanent binding", named.name, record.Key.subject())
590				}
591				if named.claim.Token.Epoch != record.Epoch {
592					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has epoch %d, record has %d", named.name, record.Key.subject(), named.claim.Token.Epoch, record.Epoch)
593				}
594				if named.claim.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
595					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s on %s has no created_at", named.name, record.Key.subject())
596				}
597				if named.claim.MachineID != "" {
598					if err := machineid.Validate(named.claim.MachineID); err != nil {
599						return err
600					}
601				}
602				signature := activeSignature{Token: named.claim.Token, MachineID: named.claim.MachineID, Kind: named.name}
603				if prior, exists := activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID]; exists {
604					if !prior.Token.matches(signature.Token) || prior.MachineID != signature.MachineID || prior.Kind != signature.Kind {
605						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent active claims", named.claim.Token.OperationID)
606					}
607				} else {
608					activeOperations[named.claim.Token.OperationID] = signature
609				}
610			}
611			seenTombstones := make(map[string]struct{}, len(record.Tombstones))
612			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
613				switch tombstone.Kind {
614				case TombstoneAborted, TombstoneReturned:
615				default:
616					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has unknown tombstone kind %q", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.Kind)
617				}
618				if err := tombstone.Token.Validate(); err != nil {
619					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s: %w", record.Key.subject(), err)
620				}
621				if digest, exists := bindings[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; !exists || digest != tombstone.Token.Digest {
622					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no matching permanent binding", record.Key.subject())
623				}
624				if tombstone.AdvancedEpoch <= tombstone.Token.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > record.Epoch || tombstone.AdvancedEpoch > state.LastEpoch {
625					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has invalid advanced epoch %d", record.Key.subject(), tombstone.AdvancedEpoch)
626				}
627				if tombstone.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
628					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease tombstone on %s has no created_at", record.Key.subject())
629				}
630				if prior, exists := terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID]; exists {
631					if !prior.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || prior.Kind != tombstone.Kind || prior.AdvancedEpoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
632						return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s has inconsistent terminal records", tombstone.Token.OperationID)
633					}
634				} else {
635					terminalOperations[tombstone.Token.OperationID] = tombstone
636				}
637				identity := fmt.Sprintf("%s\x00%s\x00%d", tombstone.Token.OperationID, tombstone.Token.Digest, tombstone.Token.Epoch)
638				if _, exists := seenTombstones[identity]; exists {
639					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s repeats a terminal token", record.Key.subject())
640				}
641				seenTombstones[identity] = struct{}{}
642				if record.Reservation != nil && record.Reservation.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) || record.Fence != nil && record.Fence.Token.matches(tombstone.Token) {
643					return fmt.Errorf("operation lease key %s has a terminal token still active", record.Key.subject())
644				}
645			}
646		}
647		if state.LastEpoch != maxRecordEpoch {
648			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease last_epoch %d does not match latest record epoch %d", state.LastEpoch, maxRecordEpoch)
649		}
650		for operationID := range activeOperations {
651			if _, terminal := terminalOperations[operationID]; terminal {
652				return fmt.Errorf("operation lease %s is both active and terminal", operationID)
653			}
654		}
655		return nil
656	}

658	func canonicalSnapshot(state Snapshot) Snapshot {
659		result := Snapshot{
660			SchemaVersion: state.SchemaVersion,
661			LastEpoch:     state.LastEpoch,
662			Bindings:      append([]Binding(nil), state.Bindings...),
663			Records:       make([]Record, len(state.Records)),
664		}
665		sort.Slice(result.Bindings, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Bindings[i].OperationID < result.Bindings[j].OperationID })
666		for index, record := range state.Records {
667			result.Records[index] = cloneRecord(record)
668			if result.Records[index].Reservation != nil {
669				result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Reservation.CreatedAt)
670			}
671			if result.Records[index].Fence != nil {
672				result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Fence.CreatedAt)
673			}
674			for tombstoneIndex := range result.Records[index].Tombstones {
675				result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt = canonicalTime(result.Records[index].Tombstones[tombstoneIndex].CreatedAt)
676			}
677			sort.Slice(result.Records[index].Tombstones, func(i, j int) bool {
678				left, right := result.Records[index].Tombstones[i], result.Records[index].Tombstones[j]
679				if left.Token.Epoch != right.Token.Epoch {
680					return left.Token.Epoch < right.Token.Epoch
681				}
682				if left.Token.OperationID != right.Token.OperationID {
683					return left.Token.OperationID < right.Token.OperationID
684				}
685				if left.Token.Digest != right.Token.Digest {
686					return left.Token.Digest < right.Token.Digest
687				}
688				return left.Kind < right.Kind
689			})
690		}
691		sort.Slice(result.Records, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Records[i].Key.canonical() < result.Records[j].Key.canonical() })
692		return result
693	}
694
695	func cloneRecord(record Record) Record {
696		result := record
697		if record.Reservation != nil {
698			copy := *record.Reservation
699			result.Reservation = &copy
700		}
701		if record.Fence != nil {
702			copy := *record.Fence
703			result.Fence = &copy
704		}
705		result.Tombstones = append([]Tombstone(nil), record.Tombstones...)
706		return result
707	}
708
709	func findRecord(records []Record, key Key) *Record {
710		canonical := key.canonical()
711		for index := range records {
712			if records[index].Key.canonical() == canonical {
713				return &records[index]
714			}
715		}
716		return nil
717	}
718
719	func ensureRecord(state *Snapshot, key Key) *Record {
720		if record := findRecord(state.Records, key); record != nil {
721			return record
722		}
723		state.Records = append(state.Records, Record{Key: key})
724		return &state.Records[len(state.Records)-1]
725	}

727	func allocateEpoch(state *Snapshot) (uint64, error) {
728		if state.LastEpoch == math.MaxUint64 {
729			return 0, errors.New("operation lease epoch exhausted")
730		}
731		state.LastEpoch++
732		return state.LastEpoch, nil
733	}

735	func activeClaim(record Record) (*Claim, string) {
736		if record.Reservation != nil {
737			return record.Reservation, "reservation"
738		}
739		if record.Fence != nil {
740			return record.Fence, "fence"
741		}
742		return nil, ""
743	}

745	func hasTerminal(record Record, token Token) bool {
746		for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
747			if tombstone.Token.matches(token) {
748				return true
749			}
750		}
751		return false
752	}

754	func ensureBinding(state *Snapshot, request Request) bool {
755		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
756			if binding.OperationID == request.OperationID {
757				return false
758			}
759		}
760		state.Bindings = append(state.Bindings, Binding{OperationID: request.OperationID, Digest: request.Digest})
761		return true
762	}

764	func checkOperationReuse(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
765		for _, binding := range state.Bindings {
766			if binding.OperationID != request.OperationID {
767				continue
768			}
769			if binding.Digest != request.Digest {
770				return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was permanently bound to another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
771			}
772			break
773		}
774		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
775		for _, key := range keys {
776			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
777		}
778		for _, record := range state.Records {
779			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
780				if tombstone.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
781					continue
782				}
783				if tombstone.Token.Digest != request.Digest {
784					return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s was used with another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
785				}
786				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal: %w", request.OperationID, ErrReturned)
787			}
788			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)
789			if claim == nil || claim.Token.OperationID != request.OperationID {
790				continue
791			}
792			if claim.Token.Digest != request.Digest {
793				return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s is active with another digest: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
794			}
795			if _, exists := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !exists {
796				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s is active on a different key set: %w", request.OperationID, ErrConflict)
797			}
798		}
799		return nil
800	}
801
802	func checkHierarchyClaims(state Snapshot, keys []Key, request Request) error {
803		requestedKeys := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
804		requestedRepositories := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
805		repositoryWide := make(map[string]bool, len(keys))
806		for _, key := range keys {
807			requestedKeys[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
808			requestedRepositories[key.Repository] = struct{}{}
809			if key.Scope == ScopeRepository {
810				repositoryWide[key.Repository] = true
811			}
812		}
813		for _, record := range state.Records {
814			claim, kind := activeClaim(record)
815			if claim == nil {
816				continue
817			}
818			if _, requested := requestedKeys[record.Key.canonical()]; requested {
819				continue
820			}
821			if _, sameRepository := requestedRepositories[record.Key.Repository]; !sameRepository {
822				continue
823			}
824			if record.Key.Scope != ScopeRepository && !repositoryWide[record.Key.Repository] {
825				continue
826			}
827			return blockedOrConflict(record.Key, kind, *claim, request)
828		}
829		return nil
830	}
831
832	func blockedOrConflict(key Key, kind string, claim Claim, request Request) error {
833		if claim.Token.OperationID == request.OperationID {
834			return fmt.Errorf("operation id %s conflicts with its active %s: %w", request.OperationID, kind, ErrConflict)
835		}
836		return &BlockedError{Key: key, Kind: kind, OperationID: claim.Token.OperationID}
837	}
838
839	func validateGuardKeySet(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token) error {
840		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
841		for _, key := range keys {
842			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
843		}
844		matched := 0
845		for _, record := range state.Records {
846			claim, _ := activeClaim(record)
847			if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
848				continue
849			}
850			if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
851				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d owns a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
852			}
853			matched++
854		}
855		if matched != len(keys) {
856			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d does not own the exact guard key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
857		}
858		return nil
859	}
860
861	func validateClaimKeySet(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token, claimKind string) error {
862		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
863		for _, key := range keys {
864			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
865		}
866		matched := 0
867		for _, record := range state.Records {
868			var claim *Claim
869			if claimKind == "reservation" {
870				claim = record.Reservation
871			} else {
872				claim = record.Fence
873			}
874			if claim == nil || !claim.Token.matches(token) {
875				continue
876			}
877			if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
878				return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d owns a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
879			}
880			matched++
881		}
882		if matched != len(keys) {
883			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d does not own the exact key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrEpochMismatch)
884		}
885		return nil
886	}

888	func matchingTerminal(state Snapshot, keys []Key, token Token, kind TombstoneKind) (uint64, bool, error) {
889		requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(keys))
890		for _, key := range keys {
891			requested[key.canonical()] = struct{}{}
892		}
893		var epoch uint64
894		matched := 0
895		for _, record := range state.Records {
896			for _, tombstone := range record.Tombstones {
897				if !tombstone.Token.matches(token) {
898					continue
899				}
900				if tombstone.Kind != kind {
901					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d ended as %s: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, tombstone.Kind, ErrReturned)
902				}
903				if _, included := requested[record.Key.canonical()]; !included {
904					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s epoch %d is terminal on a larger key set: %w", token.OperationID, token.Epoch, ErrConflict)
905				}
906				if epoch == 0 {
907					epoch = tombstone.AdvancedEpoch
908				} else if epoch != tombstone.AdvancedEpoch {
909					return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s has inconsistent terminal epochs: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
910				}
911				matched++
912				break
913			}
914		}
915		if matched == 0 {
916			return 0, false, nil
917		}
918		if matched != len(keys) {
919			return 0, false, fmt.Errorf("operation %s is terminal on only part of the key set: %w", token.OperationID, ErrConflict)
920		}
921		return epoch, true, nil
922	}

924	func ensurePrivateDir(path string) error {
925		if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
926			return err
927		}
928		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
929		if err != nil {
930			return err
931		}
932		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
933			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a private directory", path)
934		}
935		if err := setPrivateMode(path, 0o700); err != nil {
936			return err
937		}
938		info, err = os.Lstat(path)
939		if err != nil {
940			return err
941		}
942		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o700)
943		if err != nil {
944			return fmt.Errorf("inspect operation lease directory permissions: %w", err)
945		}
946		if !private {
947			return fmt.Errorf("operation lease directory %s permissions are not private (want 0700 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
948		}
949		return nil
950	}

952	func canonicalTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
953		return value.Round(0).UTC()
954	}

1	// Package lease provides cooperative, durable repository operation fencing.
2	// Its default authority lives in private XDG state, outside repository roots.

5	import (

111	func RepositoryKey(repository string) Key {

113	}

117	}

119	// GitCommonDirIdentity is the host-local canonical lease identity shared by
120	// every remote alias and linked worktree of one clone.
121	func GitCommonDirIdentity(commonDir string) string {
122		if strings.TrimSpace(commonDir) == "" {
123			return ""
124		}
125		return "git-common-dir:" + filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(commonDir))
126	}

128	func (k Key) Validate() error {
129		if err := validateIdentity("repository identity", k.Repository); err != nil {
130			return err
131		}
132		switch k.Scope {
133		case ScopeRepository:
134			if k.Branch != "" {
135				return errors.New("repository lease key must not name a branch")
136			}
137		case ScopeBranch:
138			if err := validateIdentity("branch", k.Branch); err != nil {
139				return err
140			}
141		default:
142			return fmt.Errorf("unknown lease scope %q", k.Scope)
143		}
144		return nil
145	}
146
147	func (k Key) canonical() string {
148		// Length prefixes keep arbitrary valid identities unambiguous.
149		return fmt.Sprintf("%08x:%s:%s:%08x:%s", len(k.Repository), k.Repository, k.Scope, len(k.Branch), k.Branch)
150	}
151
152	func (k Key) subject() string {
153		if k.Scope == ScopeBranch {
154			return k.Repository + " branch " + k.Branch
155		}
156		return k.Repository
157	}
158
159	func (r Request) Validate() error {
160		if !operationIDPattern.MatchString(r.OperationID) {
161			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation id %q", r.OperationID)
162		}
163		if !assessment.ValidFingerprint(r.Digest) {
164			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has invalid digest %q", r.OperationID, r.Digest)
165		}
166		if r.MachineID != "" {
167			if err := machineid.Validate(r.MachineID); err != nil {
168				return err
169			}
170		}
171		return nil
172	}
173
174	func (b Binding) Validate() error {
175		return (Request{OperationID: b.OperationID, Digest: b.Digest}).Validate()
176	}
177
178	func (t Token) Validate() error {
179		if err := (Request{OperationID: t.OperationID, Digest: t.Digest}).Validate(); err != nil {
180			return err
181		}
182		if t.Epoch == 0 {
183			return fmt.Errorf("operation %s has zero lease epoch", t.OperationID)
184		}
185		return nil
186	}
187
188	func (t Token) matches(other Token) bool {
189		return t.OperationID == other.OperationID && t.Digest == other.Digest && t.Epoch == other.Epoch
190	}
191
192	func (t Token) sameOperation(request Request) bool {
193		return t.OperationID == request.OperationID && t.Digest == request.Digest
194	}
195
196	// CanonicalKeys validates, deduplicates, and sorts keys in the one order used
197	// by every multi-key acquisition.
198	func CanonicalKeys(keys []Key) ([]Key, error) {
199		if len(keys) == 0 {
200			return nil, errors.New("operation lease requires at least one key")
201		}
202		unique := make(map[string]Key, len(keys))
203		for _, key := range keys {
204			if err := key.Validate(); err != nil {
205				return nil, err
206			}
207			unique[key.canonical()] = key
208		}
209		canonical := make([]Key, 0, len(unique))
210		for _, key := range unique {
211			canonical = append(canonical, key)
212		}
213		sort.Slice(canonical, func(i, j int) bool { return canonical[i].canonical() < canonical[j].canonical() })
214		return canonical, nil
215	}
216
217	func validateIdentity(name, value string) error {
218		if value == "" || value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
219			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required and must be trimmed", name)
220		}
221		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
222			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
223		}
224		for _, char := range value {
225			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
226				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
227			}
228		}
229		return nil
230	}

19	// setPrivateMode installs a protected DACL. Windows os.FileMode permission
20	// bits only model the read-only attribute and cannot establish privacy.
21	func setPrivateMode(path string, want fs.FileMode) error {
22		inheritance := ""
23		switch want.Perm() {
24		case 0o600:
25		case 0o700:
26			inheritance = "OICI"
27		default:
28			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported private Windows mode %04o", want.Perm())
29		}
30		current, _, err := privateSIDs()
31		if err != nil {
32			return err
33		}
34		ace := func(sid string) string {
35			return fmt.Sprintf("(A;%s;GA;;;%s)", inheritance, sid)
36		}
37		descriptor, err := windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString("D:P" + ace(current) + ace(localSystemSID) + ace(administratorsSID))
38		if err != nil {
39			return fmt.Errorf("build private Windows security descriptor: %w", err)
40		}
41		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
42		if err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("read private Windows DACL: %w", err)
44		}
45		if dacl == nil {
46			return fmt.Errorf("private Windows security descriptor has no DACL")
47		}
48		err = windows.SetNamedSecurityInfo(
49			path,
50			windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT,
51			windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
52			nil,
53			nil,
54			dacl,
55			nil,
56		)
57		runtime.KeepAlive(descriptor)
58		if err != nil {
59			return fmt.Errorf("set private Windows DACL: %w", err)
60		}
61		return nil
62	}
63
64	func privateModeMatches(path string, _ fs.FileMode, _ fs.FileMode) (bool, error) {
65		current, allowed, err := privateSIDs()
66		if err != nil {
67			return false, err
68		}
69		descriptor, err := windows.GetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
70		if err != nil {
71			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner and DACL: %w", err)
72		}
73		owner, _, err := descriptor.Owner()
74		if err != nil {
75			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner: %w", err)
76		}
77		if !privateSIDAllowed(owner, allowed) {
78			return false, nil
79		}
80		control, _, err := descriptor.Control()
81		if err != nil {
82			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows security descriptor control: %w", err)
83		}
84		if control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED == 0 {
85			return false, nil
86		}
87		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
88		if err != nil {
89			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL: %w", err)
90		}
91		if dacl == nil {
92			return false, nil
93		}
94		seenCurrent := false
95		for index := uint16(0); index < dacl.AceCount; index++ {
96			var ace *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
97			if err := windows.GetAce(dacl, uint32(index), &ace); err != nil {
98				return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL entry %d: %w", index, err)
99			}
100			switch ace.Header.AceType {
101			case windows.ACCESS_DENIED_ACE_TYPE:
102				continue
103			case windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE_TYPE:
104			default:
105				return false, nil
106			}
107			sid := (*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&ace.SidStart))
108			value := sid.String()
109			if _, ok := allowed[value]; !ok {
110				return false, nil
111			}
112			if value == current {
113				seenCurrent = true
114			}
115		}
116		return seenCurrent, nil
117	}
118
119	func privateSIDAllowed(sid *windows.SID, allowed map[string]struct{}) bool {
120		if sid == nil {
121			return false
122		}
123		_, ok := allowed[sid.String()]
124		return ok
125	}
126
127	func privateSIDs() (string, map[string]struct{}, error) {
128		user, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
129		if err != nil {
130			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("read current Windows user: %w", err)
131		}
132		current := user.User.Sid.String()
133		if current == "" {
134			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("current Windows user has an invalid SID")
135		}
136		return current, map[string]struct{}{
137			current:           {},
138			localSystemSID:    {},
139			administratorsSID: {},
140		}, nil
141	}

147		}
148		to, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(destination)
149		if err != nil {

151		}
152		return windows.MoveFileEx(from, to, windows.MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING|windows.MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)
153	}

19	// CheckoutOwnership says who is expected to clean up a checkout. Canonical and
20	// dev-owned checkouts are part of dev's durable inventory; external and
21	// ephemeral checkouts are still shown because hiding them would make the WT
22	// count impossible to explain.
23	type CheckoutOwnership string

25	const (

32	// RepoCheckout is one checkout in a repository context. The first checkout is
33	// always the canonical checkout; the rest are linked worktrees in Git order.
34	type RepoCheckout struct {
35		Worktree gitx.Worktree
36		Status   gitx.Status
37		// StatusErr is retained so a prunable or unreadable checkout can remain
38		// visible without pretending its Git state was successfully inspected.
39		StatusErr error
40		// PathErr distinguishes an unreadable checkout path from a checkout which is
41		// conclusively missing. Callers must not turn either case into a clean Git
42		// status.
43		PathErr      error
44		Exists       bool
45		LastActivity time.Time
46		LastCommit   time.Time
47		LastSubject  string
48		Sessions     []runtime.Session
49		Tasks        []*task.Task
50		Ownership    CheckoutOwnership
51	}

53	// Branch returns the named branch, falling back to the live status for the
54	// synthetic canonical checkout.
55	func (c RepoCheckout) Branch() string {
56		if c.Worktree.Branch != "" {
57			return c.Worktree.Branch
58		}
59		return c.Status.Branch
60	}

62	// RepoContext is the complete operational context for one discovered repo.
63	type RepoContext struct {
64		Repo repo.Repo
65		// Checkouts contains the canonical checkout followed by linked worktrees.
66		Checkouts []RepoCheckout
67		// OtherTasks are tracked branches which are not checked out here (for
68		// example cold or branch-only tasks on another branch).
69		OtherTasks []*task.Task
70		Runtime    string
71		// RuntimeErr and TaskErr retain collection failures so a report cannot
72		// mislabel unavailable observations as a closed runtime or an untracked task.
73		RuntimeErr error
74		TaskErr    error
75		// WorktreeCount is kept separately so a failed Git query can still explain
76		// the number shown from the administrative worktrees directory.
77		WorktreeCount int
78		WorktreeErr   error
79		LastActivity  time.Time
80	}

82	// Main returns the canonical checkout.
83	func (c RepoContext) Main() (RepoCheckout, bool) {
84		if len(c.Checkouts) == 0 {
85			return RepoCheckout{}, false
86		}
87		return c.Checkouts[0], true
88	}

90	// Linked returns only linked worktrees.
91	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
92		if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
93			return nil
94		}
95		return c.Checkouts[1:]
96	}

98	// CheckoutIndexForPath returns the most-specific checkout containing path. It
99	// uses the same symlink-aware matching as runtime assignment, so a current
100	// directory under a nested linked worktree never resolves to the canonical
101	// checkout merely because that checkout is its lexical parent.
102	func (c RepoContext) CheckoutIndexForPath(path string) (int, bool) {
103		best, bestLen := -1, -1
104		for index := range c.Checkouts {
105			for _, root := range checkoutRoots(c.Repo, index, c.Checkouts[index]) {
106				if pathContains(root, path) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
107					best, bestLen = index, len(filepath.Clean(root))
108				}
109			}
110		}
111		return best, best >= 0
112	}

114	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
115	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
116	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
117		seen := map[string]bool{}
118		var out []runtime.Session
119		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
120			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
121				key := session.Handle
122				if key == "" {
123					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
124				}
125				if seen[key] {
126					continue
127				}
128				seen[key] = true
129				out = append(out, session)
130			}
131		}
132		return out
133	}

135	// RepoContextOptions controls enrichment that does not affect readiness.
136	type RepoContextOptions struct {
137		IncludeActivity bool
138	}

140	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository with
141	// commit/activity enrichment enabled.
142	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
143		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
144		return CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, r, tasks, sessions, runtimeName, RepoContextOptions{IncludeActivity: true})
145	}
146
147	// CollectRepoContextWithOptions is the configurable form used by the fast
148	// current-directory status path. Repositories with no linked-worktree admin
149	// entries deliberately skip `git worktree list`.
150	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
151		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string, options RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
152
153		out := RepoContext{Repo: r, Runtime: runtimeName}
154		mainExists, mainPathErr := pathIsDir(r.Path)
155		main := RepoCheckout{
156			Worktree: gitx.Worktree{Path: r.Path, Main: true},
157			Exists:   mainExists, PathErr: mainPathErr, Ownership: CheckoutCanonical,
158		}
159		if r.Bare {
160			main.Worktree.Bare = true
161		} else {
162			main.Status, main.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
163			main.Worktree.Branch = main.Status.Branch
164			main.Worktree.Detached = main.Status.Detached
165			if options.IncludeActivity {
166				main.LastActivity, main.LastCommit, main.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, r.Path, main.Status)
167			}
168		}
169		out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, main)
170
171		out.WorktreeCount, out.WorktreeErr = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
172		if out.WorktreeErr == nil && out.WorktreeCount > 0 {
173			worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
174			if err != nil {
175				out.WorktreeErr = err
176			} else {
177				out.WorktreeCount = 0
178				for _, w := range worktrees {
179					if w.Main {
180						continue
181					}
182					exists, pathErr := pathIsDir(w.Path)
183					checkout := RepoCheckout{
184						Worktree: w, Exists: exists, PathErr: pathErr, Ownership: CheckoutExternal,
185					}
186					if IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
187						checkout.Ownership = CheckoutEphemeral
188					}
189					out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
190					out.WorktreeCount++
191				}
192			}
193		}
194		inspectLinkedCheckouts(ctx, &out, options)
195
196		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
197		assignSessions(&out, sessions)
198		for _, checkout := range out.Checkouts {
199			if checkout.LastActivity.After(out.LastActivity) {
200				out.LastActivity = checkout.LastActivity
201			}
202			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
203				if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
204					out.LastActivity = t.Updated
205				}
206			}
207		}
208		for _, t := range out.OtherTasks {
209			if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
210				out.LastActivity = t.Updated
211			}
212		}
213		return out
214	}
215
216	func inspectLinkedCheckouts(ctx context.Context, out *RepoContext, options RepoContextOptions) {
217		if out == nil || len(out.Checkouts) < 2 {
218			return
219		}
220		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, 8)
221		var wait sync.WaitGroup
222		for index := 1; index < len(out.Checkouts); index++ {
223			checkout := &out.Checkouts[index]
224			if !checkout.Exists || checkout.PathErr != nil || checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
225				continue
226			}
227			wait.Add(1)
228			go func(checkout *RepoCheckout) {
229				defer wait.Done()
230				semaphore <- struct{}{}
231				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
232				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
233				if options.IncludeActivity {
234					checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status)
235				}
236			}(checkout)
237		}
238		wait.Wait()
239	}

241	// IsEphemeralWorktree recognises turn-scoped checkouts owned by an agent
242	// harness. They stay visible, but the label prevents an agent from treating
243	// them like durable dev-owned work.
244	func IsEphemeralWorktree(path, branch string) bool {
245		slashPath := filepath.ToSlash(path)
246		return strings.Contains(slashPath, "/.claude/worktrees/") ||
247			strings.HasPrefix(branch, "worktree-")
248	}
249
250	func linkedAdminCount(commonDir string) (int, error) {
251		if commonDir == "" {
252			return 0, nil
253		}
254		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(commonDir, "worktrees"))
255		if err != nil {
256			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
257				return 0, nil
258			}
259			return 0, err
260		}
261		n := 0
262		for _, entry := range entries {
263			if entry.IsDir() {
264				n++
265			}
266		}
267		return n, nil
268	}
269
270	func pathIsDir(path string) (bool, error) {
271		info, err := os.Stat(path)
272		if err != nil {
273			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
274				return false, nil
275			}
276			return false, err
277		}
278		if !info.IsDir() {
279			return false, fmt.Errorf("checkout path is not a directory")
280		}
281		return true, nil
282	}
283
284	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
285		latest := status.LatestChange
286		var commit time.Time
287		var subject string
288		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
289			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
290			if commit.After(latest) {
291				latest = commit
292			}
293			subject = lastSubject
294		}
295		return latest, commit, subject
296	}

298	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
299		for _, t := range tasks {
300			assigned := false
301			if t.WorktreePath != "" {
302				for i := 1; i < len(out.Checkouts); i++ {
303					if samePath(t.WorktreePath, out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path) {
304						out.Checkouts[i].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, t)
305						out.Checkouts[i].Ownership = CheckoutDev
306						assigned = true
307						break
308					}
309				}
310			} else if len(out.Checkouts) > 0 && t.Branch == out.Checkouts[0].Branch() {
311				out.Checkouts[0].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[0].Tasks, t)
312				assigned = true
313			}
314			if !assigned {
315				out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, t)
316			}
317		}
318		for i := range out.Checkouts {
319			sort.SliceStable(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
320				return out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[a].ID < out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[b].ID
321			})
322		}
323		sort.SliceStable(out.OtherTasks, func(i, j int) bool {
324			return out.OtherTasks[i].ID < out.OtherTasks[j].ID
325		})
326	}
