328	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
329	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
330	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
331	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
332		for _, session := range sessions {
333			assigned := map[int]bool{}
334			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
335				best, bestLen := -1, -1
336				for i := range out.Checkouts {
337					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Repo, i, out.Checkouts[i]) {
338						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
339							best, bestLen = i, len(filepath.Clean(root))
340						}
341					}
342				}
343				if best >= 0 {
344					assigned[best] = true
345				}
346			}
347			for i := range assigned {
348				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
349			}
350		}
351	}
352
353	func checkoutRoots(r repo.Repo, index int, checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
354		roots := []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
355		if index == 0 && r.RealPath != "" && !samePath(r.RealPath, r.Path) {
356			roots = append(roots, r.RealPath)
357		}
358		return roots
359	}
360
361	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
362		if root == "" || path == "" {
363			return false
364		}
365		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
366		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
367			return false
368		}
369		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
370	}
371
372	func samePath(a, b string) bool {
373		return a != "" && b != "" && normalizePath(a) == normalizePath(b)
374	}
375
376	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
377	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
378	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
379	// is not sufficient.
380	func normalizePath(path string) string {
381		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
382		cur := clean
383		for {
384			if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
385				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
386				if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
387					return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
388				}
389				return filepath.Clean(real)
390			}
391			parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
392			if parent == cur {
393				return clean
394			}
395			cur = parent
396		}
397	}
398
399	// FormatRepoContext renders the deterministic Markdown used by both the CLI
400	// and the TUI's yy binding. checkoutIndex < 0 means the whole repository.
401	func FormatRepoContext(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
402		var b strings.Builder
403		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
404			checkout := c.Checkouts[checkoutIndex]
405			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev worktree context: %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout))
406			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, false)
407			return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
408		}
409
410		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev repo context: %s\n\n", c.Repo.Display())
411		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Repository: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Display())
412		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Main path: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Path)
413		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Linked worktrees: %d\n", c.WorktreeCount)
414		if c.Runtime != "" && c.Runtime != "none" {
415			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime: `%s`\n", c.Runtime)
416		}
417		if c.WorktreeErr != nil {
418			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Worktree inventory error: %s\n", c.WorktreeErr)
419		}
420		if c.RuntimeErr != nil {
421			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime inventory error: %s\n", c.RuntimeErr)
422		}
423		if c.TaskErr != nil {
424			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Task inventory error: %s\n", c.TaskErr)
425		}
426		b.WriteString("\n## Checkouts\n")
427		for i, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
428			b.WriteString("\n")
429			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, i == 0)
430		}
431		if len(c.OtherTasks) > 0 {
432			b.WriteString("\n## Other tracked tasks\n\n")
433			for _, t := range c.OtherTasks {
434				writeTaskMarkdown(&b, t)
435			}
436		}
437		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
438	}
439
440	func writeCheckoutMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, c RepoContext, checkout RepoCheckout, canonical bool) {
441		label := string(checkout.Ownership)
442		if canonical {
443			label = "canonical"
444		}
445		fmt.Fprintf(b, "### %s — %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout), label)
446		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Path: `%s`\n", checkout.Worktree.Path)
447		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Branch: `%s`\n", displayBranch(checkout))
448		if checkout.Worktree.Bare {
449			b.WriteString("- Git: bare repository\n")
450		} else if checkout.PathErr != nil {
451			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.PathErr)
452		} else if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
453			b.WriteString("- Git: unavailable (checkout path is missing)\n")
454		} else if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
455			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.StatusErr)
456		} else {
457			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: %s", checkout.Status.Summary())
458			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
459				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", checkout.Status.Breakdown())
460			}
461			b.WriteString("\n")
462			if checkout.Status.Upstream != "" {
463				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Upstream: `%s`\n", checkout.Status.Upstream)
464			} else {
465				b.WriteString("- Upstream: not published\n")
466			}
467		}
468		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
469			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)
470			if reason == "" {
471				reason = "no reason recorded"
472			}
473			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: locked — %s\n", reason)
474		}
475		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || checkout.PathErr == nil && !checkout.Exists {
476			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)
477			if reason == "" {
478				reason = "checkout path is missing"
479			}
480			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: prunable — %s\n", reason)
481		}
482		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
483			if c.RuntimeErr != nil {
484				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: unavailable (%s)\n", c.RuntimeErr)
485			} else {
486				b.WriteString("- Runtime: closed\n")
487			}
488		} else {
489			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
490				status := session.AgentStatus
491				if status == "" {
492					status = "unknown"
493				}
494				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: `%s %s` (%s)\n", c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
495				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
496					fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Agent sessions: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
497				}
498			}
499		}
500		if len(checkout.Tasks) == 0 {
501			if c.TaskErr != nil {
502				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: unavailable (%s)\n", c.TaskErr)
503			} else {
504				b.WriteString("- Task: untracked\n")
505			}
506		} else {
507			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
508				writeTaskMarkdown(b, t)
509			}
510		}
511	}
512
513	func writeTaskMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, t *task.Task) {
514		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: `%s` — %s", t.ID, t.State)
515		if t.Next != "" {
516			fmt.Fprintf(b, "; next: %s", t.Next)
517		}
518		b.WriteString("\n")
519		if t.AgentSession != "" {
520			fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Recorded agent: `%s`\n", t.AgentSession)
521		}
522	}
523
524	func displayBranch(checkout RepoCheckout) string {
525		if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
526			return branch
527		}
528		if checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached {
529			return "(detached HEAD)"
530		}
531		return "(unknown branch)"
532	}
533
534	func markdownCodes(values []string) string {
535		quoted := make([]string, 0, len(values))
536		for _, value := range values {
537			quoted = append(quoted, "`"+value+"`")
538		}
539		return strings.Join(quoted, ", ")
540	}
541
542	// FormatSessions renders the ys payload. checkoutIndex < 0 selects the whole
543	// repository; otherwise it selects one checkout.
544	func FormatSessions(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
545		indices := make([]int, 0, len(c.Checkouts))
546		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
547			indices = append(indices, checkoutIndex)
548		} else {
549			for i := range c.Checkouts {
550				indices = append(indices, i)
551			}
552		}
553		var b strings.Builder
554		for _, i := range indices {
555			checkout := c.Checkouts[i]
556			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
557				status := session.AgentStatus
558				if status == "" {
559					status = "unknown"
560				}
561				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s %s` (%s)\n",
562					checkout.Worktree.Path, c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
563				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
564					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - agents: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
565				}
566			}
567		}
568		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
569	}
570
571	// LinkedWorktreePaths returns the yw payload: absolute linked-worktree paths,
572	// one per line. The canonical checkout is intentionally excluded because WT
573	// counts linked worktrees only.
574	func LinkedWorktreePaths(c RepoContext) string {
575		paths := make([]string, 0, len(c.Linked()))
576		for _, checkout := range c.Linked() {
577			paths = append(paths, checkout.Worktree.Path)
578		}
579		return strings.Join(paths, "\n")
580	}

25	func newRepoContextCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
26		var jsonOut, refresh bool
27		cmd := &cobra.Command{
28			Use:   "context [repo]",
29			Short: "Print agent-ready Git, worktree, runtime and task context",
30			Long: `Print a deterministic Markdown handoff or a versioned JSON report for one repository.
31
32	Local Git, task and runtime facts are always collected live. Forge and configured
33	fleet-host observations use their private caches by default and expose provenance,
34	age and collection errors; --refresh may contact forge providers and fleet hosts.
35	With no repository argument, the repository containing the current directory is
36	used, and a linked-worktree current directory remains the selected checkout while
37	the report still covers the whole clone.`,
38			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
39			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
40				ctx := ctxOf()
41				repository, selectedPath, err := resolveRepoContextTarget(ctx, app, args)
42				if err != nil {
43					return err
44				}
45				local := collectLocalRepoContext(ctx, app, repository, selectedPath, true)
46				now := time.Now().UTC()
47				forgeFacts := collectRepoContextForge(ctx, app, refresh, now)
48				fleetFacts := collectRepoContextFleet(ctx, app, refresh)
49				report, err := repocontext.Build(repocontext.BuildInput{
50					GeneratedAt: now, Context: local.Context,
51					SelectedCheckout: local.SelectedCheckout, SelectionErr: local.SelectionErr,
52					Topology: local.Topology, TopologyErr: local.TopologyErr,
53					Runtimes: local.Runtimes, Forge: forgeFacts, Fleet: fleetFacts,
54					Hostname: config.Hostname(),
55				})
56				if err != nil {
57					return err
58				}
59				if jsonOut {
60					encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
61					encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
62					return encoder.Encode(report)
63				}
64				legacy := inventory.FormatRepoContext(local.Context, -1)
65				fmt.Fprint(app.Out, repocontext.FormatMarkdown(report, legacy))
66				return nil
67			},
68		}
69		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit the additive schema-v1 JSON report")
70		cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&refresh, "refresh", false, "refresh external forge and configured fleet observations")
71		return cmd
72	}

74	type localRepoContext struct {
75		Context          inventory.RepoContext
76		SelectedCheckout int
77		SelectionErr     error
78		Topology         gitx.RecoveryTopology
79		TopologyErr      error
80		Runtimes         []repocontext.RuntimeInput
81	}

83	// collectLocalRepoContext is the single CLI collector used by repo context and
84	// status. It executes only local Git/task/runtime probes; includeTopology adds
85	// repository-wide remote/ref facts but never performs fetch or other network I/O.
86	func collectLocalRepoContext(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, selectedPath string, includeTopology bool) localRepoContext {
87		var (
88			tasks    = []*task.Task{}
89			tasksErr error
90		)
91		if app.Tasks == nil {
92			tasksErr = errors.New("task store is unavailable")
93		} else {
94			listed, diagnostics, err := app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
95			if err != nil {
96				tasksErr = err
97			} else {
98				tasks = tasksForRepo(listed, repository)
99				for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
100					tasksErr = errors.Join(tasksErr, diagnostic)
101				}
102			}
103		}
104
105		rt := app.Runtime()
106		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
107		local := localRepoContext{
108			Context: inventory.CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, repository, tasks, sessions, rt.Name(), inventory.RepoContextOptions{
109				IncludeActivity: includeTopology,
110			}),
111			Runtimes: []repocontext.RuntimeInput{{
112				Backend: rt.Name(), Available: rt.Available(), Sessions: sessions, Err: runtimeErr,
113			}},
114			SelectedCheckout: -1,
115		}
116		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
117		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
118		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
119			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
120		} else {
121			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
122		}
123		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
124			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
125		}
126		return local
127	}

129	func resolveRepoContextTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (repo.Repo, string, error) {
130		if len(args) == 1 {
131			resolved, _, err := resolveRepoRef(app, args[0])
132			if err != nil {
133				return repo.Repo{}, "", err
134			}
135			if !resolved.HasGit {
136				return resolved, resolved.Path, nil
137			}
138			discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, resolved.Path)
139			if err != nil {
140				return repo.Repo{}, "", err
141			}
142			selectedPath := discovered.Root
143			if selectedPath == "" {
144				selectedPath = discovered.MainRoot
145			}
146			mainPath := discovered.MainRoot
147			if mainPath == "" {
148				mainPath = selectedPath
149			}
150			name := resolved.Name
151			if name == "" {
152				name = discovered.Name
153			}
154			return repo.Repo{
155				Name: name, Path: mainPath, RealPath: mainPath,
156				GitDir: discovered.GitCommonDir, CommonDir: discovered.GitCommonDir,
157				MainRoot: mainPath, HasGit: true, Bare: discovered.Bare,
158			}, selectedPath, nil
159		}
160		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
161		if err != nil {
162			return repo.Repo{}, "", err
163		}
164		discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
165		if err != nil {
166			return repo.Repo{}, "", fmt.Errorf("%s is not a git repository — pass a repo", config.Contract(cwd))
167		}
168		selectedPath := discovered.Root
169		if selectedPath == "" {
170			selectedPath = discovered.MainRoot
171		}
172		return repo.Repo{
173			Name: discovered.Name, Path: discovered.MainRoot, RealPath: discovered.MainRoot,
174			GitDir: discovered.GitCommonDir, CommonDir: discovered.GitCommonDir,
175			MainRoot: discovered.MainRoot, HasGit: true, Bare: discovered.Bare,
176		}, selectedPath, nil
177	}

179	func collectRepoContextForge(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool, now time.Time) repocontext.ForgeInput {
180		cacheInput := func(cache forge.Cache, collectionErr error) repocontext.ForgeInput {
181			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
182			if forgeCacheStale(cache, app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, now) {
183				freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
184			}
185			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
186			if !cache.Complete || collectionErr != nil {
187				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
188			}
189			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
190				Authority: assessment.AuthorityCache, Freshness: freshness,
191				Completeness: completeness, ObservedAt: cache.FetchedAt,
192				Records: append([]forge.RemoteRepo{}, cache.Repos...),
193				Err:     errors.Join(collectionErr, forgeCacheErrors(cache)),
194			}
195		}
196
197		if !refresh {
198			cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
199			if !ok {
200				return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: errors.New("no cached forge inventory; rerun with --refresh to collect one")}
201			}
202			return cacheInput(cache, nil)
203		}
204
205		rows, collectionErr := collectRemotes(ctx, app)
206		records := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(rows))
207		for _, row := range rows {
208			records = append(records, row.Repo)
209		}
210		if collectionErr == nil {
211			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
212				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
213				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
214				Records: records,
215			}
216		}
217		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
218			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
219			if len(records) > 0 {
220				cached.Records = records
221			}
222			return cached
223		}
224		if len(records) > 0 {
225			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
226				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
227				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
228				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
229			}
230		}
231		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
232	}
233
234	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
235		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
236			return true
237		}
238		if ttl <= 0 {
239			return false
240		}
241		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
242	}
243
244	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
245		var providerErrors []error
246		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
247		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
248		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
249			name := string(kind)
250			kinds = append(kinds, name)
251			byKind[name] = status
252		}
253		sort.Strings(kinds)
254		for _, kind := range kinds {
255			status := byKind[kind]
256			if status.Error != "" {
257				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
258			} else if !status.Complete {
259				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
260			}
261		}
262		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
263	}
264
265	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
266		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
267		if err != nil {
268			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
269		}
270		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
271			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
272			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
273			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
274		}
275		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
276			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
277		}
278		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
279			return input
280		}
281		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
282		if parallel <= 0 {
283			parallel = 1
284		}
285		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
286		var wait sync.WaitGroup
287		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
288			wait.Add(1)
289			go func() {
290				defer wait.Done()
291				semaphore <- struct{}{}
292				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
293				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
294			}()
295		}
296		wait.Wait()
297		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
298			input.Err = err
299		}
300		return input
301	}

90	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
91		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
92			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
93		}
94		seen := map[string]bool{}
95		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
96		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
97		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
98		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
99		identities := map[string]bool{}
100		var out []Repo
101
102		for _, root := range roots {
103			info, err := os.Stat(root)
104			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
105				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
106			}
107			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
108
109			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
110				if err != nil {
111					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
112				}
113				if ctx.Err() != nil {
114					return ctx.Err()
115				}
116				isRoot := path == rootClean
117				name := d.Name()
118				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
119				isDir := d.IsDir()
120				if isLink {
121					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
122					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
123					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
124					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
125						isDir = info.IsDir()
126					}
127				}
128				if !isDir {
129					return nil
130				}
131				if !isRoot && (skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare")) {
132					return filepath.SkipDir
133				}
134
135				rel := "."
136				depth := 0
137				if !isRoot {
138					rel, _ = filepath.Rel(rootClean, path)
139					depth = len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
140				}
141
142				if isRepoDir(path) {
143					real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
144					if real == "" {
145						real = path
146					}
147					bare := isBareDir(path)
148					identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot := real, real, real, real
149					if !bare && opts.Fast && gitEntryIsFile(path) {
150						// A direct .git file at a discovered root is a linked
151						// worktree. Submodules are already hidden below their parent
152						// repository because discovery never descends into one.
153						return filepath.SkipDir
154					}
155					if !bare && !opts.Fast {
156						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path); err == nil {
157							// A linked worktree is execution state, not another
158							// project in the repo inventory.
159							if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
160								return filepath.SkipDir
161							}
162							identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot = g.GitCommonDir, g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir, g.MainRoot
163							real = g.MainRoot
164						}
165					}
166					if !seen[path] && !identities[identity] {
167						seen[path], identities[identity] = true, true
168						out = append(out, Repo{
169							Name:      name,
170							Path:      path,
171							RealPath:  real,
172							Symlink:   isLink,
173							Root:      rootClean,
174							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
175							GitDir:    gitDir,
176							CommonDir: commonDir,
177							MainRoot:  mainRoot,
178							Bare:      bare,
179							HasGit:    true,
180						})
181					}
182					// Never descend into a repo: its subdirectories are source
183					// code, and any nested .git is a submodule or a worktree that
184					// belongs to this repo, not a project of its own.
185					return filepath.SkipDir
186				}
187				if depth >= opts.MaxDepth {
188					return filepath.SkipDir
189				}
190				if opts.IncludeNonRepos && depth == 1 {
191					if !seen[path] {
192						seen[path] = true
193						out = append(out, Repo{Name: name, Path: path, Root: rootClean, Category: ""})
194					}
195				}
196				return nil
197			})
198			if err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
199				return out, ctx.Err()
200			}
201		}
202
203		for i := range out {
204			if out[i].Category == "." {
205				out[i].Category = ""
206			}
207		}
208		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
209			if out[i].Name != out[j].Name {
210				return strings.ToLower(out[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(out[j].Name)
211			}
212			return out[i].Path < out[j].Path
213		})
214		return out, nil
215	}
216
217	// isRepoDir reports whether path is a repository root: it holds a .git entry
218	// (directory for a normal clone, file for a linked worktree or submodule).
219	func isRepoDir(path string) bool {
220		if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
221			return true
222		}
223		return isBareDir(path)
224	}
225
226	func gitEntryIsFile(path string) bool {
227		info, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git"))
228		return err == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular()
229	}
230
231	// isBareDir recognises a bare repository by its skeleton, without shelling out.
232	func isBareDir(path string) bool {
233		for _, marker := range []string{"HEAD", "objects", "refs"} {
234			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, marker)); err != nil {
235				return false
236			}
237		}
238		return true
239	}
240
241	// Resolve finds a repo by name, display name, or path.
242	//
243	// Matching is deliberately layered: an exact name or path wins outright, and
244	// only then does a substring search run — so a repo literally named "web"
245	// is never shadowed by "web-frontend".
246	func Resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
247		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, DefaultOptions())
248	}
249
250	// ResolveCompletion resolves the same references without launching one Git
251	// process per repository in the scan roots.
252	func ResolveCompletion(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
253		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, CompletionOptions())
254	}
255
256	func resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string, opts Options) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
257		all, err := Discover(ctx, roots, opts)
258		if err != nil {
259			return Repo{}, nil, err
260		}
261		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
262			if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, abs); err == nil {
263				real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs)
264				if real == "" {
265					real = g.MainRoot
266				}
267				// Preserve an explicit navigation alias. The caller named this
268				// path on purpose; resolving it to the physical checkout would
269				// defeat a bootstrap symlink catalog.
270				return Repo{
271					Name: filepath.Base(abs), Path: abs, RealPath: real,
272					Symlink: real != abs, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
273				}, nil, nil
274			}
275		}
276		for _, r := range all {
277			if r.Name == ref || r.Display() == ref || r.Path == ref {
278				return r, nil, nil
279			}
280		}
281		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
282		var hits []Repo
283		for _, r := range all {
284			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Display()), needle) {
285				hits = append(hits, r)
286			}
287		}
288		switch len(hits) {
289		case 1:
290			return hits[0], nil, nil
291		case 0:
292			return Repo{}, nil, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref}
293		default:
294			return Repo{}, hits, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: hits}
295		}
296	}
297
298	// NotFoundError reports a repo reference that matched nothing.
299	type NotFoundError struct{ Ref string }
```

35	func NewStore(path string) *Store {

37			path = DefaultPath()
38		}
39		if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path); err == nil {
40			path = absolute
41		}

45	// LoadOrCreate returns this machine's stable ID from the default private store.

50	func Validate(value string) error {
51		parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
52		if err != nil || parsed == uuid.Nil || parsed.String() != value {
53			return fmt.Errorf("machine_id %q is not a canonical non-zero UUID", value)
54		}
55		return nil
56	}

58	func (s *Store) Load() (string, error) {
59		if s == nil || s.Path == "" {
60			return "", errors.New("load machine identity from nil store")
61		}
62		if err := checkPrivateDir(filepath.Dir(s.Path)); err != nil {
63			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity directory: %w", err)
64		}
65		info, err := os.Lstat(s.Path)
66		if err != nil {
67			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity: %w", err)
68		}
69		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
70			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity %s is not a regular file", s.Path)
71		}
72		private, err := privateModeMatches(s.Path, info.Mode(), 0o600)
73		if err != nil {
74			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity permissions: %w", err)
75		}
76		if !private {
77			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity %s permissions are not private (want 0600 or a protected owner-only policy)", s.Path)
78		}
79		file, err := os.Open(s.Path)
80		if err != nil {
81			return "", fmt.Errorf("open machine identity: %w", err)
82		}
83		defer file.Close()
84		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
85		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
86		var payload document
87		if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
88			return "", fmt.Errorf("decode machine identity: %w", err)
89		}
90		var extra any
91		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
92			if err == nil {
93				return "", errors.New("decode machine identity: multiple JSON values")
94			}
95			return "", fmt.Errorf("decode machine identity trailing data: %w", err)
96		}
97		if payload.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
98			return "", fmt.Errorf("machine identity schema_version %d: want %d", payload.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
99		}
100		if err := Validate(payload.MachineID); err != nil {
101			return "", err
102		}
103		return payload.MachineID, nil
104	}

106	func (s *Store) LoadOrCreate(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
107		if s == nil || s.Path == "" {
108			return "", errors.New("create machine identity with nil store")
109		}
110		if ctx == nil {
111			ctx = context.Background()
112		}
113		directory := filepath.Dir(s.Path)
114		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("prepare machine identity directory: %w", err)
116		}
117		lockDirectory := filepath.Join(directory, ".lock")
118		if err := ensurePrivateDir(lockDirectory); err != nil {
119			return "", fmt.Errorf("prepare machine identity lock: %w", err)
120		}
121		var result string
122		err := lockx.WithDir(ctx, lockDirectory, "machine identity", func() error {
123			loaded, err := s.Load()
124			if err == nil {
125				result = loaded
126				return nil
127			}
128			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
129				return err
130			}
131			generate := s.generate
132			if generate == nil {
133				generate = uuid.NewString
134			}
135			candidate := generate()
136			if err := Validate(candidate); err != nil {
137				return fmt.Errorf("generate machine identity: %w", err)
138			}
139			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {
140				return err
141			}
142			result = candidate
143			return nil
144		})
145		return result, err
146	}
147
148	func (s *Store) write(id string) error {
149		if err := Validate(id); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		directory := filepath.Dir(s.Path)
153		if err := ensurePrivateDir(directory); err != nil {
154			return err
155		}
156		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(directory, ".identity-*.tmp")
157		if err != nil {
158			return fmt.Errorf("create machine identity temp file: %w", err)
159		}
160		name := temporary.Name()
161		defer os.Remove(name)
162		if err := setPrivateMode(name, 0o600); err != nil {
163			_ = temporary.Close()
164			return err
165		}
166		encoder := json.NewEncoder(temporary)
167		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
168		if err := encoder.Encode(document{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, MachineID: id}); err != nil {
169			_ = temporary.Close()
170			return fmt.Errorf("encode machine identity: %w", err)
171		}
172		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
173			_ = temporary.Close()
174			return fmt.Errorf("sync machine identity: %w", err)
175		}
176		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
177			return fmt.Errorf("close machine identity: %w", err)
178		}
179		if err := replaceFile(name, s.Path); err != nil {
180			return fmt.Errorf("publish machine identity: %w", err)
181		}
182		if err := syncDirectory(directory); err != nil {
183			return fmt.Errorf("sync machine identity directory: %w", err)
184		}
185		return nil
186	}
187
188	func ensurePrivateDir(path string) error {
189		created := false
190		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
191			if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0o700); err != nil {
192				return err
193			}
194			created = true
195		} else if err != nil {
196			return err
197		}
198		if created {
199			if err := setPrivateMode(path, 0o700); err != nil {
200				return err
201			}
202		}
203		return checkPrivateDir(path)
204	}
205
206	func checkPrivateDir(path string) error {
207		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
208		if err != nil {
209			return err
210		}
211		if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
212			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a private directory", path)
213		}
214		private, err := privateModeMatches(path, info.Mode(), 0o700)
215		if err != nil {
216			return fmt.Errorf("inspect machine identity directory permissions: %w", err)
217		}
218		if !private {
219			return fmt.Errorf("machine identity directory %s permissions are not private (want 0700 or a protected owner-only policy)", path)
220		}
221		return nil
222	}

3	package machineid

5	import (

8		"runtime"
9		"unsafe"
10
11		"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
12	)
13
14	const (
15		localSystemSID    = "S-1-5-18"
16		administratorsSID = "S-1-5-32-544"
17	)
18
19	// setPrivateMode installs a protected DACL. Windows os.FileMode permission
20	// bits only model the read-only attribute and cannot establish privacy.
21	func setPrivateMode(path string, want fs.FileMode) error {
22		inheritance := ""
23		switch want.Perm() {
24		case 0o600:
25		case 0o700:
26			inheritance = "OICI"
27		default:
28			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported private Windows mode %04o", want.Perm())
29		}
30		current, _, err := privateSIDs()
31		if err != nil {
32			return err
33		}
34		ace := func(sid string) string {
35			return fmt.Sprintf("(A;%s;GA;;;%s)", inheritance, sid)
36		}
37		descriptor, err := windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString("D:P" + ace(current) + ace(localSystemSID) + ace(administratorsSID))
38		if err != nil {
39			return fmt.Errorf("build private Windows security descriptor: %w", err)
40		}
41		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
42		if err != nil {
43			return fmt.Errorf("read private Windows DACL: %w", err)
44		}
45		if dacl == nil {
46			return fmt.Errorf("private Windows security descriptor has no DACL")
47		}
48		err = windows.SetNamedSecurityInfo(
49			path,
50			windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT,
51			windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION,
52			nil,
53			nil,
54			dacl,
55			nil,
56		)
57		runtime.KeepAlive(descriptor)
58		if err != nil {
59			return fmt.Errorf("set private Windows DACL: %w", err)
60		}
61		return nil
62	}
63
64	func privateModeMatches(path string, _ fs.FileMode, _ fs.FileMode) (bool, error) {
65		current, allowed, err := privateSIDs()
66		if err != nil {
67			return false, err
68		}
69		descriptor, err := windows.GetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
70		if err != nil {
71			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner and DACL: %w", err)
72		}
73		owner, _, err := descriptor.Owner()
74		if err != nil {
75			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows owner: %w", err)
76		}
77		if !privateSIDAllowed(owner, allowed) {
78			return false, nil
79		}
80		control, _, err := descriptor.Control()
81		if err != nil {
82			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows security descriptor control: %w", err)
83		}
84		if control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED == 0 {
85			return false, nil
86		}
87		dacl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
88		if err != nil {
89			return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL: %w", err)
90		}
91		if dacl == nil {
92			return false, nil
93		}
94		seenCurrent := false
95		for index := uint16(0); index < dacl.AceCount; index++ {
96			var ace *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
97			if err := windows.GetAce(dacl, uint32(index), &ace); err != nil {
98				return false, fmt.Errorf("read Windows DACL entry %d: %w", index, err)
99			}
100			switch ace.Header.AceType {
101			case windows.ACCESS_DENIED_ACE_TYPE:
102				continue
103			case windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE_TYPE:
104			default:
105				return false, nil
106			}
107			sid := (*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&ace.SidStart))
108			value := sid.String()
109			if _, ok := allowed[value]; !ok {
110				return false, nil
111			}
112			if value == current {
113				seenCurrent = true
114			}
115		}
116		return seenCurrent, nil
117	}
118
119	func privateSIDAllowed(sid *windows.SID, allowed map[string]struct{}) bool {
120		if sid == nil {
121			return false
122		}
123		_, ok := allowed[sid.String()]
124		return ok
125	}
126
127	func privateSIDs() (string, map[string]struct{}, error) {
128		user, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
129		if err != nil {
130			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("read current Windows user: %w", err)
131		}
132		current := user.User.Sid.String()
133		if current == "" {
134			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("current Windows user has an invalid SID")
135		}
136		return current, map[string]struct{}{
137			current:           {},
138			localSystemSID:    {},
139			administratorsSID: {},
140		}, nil
141	}
142
143	func replaceFile(source, destination string) error {
144		from, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(source)
145		if err != nil {
146			return err
147		}
148		to, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(destination)
149		if err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152		return windows.MoveFileEx(from, to, windows.MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING|windows.MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)
153	}
154
155	// MoveFileEx with MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH durably publishes the replacement.
156	// Windows does not expose a portable directory fsync through os.File.
157	func syncDirectory(string) error { return nil }

326	func RecoverySnapshotWithOptions(ctx context.Context, dir string, options RecoverySnapshotOptions) (RecoverySnapshot, error) {
327		snapshot := RecoverySnapshot{
328			Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete,
329			Refs:         []RecoveryRef{},
330			Worktrees:    []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{},
331			AdminRoots:   []RecoveryAdminRoot{},

338			maxCapture = recoveryMaxAggregateCapture
339		}
340		if maxCapture < 0 || maxCapture > recoveryMaxAggregateCapture {
341			snapshot.Completeness = RecoveryCompletenessUnknown
342			return snapshot, fmt.Errorf("recovery capture limit must be between 1 and %d bytes", recoveryMaxAggregateCapture)
343		}
344		collector := recoveryCollector{ctx: ctx, snapshot: &snapshot, maxCaptureBytes: maxCapture}

406	type recoveryCollector struct {
407		ctx             context.Context
408		snapshot        *RecoverySnapshot

414	func (collector *recoveryCollector) contextError(scope, subject string) error {
415		if cause := context.Cause(collector.ctx); cause != nil {
416			if !collector.cancelRecorded {
417				collector.cancelRecorded = true
418				collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
419					Code: "collection-cancelled", Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure,
420					Scope: scope, Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: cause.Error(),
421				})
422			}
423			collector.markPartial(nil)
424			return cause
425		}
426		return nil
427	}
428
429	func (collector *recoveryCollector) failure(code, scope, subject string, err error, local *RecoveryCompleteness) error {
430		if cause := context.Cause(collector.ctx); cause != nil || errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
431			if cause == nil {
432				cause = err
433			}
434			if !collector.cancelRecorded {
435				collector.cancelRecorded = true
436				collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
437					Code: "collection-cancelled", Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure,
438					Scope: scope, Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: cause.Error(),
439				})
440			}
441			collector.markPartial(local)
442			return cause
443		}
444		collector.markPartial(local)
445		collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
446			Code: code, Kind: RecoveryFindingProbeFailure, Scope: scope,
447			Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: recoveryCleanText(err.Error()),
448		})
449		return nil
450	}
451
452	func (collector *recoveryCollector) blocker(code, scope, subject, message string) {
453		collector.addFinding(RecoveryFinding{
454			Code: code, Kind: RecoveryFindingBlocker, Scope: scope,
455			Subject: subject, Blocking: true, Message: message,
456		})
457	}
458
459	func (collector *recoveryCollector) addFinding(finding RecoveryFinding) {
460		finding.Code = recoveryIdentifier(finding.Code)
461		finding.Scope = recoveryIdentifier(finding.Scope)
462		finding.Subject = recoveryCleanSubject(finding.Subject)
463		finding.Message = recoveryCleanText(finding.Message)
464		collector.snapshot.Findings = append(collector.snapshot.Findings, finding)
465	}
466
467	func (collector *recoveryCollector) markPartial(local *RecoveryCompleteness) {
468		if collector.snapshot.Completeness != RecoveryCompletenessUnknown {
469			collector.snapshot.Completeness = RecoveryCompletenessPartial
470		}
471		if local != nil && *local != RecoveryCompletenessUnknown {
472			*local = RecoveryCompletenessPartial
473		}
474	}

476	func (collector *recoveryCollector) reserveCapture(size int64) bool {
477		if size < 0 || size > collector.maxCaptureBytes-collector.capturedBytes {
478			return false
479		}
480		collector.capturedBytes += size
481		return true
482	}

484	func (collector *recoveryCollector) releaseCapture(size int64) {
485		if size > 0 && size <= collector.capturedBytes {
486			collector.capturedBytes -= size
487		}
488	}

490	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectObjectFormat(repository Repo) error {
491		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
492			"rev-parse", "--show-object-format=storage")
493		if err != nil {
494			if cancelErr := collector.failure("object-format-probe-failed", "object-format", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
495				return cancelErr
496			}
497		}
498		format := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
499		if format == "" {
500			if err == nil {
501				_ = collector.failure("object-format-parse-failed", "object-format", "repository", errors.New("Git returned an empty object format"), nil)
502			}
503			return nil
504		}
505		if strings.ContainsAny(format, "\x00\r\n \t") {
506			_ = collector.failure("object-format-parse-failed", "object-format", "repository", fmt.Errorf("unexpected object format %q", format), nil)
507			return nil
508		}
509		collector.snapshot.ObjectFormat = format
510		return nil
511	}

513	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectRefs(repository Repo) error {
514		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
515			"for-each-ref", "--sort=refname", "--format=%(refname)%00%(objectname)%00%(objecttype)%00", "refs")
516		if err != nil {
517			if cancelErr := collector.failure("refs-probe-failed", "refs", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
518				return cancelErr
519			}
520		}
521		refs, parseErr := parseRecoveryRefs(output)
522		collector.snapshot.Refs = refs
523		if parseErr != nil {
524			_ = collector.failure("refs-parse-failed", "refs", "repository", parseErr, nil)
525		}
526		return nil
527	}

529	func parseRecoveryRefs(output []byte) ([]RecoveryRef, error) {
530		refs := []RecoveryRef{}
531		var parseErrors []error
532		for recordIndex, record := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{'\n'}) {
533			record = bytes.TrimSuffix(record, []byte{'\r'})
534			if len(record) == 0 {
535				continue
536			}
537			fields := bytes.Split(record, []byte{0})
538			if len(fields) == 4 && len(fields[3]) == 0 {
539				fields = fields[:3]
540			}
541			if len(fields) != 3 {
542				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d has %d fields", recordIndex, len(fields)))
543				continue
544			}
545			name, oid, objectType := string(fields[0]), string(fields[1]), string(fields[2])
546			if !utf8.ValidString(name) || !strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/") || oid == "" || objectType == "" {
547				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("ref record %d is invalid", recordIndex))
548				continue
549			}
550			refs = append(refs, RecoveryRef{Name: name, OID: oid, ObjectType: objectType, Kind: recoveryRefKind(name)})
551		}
552		sort.Slice(refs, func(i, j int) bool { return refs[i].Name < refs[j].Name })
553		return refs, errors.Join(parseErrors...)
554	}

556	func recoveryRefKind(name string) RecoveryRefKind {
557		switch {
558		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/heads/"):
559			return RecoveryRefHead
560		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/tags/"):
561			return RecoveryRefTag
562		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/notes/"):
563			return RecoveryRefNote
564		case name == "refs/stash":
565			return RecoveryRefStash
566		case strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/remotes/"):
567			return RecoveryRefRemote
568		default:
569			return RecoveryRefOther
570		}
571	}

573	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectRepositoryConfig(repository Repo) error {
574		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
575			"config", "--null", "--local", "--list")
576		if err != nil {
577			if cancelErr := collector.failure("config-probe-failed", "repository-config", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
578				return cancelErr
579			}
580		}
581		var parseErrors []error
582		promisorRemotes := map[string]struct{}{}
583		for recordIndex, record := range recoveryNULRecords(output) {
584			newline := bytes.IndexByte(record, '\n')
585			if newline < 1 {
586				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("config record %d has no key/value separator", recordIndex))
587				continue
588			}
589			key := strings.ToLower(string(record[:newline]))
590			value := string(record[newline+1:])
591			switch {
592			case key == "extensions.partialclone":
593				if strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
594					collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
595					promisorRemotes[strings.TrimSpace(value)] = struct{}{}
596				}
597			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "remote.") && strings.HasSuffix(key, ".promisor"):
598				remote := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "remote."), ".promisor")
599				parsed, boolErr := recoveryGitBool(value)
600				if boolErr != nil {
601					parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("config %s: %w", key, boolErr))
602					continue
603				}
604				if parsed {
605					collector.snapshot.Repository.Promisor = true
606					collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
607					promisorRemotes[remote] = struct{}{}
608				}
609			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "remote.") && strings.HasSuffix(key, ".partialclonefilter"):
610				remote := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "remote."), ".partialclonefilter")
611				collector.snapshot.Repository.PartialClone = true
612				promisorRemotes[remote] = struct{}{}
613			case strings.HasPrefix(key, "filter.lfs."):
614				collector.snapshot.Repository.LFSConfigured = true
615			}
616		}
617		for remote := range promisorRemotes {
618			if remote != "" {
619				collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes = append(collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes, remote)
620			}
621		}
622		sort.Strings(collector.snapshot.Repository.PromisorRemotes)
623		if parseErr := errors.Join(parseErrors...); parseErr != nil {
624			_ = collector.failure("config-parse-failed", "repository-config", "repository", parseErr, nil)
625		}
626		return nil
627	}
628
629	func recoveryGitBool(value string) (bool, error) {
630		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
631		case "true", "yes", "on", "1":
632			return true, nil
633		case "false", "no", "off", "0", "":
634			return false, nil
635		default:
636			return false, fmt.Errorf("invalid Git boolean %q", value)
637		}
638	}

645				return cancelErr
646			}
647			return nil

650		if parseErr != nil {

652			return nil

655		if shallow {
656			collector.blocker("shallow-repository", "object-store", "repository", "repository history is shallow")
657		}

661	func (collector *recoveryCollector) collectWorktreeList(repository Repo) error {
662		output, err := recoveryGit(collector.ctx, repository.GitCommonDir, nil,
663			"worktree", "list", "--porcelain", "-z")
664		if err != nil {
665			if cancelErr := collector.failure("worktrees-probe-failed", "worktrees", "repository", err, nil); cancelErr != nil {
666				return cancelErr
667			}
668		}
669		worktrees, parseErr := parseRecoveryWorktrees(output)
670		if parseErr != nil {
671			_ = collector.failure("worktrees-parse-failed", "worktrees", "repository", parseErr, nil)
672		}
673		if len(worktrees) == 0 && repository.Root != "" {
674			worktrees = append(worktrees, RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{
675				Path: repository.Root, GitDir: repository.GitDir, Bare: repository.Bare,
676				Main: true, Presence: RecoveryPresenceUnknown, Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessPartial,
677			})
678			if err == nil && parseErr == nil {
679				_ = collector.failure("worktrees-parse-failed", "worktrees", "repository", errors.New("Git returned no worktrees"), &worktrees[0].Completeness)
680			}
681		}
682		collector.snapshot.Worktrees = worktrees
683		return nil
684	}
685
686	func parseRecoveryWorktrees(output []byte) ([]RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot, error) {
687		worktrees := []RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{}
688		var current *RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot
689		var parseErrors []error
690		flush := func() {
691			if current == nil {
692				return
693			}
694			if current.Path == "" {
695				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, errors.New("worktree record has no path"))
696			} else {
697				current.Main = len(worktrees) == 0
698				worktrees = append(worktrees, *current)
699			}
700			current = nil
701		}
702		for fieldIndex, raw := range bytes.Split(output, []byte{0}) {
703			if len(raw) == 0 {
704				flush()
705				continue
706			}
707			keyBytes, valueBytes, hasValue := bytes.Cut(raw, []byte{' '})
708			key, value := string(keyBytes), ""
709			if hasValue {
710				value = string(valueBytes)
711			}
712			if key == "worktree" {
713				flush()
714				current = &RecoveryWorktreeSnapshot{
715					Path: value, Presence: RecoveryPresenceUnknown, Completeness: RecoveryCompletenessComplete,
716					Operations: []RecoveryOperation{}, IndexEntries: []RecoveryIndexEntry{},
717					TrackedFiles: []RecoveryTrackedFile{}, DirtyPaths: []RecoveryDirtyPath{},
718					UntrackedPaths: []string{}, IgnoredPaths: []string{}, LFSPaths: []RecoveryLFSPath{},
719					Submodules: []RecoverySubmodule{}, NestedRepositories: []RecoveryNestedRepository{},
720				}
721				continue
722			}
723			if current == nil {
724				parseErrors = append(parseErrors, fmt.Errorf("worktree field %d precedes a worktree path", fieldIndex))
725				continue
726			}
727			switch key {
728			case "HEAD":
729				current.Head = value
730			case "branch":
731				current.Branch = strings.TrimPrefix(value, "refs/heads/")
732			case "detached":
733				current.Detached = true
734			case "bare":
735				current.Bare = true
736			case "locked":
737				current.Locked, current.LockedReason = true, value
738			case "prunable":
739				current.Prunable, current.PrunableReason = true, value
```

32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {

190		}
191		after, err := file.Stat()
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, nil, err
194		}
195		current, err = root.Lstat(name)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, nil, err
198		}
199		if unsafeLink(after) || unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, after) ||
200			!sameStableSourceState(after, current) || after.Size() != int64(len(data)) {
201			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed during read: %w", ErrChanged)
202		}
203		return data, opened, nil
204	}
205
206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}
213
214	func sameStableSourceState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
215		return SameFileState(left, right) && samePlatformState(left, right)
216	}
217
218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}
243
244	func unsafeLink(info fs.FileInfo) bool {
245		return info != nil && (info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || isReparsePoint(info))
246	}

135	// DecodeStrict reads exactly one bounded JSON value, rejects unknown fields,
136	// and requires EOF after optional JSON whitespace.
137	func DecodeStrict(reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
138		if reader == nil || target == nil {
139			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a reader and target")
140		}
141		if maxBytes <= 0 {
142			return errors.New("fleet protocol decode requires a positive limit")
143		}
144		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maxBytes+1))
145		if err != nil {
146			return fmt.Errorf("read fleet protocol: %w", err)
147		}
148		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
149			return fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
150		}
151		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
152		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
153		if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
154			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol: %w", err)
155		}
156		var extra any
157		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
158			if err == nil {
159				return errors.New("decode fleet protocol: multiple JSON values")
160			}
161			return fmt.Errorf("decode fleet protocol trailing data: %w", err)
162		}
163		return nil
164	}

166	// MarshalBounded encodes one protocol value and enforces the matching bound
167	// before it can be handed to Transport.
168	func MarshalBounded(value any, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
169		if maxBytes <= 0 {
170			return nil, errors.New("fleet protocol encode requires a positive limit")
171		}
172		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode fleet protocol: %w", err)
175		}
176		if int64(len(data))+1 > maxBytes {
177			return nil, fmt.Errorf("fleet protocol exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrProtocolLimit)
178		}
179		return append(data, '\n'), nil
180	}
181
182	// UnmarshalStrict applies DecodeStrict to an in-memory transport response.
183	func UnmarshalStrict(data []byte, maxBytes int64, target any) error {
184		return DecodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(data), maxBytes, target)
185	}

31	// MaybeServeAskpass turns the dev executable into a one-shot SSH_ASKPASS
32	// helper. The password arrives through an inherited descriptor, never argv.
33	func MaybeServeAskpass() (bool, int) {
34		if os.Getenv(askpassMarker) != "1" {
35			return false, 0
36		}
37		fd, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv(askpassFD))
38		if err != nil || fd < 3 {
39			return true, 2
40		}
41		file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), "dev-fleet-askpass")
42		if file == nil {
43			return true, 2
44		}
45		defer file.Close()
46		password, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 64*1024))
47		if err != nil {
48			return true, 2
49		}
50		password = bytes.TrimSuffix(password, []byte{'\n'})
51		_, err = os.Stdout.Write(append(password, '\n'))
52		if err != nil {
53			return true, 2
54		}
55		return true, 0

132			return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}

169		err := runSSHCommand(cmd, password)
170		result := Result{Stdout: stdout.Bytes(), Stderr: stderr.Bytes(), ExitCode: 0, Attempts: 1}
171		if stdout.Exceeded() || stderr.Exceeded() {
172			message := captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr)
173			result.ExitCode = 125
174			result.CaptureError = message
175			result.TransportError = message
176			result.Stderr = appendBounded(result.Stderr, []byte("\n"+message), effectiveLimit(t.StderrLimit, DefaultStderrLimit))
177			return result
178		}
179		if err == nil {
180			return result
181		}
182		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
183		if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || errors.Is(ctx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded) {
184			result.ExitCode, result.TimedOut = 124, true
185		} else if errors.As(err, &exitErr) {
186			result.ExitCode = exitErr.ExitCode()
187			if result.ExitCode < 0 {
188				result.ExitCode = 255
189			}
190		} else {
191			result.ExitCode = 255
192			if len(result.Stderr) == 0 {
193				result.Stderr = []byte(err.Error())
194			}
195		}
196		return result
197	}
198
199	// runSSHCommand starts SSH before writing an askpass secret. Starting first is
200	// load-bearing: a secret larger than the pipe capacity must remain cancellable
201	// through the command context instead of blocking before SSH exists.
202	func runSSHCommand(cmd *exec.Cmd, password string) error {
203		if password == "" {
204			return cmd.Run()
205		}
206		executable, err := os.Executable()
207		if err != nil {
208			return err
209		}
210		reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
211		if err != nil {
212			return err
213		}
214		cmd.ExtraFiles = []*os.File{reader}
215		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
216			askpassMarker+"=1", askpassFD+"=3", "SSH_ASKPASS="+executable,
217			"SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force", "DISPLAY=dev-fleet")
218		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
219			_ = reader.Close()
220			_ = writer.Close()
221			return err
222		}
223		// The child owns its inherited descriptor after Start; closing the parent
224		// copy lets an early SSH exit interrupt a blocked write.
225		readerCloseErr := reader.Close()
226		writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
227		go func() {
228			_, writeErr := io.Copy(writer, strings.NewReader(password+"\n"))
229			writeDone <- errors.Join(writeErr, writer.Close())
230		}()
231		waitErr := cmd.Wait()
232		// A descendant could retain the inherited read descriptor after SSH exits.
233		// Close our writer so that cannot strand the write goroutine.
234		_ = writer.Close()
235		writeErr := <-writeDone
236		return errors.Join(waitErr, readerCloseErr, writeErr)
237	}
238
239	func sshArgs(host Host, pty, password bool) []string {
240		connect := host.ConnectTimeout.Duration
241		if connect <= 0 {
242			connect = 15 * time.Second
243		}
244		seconds := int(connect.Round(time.Second) / time.Second)
245		if seconds < 1 {
246			seconds = 1
247		}
248		args := []string{"-o", "ConnectTimeout=" + strconv.Itoa(seconds), "-o", "ServerAliveInterval=15", "-o", "ServerAliveCountMax=2"}
249		if password {
250			args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=no", "-o", "PubkeyAuthentication=no", "-o", "PreferredAuthentications=keyboard-interactive,password", "-o", "NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1")
251		} else {
252			args = append(args, "-o", "BatchMode=yes")
253		}
254		if pty {
255			args = append(args, "-t")
256		} else {
257			// A fixed protocol command never needs a TTY or client-side forwarding.
258			// Do not add host-key overrides here: OpenSSH's configured strict host-key
259			// verification remains authoritative.
260			args = append(args,
261				"-T",
262				"-o", "ClearAllForwardings=yes",
263				"-o", "ForwardAgent=no",
264				"-o", "ForwardX11=no",
265				"-o", "PermitLocalCommand=no",
266			)
267		}
268		if host.User != "" && host.SSHAlias != "" {
269			args = append(args, "-l", host.User)
270		}
271		if host.Port > 0 {
272			args = append(args, "-p", strconv.Itoa(host.Port))
273		}
274		if host.IdentityFile != "" && !password {
275			args = append(args, "-i", devconfig.Expand(host.IdentityFile))
276		}
277		return args
278	}
279
280	func remoteCommand(host Host, args []string) string {
281		devPath := host.DevPath
282		if devPath == "" {
283			devPath = "auto"
284		}
285		quotedArgs := make([]string, len(args))
286		for index, arg := range args {
287			quotedArgs[index] = shellQuote(arg)
288		}
289		joined := strings.Join(quotedArgs, " ")
290		if devPath != "auto" {
291			return "exec " + shellQuote(devconfig.Expand(devPath)) + " " + joined
292		}
293		path := `PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:/opt/homebrew/bin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/snap/bin:$PATH"`
294		return path + "; export PATH; command -v dev >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 127; exec dev " + joined
295	}
296
297	func shellQuote(value string) string {
298		return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'"
299	}
300
301	func permissionDenied(stderr []byte) bool {
302		return strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(stderr)), "permission denied")
303	}

305	func (t Transport) resolvePassword(host Host) (string, error) {
306		source := host.SSHLoginPasswordSource
307		switch host.PasswordKind() {
308		case "plain":
309			return source.Value, nil
310		case "bitwarden":
311			cmd := exec.Command("bw", "get", "password", source.Item)
312			out, err := cmd.Output()
313			if err != nil {
314				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve Bitwarden SSH password for %s: %w", host.Name, err)
315			}
316			return strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), nil
317		case "prompt":
318			promptPasswordMu.Lock()
319			defer promptPasswordMu.Unlock()
320			writer := t.Err
321			if writer == nil {
322				writer = os.Stderr
323			}
324			fmt.Fprintf(writer, "SSH password for %s: ", host.Name)
325			terminal, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
326			if err != nil {
327				return "", fmt.Errorf("open terminal for SSH password: %w", err)
328			}
329			defer terminal.Close()
330			password, err := term.ReadPassword(terminal.Fd())
331			fmt.Fprintln(writer)
332			if err != nil {
333				return "", err
334			}
335			return string(password), nil
336		default:
337			return "", nil
338		}
339	}

341	type captureBuffer struct {
342		limit    int64
343		buffer   bytes.Buffer
344		exceeded bool
345	}
346
347	func newCaptureBuffer(limit int64) *captureBuffer {
348		return &captureBuffer{limit: limit}
349	}
350
351	func (b *captureBuffer) Write(value []byte) (int, error) {
352		remaining := b.limit - int64(b.buffer.Len())
353		if remaining > 0 {
354			keep := int64(len(value))
355			if keep > remaining {
356				keep = remaining
357			}
358			_, _ = b.buffer.Write(value[:int(keep)])
359		}
360		if int64(len(value)) > remaining {
361			b.exceeded = true
362		}
363		// Consume excess output without retaining it. The command timeout still
364		// bounds a peer that writes forever, while the parent process stays bounded.
365		return len(value), nil
366	}
367
368	func (b *captureBuffer) Bytes() []byte {
369		return append([]byte(nil), b.buffer.Bytes()...)
370	}
371
372	func (b *captureBuffer) Exceeded() bool { return b.exceeded }
373
374	func effectiveLimit(configured, fallback int64) int64 {
375		if configured <= 0 {
376			return fallback
377		}
378		return configured
379	}
380
381	func captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr *captureBuffer) string {
382		streams := make([]string, 0, 2)
383		if stdout.Exceeded() {
384			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stdout exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stdout.limit))
385		}
386		if stderr.Exceeded() {
387			streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stderr exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stderr.limit))
388		}
389		return "fleet transport: remote " + strings.Join(streams, " and ")
390	}
391
392	func boundedBytes(value []byte, limit int64) []byte {
393		if int64(len(value)) > limit {
394			value = value[:int(limit)]
395		}
396		return append([]byte(nil), value...)
397	}
398
399	func appendBounded(current, suffix []byte, limit int64) []byte {
400		if int64(len(current)) >= limit {
401			return append([]byte(nil), current...)
402		}
403		available := limit - int64(len(current))
404		if int64(len(suffix)) > available {
405			suffix = suffix[:int(available)]
406		}
407		return append(append([]byte(nil), current...), suffix...)
408	}
409
410	func localTransportFailure(message string) Result {
411		return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}
412	}

17	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
18	// render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
19	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
20	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
21	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
22		// Header + its blank line, table header, blank before detail, blank before
23		// footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and terminal width.
24		fixed := 2 + 1 + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
25		h := m.height - fixed
26		if h < 3 {
27			return 3
28		}
29		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
30		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
31			h--
32		}
33		return h
34	}

36	func lineCount(s string) int {
37		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\n")
38		if s == "" {
39			return 0
40		}
41		return strings.Count(s, "\n") + 1
42	}

44	// View implements tea.Model.
45	func (m Model) View() string {
46		if m.quitting {
47			return ""
48		}
49		if m.noteMode() {
50			return m.renderNotes()
51		}
52		if m.overlay.kind != overlayNone {
53			return m.renderOverlay()
54		}
55		if m.mode == modeStats {
56			return m.renderStats()
57		}
58		var b strings.Builder
59		b.WriteString(m.renderHeader())
60		b.WriteString("\n")
61
62		switch m.view {
63		case ViewRepos:
64			b.WriteString(m.renderRepos())
65		case ViewFleet:
66			b.WriteString(m.renderFleet())
67		case ViewTries:
68			b.WriteString(m.renderTries())
69		case ViewRemote:
70			b.WriteString(m.renderRemotes())
71		case ViewSkills:
72			b.WriteString(m.renderSkills())
73		default:
74			b.WriteString(m.renderTasks())
75		}
76
77		b.WriteString("\n")
78		b.WriteString(m.renderDetail())
79		b.WriteString("\n")
80		b.WriteString(m.renderFooter())
81		return b.String()
82	}

84	func (m Model) renderStats() string {
85		var b strings.Builder
86		title := "repo activity"
87		if m.stats != nil && m.stats.Repo != "" {
88			title = m.stats.Repo + " activity"
89		}
90		b.WriteString(styleTitle.Render("dev  HEATMAP  "+title) + "\n\n")
91		if m.err != nil {
92			b.WriteString("  " + styleErr.Render("✗ "+m.err.Error()) + "\n")
93		} else if m.stats == nil {
94			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Loading activity…") + "\n")
95		} else if m.stats.Seconds == 0 {
96			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("No activity recorded for this repository.\n"))
97			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Press b to backfill only this repo from Git history.\n"))
98		} else {
99			b.WriteString(m.stats.Heatmap)
100			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n  %s   %d active days   %s → %s\n",
101				styleOK.Render(humanSeconds(m.stats.Seconds)), m.stats.ActiveDays,
102				m.stats.Since.Format("2006-01-02"), m.stats.Until.Format("2006-01-02"))
103		}
104		b.WriteString("\n  " + styleHelp.Render("b backfill this repo · r reread stats · H / esc back · q quit"))
105		return b.String()
106	}

108	func humanSeconds(seconds int) string {
109		d := time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second
110		if d < time.Hour {
111			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
112		}
113		return fmt.Sprintf("%dh %dm", int(d.Hours()), int(d.Minutes())%60)
114	}

116	// renderHeader shows the tab strip, so which list is showing — and that there
117	// is another one — is never in doubt.
118	func (m Model) renderHeader() string {
119		var tabs []string
120		for _, v := range Views {
121			label := " " + strings.ToUpper(v.String()) + " "
122			if v == m.view {
123				tabs = append(tabs, styleSelected.Render(label))
124			} else {
125				tabs = append(tabs, styleDim.Render(label))
126			}
127		}
128		line := styleTitle.Render("dev") + "  " + strings.Join(tabs, styleDim.Render("│")) +
129			"   " + styleDim.Render(m.Summary())
130		if m.filter != "" {
131			line += "   " + styleWarm.Render("/"+m.filter)
132		}
133		return line + "\n"
134	}

136	// window returns the slice of a list visible around the cursor, and the offset
137	// it starts at, so a long inventory scrolls instead of overflowing.
138	func (m Model) window(n int) (from, to int) {
139		h := m.listHeight()
140		if n <= h {
141			return 0, n
142		}
143		from = m.at() - h/2
144		if from < 0 {
145			from = 0
146		}
147		if from+h > n {
148			from = n - h
149		}
150		return from, from + h
151	}

153	func (m Model) renderTasks() string {
154		rows := m.visibleTasks()
155		if len(rows) == 0 {
156			return m.emptyTasks()
157		}
158		nameW, branchW, nextW := m.columnWidths()
159
160		var b strings.Builder
161		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s  %-6s  %-*s  %-16s  %-5s  %s",
162			nameW, "TASK", "STATE", branchW, "BRANCH", "GIT", "AGE", "NEXT")) + "\n")
163
164		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
165		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
166			r := rows[i]
167			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-*s  %-6s  %-*s  %-16s  %-5s  %s",
168				nameW, pad(r.Task.Title(), nameW),
169				r.Task.State.Label(),
170				branchW, pad(r.Task.Branch, branchW),
171				pad(gitColumn(r), 16),
172				pad(shortAge(r), 5),
173				pad(nextColumn(r), nextW),
174			)
175			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, colourState(r.Task.State, line)))
176		}
177		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
178		return b.String()
179	}

181	func (m Model) renderRepos() string {
182		items := m.visibleRepoItems()
183		if len(items) == 0 {
184			if m.loadingLocal {
185				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading local repositories…") + "\n"
186			}
187			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No repositories found. Check paths.scan_roots in your config,"+
188				" or run `dev config init`.\n")
189		}
190		columns := m.repoColumns()
191
192		var b strings.Builder
193		var headers []string
194		for _, c := range columns {
195			headers = append(headers, fitCell(c.header, c.width))
196		}
197		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render("  "+strings.Join(headers, "  ")) + "\n")
198
199		from, to := m.window(len(items))
200		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
201			item := items[i]
202			r := item.Repo
203			cells := make([]string, 0, len(columns))
204			for _, c := range columns {
205				cells = append(cells, fitCell(m.repoItemColumnValue(item, c.name), c.width))
206			}
207			line := strings.Join(cells, "  ")
208			styled := line
209			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
210				if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
211					styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
212				} else if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal ||
213					checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
214					styled = styleDim.Render(line)
215				}
216			} else if r.Status.Dirty() {
217				styled = styleDirty.Render(line)
218			} else if len(r.Tasks) == 0 && !r.Live {
219				styled = styleClean.Render(line)
220			}
221			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
222		}
223		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(items), from, to))
224		return b.String()
225	}

227	func (m Model) repoItemColumnValue(item repoItem, name string) string {
228		r := item.Repo
229		checkout, child := item.checkout()
230		if !child {
231			if name == "repo" && r.Worktrees > 0 {
232				marker := "▸ "
233				if m.repoExpanded(r) {
234					marker = "▾ "
235				}
236				return marker + r.Repo.Display()
237			}
238			if name == "live" {
239				return parentLiveColumn(r)
240			}
241			return repoColumnValue(r, name)
242		}
243
244		switch name {
245		case "repo":
246			connector := "├─ "
247			if item.CheckoutIndex == len(r.Context.Checkouts)-1 {
248				connector = "└─ "
249			}
250			label := filepath.Base(checkout.Worktree.Path)
251			if label == "." || label == string(filepath.Separator) || label == "" {
252				label = checkout.Branch()
253			}
254			if checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutExternal || checkout.Ownership == inventory.CheckoutEphemeral {
255				label += " (" + string(checkout.Ownership) + ")"
256			}
257			return connector + label
258		case "branch":
259			if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
260				return branch
261			}
262			return "(detached)"
263		case "git":
264			switch {
265			case checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists:
266				return "prunable"
267			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
268				return "locked"
269			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
270				return "?"
271			default:
272				return checkout.Status.Summary()
273			}
274		case "live":
275			return checkoutLiveColumn(r.Runtime, checkout)
276		case "latest":
277			return latestAge(checkout.LastActivity)
278		case "worktrees":
279			return "—"
280		case "tasks":
281			return taskStateSummary(checkout.Tasks)
282		case "notes":
283			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
284				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
285			}
286			return "—"
287		case "category":
288			return "—"
289		case "path":
290			return contract(checkout.Worktree.Path)
291		}
292		return ""
293	}

295	func parentLiveColumn(r RepoRow) string {
296		sessions := r.Sessions()
297		if len(sessions) == 0 {
298			return repoColumnValue(r, "live")
299		}
300		if len(sessions) > 1 {
301			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", r.Runtime, len(sessions))
302		}
303		status := sessions[0].AgentStatus
304		if status != "" {
305			return r.Runtime + ":" + status
306		}
307		return r.Runtime
308	}
309
310	func checkoutLiveColumn(runtimeName string, checkout inventory.RepoCheckout) string {
311		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
312			return "closed"
313		}
314		if len(checkout.Sessions) > 1 {
315			return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d live", runtimeName, len(checkout.Sessions))
316		}
317		if status := checkout.Sessions[0].AgentStatus; status != "" {
318			return runtimeName + ":" + status
319		}
320		return runtimeName
321	}
322
323	func taskStateSummary(tasks []*task.Task) string {
324		if len(tasks) == 0 {
325			return "—"
326		}
327		counts := map[task.State]int{}
328		for _, t := range tasks {
329			counts[t.State]++
330		}
331		var parts []string
332		for _, state := range task.States {
333			if counts[state] > 0 {
334				parts = append(parts, state.Icon()+fmt.Sprintf("%d", counts[state]))
335			}
336		}
337		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
338	}
339
340	type repoColumnSpec struct {
341		name, header string
342		width, min   int
343	}
344
345	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
346		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
347		if len(names) == 0 {
348			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
349		}
350		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
351			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
352			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
353			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
354			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
355			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
356			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
357			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
358			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
359			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
360			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
361			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
362			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
363		}
364		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
365		for _, name := range names {
366			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
367				columns = append(columns, c)
368			}
369		}
370		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
371		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
372		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
373		for _, c := range columns {
374			total += c.width
375		}
376		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
377			for i := range columns {
378				if columns[i].name != preferred {
379					continue
380				}
381				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
382				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
383				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
384				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
385					columns[i].width--
386					total--
387				}
388			}
389			if total <= m.width {
390				break
391			}
392		}
393		return columns
394	}
395
396	func repoColumnValue(r RepoRow, name string) string {
397		switch name {
398		case "repo":
399			return r.Repo.Display()
400		case "branch":
401			if r.Repo.Bare {
402				return "(bare)"
403			}
404			return r.Status.Branch
405		case "git":
406			if r.Repo.Bare {
407				return "—"
408			}
409			return r.Status.Summary()
410		case "remote":
411			if r.TopologyErr != nil {
412				return "?"
413			}
414			return r.Topology.Summary()
415		case "size":
416			return sizeCell(r.Usage, r.SizeError, r.SizeTarget)
417		case "live":
418			if !r.Live {
419				return "—"
420			}
421			if r.RuntimeStatus != "" {
422				return r.Runtime + ":" + r.RuntimeStatus
423			}
424			return r.Runtime
425		case "latest":
426			return latestAge(r.LastActivity)
427		case "worktrees":
428			if r.Worktrees > 0 {
429				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.Worktrees)
430			}
431			return "—"
432		case "tasks":
433			if tasks := r.StateSummary(); tasks != "" {
434				return tasks
435			}
436			return "—"
437		case "notes":
438			if r.NoteCount > 0 {
439				return fmt.Sprintf("%d", r.NoteCount)
440			}
441			return "—"
442		case "category":
443			if r.Repo.Category != "" {
444				return r.Repo.Category
445			}
446			return "—"
447		case "path":
448			return contract(r.Repo.Path)
449		}
450		return ""
451	}
452
453	func latestAge(at time.Time) string {
454		if at.IsZero() {
455			return "—"
456		}
457		d := time.Since(at)
458		switch {
459		case d < time.Hour:
460			return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", int(d.Minutes()))
461		case d < 24*time.Hour:
462			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh", int(d.Hours()))
463		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
464			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd", int(d.Hours()/24))
465		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
466			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
467		default:
468			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
469		}
470	}
471
472	func fitCell(s string, width int) string {
473		s = pad(s, width)
474		if n := lipgloss.Width(s); n < width {
475			s += strings.Repeat(" ", width-n)
476		}
477		return s
478	}

480	func (m Model) renderRemotes() string {
481		if m.remotesLoading && len(m.remotes) == 0 {
482			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading repositories from forge CLIs…") + "\n"
483		}
484		rows := m.visibleRemotes()
485		if len(rows) == 0 {
486			if !m.remotesLoaded {
487				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Remote repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
488			}
489			if m.filter != "" {
490				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repository matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
491			}
492			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No remote repositories returned. Check forge authentication and `dev doctor`.") + "\n"
493		}
494		nameW := clamp(m.width*30/100, 18, 38)
495		descW := m.width - nameW - 38
496		if descW < 12 {
497			descW = 12
498		}
499
500		var b strings.Builder
501		if m.remotesLoading {
502			b.WriteString("  " + styleDim.Render("Showing cached repositories while refreshing…") + "\n")
503		}
504		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
505			"FORGE", nameW, "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "UPDATED", "LOCAL", "DESCRIPTION")) + "\n")
506		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
507		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
508			r := rows[i]
509			local := "—"
510			if r.Cloned() {
511				local = "yes"
512				if r.LocalKind != "" {
513					local = string(r.LocalKind)
514					if r.LocalKind == "repository" {
515						local = "repo"
516					}
517				}
518			}
519			vis := strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility)
520			if vis == "" {
521				vis = "—"
522			}
523			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-7s  %-*s  %-9s  %-12s  %-7s  %s",
524				r.Repo.Forge, nameW, pad(r.Repo.FullName, nameW),
525				pad(vis, 9), pad(remoteAge(r), 12), pad(local, 7), pad(r.Repo.Description, descW))
526			styled := line
527			if r.Cloned() {
528				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
529			} else if r.Repo.Archived {
530				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
531			}
532			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
533		}
534		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
535		return b.String()
536	}
