538	func (m Model) renderFleet() string {
539		rows := m.visibleFleet()
540		if len(rows) == 0 {
541			if m.fleetLoading {
542				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading configured dev hosts…") + "\n"
543			}
544			if !m.fleetLoaded {
545				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Fleet repositories load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
546			}
547			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No fleet row matches the current filter.") + "\n"
548		}
549		hostW := clamp(m.width*14/100, 10, 22)
550		repoW := clamp(m.width*24/100, 16, 34)
551		pathW := m.width - hostW - repoW - 58
552		if pathW < 12 {
553			pathW = 12
554		}
555		var b strings.Builder
556		b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
557			hostW, "HOST", "STATE", repoW, "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "PATH")) + "\n")
558		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
559		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
560			row := rows[i]
561			repoName, branch, git, live, tasks, path := "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", row.Error
562			if row.Repository != nil {
563				repoName, branch, git, path = row.Repository.Display, row.Repository.Branch, row.Repository.Status.Summary(), contract(row.Repository.Path)
564				if row.Repository.Live {
565					live = row.Repository.Runtime
566					if row.Repository.AgentStatus != "" {
567						live += ":" + row.Repository.AgentStatus
568					}
569				}
570				tasks = fleetTasks(row.Repository.Tasks.Hot, row.Repository.Tasks.Warm, row.Repository.Tasks.Cold, row.Repository.Tasks.Done)
571			}
572			state := string(row.State)
573			if row.FromCache {
574				state = "stale"
575			}
576			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-*s  %-8s  %-*s  %-18s  %-14s  %-10s  %-8s  %s",
577				hostW, pad(row.Host, hostW), pad(state, 8), repoW, pad(repoName, repoW), pad(branch, 18),
578				pad(git, 14), pad(live, 10), pad(tasks, 8), pad(path, pathW))
579			styled := line
580			if row.Repository != nil && row.Repository.Live {
581				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
582			} else if row.State != "ok" {
583				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
584			}
585			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
586		}
587		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
588		return b.String()
589	}
590	func (m Model) renderSkills() string {
591		if m.skillsLoading {
592			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading local agent skills…") + "\n"
593		}
594		if m.skillsChecking {
595			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Checking skill sources…") + "\n"
596		}
597		rows := m.visibleSkills()
598		if len(rows) == 0 {
599			if !m.skillsLoaded {
600				return "  " + styleDim.Render("Agent skills load when this view is opened.") + "\n"
601			}
602			if m.filter != "" {
603				return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skill matches /"+m.filter) + "\n"
604			}
605			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No agent skills found. Press a to open the installer.") + "\n"
606		}
607		skillW := clamp(m.width*24/100, 14, 30)
608		agentW := clamp(m.width*25/100, 16, 34)
609		showSource := m.width >= 76
610		sourceW := m.width - skillW - agentW - 35
611		if sourceW < 12 {
612			sourceW = 12
613		}
614
615		var b strings.Builder
616		if showSource {
617			b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-10s  %-*s  %s",
618				"SCOPE", skillW, "SKILL", "UPDATE", agentW, "AGENTS", "SOURCE")) + "\n")
619		} else {
620			b.WriteString(styleHeader.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-7s  %-*s  %-10s  %s",
621				"SCOPE", skillW, "SKILL", "UPDATE", "AGENTS")) + "\n")
622		}
623		from, to := m.window(len(rows))
624		for i := from; i < to; i++ {
625			row := rows[i]
626			line := fmt.Sprintf("%-7s  %-*s  %-10s  %s",
627				row.Scope, skillW, pad(row.Name, skillW), skillUpdateLabel(row.UpdateStatus),
628				pad(skillAgentSummary(row.Agents), agentW))
629			if showSource {
630				line += "  " + pad(skillSource(row), sourceW)
631			}
632			styled := line
633			switch row.UpdateStatus {
634			case agentskill.UpdateAvailable, agentskill.UpdateMissing, agentskill.UpdateFailed:
635				styled = styleDrift.Render(line)
636			case agentskill.UpdateCurrent:
637				styled = styleLive.Render(line)
638			case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
639				styled = styleDim.Render(line)
640			}
641			b.WriteString(m.renderLine(i, line, styled))
642		}
643		b.WriteString(m.scrollNote(len(rows), from, to))
644		return b.String()
645	}
646
647	func fleetTasks(hot, warm, cold, done int) string {
648		var parts []string
649		for _, item := range []struct {
650			label string
651			n     int
652		}{{"H", hot}, {"W", warm}, {"C", cold}, {"D", done}} {
653			if item.n > 0 {
654				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", item.label, item.n))
655			}
656		}
657		if len(parts) == 0 {
658			return "—"
659		}
660		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
661	}
662
663	func skillUpdateLabel(status agentskill.UpdateStatus) string {
664		switch status {
665		case agentskill.UpdateAvailable:
666			return "update"
667		case agentskill.UpdateMissing:
668			return "missing"
669		case agentskill.UpdateUnknown:
670			return "unknown"
671		case agentskill.UpdateFailed:
672			return "failed"
673		default:
674			return string(status)
675		}
676	}
677
678	func skillAgentSummary(agents []string) string {
679		if len(agents) == 0 {
680			return "—"
681		}
682		if len(agents) <= 3 {
683			return strings.Join(agents, ", ")
684		}
685		return strings.Join(agents[:3], ", ") + fmt.Sprintf(" +%d", len(agents)-3)
686	}
687
688	func skillSource(row agentskill.Skill) string {
689		if row.Source != "" {
690			return row.Source
691		}
692		return string(row.ManagedBy)
693	}
694
695	func remoteAge(r RemoteRow) string {
696		if r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
697			return "—"
698		}
699		d := time.Since(r.Repo.UpdatedAt)
700		switch {
701		case d < 24*time.Hour:
702			return fmt.Sprintf("%dh ago", int(d.Hours()))
703		case d < 14*24*time.Hour:
704			return fmt.Sprintf("%dd ago", int(d.Hours()/24))
705		case d < 60*24*time.Hour:
706			return fmt.Sprintf("%dw ago", int(d.Hours()/24/7))
707		default:
708			return fmt.Sprintf("%dmo ago", int(d.Hours()/24/30))
709		}
710	}

712	// renderLine applies the cursor marker and styling to one row.
713	func (m Model) renderLine(i int, plain, styled string) string {
714		if i == m.at() {
715			return styleSelected.Render("▸ ") + styleSelected.Render(plain) + "\n"
716		}
717		return "  " + styled + "\n"
718	}

720	func (m Model) scrollNote(total, from, to int) string {
721		if total <= to-from {
722			return ""
723		}
724		return "  " + styleDim.Render(fmt.Sprintf("… %d–%d of %d", from+1, to, total)) + "\n"
725	}

727	func (m Model) emptyTasks() string {
728		if m.loadingLocal {
729			return "  " + styleDim.Render("Loading tasks, repositories, and experiments…") + "\n"
730		}
731		if len(m.rows) == 0 {
732			return "  " + styleDim.Render("No tasks recorded yet.\n") +
733				"  " + styleDim.Render("Press tab for the repository list, then s to start work on one.\n") +
734				"  " + styleDim.Render("Or run `dev adopt` to import worktrees and branches already in flight.\n")
735		}
736		return "  " + styleDim.Render("Nothing matches. Press 0 to clear the filter, or a to include done tasks.\n")
737	}

739	func (m Model) columnWidths() (name, branch, next int) {
740		const fixed = 2 + 6 + 16 + 5 + 10
741		avail := m.width - fixed
742		if avail < 40 {
743			avail = 40
744		}
745		name = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
746		branch = clamp(avail*30/100, 12, 30)
747		next = avail - name - branch
748		if next < 10 {
749			next = 10
750		}
751		return name, branch, next
752	}

755	// dashboard rather than a listing.
756	func (m Model) renderDetail() string {
757		switch m.mode {

763				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to save · esc to cancel")
764		case modeConfirmPark:
765			row, _ := m.currentTask()
766			return "  " + styleTitle.Render("park "+row.Task.Title()) +
767				"\n  next: " + m.input.View() +
768				"\n  " + styleHelp.Render("enter to park (session closes, worktree stays) · esc to cancel")
769		case modeStartTask:

774		case modeStartDirect:

779		case modeConfirmClone:

784		case modeConfirmSkillUpdate:

1073	func (m Model) renderFooter() string {
1074		var status string
1075		switch {
1076		case m.err != nil:
1077			status = styleErr.Render("✗ " + m.err.Error())
1078		case m.status != "":
1079			status = styleOK.Render("✓ " + m.status)
1080		}
1081
1082		var bindings []string
1083		switch m.view {
1084		case ViewRepos:
1085			sortBy := m.actions.RepoSort
1086			if sortBy == "" {
1087				sortBy = "activity"
1088			}
1089			if m.actions.RepoReverse {
1090				sortBy += "↑"
1091			}
1092			if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok && item.child() {
1093				bindings = append(bindings, "enter open worktree", "space collapse")
1094			} else {
1095				bindings = append(bindings, "enter ad hoc", "space worktrees", "m metadata", "n add note", "N notes", "s worktree task", "d direct task")
1096			}
1097			bindings = append(bindings, "O sort:"+sortBy, "R reverse")
1098		case ViewFleet:
1099			if row, ok := m.currentFleet(); ok && row.Repository != nil {
1100				bindings = append(bindings, "enter remote open")
1101			}
1102			bindings = append(bindings, "r refresh")
1103		case ViewTries:
1104			sortBy := m.trySort
1105			if sortBy == "" {
1106				sortBy = "activity"
1107			}
1108			if m.tryReverse {
1109				sortBy += "↑"
1110			}
1111			bindings = append(bindings, "enter open", "n new", "space actions", "a history",
1112				"O sort:"+sortBy, "R reverse")
1113		case ViewRemote:
1114			if r, ok := m.currentRemote(); ok && r.Cloned() {
1115				bindings = append(bindings, "enter open local", "n add note", "N notes")
1116			} else {
1117				bindings = append(bindings, "c clone")
1118			}
1119		case ViewSkills:
1120			bindings = append(bindings, "a add", "c check", "u update selected")
1121		default:

1155	// wrapBindings lays the key hints out over as many lines as the width needs,
1156	// rather than truncating them — a hint you cannot read is not a hint.
1157	func wrapBindings(items []string, width int) string {
1158		if width < 20 {
1159			width = 20
1160		}
1161		var lines []string
1162		cur := ""
1163		for _, it := range items {
1164			candidate := it
1165			if cur != "" {
1166				candidate = cur + " · " + it
1167			}
1168			if lipgloss.Width(candidate) > width && cur != "" {
1169				lines = append(lines, cur)
1170				cur = it
1171				continue
1172			}
1173			cur = candidate
1174		}
1175		if cur != "" {
1176			lines = append(lines, cur)
1177		}
1178		return strings.Join(lines, "\n  ")
1179	}

1242			used += w

+func startDirectFromTUI(ctx context.Context, app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, row tui.RepoRow, name string) (string, error) {
+	if err := guardSharedCheckout(ctx, app, rt, row.Repo.Path); err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, row.Repo.Path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("direct task needs a named branch; this repo has detached HEAD")
+	}
+	id := task.MakeID(row.Repo.Name, status.Branch)
+	replaceDoneRevision := ""
+	existing, err := existingTaskForStart(app.Tasks, id)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if existing != nil && existing.State != task.Done {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("task %s already exists (state %s)", existing.ID, existing.State)
+	}
+	if existing != nil {
+		replaceDoneRevision = existing.Revision()
+	}

+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	tracked := &task.Task{
+		Name: name, Repo: row.Repo.Name, RepoPath: row.Repo.Path,
+		Branch: status.Branch, Base: status.Branch, Mode: task.ModeDirect,
+		State: task.Hot, Owner: config.Hostname(),

+	setTaskRuntime(tracked, rt, handle)
+	if replaceDoneRevision != "" {
+		err = app.Tasks.ReplaceDone(tracked, replaceDoneRevision)

+		}
+		return "", err
+	}
+	annotate(app, rt, tracked)
+	return fmt.Sprintf("tracking %s directly on %s; no branch/worktree created", name, status.Branch), nil

12	// Readiness is one cheap, local-only context projection. It intentionally
13	// carries no authority to mutate; the full Report binds the same result to

15	type Readiness struct {

17		Reasons []assessment.Reason
18	}

20	// LocalReadiness keeps independently actionable checkout, task, and worktree

37	// AssessLocal derives readiness from facts already collected by inventory. It
38	// does not run Git, inspect a runtime, or contact a forge/fleet host.
39	func AssessLocal(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) LocalReadiness {
40		return LocalReadiness{
41			Checkout: assessCheckout(context, selectedIndex),
42			Task:     assessTasks(context, selectedIndex, hostname),
43			Worktree: assessWorktrees(context, selectedIndex),
44		}
45	}

47	func assessCheckout(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
48		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
49			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the selected checkout is absent from the local inventory", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
50		}
51		checkout := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex]
52		switch {
53		case checkout.Worktree.Bare || context.Repo.Bare:
54			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
55		case checkout.PathErr != nil:
56			return indeterminate("checkout-path-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path could not be inspected", "restore path access and rerun context")
57		case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
58			return blocked("checkout-missing", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path is missing or prunable", "repair or remove the stale worktree registration")
59		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
60			return indeterminate("checkout-status-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "Git status could not be collected", "repair the checkout and rerun context")
61		case checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached || checkout.Branch() == "":
62			return blocked("checkout-detached", "selected-checkout", "the checkout does not have an attached branch", "check out an explicit branch")
63		case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
64			return blocked("checkout-conflicted", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d unmerged path(s)", checkout.Status.Conflicted), "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement")
65		case checkout.Status.Dirty():
66			return blocked("checkout-dirty", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d changed path(s)", checkout.Status.Changed), "commit or deliberately preserve the changes")
67		default:
68			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
69		}
70	}
71
72	func assessTasks(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) Readiness {
73		if context.TaskErr != nil {
74			return indeterminate("task-inventory-unavailable", "task-inventory", "task records could not be collected", "repair the task store and rerun context")
75		}
76		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
77			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "task scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
78		}
79		// Transfer/repository readiness covers every non-DONE task attached to the
80		// clone, including cold and branch-only records without a local checkout.
81		// Looking only at the selected checkout can otherwise hide another machine's
82		// ownership claim and incorrectly report not-applicable.
83		active := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(context.OtherTasks)+len(context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Tasks))
84		sessionCount := map[string]int{}
85		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
86		add := func(candidate *task.Task, sessions int) {
87			if candidate == nil || candidate.State == task.Done {
88				return
89			}
90			if _, exists := seen[candidate.ID]; exists {
91				return
92			}
93			seen[candidate.ID] = struct{}{}
94			active = append(active, candidate)
95			sessionCount[candidate.ID] = sessions
96		}
97		for _, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
98			for _, candidate := range checkout.Tasks {
99				add(candidate, len(checkout.Sessions))
100			}
101		}
102		for _, candidate := range context.OtherTasks {
103			add(candidate, 0)
104		}
105		if len(active) == 0 {
106			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
107		}
108		var reasons []assessment.Reason
109		hasIndeterminate := false
110		for _, candidate := range active {
111			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
112				hasIndeterminate = true
113				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
114					Code: "task-record-invalid", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task record is invalid",
115					Remediation: "repair or recreate the task record",
116				})
117				continue
118			}
119			if hostname != "" && candidate.Owner != "" && candidate.Owner != hostname {
120				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
121					Code: "task-owned-elsewhere", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task is owned by another machine",
122					Remediation: "complete an explicit ownership handoff before writing",
123				})
124			}
125			if candidate.State == task.Hot {
126				if context.RuntimeErr != nil {
127					hasIndeterminate = true
128					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
129						Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task cannot be checked against live runtime state",
130						Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
131					})
132				} else if sessionCount[candidate.ID] == 0 {
133					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
134						Code: "hot-task-runtime-missing", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task has no observed runtime session",
135						Remediation: "resume the task or reconcile its lifecycle state",
136					})
137				}
138			}
139		}
140		if hasReason(reasons, "task-owned-elsewhere") || hasReason(reasons, "hot-task-runtime-missing") {
141			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
142		}
143		if hasIndeterminate {
144			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
145		}
146		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
147	}
148
149	func assessWorktrees(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
150		if context.WorktreeErr != nil {
151			return indeterminate("worktree-inventory-unavailable", "worktrees", "linked worktrees could not be enumerated", "repair Git worktree metadata and rerun context")
152		}
153		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
154			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "worktree scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
155		}
156		indices := []int{}
157		if selectedIndex > 0 {
158			indices = append(indices, selectedIndex)
159		} else {
160			for index := 1; index < len(context.Checkouts); index++ {
161				indices = append(indices, index)
162			}
163		}
164		if len(indices) == 0 {
165			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
166		}
167		var reasons []assessment.Reason
168		hasUnknown := context.RuntimeErr != nil
169		if hasUnknown {
170			reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
171				Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "worktrees",
172				Detail:      "worktree runtime coverage could not be collected",
173				Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
174			})
175		}
176		for _, index := range indices {
177			checkout := context.Checkouts[index]
178			subject := fmt.Sprintf("worktree:%d", index)
179			switch {
180			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
181				hasUnknown = true
182				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-path-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path could not be inspected", Remediation: "restore path access and rerun context"})
183			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
184				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-missing", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree path is missing or prunable", Remediation: "repair or remove the stale worktree registration"})
185			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
186				hasUnknown = true
187				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-status-unavailable", Subject: subject, Detail: "Git status could not be collected for the worktree", Remediation: "repair the worktree and rerun context"})
188			case checkout.Worktree.Locked:
189				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-locked", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree is locked", Remediation: "verify the lock owner before unlocking it"})
190			case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
191				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-conflicted", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree has unmerged paths", Remediation: "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement"})
192			case checkout.Status.Dirty():
193				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-dirty", Subject: subject, Detail: "the worktree contains uncommitted changes", Remediation: "commit or deliberately preserve the changes"})
194			case len(checkout.Sessions) > 0:
195				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{Code: "worktree-runtime-live", Subject: subject, Detail: "a runtime session still covers the worktree", Remediation: "quiesce and close the runtime before retirement"})
196			}
197		}
198		if len(reasons) == 0 {
199			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
200		}
201		if hasKnownBlocker(reasons) {
202			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
203		}
204		if hasUnknown {
205			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
206		}
207		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
208	}

210	func blocked(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
211		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
212	}
213
214	func indeterminate(code, subject, detail, remediation string) Readiness {
215		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{Code: code, Subject: subject, Detail: detail, Remediation: remediation}}}
216	}
217
218	func hasReason(reasons []assessment.Reason, code string) bool {
219		for _, reason := range reasons {
220			if reason.Code == code {
221				return true
222			}
223		}
224		return false
225	}
226
227	func hasKnownBlocker(reasons []assessment.Reason) bool {
228		for _, reason := range reasons {
229			switch reason.Code {
230			case "worktree-missing", "worktree-locked", "worktree-conflicted", "worktree-dirty", "worktree-runtime-live":
231				return true
232			}
233		}
234		return false
235	}

The transport limits reveal a confirmed end-to-end failure: the local-file protocol permits and documents 32 MiB of raw content, but base64 expands that to roughly 42.7 MiB while the SSH transport rejects stdin above 32 MiB. A valid multi-file manifest near the advertised ceiling therefore plans successfully and fails before the remote command receives it.

237	func fleetFilesHost(cfg fleet.Config, name string) (fleet.Host, error) {
238		var selected *fleet.Host
239		for index := range cfg.Hosts {
240			if cfg.Hosts[index].Name == name {
241				if selected != nil {
242					return fleet.Host{}, errors.New("fleet files requires exactly one target")
243				}
244				copy := cfg.Hosts[index]
245				selected = &copy
246			}
247		}
248		if selected == nil {
249			return fleet.Host{}, fmt.Errorf("unknown fleet host %q", name)
250		}
251		return *selected, nil
252	}

254	func fleetFilePatterns(project projectconfig.Result, adHoc []string) []localfiles.Pattern {
255		var patterns []localfiles.Pattern
256		if project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include != nil {
257			source, _ := project.SourceFor("local_files.include")
258			for _, value := range *project.Effective.LocalFiles.Include {
259				patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: source})
260			}
261		}
262		for _, value := range adHoc {
263			patterns = append(patterns, localfiles.Pattern{Value: value, Source: "--file"})
264		}
265		return patterns
266	}

268	func resolveFleetFilesSource(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (string, gitx.Status, string, string, error) {
269		checkout := ""
270		if ref == "" {
271			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
272			if err != nil {
273				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
274			}
275			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
276			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
277				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare Git checkout")
278			}
279			checkout = gitRepo.Root
280		} else if absolute, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
281			if _, statErr := os.Stat(absolute); statErr == nil {
282				gitRepo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, absolute)
283				if discoverErr != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
284					return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("explicit fleet files path is not inside a non-bare Git checkout")
285				}
286				checkout = gitRepo.Root
287			}
288		}
289		if checkout == "" {
290			repository, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), ref)
291			if err != nil {
292				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
293			}
294			gitRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path)
295			if err != nil || gitRepo.Bare {
296				return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
297			}
298			checkout = gitRepo.MainRoot
299		}
300		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
301		if err != nil {
302			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
303		}
304		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
305			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", errors.New("fleet files requires an attached source branch")
306		}
307		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
308		if err != nil {
309			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
310		}
311		identity, err := localfiles.FetchRemoteIdentity(ctx, checkout, status.Branch)
312		if err != nil {
313			return "", gitx.Status{}, "", "", err
314		}
315		return checkout, status, head, identity, nil
316	}
317
318	func renderFleetFilesReport(app *App, report localfiles.Report, jsonOutput bool) error {
319		if jsonOutput {
320			encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
321			encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
322			return encoder.Encode(report)
323		}
324		table := app.newTable("PATH", "SIZE", "MODE", "STATE")
325		for _, file := range report.Files {
326			table.Add(file.Path, fmt.Sprintf("%d", file.Size), file.Mode, string(file.State))
327		}
328		table.Render(app.Out)
329		return nil
330	}

332	func writeFleetProtocol(writer io.Writer, value any, limit int64) error {
333		body, err := fleet.MarshalBounded(value, limit)
334		if err != nil {
335			return err
336		}
337		_, err = writer.Write(body)
338		return err
339	}

341	func newFleetCapabilityProtocolCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

344			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
345				var request fleet.CapabilityRequest

347					return err
348				}
349				response, err := localfiles.NewService(app.Cfg).Capability(ctxOf(), request)
350				if err != nil {
351					return err
352				}
353				return writeFleetProtocol(app.Out, response, fleet.MaxCapabilityBytes)
354			},

358	func newFleetFilesPlanProtocolCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
359		return &cobra.Command{
360			Use: "_files-plan", Hidden: true, Args: cobra.NoArgs,
361			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
362				var request localfiles.PlanRequest
363				if err := fleet.DecodeStrict(app.In, localfiles.MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes, &request); err != nil {
364					return err
365				}
366				response, err := localfiles.NewService(app.Cfg).Plan(ctxOf(), request)
367				wire := localfiles.PlanWireResponse{
368					SchemaVersion: localfiles.SchemaVersion, ProtocolVersion: fleet.LocalFilesProtocolVersion,
369				}
370				if err != nil {
371					var target *localfiles.TargetError
372					if !errors.As(err, &target) {
373						return err
374					}
375					wire.ErrorCode = target.Code
376				} else {
377					wire.Plan = &response
378				}
379				if err := wire.Validate(request); err != nil {
380					return err
381				}
382				return writeFleetProtocol(app.Out, wire, localfiles.MaxPlanEnvelopeBytes)
383			},
384		}
385	}

387	func newFleetFilesApplyProtocolCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

389			Use: "_files-apply", Hidden: true, Args: cobra.NoArgs,
390			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
391				service := localfiles.NewService(app.Cfg)
392				// Do not consume stdin on unsupported native Windows targets. A valid
393				// capability exchange is the only route by which a client sends content.
394				capability, err := service.Capability(ctxOf(), fleet.LocalFilesCapabilityRequest())
395				if err != nil {
396					return err
397				}
398				if !capability.Supported {
399					return errors.New("native target does not support local-file payloads")
400				}
401				var envelope localfiles.ApplyEnvelope
402				if err := fleet.DecodeStrict(app.In, localfiles.MaxApplyEnvelopeBytes, &envelope); err != nil {
403					return err
404				}
405				response, err := service.Apply(ctxOf(), envelope)
406				if err != nil {
407					return err
408				}
409				return writeFleetProtocol(app.Out, response, localfiles.MaxApplyResponseBytes)
410			},
411		}
412	}

147	func applySyncCheckout(ctx context.Context, candidate syncCandidate, request SyncRequest, remoteRef, remoteOID string, result *SyncResult) {
148		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, candidate.repository.Path)
149		if err != nil || repository.GitCommonDir != candidate.repository.CommonDir {
150			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, "target clone changed while acquiring operation lease"
151			return
152		}
153		worktree, checkedOut, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, candidate.repository.Path, request.Branch)
154		if err != nil {
155			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
156			return
157		}
158		if !checkedOut {
159			result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncFetched, remoteOID
160			return
161		}
162		result.Path = worktree.Path
163		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, worktree.Path)
164		if err != nil {
165			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
166			return
167		}
168		if status.Dirty() || status.Conflicted > 0 {
169			result.State, result.Error = SyncDirty, status.Summary()
170			return
171		}
172		localOID, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
173		if err != nil {
174			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
175			return
176		}
177		result.BeforeOID = localOID
178		if localOID == remoteOID {
179			result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncCurrent, localOID
180			return
181		}
182		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", localOID, remoteOID); err != nil {
183			if _, aheadErr := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", remoteOID, localOID); aheadErr == nil {
184				result.State, result.Error = SyncAhead, "checked-out branch contains commits not on the fetched remote"
185			} else {
186				result.State, result.Error = SyncDiverged, "checked-out branch diverged; rebase or merge manually"
187			}
188			return
189		}
190		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "merge", "--ff-only", remoteRef); err != nil {
191			result.State, result.Error = SyncFailed, err.Error()
192			return
193		}
194		after, err := gitx.Run(ctx, worktree.Path, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
195		if err != nil || after != remoteOID {
196			result.State = SyncFailed
197			result.Error = "fast-forward completed without reaching the fetched remote revision"
198			return
199		}
200		result.State, result.AfterOID = SyncUpdated, after
201	}

203	func matchingRemote(topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) string {
204		var names []string
205		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
206			matched := false
207			for _, raw := range append(append([]string{}, remote.FetchURLs...), remote.PushURLs...) {
208				if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == identity {
209					matched = true
210					break
211				}
212			}
213			if matched {
214				names = append(names, remote.Name)
215			}
216		}
217		sort.Strings(names)
218		if len(names) == 0 {
219			return ""
220		}
221		return names[0]
222	}
223
224	func matchingRemoteAt(ctx context.Context, path string, topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) string {
225		var names []string
226		for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
227			matched := false
228			for _, key := range []string{"remote." + remote.Name + ".url", "remote." + remote.Name + ".pushurl"} {
229				raw, err := gitx.Run(ctx, path, "config", "--get-all", key)
230				if err != nil {
231					continue
232				}
233				for _, value := range strings.Split(raw, "\n") {
234					if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(value) == identity {
235						matched = true
236						break
237					}
238				}
239				if matched {
240					break
241				}
242			}
243			if matched {
244				names = append(names, remote.Name)
245			}
246		}
247		if len(names) == 0 {
248			return matchingRemote(topology, identity)
249		}
250		sort.Strings(names)
251		return names[0]
252	}

 )

 type cacheFile struct {
    Version    int       `json:"version"`
    EndpointID string    `json:"endpoint_id"`
    FetchedAt  time.Time `json:"fetched_at"`
    Snapshot   Snapshot  `json:"snapshot"`
 }

 func CacheRoot() string { return filepath.Join(devconfig.CacheHome(), "dev", "fleet", "v1") }

 func cachePath(host Host) string {
    name := devconfig.Slug(host.Name)
    return filepath.Join(CacheRoot(), name+".json")
 }

 func EndpointID(host Host) string {
-	parts := []string{host.Name, host.SSHAlias, host.Hostname, host.User, host.IdentityFile, host.DevPath}
+	parts := []string{host.Name, host.MachineID, host.SSHAlias, host.Hostname, host.User, strconv.Itoa(host.Port), host.IdentityFile, host.DevPath}
    parts = append(parts, time.Duration(host.ConnectTimeout.Duration).String(), time.Duration(host.CommandTimeout.Duration).String())
    sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
    return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
 }

 func SaveCache(host Host, snapshot Snapshot) error {
    path := cachePath(host)
    if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
        return err
    }
    payload := cacheFile{Version: 1, EndpointID: EndpointID(host), FetchedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Snapshot: snapshot}
    data, err := json.MarshalIndent(payload, "", "  ")
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }
    data = append(data, '\n')
    temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".fleet-*.tmp")
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }
    name := temporary.Name()
    defer os.Remove(name)
    if _, err := temporary.Write(data); err != nil {
        _ = temporary.Close()
        return err
    }
    if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
        return err
    }
    if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o600); err != nil {
        return err
    }
    return os.Rename(name, path)
 }

 func LoadCache(host Host) (Snapshot, time.Time, bool) {
    data, err := os.ReadFile(cachePath(host))
    if err != nil {
        return Snapshot{}, time.Time{}, false
    }
    var payload cacheFile
    if json.Unmarshal(data, &payload) != nil || payload.Version != 1 || payload.EndpointID != EndpointID(host) || payload.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
        return Snapshot{}, time.Time{}, false
    }
    if payload.Snapshot.SchemaVersion != SnapshotSchemaVersion {
        return Snapshot{}, time.Time{}, false
    }
    return payload.Snapshot, payload.FetchedAt, true
 }

 type Config struct {
    SchemaVersion int      `toml:"schema_version"`
    Defaults      Defaults `toml:"defaults"`

 func DefaultConfig() Config {
    return Config{
        SchemaVersion: ConfigSchemaVersion,
        Defaults: Defaults{
            ConnectTimeout: devconfig.Duration{Duration: 15 * time.Second},
            CommandTimeout: devconfig.Duration{Duration: 5 * time.Minute},
            CacheTTL:       devconfig.Duration{Duration: 15 * time.Minute},
            MaxParallel:    4,
            DevPath:        "auto",
        },
    }
 }

 func ConfigFile() string {
    return filepath.Join(devconfig.ConfigHome(), "dev", "remotes.toml")
 }

 func LoadConfig(path string) (Config, error) {
    cfg := DefaultConfig()
    if path == "" {
        path = ConfigFile()
    }
    metadata, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
    switch {
    case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
        return cfg, nil
    case err != nil:
        return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
    }
    if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
        return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: unknown field(s): %v", path, undecoded)
    }
    cfg.Source = path
    cfg.ApplyDefaults()
    if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
        return cfg, err
    }
    return cfg, nil
 }

 func (c *Config) ApplyDefaults() {
    for index := range c.Hosts {
        host := &c.Hosts[index]
        if host.DevPath == "" {
            host.DevPath = c.Defaults.DevPath
        }
        if host.ConnectTimeout.Duration == 0 {
            host.ConnectTimeout = c.Defaults.ConnectTimeout
        }
        if host.CommandTimeout.Duration == 0 {
            host.CommandTimeout = c.Defaults.CommandTimeout
        }
    }
 }

 func (c Config) Validate() error {
    if c.SchemaVersion != ConfigSchemaVersion {
        return fmt.Errorf("remotes schema_version %d: want %d", c.SchemaVersion, ConfigSchemaVersion)
    }
    if c.Defaults.MaxParallel <= 0 {
        return errors.New("defaults.max_parallel must be positive")
    }
    if c.Defaults.ConnectTimeout.Duration <= 0 || c.Defaults.CommandTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
        return errors.New("default timeouts must be positive")
    }
    seen := map[string]bool{}
    for index, host := range c.Hosts {
        if strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) == "" || host.Name != strings.TrimSpace(host.Name) {
            return fmt.Errorf("hosts[%d].name is required and must be trimmed", index)
        }
        if seen[host.Name] {
            return fmt.Errorf("duplicate host name %q", host.Name)
        }
        seen[host.Name] = true
+		if host.MachineID != "" {
+			if err := machineid.Validate(host.MachineID); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("host %q: %w", host.Name, err)
+			}
+		}
        if host.SSHAlias == "" && host.Hostname == "" {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q must define ssh_alias or hostname", host.Name)
        }
        if host.Port < 0 || host.Port > 65535 {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q port %d is invalid", host.Name, host.Port)
        }
        if host.ConnectTimeout.Duration <= 0 || host.CommandTimeout.Duration <= 0 {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q timeouts must be positive", host.Name)
        }
        if host.DevPath != "" && host.DevPath != "auto" && !filepath.IsAbs(devconfig.Expand(host.DevPath)) {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q dev_path must be auto or absolute", host.Name)
        }
        if err := validatePasswordSource(host.Name, host.SSHLoginPasswordSource); err != nil {
            return err
        }
    }
    return nil
 }

 func validatePasswordSource(host string, source PasswordSource) error {
    kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(source.Type))
    if kind == "" {
        kind = "none"
    }
    switch kind {
    case "none", "prompt":
        return nil
    case "plain":
        if source.Value == "" {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q plain ssh_login_password_source requires value", host)
        }
    case "bitwarden":
        if source.Item == "" {
            return fmt.Errorf("host %q bitwarden ssh_login_password_source requires item", host)
        }
    default:
        return fmt.Errorf("host %q ssh_login_password_source.type %q: want none, plain, prompt or bitwarden", host, source.Type)
    }
    return nil
 }

 func (h Host) PasswordKind() string {
    kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(h.SSHLoginPasswordSource.Type))
    if kind == "" {
        return "none"
    }
    return kind
 }

 func (h Host) Destination() string {
    if h.SSHAlias != "" {
        return h.SSHAlias
    }
    if h.User != "" {
        return h.User + "@" + h.Hostname
    }
    return h.Hostname
 }

 func CheckPrivateMode(path string, cfg Config) error {
    needsPrivate := false
    for _, host := range cfg.Hosts {
        if host.PasswordKind() == "plain" {
            needsPrivate = true
            break
        }
    }
    if !needsPrivate {
        return nil
    }
    info, err := os.Stat(path)
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }
    if info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
        return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a plaintext SSH password and must have mode 0600", path)
    }
    return nil
 }

    SyncDirty        SyncState = "blocked-dirty"

 func matchingRemote(topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) string {
    var names []string
    for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
        matched := false
        for _, raw := range append(append([]string{}, remote.FetchURLs...), remote.PushURLs...) {
            if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(raw) == identity {
                matched = true
                break
            }
        }
        if matched {
            names = append(names, remote.Name)
        }
    }
    sort.Strings(names)
    if len(names) == 0 {
        return ""
    }
    return names[0]
 }

 func matchingRemoteAt(ctx context.Context, path string, topology gitx.RecoveryTopology, identity string) string {
    var names []string
    for _, remote := range topology.Remotes {
        matched := false
        for _, key := range []string{"remote." + remote.Name + ".url", "remote." + remote.Name + ".pushurl"} {
            raw, err := gitx.Run(ctx, path, "config", "--get-all", key)
            if err != nil {
                continue
            }
            for _, value := range strings.Split(raw, "\n") {
                if catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(value) == identity {
                    matched = true
                    break
                }
            }
            if matched {
                break
            }
        }
        if matched {
            names = append(names, remote.Name)
        }
    }
    if len(names) == 0 {
        return matchingRemote(topology, identity)
    }
    sort.Strings(names)
    return names[0]
 }

+// runSSHCommand starts SSH before writing an askpass secret. Starting first is
+// load-bearing: a secret larger than the pipe capacity must remain cancellable
+// through the command context instead of blocking before SSH exists.
+func runSSHCommand(cmd *exec.Cmd, password string) error {
+	if password == "" {
+		return cmd.Run()
+	}
+	executable, err := os.Executable()
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	reader, writer, err := os.Pipe()
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	cmd.ExtraFiles = []*os.File{reader}
+	cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env,
+		askpassMarker+"=1", askpassFD+"=3", "SSH_ASKPASS="+executable,
+		"SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force", "DISPLAY=dev-fleet")
+	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
+		_ = reader.Close()
+		_ = writer.Close()
+		return err
+	}
+	// The child owns its inherited descriptor after Start; closing the parent
+	// copy lets an early SSH exit interrupt a blocked write.
+	readerCloseErr := reader.Close()
+	writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		_, writeErr := io.Copy(writer, strings.NewReader(password+"\n"))
+		writeDone <- errors.Join(writeErr, writer.Close())
+	}()
+	waitErr := cmd.Wait()
+	// A descendant could retain the inherited read descriptor after SSH exits.
+	// Close our writer so that cannot strand the write goroutine.
+	_ = writer.Close()
+	writeErr := <-writeDone
+	return errors.Join(waitErr, readerCloseErr, writeErr)
+}

+	remaining := b.limit - int64(b.buffer.Len())
+	if remaining > 0 {
+		keep := int64(len(value))
+		if keep > remaining {
+			keep = remaining
+		}
+		_, _ = b.buffer.Write(value[:int(keep)])
+	}
+	if int64(len(value)) > remaining {
+		b.exceeded = true
+	}
+	// Consume excess output without retaining it. The command timeout still
+	// bounds a peer that writes forever, while the parent process stays bounded.
+	return len(value), nil
+}
+
+func (b *captureBuffer) Bytes() []byte {
+	return append([]byte(nil), b.buffer.Bytes()...)
+}
+
+func (b *captureBuffer) Exceeded() bool { return b.exceeded }
+
+func effectiveLimit(configured, fallback int64) int64 {
+	if configured <= 0 {
+		return fallback
+	}
+	return configured
+}
+
+func captureLimitMessage(stdout, stderr *captureBuffer) string {
+	streams := make([]string, 0, 2)
+	if stdout.Exceeded() {
+		streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stdout exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stdout.limit))
+	}
+	if stderr.Exceeded() {
+		streams = append(streams, fmt.Sprintf("stderr exceeded %d-byte capture limit", stderr.limit))
+	}
+	return "fleet transport: remote " + strings.Join(streams, " and ")
+}
+
+func boundedBytes(value []byte, limit int64) []byte {
+	if int64(len(value)) > limit {
+		value = value[:int(limit)]
+	}
+	return append([]byte(nil), value...)
+}
+
+func appendBounded(current, suffix []byte, limit int64) []byte {
+	if int64(len(current)) >= limit {
+		return append([]byte(nil), current...)
+	}
+	available := limit - int64(len(current))
+	if int64(len(suffix)) > available {
+		suffix = suffix[:int(available)]
+	}
+	return append(append([]byte(nil), current...), suffix...)
+}
+
+func localTransportFailure(message string) Result {
+	return Result{ExitCode: 125, Stderr: []byte(message), CaptureError: message, TransportError: message}
+}

224	// NewReport constructs, canonicalizes, and seals a report.
225	func NewReport(profile Profile, generatedAt time.Time, gates []Gate) (Report, error) {
226		report := Report{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Profile: profile, GeneratedAt: generatedAt, Gates: gates}
227		if err := report.Seal(); err != nil {

233	// Seal canonicalizes the report and records a fingerprint over every field
234	// except Fingerprint itself.
235	func (r *Report) Seal() error {
236		if r == nil {
237			return errors.New("seal nil assessment report")
238		}
239		if r.SchemaVersion == 0 {
240			r.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
241		}
242		canonical := r.Canonical()
243		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
244		if err := canonical.validateContent(); err != nil {
245			return err
246		}
247		fingerprint, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
248		if err != nil {
249			return err
250		}
251		canonical.Fingerprint = fingerprint
252		*r = canonical
253		return nil
254	}

256	// Validate verifies the schema, policy invariants, canonical fingerprint, and
257	// deterministic ordering of a sealed report.
258	func (r Report) Validate() error {
259		if err := r.validateContent(); err != nil {
260			return err
261		}
262		if !ValidFingerprint(r.Fingerprint) {
263			return fmt.Errorf("invalid report fingerprint %q", r.Fingerprint)
264		}
265		canonical := r.Canonical()
266		canonical.Fingerprint = ""
267		want, err := canonical.computeFingerprint()
268		if err != nil {
269			return err
270		}
271		if r.Fingerprint != want {
272			return fmt.Errorf("assessment fingerprint mismatch: got %s, want %s", r.Fingerprint, want)
273		}
274		if !reportsEqualOrdering(r, r.Canonical()) {
275			return errors.New("assessment report is not in canonical order")
276		}
277		return nil
278	}

282			return fmt.Errorf("assessment schema_version %d: want %d", r.SchemaVersion, SchemaVersion)
283		}
284		if err := r.Profile.Validate(); err != nil {
285			return err
286		}
287		if r.GeneratedAt.IsZero() {
288			return errors.New("assessment generated_at is required")
289		}
290		seenGates := make(map[string]struct{}, len(r.Gates))
291		for _, gate := range r.Gates {
292			if err := gate.Validate(r.Profile); err != nil {
293				return err
294			}
295			if _, exists := seenGates[gate.Code]; exists {
296				return fmt.Errorf("assessment repeats gate %q", gate.Code)
297			}
298			seenGates[gate.Code] = struct{}{}
299		}
300		return nil
301	}

303	// Canonical returns a deep copy with UTC timestamps and order-insensitive
304	// collections sorted by their complete stable representation.
305	func (r Report) Canonical() Report {
306		result := r
307		result.GeneratedAt = canonicalTime(result.GeneratedAt)
308		result.Gates = make([]Gate, len(r.Gates))
309		copy(result.Gates, r.Gates)
310		for gateIndex := range result.Gates {
311			gate := &result.Gates[gateIndex]
312			gate.Sources = append([]Source(nil), gate.Sources...)
313			for sourceIndex := range gate.Sources {
314				gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt = canonicalTime(gate.Sources[sourceIndex].ObservedAt)
315			}
316			sort.Slice(gate.Sources, func(i, j int) bool {
317				left, right := gate.Sources[i], gate.Sources[j]
318				return strings.Join([]string{left.ID, string(left.Authority), string(left.Freshness), string(left.Completeness), left.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), left.Fingerprint}, "\x00") <
319					strings.Join([]string{right.ID, string(right.Authority), string(right.Freshness), string(right.Completeness), right.ObservedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), right.Fingerprint}, "\x00")
320			})
321			gate.Reasons = append([]Reason(nil), gate.Reasons...)
322			sort.Slice(gate.Reasons, func(i, j int) bool {
323				left, right := gate.Reasons[i], gate.Reasons[j]
324				return strings.Join([]string{left.Code, left.Subject, left.Detail, left.Remediation}, "\x00") <
325					strings.Join([]string{right.Code, right.Subject, right.Detail, right.Remediation}, "\x00")
326			})
327		}
328		sort.Slice(result.Gates, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Gates[i].Code < result.Gates[j].Code })
329		return result
330	}
331
332	func (r Report) computeFingerprint() (string, error) {
333		payload := struct {
334			SchemaVersion int       `json:"schema_version"`
335			Profile       Profile   `json:"profile"`
336			GeneratedAt   time.Time `json:"generated_at"`
337			Gates         []Gate    `json:"gates"`
338		}{r.SchemaVersion, r.Profile, r.GeneratedAt, r.Gates}
339		encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
340		if err != nil {
341			return "", fmt.Errorf("encode assessment fingerprint: %w", err)
342		}
343		return FingerprintBytes(encoded), nil
344	}
345
346	// Decode reads exactly one strict schema-v1 report and verifies its seal.
347	func Decode(reader io.Reader) (Report, error) {
348		if reader == nil {
349			return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment from nil reader")
350		}
351		decoder := json.NewDecoder(reader)
352		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
353		var report Report
354		if err := decoder.Decode(&report); err != nil {
355			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment: %w", err)
356		}
357		var extra any
358		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
359			if err == nil {
360				return Report{}, errors.New("decode assessment: multiple JSON values")
361			}
362			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("decode assessment trailing data: %w", err)
363		}
364		if err := report.Validate(); err != nil {
365			return Report{}, err
366		}
367		return report, nil
368	}
369
370	func FingerprintBytes(value []byte) string {
371		digest := sha256.Sum256(value)
372		return fingerprintPrefix + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
373	}
374
375	func ValidFingerprint(value string) bool {
376		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix) || len(value) != len(fingerprintPrefix)+sha256.Size*2 {
377			return false
378		}
379		digest := strings.TrimPrefix(value, fingerprintPrefix)
380		if digest != strings.ToLower(digest) {
381			return false
382		}
383		decoded, err := hex.DecodeString(digest)
384		return err == nil && len(decoded) == sha256.Size
385	}
386
387	func validateText(name, value string, required bool) error {
388		if value == "" {
389			if required {
390				return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", name)
391			}
392			return nil
393		}
394		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
395			return fmt.Errorf("%s is not valid UTF-8", name)
396		}
397		if value != strings.TrimSpace(value) {
398			return fmt.Errorf("%s must be trimmed", name)
399		}
400		for _, char := range value {
401			if unicode.IsControl(char) {
402				return fmt.Errorf("%s contains a control character", name)
403			}
404		}
405		return nil
406	}
407
408	func canonicalTime(value time.Time) time.Time {
409		if value.IsZero() {
410			return value
411		}
412		return value.Round(0).UTC()
413	}
414
415	func reportsEqualOrdering(left, right Report) bool {
416		leftJSON, leftErr := json.Marshal(left)
417		rightJSON, rightErr := json.Marshal(right)
418		return leftErr == nil && rightErr == nil && string(leftJSON) == string(rightJSON)
419	}

1	package assessment

3	import "fmt"

5	// ReduceOutcomes combines independent requirements using the fail-closed
6	// precedence blocked > indeterminate > eligible > not-applicable. No evidence
7	// is itself indeterminate.
8	func ReduceOutcomes(outcomes ...Outcome) Outcome {
9		if len(outcomes) == 0 {
10			return OutcomeIndeterminate
11		}
12		result := OutcomeNotApplicable
13		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
14			switch outcome {
15			case OutcomeBlocked:
16				return OutcomeBlocked
17			case OutcomeIndeterminate:
18				result = OutcomeIndeterminate
19			case OutcomeEligible:
20				if result == OutcomeNotApplicable {
21					result = OutcomeEligible
22				}
23			case OutcomeNotApplicable:
24			default:
25				return OutcomeIndeterminate
26			}
27		}
28		return result
29	}
30
31	// Reduce applies source-quality policy after reducing requirement outcomes.
32	// Cheap reports retain the observed result for display. Deep reports downgrade
33	// any conclusive result to indeterminate unless every relied-on source is fresh,
34	// complete, and backed by a live authority.
35	func Reduce(profile Profile, sources []Source, outcomes ...Outcome) (Outcome, error) {
36		if err := profile.Validate(); err != nil {
37			return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
38		}
39		for _, outcome := range outcomes {
40			if err := outcome.Validate(); err != nil {
41				return OutcomeIndeterminate, err
42			}
43		}
44		for _, source := range sources {
45			if err := source.Validate(); err != nil {
46				return OutcomeIndeterminate, fmt.Errorf("reduce assessment source: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		result := ReduceOutcomes(outcomes...)
50		if result == OutcomeNotApplicable || result == OutcomeIndeterminate {
51			return result, nil
52		}
53		if len(sources) == 0 {
54			return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
55		}
56		if profile == ProfileDeep {
57			for _, source := range sources {
58				if !source.conclusive() {
59					return OutcomeIndeterminate, nil
60				}
61			}
62		}
63		return result, nil
64	}

301	// Build joins live local facts with optional external observations. It performs
302	// no probes and never places raw Git endpoints in the returned report.
303	func Build(input BuildInput) (Report, error) {
304		now := input.GeneratedAt
305		if now.IsZero() {
306			now = time.Now().UTC()
307		}
308		now = now.Round(0).UTC()
309
310		report := Report{
311			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion,
312			GeneratedAt:   now,
313			Repository: Repository{
314				Name: input.Context.Repo.Name, Display: input.Context.Repo.Display(),
315				Path: input.Context.Repo.Path, RealPath: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.RealPath),
316				CommonDir: optionalString(input.Context.Repo.CommonDir),
317				Bare:      input.Context.Repo.Bare, HasGit: input.Context.Repo.HasGit,
318			},
319			Sources:      []Source{},
320			Capabilities: []Capability{},
321			Remotes:      []Remote{},
322			Errors:       []CollectionError{},
323		}
324
325		report.Local = buildLocalFacts(input, &report.Errors)
326		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(report.Local.Checkouts) {
327			checkout := report.Local.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout]
328			report.SelectedCheckout = &CheckoutSelection{
329				Index: checkout.Index, Path: checkout.Path, Branch: checkout.Branch,
330				Canonical: checkout.Canonical, Ownership: checkout.Ownership,
331			}
332		} else {
333			message := "selected checkout is not present in the local checkout inventory"
334			if input.SelectionErr != nil {
335				message = cleanError(input.SelectionErr)
336			}
337			report.Errors = append(report.Errors, CollectionError{
338				Code: "selection-unavailable", Scope: "local", Subject: "selected-checkout", Message: message,
339			})
340		}
341
342		localIdentities := privateRemoteIdentities(input.Topology)
343		report.Remotes, report.Forge, report.Errors = buildRemoteFacts(now, input, report.Errors)
344		report.Fleet, report.Errors = buildFleetFacts(now, input.Fleet, localIdentities, report.Errors)
345
346		sources := buildSources(now, input, report)
347		report.Sources = sources
348		report.Capabilities = buildCapabilities(input, report)
349
350		readiness := AssessLocal(input.Context, input.SelectedCheckout, input.Hostname)
351		sourceMap := make(map[string]assessment.Source, len(sources))
352		for _, source := range sources {
353			sourceMap[source.ID] = source.assessmentSource()
354		}
355		gates := []assessment.Gate{
356			readinessGate("checkout-readiness", readiness.Checkout, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.checkout")),
357			readinessGate("task-readiness", readiness.Task, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.tasks", "local.runtime")),
358			readinessGate("worktree-readiness", readiness.Worktree, sourcesNamed(sourceMap, "local.worktrees", "local.runtime")),
359			{
360				Code: "whole-clone-eviction", Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate,
361				Reasons: []assessment.Reason{{
362					Code: "recovery-proof-unavailable", Subject: "repository",
363					Detail:      "whole-clone eviction is not assessed by the context profile",
364					Remediation: "create and restore-verify a recovery receipt before eviction",
365				}},
366			},
367		}
368		assessmentReport, err := assessment.NewReport(assessment.ProfileCheap, now, gates)
369		if err != nil {
370			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("seal repository context assessment: %w", err)
371		}
372		report.Assessment = assessmentReport
373
374		sort.Slice(report.Errors, func(i, j int) bool {
375			left, right := report.Errors[i], report.Errors[j]
376			return strings.Join([]string{left.Scope, left.Code, left.Subject, left.Message}, "\x00") <
377				strings.Join([]string{right.Scope, right.Code, right.Subject, right.Message}, "\x00")
378		})
379		return report, nil
380	}

382	func buildLocalFacts(input BuildInput, reportErrors *[]CollectionError) LocalFacts {
383		context := input.Context
384		local := LocalFacts{
385			Checkouts:                          make([]CheckoutFacts, 0, len(context.Checkouts)),
386			OtherTasks:                         []TaskFacts{},
387			ObservedLinkedWorktreeAdminEntries: context.WorktreeCount,
388			CheckoutsComplete:                  context.WorktreeErr == nil,
389			TaskInventoryComplete:              context.TaskErr == nil,
390			Runtimes:                           []RuntimeFacts{},
391		}
392		if context.WorktreeErr == nil {
393			count := context.WorktreeCount
394			local.LinkedWorktreeCount = &count
395		} else {
396			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("worktree-inventory-failed", "local", "worktrees", context.WorktreeErr))
397		}
398		if context.TaskErr != nil {
399			*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-inventory-failed", "local", "tasks", context.TaskErr))
400		}
401
402		for index, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
403			facts := CheckoutFacts{
404				Index: index, Path: checkout.Worktree.Path, Canonical: index == 0,
405				Ownership: checkout.Ownership, Locked: checkout.Worktree.Locked,
406				LockedReason:   optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)),
407				Prunable:       checkout.Worktree.Prunable,
408				PrunableReason: optionalString(strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)),
409				Branch:         optionalString(checkout.Branch()), Head: optionalString(checkout.Worktree.Head),
410				LastActivity: optionalTime(checkout.LastActivity), LastCommit: optionalTime(checkout.LastCommit),
411				LastSubject: optionalString(checkout.LastSubject), Sessions: []RuntimeSession{}, Tasks: []TaskFacts{},
412			}
413			switch {
414			case checkout.PathErr != nil:
415				facts.State = "error"
416				facts.PathError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.PathErr))
417				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-path-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.PathErr))
418			case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
419				facts.State = "missing"
420				exists := false
421				facts.Exists = &exists
422			case checkout.Worktree.Bare || index == 0 && context.Repo.Bare:
423				facts.State = "bare"
424				exists := true
425				facts.Exists = &exists
426				detached := false
427				facts.Detached = &detached
428			case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
429				facts.State = "error"
430				exists := true
431				facts.Exists = &exists
432				facts.StatusError = optionalString(cleanError(checkout.StatusErr))
433				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("checkout-status-probe-failed", "local", checkoutSubject(index), checkout.StatusErr))
434			default:
435				facts.State = "available"
436				exists := true
437				facts.Exists = &exists
438				status := checkout.Status
439				facts.Status = &status
440				detached := checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached
441				facts.Detached = &detached
442			}
443			for _, tracked := range checkout.Tasks {
444				facts.Tasks = append(facts.Tasks, taskFacts(tracked))
445				if tracked != nil {
446					if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
447						*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
448					}
449				}
450			}
451			local.Checkouts = append(local.Checkouts, facts)
452		}
453		for _, tracked := range context.OtherTasks {
454			local.OtherTasks = append(local.OtherTasks, taskFacts(tracked))
455			if tracked != nil {
456				if err := tracked.Validate(); err != nil {
457					*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("task-record-invalid", "local", "task", err))
458				}
459			}
460		}
461
462		runtimes := input.Runtimes
463		if len(runtimes) == 0 && (context.Runtime != "" || context.RuntimeErr != nil || len(context.Sessions()) > 0) {
464			runtimes = []RuntimeInput{{
465				Backend: context.Runtime, Available: context.RuntimeErr == nil,
466				Sessions: context.Sessions(), Err: context.RuntimeErr,
467			}}
468		}
469		for runtimeIndex, observed := range runtimes {
470			backend := strings.TrimSpace(observed.Backend)
471			if backend == "" {
472				backend = fmt.Sprintf("unknown-%d", runtimeIndex+1)
473			}
474			runtimeFacts := RuntimeFacts{
475				Backend: backend, Available: observed.Available,
476				SourceID: "local.runtime", Sessions: []RuntimeSession{},
477			}
478			if observed.Err != nil {
479				runtimeFacts.Error = optionalString(cleanError(observed.Err))
480				*reportErrors = append(*reportErrors, collectionError("runtime-inventory-failed", "local", "runtime:"+safeIdentifier(backend), observed.Err))
481			}
482			for _, session := range observed.Sessions {
483				indices := sessionCheckoutIndices(context, session)
484				if len(indices) == 0 {
485					continue
486				}
487				projected := RuntimeSession{
488					Backend: backend, Handle: session.Handle, Label: optionalString(session.Label),
489					AgentStatus:   optionalString(session.AgentStatus),
490					AgentSessions: append([]string{}, session.AgentSessions...),
491					Focused:       session.Focused, Checkouts: indices,
492				}
493				sort.Strings(projected.AgentSessions)
494				runtimeFacts.Sessions = append(runtimeFacts.Sessions, projected)
495				for _, checkoutIndex := range indices {
496					if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(local.Checkouts) {
497						local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions = append(local.Checkouts[checkoutIndex].Sessions, projected)
498					}
499				}
500			}
501			sortRuntimeSessions(runtimeFacts.Sessions)
502			local.Runtimes = append(local.Runtimes, runtimeFacts)
503		}
504		sort.Slice(local.Runtimes, func(i, j int) bool { return local.Runtimes[i].Backend < local.Runtimes[j].Backend })
505		for index := range local.Checkouts {
506			sortRuntimeSessions(local.Checkouts[index].Sessions)
507		}
508		return local
509	}

511	func buildRemoteFacts(now time.Time, input BuildInput, reportErrors []CollectionError) ([]Remote, ForgeFacts, []CollectionError) {
512		forgeFacts := ForgeFacts{Error: optionalError(input.Forge.Err)}
513		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
514			sourceID := "forge.inventory"
515			forgeFacts.SourceID = &sourceID
516			records := len(input.Forge.Records)
517			forgeFacts.RecordsConsidered = &records
518			complete := input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete
519			forgeFacts.Complete = &complete
520		} else if input.Forge.Err != nil {
521			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-unavailable", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
522		}
523		if input.Forge.Err != nil && !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() {
524			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("forge-inventory-partial", "forge", "inventory", input.Forge.Err))
525		}
526		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
527			reportErrors = append(reportErrors, collectionError("remote-topology-failed", "local", "remotes", input.TopologyErr))
528			if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
529				zero := 0
530				forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &zero
531			}
532			return []Remote{}, forgeFacts, reportErrors
533		}
534
535		recordsByIdentity := forgeRecordsByIdentity(input.Forge.Records)
536		currentUpstream := ""
537		if input.SelectedCheckout >= 0 && input.SelectedCheckout < len(input.Context.Checkouts) {
538			status := input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].Status
539			if input.Context.Checkouts[input.SelectedCheckout].StatusErr == nil && status.Upstream != "" {
540				currentUpstream, _, _ = strings.Cut(status.Upstream, "/")
541			}
542		}
543		matchedRecords := map[string]struct{}{}
544		remotes := make([]Remote, 0, len(input.Topology.Remotes))
545		for _, observed := range input.Topology.Remotes {
546			remote := Remote{Name: observed.Name, Roles: remoteRoles(observed.Name, currentUpstream), Fetch: []RemoteEndpoint{}, Push: []RemoteEndpoint{}}
547			for index, raw := range observed.FetchURLs {
548				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
549				remote.Fetch = append(remote.Fetch, endpoint)
550				for _, key := range matched {
551					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
552				}
553				if endpointErr != nil {
554					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
555						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.fetch.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
556					})
557				}
558			}
559			for index, raw := range observed.PushURLs {
560				endpoint, matched, endpointErr := buildRemoteEndpoint(raw, recordsByIdentity, forgeFacts.SourceID != nil, input.Forge.Authority == assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive && input.Forge.Freshness == assessment.FreshnessFresh && input.Forge.Completeness == assessment.CompletenessComplete)
561				remote.Push = append(remote.Push, endpoint)
562				for _, key := range matched {
563					matchedRecords[key] = struct{}{}
564				}
565				if endpointErr != nil {
566					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{
567						Code: endpointErr.Code, Scope: "remote", Subject: fmt.Sprintf("%s.push.%d", safeIdentifier(observed.Name), index), Message: endpointErr.Message,
568					})
569				}
570			}
571			remotes = append(remotes, remote)
572		}
573		if forgeFacts.SourceID != nil {
574			matches := len(matchedRecords)
575			forgeFacts.MatchingRecords = &matches
576		}
577		return remotes, forgeFacts, reportErrors
578	}
579
580	type endpointBuildError struct {
581		Code    string
582		Message string
583	}
584
585	func buildRemoteEndpoint(raw string, records map[string][]forge.RemoteRepo, forgeAvailable, exactForge bool) (RemoteEndpoint, []string, *endpointBuildError) {
586		transport, displayIdentity, displayOK := publicEndpointIdentity(raw)
587		forgeMatch := "unavailable"
588		if forgeAvailable {
589			forgeMatch = "none"
590		}
591		endpoint := RemoteEndpoint{Transport: transport, Identity: optionalString(displayIdentity), ForgeMatch: forgeMatch}
592		privateIdentity := privateRemoteIdentity(raw)
593		if !displayOK {
594			message := "endpoint has no display-safe cross-host identity"
595			endpoint.Error = &message
596			return endpoint, nil, &endpointBuildError{Code: "remote-identity-unavailable", Message: message}
597		}
598
599		candidates := dedupeForgeRecords(records[privateIdentity])
600		var exact *forge.RemoteRepo
601		matched := []string{}
602		switch len(candidates) {
603		case 1:
604			if exactForge {
605				exact = &candidates[0]
606			}
607			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "exact"
608			matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidates[0]))
609		case 0:
610			if forgeAvailable {
611				endpoint.ForgeMatch = "none"
612			}
613		default:
614			endpoint.ForgeMatch = "ambiguous"
615			message := fmt.Sprintf("normalized endpoint identity matches %d forge records", len(candidates))
616			endpoint.Error = &message
617			for _, candidate := range candidates {
618				matched = append(matched, forgeRecordKey(candidate))
619			}
620			if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw}); ok {
621				endpoint.WebURL = &web
622			}
623			return endpoint, matched, &endpointBuildError{Code: "forge-match-ambiguous", Message: message}
624		}
625		if web, ok := forge.DeriveWebURL(forge.WebURLRequest{Remote: raw, Exact: exact}); ok {
626			endpoint.WebURL = &web
627		}
628		return endpoint, matched, nil
629	}
