631	func buildFleetFacts(now time.Time, input FleetInput, localIdentities map[string]struct{}, reportErrors []CollectionError) (FleetFacts, []CollectionError) {
632		facts := FleetFacts{Coverage: FleetCoverageConfiguredHostsOnly, Hosts: []FleetHostObservation{}, Error: optionalError(input.Err)}
633		if !input.Configured {
634			if input.Err == nil {
635				facts.Error = optionalString("fleet configuration was not collected")
636			}
637			if facts.Error != nil {
638				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-config-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "configuration", Message: *facts.Error})
639			}
640			return facts, reportErrors
641		}
642		count := len(input.ConfiguredHostNames)
643		facts.ConfiguredHosts = &count
644		results := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
645		for _, result := range input.Results {
646			if _, exists := results[result.Name]; !exists {
647				results[result.Name] = result
648			}
649		}
650		for index, name := range input.ConfiguredHostNames {
651			result, found := results[name]
652			if !found {
653				result = fleet.HostResult{Name: name, State: fleet.HostUnreachable, Error: "configured host produced no observation"}
654			}
655			host := FleetHostObservation{
656				Name: name, State: result.State, CachedAt: optionalTimeValue(result.CachedAt),
657				Match: FleetMatchUnavailable, Repositories: []FleetRepository{}, Error: optionalString(cleanText(result.Error)),
658			}
659			if result.Snapshot != nil {
660				matches := matchingFleetRepositories(result.Snapshot.Repositories, localIdentities)
661				for _, matched := range matches {
662					host.Repositories = append(host.Repositories, fleetRepositoryFacts(matched))
663				}
664				switch {
665				case len(localIdentities) == 0:
666					host.Match = FleetMatchUnavailable
667					if host.Error == nil {
668						host.Error = optionalString("local repository has no normalized remote identity")
669					}
670				case len(matches) == 0:
671					host.Match = FleetMatchNotFound
672				case len(matches) == 1:
673					host.Match = FleetMatchExact
674				default:
675					host.Match = FleetMatchAmbiguous
676					message := fmt.Sprintf("%d repositories on this host share a local normalized remote identity", len(matches))
677					if host.Error == nil {
678						host.Error = &message
679					}
680					reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-match-ambiguous", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: message})
681				}
682
683				observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
684				if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
685					observedAt = *result.CachedAt
686				}
687				if !observedAt.IsZero() {
688					sourceID := fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index)
689					host.SourceID = &sourceID
690				}
691			}
692			if result.Error != "" || result.Snapshot == nil {
693				message := result.Error
694				if message == "" {
695					message = "host produced no repository snapshot"
696				}
697				reportErrors = append(reportErrors, CollectionError{Code: "fleet-host-unavailable", Scope: "fleet", Subject: "host:" + safeIdentifier(name), Message: cleanText(message)})
698			}
699			facts.Hosts = append(facts.Hosts, host)
700		}
701		return facts, reportErrors
702	}
703
704	func buildSources(now time.Time, input BuildInput, report Report) []Source {
705		sources := []Source{}
706		selectedFacts := any(nil)
707		checkoutCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessUnknown
708		if report.SelectedCheckout != nil {
709			selectedFacts = report.Local.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
710			checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessComplete
711			selected := input.Context.Checkouts[report.SelectedCheckout.Index]
712			if selected.PathErr != nil || selected.StatusErr != nil {
713				checkoutCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
714			}
715		}
716		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.checkout", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, checkoutCompleteness, now, now, selectedFacts))
717
718		taskCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
719		if input.Context.TaskErr != nil {
720			taskCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
721		}
722		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.tasks", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, taskCompleteness, now, now, struct {
723			Checkouts  []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
724			OtherTasks []TaskFacts     `json:"other_tasks"`
725		}{report.Local.Checkouts, report.Local.OtherTasks}))
726
727		worktreeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
728		if input.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
729			worktreeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
730		}
731		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.worktrees", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, worktreeCompleteness, now, now, struct {
732			Count     *int            `json:"count"`
733			Checkouts []CheckoutFacts `json:"checkouts"`
734		}{report.Local.LinkedWorktreeCount, report.Local.Checkouts}))
735
736		runtimeCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
737		if len(report.Local.Runtimes) == 0 {
738			runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
739		}
740		for _, observed := range report.Local.Runtimes {
741			if observed.Error != nil {
742				runtimeCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
743			}
744		}
745		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.runtime", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, runtimeCompleteness, now, now, report.Local.Runtimes))
746
747		remoteCompleteness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
748		if input.TopologyErr != nil {
749			remoteCompleteness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
750		}
751		sources = append(sources, newSource("local.remotes", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, remoteCompleteness, now, now, report.Remotes))
752
753		if input.Fleet.Configured {
754			sources = append(sources, newSource("local.fleet-config", assessment.AuthorityLocalLive, assessment.FreshnessFresh, assessment.CompletenessComplete, now, now, input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames))
755		}
756		if !input.Forge.ObservedAt.IsZero() && input.Forge.Authority != "" {
757			freshness := input.Forge.Freshness
758			if freshness == "" {
759				freshness = assessment.FreshnessUnknown
760			}
761			completeness := input.Forge.Completeness
762			if completeness == "" {
763				completeness = assessment.CompletenessUnknown
764			}
765			sources = append(sources, newSource("forge.inventory", input.Forge.Authority, freshness, completeness, input.Forge.ObservedAt, now, struct {
766				Remotes []Remote   `json:"remotes"`
767				Forge   ForgeFacts `json:"forge"`
768			}{report.Remotes, report.Forge}))
769		}
770		resultByName := map[string]fleet.HostResult{}
771		for _, result := range input.Fleet.Results {
772			resultByName[result.Name] = result
773		}
774		for index, name := range input.Fleet.ConfiguredHostNames {
775			result, ok := resultByName[name]
776			if !ok || result.Snapshot == nil || index >= len(report.Fleet.Hosts) {
777				continue
778			}
779			observedAt := result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt
780			if observedAt.IsZero() && result.CachedAt != nil {
781				observedAt = *result.CachedAt
782			}
783			if observedAt.IsZero() {
784				continue
785			}
786			authority := assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive
787			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
788			if result.FromCache {
789				authority = assessment.AuthorityCache
790				if input.Fleet.CacheTTL > 0 && now.Sub(observedAt) > input.Fleet.CacheTTL {
791					freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
792				}
793			}
794			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
795			if result.Error != "" || result.State != fleet.HostOK && !result.FromCache {
796				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
797			}
798			sources = append(sources, newSource(fmt.Sprintf("fleet.host.%d", index), authority, freshness, completeness, observedAt, now, report.Fleet.Hosts[index]))
799		}
800		sort.Slice(sources, func(i, j int) bool { return sources[i].ID < sources[j].ID })
801		return sources
802	}
803
804	func buildCapabilities(input BuildInput, report Report) []Capability {
805		capabilities := []Capability{}
806		localState := CapabilityAvailable
807		if input.TopologyErr != nil || input.Context.WorktreeErr != nil {
808			localState = CapabilityPartial
809		}
810		for _, checkout := range input.Context.Checkouts {
811			if checkout.PathErr != nil || checkout.StatusErr != nil {
812				localState = CapabilityPartial
813			}
814		}
815		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{Code: "local-git", State: localState, SourceIDs: []string{"local.checkout", "local.worktrees", "local.remotes"}})
816
817		taskState := CapabilityAvailable
818		if input.Context.TaskErr != nil {
819			taskState = CapabilityPartial
820		}
821		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{Code: "task-inventory", State: taskState, SourceIDs: []string{"local.tasks"}})
822
823		runtimeState := CapabilityAvailable
824		if len(report.Local.Runtimes) == 0 {
825			runtimeState = CapabilityUnavailable
826		}
827		for _, observed := range report.Local.Runtimes {
828			if observed.Error != nil {
829				runtimeState = CapabilityPartial
830			}
831		}
832		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{Code: "runtime-inventory", State: runtimeState, SourceIDs: []string{"local.runtime"}})
833
834		forgeCapability := Capability{Code: "forge-inventory", State: CapabilityUnavailable, SourceIDs: []string{}}
835		if report.Forge.SourceID != nil {
836			forgeCapability.State = CapabilityAvailable
837			forgeCapability.SourceIDs = []string{*report.Forge.SourceID}
838			if input.Forge.Err != nil || input.Forge.Completeness != assessment.CompletenessComplete {
839				forgeCapability.State = CapabilityPartial
840			}
841		}
842		if report.Forge.Error != nil {
843			forgeCapability.Detail = *report.Forge.Error
844		}
845		capabilities = append(capabilities, forgeCapability)
846
847		fleetCapability := Capability{Code: "fleet-inventory", State: CapabilityUnavailable, SourceIDs: []string{}}
848		if input.Fleet.Configured {
849			fleetCapability.State = CapabilityAvailable
850			fleetCapability.SourceIDs = []string{"local.fleet-config"}
851			for _, host := range report.Fleet.Hosts {
852				if host.SourceID != nil {
853					fleetCapability.SourceIDs = append(fleetCapability.SourceIDs, *host.SourceID)
854				}
855				if host.Error != nil || host.SourceID == nil {
856					fleetCapability.State = CapabilityPartial
857				}
858			}
859		}
860		if report.Fleet.Error != nil {
861			fleetCapability.Detail = *report.Fleet.Error
862		}
863		capabilities = append(capabilities, fleetCapability)
864		capabilities = append(capabilities, Capability{
865			Code: "whole-clone-eviction", State: CapabilityNotImplemented, SourceIDs: []string{},

969	func publicEndpointIdentity(raw string) (transport, identity string, ok bool) {
970		if !utf8.ValidString(raw) || containsControl(raw) {
971			return "unknown", "", false
972		}
973		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
974		if trimmed == "" {
975			return "unknown", "", false
976		}
977		redacted := trimmed
978		if parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
979			transport = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
980			parsed.User = nil
981			parsed.RawQuery = ""
982			parsed.ForceQuery = false
983			parsed.Fragment = ""
984			redacted = parsed.String()
985		} else {
986			if index := strings.IndexAny(redacted, "?#"); index >= 0 {
987				redacted = redacted[:index]
988			}
989			colon := strings.IndexByte(redacted, ':')
990			at := strings.LastIndexByte(redacted, '@')
991			if at >= 0 && colon > at {
992				transport = "ssh"
993				redacted = "git@" + redacted[at+1:]
994			} else if filepath.IsAbs(redacted) || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(redacted, "~") {
995				transport = "local"
996			} else {
997				transport = "unknown"
998			}
999		}
1000		identity = catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(redacted)
1001		if identity == "" || containsControl(identity) {
1002			return transport, "", false
1003		}
1004		return transport, identity, true
1005	}

1118	// cleanText removes controls and structurally redacts URL/scp-like tokens while
1119	// preserving enough of an error to diagnose which probe failed.
1120	func cleanText(value string) string {
1121		value = strings.Map(func(r rune) rune {
1122			if unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) {
1123				return ' '
1124			}
1125			return r
1126		}, value)
1127		fields := strings.Fields(value)
1128		for index, field := range fields {
1129			fields[index] = redactTextToken(field)
1130		}
1131		return strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(fields, " "))
1132	}
1133
1134	func redactTextToken(token string) string {
1135		prefix := strings.TrimLeft(token, "([{<\"'")
1136		leading := token[:len(token)-len(prefix)]
1137		core := strings.TrimRight(prefix, ")]}>\"',;.")
1138		trailing := prefix[len(core):]
1139		if parsed, err := url.Parse(core); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" && parsed.Host != "" {
1140			parsed.User = nil
1141			parsed.RawQuery = ""
1142			parsed.ForceQuery = false
1143			parsed.Fragment = ""
1144			return leading + parsed.String() + trailing
1145		}
1146		colon := strings.IndexByte(core, ':')
1147		at := strings.LastIndexByte(core, '@')
1148		if at > 0 && (colon > at || strings.Contains(core[:at], ":")) {
1149			core = "[redacted]@" + core[at+1:]
1150			if query := strings.IndexAny(core, "?#"); query >= 0 {
1151				core = core[:query]
1152			}
1153		}
1154		return leading + core + trailing
1155	}
1156
1157	func containsControl(value string) bool {
1158		return strings.IndexFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
1159			return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
1160		}) >= 0
1161	}
1162
1163	func safeIdentifier(value string) string {
1164		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
1165		var b strings.Builder
1166		lastDash := false
1167		for _, r := range value {
1168			if r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' {
1169				b.WriteRune(r)
1170				lastDash = false
1171			} else if !lastDash {
1172				b.WriteByte('-')
1173				lastDash = true
1174			}
1175		}
1176		result := strings.Trim(b.String(), "-")
1177		if result == "" {
1178			return "unknown"
1179		}
1180		return result
1181	}
1182

47	func assessCheckout(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int) Readiness {
48		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
49			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the selected checkout is absent from the local inventory", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
50		}
51		checkout := context.Checkouts[selectedIndex]
52		switch {
53		case checkout.Worktree.Bare || context.Repo.Bare:
54			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
55		case checkout.PathErr != nil:
56			return indeterminate("checkout-path-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path could not be inspected", "restore path access and rerun context")
57		case !checkout.Exists || checkout.Worktree.Prunable:
58			return blocked("checkout-missing", "selected-checkout", "the checkout path is missing or prunable", "repair or remove the stale worktree registration")
59		case checkout.StatusErr != nil:
60			return indeterminate("checkout-status-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "Git status could not be collected", "repair the checkout and rerun context")
61		case checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached || checkout.Branch() == "":
62			return blocked("checkout-detached", "selected-checkout", "the checkout does not have an attached branch", "check out an explicit branch")
63		case checkout.Status.Conflicted > 0:
64			return blocked("checkout-conflicted", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d unmerged path(s)", checkout.Status.Conflicted), "resolve the Git operation before transfer or retirement")
65		case checkout.Status.Dirty():
66			return blocked("checkout-dirty", "selected-checkout", fmt.Sprintf("the checkout has %d changed path(s)", checkout.Status.Changed), "commit or deliberately preserve the changes")
67		default:
68			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
69		}
70	}

72	func assessTasks(context inventory.RepoContext, selectedIndex int, hostname string) Readiness {
73		if context.TaskErr != nil {
74			return indeterminate("task-inventory-unavailable", "task-inventory", "task records could not be collected", "repair the task store and rerun context")
75		}
76		if selectedIndex < 0 || selectedIndex >= len(context.Checkouts) {
77			return indeterminate("checkout-selection-unavailable", "selected-checkout", "task scope cannot be selected without a checkout", "rerun context from an existing checkout")
78		}
79		// Transfer/repository readiness covers every non-DONE task attached to the
80		// clone, including cold and branch-only records without a local checkout.
81		// Looking only at the selected checkout can otherwise hide another machine's
82		// ownership claim and incorrectly report not-applicable.
83		active := make([]*task.Task, 0, len(context.OtherTasks)+len(context.Checkouts[selectedIndex].Tasks))
84		sessionCount := map[string]int{}
85		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
86		add := func(candidate *task.Task, sessions int) {
87			if candidate == nil || candidate.State == task.Done {
88				return
89			}
90			if _, exists := seen[candidate.ID]; exists {
91				return
92			}
93			seen[candidate.ID] = struct{}{}
94			active = append(active, candidate)
95			sessionCount[candidate.ID] = sessions
96		}
97		for _, checkout := range context.Checkouts {
98			for _, candidate := range checkout.Tasks {
99				add(candidate, len(checkout.Sessions))
100			}
101		}
102		for _, candidate := range context.OtherTasks {
103			add(candidate, 0)
104		}
105		if len(active) == 0 {
106			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeNotApplicable}
107		}
108		var reasons []assessment.Reason
109		hasIndeterminate := false
110		for _, candidate := range active {
111			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
112				hasIndeterminate = true
113				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
114					Code: "task-record-invalid", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task record is invalid",
115					Remediation: "repair or recreate the task record",
116				})
117				continue
118			}
119			if hostname != "" && candidate.Owner != "" && candidate.Owner != hostname {
120				reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
121					Code: "task-owned-elsewhere", Subject: "task", Detail: "a selected task is owned by another machine",
122					Remediation: "complete an explicit ownership handoff before writing",
123				})
124			}
125			if candidate.State == task.Hot {
126				if context.RuntimeErr != nil {
127					hasIndeterminate = true
128					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
129						Code: "runtime-inventory-unavailable", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task cannot be checked against live runtime state",
130						Remediation: "restore runtime inspection and rerun context",
131					})
132				} else if sessionCount[candidate.ID] == 0 {
133					reasons = append(reasons, assessment.Reason{
134						Code: "hot-task-runtime-missing", Subject: "task", Detail: "a HOT task has no observed runtime session",
135						Remediation: "resume the task or reconcile its lifecycle state",
136					})
137				}
138			}
139		}
140		if hasReason(reasons, "task-owned-elsewhere") || hasReason(reasons, "hot-task-runtime-missing") {
141			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeBlocked, Reasons: reasons}
142		}
143		if hasIndeterminate {
144			return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeIndeterminate, Reasons: reasons}
145		}
146		return Readiness{Outcome: assessment.OutcomeEligible}
147	}

 // normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
 // paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
 // also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
 // is not sufficient.
 func normalizePath(path string) string {
    clean := filepath.Clean(path)
    cur := clean
    for {
        if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
            rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
            if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
                return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
            }
            return filepath.Clean(real)
        }
        parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
        if parent == cur {
            return clean
        }
        cur = parent
    }
 }

100	// directory under a nested linked worktree never resolves to the canonical
101	// checkout merely because that checkout is its lexical parent.
102	func (c RepoContext) CheckoutIndexForPath(path string) (int, bool) {
103		best, bestLen := -1, -1

140	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository with
141	// commit/activity enrichment enabled.
142	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,

150	func CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
151		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string, options RepoContextOptions) RepoContext {
152
153		out := RepoContext{Repo: r, Runtime: runtimeName}
154		mainExists, mainPathErr := pathIsDir(r.Path)

158		}
159		if r.Bare {
160			main.Worktree.Bare = true
161		} else {

163			main.Worktree.Branch = main.Status.Branch
164			main.Worktree.Detached = main.Status.Detached
165			if options.IncludeActivity {
166				main.LastActivity, main.LastCommit, main.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, r.Path, main.Status)
167			}
168		}
169		out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, main)
170
171		out.WorktreeCount, out.WorktreeErr = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
172		if out.WorktreeErr == nil && out.WorktreeCount > 0 {
173			worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
174			if err != nil {
175				out.WorktreeErr = err
176			} else {
177				out.WorktreeCount = 0
178				for _, w := range worktrees {
179					if w.Main {
180						continue
181					}
182					exists, pathErr := pathIsDir(w.Path)
183					checkout := RepoCheckout{
184						Worktree: w, Exists: exists, PathErr: pathErr, Ownership: CheckoutExternal,
185					}
186					if IsEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
187						checkout.Ownership = CheckoutEphemeral

189					out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)

193		}
194		inspectLinkedCheckouts(ctx, &out, options)
195
196		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
197		assignSessions(&out, sessions)
198		for _, checkout := range out.Checkouts {
199			if checkout.LastActivity.After(out.LastActivity) {
200				out.LastActivity = checkout.LastActivity
201			}
202			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
203				if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
204					out.LastActivity = t.Updated
205				}
206			}
207		}
208		for _, t := range out.OtherTasks {
209			if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
210				out.LastActivity = t.Updated
211			}
212		}
213		return out
214	}

216	func inspectLinkedCheckouts(ctx context.Context, out *RepoContext, options RepoContextOptions) {
217		if out == nil || len(out.Checkouts) < 2 {
218			return
219		}
220		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, 8)
221		var wait sync.WaitGroup
222		for index := 1; index < len(out.Checkouts); index++ {
223			checkout := &out.Checkouts[index]
224			if !checkout.Exists || checkout.PathErr != nil || checkout.Worktree.Prunable {
225				continue
226			}
227			wait.Add(1)
228			go func(checkout *RepoCheckout) {
229				defer wait.Done()
230				semaphore <- struct{}{}
231				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
232				checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path)
233				if options.IncludeActivity {
234					checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, checkout.Worktree.Path, checkout.Status)
235				}
236			}(checkout)
237		}
238		wait.Wait()
239	}

284	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
285		latest := status.LatestChange
286		var commit time.Time
287		var subject string
288		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
289			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)

291				latest = commit
292			}
293			subject = lastSubject
294		}
295		return latest, commit, subject

328	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
329	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
330	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
331	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
332		for _, session := range sessions {
333			assigned := map[int]bool{}
334			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
335				best, bestLen := -1, -1
336				for i := range out.Checkouts {
337					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Repo, i, out.Checkouts[i]) {
338						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
339							best, bestLen = i, len(filepath.Clean(root))
340						}
341					}
342				}
343				if best >= 0 {
344					assigned[best] = true
345				}
346			}
347			for i := range assigned {
348				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)

353	func checkoutRoots(r repo.Repo, index int, checkout RepoCheckout) []string {

356			roots = append(roots, r.RealPath)

361	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
362		if root == "" || path == "" {
363			return false
364		}
365		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
366		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
367			return false
368		}
369		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
370	}
371
372	func samePath(a, b string) bool {
373		return a != "" && b != "" && normalizePath(a) == normalizePath(b)
374	}
375
376	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
377	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
378	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
379	// is not sufficient.
380	func normalizePath(path string) string {
381		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
382		cur := clean
383		for {
384			if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
385				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
386				if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
387					return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
388				}
389				return filepath.Clean(real)
390			}
391			parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
392			if parent == cur {
393				return clean
394			}
395			cur = parent
396		}
397	}

481		}
482		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
483			if c.RuntimeErr != nil {
484				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: unavailable (%s)\n", c.RuntimeErr)
485			} else {
486				b.WriteString("- Runtime: closed\n")
487			}
488		} else {
489			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
490				status := session.AgentStatus
491				if status == "" {
492					status = "unknown"
493				}
494				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: `%s %s` (%s)\n", c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
495				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
496					fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Agent sessions: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
497				}
498			}
499		}
500		if len(checkout.Tasks) == 0 {
501			if c.TaskErr != nil {
502				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: unavailable (%s)\n", c.TaskErr)
503			} else {
504				b.WriteString("- Task: untracked\n")
505			}
506		} else {
507			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
508				writeTaskMarkdown(b, t)
509			}
510		}
511	}
512
513	func writeTaskMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, t *task.Task) {
514		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: `%s` — %s", t.ID, t.State)
515		if t.Next != "" {
516			fmt.Fprintf(b, "; next: %s", t.Next)
517		}
518		b.WriteString("\n")
519		if t.AgentSession != "" {
520			fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Recorded agent: `%s`\n", t.AgentSession)
521		}
522	}
523
524	func displayBranch(checkout RepoCheckout) string {
525		if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
526			return branch
527		}
528		if checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached {
529			return "(detached HEAD)"
530		}
531		return "(unknown branch)"
532	}
533
534	func markdownCodes(values []string) string {
535		quoted := make([]string, 0, len(values))
536		for _, value := range values {
537			quoted = append(quoted, "`"+value+"`")
538		}
539		return strings.Join(quoted, ", ")
540	}
541
542	// FormatSessions renders the ys payload. checkoutIndex < 0 selects the whole
543	// repository; otherwise it selects one checkout.
544	func FormatSessions(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
545		indices := make([]int, 0, len(c.Checkouts))
546		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
547			indices = append(indices, checkoutIndex)
548		} else {
549			for i := range c.Checkouts {
550				indices = append(indices, i)
551			}
552		}
553		var b strings.Builder
554		for _, i := range indices {
555			checkout := c.Checkouts[i]
556			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
557				status := session.AgentStatus
558				if status == "" {
559					status = "unknown"
560				}
561				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s %s` (%s)\n",
562					checkout.Worktree.Path, c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
563				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
564					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - agents: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
565				}
566			}
567		}
568		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
569	}
570
571	// LinkedWorktreePaths returns the yw payload: absolute linked-worktree paths,
572	// one per line. The canonical checkout is intentionally excluded because WT
573	// counts linked worktrees only.
574	func LinkedWorktreePaths(c RepoContext) string {
575		paths := make([]string, 0, len(c.Linked()))
576		for _, checkout := range c.Linked() {
577			paths = append(paths, checkout.Worktree.Path)
578		}
579		return strings.Join(paths, "\n")
580	}

83	// collectLocalRepoContext is the single CLI collector used by repo context and
84	// status. It executes only local Git/task/runtime probes; includeTopology adds
85	// repository-wide remote/ref facts but never performs fetch or other network I/O.
86	func collectLocalRepoContext(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, selectedPath string, includeTopology bool) localRepoContext {
87		var (
88			tasks    = []*task.Task{}
89			tasksErr error
90		)
91		if app.Tasks == nil {
92			tasksErr = errors.New("task store is unavailable")
93		} else {
94			listed, diagnostics, err := app.Tasks.ListWithDiagnostics()
95			if err != nil {
96				tasksErr = err
97			} else {
98				tasks = tasksForRepo(listed, repository)
99				for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
100					tasksErr = errors.Join(tasksErr, diagnostic)
101				}
102			}
103		}
104
105		rt := app.Runtime()
106		sessions, runtimeErr := rt.List(ctx)
107		local := localRepoContext{
108			Context: inventory.CollectRepoContextWithOptions(ctx, repository, tasks, sessions, rt.Name(), inventory.RepoContextOptions{
109				IncludeActivity: includeTopology,
110			}),
111			Runtimes: []repocontext.RuntimeInput{{
112				Backend: rt.Name(), Available: rt.Available(), Sessions: sessions, Err: runtimeErr,
113			}},
114			SelectedCheckout: -1,
115		}
116		local.Context.TaskErr = tasksErr
117		local.Context.RuntimeErr = runtimeErr
118		if selected, ok := local.Context.CheckoutIndexForPath(selectedPath); ok {
119			local.SelectedCheckout = selected
120		} else {
121			local.SelectionErr = fmt.Errorf("selected path %s is not represented by the repository worktree inventory", config.Contract(selectedPath))
122		}
123		if includeTopology && repository.HasGit {
124			local.Topology, local.TopologyErr = gitx.RecoveryTopologyOf(ctx, repository.Path)
125		}
126		return local
127	}

129	func resolveRepoContextTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (repo.Repo, string, error) {
130		if len(args) == 1 {
131			resolved, _, err := resolveRepoRef(app, args[0])
132			if err != nil {
133				return repo.Repo{}, "", err
134			}
135			if !resolved.HasGit {
136				return resolved, resolved.Path, nil
137			}
138			discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, resolved.Path)
139			if err != nil {
140				return repo.Repo{}, "", err
141			}
142			selectedPath := discovered.Root
143			if selectedPath == "" {
144				selectedPath = discovered.MainRoot
145			}
146			mainPath := discovered.MainRoot
147			if mainPath == "" {
148				mainPath = selectedPath
149			}
150			name := resolved.Name
151			if name == "" {
152				name = discovered.Name
153			}
154			return repo.Repo{
155				Name: name, Path: mainPath, RealPath: mainPath,
156				GitDir: discovered.GitCommonDir, CommonDir: discovered.GitCommonDir,
157				MainRoot: mainPath, HasGit: true, Bare: discovered.Bare,
158			}, selectedPath, nil
159		}
160		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
161		if err != nil {
162			return repo.Repo{}, "", err
163		}
164		discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
165		if err != nil {
166			return repo.Repo{}, "", fmt.Errorf("%s is not a git repository — pass a repo", config.Contract(cwd))
167		}
168		selectedPath := discovered.Root
169		if selectedPath == "" {
170			selectedPath = discovered.MainRoot
171		}
172		return repo.Repo{
173			Name: discovered.Name, Path: discovered.MainRoot, RealPath: discovered.MainRoot,
174			GitDir: discovered.GitCommonDir, CommonDir: discovered.GitCommonDir,
175			MainRoot: discovered.MainRoot, HasGit: true, Bare: discovered.Bare,
176		}, selectedPath, nil
177	}

179	func collectRepoContextForge(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool, now time.Time) repocontext.ForgeInput {
180		cacheInput := func(cache forge.Cache, collectionErr error) repocontext.ForgeInput {
181			freshness := assessment.FreshnessFresh
182			if forgeCacheStale(cache, app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, now) {
183				freshness = assessment.FreshnessStale
184			}
185			completeness := assessment.CompletenessComplete
186			if !cache.Complete || collectionErr != nil {
187				completeness = assessment.CompletenessPartial
188			}
189			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
190				Authority: assessment.AuthorityCache, Freshness: freshness,
191				Completeness: completeness, ObservedAt: cache.FetchedAt,
192				Records: append([]forge.RemoteRepo{}, cache.Repos...),
193				Err:     errors.Join(collectionErr, forgeCacheErrors(cache)),
194			}
195		}
196
197		if !refresh {
198			cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
199			if !ok {
200				return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: errors.New("no cached forge inventory; rerun with --refresh to collect one")}
201			}
202			return cacheInput(cache, nil)
203		}
204
205		rows, collectionErr := collectRemotes(ctx, app)
206		records := make([]forge.RemoteRepo, 0, len(rows))
207		for _, row := range rows {
208			records = append(records, row.Repo)
209		}
210		if collectionErr == nil {
211			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
212				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
213				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessComplete, ObservedAt: now,
214				Records: records,
215			}
216		}
217		if cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok {
218			cached := cacheInput(cache, collectionErr)
219			if len(records) > 0 {
220				cached.Records = records
221			}
222			return cached
223		}
224		if len(records) > 0 {
225			return repocontext.ForgeInput{
226				Authority: assessment.AuthorityRemoteLive, Freshness: assessment.FreshnessFresh,
227				Completeness: assessment.CompletenessPartial, ObservedAt: now,
228				Records: records, Err: collectionErr,
229			}
230		}
231		return repocontext.ForgeInput{Err: collectionErr}
232	}
233
234	func forgeCacheStale(cache forge.Cache, ttl time.Duration, now time.Time) bool {
235		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
236			return true
237		}
238		if ttl <= 0 {
239			return false
240		}
241		return now.Sub(cache.FetchedAt) > ttl
242	}
243
244	func forgeCacheErrors(cache forge.Cache) error {
245		var providerErrors []error
246		kinds := make([]string, 0, len(cache.Providers))
247		byKind := map[string]forge.ProviderStatus{}
248		for kind, status := range cache.Providers {
249			name := string(kind)
250			kinds = append(kinds, name)
251			byKind[name] = status
252		}
253		sort.Strings(kinds)
254		for _, kind := range kinds {
255			status := byKind[kind]
256			if status.Error != "" {
257				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", kind, status.Error))
258			} else if !status.Complete {
259				providerErrors = append(providerErrors, fmt.Errorf("%s: provider inventory is incomplete", kind))
260			}
261		}
262		return errors.Join(providerErrors...)
263	}
264
265	func collectRepoContextFleet(ctx context.Context, app *App, refresh bool) repocontext.FleetInput {
266		cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
267		if err != nil {
268			return repocontext.FleetInput{Err: err}
269		}
270		input := repocontext.FleetInput{
271			Configured: true, CacheTTL: cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration,
272			ConfiguredHostNames: make([]string, len(cfg.Hosts)),
273			Results:             make([]fleet.HostResult, len(cfg.Hosts)),
274		}
275		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
276			input.ConfiguredHostNames[index] = host.Name
277		}
278		if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
279			return input
280		}
281		parallel := cfg.Defaults.MaxParallel
282		if parallel <= 0 {
283			parallel = 1
284		}
285		semaphore := make(chan struct{}, parallel)
286		var wait sync.WaitGroup
287		for index, host := range cfg.Hosts {
288			wait.Add(1)
289			go func() {
290				defer wait.Done()
291				semaphore <- struct{}{}
292				defer func() { <-semaphore }()
293				input.Results[index] = collectFleetHost(ctx, host, !refresh)
294			}()
295		}
296		wait.Wait()
297		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
298			input.Err = err
299		}
300		return input
301	}

49	func tasksForRepo(tasks []*task.Task, r repo.Repo) []*task.Task {
50		var out []*task.Task
51		for _, t := range tasks {
52			if sameCleanPath(t.RepoPath, r.Path) || sameCleanPath(t.RepoPath, r.RealPath) {
53				out = append(out, t)
54			}
55		}
56		return out
57	}
58
59	func sameCleanPath(a, b string) bool {
60		if a == "" || b == "" {
61			return false
62		}
63		left, right := filepath.Clean(a), filepath.Clean(b)
64		if left == right {
65			return true
66		}
67		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(left); err == nil {
68			left = filepath.Clean(resolved)
69		}
70		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(right); err == nil {
71			right = filepath.Clean(resolved)
72		}
73		return left == right
74	}
75

3	// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction

16	// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir. The lock file
17	// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
18	// directory being protected. label names the caller in wrapped errors.
19	func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
20		if operation == nil {
21			return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
22		}
23		if ctx == nil {
24			ctx = context.Background()
25		}
26		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
27			return fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
28		}
29		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
30		if err != nil {
31			return fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
32		}
33		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
34		if err != nil {
35			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
36		}
37		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
38		lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
39		if err != nil {
40			return fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
41		}
42		defer func() {
43			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
44				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", label, releaseErr))
45			}
46		}()
47		return operation()
48	}
49

146	// Select resolves a configured backend name to a Runtime.
147	//
148	// "auto" prefers the richest backend that is actually available: herdr (which
149	// models workspaces, worktrees and agent sessions), then tmux, then zellij,
150	// then None.
151	// None is always available so dev never hard-fails for lack of a multiplexer.
152	func Select(backend string) Runtime {
153		herdr, tmux, zellij, none := NewHerdr(), NewTmux(), NewZellij(), None{}
154		switch backend {
155		case "herdr":
156			return herdr
157		case "tmux":
158			return tmux
159		case "zellij":
160			return zellij
161		case "none":
162			return none
163		case "", "auto":
164			if herdr.Available() {
165				return herdr
166			}
167			if tmux.Available() {
168				return tmux
169			}
170			if zellij.Available() {

172			}
173			return none
174		}

176	}

193		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {

2	// change streams exist, what state each is in, which machine owns it, and what
3	// the next action is. Everything else — branch, dirty, ahead/behind, whether a
4	// worktree exists — is derived live and deliberately not stored here.

16	// State is where a change stream sits in its lifecycle.
17	type State string
18
19	const (
20		// Hot: worktree and branch exist, a runtime session is open, actively worked on.
21		Hot State = "hot"
22		// Warm: worktree and branch kept, runtime closed. Back within days.
23		Warm State = "warm"
24		// Cold: committed and pushed, worktree removed. Reconstructible anywhere.
25		Cold State = "cold"
26		// Done: merged. Kept only until the entry is reaped.
27		Done State = "done"
28	)
29
30	// States lists the lifecycle in order, for help text and validation.
31	var States = []State{Hot, Warm, Cold, Done}
32
33	// ParseState validates a user-supplied state name.
34	func ParseState(s string) (State, error) {
35		got := State(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s)))
36		for _, valid := range States {
37			if got == valid {
38				return got, nil
39			}
40		}
41		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown state %q: want one of %s", s, JoinStates(", "))
42	}
43
44	// JoinStates renders the valid state names.
45	func JoinStates(sep string) string {
46		parts := make([]string, len(States))
47		for i, s := range States {
48			parts[i] = string(s)
49		}
50		return strings.Join(parts, sep)
51	}

92		// Repo is the repository's display name.
93		Repo string `toml:"repo"`
94		// RepoPath is the main checkout, the directory git commands run in.
95		RepoPath string `toml:"repo_path"`
96		// Branch is the change stream's identity — the one durable handle that
97		// survives every machine, worktree and runtime.
98		Branch string `toml:"branch"`
99		// Base is the ref the branch was created from, recorded so `dev done` can
100		// integrate without re-guessing.
101		Base string `toml:"base"`
102		// WorktreePath is the linked checkout, empty when the task works directly
103		// in the main checkout or has gone cold.
104		WorktreePath string `toml:"worktree_path"`
105		// Mode says whether this task uses a worktree, a branch in the canonical
106		// checkout, or the current branch directly. Older entries infer it.
107		Mode CheckoutMode `toml:"mode"`
108
109		State State `toml:"state"`
110		// Owner is the hostname that last held this task hot. One writer per
111		// branch at a time avoids two machines diverging the same history.
112		Owner string `toml:"owner"`
113		// Next is the single most valuable field in the file: what to do when you
114		// come back. Without it, parking a task still loses the thread.
115		Next string   `toml:"next"`
116		Note string   `toml:"note"`
117		Tags []string `toml:"tags"`
118
119		// AgentSession reserves a resumable agent context ("claude:<uuid>"). The
120		// production start/park/resume flow does not yet capture or attach it.
121		AgentSession string `toml:"agent_session"`
122		// RuntimeHandle is the last known runtime session id (e.g. a Herdr
123		// workspace id). RuntimeName records which backend owns that opaque handle.
124		// Both are advisory and must be revalidated against live checkout coverage.
125		RuntimeHandle string `toml:"runtime_handle"`
126		RuntimeName   string `toml:"runtime_name"`
127
128		Created time.Time `toml:"created"`
129		Updated time.Time `toml:"updated"`
130
131		// storedRevision is populated only by Store after a successful read/write.
132		// It never enters TOML or Revision and lets legacy Save callers participate
133		// in compare-and-swap without adding a persisted field older binaries erase.
134		storedRevision string
135	}
136
137	// Revision returns a deterministic fingerprint of the task identity and every
138	// field represented by its TOML record. It is deliberately computed rather
139	// than persisted: older dev binaries can continue to read and rewrite task
140	// files without erasing a revision field they do not know about.
141	func (t Task) Revision() string {
142		hash := sha256.New()
143		writeString := func(value string) {
144			var length [8]byte
145			binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(length[:], uint64(len(value)))
146			_, _ = hash.Write(length[:])
147			_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(value))
148		}
149		writeTime := func(value time.Time) {
150			writeString(value.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano))
151		}
152
153		writeString("dev-task-revision-v1")
154		writeString(t.ID)
155		writeString(t.Name)
156		writeString(t.Repo)
157		writeString(t.RepoPath)
158		writeString(t.Branch)
159		writeString(t.Base)
160		writeString(t.WorktreePath)
161		writeString(string(t.Mode))
162		writeString(string(t.State))
163		writeString(t.Owner)
164		writeString(t.Next)
165		writeString(t.Note)
166		writeString(fmt.Sprint(len(t.Tags)))
167		for _, tag := range t.Tags {
168			writeString(tag)
169		}
170		writeString(t.AgentSession)
171		writeString(t.RuntimeHandle)
172		writeString(t.RuntimeName)
173		writeTime(t.Created)
174		writeTime(t.Updated)
175
176		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
177	}
178
179	// EffectiveMode returns the explicit mode, or infers a legacy task. Before
180	// modes were recorded, a path meant worktree and no path meant a canonical
181	// branch task; direct mode is never guessed because it changes integration
182	// semantics and must be explicit.
183	func (t Task) EffectiveMode() CheckoutMode {
184		if t.Mode != "" {
185			return t.Mode
186		}
187		if t.WorktreePath != "" {
188			return ModeWorktree
189		}
190		return ModeBranch
191	}
192
193	// Title is the display name, falling back to the branch when unnamed.
194	func (t Task) Title() string {
195		if t.Name != "" {
196			return t.Name
197		}
198		return t.Branch
199	}
200
201	// OwnedBy reports whether host is this task's owner. An empty owner means
202	// unclaimed, which counts as owned by anyone.
203	func (t Task) OwnedBy(host string) bool { return t.Owner == "" || t.Owner == host }
204
205	// Validate rejects a task that could not be acted on later.
206	func (t Task) Validate() error {
207		if t.ID != "" {
208			if err := ValidateID(t.ID); err != nil {
209				return fmt.Errorf("task ID: %w", err)
210			}
211		}
212		switch {
213		case t.Repo == "":
214			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo is required", t.ID)
215		case t.Branch == "":
216			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: branch is required", t.ID)
217		case t.RepoPath == "":
218			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: repo_path is required", t.ID)
219		}
220		if _, err := ParseState(string(t.State)); err != nil {
221			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: %w", t.ID, err)
222		}
223		switch t.Mode {
224		case "", ModeWorktree, ModeBranch, ModeDirect:
225		default:
226			return fmt.Errorf("task %s: unknown mode %q", t.ID, t.Mode)
227		}
228		return nil
229	}
230

363	// an inventory-completeness gate.

365		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)

1	// Package inventory joins the three sources that describe work in progress:
2	// the task registry (human intent), git (durable code state) and the runtime
3	// (what is live right now). It is the single code path behind `dev ls`,
4	// `dev status`, `dev sweep` and the TUI, so all four can never disagree.
5	package inventory
6
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"os"
10		"sort"
11		"strings"
12		"sync"
13		"time"
14
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
17		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
18	)
19
20	// Row is one task enriched with everything derived live.
21	type Row struct {
22		Task *task.Task
23
24		// Checkout is where the task's code currently lives: its worktree if it
25		// has one, else the repo. Empty when nothing exists on disk.
26		Checkout string
27		// CheckoutExists reports whether that directory is actually present. A
28		// cold task, or one whose worktree was removed behind dev's back, is not.
29		CheckoutExists bool
30		// WorktreeMissing flags a task that records a worktree path which is no
31		// longer a registered git worktree — the drift `dev sweep` reports.
32		WorktreeMissing bool
33
34		// Status is the live git status of Checkout. Zero when there is nothing
35		// on disk to inspect.
36		Status    gitx.Status
37		StatusErr error
38
39		// LastCommit is the author time of HEAD, used to age a task.
40		LastCommit time.Time
41
42		// Session is the live runtime session hosting this checkout, if any.
43		Session *runtime.Session
44		// sessionsTracked reports whether the runtime can observe sessions at all.
45		// With the "none" backend it cannot, so "hot but nothing live" is not
46		// drift — it is the only state that backend can ever produce.
47		sessionsTracked bool
48	}
49
50	// Live reports whether a runtime session is currently hosting this task.
51	func (r Row) Live() bool { return r.Session != nil }
52
53	// StateDrift reports a task whose recorded state disagrees with reality:
54	// hot with no live session, or warm/cold with one. It is what `dev sweep`
55	// turns into suggestions — dev reports drift and never silently rewrites it.
56	func (r Row) StateDrift() string {
57		if r.sessionsTracked {
58			switch r.Task.State {
59			case task.Hot:
60				if !r.Live() {
61					return "no live session"
62				}
63			case task.Warm, task.Cold:
64				if r.Live() {
65					return "session is live"
66				}
67			}
68		}
69		if r.Task.State == task.Cold && r.CheckoutExists && r.Task.WorktreePath != "" {
70			return "worktree still on disk"
71		}
72		if r.WorktreeMissing {
73			return "worktree is gone"
74		}
75		return ""
76	}
77
78	// Age is how long since the task's last commit, falling back to when the entry
79	// was last written for a task with no commits of its own.
80	func (r Row) Age() time.Duration {
81		ref := r.LastCommit
82		if ref.IsZero() || r.Task.Updated.After(ref) {
83			ref = r.Task.Updated
84		}
85		if ref.IsZero() {
86			return 0
87		}
88		return time.Since(ref)
89	}
90
91	// Options tunes what a Collect call spends time on.
92	type Options struct {
93		// SkipRuntime avoids querying the multiplexer, for callers that only need
94		// git facts (and for tests).
95		SkipRuntime bool
96		// SkipGit avoids running git per task, for a fast listing.
97		SkipGit bool
98	}
99
100	// Collect builds the enriched inventory. Git probes run concurrently: each is
101	// a handful of process spawns, and a machine with dozens of tasks would
102	// otherwise make `dev ls` feel slow.
103	func Collect(ctx context.Context, tasks []*task.Task, rt runtime.Runtime, opts Options) []Row {
104		rows := make([]Row, len(tasks))
105
106		var sessions []runtime.Session
107		tracked := false
108		if !opts.SkipRuntime && rt != nil && rt.Name() != "none" {
109			if s, err := rt.List(ctx); err == nil {
110				sessions, tracked = s, true
111			}
112		}
113
114		var wg sync.WaitGroup
115		// Bound concurrency: git is process-heavy and an unbounded fan-out over a
116		// large inventory would thrash.
117		sem := make(chan struct{}, 8)
118
119		for i, t := range tasks {
120			rows[i].Task = t
121			rows[i].Checkout = checkoutOf(t)
122
123			if opts.SkipGit || rows[i].Checkout == "" {
124				continue
125			}
126			wg.Add(1)
127			go func(i int) {
128				defer wg.Done()
129				sem <- struct{}{}
130				defer func() { <-sem }()
131				enrich(ctx, &rows[i])
132			}(i)
133		}
134		wg.Wait()
135
136		for i := range rows {
137			rows[i].Session = matchSession(sessions, rows[i])
138			rows[i].sessionsTracked = tracked
139		}
140		return rows
141	}
142
143	func checkoutOf(t *task.Task) string {
144		if t.WorktreePath != "" {
145			return t.WorktreePath
146		}
147		return t.RepoPath
148	}
149
150	func enrich(ctx context.Context, r *Row) {
151		info, err := os.Stat(r.Checkout)
152		r.CheckoutExists = err == nil && info.IsDir()
153		if !r.CheckoutExists {
154			if r.Task.WorktreePath != "" {
155				r.WorktreeMissing = true
156			}
157			return
158		}
159		if st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Checkout); err != nil {
160			r.StatusErr = err
161		} else {
162			r.Status = st
163		}
164		if unix, _, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, r.Checkout); err == nil && unix > 0 {
165			r.LastCommit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
166		}
167		// A recorded worktree that git no longer knows about is drift worth
168		// surfacing: the directory may exist while the administrative entry is gone.
169		if r.Task.WorktreePath != "" {
170			if _, ok, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, r.Task.RepoPath, r.Task.Branch); err == nil && !ok {
171				r.WorktreeMissing = true
172			}
173		}
174	}
175
176	// matchSession picks the runtime session hosting a row's checkout. An exact
177	// directory match is preferred over a containing one, so a worktree's own
178	// session always wins over the parent repo's.
179	func matchSession(sessions []runtime.Session, r Row) *runtime.Session {
180		if r.Checkout == "" {
181			return nil
182		}
183		var contains *runtime.Session
184		for i := range sessions {
185			for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
186				if d == r.Checkout {
187					return &sessions[i]
188				}
189				if strings.HasPrefix(d, r.Checkout+"/") && contains == nil {
190					contains = &sessions[i]
191				}
192			}
193		}
194		return contains
195	}
196
197	// Filter narrows rows by state and repo. An empty filter matches everything.
198	type Filter struct {
199		States []task.State
200		Repo   string
201		// LiveOnly keeps only tasks with a runtime session.
202		LiveOnly bool
203		// DirtyOnly keeps only tasks with uncommitted work.
204		DirtyOnly bool
205	}
206
207	// Apply returns the rows matching f.
208	func (f Filter) Apply(rows []Row) []Row {
209		out := rows[:0:0]
210		for _, r := range rows {
211			if len(f.States) > 0 && !containsState(f.States, r.Task.State) {
212				continue
213			}
214			if f.Repo != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Task.Repo), strings.ToLower(f.Repo)) {
215				continue
216			}
217			if f.LiveOnly && !r.Live() {
218				continue
219			}
220			if f.DirtyOnly && !r.Status.Dirty() {
221				continue
222			}
223			out = append(out, r)
224		}
225		return out
226	}
227
228	func containsState(list []task.State, s task.State) bool {
229		for _, v := range list {
230			if v == s {
231				return true
232			}
233		}
234		return false
235	}
236
237	// Orphans reports live runtime sessions that no task claims — the "I opened
238	// this and never wrote it down" case that makes a sidebar grow without bound.
239	func Orphans(sessions []runtime.Session, rows []Row) []runtime.Session {
240		claimed := map[string]bool{}
241		for _, r := range rows {
242			if r.Session != nil {
243				claimed[r.Session.Handle] = true
244			}
245		}
246		var out []runtime.Session
247		for _, s := range sessions {
248			if !claimed[s.Handle] {
249				out = append(out, s)
250			}
251		}
252		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Label < out[j].Label })
253		return out
254	}

345	func (m Model) repoColumns() []repoColumnSpec {
346		names := m.actions.RepoColumns
347		if len(names) == 0 {
348			names = []string{"repo", "branch", "git", "size", "live", "latest", "worktrees", "tasks"}
349		}
350		defaults := map[string]repoColumnSpec{
351			"repo":      {"repo", "REPO", 28, 12},
352			"branch":    {"branch", "BRANCH", 22, 10},
353			"git":       {"git", "GIT", 16, 8},
354			"remote":    {"remote", "REMOTE", 24, 10},
355			"size":      {"size", "SIZE", 9, 6},
356			"live":      {"live", "LIVE", 15, 7},
357			"latest":    {"latest", "LATEST", 8, 6},
358			"worktrees": {"worktrees", "WT", 3, 2},
359			"tasks":     {"tasks", "TASKS", 18, 8},
360			"notes":     {"notes", "NOTES", 6, 5},
361			"category":  {"category", "CATEGORY", 14, 8},
362			"path":      {"path", "PATH", 30, 12},
363		}
364		columns := make([]repoColumnSpec, 0, len(names))
365		for _, name := range names {
366			if c, ok := defaults[name]; ok {
367				columns = append(columns, c)
368			}
369		}
370		// Shrink flexible columns to fit. Configuration controls what exists and in
371		// what order; width adapts to the current pane.
372		total := 2 + 2*(len(columns)-1)
373		for _, c := range columns {
374			total += c.width
375		}
376		for _, preferred := range []string{"path", "remote", "tasks", "repo", "branch", "live", "git", "size"} {
377			for i := range columns {
378				if columns[i].name != preferred {
379					continue
380				}
381				// Exhaust the least-important flexible column before touching
382				// the next. Round-robin shrinking made LIVE unreadable while REPO
383				// and TASKS still had plenty of space.
384				for total > m.width && columns[i].width > columns[i].min {
385					columns[i].width--
386					total--
387				}
388			}
389			if total <= m.width {
390				break
391			}
392		}
393		return columns
394	}

from pathlib import Path
paths = [
    Path('.specstory/history/2026-08-31_04-24-16Z-fleet-remote-feature-repo.md'),
    Path('.specstory/history/2026-08-31_16-16-17Z-image-hash-1-image.md'),

            body, ending = line[:-2], b'\r\n'
        elif line.endswith(b'\n') or line.endswith(b'\r'):
            body, ending = line[:-1], line[-1:]
        else:
            body, ending = line, b''
        body = body.rstrip(b' \t')
        prefix_len = len(body) - len(body.lstrip(b' \t'))
        prefix = body[:prefix_len]
        if b'\t' in prefix:
            prefix = prefix.expandtabs(4)
            body = prefix + body[prefix_len:]
        cleaned.append(body + ending)
    result = b''.join(cleaned)
    if result != data:
        path.write_bytes(result)

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, tempfile
paths = [
    Path('.specstory/history/2026-08-31_04-24-16Z-fleet-remote-feature-repo.md'),
    Path('.specstory/history/2026-08-31_16-16-17Z-image-hash-1-image.md'),
]
for path in paths:
    data = path.read_bytes()
    lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)
    cleaned = []
    for line in lines:
        if line.endswith(b'\r\n'):
            body, ending = line[:-2], b'\r\n'
        elif line.endswith(b'\n') or line.endswith(b'\r'):
            body, ending = line[:-1], line[-1:]
        else:
            body, ending = line, b''
        body = body.rstrip(b' \t')
        prefix_len = len(body) - len(body.lstrip(b' \t'))
        prefix = body[:prefix_len]
        if b'\t' in prefix:
            body = prefix.expandtabs(4) + body[prefix_len:]
        cleaned.append(body + ending)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile() as tmp:
        tmp.write(b''.join(cleaned))
        tmp.flush()
        oid = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'hash-object', '-w', tmp.name], text=True).strip()
    subprocess.run(['git', 'update-index', '--add', '--cacheinfo', f'100644,{oid},{path.as_posix()}'], check=True)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, tempfile
paths = [
    Path('.specstory/history/2026-08-31_04-24-16Z-fleet-remote-feature-repo.md'),
    Path('.specstory/history/2026-08-31_16-16-17Z-image-hash-1-image.md'),
]
for path in paths:
    data = path.read_bytes()
    cleaned = []
    for line in data.splitlines(keepends=True):
        if line.endswith(b'\r\n'):
            body, ending = line[:-2], b'\r\n'
        elif line.endswith(b'\n') or line.endswith(b'\r'):
            body, ending = line[:-1], line[-1:]
        else:
            body, ending = line, b''
        body = body.rstrip(b' \t')
        prefix_len = len(body) - len(body.lstrip(b' \t'))
        prefix = body[:prefix_len]
        if b'\t' in prefix:
            body = prefix.expandtabs(4) + body[prefix_len:]
        cleaned.append(body + ending)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile() as tmp:
        tmp.write(b''.join(cleaned))
        tmp.flush()
        oid = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'hash-object', '-w', tmp.name], text=True).strip()
    subprocess.run(['git', 'update-index', '--add', '--cacheinfo', f'100644,{oid},{path.as_posix()}'], check=True)
